text.body: <0.1> śrīdurgādevyai namaḥ śrīmaddevībhāgavatamāhātmyam sṛṣṭī yā sargarūpā jagadavanavidhau pālinī yā ca raudrī saṃhāre cāpi yasyā jagadidamakhilaṃ krīḍanaṃ yā'parākhyā | paśyantī madhyamā'tho tadanu bhagavatī vaikharīvarṇarūpā sā'smadvācaṃ prasannā vidhiharigiriśārādhitā'laṅkarotu || 1 || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam | devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 2 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ| sūta jīva samā bahvīryastvaṃ śrāvayasīha naḥ | kathā manoharāḥ puṇyā vyāsaśiṣya mahāmate || 3 || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ viṣṇoścaritamadbhutam | avatāra kathopetamasmābhirbhaktitaḥ śrutam ||4|| śivasya caritaṃ divyaṃ bhasmarudrākṣayostathā | setihāsaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ tava mukhāmbujāt ||5|| adhunā śrotumicchāmaḥ pāvanātpāvanaṃ param | bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāmanāyāsena sarvaśaḥ || 6 || tattvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga yena siddhyanti mānavāḥ | kalāvapi varaṃ tvatto na vidyaḥ saṃśayacchidam || 7 | sūta uvāca| sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahābhāgā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | sarvaśāstrasya yatsāraṃ to vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ ||8|| tāvadgarjanti tīrthāni purāṇāni vratāni ca | yāvanna śrūyate samyagdevībhāgavataṃ naraiḥ || 9 || tāvatpāpāṭavī nṝṇāṃ kleśadā'dabhrakaṇṭakā | yāvanna paraśuḥ prāpto devībhāgavatābhidhaḥ || 10 || tāvatkleśāvahaṃ nṝṇāmupasargamahātamaḥ | yāvannaivodayaṃ prāpto devībhāgavatoṣṇaguḥ ||11|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ| sūta sūta mahābhāga vada no vadatāṃvara | kīdṛśaṃ tatpurāyaṇaṃ hi vidhistacchravaṇe ca kaḥ || 12 || katibhirvāsarairetacchrotavyaṃ kiṃ ca pūjanam | kairmānavaiḥ śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ kānkānkāmānavāpnuyuḥ || 13|| sūta uvāca| viṣṇoraṃśo munirjātaḥ satyavatyāṃ parāśarāt | vibhajya vedāṃścaturaḥ śiṣyānadhyāpayatpurā || 14 || vrātyānāṃ dvijabandhūnāṃ vedeṣvanadhikāriṇām | strīṇāṃ durmedhasāṃ nṝṇāṃ dharmajñānaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 15 || vicāryaitattu manasā bhagavānbādarāyaṇaḥ | purāṇaṃ saṃhitāṃ dadhyau teṣāṃ dharmavidhitsayā || 16 || aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni sa kṛtvā bhagavānmuniḥ | māmevādhyāpayāmāsa bhāratākhyānameva ca || 17 || devībhāgavataṃ tatra purāṇaṃ bhogamokṣadam | svayaṃ tu śrāvayāmāsa janamejayabhūpatim ||18|| pūrvaṃ yasya pitā rājā parīkṣittakṣakāhinā | saṃdaṣṭastasya saṃśuddhyai rājñā bhāgavataṃ śrutam || 19 || navabhirdivasaiḥ śrīmadvedavyāsamukhāmbujāt | trailokyamātaraṃ devīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || 20 | navāha yajñe sampūrṇe parīkṣidapi bhūpatiḥ | divyarūpadharo devyāḥ sālokyaṃ tatkṣaṇādagāt ||21|| piturdivyāṃ gati rājā vilokya janamejayaḥ | vyāsaṃ muniṃ samabhyarcya parāṃ mudamavāpa ha || 22|| aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ madhye sarvottamaṃ param | devībhāgavataṃ nāma dharmakāmārthamokṣadam ||23|| ye śṛṇvanti sadā bhaktyā devyā bhāgavatīṃ kathām | teṣāṃ siddhirna dūrasthā tasmātsevyā sadā nṛbhiḥ || 24 || dinamarddhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā muhūrtaṃ kṣaṇameva vā | ye śṛṇvanti narā bhaktyā na teṣāṃ durgatiḥ kvacit || sarvayajñeṣu tīrtheṣu sarvadāneṣu yatphalam | sakṛtpurāṇaśravaṇāttatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || 26 || kṛtā do bahavo dharmāḥ kalau dharmastu kevalam | purāṇaśravaṇādanyo vidyate nāparo nṛṇām || 27|| | dharmācāravihīnānāṃ kalāvalpāyuṣāṃ nṛṇām | vyāso hitāya vidadhe purāṇākhyaṃ sudhārasam ||28|| sudhāṃ pibanneka eva naraḥ syādajarāmaraḥ | devyāḥ kathāmṛtaṃ kuryātkulamevājarāmaram ||29|| māsānāṃ niyamo nātra dinānāṃ niyamo'pi na | sadā sevyaṃ sadā sevyaṃ devībhāgavataṃ naraiḥ ||30|| āśvine madhumāse vā tapomāse śucau tathā | caturṣu navarātreṣu viśeṣātphaladāyakam || 31 || ato navāhayajño'yaṃ sarvasmātpuṇyakarmaṇaḥ | phalādhikapradānena proktaḥ puṇyaprado nṛṇām ||32|| ye durhṛdaḥ pāparatā vimūḍhā mitradruho vedaviniṃdakāśca | hiṃsāratā nāstikamārgasaktā navāhayajñena punaṃti te kalau || 33 || parasvadārāhaṇeti'lubdhā ye vai narāḥ kalmaṣabhārabhājaḥ | godevatā brāhmaṇabhaktihīnā navāhajñena bhavanti śuddhāḥ || 34 || tapobhirugrairvratatīrthasevanairdānairanekairniyamairmakhaiśca | hutairjapairyacca phalena labhyate navāhayajñena tadāpyate nṛṇām || 35 || tathā na gaṅgā na gayā na kāśī na naimiṣaṃ no mathurā na puṣkaram | punāti sadyo badarīvanaṃ no yathā hi devīmakha eṣa viprāḥ || 36 || ato bhāgavataṃ devyāḥ purāṇaṃ parataḥ param | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmuttamaṃ sādhanaṃ matam ||37|| āśvinasya site pakṣe kanyārāśigate ravau | mahāṣṭamyāṃ samabhyarcya haikasiṃhāsanasthitam ||38|| devīprītipadaṃ bhaktyā śrībhāgavatapustakam | dadyādviprāya yogyāya sa devyāḥ padavīṃ labhet ||39|| devī bhāgavatasyāpi ślokaṃ ślokārddhameva vā | bhaktyā yaśca paṭhennityaṃ sa devyāḥ prītibhāgbhavet || upasargabhavaṃ ghoraṃ mahāmārīsamudbhavam | utpātānakhilāṃścāpi haṃti śravaṇamātrataḥ ||41 || bālagrahakṛtaṃ yacca bhūtapretakṛtaṃ bhayam | devībhāgavatasyāsya śravaṇādyāti dūrataḥ || 42 || yastu bhāgavataṃ devyāḥ paṭhedbhaktyā śṛṇoti vā | dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca labhate naraḥ || 43 || śravaṇādvasudevo'sya prasenānveṣaṇe gatam | cirāyitaṃ priyaṃ putraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ labdhvā mumoda ha ||44|| ya etāṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrīmadbhāgavatīṃ kathām | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sa labhate bhaktyā yaśca paṭhedimām || aputro labhate putraṃ daridro dhanavānbhavet | rogī rogātpramucyeta śrutvā bhāgavatāmṛtam ||46|| vaṃdhyā vā kākavaṃdhyā vā mṛtavatsā ca yāṅganā | devībhāgavataṃ śrutvā labhetputraṃ cirāyuṣam ||47 || pūjitaṃ yadgṛhe nityaṃ śrībhāgavatapustakam | tadgṛhaṃ tīrthaṃbhūtaṃ hi vasatāṃ pāpanāśakam ||48|| aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ | yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sa siddhiṃ labhate parām ||49|| paṭhandvijo vedavidagraṇīrbhavedvāhuprajāto dharaṇīpatiḥ syāt | vaiśyaḥ paṭhanvittasamṛddhimeti śūdro'pi śṛṇvansvakṛtottamaḥ syāt || 50 || iti śrīskanda purāṇe mānasakhaṇḍe devībhāgavatamāhātmye prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1|| <0.2> atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ| vasudevo mahābhāgaḥ kathaṃ putramavāptavān | prasenaḥ kutra kṛṣṇena bhramatā'nveṣitaḥ katham ||1|| vidhinā kena kasmācca devībhāgavataṃ śrutam | vasudevena sumate vada sūta kathāmimām ||2|| sūta uvāca| satrājidbhojavaṃśīyo dvāravatyāṃ sukhaṃ vasan | sūryasyārādhane yukto bhaktaśca paramaḥ sakhā ||3|| atha kālena kiyatā prasannaḥ savitā'bhavat | svalokaṃ darśayāmāsa tadbhaktyā praṇayena ca ||4|| tasmai pratītasya bhagavānsyamaṃtakamaṇiṃ dadau | sa taṃ bibhranmaṇiṃ kaṇṭhe dvārakāmājagāma ha ||5|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ tejasā bhrāntā matvādityaṃ puraukasaḥ | kṛṣṇamūcūḥ samabhyetya sudharmāyāmavasthitam ||6|| eṣa āyāti savitā didṛkṣustvāṃ jagatpate | śrutvā kṛṣṇastu tadvācaṃ prahasyovāca saṃsadi ||7|| savitā naiṣa bho bālāḥ satrājinmaṇinā jvalan | syamantakena cāyāti bhāsvaddattena bhāsvatā || 8 || atha viprānsamāhūya svastivācanapūrvakam | prāveśayatsamabhyarcya satrājitsvagṛhe maṇim ||9|| na tatra mārī durbhikṣaṃ nopasargabhayaṃ kvacit | yatrāste sa maṇirnityamaṣṭabhāra suvarṇadaḥ || 10 || atha satrājito bhrātā praseno nāma karhicit | kaṇṭhe baddhvā maṇiṃ sadyo hayamāruhya saiṃdhavam||11|| mṛgayārthaṃ vanaṃ yātastamadrākṣīnmṛgādhipaḥ | prasenaṃ sahayaṃ hatvā siṃho jagrāha taṃ maṇim ||12|| jāmbavānṛkṣarājo'tha dṛṣṭvā maṇidharaṃ harim | hatvā ca taṃ biladvāri maṇiṃ jagrāha vīryavān || 13 || sa taṃ maṇiṃ svaputrāya krīḍanārthamadātprabhuḥ | atha cikrīḍa bālo'pi maṇiṃ saṃprāpya bhāsvaram || 14 || prasene'nāgate cātha satrājitparyatapyata | na jāne kena nihataḥ praseno maṇimicchatā || 15 || atha lokamukhodgīrṇā kiṃvadantī pure'bhavat | kṛṣṇena nihato nūnaṃ praseno maṇilipsunā || 16 | sa taṃ śuśrāva kṛṣṇopi duryaśo liptamātmani | mārṣṭuṃ tattasya padavīṃ puraukobhiḥ sahāgamat || 17|| gatvā sa vipine'paśyatprasenaṃ hariṇā hatam | yayau mṛgendramanviṣyannasṛgbiṃdvaṃkitādhvanā || 18|| atha kṛṣṇo hataṃ siṃhaṃ biladvāri vilokya ca | uvāca bhagavānvācaṃ kṛpayā puravāsinaḥ || 19|| tiṣṭhadhvaṃ yūyamatraiva yāvadāgamanaṃ mama | praviśāmi bilaṃ tvetanmaṇihārakalabdhaye ||20|| tathetyuktvā tu te tasthustatraiva dvārakaukasaḥ | jagāmāṃtarbilaṃ kṛṣṇo yatra jāmbavato gṛham ||21|| ṛkṣarājasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇo maṇidharaṃ tadā | hartumaicchanmaṇiṃ tāvaddhātrī cukrośa bhītavat ||22|| śrutvā dhātrīravaṃ sadyaḥ samāgatyarthakṣarāṭ tadā | yuyudhe svāminā sākamaviśrāmamaharniśam ||23|| evaṃ trinavarātraṃ tu mahadyuddhamabhūttayoḥ | kṛṣṇāgamapratīkṣāste tasthurdvāri puraukasaḥ ||24|| dvādaśāhaṃ tato bhītyā pratijagmurnijālayam | tatra te kathayāmāsurvṛttāṃtaṃ sarvamāditaḥ ||25| satrājitaṃ śapaṃtaste sarve śokākulā bhṛśam | vāsudevo mahābhāgaḥ śrutvā putrasya tāṃ kathām ||26| mumoha saparīvārastadā paramayā śucā | cintayāmāsa bahudhā kathaṃ śreyo bhavenmama ||27| athājagāma bhagavāndevarṣirbrahmalokataḥ | utthāya taṃ praṇamyāsau vasudevo'bhyapūjayat ||28| nārado'nāmayaṃ pṛṣṭvā vāsudevaṃ mahāmatim | prapaccha ca yaduśreṣṭhaṃ kiṃ citayasi tadvada || 29|| vasudeva uvāca| putro me'tipriyaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prasenānveṣaṇāya tu | pauraiḥ sākaṃ vanaṃ gatvā nihataṃ taṃ tadaikṣata || 30 || prasenaghātakaṃ dṛṣṭvā biladvāre mṛtaṃ harim | dvāri paurānadhiṣṭhāya bilāṃtargatavānsvayam ||31| bahavo divasā yātā nāyātyadyāpi me sutaḥ | ataḥ śocāmi tad brūhi yena lapsye sutaṃ mune || 32 || nārada uvāca| putraprāptyai yaduśreṣṭha devīmārādhayāṃbikām | tasyā ārādhanenaiva sadyaḥ śreyo hyavāpsyasi ||33|| vasudeva uvāca| bhagavankā hi sā devī kiṃprabhāvā maheśvarī | kathamārādhanaṃ tasyā devarṣe kṛpayā vada ||34|| nārada uvāca| vasudeva mahābhāga śṛṇu saṃkṣepato mama | devyā māhātmyamatulaṃ ko vaktuṃ vistarātkṣamaḥ || 35 || yā sā bhagavatī nityā saccidānandarūpiṇī | parātparatarā devī yayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat ||36|| yadārādhanato brahmā sṛjatīdaṃ carācaram | yāṃ ca stutvā vinirmukto madhukaiṭabhajādbhayāt || 37|| viṣṇuryatkṛpayā viśvaṃ bibharti bhagavānidam | rudraḥ saṃharate yasyāḥ kṛpāpāṃganirīkṣaṇāt || 38|| saṃtārabaṃdhaheturyā saiva muktipradāyinī | sā vidyā paramā devī saiva sarveśvareśvarī ||39|| navarātravidhānena sampūjya jagadaṃbikām | navāhobhiḥ purāṇaṃ ca devyā bhāgavataṃ śṛṇu ||40| yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sadyaḥ putramavāpsyasi | bhuktirmuktirna dūrasthā paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇām ||41 || ityukto nāradenāsau vasudevaḥ praṇamya tam | uvāca parayā prītyā nāradaṃ munisattamam ||42|| vasudeva uvāca| bhagavaṃstava vākyena saṃsmṛtaṃ vṛttamātmanaḥ | śrūyatāṃ tacca vakṣyāmi devīmāhātmyasaṃbhavam ||43|| purā nabhogirā kaṃso devakyaṣṭamagarbhataḥ | jñātvātmamṛtyuṃ pāpo māṃ sabhāryāṃ nyaruṇadbhiyā 44 || kārāgāre'hamavasaṃ devakyā saha bhāryayā | jātaṃ jātaṃ samavadhītputraṃ kaṃso'pi pāpakṛt || 45|| ṣaṭ putrā nihatāstena tadā śokākulā bhṛśam | atapyaddevakī devī naktaṃdivamaninditā ||46 || tadā'haṃ gargamāhūya muniṃ natvā'bhipūjya ca | nivedya devakīduḥkhamavocaṃ putrakāmyayā || 47 | bhagavankaruṇāsindho yādavānāṃ gururbhavān | āyuṣmatputrasaṃprāptisādhanaṃ vada me mune || 48 || tato gargaḥ prasannātmā māmuvāca dayānidhiḥ | vasudeva mahābhāga śṛṇu tatsādhanaṃ param || 49 || yā sā bhagavatī durgā bhaktadurgatihāriṇī | tāmārādhaya kalyāṇīṃ sadyaḥ śreyo hyavāpsyasi 50 || yadārādhanataḥ sarve sarvānkāmānavāpnuyuḥ | na kiciddurlabhaṃ loke durgārcanavatāṃ nṛṇām ||51|| ityukto'haṃ mudā yuktaḥ sabhāryo munipuṅgavam | praṇamya parayā bhaktyā prāvocaṃ vihitāṃjaliḥ || 52 || vasudeva uvāca| yadyasti bhagavanprītirmayi te karuṇānidhe | tadā purā madarthe tvaṃ samārādhaya caṇḍikām ||53 || niruddhaḥ kaṃsagehe'haṃ na kiṃcitkartumutsahe | atastvameva duḥkhābdhermāmuddhara mahāmate || 54 || ityuktastu mayā prītaḥ provāca munipuṅgavaḥ | vasudeva tava prītyā kariṣyāmi hitaṃ tava || 55|| atha gargamuniḥ prītyā mayā saṃprārthito'gamat | ārirādhayiṣurdurgāṃ viṃdhyādriṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 56 || tatra gatvā jagaddhātrīṃ bhaktābhīṣṭapradāyinīm | ārādhayāmāsa munirjapapāṭhaparāyaṇaḥ ||57|| yataḥ samāpte niyame vāguvācāśarīriṇī | prasannā'haṃ mune kāryasiddhistava bhaviṣyati ||58|| bhūbhāraharaṇārthāya mayā saṃpreṣito hariḥ | vasudevasya devakyāṃ svāṃśenāvatariṣyati || 59 || kaṃsabhītyā tamādāya bālamānakaduṃdubhiḥ | prāpayiṣyati sadyastu gokule nandaveśmani || 60 | yaśodātanayāṃ nītvā svagṛhe kaṃsabhūbhuje | dāsyatyatha ca tāṃ haṃtuṃ kaṃsa ākṣepsyati kṣitau 61 || sā taddhastādvinirgatya sadyo divyavapurddharā | madaṃśabhūtā viṃdhyādrau kariṣyati jagaddhitam ||62|| iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praṇamya jagadambikām | gargo muniḥ prasannātmā mathurāmagamatpurīm ||63|| varadānaṃ mahādevyā gargācāryasukhāvaham | śrutvā sabhāryaḥ saṃprītaḥ paraṃ mudamathāgamat ||64|| tadārabhya paraṃ jāne devīmāhātmyamuttamam | adhunāpi hi devarṣe śrutaṃ tava mukhāṃbujāt || 65 || ato bhāgavataṃ devyāstvameva śrāvaya prabho | madbhāgyādeva devarṣe saṃprāpto'si dayānidhe || 66 || vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā nāradaḥ prītamānasaḥ | sudine śubhanakṣatre kathāraṃbhamathākarot ||67|| kathāvighnavighātārthaṃ dvijā jepurnavākṣaram | mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇoktaṃ peṭhurdevyāḥ stavaṃ tathā || 68 || prathamaskaṃdhamārabhya śrīnāradamukhodgatam | śuśrāva vasudevaśva bhaktyā bhāgavatāmṛtam ||69|| navame'hni kathāpūrtau pustakaṃ vācakaṃ tathā | prasannaḥ pūjayāmāsa vasudevo mahāmanāḥ || 70 || atha tatra bilasyāṃtaḥ kṛṣṇajāṃbavatormṛdhe | kṛṣṇamuṣṭiviniṣpātaślathāṅgo jāṃbavānabhūt ||71 || athāgatasmṛtiḥ so hi bhagavaṃtaṃ praṇamya ca | uvāca parayā bhaktyā svāparādhaṃ kṣamāpayan || 72 | jñāto'si raghuvaryastvaṃ yadroṣātsaritāṃ patiḥ | kṣobhaṃ jagāma laṃkāṃ ca rāvaṇaḥ sānugo hataḥ || 73 || sa evāsi bhavānkṛṣṇa maddaurātmyaṃ kṣamasva bhoḥ | brūhi yatkaraṇīyaṃ me bhṛtyo'haṃ tava sarvathā ||74 || śrutvā jāṃbavato vācamabravījjagadīśvaraḥ | maṇihetoriha prāptā vayamṛkṣapate bilam || 75 || dvijā bhāryayā sahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ devarṣirnāradaśvātha ṛkṣarājastataḥ prītyā kanyāṃ jāmbavatīṃ nijām| dadau kṛṣṇāya saṃpūjya syamaṃtakamaṇiṃ tathā || 76 || sa tāṃ patnīṃ samādāya maṇiṃ kaṃṭhe tathā dadhat | abhimaṃtryarkṣarājañca pratasthe dvārakāṃ prati || 77 || kathāsamāptidivase vasudeva udāradhīḥ | brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa dakṣiṇābhiratoṣayat || 78|| āśīrvādaṃ prayuñjānā dvijā yatsamaye hariḥ | ājagāma kṣaṇe tasminpatnyā saha maṇiṃ dadhat || 79|| bhāryayā sahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vasudevapurogamāḥ | dṛṣṭvā harṣāśrupūrṇākṣāḥ samavāpuḥ parāṃ mudam ||80|| devarṣirnāradaścātha kṛṣṇāgamanaharṣitaḥ | āmaṃtrya vasudevaṃ ca kṛṣṇo brahmasabhāṃ yayau || 81 || haricaritamidaṃ yatkīrtitaṃ duryaśoghnaṃ paṭhati vimalabhaktyā śuddhacittaḥ śṛṇoti | sa bhavati sukhapūrṇaḥ sarvadā siddhikāmo jagati ca vapuṣo'nte muktimārgaṃ labhecca || 82 || iti śrīskandapurāṇe mānasakhaṇḍe devībhāgavatamāhātmye dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <0.3> sūta uvāca| athetihāsamanyacca śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ | devībhāgavatasyāsya māhātmyaṃ yatra gīyate || 1|| ekadā kuṃbhayonistu lopāmudrāpatirmuniḥ | gatvā kumāramabhyarcya papraccha vividhāḥ kathāḥ ||2|| sa tasmai bhagavānskandaḥ kathayāmāsa bhūriśaḥ | dānatīrthavratādīnāṃ māhātmyopacitāḥ kathāḥ ||3|| vārāṇasyāśca māhātmyaṃ maṇikarṇībhavaṃ tathā | gaṃgāyāścāpi tīrthānāṃ varṇitaṃ bahuvistaram ||4|| śrutvātha sa muniḥ prītaḥ kumāraṃ bhūrivarcasam | punaḥ papraccha lokānāṃ hitārthaṃ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ || 5 || agastya uvāca| bhagavaṃstārakārāte devībhāgavatasya tu | māhātmyaśravaṇe tasya vidhiṃ cāpi vada prabho ||6|| devībhāgavataṃ nāma purāṇaṃ paramottamam | trailokyajananī sākṣādgīyate yatra śāśvatī ||7|| skanda uvāca| śrībhāgavatamāhātmyaṃ ko vaktuṃ vistarātkṣamaḥ | śṛṇu saṃkṣepato brahmankathayiṣyāmi sāṃpratam ||8|| yā nityā saccidānandarūpiṇī jagadambikā | sākṣātsamāśritā yatra bhuktimuktipradāyinī ||9|| atastadvāṅmayī mūrtirdevībhāgavate mune | paṭhanācchravaṇādyasya na kiṃcidiha durlabham || 10 || āsīdvivasvataḥ putraḥ śrāddhadeva iti śrutaḥ | so'napatyo'karodiṣṭiṃ vasiṣṭhānumato nṛpaḥ || 11 || hotāraṃ prārthayāmāsa śraddhā'tha dayitā manoḥ | kanyā bhavatu me brahmaṃstathopāyo vidhīyatām || 12|| manasā cintayanhotā kanyāmevājuhoddhaviḥ | tatastadvyabhicāreṇa kanyelā nāma cābhavat || 13|| ||13|| atha rājā sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā provāca vimanā gurum | kathaṃ saṅkalpavaiṣamyamiha jātaṃ prabho tava || 14|| tacchrutvā sa munirdadhyau jñātvā hoturvyatikramam | īśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāta ilāyāḥ puṃstvakāmyayā || 15 || munestapaḥprabhāvācca pareśānugrahāttathā | paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāmilā puruṣatāmagāt || 16 || guruṇā kṛtasaṃskāraḥ sudyumno'tha manoḥ sutaḥ | nidhirbabhūva vidyānāṃ saritāmiva sāgaraḥ ||17|| atha kālena sudyumnastāruṇyaṃ samavāpya ca | mṛgayārthaṃ vanaṃ yāto hayamāruhya saindhavam ||18|| vanādvanāṃtaraṃ gacchanbahu babhrāma sānugaḥ | daivādadhastāddhemādreḥ sa kumāro vanaṃ yayau || 19 || kasmiṃścitsamaye yatra bhāryayā'parṇayā saha | aramaddevadevastu śaṅkaro bhagavānmudā ||20| tadā tu munayastatra śivadarśanalālasāḥ | ājagmuratha tāndṛṣṭvā girijā vrīḍitā'bhavat || 21 || ramamāṇau tu tau dṛṣṭvā giriśau saṃśitavratāḥ | nivṛttā munayo jagmurvaikuṇṭhanilayaṃ tadā ||22|| priyāyāḥ priyamanvicchañchivo'raṇyaṃ śaśāpa ha | adyārabhya viśedyo'tra pumān yoṣidbhavediti || 23 || tata ārabhya taṃ deśaṃ puruṣā varjayaṃti hi | tatra praviṣṭaḥ sudyumno babhūva pramadottamā ||24|| strībhūtānugānaśvaṃ vaḍavāṃ vīkṣya vismitaḥ | atha sā sundarī yoṣā vicacāra vane vane || 25|| ekadā sā jagāmātha budhasyāśramasannidhau | dṛṣṭvā tāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ pīnonnatapayodharām ||26|| biṃboṣṭhīṃ kundadaśanāṃ sumukhīmutpalekṣaṇām | anaṅgaśaraviddhāṃgaścakame bhagavānbudhaḥ ||27|| sāpi taṃ cakame subhrūḥ kumāraṃ somanaṃdanam | tatastasyāśrame'vātsīdramamāṇā budhena sā ||28|| atha kālena kiyatā purūravasamātmajam | sa tasyāṃ janayāmāsa mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ || 29|| atha varṣeṣu yāteṣu kadācitsā budhāśrame | smṛtvā svaṃ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ duḥkhitā nirjagāma ha ||30|| gurorathāśramaṃ gatvā vasiṣṭhasya praṇamya tam | nivedya vṛttaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau puṃstvamabhīpsatī ||31|| vasiṣṭho jñātavṛttāṃto gatvā kailāsaparvatam | saṃpūjya śaṃbhuṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 32 || vasiṣṭha uvāca| namo namaḥ śivāyāstu śaṃkarāya kapardine | girijārddhāṅgadehāya namaste caṃdramaulaye ||33|| mṛḍāya sukhadātre te namaḥ kailāsavāsine | nīlakaṇṭhāya bhaktānāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyine ||34|| śivāya śivarūpāya prapannabhayahāriṇe | namo vṛṣabhavāhāya śaraṇyāya parātmane ||35|| brahmaviṣṇvīśarūpāya sargasthitilayeṣu ca | namo devādhidevāya varadāya purāraye ||36|| yajñarūpāya yajatāṃ phaladātre namo namaḥ | gaṃgādharāya sūryenduśikhinetrāya te namaḥ || 37 || evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavānprādurāsījjagatpatiḥ | vṛṣārūḍho'mbikopetaḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhaḥ ||38|| rajatācalasaṃkāśastrinetraścaṃdraśekharaḥ| praṇataṃ parituṣṭātmā provāca munisattamam ||39|| śrībhagavānuvāca| varaṃ varaya viprarṣe yatte manasi vartate | ityuktastaṃ praṇamyelā pum̐stvamabhyarthayanmuniḥ || 40 || atha prasanno bhagavānuvāca munisattamam | māsaṃ pumānsa bhavitā māsaṃ nārī bhaviṣyati || 41 || iti prāpya varaṃ śaṃbhormaharṣirjagadambikām | varadānonmukhīṃ devīṃ praṇanāma maheśvarīm || 42 || koṭicaṃdrakalākāntiṃ susmitāṃ paripūjya ca | tuṣṭāva bhaktyā satatamilāyāḥ puṃstvakāmyayā 43 || jaya devi mahādevi bhaktānugrahakāriṇi | jaya sarvasurārādhye jayānaṃtaguṇālaye ||44|| namo namaste deveśi śaraṇāgatavatsale | jaya durge duḥkhahaṃtri duṣṭadaityaniṣūdini || 45 || bhaktigamye mahāmāye namaste jagadambike | saṃsārasāgarottārapotībhūtapadāmbuje ||46|| brahmādayo'pi vibudhāstvatpādāṃbujasevayā | viśvasargasthitilayaprabhutvaṃ samavāpnuyuḥ || 47 || prasannā bhava deveśi caturvargapradāyini | kastvāṃ stotuṃ kṣamo devi kevalaṃ praṇato'smyaham 48|| evaṃ stutā bhagavatī durgā nārāyaṇī parā | bhaktyā vasiṣṭhamuninā prasannā tatkṣaṇādabhūt ||49 || tadovāca mahādevī praṇatārtiharī munim | sudyumnabhavanaṃ gatvā kuru bhaktyā madarcanam ||50|| sudyumnaṃ śrāvaya prītyā purāṇaṃ matpriyaṃkaram | devībhāgavataṃ nāma navāhobhirdvijottama || 51|| śravaṇādeva satataṃ puṃstvamasya bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā ca tirodhānaṃ gacchataḥsma śiveśvarau || 52 || vasiṣṭhastāṃ diśaṃ natvā samāgatyāśramaṃ nijam | samāhūya ca sudyumnaṃ devyārādhanamādiśat || 53|| āśvinasya site pakṣe saṃpūjya jagadaṃbikām | navarātravidhānena śrāvayāmāsa bhūpatim ||54 || śrutvā bhaktyāpi sudyumnaḥ śrīmadbhāgavatāmṛtam | praṇamyābhyarcya ca guruṃ lebhe puṃstvaṃ niraṃtaram 55 || rājyāsane'bhiṣiktastu vasiṣṭhena maharṣiṇā | bhuvaṃ śaśāsa dharmeṇa prajāścaivānuraṃjayan || 56 || īje ca vividhairyajñaiḥ saṃpūrṇavaradakṣiṇaiḥ | putreṣu rājyaṃ saṃdiśya prāpa devyāḥ salokatām || 57 || || iti kathitamaśeṣaṃ setihāsaṃ ca viprā yadi paṭhati subhaktyā mānavo vā śṛṇoti | sa iha sakalakāmānprāpya devyāḥ prasādātparamamṛtamathānte yāti devyāḥ salokam ||58|| iti śrīskandapurāṇe mānasakhaṇḍe devībhāgavatamāhātmye tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <0.4> atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca| iti śrutvā kathāṃ divyāṃ vicitrāṃ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ | śuśrūṣuḥ punarāhedaṃ viśākhaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 1 || agastya uvāca| devasenāpate . deva vicitreyaṃ śrutā kathā | punaranyacca māhātmyaṃ vada bhāgavatasya me ||2|| skanda uvāca| mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhūta mune śṛṇu kathāmimām | yatraikadeśa mahimā proktā bhāgavatasya tu || 3 || varṇyate dharmavistāro gāyatrīmadhikṛtya ca | gāyatryā mahimā yatra tadbhāgavatamiṣyate ||4|| bhagavatyā idaṃ yasmāttasmādbhāgavataṃ viduḥ | brahmaviṣṇuśivārādhyā parā bhagavatī hi sā ||5|| ṛtavāgiti vikhyāto munirāsīnmahāmatiḥ | tasya putro'bhavatkāle gaṇḍānte pauṣṇabhāntime || 6 || sa tasya jātakarmādi kriyāścakre yathāvidhi | cūḍopanayanādīṃśca saṃskārānapi so'karot ||7| yata ārabhya jāto'sau putrastasya mahātmanaḥ | tata evātha sa muniḥ śokarogākulo'bhavat || 8|| roṣalobhaparītātmā tathā mātāpi tasya ca | bahurāgārditā nityaṃ śucā duḥkhīkṛtā bhṛśam || 9 || ṛtavāksa muniścintāmavāpa bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ | kimetatatkāraṇaṃ jātaṃ putro me'tyaṃtadurmatiḥ || 10 || kasyacinmuniputrasya balātpatnīṃ jahāra ca | mene śikṣāṃ piturnāsau na ca māturvimūḍhadhīḥ || 11 || tato viṣaṇṇacittastu ṛtavāgabravīdidam | aputratā varaṃ nṝṇāṃ na kadācitkuputratā || 12 || pitṝnkuputraḥ svaryātānniraye pātayatyapi | yāvajjīvetsadā pitroḥ kevalaṃ duḥkhadāyakaḥ || 13|| pitrorduḥkhāya dhigjanma kuputrasya ca pāpinaḥ | suhṛdāṃ nopakārāya nāpakārāya vairiṇām || 14|| dhanyāste mānavā loke suputro yadgṛhe sthitaḥ | paropakāraśīlaśca piturmātuḥ sukhāvahaḥ || 15 || kuputreṇa kulaṃ naṣṭaṃ kuputreṇa hataṃ yaśaḥ | kuputreṇeha cāmutra duḥkhaṃ nirayayātanāḥ || 16 || kuputreṇānvayo naṣṭo janma naṣṭaṃ kubhāryayā | kubhojanena divasaḥ kumitreṇa sukhaṃ kutaḥ || 17|| skanda uvāca| evaṃ duṣṭasya putrasya duṣṭairācaraṇairmuniḥ | tapyamāno'niśaṃ kāle gatvā gargamapṛcchata || 18 | ṛtavāguvāca| bhagavaṃstvāmahaṃ praṣṭumicchāmi vada tatprabho | jyotiḥjñāstrasya cācārya putradauḥśīlyakāraṇam ||19|| guruśuśrūṣayā vedā adhītā vidhivanmayā | brahmacārivrataṃ tīrtvā vivāho vidhivatkṛtaḥ ||20|| bhāryayā saha gārhasthyadharmaścānuṣṭhito'niśam | paṃcayajñavidhānaṃ ca mayā'kāri yathāvidhi || 21 || narakādbibhyatā vipra na tu kāmasukhecchayā | garbhādhānaṃ ca vidhivatputraprāptyai mayā kṛtam ||22|| putro'yaṃ mama doṣeṇa māturdoṣeṇa vā mune | jāto duḥkhāvahaḥ pitrorduḥśīlo baṃdhuśokadaḥ ||23| etanniśamya vacanaṃ gargācāryo munestadā | vicārya sarvaṃ taddhetuṃ jyotirvidvācamabravīt ||24|| garga uvāca| mune naivāparādhaste na māturna kulasya ca | revatyaṃtaṃ tu gaṇḍāntaṃ putradauḥśīlyakāraṇam ||25|| duṣṭe kāle yato janma putrasya tava bho mune | tenaiva tava duḥkhāya nānyo heturmanāgapi ||26|| tadduḥkhaśāṃtaye brahmañjagatāṃ mātaraṃ śivām | samārādhaya yatnena durgāṃ durgatināśinīm ||27|| gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā ṛtavāk krodhamūrcchitaḥ | revatīṃ tu śaśāpāsau vyomnaḥ patatu revatī ||28|| datte śāpe tu tenātha pūṣṇo bhaṃ ca papāta khāt | kumudādrau bhāsamānaṃ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ ||29|| khyāto raivatakaścābhūttatpātātkumudācalaḥ | atīva ramaṇīyaśca tataḥ prabhṛti so'pyabhūt || 30|| dattvā śāpaṃ ca revatyai gargoktavidhinā muniḥ | samārādhyāṃbikāṃ devīṃ sukhasaubhāgyabhāgabhūt ||31|| skanda uvāca| revatyṛkṣasya yattejastasmājjātā tu kanyakā | rūpeṇāpratimā loke dvitīyā śrīrivābhavat ||32|| atha tāṃ pramucaḥ kanyāṃ revatīkāṃtisaṃbhavām | dṛṣṭvā nāma cakārāsyā revatīti mudā muniḥ ||33|| ninye'tha svāśrame caināṃ poṣayāmāsa dharmataḥ | brahmarṣiḥ pramuco nāma kumudādrau sutāmiva ||34|| atha kālena ca prauḍhāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ rūpaśālinīm | sa muniścintayāmāsa ko'syā yogyo varo bhavet ||35|| bahudhā'nveṣayaṃstasyā nāsasādocitaṃ patim | tatogniśālāṃ saṃviśya munistuṣṭāva pāvakam ||36|| kanyāvaraṃ tadāśaṃsatprītastamapi havyavāṭ | dharmiṣṭho balavānvīraḥ priyavāgaparājitaḥ ||37| durdamo bhavitā bhartā mune'syāḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | iti śrutvā vaco vahneḥ prasannobhūnmunistadā ||38|| daivādākheṭakavyājāttatkṣaṇādāgato nṛpaḥ | durdamo nāma medhāvī tasyāśramapadaṃ muneḥ || 39 || putro vikramaśīlasya balavān vīryavattaraḥ | kālindījaṭhare jātaḥ priyavratakulodbhavaḥ || 40 || munerāśramamāviśya tamadṛṣvātaka mahāmunim | āmaṃtrya tāṃ priye ceti revatīṃ pṛṣṭavānnṛpaḥ || 41 || rājovāca| maharṣirbhagavānasmādāśramātvta gataḥ priye | tatpādau draṣṭumicchāmi vada kalyāṇi tattvataḥ || 42 || kanyovāca| agniśālāmupagato mahārāja mahāmuniḥ | niścakrāmāśramāttūrṇaṃ rājāpyākarṇya tadvacaḥ ||43|| tathā'gniśālādvārasthaṃ rājānaṃ durdamaṃ muniḥ | rājalakṣaṇasaṃyuktamapaśyatpraśrayānatam ||44|| praṇanāma ca taṃ rājā muniḥ śiṣyamuvāca ha | gautamānīyatāmarghyamarghyayogyo'sti bhūpatiḥ || 45 || āgataścirakālena jāmāteti viśeṣataḥ | ityuktvārghyaṃ dadau tasmai sopi jagrāha cintayan || 46 || munirāsanamāsīnaṃ gṛhītārghyaṃ ca bhūpatim | āśīrbhirabhinaṃdyātha kuśalaṃ cāpyapṛcchata ||47|| api te'nāmayaṃ rājanbale kośe suhṛtsu ca | bhṛtye'mātye pure deśe tathātmani janādhipa || 48 || bhāryā'sti te kuśalinī yataḥ sātraiva tiṣṭhati | ato na pṛcchāmyasyāste cānyāsāṃ kuśalaṃ vada || rājovāca| bhagavaṃstvatprasādena sarvatrānāmayaṃ mama | etatkutūhalaṃ brahmanmadbhāryā kāstra vidyate ||50|| ṛṣiruvāca| revatī nāma te bhāryā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi | vidyatestra kathaṃ patnī tāṃ na vetsi mahīpate || 51 || rājovāca| subhadrādyāstu yā bhāryā mama santi gṛhe vibho | jānāmi tāstu bhagavanna vai jānāmi revatīm ||52|| ṛṣiruvāca| priyeti sāṃprataṃ rājaṃstvayoktā yā mahāmate | sā vismṛtā kṣaṇādeva yā te ślāghyatamā priyā || rājovāca| tvayoktaṃ yanmṛṣā tanno tathaivāmantritā mayā | mune duṣṭo na me bhāvaḥ kopaṃ mā kartumarhasi || 54 || ṛṣiruvāca| rājannuktaṃ tvayā satyaṃ na bhāvo dūṣitastava | vahninā preritenetthaṃ bhavatā 'vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||55 || adya pṛṣṭo mayā vahniḥ ko'syā bharttā bhaviṣyati | tenoktaṃ durdamo rājā bhavitā'syāḥ patirdhruvam ||56|| tadādatsva mayā dattāmimāṃ kanyāṃ mahīpate | priyetyāmaṃtritā pūrvaṃ mā vicāraṃ kuruṣva bhoḥ || 57|| śrutvaitatso'bhavattūṣṇīṃ ciṃtayanmunibhāṣitam | vaivāhikaṃ vidhiṃ tasya muniḥ kartuṃ samudyataḥ || 58 || athodyataṃ vivāhāya dṛṣṭvā kanyā'bravīnmunim | revatyṛkṣe vivāho me tāta kartuṃ tvamarhasi || 59 || ṛṣiruvāca | vatse vivāhayogyāni satyanyarkṣāṇi bhūriśaḥ | revatyāṃ kathamudvāhaḥ pauṣṇabhaṃ na divi sthitam ||60|| kanyovāca| revatyṛkṣaṃ vinā kālo mamodvāhocito na hi | ataḥ saṃprārthayāmyetadvivāhaṃ pauṣṇabhe kuru || 61 || ṛṣiruvāca| ṛtavāṅmuninā pūrvaṃ revatībhaṃ nipātitam | bhāntare cenna te prītirvivāhaḥ syātkathaṃ tava || 62 || kanyovāca| tapaḥ kiṃ taptavāneka ṛtavāgeva kevalam | bhavatā kiṃ tapo nedṛktaptaṃ vākkāyamānasaḥ || 63|| jagatsraṣṭuṃ samarthastvaṃ vedmyahaṃ te tapobalam | revatyṛkṣaṃ divi sthāpya mamodvāhaṃ pitaḥ kuru || 64 || | ṛṣiruvāca| evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te yathaiva tvaṃ bravīṣi mām | tvatkṛte somamārge'haṃ sthāpayāmyadya pauṣṇabham 65 || skanda uvāca| evamuktvā munistūrṇaṃ pauṣṇabhaṃ svatapobalāt | yathāpūrvaṃ tathā cakre somamārge ghaṭodbhava ||66 || revatīnāmni nakṣatre vivāhavidhinā muniḥ | revatīṃ pradadau rājñe durddamāya mahātmane || 67 || kṛtvā vivāhaṃ kanyāyā munī rājānamabravīt | kiṃ te'bhilaṣitaṃ vīra vada tatpūrayāmyaham ||68|| rājovāca| manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasyāhaṃ vaṃśe jāto'smi he mune | manvantarādhipaṃ putraṃ tvatprasādācca kāmaye || 69 || muniruvāca| yadyeṣā kāmanā te'sti devyā ārādhanaṃ kuru | bhaviṣyatyeva te putro manurmanvaṃtarādhipaḥ || 70 || devībhāgavataṃ nāma purāṇaṃ yattu paṃcamam | paṃcakṛtvastu tacchrutvā lapsyase 'bhimataṃ sutam || 71 || revatyā raivato nāma paṃcamo bhavitā manuḥ | vedavicchāstratattvajño dharmavānaparājitaḥ ||72|| ityukto muninā rājā praṇamya mudito munim | bhāryayā saha medhāvī jagāma nagaraṃ nijam || 73 || pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra sa mahāmatiḥ | pālayāmāsa dharmātmā prajāḥ putrānivaurasān||74|| ekadā lomaśo nāma mahātmā munirāgataḥ | praṇipatya tamabhyarcya prāṃjaliścābravīnnṛpaḥ || 75 || rājovāca| bhagavaṃstvatprasādena śrotumicchāmi bho mune | devī bhāgavataṃ nāma purāṇaṃ putralipsayā || 76 || śrutvā vācaṃ prajābhartuḥ prītaḥ provāca lomaśaḥ | dhanyo'si rājaṃste bhaktirjātā trailokyamātari 77|| surāsuranarārādhyā yā parā jagadambikā | tasyāṃ cedbhaktirutpannā kāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati ||78 || atastvāṃ śrāvayiṣyāmi śrīmadbhāgavataṃ nṛpa | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa na kiṃcidapi durlabham ||79|| ityuktvā sudine brahmankathāraṃbhamathākarot | paṃcakṛtvaḥ sa śuśrāva vidhivadbhāryayā saha || 80 || samāptidivase rājā purāṇaṃ ca muniṃ tathā | pūjayāmāsa dharmātmā mudā paramayā yutaḥ || 81 || hutvā navārṇamaṃtreṇa bhojayitvā kumārikāḥ | vāḍavāṃśca sapatnīkāndakṣiṇābhiratoṣayat || 82 || atha kālena kiyatā bhagavatyāḥ prasādataḥ | garbhaṃ dadhāra sā rājñī lokakalyāṇakārakam ||83|| puṇye'tha samaye prāpte grahaiḥ susthānasaṃgataiḥ | sarvamaṃgalasaṃpanne revatī suṣuve sutam ||84|| śrutvā putrasya jananaṃ snātvā rājā mudānvitaḥ | sa suvarṇāṃbhasā cakre jātakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 85|| yathāvidhi ca dānāni dattvā viprānatoṣayat | kṛtopanayanaṃ rājā sāṃgānvedānapāṭhayat ||86|| sarvavidyānidhirjātau dharmiṣṭho'stravidāṃ varaḥ | dharmasya vaktā karttā ca raivato nāma vīryavān || 87 || niyuktavānatha brahmā raivataṃ mānave pade | manvantarādhipaḥ śrīmāngāṃ śaśāsa sa dharmataḥ ||88|| itthaṃ devyāḥ prabhāvo'yaṃ saṃkṣepeṇopavarṇitaḥ | purāṇasya ca māhātmyaṃ ko vaktuṃ vistarātkṣamaḥ || 89 || sūta uvāca| kuṃbhayonistu māhātmyaṃ vidhiṃ bhāgavatasya ca | śrutvā kumāraṃ cābhyarcya svāśramaṃ punarāyayau || 90 || idaṃ mayā bhāgavatasya viprā māhātmyamuktaṃ bhavatāṃ samakṣam | śṛṇoti bhaktyā paṭhatīha bhogānbhuktvā'khilānmuktimupaiti cāṃte || 91 || iti śrīskandapurāṇe mānasakhaṇḍe śrīdevībhāgavatamāhātmye caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <0.5> atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ| sūta sūta mahābhāga śrutaṃ māhātmyamuttamam | adhunā śrotumicchāmaḥ purāṇaśravaṇe vidhim ||1|| sūta uvāca| śrūyatāṃ munayaḥ sarve purāṇaśravaṇe vidhim | narāṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ yena siddhiḥ syātsārvakāmikī ||2|| ādau daivajñamāhūya muhūrtaṃ kalpayetsudhīḥ | ārabhya śucimāsaṃ tu māsaṣaṭkaṃ śubhāvaham ||3|| hastāśvimūlapuṣyarkṣe brahmamaitrenduvaiṣṇave | sattithau śubhavāre ca purāṇaśravaṇaṃ śubham ||4|| gurubhādveda4vedā4bja1śarāṃ5gā6bdhi4guṇaiḥ4kramāt | dharmāptirindirāprāptiḥ kathāsiddhiḥ paraṃ sukham || 5 || pīḍā'tha bhūpatibhayaṃ jñānaprāptiḥ kramātphalam | purāṇaśravaṇe cakraṃ śodhayecchivabhāṣitam || 6|| athavā prītaye devyā navarātracatuṣṭaye | śṛṇuyādanyamāse'pi tithivārarkṣaśodhite ||7|| saṃbhāraṃ tādṛśaṃ kāryaṃ vivāhādau ca yādṛśam | navāhyajñe cāpyasminvidheyaṃ yatnato budhaiḥ ||8|| sahāyā bahavaḥ kāryā dambhalobhavivarjitāḥ | caturāśca vadānyāśca devībhaktiparā narāḥ || 9|| preṣyā yatnena vārteyaṃ deśe deśe jane jane | āgantavyamihāvaśyaṃ kathā devyā bhaviṣyati ||10|| saurāśca gāṇapatyāśca śaivāḥ śāktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ | sarveṣāmapi sevyeyaṃ yato devāḥ saśaktayaḥ || 11 || śrīmaddevībhāgavatapīyūṣarasalolupaiḥ | āgaṃtavyaṃ viśeṣeṇa kathārthaṃ prematatparaiḥ || 12 || brāhmaṇādyāśca ye varṇāḥ striyaścāśramiṇastathā | sakāmāścāpi niṣkāmāḥ pātavyaṃ taiḥ kathāmṛtam || 13 || nāvakāśaḥ kadācitsyānnavāhaśravaṇe'pi taiḥ | āgaṃtavyaṃ yathākālaṃ yajñe puṇyā kṣaṇasthitiḥ || 14 || vinayenaiva karttavyamevamākāraṇaṃ nṛṇām | āgatānāṃ ca karttavyaṃ vāsasthānaṃ yathocitam 15 || kathāsthānaṃ prakarttavyaṃ bhūmau mārjanapūrvakam | lepanaṃ gomayenātha viśālāyāṃ manoramam ||16|| kāryastu maṇḍapo ramyo raṃbhāstaṃbhopaśobhitaḥ | vitānamupariṣṭhāttu patākādhvaja rājitaḥ || 17 || vaktuścaivāsanaṃ divyaṃ sukhāstaraṇasaṃyutam | racitavyaṃ prayatnena prāṅmukhaṃ vāpyudaṅmukham || 18 || yathocitāni kurvīta śrotṝṇāmāsanāni ca | nṛṇāṃ caivātha nārīṇāṃ kathāśravaṇahetave || 19 || vāgmī dāṃtaśca śāstrajño devyārādhanatatparaḥ | dayālunispṛho dakṣo dhīro vaktottamo mataḥ ||20|| brahmaṇyo devatābhaktaḥ kathārasaparāyaṇaḥ | udāro'lolupo namraḥ śrotā hiṃsādivarjitaḥ || 21 || pākhaṇḍanirato lubdhaḥ straiṇo dharmadhvajastathā | niṣṭhuraḥ krodhano vaktā devīyajñe na śasyate || 22 || saṃśayacchedanāyaikaḥ paṇḍitaśca tathāguṇaḥ | śrotṛbodhakṛdavyagraḥ kāryyo vaktuḥ sahāyakṛt || 23 || muhūrtaṃ divasādarvāgvaktṛśrotādibhirjanaiḥ | karttavyaṃ kṣaurakarmādi tato niyamakalpanam ||24|| aruṇodayavelāyāṃ snāyācchaucaṃ vidhāya ca | saṃdhyā tarpaṇakāryaṃ ca nityaṃ saṃkṣepataścaret || 25 | kathāśravaṇayogyatvasiddhaye gāśca dāpayet | samastavighnahartāramādau gaṇapatiṃ yajet || 26 || kalaśāṃścāpi saṃsthāpya pūjayettatra digbhavān | vaṭukaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca yoginīrmātṛkāstathā ||27|| tulasīṃ cāpi saṃpūjya grahānviṣṇuṃ ca śaṃkaram | navākṣareṇa manunā pūjayejjagadambikām ||28|| sarvopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya śrībhāgavatapustakam | śrīdevyā vāṅmayīṃ mūrtiṃ yathāvacchobhanākṣaram 29|| kathāvighnopaśāṃtyarthaṃ vṛṇuyāttaṃ ca vāḍavān | jāpyo navārṇamaṃtrastaiḥ pāṭhyaḥ saptaśatīstavaḥ 30 || pradakṣiṇanamaskārānkṛtvāṃte stutimācaret | kātyāyani mahāmāye bhavāni bhuvaneśvari ||31|| saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ māmuddhara kṛpāmaye | brahmaviṣṇuśivārādhye prasīda jagadaṃbike || 32|| manobhilaṣitaṃ devi varaṃ dehi namo'stu te | iti saṃprārthya śṛṇuyātkathāṃ niyatamānasaḥ ||33|| vaktāraṃ cāpi saṃpūjya vyāsabuddhyā tadātmavān | mālyālaṃkāravastrādyaiḥ saṃbhūṣya' prārthayecca tam ||34|| sarvaśāstretihāsajña vyāsarūpa namo'stu te | kathācaṃdrodayenāṃtastamaḥstomaṃ nirākuru || 35 tadagre tu navāhāntaṃ karttavyā niyamāstadā | viprādīnupaveśyādau saṃpūjyopaviśetsvayam ||36|| śrotavyaṃ sāvadhānena caturvargaphalāptaye | gṛhaputrakalatrāptaghanacintāmapāsya ca || 37|| sūryodayaṃ samārabhya kiṃcitsūrye'vaśeṣite | muhūrtamātraṃ viśramya madhyāhne vācayetsudhīḥ || 38 || malamūtrajayāyaiṣāṃ laghu bhojanamiṣyate | haviṣyānnaṃ varaṃ bhojyaṃ sakṛdeva kathārthinā || 39|| athavā syātphalāhārī payobhugvā ghṛtāśanaḥ | yathā syānna kathāvighnastathā kāryaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ 40 || kathāśravaṇaniṣṭhānāṃ vakṣyāmi niyamaṃ dvijāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ madhye ye bhedadarśinaḥ || 41 || devībhaktivihīnā ye pākhaṇḍā hiṃsakāḥ khalāḥ | vipradruho nāstikā ye na te yogyāḥ kathāśrave ||42|| brahmasvaharaṇe lubdhāḥ paradāradhaneṣu ca | devasvaharaṇe teṣāṃ nādhikāraḥ kathāśrave ||43|| brahmacārī ca bhūśāyī satyavaktā jitendriyaḥ | kathāsamāptau bhuṃjīta patrāvalyāṃ yatātmavān 44 || vṛṃtāṃkaṃ ca kalindaṃ ca tailaṃ ca dvidalaṃ madhu | dagdhamannaṃ paryuṣitaṃ bhāvaduṣṭaṃ tyajedvratī ||45|| āmiṣaṃ ca masūrānnamudakyā dṛṣṭameva ca | rasonaṃ mūlakaṃ hiṃguṃ palāṃḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ tathā || 46 || kūṣmāṃḍanalikāśākaṃ na bhuṃjīta kathāvratī | kāmaṃ krodhaṃ madaṃ lobhaṃ daṃbhaṃ mānaṃ ca varjayet ||47|| vipradhrukpatitavrātyaśvapākayavanāṃtyajaiḥ | udakyayā vedabāhyairna vadedyaḥ kathāvratī ||48|| vedagoguruviprāṇāṃ strīrājñāṃ mahatāṃ tathā | devānāṃ devabhaktānāṃ na niṃdāṃ śṛṇuyādapi || 49 || vinayaṃ cārjavaṃ śaucaṃ dayāṃ ca mitabhāṣaṇam | udāraṃ mānasaṃ caiva kuryādyastu kathāvratī || 50 || vaṃdhyā vā kākavaṃdhyā vā durbhagā vā mṛtārbhakā | daridraścānapatyaśca bhaktyemāṃ śṛṇuyātkathām ||51|| vaṃdhyā vā kākavaṃdhyā vā durbhagā vā mṛtārbhakā | patadgarbhāṃganā yā ca tābhiḥ śrāvyā tathā kathā 52 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca yo vāṃchati vinā śramam | bhagavatyā bhāgavataṃ śrotavyaṃ tena yatnataḥ || 53 || kathādināni caitāni nayayajñaiḥ samāni hi | teṣu dattaṃ hutaṃ japtamanantaphaladaṃ bhavet ||54|| evaṃ vrataṃ navāhaṃ tu kṛtvodyāpanamācaret | mahāṣṭamīvrataṃ yadvattathā kāryaṃ phalepsubhiḥ || 55 || niṣkāmāḥ śravaṇenaiva pūtā muktiṃ vrajanti hi | bhogamokṣapradā nṝṇāṃ yato bhagavatī parā || 56 || pustakasya ca vaktuśca pūjā kāryā tu nityaśaḥ | vaktrā dattaṃ prasādaṃ tu gṛhṇādbhaktipūrvakam ||57|| kumārīḥ pūjayennityaṃ bhojayetprārthayecca yaḥ | suvāsinīśca viprāṃśca tasya siddhirna saṃśayaḥ || 58 || gāyatryā nāmasāhasraṃ samāptāvatha vā paṭhet | viṣṇornāmasahasraṃ ca sarvadoṣopaśāntaye || 59 || yasya smṛtyā ca nāmoktyā tapoyajñakriyādiṣu | nyūnaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti tasmādviṣṇuṃ ca kīrtayet 60 || devyāḥ saptaśatīmaṃtraiḥ samāptau homamācaret | devīmāhātmyamūlena navārṇamanunā'thavā || 61 || gāyatryā tvathavā homaḥ pāyasena sasarpiṣā | yato bhāgavataṃ tvetadgāyatrīmayamīritam || 62|| vācakaṃ toṣayetsamyagvastrabhūṣādhanādibhiḥ | prasanne vācake sarvāḥ prasannā tasya devatāḥ || 63|| brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā dakṣiṇābhiśca toṣayet | pṛthivyāṃ devarūpāste tuṣṭeṣveṣvīpsitaṃ phalam ||64|| suvāsinīḥ kumārīśca devībhaktayā ca bhojayet | tābhyo'pi dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā prārthayetsiddhimātmanaḥ || 65|| dadyāddānāni cānyāni suvarṇaṃ gāḥ payasvinīḥ | hayānibhānmedinīṃ ca tasya syādakṣayaṃ phalam ||66|| devībhāgavataṃ caitallikhitaṃ śobhanākṣaram | hemasiṃhāsane sthāpyaṃ paṭṭavastreṇa veṣṭitam || 67 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā navamyāṃ ca vācakāyārcitāya ca | dadyātsa bhogānbhuktveha durlabhaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt 68 || || daridro durbalo bālastaruṇo jaraṭho'pi vā | purāṇavettā vaidyaḥ syātpūjyo mānyaśca sarvadā || 69 || santi lokasya bahavo guravo guṇajanmataḥ | sarveṣāmapi teṣāṃ ca purāṇajñaḥ paro guruḥ || 70 || paurāṇiko brāhmaṇastu vyāsāsanasamāśritaḥ | asamāpte prasaṃge tu namaskuryānna kasyacit || 71 || paurāṇikīṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ ye'pi śṛṇvaṃtyabhaktitaḥ | teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ nāsti duḥkhadāridryabhāginām ||72|| asaṃpūjya purāṇaṃ tu tāmbūlakusumādibhiḥ | ye śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ devyāste daridrā bhavaṃti hi 73 || kīrtyamānāṃ kathāṃ tyaktvā ye vrajaṃtyanyato narāḥ | bhogāntare praṇaśyaṃti teṣāṃ dārāśca sampadaḥ ||74|| ye ca tuṃgāsanārūḍhāḥ kathāṃ śṛṇvaṃti dāṃbhikāḥ | te vāyasā bhavaṃtyatra bhuktvā nirayayātanām ||75 || ` ye cāḍhyāsanasaṃsthāśca ye vīrāsanasaṃsthitāḥ | śṛṇvaṃti ca kathāṃ divyāṃ te syurarjunaśākhinaḥ 76 || kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ ye vadaṃti duruttaram | rāsabhāste bhavaṃtīha kṛkalāsāstataḥ param ||77|| niṃdaṃti ye purāṇajñānkathāṃ vā pāpahāriṇīm | te tu janmaśataṃ duṣṭāḥ śunakāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ || 78 || ye śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ vaktuḥ samānāsanasaṃsthitāḥ | gurutalpasamaṃ pāpaṃ labhaṃte narakālayāḥ ||79 || ye cāpraṇamya śṛṇvaṃti te bhavanti viṣadrumāḥ | śayānā ye'pi śṛṇvaṃti bhavaṃtyajagarāhayaḥ || 80 || ye kadācana paurāṇīṃ na śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ narāḥ | te ghoraṃ narakaṃ bhuktvā bhavanti grāmasūkarāḥ || 81 || ye kathāṃ nānumodaṃte vighnaṃ kurvanti ye śaṭhāḥ | koṭyabdaṃ nirayaṃ bhuktvā bhavaṃti grāmasūkarāḥ 82 || āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ dravyaṃ phalaṃ vastrāṇi kambalam | purāṇajñāya yacchanti te vrajanti hareḥ padam || 83 || purāṇapustakasyāpi ye paṭṭavasanaṃ navam | prayacchanti śubhaṃ sūtraṃ te narāḥ sukhabhāginaḥ || 84 || purāṇānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śravaṇādyatphalaṃ labhet | tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ devībhāgavatāllabhet || 85 || yathā saritsu pravarā gaṃgā deveṣu śaṃkaraḥ | kāvye rāmāyaṇaṃ yadvajjyotiṣmatsu yathā raviḥ ||86|| āhlādakānāṃ candraśca dhanānāṃ ca yathā yaśaḥ | kṣamāvatāṃ yathā bhūmirgāmbhīrye sāgaro yathā || 87 || maṃtrāṇāṃ caiva sāvitrī pāpanāśe harismṛtiḥ | aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ devībhāgavataṃ tathā || 88 || yena kenāpyupāyena navakṛtvaḥ śṛṇoti cet | na śakyaṃ tatphalaṃ vaktuṃ jīvanmuktaḥ sa eva ha || 89 || rājaśatrubhaye prāpte mahāmārībhaye tathā | durbhikṣe rāṣṭrabhaṃge ca tacchāṃtyai śṛṇuyādidam ||10|| bhūtapretavināśāya rājyalābhāya śatrutaḥ | putralābhāya śṛṇuyāddevībhāgavataṃ dvijāḥ || 91 || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ yastu paṭhedvā śṛṇuyādapi | ślokārddhaṃ ślokapādaṃ vā saṃyāti paramāṃ gatim || 92 || bhagavatyā svayaṃ devyā ślokārddhena prakāśitam | śiṣyapraśiṣyadvāreṇa tadeva vipulīkṛtam ||93|| na gāyatryāḥ paro dharmo na gāyatryāḥ paraṃ tapaḥ | na gāyatryāḥ samo devo na gāyatryāḥ paro manuḥ || 94 || gātāraṃ trāyate yasmādgāyatrī tena socyate | sā'tra bhāgavate devī sarahasyā pratiṣṭhitā || 95 || ato bhāgavatasyāsya devyāḥ prītikarasya ca | mahāṃtyapi purāṇāni kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ||96|| śrīmadbhāgavataṃ purāṇamamalaṃ yadbrāhmaṇānāṃ dhanaṃ dharmo dharmasutena yatra gadito nārāyaṇenāmalaḥ | gāyatryāśca rahasyamatra ca maṇidvīpaśca saṃvarṇitaḥ śrīdevyā himabhūbhṛte bhagavatī gītā ca gītā svayam ||97|| tasmānnāsya purāṇasya loke'nyatsadṛśaṃ param | ataḥ sadaiva saṃsevyaṃ devībhāgavataṃ dvijāḥ || 98 || yasyāḥ prabhāvamakhilaṃ na hi veda dhātā no vā harirna giriśo na hi cāpyanantaḥ | aṃśāṃśakā api ca te kimutānyadevāstasyai namo'stu satataṃ jagadambikāyai || 99 || yatpādapaṃkajarajaḥ samavāpya viśvaṃ brahmā sṛjatyanudinaṃ ca bibharti viṣṇuḥ | rudraśca saṃharati netarathā samarthāstasyai namo'stu satataṃ jagadambikāyai || 100 || sudhākūpārāṃtastridaśataruvāṭī vilasite maṇidvīpe cintāmaṇimayagṛhe citrarucire | virājantīmambāṃ paraśivahṛdi smeravadanāṃ naro dhyātvā bhogaṃ bhajati khalu mokṣaṃ ca labhate || 101 || brahmeśācyutaśakrādyairmaharṣibhirupāsitā| jagataḥ śreyase sā'stu maṇidvīpādhidevatā || 102|| iti śrīskandapurāṇe mānasakhaṇḍe devībhāgavatamāhātmye vaṇavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || samāptamidaṃ skāndīyaṃ śrīmaddevībhāgavatamāhātmyam | <1.1> śaunakapraśnaḥ oṃ sarvacaitanyarūpāṃ tāṃ ādyāṃ vidyāṃ ca dhīmahi | buddhiṃ yā naḥ pracodayāt || 1 || śaunaka uvāca sūta sūta mahābhāga dhanyo'si puruṣarṣabha | yadadhītāstvayā samyak purāṇasaṃhitāḥ śubhāḥ || 2 || aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni kṛṣṇena muninānagha | kathitāni sudivyāni paṭhitāni tvayānagha || 3 || pañcalakṣaṇayuktāni sarahasyāni mānada | tvayā jñātāni sarvāṇi vyāsātsatyavatīsutāt || 4 || asmākaṃ puṇyayogena prāptastvaṃ kṣetramuttamam | divyaṃ viśvasanaṃ puṇyaṃ kalidoṣavivarjitam || 5 || samājo'yaṃ munīnāṃ hi śrotukāmo'sti puṇyadām | purāṇasaṃhitāṃ sūta brūhi tvaṃ naḥ samāhitaḥ || 6 || dīrghāyurbhava sarvajña tāpatrayavivarjitaḥ | kathayādya mahābhāga purāṇaṃ brahmasammitam || 7 || śrotrendriyayutāḥ sūta narāḥ svādavicakṣaṇāḥ | na śṛṇvanti purāṇāni vañcitā vidhinā hi te || 8 || yathā jihvendriyāhlādaḥ ṣaḍrasaiḥ pratipadyate | tathā śrotrendriyāhlādo vacobhiḥ sudhiyāṃ smṛtaḥ || 9 || aśrotrāḥ phaṇinaḥ kāmaṃ muhyanti hi nabhoguṇaiḥ | sakarṇā ye na śṛṇvanti te'pyakarṇāḥ kathaṃ na ca || 10 || ataḥ sarve dvijāḥ saumya śrotukāmāḥ samāhitāḥ | vartante naimiṣāraṇye kṣetre kalibhayārditāḥ || 11 || yena kenāpyupāyena kālātivāhanaṃ smṛtam | vyasanairiha mūrkhāṇāṃ budhānāṃ śāstracintanaiḥ || 12 || śāstrāṇyapi vicitrāṇi jalpavādayutāni ca | trividhāni purāṇāni śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca | vitāṇḍācchalayuktāni garvāmarṣakarāṇi ca | nānārthavādayuktāni hetumanti bṛhanti ca || 13 || sāttvikaṃ tatra vedāntaṃ mīmāṃsā rājasaṃ matam | tāmasaṃ nyāyaśāstraṃ ca hetuvādābhiyantritam || 14 || tathaiva ca purāṇāni triguṇāni kathānakaiḥ | kathitāni tvayā saumya pañcalakṣaṇavanti ca || 15 || tatra bhāgavataṃ puṇyaṃ pañcamaṃ vedasammitam | kathitaṃ yattvayā pūrvaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam || 16 || uddeśamātreṇa tadā kīrtitaṃ paramādbhutam | muktipradaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ kāmadaṃ dharmadaṃ tathā || 17 || vistareṇa tadākhyāhi purāṇottamamādarāt | śrotukāmā dvijāḥ sarve divyaṃ bhāgavataṃ śubham || 18 || tvaṃ tu jānāsi dharmajña paurāṇīṃ saṃhitāṃ kila | kṛṣṇoktāṃ gurubhaktatvāt samyak sattvaguṇāśrayaḥ || 19 || śrutānyanyāni sarvajña tvanmukhānniḥsṛtāni ca | naiva tṛptiṃ vrajāmo'dya sudhāpāne'marā yathā || 20 || dhiksudhāṃ pibatāṃ sūta muktirnaiva kadācana | pibanbhāgavataṃ sadyo naro mucyeta saṅkaṭāt || 21 || sudhāpānanimittaṃ yat kṛtā yajñāḥ sahasraśaḥ | na śāntimadhigacchāmaḥ sūta sarvātmanā vayam || 22 || makhānāṃ hi phalaṃ svargaḥ svargātpracyavanaṃ punaḥ | evaṃ saṃsāracakre'smnin bhramaṇaṃ ca nirantaram || 23 || vinā jñānena sarvajña naiva muktiḥ kadācana | bhramatāṃ kālacakre'tra narāṇāṃ triguṇātmake || 24 || ataḥ sarvarasopetaṃ puṇyaṃ bhāgavataṃ vada | pāvanaṃ muktidaṃ guhyaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ sadā priyam || 25 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe śaunakapraśno nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || <1.2> granthasaṃkhyāviṣayavarṇanam sūta uvāca dhanyo'hamatibhāgyo'haṃ pāvito'haṃ mahātmabhiḥ | yatpṛṣṭaṃ sumahatpuṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ vedaviśrutam || 1 || tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi sarvaśrutyarthasammatam | rahasyaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāmāgamānāmanuttamam || 2 || natvā tatpadapaṅkajaṃ sulalitaṃ muktipradaṃ yogināṃ || brahmādyairapi sevitaṃ stutiparairdhyeyaṃ munīndraiḥ sadā | vakṣyāmyadya savistaraṃ bahurasaṃ śrīmatpurāṇottamaṃ || bhaktyā sarvarasālayaṃ bhagavatīnāmnā prasiddhaṃ dvijāḥ || 3 || yā vidyetyabhidhīyate śrutipathe śaktiḥ sadādyā parā || sarvajñā bhavabandhachittinipuṇā sarvāśaye saṃsthitā | durjñeyā sudurātmabhiśca munibhirdhyānāspadaṃ prāpitā || pratyakṣā bhavatīha sā bhagavatī siddhipradā syātsadā || 4 || sṛṣṭvākhilaṃ jagadidaṃ sadasatsvarūpaṃ śaktyā svayā triguṇayā paripāti viśvam | saṃhṛtya kalpasamaye ramate tathaikā tāṃ sarvaviśvajananīṃ manasā smarāmi || 5 || brahmā sṛjatyakhilametaditi prasiddhaṃ paurāṇikaiśca kathitaṃ khalu vedavidbhiḥ | viṣṇostu nābhikamale kila tasya janma tairuktameva sṛjate na hi sa svatantraḥ || 6 || viṣṇustu śeṣaśayane svapitīti kāle tannābhipadyamukule khalu tasya janma | ādhāratāṃ kila gato'tra sahasramauliḥ sambodhyatāṃ sa bhagavān hi kathaṃ murāriḥ || 7 || ekārṇavasya salilaṃ rasarūpameva pātraṃ vinā na hi rasasthitirasti kaccit | yā sarvabhūtaviṣaye kila śaktirūpā tāṃ sarvabhūtajananīṃ śaraṇaṃ gato'smi || 8 || yoganidrāmīlitākṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvāmbuje sthitaḥ | ajastuṣṭāva yāṃ devīṃ tāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 9 || tāṃ dhyātvā saguṇāṃ māyāṃ muktidāṃ nirguṇāṃ tathā | vakṣye purāṇamakhilaṃ śṛṇvantu munayastviha || 10 || purāṇamuttamaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīmadbhāgavatābhidham | aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi ślokāstatra tu saṃskṛtāḥ || 11 || skandhā dvādaśa caivātra kṛṣṇena vihitāḥ śubhāḥ | triśataṃ pūrṇamadhyāyā aṣṭādaśayutāḥ smṛtāḥ || 12 || viṃśatiḥ prathame tatra dvitīye dvādaśaiva tu | triṃśaccaiva tṛtīye tu caturthe pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 13 || pañcatriṃśattathādhyāyāḥ pañcame parikīrtitāḥ | ekatriṃśattathā ṣaṣṭhe catvāriṃśacca saptame || 14 || aṣṭame tattvasaṅkhyāśca pañcāśannavame tathā | trayodaśa tu samproktā daśame muninā kila || 15 || tathā caikādaśaskandhe caturviṃśatirīritāḥ | caturdaśaiva cādhyāyā dvādaśe munisattamāḥ || 16 || evaṃ saṅkhyā samākhyātā purāṇe'sminmahātmanā | aṣṭādaśasahasrīyā saṅkhyā ca parikīrtitā || 17 || sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca | vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam || 18 || nirguṇā yā sadā nityā vyāpikā vikṛtā śivā | yogagamyākhilādhārā turīyā yā ca saṃsthitā || 19 || tasyāstu sāttvikī śaktī rājasī tāmasī tathā | mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī mahākālīti tāḥ striyaḥ || 20 || tāsāṃ tisṝṇāṃ śaktīnāṃ dehāṅgīkāralakṣaṇaḥ | sṛṣṭyarthaṃ ca samākhyātaḥ sargaḥ śāstraviśāradaiḥ || 21 || haridruhiṇarudrāṇāṃ samutpattistataḥ smṛtā | pālanotpattināśārthaṃ pratisargaḥ smṛto hi saḥ || 22 || somasūryodbhavānāṃ ca rājñāṃ vaṃśaprakīrtanam | hiraṇyakaśipvādīnāṃ vaṃśāste parikīrtitāḥ || 23 || svāyambhuvamukhānāṃ ca manūnāṃ parivarṇanam | kālasaṅkhyā tathā teṣāṃ tattanmanvantarāṇi ca || 24 || teṣāṃ vaṃśānukathanaṃ vaṃśānucaritaṃ smṛtam | pañcalakṣaṇayuktāni bhavanti munisattamāḥ || 25 || sapādalakṣaṃ ca tathā bhārataṃ muninā kṛtam | itihāsa iti proktaṃ pañcamaṃ vedasammatam || 26 || śaunaka uvāca kāni tāni purāṇāni brūhi sūta savistaram | katisaṅkhyāni sarvajña śrotukāmā vayaṃ tviha || 27 || kalikālavibhītāḥ smo naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ | brahmaṇātra samādiṣṭāścakraṃ dattvā manomayam || 28 || kathitaṃ tena naḥ sarvāngacchantvetasya pṛṣṭhataḥ | nemiḥ saṃśīryate yatra sa deśaḥ pāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 29 || kalestatra praveśo na kadācit sambhaviṣyati | tāvattiṣṭhantu tatraiva yāvatsatyayugaṃ punaḥ || 30 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya gṛhītvā tatkathānakam | cālayannirgatastūrṇaṃ sarvadeśadidṛkṣayā || 31 || pretyātra cālayaṃścakraṃ nemiḥ śīrṇo'tra paśyataḥ | tenedaṃ naimiṣaṃ proktaṃ kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam || 32 || kalipraveśo naivātra tasmātsthānaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā | munibhiḥ siddhasaṅghaiśca kalibhītairmahātmabhiḥ || 33 || paśuhīnāḥ kṛtā yajñāḥ puroḍāśādibhiḥ kila | kālātivāhanaṃ kāryaṃ yāvatsatyayugāgamaḥ || 34 || bhāgyayogena samprāptaḥ sūta tvaṃ cātra sarvathā | kathayādya purāṇaṃ hi pāvanaṃ brahmasammatam || 35 || sūta śuśrūṣavaḥ sarve vaktā tvaṃ matimānatha | nirvyāpārā vayaṃ nūnamekacittāstathaiva ca || 36 || tvaṃ sūta bhava dīrghāyustāpatrayavivarjitaḥ | kathayādya purāṇaṃ hi puṇyaṃ bhāgavataṃ śivam || 37 || yatra dharmārthakāmānāṃ varṇanaṃ vidhipūrvakam | vidyāṃ prāpya tayā mokṣaḥ kathito muninā kila || 38 || dvaipāyanena muninā kathitaṃ yacca pāvanam | na tṛpyāmo vayaṃ sūta kathāṃ śrutvā manoramām || 39 || sakalaguṇagaṇānāmekapātraṃ pavitramakhilabhuvanamāturnāṭyavadyadvicitram | nikhilamalagaṇānāṃ nāśakṛtkāmakandaṃ prakaṭaya bhagavatyā nāmayuktaṃ purāṇam || 40 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ || prathamaskandhe granthasaṃkhyāviṣayavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <1.3> purāṇavarṇanapūrvakatattadyugīyavyāsavarṇanam sūta uvāca śṛṇvantu sampravakṣyāmi purāṇāni munīśvarāḥ | yathāśrutāni tattvena vyāsātsatyavatīsutāt || 1 || madvayaṃ bhadvayaṃ caiva bratrayaṃ vacatuṣṭayam | anāpaliṃgakūskāni purāṇāni pṛthakpṛthak || 2 || caturdaśasahasraṃ ca matsyamādyaṃ prakīrtitam | || tathā grahasahasraṃ tu mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahādbhutam || 3 || || caturdaśasahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca | || bhaviṣyaṃ parisaṃkhyātaṃ munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || 4 || aṣṭādaśasahasraṃ vai puṇyaṃ bhāgavataṃ kila | tathā cāyutasaṃkhyākaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmasaṃjñakam || 5 || dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi brahmāṇḍaṃ ca śatādhikam | tathāṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ brahmavaivartameva ca || 6 || ayutaṃ vāmanākhyaṃ ca vāyavyaṃ ṣaṭśatāni ca | caturviṃśatisaṃkhyātaḥ sahasrāṇi tu śaunaka || 7 || trayoviṃśatisāhasraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramādbhutam | caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ vārāhaṃ paramādbhutam || 8 || ṣoḍaśaiva sahasrāṇi purāṇaṃ cāgnisaṃjñitam | pañcaviṃśatisāhasraṃ nāradaṃ paramaṃ matam || 9 || pañcapañcāśatsāhasraṃ padmākhyaṃ vipulaṃ matam | ekādaśasahasrāṇi liṅgākhyaṃ cātivismṛtam || 10 || ekonaviṃśatsāhasraṃ gāruḍaṃ haribhāṣitam | saptadaśasahasraṃ ca purāṇaṃ kūrmabhāṣitam || 11 || ekāśītisahasrāṇi skandākhyaṃ paramādbhutam | purāṇākhyā ca saṃkhyā ca vistareṇa mayānaghāḥ || 12 || tathaivopapurāṇāni śṛṇvantu ṛṣisattamāḥ | sanatkumāraṃ prathamaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ tataḥ param || 13 || nāradīyaṃ śivaṃ caiva daurvāsasamanuttamam | kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva tathā cauśanasaṃ smṛtam || 14 || vāruṇaṃ kālikākhyaṃ ca sāmbaṃ nandikṛtaṃ śubham | sauraṃ pārāśaraproktamādityaṃ cātivistaram || 15 || māheśvaraṃ bhāgavataṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ ca savistaram | etānyupapurāṇāni kathitāni mahātmabhiḥ || 16 || aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni kṛtvā satyavatīsutaḥ | bhāratākhyānamatulaṃ cakre tadupabṛṃhitam || 17 || manvantareṣu sarveṣu dvāpare dvāpare yuge | prāduḥkaroti dharmārthī purāṇāni yathāvidhi || 18 || dvāpare dvāpare viṣṇurvyāsarūpeṇa sarvadā | vedamekaṃ sa bahudhā kurute hitakāmyayā || 19 || alpāyuṣo'lpabuddhīṃśca viprānjñātvā kalāvatha | purāṇasaṃhitāṃ puṇyāṃ kurute'sau yuge yuge || 20 || strīśūdradvijabandhūnāṃ na vedaśravaṇaṃ matam | teṣāmeva hitārthāya purāṇāni kṛtāni ca || 21 || manvantare saptame'tra śubhe vaivasvatābhidhe | aṣṭāviṃśatime prāpte dvāpare munisattamāḥ || 22 || vyāsaḥ satyavatīsūnurgururme dharmavittamaḥ | ekonatriṃśatsaṃprāpte drauṇirvyāso bhaviṣyati || 23 || atītāstu tathā vyāsāḥ saptaviṃśatireva ca | purāṇasaṃhitāstaistu kathitāstu yuge yuge || 24 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ brūhi sūta mahābhāga vyāsāḥ pūrvayugodbhavāḥ | vaktārastu purāṇānāṃ dvāpare dvāpare yuge || 25 || sūta uvāca dvāpare prathame vyastāḥ svayaṃ vedāḥ svayambhuvā | prajāpatirdvitīye tu dvāpare vyāsakāryakṛt || 26 || tṛtīye cośanā vyāsaścaturthe tu bṛhaspatiḥ | pañcame savitā vyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhe mṛtyustathāpare || 27 || maghavā saptame prāpte vasiṣṭhastvaṣṭame smṛtaḥ | sārasvatastu navame tridhāmā daśame tathā || 28 || ekādaśe'tha trivṛṣo bharadvājastataḥ param | trayodaśe cāntarikṣo dharmaścāpi caturdaśe || 29 || trayyāruṇiḥ pañcadaśe ṣoḍaśe tu dhanañjayaḥ | medhātithiḥ saptadaśe vratī hyaṣṭādaśe tathā || 30 || atrirekonaviṃśe'tha gautamastu tataḥ param | uttamaścaikaviṃśe'tha haryātmā parikīrtitaḥ || 31 || veno vājaśravāścaiva somo'muṣyāyaṇastathā | tṛṇabindustathā vyāso bhārgavastu tataḥ param || 32 || tataḥ śaktirjātukarṇyaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastataḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyeyaṃ kathitā yā mayā śrutā || 33 || kṛṣṇadvaipāyanātproktaṃ purāṇaṃ ca mayā śrutam | śrīmadbhāgavataṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaughanāśanam || 34 || kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva vedārthaparibṛṃhitam | sarvāgamarasārāmaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ sadā priyam || 35 || vyāsena kṛtvātiśubhaṃ purāṇaṃ śukāya putrāya mahātmane yat | vairāgyayuktāya ca pāṭhitaṃ vai vijñāya caivāraṇisambhavāya || 36 || śrutaṃ mayā tatra tathā gṛhītaṃ yathārthavadvyāsamukhānmunīndrāḥ | purāṇaguhyaṃ sakalaṃ sametaṃ guroḥ prasādātkaruṇānidheśca || 37 || sūtena pṛṣṭaḥ sakalaṃ jagāda dvaipāyanastatra purāṇaguhyam | ayonijenādbhutabuddhinā vai śrutaṃ mayā tatra mahāprabhāvam || 38 || śrīmadbhāgavatāmarāṃghripaphalāsvādādaraḥ sattamāḥ saṃsārārṇavadurvigāhyasalilaṃ santartukāmaḥ śukaḥ | nānākhyānarasālayaṃ śrutipuṭaiḥ premṇāśṛṇodadbhutaṃ tacchrutvā na vimucyate kalibhayādevaṃvidhaḥ kaḥ kṣitau || 39 || pāpīyānapi vedadharmarahitaḥ svācārahīnāśayo || vyājenāpi śṛṇoti yaḥ paramidaṃ śrīmatpurāṇottamam | bhuktyā bhogakalāpamatra vipulaṃ dehāvasāne'calaṃ yogiprāpyamavāpnuyādbhagavatīnāmāṅkitaṃ sundaram || 40 || yā nirguṇā hariharādibhirapyalabhyā vidyā satāṃ priyatamātha samādhigamyā | sā tasya cittakuhare prakaroti bhāvaṃ yaḥ saṃśṛṇoti satataṃ tu satīpurāṇam || 41 || samprāpya mānuṣabhavaṃ sakalāṅgayuktaṃ potaṃ bhavārṇavajalottaraṇāya kāmam | samprāpya vācakamaho na śṛṇoti mūḍhaḥ sa vañcito'tra vidhinā sukhadaṃ purāṇam || 42 || yaḥ prāpya karṇayugalaṃ paṭumānuṣatve rāgī śṛṇoti satataṃ ca parāpavādān | sarvārthadaṃ rasanidhiṃ vimalaṃ purāṇaṃ naṣṭaḥ kuto na śṛṇute bhuvi mandabuddhiḥ || 43 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe purāṇavarṇanapūrvakatattadyugīyavyāsavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <1.4> devīsarvottametikathanam ṛṣaya ūcuḥ saumya vyāsasya bhāryāyāṃ kasyāṃ jātaḥ sutaḥ śukaḥ | kathaṃ vā kīdṛśo yena paṭhiteyaṃ susaṃhitā || 1 || ayonijastvayā proktastathā cāraṇijaḥ śukaḥ | sandeho'sti mahāṃstatra kathayādya mahāmate || 2 || garbhayogī śrutaḥ pūrvaṃ śuko nāma mahātapāḥ | kathaṃ ca paṭhitaṃ tena purāṇaṃ bahuvistaram || 3 || sūta uvāca purā sarasvatītīre vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | āśrame kalaviṃkau tu dṛṣṭvā vismayamāgataḥ || 4 || jātamātraṃ śiśuṃ nīḍe muktamaṇḍānmanoharam | tāmrāsyaṃ śubhasarvāṅgaṃ picchāṃkuravivarjitam || 5 || tau tu bhakṣyārthamatyantaṃ ratau śramaparāyaṇau | śiśoścaṃcupuṭe bhakṣyaṃ kṣipantau ca punaḥ punaḥ || 6 || aṅgenāṅgāni bālasya gharṣayantau mudānvitau | cumbantau ca mukhaṃ premṇā kalaviṃkau śiśoḥ śubham || 7 || vīkṣya premādbhutaṃ tatra bāle caṭakayostadā | vyāsaścintāturaḥ kāmaṃ manasā samacintayat || 8 || tiraścāmapi yatprema putre samabhilakṣyate | kiṃ citraṃ yanmanuṣyāṇāṃ sevāphalamabhīpsatām || 9 || kimetau caṭakau cāsya vivāhaṃ sukhasādhanam | viracya sukhinau syātāṃ dṛṣṭvā vadhvā mukhaṃ śubham || 10 || athavā vārdhake prāpte paricaryāṃ kariṣyati | putraḥ paramadharmiṣṭhaḥ puṇyārthaṃ kalaviṃkayoḥ || 11 || arjayitvāthavā dravyaṃ pitarau tarpayiṣyati | athavā pretakāryāṇi kariṣyati yathāvidhi || 12 || athavā kiṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ gatvā saṃvitariṣyati | nīlotsargaṃ ca vidhivatprakariṣyati bālakaḥ || 13 || saṃsāre'tra samākhyātaṃ sukhānāmuttamaṃ sukham | putragātrapariṣvaṃgo lālanañca viśeṣataḥ || 14 || aputrasya gatirnāsti svargo naiva ca naiva ca | putrādanyatarannāsti paralokasya sādhanam || 15 || manvādibhiśca munibhirdharmaśāstreṣu bhāṣitam | putravānsvargamāpnoti nāputrastu kathañcana || 16 || dṛśyate'tra samakṣaṃ tannānumānena sādhyate | putravānmucyate pāpādāptavākyaṃ ca śāśvatam || 17 || āture mṛtyukāle'pi bhūmiśayyāgato naraḥ | karoti manasā cintāṃ duḥkhitaḥ putravarjitaḥ || 18 || dhanaṃ me vipulaṃ gehe pātrāṇi vividhāni ca | mandiraṃ sundaraṃ caitatko'sya svāmī bhaviṣyati || 19 || mṛtyukāle manastasya duḥkhena bhramate yataḥ | ato'sya durgatirnūnaṃ bhrāntacittasya sarvathā || 20 || evaṃ bahuvidhāṃ cintāṃ kṛtvā satyavatīsutaḥ | niḥśvasya bahudhā coṣṇaṃ vimanāḥ sambabhūva ha || 21 || vicārya manasātyarthaṃ kṛtvā manasi niścayam | jagāma ca tapastaptuṃ meruparvatasanidhau || 22 || manasā cintayāmāsa kaṃ devaṃ samupāsmahe | varapradānanipuṇaṃ vāñchitārthapradaṃ tathā || 23 || viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ surendraṃ vā brahmāṇaṃ vā divākaram | gaṇeśaṃ kārtikeyaṃ ca pāvakaṃ varuṇaṃ tathā || 24 || evaṃ cintayatastasya nārado munisattamaḥ | yadṛcchayā samāyāto vīṇāpāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ || 25 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprīto vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | kṛtvārghyamāsanaṃ dattvā papraccha kuśalaṃ munim || 26 || śrutvātha kuśalapraśnaṃ papraccha munisattamaḥ | cintāturo'si kasmāttvaṃ dvaipāyana vadasva me || 27 || vyāsa uvāca aputrasya gatirnāsti na sukhaṃ mānase yataḥ | tadarthaṃ duḥkhitaścāhaṃ cintayāmi puna punaḥ || 28 || tapasā toṣayāmyadya kaṃ devaṃ vācchitārthadam | iti cintāturo'smyadya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 29 || sarvajño'si maharṣe tvaṃ kathayāśu kṛpānidhe | kaṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi yo me putraṃ pradāsyati || 30 || sūta uvāca iti vyāsena pṛṣṭastu nārado vedavinmuniḥ | uvāca parayā prītyā kṛṣṇaṃ prati mahāmanāḥ || 31 || nārada uvāca pārāśarya mahābhāga yattvaṃ pṛcchasi māmiha | tamevārthaṃ purā pṛṣṭaḥ pitrā me madhusūdanaḥ || 32 || dhyānasthaṃ ca hariṃ dṛṣṭvā pitā me vismayaṃ gataḥ | paryapṛcchata deveśaṃ śrīnāthaṃ jagataḥ patim || 33 || kaustubhodbhāsitaṃ divyaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam | pītāmbaraṃ caturbāhuṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam || 34 || kāraṇaṃ sarvalokānāṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum | vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ tapyamānaṃ mahattapaḥ || 35 || brahmovāca devadeva jagannātha bhūtabhavyabhavatprabho | tapaścarasi kasmāttvaṃ kiṃ dhyāyasi janārdana || 36 || vismayo'yaṃ mamātyarthaṃ tvaṃ sarvajagatāṃ prabhuḥ | dhyānayukto'si deveśa kiṃ ca citramataḥ param || 37 || tvannābhikamalājjātaḥ kartāhamakhilasya ha | tvattaḥ ko'pyadhiko'styatra taṃ devaṃ brūhi māpate || 38 || jānāmyahaṃ jagannātha tvamādiḥ sarvakāraṇam | kartā pālayitā hartā samarthaḥ sarvakāryakṛt || 39 || icchayā te mahārāja sṛjāmyahamidaṃ jagat | haraḥ saṃharate kāle so'pi te vacane sadā || 40 || sūryo bhramati cākāśe vāyurvāti śubhāśubhaḥ | agnistapati parjanyo varṣatīśa tvadājñayā || 41 || tvaṃ tu dhyāyasi kaṃ devaṃ saṃśayo'yaṃ mahānmama | tvattaḥ paraṃ na paśyāmi devaṃ vai bhuvanatraye || 42 || kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vadasvādya bhakto'smi tava suvrata | mahatāṃ naiva gopyaṃ hi prāyaḥ kiñciditi smṛtiḥ || 43 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya harirāha prajāpatim | śṛṇuṣvaikamanā brahmaṃstvāṃ bravīmi manogatam || 44 || yadyapi tvāṃ śivaṃ māṃ ca sthitisṛṣṭyantakāraṇam | te jānanti janāḥ sarve sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ || 45 || sraṣṭā tvaṃ pālakaścāhaṃ haraḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ | kṛtāḥ śaktyeti saṃtarkaḥ kriyate vedapāragaiḥ || 46 || jagatsaṃjanane śaktistvayi tiṣṭhati rājasī | sāttvikī mayi rudre ca tāmasī parikīrtitā || 47 || tayā virahitastvaṃ na tatkarmakaraṇe prabhuḥ | nāhaṃ pālayituṃ śaktaḥ saṃhartuṃ nāpi śaṅkaraḥ || 48 || tadadhīnā vayaṃ sarve vartāmaḥ satataṃ vibho | pratyakṣe ca parokṣe ca dṛṣṭāntaṃ śṛṇu suvrata || 49 || śeṣe svapimi paryaṅke paratantro na saṃśayaḥ | tadadhīnaḥ sadottiṣṭhe kāle kālavaśaṃ gataḥ || 50 || tapaścarāmi satataṃ tadadhīno'smyahaṃ sadā | kadācitsaha lakṣyā ca viharāmi yathāsukham || 51 || kadāciddānavaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ prakaromyaham | dāruṇaṃ dehadamanaṃ sarvalokabhayaṅkaram || 52 || pratyakṣaṃ tava dharmajña tasminnekārṇave purā | pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi bāhuyuddhaṃ mayā kṛtam || 53 || tau karṇamalajau duṣṭau dānavau madagarvitau | deva devyāḥ prasādena nihatau madhukaiṭabhau || 54 || tadā tvayā na kiṃ jñātaṃ kāraṇaṃ tu parātparam | śaktirūpaṃ mahābhāga kiṃ pṛcchasi punaḥ punaḥ || 55 || yadicchaḥ puruṣo bhūtvā vicarāmi mahārṇave | kacchapaḥ kolasiṃhaśca vāmanaśca yuge yuge || 56 || na kasyāpi priyo loke tiryagyoniṣu sambhavaḥ | nābhavaṃ svecchayā vāmavarāhādiṣu yoniṣu || 57 || vihāya lakṣyā saha saṃvihāraṃ ko yāti matsyādiṣu hīnayoniṣu | śayyāṃ ca muktvā garuḍāsanasthaḥ karomi yuddhaṃ vipulaṃ svatantraḥ || 58 || purā puraste'ja śiro madīyaṃ gataṃ dhanurjyāskhalanātkva cāpi | tvayā tadā vājiśiro gṛhītvā saṃyojitaṃ śilpivareṇa bhūyaḥ || 59 || hayānano'haṃ parikīrtitaśca pratyakṣametattava lokakartaḥ | viḍambaneyaṃ kila lokamadhye kathaṃ bhavedātmaparo yadi syām || 60 || tasmānnāhaṃ svatantro'smi śaktyadhīno'smi sarvathā | tāmeva śaktiṃ satataṃ dhyāyāmi ca nirantaram || 61 || nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcijjānāmi kamalodbhava | nārada uvāca ityuktaṃ viṣṇunā tena padmayonestu sannidhau || 62 || tena cāpyahamukto'smi tathaiva munipuṅgava | tasmāttvamapi kalyāṇa puruṣārthāptihetave || 63 || asaṃśayaṃ hṛdambhoje bhaja devīpadāmbujam | sarvaṃ dāsyati sā devī yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhavettava || 64 || sūta uvāca nāradenaivamuktastu vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | devīpādābjaniṣṇātastapase prayayau girau || 65 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe devīsarvottametikathanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <1.5> hayagrīvāvatārakathanam ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sūtāsmākaṃ manaḥ kāmaṃ magnaṃ saṃśayasāgare | yathoktaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ jagadvismayakārakam || 1 || yanmūrdhā mādhavasyāpi gato dehātpunaḥ param | hayagrīvastato jātaḥ sarvakartā janārdanaḥ || 2 || vedo'pi stauti yaṃ devaṃ devāḥ sarve yadāśrayāḥ | ādidevo jagannāthaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ || 3 || tasyāpi vadanaṃ chinnaṃ daivayogātkathaṃ tadā | tatsarvaṃ kathayāśu tvaṃ vistareṇa mahāmate || 4 || sūta uvāca śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve sāvadhānāḥ samantataḥ | caritaṃ devadevasya viṣṇoḥ paramatejasaḥ || 5 || kadāciddāruṇaṃ yuddhaṃ kṛtvā devaḥ sanātanaḥ | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi pariśrānto janārdanaḥ || 6 || same deśe śubhe sthāne kṛtvā padmāsanaṃ vibhuḥ | avalambya dhanuḥ sajyaṃ kaṇṭhadeśe dharāsthitam || 7 || dattvā bhāraṃ dhanuṣkoṭyāṃ nidrāmāpa ramāpatiḥ | śrāntatvāddaivayogācca jātastatrātinidritaḥ || 8 || tadā kālena kiyatā devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ | brahmeśasahitāḥ sarve yajñaṃ kartuṃ samudyatāḥ || 9 || gatāḥ sarve'tha vaikuṇṭhaṃ draṣṭuṃ devaṃ janārdanam | devakāryārthasiddhyarthaṃ makhānāmadhipaṃ prabhum || 10 || adṛṣṭvā taṃ tadā tatra jñānadṛṣṭyā vilokya te | yatrāste bhagavān viṣṇurjagmustatra tadā surāḥ || 11 || dadṛśuste tadeśānaṃ yoganidrāvaśaṃ gatam | vicetanaṃ vibhuṃ viṣṇuṃ tatrāsāṃcakrire surāḥ || 12 || sthiteṣu sarvadeveṣu nidrāsupte jagatpatau | cintāmāpuḥ surāḥ sarve brahmarudrapurogamāḥ || 13 || tānuvāca tataḥ śakraḥ kiṃ kartavyaṃ surottamāḥ | nidrābhaṅgaḥ kathaṃ kāryaścintayantu surottamāḥ || 14 || tamuvāca tadā śambhurnidrābhaṅge'sti dūṣaṇam | kāryaṃ caiva prakartavyaṃ yajñasya surasattamāḥ || 15 || utpāditā tadā vamrī brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā | tayā bhakṣayituṃ tatra dhanuṣo'graṃ dharāsthitam || 16 || bhakṣite'gre tadā nimnaṃ gamiṣyati śarāsanam | tadā nidrāvimukto'sau devadevo bhaviṣyati || 17 || devakāryaṃ tadā sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | sa vamrīṃ saṃdideśātha devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ || 18 || tamuvāca tadā vamrī devadevasya māpateḥ | nidrābhaṅgaḥ kathaṃ kāryo devasya jagatāṃ guroḥ || 19 || nidrābhaṅgaḥ kathācchedo dampatyoḥ prītibhedanam | śiśumātṛvibhedaśca brahmahatyāsamaṃ smṛtam || 20 || tatkathaṃ devadevasya karomi sukhanāśanam | kiṃ phalaṃ bhakṣaṇāddeva yena pāpaṃ karomyaham || 21 || sarvaḥ svārthavaśo lokaḥ kurute pātakaṃ kila | tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi svārthameva prabhakṣaṇam || 22 || brahmovāca tava bhāgaṃ kariṣyāmo makhamadhye yathā śṛṇu | tena tvaṃ kuru kāryaṃ no viṣṇuṃ bodhaya māciram || 23 || homakarmaṇi pārśve ca havirdānātpatiṣyati | tatte bhāgaṃ vijānīhi kuru kāryaṃ tvarānvitā || 24 || sūta uvāca ityuktā brahmaṇā vamrī dhanuṣo'graṃ tvarānvitā | cakhāda saṃsthitaṃ bhūmau vimuktā jyā tadābhavat || 25 || pratyañjāyāṃ vimuktāyāṃ muktā koṭistathottarā | śabdaḥ samabhavadghorastena trastāḥ surāstadā || 26 || brahmāṇḍaṃ kṣubhitaṃ sarvaṃ vasudhā kampitā tadā | samudrāśca samudvignāstresuśca jalajantavaḥ || 27 || vavurvātāstathā cogrāḥ parvatāśca cakampire | ulkāpātā mahotpātā babhūvurduḥkhaśaṃsinaḥ || 28 || diśo ghoratarāścāsansūryo'pyastaṃgato'bhavat | cintāmāpuḥ surāḥ sarve kiṃ bhaviṣyati durdine || 29 || evaṃ cintayatāṃ teṣāṃ mūrdhā viṣṇoḥ sakuṇḍalaḥ | gataḥ samukuṭaḥ kvāpi devadevasya tāpasāḥ || 30 || andhakāre tadā ghore śānte brahmaharau tadā | śirohīnaṃ śarīraṃ tu dadṛśāte vilakṣaṇam || 31 || dṛṣṭvā kabandhaṃ viṣṇoste vismitāḥ surasattamāḥ | cintāsāgaramagnāśca ruruduḥ śokakarśitāḥ || 32 || hā nātha kiṃ prabho jātamatyadbhutamamānuṣam | vaiśasaṃ sarvadevānāṃ devadeva sanātana || 33 || māyeyaṃ kasya devasya yayā te'dya śiro hṛtam | acchedyastvamabhedyo'si apradāhyo'si sarvadā || 34 || evaṃ gate tvayi vibho mariṣyanti ca devatāḥ | kīdṛśastvayi naḥ snehaḥ svārthenaiva rudāmahe || 35 || nāyaṃ vighnaḥ kṛto daityairna yakṣairna ca rākṣasaiḥ | devaireva kṛtaḥ kasya dūṣaṇaṃ ca ramāpate || 36 || parādhīnāḥ surāḥ sarve kiṃ kurmaḥ kva vrajāma ca | śaraṇaṃ naiva deveśa surāṇāṃ mūḍhacetasām || 37 || na caiṣā sāttvikī māyā rājasī na ca tāmasī | yayā chinnaṃ śiraste'dya māyeśasya jagadguroḥ || 38 || krandamānāṃstadā dṛṣṭvā devāñchivapurogamān | bṛhaspatistadovāca śamayanvedavittamaḥ || 39 || ruditena mahābhāgāḥ kranditena tathāpi kim | upāyaścātra kartavyaḥ sarvathā buddhigocaraḥ || 40 || daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca deveśa sadṛśāvubhau | upāyaśca vidhātavyo daivātphalati sarvathā || 41 || indra uvāca daivameva paraṃ manye dhikpauruṣamanarthakam | viṣṇorapi śiraśchinnaṃ surāṇāṃ caiva paśyatām || 42 || brahmovāca avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kālenāpāditaṃ ca yat | śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi daivaṃ ko'tikrametpunaḥ || 43 || dehavānsukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktā naivātra saṃśayaḥ | yathā kālavaśātkṛttaṃ śiro me śambhunā purā || 44 || tathaiva liṅgapātaśca mahādevasya śāpataḥ | tathaivādya harermūrdhā patito lavaṇāmbhasi || 45 || sahasrabhagasaṃprāptirduḥkhaṃ caiva śacīpateḥ | svargādbhraṃśastathā vāsaḥ kamale mānase sare || 46 || ete duḥkhasya bhoktāraḥ kena duḥkhaṃ na bhujyate | saṃsāre'sminmahābhāgāstasmācchokaṃ tyajantu vai || 47 || cintayantu mahāmāyāṃ vidyādevīṃ sanātanīm | sā vidhāsyati naḥ kāryaṃ nirguṇā prakṛtiḥ parā || 48 || brahmavidyāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ sarveṣāṃ jananīṃ tathā | yayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 49 || sūta uvāca ityuktvā vai surānvedhā nigamānādideśa ha | dehayuktānsthitānagre surakāryārthasiddhaye || 50 || brahmovāca stuvantu paramāṃ devīṃ brahmavidyāṃ sanātanīm | gūḍhāṅgīṃ ca mahāmāyāṃ sarvakāryārthasādhanīm || 51 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya vedāḥ sarvāṅgasundarāḥ | tuṣṭuvurjñānagamyāṃ tāṃ mahāmāyāṃ jagatsthitām || 52 || vedā ūcuḥ namo devi mahāmāye viśvotpattikare śive | nirguṇe sarvabhūteśi mātaḥ śaṅkarakāmade || 53 || tvaṃ bhūmiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ prāṇāḥ prāṇavatāṃ tathā | dhīḥ śrīḥ kāntiḥ kṣamā śāntiḥ śraddhā medhā dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ || 54 || tvamudgīthe'rdhamātrāsi gāyatrī vyāhṛtistathā | jayā ca vijayā dhātrī lajjā kīrtiḥ spṛhā dayā || 55 || tvāṃ saṃstumo'mba bhuvanatrayasaṃvidhānadakṣāṃ dayārasayutāṃ jananīṃ janānām | vidyāṃ śivāṃ sakalalokahitāṃ vareṇyāṃ vāgbījavāsanipuṇāṃ bhavanāśakartrīm || 56 || brahmā haraḥ śaurisahasranetravāgvahnisūryā bhuvanādhināthāḥ | te tvatkṛtāḥ santi tato na mukhyā mātā yatastvaṃ sthirajaṅgamānām || 57 || sakalabhuvanametatkartukāmā yadā tvaṃ sṛjasi janani devānviṣṇurudrājamukhyān | sthitilayajananaṃ taiḥ kārayasyekarūpā na khalu tava kathaṃciddevi saṃsāraleśaḥ || 58 || na te rūpaṃ vettuṃ sakalabhuvane ko'pi nipuṇo na nāmnāṃ saṃkhyāṃ te kathitumiha yogyo'sti puruṣaḥ | yadalpaṃ kīlālaṃ kalayitumaśaktaḥ sa tu naraḥ kathaṃ pārāvārākalanacaturaḥ syādṛtamatiḥ || 59 || na devānāṃ madhye bhagavati tavānantavibhavaṃ vijānātyeko'pi tvamiha bhuvanaikāsi jananī | kathaṃ mithyā viśvaṃ sakalamapi caikā racayasi pramāṇaṃ tvetasminnigamavacanaṃ devi vihitam || 60 || nirīhaivāsi tvaṃ nikhilajagatāṃ kāraṇamaho caritraṃ te citraṃ bhagavati mano no vyathayati | kathaṃkāraṃ vācyaḥ sakalanigamāgocaraguṇaprabhāvaḥ svaṃ yasmātsvayamapi na jānāsi paramam || 61 || na kiṃ jānāsi tvaṃ janani madhujinmaulipatanaṃ || śive kiṃ vā jñātvā vividiṣasi śaktiṃ madhujitaḥ | hareḥ kiṃ vā mātarduritatatireṣā balavatī || bhavatyāḥ pādābje bhajananipuṇe kvāsti duritam || 62 || upekṣā kiṃ ceyaṃ tava surasamūhe'tiviṣamā || harermūrdhno nāśo matamiha mahāścaryajanakam | mahadduḥkhaṃ mātastvamasi jananacchedakuśalā || na jānīmo maulervighaṭanavilambaḥ kathamabhūt || 63 || jñātvā doṣaṃ sakalasuratāpāditaṃ devi citte kiṃ vā viṣṇāvamarajanitaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ pātitaṃ te | viṣṇorvā kiṃ samarajanitaḥ ko'pi garvo'tivegācchettuṃ mātastava vilasitaṃ naiva vidmo'tra bhāvam || 64 || kiṃ vā daityaiḥ samaravijitaistīrthadeśe suramye ghoraṃ taptvā bhagavati varaṃ labdhavadbhirbhavatyāḥ | antardhānaṃ gamitamadhunā viṣṇuśīrṣaṃ bhavāni draṣṭuṃ kiṃ vā vigataśirasaṃ vāsudevaṃ vinodaḥ || 65 || sindhoḥ putryāṃ roṣitā kiṃ tvamādye kasmādenāṃ prekṣase nāthahīnām | kṣantavyaste svāṃśajātāparādho vyutthāpyainaṃ moditā māṃ kuruṣva || 66 || ete surāstvāṃ satataṃ namanti kāryeṣu mukhyāḥ prathitaprabhāvāḥ | śokārṇavāttāraya devi devānutthāpya devaṃ sakalādhinātham || 67 || mūrdhā gataḥ kvāmba harerna vidmo nānyo'styupāyaḥ khalu jīvane'dya | yathā sudhā jīvanakarmadakṣā tathā jagajjīvitadāsi devi || 68 || sūta uvāca evaṃ stutā tadā devī guṇātītā maheśvarī | prasannā paramā māyā vedaiḥ sāṅgaiśca sāmagaiḥ || 69 || tānuvāca tadā vāṇī cākāśasthāśarīriṇī | devānprati sukhaiḥ śabdairjanānandakarī śubhā || 70 || mā kurudhvaṃ surāścintāṃ svasthāstiṣṭhantu cāmarāḥ | stutāhaṃ nigamaiḥ kāmaṃ santuṣṭāsmi na saṃśayaḥ || 71 || yaḥ pumānmānuṣe loke stautyetāṃ māmakīṃ stutim | patiṣyati sadā bhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 72 || śṛṇoti vā stotramidaṃ madīyaṃ bhaktyā trikālaṃ satataṃ naro yaḥ | vimuktaduḥkhaḥ sa bhavetsukhī ca vedoktametannanu vedatulyam || 73 || śṛṇvantu kāraṇaṃ cādya yadgataṃ vadanaṃ hareḥ | akāraṇaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ saṃsāre'tra bhaviṣyati || 74 || udadhestanayāṃ viṣṇuḥ saṃsthitāmantike priyām | jahāsa vadanaṃ vīkṣya tasyāstatra manoramam || 75 || tayā jñātaṃ harirnūnaṃ kathaṃ māṃ hasati prabhuḥ | virūpaṃ hariṇā dṛṣṭaṃ mukhaṃ me kena hetunā || 76 || vināpi kāraṇenādya kathaṃ hāsyasya sambhavaḥ | sapatnīva kṛtā tena manye'nyā varavarṇinī || 77 || tataḥ kopayutā jātā mahālakṣmī tamoguṇā | tāmasī tu tadā śaktistasyā dehe samāviśat || 78 || kenacitkālayogena devakāryārthasiddhaye | praviṣṭā tāmasī śaktistasyā dehe'tidāruṇā || 79 || tāmasyāviṣṭadehā sā cukopātiśayaṃ tadā | śanakaiḥ samuvācedamidaṃ patatu te śiraḥ || 80 || strīsvabhāvācca bhāvitvātkālayogādvinirgataḥ | avicārya tadā dattaḥ śāpaḥ svasukhanāśanaḥ || 81 || sapatnīsambhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ vaidhavyādadhikaṃ tviti | vicintya manasetyuktaṃ tāmasīśaktiyogataḥ || 82 || anṛtaṃ sāhasaṃ māyā mūrkhatvamatilobhatā | aśaucaṃ nirdayatvaṃ ca strīṇāṃ doṣāḥ svabhāvajāḥ || 83 || saśīrṣaṃ vāsudevaṃ taṃ karomyadya yathā purā | śiro'sya śāpayogena nimagnaṃ lavaṇāmbudhau || 84 || anyacca kāraṇaṃ kiñcidvartate surasattamāḥ | bhavatāṃ ca mahatkāryaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 85 || purā daityo mahābāhurhayagrīvo'tiviśrutaḥ | tapaścakre sarasvatyāstīre paramadāruṇam || 86 || japannekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ māyābījātmakaṃ mama | nirāhāro jitātmā ca sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ || 87 || dhyāyanmāṃ tāmasīṃ śaktiṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca tapaścakre'tidāruṇam || 88 || tadāhaṃ tāmasaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā tatra samāgatā | darśane puratastasya dhyātaṃ tattena yādṛśam || 89 || siṃhopari sthitā tatra tamavocaṃ dayānvitā | varaṃ brūhi mahābhāga dadāmi tava suvrata || 90 || iti śrutvā vaco devyā dānavaḥ premapūritaḥ | pradakṣiṇāṃ praṇāmaṃ ca cakāra tvaritastadā || 91 || dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ madīyaṃ sa premosphullavilocanaḥ | harṣāśrupūrṇanayanastuṣṭāva sa ca māṃ tadā || 92 || hayagrīva uvāca namo devyai mahāmāye sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇi | bhaktānugrahacature kāmade mokṣade śive || 93 || dharāmbutejaḥpavanakhapañcānāṃ ca kāraṇam | tvaṃ gandharasarūpāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ sparśaśabdayoḥ || 94 || ghrāṇaṃ ca rasanā cakṣustvakśrotramindriyāṇi ca | karmendriyāṇi cānyāni tvattaḥ sarvaṃ maheśvari || 95 || devyuvāca kiṃ te'bhīṣṭaṃ varaṃ brūhi vāñchitaṃ yaddadāmi tat | parituṣṭāsmi bhaktyā te tapasā cādbhutena ca || 96 || hayagrīva uvāca yathā me maraṇaṃ mātarna bhavettattathā kuru | bhaveyamamaro yogī tathājeyaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 97 || devyuvāca jātasya hi dhruvaṃ mṛtyurdhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca | maryādā cedṛśī loke bhavecca kathamanyathā || 98 || evaṃ tvaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā maraṇe rākṣasottama | varaṃ varaya ceṣṭaṃ te vicārya manasā kila || 99 || hayagrīva uvāca hayagrīvācca me mṛtyurnānyasmājjagadambike | iti me vāñchitaṃ kāmaṃ pūrayasva manogatam || 100 || devyuvāca gṛhaṃ gaccha mahābhāga kuru rājyaṃ yathāsukham | hayagrīvādṛte mṛtyurna te nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati || 101 || iti dattvā varaṃ tasmā antardhānaṃ gatā tathā | mudaṃ paramikāṃ prāpya so'pi svabhavanaṃ gataḥ || 102 || sa pīḍayati duṣṭātmā munīn vedāṃśca sarvaśaḥ | na ko'pi vidyate tasya hantādya bhuvanatraye || 103 || tasmācchīrṣaṃ hayasyāsya samuddhṛtya manoharam | dehe'tra viśiroviṣṇostvaṣṭā saṃyojayiṣyati || 104 || hayagrīvo'tha bhagavānhaniṣyati tamāsuram | pāpiṣṭhaṃ dānavaṃ krūraṃ devānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 105 || sūta uvāca evaṃ surāṃstadābhāṣya śarvāṇī virarāma ha | devāstadātisantuṣṭāstamūcurdevaśilpinam || 106 || devā ūcuḥ kuru kāryaṃ surāṇāṃ vai viṣṇoḥ śīrṣābhiyojanam | dānavapravaraṃ daityaṃ hayagrīvo haniṣyati || 107 || sūta uvāca iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ tvaṣṭā cātitvarānvitaḥ | vājiśīrṣaṃ cakartāśu khaḍgena surasannidhau || 108 || viṣṇoḥ śarīre tenāśu yojitaṃ vājimastakam | hayagrīvo harirjāto mahāmāyāprasādataḥ || 109 || kiyatā tena kālena dānavo madadarpitaḥ | nihatastarasā saṃkhye devānāṃ ripurojasā || 110 || ya idaṃ śubhamākhyānaṃ śṛṇvanti bhuvi mānavāḥ | sarvaduḥkhavinirmuktāste bhavanti na saṃśayaḥ || 111 || mahāmāyācaritrañca pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam | paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvasampattikārakam || 112 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe hayagrīvāvatārakathanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <1.6> madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhodyogavarṇanam ṛṣaya ūcuḥ saumya yacca tvayā proktaṃ śaureryuddhaṃ mahārṇave | madhukaiṭabhayoḥ sārdhaṃ pañcavarṣasahasrakam || 1 || kasmāttau dānavau jātau tasminnekārṇave jale | mahāvīryo durādharṣau devairapi sudurjayau || 2 || kathaṃ tāvasurau jātau kathaṃ ca hariṇā hatau | tadācakṣva mahāprājña caritaṃ paramādbhutam || 3 || śrotukāmā vayaṃ sarve tvaṃ vaktā ca bahuśrutaḥ | daivāccātraiva saṃjātaḥ saṃyogaśca tathāvayoḥ || 4 || mūrkheṇa saha saṃyogo viṣādapi sudurjaraḥ | vijñena saha saṃyogaḥ sudhārasasamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5 || jīvanti paśavaḥ sarve khādanti mehayanti ca | jānanti viṣayākāraṃ vyavāyasukhamadbhutam || 6 || na teṣāṃ sadasajjñānaṃ viveko na ca mokṣadaḥ | paśubhiste samā jñeyā yeṣāṃ na śravaṇādaraḥ || 7 || mṛgādyāḥ paśavaḥ kecijjānanti śrāvaṇaṃ sukham | aśrotrāḥ phaṇinaścaiva mumuhurnādapānataḥ || 8 || pañcānāmindriyāṇāṃ vai śubhe śravaṇadarśane | śravaṇādvastuvijñānaṃ darśanāccittarañjanam || 9 || śravaṇaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ tathā | tāmasaṃ ca mahābhāga sujñoktaṃ niścayānvitam || 10 || sāttvikaṃ vedaśāstrādi sāhityaṃ caiva rājasam | tāmasaṃ yuddhavārtā ca paradoṣaprakāśanam || 11 || sāttvikaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ prajñāvadbhiśca paṇḍitaiḥ | uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva tathaivādhamamityuta || 12 || uttamaṃ mokṣaphaladaṃ svargadaṃ madhyamaṃ tathā | adhamaṃ bhogadaṃ proktaṃ nirṇīya viditaṃ budhaiḥ || 13 || sāhityaṃ caiva trividhaṃ svīyāyāṃ cottamaṃ smṛtam | madhyamaṃ vārayoṣāyāṃ paroḍhāyāṃ tathādhamam || 14 || tāmasaṃ trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ vidvadbhiḥ śāstradarśibhiḥ | ātatāyiniyuddhaṃ yattaduttamamudāhṛtam || 15 || madhyamaṃ cāpi vidveṣātpāṇḍavānāṃ tathāribhiḥ | adhamaṃ nirnimittaṃ tu vivāde kalahe tathā || 16 || tadatra śravaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ purāṇasya mahāmate | buddhipravardhanaṃ puṇyaṃ tataḥ pāpapraṇāśanam || 17 || tadākhyāhi mahābuddhe kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām | śrutāṃ dvaipāyanātpūrvaṃ sarvārthasya prasādhinīm || 18 || sūta uvāca yūyaṃ dhanyā mahābhāgā dhanyo'haṃ pṛthivītale | yeṣāṃ śravaṇabuddhiśca mamāpi kathane kila || 19 || purā caikārṇave jāte vilīne bhuvanatraye | śeṣaparyaṅkasupte ca devadeve janārdane || 20 || viṣṇukarṇamalodbhūtau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau | mahābalau ca tau daityau vivṛddhau sāgare jale || 21 || krīḍamānau sthitau tatra vicarantāvitastataḥ | tāvekadā mahākāyau krīḍāsaktau mahārṇave || 22 || cintāmavāpatuścitte bhrātarāviva saṃsthitau | nākāraṇaṃ bhavetkāryaṃ sarvatraiṣā paramparā || 23 || ādheyaṃ tu vinādhāraṃ na tiṣṭhati kathañcana | ādhārādheyabhāvastu bhāti no cittagocaraḥ || 24 || kva tiṣṭhati jalaṃ cedaṃ sukharūpaṃ suvistaram | kena sṛṣṭaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ magnāvāvāñjale sthitau || 25 || āvāṃ vā kathamutpannau kena votpāditāvubhau | pitarau kveti vijñānaṃ nāsti kāmaṃ tathāvayoḥ || 26 || sūta uvāca evaṃ kāmayamānau tau jagmaturna viniścayam | uvāca kaiṭabhastatra madhuṃ pārśve sthitaṃ jale || 27 || kaiṭabha uvāca madho vāmatra salile sthātuṃ śaktirmahābalā | vartate bhrātaracalā kāraṇaṃ sā hi me matā || 28 || tayā tatamidaṃ toyaṃ tadādhāraṃ ca tiṣṭhati | sā eva paramā devī kāraṇañca tathāvayoḥ || 29 || evaṃ vibudhyamānau tau cintāviṣṭau yadāsurau | tadākāśe śrutaṃ tābhyāṃ vāgbījaṃ sumanoharam || 30 || gṛhītaṃ ca tatastābhyāṃ tasyābhyāso dṛḍhaḥ kṛtaḥ | tadā saudāmanī dṛṣṭā tābhyāṃ khe cotthitā śubhā || 31 || tābhyāṃ vicāritaṃ tatra mantro'yaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | tathā dhyānamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ gagane saguṇaṃ kila || 32 || nirāhārau jitātmānau tanmanaskau samāhitau | babhūvaturvicintyaivaṃ japadhyānaparāyaṇau || 33 || evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tābhyāṃ taptaṃ mahattapaḥ | prasannā paramā śaktirjātā sā paramā tayoḥ || 34 || khinnau tau dānavau dṛṣṭvā tapase kṛtaniścayau | tayoranugrahārthāya vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 35 || varaṃ vāṃ vāñchitaṃ daityau brūtaṃ paramasammatam | dadāmi parituṣṭāsmi yuvayostapasā kila || 36 || sūta uvāca iti śrutvā tu tāṃ vāṇīṃ dānavāvūcatustadā | svecchayā maraṇaṃ devi varaṃ nau dehi suvrate || 37 || vāguvāca vāñchitaṃ maraṇaṃ daityau bhavedvā matprasādataḥ | ajeyau devadaityaiśca bhrātarau nātra saṃśayaḥ || 38 || sūta uvāca iti dattavarau devyā dānavau madadarpitau | cakratuḥ sāgare krīḍāṃ yādogaṇasamanvitau || 39 || kālena kiyatā viprā dānavābhyāṃ yadṛcchayā | dṛṣṭaḥ prajāpatirbrahmā padmāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ || 40 || dṛṣṭvā tu muditāvāstāṃ yuddhakāmau mahābalau | tamūcatustadā tatra yuddhaṃ nau dehi suvrata || 41 || nocetpadmaṃ parityajya yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha māciram | yadi tvaṃ nirbalaścāsi kva yogyaṃ śubhamāsanam || 42 || vīrabhogyamidaṃ sthānaṃ kātaro'si tyajāśu vai | tayoriti vacaḥ śrutvā cintāmāpa prajāpatiḥ || 43 || dṛṣṭvā ca balinau vīrau kiṃ karomīti tāpasaḥ | cintāviṣṭastadā tasthau cintayanmanasā tadā || 44 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhodyogavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <1.7> viṣṇuprabodhaḥ sūta uvāca tau vīkṣya balinau brahmā tadopāyānacintayat | sāmadānabhidādīṃśca yuddhāntānsarvatantravit || 1 || na jāne'haṃ balaṃ nūnametayorvā yathātatham | ajñāte tu bale kāmaṃ naiva yuddhaṃ praśasyate || 2 || stutiṃ karomi cedadya duṣṭayormadamattayoḥ | prakāśitaṃ bhavennūnaṃ nirbalatvaṃ mayā svayam || 3 || vadhiṣyati tadaiko'pi nirbalatve prakāśite | dānaṃ naivādya yogyaṃ vā bhedaḥ kāryo mayā katham || 4 || viṣṇuṃ prabodhayāmyadya śeṣe suptaṃ janārdanam | caturbhujaṃ mahāvīryaṃ duḥkhahā sa bhaviṣyati || 5 || iti sañcintya manasā padmanālagato'bjajaḥ | jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ manasā duḥkhanāśakam || 6 || tuṣṭāva bodhanārthaṃ taṃ śubhaiḥ sambodhanairharim | nārāyaṇaṃ jagannāthaṃ nispandaṃ yoganidrayā || 7 || brahmovāca dīnanātha hare viṣṇo vāmanottiṣṭha mādhava | bhaktārtihṛddhṛṣīkeśa sarvāvāsa jagatpate || 8 || antaryāminnameyātmanvāsudeva jagatpate | duṣṭārināśanaikāgracitta cakragadādhara || 9 || sarvajña sarvalokeśa sarvaśaktisamanvita | uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha deveśa duḥkhanāśana pāhi mām || 10 || viśvambhara viśālākṣa puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana | jagadyone nirākāra sargasthityantakāraka || 11 || imau daityau mahārāja hantukāmau madoddhatau | na jānāsyakhilādhāra kathaṃ māṃ saṅkaṭe gatam || 12 || upekṣase'tiduḥkhārtaṃ yadi māṃ śaraṇaṃ gatam | pālakatvaṃ mahāviṣṇo nirādhāraṃ bhavettataḥ || 13 || evaṃ stuto'pi bhagavān na bubodha yadā hariḥ | yoganidrāsamākrāntastadā brahmā hyacintayat || 14 || nūnaṃ śaktisamākrānto viṣṇurnidrāvaśaṃ gataḥ | jajāgāra na dharmātmā kiṃ karomyadya duḥkhitaḥ || 15 || hantukāmāvubhau prāptau dānavau madagarvitau | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi nāsti me śaraṇaṃ kvacit || 16 || iti saṃcintya manasā niścayaṃ pratipadya ca | tuṣṭāva yoganidrāṃ tāmekāgrahṛdayasthitaḥ || 17 || vicārya manasāpyevaṃ śaktirme rakṣaṇe kṣamā | yayā hyacetano viṣṇuḥ kṛto'sti spandavarjitaḥ || 18 || vyasuryathā na jānāti guṇācchabdādikāniha | tathā harirna jānāti nidrāmīlitalocanaḥ || 19 || na jahāti yato nidrāṃ bahudhā saṃstuto'pyasau | manye nāsya vaśe nidrā nidrayāyaṃ vaśīkṛtaḥ || 20 || yo yasya vaśamāpantaḥ sa tasya kiṅkaraḥ kila | tasmācca yoganidreyaṃ svāminī māpaterhareḥ || 21 || sindhujāyā api vaśe yayā svāmī vaśīkṛtaḥ | nūnaṃ jagadidaṃ sarvaṃ bhagavatyā vaśīkṛtam || 22 || ahaṃ viṣṇustathā śambhuḥ sāvitrī ca ramāpyumā | sarve vayaṃ vaśe yasyā nātra kiñcidvicāraṇā || 23 || harirapyavaśaḥ śete yathānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ | yayābhibhūtaḥ kā vārtā kilānyeṣāṃ mahātmanām || 24 || staumyadya yoganidrāṃ vai yayā mukto janārdanaḥ | ghaṭayiṣyati yuddhe ca vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ || 25 || iti kṛtvā matiṃ brahmā padmanālasthitastadā | tuṣṭāva yoganidrāṃ tāṃ viṣṇoraṅgeṣu saṃsthitām || 26 || brahmovāca devi tvamasya jagataḥ kila kāraṇaṃ hi jñātaṃ mayā sakalavedavacobhiramba | yadviṣṇurapyakhilalokavivekakartā nidrāvaśaṃ ca gamitaḥ puruṣottamo'dya || 27 || ko veda te janani mohavilāsalīlāṃ mūḍho'smyahaṃ harirayaṃ vivaśaśca śete | īdṛktayā sakalabhūtamanonivāse vidvattamo vibudhakoṭiṣu nirguṇāyāḥ || 28 || sāṃkhyā vadanti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca yāṃ tāṃ caitanyabhāvarahitāṃ jagataśca kartrīm | kiṃ tādṛśāsi kathamatra jagannivāsaścaitanyatāvirahito vihitastvayādya || 29 || nāṭyaṃ tanoṣi saguṇā vividhaprakāraṃ no vetti ko'pi tava kṛtyavidhānayogam | dhyāyanti yāṃ munigaṇā niyataṃ trikālaṃ sandhyeti nāma parikalpya guṇān bhavāni || 30 || buddhirhi bodhakaraṇā jagatāṃ sadā tvaṃ śrīścāsi devi satataṃ sukhadā surāṇām | kīrtistathā matidhṛtī kila kāntireva śraddhā ratiśca
