sakaleṣu janeṣu mātaḥ || 31 || nātaḥ paraṃ kila vitarkaśataiḥ pramāṇaṃ prāptaṃ mayā yadiha duḥkhagatiṃ gatena | tvaṃ cātra sarvajagatāṃ jananīti satyaṃ nidrālutāṃ vitaratā hariṇātra dṛṣṭam || 32 || tvaṃ devi vedaviduṣāmapi durvibhāvyā vedo'pi nūnamakhilārthatayā na veda | yasmāttvadudbhavamasau śrutirāpnuvānā pratyakṣameva sakalaṃ tava kāryametat || 33 || kaste caritramakhilaṃ bhuvi veda dhīmānnāhaṃ harirna ca bhavo na surāstathānye | jñātuṃ kṣamāśca munayo na mamātmajāśca durvācya eva mahimā tava sarvaloke || 34 || yajñeṣu devi yadi nāma na te vadanti svāheti vedaviduṣo havane kṛte'pi | na prāpnuvanti satataṃ makhabhāgadheyaṃ devāstvameva vibudheṣvapi vṛttidāsi || 35 || trātā vayaṃ bhagavati prathamaṃ tvayā vai devārisambhavabhayādadhunā tathaiva | bhīto'smi devi varade śaraṇaṃ gato'smi ghoraṃ nirīkṣya madhunā saha kaiṭabhaṃ ca || 36 || no vetti viṣṇuradhunā mama duḥkhametajjāne tvayātmavivaśīkṛtadehayaṣṭiḥ | muñcādidevamathavā jahi dānavendrau yadrocate tava kuruṣva mahānubhāve || 37 || jānanti ye na tava devi paraṃ prabhāvaṃ dhyāyanti te hariharāvapi mandacittāḥ | jñātaṃ mayādya janani prakaṭaṃ pramāṇaṃ yadviṣṇurapyatitarāṃ vivaśo'tha śete || 38 || sindhūdbhavāpi na hariṃ pratibodhituṃ vai śaktā patiṃ tava vaśānugamadya śaktyā | manye tvayā bhagavati prasabhaṃ ramāpi prasvāpitā na bubudhe vivaśīkṛteva || 39 || dhanyāsta eva bhuvi bhaktiparāstavāṃghrau tyaktvānyadevabhajanaṃ tvayi līnabhāvāḥ | kurvanti devi bhajanaṃ sakalaṃ nikāmaṃ jñātvā samastajananīṃ kila kāmadhenum || 40 || dhīkāntikīrtiśubhavṛttiguṇādayaste viṣṇorguṇāstu parihṛtya gatāḥ kva cādya | bandīkṛto harirasau nanu nidrayātra śaktyā tavaiva bhagavatyatimānavatyāḥ || 41 || tvaṃ śaktireva jagatāmakhilaprabhāvā tvannirmitaṃ ca sakalaṃ khalu bhāvamātram | tvaṃ krīḍase nijavinirmitamohajāle nāṭye yathā viharate svakṛte naṭo vai || 42 || viṣṇustvayā prakaṭitaḥ prathamaṃ yugādau dattā ca śaktiramalā khalu pālanāya | trātaṃ ca sarvamakhilaṃ vivaśīkṛto'dya yadrocate tava tathāmba karoṣi nūnam || 43 || sṛṣṭvātra māṃ bhagavati pravināśituṃ cennecchāsti te kuru dayāṃ parihṛtya maunam | kasmādimau prakaṭitau kila kālarūpau yadvā bhavāni hasituṃ nu kimicchase mām || 44 || jñātaṃ mayā tava viceṣṭitamadbhutaṃ vai kṛtvākhilaṃ jagadidaṃ ramase svatantrā | līnaṃ karoṣi sakalaṃ kila māṃ tathaiva hantuṃ tvamicchasi bhavāni kimatra citram || 45 || kāmaṃ kuruṣva vadhamadya mamaiva mātarduḥkhaṃ na me maraṇajaṃ jagadambike'tra | kartā tvayaiva vihitaḥ prathamaṃ sa cāyaṃ daityāhato'tha mṛta ityayaśo gariṣṭham || 46 || uttiṣṭha devi kuru rūpamihādbhutaṃ tvaṃ māṃ vā tvimau jahi yathecchasi bālalīle | no cetprabodhaya hariṃ nihanedimau yastvatsādhyametadakhilaṃ kila kāryajātam || 47 || sūta uvāca evaṃ stutā tadā devī tāmasī tatra vedhasā | niḥsṛtya haridehāttu saṃsthitā pārśvatastadā || 48 || tyaktvāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ | nirgatā yoganidrā sā nāśāya ca tayostadā || 49 || vispanditaśarīro'sau yadā jāto janārdanaḥ | dhātā paramikāṃ prāpto mudaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ tataḥ || 50 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe viṣṇuprabodho nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <1.8> ārādhyanirṇayavarṇanam ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sandeho'tra mahābhāga kathāyāṃ tu mahādbhutaḥ | vedaśāstrapurāṇaiśca niścitaṃ tu sadā budhaiḥ || 1 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca trayo devāḥ sanātanāḥ | nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcidbrahmāṇḍe'sminmahāmate || 2 || brahmā sṛjati lokānvai viṣṇuḥ pātyakhilaṃ jagat | rudraḥ saṃharate kāle traya ete'tra kāraṇam || 3 || ekā mūrtistrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | rajaḥsattvatamobhiśca saṃyutāḥ kāryakārakāḥ || 4 || teṣāṃ madhye hariḥ śreṣṭho mādhavaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | ādidevo jagannāthaḥ samarthaḥ sarvakarmasu || 5 || nānyaḥ ko'pi samartho'sti viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ | sa kathaṃ svāpitaḥ svāmī vivaśo yogamāyayā || 6 || kva gataṃ tasya vijñānaṃ jīvataśceṣṭitaṃ kutaḥ | sandeho'yaṃ mahābhāga kathayasva yathāśubham || 7 || kā sā śaktiḥ purā proktā yayā viṣṇujitaḥ prabhuḥ | kuto jātā kathaṃ śaktā kā śaktirvada suvrata || 8 || yastu sarveśvaro viṣṇurvāsudevo jagadguruḥ | paramātmā parānandaḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥ || 9 || sarvakṛtsarvabhṛtsraṣṭā virajaḥ sarvagaḥ śuciḥ | sa kathaṃ nidrayā nītaḥ paratantraḥ parātparaḥ || 10 || etadāścaryabhūto hi sandeho naḥ parantapa | chindhi jñānāsinā sūta vyāsaśiṣya mahāmate || 11 || sūta uvāca kaḥ sandehaṃ bhinattyenaṃ trailokye sacarācare | muhyanti munayaḥ kāmaṃ brahmaputrāḥ sanātanāḥ || 12 || nāradaḥ kapilaścaiva praśne'sminmunisattamāḥ | kiṃ bravīmi mahābhāgā durghaṭe'sminvimarśane || 13 || deveṣu viṣṇuḥ kathitaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvapālakaḥ | yato virāḍidaṃ sarvamutpannaṃ sacarācaram || 14 || te sarve samupāsante natvā devaṃ parātparam | nārāyaṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam || 15 || tathā kecinmahādevaṃ śaṅkaraṃ śaśiśekharam | trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca śūlapāṇiṃ vṛṣadhvajam || 16 || tathā vedeṣu sarveṣu gītaṃ nāmnā triyambakam | kapardinaṃ pañcavaktraṃ gaurīdehārdhadhāriṇam || 17 || kailāsavāsanirataṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitam | bhūtavṛndayutaṃ devaṃ dakṣayajñavighātakam || 18 || tathā sūryaṃ vedavidaḥ sāyaṃprātardine dine | madhyāhne tu mahābhāgāḥ stuvanti vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 19 || tathā vedeṣu sarveṣu sūryopāsanamuttamam | paramātmeti vikhyātaṃ nāma tasya mahātmanaḥ || 20 || agniḥ sarvatra vedeṣu saṃstuto vedavittamaiḥ | indraścāpi trilokeśo varuṇaśca tathāparaḥ || 21 || yathā gaṅgā pravāhaiśca bahubhiḥ parivartate | tathaiva sarvadeveṣu viṣṇuḥ prokto maharṣibhiḥ || 22 || trīṇyeva hi pramāṇāni paṭhitāni supaṇḍitaiḥ | pratyakṣaṃ cānumānaṃ ca śābdaṃ caiva tṛtīyakam || 23 || catvāryevetare prāhurupamānayutāni ca | arthāpattiyutānyanye pañca prāhurmahādhiyaḥ || 24 || sapta paurāṇikāścaiva pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | etaiḥ pramāṇairdurjñeyaṃ yadbrahma paramaṃ ca tat || 25 || vitarkaścātra kartavyo buddhyā caivāgamena ca | niścayātmikayā yuktyā vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 26 || pratyakṣatastu vijñānaṃ cintyaṃ matimatā sadā | dṛṣṭāntenāpi satataṃ śiṣṭamārgānusāriṇā || 27 || vidvāṃso'pi vadantyevaṃ purāṇaiḥ parigīyate | druhiṇe sṛṣṭiśaktiśca harau pālanaśaktitā || 28 || hare saṃhāraśaktiśca sūrye śaktiḥ prakāśikā | dharādharaṇaśaktiśca śeṣe kūrme tathaiva ca || 29 || sādyā śaktiḥ pariṇatā sarvasminyā pratiṣṭhitā | dāhaśaktistathā vahnau samīre preraṇātmikā || 30 || śivo'pi śavatāṃ yāti kuṇḍalinyā vivarjitaḥ | śaktihīnastu yaḥ kaścidasamarthaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ || 31 || evaṃ sarvatra bhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca | brahmādistambaparyantaṃ brahmāṇḍe'sminmahātapāḥ || 32 || śaktihīnaṃ tu nindyaṃ syādvastumātraṃ carācaram | aśaktaḥ śatruvijaye gamane bhojane tathā || 33 || evaṃ sarvagatā śaktiḥ sā brahmeti vivicyate | sopāsyā vividhaiḥ samyagvicāryā sudhiyā sadā || 34 || viṣṇau ca sāttvikī śaktistayā hīno'pyakarmakṛt | druhiṇe rājasī śaktiryayā hīno hyasṛṣṭikṛt || 35 || śive ca tāmasī śaktistayā saṃhārakārakaḥ | ityūhyaṃ manasā sarvaṃ vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 36 || śaktiḥ karoti brahmāṇḍaṃ sā vai pālayate'khilam | icchayā saṃharatyeṣā jagadetaccarācaram || 37 || na viṣṇurna haraḥ śakro na brahmā na ca pāvakaḥ | na sūryo varuṇaḥ śaktaḥ sve sve kārye kathañcana || 38 || tayā yuktā hi kurvanti svāni kāryāṇi te surāḥ | saiva kāraṇakāryeṣu pratyakṣeṇāvagamyate || 39 || saguṇā nirguṇā sā tu dvidhā proktā manīṣibhiḥ | saguṇā rāgibhiḥ sevyā nirguṇā tu virāgibhiḥ || 40 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ svāminī sā nirākulā | dadāti vācchitānkāmānpūjitā vidhipūrvakam || 41 || na jānanti janā mūḍhāstāṃ sadā māyayāvṛtāḥ | jānanto'pi narāḥ kecinmohayanti parānapi || 42 || paṇḍitāḥ svodarārthaṃ vai pākhaṇḍāni pūthakpṛthak | pravartayanti kalinā preritā mandacetasaḥ || 43 || kalāvasminmahābhāgā nānābhedasamutthitāḥ | nānye yuge tathā dharmā vedabāhyāḥ kathañcana || 44 || viṣṇuścaratyasāvugra tapo varṣāṇyanekaśaḥ | brahmā harastrayo devā dhyāyantaḥ kamapi dhuvam || 45 || kāmayānāḥ sadā kāmaṃ te trayaḥ sarvadaiva hi | yajanti yajñānvividhānbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 46 || te vai śaktiṃ parāṃ devīṃ brahmākhyāṃ paramātmikām | dhyāyanti manasā nityaṃ nityāṃ matvā sanātanīm || 47 || tasmācchaktiḥ sadā sevyā vidvadbhiḥ kṛtaniścayaiḥ | niścayaḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ jñātavyo munisattamāḥ || 48 || kṛṣṇācchrutaṃ mayā caitattena jñātaṃ tu nāradāt | pituḥ sakāśāttenāpi brahmaṇā viṣṇuvākyataḥ || 49 || na śrotavyaṃ na mantavyamanyeṣāṃ vacanaṃ budhaiḥ | śaktireva sadā sevyā vidvadbhiḥ kṛtaniścayaiḥ || 50 || pratyakṣamapi draṣṭavyamaśaktasya viceṣṭitam | ataḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu jñātavyā śaktireva hi || 51 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe ārādhyanirṇayavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <1.9> harikṛtamadhukaiṭabhavadhavarṇanam sūta uvāca yadā vinirgatā nidrā dehāttasya jagadguroḥ | netrāsyanāsikābāhuhṛdayebhyastathorasaḥ || 1 || niḥsṛtya gagane tasthau tāmasī śaktiruttamā | udatiṣṭhajjagannātho jṛmbhamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 2 || tadāpaśyat sthitaṃ tatra bhayatrastaṃ prajāpatim | uvāca ca mahātejā meghagambhīrayā girā || 3 || viṣṇuruvāca kimāgato'si bhagavaṃstapastyaktvātra padmaja | kasmāccintāturo'si tvaṃ bhayākulitamānasaḥ || 4 || brahmovāca tvatkarṇamalajau deva daityau ca madhukaiṭabhau | hantuṃ māṃ samupāyātau ghorarūpau mahābalau || 5 || bhayāttayoḥ samāyātastvatsamīpaṃ jagatpate | trāhi māṃ vāsudevādya bhayatrastaṃ vicetanam || 6 || viṣṇuruvāca tiṣṭhādya nirbhayo jātastau haniṣyāmyahaṃ kila | yuddhāyājagmaturmūḍhau matsamīpaṃ gatāyuṣau || 7 || sūta uvāca evaṃ vadati deveśe dānavau tau mahābalau | vicinvānāvajaṃ cobhau saṃprāptau madagarvitau || 8 || nirādhārau jale tatra saṃsthitau vigatajvarau | tāvūcaturmadonmattau brahmāṇaṃ munisattamāḥ || 9 || palāyitvā samāyātaḥ sannidhāvasya kiṃ tataḥ | yuddhaṃ kuru haniṣyāvaḥ paśyato'syaiva sannidhau || 10 || paścādenaṃ haniṣyāvaḥ sarpabhogoparisthitam | tvamadya kuru saṃgrāmaṃ dāso'smīti ca vā vada || 11 || sūta uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viṣṇustāvuvāca janārdanaḥ | kurutaṃ samaraṃ kāmaṃ mayā dānavapuṅgavau || 12 || hariṣyāmi madaṃ cāhaṃ yuvayormattayoḥ kila | āgacchataṃ mahābhāgau śraddhā cedvāṃ mahābalau || 13 || sūta uvāca śrutvā tadvacanaṃ cobhau krodhavyākulalocanau | nirādhārau jalasthau ca yuddhodyuktau babhūvatuḥ || 14 || madhuśca kupitastatra hariṇā saha saṃyugam | kartuṃ pracalitastūrṇaṃ kaiṭabhastu tathā sthitaḥ || 15 || bāhuyuddhaṃ tayorāsīnmallayoriva mattayoḥ | śrānte madhau kaiṭabhastu saṃgrāmamakarottadā || 16 || punarmadhuḥ kaiṭabhaśca yuyudhāte punaḥ punaḥ | bāhuyuddhena rāgāndhau viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 17 || prekṣakastu tadā brahmā devī caivāntarikṣagā | na mamlatustadā tau tu viṣṇustu glānimāptavān || 18 || pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi yadā jātāni yuddhyatā | hariṇā cintitaṃ tatra kāraṇaṃ maraṇe tayoḥ || 19 || pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi mayā yuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ kila | na śrāntau dānavau ghorau śrānto'haṃ caitadadbhutam || 20 || kva gataṃ me balaṃ śauryaṃ kasmāccemāvanāmayau | kimatra kāraṇaṃ cintyaṃ vicārya manasā tviha || 21 || iti cintāparaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ harṣaparāvubhau | ūcatustau madonmattau meghamambhīraniḥsvanau || 22 || tava nocedbalaṃ viṣṇo yadi śrānto'si yuddhataḥ | brūhi dāso'smi vāṃ nūnaṃ kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim || 23 || na cedyuddhaṃ kuruṣvādya samartho'si mahāmate | hatvā tvāṃ nihaniṣyāvaḥ puruṣaṃ ca caturmukham || 24 || sūta uvāca śrutvā tadbhāṣitaṃ viṣṇustayostasminmahodadhau | uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ sāmapūrvaṃ mahāmanāḥ || 25 || hariruvāca śrānte bhīte tyaktaśastre patite bālake tathā | praharanti na vīrāste dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ || 26 || pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ mayā tviha | eko'haṃ bhrātarau vāṃ ca balinau sadṛśau tathā || 27 || kṛtaṃ viśramaṇaṃ madhye yuvābhyāṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ | tathā viśramaṇaṃ kṛtvā yudhye'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 28 || tiṣṭhataṃ hi yuvāṃ tāvadbalavantau madotkaṭau | viśramyāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yuddhaṃ vā nyāyamārgataḥ || 29 || sūta uvāca iti śrutvā vacastasya viśrabdhau dānavottamau | saṃsthitau dūratastatra saṃgrāme kṛtaniścayau || 30 || atidūre ca tau dṛṣṭvā vāsudevaścaturbhujaḥ | dadhyau ca manasā tatra kāraṇaṃ maraṇe tayoḥ || 31 || cintanājjñānamutpannaṃ devīdattavarāvubhau | kāmaṃ vāñchitamaraṇau na mamlaturatastvimau || 32 || vṛthā mayā kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ śramo'yaṃ me vṛthā gataḥ | karomi ca kathaṃ yuddhamevaṃ jñātvā viniścayam || 33 || akṛte ca tathā yuddhe kathametau gamiṣyataḥ | vināśaṃ duḥkhadau nityaṃ dānavau varadarpitau || 34 || bhagavatyā varo dattastayā so'pi ca durghaṭaḥ | maraṇaṃ cecchayā kāmaṃ duḥkhito'pi na vāñchati || 35 || rogagrasto'pi dīno'pi na mumūrṣati kaścana | kathaṃ cemau madonmattau martukāmau bhaviṣyataḥ || 36 || nanvadya śaraṇaṃ yāmi vidyāṃ śaktiṃ sukāmadām | vinā tayā na sidhyanti kāmāḥ samyakprasannayā || 37 || evaṃ sañcintyamānastu gagane saṃsthitāṃ śivām | apaśyadbhagavānviṣṇuryoganidrāṃ manoharām || 38 || kṛtājjalirameyātmā tāṃ ca tuṣṭāva yogavit | vināśārthaṃ tayostatra varadāṃ bhuvaneśvarīm || 39 || viṣṇuruvāca namo devi mahāmāye sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇi | anādinidhane caṇḍi bhuktimuktiprade śive || 40 || na te rūpaṃ vijānāmi saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā | caritrāṇi kuto devi saṃkhyātītāni yāni te || 41 || anubhūto mayā te'dya prabhāvaścātidurghaṭaḥ | yadahaṃ nidrayā līnaḥ sañjāto'smi vicetanaḥ || 42 || brahmaṇā cātiyatnena bodhito'pi punaḥ punaḥ | na prabuddhaḥ sarvathāhaṃ saṅkocitaṣaḍindriyaḥ || 43 || acetanatvaṃ samprāptaḥ prabhāvāttava cāmbike | tvayā muktaḥ prabuddho'haṃ yuddhaṃ ca bahudhā kṛtam || 44 || śrānto'haṃ na ca tau śrāntau tvayā dattavarau varau | brahmāṇaṃ hantumāyātau dānavau madagarvitau || 45 || āhūtau ca mayā kāmaṃ dvandvayuddhāya mānade | kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ mayā tābhyāṃ mahārṇave || 46 || maraṇe varadānaṃ te tato jñātaṃ mahādbhutam | jñātvāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptastvāmadya śaraṇapradām || 47 || sāhāyyaṃ kuru me mātaḥ khinno'haṃ yuddhakarmaṇā | dṛptau tau varadānena tava devārtināśane || 48 || hantuṃ māmudyatau pāpau kiṃ karomi kva yāmi ca | ityuktā sā tadā devī smitapūrvamuvāca ha || 49 || praṇamantaṃ jagannāthaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam | devadeva hare viṣṇo kuru yuddhaṃ punaḥ svayam || 50 || vañcayitvā tvimau śūrau hantavyau ca vimohitau | mohayiṣyāmyahaṃ nūnaṃ dānavau vakrayā dṛśā || 51 || jahi nārāyaṇāśu tvaṃ mama māyāvimohitau | sūta uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viṣṇustasyāḥ prītirasānvitam || 52 || saṃgrāmasthalamāsādya tasthau tatra mahārṇave | tadāyātau ca tau vīrau yuddhakāmau mahābalau || 53 || vīkṣya viṣṇuṃ sthitaṃ tatra harṣayuktau babhūvatuḥ | tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mahākāma kuru yuddhaṃ caturbhuja || 54 || daivādhīnau viditvādya nūnaṃ jayaparājayau | sabalo jayamāpnoti daivājjayati durbalaḥ || 55 || sarvathaiva na kartavyau harṣaśokau mahātmanā | purā vai bahavo daityā jitā dānavavairiṇā || 56 || adhunā cāvayoḥ sārdhaṃ yudhyamānaḥ parājitaḥ | sūta uvāca ityuktvā tau mahābāhū yuddhāya samupasthitau || 57 || vīkṣya viṣṇurjaghānāśu muṣṭinādbhutakarmaṇā | tāvapyatibalonmattau jadhnaturmuṣṭinā harim || 58 || evaṃ parasparaṃ jātaṃ yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam | yudhyamānau mahāvīryau dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇastadā || 59 || apaśyatsammukhaṃ devyāḥ kṛtvā dīnāṃ dṛśaṃ hariḥ | sūta uvāca taṃ vīkṣya tādṛśaṃ viṣṇuṃ karuṇārasasaṃyutam || 60 || jahāsātīva tāmrākṣī vīkṣamāṇā tadāsurau | tau jaghāna kaṭākṣaiśca kāmabāṇairivāparaiḥ || 61 || mandasmitayutaiḥ kāmaṃ premabhāvayutairanu | dṛṣṭvā mumuhatuḥ pāpau devyā vakravilokanam || 62 || viśeṣamiti manvānau kāmabāṇātipīḍitau | vīkṣamāṇau sthitau tatra tāṃ devīṃ viśadaprabhām || 63 || hariṇāpi ca taddṛṣṭaṃ devyāstatra cikīrṣitam | mohitau tau parijñāya bhagavānkāryavittamaḥ || 64 || uvāca tau hasan ślakṣṇaṃ meghagambhīrayā girā | varaṃ varayatāṃ vīrau yuvayoryo'bhivācchitaḥ || 65 || dadāmi paramaprīto yuddhena yuvayoḥ kila | dānavā bahavo dṛṣṭā yudhyamānā mayā purā || 66 || yuvayoḥ sadṛśaḥ ko'pi na dṛṣṭo na ca vai śrutaḥ | tasmāttuṣṭo'smi kāmaṃ vai nistulena balena ca || 67 || bhrātrośca vāñchitaṃ kāmaṃ prayacchāmi mahābalau | sūta uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sābhimānau smarāturau || 68 || vīkṣamāṇau mahāmāyāṃ jagadānandakāriṇīm | tamūcatuśca kāmārtau viṣṇuṃ kamalalocanau || 69 || hare na yācakāvāvāṃ tvaṃ kiṃ dātumihecchasi | dadāva tulyaṃ deveśa dātārau nau na yācakau || 70 || prārthaya tvaṃ hṛṣīkeśa mano'bhilaṣitaṃ varam | tuṣṭau svastava yuddhena vāsudevādbhutena ca || 71 || tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca janārdanaḥ | bhavetāmadya me tuṣṭau mama vadhyāvubhāvapi || 72 || sūta uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viṣṇordānavau cātivismitau | vañcitāviti manvānau tasthatuḥ śokasaṃyutau || 73 || vicārya manasā tau tu dānavau viṣṇumūcatuḥ | prekṣya sarvaṃ jalamayaṃ bhūmiṃ sthalavivarjitām || 74 || hare yo'yaṃ varo dattastvayā pūrvaṃ janārdana | satyavāgasi deveśa dehi taṃ vāñchitaṃ varam || 75 || nirjale vipule deśe hanasva madhusūdana | vadhyāvāvāṃ tu bhavataḥ satyavāgbhava mādhava || 76 || smṛtvā cakraṃ tadā viṣṇustāvuvāca hasanhariḥ | hanmyadya vāṃ mahābhāgau nirjale vipule sthale || 77 || ityuktyā devadeveśa ūrū kṛtvātivistarau | darśayāmāsa tau tatra nirjalaṃ ca jalopari || 78 || nāstyatra dānavau vāri śirasī muñcatāmiha | satyavāgahamadyaiva bhaviṣyāmi ca vāṃ tathā || 79 || tadākarṇya vacastathyaṃ vicintya manasā ca tau | vardhayāmāsaturdehaṃ yojanānāṃ sahasrakam || 80 || bhagavāndviguṇaṃ cakre jaghanaṃ vismitau tadā | śīrṣe sandadhatāṃ tatra jaghane paramādbhute || 81 || rathāṃgena tadā chinne viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | jaghanopari vegena prakṛṣṭe śirasī tayoḥ || 82 || gataprāṇau tadā jātau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau | sāgaraḥ sakalo vyāptastadā vai medasā tayoḥ || 83 || medinīti tato jātaṃ nāma pṛthvyāḥ samantataḥ | abhakṣyā mṛttikā tena kāraṇena munīśvarāḥ || 84 || iti vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi suniścitam | mahāvidyā mahāmāyā sevanīyā sadā budhaiḥ || 85 || ārādhyā paramā śaktiḥ sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ | nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcidadhikaṃ bhuvanatraye || 86 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ vedaśāstrārthanirṇayaḥ | pūjanīyā parā śaktirnirguṇā saguṇāthavā || 87 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe harikṛtamadhukaiṭabhavadhavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <1.10> śivavaradānavarṇanam ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sūta pūrvaṃ tvayā proktaṃ vyāsenāmitatejasā | kṛtvā purāṇamakhilaṃ śukāyādhyāpitaṃ śubham || 1 || vyāsena tu tapastaptvā kathamutpāditaḥ śukaḥ | vistaraṃ brūhi sakalaṃ yacchrutaṃ kṛṣṇatastvayā || 2 || sūta uvāca pravakṣyāmi śukotpattiṃ vyāsātsatyavatīsutāt | yathotpannaḥ śukaḥ sākṣādyogināṃ pravaro muniḥ || 3 || meruśṛṅge mahāramye vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | tapaścacāra so'tyugraṃ putrārthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ || 4 || japannekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ vāgbījaṃ nāradācchrutam | dhyāyanparāṃ mahāmāyāṃ putrakāmastaponidhiḥ || 5 || agnerbhūmestathā vāyorantarikṣasya cāpyayam | vīryeṇa sammitaḥ putro mama bhūyāditi sma ha || 6 || atiṣṭhatsa gatāhāraḥ śatasaṃvatsaraṃ prabhuḥ | ārādhayanmahādevaṃ tathaiva ca sadāśivām || 7 || śaktiḥ sarvatra pūjyeti vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ | aśakto nindyate loke śaktastu paripūjyate || 8 || yatra parvataśṛṅge vai karṇikāravanādbhute | krīḍanti devatāḥ sarve munayaśca tapo'dhikāḥ || 9 || ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaścāśvinau tathā | vasanti munayo yatra ye cānye brahmavittamāḥ || 10 || tatra hemagireḥ śṛṅge saṃgītadhvaninādite | tapaścacāra dharmātmā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ || 11 || tato'sya tejasā vyāptaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram | agnivarṇā jaṭā jātā pārāśaryasya dhīmataḥ || 12 || tato'sya teja ālakṣya bhayamāpa śacīpatiḥ | turāsāhaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā bhayatrastaṃ śramāturam || 13 || uvāca bhagavān rudro maghavantaṃ tathāsthitam | śaṅkara uvāca kathamindrādya bhīto'si kiṃ duḥkhaṃ te sureśvara || 14 || amarṣo naiva kartavyastāpaseṣu kadācana | tapaścaranti munayo jñātvā māṃ śaktisaṃyutam || 15 || na tvete'hitamicchanti tāpasāḥ sarvathaiva hi | ityuktavacanaḥ śakrastamuvāca vṛṣadhvajam || 16 || kasmāttapasyati vyāsaḥ ko'rthastasya manogataḥ | śiva uvāca pārāśaryastu putrārthī tapaścarati duścaram || 17 || pūrṇavarṣaśataṃ jātaṃ dadāmyadya sutaṃ śubham | sūta uvāca ityuktyā vāsavaṃ rudro dayayā muditānanaḥ || 18 || gatvā ṛṣisamīpaṃ tu tamuvāca jagadguruḥ | uttiṣṭha vāsavīputra putraste bhavitā śubhaḥ || 19 || sarvatejomayo jñānī kīrtikartā tavānagha | akhilasya janasyātra vallabhaste sutaḥ sadā || 20 || bhaviṣyati guṇaiḥ pūrṇaḥ sāttvikaiḥ satyavikramaḥ | sūta uvāca tadākarṇya vacaḥ ślakṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastadā || 21 || śūlapāṇiṃ namaskṛtya jagāmāśramamātmanaḥ | sa gatvāśramamevāśu bahuvarṣaśramāturaḥ || 22 || araṇīsahitaṃ guhyaṃ mamanthāgniṃ cikīrṣayā | manthanaṃ kurvatastasya citte cintābharastadā || 23 || prādurbabhūva sahasā sutotpattau mahātmanaḥ | manthānāraṇisaṃyogānmanthanācca samudbhavaḥ || 24 || pāvakasya yathā tadvatkathaṃ me syātsutodbhavaḥ | putrāraṇistu yā khyātā sā mamādya na vidyate || 25 || taruṇī rūpasampannā kulotpantā pativratā | kathaṃ karomi kāntāṃ ca pādayoḥ śṛṅkhalāsamām || 26 || putrotpādanadakṣāṃ ca pātivratye sadā sthitām | pativratāpi dakṣāpi rūpavatyapi kāminī || 27 || sadā bandhanarūpā ca svecchāsukhavidhāyinī | śivo'pi vartate nityaṃ kāminīpāśasaṃyutaḥ || 28 || kathaṃ karomyahaṃ cātra durghaṭaṃ ca gṛhāśramam | evaṃ cintayatastasya ghṛtācī divyarūpiṇī || 29 || prāptā dṛṣṭipathaṃ tatra samīpe gagane sthitā | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cañcalāpāṅgīṃ samīpasthāṃ varāpsarām || 30 || pañcabāṇaparītāṅgastūrṇamāsīddhṛtavrataḥ | cintayāmāsa ca tadā kiṃ karomyadya saṃkaṭe || 31 || dharmasya purataḥ prāpte kāmabhāve durāsade | aṅgīkaromi yadyenāṃ vañcanārthamihāgatām || 32 || hasiṣyanti mahātmānastāpasā māṃ tu vihvalam | tapastaptvā mahāghoraṃ pūrṇavarṣaśataṃ tviha || 33 || dṛṣṭvāpsarāṃ ca vivaśaḥ kathaṃ jāto mahātapāḥ | kāmaṃ nindāpi bhavatu yadi syādatulaṃ sukham || 34 || gṛhasthāśramasambhūtaṃ sukhadaṃ putrakāmadam | svargadaṃ ca tathā proktaṃ jñānināṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || 35 || na bhaviṣyati tannūmanayā devakanyayā | nāradācca mayā pūrvaṃ śrutamasti kathānakam | yathorvaśīvaśo rājā parābhūtaḥ purūravāḥ || 36 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāyurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe śivavaradānavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <1.11> budhotpattiḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ko'sau purūravā rājā korvaśī devakanyakā | kathaṃ kaṣṭaṃ ca samprāptaṃ tena rājñā mahātmanā || 1 || sarvaṃ kathānakaṃ brūhi lomaharṣaṇajādhunā | śrotukāmā vayaṃ sarve tvanmukhābjacyutaṃ rasam || 2 || amṛtādapi miṣṭā te vāṇī sūta rasātmikā | na tṛpyāmo vayaṃ sarve sudhayā ca yathāmarāḥ || 3 || sūta uvāca śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve kathāṃ divyāṃ manoramām | vakṣyāmyahaṃ yathābuddhyā śrutāṃ vyāsavarottamāt || 4 || gurostu dayitā bhāryā tārā nāmeti viśrutā | rūpayauvanayuktā sā cārvaṅgī madavihvalā || 5 || gataikadā vidhordhāma yajamānasya bhāminī | dṛṣṭā ca śaśinātyarthaṃ rūpayauvanaśālinī || 6 || kāmāturastadā jātaḥ śaśī śaśimukhīṃ prati | sāpi vīkṣya vidhuṃ kāmaṃ jātā madanapīḍitā || 7 || tāvanyonyaṃ premayuktau smarārtau ca babhūvatuḥ | tārā śaśī madonmattau kāmabāṇaprapīḍitau || 8 || remāte madamattau tau parasparaspṛhānvitau | dināni katicittatra jātāni ramamāṇayoḥ || 9 || bṛhaspatistu duḥkhārtastārāmānayituṃ gṛham | preṣayāmāsa śiṣyaṃ tu nāyātā sā vaśīkṛtā || 10 || punaḥ punaryadā śiṣyaṃ parāvartata candramāḥ | bṛhaspatistadā kruddho jagāma svayameva hi || 11 || gatvā somagṛhaṃ tatra vācaspatirudāradhīḥ | uvāca śaśinaṃ kruddhaḥ smayamānaṃ madānvitam || 12 || kiṃ kṛtaṃ kila śītāṃśo karma dharmavigarhitam | rakṣitā mama bhāryeyaṃ sundarī kena hetunā || 13 || tava deva guruścāhaṃ yajamāno'si sarvathā | gurubhāryā kathaṃ mūḍha bhuktā kiṃ rakṣitāthavā || 14 || brahmahā hemahārī ca surāpo gurutalpagaḥ | mahāpātakino hyete tatsaṃsargī ca pañcamaḥ || 15 || mahāpātakayuktastvaṃ durācāro'tigarhitaḥ | na devasadanārho'si yadi bhukteyamaṅganā || 16 || muñcemāmasitāpāṅgīṃ nayāmi sadanaṃ mama | nocedvakṣyāmi duṣṭātman gurudārāpahāriṇam || 17 || ityevaṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ tamuvāca rohiṇīpatiḥ | guruṃ krodhasamāyuktaṃ kāntāvirahaduḥkhitam || 18 || induruvāca krodhātte tu durārādhyā brāhmaṇāḥ krodhavarjitāḥ | pūjārhā dharmaśāstrajñā varjanīyāstato'nyathā || 19 || āgamiṣyati sā kāmaṃ gṛhaṃ te varavarṇinī | atraiva saṃsthitā bālā kā te hānirihānagha || 20 || icchayā saṃsthitā cātra sukhakāmārthinī hi sā | dināni katicitsthitvā svecchayā cāgamiṣyati || 21 || tvayaivodāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ dharmaśāstramataṃ tathā | na strī duṣyati cāreṇa na vipro vedakarmaṇā || 22 || ityuktaḥ śaśinā tatra gururatyantaduḥkhitaḥ | jagāma svagṛhaṃ tūrṇaṃ cintāviṣṭaḥ smarāturaḥ || 23 || dināni katicittatra sthitvā cintāturo guruḥ | yayāvatha gṛhaṃ tasya tvaritaścauṣadhīpateḥ || 24 || sthitaḥ kṣatrā niṣiddho'sau dvāradeśe ruṣānvitaḥ | nājagāma śaśī tatra cukopāti bṛhaspatiḥ || 25 || ayaṃ me śiṣyatāṃ yāto gurupatnīṃ tu mātaram | jagrāha balato'dharmī śikṣaṇīyo mayādhunā || 26 || uvāca vācaṃ kopāttu dvāradeśasthito bahiḥ | kiṃ śeṣe bhavane manda pāpācāra surādhama || 27 || dehi me kāminīṃ śīghraṃ nocecchāpaṃ dadāmyaham | karomi bhasmasānnūnaṃ na dadāsi priyāṃ mama || 28 || sūta uvāca krūrāṇi caivamādīni bhāṣaṇāni bṛhaspateḥ | śrutvā dvijapatiḥ śīghraṃ nirgataḥ sadanādbahiḥ || 29 || tamuvāca hasansomaḥ kimidaṃ bahu bhāṣase | na te yogyāsitāpāṅgī sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || 30 || kurūpāṃ ca svasadṛśīṃ gṛhāṇānyāṃ striyaṃ dvija | bhikṣukasya gṛhe yogyā nedṛśī varavarṇinī || 31 || ratiḥ svasadṛśe kānte nāryāḥ kila nigadyate | tvaṃ na jānāsi mandātman kāmaśāstravinirṇayam || 32 || yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha durbuddhe nāhaṃ dāsyāmi kāminīm | yacchakyaṃ kuru tatkāmaṃ na deyā varavarṇinī || 33 || kāmārtasya ca te śāpo na māṃ bādhitumarhati | nāhaṃ dade guro kāntāṃ yathecchasi tathā kuru || 34 || sūta uvāca ityuktaḥ śaśinā cejyaścintāmāpa ruṣānvitaḥ | jagāma tarasā sadma krodhayuktaḥ śacīpateḥ || 35 || dṛṣṭvā śatakratustatra guruṃ duḥkhāturaṃ sthitam | pādyārghyācamanīyādyaiḥ pūjayitvā susaṃsthitaḥ || 36 || papraccha paramodārastaṃ tathāvasthitaṃ gurum | kā cintā te mahābhāga śokārto'si mahāmune || 37 || kenāpamānito'si tvaṃ mama rājye guruśca me | tvadadhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ sainyaṃ lokādhipaiḥ saha || 38 || bahmā viṣṇustathā śambhurye cānye devasattamāḥ | kariṣyanti ca sāhāyyaṃ kā cintā vada sāmpratam || 39 || gururuvāca śaśināpahṛtā bhāryā tārā mama sulocanā | na dadāti sa duṣṭātmā prārthito'pi punaḥ punaḥ || 40 || kiṃ karomi sureśāna tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama | sāhāyyaṃ kuru deveśa duḥkhito'smi śatakrato || 41 || indra uvāca mā śokaṃ kuru dharmajña dāso'smi tava suvrata | ānayiṣyāmyahaṃ nūnaṃ bhāryāṃ tava mahāmate || 42 || preṣite cenmayā dūte na dāsyati madākulaḥ | tato yuddhaṃ kariṣyāmi devasainyaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || 43 || ityāśvāsya guruṃ śakro dūtaṃ vaktṛvicakṣaṇam | preṣayāmāsa somāya vārtāśaṃsinamadbhutam || 44 || sa gatvā śaśilokaṃ tu tvaritaḥ suvicakṣaṇaḥ | uvāca vacanenaiva vacanaṃ rohiṇīpatim || 45 || preṣito'haṃ mahābhāga śakreṇa tvāṃ vivakṣayā | kathitaṃ prabhuṇā yacca tadbravīmi mahāmate || 46 || dharmajño'si mahābhāga nītiṃ jānāsi suvrata | atriḥ pitā te dharmātmā na nidyaṃ kartumarhasi || 47 || bhāryā rakṣyā sarvabhūtairyathāśakti hyatandritaiḥ | tadarthe kalahaḥ kāmaṃ bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || yathā tava tathā tasya yatnaḥ syāddārarakṣaṇe | ātmavatsarvabhūtāni cintaya tvaṃ sudhānidhe || 49 || aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāste kāminyo dakṣajāḥ śubhāḥ | gurupatnīṃ kathaṃ bhoktuṃ tvamicchasi sudhānidhe || 50 || svarge sadā vasantyetā menakādyā manoramāḥ | bhuṃkṣva tāḥ svecchayā kāmaṃ muñca patnīṃ gurorapi || 51 || īśvarā yadi kurvanti jugupsitamahantayā | ajñāstadanuvartante tadā dharmakṣayo bhavet || 52 || tasmānmuñca mahābhāga guroḥ patnīṃ manoramām | kalahastvannimitto'dya surāṇāṃ na bhavedyathā || 53 || sūta uvāca somaḥ śakravacaḥ śrutvā kiñcitkrodhasamākulaḥ | bhaṅgyā prativacaḥ prāha śakradūtaṃ tadā śaśī || 54 || indurāvāca dharmajño'si mahābāho devānāmadhipaḥ svayam | purodhāpi ca te tādṛgyuvayoḥ sadṛśī matiḥ || 55 || paropadeśe kuśalā bhavanti bahavo janāḥ | durlabhastu svayaṃ kartā prāpte karmaṇi sarvadā || 56 || bārhaspatyapraṇītaṃ ca śāstraṃ gṛhṇanti mānavāḥ | ko virodho'tra deveśa kāmayānāṃ bhajanstriyam || 57 || svakīyaṃ balināṃ sarvaṃ durbalānāṃ na kiñcana | svīyā ca parakīyā ca bhramo'yaṃ mandacetasām || 58 || tārā mayyanuraktā ca yathā na tu tathā gurau | anuraktā kathaṃ tyājyā dharmato nyāyatastathā || 59 || gṛhārambhastu raktāyāṃ viraktāyāṃ kathaṃ bhavet | virakteyaṃ yadā jātā cakame'nujakāminīm || 60 || na dāsye'haṃ varārohāṃ gaccha dūta vada svayam | īśvaro'si sahasrākṣa yadicchasi kuruṣva tat || 61 || sūta uvāca ityuktaḥ śaśinā dūtaḥ prayayau śakrasannidhim | indrāyācaṣṭa tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ śītaraśminā || 62 || turāṣāḍapi tacchrutvā krodhayukto babhūva ha | senodyogaṃ tathā cakre sāhāyyārthaṃ gurorvibhuḥ || 63 || śukrastu vigrahaṃ śrutvā gurudveṣāttato yayau | mā dadasveti taṃ vākyamuvāca śaśinaṃ prati || 64 || sāhāyyaṃ te kariṣyāmi mantraśaktyā mahāmate | bhavitā yadi saṃgrāmastava cendreṇa māriṣa || 65 || śaṅkarastu tadākarṇya gurudārābhimarśanam | guruśatruṃ bhṛguṃ matvā sāhāyyamakarottadā || 66 || saṃgrāmastu tadā vṛtto devadānavayordrutam | bahūni tatra varṣāṇi tārakāsuravatkila || 67 || devāsurakṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra pitāmahaḥ | haṃsārūḍho jagāmāśu taṃ deśaṃ kleśaśāntaye || 68 || rākāpatiṃ tadā prāha muñca bhāryāṃ guroriti | nocedviṣṇuṃ samāhūya kariṣyāmi tu saṃkṣayam || 69 || bhṛguṃ nivārayāmāsa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | kimanyāyamatirjātā saṅgadoṣānmahāmate || 70 || niṣedhayāmāsa tato bhṛgustaṃ cauṣadhīpatim | muñca bhāryāṃ guroradya pitrāhaṃ preṣitastava || 71 || sūta uvāca dvijarājastu tacchrutvā bhṛgorvacanamadbhutam | dadau ca tatpriyāṃ bhāryāṃ gurorgarbhavatīṃ śubhām || 72 || prāpya kāntāṃ gururhṛṣṭaḥ svagṛhaṃ mudito yayau | tato devāstato daityā yayuḥ svānsvāngṛhānprati || 73 || brahmā svasadanaṃ prāptaḥ kailāsaṃ cāpi śaṅkaraḥ | bṛhaspatistu santuṣṭaḥ prāpya bhāryāṃ manoramām || 74 || tataḥ kālena kiyatā tārāsūta sutaṃ śubham | sudine śubhanakṣatre tārāpatisamaṃ guṇaiḥ || 75 || dṛṣṭvā putraṃ gururjātaṃ cakāra vidhipūrvakam | jātakarmādikaṃ sarvaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 76 || śrutaṃ candramasā janma putrasya munisattamāḥ | dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa guruṃ prati mahāmatiḥ || 77 || na cāyaṃ tava putro'sti mama vīryasamudbhavaḥ | kathaṃ tvaṃ kṛtavānkāmaṃ jātakarmādikaṃ vidhim || 78 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya dūtasya ca bṛhaspatiḥ | uvāca mama putro me sadṛśo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 79 || punarvivādaḥ sañjāto militā devadānavāḥ | yuddhārthamāgatāsteṣāṃ samājaḥ samajāyata || 80 || tatrāgataḥ svayaṃ brahmā śāntikāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ | nivārayāmāsa mukhe saṃsthitānyuddhadurmadān || 81 || tārāṃ papraccha dharmātmā kasyāyaṃ tanayaḥ śubhe | satyaṃ vada varārohe yathā kleśaḥ praśāmyati || 82 || tamuvācāsitāpāṅgī lajjamānāpyadhomukhī | candrasyeti śanairantarjagāma varavarṇinī || 83 || jagrāha taṃ sutaṃ somaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā | nāma cakre budha iti jagāma svagṛhaṃ punaḥ || 84 || yayau brahmā svakaṃ dhāma sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ | yathāgataṃ gataṃ sarvaiḥ sarvaśaḥ prekṣakairjanaiḥ || 85 || kathiteyaṃ budhotpattirgurukṣetre ca somataḥ | yathā śrutā mayā pūrvaṃ vyāsātsatyavatīsutāt || 86 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe budhotpattirnāmekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <1.12> sudyumnastutiḥ sūta uvāca tataḥ purūravā jajñe ilāyāṃ kathayāmi vaḥ | budhaputro'tidharmātmā yajñakṛddānatatparaḥ || 1 || sudyumno nāma bhūpālaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ | saindhavaṃ hayamāruhya cacāra mṛgayāṃ vane || 2 || yutaḥ katipayāmātyairdarśitaścārukuṇḍalaḥ | dhanurājagavaṃ baddhvā bāṇasaṅghaṃ tathādbhutam || 3 || sa bhramaṃstadvanoddeśe hanyamāno rurūnmṛgān | śaśāṃśca sūkarāṃścaiva khaḍgāṃśca gavayāṃstathā || 4 || śarabhānmahiṣāṃścaiva sāmbharānvanakukkuṭān | nighnanmedhyān paśūn rājā kumāravanamāviśat || 5 || meroradhastale divyaṃ mandāradrumarājitam | aśokalatikākīrṇaṃ bakulairadhivāsitam || 6 || sālaistālaistamālaiśca campakaiḥ panasaistathā | āmrairnīpairmadhūkaiśca mādhavīmaṇḍapāvṛtam || 7 || dāḍimairnārikelaiśca kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam | yūthikāmālatīkundapuṣpavallīsamāvṛtam || 8 || haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ kīcakadhvanināditam | bhramarālirutārāmaṃ vanaṃ sarvasukhāvaham || 9 || dṛṣṭvā pramudito rājā sudyumnaḥ sevakairvṛtaḥ | vṛkṣānsupuṣpitānvīkṣya kokilārāvamaṇḍitān || 10 || praviṣṭastatra rājarṣiḥ strītvamāpa kṣaṇāttataḥ | aśvo'pi vaḍavā jātaścintāviṣṭaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ || 11 || kimetaditi cintārtaścintyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | duḥkhaṃ bahutaraṃ prāptaḥ sudyumno lajjayānvitaḥ || 12 || kiṃ karomi kathaṃ yāmi gṛhaṃ strībhāvasaṃyutaḥ | kathaṃ rājyaṃ kariṣyāmi kena vā vañcito hyaham || 13 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sūtāścaryamidaṃ proktaṃ tvayā yallomaharṣaṇa | sudyumnaḥ strītvamāpanno bhūpatirdevasannibhaḥ || 14 || kiṃ tatkāraṇamācakṣva vane tatra manohare | kiṃ kṛtaṃ tena rājñā ca vistaraṃ vada suvrata || 15 || sūta uvāca ekadā giriśaṃ draṣṭumṛṣayaḥ sanakādayaḥ | diśo vitimirābhāsāḥ kurvantaḥ samupāgaman || 16 || tasmiṃśca samaye tatra śaṅkaraḥ pramadāyutaḥ | krīḍāsakto mahādevo vivastrā kāminī śivā || 17 || utsaṅge saṃsthitā bhartū ramamāṇā manoramā | tānvilokyāmbikā devī vivastrā vrīḍitā bhṛśam || 18 || bharturaṅkātsamutthāya vastramādāya paryadhāt | lajjāviṣṭā sthitā tatra vepamānātimāninī || 19 || ṛṣayo'pi tayorvīkṣya prasaṅgaṃ ramamāṇayoḥ | parivṛtya yayustūrṇaṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam || 20 || hrīyutāṃ kāminīṃ vīkṣya provāca bhagavānharaḥ | kathaṃ lajjāturāsi tvaṃ sukhaṃ te prakaromyaham || 21 || adyaprabhṛti yo mohātpumānko'pi varānane | vanaṃ ca praviśedetatsa vai yoṣidbhaviṣyati || 22 || iti śaptaṃ vanaṃ tena ye jānanti janāḥ kvacit | varjayantīha te kāmaṃ vanaṃ doṣasamṛddhimat || 23 || sudyumnastu tadajñānātpraviṣṭaḥ sacivaiḥ saha | tathaiva strītvamāpannastaiḥ saheti na saṃśayaḥ || 24 || cintāviṣṭaḥ sa rājarṣirna jagāma gṛhaṃ hriyā | vicacāra bahistasmādvanadeśāditastataḥ || 25 || ileti nāma samprāptaṃ strītve tena mahātmanā | vicaraṃstatra samprāpto budhaḥ somasuto yuvā || 26 || strībhiḥ parivṛtāṃ tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā kāntāṃ manoramām | hāvabhāvakalāyuktāṃ cakame bhagavāmbudhaḥ || 27 || sāpi taṃ cakame kāntaṃ budhaṃ somasutaṃ patim | saṃyogastatra sañjātastayoḥ premṇā parasparam || 28 || sa tasyāṃ janayāmāsa purūravasamātmajam | ilāyāṃ somaputrastu cakravartinamuttamam || 29 || sā prāsūta sutaṃ bālā cintāviṣṭā vane sthitā | sasmāra svakulācāryaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ munisattamam || 30 || sa tadāsya daśāṃ dṛṣṭvā sudyumnasya kṛpānvitaḥ | atoṣayanmahādevaṃ śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram || 31 || tasmai sa bhagavāṃstuṣṭaḥ pradadau vāñchitaṃ varam | vasiṣṭhaḥ prārthayāmāsa puṃstvaṃ rājñaḥ priyasya ca || 32 || śaṅkarastu nijāṃ vācamṛtāṃ kurvannuvāca ha | māsaṃ pumāṃstu bhavitā māsaṃ strī bhūpatiḥ kila || 33 || itthaṃ prāpya varaṃ rājā jagāma svagṛhaṃ punaḥ | cakre rājyaṃ sa dharmātmā vasiṣṭhasyāpyanugrahāt || 34 || strītve tiṣṭhati harmyeṣu puṃstve rājyaṃ praśāsti ca | prajāstasminsamudvignā nābhyanandanmahīpatim || 35 || kāle tu yauvanaṃ prāptaḥ putraḥ purūravāstadā | pratiṣṭhāṃ nṛpatistasmai dattvā rājyaṃ vanaṃ yayau || 36 || gatvā tasminvane ramye nānādrumasamākule | nāradānmantramāsādya navākṣaramanuttamam || 37 || jajāpa mantramatyarthaṃ premapūritamānasaḥ | parituṣṭā tadā devī saguṇā tāriṇī śivā || 38 || siṃhārūḍhā sthitā cāgre divyarūpā manoramā | vāruṇīpānasammattā madāghūrṇitalocanā || 39 || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ divyarūpāṃ ca premākulitalocanaḥ | praṇamya śirasā prītyā tuṣṭāva jagadambikām || 40 || ilovāca divyaṃ ca te bhagavati prathitaṃ svarūpaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayā sakalalokahitānurūpam | vande tvadaṃghrikamalaṃ surasaṅghasevyaṃ kāmapradaṃ janani cāpi vimuktidaṃ ca || 41 || ko vetti te'mba bhuvi martyatanurnikāmaṃ muhyanti yatra munayaśca surāśca sarve | aiśvaryametadakhilaṃ kṛpaṇe dayāṃ ca dṛṣṭvaiva devi sakalaṃ kila vismayo me || 42 || śambhurhariḥ kamalajo maghavā raviśca vitteśavahnivaruṇāḥ pavanaśca somaḥ | jānanti naiva vasavo'pi hi te prabhāvaṃ budhyetkathaṃ tava guṇānaguṇo manuṣyaḥ || 43 || jānāti viṣṇuramitadyutiramba sākṣāttvāṃ sāttvikīmudadhijāṃ sakalārthadāṃ ca | ko rājasīṃ hara umāṃ kila tāmasīṃ tvāṃ vedāmbike na tu punaḥ khalu nirguṇāṃ tvām || 44 || kvāhaṃ sumandamatirapratimaprabhāvaḥ kvāyaṃ tavātinipuṇo mayi suprasādaḥ | jāne bhavāni caritaṃ karuṇāsametaṃ yatsevakāṃśca dayase tvayi bhāvayuktān || 45 || vṛttastvayā harirasau vanajeśayāpi naivācaratyapi mudaṃ madhusūdanaśca | pādau tavādipuruṣaḥ kila pāvakena kṛtvā karoti ca kareṇa śubhau pavitrau || 46 || vāñchatyaho hariraśoka ivātikāmaṃ pādāhatiṃ pramuditaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ | tāṃ tvaṃ karoṣi ruṣitā praṇataṃ ca pāde dṛṣṭvā patiṃ sakaladevanutaṃ smarārtam || 47 || vakṣaḥsthale vasasi devi sadaiva tasya paryaṅkavatsucarite vipule'tiśānte | saudāminīva sughane suvibhūṣite ca kiṃ te na vāhanamasau jagadīśvaro'pi || 48 || tvaṃ cejjahāsi madhusūdanamamba kopānnaivārcito'pi sa bhavetkila śaktihīnaḥ | pratyakṣameva puruṣaṃ svajanāstvajanti śāntaṃ śriyojjhitamatīva guṇairviyuktam || 49 || brahmādayaḥ suragaṇā na tu kiṃ yuvatyo ye tvatpadāmbujamaharniśamāśrayanti | manye tvayaiva vihitāḥ khalu te pumāṃsaḥ kiṃ varṇayāmi tava śaktimanantavīrye || 50 || tvaṃ nāpumānna ca pumāniti me vikalpo yākāsi devi saguṇā nanu nirguṇā vā | tāṃ tvāṃ namāmi satataṃ kila bhāvayukto vāñchāmi bhaktimacalāṃ tvayi mātaraṃ tu || 51 || sūta uvāca iti stutvā mahīpālo jagāma śaraṇaṃ tadā | parituṣṭā dadau devī tatra sāyujyamātmani || 52 || sudyumnastu tataḥ prāpa padaṃ paramakaṃ sthiram | tasyā devyāḥ prasādena munīnāmapi durlabham || 53 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ || prathamaskandhe sudyumnastutirnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <1.13> purūravasa urvaśyāśca caritravarṇanam sūta uvāca sudyune tu divaṃ yāte rājyaṃ cakre purūravāḥ | saguṇaśca surūpaśca prajārañjanatatparaḥ || 1 || pratiṣṭhāne pure ramye rājyaṃ sarvanamaskṛtam | cakāra sarvadharmajñaḥ prajārakṣaṇatatparaḥ || 2 || mantraḥ suguptastasyāsītparatrābhijñatā tathā | sadaivotsāhaśaktiśca prabhuśaktistathottamā || 3 || sāmadānādayaḥ sarve vaśagāstasya bhūpateḥ | varṇāśramānsvadharmasthānkurvan rājyaṃ śaśāsa ha || 4 || yajñāṃśca vividhāṃścakre sa rājā bahudakṣiṇān | dānāni ca pavitrāṇi dadāvatha narādhipaḥ || 5 || tasya rūpaguṇaudāryaśīladraviṇavikramān | śrutvorvaśī vaśībhūtā cakame taṃ narādhipam || 6 || brahmaśāpābhitaptā sā mānuṣaṃ lokamāsthitā | guṇinaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ matvā varayāmāsa māninī || 7 || samayaṃ cedṛśaṃ kṛtvā sthitā tatra varāṅganā | etāvuraṇakau rājannyastau rakṣasva mānada || 8 || ghṛtaṃ me bhakṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ nānyatkiñcinnṛpāśanam | nekṣe tvāṃ ca mahārāja nagnamanyatra maithunāt || 9 || bhāṣābandhastvayaṃ rājan yadi bhagno bhaviṣyati | tadā tyaktvā gamiṣyāmi satyametadbravīmyaham || 10 || aṅgīkṛtaṃ ca tadrājñā kāminyā bhāṣitaṃ tu yat | sthitā bhāṣaṇabandhena śāpānugahakāmyayā || 11 || reme tadā sa bhūpālo līno varṣagaṇānbahūn | dharmakarmādikaṃ tyaktvā corvaśyā madamohitaḥ || 12 || ekacittastu sañjātastanmanasko mahīpatiḥ | na śaśāka tayā hīnaḥ kṣaṇamapyatimohitaḥ || 13 || evaṃ varṣagaṇānte tu svargasthaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | urvaśīṃ nāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā gandharvānāha devarāṭ || 14 || urvaśīmānayadhvaṃ bho gandharvāḥ sarva eva hi | hṛtvoraṇau gṛhāttasya bhūpateḥ samaye kila || 15 || urvaśīrahitaṃ sthānaṃ madīyaṃ nātiśobhate | yena kenāpyupāyena tāmānayata kāminīm || 16 || ityuktāste'tha gandharvā viśvāvasupurogamāḥ | tato gatvā mahāgāḍhe tamasi pratyupasthite || 17 || jahrustāvuraṇau devā ramamāṇaṃ vilokya tam | cakrandatustadā tau tu hriyamāṇau vihāyasā || 18 || urvaśī tadupākarṇya kranditaṃ sutayoriva | kupitovāca rājānaṃ samayo'yaṃ kṛto mayā || 19 || naṣṭāhaṃ tava viśvāsāddhṛtau corairmamoraṇau | rājanputrasamāvetau tvaṃ kiṃ śeṣe striyā samaḥ || 20 || hatāsmyahaṃ kunāthena napuṃsā vīramāninā | uraṇau me gatau cādya sadā prāṇapriyau mama || 21 || evaṃ vilapyamānāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā vimohitaḥ | nagna eva yayau tūrṇaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 22 || vidyutprakāśitā tatra gandharvairnṛpaveśmani | nagnabhūtastayā dṛṣṭo bhūpatirgantukāmayā || 23 || tyaktvoraṇau gatāḥ sarve gandharvāḥ pathi pārthivaḥ | nagno jagrāha tau śrānto jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati || 24 || tadorvaśīṃ gatāṃ dṛṣṭvā vilalāpātiduḥkhitaḥ | nagnaṃ vīkṣya patiṃ nārī gatā sā varavarṇinī || 25 || krandansa deśadeśeṣu babhrāma nṛpatiḥ svayam | taccitto vihvalaḥ śocanvivaśaḥ kāmamohitaḥ || 26 || bhramanvai sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ kurukṣetre dadarśa tām | dṛṣṭvā saṃhṛṣṭavadanaḥ prāha sūktaṃ nṛpottamaḥ || 27 || aye jāye tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ghore na tyaktumarhasi | māṃ tvaṃ tvanmanasaṃ kāntaṃ vaśagaṃ cāpyanāgasam || 28 || sa deho'yaṃ patatyatra devi dūraṃ hṛtastvayā | khādantyenaṃ vṛkāḥ kākāstvayā tyaktaṃ varoru yat || 29 || evaṃ vilapamānaṃ taṃ rājānaṃ prāha corvaśī | duḥkhitaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ śrāntaṃ kāmārtaṃ vivaśaṃ bhṛśam || 30 || urvaśyuvāca mūrkho'si nṛpaśārdūla jñānaṃ kutra gataṃ tava | kvāpi sakhyaṃ na ca strīṇāṃ vṛkāṇāmiva pārthiva || 31 || na viśvāso hi kartavyaḥ strīṣu caureṣu pārthivaiḥ | gṛhaṃ gaccha sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva mā viṣāde manaḥ kṛthāḥ || 32 || ityevaṃ bodhito rājā na vivedātimohitaḥ | duḥkhaṃ ca paramaṃ prāptaḥ svairiṇīsnehayantritaḥ || 33 || sūta uvāca iti sarvaṃ samākhyātamurvaśīcaritaṃ mahat | vede vistaritaṃ caitatsaṃkṣepātkathitaṃ mayā || 34 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe purūravasa urvaśyāśca caritravarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <1.14> vyāsena gṛhasthadharmavarṇanam sūta uvāca dṛṣṭvā tāmasitāpāṅgīṃ vyāsaścintāparo'bhavat | kiṃ karomi na me yogyā devakanyeyamapsarāḥ || 1 || evaṃ cintayamānaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā vyāsaṃ tadāpsarāḥ | bhayabhītā hi sañjātā śāpaṃ mā visṛjedayam || 2 || sā kṛtvātha śukīrūpaṃ nirgatā bhayavihvalā | kṛṣṇastu vismayaṃ prāpto vihaṅgīṃ tāṃ vilokayan || 3 || kāmastu dehe vyāsasya darśanādeva saṅgataḥ | mano'tivismitaṃ jātaṃ sarvagātreṣu vismitaḥ || 4 || sa tu dhairyeṇa mahatā nigahṇanmānasaṃ muniḥ | na śaśāka niyantuṃ ca sa vyāsaḥ prasṛtaṃ manaḥ || 5 || bahuśo gṛhyamāṇaṃ ca ghṛtācyā mohitaṃ manaḥ | bhāvitvānnaiva vidhṛtaṃ vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ || 6 || mandhanaṃ kurvatastasya muneragnicikīrṣayā | araṇyāmeva sahasā tasya śukramathāpatat || 7 || so'vicintya tathā pātaṃ mamanthāraṇimeva ca | tasmācchukaḥ samudbhūto vyāsākṛtimanoharaḥ || 8 || vismayaṃ janayanbālaḥ sañjātastadaraṇyajaḥ | yathādhvare samiddho'gnirbhāti havyena dīptimān || 9 || vyāsastu sutamālokya vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ | kimetaditi sañcintya varadānācchivasya vai || 10 || tejorūpī śuko jāto'pyaraṇīgarbhasambhavaḥ | dvitīyo'gnirivātyarthaṃ dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā || 11 || vilokayāmāsa tadā vyāsastu muditaṃ sutam | divyena tejasā yuktaṃ gārhapatyamivāparam || 12 || gaṅgāntaḥ snāpayāmāsa samāgatya girestadā | puṣpavṛṣṭistu khājjātā śiśorupari tāpasāḥ || 13 || jātakarmādikaṃ cakre vyāsastasya mahātmanaḥ | devadundubhayo nedurnanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || 14 || jagurgandharvapatayo muditāste didṛkṣavaḥ | viśvāvasurnāradaśca tumburuḥ śukasambhave || 15 || tuṣṭuvurmuditāḥ sarve devā vidyādharāstathā | dṛṣṭvā vyāsasutaṃ divyamaraṇīgarbhasambhavam || 16 || antarikṣātpapātorvyāṃ daṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ śubham | kamaṇḍalustathā divyaḥ śukasyārthe dvijottamāḥ || 17 || sadyaḥ sa vavṛdhe bālo jātamātro'tidīptimān | tasyopanayanaṃ cakre vyāso vidyāvidhānavit || 18 || utpannamātraṃ taṃ vedāḥ sarahasyāḥ sasaṃgrahāḥ | upatasthurmahātmānaṃ yathāsya pitaraṃ tathā || 19 || yato dṛṣṭaṃ śukīrūpaṃ ghṛtācyāḥ sambhave tadā | śuketi nāma putrasya cakāra munisattamaḥ || 20 || bṛhaspatimupādhyāyaṃ kṛtvā vyāsasutastadā | vratāni brahmacaryasya cakāra vidhipūrvakam || 21 || so'dhītya nikhilānvedān sarahasyānsasaṃgrahān | dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi kṛtvā gurukule śukaḥ || 22 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā samāvṛtto munistadā | ājagāma pituḥ pārśvaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca || 23 || dṛṣṭvā vyāsaḥ śukaṃ prāptaṃ premṇotthāya sasambhramaḥ | āliliṅga muhurghrāṇaṃ mūrdhni tasya cakāra ha || 24 || papraccha kuśalaṃ vyāsastathā cādhyayanaṃ śuci | āśvāsya sthāpayāmāsa śukaṃ tatrāśrame śubhe || 25 || dārakarma tato vyāsaḥ śukasya paryacintayat | kanyāṃ munisutāṃ kāntāmapṛcchadativegavān || 26 || śukaṃ prāha sutaṃ vyāso vedo'dhītastvayānagha | dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi kuru bhāryāṃ mahāmate || 27 || gārhasthyaṃ ca samāsādya yaja devānpitṝnatha | ṛṇānmocaya māṃ putra prāpya dārānmanoramān || 28 || aputrasya gatirnāsti svargo naiva ca naiva ca | tasmātputra mahābhāga kuruṣvādya gṛhāśramam || 29 || kṛtvā gṛhāśramaṃ putra sukhinaṃ kuru māṃ śuka | āśā me mahatī putra pūrayasva mahāmate || 30 || tapastaptvā mahāghoraṃ prāpto'si tvamayonijaḥ | devarūpī mahāprājña pāhi māṃ pitaraṃ śuka || 31 || sūta uvāca iti vādinamabhyāśe prāptaḥ prāha śukastadā | viraktaḥ so'tiraktaṃ taṃ sākṣātpitaramātmanaḥ || 32 || śuka uvāca kiṃ tvaṃ vadasi dharmajña vedavyāsa mahāmate | tattvena śādhi śiṣyaṃ māṃ tvadājñāṃ karavāṇyalam || 33 || vyāsa uvāca tvadarthe yattapastaptaṃ mayā putra śataṃ samāḥ | prāptastvaṃ cātiduḥkhena śivasyārādhanena ca || 34 || dadāmi tava vittaṃ tu prārthayitvātha bhūpatim | sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva mahāprājña prāpya yauvanamuttamam || 35 || śuka uvāca kiṃ sukhaṃ mānuṣe loke brūhi tāta nirāmayam | duḥkhaviddhaṃ sukhaṃ prājñā na vadanti sukhaṃ kila || 36 || striyaṃ kṛtvā mahābhāga bhavāmi tadvaśānugaḥ | sukhaṃ kiṃ paratantrasya strījitasya viśeṣataḥ || 37 || kadācidapi mucyeta lohakāṣṭhādiyantritaḥ | putradārairnibaddhastu na vimucyeta karhicit || 38 || viṇmūtrasambhavo deho nārīṇāṃ tanmayastathā | kaḥ prītiṃ tatra viprendra vibudhaḥ kartumicchati || 39 || ayonijo'haṃ viprarṣe yonau me kīdṛśī matiḥ | na vāñchāmyahamagre'pi yonāveva samudbhavam || 40 || viṭsukhaṃ kimu vāñchāmi tyaktvā''tmasukhamadbhutam | ātmārāmaśca bhūyo'pi na bhavatyatilolupaḥ || 41 || prathamaṃ paṭhitā vedā mayā vistāritāśca te | hiṃsāmayāste patitāḥ karmamārgapravartakāḥ || 42 || bṛhaspatirguruḥ prāptaḥ so'pi magno gṛhārṇave | avidyāgrastahṛdayaḥ kathaṃ tārayituṃ kṣamaḥ || 43 || rogagrasto yathā vaidyaḥ pararogacikitsakaḥ | tathā gururmumukṣorme gṛhastho'yaṃ viḍambanā || 44 || kṛtvā praṇāmaṃ gurave tvatsamīpamupāgataḥ | trāhi māṃ tattvabodhena bhītaṃ saṃsārasarpataḥ || 45 || saṃsāre'sminmahāghore bhramaṇaṃ nabhacakravat | na ca viśramaṇaṃ kyāpi sūryasyeva divāniśi || 46 || kiṃ sukhaṃ tāta saṃsāre nijatattvavicāraṇāt | mūḍhānāṃ sukhabuddhistu viṭsu kīṭasukhaṃ yathā || 47 || adhītya vedaśāstrāṇi saṃsāre rāgiṇaśca ye | tebhyaḥ paro na mūrkho'sti sadharmā śvāśvasūkaraiḥ || 48 || mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya vedaśāstrāṇyadhītya ca | badhyate yadi saṃsāre ko vimucyeta mānavaḥ || 49 || nātaḥ parataraṃ loke kvacidāścaryamadbhutam | putradāragṛhāsaktaḥ paṇḍitaḥ parigīyate || 50 || na bādhyate yaḥ saṃsāre naro māyāguṇaistribhiḥ | sa vidvānsa ca medhāvī śāstrapāraṃ gato hi saḥ || 51 || kiṃ vṛthādhyayanenātra dṛḍhabandhakareṇa ca | paṭhitavyaṃ tadevāśu mocayedbhavabandhanāt || 52 || gahṇāti puruṣaṃ yasmādgṛhaṃ tena prakīrtitam | kva sukhaṃ bandhanāgāre tena bhīto'smyahaṃ pitaḥ || 53 || ye'budhā mandamatayo vidhinā muṣitāśca ye | te prāpya mānuṣaṃ janma punarbandhaṃ viśantyuta || 54 || vyāsa uvāca na gṛhaṃ bandhanāgāraṃ bandhane na ca kāraṇam | manasā yo vinirmukto gṛhastho'pi vimucyate || 55 || nyāyāgatadhanaḥ kurvanvedoktaṃ vidhivatkramāt | gṛhastho'pi vimucyeta śrāddhakṛtsatyavāk śuciḥ || 56 || brahmacārī yatiścaiva vānaprastho vratasthitaḥ | gṛhasthaṃ samupāsante madhyāhnātikrame sadā || 57 || śraddhayā cānnadānena vācā sūnṛtayā tathā | upakurvanti dharmasthā gṛhāśramanivāsinaḥ || 58 || gṛhāśramātparo dharmo na dṛṣṭo na ca vai śrutaḥ | vasiṣṭhādibhirācāryairjñānibhiḥ samupāśritaḥ || 59 || kimasādhyaṃ mahābhāga vedoktāni ca kurvataḥ | svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca sajjanma yadyadvāñchati tadbhavet || 60 || āśramādāśramaṃ gacchediti dharmavido viduḥ | tasmādagniṃ samādhāya kuru karmāṇyatandritaḥ || 61 || devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca santarpya vidhivatsuta | putramutpādya dharmajña saṃyojya ca gṛhāśrame || 62 || tyaktvāgṛhaṃ vanaṃ gatvā kartāsi vratamuttamam | vānaprasthāśramaṃ kṛtvā saṃnyāsaṃ ca tataḥ param || 63 || indriyāṇi mahābhāga mādakāni suniścitam | adārasya durantāni pañcaiva manasā saha || 64 || tasmāddārānprakurvīta tajjayāya mahāmate | vārdhake tapa ātiṣṭhediti śāstroditaṃ vacaḥ || 65 || viśvāmitro mahābhāga tapaḥ kṛtvātiduścaram | trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ || 66 || mohitaśca mahātejā vane menakayā sthitaḥ | śakuntalā samutpannā putrī tadvīryajā śubhā || 67 || dṛṣṭvā dāśasutāṃ kālīṃ pitā mama parāśaraḥ | kāmabāṇārditaḥ kanyāṃ tāṃ jagrāhoḍupe sthitaḥ || 68 || brahmāpi svasutāṃ dṛṣṭvā pañcabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ | dhāvamānaśca rudreṇa mūrcchitaśca nivāritaḥ || 69 || tasmāttvamapi kalyāṇa kuru me vacanaṃ hitam | kulajāṃ kanyakāṃ vṛtvā vedamārgaṃ samāśraya || 70 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe vyāsena gṛhasthadharmavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <1.15> śukavairāgyavarṇanam nāhaṃ gṛhaṃ kariṣyāmi duḥkhadaṃ sarvadā pitaḥ | vāgurāsadṛśaṃ nityaṃ bandhanaṃ sarvadehinām || 1 || dhanacintāturāṇāṃ hi kva sukhaṃ tāta dṛśyate | svajanaiḥ khalu pīḍyante nirdhanā lolupā janāḥ || 2 || indro'pi na sukhī tādṛgyādṛśo bhikṣuniḥspṛhaḥ | ko'nyaḥ syādiha saṃsāre trilokīvibhave sati || 3 || tapantaṃ tāpasaṃ dṛṣṭvā maghavā duḥkhito'bhavat | vighnānbahuvidhānasya karoti ca divaspatiḥ || 4 || brahmāpi na sukhī viṣṇurlakṣmīṃ prāpya manoramām | khedaṃ prāpnoti satataṃ saṃgrāmairasuraiḥ saha || 5 || karoti vipulānyatnāṃstapaścarati duścaram | ramāpatirapi śrīmānkasyāsti vipulaṃ sukham || 6 || śaṅkaro'pi sadā duḥkhī bhavatyeva ca vedmyaham | tapaścaryāṃ prakurvāṇo daityayuddhakaraḥ sadā || 7 || kadācinna sukhī śete dhanavānapi lolupaḥ | nirdhanastu kathaṃ tāta sukhaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 8 || jānannapi mahābhāga putraṃ vā vīryasambhavam | niyokṣyasi mahāghore saṃsāre duḥkhade sadā || 9 || janmaduḥkhaṃ jarāduḥkhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca maraṇe tathā | garbhavāse punarduḥkhaṃ viṣṭhāmūtramaye pitaḥ || 10 || tasmādatiśayaṃ duḥkhaṃ tṛṣṇālobhasamudbhavam | yāñcāyāṃ paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ maraṇādapi mānada || 11 || pratigrahadhanā viprā na buddhibalajīvanāḥ | parāśā paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ maraṇaṃ ca dine dine || 12 || paṭhitvā sakalān vedāñchāstrāṇi ca samantataḥ | gatvā ca dhanināṃ kāryā stutiḥ sarvātmanā budhaiḥ || 13 || ekodarasya kā cintā patramūlaphalādibhiḥ | yenakenāpyupāyena santuṣṭyā ca prapūryate || 14 || bhāryā putrāstathā pautrāḥ kuṭumbe vipule sati | pūraṇārthaṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ kva sukhaṃ pitaradbhutam || 15 || yogaśāstraṃ vada mama jñānaśāstraṃ sukhākaram | karmakāṇḍe'khile tāta na rame'haṃ kadācana || 16 || vada karmakṣayopāyaṃ prārabdhaṃ sañcitaṃ tathā | vartamānaṃ yathā naśyet trividhaṃ karmamūlajam || 17 || jalūkeva sadā nārī rudhiraṃ pibatīti vai | mūrkhastu na vijānāti mohito bhāvaceṣṭitaiḥ || 18 || bhogairvīryaṃ dhanaṃ pūrṇaṃ manaḥ kuṭilabhāṣaṇaiḥ | kāntā harati sarvasvaṃ kaḥ stenastādṛśo'paraḥ || 19 || nidrāsukhavināśārthaṃ mūrkhastu dārasaṃgraham | karoti vañcito dhātrā duḥkhāya na sukhāya ca || 20 || sūta uvāca evaṃvidhāni vākyāni śrutvā vyāsaḥ śukasya ca | samprāpa mahatīṃ cintāṃ kiṃ karomītyasaṃśayam || 21 || tasya susruvuraśrūṇi locanāduḥkhajāni ca | vepathuśca śarīre'bhūdglāniṃ prāpa manastathā || 22 || śocantaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā dīnaṃ śokapariplutam | uvāca pitaraṃ vyāsaṃ vismayotphullalocanaḥ || 23 || aho māyābalaṃ cograṃ yanmohayati paṇḍitam | vedāntasya ca kartāraṃ sarvajñaṃ vedasammitam || 24 || na jāne kā ca sā māyā kiṃsvitsātīva duṣkarā | yā mohayati vidvāṃsaṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam || 25 || purāṇānāṃ ca vaktā ca nirmātā bhāratasya ca | vibhāgakartā vedānāṃ so'pi mohamupāgataḥ || 26 || tāṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ devīṃ yā mohayati vai jagat | brahmaviṣṇuharādīṃśca kathānyeṣāṃ ca kīdṛśī || 27 || ko'pyasti triṣu lokeṣu yo na muhyati māyayā | yanmohaṃ gamitāḥ pūrve brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ || 28 || aho balamaho vīryaṃ devyā khalu vinirmitam | māyayaiva vaśaṃ nītaḥ sarvajña īśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 29 || viṣṇvaṃśasambhavo vyāsa iti paurāṇikā jaguḥ | so'pi mohārṇave magno bhagnapoto vaṇigyathā || 30 || aśrupātaṃ karotyadya vivaśaḥ prākṛto yathā | aho māyābalaṃ caitaddustyajaṃ paṇḍitairapi || 31 || ko'yaṃ ko'haṃ kathaṃ ceha kīdṛśo'yaṃ bhramaḥ kila | pañcabhūtātmake dehe pitāputreti vāsanā || 32 || baliṣṭhā khalu māyeyaṃ māyināmapi mohinī | yayābhibhūtaḥ kṛṣṇo'pi karoti rodanaṃ dvijaḥ || 33 || sūta uvāca tāṃ natvā manasā devīṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇām | jananīṃ sarvadevānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ tatheśvarīm || 34 || pitaraṃ prāha dīnaṃ taṃ śokārṇavapariplutam | araṇīsambhavo vyāsaṃ hetumadvacanaṃ śubham || 35 || pārāśarya mahābhāga sarveṣāṃ bodhadaḥ svayam | kiṃ śokaṃ kuruṣe svāminyathājñaḥ prākṛto naraḥ || 36 || adyāhaṃ tava putro'smi na jāne pūrvajanmani | ko'haṃ kastvaṃ mahābhāga vibhramo'yaṃ mahātmani || 37 || kuru dhairyaṃ prabudhyasva mā viṣāde manaḥ kṛthāḥ | mohajālamimaṃ matvā muñca śokaṃ mahāmate || 38 || kṣudhānivṛttirbhakṣyeṇa na putradarśanena ca | pipāsā jalapānena yāti naivātmajekṣaṇāt || 39 || ghrāṇaṃ sukhaṃ sugandhena karṇajaṃ śravaṇena ca | strīsukhaṃ tu striyā nūnaṃ putro'haṃ kiṃ karomi te || 40 || ajīgartena putro'pi hariścandrāya bhūbhuje | paśukāmāya yajñārthe datto maulyena sarvathā || 41 || sukhānāṃ sādhanaṃ dravyaṃ dhanātsukhasamuccayaḥ | dhanamarjaya lobhaścetputro'haṃ kiṃ karomyaham || 42 || māṃ prabodhaya buddhyā tvaṃ daivajño'si mahāmate | yathā mucyeyamatyantaṃ garbhavāsabhayānmune || 43 || durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma karmabhūmāvihānagha | tatrāpi brāhmaṇatvaṃ vai durlabhaṃ cottame kule || 44 || baddho'hamiti me buddhirnāpasarpati cittataḥ | saṃsāravāsanājāle niviṣṭā vṛddhigāminī || 45 || sūta uvāca ityuktastu tadā vyāsaḥ putreṇāmitabuddhinā | pratyuvāca śukaṃ śāntaṃ caturthāśramamānasam || 46 || vyāsa uvāca paṭha putra mahābhāga mayā bhāgavataṃ kṛtam | śubhaṃ na cātivistīrṇaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmasammitam || 47 || skandhā dvādaśa tatraiva pañcalakṣaṇasaṃyutam | sarveṣāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mama sammatam || 48 || sadasajjñānavijñānaṃ śrutamātreṇa jāyate | yena bhāgavateneha tatpaṭha tvaṃ mahāmate || 49 || vaṭapatraśayānāya viṣṇave bālarūpiṇe | kenāsmi bālabhāvena nirmito'haṃ cidātmanā || 50 || kimarthaṃ kena dravyeṇa kathaṃ jānāmi cākhilam | ityevaṃ cintyamānāya mukundāya mahātmane || 51 || ślokārdhena tayā proktaṃ bhagavatyākhilārthadam | sarvaṃ khalvidamevāhaṃ nānyadasti sanātanam || 52 || tadvaco viṣṇunā pūrvaṃ saṃvijñātaṃ manasyapi | kenoktā vāgiyaṃ satyā cintayāmāsa cetasā || 53 || kathaṃ vedmi pravaktāraṃ strīpuṃsau vā napuṃsakam | iti cintāprapannena dhṛtaṃ bhāgavataṃ hṛdi || 54 || punaḥ punaḥ kṛtoccārastasminevāstacetasā | vaṭapatre śayānaḥ sannabhūccintāsamanvitaḥ || 55 || tadā śāntā bhagavatī prādurāsa caturbhujā | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmavarāyudhadharā śivā || 56 || divyāmbaradharā devī divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | saṃyutā sadṛśībhiśca sakhībhiḥ svavibhūtibhiḥ || 57 || prādurbabhūva tasyāgre viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ | mandahāsyaṃ prayuñjānā mahālakṣmīḥ śubhānanā || 58 || sūta uvāca tāṃ tathā saṃsthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛdaye kamalekṣaṇaḥ | vismitaḥ salile tasminnirādhārā manoramām || 59 || ratirbhūtistathā buddhirmatiḥ kīrtiḥ smṛtirdhṛtiḥ | śraddhā medhā svadhā svāhā kṣudhā nidrā dayā gatiḥ || 60 || tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kṣamā lajjā jṛmbhā tandrā ca śaktayaḥ | saṃsthitāḥ sarvataḥ pārśve mahādevyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 61 || varāyudhadharāḥ sarvā nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ | mandāramālākulitā muktāhāravirājitāḥ || 62 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāśca saṃvīkṣya tasminnekārṇave jale | vismayāviṣṭahṛdayaḥ sambabhūva janārdanaḥ || 63 || cintayāmāsa sarvātmā dṛṣṭamāyo'tivismitaḥ | kuto bhūtāḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ kuto'haṃ vaṭatalpagaḥ || 64 || asminnekārṇave ghore nyagrodhaḥ kathamutthitaḥ | kenāhaṃ sthāpito'smyatra śiśuṃ kṛtvā śubhākṛtim || 65 || mameyaṃ jananī no vā māyā vā kāpi durghaṭā | darśanaṃ kenacittvadya dattaṃ vā kena hetunā || 66 || kiṃ mayā cātra vaktavyaṃ gantavyaṃ vā na vā kvacit | maunamāsthāya tiṣṭheyaṃ bālabhāvādatandritaḥ || 67 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe śukavairāgyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <1.16> vyāsopadeśavarṇanam dṛṣṭvā taṃ vismitaṃ devaṃ śayānaṃ vaṭapatrake | uvāca sasmitaṃ vākyaṃ viṣṇo kiṃ vismito hyasi || 1 || mahāśaktyāḥ prabhāveṇa tvaṃ māṃ vismṛtavānpurā | prabhave pralaye jāte bhūtvā bhūtvā punaḥ punaḥ || 2 || nirguṇā sā parā śaktiḥ saguṇastvaṃ tathāpyaham | sāttvikī kila yā śaktistāṃ śaktiṃ viddhi māmikām || 3 || tvannābhikamalādbrahmā bhaviṣyati prajāpatiḥ | sa kartā sarvalokasya rajoguṇasamanvitaḥ || 4 || sa tadā tapa āsthāya prāpya śaktimanuttamām | rajasā raktavarṇañca kariṣyati jagattrayam || 5 || saguṇānpañcabhūtāṃśca samutpādya mahāmatiḥ | indriyāṇīndriyeśāṃśca manaḥpūrvānsamantataḥ || 6 || kariṣyati tataḥ sargaṃ tena kartā sa ucyate | viśvasyāsya mahābhāga tvaṃ vai pālayitā tathā || 7 || tadbhuvormadhyadeśācca krodhādrudro bhaviṣyati | tapaḥ kṛtvā mahāghoraṃ prāpya śaktiṃ tu tāmasīm || 8 || kalpānte so'pi saṃhartā bhaviṣyati mahāmate | tenāhaṃ tvāmupāyātā sāttvikīṃ tvamavehi mām || 9 || sthāsye'haṃ tvatsamīpasthā sadāhaṃ madhusūdana | hṛdaye te kṛtāvāsā bhavāmi satataṃ kila || 10 || viṣṇuruvāca ślokasyārdhaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ devi sphuṭākṣaram | tatkenoktaṃ varārohe rahasyaṃ paramaṃ śivam || 11 || tanme brūhi varārohe saṃśayo'yaṃ varānane | nirdhano hi yathā dravyaṃ tatsmarāmi punaḥ punaḥ || 12 || vyāsa uvāca viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā mahālakṣmīḥ smitānanā | uvāca parayā prītyā vacanaṃ cāruhāsinī || 13 || mahālakṣmīruvāca śṛṇu śaure vaco mahyaṃ saguṇāhaṃ caturbhujā | māṃ jānāsi na jānāsi nirguṇāṃ saguṇālayām || 14 || tvaṃ jānīhi mahābhāga tayā tatprakaṭīkṛtam | puṇyaṃ bhāgavataṃ viddhi vedasāraṃ śubhāvaham || 15 || kṛpāṃ ca mahatīṃ manye devyāḥ śatruniṣūdana | yayā proktaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ hitāya tava suvrata || 16 || rakṣaṇīyaṃ sadā citte na vismāryaṃ kadācana | sāraṃ hi sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ mahāvidyāprakāśitam || 17 || nātaḥ paraṃ veditavyaṃ vartate bhuvanatraye | priyo'si khalu devyāstvaṃ tena te vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 18 || vyāsa uvāca iti śrutvā vaco devyā mahālakṣyāścaturbhujaḥ | dadhāra hṛdaye nityaṃ matvā mantramanuttamam || 19 || kālena kiyatā tatra tannābhikamalodbhavaḥ | brahmā daityabhayāttrasto jagāma śaraṇaṃ hareḥ || 20 || tataḥ kṛtvā mahāyuddhaṃ hatvā tau madhukaiṭabhau | jajāpa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ ślokārdhaṃ viśadākṣaram || 21 || japantaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ | papraccha paramaprītaḥ kañjajaḥ kamalāpatim || 22 || kiṃ tvaṃ japasi deveśa tvattaḥ ko'pyadhiko'sti vai | yatkṛtvā puṇḍarīkākṣa prīto'si jagadīśvara || 23 || hariruvāca mayi tvayi ca yā śaktiḥ kriyākāraṇalakṣaṇā | vicāraya mahābhāga yā sā bhagavatī śivā || 24 || yasyādhāre jagatsarvaṃ tiṣṭhatyatra mahārṇave | sākārā yā mahāśaktirameyā ca sanātanī || 25 || yayā visṛjyate viśvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram | saiṣā prasannā varadā nṛṇāṃ bhavati muktaye || 26 || sā vidyā paramā mukterhetubhūtā sanātanī | saṃsārabandhahetuśca saiva sarveśvareśvarī || 27 || ahaṃ tvamakhilaṃ viśvaṃ tasyāścicchaktisambhavam | viddhi brahmanna sandehaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvadānagha || 28 || ślokārdhena tayā proktaṃ tadvai bhāgavataṃ kila | vistaro bhavitā tasya dvāparādau yuge tathā || 29 || vyāsa uvāca brahmaṇā saṃgṛhītaṃ ca viṣṇostu nābhipaṅkaje | nāradāya ca tenoktaṃ putrāyāmitabuddhaye || 30 || nāradena tathā mahyaṃ dattaṃ hi muninā purā | mayā kṛtamidaṃ pūrṇaṃ dvādaśaskandhavistaram || 31 || tatpaṭhasva mahābhāga purāṇaṃ brahmasammitam | pañcalakṣaṇayuktaṃ ca devyāścaritamuttamam || 32 || tattvajñānarasopetaṃ sarveṣāmuttamottamam | dharmaśāstrasamaṃ puṇyaṃ vedārthenopabṛṃhitam || 33 || vṛtrāsuravadhopetaṃ nānākhyānakathāyutam | brahmavidyānidhānaṃ tu saṃsārārṇavatārakam || 34 || gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mahābhāga yogyo'si matimattaraḥ | puṇyaṃ bhāgavataṃ nāma purāṇaṃ puruṣarṣabha || 35 || aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇāṃ ślokānāṃ kuru saṃgraham | ajñānanāśanaṃ divyaṃ jñānabhāskarabodhakam || 36 || sukhadaṃ śāntidaṃ dhanyaṃ dīrghāyuṣyakaraṃ śivam | śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ cedaṃ putrapautravivardhanam || 37 || śiṣyo'yaṃ mama dharmātmā lomaharṣaṇasambhavaḥ | paṭhiṣyati tvayā sārdhaṃ purāṇīṃ saṃhitāṃ śubhām || 38 || sūta uvāca ityuktaṃ tena putrāya mahyaṃ ca kathitaṃ kila | mayā gṛhītaṃ tatsarvaṃ purāṇaṃ cātivistaram || 39 || śuko'dhītya purāṇaṃ tu sthito vyāsāśrame śubhe | na lebhe śarma dharmātmā brahmātmaja ivāparaḥ || 40 || ekāntasevī vikalaḥ sa śūnya iva lakṣyate | nātyantabhojanāsakto nopavāsaratastathā || 41 || cintāviṣṭaṃ śukaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyāsaḥ prāha sutaṃ prati | kiṃ putra cintyate nityaṃ kasmādvyagro'si mānada || 42 || āsse dhyānaparo nityamṛṇagrasta ivādhanaḥ | kā cintā vartate putra mayi tāte tu tiṣṭhati || 43 || sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva yathākāmaṃ muñca śokaṃ manogatam | jñānaṃ cintaya śāstroktaṃ vijñāne ca matiṃ kuru || 44 || na cenmanasi te śāntirvacasā mama suvrata | gaccha tvaṃ mithilāṃ putra pālitāṃ janakena ha || 45 || sa te mohaṃ mahābhāga nāśayiṣyati bhūpatiḥ | janako nāma dharmātmā videhaḥ satyasāgaraḥ || 46 || taṃ gatvā nṛpatiṃ putra sandehaṃ svaṃ nivartaya | varṇāśramāṇāṃ dharmāṃstvaṃ pṛccha putra yathātatham || 47 || jīvanmuktaḥ sa rājarṣirbahmajñānamatiḥ śuciḥ | tathyavaktātiśāntaśca yogī yogapriyaḥ sadā || 48 || sūta uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ | pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ śukaścāraṇisambhavaḥ || 49 || dambho'yaṃ kila dharmātmanbhāti citte mamādhunā | jīvanmukto videhaśca rājyaṃ śāsti mudānvitaḥ || 50 || vandhyāputra ivābhāti rājāsau janakaḥ pitaḥ | kurvan rājyaṃ videhaḥ kiṃ sandeho'yaṃ mamādbhutaḥ || 51 || draṣṭumicchāmyahaṃ bhūpaṃ videhaṃ nṛpasattamam | kathaṃ tiṣṭhati saṃsāre padmapatramivāmbhasi || 52 || sandeho'yaṃ mahāṃstāta videhe parivartate | mokṣaḥ kiṃ vadatāṃ śreṣṭha saugatānāmivāparaḥ || 53 || kathaṃ bhuktamabhuktaṃ syādakṛtaṃ ca kṛtaṃ katham | vyavahāraḥ kathaṃ tyājya indriyāṇāṃ mahāmate || 54 || mātā putrastathā bhāryā bhaginī kulaṭā tathā | bhedābhedaḥ kathaṃ na syādyadyetanmuktatā katham || 55 || kaṭu kṣāraṃ tathā tīkṣṇāṃ kaṣāyaṃ miṣṭameva ca | rasanā yadi jānāti bhuṃkte bhogānanuttamān || 56 || śītoṣṇusukhaduḥkhādiparijñānaṃ yadā bhavet | muktatā kīdṛśī tāta sandeho'yaṃ mamādbhutaḥ || 57 || śatrumitraparijñānaṃ vairaṃ prītikaraṃ sadā | vyavahāre pare tiṣṭhankathaṃ na kurute nṛpaḥ || 58 || cauraṃ vā tāpasaṃ vāpi samānaṃ manyate katham | asamā yadi buddhiḥ syānmuktatā tarhi kīdṛśī || 59 || dṛṣṭapūrvo na me kaścijjīvanmuktaśca bhūpatiḥ | śaṅkeyaṃ mahatī tāta gṛhe muktaḥ kathaṃ nṛpaḥ || 60 || didṛkṣā mahatī jātā śrutvā taṃ bhūpatiṃ tathā | sandehavinivṛttyarthaṃ gacchāmi mithilāṃ prati || 61 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe śukaṃ prati vyāsopadeśavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <1.17> śukasya rājamandirapraveśavarṇanam sūta uvāca ityuktvā pitaraṃ putraḥ pādayoḥ patitaḥ śukaḥ | baddhāñjaliruvācedaṃ gantukāmo mahāmanāḥ || 1 || āpṛcche tvāṃ mahābhāga grāhyaṃ te vacanaṃ mayā | videhāndraṣṭumicchāmi pālitāñjanakena tu || 2 || vinā daṇḍaṃ kathaṃ rājyaṃ karoti janakaḥ kila | dharme na vartate loko daṇḍaścenna bhavedyadi || 3 || dharmasya kāraṇaṃ daṇḍo manvādiprahitaḥ sadā | sa kathaṃ vartate tāta saṃśayo'yaṃ mahānmama || 4 || mama mātā tviyaṃ vandhyā tadvadbhāti viceṣṭitam | pṛcchāmi tvāṃ mahābhāga gacchāmi ca parantapa || 5 || sūta uvāca taṃ dṛṣṭvā gantukāmaṃ ca śukaṃ satyavatīsutaḥ | āliṅgyovāca putraṃ taṃ jñāninaṃ niḥspṛhaṃ dṛḍham || 6 || vyāsa uvāca svastyastu śaka dīrghāyurbhava putra mahāmate | satyāṃ vācaṃ pradattvā me gaccha tāta yathāsukham || 7 || āgantavyaṃ punargatvā mamāśramamanuttamam | na kutrāpi ca gantavyaṃ tvayā putra kathañcana || 8 || sukhaṃ jīvāmi putrāhaṃ dṛṣṭvā te mukhapaṅkajam | apaśyanduḥkhamāpnomi prāṇastvamasi me suta || 9 || dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ janakaṃ putra sandehaṃ vinivartya ca | atrāgatya sukhaṃ tiṣṭha vedādhyayanatatparaḥ || 10 || sūta uvāca ityuktaḥ so'bhivādyāryaṃ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇām | calitastarasātīva dhanurmuktaḥ śaro yathā || 11 || sampaśyanvividhāndeśām̐llokāṃśca vittadharmiṇaḥ | vanāni pādapāṃścaiva kṣetrāṇi phalitāni ca || 12 || tāpasāṃstapyamānāṃśca yājakāndīkṣayānvitān | yogābhyāsaratānyogivānaprasthānvanaukasaḥ || 13 || śaivānpāśupatāṃścaiva saurāñchāktāṃśca vaiṣṇavān | vīkṣya nānāvidhāndharmāñjagāmātismayanmuniḥ || 14 || varṣadvayena meruṃ ca samullaṅghya mahāmatiḥ | himācalaṃ ca varṣeṇa jagāma mithilāṃ prati || 15 || praviṣṭo mithilāṃ madhye paśyansarvarddhimuttamām | prajāśca sukhitāḥ sarvāḥ sadācārāḥ susaṃsthitāḥ || 16 || kṣatrā nivāritastatra kastvamatra samāgataḥ | kiṃ te kāryaṃ vadasveti pṛṣṭastena na cābravīt || 17 || niḥsṛtya nagaradvārātsthitaḥ sthāṇurivācalaḥ | vismito'tihasaṃstasthau vaco novāca kiñcana || 18 || pratīhāra uvāca brūhi mūko'si kiṃ brahmankimarthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ | calanaṃ ca vinā kāryaṃ na bhavediti me matiḥ || 19 || rājājñayā praveṣṭavyaṃ nagare'sminsadā dvija | ajñātakulaśīlasya praveśo nātra sarvathā || 20 || tejasvī bhāsi nūnaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇo vedavittamaḥ | kulaṃ kāryaṃ ca me brūhi yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha mānada || 21 || śuka uvāca yadarthamāgato'smyatra tatprāptaṃ vacanāttava | videhanagaraṃ draṣṭuṃ praveśo yatra durlabhaḥ || 22 || moho'yaṃ mama durbuddheḥ samullaṅghya giridvayam | rājānaṃ draṣṭukāmo'haṃ paryaṭansamupāgataḥ || 23 || vañcito'haṃ svayaṃ pitrā dūṣaṇaṃ kasya dīyate | bhrāmito'haṃ mahābhāga karmaṇā vā mahītale || 24 || dhanāśā puruṣasyeha paribhramaṇakāraṇam | sā me nāsti tathāpyatra samprāpto'smi bhramātkila || 25 || nirāśasya sukhaṃ nityaṃ yadi mohe na majjati | nirāśo'haṃ mahābhāga magno'sminmohasāgare || 26 || kva merurmithilā kveyaṃ padbhyāṃ ca samupāgataḥ | pariśramaphalaṃ kiṃ me vañcito vidhinā kila || 27 || prārabdhaṃ kila bhoktavyaṃ śubhaṃ vāpyathavāśubham | udyamastadvaśe nityaṃ kārayatyeva sarvathā || 28 || na tīrthaṃ na ca vedo'tra yadarthamiha me śramaḥ | apraveśaḥ pure jāto videho nāma bhūpatiḥ || 29 || ityuktyā virarāmāśu maunībhūta iva sthitaḥ | jñāto hi pratihāreṇa jñānī kaściddvijottamaḥ || 30 || sāmapūrvamuvācāsau taṃ kṣattā saṃsthitaṃ munim | gaccha bho yatra te kāryaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ dvijasattama || 31 || aparādho mama brahmanyannivāritavānaham | tatkṣantavyaṃ mahābhāga vimuktānāṃ kṣamā balam || 32 || śuka uvāca kiṃ te'tra dūṣaṇaṃ kṣattaḥ paratantro'si sarvadā | prabhukāryaṃ prakartavyaṃ sevakena yathocitam || 33 || na bhūpadūṣaṇaṃ cātra yadahaṃ rakṣitastvayā | coraśatruparijñānaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvathā budhaiḥ || 34 || mamaiva sarvathā doṣo yadahaṃ samupāgataḥ | gamanaṃ paragehe yallaghutāyāśca kāraṇam || 35 || pratīhāra uvāca kiṃ sukhaṃ dvija kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ śubhamicchatā | kaḥ śatrurhitakartā ko brūhi sarvaṃ mamādya vai || 36 || śuka uvāca dvaividhyaṃ sarvalokeṣu sarvatra dvividho janaḥ | rāgī caiva virāgī ca tayościttaṃ dvidhā punaḥ || 37 || virāgī trividhaḥ kāmaṃ jñāto'jñātaśca madhyamaḥ | rāgī ca dvividhaḥ prokto mūrkhaśca caturastathā || 38 || cāturyaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ śāstrajaṃ matijaṃ tathā | matistu dvividhā loke yuktāyukteti sarvathā || 39 || pratīhāra uvāca yaduktaṃ bhavatā vidvannārthajño'haṃ dvijottama | tatsarvaṃ vistareṇādya yathārthaṃ vada sattama || 40 || śuka uvāca rāgo yasyāsti saṃsāre sa rāgītyucyate dhruvam | duḥkhaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tasya sukhaṃ ca vividhaṃ punaḥ || 41 || dhanaṃ prāpya sutāndārānmānaṃ ca vijayaṃ tathā | tadaprāpya mahadduḥkhaṃ bhavatyeva kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 42 || kāryastasya sukhopāyaḥ kartavyaṃ sukhasādhanam | tasyārātiḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sukhavighnaṃ karoti yaḥ || 43 || sukhotpādayitā mitraṃ rāgayuktasya sarvadā | caturo naiva muhyeta mūrkhaḥ sarvatra muhyati || 44 || viraktasyātmaraktasya sukhamekāntasevanam | ātmānucintanaṃ caiva vedāntasya ca cintanam || 45 || duḥkhaṃ tadetatsarvaṃ hi saṃsārakathanādikam | śatravo bahavastasya vijñasya śubhamicchataḥ || 46 || kāmaḥ krodhaḥ pramādaśca śatravo vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ | bandhuḥ santoṣa evāsya nānyo'sti bhuvanatraye || 47 || sūta uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya matvā taṃ jñāninaṃ dvijam | kṣattā praveśayāmāsa kakṣāṃ cātimanoramām || 48 || nagaraṃ vīkṣamāṇaḥ saṃstraividhyajanasaṅkulam | nānāvipaṇidravyāḍhyaṃ krayavikrayakārakam || 49 || rāgadveṣayutaṃ kāmalobhamohākulaṃ tathā | vivadatsujanākīrṇaṃ vasupūrṇaṃ mahattaram || 50 || paśyansa trividhām̐llokānprāsaradrājamandiram | prāptaḥ paramatejasvī dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ || 51 || nivāritaśca tatraiva pratīhāreṇa kāṣṭhavat | tatraiva ca sthito dvāri mokṣamevānucintayan || 52 || chāyāyāmātape caiva samadarśī mahātapāḥ | dhyānaṃ kṛtvā tathaikānte sthitaḥ sthāṇurivācalaḥ || 53 || taṃ muhūrtādupāgatya rājño'mātyaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | prāveśayattataḥ kakṣāṃ dvitīyāṃ rājaveśmanaḥ || 54 || tatra divyaṃ manoramyaṃ puṣpitaṃ divyapādapam | tadvanaṃ darśayitvā tu kṛtvā cātithisatkriyām || 55 || vāramukhyāḥ striyastatra rājasevāparāyaṇāḥ | gītavāditrakuśalāḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradāḥ || 56 || tā ādiśya ca sevārthaṃ śukasya mantrisattamaḥ | nirgataḥ sadanāttasmādvyāsaputraḥ sthitastadā || 57 || pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā tābhiḥ strībhiryathāvidhi | deśakālopapannena nānānnenātitoṣitaḥ || 58 || tato'ntaḥpuravāsinyastasyāntaḥpurakānanam | ramyaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsuraṅganāḥ kāmamohitāḥ || 59 || sa yuvā rūpavānkānto mṛdubhāṣī manoramaḥ | dṛṣṭvā tā mumuhuḥ sarvāstaṃ ca kāmamivāparam || 60 || jitendriyaṃ muniṃ mattvā sarvāḥ paryacaraṃstadā | āraṇeyastu śuddhātmā mātṛbhāvamakalpayat || 61 || ātmārāmo jitakrodho na hṛṣyati na tapyati | paśyaṃstāsāṃ vikārāṃśca svastha eva sa tasthivān || 62 || tasmai śayyāṃ suramyāṃ ca dadurnāryaḥ susaṃskṛtām | parārdhyāstaraṇopetāṃ nānopaskarasaṃvṛtām || 63 || sa kṛtvā pādaśaucaṃ ca kuśapāṇiratandritaḥ | upāsya paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ dhyānamevānvapadyata || 64 || yāmamekaṃ sthito dhyāne suṣvāpa tadanantaram | suptvā yāmadvayaṃ tatra codatiṣṭhattataḥ śukaḥ || 65 || pāścātyaṃ yāminīyāmaṃ dhyānamevānvapadyata | snātvā prātaḥkriyāḥ kṛtvā punarāste samāhitaḥ || 66 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe śukasya rājamandirapraveśavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <1.18> janakopadeśavarṇanam sūta uvāca|| sūta uvāca śrutvā tamāgataṃ rājā mantribhiḥ sahitaḥ śuciḥ | puraḥ purohitaṃ kṛtvā guruputraṃ samabhyagāt || 1 || kṛtvārhaṇāṃ nṛpaḥ samyagdattāsanamanuttamam | papraccha kuśalaṃ gāṃ ca vinivedya payasvinīm || 2 || sa ca tāṃ nṛpapūjāṃ vai pratyagṛhṇādyathāvidhi | papraccha kuśalaṃ rājñe svaṃ nivedya nirāmayam || 3 || kṛtvā kuśalasaṃpraśnamupaviṣṭaṃ sukhāsane | śuka vyāsasutaṃ śāntaṃ paryapṛcchata pārthivaḥ || 4 || kiṃ nimittaṃ mahābhāga niḥspṛhasya ca māṃ prati | jātaṃ hyāgamanaṃ brūhi kāryaṃ tanmunisattama || 5 || śuka uvāca vyāsenokto mahārāja kuru dāraparigraham | sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca gṛhasthāśrama uttamaḥ || 6 || mayā nāṅgīkṛtaṃ vākyaṃ mattvā bandhaṃ gurorapi | na bandho'stīti tenokto nāhaṃ tatkṛtavānpunaḥ || 7 || iti sandigdhamanasaṃ matvā sa munisattamaḥ | uvāca vacanaṃ tathyaṃ mithilāṃ gaccha mā śucaḥ || 8 || yājyo'sti janakastatra jīvanmukto narādhipaḥ | videho lokaviditaḥ pāti rājyamakaṇṭakam || 9 || kurvan rājyaṃ tathā rājā māyāpāśairna badhyate | tvaṃ bibheṣi kathaṃ putra vanavṛttiḥ parantapa || 10 || paśya taṃ nṛpaśārdūlaṃ tyaja mohaṃ manogatam | kuru dārānmahābhāga pṛccha vā bhūpatiṃ ca tam || 11 || sandehaṃ te manojātaṃ kathayiṣyati pārthivaḥ | tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya māmehi tarasā suta || 12 || samprāpto'haṃ mahārāja tvatpure ca tadājñayā | mokṣakāmo'smi rājendra brūhi kṛtyaṃ mamānagha || 13 || tapastīrthavratejyāśca svādhyāyastīrthasevanam | jñānaṃ vā vada rājendra mokṣaṃ prati ca kāraṇam || 14 || janaka uvāca śṛṇu vipreṇa kartavyaṃ mokṣamārgāśritena yat | upanīto vasedādau vedābhyāsāya vai gurau || 15 || adhītya vedavedāntāndattvā ca gurudakṣiṇām | samāvṛttastu gārhasthye sadāro nivasenmuniḥ || 16 || nyāyavṛttistu santoṣī nirāśī gatakalmaṣaḥ | agnihotrādikarmāṇi kurvāṇaḥ satyavākśuciḥ || 17 || putraṃ pautraṃ samāsādya vānaprasthāśrame vaset | tapasā ṣaḍripūñjitvā bhāryāṃ putre niveśya ca || 18 || sarvānagnīnyathānyāyamātmanyāropya dharmavit | vasetturyāśrame śrāntaḥ śuddhe vairāgyasambhave || 19 || viraktasyādhikāro'sti saṃnyāse nānyathā kvacit | vedavākyamidaṃ tathyaṃ nānyatheti matirmama || 20 || śukāṣṭacatvāriśadvai saṃskārā vedabodhitāḥ | catvāriṃśadgṛhasthasya proktāstatra mahātmabhiḥ || 21 || aṣṭau ca muktikāmasya proktāḥ śamadamādayaḥ | āśramādāśramaṃ gacchediti śiṣṭānuśāsanam || 22 || śuka uvāca utpanne hṛdi vairāgye jñānavijñānasambhave | avaśyameva vastavyamāśrameṣu vaneṣu vā || 23 || janaka uvāca indriyāṇi baliṣṭhāni na niyuktāni mānada | apakvasya prakurvanti vikārāṃstānanekaśaḥ || 24 || bhojanecchāṃ sukhecchāṃ ca śayyecchāmātmajasya ca | yatī bhūtvā kathaṃ kuryādvikāre samupasthite || 25 || durjaraṃ vāsanājālaṃ na śāntimupayāti vai | atastacchamanārthāya krameṇa ca parityajet || 26 || ūrdhvaṃ suptaḥ patatyeva na śayānaḥ patatyadhaḥ | parivrajya paribhraṣṭo na mārgaṃ labhate punaḥ || 27 || yathā pipīlikā mūlācchākhāyāmadhirohati | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ phalaṃ yāti sukhena padagāminī || 28 || vihaṅgastarasā yāti vighnaśaṅkāmudasya vai | śrānto bhavati viśramya sukhaṃ yāti pipīlikā || 29 || manastu prabalaṃ kāmamajeyamakṛtātmabhiḥ | ataḥ krameṇa jetavyamāśramānukrameṇa ca || 30 || gṛhasthāśramasaṃstho'pi śāntaḥ sumatirātmavān | na ca hṛṣyenna ca tapellābhālābhe samo bhavet || 31 || vihataṃ karma kurvāṇastyajaṃścintānvitaṃ ca yat | ātmalābhena santuṣṭo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 32 || paśyāhaṃ rājyasaṃstho'pi jīvanmukto yathānagha | vicarāmi yathākāmaṃ na me kiñcitprajāyate || 33 || bhuñjāno vividhānbhogānkurvankāryāṇyanekaśaḥ | bhaviṣyāmi yathāhaṃ tvaṃ tathā mukto bhavānagha || 34 || kathyate khalu yaddṛśyamadṛśyaṃ badhyate kutaḥ | dṛśyāni pañcabhūtāni guṇāsteṣāṃ tathā punaḥ || 35 || ātmā gamyo'numānena pratyakṣo na kadācana | sa kathaṃ badhyate brahmannirvikāro nirañjanaḥ || 36 || manastu sukhaduḥkhānāṃ mahatāṃ kāraṇaṃ dvija | jāte tu nirmale hyasminsarvaṃ bhavati nirmalam || 37 || bhramansarveṣu tīrtheṣu snātvā snātvā punaḥ punaḥ | nirmalaṃ na mano yāvattāvatsarvaṃ nirarthakam || 38 || na deho na ca jīvātmā nendriyāṇi parantapa | mana eva manuṣyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bandhamokṣayoḥ || 39 || śuddho muktaḥ sadaivātmā na vai badhyeta karhicit | bandhamokṣau manaḥsaṃsthau tasmiñchānte praśāmyati || 40 || śatrurmitramudāsīno bhedāḥ sarve manogatāḥ | ekātmatve kathaṃ bhedaḥ sambhaveddvaitadarśanāt || 41 || jīvo brahma sadaivāhaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | bhedabuddhistu saṃsāre vartamānā pravartate || 42 || avidyeyaṃ mahābhāga vidyā caitannivartanam | vidyāvidye ca vijñeye sarvadaiva vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 43 || vinātapaṃ hi chāyāyā jñāyate ca kathaṃ sukham | avidyayā vinā tadvatkathaṃ vidyāṃ ca vetti vai || 44 || guṇā guṇeṣu vartante bhūtāni ca tathaiva ca | indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu ko doṣastatra cātmanaḥ || 45 || maryādā sarvarakṣārthaṃ kṛtā vedeṣu sarvaśaḥ | anyathā dharmanāśaḥ syātsaugatānāmivānagha || 46 || dharmanāśe vinaṣṭaḥ syādvarṇācāro'tivartitaḥ | ato vedapradiṣṭena mārgeṇa gacchatāṃ śubham || 47 || śuka uvāca sandeho vartate rājanna nivartati me kvacit | bhavatā kathitaṃ yattacchṛṇvato me narādhipa || 48 || vedadharmeṣu hiṃsā syādadharmabahulā hi sā | kathaṃ muktiprado dharmo vedokto bata bhūpate || 49 || pratyakṣeṇa tvanācāraḥ somapānaṃ narādhipa | paśūnāṃ hiṃsanaṃ tadvadbhakṣaṇaṃ cāmiṣasya ca || 50 || sautrāmaṇau tathā proktaḥ pratyakṣeṇa surāgrahaḥ | dyūtakrīḍā tathā proktā vratāni vividhāni ca || 51 || śrūyate sma purā hyāsīcchaśabindurnṛpottamaḥ | yajvā dharmaparo nityaṃ vadānyaḥ satyasāgaraḥ || 52 || goptā ca dharmasetūnāṃ śāstā cotpathagāminām | yajñāśca vihitāstena bahavo bhūridakṣiṇāḥ || 53 || carmaṇāṃ parvato jāto vindhyācalasamaḥ punaḥ | meghāmbuplāvanājjātā nadī carmaṇvatī śubhā || 54 || so'pi rājā divaṃ yātaḥ kīrtirasyācalā bhuvi | evaṃ dharmeṣu vedeṣu na me buddhiḥ pravartate || 55 || strīsaṅgena sadā bhoge sukhamāpnoti mānavaḥ | alābhe duḥkhamatyantaṃ jīvanmuktaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 56 || janaka uvāca hiṃsā yajñeṣu pratyakṣā sāhiṃsā parikīrtitā | upādhiyogato hiṃsā nānyatheti vinirṇayaḥ || 57 || yathā cendhanasaṃyogādagnau dhūmaḥ pravartate | tadviyogāttathā tasminnirdhūmatvaṃ vibhāti vai || 58 || ahiṃsāṃ ca tathā viddhi vedoktāṃ munisattama | rāgiṇāṃ sāpi hiṃsaiva niḥspṛhāṇāṃ na sā matā || 59 || arāgeṇa ca yatkarma tathāhaṅkāravarjitam | akṛtaṃ vedavidvāṃsaḥ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 60 || gṛhasthānāṃ tu hiṃsaiva yā yajñe dvijasattama | arāgeṇa ca yatkarma tathāhaṃkāravarjitam || 61 || sāhiṃsaiva mahābhāga mumukṣūṇāṃ jitātmanām || 62 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamaskandhe śukāya janakopadeśavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <1.19> śukasya vivāhādikāryavarṇanam śuka uvāca sandeho'yaṃ mahārāja vartate hṛdaye mama | māyāmadhye vartamānaḥ sa kathaṃ niḥspṛho bhavet || 1 || śāstrajñānaṃ ca samprāpya nityānityavicāraṇam | tyajate na mano mohaṃ sa kathaṃ mucyate naraḥ || 2 || antargataṃ tamaśchettuṃ śāstrādbodho hi na kṣamaḥ | yathā na naśyati tamaḥ kṛtayā dīpavārtayā || 3 || adrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣu kartavyaḥ sarvadā budhaiḥ | sa kathaṃ rājaśārdūla gṛhasthasya bhavettathā || 4 || vittaiṣaṇā na te śāntā tathā rājyasukhaiṣaṇā | jayaiṣaṇā ca saṅgrāme jīvanmuktaḥ kathaṃ bhaveḥ || 5 || caureṣu caurabuddhistu sādhubuddhistu tāpase | svaparatvaṃ tavāpyasti videhastvaṃ kathaṃ nṛpa || 6 || kaṭutīkṣṇukaṣāyāmlarasānvetsi śubhāśubhān | śubheṣu ramate cittaṃ nāśubheṣu tathā nṛpa || 7 || jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiśca tava rājan bhavanti hi | avasthāstu yathākālaṃ turīyā tu kathaṃ nṛpa || 8 || padātyaśvarathebhāśca sarve vai vaśagā mama | svāmyahaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ manyase tvaṃ na manyase || 9 || miṣṭamatsi sadā rājanmudito vimanāstathā | mālāyāṃ ca tathā sarpe samadṛk kva nṛpottama || 10 || vimuktastu bhavedrājan samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ | ekātmabuddhiḥ sarvatra hitakṛtsarvajantuṣu || 11 || na me'dya ramate cittaṃ gṛhadārādiṣu kvacit | ekākī niḥspṛho'tyarthaṃ careyamiti me matiḥ || 12 || niḥsaṅgo nirmamaḥ śāntaḥ patramūlaphalāśanaḥ | mṛgavadvicariṣyāmi nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ || 13 || kiṃ me gṛheṇa vittena bhāryayā ca surūpayā | virāgamanasaḥ kāmaṃ guṇātītasya pārthiva || 14 || cintyase vividhākāraṃ nānārāgasamākulam | dambho'yaṃ kila te bhāti vimukto'smīti bhāṣase || 15 || kadācicchatrujā cintā dhanajā ca kadācana | kadācitsainyajā cintā niścinto'si kadā nṛpa || 16 || vaikhānasā ye munayo mitāhārā jitavratāḥ | te'pi muhyanti saṃsāre jānanto'pi hyasatyatām || 17 || tava vaṃśasamutthānāṃ videhā iti bhūpate | kuṭilaṃ nāma jānīhi nānyatheti kadācana || 18 || vidyādharo yathā mūrkho janmāndhastu divākaraḥ | lakṣmīdharo daridraśca nāma teṣāṃ nirarthakam || 19 || tava vaṃśodbhavā ye ye śrutāḥ pūrve mayā nṛpāḥ | videhā iti vikhyātā nāmataḥ karmato na te || 20 || nimināmābhavadrājā pūrvaṃ tava kule nṛpa | yajñārthaṃ sa tu rājarṣirvasiṣṭhaṃ svaguruṃ munim || 21 || nimantrayāmāsa tadā tamuvāca nṛpaṃ muniḥ | nimantrito'smi yajñārthaṃ devendreṇādhunā kila || 22 || kṛtvā tasya makhaṃ pūrṇaṃ kariṣyāmi tavāpi vai | tāvatkuruṣva rājendra sambhāraṃ tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 23 || ityuktyā niryayau so'tha mahendrayajane muniḥ | nimiranyaṃ guruṃ kṛtvā cakāra makhamuttamam || 24 || tacchrutvā kupito'tyarthaṃ vasiṣṭho nṛpatiṃ punaḥ | śaśāpa ca patatvadya dehaste gurulopaka || 25 || rājāpi taṃ śaśāpātha tavāpi ca patatvayam | anyonyaśāpātpatitau tāveva ca mayā śrutam || 26 || videhena ca rājendra kathaṃ śapto guruḥ svayam | vinoda iva me citte vibhāti nṛpasattama || 27 || janaka uvāca satyamuktaṃ tvayā nātra mithyā kiñcididaṃ matam | tathāpi śṛṇu viprendra gururmama supūjitaḥ || 28 || pituḥ saṅgaṃ parityajya tvaṃ vanaṃ gantumicchasi | mṛgaiḥ saha susambandho bhavitā te na saṃśayaḥ || 29 || mahābhūtāni sarvatra niḥsaṅgaḥ kva bhaviṣyasi | āhārārthaṃ sadā cintā niścintaḥ syāḥ kathaṃ mune || 30 || daṇḍājinakṛtā cintā yathā tava vane'pi ca | tathaiva rājyacintā me cintayānasya vā na vā || 31 || vikalpopahatastvaṃ vai dūradeśamupāgataḥ | na me vikalpasandeho nirvikalpo'smi sarvathā || 32 || sukhaṃ svapimi viprāhaṃ sukhaṃ bhuñjāmi sarvathā | na baddho'smīti buddhyāhaṃ sarvadaiva sukhī mune || 33 || tvaṃ tu duḥkhī sadaivāsi baddho'hamiti śaṅkayā | iti śaṅkāṃ parityajya sukhī bhava samāhitaḥ || 34 || deho'yaṃ mama bandho'yaṃ na mameti ca muktatā | tathā dhanaṃ gṛhaṃ rājyaṃ na mameti ca niścayaḥ || 35 || sūta uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya śukaḥ prītamanābhavat | āpṛcchya taṃ jagāmāśu vyāsasyāśramamuttamam || 36 || āgacchantaṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyāso'pi sukhamāptavān | āliṅgyāghrāya mūrdhānaṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ punaḥ || 37 || sthitastatrāśrame ramye pituḥ pārśve samāhitaḥ | vedādhyayanasampannaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 38 || janakasya daśāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājyasthasya mahātmanaḥ | sa nirvṛtiṃ parāṃ prāpya piturāśramasaṃsthitaḥ || 39 || pitṝṇāṃ subhagā kanyā pīvarī nāma sundarī | śukaścakāra patnīṃ tāṃ yogamārgasthito'pi hi || 40 || sa tasyāṃ janayāmāsa putrāṃścatura eva hi | kṛṣṇaṃ gauraprabhaṃ caiva bhūriṃ devaśrutaṃ tathā || 41 || kanyāṃ kīrtiṃ samutpādya vyāsaputraḥ pratāpavān | dadau vibhrājaputrāya tvaṇuhāya mahātmane || 42 || aṇuhasya sutaḥ śrīmānbrahmadattaḥ pratāpavān | brahmajñaḥ pṛthivīpālaḥ śakakanyāsamudbhavaḥ || 43 || kālena kiyatā tatra nāradasyopadeśataḥ | jñānaṃ paramakaṃ prāpya yogamārgamanuttamam || 44 || putre rājyaṃ nidhāyātha gato badarikāśramam | māyābījopadeśena tasya jñānaṃ nirargalam || 45 || nāradasya prasādena jātaṃ sadyo vimuktidam | kailāsaśikhare ramye tyaktvā saṅgaṃ pituḥ śukaḥ || 46 || dhyānamāsthāya vipulaṃ sthitaḥ saṅgaparāṅmukhaḥ | utpapāta gireḥ śṛṅgātsiddhiṃ ca paramāṃ gataḥ || 47 || ākāśago mahātejā virarāja yathā raviḥ | gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ dvidhā jātaṃ śukasyotpatane tadā || 48 || utpātā bahavo jātāḥ śukaścākāśago'bhavat | antarikṣe yathā vāyuḥ stūyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ || 49 || tejasātivirājanvai dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ | vyāsastu virahākrāntaḥ krandanputreti cāsakṛt || 50 || gireḥ śṛṅge gatastatra śuko yatra sthito'bhavat | krandamānaṃ tadā dīnaṃ vyāsaṃ matvā śramākulam || 51 || sarvabhūtagataḥ sākṣī pratiśabdamadāttadā | tatrādyāpi gireḥ śṛṅge pratiśabdaḥ sphuṭo'bhavat || 52 || rudantaṃ taṃ samālakṣya vyāsaṃ śokasamanvitam | putra putreti bhāṣantaṃ viraheṇa pariplutam || 53 || śivastatra samāgatya pārāśaryamabodhayat | vyāsa śokaṃ mā kuru tvaṃ putraste yogavittamaḥ || 54 || paramāṃ gatimāpanno durlabhāṃ cākṛtātmabhiḥ | tasya śoko na kartavyastvayāśokaṃ vijānatā || 55 || kīrtiste vipulā jātā tena putreṇa cānagha | vyāsa uvāca na śoko yāti deveśa kiṃ karomi jagatpate || 56 || atṛpte locane me'dya putradarśanalālase | mahādeva uvāca chāyāṃ drakṣyasi putrasya
