svasutānāha sarvānsarpānvaśe sthitān | bālāñchyāmānprakurvantu yāvato'śvaśarīrake || 15 || neti kecana tatrāhustānathāsau śaśāpa ha | janamejayasya yajñe vai gamiṣyatha hutāśanam || 16 || anye cakrurhayaṃ sarpāḥ karburaṃ varṇabhogakaiḥ | veṣṭayitvāsya pucchaṃ tu mātuḥ priyacikīrṣayā || 17 || bhaginyau ca susaṃyukte gatvā dadṛśaturhayam | karburaṃ taṃ hayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinatā cātiduḥkhitā || 18 || tadājagāma garuḍaḥ sutastasyā mahābalaḥ | sa dṛṣṭvā mātaraṃ dīnāmapṛcchatpannagāśanaḥ || 19 || mātaḥ kathaṃ sudīnāsi ruditeva vibhāsi me | jīvamāne mayi sute tathānye ravisārathau || 20 || duḥkhitāsi tato vāṃ dhigjīvitaṃ cārulocane | kiṃ jātena sutenātha yadi mātā suduḥkhitā || 21 || śaṃsa me kāraṇaṃ mātaḥ karomi vigatajvarām | vinatovāca sapatnyā dāsyahaṃ putra kiṃ bravīmi vṛthā kṣatā || 22 || vaha māṃ sā bravītyadya tenāsmi duḥkhitā suta | garuḍa uvāca vahiṣye'haṃ tatra kila yatra sā gantumutsukā || 23 || mā śokaṃ kuru kalyāṇi niścintāṃ tvāṃ karomyaham | vyāsa uvāca ityuktā sā gatā pārśvaṃ kadrośca vinatā tadā || 24 || dāsībhāvamapākartuṃ garuḍo'pi mahābalaḥ | uvāha tāṃ saputrāṃ vai sindhoḥ pāraṃ jagāma ha || 25 || gatvā tāṃ garuḍaḥ prāha brūhi mātarnamo'stu te | kathaṃ mucyeta me mātā dāsībhāvādasaṃśayam || 26 || kadrūruvāca amṛtaṃ devalokāttvaṃ balādānīya me sutān | samarpaya sutādyāśu mātaraṃ mocayābalām || 27 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktaḥ prayayau śīghramindralokaṃ mahābalaḥ | kṛtvā yuddhaṃ jahārāśu sudhākumbhaṃ khagottamaḥ || 28 || samānīyāmṛtaṃ mātre vainateyaḥ samarpayat | mocitā vinatā tena dāsībhāvādasaṃśayam || 29 || amṛtaṃ sañjahārendraḥ snātuṃ sarpā yadā gatāḥ | dāsībhāvādvinirmuktā vinatā vipaterbalāt || 30 || tatrāstīrṇāḥ kuśāstaistu līḍhāḥ pannaganāmakaiḥ | dvijihvāste susampannāḥ kuśāgrasparśamātrataḥ || 31 || mātrā śaptāśca ye nāgā vāsukipramukhāḥ śucā | brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatvā te hocuḥ śāpajaṃ bhayam || 32 || tānāha bhagavānbrahmā jaratkārurmahāmuniḥ | vāsukerbhaginīṃ tasmai arpayadhvaṃ sanāmikām || 33 || tasyāṃ yo jāyate putraḥ sa vastrātā bhaviṣyati | āstīka iti nāmāsau bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 34 || vāsukistu tadākarṇya vacanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śivam | vanaṃ gatvā sutāṃ tasmai dadau vinayapūrvakam || 35 || sanāmāṃ tāṃ munirjñātvā jaratkāruruvāca tam | apriyaṃ me yadā kuryāttadā tāṃ santyajāmyaham || 36 || vāgbandhaṃ tādṛśaṃ kṛtvā munirjagrāha tāṃ svayam | dattvā ca vāsukiḥ kāmaṃ bhavanaṃ svaṃ jagāma ha || 37 || kṛtvā parṇakuṭīṃ śubhrāṃ jaratkārurmahāvane | tayā saha sukhaṃ prāpa ramamāṇaḥ parantapa || 38 || ekadā bhojanaṃ kṛtvā supto'sau munisattamaḥ | bhaginī vāsukestatra saṃsthitā varavarṇinī || 39 || na sambodhayitavyo'haṃ tvayā kānte kathañcana | ityuktvā tu gato nidrāṃ munistāṃ sudatīṃ tadā || 40 || ravirastagiriṃ prāptaḥ sandhyākāla upasthite | kiṃ karomi na me śāntistyajenmāṃ bodhitaḥ punaḥ || 41 || dharmalopabhayādbhītā jaratkāruracintayat | nocetprabothayāmyenaṃ sandhyākālo vṛthā vrajet || 42 || dharmanāśādvaraṃ tyāgastathāpi maraṇaṃ dhruvam | dharmahānirnarāṇāṃ hi narakāya bhavetpunaḥ || 43 || iti sañcintya sā bālā taṃ muniṃ pratyabodhayat | sandhyākālo'pi sañjāta uttiṣṭhottiṣṭhasuvrata || 44 || utthito'sau muniḥ kopāttāmuvāca vrajāmyaham | tvaṃ tu bhrātṛgṛhaṃ yāhi nidrāvicchedakāriṇī || 45 || vepamānābravīdvākyamityuktā muninā tadā | bhrātrā dattā yadarthaṃ tatkathaṃ syādamitaprabha || 46 || muniḥ prāha jaratkāruṃ tadastīti nirākulaḥ | gatā sā muninā tyaktā vāsukeḥ sadanaṃ tadā || 47 || pṛṣṭā bhrātrābravīdvākyaṃ yathoktaṃ patinā tadā | astītyuktvā ca hitvā māṃ gato'sau munisattamaḥ || 48 || vāsukistu tadākarṇya satyāvāṅmunirityuta | viśvāsaṃ ca paraṃ kṛtvā bhaginīṃ tāṃ samāśrayat || 49 || tataḥ kālena kiyatā jāto'sau munibālakaḥ | āstīka iti nāmāsau vikhyātaḥ kurusattama || 50 || tenāyaṃ rakṣito yajñastava pārthivasattama | mātṛpakṣasya rakṣārthaṃ muninā bhāvitātmanā || 51 || bhavyaṃ kṛtaṃ mahārāja mānito'yaṃ tvayā muniḥ | yāyāvarakulotpano vāsukerbhaginīsutaḥ || 52 || svasti te'stu mahābāho bhārataṃ sakalaṃ śrutam | dānāni bahu dattāni pūjitā munayastathā || 53 || kṛtena sukṛtenāpi na pitā svargatiṃ gataḥ | pāvitaṃ na kulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tvayā bhūpatisattama || 54 || devyāścāyatanaṃ bhūpa vistīrṇaṃ kuru bhaktitaḥ | yena vai sakalā siddhistava syājjanamejaya || 55 || pūjitā parayā bhaktyā śivā sakaladā sadā | kulavṛddhiṃ karotyeva rājyaṃ ca susthiraṃ sadā || 56 || devīmakhaṃ vidhānena kṛtvā pārthivasattama | śrīmadbhāgavataṃ nāma purāṇaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu || 57 || tvāmahaṃ śrāvayiṣyāmi kathāṃ paramapāvanīm | saṃsāratāriṇīṃ divyāṃ nānārasasamāhṛtām || 58 || na śrotavyaṃ paraṃ cāsmātpurāṇādvidyate bhuvi | nārādhyaṃ vidyate rājandevīpādāmbujādṛte || 59 || te sabhāgyāḥ kṛtaprajñā dhanyāste nṛpasattama | yeṣāṃ citte sadā devī vasati premasaṃkule || 60 || suduḥkhitāste dṛśyante bhuvi bhārata bhārate | nārādhitā mahāmāyā yairjanaiśca sadāmbikā || 61 || brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve yadārādhanatatparāḥ | vartante sarvadā rājaṃstāṃ na seveta ko janaḥ || 62 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt | bhagavatyā samākhyātaṃ viṣṇave yadanuttamam || 63 || tena śrutena te rājaṃścitte śāntirbhaviṣyati | pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayaḥ svargaḥ purāṇaśravaṇādbhavet || 64 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaskandhe śrotṛpravaktṛprasaṅgo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <3.1> bhuvaneśvarīvarṇanam janamejaya uvāca bhagavan bhavatā proktaṃ yajñamambābhidhaṃ mahat | sā kā kathaṃ samutpannā kutra kasmācca kiṃguṇā || 1 || kīdṛśaśca makhastasyāḥ svarūpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tathā | vidhānaṃ vidhivadbrūhi sarvajño'si dayānidhe || 2 || brahmāṇḍasya tathotpattiṃ vada vistaratastathā | yathoktaṃ yādṛśaṃ brahmannakhilaṃ vetsi bhūsura || 3 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca trayo devā mayā śrutāḥ | sṛṣṭipālanasaṃhārakārakāḥ saguṇāstvamī || 4 || svatantrāste mahātmānaḥ pārāśarya vadasva me | āhosvitparatantrāste śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam || 5 || mṛtyudharmāśca te no vā saccidānandarūpiṇaḥ | adhibhūtādibhiryuktā na vā duḥkhaistridhātmakaiḥ || 6 || kālasya vaśagā no vā te sureṃdrā mahābalāḥ | kathaṃ te vai samutpannā kasmāditi ca saṃśayaḥ || 7 || harṣaśokayutāste vai nidrālasyasamanvitāḥ | saptadhātumayāsteṣāṃ dehāḥ kiṃ vānyathā mune || 8 || kairdravyairnirmitāste vai kairguṇairindriyaistathā | bhogaśca kīdṛśasteṣāṃ pramāṇamāyuṣastathā || 9 || nivāsasthānamapyeṣāṃ vibhūtiṃ ca vadasva me | śrotumicchāmyahaṃ brahman vistareṇa kathāmimām || 10 || vyāsa uvāca durgamaḥ praśnabhāro'yaṃ kṛto rājaṃstvayā'dhunā | brahmādīnāṃ samutpattiḥ kasmāditi mahāmate || 11 || etadeva mayā pūrvaṃ pṛṣṭo'sau nārado muniḥ | vismitaḥ pratyuvācedamutthitaḥ śṛṇu bhūpate || 12 || kasmiṃśca samaye cāhaṃ gaṅgātīre sthitaṃ munim | apaśyaṃ nāradaṃ śāntaṃ sarvajñaṃ vedavittamam || 13 || dṛṣṭvāhaṃ mudito bhūtvā pādayorapataṃ muneḥ | tejājñaptaḥ samīpe'sya saṃviṣṭaśca varāsane || 14 || śrutvā kuśalavārtāṃ vai tamapṛcchaṃ vidheḥ sutam | nirviṣṭaṃ jāhnavītīre nirjane sūkṣmavāluke || 15 || mune'tivitatasyāsya brahmāṇḍasya mahāmate | kaḥ kartā paramaḥ proktastanme brūhi vidhānataḥ || 16 || kasmādetatsamutpannaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ munisattama | anityaṃ vā tathā nityaṃ tadācakṣva dvijottama || 17 || ekakartṛkametadvā bahukartṛkamanyathā | akartṛkaṃ na kāryaṃ syādvirodho'yaṃ vibhāti me || 18 || iti sandehasandohe magnaṃ māṃ tārayādhunā | vikalpakoṭīḥ kṛrvāṇaṃ saṃsāre'smin pravistare || 19 || bruvanti śaṃkaraṃ kecinmatvā kāraṇakāraṇam | sadāśivaṃ mahādevaṃ pralayotpattivarjitam || 20 || ātmārāmaṃ sureśaṃ ca triguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ haram | saṃsāratārakaṃ nityaṃ sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇam || 21 || anye viṣṇuṃ stuvantyenaṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhumīśvaram | paramātmānamavyaktaṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitam || 22 || bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ śāntaṃ sarvādiṃ sarvatomukham | vyāpakaṃ viśvaśaraṇamanādinidhanaṃ harim || 23 || dhātāraṃ ca tathā cānye bruvanti sṛṣṭikāraṇam | tameva sarvavettāraṃ sarvabhūtapravartakam || 24 || caturmukhaṃ sureśānaṃ nābhipadmabhavaṃ vibhum | sraṣṭāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ satyalokanivāsinam || 25 || dineśaṃ pravadantyanye sarveśaṃ vedavādinaḥ | stuvanti caiva gāyanti sāyaṃ prātaratandritāḥ || 26 || yajanti ca tathā yajñe vāsavaṃ ca śatakratum | sahasrākṣaṃ devadevaṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhumulbaṇam || 27 || yajñādhīśaṃ surādhīśaṃ trilokeśaṃ śacīpatim | yajñānāṃ caiva bhoktāraṃ somapaṃ somapapriyam || 28 || varuṇaṃ ca tathā somaṃ pāvakaṃ pavanaṃ tathā | yamaṃ kuberaṃ dhanadaṃ gaṇādhīśaṃ tathāpare || 29 || herambaṃ gajavaktraṃ ca sarvakāryaprasādhakam | smaraṇātsiddhidaṃ kāmaṃ kāmadaṃ kāmagaṃ param || 30 || bhavānīṃ kecanācāryāḥ pravadantyakhilārthadām | ādimāyāṃ mahāśaktiṃ prakṛtiṃ puruṣānugām || 31 || brahmaikatāsamāpannāṃ sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇīm | mātaraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ devatānāṃ tathaiva ca || 32 || anādinidhanāṃ pūrṇāṃ vyāpikāṃ sarvajantuṣu | īśvarīṃ sarvalokānāṃ nirguṇāṃ saguṇāṃ śivām || 33 || vaiṣṇavīṃ śāṅkarīṃ brāhmīṃ vāsavīṃ vāruṇīṃ tathā | vārāhīṃ nārasiṃhīṃ ca mahālakṣmīṃ tathādbhutām || 34 || vedamātaramekāṃ ca vidyāṃ bhavataroḥ sthirām | sarvaduḥkhanihantrīṃ ca smaraṇātsarvakāmadām || 35 || mokṣadāṃ ca mumukṣūṇāṃ kāmadāṃ ca phalārthinām | triguṇātītarūpāṃ ca guṇavistārakārakām || 36 || nirguṇāṃ saguṇāṃ tasmāttāṃ dhyāyanti phalārthinaḥ | niraṃjanaṃ nirākāraṃ nirlepaṃ nirguṇaṃ kila || 37 || arūpaṃ vyāpakaṃ brahma pravadanti munīśvarāḥ | vedopaniṣadi proktastejomaya iti kvacit || 38 || sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasranayanastathā | sahasrakarakarṇaśca sahasrāsyaḥ sahasrapāt || 39 || viṣṇoḥ pādamathākāśaṃ paramaṃ samudāhṛtam | virājaṃ virajaṃ śāntaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 40 || puruṣottamaṃ tathā cānye pravadanti purāvidaḥ | naiko'pīti vadantyanye prabhurīśaḥ kadācana || 41 || anīśvaramidaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍamiti kecana | na kadāpīśajanyaṃ yajjagadetadacintitam || 42 || sadaivedamanīśaṃ ca svabhāvotthaṃ sadedṛśam | akartāsau pumānproktaḥ prakṛtistu tathā ca sā || 43 || evaṃ vadanti sāṅkhyāśca munayaḥ kapilādayaḥ | ete sandehasandohāḥ prabhavanti tathā'pare || 44 || vikalpopahataṃ cetaḥ kiṃ karomi munīśvara | dharmādharmavivakṣāyāṃ na mano me sthiraṃ bhavet || 45 || ko dharmaḥ kīdṛśo'dharmaścihnaṃ naivopalabhyate | devāḥ sattvaguṇotpannāḥ satyadharmavyavasthitāḥ || 46 || pīḍyante dānavaiḥ pāpaiḥ kutra dharmavyavasthitiḥ | dharmasthitāḥ sadācārāḥ pāṇḍavā mama vaṃśajāḥ || 47 || duḥkhaṃ bahuvidhaṃ prāptāstatra dharmasya kā sthitiḥ | ato me hṛdayaṃ tāta vepate'tīva saṃśaye || 48 || kuru me'saṃśayaṃ cetaḥ samartho'si mahāmune | trāhi saṃsāravārdhestvaṃ jñānapotena māṃ mune || 49 || majjantaṃ cotpatantaṃ ca magnaṃ mohajalāvile || 50 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe bhuvaneśvarīvarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || <3.2> brahmādīnāṅgativarṇanam vyāsa uvāca yattvayā ca mahābāho pṛṣṭo'haṃ kurusattama | tānpraśnānnāradaḥ prāha mayā pṛṣṭo munīśvaraḥ || 1 || nārada uvāca vyāsa kiṃ te bravīmyadya purā'yaṃ saṃśayo mama | utpanno hṛdaye'tyarthaṃ saṃdehāsārapīḍitaḥ || 2 || gatvā'haṃ pitaraṃ sthāne brahmāṇamamitaujasam | apṛcchaṃ yattvayā pṛṣṭaṃ vyāsādya praśnamuttamam || 3 || pitaḥ kutaḥ samutpannaṃ brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ vibho | bhavatkṛtena vā samyak kiṃ vā viṣṇukṛtaṃ tvidam || 4 || rudrakṛtaṃ vā viśvātman brūhi satyaṃ jagatpate | ārādhanīyaḥ kaḥ kāmaṃ sarvotkṛṣṭaśca kaḥ prabhuḥ || 5 || tatsarvaṃ vada me brahmansandehāṃśchindhi cānagha | nimagno hyasmi saṃsāre duḥkharūpe'nṛtopame || 6 || sandehāndolitaṃ ceto na praśāmyati kutracit | na tīrtheṣu na deveṣu sādhaneṣvitareṣu ca || 7 || avijñāya paraṃ tattvaṃ kutaḥ śāntiḥ parantapa | vikīrṇaṃ bahudhā cittaṃ naikatra sthiratāṃ vrajet || 8 || kaṃ smarāmi yaje kaṃ vā kaṃ vrajāmyarcayāmi kam | staumi kaṃ nābhijānāmi deva sarveśvareśvaram || 9 || tato māṃ pratyuvācedaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | mayā satyavatīsūno kṛte praśne sudustare || 10 || brahmovāca kiṃ bravīmi sutādyāhaṃ durbodhaṃ praśnamuttamam | tvayāśakyaṃ mahābhāga viṣṇorapi suniścayāt || 11 || rāgī ko'pi na jānāti saṃsāre'sminmahāmate | viraktaśca vijānāti nirīho yo vimatsaraḥ || 12 || ekārṇave purā jāte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame bhūtamātre samutpanne sañjajñe kamalādaham || 13 || nāpaśyaṃ taraṇiṃ somaṃ na vṛkṣānna ca parvatān | karṇikāyāṃ samāviṣṭaścintāmakaravaṃ tadā || 14 || kasmādahaṃ samudbhūtaḥ salile'sminmahārṇave | ko me trātā prabhuḥ kartā saṃhartā vā yugātyaye || 15 || na ca bhūrvidyate spaṣṭā yadādhāraṃ jalaṃ tvidam | paṅkajaṃ kathamutpannaṃ prasiddhaṃ rūḍhiyogayoḥ || 16 || paśyāmyadyāsya paṅkaṃ taṃ mūlaṃ vai paṅkajasya ca | bhaviṣyati dharā tatra mūlaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 17 || uttaransalile tatra yāvadvarṣasahasrakam | anveṣamāṇo dharaṇīṃ nāvāpa tāṃ yadā tadā || 18 || tapastapeti cākāśe vāgabhūdaśarīriṇī | tato mayā tapastaptaṃ padme varṣasahasrakam || 19 || sṛjeti punarudbhūtā vāṇī tatra śrutā mayā | vimūḍho'haṃ tadākarṇya kaṃ sṛjāmi karomi kim || 20 || tadā daityāvapi prāptau dāruṇau madhukaiṭabhau | tābhyāṃ vibhīṣitaścāhaṃ yuddhāya makarālaye || 21 || tato'haṃ nālamālambya vārimadhyamavātaram | tadā tatra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ paramādbhutaḥ || 22 || meghaśyāmaśarīrastu pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ | śeṣaśāyī jagannātho vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || 23 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmādyāyudhaiḥ suvirājitaḥ | tamadrākṣaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ śeṣaparyaṅkaśāyinam || 24 || yoganidrāsamākrāntamavispandinamacyutam | śayānaṃ taṃ samālokya bhogibhogopari sthitam || 25 || cintā mamādbhutā jātā kiṃ karomīti nārada | mayā smṛtā tadā devī stutā nidrāsvarūpiṇī || 26 || dehānnirgatya sā devī gagane saṃsthitā śivā | avitarkyaśarīrā sā divyābharaṇamaṇḍitā || 27 || viṣṇordehaṃ vihāyāśu virarāja nabhaḥsthitā | udatiṣṭhadameyātmā tayā mukto janārdanaḥ || 28 || paṃcavarṣasahasrāṇi kṛtavān yuddhamuttamam | tadā vilokitau daityau hariṇā vinipātitau || 29 || utsaṅgaṃ vimalaṃ kṛtvā tatraiva nihatau ca tau | rudrastatraiva samprāpto yatrāvāṃ saṃsthitāvubhau || 30 || tribhiḥ saṃvīkṣitāsmāmiḥ svasthā devī manoharā | saṃstutā paramā śaktiruvācāsmānavasthitān || 31 || kṛpāvalokanaiḥ kṛtvā pāvanairmuditānatha | devyuvāca kājeśāḥ svāni kāryāṇi kurudhvaṃ samatandritāḥ || 32 || sṛṣṭisthitiviśiṣṭāni hatāvetau mahāsurau | kṛtvā svāni niketāni vasadhvaṃ vigatajvarāḥ || 33 || prajāścaturvidhāḥ sarvāḥ sṛjadhvaṃ svavibhūtibhiḥ | brahmovāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ peśalaṃ sukhadaṃ mṛdu || 34 || abrūma tāmaśaktiḥ smaḥ kathaṃ kurmastvimāḥ prajāḥ | na mahī vitatā mātaḥ sarvatra vitataṃ jalam || 35 || na bhūtāni guṇāścāpi tanmātrāṇīndriyāṇi ca | tadākarṇya vaco'smākaṃ śivā jātā smitānanā || 36 || jhaṭityevāgataṃ tatra vimānaṃ gaganācchubham | sovācāsminsurāḥ kāmaṃ viśadhvaṃ gatasādhvasāḥ || 37 || vimāne brahmaviṣṇvīśā darśayāmyadya cādbhutam | tanniśamya vacastasyā omityuktvā punarvayam || 38 || samāruhyopaviṣṭāḥ smo vimāne ratnamaṇḍite | muktādāmasusaṃvīte kiṅkiṇījālaśabdite || 39 || surasadmanibhe ramye trayastatrāviśaṅkitāḥ | sopaviṣṭāṃstato dṛṣṭvā devyasmānvijitendriyān || 40 || svaśaktyā tadvimānaṃ vai nodayāmāsa cāmbare || 41 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe brahmādīnāṅgativarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <3.3> vimānasthairharādibhirdevīdarśanam brahmovāca vimānaṃ tanmanovegaṃ yatra sthānāntare gatam | na jalaṃ tatra paśyāmo vismitāḥ smo vayaṃ tadā || 1 || vṛkṣāḥ sarvaphalā ramyāḥ kokilārāvamaṇḍitāḥ | mahī mahīdharāḥ kāmaṃ vanānyupavanāni ca || 2 || nāryaśca puruṣāścaiva paśavaśca saridvarāḥ | vāpyaḥ kūpāstaḍāgāśca palvalāni ca nirjharāḥ || 3 || purato nagaraṃ ramyaṃ divyaprākāramaṇḍitam | yajñaśālāsamāyuktaṃ nānāharmyavirājitam || 4 || pratyabhijñā tadā jātāpyasmākaṃ prekṣya tatpuram | svargo'yamiti kenāsau nirmitosti tadādbhutam || 5 || rājānaṃ devasaṅkāśaṃ vrajantaṃ mṛgayāṃ vane | asmābhiḥ saṃsthitā dṛṣṭā vimānopari cāmbikā || 6 || kṣaṇāccacāla gagane vimānaṃ pavaneritam | muhūrtādvā tataḥ prāptaṃ deśe cānye manohare || 7 || nandanaṃ ca vanaṃ tatra dṛṣṭamasmābhiruttamam | pārijātatarucchāyāsaṃśritā surabhiḥ sthitā || 8 || caturdanto gajastasyāḥ samīpe samavasthitaḥ | apsarasāṃ tatra vṛndāni menakāprabhṛtīni ca || 9 || krīḍanti vividhairbhāvairgānanṛtyasamanvitaiḥ | gandharvāḥ śataśastatra yakṣā vidyādharāstathā || 10 || mandāravāṭikāmadhye gāyanti ca ramanti ca dṛṣṭaḥ śatakratustatra paulomyā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 11 || vayaṃ tu vismitāścāsma dṛṣṭvā traiviṣṭapaṃ tadā | yādaḥpatiṃ kuberaṃ ca yamaṃ sūryaṃ vibhāvasum || 12 || vilokya vismitāścāsma vayaṃ tatra surānsthitān | tadā vinirgato rājā purāttasmātsumaṇḍitāt || 13 || devarāja ivākṣobhyo naravāhyāvanau sthitaḥ | vimānasthā vayaṃ tacca cacāla tarasāgatam || 14 || brahmalokaṃ tadā divyaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam | tatra brahmāṇamālokya vismitau harakeśavau || 15 || sabhāyāṃ tatra vedāśca sarve sāṅgāḥ svarūpiṇaḥ | sāgarāḥ saritaścaiva parvatāḥ pannagoragāḥ || 16 || māmūcatuścaturvaktraḥ ko'yaṃ brahmā sanātanaḥ | tāvavocamahaṃ naiva jāne sṛṣṭipatiṃ patim || 17 || ko'haṃ ko'yaṃ kimarthaṃ vā bhramo'yaṃ mama ceśvarau | kṣaṇādatha vimānaṃ taccacālāśu manojavam || 18 || kailāsaśikhare prāptaṃ ramye yakṣagaṇānvite | mandāravāṭikāramye kīrakokilakūjite || 19 || vīṇāmurajavādyaiśca nādite sukhade śive | yadā prāptaṃ vimānaṃ tattadaiva sadanācchubhāt || 20 || nirgato bhagavāñchambhurvṛṣārūḍhastrilocanaḥ | pañcānano daśabhujaḥ kṛtasomārdhaśekharaḥ || 21 || vyāghracarmaparīdhāno gajacarmottarīyakaḥ | pārṣṇirakṣau mahāvīrau gajānanaṣaḍānanau || 22 || śivena saha putrau dvau vrajamānau virejatuḥ | nandiprabhṛtayaḥ sarve gaṇapāśca varāśca te || 23 || jayaśabdaṃ prayuñjānā vrajanti śivapṛṣṭhagāḥ | taṃ vīkṣya śaṅkaraṃ cānyaṃ vismitāstatra nārada || 24 || mātṛbhiḥ saṃśayāviṣṭastatrāhaṃ nyavasaṃ mune | kṣaṇāttasmādgireḥ śṛṅgādvimānaṃ vātaraṃhasā || 25 || vaikuṇṭhasadanaṃ prāptaṃ ramāramaṇamandiram | asambhāvyā vibhūtiśca tatra dṛṣṭā mayā suta || 26 || visiṣmiye tadā viṣṇurdṛṣṭvā tatpuramuttamam | sadanāgre yayau tāvaddhariḥ kamalalocanaḥ || 27 || atasīkusumābhāsaḥ pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ | dvijarājādhirūḍhaśca divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 28 || vījyamānastadā lakṣmyā kāminyā cāmaraiḥ śubhaiḥ | taṃ vīkṣya vismitāḥ sarve vayaṃ viṣṇuṃ sanātanam || 29 || parasparaṃ nirīkṣantaḥ sthitāstasmin varāsane | tataścacāla tarasā vimānaṃ vātaraṃhasā || 30 || sudhāsamudraḥ samprāptau miṣṭavārimahormimān | yādogaṇasamākīrṇaścaladvīcivirājitaḥ || 31 || mandārapārijātādyaiḥ pādapairatiśobhitaḥ | nānāstaraṇasaṃyukto nānācitravicitritaḥ || 32 || muktādāmaparikliṣṭo nānādāmavirājitaḥ | aśokabakulākhyaiśca vṛkṣaiḥ kurubakādibhiḥ || 33 || saṃvṛtaḥ sarvataḥ saumyaiḥ ketakīcampakairvṛtaḥ | kokilārāvasaṅghuṣṭo divyagandhasamanvitaḥ || 34 || dvirephātiraṇatkārairañjitaḥ paramādbhutaḥ | tasmindvīpe śivākāraḥ paryaṅkaḥ sumanoharaḥ || 35 || ratnālikhacito'tyarthaṃ nānāratnavirājitaḥ | dṛṣṭo'smābhirvimānasthairdūrataḥ parimaṇḍitaḥ || 36 || nānāstaraṇasaṃchanna indracāpasamanvitaḥ | paryaṅkapravare tasminnupaviṣṭā varāṅganā || 37 || raktamālyāmbaradharā raktagandhānulepanā | suraktanayanā kāntā vidyutkoṭisamaprabhā || 38 || sucāruvadanā raktadantacchadavirājitā | ramākoṭyadhikā kāntyā sūryabimbanibhākhilā || 39 || varapāśāṅkuśābhīṣṭadharā śrībhuvaneśvarī | adṛṣṭapūrvā dṛṣṭā sā sundarī smitabhūṣaṇā || 40 || hrīṅkārajapaniṣṭhaistu pakṣivṛndairniṣevitā | aruṇā karuṇāmūrtiḥ kumārī navayauvanā || 41 || sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā mandasmitamukhāmbujā | udyatpīnakucadvandvanirjitāmbhojakuḍmalā || 42 || nānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇabhūṣaṇairupaśobhitā | kanakāṅgadakeyūrakirīṭapariśobhitā || 43 || kanakacchrīcakratāṭaṅkaviṭaṅkavadanāmbujā | hṛllekhā bhuvaneśīti nāmajāpaparāyaṇaiḥ || 44 || sakhīvṛndaiḥ stutā nityaṃ bhuvaneśī maheśvarī | hṛllekhādyābhiramarakanyābhiḥ pariveṣṭitā || 45 || anaṅgakusumādyābhirdevībhiḥ pariveṣṭitā | devī ṣaṭkoṇamadhyasthā yantrarājopari sthitā || 46 || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ vismitāḥ sarve vayaṃ tatra sthitā'bhavan | keyaṃ kāntā ca kiṃ nāma na jānīmo'tra saṃsthitāḥ || 47 || sahasranayanā rāmā sahasrakarasaṃyutā | sahasravadanā ramyā bhāti dūrādasaṃśayam || 48 || nāpsarā nāpi gandharvī neyaṃ devāṅganā kila | iti saṃśayamāpannāstatra nārada saṃsthitāḥ || 49 || tadā'sau bhagavānviṣṇurdṛṣṭvā tāṃ cāruhāsinīm | uvācāmbāṃ svavijñānātkṛtvā manasi niścayam || 50 || eṣā bhagavatī devī sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ hi naḥ | mahāvidyā mahāmāyā pūrṇā prakṛtiravyayā || 51 || durjñeyā'lpadhiyāṃ devī yogagamyā durāśayā | icchā parātmanaḥ kāmaṃ nityānityasvarūpiṇī || 52 || durārādhyā'lpabhāgyaiśca devī viśveśvarī śivā | vedagarbhā viśālākṣī sarveṣāmādirīśvarī || 53 || eṣā saṃhṛtya sakalaṃ viśvaṃ krīḍati saṃkṣaye | liṅgāni sarvajīvānāṃ svaśarīre niveśya ca || 54 || sarvabījamayī hyeṣā rājate sāmprataṃ surau | vibhūtayaḥ sthitāḥ pārśve paśyatāṃ koṭiśaḥ kramāt || 55 || divyābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyā divyagandhānulepanāḥ | paricaryāparāḥ sarvāḥ paśyatāṃ brahmaśaṅkarau || 56 || dhanyā vayaṃ mahābhāgāḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma sāmpratam | yadatra darśanaṃ prāptaṃ bhagavatyāḥ svayaṃ tvidam || 57 || tapastaptaṃ purā yatnāttasyedaṃ phalamuttamam | anyathā darśanaṃ kutra bhavedasmākamādarāt || 58 || paśyanti puṇyapuñjā ye ye vadānyāstapasvinaḥ | rāgiṇo naiva paśyanti devīṃ bhagavatīṃ śivām || 59 || mūlaprakṛtirevaiṣā sadā puruṣasaṅgatā | brahmāṇḍaṃ darśayatyeṣā kṛtvā vai paramātmane || 60 || draṣṭā'sau dṛśyamakhilaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ devatāḥ surau | tasyaiṣā kāraṇaṃ sarvā māyā sarveśvarī śivā || 61 || kvāhaṃ vā kva surāḥ sarve rambhādyāḥ surayoṣitaḥ | lakṣāṃśena tulāmasyā na bhavāmaḥ kathañcana || 62 || saiṣā varāṅganā nāma yā vai dṛṣṭā mahārṇave | bālabhāve mahādevī dolayantīva māṃ mudā || 63 || śayanaṃ vaṭapatre ca paryaṅke susthire dṛḍhe | pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ kare kṛtvā niveśya mukhapaṅkaje || 64 || lelihantañca krīḍantamanekaibālaceṣṭitaiḥ | ramamāṇaṃ komalāṅgaṃ vaṭapatrapuṭe sthitam || 65 || gāyantī dolayantī ca bālabhāvānmayi sthite | seyaṃ suniścitaṃ jñātaṃ jātaṃ me darśanādiva || 66 || kāmaṃ no jananī saiṣā śṛṇu taṃ pravadāmyaham | anubhūtaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ pratyabhijñā samutthitā || 67 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe vimānasthairharādibhirdevīdarśanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <3.4> viṣṇunā kṛtaṃ devīstotram brahmovāca ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ punarāha janārdanaḥ | vayaṃ gacchema pārśve'syāḥ praṇamantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 1 || seyaṃ varā mahāmāyā dāsyatyeṣā varān hi naḥ | stuvāmaḥ sannidhiṃ prāpya nirbhayāścaraṇāntike || 2 || yadi no vārayiṣyanti dvārasthāḥ paricārakāḥ | paṭhiṣyāmaśca tatrasthāḥ stutiṃ devyāḥ samāhitāḥ || 3 || brahmovāca ityukte hariṇā vākye suprahṛṣṭau susaṃsthitau | jātau pramuditau kāmaṃ nikaṭe gamanāya ca || 4 || omityuktvā hariṃ sarve vimānāttvaritāstrayaḥ | uttīrya nirgatā dvāri śaṅkamānā manasyalam || 5 || dvārasthān vīkṣya tānsarvāndevī bhagavatī tadā | smitaṃ kṛtvā cakārāśu tāṃstrīnstrīrūpadhāriṇaḥ || 6 || vayaṃ yuvatayo jātāḥ surūpāścārubhūṣaṇāḥ | vismayai paramaṃ prāptā gatāstatsannidhiṃ punaḥ || 7 || sā dṛṣṭvā naḥ sthitāṃstatra strīrūpāṃścaraṇāntike | vyalokayata cārvaṅgī premasampūrṇayā dṛśā || 8 || praṇamya tāṃ mahādevīṃ purataḥ saṃsthitā vayam | parasparaṃ lokayantaḥ strīrūpāścārubhūṣaṇāḥ || 9 || pādapīṭhaṃ prekṣamāṇā nānāmaṇivibhūṣitam | sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ sthitāstatra vayaṃ trayaḥ || 10 || kāścidraktāmbarāstatra sahacaryaḥ sahasraśaḥ | kāścinnīlāmbarā nāryastathā pītāmbarāḥ śubhāḥ || 11 || devyaḥ sarvāḥ śubhākārā vicitrāmbarabhūṣaṇāḥ | virejuḥ pārśvatastasyāḥ paricaryāparāḥ kila || 12 || jaguśca nanṛtuścānyāḥ paryupāsanta tāḥ striyaḥ | vīṇāmārutavādyāni vādayanto mudānvitāḥ || 13 || śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi yaddṛṣṭaṃ tatra cādbhutam | nakhadarpaṇamadhye vai devyāścaraṇapaṅkaje || 14 || brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ sarvaṃ tatra sthāvarajaṅgamam | ahaṃ viṣṇuśca rudraśca vāyuragniryamo raviḥ || 15 || varuṇaḥ śītagustvaṣṭā kuberaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | parvatāḥ sāgarā nadyo gandharvāpsarasastathā || 16 || viśvāvasuścitraketuḥ śvetaścitrāṅgadastathā | nāradastumburuścaiva hāhāhūhūstathaiva ca || 17 || aśvinau vasavaḥ sādhyāḥ siddhāśca pitarastathā | nāgāḥ śeṣādayaḥ sarve kinnaroragarākṣasāḥ || 18 || vaikuṇṭho brahmalokaśca kailāsaḥ parvatottamaḥ | sarvaṃ tadakhilaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ nakhamadhyasthitaṃ ca naḥ || 19 || majjanmapaṅkajaṃ tatra sthito'haṃ caturānanaḥ | śeṣaśāyī jagannāthastathā ca madhukaiṭabhau || 20 || brahmovāca evaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayā tatra pādapadmanakhe sthitam | vismato'haṃ tato vīkṣya kimetaditi śaṅkitaḥ || 21 || viṣṇuśca vismayāviṣṭaḥ śaṅkaraśca tathā sthitaḥ | tāṃ tadā menire devīṃ vayaṃ viśvasya mātaram || 22 || tato varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ vyatikrāntaṃ prapaśyataḥ | sudhāmaye śive dvīpe vihāraṃ vividhaṃ tadā || 23 || sakhya iva tadā tatra menire'smānavasthitān | devyaḥ pramuditākārā nānābharaṇamaṇḍitāḥ || 24 || vayamapyatiramyatvādbabhūvima vimohitāḥ | prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve paśyanbhāvānmanoramān || 25 || ekadā tāṃ mahādevīṃ devīṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīm | tuṣṭāva bhagavānviṣṇuryuvatībhāvasaṃsthitaḥ || 26 || śrībhagavānuvāca namo devyai prakṛtyai ca vidhātryai satataṃ namaḥ | kalyāṇai kāmadāyai ca vṛddhyai siddhyai namo namaḥ || 27 || saccidānandarūpiṇyai saṃsārāraṇaye namaḥ | pañcakṛtyavidhātryai te bhuvaneśyai namo namaḥ || 28 || sarvādhiṣṭānarūpāyai kūṭasthāyai namo namaḥ | ardhamātrārthabhūtāyai hṛllekhāyai namo namaḥ || 29 || jñātaṃ mayā'khilamidaṃ tvayi sanniviṣṭaṃ tvatto'sya sambhavalayāvapi mātaradya | śaktiśca te'sya karaṇe vitataprabhāvā jñātā'dhunā sakalalokamayīti nūnam || 30 || vistārya sarvamakhilaṃ sadasadvikāraṃ sandarśayasyavikalaṃ puruṣāya kāle | tattvaiśca ṣoḍaśabhireva ca saptabhiśca bhāsīndrajālamiva naḥ kila rañjanāya || 31 || na tvāmṛte kimapi vastugataṃ vibhāti vyāpyaiva sarvamakhilaṃ tvamavasthitā'si | śaktiṃ vinā vyavahṛto puruṣo'pyaśakto vambhaṇyate janani buddhimatā janena || 32 || prīṇāsi viśvamakhilaṃ satataṃ prabhāvaiḥ svaistejasā ca sakalaṃ prakaṭīkaroṣi | atsyeva devi tarasā kila kalpakāle ko veda devi caritaṃ tava vai bhavasya || 33 || trātā vayaṃ janani te madhukaiṭabhābhyāṃ lokāśca te suvitatāḥ khalu darśitā vai | nītāḥ sukhasya bhavane paramāṃ ca koṭiṃ yaddarśanaṃ tava bhavāni mahāprabhāvam || 34 || nāhaṃ bhavo na ca viriṃci viveda mātaḥ ko'nyo hi vetti caritaṃ tava durvibhāvyam | kānīha santi bhuvanāni mahāprabhāve hyasminbhavāni racite racanākalāpe || 35 || asmābhiratra bhuvane hariranya eva dṛṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kamalajaḥ prathitaprabhāvaḥ | anyeṣu devi bhuvanepu na santi kiṃ te kiṃ vidma devi vitataṃ tava suprabhāvam || 36 || yāce'mba te'ṅghrikamalaṃ praṇipatya kāmaṃ citte sadā vasatu rūpamidaṃ tavaitat | nāmāpi vaktrakuhare satataṃ tavaiva sandarśanaṃ tava padāmbujayoḥ sadaiva || 37 || bhṛtyo'yamasti satataṃ mayi bhāvanīyaṃ tvāṃ svāminīti manasā nanu cintayāmi | eṣā''vayoraviratā kila devi bhūyādvyāptiḥ sadaiva jananī sutayorivārthe || 38 || tvaṃ vetsi sarvamakhilaṃ bhuvanaprapañcaṃ sarvajñatā parisamāptinitāntabhūmiḥ | kiṃ pāmareṇa jagadamba nivedanīyaṃ yadyuktamācara bhavāni taveṅgitaṃ syāt || 39 || brahmā sṛjatyavati viṣṇurumāpatiśca saṃhārakāraka iyaṃ tu jane prasiddhiḥ | kiṃ satyametadapi devi tavecchayā vai kartuṃ kṣamā vayamaje tava śaktiyuktāḥ || 40 || dhātrī dharādharasute na jagadbibharti ādhāraśaktirakhilaṃ tava vai bibharti | sūryo'pi bhāti varade prabhayā yutaste tvaṃ sarvametadakhilaṃ virajā vibhāsi || 41 || brahmā'hamīśvaravaraḥ kila te prabhāvātsarve vayaṃ janiyutā na yadā tu nityāḥ | ke'nye surāḥ śatamakhapramukhāśca nityā nityā tvameva jananī prakṛtiḥ purāṇā || 42 || tvaṃ cedbhavāni dayase puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ jāne'hamadya tava saṃnidhigaḥ sadaiva | nocedahaṃ vibhuranādiranīha īśo viśvātmadhīriti tamaḥprakṛtiḥ sadaiva || 43 || vidyā tvameva nanu buddhimatāṃ narāṇāṃ śaktistvameva kila śaktimatāṃ sadaiva | tvaṃ kīrtikāntikamalāmalatuṣṭirūpā muktipradā viratireva manuṣyaloke || 44 || gāyatryasi prathamavedakalā tvameva svāhā svadhā bhagavatī saguṇārdhamātrā | āmnāya eva vihito nigamo bhavatyai sañjīvanāya satataṃ surapūrvajānām || 45 || mokṣārthameva racayasyakhilaṃ prapañcaṃ teṣāṃ gatāḥ khalu yato nanu jīvabhāvam | aṃśā anādinidhanasya kilānaghasya pūrṇārṇavasya vitatā hi yathā taraṅgāḥ || 46 || jīvo yadā tu parivetti tavaiva kṛtyaṃ tvaṃ saṃharasyakhilametaditi prasiddham | nāṭyaṃ naṭena racitaṃ vitathe'ntaraṅge kārye kṛte viramase prathitaprabhāvā || 47 || trātā tvameva mama mohamayādbhavābdhestvāmambike satatamemi mahārtide ca | rāgādibhirviracite vitathe kilānte māmeva pāhi bahuduḥkhakare ca kāle || 48 || namo devi mahāvidye namāmi caraṇau tava | sadā jñānaprakāśaṃ me dehi sarvārthade śive || 49 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe viṣṇunā kṛtaṃ devīstotraṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <3.5> harabrahmakṛtastutivarṇanam brahmovāca ityuktvā virate viṣṇau devadeve janārdane | uvāca śaṅkaraḥ śarvaḥ praṇataḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ || 1 || śiva uvāca yadi haristava devi vibhāvajastadanu padmaja eva tavodbhavaḥ | kimahamatra tavāpi na sadguṇaḥ sakalalokavidhau caturā śive || 2 || tvamasi bhūḥ salilaṃ pavanastathā khamapi vahniguṇaśca tathā punaḥ | janani tāni punaḥ karaṇāni ca tvamasi buddhimano'pyatha haṅkṛtiḥ || 3 || na ca vidanti vadanti ca ye'nyathā hariharājakṛtaṃ nikhilaṃ jagat | tava kṛtāstraya eva sadaiva te viracayanti jagatsacarācaram || 4 || avanivāyukhavahnijalādibhiḥ saviṣayaiḥ saguṇaiśca jagadbhavet | yadi tadā kathamadya ca tatsphuṭaṃ prabhavatīti tavāmba kalāmṛte || 5 || bhavasi sarvamidaṃ sacarācaraṃ tvamajaviṣṇuśivākṛtikalpitam | vividhaveṣavilāsakutūhalairviramase ramase'mba yathāruci || 6 || sakalalokasisṛkṣurahaṃ hariḥ kamalabhūśca bhavāma yadā'mbike | tava padāmbujapāṃsuparigrahaṃ samadhigamya tadā nanu cakrima || 7 || yadi dayārdramanā na sadāmbike kathamahaṃ vihitaśca tamoguṇaḥ | kamalajaśca rajoguṇasaṃbhavaḥ suvihitaḥ kimu sattvaguṇo hariḥ || 8 || yadi na te viṣamā matirambike kathamidaṃ bahudhā vihitaṃ jagat | sacivabhūpatibhṛtyajanāvṛtaṃ bahudhanairadhanaiśca samākulam || 9 || tava guṇāsraya eva sadā kṣamāḥ prakaṭanāvanasaṃharaṇeṣu vai | hariharadruhiṇāśca kramāttvayā viracitāstrijagatāṃ kila kāraṇam || 10 || paricitāni mayā hariṇā tathā kamalajena vimānagatena vai | pathigatairbhuvanāni kṛtāni vā kathaya kena bhavāni navāni ca || 11 || sṛjasi pāsi jagajjagadambike svakalayā kiyadicchasi nāśitum | ramayase svapatiṃ puruṣaṃ sadā tava gatiṃ na hi vidma vayaṃ śive || 12 || janani dehi padāmbujasevanaṃ yuvatibhāgavatānapi naḥ sadā | puruṣatāmadhigamya padāmbujādvirahitāḥ kva labhema sukhaṃ sphuṭam || 13 || na rucirasti mamāmba padāmbujaṃ tava vihāya śive bhuvaneṣvalam | nivasituṃ naradehamavāpya ca tribhuvanasya patitvamavāpya vai || 14 || sudati nāsti manāgapi me ratiryuvatibhāvamavāpya tavāntike | puruṣatā kva sukhāya bhavatyalaṃ tava padaṃ na yadīkṣaṇagocaram || 15 || tribhuvaneṣu bhavatviyamambike mama sadaiva hi kīrtiranāvilā | yuvatibhāvamavāpya padāmbujaṃ paricitaṃ tava saṃsṛtināśanam || 16 || bhuvi vihāya tavāntikasevanaṃ ka iha vāñchati rājyamakaṃṭakam | truṭirasau kila yāti yugātmatāṃ na nikaṭaṃ yadi te'ṅghrisaroruham || 17 || tapasi ye niratā munayo'malāstava vihāya padāmbujapūjanam | janani te vidhinā kila vañcitāḥ paribhavo vibhave parikalpitaḥ || 18 || na tapasā na damena samādhinā na ca tathā vihitaiḥ kratubhiryathā | tava padābjaparāganiṣevaṇādbhavati muktiraje bhavasāgarāt || 19 || kuru dayāṃ dayase yadi devi māṃ kathaya mantramanāvilamadbhutam | samabhavaṃ prajapansukhito hyahaṃ suviśadaṃ ca navārṇamanuttamam || 20 || prathamajanmani cādhigato mayā tadadhunā na vibhāti navākṣaraḥ | kathaya māṃ manumadya bhavārṇavājjanani tāraya tāraya tārake || 21 || ityuktā sā tadā devī śivenādbhutatejasā | uccacārāmbikā mantraṃ prasphuṭaṃ ca navākṣaram || 22 || taṃ gṛhītvā mahādevaḥ parāṃ mudamavāpa ha | praṇamya caraṇau devyāstatraivāvasthitaḥ śivaḥ || 23 || japannavākṣaraṃ mantraṃ kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā | bījayuktaṃ śubhoccāraṃ śaṅkarastasthivāṃstadā || 24 || taṃ tathā'vasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram | avocaṃ tāṃ mahāmāyāṃ saṃsthito'haṃ padāntike || 25 || na vedāstvāmevaṃ kalayitumihāsannapaṭavo yataste nocustvāṃ sakalajanadhātrīmavikalām | svadhābhūtā devī sakalamakhahomeṣu vihitā tadā tvaṃ sarvajñā janani khalu jātā tribhuvane || 26 || kartā'haṃ prakaromi sarvamakhilaṃ brahmāṇḍamatyadbhutaṃ ko'nyostīha carācare tribhuvane mattaḥ samarthaḥ pumān | dhanyo'smyatra na saṃśayaḥ kila yadā brahmā'smi lokātigo magno'haṃ bhavasāgare pravitate garvābhiveśāditi || 27 || adyāhaṃ tava pādapaṅkajaparāgādānagarveṇa vai dhanyo'smīti yathārthavādanipuṇo jātaḥ prasādācca te | yāce tvāṃ bhavabhītināśacaturāṃ muktipradāṃ ceśvarīṃ hitvā mohakṛtaṃ mahārtinigaḍaṃ tvadbhaktiyuktaṃ kuru || 28 || ato'hañca jāto vimuktaḥ kathaṃ syāṃ sarojādameyāttvadāviṣkṛtādvai | tavājñākaraḥ kiṅkaro'smīti nūnaṃ śive pāhi māṃ mohamagnaṃ bhavābdhau || 29 || na jānanti ye mānavāste vadanti prabhuṃ māṃ tavādyaṃ caritraṃ pavitram | yajantīha ye yājakāḥ svargakāmā na te te prabhāvaṃ vidantyeva kāmam || 30 || tvayā nirmito'haṃ vidhitve vihāraṃ vikartuṃ caturdhā vidhāyādisargam | ahaṃ vedmi ko'nyo vivedātimāye kṣamasvāparādhaṃ tvahaṅkārajaṃ me || 31 || śramaṃ ye'ṣṭadhā yogamārge pravṛttāḥ prakurvanti mūḍhāḥ samādhau sthitā vai | na jānanti te nāma mokṣapradaṃ vā samuccāritaṃ jātu mātarmiṣeṇa || 32 || vicāre pare tattvasaṃkhyāvidhāne pade mohitā nāma te saṃvihāya | na kiṃ te vimūḍhā bhavābdhau bhavāni tvamevāsi saṃsāramuktipradā vai || 33 || paraṃ tattvavijñānamādyairjanairyairaje cānubhūtaṃ tyajantyeva te kim | nimeṣārdhamātraṃ pavitraṃ caritraṃ śivā cāmbikā śaktirīśeti nāma || 34 || na kiṃ tvaṃ samarthā'si viśvaṃ vidhātuṃ dṛśaivāśu sarvaṃ caturdhā vibhaktam | vinodārthamevaṃ vidhiṃ māṃ vidhāyādisarge kiledaṃ karoṣīti kāmam || 35 || hariḥ pālakaḥ kiṃ tvayā'sau madhorvā tathā kaiṭabhādrakṣitaḥ sindhumadhye | haraḥ saṃhṛtaḥ kiṃ tvayā'sau na kāle kathaṃ me bhruvormadhyadeśātsa jātaḥ || 36 || na te janma kutrāpi dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vā kutaḥ sambhavaste na ko'pīha veda | kilādyāsi śaktistvamekā bhavāni svatantraiḥ samastairato bodhitā'si || 37 || tvayā saṃyuto'haṃ vikartuṃ samartho haristrātumamba tvayā saṃyutaśca | haraḥ samprahartuṃ tvayaiveha yuktaḥ kṣamā nādya sarve tvayā viprayuktāḥ || 38 || yathā'haṃ hariḥ śaṅkaraḥ kiṃ tathā'nye na jātā na santīha no vā'bhaviṣyan | na muhyanti ke'smiṃstavātyantacitre vinode vivādāspade'lpāśayānām || 39 || akartā guṇaspaṣṭa evādya devo nirīho'nupādhiḥ sadaivākalaśca | tathāpīśvaraste vitīrṇaṃ vinodaṃ susampaśyatītyāhurevaṃ vidhijñāḥ || 40 || dṛṣṭādṛṣṭavibhede'sminprāktvatto vai pumānparaḥ | nānyaḥ ko'pi tṛtīyo'sti prameye suvicārite || 41 || na mithyā vedavākyaṃ vai kalpanīyaṃ kadācana | virodho'yaṃ mayā'tyantaṃ hṛdaye tu viśaṅkitaḥ || 42 || ekamevādvitīyaṃ yadbrahma vedā vadanti vai | sā kiṃ tvaṃ vāpyasau vā kiṃ sandehaṃ vinivartaya || 43 || niḥsaṃśayaṃ na me cetaḥ prabhavatyaviśaṅkitam | dvitvaikatvavicāre'sminnimagnaṃ kṣullakaṃ manaḥ || 44 || svamukhenāpi sandehaṃ chettumarhasi māmakam | puṇyabhogācca me prāptā saṅgatistava pādayoḥ || 45 || pumānasi tvaṃ strī vāsi vada vistarato mama | jñātvā'haṃ paramāṃ śaktiṃ muktaḥ syāṃ bhavasāgarāt || 46 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe harabrahmakṛtastutivarṇanaṃ pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <3.6> brahmaṇe śrīdevyā upadeśavarṇanam brahmovāca iti pṛṣṭā mayā devī vinayāvanatena ca | uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇamādyā bhagavatī hi sā || 1 || devyuvāca sadaikatvaṃ na bhedo'sti sarvadaiva mamāsya ca | yo'sau sāhamahaṃ yo'sau bhedo'sti mativibhramāt || 2 || āvayorantaraṃ sūkṣmaṃ yo veda matimānhi saḥ | vimuktaḥ sa tu saṃsārānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 3 || ekamevādvitīyaṃ vai brahma nityaṃ sanātanam | dvaitabhāvaṃ punaryāti kāla utpitsusaṃjñake || 4 || yathā dīpastathopādheryogātsañjāyate dvidhā | chāyevādarśamadhye vā pratibimbaṃ tathāvayoḥ || 5 || bheda utpattikāle vai sargārthaṃ prabhavatyaja | dṛśyādṛśyavibhedo'yaṃ dvaividhye sati sarvathā || 6 || nāhaṃ strī na pumāṃścāhaṃ na klībaṃ sargasaṃkṣaye | sarge sati vibhedaḥ syātkalpito'yaṃ dhiyā punaḥ || 7 || ahaṃ buddhirahaṃ śrīśca dhṛtiḥ kīrtiḥ smṛtistathā | śraddhā medhā dayā lajjā kṣudhā tṛṣṇā tathā kṣamā || 8 || kāntiḥ śāntiḥ pipāsā ca nidrā tandrā jarājarā | vidyāvidyā spṛhā vāñchā śaktiścāśaktireva ca || 9 || vasā majjā ca tvakcāhaṃ dṛṣṭirvāganṛtānṛtā | parā madhyā ca paśyantī nāḍyo'haṃ vividhāśca yāḥ || 10 || kiṃ nāhaṃ paśya saṃsāre madviyuktaṃ kimasti hi | sarvamevāhamityevaṃ niścayaṃ viddhi padmaja || 11 || etairme niścitai rūpairvihīnaṃ kiṃ vadasva me | tasmādahaṃ vidhe cāsminsarge vai vitatābhavam || 12 || nūnaṃ sarveṣu deveṣu nānānāmadharā hyaham | bhavāmi śaktirūpeṇa karomi ca parākramam || 13 || gaurī brāhmī tathā raudrī vārāhī vaiṣṇavī śivā | vārūṇī cātha kauberī nārasiṃhī ca vāsavī || 14 || utpanneṣu samasteṣu kāryeṣu praviśāmi tān | karomi sarvakāryāṇi nimittaṃ taṃ vidhāya vai || 15 || jale śītaṃ tathā vahnāvauṣṇyaṃ jyotirdivākare | niśānāthe himā kāmaṃ prabhavāmi yathā tathā || 16 || mayā tyaktaṃ vidhe nūnaṃ spandituṃ na kṣamaṃ bhavet | jīvajātaṃ ca saṃsāre niścayo'yaṃ bruve tvayi || 17 || aśaktaḥ śaṅkaro hantuṃ daityānkila mayojjhitaḥ | śaktihīnaṃ naraṃ brūte lokaścaivātidurbalam || 18 || rudrahīnaṃ viṣṇuhīnaṃ na vadanti janāḥ kila | śaktihīnaṃ yathā sarve pravadanti narādhamam || 19 || patitaḥ skhalito bhītaḥ śāntaḥ śatruvaśaṃ gataḥ | aśaktaḥ procyate loke nārudraḥ ko'pi kathyate || 20 || tadviddhi kāraṇaṃ śaktiryathā tvaṃ ca sisṛkṣasi | bhavitā ca yadā yuktaḥ śaktyā kartā tadākhilam || 21 || tathā haristathā śaṃbhustathendro'tha vibhāvasuḥ | śaśī sūryo yamastvaṣṭā varuṇaḥ pavanastathā || 22 || dharā sthirā tadā dhartuṃ śaktiyuktā yadā bhavet | anyathā cedaśaktā syātparamāṇośca dhāraṇe || 23 || tathā śeṣastathā kūrmo ye'nye sarve ca diggajāḥ | madyuktā vai samarthāśca svāni kāryāṇi sādhitum || 24 || jalaṃ pibāmi sakalaṃ saṃharāmi vibhāvasum | pavanaṃ stambhayāmyadya yadicchāmi tathācaram || 25 || tattvānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ kadāpi kamalodbhava | asatāṃ bhāvasandehaḥ kartavyo na kadācana || 26 || kadācitprāgabhāvaḥ syātpradhvaṃsābhāva eva vā | mṛtpiṇḍeṣu kapāleṣu ghaṭābhāvo yathā tathā || 27 || adyātra pṛthivī nāsti kva gateti vicāraṇe | sañjātā iti vijñeyā asyāstu paramāṇavaḥ || 28 || śāśvataṃ kṣaṇikaṃ śūnyaṃ nityānityaṃ sakartukam | ahaṅkārāgrimañcaiva saptabhedairvivakṣitam || 29 || gṛhāṇāja mahatattvamahaṅkārastadudbhavaḥ | tataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni racayasva yathā purā || 30 || vrajantu svāni dhiṣṇyāni viracya nivasantu vaḥ | svāni svāni ca kāryāṇi kurvantu daivabhāvitāḥ || 31 || gṛhāṇemāṃ vidhe śaktiṃ surūpāṃ cāruhāsinīm | mahāsarasvatīṃ nāmnā rajoguṇayutāṃ varām || 32 || śvetāmbaradharāṃ divyāṃ divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | varāsanasamārūḍhāṃ krīḍārthaṃ sahacāriṇīm || 33 || eṣā sahacarī nityaṃ bhaviṣyati varāṅganā | māvamaṃsthā vibhūtiṃ me matvā pūjyatamāṃ priyām || 34 || gaccha tvamanayā sārdhaṃ satyalokaṃ batāśu vai | bījāccaturvidhaṃ sarvaṃ samutpādaya sāmpratam || 35 || liṅgakośāśca jīvaistaiḥ sahitāḥ karmabhistathā | vartante saṃsthitāḥ kāle tānkuru tvaṃ yathā purā || 36 || kālakarmasvabhāvākhyaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ sakalaṃ jagat | svabhāvasvaguṇairyuktaṃ pūrvavatsacarācaram || 37 || mānanīyastvayā viṣṇuḥ pūjanīyaśca sarvadā | sattvaguṇapradhānatvādadhikaḥ sarvataḥ sadā || 38 || yadā yadā hi kāryaṃ vo bhaviṣyati duratyayam | kariṣyati pṛthivyāṃ vai avatāraṃ tadā hariḥ || 39 || tiryagyonāvathānyatra mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritaḥ | dānavānāṃ vināśaṃ vai kariṣyati janārdanaḥ || 40 || bhavo'yaṃ te sahāyaśca bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ | samutpādya surānsarvānviharasva yathāsukham || 41 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā nānāyajñaiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ | yajiṣyanti vidhānena sarvānvaḥ susamāhitāḥ || 42 || mannāmoccāraṇātsarve makheṣu sakaleṣu ca | sadā tṛptāśca santuṣṭā bhaviṣyadhvaṃ surāḥ kila || 43 || śivaśca mānanīyo vai sarvathā yattamoguṇaḥ | yajñakāryeṣu sarveṣu pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 44 || yadā punaḥ surāṇāṃ vai bhayaṃ daityādbhaviṣyati | śaktayo me tadotpannā hariṣyanti suvigrahāḥ || 45 || vārāhī vaiṣṇavī gaurī nārasiṃhī sadāśivā | etāścānyāśca kāryāṇi kuru tvaṃ kamalodbhava || 46 || navākṣaramimaṃ mantraṃ bījadhyānayutaṃ sadā | japansarvāṇi kāryāṇi kuru tvaṃ kamalodbhava || 47 || mantrāṇāmuttamo'yaṃ vai tvaṃ jānīhi mahāmate | hṛdaye te sadā dhāryaḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 48 || ityuktvā māṃ jaganmātā hariṃ prāha śucismitā | viṣṇo vraja gṛhāṇemāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ manoharām || 49 || sadā vakṣaḥsthale sthāne bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ | krīḍārthaṃ te mayā dattā śaktiḥ sarvārthadā śivā || 50 || tvayeyaṃ nāvamantavyā mānanīyā ca sarvadā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇākhyo'yaṃ yogo vai vihito mayā || 51 || jīvanārthaṃ kṛtā yajñā devānāṃ sarvathā mayā | avirodhena saṅgena vartitavyaṃ tribhiḥ sadā || 52 || tvaṃ ca vedhāḥ śivastvete devā madguṇasambhavāḥ | mānyāḥ pūjyāśca sarveṣāṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 53 || ye vibhedaṃ kariṣyanti mānavā mūḍhacetasaḥ | nirayaṃ te gamiṣyanti vibhedānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 54 || yo hariḥ sa śivaḥ sākṣādyaḥ śivaḥ sa svayaṃ hariḥ | etayorbhedamātiṣṭhannarakāya bhavennaraḥ || 55 || tathaiva druhiṇo jñeyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | aparo guṇabhedo'sti śṛṇu viṣṇo bravīmi te || 56 || mukhyaḥ sattvaguṇaste'stu paramātmavicintane | gauṇatve'pi parau khyātau rajoguṇatamoguṇau || 57 || lakṣmyā saha vikāreṣu nānābhedeṣu sarvadā | rajoguṇayuto bhūtvā viharasvānayā saha || 58 || vāgbījaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca māyābījaṃ tṛtīyakam | mantro'yaṃ tvaṃ ramākānta maddattaḥ paramārthadaḥ || 59 || gṛhītvā japa taṃ nityaṃ viharasva yathāsukham | na te mṛtyubhayaṃ viṣṇo na kālaprabhavaṃ bhayam || 60 || yāvadeṣa vihāro me bhaviṣyati suniścayaḥ | saṃhariṣyāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ yadā viśvaṃ carācaram || 61 || bhavanto'pi tadā nūnaṃ mayi līnā bhaviṣyatha | smartavyo'yaṃ sadā mantraḥ kāmado mokṣadastathā || 62 || udgīthena ca saṃyuktaḥ kartavyaḥ śubhamicchatā | kārayitvātha vaikuṇṭhaṃ vastavyaṃ puruṣottama || 63 || viharasva yathākāmaṃ cintayanmāṃ sanātanīm | brahmovāca ityuktvā vāsudevaṃ sā triguṇā prakṛtiḥ parā || 64 || nirguṇā śaṅkaraṃ devamavocadamṛtaṃ vacaḥ | devyuvāca gṛhāṇa haragaurīṃ tvaṃ mahākālīṃ manoharām || 65 || kailāsaṃ kārayitvā ca viharasva yathāsukham | mukhyastamoguṇaste'stu gauṇau sattvarajoguṇau || 66 || viharāsuranāśārthaṃ rajoguṇatamoguṇau | tapastaptaṃ tathā kartuṃ smaraṇaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 67 || sarvasattvaguṇaḥ śānto gṛhītavyaḥ sadānagha | sarvathā triguṇā yūyaṃ sṛṣṭisthityantakārakāḥ || 68 || ebhirvihīnaṃ saṃsāre vastu naivātra kutracit | vastumātraṃ tu yaddṛśyaṃ saṃsāre triguṇaṃ hi tat || 69 || dṛśyaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ loke na bhūtaṃ no bhaviṣyati | nirguṇaḥ paramātmāsau na tu dṛśyaḥ kadācana || 70 || saguṇā nirguṇā cāhaṃ samaye śaṅkarottamā | sadāhaṃ kāraṇaṃ śambho na ca kāryaṃ kadācana || 71 || saguṇā kāraṇatvādvai nirguṇā puruṣāntike | mahattattvamahaṅkāro guṇāḥ śabdādayastathā || 72 || kāryakāraṇarūpeṇa saṃsarante tvaharniśam || sadudbhūtastvahaṅkārastenāhaṃ kāraṇaṃ śivā || 73 || ahaṅkāraśca me kāryaṃ triguṇo'sau pratiṣṭhitaḥ | ahaṅkārānmahattattvaṃ buddhiḥ sā parikīrtitā || 74 || mahattattvaṃ hi kāryaṃ syādahaṅkāro hi kāraṇam | tanmātrāṇi tvahaṅkārādutpadyante sadaiva hi || 75 || kāraṇaṃ pañcabhūtānāṃ tāni sarvasamudbhave | karmendriyāṇi paṃcaiva pañca jñānendriyāṇi ca || 76 || mahābhūtāni pañcaiva manaḥ ṣoḍaśameva ca | kāryañca kāraṇañcaiva gaṇo'yaṃ ṣoḍaśātmakaḥ || 77 || paramātmā pumānādyo na kāryaṃ na ca kāraṇam | evaṃ samudbhavaḥ śambho sarveṣāmādisambhave || 78 || saṃkṣepeṇa mayā proktastava tatra samudbhavaḥ | vrajantvadya vimānena kāryārthaṃ mama sattamāḥ || 79 || smaraṇāddarśanaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsye'haṃ viṣame sthite | smartavyāhaṃ sadā devāḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ || 80 || ubhayoḥ smaraṇādeva kāryasiddhirasaṃśayam | brahmovāca ityuktvā visasarjāsmāndattvā śaktīḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ || 81 || viṣṇave'tha mahālakṣmīṃ mahākālīṃ śivāya ca | mahāsarasvatīṃ mahyaṃ sthānāttasmādvisarjitāḥ || 82 || sthalāntaraṃ samāsādya te jātāḥ puruṣā vayam | cintayantaḥ svarūpaṃ tatprabhāvaṃ paramādbhutam || 83 || vimānaṃ tatsamāsādya saṃrūḍhāstatra vai trayaḥ | na dvīpo'sau na sā devī sudhāsindhustathaiva ca || punardṛṣṭaṃ vimānaṃ vai tatrāsmābhirna cānyathā || 84 || āsādya tasminvitate vimāne prāptā vayaṃ paṅkajasannidhau ca | mahārṇave yatra hatau duratyayau murāriṇā tau madhukaiṭabhākhyau || 85 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe brahmaṇe śrīdevyā upadeśavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <3.7> tattvanirūpaṇavarṇanam brahmovāca evaṃprabhāvā sā devī mayā dṛṣṭātha viṣṇunā | śivenāpi mahābhāga tāstā devyaḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 1 || vyāsa uvāca ityākarṇya piturvākyaṃ nārado munisattamaḥ | papraccha paramaprītaḥ prajāpatimidaṃ vacaḥ || 2 || nārada uvāca pumānādyo'vināśī yo nirguṇo'cyutiravyayaḥ | dṛṣṭaścaivānubhūtaśca tadvadasva pitāmaha || 3 || triguṇā vīkṣitā śaktirnirguṇā kīdṛśī pitaḥ | tasyāḥ svarūpaṃ me brūhi puruṣasya ca padmaja || 4 || yadarthañca mayā taptaṃ śvetadvīpe mahātapaḥ | dṛṣṭāḥ siddhā mahātmānastāpasā gatamanyavaḥ || 5 || paramātmā na samprāpto mayā'sau dṛṣṭigocaraḥ | punaḥ punastapastīvraṃ kṛtaṃ tatra prajāpate || 6 || bhavatā saguṇā śaktirdṛṣṭā tāta manoramā | nirguṇā nirguṇaścaiva kīdṛśau tau vadasva me || 7 || vyāsa uvāca iti pṛṣṭhaḥ pitā tena nāradena prajāpatiḥ | uvāca vacanaṃ tathyaṃ smitapūrvaṃ pitāmahaḥ || 8 || brahmovāca nirguṇasya mune rūpaṃ na bhaveddṛṣṭigocaram | dṛśyañca naśvaraṃ yasmādarūpaṃ dṛśyate katham || 9 || nirguṇā durgamā śaktirnirguṇaśca tathā pumān | jñānagamyau munīnāṃ tu bhāvanīyau tathā punaḥ || 10 || anādinidhanau viddhi sadā prakṛtipūruṣau | viśvāsenābhigamyau tau nāviśvāsena karhicit || 11 || caitanyaṃ sarvabhūteṣu yattadviddhi parātmakam | tejaḥ sarvatragaṃ nityaṃ nānābhāveṣu nārada || 12 || tañca tāñca mahābhāga vyāpakau viddhi sarvagau | tābhyāṃ vihīnaṃ saṃsāre na kiñcidvastu vidyate || 13 || tau vicintyau sadā dehe miśrībhūtau sadāvyayau | ekarūpau cidātmānau niguṇau nirmalāvubhau || 14 || yā śaktiḥ paramātmā'sau sā yo'sau sā paramā matā | antaraṃ naitayoḥ ko'pi sūkṣmaṃ veda ca nārada || 15 || adhītya sarvaśāstrāṇi vedānsāṅgāṃśca nārada | na jānāti tayoḥ sūkṣmamantaraṃ viratiṃ vinā || 16 || ahaṅkārakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ viśvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | kathaṃ tadrahitaṃ putra bhavetkalpaśatairapi || 17 || nirguṇaṃ saguṇaḥ putra kathaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā | saguṇaṃ ca mahābuddhe cetasā saṃvicāraya || 18 || pittenācchāditā jihvā cakṣuśca munisattama | kaṭu pittaṃ vijānāti rasaṃ rūpaṃ na tattathā || 19 || guṇaiḥ samāvṛtaṃ cetaḥ kathaṃ jānāti nirguṇam | ahaṅkārodbhavaṃ tacca tadvihīnaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 20 || yāvanna guṇavicchedastāvattaddarśanaṃ kutaḥ | taṃ paśyati tadā citte yadā'haṅkāravarjitaḥ || 21 || nārada uvāca svarūpaṃ devadeveśa trayāṇāmeva vistarāt | guṇānāṃ yatsvarūpo'sti hyahaṅkārastrirūpakaḥ || 22 || sāttviko rājasaścaiva tāmasaśca tathāparaḥ | vibhedena svarūpāṇi vadasva puruṣottama || 23 || yajjñātvā vipramucye'haṃ jñānaṃ tadvada me prabho | guṇānāṃ lakṣaṇānyeva vitatāni vibhāgaśaḥ || 24 || brahmovāca trayāṇāṃ śaktayastistrastadbravīmi tavānagha | jñānaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktirarthaśaktistathāparā || 25 || sāttvikasya jñānaśaktī rājasasya kriyātmikā | dravyaśaktistāmasasya tisraśca kathitāstava || 26 || teṣāṃ kāryāṇi vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ | tāmasyā dravyaśakteśca śabdasparśasamudbhavaḥ || 27 || rūpaṃ rasaśca gandhaśca tanmātrāṇi pracakṣate | śabdaikaguṇamākāśaṃ vāyuḥ sparśaguṇastathā || 28 || surūpaikaguṇo'gniśca jalaṃ rasaguṇātmakam | pṛthvī gandhaguṇā jñeyā sūkṣmāṇyetāni nārada || 29 || daśaitāni militvā tu dravyaśaktiyutāni vai | tāmasāhaṅkārajaḥ syātsargastadanuvṛttikaḥ || 30 || rājasyāśca kriyāśakterutpannāni śṛṇuṣva me | śrotraṃ tvagrasanā cakṣurghrāṇaṃ caiva ca pañcamam || 31 || jñānendriyāṇi caitāni tathā karmendriyāṇi ca | vākpāṇipādapāyuśca guhyāntāni ca pañca vai || 32 || prāṇo'pānaśca vyānaśca samānodānavāyavaḥ | pañcadaśa militvaiva rājasaḥ sarga ucyate || 33 || sādhanāni kilaitāni kriyāśaktimayāni ca | upādānaṃ kilaiteṣāṃ cidanuvṛttirucyate || 34 || jñānaśaktisamāyuktāḥ sāttvikācca samudbhavāḥ | diśo vāyuśca sūryaśca varuṇaścāśvināvapi || 35 || jñānendriyāṇāṃ pañcānāṃ pañcādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ | candro brahmā tathā rudraḥ kṣetrajñaśca caturthakaḥ || 36 || ityantaḥkaraṇākhyasya buddhyādeścādhidaivatam | catvāryeva tathā proktāḥ kilādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ || 37 || manasā saha caitāni nūnaṃ pañcadaśaiva tu | sāttvikasya tu sargo'yaṃ sāttvikākhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 38 || sthūlasūkṣmādibhedena dve rūpe paramātmanaḥ | jñānarūpaṃ nirākāraṃ nidānaṃ tatpracakṣate || 39 || sādhakasya tu dhyānādau sthūlarūpaṃ pracakṣate | śarīraṃ sūkṣmamevedaṃ puruṣasya prakīrtitam || 40 || mama caiva śarīraṃ vai sūtramityabhidhīyate | sthūlaṃ śarīraṃ vakṣyāmi brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ || 41 || śṛṇu nārada yatnena yacchrutvā vipramucyate | tanmātrāṇi puroktāni bhūtasūkṣmāṇi yāni vai || 42 || pañcīkṛtya tu tānyeva pañcabhūtasamudbhavaḥ | pañcīkaraṇabhedo'yaṃ śṛṇu saṃvadataḥ kila || 43 || prathamaṃ rasatanmātrāmupādāya manasyapi | kalpayecca tathā tadvai yathā bhavati codakam || 44 || śiṣṭānāṃ caiva bhūtānāmaṃśānkṛtvā pṛthakpṛthak | udake miśrayeccāṃśānkṛte rasamaye tataḥ || 45 || tadā bhūtavibhāge ca caitanye ca prakāśite | caitanyasya praveśāttu tadā'hamiti saṃśayaḥ || 46 || pratīyamāne tenaiva viśeṣeṇābhimānataḥ | ādinārāyaṇo devo bhagavāniti cocyate || 47 || ghanībhūte'tha bhūtānāṃ vibhāge spaṣṭatāṃ gate | vṛddhiṃ prāpya guṇaiścetthamekaikaguṇavṛddhitaḥ || 48 || ākāśasya guṇaścaikaḥ śabda eva na cāparaḥ | śabdasparśau ca vāyośca dvau guṇau parikīrtitau || 49 || agneḥ śabdaśca sparśaśca rūpamete trayo guṇāḥ | śabdasparśarūparasāścatvāro vai jalasya ca || 50 || sparśaśabdarasā rūpaṃ gandhaśca pṛthivīguṇāḥ | evaṃ militayogaiśca brahmāṇḍotpattirucyate || 51 || sarve jīvā militvaiva brahmāṇḍāṃśasamudbhavāḥ | caturaśītilakṣāśca proktā vai jīvajātayaḥ || 52 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe tattvanirūpaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <3.8> guṇānāṃ rūpasaṃsthānādivarṇanam brahmovāca sargo'yaṃ kathitastāta yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayā'dhunā | guṇānāṃ rūpasaṃsthāṃ vai śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ || 1 || sattvaṃ prītyātmakaṃ jñeyaṃ sukhātprītisamudbhavaḥ | ārjavaṃ ca tathā satyaṃ śaucaṃ śraddhā kṣamā dhṛtiḥ || 2 || anukampā tathā lajjā śāntiḥ santoṣa eva ca | etaiḥ sattvapratītiśca jāyate niścalā sadā || 3 || śvetavarṇaṃ tathā sattvaṃ dharme prītikaraḥ sadā | sacchraddhotpādakaṃ nityamasacchraddhānivārakam || 4 || sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ca tathāparā | śraddhā tu trividhā proktā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || 5 || raktavarṇaṃ rajaḥ proktamaprītikaramadbhutam | aprītirduḥkhayogatvādbhavatyeva suniścitā || 6 || pradveṣo'tha tathā droho matsaraḥ stambha eva ca | utkaṇṭhā ca tathā nidrā śraddhā tatra ca rājasī || 7 || māno madastathā garvo rajasā kila jāyate | pratyetavyaṃ rajastvetairlakṣaṇaiśca vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 8 || kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tamaḥ proktaṃ mohanaṃ ca viṣādakṛt | ālasyaṃ ca tathā'jñānaṃ nidrā dainyaṃ bhayaṃ tathā || 9 || vivādaścaiva kārpaṇyaṃ kauṭilyaṃ roṣa eva ca | vaiṣamyaṃ vātināstikyaṃ paradoṣānudarśanam || 10 || pratyetavyaṃ tamastvetairlakṣaṇaiḥ sarvathā budhaiḥ | tāmasyā śraddhayā yuktaṃ paratāpopapādakam || 11 || sattvaṃ prakāśayitavyaṃ niyantavyaṃ rajaḥ sadā | saṃhartavyaṃ tamaḥ kāmaṃ janena śubhamicchatā || 12 || anyonyābhibhavāccaite virudhyanti parasparam | tatho'nyonyāśrayāḥ sarve na tiṣṭhanti nirāśrayāḥ || 13 || sattvaṃ na kevalaṃ kvāpi na rajo na tamastathā | militāśca sadā sarve tenānyonyāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14 || anyonyamithunāccaiva vistāraṃ kathayāmyaham | śṛṇu nārada yajjñātvā mucyate bhavabandhanāt || 15 || sandeho'tra na kartavyo jñātvetyuktaṃ mayā vacaḥ | jñātaṃ tadanubhūtaṃ yatparijñātaṃ phale sati || 16 || śravaṇāddarśanāccaiva sapadyeva mahāmate | saṃskārānubhavāccaiva parijñātaṃ na jāyate || 17 || śrutaṃ tīrthaṃ pavitrañca śraddhotpannā ca rājasī | nirgatastatra tīrthe vai dṛṣṭaṃ caiva yathāśrutam || 18 || snātastatra kṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ dattaṃ dānaṃ ca rājasam | sthitastatra kiyatkālaṃ rajoguṇasamāvṛtaḥ || 19 || rāgadveṣānna nirmuktaḥ kāmakrodhasamāvṛtaḥ | punareva gṛhaṃ prāpto yathāpūrvaṃ tathā sthitaḥ || 20 || śrutaṃ ca nānubhūtaṃ vai tena tīrthaṃ munīśvara | na prāptaṃ ca phalaṃ yasmādaśrutaṃ viddhi nārada || 21 || niṣpāpatvaṃ balaṃ viddhi tīrthasya munisattama | kṛṣeḥ phalaṃ yathā loke niṣpannānnasya bhakṣaṇam || 22 || pāpadehavikārā ye kāmakrodhādayaḥ pare | lobho mohastathā tṛṣṇā dveṣo rāgastathā madaḥ || 23 || asūyerṣyākṣamāśāntiḥ pāpānyetāni nārada | na nirgatāni dehāttu tāvatpāpayuto naraḥ || 24 || kṛte tīrthe yadaitāni dehānna nirgatāni cet | niṣphalaḥ śrama evaikaḥ karṣakasya yathā tathā || 25 || śrameṇāpīḍitaṃ kṣetraṃ kṛṣṭā bhūmiḥ sudurghaṭā | uptaṃ bījaṃ mahārghaṃ ca hitā vṛttirudāhṛtā || 26 || ahorātraṃ parikliṣṭo rakṣaṇārthaṃ phalotsukaḥ | kāle suptastu hemante vane vyāghrādibhirbhṛśam || 27 || bhakṣitaṃ śalabhaiḥ sarvaṃ nirāśaśca kṛtaḥ punaḥ | tadvattīrthaśramaḥ putra kaṣṭado na phalapradaḥ || 28 || sattvaṃ samutkaṭaṃ jātaṃ pravṛddhaṃ śāstradarśanāt | vairāgyaṃ tatphalaṃ jātaṃ tāmasārtheṣu nārada || 29 || prasahyābhibhavatyeva tadrajastamasī ubhe | rajaḥ samutkaṭaṃ jātaṃ pravṛttaṃ lobhayogataḥ || 30 || tattathābhibhavatyeva tamaḥsattve tathā ubhe | tamastathotkaṭaṃ bhūtvā pravṛddhaṃ mohayogataḥ || 31 || tatsattvarajasī cobhe saṅgamyābhibhavatyapi | vistaraṃ kathayāmyadya yathābhibhavatīti vai || 32 || yadā sattvaṃ pravṛddhaṃ vai matirdharme sthitā tadā | na cintayati bāhyārthaṃ rajastamaḥsamudbhavam || 33 || arthaṃ sattvasamudbhūtaṃ gṛhṇāti ca na cānyathā | anāyāsakṛtaṃ cārthaṃ dharmaṃ yajñaṃ ca vāñchati || 34 || sāttvikeṣveva bhogeṣu kāmaṃ vai kurute tadā | rājaseṣu na mokṣārthaṃ tāmaseṣu punaḥ kutaḥ || 35 || evaṃ jitvā rajaḥ pūrvaṃ tataśca tamaso jayaḥ | sattvaṃ ca kevalaṃ putra tadā bhavati nirmalam || 36 || yadā rajaḥ pravṛddhaṃ vai tyaktvā dharmān sanātanān | anyathākurute dharmācchraddhāṃ prāpya tu rājasīm || 37 || rājasādarthasaṃvṛddhistathā bhogastu rājasaḥ | sattvaṃ vinirgataṃ tena tamasaścāpi nigrahaḥ || 38 || yadā tamo vivṛddhaṃ syādutkaṭaṃ sambabhūva ha | tadā vede na viśvāso dharmaśāstre tathaiva ca || 39 || śraddhāṃ ca tāmasīṃ prāpya karoti ca dhanātyayam | drohaṃ sarvatra kurute na śāntimadhigacchati || 40 || jitvā sattvaṃ rajaścaiva krodhano durmatiḥ śaṭhaḥ | vartate kāmacāreṇa bhāveṣu vitateṣu ca || 41 || ekaṃ sattvaṃ na bhavati rajaścaikaṃ tamastathā | sahaivāśritya vartante guṇā mithunadharmiṇaḥ || 42 || rajo vinā na sattvaṃ syādrajaḥ sattvaṃ vinā kvacit | tamo vinā na caivaite vartante puruṣarṣabha || 43 || tamastābhyāṃ vihīnaṃ tu kevalaṃ na kadācana | sarve mithunadharmāṇo guṇāḥ kāryāntareṣu vai || 44 || anyonyasaṃśritāḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti na viyojitāḥ | anyonyajanakāścaiva yataḥ prasavadharmiṇaḥ || 45 || sattvaṃ kadācicca rajastamasī janayatyuta | kadācittu rajaḥ sattvatamasī janayatyapi || 46 || kadācittu tamaḥ sattvarajasī janayatyubhe | janayantyevamanyonyaṃ mṛtpiṇḍaśca ghaṭaṃ yathā || 47 || buddhisthāste guṇāḥ kāmānbodhayanti parasparam | devadattaviṣṇumitrayajñadattādayo yathā || 48 || yathā strīpuruṣaścaiva mithunau ca parasparam | tathā guṇāḥ samāyānti yugmabhāvaṃ parasparam || 49 || rajaso mithune sattvaṃ sattvasya mithune rajaḥ | ubhe te sattvarajasī tamaso mithune viduḥ || 50 || nārada uvāca ityetatkathitaṃ pitrā guṇarūpamanuttamam | śrutvāpyetatsa evāhaṃ tato'pṛcchaṃ pitāmaham || 51 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe guṇānāṃ rūpasaṃsthānādivarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <3.9> guṇānāṃ guṇaparijñānavarṇanam nārada uvāca guṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tāta bhavatā kathitaṃ kila | na tṛpto'smi pibanmiṣṭaṃ tvanmukhātpracyutaṃ rasam || 1 || guṇānāṃ tu parijñānaṃ yathāvadanuvarṇaya | yenāhaṃ paramāṃ śāntimadhigacchāmi cetasi || 2 || vyāsa uvāca iti pṛṣṭastu putreṇa nāradena mahātmanā | uvāca ca jagatkartā rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ || 3 || brahmovāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi guṇānāṃ parivarṇanam | samyaṅ nāhaṃ vijānāmi yathāmati vadāmi te || 4 || sattvaṃ tu kevalaṃ naiva kutrāpi parilakṣyate | miśrībhāvāttu teṣāṃ vai miśratvaṃ pratibhāti vai || 5 || yathā kācidvarā nārī sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | hāvabhāvayutā kāmaṃ bhartuḥ prītikarī bhavet || 6 || mātāpitrostathā saiva bandhuvargasya prītidā | duḥkhaṃ mohaṃ sapatnīṣu janayatyapi saiva hi || 7 || evaṃ sattvena tenaiva strītvamāpāditena ca | rajasastamasaścaiva janitā vṛttiranyathā || 8 || rajasā strīkṛtenaiva tamasā ca tathā punaḥ | anyonyasya samāyogādanyathā pratibhāti vai || 9 || avasthānātsvabhāveṣu na vai jātyantarāṇi ca | lakṣyate viparītāni yogānnārada kutracit || 10 || yathā rūpavatī nārī yauvanena vibhūṣitā | lajjāmādhuryayuktā ca tathā vinayasaṃyutā || 11 || kāmaśāstravidhijñā ca dharmaśāstre'pi sammatā | bhartuḥprītikarī bhūtvā sapatnīnāṃ ca duḥkhadā || 12 || mohaduḥkhasvabhāvasthā sattvasthetyucyate janaiḥ | tathā sattvaṃ vikurvāṇamanyabhāvaṃ vibhāti vai || 13 || corairupadrutānāṃ hi sādhūnāṃ sukhadā bhavet | duḥkhā mūḍhā ca dasyūnāṃ saiva senā tathāguṇā || 14 || viparītapratītiṃ vai varjayanti svabhāvataḥ | yathā ca durdinaṃ jātaṃ mahāmeghaghanāvṛtam || 15 || vidyutstanitasaṃyuktaṃ timireṇāvaguṇṭhitam | siṃcadbhūmiṃ pravarṣadvai tamorūpamudāhṛtam || 16 || yadetatkarṣakāṇāṃ vai tadevātīva durdinam | bījopaskarayuktānāṃ sukhadaṃ prabhavatyuta || 17 || apracchannagṛhāṇāṃ ca durbhagānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | tṛṇakāṣṭhagṛhītānāṃ duḥkhadaṃ gṛhamedhinām || 18 || proṣitabhartṛkāṇāṃ vai mohadaṃ pravadantyapi | svabhāvasthā guṇāḥ sarve viparītā vibhānti vai || 19 || lakṣaṇāni punasteṣāṃ śṛṇu putra bravīmyaham | laghuprakāśakaṃ sattvaṃ nirmalaṃ viśadaṃ sadā || 20 || yadāṅgāni laghūnyeva netrādīnīndriyāṇi ca | nirmalaṃ ca tathā ceto gṛhṇāti viṣayānna tān || 21 || tadā sattvaṃ śarīre vai mantavyañca samutkaṭam | jṛmbhāṃ stambhaṃ ca tandrāṃ ca calañcaiva rajaḥ punaḥ || 22 || yadā tadutkaṭaṃ jātaṃ dehe yasya ca kasyacit | kaliṃ mṛgayate kartuṃ gantuṃ grāmāntaraṃ tathā || 23 || calacittasya so'tyarthaṃ vivāde codyatastathā | gurumāvaraṇaṃ kāmaṃ tamo bhavati tadyadā || 24 || tadāṅgāni gurūṇyāśu prabhavantyāvṛtāni ca | indriyāṇi manaḥ śūnyaṃ nidrāṃ naivābhivāñchati || 25 || guṇānāṃ lakṣaṇānyevaṃ vijñeyānīha nārada | nārada uvāca vibhinnalakṣaṇāḥ proktāḥ pitāmaha guṇāstrayaḥ || 26 || kathamekatra saṃsthāne kāryaṃ kurvanti śāśvatam | parasparaṃ militvā hi vibhinnāḥ śatravaḥ kila || 27 || ekatrasthāḥ kathaṃ kāryaṃ kurvantīti vadasva me | brahmovāca śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi guṇāste dīpavṛttayaḥ || 28 || pradīpaśca yathā kāryaṃ prakarotyarthadarśanam | vartistailaṃ yathārciśca viruddhāśca parasparam || 29 || viruddhaṃ hi tathā tailamagninā saha saṅgatam | tailaṃ vartivirodhyeva pāvako'pi parasparam || 30 || ekatrasthāḥ padārthānāṃ prakurvanti pradarśanam | nārada uvāca evaṃ prakṛtijāḥ proktā guṇāḥ satyavatīsuta || 31 || viśvasya kāraṇaṃ te vai mayā pūrvaṃ yathā śrutam | vyāsa uvāca ityuktaṃ nāradenātha mama sarvaṃ savistaram || 32 || guṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ caiva vibhāgaśaḥ | ārādhyā paramā śaktiryayā sarvamidaṃ tatam || 33 || saguṇā nirguṇā caiva kāryabhede sadaiva hi | akartā puruṣaḥ pūrṇo nirīhaḥ paramo'vyayaḥ || 34 || karotyeṣā mahāmāyā viśvaṃ sadasadātmakam | brahmā viṣṇustathā rudraḥsūryaścandraḥ śacīpatiḥ || 35 || aśvinau vasavastvaṣṭā kubero yādasāṃ patiḥ | vahnirvāyustathā pūṣā senānīśca vināyakaḥ || 36 || sarve śaktiyutāḥ śaktāḥ kartuṃ kāryāṇi svāni ca | anyathā te'pyaśaktā vai praspanditumanīśvarāḥ || 37 || sā caiva kāraṇaṃ rājan jagataḥ parameśvarī | samārādhaya tāṃ bhūpa kuru yajñaṃ janādhipa || 38 || pūjanaṃ parayā bhaktyā tasyā eva vidhānataḥ | mahālakṣmīrmahākālī tathā mahāsarasvatī || 39 || īśvarī sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | sarvakāmārthadā śāntā sukhasevyā dayānvitā || 40 || nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa vāñchitārthaphalapradā | devairārādhitā pūrvaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ || 41 || mokṣakāmaiśca vividhaistāpasairvijitātmabhiḥ | aspaṣṭamapi yannāma prasaṅgenāpi bhāṣitam || 42 || dadāti vāñchitānarthāndurlabhānapi sarvathā | ai ai iti bhayārtena dṛṣṭvā vyāghrādikaṃ vane || 43 || binduhīnamapītyuktaṃ vāñchitaṃ pradadāti vai | tatra satyavratasyaiva dṛṣṭānto nṛpasattama || 44 || pratyakṣa eva cāsmākaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām | brāhmaṇānāṃ samājeṣu tasyodāharaṇaṃ budhaiḥ || 45 || kathyamānaṃ mayā rājañchrutaṃ sarvaṃ savistaram | anakṣaro mahāmūrkho nāmnā satyavrato dvijaḥ || 46 || śrutvā'kṣaraṃ kolamukhātsamuccārya svayaṃ tataḥ | binduhīnaṃ prasaṃgena jāto'sau vibudhottamaḥ || 47 || aikāroccāraṇāddevī tuṣṭā bhagavatī tadā | cakāra kavirājaṃ taṃ dayārdrā parameśvarī || 48 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe guṇaparijñānavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <3.10> satyavratākhyānavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca ko'sau satyavrato nāma brāhmaṇo dvijasattamaḥ | kasmindeśe samutpannaḥ kīdṛśaśca vadasva me || 1 || kathaṃ tena śrutaḥ śabdaḥ kathamuccāritaḥ punaḥ | siddhiśca kīdṛśī jātā tasya viprasya tatkṣaṇāt || 2 || kathaṃ tuṣṭā bhavānī sā sarvajñā sarvasaṃsthitā | vistareṇa vadasvādya kathāmetāṃ manoramām || 3 || sūta uvāca iti pṛṣṭastadā rājñā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | uvāca paramodāraṃ vacanaṃ rasavacchuci || 4 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām | śrutā munisamājeṣu mayā pūrvaṃ kurūdvaha || 5 || ekadā'haṃ kuruśreṣṭha kurvaṃstīrthāṭanaṃ śuci | samprāpto naimiṣāraṇyaṃ pāvanaṃ munisevitam || 6 || praṇamyāhaṃ munīnsarvān sthitastatra varāśrame | vidhiputrāstu yatrāsañjīvanmuktā mahāvratāḥ || 7 || kathāprasaṃga evāsīttatra viprasamāgame | jamadagnistu papraccha munīnevaṃ samāsthitaḥ || 8 || jamadagniruvāca sandeho'sti mahābhāgā mama cetasi tāpasāḥ | samājeṣu munīnāṃ vai niḥsandeho bhavāmyaham || 9 || brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro maghavā varuṇo'nalaḥ | kuberaḥ pavanastvaṣṭā senānīśca gaṇādhipaḥ || 10 || sūryo'śvinau bhagaḥ pūṣā niśānātho grahāstathā | ārādhanīyatamaḥ ko'tra vāñchitārthaphalapradaḥ || 11 || sukhasevyaśca satataṃ cāśutoṣaśca mānadāḥ | bruvantu munayaḥ śīghraṃ sarvajñāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 12 || evaṃ praśne kṛte tatra lomaśo vākyamabravīt | jamadagne śṛṇuṣvaitadyatpṛṣṭaṃ vai tvayā'dhunā || 13 || sevanīyatamā śaktiḥ sarveṣāṃ śubhamicchatām | parā prakṛtirādyā ca sarvagā sarvadā śivā || 14 || devānāṃ jananī saiva brahmādīnāṃ mahātmanām | ādiprakṛtimūlaṃ sā saṃsārapādapasya vai || 15 || smṛtā coccāritā devī dadāti kila vāñchitam | sarvadaivārdracittā sā varadānāya sevitā || 16 || itihāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇvantu munayaḥ śubham | akṣaroccāraṇādeva yathā prāptaṃ dvijena vai || 17 || kosaleṣu dvijaḥ kaściddevadatteti viśrutaḥ | anapatyaścakāreṣṭiṃ putrāya vidhipūrvakam || 18 || tamasātīramāsthāya kṛtvā maṇḍapamuttamam | dvijānāhūya vedajñānsatrakarmaviśāradān || 19 || kṛtvā vedīṃ vidhānena sthāpayitvā vibhāvasūn | putreṣṭiṃ vidhivattatra cakāra dvijasattamaḥ || 20 || brahmāṇaṃ kalpayāmāsa suhotraṃ munisattamam | adhvaryuṃ yājñavalkyaṃ ca hotāraṃ ca bṛhaspatim || 21 || prastotāraṃ tathā pailamudgātāraṃ ca gobhilam | sabhyānanyānmunīnkṛtvā vidhivatpradadau vasu || 22 || udgātā sāmagaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ saptasvarasamanvitam | rathantaramagāyattu svaritena samanvitam || 23 || tadā'sya svarabhaṅgo'bhūtkṛte śvāse muhurmuhuḥ | devadattaścukopāśu gobhilaṃ pratyuvāca ha || 24 || mūrkho'si munimukhyādya svarabhaṅgastvayā kṛtaḥ | kāmyakarmaṇi sañjāte putrārthaṃ yajataśca me || 25 || gobhilastu tadovāca devadattaṃ sukopitaḥ | mūrkhaste bhavitā putraḥ śaṭhaḥ śabdavivarjitaḥ || 26 || sarvaprāṇiśarīre tu śvāsocchvāsaḥ sudurgrahaḥ | na me'tra dūṣaṇaṃ kiṃcitsvarabhaṅge mahāmate || 27 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya gobhilasya mahātmanaḥ | śāpādbhīto devadattastamuvācātiduḥkhitaḥ || 28 || kathaṃ kruddho'si viprendra vṛthā mayi nirāgasi | akrodhanā hi munayo bhavanti sukhadāḥ sadā || 29 || svalpe'parādhe viprendra kathaṃ śaptastvayā hyaham | aputro'haṃ sutaptaḥ prāk tāpayuktaḥ punaḥ kṛtaḥ || 30 || mūrkhaputrādaputratvaṃ varaṃ vedavido viduḥ | tathāpi brāhmaṇo mūrkhaḥ sarveṣāṃ nindya eva hi || 31 || paśuvacchūdravaccaiva na yogyaḥ sarvakarmasu | kiṃ karomīha mūrkheṇa putreṇa dvijasattama || 32 || yathā śūdrastathā mūrkho brāhmaṇo nātra saṃśayaḥ | na pūjārho na dānārho nindyaśca sarvakarmasu || 33 || deśe vai vasamānaśca brāhmaṇo vedavarjitaḥ | karadaḥ śūdravaccaiva mantavyaḥ sa ca bhūbhujā || 34 || nāsane pitṛkāryeṣu devakāryeṣu sa dvijaḥ | mūrkhaḥ samupaveśyaśca kāryaśca phalamicchatā || 35 || rājñā śūdrasamo jñeyo na yojyaḥ sarvakarmasu | karṣakastu dvijaḥ kāryo brāhmaṇo vedavarjitaḥ || 36 || vinā vipreṇa kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuśacaṭena vai | na tu vipreṇa mūrkheṇa śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ kadācana || 37 || āhārādadhikaṃ cānnaṃ na dātavyamapaṇḍite | dātā narakamāpnoti grahītā tu viśeṣataḥ || 38 || dhigrājyaṃ tasya rājño vai yasya deśe'budhā janāḥ | pūjyante brāhmaṇā mūrkhā dānamānādikairapi || 39 || āsane pūjane dāne yatra bhedo na cāṇvapi | mūrkhapaṇḍitayorbhedo jñātavyo vibudhena vai || 40 || mūrkhā yatra sugarviṣṭhā dānamānaparigrahaiḥ | tasmindeśe na vastavyaṃ paṇḍitena kathañcana || 41 || asatāmupakārāya durjanānāṃ vibhūtayaḥ | picumandaḥ phalāḍhyo'pi kākairevopabhujyate || 42 || bhuktvānnaṃ vedavidvipro vedābhyāsaṃ karoti vai | krīḍanti pūrvajāstasya svarge pramuditāḥ kila || 43 || gobhilātaḥ vimuktaṃ vai tvayā vedaviduttama | saṃsāre mūrkhaputratvaṃ maraṇādatigarhitam || 44 || kṛpāṃ kuru mahābhāga śāpasyānugrahaṃ prati | dīnoddhāraṇaśakto'si patāmi tava pādayoḥ || 45 || lomaśa uvāca ityuktvā devadattastu patitastasya pādayoḥ | stuvandīnahṛdatyarthaṃ kṛpaṇaḥ sāśrulocanaḥ || 46 || gobhilastu tadā tatra dṛṣṭvā taṃ dīnacetasam | kṣaṇakopā mahānto vai pāpiṣṭhāḥ kalpakopanāḥ || 47 || jalaṃ svabhāvataḥ śītaṃ pāvakātapayogataḥ | uṣṇaṃ bhavati tacchīghraṃ tadvinā śiśiraṃ bhavet || 48 || dayāvāngobhilastvāha devadattaṃ suduḥkhitam | mūrkho bhūtvā sutaste vai vidvānapi bhaviṣyati || 49 || iti dattavaraḥ so'tha mudito'bhūddvijarṣabhaḥ | iṣṭiṃ samāpya viprānvai visasarja yathāvidhi || 50 || kālena kiyatā tasya bhāryā rūpamatī satī | garbhaṃ dadhāra kāle sā rohiṇī rohiṇīsamā || 51 || garbhādhānādikaṃ karma cakāra vidhivaddvijaḥ | puṃsavanavidhānañca śṛṅgārakaraṇaṃ tathā || 52 || sīmantonnayanañcaiva kṛtaṃ vedavidhānataḥ | dadau dānāni mudito matveṣṭiṃ saphalāṃ tathā || 53 || śubhe'hni suṣuve putraṃ rohiṇī rohiṇīyute | dine lagne śubhe'tyarthaṃ jātakarma cakāra saḥ || 54 || putradarśanakaṃ kṛtvā nāmakarma cakāra ca | utathya iti putrasya kṛtaṃ nāma purāvidā || 55 || sa cāṣṭame tathā varṣe śubhe vai śubhavāsare | tasyopanayanaṃ karma cakāra vidhivatpitā || 56 || vedamadhyāpayāmāsa gurustaṃ vai vrate sthitam | noccacāra tathotathyaḥ saṃsthito mugdhavattadā || 57 || bahudhā pāṭhitaḥ pitrā na dadhāra matiṃ śaṭhaḥ | mūḍhavattiṣṭhate'tyarthaṃ taṃ śuśoca pitā tadā || 58 || evaṃ kurvansadā'bhyāsaṃ jāto dvādaśavārṣikaḥ | na veda vidhivatkartuṃ sandhyāvandanakaṃ vidhim || 59 || mūrkho'bhūditi lokeṣu gatā vārtā'tivistarā | brāhmaṇeṣu ca sarveṣu tāpaseṣvitareṣu ca || 60 || jahāsa lokastaṃ vipraṃ yatra tatra gataṃ mune | pitā mātā ninindātha mūrkhaṃ tamatibhartsayan || 61 || nindito'tha janaiḥ kāmaṃ pitṛbhyāmatha bāndhavaiḥ | vairāgyamagamadvipro jagāma vanamapyasau || 62 || andho varastathā paṅgurna mūrkhastu varaḥ sutaḥ | ityukto'sau pitṛbhyāṃ vai viveśa kānanaṃ prati || 63 || gaṃgātīre śubhe sthāne kṛtvoṭajamanuttamam | vanyāṃ vṛttiṃ ca saṅkalpya sthitastatra samāhitaḥ || 64 || niyamaṃ ca paraṃ kṛtvā nāsatyaṃ prabravīmyaham | sthitastatrāśrame ramye brahmacaryavrato hi saḥ || 65 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe satyavratākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <3.11> satyavratākhyānavarṇanam lomaśa uvāca na vedādhyayanaṃ kiñcijjānāti na japaṃ tathā | dhyānaṃ na devatānāñca na caivārādhanaṃ tathā || 1 || nāsanaṃ veda vipro'so prāṇāyāmaṃ tathā punaḥ | pratyāhāraṃ tu no veda bhūtaśuddhiñca kāraṇam || 2 || na mantrakīlakaṃ jāpyaṃ gāyatrīñca na veda saḥ | śaucaṃ snānavidhiñcaiva tathācamanakaṃ punaḥ || 3 || prāṇāgnihotraṃ no veda balidānaṃ na cātithim | na sandhyāṃ samidho homaṃ viveda ca tathā muniḥ || 4 || so'karotprātarutthāya yatkiñciddantadhāvanam | snānaṃ ca śūdravattatra gaṃgāyāṃ mantravarjitam || 5 || phalānyādāya vanyāni madhyānhe'pi yadṛcchayā | bhakṣyābhakṣyaparijñānaṃ na jānāti śaṭhastathā || 6 || satyaṃ brūte sthitastatra nānṛtaṃ vadate punaḥ | janaiḥ satyatapā nāma kṛtamasya dvijasya vai || 7 || nāhitaṃ kasyacitkuryānna tathā'vihitaṃ kvacit | sukhaṃ svapiti tatraiva nirbhayaścintayanniti || 8 || kadā me maraṇaṃ bhāvi duḥkhaṃ jīvāmi kānane | jīvitaṃ dhikca mūrkhasya tarasā maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 9 || daivenāhaṃ kṛto mūrkho nānyo'tra kāraṇaṃ mama | prāpya caivottamaṃ janma vṛthā jātaṃ mamādhunā || 10 || yathā vandhyā surūpā ca yathā vā niṣphalo drumaḥ | adugdhadohā dhenuśca tathā'haṃ niṣphalaḥ kṛtaḥ || 11 || kiṃ nu nindāmyahaṃ daivaṃ nūnaṃ karma mamedṛśam | na dattaṃ pustakaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya mahātmane || 12 || na vai vidyā mayā dattā pūrvajanmani nirmalā | tenāhaṃ karmayogena śaṭho'smi ca dvijādhamaḥ || 13 || na ca tīrthe tapastaptaṃ sevitā na ca sādhavaḥ | na dvijāḥ pūjitā dravyaistena jāto'smi duṣṭadhīḥ || 14 || vartante muniputrāśca vedaśāstrārthapāragāḥ | ahaṃ sumūḍhaḥ sañjāto daivayogena kenacit || 15 || na jānāmi tapastaptuṃ kiṃ karomi susādhanam | mithyāyaṃ me'tra saṅkalpo na me bhāgyaṃ śubhaṃ kila || 16 || daivameva paraṃ manye dhikpauruṣamanarthakam | vṛthā śramakṛtaṃ kāryaṃ daivādbhavati sarvathā || 17 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca śakrādyāḥ kila devatāḥ | kālasya vaśagāḥ sarve kālo hi duratikramaḥ || 18 || evaṃvidhānvitarkāṃstu kurvāṇo'harniśaṃ dvijaḥ | sthitastatrāśrame tīre jānhavyāḥ pāvane sthale || 19 || viraktaḥ sa tu sañjātaḥ sthitastatrāśrame dvijaḥ | kālātivāhanaṃ śāntaścakāra vijane vane || 20 || evaṃ sthitasya tu vane vimalodake vai varṣāṇi tatra navapañca gatāni kāmam | nārādhanaṃ na ca japaṃ na viveda mantraṃ kālātivāhanamasau kṛtavān vane vai || 21 || jānāti tasya vitataṃ vratameva lokaḥ satyaṃ vadatyapi muniḥ kila nāmajātam | jātaṃ yaśaśca sakaleṣu janeṣu kāmaṃ satyavrato'yamaniśaṃ na mṛṣābhibhāṣī || 22 || tatraikadā tu mṛgayāṃ ramamāṇa eva prāpto niṣādaniśaṭho dhṛtacāpabāṇaḥ | krīḍan vane'tivipule yamatulyadehaḥ krūrākṛtirhananakarmaṇi cātidakṣaḥ || 23 || tenātikṛṣṭena śareṇa viddhaḥ kolaḥ kirātena dhanurdhareṇa | palāyamāno bhayavihvalaśca muneḥ samīpaṃ vidruto jagāma || 24 || vikaṃpamāno rudhirārdradeho yadā jagāmāśramamaṇḍalaṃ vai | kālastadātīva dayārdrabhāvaṃ prāpto munistatra samīkṣya dīnam || 25 || agre vrajantaṃ rudhirārdradehaṃ dṛṣṭvā muniḥ sūkaramāśu viddham | dayābhiveśādatikampamānaḥ sārasvataṃ bījamathoccacāra || 26 || ajñātapūrvaṃ ca tathāśrutañca daivānmukhe vai samupāgatañca | na jñātavānbījamasau vimūḍho mamajja śoke sa munirmahātmā || 27 || kolaḥ praviśyāśramamaṇḍalaṃ tad gato nikuñje pravilīya gūḍham | aprāptamārgo dṛḍhanirviṇṇacetāḥ pravepamānaḥ śarapīḍitatvāt || 28 || tataḥ kṣaṇādākaraṇāntakṛṣṭaṃ cāpaṃ dadhāno'tikarāladehaḥ | prāptastadante sa ca mṛgyamāṇo niṣādarājaḥ kila kāla eva || 29 || dṛṣṭvā muniṃ tatra kuśāsane sthitaṃ nāmnā tu satyavratamadvitīyam | vyādhaḥ praṇamya pramukhe sthito'sau papraccha kolaḥ kva gato dvijeśa || 30 || jānāmi te'haṃ suvrataṃ prasiddhaṃ tenādya pṛcche mama bāṇaviddhaḥ | kṣudhārditaṃ me sakalaṃ kuṭumbaṃ vibhartukāmaḥ kila āgato'smi || 31 || vṛttirmamaiṣā vihitā vidhātrā nānyā'sti viprendra ṛtaṃ bravīmi | bhartavyameveha kuṭumbamañjasā kenāpyupāyena śubhāśubhena || 32 || satyaṃ bravītvadya satyavrato'si kṣudhāturo vartate poṣyavargaḥ | kvāso gataḥ sūkaro bāṇaviddhaḥ pṛcchāmyahaṃ vāḍava brūhi tūrṇam || 33 || teneti pṛṣṭaḥ sa munirmahātmā vitarkamagnaḥ prababhūva kāmam | satyavrataṃ me'dya bhavenna bhagnaṃ na dṛṣṭa ityuccaritena kiṃ vai || 34 || gato'tra kolaḥ śaraviddhadehaḥ kathaṃ bravīmyadya mṛṣā'mṛṣā vā | kṣudhārdito'yaṃ paripṛcchatīva dṛṣṭvā haniṣyatyapi sūkaraṃ vai || 35 || satyaṃ na satyaṃ khalu yatra hiṃsā dayānvitaṃ cānṛtameva satyam | hitaṃ narāṇāṃ bhavatīha yena tadeva satyaṃ na tathā'nyathaiva || 36 || hitaṃ kathaṃ syādubhayorviruddhayostaduttaraṃ kiṃ na yathā mṛṣā vacaḥ | vicārayanvāḍava dharmasaṅkaṭe na prāpa vaktuṃ vacanaṃ yathocitam || 37 || bāṇāhataṃ vīkṣya dayānvitañca kolaṃ tadante samudāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ | tena prasannā nijabījataḥ śivā vidyāṃ durāpāṃ pradadau ca tasmai || 38 || bījoccāraṇato devyā vidyā prasphuritākhilā | vālmīkeśca yathāpūrvaṃ tathā sa hyabhavatkaviḥ || 39 || tamuvāca dvijo vyādhaṃ sammukhasthaṃ dhanurdharam | satyakāmastu dharmātmā ślokamekaṃ dayāparaḥ || 40 || yā paśyati na sā brūte yā brūte sā na paśyati | aho vyādha svakāryārthin kiṃ pṛcchasi punaḥ punaḥ || 41 || ityuktastu tadā tena gato'sau paśuhā punaḥ | nirāśaḥ sūkare tasminparāvṛtto nijālaye || 42 || brāhmaṇastu kavirjātaḥ prācetasa ivāparaḥ | prasiddhaḥ sarvalokeṣu nāmnā satyavrato dvijaḥ || 43 || sārasvataṃ tato bījaṃ jajāpa vidhipūrvakam | paṇḍitaścātivikhyāto dvijo'sau dharaṇītale || 44 || pratiparvasu gāyanti brāhmaṇā yadyaśaḥ sadā | ākhyānaṃ cātivistīrṇa stuvanti munayaḥ kila || 45 || tacchrutvā sadanaṃ tasya samāgamya tadāśrame | yena tyaktaḥ purā tena gṛhaṃ nīto'timānitaḥ || 46 || tasmādrājansadā sevyā pūjanīyā ca bhaktitaḥ | ādiśaktiḥ parā devī jagatāṃ kāraṇaṃ hi sā || 47 || tasyā yajñaṃ mahārāja kuru vedavidhānataḥ | sarvakāmapradaṃ nityaṃ niścayaṃ kathitaṃ purā || 48 || smṛtā sampūjitā bhaktyā dhyātā coccāritā stutā | dadāti vāñchitānarthānkāryadā tena kīrtyate || 49 || anubhāvamidaṃ rājan kartavyaṃ sarvathā budhaiḥ | dṛṣṭvā rogayutāndīnānkṣudhitānnirdhanāñchaṭhān || 50 || janānārtāṃstathā mūrkhānpīḍitānvairibhiḥ sadā | dāsānājñākarānkṣudrānvikalānvihvalānatha || 51 || atṛptānbhojane bhoge sadārtānajitendriyān | tṛṣṇādhikānaśaktāṃśca sadādhiparipīḍitān || 52 || tathā vibhavasampannān putrapautravivardhanān | puṣṭadehāṃśca sambhogaiḥ saṃyutānvedavādinaḥ || 53 || rājalakṣmyā yutāñchūrānvaśīkṛtajanānatha | svajanairaviyuktāṃśca sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitān || 54 || vyatirekānvayābhyāṃ ca vicetavyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ | ebhirna pūjitā devī sarvārthaphaladā śivā || 55 || samārādhitā ca tathā nṛbhirebhiḥ sadāmbikā | yato'mī sukhinaḥ sarve saṃsāre'sminna saṃśayaḥ || 56 || vyāsa uvāca iti rājañchrutaṃ tatra mayā munisamāgame | lomaśasya mukhātkāmaṃ devīmāhātmyamuttamam || 57 || iti sañcintya rājendra kartavyaṃ ca sadārcanam | bhaktyā paramayā devyāḥ prītyā ca puruṣarṣabha || 58 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe satyavratākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <3.12> ambāyajñavidhivarṇanam rājovāca vada yajñavidhiṃ samyagdevyāstasyāḥ samantataḥ | śrutvā karomyahaṃ svāminyathāśakti hyatandritaḥ || 1 || pūjāvidhiṃ ca mantrāṃśca homadravyamasaṃśayam | brāhmaṇāḥ katisaṃkhyāśca dakṣiṇāścatathā punaḥ || 2 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi devyā yajñaṃ vidhānataḥ | trividhaṃ tu sadā jñeyaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 3 || sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ caiva tāmasaṃ ca tathāparam | munīnāṃ sāttvikaṃ proktaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam || 4 || tāmasaṃ rākṣasānāṃ vai jñānināṃ tu guṇojjhitam | vimuktānāṃ jñānamayaṃ vistarātprabravīmi te || 5 || deśaḥ kālastathā dravyaṃ mantrāśca brāhmaṇāstathā | śraddhā ca sātvakī yatra taṃ yajñaṃ sāttvikaṃ viduḥ || 6 || dravyaśuddhiḥ kriyāśuddhirmantraśuddhiśca bhūmipa | bhavedyadi tadā pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ bhavati nānyathā || 7 || anyāyopārjitenaiva kartavyaṃ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam | na kīrtiriha loke ca paraloke na tatphalam || 8 || tasmānnyāyārjitenaiva kartavyaṃ sukṛtaṃ sadā | yaśase paralokāya bhavatyeva sukhāya ca || 9 || pratyakṣaṃ tava rājendra pāṇḍavaistu makhaḥ kṛtaḥ | rājasūyaḥ kratuvaraḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaḥ || 10 || yatra sākṣāddhariḥ kṛṣṇo yādavendro mahāmanāḥ | brāhmaṇāḥ pūrṇavidyāśca bhāradvājādayastathā || 11 || kṛtvā yajñaṃ susampūrṇaṃ māsamātreṇa pāṇḍavaiḥ | prāptaṃ mahattaraṃ kaṣṭaṃ vanavāsaśca dāruṇaḥ || 12 || pīḍanañcaiva pāñcālyāstathā dyūte parājayaḥ | vanavāso mahatkaṣṭaṃ kva gataṃ makhajaṃ phalam || 13 || dāsatvañca virāṭasya kṛtaṃ sarvamahātmabhiḥ | kīcakena parikliṣṭā draupadī ca pramadvarā || 14 || āśīrvādā dvijātīnāṃ kva gatāḥ śuddhacetasām | bhaktirvā vāsudevasya kva gatā tatra saṃkaṭe || 15 || na rakṣitā tadā bālā kenāpi drupadātmajā | prāptakeśagrahā kāle sādhvī ca varavarṇinī || 16 || kimatra cintanīyaṃ vai dharmavaiguṇyakāraṇam | keśave sati deveśe dharmaputre yudhiṣṭhire || 17 || bhavitavyamiti prokte niṣphalaḥ syāttadāgamaḥ | vedamantrāstathānye ca vitathāḥ syurasaṃśayam || 18 || sādhanaṃ niṣphalaṃ sarvamupāyaśca nirarthakaḥ | bhavitavyaṃ bhavatyeva vacane pratipādake || 19 || āgamo'pyarthavādaḥ syātkriyāḥ sarvā nirarthakāḥ | svargārthañca tapo vyarthaṃ varṇadharmaśca vai tathā || 20 || sarvaṃ pramāṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syādbhavitavye kṛte hṛdi | ubhayañcāpi mantavyaṃ daivaṃ copāya eva ca || 21 || kṛte karmaṇi cetsiddhirviparitā yadā bhavet | vaiguṇyaṃ kalpanīyaṃ syātprājñaiḥ paṇḍitamaulibhiḥ || 22 || tatkarma bahudhā proktaṃ vidvadbhiḥ karmakāribhiḥ | kartṛbhedānmantrabhedāddravyabhedāttathā punaḥ || 23 || yathā maghavatā pūrvaṃ viśvarūpo vṛto guruḥ | viparītaṃ kṛtaṃ tena karma mātṛhitāya vai || 24 || devebhyo dānavebhyastu svastītyuktvā punaḥ punaḥ | asurā mātṛpakṣīyāḥ kṛtaṃ teṣāñca rakṣaṇam || 25 || daityān dṛṣṭvātisampuṣṭāṃścukopa maghavā tadā | śirāṃsi tasya vajreṇa ciccheda tarasā hariḥ || 26 || kriyāvaiguṇyamatraiva kartṛbhedādasaṃśayam | nocetpañcālarājena roṣeṇāpi kṛtā kriyā || 27 || bhāradvājavināśāya putrasyotpādanāya ca | dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ samutpanno vedimadhyācca draupadī || 28 || purā daśarathenāpi putreṣṭistu kṛtā yadā | aputrasya sutāstasya catvāraḥ samprajajñire || 29 || ataḥ kriyā kṛtā yuktyā siddhidā sarvathā bhavet | ayuktyā viparitā syātsarvathā nṛpasattama || 30 || pāṇḍavānāṃ yathā yajñe kiñcidvaiguṇyayogataḥ | viparītaṃ phalaṃ prāptaṃ nirjitāste durodare || 31 || satyavādī tathā rājan dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ | draupadī ca tathā sādhvī tathānyepyanujāḥ śubhāḥ || 32 || kudravyayogādvaiguṇyaṃ samutpannaṃ makhe'thavā | sābhimānaiḥ kṛtādvāpi dūṣaṇaṃ samupasthitam || 33 || sāttvikastu mahārāja durlabho vai makhaḥ smṛtaḥ | vaikhānasamunīnāṃ hi vihito'sau mahāmakhaḥ || 34 || sāttvikaṃ bhojanaṃ ye vai nityaṃ kurvanti tāpasāḥ | nyāyārjitañca vanyañca tathā ṛṣyaṃ susaṃskṛtam || 35 || puroḍāśaparā nityaṃ viyūpā mantrapūrvakāḥ | śraddhādhikā makhā rājan sāttvikāḥ paramāḥ smṛtāḥ || 36 || rājasā dravyabahulāḥ sayūpāśca susaṃskṛtāḥ | kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāñcaiva sābhimānāśca vai makhāḥ || 37 || tāmasā dānavānāṃ vai sakrodhā madavardhakāḥ | sāmarṣāḥ saṃskṛtāḥ krūrā makhāḥ proktā mahātmabhiḥ || 38 || munīnāṃ mokṣakāmānāṃ viraktānāṃ mahātmanām | mānasastu smṛto yāgaḥ sarvasādhanasaṃyutaḥ || 39 || anyeṣu sarvayajñeṣu kiñcinnyūnaṃ bhavedapi | dravyeṇa śraddhayā vā'pi kriyayā brāhmaṇaistathā || 40 || deśakālapṛthagdravyasādhanaiḥ sakalaistathā | nānyo bhavati pūrṇe vai tathā bhavati mānasaḥ || 41 || prathamaṃ tu manaḥ śodhyaṃ kartavyaṃ guṇavarjitam | śuddhe manasi deho vai śuddha eva na saṃśayaḥ || 42 || indriyārthaparityaktaṃ yadā jātaṃ manaḥ śuci | tadā tasya makhasyāsau prabhavedadhikāravān || 43 || tadā'sau maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā bahuyojanavistṛtam | stambhaiśca vipulaiḥ ślakṣṇairyajñiyadrumasambhavaiḥ || 44 || vedīṃ ca viśadāṃ tatra manasā parikalpayet | agnayo'pi tathā sthāpyā vidhivanmanasā kila || 45 || brāhmaṇānāñca varaṇaṃ tathaiva pratipādya ca | brahmādhvaryustathā hotā prastotā vidhipūrvakam || 46 || udgātā pratihartā ca sabhyāścānye yathāvidhi | pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena manasaiva dvijottamāḥ || 47 || prāṇo'pānastathā vyānaḥ samānodāna eva ca | pāvakāḥ pañca evaite sthāpyā vedyāṃ vidhānataḥ || 48 || gārhapatyastadā prāṇo'pānaścāhavanīyakaḥ | dakṣiṇāgnistathā vyānaḥ samānaścāvasathyakaḥ || 49 || sabhyodānaḥ smṛtā hyete pāvakāḥ paramotkaṭāḥ | dravyañca manasā bhāvyaṃ nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ śuci || 50 || mana eva tadā hotā yajamānastathaiva tat | yajñādhidevatā brahma nirguṇaṃ ca sanātanam || 51 || phaladā nirguṇā śaktiḥ sadā nirvedadā śivā | brahmavidyākhilādhārā vyāpya sarvatra saṃsthitā || 52 || taduddeśena taddravyaṃ hunetprāṇāgniṣu dvijaḥ | paścāccittaṃ nirālambaṃ kṛtvā prāṇānapi prabho || 53 || kuṇḍalīmukhamārgeṇa hunedbrahmaṇi śāśvate | svānubhūtyā svayaṃ sākṣātsvātmabhūtāṃ maheśvarīm || 54 || samādhinaiva yogena dhyāyeccetasyanākulaḥ | sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani || 55 || yadā paśyati bhūtātmā tadā paśyati tāṃ śivām | dṛṣṭvā tāṃ brahmavidbhūyātsaccidānandarūpiṇīm || 56 || tadā māyādikaṃ sarvaṃ dagdhaṃ bhavati bhūmipa | prārabdhaṃ karmamātraṃ tu yāvaddehaṃ ca tiṣṭhati || 57 || jīvanmuktastadā jāto mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt | kṛtakṛtyo bhavettāta yo bhajejjagadambikām || 58 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena dhyeyā śrībhuvaneśvarī | śrotavyā caiva mantavyā guruvākyānusārataḥ || 59 || rājannevaṃ kṛto yajño mokṣado nātra saṃśayaḥ | anye yajñāḥ sakāmāstu prabhavanti kṣayonmukhāḥ || 60 || agniṣṭomena vidhivatsvargakāmo yajediti | vedānuśāsanaṃ caitatpravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 61 || kṣīṇe puṇye mṛtyulokaṃ viśanti ca yathāmati | tasmāttu mānasaḥ śreṣṭho yajño'pyakṣaya eva saḥ || 62 || na rājñā sādhituṃ yogyo makho'sau jayamicchatā | tāmasastu kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ sarpayajñastvayādhunā || 63 || vairaṃ nirvāhitaṃ rājaṃstakṣakasya durātmanaḥ | yatkṛte nihatāḥ sarpāstvayā'gnau koṭiśaḥ pare || 64 || devīyajñaṃ kuruṣvādya vitataṃ vidhipūrvakam | viṣṇunā yaḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭyādau nṛpasattama || 65 || tathā tvaṃ kuru rājendra vidhiṃ te prabravīmyaham | brāhmaṇāḥ santi rājendra vidhijñā vedavittamāḥ || 66 || devībījavidhānajñā mantramārgavicakṣaṇāḥ | yājakāste bhaviṣyanti yajamānastvameva hi || 67 || kṛtvā yajñaṃ vidhānena dattvā puṇyaṃ makhārjitam | samuddhara mahārāja pitaraṃ durgatiṅgatam || 68 || viprāvamānajaṃ pāpaṃ durghaṭaṃ narakapradam | tathaiva śāpajo doṣaḥ prāptaḥ pitrā tavānagha || 69 || tathā durmaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ sarpadaṃśena bhūbhujā | antarāle tathā mṛtyūrna bhūmau kuśasaṃstare || 70 || na saṅgrāme na gaṅgāyāṃ snānadānādivarjitam | maraṇaṃ te pitustatra saudhe jātaṃ kurūdvaha || 71 || kṛpaṇāni ca sarvāṇi narakasya nṛpottama | tatraikaṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya na jātaṃ cātidurlabham || 72 || yatra yatra sthitaḥprāṇo jñātvā kālaṃ samāgatam | sādhanānāmabhāve'pi hyavaśaścātisaṅkaṭe || 73 || yadā nirvedamāyāti manasā nirmalena vai | pañcabhūtātmako deho mama kiñcātra duḥkhadam || 74 || patatvadya yathākāmaṃ mukto'haṃ nirguṇo'vyayaḥ |
