nāśātmakāni tattvāni tatra kā paridevanā || 75 || brahmaivāhaṃ na saṃsārī sadā muktaḥ sanātanaḥ | dehena mama sambandhaḥ karmaṇā pratipāditaḥ || 76 || tāni sarvāṇi muktāni śubhāni cetarāṇi ca | manuṣyadehayogena sukhaduḥkhānusādhanāt || 77 || vimukto'tibhayādghorādasmātsaṃsārasaṅkaṭāt | ityevaṃ cintyamānastu snānadānavivarjitaḥ || 78 || maraṇaṃ cedavāpnoti sa muccyejjanmaduḥkhataḥ | eṣā kāṣṭhā parā proktā yogināmapi durlabhā || 79 || pitā te nṛpaśārdūla śrutvā śāpaṃ dvijoditam | dehe mamatvaṃ kṛtavānna nirvedamavāptavān || 80 || nīrogo mama deho'yaṃ rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam | kathaṃ jīvāmyahaṃ kāmaṃ mantrajñānānayantu vai || 81 || auṣadhaṃ maṇimantraṃ ca yantraṃ paramakaṃ tathā | ārohaṇaṃ tathā saudhe kṛtavānnṛpatistadā || 82 || na snānaṃ na kṛtaṃ dānaṃ na devyāḥ smaraṇaṃ kṛtam | na bhūmau śayanaṃ caiva daivaṃ matvā paraṃ tathā || 83 || magno mohārṇave ghore mṛtaḥ saudhe'hinā hataḥ | kṛtvā pāpaṃ kaleryogāttāpasasyāvamānajam || 84 || avaśyameva narakaṃ etairācaraṇairbhavet | tasmāttaṃ pitaraṃ pāpātsamuddhara nṛpottama || 85 || sūta uvāca iti śrutvā vacastasya vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ | sāśrukaṇṭho'tiduḥkhārto babhūva janamejayaḥ || 86 || dhigidaṃ jīvitaṃ me'dya pitā me narake sthitaḥ | tatkaromi yathaivādya svargaṃ yātyuttarāsutaḥ || 87 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe ambāyajñavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <3.13> viṣṇunānuṣṭhānavarṇanam rājovāca hariṇā tu kathaṃ yajñaḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ pitāmaha | jagatkāraṇarūpeṇa viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 1 || ke sahāyāstu tatrāsanbrāhmaṇāḥ ke mahāmate | ṛtvijo vedatattvajñāstanme brūhi parantapa || 2 || paścātkaromyahaṃ yajñaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā | śrutvā viṣṇukṛtaṃ yāgamambikāyāḥ samāhitaḥ || 3 || vyāsa uvāca rājañchṛṇu mahābhāga vistaraṃ paramādbhutam | yathā bhagavatā yajñaḥ kṛtaśca vidhipūrvakaḥ || 4 || visarjitā yadā devyā dattvā śaktīśca tāstrayaḥ | kājeśāḥ puruṣā jātā vimānavaramāsthitāḥ || 5 || prāptā mahārṇavaṃ ghoraṃ trayaste vibudhottamāḥ | cakruḥ sthānāni vāsārthaṃ samutpādya dharāṃ sthitāḥ || 6 || ādhāraśaktiracalā muktā devyā svayaṃ tataḥ | tadādhārā sthitā jātā dharā medaḥsamanvitā || 7 || madhukaiṭabhayormedaḥ saṃyogānmedinī smṛtā | dhāraṇācca dharā proktā pṛthvī vistārayogataḥ || 8 || mahī cāpi mahīyastvāddhṛtā sā śeṣamastake | girayaśca kṛtāḥ sarve dhāraṇārtha pravistarāḥ || 9 || lohakīlaṃ yathā kāṣṭhe tathā te girayaḥ kṛtāḥ | mahīdharo mahārāja procyate vibudhairjanaiḥ || 10 || jātarūpamayo merurbahuyojanavistaraḥ | kṛto maṇimayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ śobhitaḥ paramādbhutaḥ || 11 || marīcirnārado'triśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ | dakṣo vasiṣṭha ityete brahmaṇaḥ prathitāḥ sutāḥ || 12 || marīceḥ kaśyapo jāto dakṣakanyāstrayodaśa | tābhyo devāśca daityāśca samutpannā hyanekaśaḥ || 13 || tatastu kāśyapī sṛṣṭiḥ pravṛttā cātivistarā | manuṣyapaśusarpādijātibhedairanekadhā || 14 || brahmaṇaścārdhadehāttu manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bhavat | śatarūpā tathā nārī sañjātā vāmabhāgataḥ || 15 || priyavratottānapādau sutau tasyā babhūvatuḥ | tistraḥ kanyā varārohā hyabhavannatisundarīḥ || 16 || evaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ samutpādya bhagavānkamalodbhavaḥ | cakāra brahmalokañca meruśṛṅge manoharam || 17 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhagavānviṣṇū ramāramaṇamuttamam | krīḍāsthānaṃ suramyañca sarvalokoparisthitam || 18 || śivo'pi paramaṃ sthānaṃ kailāsākhyaṃ cakāra ha | samāsādya bhūtagaṇaṃ vijahāra yathāruci || 19 || svargastriviṣṭapo meruśikharopari kalpitaḥ | tacca sthānaṃ surendrasya nānāratnavirājitam || 20 || samudramathanātprāptaḥ pārijātastaruttamaḥ | caturdantastathā nāgaḥ kāmadhenuśca kāmadā || 21 || uccaiḥśravāstathāśvo vai rambhādyapsarasastathā | indreṇopāttamakhilaṃ jātaṃ vai svargabhūṣaṇam || 22 || dhanvantariścandramāśca sāgarācca samudbabhau | svargasthitau virājete devau bahugaṇairvṛtau || 23 || evaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ samutpannā trividhā nṛpasattama | devatiryaṅmanuṣyādibhedairvividhakalpitā || 24 || aṇḍajāḥ svedajāścaiva codbhijjāśca jarāyujāḥ | caturbhedaiḥ samutpannā jīvāḥ karmayutāḥ kila || 25 || evaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ samāsādya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | vihāraṃ sveṣu sthāneṣu cakruḥ sarve yathepsitam || 26 || evaṃ pravartite sarge bhagavānprabhuracyutaḥ | mahālakṣmyā samaṃ tatra cikrīḍa bhuvane svake || 27 || ekasminsamaye viṣṇurvaikuṇṭhe saṃsthitaḥ purā | sudhāsindhusthitaṃ dvīpaṃ sasmāra maṇimaṇḍitam || 28 || yatra dṛṣṭvā mahāmāyāṃ mantraścāsāditaḥ śubhaḥ | smṛtvā tāṃ paramāṃ śaktiṃ strībhāvaṃ gamito yathā || 29 || yajñaṃ kartuṃ manaścakre ambikāyā ramāpatiḥ | uttīrya bhuvanāttasmātsamāhūya maheśvaram || 30 || brahmāṇaṃ varuṇaṃ śakraṃ kuberaṃ pāvakaṃ yamam | vasiṣṭhaṃ kaśyapaṃ dakṣaṃ vāmadevaṃ bṛhaspatim || 31 || sambhāraṃ kalpayāmāsa yajñārthaṃ cātivistaram | mahāvibhavasaṃyuktaṃ sāttvikañca manoharam || 32 || maṇḍapaṃ vitataṃ tatra kārayāmāsa śilpibhiḥ | ṛtvijo varayāmāsa saptaviṃśatisuvratān || 33 || citiñca kārayāmāsa vedīścaiva suvistarāḥ | prajepurbrāhmaṇā mantrāndevyā bījasamanvitān || 34 || juhuvuste haviḥ kāmaṃ vidhivatparikalpite | kṛte tu vitate home vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 35 || viṣṇuṃ tadā samābhāṣya susvarā madhurākṣarā | viṣṇo tvaṃ bhava devānāṃ hare śreṣṭhatamaḥ sadā || 36 || mānyaśca pūjanīyaśca samarthaśca sureṣvapi | sarve tvāmarcayiṣyanti brahmādyāśca savāsavāḥ || 37 || prabhaviṣyanti bho bhaktyā mānavā bhuvi sarvataḥ | varadastvaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhavitā mānaveṣu vai || 38 || kāmadaḥ sarvadevānāṃ paramaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sarvayajñeṣu mukhyastvaṃ pūjyaḥ sarvaiśca yājñikaiḥ || 39 || tvāṃ janāḥ pūjayiṣyanti varadastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | śrayiṣyanti ca devāstvāṃ dānavairatipīḍitāḥ || 40 || śaraṇastvañca sarveṣāṃ bhavitā puruṣottama | purāṇeṣu ca sarveṣu vedeṣu vitateṣu ca || 41 || tvaṃ vai pūjyatamaḥ kāmaṃ kīrtistava bhaviṣyati | yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhūtale || 42 || tadāṃśenāvatīryāśu kartavyaṃ dharmarakṣaṇam | avatārāḥ suvikhyātāḥ pṛthivyāṃ tava bhāgaśaḥ || 43 || bhaviṣyanti dharāyāṃ vai mānanīyā mahātmanām | avatāreṣu sarveṣu nānāyoniṣu mādhava || 44 || vikhyātaḥ sarvalokeṣu bhavitā madhusūdana | avatāreṣu sarveṣu śaktiste sahacāriṇī || 45 || bhaviṣyati mamāṃśena sarvakāryaprasādhinī | vārāhī nārasiṃhī ca nānābhedairanekadhā || 46 || nānāyudhāḥ śubhākārāḥ sarvābharaṇamaṇḍitāḥ | tābhiryuktaḥ sadā viṣṇo surakāryāṇi mādhava || 47 || sādhayiṣyasi tatsarvaṃ maddattavaradānataḥ | tāstvayā nāvamantavyāḥ sarvadā garvaleśataḥ || 48 || pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena mānanīyāśca sarvathā | nūnaṃ tā bhārate khaṇḍe śaktayaḥ sarvakāmadāḥ || 49 || bhaviṣyanti manuṣyāṇāṃ pūjitāḥ pratimāsu ca | tāsāṃ tava ca deveśa kīrtiḥ syāndakhileṣvapi || 50 || dvīpeṣu saptasvapi ca vikhyātā bhuvi maṇḍale | tāśca tvāṃ vai mahābhāga mānavā bhuvi maṇḍale || 51 || arcayiṣyanti vāñchārthaṃ sakāmāḥ satataṃ hare | arcāsu copahāraiśca nānābhāvasamanvitāḥ || 52 || pūjayiṣyanti vedoktairmantrairnāmajapaistathā | mahimā tava bhūrloke svarge ca madhusūdana || 53 || pūjanāddevadeveśa vṛddhimeṣyati mānavaiḥ | vyāsa uvāca iti dattvā varānvāṇī virarāma khasambhavā || 54 || bhagavānapi prītātmā hyabhavacchravaṇādiva | samāpya vidhivadyajñaṃ bhagavānharirīśvaraḥ || 55 || visarjayitvā tāndevānbrahmaputrānmunīnatha | jagāmānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ || 56 || svāni svāni ca dhiṣṇyāni punaḥ sarve surāstataḥ | munayo vismitā vārtāṃ kurvantaste parasparam |57 || yayuḥ pramuditāḥ kāmaṃ svāśramānpāvanānatha || 58 || śrutvā vāṇīṃ paramaviśadāṃ vyomajāṃ śrotraramyāṃ sarveṣāṃ vai prakṛtiviṣaye bhaktibhāvaśca jātaḥ | cakruḥ sarve dvijamunigaṇāḥ pūjanaṃ bhaktiyuktāstasyāḥ kāmaṃ nikhilaphaladaṃ cāgamoktaṃ munīndrāḥ || 59 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe ambikāmakhasya viṣṇunānuṣṭhānavarṇanaṃ trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <3.14> yudhājidvīrasenayoryuddhārthaṃ sajjībhavanam janamejaya uvāca śruto vai hariṇā klṛpto yajño vistarato dvija | mahimānaṃ tathāmbāyā vada vistarato mama || 1 || śrutvā devyāścaritraṃ vai kurve makhamanuttamam | prasādāttava viprendra bhaviṣyāmi ca pāvanaḥ || 2 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi devyāścaritamuttamam | itihāsaṃ purāṇañca kathayāmi suvistaram || 3 || kosaleṣu nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ | puṣyaputro mahātejā dhruvasandhiriti smṛtaḥ || 4 || dharmātmā satyasandhaśca varṇāśramahite rataḥ | ayodhyāyāṃ samṛddhāyāṃ rājyaṃ cakre śucivrataḥ || 5 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānye tathā dvijāḥ | svāṃ svāṃ vṛttiṃ samāsthāya tadrājye dharmato'bhavan || 6 || na caurāḥ piśunā dhūrtāstasya rājye ca kutracit | dambhāḥ kṛtaghnā mūrkhāśca vasanti kila mānavāḥ || 7 || evaṃ vai vartamānasya nṛpasya kurusattama | dve patnyau rūpasampanne hyāsatuḥ kāmabhogade || 8 || manoramā dharmapatnī surūpā'tivicakṣaṇā | līlāvatī dvitīyā ca sā'pi rūpaguṇānvitā || 9 || vijahāra sapatnībhyāṃ gṛheṣūpavaneṣu ca | krīḍāgirau dīrghikāsu saudheṣu vividheṣu ca || 10 || manoramā śubhe kāle suṣuve putramuttamam | sudarśanābhidhaṃ putraṃ rājalakṣaṇasaṃyutam || 11 || līlāvatyapi tatpatnī māsenaikena bhāminī | suṣuve sundaraṃ putraṃ śubhe pakṣe dine tathā || 12 || cakāra nṛpatistatra jātakarmādikaṃ dvayoḥ | dadau dānāni viprebhyaḥ putrajanmapramoditaḥ || 13 || prītiṃ tayoḥ samāṃ rājā cakāra sutayornṛpa | nṛpaścakāra sauhārdeṣvantaraṃ na kadācana || 14 || cūḍākarma tayoścakre vidhinā nṛpasattamaḥ | yathāvibhavamevāsau prītiyuktaḥ parantapaḥ || 15 || kṛtacūḍau sutau kāmaṃ jahraturnṛpatermanaḥ | krīḍamānāvubhau kāntau lokānāmanurañjakau || 16 || tayoḥ sudarśano jyeṣṭho līlāvatyāḥ sutaḥ śubhaḥ | śatrujitsaṃjñakaḥ kāmaṃ cāṭuvākyo babhūva ha || 17 || nṛpateḥ prītijanako mañjuvākcārudarśanaḥ | prajānāṃ vallabhaḥ so'bhūttathā mantrijanasya vai || 18 || tathā tasminnṛpaḥ prītiñcakāra guṇayogataḥ | mandabhāgyānmandabhāvo na tathā vai sudarśane || 19 || evaṃ gacchati kāle tu dhruvasandhirnṛpottamaḥ | jagāma vanamadhye'sau mṛgayābhirataḥ sadā || 20 || nighnanmṛgān rurūnkambūnsūkarāngavayāñchaśān | mahiṣāñcharabhānkhaḍgāṃścikrīḍa nṛpatirvane || 21 || krīḍamāne nṛpe tatra vane ghore'tidāruṇe | udatiṣṭhannikuñjāttu siṃhaḥ paramakopanaḥ || 22 || rājñā śilīmukhenādau viddhaḥ krodhavaśaṃ gataḥ | dṛṣṭvāgre nṛpatiṃ siṃho nanāda meghaniḥsvanaḥ || 23 || kṛtvā cordhvaṃ sa lāṅgūlaṃ prasāritabṛhatsaṭaḥ | hantuṃ nṛpatimākāśādutpapātātikopanaḥ || 24 || nṛpatistarasā vīkṣya dadhārāsiṃ kare tadā | vāme carma samādāya sthitaḥ siṃha ivāparaḥ || 25 || sevakāstasya ye sarve te'pi bāṇānpṛthakpṛthak | amuñcankupitāḥ kāmaṃ siṃhopari ruṣānvitāḥ || 26 || hāhākāro mahānāsītsamprahāraśca dāruṇaḥ | utpapāta tataḥ siṃho nṛpasyopari dāruṇaḥ || 27 || taṃ patantaṃ samālokya khaḍgenābhyahanannṛpaḥ | so'pi krūrairnakhāgraiśca tatrāgatya vidāritaḥ || 28 || sa nakhairāhato rājā papāta ca mamāra vai | cukruśuḥ sainikāste tu nirjaghnurviśikhaistadā || 29 || mṛtaḥ siṃho'pi tatraiva bhūpatiśca tathā mṛtaḥ | sainikairmantrimukhyāśca tatrāgatya niveditāḥ || 30 || paralokagataṃ bhūpaṃ śrutvā te mantrisattamāḥ | saṃskāraṃ kārayāmāsurgatvā tatra vanāntike || 31 || paralokakriyāṃ sarvāṃ vasiṣṭho vidhipūrvakam | kārayāmāsa tatraiva paralokasukhāvaham || 32 || prajāḥ prakṛtayaścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca mahāmuniḥ | sudarśanaṃ nṛpaṃ kartuṃ mantraṃ cakruḥ parasparam || 33 || dharmapatnīsutaḥ śāntaḥ puruṣaśca sulakṣaṇaḥ | ayaṃ nṛpāsanārhaśca hyabruvanmantrisattamāḥ || 34 || vasiṣṭho'pi tathaivāha yogyo'yaṃ nṛpateḥ sutaḥ | bālo'pi dharmavān rājā nṛpāsanamihārhati || 35 || kṛte mantre mantrivṛddhairyudhājinnāma pārthivaḥ | tatrājagāma tarasā śrutvā tūjjayinīpatiḥ || 36 || mṛtaṃ jāmātaraṃ śrutvā līlāvatyāḥ pitā tadā | tatrājagāma tvarito dauhitrapriyakāmyayā || 37 || vīrasenastathā''yātaḥ sudarśanahitecchayā | kaliṅgādhipatiścaiva manoramāpitā nṛpaḥ || 38 || ubhau tau sainyasaṃyuktau nṛpau sādhvasasaṃsthitau | cakraturmantrimukhyaistairmantraṃ rājyasya kāraṇāt || 39 || yudhājittu tadā'pṛcchajjyeṣṭhaḥ kaḥ sutatordvayoḥ | rājyaṃ prāpnoti jyeṣṭho vai na kanīyānkadācana || 40 || vīraseno'pi tatrāha dharmapatnīsutaḥ kila | rājyārhaḥ sa yathā rājan śāstrajñebhyo mayā śrutam || 41 || yudhājitpunarāhedaṃ jyeṣṭho'yaṃ ca yathā guṇaiḥ | rājalakṣaṇasaṃyukto na tathāyaṃ sudarśanaḥ || 42 || vivādo'tra susampanno nṛpayostatra lubdhayoḥ | kaḥ sandehamapākartuṃ kṣamaḥ syādatisaṅkaṭe || 43 || yudhājinmantriṇaḥ prāha yūyaṃ svārthaparāḥ kila | sudarśanaṃ nṛpaṃ kṛtvā dhanaṃ bhoktuṃ kilecchatha || 44 || yuṣmākaṃ tu vicāro'yaṃ mayā jñātastatheṅgitaiḥ | śatrujitsabalastasmātsammato vo nṛpāsane || 45 || mayi jīvati kaḥ kuryātkanīyāṃsaṃ nṛpaṃ kila | tyaktvā jyeṣṭhaṃ guṇārhañca senayā ca samanvitam || 46 || nūnaṃ yuddhaṃ kariṣyāmi tasminkhaḍgasya medinī | dhārayā ca dvidhā bhūyādyuṣmākaṃ tatra kā kathā || 47 || vīrasenastu tacchrutvā yudhājitamabhāṣata | bālau dvau sadṛśaprajñau ko bhedo'tra vicakṣaṇa || 48 || evaṃ vivadamānau tau saṃsthitau nṛpatī tadā | prajāśca ṛṣayaścaiva babhūvurvyagramānasāḥ || 49 || samājagmuśca sāmantāḥ sasainyāḥ kleśatatparāḥ | vigrahañcābhikāṅkṣantaḥ parasparamatandritāḥ || 50 || niṣādā hyāyayustatra śṛṅgaverapurāśrayāḥ | rājadravyamapāhartuṃ mṛtaṃ śrutvā mahīpatim || 51 || putrau ca bālakau śrutvā vigrahaṃ ca parasparam | caurāstatra samājagmurdeśadeśāntarādapi || 52 || sammardastatra sañjātaḥ kalahe samupasthite | yudhājidvīrasenaśca yuddhakāmau babhūvatuḥ || 53 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe yudhājidvīrasenayoryuddhārthaṃ sajjībhavanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <3.15> manoramayā bhāradvājāśramaṃ prati gamanam vyāsa uvāca saṃyuge ca sati tatra bhūpayorāhavāya samupāttaśastrayoḥ | krodhalobhavaśayoḥ samaṃ tataḥ sambabhūva tumulastu vimardaḥ || 1 || saṃsthitaḥ sa samare dhṛtacāpaḥ pārthivaḥ pṛthulabāhuyudhājit | saṃyutaḥ svabalavāhanādikairāhavāya kṛtaniścayo nṛpaḥ || 2 || vīrasena iha sainyasaṃyutaḥ kṣātradharmamanusṛtya saṅgare | putrikātmajahitāya pārthivaḥ saṃsthitaḥ surapateḥ samatejāḥ || 3 || sa bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ visasarja pārthivo yudhājitaṃ vīkṣya raṇe sthitañca | giriṃ taḍitvāniva toyavṛṣṭibhiḥ krodhānvitaḥ satyaparākramo'sau || 4 || taṃ vīraseno viśikhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ samāvṛṇodāśugamairajihmagaiḥ | ciccheda bāṇaiśca śilīmukhānasau tenaiva muktānativegapātinaḥ || 5 || gajarathaturagāṇāṃ sambabhūvātiyuddhaṃ suranaramunisaṅghairvīkṣitañcātighoram | vitatavihagavṛndairāvṛtaṃ vyoma sadyaḥ piśitamaśitukāmaiḥ kāmagṛdhrādibhiśca || 6 || tatrādbhutā kṣatajasindhuruvāha ghorā vṛndebhya eva gajavīraturaṅgamāṇām | trāsāvahā nayanamārgagatā narāṇāṃ pāpātmanāṃ ravijamārgabhaveva kāmam || 7 || kīrṇāni bhinnapuline naramastakāni keśāvṛtāni ca vibhānti yathaiva sindhau | tumbīphalāni vihitāni vihartukāmairbālairyathā ravisutāprabhavaiśca nūnam || 8 || vīraṃ mṛtaṃ bhuvi gataṃ patitaṃ rathādvai gṛdhraḥ palārthamupari bhramatīti manye | jīvo'pyasau nijaśarīramavekṣya kāntaṃ kāṅkṣatyaho'tivivaśo'pi punaḥ praveṣṭum || 9 || ājau hato'pi nṛvaraḥ suvimānarūḍhaḥ svāṅke sthitāṃ suravadhūṃ pravadatyabhīṣṭam | paśyādhunā mama śarīramidaṃ pṛthivyāṃ bāṇāhataṃ nipatitaṃ karabhoru kāntam || 10 || eko hatastu ripuṇaiva gato'ntarikṣaṃ devāṅganāṃ samadhigamya yuto vimāne | tāvatpriyā hutavahe susamarpya dehaṃ jagrāha kāntamabalā sabalā svakīyā || 11 || yuddhe mṛtau ca subhaṭau divi saṅgatau tāvanyonyaśastranihatau saha samprayātau | tatraiva jaghnaturalaṃ paramāhitāstrāvekāpsaro'rthavihatau kalahākulau ca || 12 || kaścidyuvā samadhigamya surāṅganāṃ vai rūpādhikāṃ guṇavatīṃ kila bhaktiyuktaḥ | svīyān guṇānpravitatānpravadaṃstadā'sau tāṃ premadāmanucakāra ca yogayuktaḥ || 13 || bhaumaṃ rajo'tivitataṃ divi saṃsthitañca rātriṃ cakāra taraṇiñca samāvṛṇodyat | magnaṃ tadeva rudhirāmbunidhāvakasmāt prādurbabhūva ravirapyatikāntiyuktaḥ || 14 || kaścidgatastu gaganaṃ kila devakanyāṃ samprāpya cāruvadanāṃ kila bhaktiyuktām | nāṅgīcakāra caturo vratanāśabhīto yāsyatyayaṃ mama vṛthā hyanukūlaśabdaḥ || 15 || saṅgrāme saṃvṛte tatra yudhājitpṛthivīpatiḥ | jaghāna vīrasenaṃ taṃ bāṇaistīvraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ || 16 || nihataḥ sa papātorvyāṃ chinnamūrdhā mahīpatiḥ | prabhagnaṃ tadbalaṃ sarvaṃ nirgataṃ ca caturdiśam || 17 || manoramā hataṃ śrutvā pitaraṃ raṇamūrdhani | bhayatrastātha sañjātā piturvairamanusmaran || 18 || haniṣyati yudhājidvai putraṃ mama durāśayaḥ | rājyalobhena pāpātmā seti cintāparābhavat || 19 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi pitā me nihato raṇe | bhartā cāpi mṛto'dyaiva putro'yaṃ mama bālakaḥ || 20 || lobho'tīva ca pāpiṣṭhastena ko na vaśīkṛtaḥ | kiṃ na kuryāttadāviṣṭaḥ pāpaṃ pārthivasattamaḥ || 21 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhrātṝngurūnsvajanabāndhavān | hanti lobhasamāviṣṭo jano nātra vicāraṇā || 22 || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ lobhādagamyāgamanaṃ tathā | karoti kila tṛṣṇārto dharmatyāgaṃ tathā punaḥ || 23 || na sahāyo'sti me kaścinnagare'tra mahābalaḥ | yadādhāre sthitā cāhaṃ pālayāmi sutaṃ śubham || 24 || hate putre nṛpeṇādya kiṃ kariṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ | na me trātā'sti bhuvane yena vai susthitā hyaham || 25 || sāpi vairayutā kāmaṃ sapatnī sarvadā bhavet | līlāvatī na me putre bhaviṣyati dayāvatī || 26 || yudhājiti samāyāte na me niḥsaraṇaṃ bhavet | jñātvā bālaṃ sutaṃ so'dya kārāgāraṃ nayiṣyati || 27 || śrūyate hi purendreṇa māturgarbhagataḥ śiśuḥ | kṛntitaḥ saptadhā paścātkṛtāste sapta saptadhā || 28 || praviśya codaraṃ mātuḥ kare kṛtvālpakaṃ pavim | ekonapañcāśadapi te'bhavanmaruto divi || 29 || sapatnyai garalaṃ dattaṃ sapatnyā nṛpabhāryayā | garbhanāśārthamuddiśya puraitadvai mayā śrutam || 30 || jātastu bālakaḥ paścāddehe viṣayutaḥ kila | tenāsau sagaro nāma vikhyāto bhuvi maṇḍale || 31 || jīvamāno'tha bhartā vai kaikeyyā nṛpabhāryayā | rāmaḥ pravrājito jyeṣṭho mṛto daśaratho nṛpaḥ || 32 || mantriṇastvavaśāḥ kāmaṃ ye me putraṃ sudarśanam | rājānaṃ kartukāmā vai yudhājidvaśagāśca te || 33 || na me bhrātā tathā śūro yo māṃ bandhātpramocayet | mahatkaṣṭañca samprāptaṃ mayā vai daivayogataḥ || 34 || udyamaḥ sarvathā kāryaḥ siddhirdaivāddhi jāyate | upāyaṃ putrarakṣārthaṃ karomyadya tvarānvitā || 35 || iti sañcintya sā bālā vidallaṃ cātimāninam | nipuṇaṃ sarvakāryeṣu cintyaṃ mantrivarottamam || 36 || samāhūya tamekānte provāca bahuduḥkhitā | gṛhītvā bālakaṃ haste rudatī dīnamānasā || 37 || pitā me nihataḥ saṃkhye putro'yaṃ bālakastathā | yudhājidbalavān rājā kiṃ vidheyaṃ vadasva me || 38 || tāmuvāca vidallo'sau nātra sthātavyameva ca | gamiṣyāmo vane kāmaṃ vārāṇasyāḥ punaḥ kila || 39 || tatra me mātulaḥ śrīmānvartate balavattaraḥ | subāhuriti vikhyāto rakṣitā sa bhaviṣyati || 40 || yudhājiddarśanotkaṇṭhamanasā nagarādbahiḥ | nirgatya rathamāruhya gantavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 41 || ityuktā tena sā rājñī gatvā līlāvatīṃ prati | uvāca pitaraṃ draṣṭuṃ gacchāmyadya sulocane || 42 || ityuktvā rathamāruhya sairandhrīsaṃyutā tadā | vidallena ca saṃyuktā niḥsṛtā nagarādbahiḥ || 43 || trastā hyārtātikṛpaṇā pituḥ śokasamākulā | dṛṣṭvā yudhājitaṃ bhūpaṃ pitaraṃ gatajīvitam || 44 || saṃskārya ca tvarāyuktā vepamānā bhayākulā | dinadvayena samprāptā rājñī bhāgīrathītaṭam || 45 || niṣādailuṇṭhitā tatra gṛhītaṃ sakalaṃ vasu | rathañcāpi gṛhītvā te nirgatā dasyavaḥ śaṭhāḥ || 46 || rudatī sutamādāya cāruvastrā manoramā | niryayau jāhnavītīre sairandhrīkaralambitā || 47 || āruhya ca bhayācchīghramuḍupaṃ sā bhayākulā | tīrtvā bhāgīrathīṃ puṇyāṃ yayau trikūṭaparvatam || 48 || bhāradvājāśramaṃ prāptā tvarayā ca bhayākulā | saṃvīkṣya tāpasāṃstatra sañjātā nirbhayā tadā || 49 || muninā sā tataḥ pṛṣṭā kā'si kasya parigrahaḥ | kaṣṭenātra kathaṃ prāptā satyaṃ brūhi śucismite || 50 || devī vā mānuṣī vāsi bālaputrā vane katham | rājyabhraṣṭeva vāmoru bhāsi tvaṃ kamalekṣaṇe || 51 || evaṃ sā muninā pṛṣṭā novāca varavarṇinī | rudatī duḥkhasantaptā vidallaṃ ca samādiśat || 52 || vidallastamuvācedaṃ dhruvasandhirnṛpottamaḥ | tasya bhāryā dharmapatnī nāmnā ceyaṃ manoramā || 53 || siṃhena nihato rājā sūryavaṃśī mahābalaḥ | putro'yaṃ nṛpatestasya nāmnā caiva sudarśanaḥ || 54 || asyāḥ pitātidharmātmā dauhitrārthaṃ mṛto raṇe | yudhājidbhayasantrastā samprāptā vijane vane || 55 || tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ prāptā bālaputrā nṛpātmajā | trātā bhava mahābhāga tvamasyā munisattama || 56 || ārtasya rakṣaṇe puṇyaṃ yajñādhikamudāhṛtam | bhayatastasya dīnasya viśeṣaphaladaṃ smṛtam || 57 || ṛṣiruvāca nirbhayā vasa kalyāṇi putraṃ pālaya suvrate | na te bhayaṃ viśālākṣi kartavyaṃ śatrusambhavam || 58 || pālayasva sutaṃ kāntaṃ rājā te'yaṃ bhaviṣyati | nātra duḥkhaṃ tathā śokaḥ kadācitsambhaviṣyati || 59 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktā muninā rājñī svasthā sā sambabhūva ha | uṭaje muninā datte vītaśokā tadāvasat || 60 || sairandhrīsahitā tatra vidallena ca saṃyutā | sudarśanaṃ pālayānā nyavasatsā manoramā || 61 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe manoramayā bhāradvājāśramaṃ prati gamanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <3.16> yudhājidbhāradvājayoḥ saṃvādavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca yudhājittvatha saṅgrāmādgatvā'yodhyāṃ mahābalaḥ | manoramāṃ ca papraccha sudarśanajighāṃsayā || 1 || sevakān preṣayāmāsa kva gateti muhurvadan | śubhe dine'tha dauhitraṃ sthāpayāmāsa cāsane || 2 || mantribhiśca vasiṣṭhena mantrairātharvaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ | abhiṣiktaśca sampūrṇaiḥ kalaśairjalapūritaiḥ || 3 || bherīśaṅkhaninādaiśca tūryāṇāṃ cātha niḥsvanaiḥ | utsavastu nagaryā vai sambabhūva kurūdvaha || 4 || viprāṇāṃ vedapāṭhaiśca bandināṃ stutibhistathā | ayodhyā muditevāsījjayaśabdaiḥ sumaṅgalaiḥ || 5 || hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇā stutivāditraniḥsvanā | nave tasminmahīpāle pūrbabhau nūtaneva sā || 6 || kecitsādhujanā ye vai cakruḥ śokaṃ gṛhe sthitāḥ | sudarśanaṃ vicintyādya kva gato'sau nṛpātmajaḥ || 7 || manoramātisādhvī sā kva gatā sutasaṃyutā | pitā'syā nihataḥ saṃkhye rājyalobhena vairiṇā || 8 || ityevaṃ cintyamānāste sādhavaḥ samabuddhayaḥ | atiṣṭhanduḥkhitāstatra śatrujidvaśavartinaḥ || 9 || yudhājidapi dauhitraṃ sthāpayitvā vidhānataḥ | rājyañca mantrisātkṛtvā calitaḥ svāṃ purīṃ prati || 10 || śrutvā sudarśanaṃ tatra munīnāmāśrame sthitam | hantukāmo jagāmāśu citrakūṭaṃ sa parvatam || 11 || niṣādādhipatiṃ śūraṃ puraskṛtya balābhidham | durdarśākhyamagādāśu śṛṅgaverapurādhipam || 12 || śrutvā manoramā tatra babhūvātisuduḥkhitā | āgacchantaṃ bālaputrā bhayārtā sainyasaṃyutam || 13 || tamuvācātiśokārtā muniṃ sāśruvilocanā | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi yudhājitsamupasthitaḥ || 14 || pitā me nihato'nena dauhitro bhūpatiḥ kṛtaḥ | sutaṃ me hantukāmo'tra samāyāti balānvitaḥ || 15 || purā śrutaṃ mayā svāminpāṇḍavā vai vane sthitāḥ | munīnāmāśrame puṇye pāñcālyā sahitāstadā || 16 || gatāste mṛgayāṃ pārthā bhrātaraḥ pañca eva te | draupadī saṃsthitā tatra munīnāmāśrame śubhe || 17 || dhaumyo'trirgālavaḥ pailo jāvālirgautamo bhṛguḥ | cyavanaścātrigotraśca kaṇvaścaiva jatuḥ kratuḥ || 18 || vītihotraḥ sumantuśca yajñadatto'tha vatsalaḥ | rāśāsanaḥ kahoḍaśca yavakrīryajñakṛtkratuḥ || 19 || ete cānye ca munayo bhāradvājādayaḥ śubhāḥ | vedapāṭhayutāḥ sarve saṃsthitāścāśrame sthitāḥ || 20 || dāsībhiḥ sahitā tatra yājñasenī sthitā mune | āśrame cārusarvāṅgī nirbhayā munisaṃvṛte || 21 || pārthā mṛgānugāstāvatprayātāśca vanādvanam | dhanurbāṇadharā vīrāḥ pañca vai śatrutāpanāḥ || 22 || tāvatsindhupatiḥ śrīmānmārgastho balasaṃyutaḥ | āgataścāśramābhyāśe śrutvā tu nigamandhvanim || 23 || śrutvā vedadhvaniṃ rājā munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām | uttatāra rathāttūrṇaṃ darśanākāṅkṣayā nṛpaḥ || 24 || yadā niragamattatra bhṛtyadvayasamanvitaḥ | vedapāṭhayutānvīkṣya munīnudyamasaṃsthitaḥ || 25 || kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ svāminsaṃsthito'tha jayadrathaḥ | āśrame munibhirjuṣṭe bhūpatiḥ saṃviveśa ha || 26 || tatropaviṣṭaṃ rājānaṃ draṣṭukāmāḥ striyastadā | āyayurmunibhāryāśca ko'yamityabruvannṛpam || 27 || tāsāṃ madhye varārohā yājñasenī samāgatā | jayadrathena dṛṣṭā sā rūpeṇa śrīrivāparā || 28 || tāṃ vilokyāsitāpāṅgīṃ devakanyāmivāparām | papraccha nṛpatirdhaumyaṃ keyaṃ śyāmā varānanā || 29 || bhāryā kasya sutā kasya nāmnā kā varavarṇinī | rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyuktā śacīva vasudhāṅgatā || 30 || barbūlavanamadhyasthā lavaṅgalatikā yathā | rākṣasīvṛndagā nūnaṃ rambhevābhāti bhāminī || 31 || satyaṃ vada mahābhāga kasyeyaṃ vallabhābalā | rājapatnīva cābhāti naiṣā munivadhūrdvija || 32 || dhaumya uvāca pāṇḍavānāṃ priyā bhāryā draupadī śubhalakṣaṇā | pāñcālī sindhurājendra vasatyatra varāśrame || 33 || jayadratha uvāca kva gatāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ pañca śūrāḥ samprati viśrutāḥ | vasantyatra vane vīrā vītaśokā mahābalāḥ || 34 || dhaumya uvāca mṛgayārthaṃ gatāḥ pañca pāṇḍavā rathasaṃsthitāḥ | āgamiṣyanti madhyānhe mṛgānādāya pārthivāḥ || 35 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya udatiṣṭhadasau nṛpaḥ | draupadīsannidhau gatvā pragamyedamuvāca ha || 36 || kuśalaṃ te varārohe kva gatāḥ patayaśca te | ekādaśa gatānyadya varṣāṇi ca vane kila || 37 || draupadī tu tadovāca svasti te'stu nṛpātmaja | viśramasvāśramābhyāśe kṣaṇādāyānti pāṇḍavāḥ || 38 || evaṃ bruvantyāṃ tasyāṃ tu lobhāviṣṭaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ | jahāra draupadīṃ vīro'nādṛtya munisattamān || 39 || kasyacinnaiva viśvāsaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvathā budhaiḥ | kurvanduḥkhamavāpnoti dṛṣṭāntastvatra vai baliḥ || 40 || vairocanasutaḥ śrīmāndharmiṣṭhaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ | yajñakartā ca dātā ca śaraṇyaḥ sādhusaṃmataḥ || 41 || nādharme nirataḥ kvāpi pralhādasya ca pautrakaḥ | ekonaśatayajñānvai sa cakāra sadakṣiṇān || 42 || sattvamūrttiḥ sadā viṣṇuḥ sevyaḥ sa yogināmapi | nirvikāro'pi bhagavāndevakāryārthasiddhaye || 43 || kaśyapācca samudbhūto viṣṇuḥ kapaṭavāmanaḥ | rājyaṃ chalena hṛtavānmahīṃ caiva sasāgarām || 44 || so'bhavatsatyavāgrājā balirvairocanistadā | kapaṭaṃ kṛtavānviṣṇurindrārthe tu mayā śrutam || 45 || anyaḥ kiṃ na karotyevaṃ kṛtaṃ vai sattvamūrtinā | vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya yajñapātaṃ cikīrṣatā || 46 || na ca viśvasitavyaṃ vai kadācitkenacittathā | lobhaścetasi cetsvāminkīdṛkpāpakṛtaṃ bhayam || 47 || lobhāhatāḥ prakurvanti pāpāni prāṇinaḥ kila | paralokādbhayaṃ nāsti kasyacitkarhicinmune || 48 || manasā karmaṇā vācā parasvādānahetutaḥ | prapatanti narāḥ samyaglobhopahatacetasaḥ || 49 || devānārādhya satataṃ vāñchanti ca dhanaṃ narāḥ | na devāstatkare kṛtvā samarthā dātumañjasā || 50 || anyasyānīyate vittaṃ prayacchanti manīṣitam | vāṇijyenātha dānena cauryeṇāpi balena vā || 51 || vikrayārthaṃ gṛhītvā ca dhānyavastrādikaṃ bahu | devānarcayate vaiśyo maharddhirme bhavediti || 52 || nātra kiṃ paravittecchā vāṇijyena parantapa | grahaṇakāle tu samprāpte maharghañcāpi kāṅkṣati || 53 || evaṃ hi prāṇinaḥ sarve parasvādānatatparāḥ | vartante satataṃ brahman viśvāsaḥ kīdṛśaḥ punaḥ || 54 || vṛthā tīrthaṃ vṛthā dānaṃ vṛthā'dhyayanameva ca | lobhamohāvṛtānāṃ vai kṛtaṃ tadakṛtaṃ bhavet || 55 || tasmādenaṃ mahābhāga visarjaya gṛhaṃ prati | saputrā'haṃ vasiṣyāmi jānakīvaddvijottama || 56 || ityukto'sau munistāvadgatvā yudhājitaṃ nṛpam | uvāca vacanaṃ rājñe bhāradvājaḥ pratāpavān || 57 || gaccha rājan yathākāmaṃ svapuraṃ nṛpasattama | neyaṃ manoramābhyeti bālaputrā suduḥkhitā || 58 || yudhājiduvāca mune muñca haṭhaṃ saumya visarjaya manoramām | na ca yāsyāmyahaṃ muktvā neṣyāmyadya balātpunaḥ || 59 || ṛṣiruvāca nayasva yadi śaktiste balenādya mamāśramāt | viśvāmitro yathā dhenuṃ vasiṣṭhasya muneḥ purā || 60 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe yudhājidbhāradvājayoḥ saṃvādavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <3.17> viśvāmitrakathottaraṃ rājaputrasya kāmabījaprāptivarṇanam vyāsa uvāca ityākarṇya vacastasya munestatrāvanīpatiḥ | mantrivṛddhaṃ samāhūya papraccha tamatandritaḥ || 1 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ subuddhe'tra mayā'dya vada suvrata | balānnayāmi tāṃ kāmaṃ saputrāñca subhāṣiṇīm || 2 || ripuralpo'pi nopekṣyaḥ sarvathā śubhamicchatā | rājayakṣmeva saṃvṛddho mṛtyave parikalpayet || 3 || nātra sainyaṃ na yoddhāsti yo māmatra nivārayet | gṛhītvā hanmi taṃ tatra dauhitrasya ripuṃ kila || 4 || niṣkaṇṭakaṃ bhavedrājyaṃ yatāmyadya balādaham | hate sudarśane nūnaṃ nirbhayo'sau bhavediti || 5 || pradhāna uvāca sāhasaṃ na hi kartavyaṃ śrutaṃ rājan munervacaḥ | viśvāmitrasya dṛṣṭāntaḥ kathitastena māriṣa || 6 || purā gādhisutaḥ śrīmānviśvāmitro'tiviśrutaḥ | vicaransa nṛpaśreṣṭho vasiṣṭhāśramamabhyagāt || 7 || namaskṛtya ca taṃ rājā viśvāmitraḥ pratāpavān | upaviṣṭo nṛpaśreṣṭho muninā dattaviṣṭaraḥ || 8 || nimantrito vasiṣṭhena bhojanāya mahātmanā | sasainyaśca sthito rājā gādhiputro mahāyaśāḥ || 9 || nandinyā''sāditaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādikaṃ ca yat | bhuktvā rājā sasainyaśca vāñchitaṃ tatra bhojanam || 10 || pratāpaṃ tañca nandinyāḥ parijñāya sa pārthivaḥ | yayāce nandinīṃ rājā vasiṣṭhaṃ munisattamam || 11 || viśvāmitra uvāca mune dhenusahasraṃ te ghaṭodhnīnāṃ dadāmyaham | nandinīṃ dehi me dhenuṃ prārthayāmi parantapa || 12 || vasiṣṭha uvāca homadhenuriyaṃ rājanna dadāmi kathañcana | sahasrañcāpi dhenūnāṃ tavedaṃ tava tiṣṭhatu || 13 || viśvāmitra uvāca ayutaṃ vātha lakṣyaṃ vā dadāmi manasepsitam | ddehi me nandinīṃ sādho grahīṣyāmi balādatha || 14 || vasiṣṭha uvāca kāmaṃ gṛhāṇa nṛpate balādadya yathāruci | nāhaṃ dadāmi te rājansvecchayā nandinīṃ gṛhāt || 15 || tacchrutvā nṛpatirbhṛtyānādideśa mahābalān | nayadhvaṃ nandinīṃ dhenuṃ baladarpasusaṃsthitāḥ || 16 || te bhṛtyā jagṛhustāṃ tu haṭhādākramya yantritām | vepamānā muniṃ prāha surabhiḥ sāśrulocanā || 17 || mune tyajasi māṃ kasmātkarṣayanti suyantritām | munistāṃ pratyuvācedaṃ tyaje nāhaṃ sudugdhade || 18 || balānnayati rājā'sau pūjito'dya mayā śubhe | kiṃ karomi na cecchāmi tyaktuṃ tvāṃ manasā kila || 19 || ityuktā muninā dhenuḥ krodhayuktā babhūva ha | hambhāravaṃ cakārāśu krūraśabdaṃ sudāruṇam || 20 || udgatāstatra dehāttu daityā ghoratarāstadā | sāyudhāstiṣṭha tiṣṭheti bruvantaḥ kavacāvṛtāḥ || 21 || sainyaṃ sarvaṃ hataṃ taistu nandinī pratimocitā | ekākī nirgato rājā viśvāmitro'tiduḥkhitaḥ || 22 || hanta pāpo'tidīnātmā nindan kṣātrabalaṃ mahat | brāhmaṃ balaṃ durārādhyaṃ matvā tapasi saṃsthitaḥ || 23 || taptvā bahūni varṣāṇi tapo ghoraṃ mahāvane | ṛṣitvaṃ prāpa gādheyastyaktvā kṣātraṃ vidhiṃ punaḥ || 24 || tasmāttvamapi rājendra mā kṛthā vairamadbhutam | kulanāśakaraṃ nūnaṃ tāpasaiḥ saha saṃyugam || 25 || munivaryaṃ vrajādya tvaṃ samāśvāsya taponidhim | sudarśano'pi rājendra tiṣṭhatvatra yathāsukham || 26 || bālo'yaṃ nirdhanaḥ kiṃ te kariṣyati nṛpāhitam | vṛthā te vairabhāvo'yamanāthe durbale śiśau || 27 || dayā sarvatra kartavyā daivādhīnamidaṃ jagat | īrṣyayā kiṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha yadbhāvyaṃ tadbhaviṣyati || 28 || vajraṃ tṛṇāyate rājan daivayogānna saṃśayaḥ | tṛṇaṃ vajrāyate kvāpi samaye daivayogataḥ || 29 || śaśako hanti śārdūlaṃ maśako vai tathā gajam | sāhasaṃ muñca medhāvin kuru me vacanaṃ hitam || 30 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya yudhājinnṛpasattamaḥ | praṇamya taṃ muniṃ mūrghnā jagāma svapuraṃ nṛpaḥ || 31 || manoramā'pi svasthā'bhūdāśrame tatra saṃsthitā | pālayāmāsa putraṃ taṃ sudarśanamṛtavratam || 32 || dine dine kumāro'sau jagāmopacayaṃ tataḥ | munibālagataḥ krīḍannirbhayaḥ sarvataḥ śubhaḥ || 33 || ekasminsamaye tatra vidallaṃ samupāgatam | klībeti muniputrastamāmantrayattadantike || 34 || sudarśanastu tacchrutvā dadhāraikākṣaraṃ sphuṭam | anusvārayutaṃ tacca provācāpi punaḥ punaḥ || 35 || bījaṃ vai kāmarājākhyaṃ gṛhītaṃ manasā tadā | jajāpa bālako'tyarthaṃ dhṛtvā cetasi sādaram || 36 || bhāviyogānmahārāja kāmarājākhyamadbhutam | svabhāvenaiva tenetthaṃ gṛhītaṃ bālakena vai || 37 || tadā'sau pañcame varṣe prāpya mantramanuttamam | ṛṣicchandovihīnañca dhyānanyāsavivarjitam || 38 || prajapanmanasā nityaṃ krīḍatyapi svapityapi | visasmāra na taṃ mantraṃ jñātvā sāramiti svayam || 39 || varṣe caikādaśe prāpte kumāro'sau nṛpātmajaḥ | muninā copanīto'tha vedamadhyāpitastathā || 40 || dhanurvedaṃ tathā sāṅgaṃ nītiśāstraṃ vidhānataḥ | abhyastāḥ sakalā vidyāstena mantrabalādinā || 41 || kadācitso'pi pratyakṣaṃ devīrūpaṃ dadarśa ha | raktāmbaraṃ raktavarṇaṃ raktasarvāṅgabhūṣaṇam || 42 || garuḍe vāhane saṃsthāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktimadbhutām | dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanaḥ sa babhūva nṛpātmajaḥ || 43 || vane tasmiṃsthitaḥ so'tha sarvavidyārthatattvavit | mātaraṃ sevamānastu vijahāra nadītaṭe || 44 || śarāsanañca samprāptaṃ viśikhāśca śilāśitāḥ | tūṇīrakavacaṃ tasmai dattaṃ cāmbikayā vane || 45 || etasminsamaye putrī kāśirājasya supriyā | nāmnā śaśikalā divyā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || 46 || śuśrāva nṛpaputraṃ taṃ vanasthañca sudarśanam | sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ śūraṃ kāmamivāparam || 47 || bandījanamukhācchrutvā rājaputraṃ susaṅgatam | cakame manasā taṃ vai varaṃ varayituṃ dhiyā || 48 || svapne tasyāḥ samāgamya jagadambā niśāntare | uvāca vacanaṃ cedaṃ samāśvāsya susaṃsthitā || 49 || varaṃ varaya suśroṇi mama bhaktaḥ sudarśanaḥ | sarvakāmapradaste'stu vacanānmama bhāmini || 50 || evaṃ śaśikalā dṛṣṭā svapne rūpaṃ manoharam | ambāyā vacanaṃ smṛtvā jaharṣa bhṛśabhāminī || 51 || utthitā sā mudā yuktā pṛṣṭā mātrā punaḥ punaḥ | pramode kāraṇaṃ bālā novācātitrapānvitā || 52 || jahāsa mudamāpannā smṛtvā svapnaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | sakhīṃ prāha tadānyāṃ vai svapnavṛttaṃ savistaram || 53 || kadācitsā vihārārthamavāpopavanaṃ śubham | sakhīyuktā viśālākṣī campakairupaśobhitam || 54 || puṣpāṇi cinvatī bālā campakādhaḥsthitābalā | apaśyadbrāhmaṇaṃ mārge āgacchantaṃ tvarānvitam || 55 || taṃ praṇamya dvijaṃ śyāmā babhāṣe madhuraṃ vacaḥ | kuto deśānmahābhāga kṛtamāgamanaṃ tvayā || 56 || dvija uvāca bhāradvājāśramādbāle nūnamāgamanaṃ mama | jātaṃ vai kāryayogena kiṃ pṛcchasi vadasva me || 57 || śaśikalovāca tatrāśrame mahābhāga varṇanīyaṃ kimasti vai | lokātigaṃ viśeṣeṇa prekṣaṇīyatamaṃ kila || 58 || brāhmaṇa uvāca dhruvasandhisutaḥ śrīmānāste sudarśano nṛpaḥ | yathārthanāmā suśroṇi vartate puruṣottamaḥ || 59 || tasya locanamatyantaṃ niṣphalaṃ pratibhāti me | yena dṛṣṭo na vāmoru kumārastu sudarśanaḥ || 60 || ekatra nihitā dhātrā guṇāḥ sarve sisṛkṣuṇā | guṇānāmākaraṃ draṣṭuṃ manye tenaiva kautukāt || 61 || tava yogyaḥ kumāro'sau bhartā bhavitumarhati | yogo'yaṃ vihito'pyāsīnmaṇikāñcanayoriva || 62 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe viśvāmitrakathottaraṃ rājaputrasya kāmabījaprāptivarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <3.18> śaśikalayā mātaraṃ prati saṃdeśapreṣaṇam vyāsa uvāca śrutvā tadvacanaṃ śyāmā premayuktā babhūva ha | pratasthe brāhmaṇastasmātsthānāduktvā samāhitaḥ || 1 || sā tu pūrvānurāgādvai magnā premṇā'ticañcalā | kāmabāṇahatevāsa gate tasmindvijottame || 2 || atha kāmārditā prāha sakhīṃ chando'nuvartinīm | vikāraśca samutpanno dehe yacchravaṇādanu || 3 || ajñātarasavijñānaṃ kumāraṃ kulasambhavam | dunoti madanaḥ pāpaḥ kiṃ karomi kva yāmi ca || 4 || svapneṣu vā mayā dṛṣṭaḥ pañcabāṇa ivāparaḥ | tapate me mano'tyarthaṃ virahākulitaṃ mṛdu || 5 || candanaṃ dehalagnaṃ me viṣavadbhāti bhāmini | sragiyaṃ sarpavaccaiva candrapādāśca vahnivat || 6 || na ca harmye vane śaṃ me dīrghikāyāṃ na parvate | na divā na niśāyāṃ vā na sukhaṃ sukhasādhanaiḥ || 7 || na śayyā na ca tāmbūlaṃ na gītaṃ na ca vādanam | prīṇayanti mano me'dya na tṛpte mama locane || 8 || prayāmyadya vane tatra yatrāsau vartate śaṭhaḥ | bhītāsmi kulalajjāyāḥ paratantrā pitustathā || 9 || svayaṃvaraṃ pitā me'dya na karoti karomi kim | dāsyāmi rājaputrāya kāmaṃ sudarśanāya vai || 10 || santyanye pṛthivīpālāḥ śataśaḥ sambhṛtarddhayaḥ | ramaṇīyā na me te'dya rājyahīno'pyasau mataḥ || 11 || vyāsa uvāca ekākī nirdhanaścaiva balahīnaḥ sudarśanaḥ | vanavāsī phalāhārastasyāścitte susaṃsthitā || 12 || vāgbījasya japātsiddhistasyā eṣāpyupasthitā | sopi dhyānaparo'tyantaṃ jajāpa mantramuttamam || 13 || svapne paśyatyasau devīṃ viṣṇumāyāmakhaṇḍitām | viśvamātaramavyaktāṃ sarvasampatkarāmbikām || 14 || śṛṅgaverapurādhyakṣo niṣādaḥ samupetya tam | dadau rathavaraṃ tasmai sarvopaskarasaṃyutam || 15 || caturbhisturagairyuktaṃ patākāvaramaṇḍitam | jaitraṃ rājasutaṃ jñātvā dadau copāyanaṃ tadā || 16 || so'pi jagrāha taṃ prītyā mitratvena susaṃsthitam | vanyairmūlaphalaiḥ samyagarcayāmāsa śambaram || 17 || kṛtātithye gate tasminniṣādādhipatau tadā | munayaḥ prītiyuktāste tamūcustāpasā mithaḥ || 18 || rājaputra dhruvaṃ rājyaṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ ca sarvathā | svalpairahobhiravyagraḥ pratāpānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 19 || prasannā te'mbikā devī varadā viśvamohinī | sahāyastu susampanno na cintāṃ kuru suvrata || 20 || manoramāṃ tathocuste munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | putraste'dya dharādhīśo bhaviṣyati śucismite || 21 || sā tānuvāca tanvaṅgī vacanaṃ vo'stu satphalam | dāso'yaṃ bhavatāṃ viprāḥ kiṃ citraṃ sadupāsanāt || 22 || na sainyaṃ sacivāḥ kośo na sahāyaśca kaścana | kena yogena putro me rājyaṃ prāptumihārhati || 23 || āśīrvādaiśca vo nūnaṃ putro'yaṃ me mahīpatiḥ | bhaviṣyati na sandeho bhavanto mantravittamāḥ || 24 || vyāsa uvāca rathārūḍhaḥ sa medhāvī yatra yāti sudarśanaḥ | akṣauhiṇīsamāvṛtta ivābhāti sa tejasā || 25 || pratāpo mantrabījasya nānyaḥ kaścana bhūpate | evaṃ vai japatastasya prītiyuktasya sarvathā || 26 || samprāpya sadgurorbījaṃ kāmarājākhyamadbhutam | japedyastu śuciḥ śāntaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 27 || na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi vāpi sudurlabham | prasannāyāḥ śivāyāśca yadaprāpyaṃ nṛpottama || 28 || te mandāste'tidurbhāgyā rogaiste samabhidrutāḥ | yeṣāṃ citte na viśvāso bhavedambārcanādiṣu || 29 || yā mātā sarvadevānāṃ yugādau parikīrtitā | ādimāteti vikhyātā nāmnā tena kurūdvaha || 30 || buddhiḥ kīrtirdhṛtirlakṣmīḥ śaktiḥ śraddhā matiḥ smṛtiḥ | sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ sā vai pratyakṣaṃ vai vibhāsate || 31 || na jānanti narā ye vai mohitā māyayā kila | na bhajanti kutarkajñā devīṃ viśveśvarīṃ śivām || 32 || brahmā viṣṇustathā śambhurvāsavo varuṇo yamaḥ | vāyuragniḥ kuberaśca tvaṣṭā pūṣāśvinau bhagaḥ || 33 || ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ | sarve dhyāyanti tāṃ devīṃ sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇīm || 34 || ko na seveta vidvānvai tāṃ śaktiṃ paramātmikām | sudarśanena sā jñātā devī sarvārthadā śivā || 35 || brahmaiva sā'tiduṣprāpyā vidyāvidyāsvarūpiṇī | yogagamyā parā śaktirmumukṣūṇāṃ ca vallabhā || 36 || paramātmasvarūpaṃ ko vettumarhati tāṃ vinā | yā sṛṣṭiṃ trividhāṃ kṛtvā darśayatyakhilātmane || 37 || sudarśanastu tāṃ devīṃ manasā paricintayan | rājyalābhātparaṃ prāpya sukhaṃ vai kānane sthitaḥ || 38 || sāpi candrakalātyarthaṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā | nānopacārairaniśaṃ dadhāra duḥkhitaṃ vapuḥ || 39 || tāvattasyāḥ pitā jñātvā kanyāṃ putravarārthinīm | subāhuḥ kārayāmāsa svayaṃvaramatandritaḥ || 40 || svayaṃvarastu trividho vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ | rājñāṃ vivāhayogyau vai nānyeṣāṃ kathitaḥ kila || 41 || icchāsvayaṃvaraścaiko dvitīyaśca paṇābhidhaḥ | yathā rāmeṇa bhagnaṃ vai tryambakasya śarāsanam || 42 || tṛtīyaḥ śauryaśulkaśca śūrāṇāṃ parikīrtitaḥ | icchāsvayaṃvaraṃ tatra cakāra nṛpasattamaḥ || 43 || śilpibhiḥ kāritā mañcāḥ śubhairāstaraṇairyutāḥ | tataśca vividhākārāḥ suklṛptāḥ sabhyamaṇḍapāḥ || 44 || evaṃ kṛte'tisambhāre vivāhārthaṃ suvistare | sakhīṃ śaśikalā prāha duḥkhitā cārulocanā || 45 || idaṃ me mātaraṃ brūhi tvamekānte vaco mama | mayā vṛtaḥ patiścitte dhruvasandhisutaḥ śubhaḥ || 46 || nānyaṃ varaṃ variṣyāmi tamṛte vai sudarśanam | sa me bhartā nṛpasuto bhagavatyā pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 47 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktā sā sakhī gatvā mātaraṃ prāha satvarā | vaidarbhīṃ vijane vākyaṃ madhuraṃ mañjubhāṣiṇī || 48 || putrī te duḥkhitā prāha sādhvī tvāṃ manmukhena yat | śṛṇu tvaṃ kuru kalyāṇi taddhitaṃ tvaritā'dhunā || 49 || bhāradvājāśrame puṇyae dhruvasandhisuto'sti yaḥ | sa me bhartā vṛtaścitte nānyaṃ bhūpaṃ vṛṇomyaham || 50 || vyāsa uvāca rājñī tadvacanaṃ śrutvā svapatau gṛhamāgate | nivedayāmāsa tadā putrīvākyaṃ yathātatham || 51 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā vismitaḥ prahasanmuhuḥ | bhāryāmuvāca vaidarbhīṃ subāhustu ṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 52 || subhru jānāsi bālo'sau rājyānniṣkāsito vane | ekākī saha mātrā vai vasate nirjane vane || 53 || tatkṛte nihato rājā vīraseno yudhājitā | sa kathaṃ nirdhano bhartā yogyaḥ syāccārulocane || 54 || brūhi putrīṃ tato vākyaṃ kadācidapi vipriyam | āgamiṣyanti rājānaḥ sthitimantaḥ svayaṃvare || 55 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe śaśikalayā mātaraṃ prati saṃdeśapreṣaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <3.19> rājasaṃvādavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca bhartrā sā'bhihitā bālāṃ putrīṃ kṛtvāṅkasaṃsthitām | uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ samāśvāsya śucismitām || 1 || kiṃ vṛthā sudati tvaṃ hi vipriyaṃ mama bhāṣase | pitā te duḥkhamāpnoti vākyenānena suvrate || 2 || sudarśano'tidurbhāgyo rājyabhraṣṭo nirāśrayaḥ | balakośavihīnaśca parityaktastu bāndhavaiḥ || 3 || mātrā saha vanaṃ prāptaḥ phalamūlāśanaḥ kṛśaḥ | na te yogyo varo'yaṃ vai vanavāsī ca durbhagaḥ || 4 || rājaputrāḥ kṛtaprajñā rūpavantaḥ susammatāḥ | tavārhāḥ putri santyanye rājacihnairalaṅkṛtāḥ || 5 || bhrātā'sya vartate kāntaḥ sa rājyaṃ kosaleṣu vai | karoti rūpasampannaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 6 || anyacca kāraṇaṃ subhru śṛṇu yacca yathā śrutam | yudhājitsatataṃ tasya vadhakāmo'sti bhūmipaḥ || 7 || dauhitraḥ sthāpitastena rājye kṛtvā'tisaṅgaram | vīrasenaṃ nṛpaṃ hatvā sammantrya sacivaiḥ saha || 8 || bhāradvājāśramaṃ prāptaṃ hantukāmaḥ sudarśanam | muninā vāritaḥ paścājjagāma nijamandiram || 9 || śaśikalovāca mātarmamepsitaḥ kāmaṃ vanastho'pi nṛpātmajaḥ | śaryātivacanenaiva sukanyā ca pativratā || 10 || cyavanañca yathā prāpya patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratā | bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || 11 || akaitavakṛtaṃ nūnaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavati striyāḥ | bhagavatyā samādiṣṭaṃ svapne varamanuttamam || 12 || tamṛte'haṃ kathaṃ cānyaṃ saṃśrayāmi nṛpātmajam | maccittabhittau likhito bhagavatyā sudarśanaḥ || 13 || taṃ vihāya priyaṃ kāntaṃ kariṣye'haṃ na cāparam | vyāsa uvāca pratyādiṣṭā'tha vaidarbhī tayā bahunidarśanaiḥ || 14 || bhartāraṃ sarvamācaṣṭa putryoktaṃ vacanaṃ bhṛśam | vivāhasya dinādarvāgāptaṃ śrutasamanvitam || 15 || dvijaṃ śaśikalā tatra preṣayāmāsa satvaram | yathā na veda me tātastathā gaccha sudarśanam || 16 || bhāradvājāśrame brūhi madvākyāttarasā vibho | pitrā me sambhṛtaḥ kāmaṃ madarthena svayaṃvaraḥ || 17 || āgamiṣyanti rājāno balayuktā hyanekaśaḥ | mayā tvaṃ vai vṛtaścitte sarvathā prītipūrvakam || 18 || bhagavatyā samādiṣṭaḥ svapne mama suropama | viṣamadmi hutāśe vā prapatāmi pradīpite || 19 || varaye tvadṛte nānyaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ preritā'pi vā | manasā karmaṇā vācā saṃvṛtastvaṃ mayā varaḥ || 20 || bhagavatyāḥ prasādena śarmāvābhyāṃ bhaviṣyati | āgantavyaṃ tvayātraiva daivaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ balam || 21 || yadadhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vartate sacarācaram | bhagavatyā yadādiṣṭaṃ na tanmithyā bhaviṣyati || 22 || yadvaśe devatāḥ sarvā vartante śaṅkarādayaḥ | vaktavyo'sau tvayā brahmannekānte vai nṛpātmajaḥ || 23 || yathā bhavati me kāryaṃ tatkartavyaṃ tvayānagha | ityuktvā dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā munirvyāpāritastayā || 24 || gatvā sarvaṃ nivedyāśu tatra pratyāgato dvijaḥ | sudarśanastu tajjñātvā niścayaṃ gamane tadā || 25 || cakāra muninā tena preritaḥ paramādarāt | vyāsa uvāca gamanāyodyataṃ putraṃ tamuvāca manoramā || 26 || vepamānā'tiduḥkhārtā jātatrāsā'śrulocanā | kutra gacchasi putrādya samāje bhūbhṛtāṃ kila || 27 || ekākī kṛtavairaśca kiṃ vicintya svayaṃvare | yudhājiddhantukāmastvāṃ sameṣyati mahīpatiḥ || 28 || na te'nyo'sti sahāyaśca tasmānmā vraja putraka | ekaputrātidīnāsmi tavādhārā nirāśrayā || 29 || nārhasi tvaṃ mahābhāga nirāśāṃ kartuṃmadya mām | pitā te nihato yena so'pi tatrāgato nṛpaḥ || 30 || ekākinaṃ gataṃ tatra yudhājittvāṃ haniṣyati | sudarśana uvāca bhavitavyaṃ bhavatyeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 31 || ādeśācca jaganmāturgacchāmyadya svayaṃvare | mā śokaṃ kuru kalyāṇi kṣatriyā'si varānane || 32 || na bibhemi prasādena bhagavatyā nirantaram | vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā rathamāruhya gantukāmaṃ sudarśanam || 33 || dṛṣṭvā manoramā putramāśīrbhiścānvamodayat | agrataste'mbikā pātu pārvatī pātu pṛṣṭhataḥ || 34 || pārvatī pārśvayoḥ pātu śivā sarvatra sāmpratam | vārāhī viṣame mārge durgā durgeṣu karhicit | kālikā kalahe ghore pātu tvāṃ parameśvarī || 35 || maṇḍape tatra mātaṅgī tathā saumyā svayaṃvare | bhavānī bhūpamadhye tu pātu tvāṃ bhavamocanī || 36 || girijā giridurgeṣu cāmuṇḍā catvareṣu ca | kāmagā kānaneṣvevaṃ rakṣatu tvāṃ sanātanī || 37 || vivāde vaiṣṇavī śaktiravatāttvāṃ raghūdvaha | bhairavī caraṇe saumya śatrūṇāṃ vai samāgame || 38 || sarvadā sarvadeśeṣu pātu tvāṃ bhuvaneśvarī | mahāmāyā jagaddhātrī saccidānandarūpiṇī || 39 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā taṃ tadā mātā vepamānā bhayākulā | uvācāhaṃ tvayā sārdhamāgamiṣyāmi sarvathā || 40 || nimiṣārdhaṃ vinā tvāṃ vai nāhaṃ sthātumihotsahe | sahaiva naya māṃ vatsa yatra te gamane matiḥ || 41 || ityuktvā niḥsṛtā mātā dhātreyīsaṃyutā tadā | viprairdattāśiṣaḥ sarve niryayurharṣasaṃyutāḥ || 42 || vārāṇasyāṃ tataḥ prāpto rathenaikena rāghavaḥ | jñātaḥ subāhunā tatra pūjitaścārhaṇādibhiḥ || 43 || niveśārthaṃ gṛhaṃ dattamannapānādikaṃ tathā | sevakaṃ samanujñāpya paricaryārthameva ca || 44 || militāstvatha rājāno nānādeśādhipāḥ kila | yudhājidapi samprāpto dauhitreṇa samanvitaḥ || 45 || karūṣādhipatiścaiva tathā madreśvaro nṛpaḥ | sindhurājastathā vīro yoddhā māhiṣmatīpatiḥ || 46 || pāñcālaḥ parvatīyaśca kāmarūpo'tivīryavān | kārṇāṭaścoladeśīyo vaidarbhaśca mahābalaḥ || 47 || akṣauhiṇī triṣaṣṭiśca militā saṃkhyayā tadā | veṣṭitā nagarī sā tu sainyaiḥ sarvatra saṃsthitaiḥ || 48 || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ svayaṃvaradidṛkṣayā | militāstatra rājāno varavāraṇasaṃyutāḥ || 49 || anyonyaṃ nṛpaputrāsta ityūcurmilitāstadā | sudarśano nṛpasuto hyāgato'sti nirākulaḥ || 50 || ekākī rathamāruhya mātrā saha mahāmatiḥ | vivāhārthamihāyātaḥ kākutsthaḥ kiṃ nu sāmpratam || 51 || etān rājasutāṃstyaktvā sasainyānsāyudhānatha | kimenaṃ rājaputrī sā variṣyati mahābhujam || 52 || yudhājidatha rājeśastānuvāca mahīpatīn | ahamenaṃ haniṣyāmi kanyārthe nātra saṃśayaḥ || 53 || keralādhipatiḥ prāha taṃ tadā nītisattamaḥ | nātra yuddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ rājannicchāsvayaṃvare || 54 || balena haraṇaṃ nāsti nātra śulkasvayaṃvaraḥ | kanyecchayā'tra varaṇaṃ vivādaḥ kīdṛśastviha || 55 || anyāyena tvayā pūrvamasau rājyātpravāsitaḥ | dauhitrāyārpitaṃ rājyaṃ balavannṛpasattama || 56 || kākutstho'yaṃ mahābhāga kosalādhipateḥ sutaḥ | kathamenaṃ rājaputraṃ haniṣyasi nirāgasam || 57 || lapsyase tatphalaṃ nūnamanayasya nṛpottama | śāstāsti kaścidāyuṣmañjagato'sya jagatpatiḥ || 58 || dharmo jayati nādharmaḥ satyaṃ jayati nānṛtam | mānayaṃ kuru rājendra tyaja pāpamatiṃ kila || 59 || dauhitrastava samprāptaḥ so'pi rūpasamanvitaḥ | rājyayuktastathā śrīmānkathaṃ taṃ na variṣyati || 60 || anye rājasutāḥ kāmaṃ vartante balavattarāḥ | kanyāsvayaṃvare kanyā svīkariṣyati sāmpratam || 61 || vṛte tathā vivādaḥ kaḥ pravadantu mahībhujaḥ | parasparaṃ virodho'tra na kartavyo vijānatā || 62 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe rājasaṃvādavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || <3.20> svapitaraṃ prati śaśikalāvākyam vyāsa uvāca itivādini bhūpāle keralādhipatau tadā | pratyuvāca mahābhāga yudhājidapi pārthivaḥ || 1 || nītireṣā mahīpāla yadbravīti bhavāniha | samāje pārthivānāṃ vai satyavāgvijitendriyaḥ || 2 || yogyeṣu vartamāneṣu kanyāratnaṃ kulodvaha | ayogyo'rhati bhūpāla nyāyo'yaṃ tava rocate || 3 || bhāgaṃ siṃhasya gomāyurbhoktumarhati vā katham | tathā sudarśano'yaṃ vai kanyāratnaṃ kimarhati || 4 || balaṃ vedo hi viprāṇāṃ bhūbhujāṃ cāpajaṃ balam | kimanyāyyaṃ mahārāja bravīmyahamihādhunā || 5 || balaṃ śulkaṃ yathā rājñāṃ vivāhe parikīrtitam | balavāneva gṛhṇātu nābalastu kadācana || 6 || tasmātkanyāpaṇaṃ kṛtvā nītiratra vidhīyatām | anyathā kalahaḥ kāmaṃ bhaviṣyati mahībhujām || 7 || evaṃ vivāde saṃvṛtte rājñāṃ tatra parasparam | āhūtastu sabhāmadhye subāhurnṛpasattamaḥ || 8 || samāhūya nṛpāḥ sarve tamūcustattvadarśinaḥ | rājannītistvayā kāryā vivāhe'tra samāhitā || 9 || kiṃ te cikīrṣitaṃ rājaṃstadvadasva samāhitaḥ | putryāḥ pradānaṃ kasmai te rocate nṛpa cetasi || 10 || subāhuruvāca putryā me manasā kāmaṃ vṛtaḥ kila sudarśanaḥ | mayā nivārito'tyarthaṃ na sā pratyeti me vacaḥ || 11 || kiṃ karomi sutāyā me na vaśe vartate manaḥ | sudarśanastathaikākī samprāpto'sti nirākulaḥ || 12 || vyāsa uvāca sampannā bhūbhujaḥ sarve samāhūya sudarśanam | ūcuḥ samāgataṃ śāntamekākinamatandritāḥ || 13 || rājaputra mahābhāga kenāhūto'si suvrata | ekākī yaḥ samāyātaḥ samāje bhūbhṛtāmiha || 14 || na vai sainyaṃ na sacivā na kośo na bṛhadbalam | kimarthañca samāyātastattvaṃ brūhi mahāmate || 15 || yuddhakāmā nṛpatayo vartante'tra samāgame | kanyārthaṃ sainyasampannāḥ kiṃ tvaṃ kartumihecchasi || 16 || bhrātā te subalaḥ śūraḥ samprāpto'sti jighṛkṣayā | yudhājicca mahābāhuḥ sāhāyyaṃ kartumāgataḥ || 17 || gaccha vā tiṣṭha rājendra yāthātathyamudāhṛtam | tvayi sainyavihīne ca yatheṣṭaṃ kuru suvrata || 18 || sudarśana uvāca na balaṃ na sahāyo me na kośo durgasaṃśrayaḥ | na mitrāṇi na sauhārdī na nṛpā rakṣakā mama || 19 || atra svayaṃvaraṃ śrutvā draṣṭukāma ihāgataḥ | svapne devyā prerito'smi bhagavatyā na saṃśayaḥ || 20 || nānyaccikīrṣitaṃ me'dya māmāha jagadīśvarī | tayā yadvihitaṃ tacca bhavitā'dya na saṃśayaḥ || 21 || na śatrurasti saṃsāre ko'pyatra jagatīśvarāḥ | sarvatra paśyato me'dya bhavānīṃ jagadambikām || 22 || yaḥ kariṣyati śatrutvaṃ mayā saha nṛpātmajāḥ | śāstā tasya mahāvidyā nāhaṃ jānāmi śatrutām || 23 || yadbhāvi tadvai bhavitā nānyathā nṛpasattamāḥ | kā cintā hyatra kartavyā daivādhīno'smi sarvathā || 24 || devabhūtamanuṣyeṣu sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā | sarveṣāṃ tatkṛtā bhaktirnānyathā nṛpasattamāḥ || 25 || sā yaṃ cikīrṣate bhūpaṃ taṃ karoti nṛpādhipāḥ | nirdhanaṃ vā naraṃ kāmaṃ kā cintā vai tadā mama || 26 || tāmṛte paramāṃ śaktiṃ brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ | na śaktāḥ spandituṃ devāḥ kā cintā me tadā nṛpāḥ || 27 || aśakto vā saśakto vā yādṛśastādṛśastvaham | tadājñayā nṛpādyaiva samprāpto'smi svayaṃvare || 28 || sā yadicchati tatkuryānmama kiṃ cintanena vai | nātra śaṃkā prakartavyā satyametadbravīmyaham || 29 || jaye parājaye lajjā na me'trāṇvapi pārthivāḥ | bhagavatyāstu lajjāsti tadadhīno'smi sarvathā || 30 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya tadākarṇya vacanaṃ rājasattamāḥ | ūcuḥ parasparaṃ prekṣya niścayajñā narādhipāḥ || 31 || satyamuktaṃ tvayā sādho na mithyā karhicidbhavet | tathāpyujjayanīnāthastvāṃ hantuṃ parikāṅkṣati || 32 || tvatkṛte na dayādiṣṭā tvāṃ bravīmo mahāmate | yadyuktaṃ tattvayā kāryaṃ vicārya manasā'nagha || 33 || sudarśana uvāca satyamuktaṃ bhavadbhiśca kṛpāvadbhiḥ suhṛjjanaiḥ | kiṃ bravīmi punarvākyamuktvā nṛpatisattamāḥ || 34 || na mṛtyuḥ kenacidbhāvyaḥ kasyacidvā kadācana | daivādhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam || 35 || svavaśo'yaṃ na jīvo'sti svakarmavaśagaḥ sadā | tatkarma trividhaṃ proktaṃ vidvadbhistattvadarśibhiḥ || 36 || sañcitaṃ vartamānañca prārabdhañca tṛtīyakam | kālakarmasvabhāvaiśca tataṃ sarvamidaṃ jagat || 37 || na devo mānuṣaṃ hantuṃ śaktaḥ kālāgamaṃ vinā | hataṃ nimittamātreṇa hanti kālaḥ sanātanaḥ || 38 || yathā pitā me nihataḥ siṃhenāmitrakarṣaṇaḥ | tathā mātāmaho'pyevaṃ yuddhe yudhājitā hataḥ || 39 || yatnakoṭiṃ prakurvāṇo hanyate daivayogataḥ | jīvedvarṣasahasrāṇi rakṣaṇena vinā naraḥ || 40 || nāhaṃ bibhemi dharmiṣṭhāḥ kadācicca yudhājitaḥ | daivameva paraṃ matvā susthito'smi sadā nṛpāḥ || 41 || smaraṇaṃ satataṃ nityaṃ bhagavatyāḥ karomyaham | viśvasya jananī devī kalyāṇaṃ sā kariṣyati || 42 || pūrvārjitaṃ hi bhoktavyaṃ śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ tathā | svakṛtasya ca bhogena kīdṛkśoko vijānatām || 43 || svakarmaphalayogena prāpya duḥkhamacetanaḥ | nimittakāraṇe vairaṃ karotyalpamatiḥ kila || 44 || na tathā'haṃ vijānāmi vairaṃ śokaṃ bhayaṃ tathā | niḥśaṅkamiha samprāptaḥ samāje bhūbhṛtāmiha || 45 || ekākī draṣṭukāmo'haṃ svayaṃvaramanuttamam | bhaviṣyati ca yadbhāvyaṃ prāpto'smi caṇḍikājñayā || 46 || bhagavatyāḥ pramāṇaṃ me nānyaṃ jānāmi saṃyataḥ | tatkṛtañca sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati ca nānyathā || 47 || yudhājitsukhamāpnotu na me vairaṃ nṛpottamāḥ | yaḥ kariṣyati me vairaṃ sa prāpsyati phalaṃ tathā || 48 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktāste tathā tena santuṣṭā bhūbhujaḥ sthitāḥ | so'pi svamāśramaṃ prāpya susthitaḥ sambabhūva ha || 49 || apare'hni śubhe kāle nṛpāḥ sammantritāḥ kila | subāhunā nṛpeṇātha rucire vai svamaṇḍape || 50 || divyāstaraṇayukteṣu mañceṣu raciteṣu ca | upaviṣṭāśca rājānaḥ śubhālaṅkaraṇairyutāḥ || 51 || divyaveṣadharāḥ kāmaṃ vimāneṣvamarā iva | dīpyamānāḥ sthitāstatra svayaṃvaradidṛkṣayā || 52 || iti cintāparāḥ sarve kadā sāpyāgamiṣyati | bhāgyavantaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ śrutapuṇyaṃ variṣyati || 53 || yadā sudarśanaṃ daivātsrajā sambhūṣayediha | vivādo vai nṛpāṇāṃ ca bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 54 || ityevaṃ cintyamānāste bhūpā mañceṣu saṃsthitāḥ | vāditraghoṣaḥ sumahānutthito nṛpamaṇḍape || 55 || atha kāśīpatiḥ prāha sutāṃ snātāṃ svalaṅkṛtām | madhūkamālāsaṃyuktāṃ kṣaumavāsovibhūṣitām || 56 || vivāhopaskarairyuktāṃ divyāṃ sindhusutopamām | cintāparāṃ suvasanāṃ smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 57 || uttiṣṭha putri sunase kare dhṛtvā śubhāṃ srajam | vraja maṇḍapamadhye'dya samājaṃ paśya bhūbhujām || 58 || guṇavān rūpasampannaḥ kulīnaśca nṛpottamaḥ | tava citte vasedyastu taṃ vṛṇuṣva sumadhyame || 59 || deśadeśādhipāḥ sarve mañceṣu raciteṣu ca | saṃviṣṭāḥ paśya tanvaṅgi varayasva yathāruci || 60 || vyāsa uvāca taṃ tathā bhāṣamāṇaṃ vai pitaraṃ mitabhāṣiṇī | uvāca vacanaṃ bālā lalitaṃ dharmasaṃyutam || 61 || śaśikalovāca nāhaṃ dṛṣṭipathe rājñāṃ gamiṣyāmi pitaḥ kila | kāmukānāṃ nareśānāṃ gacchantyanyāśca yoṣitaḥ || 62 || dharmaśāstre śrutaṃ tāta mayedaṃ vacanaṃ kila | eka eva varo nāryā nirīkṣyaḥ syānna cāparaḥ || 63 || satītvaṃ nirgataṃ tasyā yā prayāti bahūnatha | saṅkalpayanti te sarve dṛṣṭvā me bhavatāttviti || 64 || svayaṃvare srajaṃ dhṛtvā yadāgacchati maṇḍape | sāmānyā sā tadā jātā kulaṭevāparā vadhūḥ || 65 || vārastrī vipaṇe gatvā yathā vīkṣya narāṃsthitān | guṇāguṇaparijñānaṃ karoti nijamānase || 66 || naikabhāvā yathā veśyā vṛthā paśyati kāmukam | tathā'haṃ maṇḍape gatvā kurve vārastriyā kṛtam || 67 || vṛddhairetaiḥ kṛtaṃ dharmaṃ na kariṣyāmi sāmpratam | patnīvrataṃ tathā kāmaṃ cariṣye'haṃ dhṛtavratā || 68 || sāmānyā prathamaṃ gatvā kṛtvā saṅkalpitaṃ bahu | vṛṇoti caikaṃ tadvadvai vṛṇomi kathamadya vai || 69 || sudarśano mayā pūrvaṃ vṛtaḥ sarvātmanā pitaḥ | tamṛte nānyathā kartumicchāmi nṛpasattama || 70 || vivāhavidhinā dehi kanyādānaṃ śubhe dine | sudarśanāya nṛpate yadīcchasi śubhaṃ mama || 71 || iti śrīdevībhāgavata mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe svapitaraṃ prati śaśikalāvākyaṃ nāmaviṃśodhyāyaḥ || 20 || <3.21> kanyayā svapitaraṃ prati sudarśanena saha vivāhārthakathanam vyāsa uvāca subāhurapi tacchrutvā yuktamuktaṃ tayā tadā | cintāviṣṭo babhūvāśu kiṃ kartavyamataḥ param || 1 || saṅgatāḥ pṛthivīpālāḥ sasainyāḥ saparigrahāḥ | upaviṣṭāśca mañceṣu yoddhukāmā mahābalāḥ || 2 || yadi bravīmi tānsarvānsutā nāyāti sāmpratam | tathāpi kopasaṃyuktā hanyurmā duṣṭabuddhayaḥ || 3 || na me sainyabalaṃ tādṛṅna durgabalamadbhutam | yenāhaṃ nṛpatīnsarvān pratyādeṣṭumihotsahe || 4 || sudarśanastathaikākī hyasahāyo'dhanaḥ śiśuḥ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ nimagno'haṃ sarvathā duḥkhasāgare || 5 || iti cintāparo rājā jagāma nṛpasannidhau | praṇamya tānuvācātha praśrayāvanato nṛpaḥ || 6 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ nṛpāḥ kāmaṃ naiti me maṇḍape sutā | bahuśaḥ preryamāṇā'pi sā mātrā'pi mayā'pi ca || 7 || mūrghnā patāmi pādeṣu rājñāṃ dāso'smi sāmpratam | pūjādikaṃ gṛhītvā'dya vrajantu sadanāni vaḥ || 8 || dadāmi bahuratnāni vastrāṇi ca gajān rathān | gṛhītvā'dya kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vrajantu bhavanānyuta || 9 || na vaśe me sutā bālā mriyate yadi kheditā | tadā me syānmahadduḥkhaṃ tena cintāturo'smyaham || 10 || bhavantaḥ karuṇāvanto mahābhāgyā mahaujasaḥ | kiṃ me tayā duhitrā tu mandayā durvinītayā || 11 || anugrāhyo'smi vaḥ kāmaṃ dāso'hamiti sarvathā | sutā suteva mantavyā bhavadbhiḥ sarvathā mama || 12 || vyāsa uvāca śrutvā subāhuvacanaṃ nocuḥ kecana bhūmipāḥ | yudhājitkrodhatāmrākṣastamuvāca ruṣānvitaḥ || 13 || rājanmūrkho'si kiṃ brūṣe kṛtvā kārya suninditam | svayaṃvaraḥ kathaṃ mohādracitaḥ saṃśaye sati || 14 || militā bhūbhujaḥ sarve tvayāhūtāḥ svayaṃvare | kathamadya nṛpā gantuṃ yogyāste svagṛhānprati || 15 || avamānya nṛpānsarvāṃstvaṃ kiṃ sudarśanāya vai | dātumicchasi putrīñca kimanāryamataḥ param || 16 || vicārya puruṣeṇādau kāryaṃ vai śubhamicchatā | ārabdhavyaṃ tvayā tattu kṛtaṃ rājannajānatā || 17 || etānvihāya nṛpatīnbalavāhanasaṃyutān | varaṃ sudarśanaṃ kartuṃ kathamicchasi sāmpratam || 18 || ahaṃ tvāṃ hanmi pāpiṣṭhaṃ tathā paścātsudarśanam | dauhitrāyādya te kanyāṃ dāsyāmīti viniścayaḥ || 19 || mayi tiṣṭhati ko'nyosti yaḥ kanyāṃ hartumicchati | sudarśanaḥ kiyānadya nirdhano nirbalaḥ śiśuḥ || 20 || bhāradvājāśrame pūrvaṃ mukto munikṛte mayā | nādyāhaṃ mocayiṣyāmi sarvathā jīvitaṃ śiśoḥ || 21 || tasmādvicārya samyaktvaṃ putryā ca bhāryayā saha | dauhitrāya priyāṃ kanyāṃ dehi me subhruvaṃ kila || 22 || sambandhī bhava dattvā tvaṃ putrīmetāṃ manoramām | uccāśrayaḥ prakartavyaḥ sarvadā śubhamicchatā || 23 || sudarśanāya dattvā tvaṃ putrīṃ prāṇapriyāṃ śubhām | ekākine'pyarājyāya kiṃ sukhaṃ prāptumicchasi || 24 || ( kulaṃ vittaṃ balaṃ rūpaṃ rājyaṃ durgaṃ suhṛjjanam | dṛṣṭvā kanyā pradātavyā nānyathā sukhamṛcchati) || paricintaya dharmaṃ tvaṃ rājanītiñca śāśvatīm | kuru kāryaṃ yathāyogyaṃ mā kṛthā matimanyathā || 25 || suhṛdasi mamātyarthaṃ hitaṃ te prabravīmyaham | samānaya sutāṃ rājan maṇḍape tāṃ sakhīvṛtām || 26 || sudarśanamṛte ceyaṃ variṣyati yadā'pyasau | vigraho me tadā na syādvivāho'stu tavepsitaḥ || 27 || anye nṛpatayaḥ sarve kulīnāḥ sabalāḥ samāḥ | virodhaḥ kīdṛśastvenaṃ vṛṇodyadi nṛpottama || 28 || anyathā'haṃ hariṣye'dya balātkanyāmimāṃ śubhām | mā virodhaṃ suduḥsādhyaṃ gaccha pārthivasattama || 29 || vyāsa uvāca yudhājitā samādiṣṭaḥ subāhuḥ śokasaṃyutaḥ | niḥśvasanbhavanaṃ gatvā bhāryāṃ prāha śucāvṛtaḥ || 30 || putrīṃ brūhi sudharmajñe kalahe samupasthite | kiṃ karttavyaṃ mayā śakyaṃ tvadvaśo'smi sulocane || 31 || vyāsa uvāca sā śrutvā pativākyaṃ tu gatvā prāha sutāntikam | vatse rājātiduḥkhārtaḥ pitā te'dyāpi vartate || 32 || tvadarthe vigrahaḥ kāmaṃ samutpanno'dya bhūbhṛtām | anyaṃ varaya suśroṇi sudarśanamṛte nṛpam || 33 || yadi sudarśanaṃ vatse haṭhāttvaṃ vai variṣyasi | yudhājittvāṃ ca māṃ caiva haniṣyati balānvitaḥ || 34 || sudarśanaṃ ca rājā'sau balamattaḥ pratāpavān | dvitīyaste patiḥ paścādbhavitā kalahe sati || 35 || tasmātsudarśanaṃ tyaktvā varayānyaṃ nṛpottamam | sukhamicchasi cenmahyaṃ tubhyaṃ vā mṛgalocane | iti mātrā bodhitāṃ tāṃ paścādrājāpyabodhayat || 36 || ubhayorvacanaṃ śrutvā nirbhayovāca kanyakā kanyovāca satyamuktaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha jānāsi ca vrataṃ mama || 37 || nānyaṃ vṛṇomi bhūpāla sudarśanamṛte kvacit | bibheṣi yadi rājendra nṛpebhyaḥ kila kātaraḥ || 38 || sudarśanāya dattvā māṃ visarjaya purādbahiḥ | sa māṃ rathe sāmāropya nirgamiṣyati te purāt || 39 || bhavitavyaṃ tu paścādvai bhaviṣyati na cānyathā | nātra cintā tvayā kāryā bhavitavye nṛpottama || 40 || yadbhāvi tadbhavatyeva sarvathātra na saṃśayaḥ | rājovāca na putri sāhasaṃ kāryaṃ matimadbhiḥ kadācana || 41 || bahubhirna viroddhavyamiti vedavido viduḥ | visrakṣyāmi kathaṃ kanyāṃ dattvā rājasutāya ca || 42 || rājāno varasaṃyuktāḥ kiṃ na kuryurasāmpratam | yadi te rocate vatse paṇaṃ saṃvidadhāmyaham || 43 || janakena yathā pūrvaṃ kṛtaḥ sītāsvayaṃvare | śaivaṃ dhanuryathā tena dhṛtaṃ kṛtvā paṇaṃ tathā || 44 || tathāhamapi tanvaṅgi karomyadya durāsadam | vivādo yena rājñāṃ vai kṛte sati śamaṃ vrajet || 45 || pālayiṣyati yaḥ kāmaṃ sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati | sudarśanastathā'nyo vā yaḥ kaścidbalavattaraḥ || 46 || pālayitvā paṇaṃ tvāṃ vai varayiṣyati sarvathā | evaṃ kṛte nṛpāṇāṃ tu vivādaḥ śamito bhavet || 47 || sukhenāhaṃ vivāhaṃ te kariṣyāmi tataḥ param | kanyovāca sandehe naiva majjāmi mūrkhakṛtyamidaṃ yataḥ || 48 || mayā sudarśanaḥ pūrvaṃ dhṛtaścetasi nānyathā | kāraṇaṃ puṇyapāpānāṃ mana eva mahīpate || 49 || manasā vidhṛtaṃ tyaktvā kathamanyaṃ vṛṇe pitaḥ | kṛte paṇe mahārāja sarveṣāṃ vaśagā hyaham || 50 || ekaḥ pālayitā dvau vā bahavo vā bhavanti cet | kiṃ kartavyaṃ tadā tāta vivāde samupasthite || 51 || saṃśayādhiṣṭhite kārye matiṃ nāhaṃ karomyataḥ | mā cintāṃ kuru rājendra dehi sudarśanāya mām || 52 || vivāhaṃ vidhinā kṛtvā śaṃ vidhāsyati caṇḍikā | yannāmakīrtanādeva duḥkhaugho vilayaṃ vrajet || 53 || tāṃ smṛtvā paramāṃ śaktiṃ kuru kāryamatandritaḥ | gatvā vada nṛpebhyastvaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭo'dya vai || 54 || āgantavyañca śvaḥ sarvairiha bhūpaiḥ svayaṃvare | ityuktvā tvaṃ visṛjyāśu sarvaṃ nṛpatimaṇḍalam || 55 || vivāhaṃ kuru rātrau me vedoktavidhinā nṛpa | pāribarhaṃ yathāyogyaṃ dattvā tasmai visarjaya || 56 || gamiṣyati gṛhītvā māṃ dhruvasandhisutaḥ kila | kadācitte nṛpāḥ kruddhāḥ saṅgrāmaṃ karttumudyatāḥ || 57 || bhaviṣyati tadā devī sāhāyyaṃ naḥ kariṣyati | so'pi rājasutastaistu saṅgrāmaṃ saṃvidhāsyati || 58 || daivānmṛdhe mṛte tasminmariṣyāmyahamapyuta | svasti testu gṛhe tiṣṭha dattvā māṃ sahasainyakaḥ || 59 || ekaivāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi tena sārdhaṃ riraṃsayā | vyāsa uvāca iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā rājā'sau kṛtaniścayaḥ | matiṃ cakre tathā kartuṃ viśvāsaṃ pratipadya ca || 60 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe kanyayā svapitaraṃ prati sudarśanena saha vivāhārthakathanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || <3.22> sudarśanaśaśikalayorvivāhavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca śrutvā sutāvākyamaninditātmā nṛpāṃśca gatvā nṛpatirjagāda | vrajantu kāmaṃ śivirāṇi bhūpāḥ śvo vā vivāhaṃ kila saṃvidhāsye || 1 || bhakṣyāṇi peyāni mayā'rpitāni gṛhṇantu sarve mayi suprasannāḥ | śvo bhāvi kāryaṃ kila maṇḍape'tra sametya sarvairiha saṃvidheyam || 2 || nāyāti putrī kila maṇḍape'dya karomi kiṃ bhūpatayo'tra kāmam | prātaḥ samāśvāsya sutāṃ nayiṣye gacchantu tasmācchivirāṇi bhūpāḥ || 3 || na vigraho buddhimatāṃ nijāśrite kṛpā vidheyā satataṃ hyapatye | vidhāya tāṃ prātārihānayiṣye sutāṃ tu gacchantu nṛpā yatheṣṭam || 4 || icchāpaṇaṃ vā paricintya citte prātaḥ kariṣyāmyatha saṃvivāham | sarvaiḥ sametyātra nṛpaiḥ sametaiḥ svayaṃvaraḥ sarvamatena kāryaḥ || 5 || śrutvā nṛpāste'vitathaṃ viditvā vaco yayuḥ svāni niketanāni | vidhāya pārśve nagarasya rakṣāṃ cakruḥ kriyā madhyadinoditāśca || 6 || subāhurapyāryajanaiḥ sametaścakāra kāryāṇi vivāhakāle | putrīṃ samāhūya gṛhe sugupte purohitairvedavidāṃ variṣṭhaiḥ || 7 || snānādikaṃ karma varasya kṛtvā vivāhabhūṣākaraṇaṃ tathaiva | ānāyya vedīracite gṛhe vai tasyārhaṇāṃ bhūmipatiścakāra || 8 || saviṣṭaraṃ cācamanīyamarghyaṃ vastradvayaṃ gāmatha kuṇḍale dve | samarpya tasmai vidhivannarendra aicchatsutādānamahīnasattvaḥ || 9 || so'pyagrahītsarvamadīnacetāḥ śaśāma cintā'tha manoramāyāḥ | kanyāṃ sukeśīṃ nidhikanyakāsamāṃ mene tadā''tmānamanuttamañca || 10 || supūjitaṃ bhūṣaṇavastradānairvarottamaṃ taṃ sacivāstadānīm | ninyuśca te kautukamaṇḍapāntarmudānvitā vītabhayāśca sarve || 11 || samāptabhūṣāṃ vidhivadvidhijñāḥ striyaśca tāṃ rājasutāṃ suyāne | āropya ninyurvarasannidhānaṇ catuṣkayukte kila maṇḍape vai || 12 || agniṃ samādhāya purohitaḥ sa hutvā yathāvacca tadantarāle | āhvāyayattau kṛtakautukau tu vadhūvarau premayutau nikāmam || 13 || lājāvisargaṃ vidhivadvidhāya kṛtvā hutāśasya pradakṣiṇāñca | tau cakratustatra yathocittaṃ tat sarvaṃ vidhānaṃ kulagotrajātam || 14 || śatadvayaṃ cāścayujāṃ rathānāṃ subhūṣitaṃ cāpi śaraughasaṃyutam | dadau nṛpendrastu sudarśanāya supūjitaṃ pāribarhaṃ vivāhe || 15 || madotkaṭānhemavibhūṣitāṃśca gajāngireḥ śṛṅgasamānadehān | śataṃ sapādaṃ nṛpasūnave'sau dadāvatha premayuto nṛpendraḥ || 16 || dāsīśataṃ kāñcanabhūṣitaṃ ca kareṇukānāṃ ca śataṃ sucāru | samarpayāmāsa varāya rājā vivāhakāle mudito'nuvelam || 17 || adātpunardāsasahasramekaṃ sarvāyudhaiḥ sambhṛtabhūṣitañca | ratnāni vāsāṃsi yathocitāni divyāni citrāṇi tathāvikāni || 18 || dadau punarvāsagṛhāṇi tasmairamyāṇi dīrghāṇi vicitritāni | sindhūdbhavānāṃ turagottamānāmadātsahasradvitayaṃ suramyam || 19 || kramelakānāñca śatatrayaṃ vai pratyādiśadbhārabhṛtāṃ sucāru | śatadvayaṃ vai śakaṭottamānāṃ tasmai dadau dhānyarasaiḥ prapūritam || 20 || manoramāṃ rājasutāṃ praṇamya jagāda vākyaṃ vihitāñjaliḥ puraḥ | dāso'smi te rājasute variṣṭhe tadbrūhi yatsyāttu manogataṃ te || 21 || taṃ cāruvākyaṃ nijagāda sāpi svastyastu te bhūpa kulasya vṛddhiḥ | sammānitā'haṃ mama sūnave tvayā dattā yato ratnavarā svakanyā || 22 || na bandiputrī nṛpa māgadhī vā staumīha kiṃ tvāṃ svajanaṃ mahattaram | sumerutulyastu kṛtaḥ suto'dya me sambandhinā bhūpatinottamena || 23 || aho'ticitraṃ nṛpateścaritraṃ paraṃ pavitraṃ tava kiṃ vadāmi | yadbhraṣṭarājyāya sutāya me'dya dattā tvayā pūjyasutā variṣṭhā || 24 || vanādhivāsāya kilādhanāya pitrā vihīnāya visainyakāya | sarvānimānbhūmipatīnvihāya phalāśanāyārthavivarjitāya || 25 || samānavitte'tha kule bale ca dadāti putrīṃ nṛpatiśca bhūyaḥ | na ko'pi me bhūpasute'rthahīne guṇānvitāṃ rūpavatīñca dadyāt || 26 || vairaṃ tu sarvaiḥ saha saṃvidhāya nṛpairvariṣṭhairbalasaṃyutaiśca | sudarśanāyātha sutā'rpitā me kiṃ varṇaye dhairyamidaṃ tvadīyam || 27 || niśamya vākyāni nṛpaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ kṛtāñjalirvākyamuvāca bhūyaḥ | gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ mama suprasiddhaṃ bhavāmi senāpatiradya cāham || 28 || nocettadardhaṃ pratigṛhya cātra sutānvito rājyaphalāni bhuṅkṣva | vihāya vārāṇasikānivāsaṃ vane pure vāsamato na me'sti || 29 || nṛpāstu santyeva ruṣānvitā vai gatvā kariṣye prathamaṃ tu sāntvanam | tataḥ paraṃ dvāvaparāvupāyau nocettato yuddhamahaṃ kariṣye || 30 || jayājayo daivavaśo tathāpi dharme jayo naiva kṛte'pyadharme | teṣāṃ kilādharmavatāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ kathaṃ bhaviṣyatyanucintitaṃ vai || 31 || ākarṇya tadbhāṣitamarthavacca jagāda vākyaṃ hitakārakaṃ tam | manoramā mānamavāpya tasmāt sarvātmanā modayutā prasannā || 32 || rājañchivaṃ te'stu kuruṣva rājyaṃ tyaktvā bhayaṃ tvaṃ svasutaiḥ sametaḥ | suto'pi me nūnamavāpya rājyaṃ sāketapuryāṃ pracariṣyatīha || 33 || visarjayāsmānnijasadma gantuṃ śivaṃ bhavānī tava saṃvidhāsyati | na kā'pi cintā mama bhūpa vartate sañcintayantyā paramāmbikāṃ vai || 34 || doṣā gatā vividhavākyapadai rasālairanyonyabhāṣaṇapadairamṛtopamaiśca | prātarnṛpāḥ samadhigamya kṛtaṃ vivāhaṃ roṣānvitā nagarabāhyagatāstathocuḥ || 35 || adyaiva taṃ nṛpakalaṅkadharañca hatvā bālaṃ tathaiva kila taṃ na vivāhayogyam | gṛhṇīma tāṃ śaśikalāṃ nṛpateśca lakṣmīṃ lajjāmavāpya nijasadma kathaṃ vrajema || 36 || śṛṇvantu tūryaninadānkila vādyamānāñchaṅkhasvanānabhibhavanti mṛdaṅgaśabdāḥ | gītadhvaniṃ ca vividhaṃ nigamasvanañca manyāmahe nṛpatinā'tra kṛto vivāhaḥ || 37 || asmānpratārya vacanairvidhivaccakāra vaivāhikena vidhinā karapīḍanaṃ vai | kartavyamadya kimaho pravicintayantu bhūpāḥ parasparamatiṃ ca samarthayantu || 38 || evaṃ vadatsu nṛpatiṣvatha kanyākāyāḥ kṛtvā vivāhavidhimapratimaprabhāvaḥ | bhūpānnimantrayitumāśu jagāma rājā kāśīpatiḥ svasuhṛdaiḥ prathitaprabhāvaiḥ || 39 || āgacchantaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpāḥ kāśīpatiṃ tadā | nocuḥ kiñcidapi krodhānmaunamādhāya saṃsthitāḥ || 40 || sa gatvā praṇipatyāha kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata | āgantavyaṃ nṛpaiḥ sarvairbhojanārthaṃ gṛhe mama || 41 || kanyayā'sau vṛto bhūpaḥ kiṃ karomi hitāhitam | bhavadbhistu śubhaḥ kāryo mahānto hi dayālavaḥ || 42 || tanniśamya vacastasya nṛpāḥ krodhapariplutāḥ | pratyūcurbhuktamasmābhiḥ svagṛhaṃ nṛpate vraja || 43 || kuru kāryāṇyaśeṣāṇi yatheṣṭaṃ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam | nṛpāḥ sarve prayāntvadya svāni svāni gṛhāṇi vai || 44 || subāhurapi tacchrutvā jagāma śaṅkito gṛham | kiṃ kariṣyanti saṃvignāḥ krodhayuktā nṛpottamāḥ || 45 || gate tasminmahīpālāścakruśca samayaṃ punaḥ | ruddhvā mārgaṃ grahīṣyāmaḥ kanyāṃ hatvā sudarśanam || 46 || kecanocuḥ kimasmākaṃ hanta tena nṛpeṇa vai | dṛṣṭvā tu kautukaṃ sarvaṃ gamiṣyāmo yathāgatam || 47 || ityuktvā te nṛpāḥ sarve mārgamākramya saṃsthitāḥ | cakārottarakāryāṇi subāhuḥ svagṛhaṃ gataḥ || 48 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe sudarśanaśaśikalayorvivāhavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || <3.23> subāhukṛtadevīstutivarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tasmai gauravabhojyāni vidhāya vidhivattadā | vāsarāṇi ca ṣaḍrājā bhojayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 1 || evaṃ vivāhakāryāṇi kṛtvā sarvāṇi pārthivaḥ | pāribarhaṃ pradatvā'tha mantrayansacivaiḥ saha || 2 || dūtaistu kathitaṃ śrutvā mārgasaṃrodhanaṃ kṛtam | babhūva vimanā rājā subāhuramitadyutiḥ || 3 || sudarśanastadovāca śvaśuraṃ saṃśitavrataḥ | asmānvisarjayāśu tvaṃ gamiṣyāmo hyaśaṅkitāḥ || 4 || bhāradvājāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ gatvā tatra samāhitāḥ | nivāsāya vicāro vai kartavyaḥ sarvathā nṛpa || 5 || nṛpebhyaśca na kartavyaṃ bhayaṃ kiñcittvayā'nagha | jaganmātā bhavānī me sāhāyyaṃ vai kariṣyati || 6 || vyāsa uvāca tasyeti matamājñāya jāmāturnupasattamaḥ | visasarja dhanaṃ datvā pratasthe so'pi satvaraḥ || 7 || balena mahatā''viṣṭo yayāvanu nṛpottamaḥ | sudarśano vṛtastatra cacāla pathi nirbhayaḥ || 8 || rathaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śūraḥ sadāro rathasaṃsthitaḥ | gacchandadarśa sainyāni nṛpāṇāṃ raghunandanaḥ || 9 || subāhurapi tānvīkṣya cintāviṣṭo babhūva ha | vidhivatsa śivāṃ citte jagāma śaraṇaṃ mudā || 10 || jajāpaikākṣaraṃ mantraṃ kāmarājamanuttamam | nirbhayo vītaśokaśca patnyā saha navoḍhayā || 11 || tataḥ sarve mahīpālāḥ kṛtvā kolāhalaṃ tadā | utthitāḥ sainyasaṃyuktā hantukāmāstu kanyakām || 12 || kāśirājastu tāndṛṣṭvā hantukāmo babhūva ha | nivāritastadā'tyarthaṃ rāghaveṇa jigīṣatā || 13 || tatrāpi neduḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaścānakadundubhiḥ | subāhośca nṛpāṇāñca parasparajighāṃsatām || 14 || śatrujittu susaṃvṛttaḥ sthitastatra jighāṃsayā | yudhājittatsahāyārthaṃ sannaddhaḥ prababhūva ha || 15 || kecicca prekṣakāstasya sahānīkaiḥ sthitāstadā | yudhājidagrato gatvā sudarśanamupasthitaḥ || 16 || śatrujittena sahito hantuṃ bhrātaramānujaḥ | parasparaṃ te bāṇaughaistatakṣuḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ || 17 || sammardaḥ sumahāṃstatra sampravṛttaḥ sumārgaṇaiḥ | kāśīpatistadā tūrṇaṃ sainyena bahunā vṛtaḥ || 18 || sāhāyyārthaṃ jagāmāśu jāmātaramaninditam | evaṃ pravṛtte saṅgrāme dāruṇe lomaharṣaṇe || 19 || prādurbabhūva sahasā devī siṃhopari sthitā | nānāyudhadharā ramyā varābhūṣaṇabhūṣitā || 20 || divyāmbaraparīdhānā mandārasraksusaṃyutā | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā te'tha bhūpālā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || 21 || keyaṃ siṃhasamārūḍhā kuto veti samutthitā | sudarśanastu tāṃ vīkṣya subāhumiti cābravīt || 22 || paśya rājanmahādevīmāgatāṃ divyadarśanām | anugrahāya me nūnaṃ prādurbhūtā dayānvitā || 23 || nirbhayo'haṃ mahārāja jāto'smi nirbhayādapi | sudarśanaḥ subāhuśca tāmālokya varānanām || 24 || praṇāmaṃ cakratustasyā muditau darśanena ca | nanāda ca tadā siṃho gajāstrastāścakampire || 25 || vavurvātā mahāghorā diśaścāsansudāruṇāḥ | sudarśanastadā prāha nijaṃ senāpatiṃ prati || 26 || mārge vraja tvaṃ tarasā bhūpālā yatra saṃsthitāḥ | kiṃ kariṣyanti rājānaḥ kupitā duṣṭacetasaḥ || 27 || śaraṇārthañca samprāptā devī bhagavatī hi naḥ | nirātaṅkaiśca gantavyaṃ mārge'sminbhūpasaṅkule || 28 || smṛtā mayā mahādevī rakṣaṇārthamupāgatā | tacchrutvā vacanaṃ senāpatistena pathā'vrajat || 29 || yudhājittu susaṅkruddhastānuvāca mahīpatīn | kiṃ sthitā bhayasantrastā nighnantu kanyakānvitam || 30 || avamanya ca naḥ sarvānbalahīno balādhikān | kanyāṃ gṛhītvā saṃyāti nirbhayastarasā śiśuḥ || 31 || kiṃ bhītāḥ kāminīṃ vīkṣya siṃhopari susaṃsthitām | nopekṣyo hi mahābhāgā hantavyo'tra samāhitaiḥ || 32 || hatvainaṃ saṅgrahīṣyāmaḥ kanyāṃ cāruvibhūṣaṇām | nāyaṃ kesariṇādattāṃ chettumarhati jambukaḥ || 33 || ityuktvā sainyasaṃyuktaḥ śatrujitsahitastadā | yoddhukāmaḥ susamprāpto yudhājitkrodhasaṃvṛtaḥ || 34 || mumoca viśikhāṃstūrṇaṃ samapuṃkhāñchilāśitān | dhanurākṛṣya karṇāntaṃ karmāraparimārjitān || 35 || hantukāmaḥ sudurmedhāḥ sudarśanamathopari | sudarśanastu tānbāṇaiścicchedāpatataḥ kṣaṇāt || 36 || evaṃ yuddhe pravṛtte'tha cukopa caṇḍikā bhṛśam | durgādevī mumocātha bāṇān yudhājitaṃ prati || 37 || nānārūpā tadā jātā nānāśasradharā śivā | samprāptā tumulaṃ tatra cakāra jagadambikā || 38 || śatrujinnihatastatra yudhājidapi pārthivaḥ | patitau tau rathābhyāṃ tu jayaśabdastadā'bhavat || 39 || vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāptā bhūpāḥ sarve vilokya tām | nidhanaṃ mātulasyāpi bhāgineyasya saṃyuge || 40 || subāhurapi taddṛṣṭvā nidhanaṃ saṃyuge tayoḥ | tuṣṭāva paramaprīto durgāṃ durgārtināśinīm || 41 || subāhuruvāca namau devyai jagaddhātryai śivāyai satataṃ namaḥ | durgāyai bhagavatyai te kāmadāyai namo namaḥ || 42 || namaḥ śivāyai śāntyai te vidyāyai mokṣade namaḥ | viśvavyāptyai jaganmātarjagaddhātryai namaḥ śive || 43 || nāhaṃ gatiṃ tava dhiyā paricintayan vai jānāmi devi saguṇaḥ kila nirguṇāyāḥ | kiṃ staumi viśvajananīṃ prakaṭaprabhāvāṃ bhaktārtināśanaparāṃ paramāñca śaktim || 44 || vāgdevatā tvamasi sarvagataiva buddhirvidyā matiśca gatirapyasi sarvajantoḥ | tvāṃ staumi kiṃ tvamasi sarvamanoniyantrī kiṃ stūyate hi satataṃ khalu cātmarūpam || 45 || brahmā haraśca harirapyaniśaṃ stuvanto nāntaṃ gatāḥ suravarāḥ kila te guṇānām | kvāhaṃ vibhedamatiramba guṇairvṛto vai vaktuṃ kṣamastava caritramaho'prasiddhaḥ || 46 || satsaṅgatiḥ kathamaho na karoti kāmaṃ prāsaṅgikāpi vihitā khalu cittaśuddhiḥ | jāmāturasya vihitena samāgamena prāptaṃ mayā'dbhutamidaṃ tava darśanaṃ vai || 47 || brahmā'pi vāñchati sadaiva haro hariśca sendrāḥ surāśca munayo viditārthatattvāḥ | yaddarśanaṃ janani te'dya mayā durāpaṃ prāptaṃ vinā damaśamādisamādhibhiśca || 48 || kvāhaṃ sumandamatirāśu tavāvalokaṃ kvedaṃ bhavāni bhavabheṣajamadvitīyam | jñātā'si devi satataṃ kila bhāvayuktā bhaktānukampanaparāmaravargapūjyā || 49 || kiṃ varṇayāmi tava devi caritrametad yadrakṣito'sti viṣame'tra sudarśano'yam | śatrū hatau subalinau tarasā tvayādya bhaktānukampi caritaṃ paramaṃ pavitram || 50 || nāścaryametaditi devi vicārite'rthe tvaṃ pāsi sarvamakhilaṃ sthirajaṅgamaṃ vai | trātastvayā ca vinihatya ripurdayātaḥ saṃrakṣito'yamadhunā dhruvasandhisūnuḥ || 51 || bhaktasya sevanaparasya svayaśo'tidīptaṃ kartuṃ bhavāni racitaṃ caritaṃ tvayaitat | nocetkathaṃ suparigṛhya sutāṃ madīyāṃ yuddhe bhavetkuśalavānanavadyaśīlaḥ || 52 || śaktā'si janmamaraṇādibhayānvihantuṃ kiṃ citramatra kila bhaktajanasya kāmam | tvaṃ gīyase janani bhaktajanairapārā tvaṃ pāpapuṇyarahitā saguṇā'guṇā ca || 53 || tvaddarśanādahamaho sukṛtī kṛtārtho jāto'smi devi bhuvaneśvari dhanyajanmā | bījaṃ na te na bhajanaṃ kila vedmi mātarjñātastavādya mahimā prakaṭaprabhāvaḥ || 54 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ stutā tadā devī prasannavadanā śivā | uvāca ca nṛpaṃ devī varaṃ varaya suvrata || 55 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe subāhukṛtadevīstutivarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || <3.24> devīmahimavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhavānyāḥ sa nṛpottamaḥ | provāca vacanaṃ tatra subāhurbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 1 || subāhuruvāca ekato devalokasya rājyaṃ bhūmaṇḍalasya ca | ekato darśanaṃ te vai na ca tulyaṃ kadācana || 2 || darśanātsadṛśaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu nāsti me | kaṃ varaṃ devi yāce'haṃ kṛtārtho'smi dharātale || 3 || etadicchāmyahaṃ mātaryācituṃ vāñchitaṃ varam | tava bhaktiḥ sadā me'stu niścalā hyanapāyinī || 4 || nagare'tra tvayā mātaḥ sthātavyaṃ mama sarvadā | durgādevīti nāmnā vai tvaṃ śaktiriha saṃsthitā || 5 || rakṣā tvayā ca kartavyā sarvadā nagarasya ha | yathā sudarśanastrāto ripusaṃghādanāmayaḥ || 6 || tathā'tra rakṣā kartavyā vārāṇasyāstvayāmbike | yāvatpurī bhavedbhūmau supratiṣṭhā susaṃsthitā || 7 || tāvattvayā'tra sthātavyaṃ durge devi kṛpānidhe | varo'yaṃ mama te deyaḥ kimanyatprārthayāmyaham || 8 || vividhānsakalānkāmāndehi me vidviṣo jahi | abhadrāṇāṃ vināśañca kuru lokasya sarvadā || 9 || vyāsa uvāca iti samprārthitā devī durgā durgārtināśinī | tamuvāca nṛpaṃ tatra stutvā vai saṃsthitaṃ puraḥ || 10 || durgovāca rājansadā nivāso me muktipuryāṃ bhaviṣyati | rakṣārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ yāvattiṣṭhati medinī || 11 || atho sudarśanastatra samāgatya mudānvitaḥ | praṇamya parayā bhaktyā tuṣṭāva jagadambikām || 12 || aho kṛpā ye kathayāmyahaṃ kiṃ trātastvayā yatkila bhaktihīnaḥ | bhaktānukampī sakalo jano'sti vimuktabhakteravanaṃ vrataṃ te || 13 || tvaṃ devi sarvaṃ sṛjasi prapañcaṃ śrutaṃ mayā pālayasi svasṛṣṭam | tvamatsi saṃhārapare ca kāle na te'tra citraṃ mama rakṣaṇaṃ vai || 14 || karomi kiṃ te vada devi kāryaṃ kva vā vrajāmītyanumodayāśu | kārye vimūḍho'smi tavājñayā'haṃ gacchāmi tiṣṭhe viharāmi mātaḥ || 15 || vyāsa uvāca taṃ tathā bhāṣamāṇaṃ tu devī prāha dayānvitā | gacchāyodhyāṃ mahābhāga kuru rājyaṃ kulocitam || 16 || smaraṇīyā sadā'haṃ te pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ | śaṃ vidhāsyāmyahaṃ nityaṃ rājyaṃ te nṛpasattama || 17 || aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāñca viśeṣataḥ | mama pūjā prakartavyā balidānavidhānataḥ || 18 || arcā madīyā nagare sthāpanīyā tvayā'nagha | pūjanīyā prayatnena trikālaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || 19 || śaratkāle mahāpūjā kartavyā mama sarvadā | navarātravidhānena bhaktibhāvayutena ca || 20 || caitre'śvine tathā''ṣāḍhe māghe kāryo mahotsavaḥ | navarātre mahārāja pūjā kāryā viśeṣataḥ || 21 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ mama bhaktisamanvitaiḥ | kartavyā nṛpaśārdūla tathā'ṣṭamyāṃ sadā budhaiḥ || 22 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktvāntarhitā devī durgā durgārtināśinī | natā sudarśanenātha stutā ca bahuvistaram || 23 || antarhitāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānaḥ sarva eva te | praṇemustaṃ samāgamya yathā śakraṃ surāstathā || 24 || subāhurapi taṃ natvā sthitaścāgre mudānvitaḥ | ūcuḥ sarve mahīpālā ayodhyādhipatiṃ tadā || 25 || tvamasmākaṃ prabhuḥ śāstā sevakāste vayaṃ sadā | kuru rājyamayodhyāyāṃ pālayāsmānnṛpottama || 26 || tvatprasādānmahārāja dṛṣṭā viśveśvarī śivā | ādiśaktirbhavānī sā caturvargaphalapradā || 27 || dhanyastvaṃ kṛtakṛtyo'si bahupuṇyo dharātale | yasmācca tvatkṛte devī prādurbhūtā sanātanī || 28 || na jānīmo vayaṃ sarve prabhāvaṃ nṛpasattama | caṇḍikāyāstamoyuktā māyayā mohitāḥ sadā || 29 || dhanadārasutānāṃ ca cintane'bhiratāḥ sadā | magnā mahārvaṇe ghore kāmakrodhajhaṣākule || 30 || pṛcchāmastvāṃ mahābhāga sarvajño'si mahāmate | keyaṃ śaktiḥ kuto jātā kiṃ prabhāvā vadasva tat || 31 || bhava tvaṃ nauśca saṃsāre sādhavo'ti dayāparāḥ | tasmānno vada kākutstha devīmāhātmyamuttamam || 32 || yatprabhāvā ca sā devī yatsvarupā yadudbhavā | satsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmastvaṃ brūhi nṛvarottama || 33 || vyāsa uvāca iti pṛṣṭastadā taistu dhruvasandhisuto nṛpaḥ | vicintya manasā devīṃ tānuvāca mudānvitaḥ || 34 || sudarśana uvāca kiṃ bravīmi mahīpālāstasyāścaritamuttamam | brahmādayo na jānanti seśāḥ suragaṇāstathā || 35 || sarvasyādyā mahālakṣmīrvareṇyā śaktiruttamā | sāttvikīyaṃ mahīpālā jagatpālanatatparā || 36 || sṛjate yā rajorūpā sattvarūpā ca pālane | saṃhāre ca tamorūpā triguṇā sā sadā matā || 37 || nirguṇā paramā śaktiḥ sarvakāmaphalapradā | sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ sā hi brahmādīnāṃ nṛpottamāḥ || 38 || nirguṇā sarvathā jñātumaśakyā yogibhirnṛpāḥ | saguṇā sukhasevyā sā cintanīyā sadā budhaiḥ || 39 || rājāna ūcuḥ bāla eva vanaṃ prāptastvaṃ tu nūnaṃ bhayāturaḥ | kathaṃ jñātā tvayā devī paramā śaktiruttamā || 40 || upāsitā kathaṃ caiva pūjitā ca kathaṃ nṛpa | yā prasannā tu sāhāyyaṃ cakāra tvarayānvitā || 41 || sudarśana uvāca bālabhāvānmayā prāptaṃ bījaṃ tasyāḥ susammatam | smarāmi prajapannityaṃ kāmabījābhidhaṃ nṛpāḥ || 42 || ṛṣibhiḥ kathyamānā sā mayā jñātāmbikā śivā | smarāmi tāṃ divārātraṃ bhaktyā paramayā parām || 43 || vyāsa uvāca tanniśamya vacastasya rājāno bhaktitatparāḥ | tāṃ matvā paramāṃ śaktiṃ niryayuḥ svagṛhānprati || 44 || subāhuragamatkāśyāṃ tamāpṛcchya sudarśanam | sudarśano'pi dharmātmā nirjjagāma sukosalān || 45 || mantriṇastu nṛpaṃ śrutvā hataṃ śatrujitaṃ mṛdhe | jitaṃ sudarśanañcaiva babhūvuḥ premasaṃyutāḥ || 46 || āgacchantaṃ nṛpaṃ śrutvā taṃ sāketanivāsinaḥ | upāyanānyupādāya prayayuḥ sammukhe janāḥ || 47 || tathā prakṛtayaḥ sarve nānopāyanapāṇayaḥ | dhruvasandhisutaṃ dattvā muditāḥ prayayuḥ prajāḥ || 48 || striyopasaṃyutaḥ so'tha prāpyāyodhyāṃ sudarśanaḥ | sammānya sarvalokāṃśca yayau rājā niveśanam || 49 || vandibhiḥ stūyamānastu vandyamānaśca mantribhiḥ | kanyābhiḥ kīryamāṇaśca lājaiḥ sumanasaistathā || 50 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ sudarśanena devīmahimavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyaskandhe caturviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || <3.25> devīsthāpanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca gatvā'yodhyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭho gṛhaṃ rājñaḥ suhṛdvṛtaḥ | śatrujinmātaraṃ prāha praṇamya śokasaṅkulām || 1 || mātarna te mayā putraḥ saṅgrāme nihataḥ kila | na pitā te yudhājicca śape te caraṇau tathā || 2 || durgayā tau hatau saṃkhye nāparādho mamātra vai | avaśyambhāvibhāveṣu pratīkāro na vidyate || 3 || na śoko'tra tvayā kāryo mṛtaputrasya mānini | svakarmavaśago jīvo bhuṅkte bhogānsukhāsukhān || 4 || dāso'smi tava bho mātaryathā mama manoramā | tathā tvamapi dharmajñe na bhedo'sti manāgapi || 5 || avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham | tasmānna śocitavyaṃ te sukhe duḥkhe kadācana || 6 || duḥkhe duḥkhādhikānpaśyetsukhe paśyetsukhādhikam | ātmānaṃ śokaharṣābhyāṃ śatrubhyāmiva nārpayet || 7 || daivādhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ nātmādhīnaṃ kadācana | na śokena tadā''tmānaṃ śoṣayenmatimānnaraḥ || 8 || yathā dārumayī yoṣā naṭādīnāṃ praceṣṭate | tathā svakarmavaśago dehī sarvatra vartate || 9 || ahaṃ vanagato mātarnābhavaṃ duḥkhamānasaḥ | cintayansvakṛtaṃ karma bhoktavyamiti vedmi ca || 10 || mṛto mātāmaho'traiva vidhurā jananī mama | bhayāturā gṛhītvā māṃ niryayau gahanaṃ vanam || 11 || luṇṭhitā taskarairmārge vastrahīnā tathā kṛtā | pātheyañca hṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bālaputrā nirāśrayā || 12 || mātā gṛhītvā māṃ prāptā bhāradvājāśramaṃ prati | vidallo'yaṃ samāyātastathā dhātreyikā'balā || 13 || munibhirmunipatnībhirdayāyuktaiḥ samantataḥ | poṣitāḥ phalanīvārairvayaṃ tatra sthitāstrayaḥ || 14 || duḥkhaṃ name tadā hyāsītsukhaṃ nādya dhanāgame | na vairaṃ na ca mātsaryaṃ mama citte tu karhicit || 15 || nīvārabhakṣaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rājabhogātparantape | tadāśī narakaṃ yāti na nīvārāśanaḥ kvacit || 16 || dharmasyācaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ puruṣeṇa vijānatā | sañjityendriyavargaṃ vai yathā na narakaṃ vrajet || 17 || mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ mātaḥ khaṇḍe'sminbhārate śubhe | āhārādi sukhaṃ nūnaṃ bhavetsarvāsu yoniṣu || 18 || prāpya taṃ mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ kartavyaṃ dharmasādhanam | svargamokṣapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ durlabhaṃ cānyayoniṣu || 19 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktā sā tadā tena līlāvatyatilajjitā | putraśokaṃ parityajya tamāhāśruvilocanā || 20 || sāparādhā'smi putrāhaṃ kṛtā pitrā yudhājitā | hatyā mātāmahaṃ te'tra hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tu yena vai || 21 || na taṃ vārayituṃ śaktā tadā'haṃ na sutaṃ mama | yatkṛtaṃ karma tenaiva nāparādho'sti me suta || 22 || tau mṛtau svakṛtenaiva kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ tayorna ca | nāhaṃ śocāmi taṃ putraṃ sadā śocāmi tatkṛtam || 23 || putra tvamasi kalyāṇa bhaginī me manoramā | na krodho na ca śoko me tvayi putra manāgapi || 24 || kuru
