rājyaṃ mahābhāga prajāḥ pālaya suvrata | bhagavatyāḥ prasādena prāptametadakaṇṭakam || 25 || tadākarṇya vaco māturnatvā tāṃ nṛpanandanaḥ | jagāma bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ yatra pūrvaṃ manoramā || 26 || nyavasattatra gatvā tu sarvānāhūya mantriṇaḥ | daivajñānatha papraccha muhūrtaṃ divasaṃ śubham || 27 || siṃhāsanaṃ tathā haimaṃ kārayitvā manoharam | siṃhāsane sthitāṃ devīṃ pūjayiṣye sadā'pyaham || 28 || sthāpayitvā''sane devīṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣadām | rājyaṃ paścātkariṣyāmi yathā rāmādibhiḥ kṛtam || 29 || pūjanīyā sadā devī sarvairnāgarikairjanaiḥ | mānanīyā śivā śaktiḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhidā || 30 || ityuktā mantriṇaste tu cakrurvai rājaśāsanam | prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsuḥ śilpibhiḥ sumanoramam || 31 || pratimāṃ kārayitvā'tha muhūrte'tha śubhe dine | dvijānāhūya vedajñānsthāpayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ || 32 || havanaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā pūjayitvā'tha devatām | prāsāde matimān devyāḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhūmipaḥ || 33 || utsavastatra saṃvṛtto vāditrāṇāñca niḥsvanaiḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ vedaghoṣairgānaistu vidhidhairnṛpa || 34 || vyāsa uvāca pratiṣṭhāpya śivāṃ devīṃ vidhivadvedavādibhiḥ | pūjāṃ nānāvidhāṃ rājā cakārātividhānataḥ || 35 || kṛtvā pūjāvidhiṃ rājā rājyaṃ prāpya svapaitṛkam | vikhyātaścāmbikā devī kosaleṣu babhūva ha || 36 || rājyaṃ prāpya nṛpaḥ sarvaṃ sāmantakanṛpānatha | vaśe cakre'tidharmiṣṭhānsaddharmavijayī nṛpaḥ || 37 || yathā rāmaḥ svarājye'bhūddilīpasya raghuryathā | prajānāṃ vai sukhaṃ tadvanmaryādā'pi tathā'bhavat || 38 || dharmo varṇāśramāṇāṃ ca catuṣpādabhavattathā | nādharme ramate cittaṃ keṣāmapi mahītale || 39 || grāme grāme ca prāsādāṃścakruḥ sarve janādhipāḥ | devyāḥ pūjā tadā prītyā kosaleṣu pravartitā || 40 || subāhurapi kāśyāṃ tu durgāyāḥ pratimāṃ śubhām | kārayitvā ca prāsādaṃ sthāpayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 41 || tatra tasyā janāḥ sarve premabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | pūjāṃ cakrurvidhānena yathā viśveśvarasya ha || 42 || vikhyātā sā babhūvātha durgādevī dharātale | deśe deśe mahārāja tasyā bhaktirvyavardhata || 43 || sarvatra bhārate loke sarvavarṇeṣu sarvathā | bhajanīyā bhavānī tu sarveṣāmabhavattadā || 44 || śaktibhaktiratāḥ sarve māninaścābhavannṛpa | āgamoktairatha stotrairjapadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || 45 || navarātreṣu sarveṣu cakruḥ sarve vidhānataḥ | arcanaṃ havanaṃ yāgaṃ devyā bhaktiparā janāḥ || 46 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe devīsthāpanavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || <3.26> kumārīpūjāvarṇanam janamejaya uvāca navarātre tu samprāpte kiṃ kartavyaṃ dvijottama | vidhānaṃ vidhivadbrūhi śaratkāle viśeṣataḥ || 1 || kiṃ phalaṃ khalu kastatra vidhiḥ kāryo mahāmate | etadvistarato brūhi kṛpayā dvijasattama || 2 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi navarātravrataṃ śubham | śaratkāle viśeṣeṇa kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 3 || vasante ca prakartavyaṃ tathaiva premapūrvakam | dvāvṛtū yamadaṃṣṭrākhyau nūnaṃ sarvajaneṣu vai || 4 || śaradvasantanāmānau durgamau prāṇināmiha | tasmādyatnādidaṃ kāryaṃ sarvatra śubhamicchatā || 5 || dvāveva sumahāghorāvṛtū rogakarau nṛṇām | vasantaśaradāveva sarvanāśakarāvubhau || 6 || tasmāttatra prakartavyaṃ caṇḍikāpūjanaṃ budhaiḥ | caitrāśvine śubhe māse bhaktipūrvaṃ narādhipa || 7 || amāvāsyāṃ ca samprāpya sambhāraṃ kalpayecchubham | haviṣyaṃ cāśanaṃ kāryamekabhuktaṃ tu taddine || 8 || maṇḍapastu prakartavyaḥ same deśe śubhe sthale | hastaṣoḍaśamānena stambhadhvajasamanvitaḥ || 9 || gauramṛdgomayābhyāṃ ca lepanaṃ kārayettataḥ | tanmadhye vedikā śubhrā kartavyā ca samā sthirā || 10 || caturhastā ca hastocchrā pīṭhārthaṃ sthānamuttamam | toraṇāni vicitrāṇi vitānañca prakalpayet || 11 || rātrau dvijānathāmantrya devītattvaviśāradān | ācāraniratāndāntānvedavedāṅgapāragān || 12 || pratipaddivase kāryaṃ prātaḥsnānaṃ vidhānataḥ | nadyāṃ nade taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ kūpe gṛhe'thavā || 13 || prātarnityaṃ puraḥ kṛtvā dvijānāṃ varaṇaṃ tataḥ | arghyapādyādikaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ madhupūrvakam || 14 || vastrālaṅkaraṇādīni deyāni ca svaśaktitaḥ | vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ vibhave sati karhicit || 15 || vipraiḥ santoṣitaiḥ kāryaṃ sampūrṇaṃ sarvathā bhavet | nava pañca trayaścaiko devyāḥ pāṭhe dvijāḥ smṛtāḥ || 16 || varayedbrāhmaṇaṃ śāntaṃ pārāyaṇakṛte tadā | svastivācanakaṃ kāryaṃ vedamantravidhānataḥ || 17 || vedyāṃ siṃhāsanaṃ sthāpya kṣaumavastrasamanvitam | tatra sthāpyā'mbikā devī caturhastāyudhānvitā || 18 || ratnabhūṣaṇasaṃyuktā muktāhāravirājitā | divyāmbaradharā saumyā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || 19 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharā siṃhe sthitā śivā | aṣṭādaśabhujā vā'pi pratiṣṭhāpyā sanātanī || 20 || arcābhāve tathā yantraṃ navārṇamantrasaṃyutam | sthāpayetpīṭhapūjārthaṃ kalaśaṃ tatra pārśvataḥ || 21 || pañcapallavasaṃyuktaṃ vedamantraiḥ susaṃskṛtam | sutīrthajalasampūrṇaṃ hemaratnaiḥ samanvitam || 22 || pārśve pūjārthasambhārānparikalpya samantataḥ | gītavāditranirghoṣānkārayenmaṅgalāya vai || 23 || tithau hastānvitāyāṃ ca nandāyāṃ pūjanaṃ varam | prathame divase rājan vidhivatkāmadaṃ nṛṇām || 24 || niyamaṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā paścātpūjāṃ samācaret | upavāsena naktena caikabhuktena vā punaḥ || 25 || kariṣyāmi vrataṃ mātarnavarātramanuttamam | sāhāyyaṃ kuru me devi jagadamba mamākhilam || 26 || yathāśakti prakartavyo niyamo vratahetave | paścātpūjā prakartavyā vidhivanmantrapūrvakam || 27 || candanāgurukarpūraiḥ kusumaiśca sugandhibhiḥ | mandārakarajāśokacampakaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ || 28 || mālatībrahmakāpuṣpaistathā bilvadalaiḥ śubhaiḥ | pūjayejjagatāṃ dhātrīṃ dhūpairdīpairvidhānataḥ || 29 || phalairnānāvidhairarghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ ca tatra vai | nārikelairmātuluṅgairdāḍimīkadalīphalaiḥ || 30 || nāraṅgaiḥ panasaiścaiva tathā pūrṇaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ | annadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhaktipūrvaṃ narādhipa || 31 || māṃsāśanaṃ ye kurvanti taiḥ kāryaṃ paśuhiṃsanam | mahiṣājavarāhāṇāṃ balidānaṃ viśiṣyate || 32 || devyagre nihatā yānti paśavaḥ svargamavyayam | na hiṃsā paśujā tatra nighnatāṃ tatkṛte'nagha || 33 || ahiṃsā yājñikī proktā sarvaśāstravinirṇaye | devatārthe visṛṣṭānāṃ paśūnāṃ svargatirdhruvā || 34 || homārthaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ kuṇḍaṃ caiva trikoṇakam | sthaṇḍilaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ trikoṇaṃ mānataḥ śubham || 35 || trikālaṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ nānādravyairmanoharaiḥ | gītavāditranṛtyaiśca kartavyaśca mahotsavaḥ || 36 || nityaṃ bhūmau ca śayanaṃ kumārīṇāṃ ca pūjanam | vastrālaṅkaraṇairdivyairbhojanaiśca sudhāmayaiḥ || 37 || ekaikāṃ pūjayennityamekavṛddhyā tathā punaḥ | dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vā'pi pratyekaṃ navakaṃ ca vā || 38 || vibhavasyānusāreṇa kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ kila | vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ rājañchaktimakhe sadā || 39 || ekavarṣā na kartavyā kanyā pūjāvidhau nṛpa | paramajñā tu bhogānāṃ gandhādīnāṃ ca bālikā || 40 || kumārikā tu sā proktā dvivarṣā yā bhavediha | trimūrtiśca trivarṣā ca kalyāṇī caturabdikā || 41 || rohiṇī pañcavarṣā ca ṣaḍvarṣā kālikā smṛtā | caṇḍikā saptavarṣā syādaṣṭavarṣā ca śāmbhavī || 42 || navavarṣā bhaveddurgā subhadrā daśavārṣikī | ata ūrdhvaṃ na kartavyā sarvakāryavigarhitā || 43 || ebhiśca nāmabhiḥ pūjā kartavyā vidhisaṃyutā | tāsāṃ phalāni vakṣyāmi navānāṃ pūjane sadā || 44 || kumārī pūjitā kuryādduḥkhadāridrayanāśanam | śatrukṣayaṃ dhanāyuṣyaṃ balavṛddhiṃ karoti vai || 45 || trimūrtipūjanādāyustrivargasya phalaṃ bhavet | dhanadhānyāgamaścaiva putrapautrādivṛddhayaḥ || 46 || vidyārthī vijayārthī ca rājyārthī yaśca pārthivaḥ | sukhārthī pūjayennityaṃ kalyāṇīṃ sarvakāmadām || 47 || kālikāṃ śatrunāśārthaṃ pūjayedbhaktipūrvakam | aiśvaryadhanakāmaśca caṇḍikāṃ paripūjayet || 48 || pūjayecchāmbhavīṃ nityaṃ nṛpasaṃmohanāya ca | duḥkhadāridryanāśāya saṅgrāme vijayāya ca || 49 || krūraśatruvināśārthaṃ tathograkarmasādhane | durgāñca pūjayedbhaktyā paralokasukhāya ca || 50 || vāñchitārthasya siddhyarthaṃ subhadrāṃ pūjayetsadā | rohiṇīṃ roganāśāya pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ || 51 || śrīrastviti ca mantreṇa pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ | śrīyuktamantrairathavā bījamantrairathāpi vā || 52 || kumārasya ca tattvāni yā sṛjatyapi līlayā | kādīnapi ca devāṃstāṃ kumārīṃ pūjayāmyaham || 53 || sattvādibhistrimūrtiryā tairhi nānāsvarūpiṇī | trikālavyāpinī śaktistrimūrtiṃ pūjayāmyaham || 54 || kalyāṇakāriṇī nityaṃ bhaktānāṃ pūjitā'niśam | pūjayāmi ca tāṃ bhaktyā kalyāṇīṃ sarvakāmadām || 55 || rohayantī ca bījāni prāgjanmasañcitāni vai | yā devī sarvabhūtānāṃ rohiṇīṃ pūjayāmyaham || 56 || kālī kālayate sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram | kalpāntasamaye yā tāṃ kālikāṃ pūjayāmyaham || 57 || tāṃ caṇḍapāpaharaṇīṃ caṇḍikāṃ pūjayāmyaham || 58 || akāraṇātsamutpattiryanmayaiḥ parikīrtitā | yasyāstāṃ sukhadāṃ devīṃ śāmbhavīṃ pūjayāmyaham || 59 || durgāttrāyati bhaktaṃ yā sadā durgātināśinī | durjñeyā sarvadevānāṃ tāṃ durgāṃ pūjayāmyaham || 60 || subhadrāṇi ca bhaktānāṃ kurute pūjitā sadā | abhadranāśinīṃ devīṃ subhadrāṃ pūjayāmyaham || 61 || ebhirmantraiḥ pūjanīyāḥ kanyakāḥ sarvadā budhaiḥ | vastrālaṅkaraṇairmālyairgandhairuccāvacairapi || 62 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe kumārīpūjāvarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || <3.27> devīpūjāmahattvavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca hīnāṅgīṃ varjayetkanyāṃ kuṣṭhayuktāṃ vraṇāṅkitām | gandhasphuritahīnāṅgīṃ viśālakulasambhavām || 1 || jātyandhāṃ kekarāṃ kāṇāṃ kurūpāṃ bahuromaśām | santyajedrogiṇīṃ kanyāṃ raktapuṣpādināṅkitām || 2 || kṣāmāṃ garbhasamudbhūtāṃ golakāṃ kanyakodbhavām | varjanīyāḥ sadā caitāḥ sarvapūjādikarmasu || 3 || arogiṇīṃ surūpāṅgīṃ sundarīṃ vraṇavarjitām | ekavaṃśasamudbhūtāṃ kanyāṃ samyakprapūjayet || 4 || brāhmaṇī sarvakāryeṣu jayārthe nṛpavaṃśajā | lābhārthe vaiśyavaṃśotthā matā vā śūdravaṃśajā || 5 || brāhmaṇairbrahmajāḥ pūjyā rājanyairbrahmavaṃśajāḥ | vaiśyaistrivargajāḥ pūjyāścatasraḥ pādasambhavaiḥ || 6 || kārubhiścaiva vaṃśotthā yathāyogyaṃ prapūjayet | navarātravidhānena bhaktipūrvaṃ sadaiva hi || 7 || aśakto niyataṃ pūjāṃ kartuñcennavarātrake | aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ sadā || 8 || purā'ṣṭamyāṃ bhadrakālī dakṣayajñavināśinī | prādurbhūtā mahāghorā yoginī koṭibhiḥ saha || 9 || ato'ṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ sadā | nānāvidhopahāraiśca gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || 10 || pāyasairāmiṣairhomairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ | phalapuṣpopahāraiśca toṣayejjagadambikām || 11 || upavāse hyaśaktānāṃ navarātravrate punaḥ | upoṣaṇatrayaṃ proktaṃ yathoktaphaladaṃ nṛpa || 12 || saptamyāṃ ca tathā'ṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ | trirātrakaraṇātsarvaṃ phalaṃ bhavati pūjanāt || 13 || pūjābhiścaiva homaiśca kumāripūjanaistathā | sampūrṇaṃ tadvrataṃ proktaṃ viprāṇāṃ caiva bhojanaiḥ || 14 || vratāni yāni cānyāni dānāni vividhāni ca | navarātravratasyāsya naiva tulyāni bhūtale || 15 || dhanadhānyapradaṃ nityaṃ sukhasantānavṛddhidam | āyurārogyadaṃ caiva svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || 16 || vidyārthī vā dhanārthī vā putrārthī vā bhavennaraḥ | tenedaṃ vidhivatkāryaṃ vrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ śivam || 17 || vidyārthī sarvavidyāṃ vai prāpnoti vratasādhanāt | rājabhraṣṭo nṛpo rājyaṃ samavāpnoti sarvadā || 18 || pūrvajanmani yairnūnaṃ na kṛtaṃ vratamuttamam | te vyādhino daridrāśca bhavanti putravarjitāḥ || 19 || vandhyā ca yā bhavennārī vidhavā dhanavarjitā | anumā tatra kartavyā neyaṃ kṛtavatī vratam || 20 || navarātravrataṃ proktaṃ na kṛtaṃ yena bhūtale | sa kathaṃ vibhavaṃ prāpya modate ca tathā divi || 21 || raktacandanasaṃmiśraiḥ komalairbilvapatrakaiḥ | bhavānī pūjitā yena sa bhavennṛpatiḥ kṣitau || 22 || nārādhitā yena śivā sanātanī duḥkhārtihā siddhikarī jagadvarā | duḥkhāvṛtaḥ śatruyutaśca bhūtale nūnaṃ daridro bhavatīha mānavaḥ || 23 || yāṃ viṣṇurindro harapadmajau tathā vahniḥ kubero varuṇo divākaraḥ | dhyāyanti sarvārthasamāptinanditāstāṃ kiṃ manuṣyā na bhajanti caṇḍikām || 24 || svāhā svadhā nāma manuprabhāvaistṛpyanti devāḥ pitarastathaiva | yajñeṣu sarveṣu mudā haranti yannāma yugmaśrutibhirmunīndrāḥ || 25 || yasyecchayā sṛjati viśvamidaṃ prajeśo nānāvatārakalanaṃ kurute hariśca | nūnaṃ karoti jagataḥ kila bhasma śambhustāṃ śarmadāṃ na bhajate nu kathaṃ manuṣyaḥ || 26 || naiko'sti sarvabhuvaneṣu tayā vihīno devo naro'tha vihagaḥ kila pannago vā | gandharvarākṣasapiśācanageṣu nūnaṃ yaḥ spandituṃ bhavati śaktiyuto yatheccham || 27 || tāṃ na seveta kaścaṇḍīṃ sarvakāmārthadāṃ śivām | vrataṃ tasyā na kaḥ kuryādvāñchannarthacatuṣṭayam || 28 || mahāpātakasaṃyukto navarātravrataṃ caret | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 29 || purā kaścidvaṇigdīno dhanahīnaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | kuṭumbī cābhavatkaścit kosale nṛpasattama || 30 || apatyāni bahūnyasyābhavankṣutpīḍitāni ca | bhakṣyaṃ kiñcittu sāyāhne prāpustasya ca bālakāḥ || 31 || bhuṅkte sma kāryakartā'sau parasyātha bubhukṣitaḥ | kuṭumbabharaṇaṃ tatra cakārātinirākulaḥ || 32 || sadā dharmarataḥ śāntaḥ sadācāraśca satyavāk | akrodhanaśca dhṛtimānnirmadaścānasūyakaḥ || 33 || sampūjya devatā nityaṃ pitṝnapyatithīṃstathā | bhuñjāne poṣyavarge'tha kṛtavānbhojanaṃ vaṇik || 34 || evaṃ gacchati kāle vai suśilo nāmato guṇaiḥ | dāridryārto dvijaṃ śāntaṃ papracchātibubhukṣitaḥ || 35 || suśīla uvāca bho bhūdeva kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vadasvādya mahāmate | kathaṃ dāridryanāśaḥ syāditi me niścayena vai || 36 || dhanaiṣaṇā me naivāsti dhanī syāmiti mānada | kuṭumbabharaṇārthaṃ vai pṛcchāmi tvāṃ dvijottama || 37 || putrī sutastu me bālo bhakṣārthī rodate bhṛśam | tāvanmātraṃ gṛhe nānnaṃ muṣṭimekāṃ dadāmyaham || 38 || visarjito yato gehādgato bālo rudanmayā | ato me dahyate'tyarthaṃ kiṃ karomi dhanaṃ vinā || 39 || vivāho'sti sutāyā me nāsti vittaṃ karomi kim | daśavarṣādhikāyāstu dānakālo'pi yātyalam || 40 || tena śocāmi viprendra sarvajño'si dayānidhe | tapo dānaṃ vrataṃ kiñcidbrūhi mantrajapaṃ tathā || 41 || yenāhaṃ poṣyavargasya karomi dvija poṣaṇam | tāvanme syāddhanaprāptirnādhikaṃ prārthaye kila || 42 || tvatprasādātkuṭumbaṃ me sukhitaṃ prabhavediha | tatkuruṣva mahābhāga jñānena paricintya ca || 43 || vyāsa uvāca iti pṛṣṭastathā tena brāhmaṇaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ | uvāca paramaprītastaṃ vaiśyaṃ nṛpasattama || 44 || vaiśyavarya kuruṣvādya navarātravrataṃ śubham | pūjanaṃ bhagavatyāśca havanaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā || 45 || vedapārāyaṇaṃ śaktijapahomādikaṃ tathā | kuruṣvādya yathāśakti tava kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati || 46 || etasmādaparaṃ kiñcidvrataṃ nāsti dharātale | navarātrābhidhaṃ vaiśya pāvanaṃ sukhadaṃ tathā || 47 || jñānadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva sukhasantānavardhanam | śatrunāśakaraṃ kāmaṃ navarātravrataṃ sadā || 48 || rājyabhraṣṭena rāmeṇa sītāvirahitena ca | kiṣkindhāyāṃ vrataṃ caitatkṛtaṃ duḥkhātureṇa vai || 49 || prataptenāpi rāmeṇa sītāvirahavahninā | vidhivatpūjitā devī navarātravratena vai || 50 || tena prāptā'tha vaidehī kṛtvā setuṃ mahārṇave | hatvā mandodarīnāthaṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam || 51 || meghanādaṃ sutaṃ hatvā kṛtvā bhūpaṃ bibhīṣaṇam | paścādayodhyāmāgatya prāptaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam || 52 || navarātravratasyāsya prabhāveṇa viśāṃvara | sukhaṃ bhūmitale prāptaṃ rāmeṇāmitatejasā || 53 || vyāsa uvāca iti vipravacaḥ śrutvā sa vaiśyastaṃ dvijaṃ gurum | kṛtvā jagrāha sanmantraṃ māyābījābhidhaṃ nṛpa || 54 || jajāpa parayā bhaktyā navarātramatandritaḥ | nānāvidhopahāraiśca pūjayāmāsa sādaram || 55 || navasaṃvatsaraṃ caiva māyābījaparāyaṇaḥ | navame vatsarānte tu mahāṣṭamyāṃ maheśvarī || 56 || ardharātre tu sañjāte pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ dadau | nānāvarapradānaiśca kṛtakṛtyañcakāra tam || 57 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe devīpūjāmahattvavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || <3.28> rāmacaritravarṇanam janamejaya uvāca kathaṃ rāmeṇa taccīrṇaṃ vrataṃ devyāḥ sukhapradam | rājyabhraṣṭaḥ kathaṃ so'tha kathaṃ sītā hṛtā punaḥ || 1 || vyāsa uvāca rājā daśarathaḥ śrīmānayodhyādhipatiḥ purā | sūryavaṃśadharaścāsīddevabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ || 2 || catvāro jajñire tasya putrā lokeṣu viśrutāḥ | rāmalakṣmaṇaśatrughnā bharataśceti nāmataḥ || 3 || rājñaḥ priyakarāḥ sarve sadṛśā guṇarūpataḥ | kausalyāyāḥ suto rāmaḥ kaikeyyā bharataḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 || sumitrātanayau jātau yamalau dvau manoharau | te jātā vai kiśorāśca dhanurbāṇadharāḥ kila || 5 || sūnavaḥ kṛtasaṃskārā bhūpateḥ sukhavardhakāḥ | kauśikena tadā''gatya prārthito raghunandanaḥ || 6 || rāghavaṃ makharakṣārthaṃ sūnuṃ ṣoḍaśavārṣikam | tasmai so'yaṃ dadau rāmaṃ kauśikāya salakṣmaṇam || 7 || tau sametya muniṃ mārge jagmatuścārudarśanau | tāṭakā nihatā mārge rākṣasī ghoradarśanā || 8 || rāmeṇaikena bāṇena munīnāṃ duḥkhadā sadā | yajñarakṣā kṛtā tatra subāhurnihataḥ śaṭhaḥ || 9 || mārīco'tha mṛtaprāyo nikṣipto bāṇavegataḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā mahatkarma yajñasya parirakṣaṇam || 10 || gatāste mithilāṃ sarve rāmalakṣmaṇakauśikāḥ | ahalyā mocitā śāpānniṣpāpā sā kṛtā'balā || 11 || videhanagare tau tu jagmaturmuninā saha | babhañja śivacāpañca janakena paṇīkṛtam || 12 || upayeme tataḥ sītāṃ jānakīñca ramāṃśajām | lakṣmaṇāya dadau rājā putrīmekāṃ tathormilām || 13 || kuśadhvajasute kanye prāpaturbhrātarāvubhau | tathā bharataśatrughnau suśilau śubhalakṣaṇau || 14 || evaṃ dārakriyāsteṣāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ cābhavannṛpa | caturṇāṃ mithilāyāṃ tu yathāvidhi vidhānataḥ || 15 || rājyayogyaṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā daśarathastadā | rāghavāya dhuraṃ dātuṃ manaścakre nijāya vai || 16 || sambhāraṃ vihitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaikeyī pūrvakalpitau | varau samprārthayāmāsa bhartāraṃ vaśavartinam || 17 || rājyaṃ sutāya caikena bharatāya mahātmane | rāmāya vanavāsañca caturdaśasamāstathā || 18 || rāmastu vacanāttasyāḥ sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ | jagāma daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ rākṣasairupasevitam || 19 || rājā daśarathaḥ putraviraheṇa prapīḍitaḥ | jahau prāṇānameyātmā pūrvaśāpamanusmaran || 20 || bharataḥ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ mātṛkṛtena vai | rājyamṛddhaṃ na jagrāha bhrātuḥ priyacikīrṣayā || 21 || pañcavaṭyāṃ vasan rāmo rāvaṇāvarajāṃ vane | śūrpaṇakhāṃ virūpāṃ vai cakārātismarāturām || 22 || kharādayastu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā chinnanāsāṃ niśācarāḥ | cakruḥ saṅgrāmamatulaṃ rāmeṇāmitatejasā || 23 || sa jaghāna kharādīṃśca daityānatibalānvitān | munīnāṃ hitamanvicchan rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ || 24 || gatvā śūrpaṇakhā laṅkāṃ kharadūṣaṇaghātanam | dūṣitā kathayāmāsa rāvaṇāya ca rāghavāt || 25 || so'pi śrutvā vināśaṃ taṃ jātaḥ krodhavaśaḥ khalaḥ | jagāma rathamāruhya mārīcasyāśramaṃ tadā || 26 || kṛtvā hemamṛgaṃ netuṃ preṣayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ | sītāpralobhanārthāya māyāvinamasambhavam || 27 || so'tha hemamṛgo bhūtvā sītādṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ | māyāvī cāticitrāṅgaścaranprabalamantike || 28 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā jānakī prāha rāghavaṃ daivanoditā | carmānayasva kānteti svādhīnapatikā yathā || 29 || avicāryātha rāmo'pi tatra saṃsthāpya lakṣmaṇam | saśaraṃ dhanurādāya yayau mṛgapadānugaḥ || 30 || sāraṅgo'pi hariṃ dṛṣṭvā māyākoṭiviśāradaḥ | dṛśyādṛśyo babhūvātha jagāma ca vanāntaram || 31 || matvā hastagataṃ rāmaḥ krodhākṛṣṭadhanuḥ punaḥ | jaghāna cātitīkṣṇena śareṇa kṛtrimaṃ mṛgam || 32 || sa hato'tibalāttena cukrośa bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ | hā lakṣmaṇa hato'smīti māyāvī naśvaraḥ khalaḥ || 33 || sa śabdastumulastāvajjānakyā saṃśrutastadā | rāghavasyeti sā matvā dīnā devaramabravīt || 34 || gaccha lakṣmaṇa tūrṇaṃ tvaṃ hato'sau raghunandanaḥ | tvāmāhvayati saumitre sāhāyyaṃ kuru satvaram || 35 || tatrāha lakṣmaṇaḥ sītāmamba rāmavadhādapi | nāhaṃ gacche'dya muktvā tvāmasahāyāmihāśrame || 36 || ājñā me rāghavasyātra tiṣṭheti janakātmaje | tadatikramabhīto'haṃ na tyajāmi tavāntikam || 37 || dūraṃ vai rāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā vane māyāvinā kila | tyaktvā tvāṃ nādhigacchāmi padamekaṃ śucismite || 38 || kṛru dhairyaṃ na manye'dya rāmaṃ hantuṃ kṣamaṃ kṣiptau | nāhaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyāmi vilaṃghya rāmabhāṣitam || |39 || vyāsa uvāca rudatī sudatī prāha te tadā vidhinoditā | akrūrā vacanaṃ krūraṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam || 40 || ahaṃ jānāmi saumitre sānurāgaṃ ca māṃ prati | preritaṃ bharatenaiva madarthamiha saṅgatam || 41 || nāhaṃ tathāvidhā nārī svairiṇī kuhakādhama | mṛte rāme patiṃ tvāṃ na kartumicchāmi kāmataḥ || 42 || nāgamiṣyati cedrāmo jīvitaṃ santyajāmyaham | vinā tena na jīvāmi vidhurā duḥkhitā bhṛśam || 43 || gaccha vā tiṣṭha saumitre na jāne'haṃ tavepsitam | kva gataṃ te'dya sauhārdaṃ jyeṣṭhe dharmarate kila || 44 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā lakṣmaṇo dīnamānasaḥ | provāca ruddhakaṇṭhastu tāṃ tadā janakātmajām || 45 || kimāttha kṣitije vākyaṃ mayi krūrataraṃ kila | kiṃ vadasyatyaniṣṭaṃ te bhāvi jāne dhiyā hyaham || 46 || ityuktvā niryayau vīrastāṃ tyaktvā prarudanbhṛśam | agrajasya yayau paśyañchokārtaḥ pṛthivīpate || 47 || gate'tha lakṣmaṇe tatra rāvaṇaḥ kapaṭākṛtiḥ | bhikṣuveṣaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praviveśa tadāśrame || 48 || jānakī taṃ yatiṃ matvā dattvārghyaṃ vanyamādarāt | bhaikṣyaṃ samarpayāmāsa rāvaṇāya durātmane || 49 || tāṃ papraccha sa duṣṭātmā namrapūrvaṃ mṛdusvaram | kā'si padmapalāśākṣi vane caikākinī priye || 50 || pitā kaste'tha vāmoru bhrātā kaḥ kaḥ patistava | mūḍhevaikākinī cātra sthitā'si varavarṇini || 51 || nirjane vipine kiṃ tvaṃ saudhārhā tvamasi priye | uṭaje munipatnīvaddevakanyāsamaprabhā || 52 || vyāsa uvāca iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca videhajā | divyaṃ diṣṭyā yatiṃ jñātvā mandodaryāḥ patiṃ tadā || 53 || rājā daśarathaḥ śrīmāṃścatvārastasya vai sutāḥ | teṣāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ patirme'sti rāmanāmeti viśrutaḥ || 54 || vivāsito'tha kaikeyyā kṛte bhūpatinā vare | caturdaśa samā rāmo vasate'tra salakṣmaṇaḥ || 55 || janakasya sutā cāhaṃ sītānāmnīti viśrutā | bhaṅktvā śaivaṃ dhanuḥ kāmaṃ rāmeṇāhaṃ vivāhitā || 56 || rāmabāhubalenātra vasāmo nirbhayā vane | kāñcanaṃ mṛgamālokya hantuṃ me nirgataḥ patiḥ || 57 || lakṣmaṇo'pi punaḥ śrutvā ravaṃ bhrāturgato'dhunā | tayorbāhubalādatra nirbhayā'haṃ vasāmi vai || 58 || mayedaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vṛttāntaṃ vanavāsake | te'trāgatyārhaṇāṃ te vai kariṣyanti yathāvidhi || 59 || yatirviṣṇusvarūpo'si tasmāttvaṃ pūjito mayā | āśramo vipine ghore kṛto'sti rakṣasāṃ kule || 60 || tasmāttvāṃ paripṛcchāmi satyaṃ brūhi mamāgrataḥ | ko'si tridaṇḍirūpeṇa vipine tvaṃ samāgataḥ || 61 || rāvaṇa uvāca laṅkeśo'haṃ marālākṣi śrīmānmandodarīpatiḥ | tvatkṛte tu kṛtaṃ rūpaṃ mayetthaṃ śobhanākṛte || 62 || āgato'haṃ varārohe bhaginyā prerito'tra vai | janasthāne hatau śrutvā bhrātarau kharadūṣaṇau || 63 || aṅgīkuru nṛpaṃ māṃ tvaṃ tyaktvā taṃ mānuṣaṃ patim | hṛtarājyaṃ gataśrīkaṃ nirbalaṃ vanavāsinam || 64 || paṭṭarājñī bhava tvaṃ me mandodaryupari sphuṭam | dāso'smi tava tanvaṅgi svāminī bhava bhāmini || 65 || jetā'haṃ lokapālānāṃ patāmi tava pādayoḥ | karaṃ gṛhāṇa me'dya tvaṃ sanāthaṃ kuru jānaki || 66 || pitā te yācitaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā vai tvatkṛte'bale | janako māmuvācetthaṃ paṇabandho mayā kṛtaḥ || 67 || rudracāpabhayānnāhaṃ samprāptastu svayaṃvare | mano me saṃsthitaṃ tāvannimagnaṃ virahāturam || 68 || vane'tra saṃsthitāṃ śrutvā pūrvānurāgamohitaḥ | āgato'smyasitāpāṅgi saphalaṃ kuru me śramam || 69 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe rāmacaritravarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || <3.29> lakṣmaṇakṛtarāmaśokasāntvanam vyāsa uvāca tadākarṇya vaco duṣṭaṃ jānakī bhayavihvalā | vepamānā sthiraṃ kṛtvā mano vācamuvāca ha || 1 || paulastya kimasadvākyaṃ tvamāttha smaramohitaḥ | nāhaṃ vai svairiṇī kintu janakasya kulodbhavā || 2 || gaccha laṅkāṃ daśāsya tvaṃ rāma tvāṃ vai haniṣyati | matkṛte maraṇaṃ tatra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 3 || ityuktvā parṇaśālāyāṃ gatā sā vahnisannidhau | gaccha gaccheti vadatī rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam || 4 || so'tha kṛtvā nijaṃ rūpaṃ jagāmoṭajamantikam | balājjagrāha tāṃ bālāṃ rudatī bhayavihvalām || 5 || rāmarāmeti krandantī lakṣmaṇeti muhurmuhuḥ | gṛhītvā nirgataḥ pāpo rathamāropya satvaraḥ || 6 || gacchannaruṇaputreṇa mārge ruddho jaṭāyuṣā | saṅgrāmo'bhūnmahāraudrastayostatra vanāntare || 7 || hatvā taṃ tāṃ gṛhītvā ca gato'sau rākṣasādhipaḥ | laṅkāyāṃ krandatī tāta kurarīva durātmanaḥ || 8 || aśokavanikāyāṃ sā sthāpitā rākṣasīyutā | svavṛttānnaiva calitā sāmadānādibhiḥ kila || 9 || rāmo'pi taṃ mṛgaṃ hatvā jagāmādāya nirvṛtaḥ | āyāntaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ vīkṣya kiṃ kṛtaṃ te'nujāsamam || 10 || ekākinīṃ priyāṃ hitvā kimarthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ | śrutvā svanaṃ tu pāpasya rāghavastvabravīdidam || 11 || saumitristvabravīdvākyaṃ sītāvāgbāṇapīḍitaḥ | prabho'trāhaṃ samāyātaḥ kālayogānna saṃśayaḥ || 12 || tadā tau parṇaśālāyāṃ gatvā vīkṣyātiduḥkhitau | jānakyanveṣaṇe yatnamubhau kartuṃ samudyatau || 13 || mārgamāṇau tu samprāptau yatrāsau patitaḥ khagaḥ | jaṭāyuḥ prāṇaśeṣastu patitaḥ pṛthivītale || 14 || tenoktaṃ rāvaṇenādya hṛtā'sau janakātmajā | mayā niruddhaḥ pāpātmā pātito'haṃ mṛdhe punaḥ || 15 || ityuktvā'sau gataprāṇaḥ saṃskṛto rāghaveṇa vai | kṛtvaurghvadaihikaṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau nirgatau tataḥ || 16 || kabandhaṃ ghātayitvāsau śāpāccāmocayatprabhuḥ | vacanāttasya hariṇā sakhyaṃ cakre'tha rāghavaḥ || 17 || hatvā ca vālinaṃ vīraṃ kiṣkindhārājyamuttamam | sugrīvāya dadau rāmaḥ kṛtasakhyāya kāryataḥ || 18 || tatraiva vārṣikānmāsāṃstasthau lakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ | cintayañjānakīṃ citte daśānanahṛtāṃ priyām || 19 || lakṣmaṇaṃ prāha rāmastu sītāvirahapīḍitaḥ | saumitre kaikayasutā jātā pūrṇamanorathā || 20 || na prāptā jānakī nūnaṃ nāhaṃ jīvāmi tāṃ vinā | nāgamiṣyāmyayodhyāyāmṛte janakanandinīm || 21 || gataṃ rājyaṃ vane vāso mṛtastāto hṛtā priyā | pīḍayanmāṃ sa duṣṭātmā daivo'gre kiṃ kariṣyati || 22 || durjñeyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ hi prāṇināṃ bharatānuja | āvayoḥ kā gatistāta bhaviṣyati suduḥkhadā || 23 || prāpya janma manorvaṃśe rājaputrāvubhau kila | vane'tiduḥkhabhoktārau jātau pūrvakṛtena ca || 24 || tyaktvā tvamapi bhogāṃstu mayā saha vinirgataḥ | daivayogācca saumitre bhuṃkṣva duḥkhaṃ duratyayam || 25 || na ko'pyasmatkule pūrvaṃ matsamo duḥkhabhāṅnaraḥ | akiñcano'kṣamaḥ kliṣṭo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || 26 || kiṃ karomyadya saumitre magno'smi duḥkhasāgare | na cāsti taraṇopāyo hyasahāyasya me kila || 27 || na vittaṃ na balaṃ vīra tvamekaḥ sahacārakaḥ | kopaṃ kasminkaromyadya bhogesminsvakṛte'nuja || 28 || gataṃ hastagataṃ rājyaṃ kṣaṇādindrāsanopamam | vane vāsastu samprāptaḥ ko veda vidhinirmitam || 29 || bālabhāvācca vaidehī calitā cāvayoḥ saha | nītā daivena duṣṭena śyāmā duḥkhatarāṃ daśām || 30 || laṅkeśasya gṛhe śyāmā kathaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati | pativratā suśīlā ca mayi prītiyutā bhṛśam || 31 || na ca lakṣmaṇa vaidehī sā tasya vaśagā bhavet | svairiṇīva varārohā kathaṃ syājjanakātmajā || 32 || tyajetprāṇānniyantṛtve maithilī bharatānuja | na rāvaṇasya vaśagā bhavediti suniścitam || 33 || mṛtā cejjānakī vīra prāṇāṃstyakṣyāmyasaṃśayam | mṛtā cedasitāpāṅgīṃ kiṃ me dehena lakṣmaṇa || 34 || evaṃ vilapamānaṃ taṃ rāmaṃ kamalalocanam | lakṣmaṇaḥ prāha dharmātmā sāntvayannṛtayā girā || 35 || dhairyaṃ kuru mahābāho tyaktvā kātaratāmiha | ānayiṣyāmi vaidehīṃ hatvā taṃ rākṣasādhamam || 36 || āpadi sampadi tulyā dhairyādbhavanti te dhīrāḥ | alpadhiyastu nimagnāḥ kaṣṭe bhavanti vibhave'pi || 37 || saṃyogo viprayogaśca daivādhīnāvubhāvapi | śokastu kīdṛśastatra dehenātmani ca kvacit || 38 || rājyādyathā vane vāso vaidehyā haraṇaṃ yathā | tathā kāle samīcīne saṃyogo'pi bhaviṣyati || 39 || prāptavyaṃ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhogānnirvartanaṃ kvacit | nānyathā jānakījāne tasmācchokaṃ tyajādhunā || 40 || vānarāḥ santi bhūyāṃso gamiṣyanti caturdiśam | śuddhiṃ janakanandinyā ānayiṣyanti te kila || 41 || jñātvā mārgasthitiṃ tatra gatvā kṛtvā parākramam | hatvā taṃ pāpakarmāṇamānayiṣyāmi maithilīm || 42 || sasainyaṃ bharataṃ vā'pi samāhūya sahānujam | haniṣyāmo vayaṃ śatruṃ kiṃ śocasi vṛthāgraja || 43 || raghuṇaikarathenaiva jitāḥ sarvā diśaḥ purā | tadvaṃśajaḥ kathaṃ śokaṃ kartumarhasi rāghava || 44 || eko'haṃ sakalāñjetuṃ samartho'smi surāsurān | kiṃ punaḥ sasahāyo vai rāvaṇaṃ kulapāṃsanam || 45 || janakaṃ vā samānīya sāhāyye raghunandana | haniṣyāmi durācāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ surakaṇṭakam || 46 || sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham | cakranemirivaikaṃ yanna bhavedraghunandana || 47 || mano'tikātaraṃ yasya sukhaduḥkhasamudbhave | sa śokasāgare magno na sukhī syātkadācana || 48 || indreṇa vyasanaṃ prāptaṃ purā vai raghunandana | nahuṣaḥ sthāpito devaiḥ sarvairmaghavataḥ pade || 49 || sthitaḥ paṅkajamadhye ca bahuvarṣagaṇānapi | ajñātavāsaṃ maghavā bhītastyaktvā nijaṃ padam || 50 || punaḥ prāptaṃ nijasthānaṃ kāle viparivartite | nahuṣaḥ patito bhūmau śāpādajagarākṛtiḥ || 51 || indrāṇīṃ kāmayānastu brāhmaṇānavamanya ca | agastikopātsañjātaḥ sarpadeho mahīpatiḥ || 52 || tasmācchoko na kartavyo vyasane sati rāghava | udyame cittamāsthāya sthātavyaṃ vai vipaścitā || 53 || sarvajño'si mahābhāga samartho'si jagatpate | kiṃ prākṛta ivātyarthaṃ kuruṣe śokamātmani || 54 || vyāsa uvāca iti lakṣmaṇavākyena bodhito raghunandanaḥ | tyaktvā śokaṃ tathātyarthaṃ babhūva vigatajvaraḥ || 55 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe lakṣmaṇakṛtarāmaśokasāntvanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || <3.30> rāmāya devīvaradānam vyāsa uvāca evaṃ tau saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā yāvattūṣṇīṃ babhūvatuḥ | ājagāma tadā''kāśānnārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 1 || raṇayanmahatīṃ vīṇāṃ svaragrāmavibhūṣitām | gāyanbṛhadrathaṃ sāma tadā tamupatasthivān || 2 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ rāma utthāya dadāvatha vṛṣaṃ śubham | āsanaṃ cārghyapādyañca kṛtavānamitadyutiḥ || 3 || pūjāṃ paramikāṃ kṛtvā kṛtāñjalirupasthitaḥ | upaviṣṭaḥ samīpe tu kṛtājño muninā hariḥ || 4 || upaviṣṭaṃ tadā rāmaṃ sānujaṃ duḥkhamānasam | papraccha nāradaḥ prītyā kuśalaṃ munisattamaḥ || 5 || kathaṃ rāghava śokārto yathā vai prākṛto naraḥ | hṛtāṃ sītāṃ ca jānāmi rāvaṇena durātmanā || 6 || surasadmagataścāhaṃ śrutavāñjanakātmajām | paulastyena hṛtāṃ mohānmaraṇaṃ svamajānatā || 7 || tava janma ca kākutstha paulastyanidhanāya vai | maithilīharaṇaṃ jātametadarthaṃ narādhipa || 8 || pūrvajanmani vaidehī muniputrī tapasvinī | rāvaṇena vane dṛṣṭā tapasyantī śucismitā || 9 || prārthitā rāvaṇenāsau bhava bhāryeti rāghava | tiraskṛtastayā'sau vai jagrāha kabaraṃ balāt || 10 || śaśāpa tatkṣaṇaṃ rāma rāvaṇaṃ tāpasī bhṛśam | kupitā tyaktumicchantī dehaṃ saṃsparśadūṣitam || 11 || durātmaṃstava nāśārthaṃ bhaviṣyāmi dharātale | ayonijā varā nārī tyaktvā dehaṃ jahāvapi || 12 || seyaṃ ramāṃśasambhūtā gṛhītā tena rakṣasā | vināśārthaṃ kulasyaiva vyālī sragiva sambhramāt || 13 || tava janma ca kākutstha tasya nāśāya cāmaraiḥ | prārthitasya hareraṃśādajavaṃśe'pyajanmanaḥ || 14 || kuru dhairyaṃ mahābāho tatra sā vartate'vaśā | satī dharmaratā sītā tvāṃ dhyāyantī divāniśam || 15 || kāmadhenupayaḥ pātre kṛtvā maghavatā svayam | pānārthaṃ preṣitaṃ tasyāḥ pītaṃ caivāmṛtaṃ yathā || 16 || surabhīdugdhapānātsā kṣuttuḍduḥkhavivarjitā | jātā kamalapatrākṣī vartate vīkṣitā mayā || 17 || upāyaṃ kathayāmyadya tasya nāśāya rāghava | vrataṃ kuruṣva śraddhāvānāśvine māsi sāmpratam || 18 || navarātropavāsañca bhagavatyāḥ prapūjanam | sarvasiddhikaraṃ rāma japahomavidhānataḥ || 19 || meghyaiśca paśubhirdevyā baliṃ dattvā viśaṃsitaiḥ | daśāṃśaṃ havanaṃ kṛtvā saśaktastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 20 || viṣṇunā caritaṃ pūrvaṃ mahādevena brahmaṇā | tathā maghavatā cīrṇaṃ svargamadhyasthitena vai || 21 || sukhinā rāma kartavyaṃ navarātravrataṃ śubham | viśeṣeṇa ca kartavyaṃ puṃsā kaṣṭagatena vai || 22 || viśvāmitreṇa kākutstha kṛtametanna saṃśayaḥ | bhṛguṇā'tha vasiṣṭhena kaśyapena tathaiva ca || 23 || guruṇā hṛtadāreṇa kṛtametanmahāvratam | tasmāttvaṃ kuru rājendra rāvaṇasya vadhāya ca || 24 || indreṇa vṛtranāśāya kṛtaṃ vratamanuttamam | tripurasya vināśāya śivenāpi purā kṛtam || 25 || hariṇā madhunāśāya kṛtaṃ merau mahāmate | vidhivatkuru kākutstha vratametadatandritaḥ || 26 || śrīrāma uvāca kā devī kiṃ prabhāvā sā kuto jātā kimāhvayā | vrataṃ kiṃ vidhivadbrūhi sarvajño'si dayānidhe || 27 || nārada uvāca śṛṇu rāma sadā nityā śaktirādyā sanātanī | sarvakāmapradā devī pūjitā duḥkhanāśinī || 28 || kāraṇaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ brahmādīnāṃ raghūdvaha | tasyāḥ śaktiṃ vinā ko'pi spandituṃ na kṣamo bhavet || 29 || viṣṇoḥ pālanaśaktiḥ sā kartṛśaktiḥ piturmama | rudrasya nāśaśaktiḥ sā tvanyāśaktiḥ parā śivā || 30 || yacca kiñcitkvacidvastu sadasadbhuvanatraye | tasya sarvasya yā śaktistadutpattiḥ kuto bhavet || 31 || na brahmā na yadā viṣṇurna rudro na divākaraḥ | na cendrādyāḥ surāḥ sarve na dharā na dharādharāḥ || 32 || tadā sā prakṛtiḥ pūrṇā puruṣeṇa pareṇa vai | saṃyutā viharatyeva yugādau nirguṇā śivā || 33 || sā bhūtvā saguṇā paścātkaroti bhuvanatrayam | pūrvaṃ saṃsṛjya brahmādīndattvā śaktīśca sarvaśaḥ || 34 || tāṃ jñātvā mucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt | sā vidyā paramā jñeyā vedādyā vedakāriṇī || 35 || asaṃkhyātāni nāmāni tasyā brahmādibhiḥ kila | guṇakarmavidhānaistu kalpitāni ca kiṃ bruve || 36 || akārādikṣakārāntaiḥ svarairvarṇaistu yojitaiḥ | asaṃkhyeyāni nāmāni bhavanti raghunandana || 37 || rāma uvāca vidhiṃ me brūhi viprarṣe vratasyāsya samāsataḥ | karomyadyaiva śraddhāvāñchrīdevyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā || 38 || nārada uvāca pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā same sthāne saṃsthāpya jagadambikām | upavāsānnavaiva tvaṃ kuru rāma vidhānataḥ || 39 || ācāryo'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi karmaṇyasminmahīpate | devakāryavidhānārthamutsāhaṃ prakaromyaham || 40 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ satyaṃ matvā rāmaḥ pratāpavān | kārayitvā śubhaṃ pīṭhaṃ sthāpayitvāmbikāṃ śivām || 41 || vidhivatpūjanaṃ tasyāścakāra vratavān hariḥ | samprāpte cāśvine māsi tasmingirivare tadā || 42 || upavāsaparo rāmaḥ kṛtavānvratamuttamam | homañca vidhivattatra balidānañca pūjanam || 43 || bhrātarau cakratuḥ premṇā vrataṃ nāradasammatam | aṣṭamyāṃ madhyarātre tu devī bhagavatī hi sā || 44 || siṃhārūḍhā dadau tatra darśanaṃ pratipūjitā | giriśṛṅge sthitovāca rāghavaṃ sānujaṃ girā || 45 || meghagambhīrayā cedaṃ bhaktibhāvena toṣitā | devyuvāca rāma rāma mahābāho tuṣṭā'smyadma vratena te || 46 || prārthayasva varaṃ kāmaṃ yatte manasi vartate | nārāyaṇāṃśasambhūtastvaṃ vaṃśe mānave'naghe || 47 || rāvaṇasya vadhāyaiva prārthitastvamarairasi | purā matsyatanuṃ kṛtvā hatvā ghorañca rākṣasam || 48 || tvayā vai rakṣitā vedāḥ surāṇāṃ hitamicchatā | bhūtvā kacchaparūpastu dhṛtavānmandaraṃ girim || 49 || akūpāraṃ pramanthānaṃ kṛtvā devānapoṣayaḥ | kolarūpaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā daśanāgreṇa medinīm || 50 || dhṛtavānasi yadrāma hiraṇyākṣaṃ jaghāna ca | nārasiṃhīṃ tanuṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyakaśipuṃ purā || 51 || prahlādaṃ rāma rakṣitvā hatavānasi rāghava | vāmanaṃ vapurāsthāya purā chalitavānbalim || 52 || bhūtvendrasyānujaḥ kāmaṃ devakāryaprasādhakaḥ | jamadagnisutastvaṃ me viṣṇoraṃśena saṅgataḥ || 53 || kṛtvāntaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu dānaṃ bhūmeradāddvije | tathedānīṃ tu kākutstha jāto daśarathātmaja || 54 || prārthitastu suraiḥ sarvai rāvaṇenātipīḍitaiḥ | kapayaste sahāyā vai devāṃśā balavattarāḥ || 55 || bhaviṣyanti naravyāghra macchaktisaṃyutā hyamī | śeṣāṃśo'pyanujaste'yaṃ rāvaṇātmajanāśakaḥ || 56 || bhaviṣyati na sandehaḥ kartavyo'tra tvayā'nagha | vasante sevanaṃ kāryaṃ tvayā tatrātiśraddhayā || 57 || hatvā'tha rāvaṇaṃ pāpaṃ kuru rājyaṃ yathāsukham | ekādaśa sahasrāṇi varṣāṇi pṛthivītale || 58 || kṛtvā rājyaṃ raghuśreṣṭha gantā'si tridivaṃ punaḥ | vyāsa uvāca ityuktvāntardadhe devī rāmastu prītamānasaḥ || 59 || samāpya tadvrataṃ cakre prayāṇaṃ daśamīdine | vijayāpūjanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ || 60 || kapipatibalayuktaḥ sānujaḥ śrīpatiśca prakaṭaparamaśaktyā preritaḥ pūrṇakāmaḥ | udadhitaṭagato'sau setubandhaṃ vidhāyāpyahanadamaraśatruṃ rāvaṇaṃ gītakīrtiḥ || 61 || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā devyāścaritamuttamam | sa bhuktvā vipulānbhogānprāpnoti paramaṃ padam || 62 || santyanyāni purāṇāni vistarāṇi bahūni ca | śrīmadbhāgavatasyāsya na tulyānīti me matiḥ || 63 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaskandhe rāmāya devīvaradānaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 || <4.1> janamejayapraśnāḥ janamejaya uvāca vāsaveya muniśreṣṭha sarvajñānanidhe'nagha | praṣṭumicchāmyahaṃ svāminnasmākaṃ kulavardhana || 1 || śūrasenasutaḥ śrīmānvasudevaḥ pratāpavān | śrutaṃ mayā hariryasya putrabhāvamavāptavān || 2 || devānāmapi pūjyo'bhūnnāmnā cānakadundubhiḥ | kārāgāre kathaṃ baddhaḥ kaṃsasya dharmatatparaḥ || 3 || devakyā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ kimāgaḥ kṛtavānasau | devakyā bālaṣaṭkasya vināśaśca kṛtaḥ punaḥ || 4 || tena kaṃsena kasmādvai yayātikulajena ca | kārāgāre kathaṃ janma vāsudevasya vai hareḥ || 5 || gokule ca kathaṃ nīto bhagavānsātvatāṃ patiḥ | gato janmāntaraṃ kasmātpitarau nigaḍe sthitau || 6 || devakīvasudevau ca kṛṣṇasyāmitatejasaḥ | kathaṃ na mocitau vṛddhau pitarau hariṇāmunā || 7 || jagatkartuṃ samarthena sthitena janakodare | prāktanaṃ kiṃ tayoḥ karma durvijñeyaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || 8 || janma vai vāsudevasya yatrāsītparamātmanaḥ | ke te putrāśca kā bālā yā kaṃsena vipothitā || 9 || śilāyāṃ nirgatā vyomni jātā tvaṣṭabhujā punaḥ | gārhasthyañca harerbrūhi bahubhāryasya cānagha || 10 || kāryāṇi tatra tānyeva dehatyāgaṃ ca tasya vai | kiṃvadantyā śrutaṃ yattanmano mohayatīva me || 11 || caritaṃ vāsudevasya tvamākhyāhi yathātatham | naranārāyaṇau devau purāṇāvṛṣisattamau || 12 || dharmaputrau mahātmānau tapaśceraturuttamam | yau munī bahuvarṣāṇi puṇye badarikāśrame || 13 || nirāhārau jitātmānau niḥspṛhau jitaṣaḍguṇau | viṣṇoraṃśau jagatsthemne tapaśceraturuttamam || 14 || tayoraṃśāvatārau hi jiṣṇukṛṣṇau mahābalau | prasiddhau munibhiḥ proktau sarvajñairnāradādibhiḥ || 15 || vidyamānaśarīrau tau kathaṃ dehāntaraṃ gatau | naranārāyaṇau devau punaḥ kṛṣṇārjunau katham || 16 || yau cakratustapaścograṃ muktyarthaṃ munisattamau | tau kathaṃ prāpaturdehau prāptayogau mahātapau || 17 || śūdraḥ svadharmaniṣṭhastu dehānte kṣatriyastu saḥ | śubhācāro mṛto yo vai sa śūdro brāhmaṇo bhavet || 18 || brāhmaṇo niḥspṛhaḥ śānto bhavarogādvimucyate | viparītamidaṃ bhāti naranārāyaṇau ca tau || 19 || tapasā śoṣitātmānau kṣatriyau tau babhūvatuḥ | kena tau karmaṇā śāntau jātau śāpena vā punaḥ || 20 || brāhmaṇau kṣatriyau jātau kāraṇaṃ tanmune vada | yādavānāṃ vināśaśca brahmaśāpāditi śrutaḥ || 21 || kṛṣṇasyāpi hi gāndhāryāḥ śāpenaiva kulakṣayaḥ | pradyumnaharaṇaṃ caiva śambareṇa kathaṃ kṛtam || 22 || vartamāne vāsudeve devadeve janārdane | putrasya sūtikāgehāddharaṇaṃ cātidurghaṭam || 23 || dvārakādurgamadhyādvai hariveśmādduratyayāt | na jñātaṃ vāsudevena tatkathaṃ divyacakṣuṣā || 24 || sandeho'yaṃ mahānbrahmannisandehaṃ kuru prabho | yatpatnyo vāsudevasya dasyubhirluṇṭhitā hṛtāḥ || 25 || svargate devadeve tu tatkathaṃ munisattama | saṃśayo jāyate brahmaṃścittāndolanakārakaḥ || 26 || viṣṇoraṃśaḥ samudbhūtaḥ śaurirbhūbhārahārakṛt | sa kathaṃ mathurārājyaṃ bhayāttyaktvā janārdanaḥ || 27 || dvāravatyāṃ gataḥ sādho sasainyaḥ sasuhṛdgaṇaḥ | avatāro hareḥ prokto bhūbhāraharaṇāya vai || 28 || pāpātmanāṃ vināśāya dharmasaṃsthāpanāya ca | tatkathaṃ vāsudevena caurāste na nipātitāḥ || 29 || yairhṛtā vāsudevasya patnyaḥ saṃluṇṭhitāśca tāḥ | stenāste kiṃ na vijñātāḥ sarvajñena satā punaḥ || 30 || bhīṣmadroṇavadhaḥ kāmaṃ bhūbhāraharaṇe mataḥ | arcitāśca mahātmānaḥ pāṇḍavā dharmatatparāḥ || 31 || kṛṣṇabhaktāḥ sadācārā yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ | te kṛtvā rājasūyañca yajñarājaṃ vidhānataḥ || 32 || dakṣiṇā vividhā dattvā brāhmaṇebhyo'tibhāvataḥ | pāṇḍuputrāstu devāṃśā vāsudevāśritā mune || 33 || ghoraṃ duḥkhaṃ kathaṃ prāptāḥ kva gataṃ sukṛtañca tat | kiṃ tatpāpaṃ mahāraudraṃ yena te pīḍitāḥ sadā || 34 || draupadī ca mahābhāgā vedīmadhyātsamutthitā | ramāṃśajā ca sādhvī ca kṛṣṇabhaktiyutā tathā || 35 || sā kathaṃ duḥkhamatulaṃ prāpa ghoraṃ punaḥ punaḥ | duḥśāsanena sā keśe gṛhītā pīḍitā bhṛśam || 36 || rajasvalā sabhāyāṃ tu nītā bhītaikavāsasā | virāṭanagare dāsī jātā matsyasya sā punaḥ || 37 || dharṣitā kīcakenātha rudatī kurarī yathā | hṛtā jayadrathenātha krandamānātiduḥkhitā || 38 || mocitā pāṇḍavaiḥ paścādbalavadbhirmahātmabhiḥ | pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kiṃ tadyena ca pīḍitāḥ || 39 || duḥkhānyanekānyāptāste kathayādya mahāmate | rājasūyaṃ kratuvaraṃ kṛtvā te mama pūrvajāḥ || 40 || duḥkhaṃ mahattaraṃ prāptāḥ pūrvajanmakṛtena vai | devāṃśānāṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ saṃśayo'yaṃ mahānhi me || 41 || sadācāraistu kaunteyairbhīṣmadroṇādayo hatāḥ | chalena dhanalābhārthaṃ jānānairnaśvaraṃ jagat || 42 || preritā vāsudevena pāpe ghore mahātmanā | kulaṃ kṣayitavantaste hariṇā paramātmanā || 43 || varaṃ bhikṣāṭanaṃ sādhornīvārairjīvanaṃ varam | yodhānna hatvā lobhena śilpena jīvanaṃ varam || 44 || vicchinnastu tvayā vaṃśo rakṣito munisattama | samutpādya sutānāśu golakācchatrunāśanān || 45 || so'lpenaiva tu kālena virāṭatanayāsutaḥ | tāpasasya gale sarpaṃ nyastavānkathamadbhutam || 46 || nako'pi brāhmaṇaṃ dveṣṭi kṣatriyasya kulodbhavaḥ | tāpasaṃ maunasaṃyuktaṃ pitrā kiṃ tatkṛtaṃ mune || 47 || etairanyaiśca sandehairvikalaṃ me mano'dhunā | sthiraṃ kuru pitaḥ sādho sarvajño'si dayānidhe || 48 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ || caturthaskandhe janamejayapraśno nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || <4.2> karmaṇo janmādikāraṇatvanirūpaṇam sūta uvāca evaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ purāṇajño vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | parīkṣitasutaṃ śāntaṃ tato vai janamejayam || 1 || uvāca saṃśayacchettṛ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ | vyāsa uvāca rājan kimetadvaktavyaṃ karmaṇāṃ gahanā gatiḥ || 2 || durjñeyā kila devānāṃ mānavānāṃ ca kā kathā | yadā samutthitaṃ caitadbrahmāṇḍaṃ triguṇātmakam || 3 || karmaṇaiva samutpattiḥ sarveṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | anādinidhanā jīvāḥ karmabījasamudbhavāḥ || 4 || nānāyoniṣu jāyante mriyante ca punaḥ punaḥ | karmaṇā rahito dehasaṃyogo na kadācana || 5 || śubhāśubhaistathā miśraiḥ karmabhirveṣṭitaṃ tvidam | trividhāni hi tānyāhurbudhāstattvavidaśca ye || 6 || sañcitāni bhaviṣyanti prārabdhāni tathā punaḥ | vartamānāni dehe'smiṃstraividhyaṃ karmaṇāṃ kila || 7 || brahmādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tadvaśatvaṃ narādhipa | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jarāmṛtyuharṣaśokādayastathā || 8 || kāmakrodhau ca lobhaśca sarve dehagatā guṇāḥ | daivādhīnāśca sarveṣāṃ prabhavanti narādhipa || 9 || rāgadveṣādayo bhāvāḥ svarge'pi prabhavanti hi | devānāṃ mānavānāñca tiraścāṃ ca tathā punaḥ || 10 || vikārāḥ sarva evaite dehena saha saṅgatāḥ | pūrvavairānuyogena snehayogena vai punaḥ || 11 || utpattiḥ sarvajantūnāṃ vinā karma na vidyate | karmaṇā bhramate sūryaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ kṣayarogavān || 12 || kapālī ca tathā rudraḥ karmaṇaiva na saṃśayaḥ | anādinidhanaṃ caitatkāraṇaṃ karma vidyate || 13 || teneha śāśvataṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | nityānityavicāre'tra nimagnā munayaḥ sadā || 14 || na jānanti kimetadvai nityaṃ vānityameva ca | māyāyāṃ vidyamānāyāṃ jagannityaṃ pratīyate || 15 || kāryābhāvaḥ kathaṃ vācyaḥ kāraṇe sati sarvathā | māyā nityā kāraṇañca sarveṣāṃ sarvadā kila || 16 || karmabījaṃ tato'nityaṃ cintanīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ | bhramatyeva jagatsarvaṃ rājankarmaniyantritam || 17 || nānāyoniṣu rājendra nānādharmamayeṣu ca | icchayā ca bhaveñcanma viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 18 || yuge yugeṣvanekāsu nīcayoniṣu tatkatham | tyaktvā vaikuṇṭhasaṃvāsaṃ sukhabhogānanekaśaḥ || 19 || viṇmūtramandire vāsaṃ saṃtrastaḥ ko'bhivāñchati | puṣpāvacayalīlāṃ ca jalakeliṃ sukhāsanam || 20 || tyaktvā garbhagṛhe vāsaṃ ko'bhivācchati buddhimān | tūlikāṃ mṛdusaṃyuktāṃ divyāṃ śayyāṃ vinirmitām || 21 || tyaktvādhomukhavāsaṃ ca ko'bhivāñchati paṇḍitaḥ | gītaṃ nṛtyañca vādyañca nānābhāvasamanvitam || 22 || muktvā ko narake vāsaṃ manasāpi vicintayet | sindhujādbhutabhāvānāṃ rasaṃ tyaktvā sudustvajam || 23 || viṇmūtrarasapānañja ka icchenmatimānnaraḥ | garbhavāsātparo nāsti narako bhuvanatraye || 24 || tadbhītāśca prakurvanti munayo dustaraṃ tapaḥ | hitvā bhogañca rājyañca vane yānti manasvinaḥ || 25 || yadbhītāstu vimūḍhātmā kastaṃ sevitumicchati | garbhe tudanti kṛmayo jaṭharāgnistapatyadhaḥ || 26 || vapāsaṃveṣṭanaṃ kūraṃ kiṃ sukhaṃ tatra bhūpate | varaṃ kārāgṛhe vāso bandhanaṃ nigaḍairvaram || 27 || alpamātraṃ kṣaṇaṃ naiva garbhavāsaḥ kvacicchubhaḥ | garbhavāse mahadduḥkhaṃ daśamāsanivāsanam || 28 || tathā niḥsaraṇe duḥkhaṃ yoniyantre'tidāruṇe | bālabhāve tadā duḥkhaṃ mūkājñabhāvasaṃyutam || 29 || kṣutṛṣṇāvedanāśaktaḥ paratantro'tikātaraḥ | kṣudhite rudite bāle mātā cintāturā tadā || 30 || bheṣajaṃ pātumicchantī jñātvā vyādhivyathāṃ dṛḍhām | nānāvidhāni duḥkhāni bālabhāve bhavanti vai || 31 || kiṃ sukhaṃ vibudhā dṛṣṭvā janma vāñchanti cecchayā | saṃgrāmamamaraiḥ sārdhaṃ sukhaṃ tyaktvā nirantaram || 32 || kartumicchecca ko mūḍhaḥ śramadaṃ sukhanāśanam | sarvathaiva nṛpaśreṣṭha sarve brahmādayaḥ surāḥ || 33 || kṛtakarmavipākena prāpnuvanti sukhāsukhe | avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham | dehavadbhirnṛbhirdevaistiryagbhiśca nṛpottama || 34 || tapasā dānayajñaiśca mānavaścendratāṃ vrajet | kṣīṇe puṇye'tha śakro'pi patatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || rāmāvatārayogena devā vānaratāṃ gatāḥ | tathā kṛṣṇasahāyārthaṃ devā yādavatāṃ gatāḥ || 36 || evaṃ yuge yuge viṣṇuravatārānanekaśaḥ | karoti dharmarakṣārthaṃ brahmaṇā prerito bhṛśam || 37 || punaḥ punarharerevaṃ nānāyoniṣu pārthiva | avatārā bhavantyanye rathacakravadadbhutāḥ || 38 || daityānāṃ hananaṃ karma kartavyaṃ hariṇā svayam | aṃśāṃśena pṛthivyāṃ vai kṛtvā janma mahātmanā || 39 || tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇajanmakathāṃ śubhām | sa eva bhagavānviṣṇuravatīrṇo yadoḥ kule || 40 || kaśyapasya muneraṃśo vasudevaḥ pratāpavān | govṛttirabhavadrājan pūrvaśāpānubhāvataḥ || 41 || kaśyapasya ca dve patnyau śāpādatra mahīpate | aditiḥ surasā caivamāsatuḥ pṛthivīpate || 42 || devakī rohiṇī cobhe bhaginyau bharatarṣabha | varuṇena mahāñchāpo dattaḥ kopāditi śrutam || 43 || rājovāca kiṃ kṛtaṃ kaśyapenāgo yena śapto mahānṛṣiḥ | sabhāryaḥ sa kathaṃ jātastadvadasva mahāmate || 44 || kathañca bhagavānviṣṇustatra jāto'sti gokule | vāsī vaikuṇṭhanilaye ramāpatirakhaṇḍitaḥ || 45 || nideśātkasya bhagavānvartate prabhuravyayaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ suraśreṣṭho yugādiḥ sarvadhārakaḥ || 46 || sa kathaṃ sadanaṃ tyaktvā karmavāniva mānuṣe | karoti jananaṃ kasmādatra me saṃśayo mahān || 47 || prāpya mānuṣadehaṃ tu karoti ca viḍambanam | bhāvānnānāvidhāṃstatra mānuṣe duṣṭajanmani || 48 || kāmaḥ krodho'marṣaśokau vairaṃ prītiśca karhicit | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ nṝṇāṃ dainyamārjavameva ca || 49 || duṣkṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ caiva vacanaṃ hananaṃ tathā | poṣaṇaṃ calanaṃ tāpo vimarśaśca vikatthanam || 50 || lobho dambhastathā mohaḥ kapaṭaḥ śocanaṃ tathā | ete cānye tathā bhāvā mānuṣye sambhavanti hi || 51 || sa kathaṃ bhagavānviṣṇustvaktyā sukhamanaśvaram | karoti mānuṣaṃ janma bhāvaistaistairabhidrutam || 52 || kiṃ sukhaṃ mānuṣaṃ prāpya bhuvi janma munīśvara | kiṃ nimittaṃ hariḥ sākṣādgarbhavāsaṃ karoti vai || 53 || garbhaduḥkhaṃ janmaduḥkhaṃ bālabhāve tathā punaḥ | yauvane kāmajaṃ duḥkhaṃ gārhastye'timahattaram || 54 || duḥkhānyetānyavāpnoti mānuṣe dvijasattama | kathaṃ sa bhagavānviṣṇuravatārānpunaḥ punaḥ || 55 || prāpya rāmāvatāraṃ hi hariṇā brahmayoninā | duḥkhaṃ mahattaraṃ prāptaṃ vanavāse'tidāruṇe || 56 || sītāvirahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃgrāmaśca punaḥ punaḥ | kāntātyāgo'pyanenaivamanubhūto mahātmanā || 57 || tathā kṛṣṇāvatāre'pi janma rakṣāgṛhe punaḥ | gokule gamanaṃ caiva gavāṃ cāraṇamityuta || 58 || kaṃsasya hananaṃ kaṣṭād dvārakāgamanaṃ punaḥ | nānāsaṃsāraduḥkhāni bhuktavānbhagavān katham || 59 || svecchayā kaḥ pratīkṣeta mukto duḥkhāni jñānavān | saṃśayaṃ chindhi sarvajña mama cittapraśāntaye || 60 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ || caturthaskandhe karmaṇo janmādikāraṇatvanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <4.3> dityā adityai śāpadānam vyāsa uvāca kāraṇāni bahūnyatrāpyavatāre hareḥ kila | sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāmaṃśāvataraṇeṣvapi || 1 || vasudevāvatārasya kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ | devakyāścaiva rohiṇyā avatārasya kāraṇam || 2 || ekadā kaśyapaḥ śrīmānyajñārthaṃ dhenumāharat | yācito'yaṃ bahuvidhaṃ na dadau dhenumuttamām || 3 || varuṇastu tato gatvā brahmāṇaṃ jagataḥ prabhum | praṇamyovāca dīnātmā svaduḥkhaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 4 || kiṃ karomi mahābhāga matto'sau na dadāti gām | śāpo mayā visṛṣṭo'smai gopālo bhava mānuṣe || 5 || bhārye dve api tatraiva bhavetāṃ cātiduḥkhite | yato vatsā rudantyatra mātṛhīnāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ || 6 || mṛtavatsāditistasmādbhaviṣyati dharātale | kārāgāranivāsā ca tenāpi bahuduḥkhitā || 7 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya yādonāthasya padmabhūḥ | samāhūya muniṃ tatra tamuvāca prajāpatiḥ || 8 || kasmāttvayā mahābhāga lokapālasya dhenavaḥ | hṛtāḥ punarna dattāśca kimanyāyaṃ karoṣi ca || 9 || jānan nyāyaṃ mahābhāga paravittāpahāraṇam | kṛtavānkathamanyāyaṃ sarvajño'si mahāmate || 10 || aho lobhasya mahimā mahato'pi na muñcati | lobhaṃ narakadaṃ nūnaṃ pāpākaramasammatam || 11 || kaśyapo'pi na taṃ tyaktuṃ samarthaḥ kiṃ karomyaham | sarvadaivādhikastasmāllobho vai kalito mayā || 12 || dhanyāste munayaḥ śāntā jito yairlobha eva ca | vaikhānasaiḥ śamaparaiḥ pratigrahaparāṅmukhaiḥ || 13 || saṃsāre balavāñchatrurlobho'medhyo'varaḥ sadā | kaśyapo'pi durācāraḥ kṛtasneho durātmanā || 14 || brahmāpi taṃ śaśāpātha kaśyapaṃ munisattamam | maryādārakṣaṇārthaṃ hi pautraṃ paramavallabham || 15 || aṃśena tvaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai prāpya janma yadoḥ kule | bhāryābhyāṃ saṃyutastatra gopālatvaṃ kariṣyasi || 16 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ śaptaḥ kaśyapo'sau varuṇena ca brahmaṇā | aṃśāvataraṇārthāya bhūbhāraharaṇāya ca || 17 || tathā dityāditiḥ śaptā śokasantaptayā bhṛśam | jātā jātā vinaśyeraṃstava putrāstu sapta vai || 18 || janamejaya uvāca kasmāddityā ca bhaginī śaptendrajananī mune | kāraṇaṃ vada śāpe ca śokastu munisattama || 19 || sūta uvāca pārīkṣitena pṛṣṭastu vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | rājānaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ kāraṇaṃ susamāhitaḥ || 20 || vyāsa uvāca rājan dakṣasute dve tu ditiścāditiruttame | kaśyapasya priye bhārye babhūvatururukrame || 21 || adityāṃ maghavā putro yadābhūdativīryavān | tadā tu tādṛśaṃ putraṃ cakame ditirojasā || 22 || patimāhāsitāpāṅgī putraṃ me dehi mānada | indrakhyabalaṃ vīraṃ dharmiṣṭhaṃ vīryavattamam || 23 || tāmuvāca muniḥ kānte svasthā bhava mayodite | vratānte bhavitā tubhyaṃ śatakratusamaḥ sutaḥ || 24 || sā tatheti pratiśrutya cakāra vratamuttamam | niṣiktaṃ muninā garbhaṃ bibhrāṇā sumanoharam || 25 || bhūmau cakāra śayanaṃ payovrataparāyaṇā | pavitrā dhāraṇāyuktā babhūva varavarṇinī || 26 || evaṃ jātaḥ susaṃpūrṇo yadā garbho'tivīryavān | śubhrāṃśumatidīptāṅgīṃ ditiṃ dṛṣṭvā tu duḥkhitā || 27 || maghavatsadṛśaḥ putro bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ | dityāstadā mama sutastejohīno bhavetkila || 28 || iti cintāparā putramindraṃ covāca māninī | śatruste'dya samutpanno ditigarbhe'tivīryavān || 29 || upāyaṃ kuru nāśāya śatroradya vicintya ca | utpattireva hantavyā dityā garbhasya śobhana || 30 || vīkṣya tāmasitāpāṅgīṃ sapatnībhāvamāsthitām | dunoti hṛdaye cintā sukhamarmavināśinī || 31 || rājayakṣmeva saṃvṛddho naṣṭo naiva bhavedripuḥ | tasmādaṅkuritaṃ hanyādbuddhimānahitaṃ kila || 32 || lohaśaṅkuriva kṣipto garbho vai hṛdaye mama | yena kenāpyupāyena pātayādya śatakrato || 33 || sāmadānabalenāpi hiṃsanīyastvayā sutaḥ | dityā garbho mahābhāga mama cedicchasi priyam || 34 || vyāsa uvāca śrutvā mātṛvacaḥ śakro vicintya manasā tataḥ | jagāmāparamātuḥ sa samīpamamarādhipaḥ || 35 || vavande vinayātpādau dityāḥ pāpamatirnṛpa | provāca vinayenāsau madhuraṃ viṣagarbhitam || 36 || indra uvāca mātastvaṃ vratayuktāsi kṣīṇadehātidurbalā | sevārthamiha samprāptaḥ kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadasva me || 37 || pādasaṃvāhanaṃ te'haṃ kariṣyāmi pativrate | guruśuśrūṣaṇātpuṇyaṃ labhate gatimakṣayām || 38 || na me kimapi bhedo'sti tathādityā śape kila | ityuktvā caraṇau spṛṣṭā saṃvāhanaparo'bhavat || 39 || saṃvāhanasukhaṃ prāpya nidrāmāpa sulocanā | śrāntā vratakṛśā suptā viśvastā paramā satī || 40 || tāṃ nidrāvaśamāpannāṃ vilokya prāviśattanum | rūpaṃ kṛtvātisūkṣmañca śastrapāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ || 41 || udaraṃ praviveśāśu tasyā yogabalena vai | garbhaṃ cakarta vajreṇa saptadhā pavināyakaḥ || 42 || ruroda ca tadā bālo vajreṇābhihatastathā | mā rudeti śanairvākyamuvāca maghavānamum || 43 || śakalāni punaḥ sapta saptadhā kartitāni ca | tadā caikonapañcāśanmarutaścābhavannṛpa || 44 || tadā prabuddhā sudatī jñātvā garbhaṃ tathākṛtam | indreṇa chalarūpeṇa cukopa bhṛśaduḥkhitā || 45 || bhaginīkṛtaṃ tu sā buddhvā śaśāpa kupitā tadā | aditiṃ maghavantañca satyavrataparāyaṇā || 46 || yathā me kartito garbhastava putreṇa chadmanā | tathā tannāśamāyātu rājyaṃ tribhuvanasya tu || 47 || yathā guptena pāpena mama garbho nipātitaḥ | adityā pāpacāriṇyā yathā me ghātitaḥ sutaḥ || 48 || tasyāḥ putrāstu naśyantu jātā jātāḥ punaḥ punaḥ | kārāgāre vasatveṣā putraśokāturā bhṛśam || 49 || anyajanmani cāpyeva mṛtāpatyā bhaviṣyati | vyāsa uvāca ityutsṛṣṭaṃ tadā śrutvā śāpaṃ marīcinandanaḥ || 50 || uvāca praṇayopeto vacanaṃ śamayanniva | mā kopaṃ kuru kalyāṇi putrāste balavattarāḥ || 51 || bhaviṣyanti surāḥ sarve maruto maghavatsakhāḥ | śāpo'yaṃ tava vāmoru tvaṣṭāviṃśe'tha dvāpare || 52 || aṃśena mānuṣaṃ janma prāpya bhokṣyati bhāminī | varuṇenāpi datto'sti śāpaḥ santāpitena ca || 53 || ubhayoḥ śāpayogena mānuṣīyaṃ bhaviṣyati | vyāsa uvāca patināśvāsitā devī santuṣṭā sābhavattadā || 54 || novāca vipriyaṃ kiñcittataḥ sā varavarṇinī | iti te kathitaṃ rājan pūrvaśāpasya kāraṇam || 55 || aditirdevakī jātā svāṃśena nṛpasattama || 56 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ || caturthaskandhe dityā adityai śāpadānaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <4.4> adhamajagataḥ sthitivarṇanam rājovāca vismito'smi mahābhāga śrutvākhyānaṃ mahāmate | saṃsāro'yaṃ pāparūpaḥ kathaṃ mucyeta bandhanāt || 1 || kaśyapasyāpi dāyādastrilokīvibhave sati | kṛtavānīdṛśaṃ karma ko na kuryāñcugupsitam || 2 || garbhe praviśya bālasya hananaṃ dāruṇaṃ kila | sevāmiṣeṇa mātuśca kṛtvā śapathamadbhutam || 3 || śāstā dharmasya goptā ca trilokyāḥ patirapyuta | kṛtavānīdṛśaṃ karma ko na kuryādasāmpratam || 4 || pitāmahā me saṃgrāme kurukṣetre'tidāruṇam | kṛtavantastathāścaryaṃ duṣṭaṃ karma jagadguro || 5 || bhīṣmodroṇaḥ kṛpaḥ karṇo dharmāśo'pi yudhiṣṭhiraḥ | sarve viruddhadharmeṇa vāsudevena noditāḥ || 6 || asāratāṃ vijānantaḥ saṃsārasya sumedhasaḥ | devāṃśāśca kathaṃ cakurninditaṃ dharmatatparāḥ || 7 || kāsthā dharmasya viprendra pramāṇaṃ kiṃ viniścitam | calacitto'smi sañjātaḥ śrutvā caitatkathānakam || 8 || āptavākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ cedāptaḥ kaḥ paradehavān | puruṣo viṣayāsakto rāgī bhavati sarvathā || 9 || rāgo dveṣo bhavennūnamarthanāśādasaṃśayam | dveṣādasatyavacanaṃ vaktavyaṃ svārthasiddhaye || 10 || jarāsandhavighātārthaṃ hariṇā sattvamūrtinā | chalena racitaṃ rūpaṃ brāhmaṇasya vijānatā || 11 || tadāptaḥ kaḥ pramāṇaṃ kiṃ sattvamūrtirapīdṛśaḥ | arjuno'pi tathaivātra kārye yajñavinirmite || 12 || kīdṛśo'yaṃ kṛto yajñaḥ kimarthaṃ śamavarjitaḥ | paralokapadārthaṃ vā yaśase vānyathā kila || 13 || dharmasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ satyametacchrutervacaḥ | dvitīyastu tathā śaucaṃ dayā pādastṛtīyakaḥ || 14 || dānaṃ pādaścaturthaśca purāṇajñā vadanti vai | tairvihīnaḥ kathaṃ dharmastiṣṭhediha susammataḥ || 15 || dharmahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ karma kathaṃ tatphaladaṃ bhavet | dharme sthirā matiḥ kvāpi na kasyāpi pratīyate || 16 || chalārthañca yadā viṣṇurvāmano'bhūñcagatprabhuḥ | yena vāmanarūpeṇa vañcito'sau balirnṛpaḥ || 17 || vihartā śatayajñasya vedājñāparipālakaḥ | dharmiṣṭho dānaśīlaśca satyavādī jitendriyaḥ || 18 || sthānātprabhraṃśito'kasmādviṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | jitaṃ kena tayoḥ kṛṣṇa balinā vāmanena vā || 19 || chalakarmavidā cāyaṃ sandeho'tra mahānmama | vañcayitvā vañcitena satyaṃ vada dvijottama || 20 || purāṇakartā tvamasi dharmajñaśca mahāmatiḥ | vyāsa uvāca jitaṃ vai balinā rājan dattā yena ca medinī || 21 || trivikramo'pi nāmnā yaḥ prathito vāmano'bhavat | chalanārthamidaṃ rājanvāmanatvaṃ narādhipa || 22 || samprāptaṃ hariṇā bhūyo dvārapālatvameva ca | satyādanyatarannāsti mūlaṃ dharmasya pārthiva || 23 || duḥsādhyaṃ dehināṃ rājansatyaṃ sarvātmanā kila | māyā balavatī bhūpa triguṇā bahurūpiṇī || 24 || yayedaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvaṃ guṇaiḥ śabalitaṃ tribhiḥ | tasmācchalavatā satyaṃ kuto'viddhaṃ bhavennṛpa || 25 || miśreṇa janitā caiva sthitireṣā sanātanī | vaikhānasāśca munayo niḥsaṅgā niṣpratigrahāḥ || 26 || satyayuktā bhavantyatra vītarāgā gataspṛhāḥ | dṛṣṭāntadarśanārthāya nirmitāste ca tādṛśāḥ || 27 || anyatsarvaṃ śabalitaṃ guṇairebhistribhinṛpa | naikaṃ vākyaṃ purāṇeṣu vedeṣu nṛpasattama || 28 || dharmaśāstreṣu cāṅgeṣu saguṇai raciteṣviha | saguṇaḥ saguṇaṃ kuryānnirguṇo na karoti vai || 29 || guṇāste miśritāḥ sarve na pṛthagbhāvasaṅgatāḥ | nirvyalīke sthire dharme matiḥ kasyāpi na sthirā || 30 || bhavodbhave mahārāja māyayā mohitasya vai | indriyāṇi pramāthīni tadāsaktaṃ manastathā || 31 || karoti vividhānbhāvānguṇaistaiḥ prerito bhṛśam | brahmādistambaparyantāḥ prāṇinaḥ sthirajaṅgamāḥ || 32 || sarve māyāvaśā rājan sānukrīḍati tairiha | sarvānvai mohayatyeṣā vikurvatyaniśaṃ jagat || 33 || asatyo jāyate rājankāryavānprathamaṃ naraḥ | indriyārthāṃścintayāno na prāpnoti yadā naraḥ || 34 || tadarthaṃ chalamādatte chalātpāpe pravartate | kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca vairiṇo balavattarāḥ || 35 || kṛtākṛtaṃ na jānanti prāṇinastadvaśaṃ gatāḥ | vibhave satyahaṅkāraḥ prabalaḥ prabhavatyapi || 36 || ahaṅkārādbhavenmoho mohānmaraṇameva ca | saṅkalpā bahavastatra vikalpāḥ prabhavanti ca || 37 || īrṣyāsūyā tathā dveṣaḥ prādurbhavati cetasi | āśā tṛṣṇā tathā dainyaṃ dambho'dharmamatistathā || 38 || prāṇināṃ prabhavantyete bhāvā mohasamudbhavāḥ | yajñadānāni tīrthāni vratāni niyamāstathā || 39 || ahaṅkārābhibhūtastu karoti puruṣo'nvaham | ahaṃbhāvakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ prabhavedvai na śaucavat || 40 || rāgalobhātkṛtaṃ karma sarvāṅgaṃ śuddhivarjitam | prathamaṃ dravyaśuddhiśca draṣṭavyā vibudhaiḥ kila || 41 || adroheṇārjitaṃ dravyaṃ praśastaṃ dharmakarmaṇi | drohārjitena dravyeṇa yatkaroti śubhaṃ naraḥ || 42 || viparītaṃ bhavettattu phalakāle nṛpottama | mano'tinirmalaṃ yasya sa samyakphalabhāgbhavet || 43 || tasminvikārayukte tu na yathārthaphalaṃ labhet | kartāraḥ karmaṇāṃ sarve ācāryaṛtvijādayaḥ || 44 || syuste viśuddhamanasastadā pūrṇaṃ bhavetphalam | deśakālakriyādravyakartṝṇāṃ śuddhatā yadi || 45 || mantrāṇāṃ ca tadā pūrṇaṃ karmaṇāṃ phalamaśnute | śatrūṇāṃ nāśamuddiśya svavṛddhiṃ paramāṃ tathā || 46 || karoti sukṛtaṃ tadvadviparītaṃ bhavetkila | svārthāsaktaḥ pumānnityaṃ na jānāti śubhāśubham || 47 || daivādhīnaḥ sadā kuryātpāpameva na satkṛtam | prājāpatyāḥ surāḥ sarve hyasurāśca tadudbhavāḥ || 48 || sarve te svārthaniratāḥ parasparavirodhinaḥ | sattvodbhavāḥ surāḥ sarve'pyuktā vedeṣu mānuṣāḥ || 49 || rajodbhavāstāmasāstu tiryaṃcaḥ parikīrtitāḥ | sattvodbhavānāṃ tairvairaṃ parasparamanāratam || 50 || tiraścāmatra kiṃ citraṃ jātivairasamudbhave | sadā drohaparā devāstapovighnakarāstathā || 51 || asantuṣṭā dveṣaparāḥ parasparavirodhinaḥ | ahaṅkārasamudbhūtaḥ saṃsāro'yaṃ yato nṛpa || 52 || rāgadveṣavihīnastu sa kathaṃ jāyate nṛpa || 53 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ || caturthaskandhe adhamajagataḥ sthitivarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <4.5> naranārāyaṇakathāvarṇanam vyāsa uvāca atha kiṃ bahunoktena saṃsāre'sminnṛpottama | dharmātmādrohabuddhistu kaścidbhavati karhicit || 1 || rāgadveṣāvṛtaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | ādye yuge'pi rājendra kimadya kalidūṣite || 2 || devāḥ serṣyāśca sadrohāśchalakarmaratāḥ sadā | mānuṣāṇāṃ tiraścāṃ ca kā vārtā nṛpa gaṇyate || 3 || drohapare drohaparo bhavediti samānatā | adrohiṇi tathā śānte vidveṣaḥ khalatā smṛtā || 4 || yaḥ kaścittāpasaḥ śānto japadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | bhavettasya jape vighnakartā vai maghavā param || 5 || satāṃ satyayugaṃ sākṣātsarvadaivāsatāṃ kaliḥ | madhyamo madhyamānāṃ tu kriyāyogau yuge smṛtau || 6 || kaścitkadācidbhavati satyadharmānuvartakaḥ | anyathānyayugānāṃ vai sarve dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 7 || vāsanā kāraṇaṃ rājan sarvatra dharmasaṃsthitau | tasyāṃ vai malināyāṃ tu dharmo'pi malino bhavet || 8 || malinā vāsanā satyaṃ vināśāyeti sarvathā | brahmaṇo hṛdayāñcātaḥ putro dharma iti smṛtaḥ || 9 || brāhmaṇaḥ satyasampanto vedadharmarataḥ sadā | dakṣasya duhitāro hi vṛtā daśa mahātmanā || 10 || vivāhavidhinā samyaṅmuninā gṛhadharmiṇā | tāsvajījanayatputrāndharmaḥ satyavatāṃ varaḥ || 11 || hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ naraṃ caiva tathā nārāyaṇaṃ nṛpa | yogābhyāsarato nityaṃ hariḥ kṛṣṇo babhūva ha || 12 || naranārāyaṇau caiva ceratustapa uttamam | prāleyādriṃ samāgatya tīrthe badarikāśrame || 13 || tapasviṣu dhurīṇau tau purāṇau munisattamau | gṛṇantau tatparaṃ brahma gaṅgāyā vipule taṭe || 14 || hareraṃśau sthitau tatra naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī | pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu cakrāte tapa uttamam || 15 || tāpitaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ tapasā sacarācaram | naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ ca śakraḥ kṣobhaṃ tadā yayau || 16 || cintāviṣṭaḥ sahasrākṣo manasā samakalpayat | kiṃ kartavyaṃ dharmaputrau tāpasau dhyānasaṃyutau || 17 || siddhārthāṃ subhṛśaṃ śreṣṭhamāsanaṃ me grahīṣyataḥ | vighnaḥ kathaṃ prakartavyastapo yena bhavenna hi || 18 || utpādya kāmaṃ krodhañca lobhaṃ vāpyatidāruṇam | ityuddiśya sahasrākṣaḥ samāruhya gajottamam || 19 || vighnakāmastu tarasā jagāma gandhamādanam | gatvā tatrāśrame puṇye tāvapaśyacchatakratuḥ || 20 || tapasā dīptadehau tu bhāskarāviva coditau | brahmaviṣṇū kimetau vai prakaṭau vā vibhāvasū || 21 || dharmaputrāvṛṣī etau tapasā kiṃ kariṣyataḥ | iti sañcintya tau dṛṣṭvā tadovāca śacīpatiḥ || 22 || kiṃ vā kāryaṃ mahābhāgau brūtaṃ dharmasutau kila | dadāmi vāṃ varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dātuṃ yāto'smyahamṛṣī || 23 || adeyamapi dāsyāmi tuṣṭo'smi tapasā kila | vyāsa uvāca evaṃ punaḥ punaḥ śakrastāvuvāca puraḥ sthitaḥ || 24 || nocatustāvṛṣī dhyānasaṃsthitau dṛḍhacetasau | tato vai mohinīṃ māyāṃ cakāra bhayadāṃ vṛṣaḥ || 25 || vṛkānsiṃhāṃśca vyāghrāṃśca samutpādyābibhīṣayat | varṣaṃ vātaṃ tathā vahniṃ samutpādya punaḥ punaḥ || 26 || bhīṣayāmāsa tau śakro māyāṃ kṛtvā vimohinīm | bhayato'pi vaśaṃ nītau na tau dharmasutau munī || 27 || naranārāyaṇau dṛṣṭvā śakraḥ svabhavanaṃ gataḥ | varadāne pralubdhau na na bhītau vahnivāyutaḥ || 28 || vyāghrasiṃhādibhiḥ kāntau calitau nāśramātsvakāt | na tayordhyānabhaṅgaṃ vai kartuṃ ko'pi kṣamo'bhavat || 29 || indro'pi sadanaṃ gatvā cintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ | calitau bhayalobhābhyāṃ nemau munivarottamau || 30 || cintayantau mahāvidyāmādiśaktiṃ sanātanīm | īśvarīṃ sarvalokānāṃ parāṃ prakṛtimadbhutām || 31 || dhyāyatāṃ kaḥ kṣamo loke bahumāyāvidapyuta | yanmūlāḥ sakalā māyā devāsurakṛtāḥ kila || 32 || te kathaṃ bādhituṃ śaktā dhyāyanti gatakalmaṣāḥ | vāgbījaṃ kāmabījañca māyābījaṃ tathaiva ca || 33 || citte yasya bhavettaṃ tu bādhituṃ ko'pi na kṣamaḥ | māyayā mohitaḥ śakro bhūyastasya pratikriyām || 34 || kartuṃ kāmavasantau tu samāhūyābravīdvacaḥ | manobhava vasantena ratyā yukto vrajādhunā || 35 || apsarobhiḥ samāyuktastarasā gandhamādanam | naranārāyaṇau tatra purāṇāvṛṣisattamau || 36 || kurutastapa ekānte sthitau badarikāśrame | gatvā tatra samīpe tu tayormanmatha mārgaṇaiḥ || 37 || cittaṃ kāmāturaṃ kāryaṃ kuru kāryaṃ mamādhunā | mohayitvoccāṭayitvā viśikhaistāḍayāśu ca || 38 || vaśīkuru mahābhāga munī dharmasutāvapi | ko hyasmin sarvasaṃsāre devo daityo'tha mānavaḥ || 39 || yaste bāṇavaśaṃ prāpto na yāti bhṛśatāḍitaḥ | brahmāhaṃ girijānāthaścandro vahnirvimohitaḥ || 40 || gaṇanā kānayoḥ kāma tvadbāṇānāṃ parākrame | vārāṅganāgaṇo'yaṃ te sahāyārthaṃ mayeritaḥ || 41 || āgamiṣyati tatraiva rambhādīnāṃ manoramaḥ | ekā tilottamā rambhā kāryaṃ sādhayituṃ kṣamā || 42 || tvamevaikaḥ kṣamaḥ kāmaṃ militaiḥ kastu saṃśayaḥ | kuru kāryaṃ mahābhāga dadāmi tava vācchitam || 43 || pralobhitau mayātyarthaṃ varadānaistapasvinau | sthānānna calitau śāntau vṛthāyaṃ me gataḥ śramaḥ || 44 || tathā vai māyayā kṛtvā bhīṣitau tāpasau bhṛśam | tathāpi notthitau sthānāddeharakṣāparau na tau || 45 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śakraṃ prāha manobhavaḥ | vāsavādya kariṣyāmi kāryaṃ te manasepsitam || 46 || yadi viṣṇuṃ maheśaṃ vā brahmāṇaṃ vā divākaram | dhyāyantau tau tadāsmākaṃ bhavitārau vaśau munī || 47 || devībhaktaṃ vaśīkartuṃ nāhaṃ śaktaḥ kathañcana | kāmarāja mahābījaṃ cintayantaṃ manasyalam || 48 || tāṃ devīṃ cenmahāśaktiṃ saṃśritau bhaktibhāvataḥ | na tadā mama bāṇānāṃ gocarau tāpasau kila || 49 || indra uvāca gaccha tvaṃ ca mahābhāga sarvaistatra samudyataiḥ | kāryaṃ mamātiduḥsādhyaṃ kartā hitamanuttamam || 50 || vyāsa uvāca iti tena samādiṣṭā yayuḥ sarve samudyatāḥ | yatra tau dharmaputrau dvau tepāte duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ || 51 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ || caturthaskandhe naranārāyaṇakathāvarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <4.6> apsarāṃ nārāyaṇasamīpe prārthanākaraṇam vyāsa uvāca prathamaṃ tatra samprāpto vasantaḥ parvatottame | puṣpitāḥ pādapāḥ sarve dvirephālivirājitāḥ || 1 || āmrāśca bakulā ramyāstilakāḥ kiṃśukāḥ śubhā | sālāstālāstamālāśca madhūkāḥ puṣpitā babhuḥ || 2 || babhūvuḥ kokilālāpā vṛkṣāgreṣu manoharāḥ | vallyo'pi puṣpitāḥ sarvā āliliṅgurnagottamān || 3 || prāṇinaḥ svāsu bhāryāsu premayuktāḥ smarāturāḥ | babhūvuścātimattāśca krīḍāsaktāḥ parasparam || 4 || vavurmandāḥ sugandhāśca susparśā dakṣiṇānilāḥ | indriyāṇi pramāthīni munīnāmapi cābhavan || 5 || ratiyuktastataḥ kāmaḥ pūrayanpañcamārgaṇān | cakāra tvaritastatra vāsaṃ badarikāśrame || 6 || rambhā tilottamādyāśca gatvā tatra varāśrame | gānaṃ cakuḥ sugītajñāḥ svaratānasamanvitam || 7 || tacchrutvā madhurodgītaṃ kokilānāñca kūjitam | bhramarālivirāvañca prabuddhau tau munīśvarau || 8 || ṛturājamakāle tu dṛṣṭvā tau puṣpitaṃ vanam | jātau cintāparau tatra naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī || 9 || kimadya śiśirāpāyaḥ saṃbhṛtaḥ samayaṃ vinā | prāṇino vihvalāḥ sarve lakṣyante'tismarāturāḥ || 10 || kāladharmaviparyāsaḥ kathamadya durāsadaḥ | naraṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prāha vismayotkullalocanaḥ || 11 || nārāyaṇa uvāca paśya bhrātarime vṛkṣāḥ puṣpitāḥ pratibhānti vai | kokilālāpasaṅghuṣṭā bhramarālivirājitāḥ || 12 || śiśiraṃ bhīmamātaṅgaṃ dārayansvakharairnakhaiḥ | vasantakesarī prāptaḥ palāśakusumairmune || 13 || raktāśokakarā tanvī devarṣe kiṃśukāṅghrikā | nīlāśokakacā śyāmā vikāsikamalānanā || 14 || nīlendīvaranetrā sā bilvavṛkṣaphalastanī | prosphullakundaradanā mañjarīkarṇaśobhitā || 15 || bandhujīvādharā śubhrā sindhuvāranakhodbhavā | puṃskokilasvarā puṇyā kadambavasanā śubhā || 16 || barhivṛndakalāpā ca sārasasvananūpurā | vāsantī baddharaśanā mattahaṃsagatistathā || 17 || putrajīvāṃśukanyastaromarājivirājitā | vasantalakṣmīḥ samprāptā brahman badarikāśrame || 18 || akāle kimiyaṃ prāptā vismayo'yaṃ mamādhunā | tapovighnakarā nūnaṃ devarṣe paricintaya || 19 || śrūyate suranārīṇāṃ gānaṃ dhyānavināśanam | āvayostapibhaṅgāya kṛtaṃ maghavatā kila || 20 || ṛturāḍanyathākāle prītiṃ sañjanayetkatham | vighno'yaṃ vihito bhāti bhītenāsuraśatruṇā || 21 || vātāḥ sugandhāḥ śītāśca samāyānti manoharāḥ | nānyatkāraṇamastīha śatakratukṛtiṃ vinā || 22 || iti bruvati viprāgrye deve nārāyaṇe vibhau | sarve dṛṣṭipathaṃ prāptā manmathapramukhāstadā || 23 || dadarśa bhagavānsarvānnaro nārāyaṇastathā | vismayāviṣṭamanasau babhūvaturubhāvapi || 24 || manmathaṃ menakāṃ caiva rambhāṃ caiva tilottamām | puṣpagandhāṃ sukeśīṃ ca mahāśvetāṃ manoramām || 25 || pramadvarāṃ dhṛtācīñca gītajñāṃ cāruhāsinīm | candraprabhāṃ ca somāṃ ca kokilālāpamaṇḍitām || 26 || vidyunmālāmbujākṣyau ca tathā kāñcanamālinīm| etāścānyā varārohā dṛṣṭāstābhyāṃ tadāntike || 27 || tāsāṃ dvyaṣṭasahasrāṇi pañcāśadadhikāni ca | vīkṣya tau vismitau jātau kāmasainyaṃ suvistaram || 28 || praṇamyāgre sthitāḥ sarvā devavārāṅganāstadā | divyābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyā divyamālopaśobhitāḥ || 29 || jaguśchalena tāḥ sarvāḥ pṛthivyāmatidurlabham | tattathāvasthitaṃ divyaṃ manmathādivivardhanam || 30 || śuśrāva bhagavānviṣṇurnaro nārāyaṇastadā | śrutvā provāca tāstatra prītyā nārāyaṇo muniḥ || 31 || āsyatāṃ sukhamatraiva karomyātithyamadbhutam | bhavatyo'tithidharmeṇa prāptāḥsvargātsumadhyamāḥ || 32 || vyāsa uvāca sābhimānastu sañcātastadā nārāyaṇo muniḥ | indreṇa preṣitā nūnaṃ tathā vighnacikīrṣayā || 33 || varākyaḥ kā imāḥ sarvāḥ sṛjāmyadya navāḥ kila | etābhyo divyarūpāśca darśayāmi tapobalam || 34 || iti sañcintya manasā kareṇoruṃ pratāḍya vai | tarasotpādayāmāsa nārīṃ sarvāṅgasundarīm || 35 || nārāyaṇorusambhūtā hyurvaśīti tataḥ śubhā | dadṛśustāḥ sthitāstatra vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ || 36 || tāsāṃ ca paricaryārthaṃ tāvatīścātisundarīḥ | prāduścakāra tarasā tadā munirasambhramaḥ || 37 || gāyantyaśca hasantyaśca nānopāyanapāṇayaḥ | praṇemustā munī sarvāḥ sthitāḥ kṛtvāñjaliṃ puraḥ || 38 || tāṃ vīkṣya vibhramakarīṃ tapaso vibhūtiṃ || devāṅganā hi mumuhuḥ pravimohayantyaḥ | ūcuśca tau pramuditānanapadyaśobhā romodgamollasitacārunijāṅgavallyaḥ || 39 || kuryuḥ kathaṃ stutimaho tapaso mahattvaṃ dhairyaṃ tathaiva bhavatāmabhivīkṣya bālāḥ | asmatkaṭākṣaviṣadigdhaśareṇa dagdhaḥ ko vā na tatra bhavatāṃ manaso vyathā na || 40 || jñātau yuvāṃ narahareḥ paramāṃśabhūtau devau munī śamadamādinidhī sadaiva | sevānimittamiha no gamanaṃ na kāmaṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ śatamakhasya vidhātumeva || 41 || bhāgyena kena yuvayoḥ kila darśanaṃ naḥ sampāditaṃ na viditaṃ khalu sañcitaṃ tat | cittaṃ kṣamaṃ nijajane vihitaṃ yuvābhyāmasmadvidhe kila kṛtāgasi tāpamuktam || 42 || kurvanti naiva vibudhāstapaso vyayaṃ vai śāpena tucchaphaladena mahānubhāvāḥ | vyāsa uvāca itthaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ surakāminīnāṃ tāvūcaturmunivarau vinayānatānām|| 43 || prītau prasannavadanau jitakāmalobhau dharmātmajau nijataporuciśobhitāṅgau | naranārāyaṇāvūcatuḥ bruvantu vāñchitān kāmāndadāvastuṣṭamānasau || 44 || yāntu svargaṃ gahītvemāmurvaśīṃ cārulocanām | upāyanamiyaṃ bālā gacchatvadya manoharā || 45 || dattāvābhyāṃ maghavataḥ prīṇanāyorusambhavā | svastyastu sarvadevebhyo yatheṣṭaṃ pravrajantu ca || 46 || ( na kasyāpi tapovighnaṃ prakartavyamataḥ param |) || devya ūcuḥ kva gacchāmo mahābhāga prāptāste pādapaṅkajam | nārāyaṇa suraśreṣṭha bhaktyā paramayā mudā || 47 || vāñchitaṃ cedvaraṃ nātha dadāsi madhusūdana | tuṣṭaḥ kamalapatrākṣa bravīmo manasepsitam || 48 || patistvaṃ bhava deveśa varamenaṃ parantapa | bhavāmaḥ prītiyuktāstvāṃ sevituṃ jagadīśvara || 49 || tvayā cotpāditā nāryaḥ santyanyāścārulocanāḥ | urvaśyādyāstathā yāntu svargaṃ vai bhavadājñayā || 50 || strīṇāṃ ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ tiṣṭhatvatra śatārdhakam | sevāṃ te'tra kariṣyāmo yuvayostāpasottamau || 51 || vāñchitaṃ dehi deveśa satyavāgbhava mādhava | āśābhaṅgo hi nārīṇāṃ hiṃsanaṃ parikīrtitam || 52 || kāmārtānāñca munibhirdharmajñaistattvadarśibhiḥ | bhāgyayogādiha prāptāḥ svargātpremapariplutāḥ || 53 || tyaktuṃ nārhasi deveśa samartho'si jagatpate | nārāyaṇa uvāca pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tapastaptaṃ mayātra vai || 54 || jitendriyeṇa cārvaṅgyaḥ kathaṃ bhaṅgaṃ karomyataḥ | necchā kāme sukhe kācitsukhadharmavināśake || 55 || paśūnāmapi sādharmye rameta matimānkatham | apsarasa ūcuḥ śabdādīnāṃ ca pañcānāṃ madhye sparśasukhaṃ varam || 56 || ānandarasamūlaṃ vai nānyadasti sukhaṃ kila | ato'smākaṃ mahārāja vacanaṃ kuru sarvathā || 57 || nirbharaṃ sukhamāsādya carasva gandhamādane | yadi vāñchasi nākatvaṃ nādhiko gandhamādanāt || 58 || ramasvātra śubhe sthāne prāpya sarvāḥ surāṅganāḥ || 59 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe || apsarasāṃ nārāyaṇasamīpe prārthanākaraṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <4.7> ahaṅkārāvartanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca ityākarṇya vacastāsāṃ dharmaputraḥ pratāpavān | vimarśamakaroccitte kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayādhunā || 1 || hāsyo'haṃ munivṛndeṣu bhaviṣyāmyadya saṅgamāt | ahaṃkārādidaṃ prāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ nātra vicāraṇā | mūlaṃ dharmavināśasya prathamaṃ yadahaṅkṛtiḥ || 2 || mūlaṃ saṃsāravṛkṣasya yataḥ prokto mahātmabhiḥ | dṛṣṭvā maunaṃ samādhāya na sthito'haṃ samāgatam || 3 || vārāṅganāgaṇaṃ juṣṭaṃ tenāsaṃ duḥkhabhājanam | utpāditāstathā nāryo mayā dharmavyayena vai || 4 || tāstu māṃ bādhituṃ vṛttāḥ kāmārtāḥ pramadottamāḥ | ūrṇanābhirivādyāhaṃ jālena svakṛtena vai || 5 || baddho'smi sudṛḍhenātra kiṃ kartavyamataḥ param | yadi cintāṃ samutsṛjya santyajāmyabalā imāḥ || 6 || śaptvā bhraṣṭā vrajiṣyanti sarvā bhagnamanorathāḥ | mukto'haṃ sañcariṣyāmi vijane paramaṃ tapaḥ || 7 || tasmātkrodhaṃ samutpādya tyakṣyāmi sundarīgaṇam | vyāsa uvāca iti sañcintya manasā munirnārāyaṇastadā || 8 || vimarśamakaroccitte sukhotpādanasādhane | dvitīyo'yaṃ mahāśatruḥ krodhaḥ santāpakārakaḥ || 9 || kāmādapyadhiko loke lobhādapi ca dāruṇaḥ | krodhābhibhūtaḥ kurute hiṃsāṃ prāṇavighātinīm || 10 || duḥkhadāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ narakārāmadīrghikām | yathāgnirgharṣaṇājjātaḥ pādapaṃ pradahettathā || 11 || dehotpannastathā krodho dehaṃ dahati dāruṇaḥ | vyāsa uvāca iti sañcintyamānaṃ taṃ bhrātaraṃ dīnamānasam || 12 || uvāca vacanaṃ tathyaṃ naro dharmasuto'nujaḥ | nara uvāca nārāyaṇa mahābhāga kopaṃ yaccha mahāmate || 13 || śāntaṃ bhāvaṃ samāśritya nāśayāhaṅkṛtiṃ parām | purāhaṅkāradoṣeṇa tapo naṣṭaṃ kilāvayoḥ || 14 || saṃgrāmaścābhavattābhyāṃ bhāvābhyāmasureṇa ha | divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu prahlādena mahādbhutam || 15 || duḥkhaṃ bahutaraṃ prāptaṃ tatrāvābhyāṃ surottama | tasmātkrodhaṃ parityajya śānto bhava munīśvara || 16 || ( śāntatvaṃ tapaso mūlaṃ munibhiḥ parikīrtitam |) || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śānto'bhūddharmanandanaḥ | janamejaya uvāca saṃśayo'yaṃ muniśreṣṭha prahlādena mahātmanā || 17 || viṣṇubhaktena śāntena kathaṃ yuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ purā | kṛtavantau kathaṃ yuddhaṃ naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī || 18 || tāpasau dharmaputrau dvau suśāntamānasāvubhau | samāgamaḥ kathaṃ jātastayordaityasutasya ca || 19 || saṃgrāmastu kathaṃ tābhyāṃ kṛtastena mahātmanā | prahlādo'pyatidharmātmā jñānavānviṣṇutatparaḥ || 20 || naranārāyaṇau tadvattāpasau sattvasaṃsthitau | tena tābhyāṃ samudbhūtaṃ vairaṃ yadi parasparam || 21 || tadā tapasi dharme ca śrama eva hi kevalam | kva japaḥ kva tapaścaryā purā satyayuge'pi ca || 22 || tādṛśairna jitaṃ cittaṃ krodhāhaṅkārasaṃvṛtam | na krodho na ca mātsaryamahaṅkārāṃkuraṃ vinā || 23 || ahaṅkārātsamutpannāḥ kāmakrodhādayaḥ kila | varṣakoṭisahasraṃ tu tapaḥ kṛtvātidāruṇam || 24 || ahaṅkārāṃkure jāte vyarthaṃ bhavati sarvathā | yathā sūryodaye jāte tamorūpaṃ na tiṣṭhati || 25 || ahaṅkārāṃkurasyāgre tathā puṇyaṃ na tiṣṭhati | prahlādo'pi mahābhāga hariṇā samayudhyata || 26 || tadā vyarthaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sukṛtaṃ kila bhūtale | naranārāyaṇau śāntau vihāya paramaṃ tapaḥ || 27 || kṛtavantau yadā yuddhaṃ kva śamaḥ sukṛtaṃ punaḥ | īdṛgbhyāṃ sattvayuktābhyāmajeyā yadyahaṅkṛtiḥ || 28 || mādṛśānāñja kā vārtā mune'haṅkārasaṃkṣaye | ahaṅkāraparityakto na ko'pyasti jagattraye || 29 || na bhūto bhavitā naiva yastyaktastena sarvathā | mucyate lohanigaḍairbaddhaḥ kāṣṭhamayaistathā || 30 || ahaṅkāranibaddhastu na kadācidvimucyate | ahaṅkārāvṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam || 31 || bhramatyeva hi saṃsāre viṣṭhāmūtrapradūṣite | brahmajñānaṃ kutastāvatsaṃsāre mohasaṃvṛte || 32 || mataṃ mīmāṃsakānāṃ vai sammataṃ bhāti suvrata | mahānto'pi sadā yuktāḥ kāmakrodhādibhirmune || 33 || mādṛśānāṃ kalāvasminkā kathā munisattama | vyāsa uvāca kāryaṃ vai kāraṇādbhinnaṃ kathaṃ bhavati bhārata || 34 || kaṭakaṃ kuṇḍalañcaiva suvarṇasadṛśaṃ bhavet | ahaṅkārodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram || 35 || paṭastantuvaśaḥ proktastadviyuktaḥ kathaṃ bhavet | māyāguṇaistribhiḥ sarvaṃ racitaṃ sthirajaṅgamam || 36 || satṛṇastambaparyantaṃ kā tatra paridevanā | brahmā viṣṇustathā rudraste cāhaṅkāramohitāḥ || 37 || bhramantyasminmahāgādhe saṃsāre nṛpasattama | vasiṣṭhanāradādyāśca munayo jñāninaḥ param || 38 || te'bhibhūtāḥ saṃsaranti saṃsāre'sminpunaḥ punaḥ | na ko'pyasti nṛpaśreṣṭha triṣu lokeṣu dehabhṛt || 39 || ebhirmāyāguṇairmuktaḥ śānta ātmasukhe sthitaḥ | kāmakrodhau tathā lobho moho'haṅkārasambhavaḥ || 40 || na muñcanti naraṃ sarvaṃ dehavantaṃ nṛpottama | adhītya vedaśāstrāṇi purāṇāni vicintya ca || 41 || kṛtvā tīrthāṭanaṃ dānaṃ dhyānañcaiva surārcanam | karoti viṣayāsaktaḥ sarvaṃ karma ca cauravat || 42 || vicārayati no pūrvaṃ kāmamohamadānvitaḥ | kṛte yuge'pi tretāyāṃ dvāpare kurunandana || 43 || viddho'trāsti ca dharmo'pi kā kathādya kalau punaḥ | spardhā sadaiva sadrohā lobhāmarṣau ca sarvadā || 44 || evaṃvidho'sti saṃsāro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | sādhavo viralā loke bhavanti gatamatsarāḥ || 45 || jitakrodhā jitāmarṣā dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ vyavasthitāḥ | rājovāca te dhanyāḥ kṛtapuṇyāste madamohavivarjitāḥ || 46 || jitendriyāḥ sadācārā jitaṃ tairbhuvanatrayam | dunomi pātakaṃ smṛtvā piturmama mahātmanaḥ || 47 || kṛtastapasvinaḥ kaṇṭhe mṛtasarpo hyaghaṃ vinā | atastasya muniśreṣṭha bhavitā kiṃ mamāgrataḥ || 48 || na jāne buddhisammohātkiṃ vā kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati | madhu paśyati mūḍhātmā prapātaṃ naiva paśyati || 49 || karoti ninditaṃ karma narakānna bibheti ca | kathaṃ yuddhaṃ purā vṛttaṃ vistarāttadvadasva me || 50 || prahlādena yathā cograṃ naranārāyaṇasya vai | prahlādastu kathaṃ yātaḥ pātālāttadvadasva me || 51 || sārasvate mahātīrthe puṇye badarikāśrame | naranārāyaṇau śāntau tāpasau munisattamau || 52 || kṛtavantau tathā yuddhaṃ hetunā kena mānada | vairaṃ bhavati vittārthaṃ dārārthaṃ vā parasparam || 53 || eṣaṇārahitau kasmāccakratuḥ pradhanaṃ mahat | prahlādo'pi ca dharmātmā jñātvā devau sanātanau || 54 || kṛtavānsa kathaṃ yuddhaṃ naranārāyaṇau munī | etadvistarato brahmañchrotumicchāmi kāraṇam || 55 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ || caturthaskandhe ahaṅkārāvartanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <4.8> prahlādatīrthayātrāvarṇanam sūta uvāca iti pṛṣṭastadā vipro rājñā pārīkṣitena vai | uvāca vistarātsarvaṃ vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ || 1 || janamejayo'pi dharmātmā nirvedaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ | cittaṃ duścaritaṃ matvā vairāṭītanayasya vai || 2 || tasyaivoddharaṇārthāya cakāra satataṃ manaḥ | viprāvamānapāpena yamalokaṃ gatasya vai || 3 || punnāmanarakādyasmāttrāyate pitaraṃ svakam | putreti nāma sārthaṃ syāttena tasya munīśvarāḥ || 4 || sarpadaṣṭaṃ nṛpaṃ śrutvā harmyopari mṛtaṃ tathā | vipraśāpādauttareyaṃ snānadānavivarjitam || 5 || piturgatiṃ niśamyāsau nirvedaṃ gatavānnṛpaḥ | pārīkṣito mahābhāgaḥ santapto bhayavihvalaḥ || 6 || papracchātha muniṃ vyāsaṃ gṛhāgatamaninditaḥ | naranārāyaṇasyemāṃ kathāṃ paramavismṛtām || 7 || vyāsa uvāca sa yadā nihato raudro hiraṇyakaśipurnṛpa | abhiṣiktastadā rājye prahlādo nāma tatsutaḥ || 8 || tasmiñchāsati daityendre devabrāhmaṇapūjake | makhairbhūmau nṛpatayo yajantaḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ || 9 || brāhmaṇāśca tapodharmatīrthayātrāśca kurvate | vaiśyāśca svasvavṛttisthāḥ śūdrāḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ || 10 || nṛsiṃhena ca pātāle sthāpitaḥ so'tha daityarāṭ | rājyaṃ cakāra tatraiva prajāpālanatatparaḥ || 11 || kadācid bhṛguputro'tha cyavanākhyo mahātapāḥ | jagāma narmadāṃ snātuṃ tīrthaṃ vai vyāhṛtīśvaram || 12 || revāṃ mahānadīṃ dṛṣṭvā tatastasyāmavātarat | uttarantaṃ prajagrāha nāgo viṣabhayaṅkaraḥ || 13 || gṛhīto bhayabhītastu pātāle munisattamaḥ | sasmāra manasā viṣṇuṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam || 14 || saṃsmṛte puṇḍarīkākṣe nirviṣo'bhūnmahoragaḥ | na prāpa cyavano duḥkhaṃ nīyamāno rasātalam || 15 || dvijihvena munistyakto nirviṇṇenātiśaṅkinā | māṃ śapeta muniḥ kuddhastāpaso'yaṃ mahāniti || 16 || cacāra nāgakanyābhiḥ pūjito munisattamaḥ | viveśāpyatha nāgānāṃ dānavānāṃ mahatpuram || 17 || kadācidbhṛguputraṃ taṃ vicarantaṃ purottame | dadarśa daityarājo'sau prahlādo dharmavatsalaḥ || 18 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ pūjayāmāsa muniṃ daityapatistadā | papraccha kāraṇaṃ kiṃ te pātālāgamane vada || 19 || preṣito'si kimindreṇa satyaṃ brūhi dvijottama | daityavidveṣayuktena mama rājyadidṛkṣayā || 20 || cyavana uvāca kiṃ me maghavatā rājan yadahaṃ preṣitaḥ punaḥ | dūtakāryaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ prāptavānnagare tava || 21 || viddhi māṃ bhṛguputraṃ taṃ svanetraṃ dharmatatparam | mā śaṅkāṃ kuru daityendra vāsavapreṣitasya vai || 22 || snānārthaṃ narmadāṃ prāptaḥ puṇyatīrthe nṛpottama | nadyāmevāvatīrṇo'haṃ gṛhītaśca mahāhinā || 23 || jāto'sau nirviṣaḥ sarpo viṣṇoḥ saṃsmaraṇādiva | mukto'haṃ tena nāgena prabhāvātsmaraṇasya vai || 24 || atrāgatena rājendra mayāptaṃ tava darśanam | viṣṇubhakto'si daityendra tadbhaktaṃ māṃ vicintaya || 25 || vyāsa uvāca tanniśamya vacaḥ ślakṣṇaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ | papraccha parayā prītyā tīrthāni vividhāni ca || 26 || prahlāda uvāca pṛthivyāṃ kāni tīrthāni puṇyāni munisattama | pātāle ca tathākāśe tāni no vada vistarāt || 27 || cyavana uvāca manovākkāyaśuddhānāṃ rājaṃstīrthaṃ pade pade | tathā malinacittānāṃ gaṅgāpi kīkaṭādhikā || 28 || prathamaṃ cenmanaḥ śuddhaṃ jātaṃ pāpavivarjitam | tadā tīrthāni sarvāṇi pāvanāni bhavanti vai || 29 || gaṅgātīre hi sarvatra vasanti nagarāṇi ca | vrajāścaivākarā grāmāḥ sarve kheṭāstathāpare || 30 || niṣādānāṃ nivāsāśca kaivartānāṃ tathāpare | hūṇabaṅgakhasānāṃ ca mlecchānāṃ daityasattama || 31 || pibanti sarvadā gāṅgaṃ jalaṃ brahmopamaṃ sadā | snānaṃ kurvanti daityendra trikālaṃ svecchayā janāḥ || 32 || tatraiko'pi viśuddhātmā na bhavatyeva māriṣa | kiṃ phalaṃ tarhi tīrthasya viṣayopahatātmasu || 33 || kāraṇaṃ mana evātra nānyadrājanvicintaya | manaḥśuddhiṃ prakartavyā satataṃ śuddhimicchatā || 34 || tīrthavāsī mahāpāpī bhavettatrātmavañcanāt | tatraivācaritaṃ pāpamānantyāya prakalpate || 35 || yathendravāruṇaṃ pakvaṃ miṣṭaṃ naivopajāyate | bhāvaduṣṭastathā tīrthe koṭistāto na śudhyati || 36 || prathamaṃ manasaḥ śuddhiḥ kartavyā śubhamicchatā | śuddhe manasi dravyasya śuddhirbhavati nānyathā || 37 || tathaivācāraśuddhiḥ syāttatastīrthaṃ prasidhyati | anyathā tu kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 38 || (hīnavarṇasya saṃsargaṃ tīrthe gatvā sadā tyajet |) || bhūtānukampanaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ karmaṇā dhiyā | yadi pṛcchasi rājendra tīrthaṃ vakṣyāmyanuttamam || 39 || prathamaṃ naimiṣaṃ puṇyaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca puṣkaram | anyeṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ saṃkhyā nāsti mahītale || 40 || pāvanāni ca sthānāni bahūni nṛpasattama | vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā naimiṣaṃ gantumudyataḥ || 41 || nodayāmāsa daityānvai harṣanirbharamānasaḥ | prahlāda uvāca uttiṣṭhantu mahābhāgā gamiṣyāmo'dya naimiṣam || 42 || drakṣyāmaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam | vyāsa uvāca ityuktā viṣṇubhaktena sarve te dānavāstadā || 43 || tenaiva saha pātālānniryayuḥ parayā mudā | te sametya ca daiteyā dānavāśca mahābalāḥ || 44 || naimiṣāraṇyamāsādya snānaṃ cakrurmudānvitāḥ | prahlādastatra tīrtheṣu carandaityaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 45 || sarasvatīṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ dadarśa vimalodakām | tīrthe tatra nṛpaśreṣṭha prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ || 46 || manaḥ prasannaṃ sañjātaṃ snātvā sārasvate jale | vidhivattatra daityendraḥ snānadānādikaṃ śubhe || 47 || cakārātiprasannātmā tīrthe paramapāvane || 48 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ || caturthaskandhe prahlādatīrthayātrāvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <4.9> prahlādanārāyaṇayoryuddhe viṣṇorāgamanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca kurvaṃstīrthavidhiṃ tatra hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ | nyagrodhaṃ sumahacchāyamapaśyatpuratastadā || 1 || dadarśa bāṇānaparānnānājātīyakāṃstadā | gṛdhrapakṣayutāṃstīvrācchilādhautānmahojvalān || 2 ||
