cintayāmāsa manasā kasyeme viśikhāstviha | ṛṣīṇāmāśrame puṇye tīrthe paramapāvane || 3 || evaṃ cintayatānena kṛṣṇājinadharau munī | samunnatajaṭābhārau dṛṣṭau dharmasutau tadā || 4 || tayoragre dhṛte śubhre dhanuṣī lakṣaṇānvite | śārṅgamājagavañcaiva tathākṣayyau maheṣudhī || 5 || dhyānasthau tau mahābhāgau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī | dṛṣṭvā dharmasutau tatra daityānāmadhipastadā || 6 || krodharaktekṣaṇastau tu provācāsurapālakaḥ | kiṃ bhavadbhyāṃ samārabdho dambho dharmavināśanaḥ || 7 || na śrutaṃ naiva dṛṣṭaṃ hi saṃsāre'sminkadāpi hi | tapasaścaraṇaṃ tīvraṃ tathā cāpasya dhāraṇam || 8 || virodho'yaṃ yuge cādye kathaṃ yuktaṃ kalipriyam | brāhmaṇasya tapo yuktaṃ tatra kiṃ cāpadhāraṇam || 9 || kva jaṭādhāraṇaṃ dehe kveṣudhī ca viḍambanau | dharmasyācaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ yuvayordivyabhāvayoḥ || 10 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā naraḥ provāca bhārata | kā te cintātra daityendra vṛthā tapasi cāvayoḥ || 11 || sāmarthye sati yatkuryāttatsaṃpadyeta tasya hi | āvāṃ kāryadvaye manda samarthau lokaviśrutau || 12 || yuddhe tapasi sāmarthyaṃ tvaṃ punaḥ kiṃ kariṣyasi | gaccha mārge yathākāmaṃ kasmādatra vikatthase || 13 || brahmatejo durārādhyaṃ na tvaṃ veda vimohitaḥ | vipracarcā na kartavyā prāṇibhiḥ sukhamīpsubhiḥ || 14 || prahlāda uvāca tāpasau mandabuddhī stho mṛṣā vāṃ garvamohitau | mayi tiṣṭhati daityendre dharmasetupravartake || 15 || na yuktametattīrthe'sminnadharmācaraṇaṃ punaḥ | kā śaktistava yuddhe'sti darśayādya tapodhana || 16 || vyāsa uvāca tadākarṇya vacastasya narastaṃ pratyuvāca ha | yuddhasvādya mayā sārdhaṃ yadi te matirīdṛśī || 17 || adya te sphoṭayiṣyāmi mūrdhānamasurādhama | ( yuddhe śraddhā na te paścādbhaviṣyati kadācana |) || vyāsa uvāca tanniśamya vacastasya daityendraḥ kupitastadā || 18 || prahlādo balavānatra pratijñāmāruroha saḥ | yena kenāpyupāyena jeṣyāmi tāvubhāvapi || 19 || naranārāyaṇau dāntāvṛṣī tapisamanvitau | vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā vacanaṃ daityaḥ pratigṛhya śarāsanam || 20 || ākṛṣya tarasā cāpaṃ jyāśabdañca cakāra ha | naro'pi dhanurādāya śarāṃstīvrāñchilāśitān || 21 || mumoca bahuśaḥ kodhātprahlādopari pārthiva || 22 || tāndaityarājastapanīyapuṅkhaiściccheda bāṇaistarasā sametya | samīkṣya chinnāṃśca naraḥ svasṛṣṭānanyānmumocāśu ruṣānvito vai || 23 || daityāthipastānapi tīvravegaiśchittvā jaghānorasi taṃ munīndram | naro'pi taṃ pañcabhirāśugaiśca kuddho'hanaddaityapatiṃ bāhudeśe || 24 || sendrāḥ surāstatra tayorhi yuddhaṃ draṣṭuṃ vimānairgaganasthitāśca | narasya vīryaṃ yudhi saṃsthitasya te tuṣṭuvurdaityapateśca bhūyaḥ || 25 || vavarṣa daityādhipa āttacāpaḥ śilīmukhānambudharo yathāpaḥ | ādāya śārṅga dhanuraprameyaṃ mumoca bāṇāñchitahemapuṅkhān || 26 || babhūva yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ tayostu jayaiṣiṇoḥ pārthiva devadaityayoḥ | vavarṣurākāśapathe sthitāste puṣpāṇi divyāni prahṛṣṭacittāḥ || 27 || cukopa daityādhipatirharau sa mumoca bāṇānatitīvravegān | ciccheda tāndharmasutaḥ sutīkṣṇairdhanurvimuktairviśikhaistadā''śu || 28 || tato nārāyaṇaṃ bāṇaiḥ prahlādaścātikarṣitaiḥ | vavarṣa susthitaṃ vīraṃ dharmaputraṃ sanātanam | nārāyaṇo'pi taṃ vegānmuktairbāṇaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ || 29 || tutodātīva purato daityānāmadhipaṃ sthitam | sannipāto'mbare tatra didṛkṣūṇāṃ babhūva ha || 30 || devānāṃ dānavānāñca kurvatāṃ jayaghoṣaṇam | ubhayoḥ śaravarṣeṇa chādite gagane tadā || 31 || divāpi rātrisadṛśaṃ babhūva timiraṃ mahat | ūcuḥ parasparaṃ devā daityāścātīva vismitāḥ || 32 || adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ yuddhaṃ vai vartate'dya sudāruṇam | devarṣayo'tha gandharvā yakṣakinnarapannagāḥ || 33 || vidyādharāścāraṇāśca vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ | nāradaḥ parvataścaiva prekṣaṇārthaṃ sthitau munī || 34 || nāradaḥ parvataṃ prāha nedṛśaṃ cābhavatpurā | tārakāsurayuddhañca tathā vṛtrāsurasya ca || 35 || madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhaṃ hariṇā cedṛśaṃ kṛtam | prahlādaḥ prabalaḥ śūro yasmānnārāyaṇena ca || 36 || karoti sadṛśaṃ yuddhaṃ siddhenādbhutakarmaṇā | vyāsa uvāca dine dine tathā rātrau kṛtvā kṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ || 37 || cakratuḥ paramaṃ yuddhaṃ tau tadā daityatāpasau | nārāyaṇastu ciccheda prahlādasya śarāsanam || 38 || tarasaikena bāṇena sa cānyaddhanurādade | nārāyaṇastu tarasā muktvānyañca śilīmukham || 39 || tadaiva madhyataścāpaṃ ciccheda laghuhastakaḥ | chinnaṃ chinnaṃ punardaityo dhanuranyatsamādade || 40 || nārāyaṇastu ciccheda viśikhairāśu kopitaḥ | chinne dhanuṣi daityendraḥ parighaṃ tu samādade || 41 || jaghāna dharmajaṃ tūrṇaṃ bāhvormadhye'tikopanaḥ | tamāyāntaṃ sa balavānmārgaṇairnavabhirmuniḥ || 42 || ciccheda parighaṃ ghoraṃ daśabhistamatāḍayat | gadāmādāya daityendraḥ sarvāyasamayīṃ dṛḍhām || 43 || jānudeśe jaghānāśu devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ruṣā | gadayā cāpi girivatsaṃsthitaḥ sthiramānasaḥ || 44 || dharmaputro'tibalavānmumocāśu śilīmukhān | gadāṃ ciccheda bhagavāṃstadā daityapaterdṛḍhām || 45 || vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ prekṣakā gagane sthitāḥ | sa tu śaktiṃ samādāya prahlādaḥ paravīrahā || 46 || cikṣepa tarasā kruddho balānnārāyaṇorasi | tāmāpatantīṃ saṃvīkṣya bāṇenaikena līlayā || 47 || saptadhā kṛtavānāśu saptabhistaṃ jaghāna ha | divyavarṣaśataṃ caiva tadyuddhaṃ paramaṃ tayoḥ || 48 || jātaṃ vismayadaṃ rājan sarveṣāṃ tatra cāśrame | tadā''jagāma tarasā pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ || 49 || prahlādasyāśramaṃ tatra jagāma ca gadādharaḥ | caturbhujo ramākānto rathāṅgadarapadmabhṛt || 50 || dṛṣṭvā tamāgataṃ tatra hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ | praṇamya parayā bhaktyā prāñjaliḥ pratyuvāca ha || 51 || prahlāda uvāca devadeva jaganātha bhaktavatsala mādhava | kathaṃ na jitavānājāvahametau tapasvinau | saṃgrāmastu mayā deva kṛtaḥ pūrṇaṃ śataṃ samāḥ || 52 || surāṇāṃ na jitau kasmāditi me vismayo mahān | viṣṇuruvāca siddhāvimau madaṃśau ca vismayaḥ ko'tra māriṣa || 53 || tāpasau na jitātmānau naranārāyaṇau jitau | gaccha tvaṃ vitalaṃ rājan kuru bhaktiṃ mamācalām || 54 || nābhyāṃ kuru virodhaṃ tvaṃ tāpasābhyāṃ mahāmate | vyāsa uvāca ityājñapto daityarājo niryayāvasuraiḥ saha || 55 || naranārāyaṇau bhūyastapoyuktau babhūvatuḥ || 56 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe prahlādanārāyaṇayoryuddhe viṣṇorāgamanavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <4.10> bhṛguśāpakāraṇavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca sandeho'yaṃ mahānatra pārāśarya kathānake | naranārāyaṇau śāntau vaiṣṇavāṃśau tapodhanau || 1 || tīrthāśrayau sattvayuktau vanyāśanaparau sadā | dharmaputrau mahātmānau tāpasau satyasaṃsthitau || 2 || kathaṃ rāgasamāyuktau jātau yuddhe parasparam | saṃgrāmaṃ cakratuḥ kasmāttyaktvā tapimanuttamām || 3 || prahlādena samaṃ pūrṇaṃ divyavarṣaśataṃ kila | hitvā śāntisukhaṃ yuddhaṃ kṛtavantau kathaṃ munī || 4 || kathaṃ tau cakraturyuddhaṃ prahlādena samaṃ munī | kathayasva mahābhāga kāraṇaṃ vigrahasya vai || 5 || (kāminī kanakaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ vigrahasya vai) || yuddhabuddhiḥ kathaṃ jātā tayośca tadviraktayoḥ | tathāvidhaṃ tapastaptaṃ tābhyāñca kena hetunā || 6 || mohārthaṃ sukhabhogārthaṃ svargārthaṃ vā parantapa | kṛtamatyutkaṭaṃ tābhyāṃ tapaḥ sarvaphalapradam || 7 || munibhyāṃ śāntacittābhyāṃ prāptaṃ kiṃ phalamadbhutam | tapasā pīḍito dehaḥ saṃgrāmeṇa punaḥ punaḥ || 8 || divyavarṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ śrameṇa paripīḍitau | na rājyārthe dhane vāpi na dāreṣu gṛheṣu ca || 9 || kimarthaṃ tu kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ tābhyāṃ tena mahātmanā | nirīhaḥ puruṣaḥ kasmātprakuryādyuddhamīdṛśam || 10 || duḥkhadaṃ sarvathā dehe jānandharmaṃ sanātanam | subuddhiḥ sukhadānīha karmāṇi kurute sadā || 11 || na duḥkhadāni dharmajña sthitireṣā sanātanī | dharmaputrau hareraṃśau sarvajñau sarvabhūṣitau || 12 || kṛtavantau kathaṃ yuddhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dharmavināśakam | tyaktvā tapaḥ samādhītaṃ sukhārāmaṃ mahatphalam || 13 || saṃyugaṃ dāruṇaṃ kṛṣṇa naiva mūrkho'pi vāñchati | śruto mayā yayātistu cyutaḥ svargānmahīpatiḥ || 14 || ahaṅkārabhavātpāpātpātitaḥ pṛthivītale | yajñakṛddānakartā ca dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 15 || śabdoccāraṇamātreṇa pātito vajrapāṇinā | ahaṅkāramṛte yuddhaṃ na bhavatyeva niścayaḥ || 16 || kiṃ phalaṃ tasya yuddhasya muneḥ puṇyavināśanam | vyāsa uvāca rājan saṃsāramūlaṃ hi trividhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 17 || ahaṅkārastu sarvajñairmunibhirdharmaniścaye | sa kathaṃ muninā tyaktuṃ yogyo dehabhṛtā kila || 18 || kāraṇena vinā kāryaṃ na bhavatyeva niścayaḥ | tapo dānaṃ tathā yajñāḥ sāttvikātprabhavanti te || 19 || rājasādvā mahābhāga tāmasātkalahastathā | kriyā svalpāpi rājendra nāhaṅkāraṃ vinā kvacit || 20 || śubhā vāpyaśubhā vāpi prabhavatyapi niścayaḥ | ahaṅkārād bandhakārī nānyo'sti jagatītale || 21 || yenedaṃ racitaṃ viśvaṃ kathaṃ tadrahitaṃ bhavet | brahmā rudrastathā viṣṇurahaṅkārayutāstvamī || 22 || anyeṣāṃ caiva kā vārtā munīnāṃ vasudhādhipa | ahaṅkārāvṛtaṃ viśvaṃ bhramatīdaṃ carācaram || 23 || punarjanma punarmṛtyuḥ sarvaṃ karmavaśānugam | devatiryaṅmanuṣyāṇāṃ saṃsāre'sminmahīpate || 24 || rathāṅgavadasarvārthaṃ bhramaṇaṃ sarvadā smṛtam | viṣṇorapyavatārāṇāṃ saṃkhyāṃ jānāti kaḥ pumān || 25 || vitate'smiṃstu saṃsāre uttamādhamayoniṣu | nārāyaṇo hariḥ sākṣānmātsyaṃ vapurupāśritaḥ || 26 || kāmaṭhaṃ saukaraṃ caiva nārasiṃhañca vāmanam | yuge yuge jagannātho vāsudevo janārdanaḥ || 27 || avatārānasaṃkhyātānkaroti vidhiyantritaḥ | vaivasvate mahārāja saptame bhagavānhariḥ || 28 || manvantare'vatārānvai cakre tāñchruṇu tattvataḥ | bhṛguśāpānmahārāja viṣṇurdevavaraḥ prabhuḥ || 29 || avatārānanekāṃstu kṛtavānakhileśvaraḥ | rājovāca sandeho'yaṃ mahābhāga hṛdaye mama jāyate || 30 || bhṛguṇā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ kathaṃ śaptaḥ pitāmaha | hariṇā ca munestasya vipriyaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ mune || 31 || yadroṣād bhṛguṇā śapto viṣṇurdevanamaskṛtaḥ | vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi bhṛgoḥ śāpasya kāraṇam || 32 || purā kaśyapadāyādo hiraṇyakaśipurnṛpaḥ | yadā tadā suraiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtaṃ saṃkhyaṃ parasparam || 33 || kṛte saṃkhye jagatsarvaṃ vyākulaṃ samajāyata | hate tasminnṛpe rājā prahlādaḥ samajāyata || 34 || devānsa pīḍayāmāsa prahlādaḥ śatrukarṣaṇaḥ | saṃgrāmo hyabhavad ghoraḥ śakraprahlādayostadā || 35 || pūrṇaṃ varṣaśataṃ rājam̐llokavismayakārakam | devairyuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ cograṃ prahrādastu parājitaḥ || 36 || nirvedaṃ paramaṃ prāpto jñātvā dharmaṃ sanātanam | virocanasutaṃ rājye pratiṣṭhāpya baliṃ nṛpa || 37 || jagāma sa tapastaptuṃ parvate gandhamādane | prāpya rājyaṃ baliḥ śrīmānsurairvairaṃ cakāra ha || 38 || yataḥ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ jātaṃ paramadāruṇam | tataḥ surairjitā daityā indreṇāmitatejasā || 39 || viṣṇunā ca sahāyena rājyabhraṣṭāḥ kṛtā nṛpa | tataḥ parājitā daityāḥ kāvyasya śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 40 || kiṃ tvaṃ na kuruṣe brahman sāhāyyaṃ naḥ pratāpavān | sthātuṃ na śaknumo hyatra praviśāmo rasātalam || 41 || yadi tvaṃ na sahāyo'si trātuṃ mantraviduttama | vyāsa uvāca ityuktaḥ so'bravīddaityānkāvyaḥ kāruṇiko muniḥ || 42 || mā bhaiṣṭa dhārayiṣyāmi tejasā svena bho'surāḥ | mantraistathauṣadhībhiśca sāhāyyaṃ vaḥ sadaiva hi || 43 || kariṣyāmi kṛtotsāhā bhavantu vigatajvarāḥ | vyāsa uvāca tataste nirbhayā jātā daityāḥ kāvyasya saṃśrayāt || 44 || devaiḥ śrutastu vṛttāntaḥ sarvaiścāramukhātkila | tatra saṃmantrya te devāḥ śakreṇa ca parasparam || 45 || mantraṃ cakruḥ susaṃvignāḥ kāvyamantraprabhāvataḥ | yoddhuṃ gacchāmahe tūrṇaṃ yāvanna cyāvayanti vai || 46 || prasahya hatvā śiṣṭāṃstu pātālaṃ prāpayāmahe | daityāñjagmustato devāḥ saṃruṣṭāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || 47 || jagmustānviṣṇusahitā dānavān hariṇoditāḥ | vadhyamānāstu te daityāḥ santrastā bhayapīḍitāḥ || 48 || kāvyasya śaraṇaṃ jagmū rakṣa rakṣeti cābruvan | tāñchukraḥ pīḍitāndṛṣṭvā devairdaityānmahābalān || 49 || mā bhaiṣṭeti vacaḥ prāha mantrauṣadhibalādvibhuḥ | dṛṣṭvā kāvyaṃ surāḥ sarve tyaktvā tānprayayuḥ kila || 50 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe bhṛguśāpakāraṇavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <4.11> śukramāturvadhavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tathā gateṣu deveṣu kāvyastānpratyuvāca ha | brahmaṇā pūrvamuktaṃ yacchruṇudhvaṃ dānavottamāḥ || 1 || viṣṇurdaityavadhe yukto haniṣyati janārdanaḥ | vārāharūpaṃ saṃsthāya hiraṇyākṣo yathā hataḥ || 2 || yathā nṛsiṃharūpeṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ | tathā sarvānkṛtotsāho haniṣyati na cānyathā || 3 || na me mantrabalaṃ samyakpratibhāti yathā harim | jetuṃ yūyaṃ samarthāḥ stha mayā trātāḥ surānatha || 4 || tasmātkālaṃ pratīkṣadhvaṃ kiyantaṃ dānavottamāḥ | ahamadya mahādevaṃ mantrārthaṃ pravrajāmi vai || 5 || prāpya mantrānmahādevādāgamiṣyāmi sāmpratam | yuṣmabhyaṃ tānpradāsyāmi yathārthaṃ dānavottamāḥ || 6 || daityā ūcuḥ parājitāḥ kathaṃ sthātuṃ pṛthivyāṃ munisattama | śaktā bhavāmo'pyabalāstāvatkālaṃ pratīkṣitum || 7 || nihatā balinaḥ sarve kecicchiṣṭāśca dānavāḥ | nādya yuktāśca saṃgrāme sthātumevaṃ sukhāvahāḥ || 8 || śukra uvāca yāvadahaṃ mantravidyāmānayiṣyāmi śaṅkarāt | tāvadbhavadbhiḥ sthātavyaṃ tapoyuktaiḥ śamānvitaiḥ || 9 || sāmadānādayaḥ proktā vidvadbhiḥ samayocitāḥ | deśaṃ kālaṃ balaṃ vīrairjñātvā śaktiṃ balaṃ budhaiḥ || 10 || sevātha samaye kāryā śatrūṇāṃ śubhakāmyayā | svaśaktyupacaye kāle hantavyāste manīṣibhiḥ || 11 || tadadya vinayaṃ kṛtvā sāmapūrvaṃ chalena vai | tiṣṭhadhvaṃ svaniketeṣu madāgamanakāṅkṣayā || 12 || prāpya mantrānmahādevādāgamiṣyāmi dānavāḥ | yudhyāmahe punardevānmāntramāsthāya vai balam || 13 || ityuktvātha bhṛgustebhyo jagāma kṛtaniścayaḥ | mahādevaṃ mahārāja mantrārthaṃ munisattamaḥ || 14 || dānavāḥ preṣayāmāsuḥ prahlādaṃ surasannidhau | satyavādinamavyagraṃ surāṇāṃ pratyayapradam || 15 || prahlādastu surānprāha praśrayāvanato nṛpaḥ | asuraiḥ sahitastatra vacanaṃ namratāyutam || 16 || nyastaśastrā vayaṃ sarve niḥsannāhāstathaiva ca | devāstapaścariṣyāmaḥ saṃvṛtā valkalairyutāḥ || 17 || prahlādasya vacaḥ śrutvā satyābhivyāhṛtaṃ tu tat | tato devā nyavartanta vijvarā muditāśca te || 18 || nyastaśastreṣu daityeṣu vinivṛttāstadā surāḥ | viśrabdhāḥ svagṛhāngatvā krīḍāsaktāḥ susaṃsthitāḥ || 19 || daityā dambhaṃ samālambya tāpasāstapisaṃyutāḥ | kaśyapasyāśrame vāsaṃ cakruḥ kāvyāgamecchayā || 20 || kāvyo gatvātha kailāsaṃ mahādevaṃ praṇamya ca | uvāca vibhunā pṛṣṭaḥ kiṃ te kāryamiti prabhuḥ || 21 || mantrānicchāmyahaṃ deva ye na santi bṛhaspatau | parājayāya devānāmasurāṇāṃ jayāya ca || 22 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya sarvajñaḥ śaṅkaraḥ śivaḥ | cintayāmāsa manasā kiṃ kartavyamataḥ param || 23 || sureṣu drohabuddhyāsau mantrārthamiha sāmpratam | prāptaḥ kāvyo gurusteṣāṃ daityānāṃ vijayāya ca || 24 || rakṣaṇīyā mayā devā iti sañcintya śaṅkaraḥ | duṣkaraṃ vratamatyugraṃ tamuvāca maheśvaraḥ || 25 || pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu kaṇadhūmamavākchirāḥ | yadi pāsyasi bhadraṃ te tato mantrānavāpsyasi || 26 || ityukto'sau praṇamyeśaṃ bāḍhamityabravīdvacaḥ | vrataṃ carāmyahaṃ deva tvayājñaptaḥ sureśvara || 27 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā śaṅkaraṃ kāvyaścakāra vratamuttamam | dhūmapānarataḥ śānto mantrārthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ || 28 || tato devāḥ parijñāya kāvyaṃ vratarataṃ tadā | daityāndambharatāṃścaiva babhūvurmantratatparāḥ || 29 || vicārya manasā sarve saṃgrāmāyodyatā nṛpa | yayurdhṛtāyudhāstatra yatra te dānavottamāḥ || 30 || tānāgatānsamīkṣyātha sāyudhāndaṃśitāṃstathā | āsaṃste bhayasaṃvignā daityā devānsamantataḥ || 31 || utpetuḥ sahasā te vai sannaddhānbhayakarśitāḥ | abruvanvacanaṃ tathyaṃ te devānvaladarpitān || 32 || nyastaśastre bhayavati ācārye vratamāsthite | dattvābhayaṃ purā devāḥ samprāptā no jighāṃsayā || 33 || satyaṃ vaḥ kva gataṃ devā dharmaśca śrutinoditaḥ | nyastaśastrā na hantavyā bhītāśca śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 34 || devā ūcuḥ bhavadbhiḥ preṣitaḥ kāvyo mantrārthaṃ kuhakena ca | tapo jñātaṃ hi yuṣmākaṃ tena yudhyāma eva hi || 35 || sajjā bhavantu yuddhāya saṃrabdhāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | śatruśchidreṇa hantavya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 36 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ daityā vicārya ca parasparam | palāyanaparāḥ sarve nirgatā bhayavihvalāḥ || 37 || śaraṇaṃ dānavā jagmurbhītāste kāvyamātaram | dṛṣṭvā tānatisantaptānabhayaṃ ca dadāvatha || 38 || kāvyamātovāca na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyaṃ bhayaṃ tyajata dānavāḥ | matsannidhau vartamānānna bhīrbhavitumarhati || 39 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ daityāḥ sthitāstatra gatavyathāḥ | nirāyudhā hyasaṃbhrāntāstatrāśramavare'surāḥ || 40 || devāstānvidrutānvīkṣya dānavāste padānugāḥ | abhijagmuḥ prasahyaitānavicārya balābalam || 41 || tatrāgatāḥ surāḥ sarve hantuṃ daityānsamudyatāḥ | vāritāḥ kāvyamātrāpi jaghnustānāśramasthitān || 42 || hanyamānānsurairdṛṣṭvā kāvyamātātivepitā | uvāca sarvānsanidrāṃstapasā vai karomyaham || 43 || ityuktvā preritā nidrā tānāgatya papāta ca | sendrā nidrāvaśaṃ yātā devā mūkavadāsthitāḥ || 44 || indraṃ nidrājitaṃ dṛṣṭvā dīnaṃ viṣṇurabhāṣata | māṃ tvaṃ praviśa bhadraṃ te naye tvāṃ ca surottama || 45 || evamuktastato viṣṇuṃ praviveśa purandaraḥ | nirbhayo gatanidraśca babhūva harirakṣitaḥ || 46 || rakṣitaṃ hariṇā dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ tatra gatavyatham | kāvyamātā tataḥ kruddhā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 47 || maghavaṃstvāṃ bhakṣayāmi saviṣṇuṃ vai tapobalāt | paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāmīdṛśaṃ me tapobalam || 48 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktau tu tayā devau viṣṇvindrau yogavidyayā | abhibhūtau mahātmānau stabdhau tau sambabhūvatuḥ || 49 || vismitāstu tadā devā dṛṣṭvā tāvatibādhitau | cakruḥ kilakilāśabdaṃ tataste dīnamānasāḥ || 50 || krośamānānsurāndṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ prāha śacīpatiḥ | viśeṣeṇābhibhūto'smi tvatto'haṃ madhusūdana || 51 || jahyenāṃ tarasā viṣṇo yāvannau na dahetprabho | tapasā darpitāṃ duṣṭāṃ mā vicāraya mādhava || 52 || ityukto bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śakreṇa prathitena ca | cakraṃ sasmāra tarasā ghṛṇāṃ tyaktvātha mādhavaḥ || 53 || smṛtamātraṃ tu samprāptaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇuvaśānugam | dadhāra ca kare kruddho vadhārthaṃ śakranoditaḥ || 54 || gṛhītvā tatkare cakraṃ śiraściccheda raṃhasā | hatāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ śakro muditaścābhavattadā || 55 || devāścātīva santuṣṭā hariṃ jaya jayeti ca | tuṣṭuvurmuditāḥ sarve sañjātā vigatajvarāḥ || 56 || indraviṣṇū tu sañjātau tatkṣaṇāddhṛdayavyathau | strīvadhācchaṃkamānau tu bhṛgoḥ śāpaṃ duratyayam || 57 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe śukramāturvadhavarṇanaṃ nāmekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <4.12> jayantyā śukrasahavāsavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu vadhaṃ ghoraṃ cukrodha bhagavānbhṛguḥ | vepamāno'tiduḥkhārtaḥ provāca madhusūdanam || 1 || bhṛguruvāca akṛtyaṃ te kṛtaṃ viṣṇo jānanpāpaṃ mahāmate | vadho'yaṃ viprajātāyā manasā kartumakṣamaḥ || 2 || ākhyātastvaṃ sattvaguṇaḥ smṛto brahmā ca rājasaḥ | tathāsau tāmasaḥ śambhurviparītaṃ kathaṃ smṛtam || 3 || tāmasastvaṃ kathaṃ jātaḥ kṛtaṃ karmātininditam | avadhyā strī tvayā viṣṇo hatā kasmānnirāgasā || 4 || śapāmi tvāṃ durācāraṃ kimanyatprakaromi te | vidhuro'haṃ kṛtaḥ pāpa tvayāhaṃ śakrakāraṇāt || 5 || na śape'haṃ tathā śakraṃ śape tvāṃ madhusūdana | sadā chalaparo'si tvaṃ kīṭayonirdurāśayaḥ || 6 || ye ca tvāṃ sāttvikaṃ prāhuste mūrkhā munayaḥ kila | tāmasastvaṃ durācāraḥ pratyakṣaṃ me janārdana || 7 || avatārā mṛtyuloke santu macchāpasambhavāḥ | prāyo garbhabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhuṃkṣva pāpājjanārdana || 8 || vyāsa uvāca tatastenātha śāpena naṣṭe dharme punaḥ punaḥ | lokasya ca hitārthāya jāyate mānuṣeṣviha || 9 || rājovāca bhūgubhāryā hatā tatra cakreṇāmitatejasā | gārhasthyañca punastasya kathaṃ jātaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 10 || vyāsa uvāca iti śaptvā hariṃ roṣāttadādāya śirastvaran | kāye saṃyojya tarasā bhṛguḥ provāca kāryavit || 11 || adya tvāṃ viṣṇunā devi hatāṃ sañjīvayāmyaham | yadi kṛtsno mayā dharmo jñāyate carito'pi vā || 12 || tena satyena jīveta yadi satyaṃ bravīmyaham | paśyantu devatāḥ sarvā mama tejobalaṃ mahat || 13 || adbhistvāṃ prokṣya śītābhirjīvayāmi tapobalāt | satyaṃ śaucaṃ tathā vedā yadi me tapaso balam || 14 || vyāsa uvāca adbhiḥ samprokṣitā devī sadyaḥ sañjīvitā tadā | utthitā paramaprītā bhṛgorbhāryā śucismitā || 15 || tatastāṃ sarvabhūtāni dṛṣṭvā suptotthitāmiva | sādhu sādhviti taṃ tāṃ tu tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvato diśam || 16 || evaṃ sañcīvitā tena bhṛguṇā varavarṇinī | vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmurdevāḥ sendrā vilokya tat || 17 || indraḥ surānathovāca muninā jīvitā satī | kāvyastaptvā tapo ghoraṃ kiṃ kariṣyati mantravit || 18 || vyāsa uvāca gatā nidrā surendrasya dehe'kṣemamabhūnnṛpa | smṛtvā kāvyasya vṛttāntaṃ mantrārthamatidāruṇam || 19 || vimṛśya manasā śakro jayantīṃ svasutāṃ tadā | uvāca kanyāṃ cārvaṅgīṃ smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 20 || gaccha putri mayā dattā kāvyāya tvaṃ tapasvine | samārādhaya tanvaṅgi matkṛte taṃ vaśaṃ kuru || 21 || upacārairmuniṃ taistaiḥ samārādhya manaḥpriyaiḥ | bhayaṃ me tarasā gatvā hara tatra varāśrame || 22 | sā piturvacanaṃ śrutvā tatrāgacchanmanoramā | tamapaśyadviśālākṣī pibantaṃ dhūmamāśrame || 23 || tasya dehaṃ samālokya smṛtvā vākyaṃ pitustadā | kadalīdalamādāya vījayāmāsa taṃ munim || 24 || nirmalaṃ śītalaṃ vāri samānīya suvāsitam | pānāya kalpayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā laghu || 25 || chāyāṃ vastrātapatreṇa bhāskare madhyage sati | racayāmāsa tanvaṅgī svayaṃ dharme sthitā satī || 26 || phalānyānīya divyāni pakvāni madhurāṇi ca | mumocāgre munestasya bhakṣārthaṃ vihitāni ca || 27 || kuśāḥ prādeśamātrā hi haritāḥ śukasannibhāḥ | dadhārāgre'tha puṣpāṇi nityakarmasamṛddhaye || 28 || nidrārthaṃ kalpayāmāsa saṃstaraṃ pallavānvitam | tasminmunau cādarasthā cakāra vyajanaṃ śanaiḥ || 29 || hāvabhāvādikaṃ kiñcidvikārajananaṃ ca tat | na cakāra jayantī sā śāpabhītā munestadā || 30 || stutiṃ cakāra tanvaṅgī gīrbhistasya mahātmanaḥ | subhāṣiṇyanukūlābhiḥ prītikartrībhirapyuta || 31 || prabuddhe jalamādāya dadhārācamanāya ca | mano'nukūlaṃ satataṃ kurvantī vyacarattadā || 32 || indro'pi sevakāṃstatra preṣayāmāsa cāturaḥ | pravṛttiṃ jñātukāmo vai munestasya jitātmanaḥ || 33 || evaṃ bahūni varṣāṇi paricaryāparābhavat | nirvikārā jitakrodhā brahmacaryaparā satī || 34 || pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu parituṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | vareṇa chandayāmāsa kāvyaṃ prītamanā haraḥ || 35 || īśvara uvāca yacca kiñcidapi brahmanvidyate bhṛgunandana | pratipaśyasi yatsarvaṃ yacca vācyaṃ na kasyacit || 36 || sarvābhibhāvakatvena bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ prajeśaśca dvijottamaḥ || 37 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ dattvā varāñchambhustatraivāntaradhīyata | kāvyastāmatha saṃvīkṣya jayantīṃ vākyamabravīt || 38 || kāsi kasyāsi suśroṇi brūhi kiṃ te cikīrṣitam | kimarthamiha samprāptā kāryaṃ vada varoru me || 39 || kiṃ vāñchasi karomyadya duṣkaraṃ cetsulocane | prīto'smi tvatkṛtenādya varaṃ varaya suvrate || 40 || tataḥ sā tu muniṃ prāha jayantī muditānanā | cikīrṣitaṃ me bhagavaṃstapasā jñātumarhasi || 41 || śukra uvāca jñātaṃ mayā tathāpi tvaṃ brūhi yanmanasepsitam | karomi sarvathā bhadraṃ prīto'smi paricaryayā || 42 || jayantyuvāca śakrasyāhaṃ sutā brahman pitrā tubhyaṃ samarpitā | jayantī nāmataścāhaṃ jayantāvarajā mune || 43 || sakāmāsmi tvayi vibho vāñchitaṃ kuru me'dhunā | raṃsye tvayā mahābhāga dharmataḥ prītipūrvakam || 44 || śukra uvāca mayā saha tvaṃ suśroṇi daśavarṣāṇi bhāmini | sarvairbhūtairadṛśyā ca ramasveha yadṛcchayā || 45 || vyāsa uvāca evamuktvā gṛhaṃ gatvā jayantyāḥ pāṇimudvahan | tayā sahāvasaddevyā daśavarṣāṇi bhārgavaḥ || 46 || adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ māyayā saṃvṛtaḥ prabhuḥ | daityāstamāgataṃ śrutvā kṛtārthaṃ mantrasaṃyutam || 47 || abhijagmurgṛhe tasya muditāste didṛkṣavaḥ | nāpaśyan ramamāṇaṃ te jayantyā saha saṃyutam || 48 || tadā vimanasaḥ sarve jātā bhagnodyamāśca te | cintāparātidīnāśca vīkṣamāṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 49 || adṛṣṭvā taṃ tu saṃvṛttaṃ pratijagmuryathāgatam | svagṛhāndaityavaryāste cintāviṣṭā bhayāturāḥ || 50 || ramamāṇaṃ tathā jñātvā śakraḥ provāca taṃ gurum | bṛhaspatiṃ mahābhāga kiṃ kartavyamitaḥ param || 51 || gacchādya dānavānbrahmanmāyayā tvaṃ pralobhaya | asmākaṃ kuru kāryaṃ tvaṃ buddhyā sañcintya mānada || 52 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ kāvyaṃ ramamāṇaṃ susaṃvṛtam | jñātvā tadrūpamāsthāya daityānmati yayau guruḥ || 53 || gatvā tatrātibhaktyāsau dānavānsamupāhvayat | āgatāste'surāḥ sarve dadṛśuḥ kāvyamagrataḥ || 54 || praṇamya saṃsthitāḥ sarve kāvyaṃ matvātimohitāḥ | na viduste gurormāyāṃ kāvyarūpavibhāvinīm || 55 || tānuvāca guruḥ kāvyarūpaḥ pracchannamāyayā | svāgataṃ mama yājyānāṃ prāpto'haṃ vo hitāya vai || 56 || ahaṃ vo bodhayiṣyāmi vidyāṃ prāptāmamāyayā | tapasā toṣitaḥ śambhuryuṣmatkalyāṇahetave || 57 || tacchrutvā prītamanaso jātāste dānavottamāḥ | kṛtakāryaṃ guruṃ matvā jahṛṣuste vimohitāḥ || 58 || praṇemuste mudā yuktā nirātaṅkā gatavyathāḥ | devebhyaśca bhayaṃ tyaktvā tasthuḥ sarve nirāmayāḥ || 59 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe jayantyā śukrasahavāsavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <4.13> śukrarūpeṇa guruṇā daityavañcanāvarṇanam rājovāca kiṃ kṛtaṃ guruṇā paścādbhṛgurūpeṇa vartatā | chalenaiva hi daityānāṃ paurohityena dhīmatā || 1 || guruḥ surāṇāmaniśaṃ sarvavidyānidhistathā | suto'ṅgirasa evāsau sa kathaṃ chalakṛnmuniḥ || 2 || dharmaśāstreṣu sarveṣu satyaṃ dharmasya kāraṇam | kathitaṃ munibhiryena paramātmāpi labhyate || 3 || vācaspatistathā mithyāvaktā ceddānavānprati | kaḥ satyavaktā saṃsāre bhaviṣyati gṛhāśramī || 4 || āhārādadhikaṃ bhojyaṃ jrahmāṇḍavibhave'pi na | tadarthaṃ munayo mithyā pravartante kathaṃ mune || 5 || śabdapramāṇamucchedaṃ śiṣṭābhāve gataṃ na kim | chalakarmapravṛtte vāvigītatvaṃ gurau katham || 6 || devāḥ sattvasamudbhūtā rājasā mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ | tiryañcastāmasāḥ proktā utpattau munibhiḥ kila || 7 || amarāṇāṃ guruḥ sākṣānmithyāvādī svayaṃ yadi | tadā kaḥ satyavaktā syādrājasastāmasaḥ punaḥ || 8 || kva sthitistasya dharmasya sandeho'yaṃ mamātmanaḥ | kā gatiḥ sarvajantūnāṃ mithyābhūte jagattraye || 9 || harirbrahmā śacīkāntastathānye surasattamāḥ | sarve chalavidhau dakṣā manuṣyāṇāñca kā kathā || 10 || kāmakrodhābhisantaptā lobhopahatacetasaḥ | chale dakṣāḥ surāḥ sarve munayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 11 || vasiṣṭho vāmadevaśca viśvāmitro gurustathā | ete pāparatāḥ kātra gatirdharmasya mānada || 12 || indro'gniścandramā vedhāḥ paradārābhilampaṭāḥ | āryatvaṃ bhuvaneṣveṣu sthitaṃ kutra mune vada || 13 || vacanaṃ kasya mantavyamupadeśadhiyānagha | sarve lobhābhibhūtāste devāśca munayastadā || 14 || vyāsa uvāca kiṃ viṣṇuḥ kiṃ śivo brahmā maghavā kiṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | dehavān prabhavatyeva vikāraiḥ saṃyutastadā || 15 || rāgī viṣṇuḥ śivo rāgī brahmāpi rāgasaṃyutaḥ | (rāgavānkimakṛtyaṃ vai na karoti narādhipa) || rāgavānapi cāturyādvideha iva lakṣyate || 16 || samprāpte saṃkaṭe so'pi guṇaiḥ sambādhyate kila | kāraṇādrahitaṃ kāryaṃ kathaṃ bhavitumarhati || 17 || brahmādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ guṇā eva hi kāraṇam | pañcaviṃśatsamudbhūtā dehāsteṣāṃ na cānyathā || 18 || kāle maraṇadharmāste sandehaḥ ko'tra te nṛpa | paropadeśe vispaṣṭaṃ śiṣṭāḥ sarve bhavanti ca || 19 || viplutirhyaviśeṣeṇa svakārye samupasthite | kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhadrohāhaṅkāramatsarāḥ || 20 || dehavānkaḥ parityaktumīśo bhavati tānpunaḥ | saṃsāro'yaṃ mahārāja sadaivaivaṃvidhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 21 || nānyathā prabhavatyeva śubhāśubhamayaḥ kila | kadācidbhagavānviṣṇustapaścarati dāruṇam || 22 || kadācidvividhānyajñānvitanoti surādhipaḥ | kadācittu ramāraṅgarañjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 23 || ramate kila vaikuṇṭhe tadvaśastaruṇo vibhuḥ | kadāciddānavaiḥ sārdhaṃ yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam || 24 || karoti karuṇāsindhustadbāṇāpīḍito bhṛśam | kadācijjayamāpnoti daivātso'pi parājayam || 25 || sukhaduḥkhābhibhūto'sau bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | śeṣe śete kadācidvai yoganidrāsamāvṛtaḥ || 26 || kāle jāgarti viśvātmā svabhāvapratibodhitaḥ | śarvo brahmā hariśceti indrādyā ye surāstathā || 27 || munayaśca vinirmāṇaiḥ svāyuṣo vicaranti hi | niśāvasāne sañjāte jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam || 28 || mriyate nātra sandeho nṛpa kiñcitkadāpi ca | svāyuṣo'nte padyajādyāḥ kṣayamṛcchanti pārthiva || 29 || prabhavanti punarviṣṇuharaśakrādayaḥ surāḥ | tasmātkāmādikānbhāvāndehavānpratipadyate || 30 || nātra te vismayaḥ kāryaḥ kadācidapi pārthiva | saṃsāro'yaṃ tu sandigdhaḥ kāmakrodhādibhirnṛpa || 31 || durlabhastadvinirmuktaḥ puruṣaḥ paramārthavit | yo bibhetīha saṃsāre sa dārānna karotyapi || 32 || vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo vicaratyaviśaṅkitaḥ | tasmādbṛhaspaterbhāryā śaśinā lambhitā punaḥ || 33 || gurūṇā lambhitā bhāryā tathā bhrāturyavīyasaḥ | evaṃ saṃsāracakre'smin rāgalobhādibhirvṛtaḥ || 34 || gārhasthyañca samāsthāya kathaṃ mukto bhavennaraḥ | tasmātsarvaprayatnena hitvā saṃsārasāratām || 35 || ārādhayenmaheśānīṃ saccidānandarūpiṇīm | tanmāyāguṇataśchannaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || 36 || bhramatyunmattavatsarvaṃ madirāmattavannṛpa | tasyā ārādhanenaiva guṇānsarvānvimṛdya ca || 37 || muktiṃ bhajeta matimānnānyaḥ panthāstvitaḥ paraḥ | ārādhitā maheśānī na yāvatkurute kṛpām || 38 || tāvadbhavetsukhaṃ kasmātko'nyo'sti dayayā yutaḥ | karuṇāsāgarāmetāṃ bhajettasmādamāyayā || 39 || yasyāstu bhajanenaiva jīvanmuktatvamaśnute | mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya sevitā na maheśvarī || 40 || niḥśreṇikāgrātpatitā adha ityeva vidmahe | ahaṅkārāvṛtaṃ viśvaṃ guṇatrayasamanvitam || 41 || asatyenāpi sambaddhaṃ mucyate kathamanyathā | hitvā sarvaṃ tataḥ sarveḥ saṃsevyā bhuvaneśvarī || 42 || rājovāca kiṃ kṛtaṃ gurūṇā tatra kāvyarūpadhareṇa ca | kadā śukraḥ samāyātastanme brūhi pitāmaha || 43 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi yatkṛtaṃ guruṇā tadā | kṛtvā kāvyasvarūpañca pracchannena mahātmanā || 44 || guruṇā bodhitā daityā matvā kāvyaṃ svakaṃ gurum | viśvāsaṃ paramaṃ kṛtvā babhūvustanmayāstadā || 45 || vidyārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā bhṛguṃ matvātimohitāḥ | guruṇā vipralabdhāste lobhātko vā na muhyati || 46 || daśavarṣātmake kāle sampūrṇasamaye tadā | jayantyā saha krīḍitvā kāvyo yājyānacintayat || 47 || āśayā mama mārgaṃ te paśyantaḥ saṃsthitāḥ kila | gatvā tānvai prapaśye'haṃ yājyānatibhayāturān || 48 || mā devebhyo bhayaṃ teṣāṃ madbhaktānāṃ bhavediti | sañcintya buddhimāsthāya jayantīṃ pratyuvāca ha || 49 || devānevopasaṃyānti putrā me cārulocane | samayaste'dya sampūrṇo jāto'yaṃ daśavārṣikaḥ || 50 || tasmād gacchāmyahaṃ devi draṣṭuṃ yājyānsumadhyame | punarevāgamiṣyāmi tavāntikamanudrutaḥ || 51 || tatheti tamuvācātha jayantī dharmavittamā | yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha dharmajña na te dharmaṃ vilopaye || 52 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ kāvyo jagāma tvaritastataḥ | apaśyaddānavānāṃ ca pārśve vācaspatiṃ tadā || 53 || chadmarūpadharaṃ saumyaṃ bodhayantaṃ chalena tān | jainaṃ dharmaṃ kṛtaṃ svena yajñanindāparaṃ tathā || 54 || bho devaripavaḥ satyaṃ bravīmi bhavatāṃ hitam | ahiṃsā paramo dharmo'hantavyā hyātatāyinaḥ || 55 || dvijairbhogaratairvede darśitaṃ hiṃsanaṃ paśoḥ | jihvāsvādaparaiḥ kāmamahiṃsaiva parā matā || 56 || evaṃvidhāni vākyāni vedaśāstraparāṇi ca | bruvāṇaṃ gurumākarṇya vismito'sau bhṛgoḥ sutaḥ || 57 || cintayāmāsa manasā mama dveṣyo guruḥ kila | vañcitāḥ kila dhūrtena yājyā me nātra saṃśayaḥ || 58 || dhiglobhaṃ pāpabījaṃ vai narakadvāramūrjitam | gururapyanṛtaṃ brūte prerito yena pāpmanā || 59 || pramāṇaṃ vacanaṃ yasya so'pi pākhaṇḍadhārakaḥ | guruḥ surāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ dharmaśāstrapravartakaḥ || 60 || kiṃ kiṃ na labhate lobhānmalinīkṛtamānasaḥ | anyo'pi gururapyevaṃ jātaḥ pākhaṇḍapaṇḍitaḥ || 61 || śailūṣaceṣṭitaṃ sarvaṃ parigṛhya dvijottamaḥ | vañjayatyatisammūḍhāndaityānyājyānmamāpyasau || 62 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe śukrarūpeṇa guruṇā daityavañcanāvarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <4.14> prahlādena śukrakopasāntvanam vyāsa uvāca || iti saṃciṃtya manasā tānuvāca hasanniva || vaṃcitā matsvarūpeṇa daityāḥ kiṃ guruṇā kila ||1|| ahaṃ kāvyo guruścā'yaṃ devakāryaprasādakaḥ || anena vaṃcitā yūyaṃ madyājyā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || mā śraddhadhvaṃ vaco'syā''ryā dābhiko'yaṃ madā kṛtiḥ || anugacchata māṃ yājyāstyajatainaṃ bṛhaspatim || 3 || ityākarṇya vacastasya dṛṣṭvā tau sadṛśau punaḥ || vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ kāvyo'yamiti niścitāḥ || 4 || sa tānvīkṣya susaṃbhrātāngururvākyamuvāca ha || gururvo vaṃcayatyeva madrūpo'yaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ || 5 || prāpto vaṃcayituṃ yuṣmāndevakāryārthasiddhaye || mā viśvāsaṃ vacasyasya kurudhvaṃ daityasattamāḥ || 6 || prāptā vidyā mayā śaṃbhoryuṣmānadhyāpa yāmi tām || devebhyo vijayaṃ nūnaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 7 || iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ kāvyaṃ rūpadharasya te || niśvāsaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ kāvyo'yamiti niścayāt|| 8 || kāvyena bahudhā tatra bodhitāḥ kila dānavāḥ || bubudhurna gurormāyāmohitāḥ kāla paryayāt || 9 || evaṃ te niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato bhārgavamabruvan || ayaṃ gururno dharmātmā buddhidaśca hite rataḥ || 4.14.10 || daśavarṣāṇi satatamayaṃ naḥ śāsti bhārgavaḥ || gaccha tvaṃ kuhako bhāsi nā'smākaṃ gururapyuta || 11 || ityuktvā bhārgavaṃ mūḍhā nirbhartsya ca punaḥ punaḥ || jagṛhustaṃ guruṃ prītyā praṇipatyā 'bhivādya ca ||12 || kāvyastu tanmayāndṛṣṭvā cukopā'tha śaśāpa ca || daityānvibodhi tānmatvā guruṇā cātivaṃcitān || 13 || yasmānmayā bodhitā vai gṛhṇīyurna ca me vacaḥ|| tasmātpranaṣṭasaṃjñā vai parābhavamavāpsyatha || 14 || madavajñāphalaṃ kāmaṃ svalpe kāle hyavāpsyatha|| tadā'sya kapaṭaṃ sarvaṃ parijñātaṃ bhaviṣyati||15|| vyāsa uvāca || ityuktvā'sau jagāmā'śu bhārgavaḥ krodhasaṃyutaḥ || bṛhaspatirmudaṃ prāpya tasthau tatra samāhitaḥ || 16 || tataḥ śaptānguru rjñātvā daityāṃstānbhārgaveṇa hi || jagāma tarasā tyaktvā svarūpaṃ svaṃ vidhāya ca || 17 || gatvovāca tadā śakraṃ kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ mayā dhuvam || śaptāḥ śukreṇa te daityā mayā tyaktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||18|| nirādhārā kṛtā nūnaṃ yatadhvaṃ surasattamāḥ || saṃgrāmārthaṃ mahābhāga śāpadagdhā mayā kṛtāḥ || 19 || iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ maghavā mudamāptavān || jahṛṣuśca surāḥ sarve pratipūjya bṛhaspatim || 4.14.20 || saṃgrāmāya matiṃ cakruḥ saṃvicārya mithaḥ punaḥ || niryayurmilitā sarve dānavā'bhimukhāḥ surāḥ || 21 || surānsamudyatānjñātvā kṛtodyogānmahābalān || aṃtarhitaṃ guruṃ caiva babhūvuściṃtayā'nvitāḥ || 22 || parasparamathocuste mohitāstasya māyayā || saṃprasādyo mahātmā ca yāto'sau ruṣṭamānasaḥ ||23|| vaṃcayitvā gataḥ pāpo guruḥ kapaṭapaṃḍitaḥ || bhrātṛstrīlaṃbhanaḥ prāyo malinoṃ'tarbahiḥ śuciḥ || 24 || kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ kathaṃ kāvyaṃ prakopitam || kūrvīmahi sahāyārthaṃ prasannaṃ hṛṣṭamānasam || 25 || iti saṃciṃtya te sarve militā bhayakaṃpitāḥ || prahlādaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā jagmuste bhārgavaṃ punaḥ || 26 || praṇemuścaraṇau tasya munermaunabhṛtastadā || bhārgavastānuvācātha roṣasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 27 || mayā prabodhitā yūyaṃ mohitā gurumāyayā || na gṛhītaṃ vaco yogyaṃ tadā yājyā hitaṃ śuci ||28|| tadā'vagaṇitaścāhaṃ bhavadbhistadvaśaṃ gataiḥ || prāptaṃ nūnaṃ madonmattairmamā'vamānajaṃ phalam || 29 || tatra gacchata sadbhraṣṭā yatrāsau kapaṭākṛtiḥ || vaṃcakaḥ surakāryārthī nāhaṃ tadvaddhi vaṃcakaḥ || 4.14.30 || vyāsa uvāca || evaṃ bruvataṃ śukraṃ tu vākyaṃ saṃdigdhayā girā || prahlādastaṃ tadovāca gṛhītvā caraṇau tataḥ || 31 || prahlāda uvāca || bhārgavā'dya samāyātānyājyānasmāṃstathā''turān || tyaktuṃ nārhasi sarvajña tvaddhitāṃstanayānhi naḥ || 32 || gate tvayi tu maṃtrārthaṃ śailūṣeṇa durātmanā || tvadveṣamadhurā''lāpairvayaṃ tena pravaṃcitāḥ || 33 || ajñānakṛtadoṣeṇa naiva kupyati śāṃtimān || sarvajñastvaṃ vijānāsi cittaṃ naḥ pravaṇaṃ tvayi || 34 || jñātvā nastapasā bhāvaṃ tyaja kopaṃ mahāmate || bruvaṃti munayaḥ sarve kṣaṇakopāhi sādhavaḥ || 35 || jalaṃ svabhāvata śītaṃ vahnyātapa samāga māt || bhavatyuṣṇaṃ viyogācca śītatvamanugacchati || 36 || krodhaścāṃḍālarūpo vai tyaktavyaḥ sarvathā budhaiḥ || tasmādroṣaṃ parityajya prasādaṃ kuru suvrata || 37 || yadi na tyajasi krodhaṃ tyajasyasmānsuduḥkhitān || tvayā tyaktā mahābhāga gamiṣyāmo rasātalam || 38 || vyāsa uvāca || prahlādasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhārgavo jñānacakṣuṣā || vilokya sumanā bhūtvā tānuvāca hasanniva || 39 || na bhetavyaṃ na gaṃtavyaṃ dānavā vā rasātalam || rakṣayiṣyāmi vo yājyānmaṃtrairavitathaiḥ kila || 4.14.40 || hitaṃ satyaṃ bravīmyadya śṛṇudhvaṃ tattu niścayam || vacanaṃ mama dharmajñāḥ śrutaṃ yadbrahmaṇaḥ purā || 41 || avaśyaṃbhāvino bhāvāḥ prabhavaṃti śubhā'śubhāḥ || devaṃ na cā'nyathā kartuṃ kṣamaḥ ko'pi dharātale || 42 || adya maṃdabalā yūyaṃ kālayogādasaṃśayam || devairjitāḥ sakṛccā'pi pātālaṃ pratipatsyatha || 43 || prāptaḥ paryāyakālo vai iti brahmā'bhyabhāṣata || bhuktaṃ rājyaṃ bhavadbhiśca pūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ samṛddhimat || 44 || yugāni daśa pūrṇāni devānākramya mūrdhani || daivayogācca yusmābhirbhuktaṃ trailokyamūrjitam || 45 || sāvarṇike manau rājyaṃ punastattu bhaviṣyati || pautrastrailokya vijayī rājyaṃ prāpsyati te baliḥ || 46 || yadā vāmanarūpeṇa hṛtaṃ devena viṣṇunā || tadaiva ca bhavatpautraḥ prokto devena jiṣṇunā ||47|| hṛtaṃ yena bale rājyaṃ devavāṃchārtha siddhaye || tvamiṃdro bhavitā cāgre sthite sāvarṇike manau ||48|| bhārgava uvāca || ityukto hariṇā pautrastava prahlāda sāṃpratam || adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ guptaścarati bhītavat || 49 || ekadā vāsavenāsau balirgardabharūpabhāk || śūnye gṛhe sthitaḥ kāmaṃ bhayabhītaḥ śatakrato || 4.14.50 || pṛṣṭaśca bahudhā tena vāsavena balistadā || kimarthaṃ gārdabhaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtavāndaityapuṃgava || 51 || bhoktā tvaṃ sarvalokasya daityānāṃ ca praśāsitā || na lajjā khararūpeṇa tava rākṣasasattama || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityarājo balistadā || 52 || provāca vacanaṃ śakraṃ ko'tra śokaḥ śatakrato || yathā viṣṇurmahātejā matsyakacchapatāṃ gataḥ ||53|| tathā'haṃ khararūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ kālayogataḥ || yathā tvaṃ kamale līnaḥ saṃsthito brahmahatyayā || 54 || pīḍitaśca tathā hyadya sthito'haṃ khararūpadhṛk || daivādhīnasya kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ sukhaṃ pākaśāsana || 55 || kālaḥ karoti vai nūnaṃ yadicchati yathā tathā || bhārgava uvāca || iti tau balideveśau kṛtvā saṃvidamuttamām || 56 || prabodhaṃ prāpatuḥ kāmaṃ yathāsthānaṃ ca jagmatuḥ || ityetatte samākhyātā mayā daivabaliṣṭhatā ||57|| daivādhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam ||58|| iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe caturthaskaṃdhe caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <4.15> devīkathanena dānavānāṃ rasātalaṃ prati gamanam vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ | prahlādastu susaṃhṛṣṭo babhūva nṛpanandanaḥ || 1 || jñātvā daivaṃ baliṣṭhañca prahlādastānuvāca ha | kṛte'pi yuddhe na jayo bhaviṣyati kadācana || 2 || tadā te jayinaḥ procurdānavā madagarvitāḥ | saṃgrāmastu prakartavyo daivaṃ kiṃ na vidāmahe || 3 || nirudyamānāṃ daivaṃ hi pradhānamasurādhipa | kena dṛṣṭaṃ kva vā dṛṣṭaṃ kīdṛśaṃ kena nirmitam || 4 || tasmādyuddhaṃ kariṣyāmo balamāsthāya sāmpratam | bhavāgre daityavarya tvaṃ sarvajño'si mahāmate || 5 || ityuktastaistadā rājan prahlādaḥ prabalārihā | senānīśca tadā bhūtvā devānyuddhe samāhvayat || 6 || te'pi tatrāsurāndṛṣṭvā saṃgrāme samupasthitān | sarve sambhṛtasambhārā devāstānsamayodhayan || 7 || saṃgrāmastu tadā ghoraḥ śakraprahlādayorabhūt | pūrṇaṃ varṣaśataṃ tatra munīnāṃ vismayāvahaḥ || 8 || vartamāne mahāyuddhe śukreṇa pratipālitāḥ | jayamāpustadā daityāḥ prahlādapramukhā nṛpa || 9 || tadaivendro gurorvākyātsarvaduḥkhavināśinīm | sasmāra manasā devīṃ muktidāṃ paramāṃ śivām || 10 || indra uvāca jaya devi mahāmāye śūladhāriṇi cāmbike | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmakhaḍgahaste'bhayaprade || 11 || namaste bhuvaneśāni śaktidarśananāyike | daśatattvātmike mātarmahābindusvarūpiṇi || 12 || mahākuṇḍalinīrūpe saccidānandarūpiṇi | prāṇāgnihotravidye te namo dīpaśikhātmike || 13 || pañcakośāntaragate pucchabrahmasvarūpiṇi | ānandakalike mātaḥ sarvopaniṣadarcite || 14 || mātaḥ prasīda sumukhī bhava hīnasattvāṃstrāyasva no janani daityaparājitān vai | tvaṃ devi naḥ śaraṇadā bhuvane pramāṇā śaktāsi duḥkhaśamane'khilavīryayukte || 15 || dhyāyanti ye'pi sukhino nitarāṃ bhavanti duḥkhānvitāvigataśokabhayāstathānye | mokṣārthino vigatamānavimuktasaṅgāḥ saṃsāravāridhijalaṃ prataranti santaḥ || 16 || tvaṃ devi viśvajanani prathitaprabhāvā saṃrakṣaṇārthamuditārtiharapratāpā | saṃhartumetadakhilaṃ kila kālarūpā ko vetti te'mba caritaṃ nanu mandabuddhiḥ || 17 || brahmā haraśca haridaśvaratho hariśca indro yamo'tha varuṇo'gnisamīraṇau ca | jñātuṃ kṣamā na munayo'pi mahānubhāvā yasyāḥ prabhāvamatulaṃ nigamāgamāśca || 18 || dhanyāsta eva tava bhaktiparā mahāntaḥ saṃsāraduḥkharahitāḥ sukhasindhumagnāḥ | ye bhaktibhāvarahitā na kadāpi duḥkhāmbhodhiṃ janikṣayataraṅgamume taranti || 19 || ye vījyamānāḥ sitacāmaraiśca krīḍanti dhanyāḥ śibikādhirūḍhāḥ | taiḥ pūjitā tvaṃ kila pūrvadehe nānopahārairiti cintayāmi || 20 || ye pūjyamānā varavāraṇasthā vilāsinīvṛndavilāsayuktāḥ | sāmantakaiścopanatairvrajanti manye hi taistvaṃ kila pūjitāsi || 21 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ stutā maghavatā devī viśveśvarī tadā | prādurbabhūva tarasā siṃhārūḍhā caturbhujā || 22 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmānbibhratī cārulocanā | raktāmbaradharā devī divyamālyavibhūṣaṇā || 23 || tānuvāca surāndevī prasannavadanā girā | bhayaṃ tyajantu bho devāḥ śaṃ vidhāsye kilādhunā || 24 || ityuktvā sā tadā devī siṃhārūḍhātisundarī | jagāma tarasā tatra yatra daityā madānvitāḥ || 25 || prahlādapramukhāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā devīṃ puraḥsthitām | ūcuḥ parasparaṃ bhītāḥ kiṃ kartavyamitastadā || 26 || devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cātra samprāptā caṇḍikā kila | mahiṣāntakarī nūnaṃ caṇḍamuṇḍavināśinī || 27 || nihaniṣyati naḥ sarvānambikā nātra saṃśayaḥ | vakradṛṣṭyā yayā pūrvaṃ nihatau madhukaiṭabhau || 28 || evaṃ cintāturānvīkṣya prahlādastānuvāca ha | yoddhavyaṃ nātha gantavyaṃ palāyya dānavottamāḥ || 29 || namucistānuvācātha palāyanaparāniha | haniṣyati jaganmātā ruṣitā kila hetibhiḥ || 30 || tathā kuru mahābhāga yathā duḥkhaṃ na jāyate | vrajāmo'dyaiva pātālaṃ tāṃ stutvā tadanujñayā || 31 || prahlāda uvāca staumi devīṃ mahāmāyāṃ sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇīm | sarveṣāṃ jananīṃ śaktiṃ bhaktānāmabhayaṅkarīm || 32 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktyā viṣṇubhaktastu prahlādaḥ paramārthavit | tuṣṭāva jagatāṃ dhātrīṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭastadā || 33 || mālāsarpavadābhāti yasyāṃ sarvaṃ carācaram | sarvādhiṣṭhānarūpāyai tasyai hrīṃmūrtaye namaḥ || 34 || tvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ viśvaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā | anye nimittamātrāste kartārastava nirmitāḥ || 35 || namo devi mahāmāye sarveṣāṃ jananī smṛtā | ko bhedastava deveṣu daityeṣu svakṛteṣu ca || 36 || mātuḥ putreṣu ko bhedo'pyaśubheṣu śubheṣu ca | tathaiva deveṣvasmāsu na kartavyastvayādhunā || 37 || yādṛśāstādṛśā mātaḥ sutāste dānavāḥ kila | yatastvaṃ viśvajananī purāṇeṣu prakīrtitā || 38 || te'pi svārthaparā nūnaṃ yathaiva vayamapyuta | nāntaraṃ daityasurayorbhedo'yaṃ mohasambhavaḥ || 39 || dhanadārādibhogeṣu vayaṃ saktā divāniśam | tathaiva devā deveśi ko bhedo'suradevayoḥ || 40 || te'pi kaśyapadāyādā vayaṃ tatsambhavāḥ kila | kuto virodhasambhūtirjātā mātastavādhunā || 41 || na tathā vihitaṃ mātastvayi sarvasamudbhave | sāmyataiva tvayā sthāpyā deveṣvasmāsu caiva hi || 42 || guṇavyatikarātsarve samutpannāḥ surāsurāḥ | guṇānvitā bhaveyuste kathaṃ dehabhṛto'marāḥ || 43 || kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca sarvadeheṣu saṃsthitāḥ | vartante sarvadā tasmāt ko'virodhī bhaveñcanaḥ || 44 || tvayā mitho virodho'yaṃ kalpitaḥ kila kautukāt | manyāmahe vibhedena nūnaṃ yuddhadidṛkṣayā || 45 || anyathā khalu bhrātṝṇāṃ virodhaḥ kīdṛśo'naghe | tvaṃ cennecchasi cāmuṇḍe vīkṣituṃ kalahaṃ kila || 46 || jānāmi dharmaṃ dharmajñe vedmi cāhaṃ śatakratum | tathāpi kalaho'smākaṃ bhogārthaṃ devi sarvadā || 47 || ekaḥ ko'pi na śāstāsti saṃsāre tvāṃ vināmbike | spṛhāvatastu kaḥ kartuṃ kṣamate vacanaṃ budhaḥ || 48 || devāsurairayaṃ sindhurmathitaḥ samaye kvacit | viṣṇunā vihito bhedaḥ sudhāratnacchalena vai || 49 || tvayāsau kalpitaḥ śauriḥ pālakatve jagadguruḥ | tena lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ lobhād gṛhītāmarasundarī || 50 || airāvatastathendreṇa pārijāto'tha kāmadhuk | uccaiḥśravāḥ suraiḥ sarvaṃ gṛhītaṃ vaiṣṇavecchayā || 51 || anayaṃ tādṛśaṃ kṛtvā jātā devāstu sādhavaḥ | (anyāyinaḥ surā nūnaṃ paśya tvaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam |) || saṃsthāpitāḥ surā nūnaṃ viṣṇunā bahumāninā || 52 || nūnaṃ daityāḥ parābhūvanpaśya tvaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam | kva dharmaḥ kīdṛśo dharmaḥ kva kāryaṃ kva ca sādhutā || 53 || kathayāmi ca kasyāgre siddhaṃ maimāṃsikaṃ matam | tārkikā yuktivādajñā vidhijñā vedavādakāḥ || 54 || uktāḥ sakartṛkaṃ viśvaṃ vivadante jaḍātmakāḥ | kartā bhavati cedasminsaṃsāre vitate kila || 55 || virodhaḥ kīdṛśastatra caikakarmaṇi vai mithaḥ | vede naikamatiḥ kasmācchāstreṣvapi tathā punaḥ || 56 || naikavākyaṃ vacasteṣāmapi vedavidāṃ punaḥ | yataḥ svārthaparaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam || 57 || niḥspṛhaḥ ko'pi saṃsāre na bhavenna bhaviṣyati | śaśinātha gurorbhāryā hṛtā jñātvā balādapi || 58 || gautamasya tathendreṇa jānatā dharmaniścayam | guruṇānujabhāryā ca bhuktā garbhavatī balāt || 59 || śapto garbhagato bālaḥ kṛtaścāndhastathā punaḥ | viṣṇunā ca śiraśchinnaṃ rāhoścakreṇa vai balāt || 60 || aparādhaṃ vinā kāmaṃ tadā sattvavatāmbike | pautro dharmavatāṃ śūraḥ satyavrataparāyaṇaḥ || 61 || yajvā dānapatiḥ śāntaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvapūjakaḥ | kṛtvātha vāmanaṃ rūpaṃ hariṇā chalavedinā || 62 || vañcito'sau baliḥ sarvaṃ hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ purā kila | tathāpi devāndharmasthānpravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 63 || vadanti cāṭuvādāṃśca dharmavādājjayaṃ gatāḥ | evaṃ jñātvā jaganmātaryathecchasi tathā kuru || 64 || śaraṇā dānavāḥ sarve jahi vā rakṣa vā punaḥ | śrīdevyuvāca sarve gacchata pātālaṃ tatra vāsaṃ yathepsitam || 65 || kurudhvaṃ dānavāḥ sarve nirbhayā gatamanyavaḥ | kālaḥ pratīkṣyo yuṣmābhiḥ kāraṇaṃ sa śubhe'śubhe || 66 || sunirvedaparāṇāṃ hi sukhaṃ sarvatra sarvadā | trailokyasya ca rājye'pi na sukhaṃ lobhacetasām || 67 || kṛte'pi na sukhaṃ pūrṇaṃ saspṛhāṇāṃ phalairapi | tasmāttyaktvā mahīmetāṃ prayāntvadya mahītalam || 68 || mamājñāṃ purataḥ kṛtvā sarve vigatakalmaṣāḥ | vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ devyāstathetyuktvā rasātalam || 69 || praṇamya dānavāḥ sarve gatāḥ śaktyābhirakṣitāḥ | antardadhe tato devī devāḥ svabhuvanaṃ gatāḥ || 70 || tyaktvā vairaṃ sthitāḥ sarve te tadā devadānavāḥ | etadākhyānamakhilaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti vadatyatha || 71 || sarvaduḥkhavinirmuktaḥ prayāti padamuttamam || 72 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe devīkathanena dānavānāṃ rasātalaṃ prati gamanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <4.16> harernānāvatāravarṇanam janamejaya uvāca bhṛguśāpānmuniśreṣṭha hareradbhutakarmaṇaḥ | avatārāḥ kathaṃ jātāḥ kasminmanvantare vibho || 1 || vistarādvada dharmajña avatārakathā hareḥ | pāpanāśakarīṃ brahmañchrutāṃ sarvasukhāvahām || 2 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi avatārān hareryathā | yasminmanvantare jātā yuge yasminnarādhipa || 3 || yena rūpeṇa yatkāryaṃ kṛtaṃ nārāyaṇena vai | tatsarvaṃ nṛpa vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa tavādhunā || 4 || dharmasyaivāvatāro'bhūccākṣuṣe manusambhave | naranārāyaṇau dharmaputrau khyātau mahītale || 5 || atha vaivasvatākhye'smindvitīye tu yuge punaḥ | dattātreyāvatāro'treḥ putratvamagamaddhariḥ || 6 || brahmā viṣṇustathā rudrastrayo'mī devasattamāḥ | putratvamagamandevāstasyātrerbhāryayā vṛtāḥ || 7 || anasūyātripatnī ca satīnāmuttamā satī | yayā samprārthitā devāḥ putratvamagamaṃstrayaḥ || 8 || brahmābhūtsomarūpastu dattātreyo hariḥ svayam | durvāsā rudrarūpo'sau putratvaṃ te prapedire || 9 || nṛsiṃhasyāvatārastu devakāryārthasiddhaye | caturthe tu yuge jāto dvidhārūpo manoharaḥ || 10 || hiraṇyakaśipoḥ samyagvadhāya bhagavān hariḥ | cakre rūpaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ devānāṃ vismayapradam || 11 || balerniyamanārthāya śreṣṭhe tretāyuge tathā | cakāra rūpaṃ bhagavān vāmanaṃ kaśyapānmuneḥ || 12 || chalayitvā makhe bhūpaṃ rājyaṃ tasya jahāra ha | pātāle sthāpayāmāsa baliṃ vāmanarūpadhṛk || 13 || yuge caikonaviṃśe'tha tretākhye bhagavān hariḥ | jamadagnisuto jāto rāmo nāma mahābalaḥ || 14 || kṣatriyāntakaraḥ śrīmānsatyavādī jitendriyaḥ | dattavānmedinīṃ kṛtsnāṃ kaśyapāya mahātmane || 15 || yo vai paraśurāmākhyo hareradbhutakarmaṇaḥ | avatārastu rājendra kathitaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || 16 || tretāyuge raghorvaṃśe rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ | naranārāyaṇāṃśau dvau jātau bhuvi mahābalau || 17 || aṣṭāviṃśe yuge śastau dvāpare'rjunaśauriṇau | dharābhārāvatārārthaṃ jātau kṛṣṇārjunau bhuvi || 18 || kṛtavantau mahāyuddhaṃ kurukṣetre'tidāruṇam | evaṃ yuge yuge rājannavatārā hareḥ kila || 19 || bhavanti bahavaḥ kāmaṃ prakṛteranurūpataḥ | prakṛterakhilaṃ sarvaṃ vaśametajjagattrayam || 20 || yathecchati tathaiveyaṃ bhrāmayatyaniśaṃ jagat | puruṣasya priyārthaṃ sā racayatyakhilaṃ jagat || 21 || sṛṣṭvā purā hi bhagavāñjagadetaccarācaram | sarvādiḥ sarvagaścāsau durjñeyaḥ paramo'vyayaḥ || 22 || nirālambo nirākāro niḥspṛhaśca parātparaḥ | upādhitastridhā bhāti yasyāḥ sā prakṛtiḥ parā || 23 || utpattikālayogātsā bhinnā bhāti śivā tadā | sā viśvaṃ kurute kāmaṃ sā pālayati kāmadā || 24 || kalpānte saṃharatyeva trirūpā viśvamohinī | tayā yukto'sṛja dbrahmā viṣṇuḥ pāti tayānvitaḥ || 25 || rudraḥ saṃharate kāmaṃ tayā sammilitaḥ śivaḥ | sā caivotpādya kākutsthaṃ purā vai nṛpasattamam || 26 || kutracitsthāpayāmāsa dānavānāṃ jayāya ca | evamasmiṃśca saṃsāre sukhaduḥkhānvitāḥ kila || 27 || bhavanti prāṇinaḥ sarve vidhitantraniyantritāḥ || 28 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe harernānāvatāravarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <4.17> nārāyaṇavaradānam janamejaya uvāca vārāṅganāstvayākhyātā naranārāyaṇāśrame | ekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śāntaṃ kāmayānā smarāturāḥ || 1 || śaptukāmastadā jāto munirnārāyaṇaśca tāḥ | nivārito nareṇātha bhrātrā dharmavidā nṛpa || 2 || kiṃ kṛtaṃ muninā tena vyasane samupasthite | tābhiḥ saṃkalpitenātha kāmārthābhirbhṛśaṃ mune || 3 || śakreṇotpāditābhiśca bahuprārthanayā punaḥ | yācitena vivāhārthaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ tena jiṣṇunā || 4 || ityetacchrotumicchāmi caritaṃ tasya mokṣadam | nārāyaṇasya me brūhi vistareṇa pitāmaha || 5 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi yathā tasya mahātmanaḥ | dharmaputrasya dharmajña vistareṇa vadāmi te || 6 || śaptukāmastu saṃdṛṣṭo nareṇātha yadā hariḥ | vārito'sau samāśvāsya munirnārāyaṇastadā || 7 || śāntakopastadovāca tāstapasvī mahāmuniḥ | smitapūrvamidaṃ vākyaṃ madhuraṃ dharmanandanaḥ || 8 || asmiñjanmani cārvaṃgyaḥ kṛtasaṃkalpavānaham | āvābhyāñca na kartavyaḥ sarvathā dārasaṃgrahaḥ || 9 || tasmād gacchantu tridivaṃ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mamopari | dharmajñā na prakurvanti vratabhaṅgaṃ parasya vai || 10 || śṛṅgāre'smin rase nūnaṃ sthāyībhāvo ratiḥ smṛtaḥ | kathaṃ karomi sambandhaṃ tadabhāve sulocanāḥ || 11 || kāraṇena vinā kāryaṃ na bhavediti niścayaḥ | kavibhiḥ kathitaṃ śāstre sthāyībhāvo rasaḥ kila || 12 || dhanyaḥ sucārusarvāṅgaḥ sabhāgyo'haṃ dharātale | prītipātraṃ yato jāto bhavatīnāmakṛtrimam || 13 || bhavatībhiḥ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā rakṣaṇīyaṃ vrataṃ mama | bhaviṣyāmi mahābhāgāḥ patirapyanyajanmani || 14 || aṣṭāviṃśe viśālākṣyo dvāpare'smindharātale | devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ prabhaviṣyāmi sarvathā || 15 || tadā bhavatyo maddārāḥ prāpya janma pṛthakpṛthak | bhūpatīnāṃ sutā bhūtvā palībhāvaṃ gamiṣyatha || 16 || ityāśvāsya haristāstu pratiśrutya parigraham | vyasarjayatsa bhagavāñjagmuśca vigatajvarāḥ || 17 || evaṃ visarjitāstena gatāḥ svargaṃ tadāṅganāḥ | śakrāya kathayāmāsuḥ kāraṇaṃ sakalaṃ punaḥ || 18 || āśrutya maghavāṃstābhyo vṛttāntaṃ tasya vistarāt | tuṣṭāva taṃ mahātmānaṃ nārīrdṛṣṭvā tathorvaśīḥ || 19 || indra uvāca aho dhairyaṃ muneḥ kāmaṃ tathaiva ca tapobalam | yenorvaśyaḥ svatapasā tādṛgrūpāḥ prakalpitāḥ || 20 || iti stutvā prasannātmā babhūva surarāṭ tataḥ | nārāyaṇo'pi dharmātmā tapasyabhirato'bhavat || 21 || ityetatsarvamākhyātaṃ munervṛttāntamadbhutam | nārāyaṇasya sakalaṃ narasya ca mahāmuneḥ || 22 || tau hi kṛṣṇārjunau vīrau bhūbhāraharaṇāya ca | jātau tau bharataśreṣṭha bhṛgoḥ śāpavaśādiha || 23 || rājovāca kṛṣṇāvatāracaritaṃ vistareṇa vadasva me | sandeho mama citte'sti taṃ nivāraya mānada || 24 || yayoḥ putratvamāpannau haryanantau mahābalau | devakīvasudevau tau duḥkhabhājau kathaṃ mune || 25 || kaṃsena nigaḍe baddhau pīḍitau bahuvatsarān | yayoḥ putro hariḥ sākṣāttapasā toṣito'bhavat || 26 || jāto'sau mathurāyāṃ tu gokule sa kathaṃ gataḥ | kaṃsaṃ hatvā dvāravatyāṃ nivāsaṃ kṛtavānkatham || 27 || pitrādisevitaṃ deśaṃ samṛddhaṃ pāvanaṃ kila | tyaktvā deśāntare'nārye gatavānsa kathaṃ hariḥ || 28 || kulañca dvijaśāpena kathamutsāditaṃ hareḥ | bhārāvatāraṇaṃ kṛtvā vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ || 29 || dehaṃ mumoca tarasā jagāma ca divaṃ hariḥ | pāpiṣṭhānāñca bhāreṇa vyākulābhūcca medinī || 30 || te hatā vāsudevena pārthenāmitakarmaṇā | luṇṭhitā yairhareḥ patnyaste kathaṃ na nipātitāḥ || 31 || bhīṣmo droṇastathā karṇo bāhliko'pyatha pārthivaḥ | vairāṭo'tha vikarṇaśca dhṛṣṭadyumnaśca pārthivaḥ || 32 || somadattādayaḥ sarve nihatāḥ samare nṛpāḥ | teṣāmuttārito bhāraścaurāṇāṃ na hṛtaḥ katham || 33 || kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ kathaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāptāḥ prānte pativratāḥ | sandeho'yaṃ muniśreṣṭha citte me parivartate || 34 || vasudevastu dharmātmā putraduḥkhena tāpitaḥ | tyaktavānsa kathaṃ prāṇānapamṛtyuṃ jagāma ha || 35 || pāṇḍavā dharmasaṃyuktāḥ kṛṣṇe ca niratāḥ sadā | te kathaṃ duḥkhabhoktāro hyabhavanmunisattama || 36 || draupadī ca mahābhāgā kathaṃ duḥkhasya bhāginī | vedīmadhyācca sañjātā lakṣmyaṃśasambhavā kila || 37 || sabhāyāṃ sā samānītā rajodoṣasamanvitā | bālā duḥśāsanenātha keśagrahaṇakarśitā || 38 || pīḍitā sindhurājñātha vanamadhyagatā satī | tathaiva kīcakenāpi pīḍitā rudatī bhṛśam || 39 || putrāḥ pañcaiva tasyāstu nihatā drauṇinā gṛhe | subhadrāyāḥ suto yuddhe bāla eva nipātitaḥ || 40 || tathā ca devakīputrā ṣaṭ kaṃsena niṣūditāḥ | samarthenāpi hariṇā daivaṃ na kṛtamanyathā | 41 || yādavānāṃ tathā śāpaḥ prabhāse nidhanaṃ punaḥ | kulakṣayastathā tīvrastatpatnīnāñca luṇṭhanam || 42 || viṣṇunā ceśvareṇāpi sākṣānnārāyaṇena ca | ugrasenasya sevā vai dāsavatsatataṃ kṛtā || 43 || sandeho'yaṃ mahābhāga tatra nārāyaṇe munau | sarvajantusamānatvaṃ vyavahāre nirantaram || 44 || harṣaśokādayo bhāvāḥ sarveṣāṃ sadṛśāḥ katham | īśvarasya harerjātā kathamapyanyathā gatiḥ || 45 || tasmādvistarato brūhi kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ mahat | alaukikena hariṇā kṛtaṃ karma mahītale || 46 || hatā āyuḥkṣaye daityāḥ kleśena mahatā punaḥ | kvaiśvaryaśaktiḥ prathitā hariṇā munisattama || 47 || rukmiṇīharaṇe nūnaṃ gṛhītvātha palāyanam | kṛtaṃ hi vāsudevena cauravaccaritaṃ tadā || 48 || mathurāmaṇḍalaṃ tyaktvā samṛddhaṃ kulasammatam | jarāsandhabhayāttena dvārakāgamanaṃ kṛtam || 49 || tadā kenāpi na jñāto bhagavānharirīśvaraḥ | kiñcitprabrūhi me brahman kāraṇaṃ vrajagopanam || 50 || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ sandehā vāsavīsuta | nāśayādya mahābhāga sarvajño'si dvijottama || 51 || gopyastathaikaḥ sandeho hṛdayānna nivartate | pāñcālyāḥ pañcabhartṛtvaṃ loke kiṃ na jugupsitam || 52 || sadācāraṃ pramāṇaṃ hi pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | paśudharmaḥ kathaṃ taistu samarthairapi saṃśritaḥ || 53 || bhīṣmeṇāpi kṛtaṃ kiṃ vā devarūpeṇa bhūtale | golakau tau samutpādya yattu vaṃśasya rakṣaṇam || 54 || dhigdharmanirṇayaḥ kāmaṃ munibhiḥ paridarśitaḥ | yena kenāpyupāyena putrotpādanalakṣaṇaḥ || 55 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe surāṅganānāṃ prati nārāyaṇavaradānaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <4.18> brahmāṇaṃ prati viṣṇuvākyam vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ mahat | avatārakāraṇaṃ caiva devyāścaritamadbhutam || 1 || dharaikadā bharākrāntā rudatī cātikarśitā | gorūpadhāriṇī dīnā bhītāgacchattriviṣṭapam || 2 || pṛṣṭā śakreṇa kiṃ te'dya vartate bhayamityatha | kena vai pīḍitāsi tvaṃ kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ vasundhare || 3 || tacchrutvelā tadovāca śṛṇu deveśa me'khilam | duḥkhaṃ pṛcchasi yattvaṃ me bhārākrānto'smi mānada || 4 || jarāsandho mahāpāpī māgadheṣu patirmama | śiśupālastathā caidyaḥ kāśirājaḥ pratāpavān || 5 || rukmī ca balavānkaṃso narakaśca mahābalaḥ | śālvaḥ saubhapatiḥ krūraḥ keśī dhenukavatsakau || 6 || sarve dharmavihīnāśca parasparavirodhinaḥ | pāpācārā madonmattāḥ kālarūpāśca pārthivāḥ || 7 || tairahaṃ pīḍitā śakra bhārākrāntākṣamā vibho | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi cintā me mahatī sthitā || 8 || pīḍitāhaṃ varāheṇa viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | śakra jānīhi hariṇā duḥkhādduḥkhataraṃ gatā || 9 || yato'haṃ duṣṭadaityena kaśyapasyātmajena vai | hṛtāhaṃ hiraṇyākṣeṇa magnā tasminmahārṇave || 10 || tadā sūkararūpeṇa viṣṇunā nihato'pyasau | uddhṛtāhaṃ varāheṇa sthāpitā hi sthirā kṛtā || 11 || nocedrasātale svasthā sthitā syāṃ sukhaśāyinī | na śaktāsmyadya deveśa bhāraṃ voḍhuṃ durātmanām || 12 || agre duṣṭaḥ samāyāti hyaṣṭāviṃśastathā kaliḥ | tadāhaṃ pīḍitā śakra gantāsmyāśu rasātalam || 13 || tasmāttvaṃ devadeveśa duḥkharūpārṇavasya ca | pārado bhava bhāraṃ me hara pādau namāmi te || 14 || iṃdra uvāca ile kiṃ te karomyadya brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja | ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi sa te duḥkhaṃ hariṣyati || 15 || tacchrutvā tvaritā pṛthvī brahmalokaṃ gatā tadā | śakro'pi pṛṣṭhataḥ prāptaḥ sarvadevapuraḥsaraḥ || 16 || surabhīmāgatāṃ tatra dṛṣṭvovāca prajāpatiḥ | mahīṃ jñātvā mahārāja dhyānena samupasthitām || 17 || kasmādrudasi kalyāṇi kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ vadādhunā | pīḍitāsi ca kena tvaṃ pāpācāreṇa bhūrvada || 18 || dharovāca kalirāyāti duṣṭo'yaṃ bibhemi tadbhayādaham | pāpācārāḥ prajāstatra bhaviṣyanti jagatpate || 19 || rājānaśca durācārāḥ parasparavirodhinaḥ | caurakarmaratāḥ sarve rākṣasāḥ pūrṇavairiṇaḥ || 20 || tānhatvā nṛpatīnbhāraṃ hara me'dya pitāmaha | pīḍitāsmi mahārāja sainyabhāreṇa bhūbhṛtām || 21 || brahyovāca nāhaṃ śaktastathā devi bhārāvataraṇe tava | gacchāvaḥ sadanaṃ viṣṇordevadevasya cakriṇaḥ || 22 || sa te bhārāpanodaṃ vai kariṣyati janārdanaḥ | pūrvaṃ mayāpi te kāryaṃ cintitaṃ suvicārya ca || 23 || tatra gaccha suraśreṣṭha yatra devo janārdanaḥ | vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā vedakartāsau puraskṛtya surāṃśca gām || 24 || jagāma viṣṇusadanaṃ haṃsārūḍhaścaturmukhaḥ | tuṣṭāva vedavākyaiśca bhaktipravaṇamānasaḥ || 25 || brahmovāca sahasraśīrṣāstvamasi sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | tvaṃ vedapuruṣaḥ pūrvaṃ devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ || 26 || bhūtapūrvaṃ bhaviṣyacca vartamānaṃ ca yadvibho | amaratvaṃ tvayā dattamasmākaṃ ca ramāpate || 27 || etāvānmahimā te'sti ko na vetti jagattraye | tvaṃ kartāpyavitā hantā tvaṃ sarvagatirīśvaraḥ || 28 || vyāsa uvāca itīḍitaḥ prabhurviṣṇuḥ prasanno garuḍadhvajaḥ | darśanañca dadau tebhyo brahmādibhyo'malāśayaḥ || 29 || papraccha svāgataṃ devānprasannavadano hariḥ | tatastvāgamane teṣāṃ kāraṇañca savistaram || 30 || tamuvācābjajo natvā dharāduḥkhañca saṃsmaran | bhārāvataraṇaṃ viṣṇo kartavyaṃ te janārdana || 31 || bhuvi dhṛtvāvatāraṃ tvaṃ dvāparānte samāgate | hatvā duṣṭānnṛpānurvyā hara bhāraṃ dayānidhe || 32 || viṣṇuruvāca nāhaṃ svatantra evātra na brahmā na śivastathā | nendro'gnirna yamastvaṣṭā na sūryo varuṇastathā || 33 || yogamāyāvaśe sarvamidaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | brahmādistambaparyantaṃ grathitaṃ guṇasūtrataḥ || 34 || yathā sā svecchayā pūrvaṃ kartumicchati suvrata | tathā karoti suhitā vayaṃ sarve'pi tadvaśāḥ || 35 || yadyahaṃ syāṃ svatantro vai cintayantu dhiyā kila | kuto'bhavaṃ matsyavapuḥ kacchapo vā mahārṇave || 36 || tiryagyoniṣu ko bhogaḥ kā kīrtiḥ kiṃ sukhaṃ punaḥ | kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tatra kṣudrayonigatasya me || 37 || kolo vātha nṛsiṃho vā vāmano vābhavaṃ kutaḥ | jamadagnisutaḥ kasmātsambhaveyaṃ pitāmaha || 38 || nṛśaṃsaṃ vā kathaṃ karma kṛtavānasmi bhūtale | kṣatajaistu hradānsarvānpūrayeyaṃ kathaṃ punaḥ || 39 || tatkathaṃ jamadagneśca putro bhūtvā dvijottamaḥ | kṣatriyānhatavānājau nirdayo garbhagānapi || 40 || rāmo bhūtvātha devendra prāviśaddaṇḍakaṃ vanam | padātiścīravāsāśca jaṭāvalkalavānpunaḥ || 41 || asahāyo hyapātheyo bhīṣaṇe nirjane vane | kurvannākheṭakaṃ tatra vyacaraṃ vigatatrapaḥ || 42 || na jñātavānmṛgaṃ haimaṃ māyayā pihitastadā | uṭaje jānakīṃ tyaktvā nirgatastatpadānugaḥ || 43 || lakṣmaṇo'pi ca tāṃ tyaktvā nirgato matpadānugaḥ | vārito'pi mayātyarthaṃ mohitaḥ prākṛtairguṇaiḥ || 44 || bhikṣurūpaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā rāvaṇaḥ kapaṭākṛtiḥ | jahāra tarasā rakṣo jānakīṃ śokakarśitām || 45 || duḥkhārtena mayā tatra ruditañca vane vane | sugrīveṇa ca mitratvaṃ kṛtaṃ kāryavaśānmayā || 46 || anyāyena hato vālī śāpāccaiva nivāritaḥ | sahāyānvānarān kṛtvā laṅkāyāṃ calitaḥ punaḥ || 47 || baddho'haṃ nāgapāśaiśca lakṣmaṇaśca mamānujaḥ | visaṃjñau patitau dṛṣṭvā vānarā vismayaṃ gatāḥ || 48 || garuḍena tadā''gatya mocitau bhrātarau kila | cintā me mahatī jātā daivaṃ kiṃ vā kariṣyati || 49 || hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vane vāso mṛtastātaḥ priyā hṛtā | yuddhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ dadātyevamagre kiṃ vā kariṣyati || 50 || prathamaṃ tu mahadduḥkhamarājyasya vanāśrayam | rājaputryānvitasyaiva dhanahīnasya me surāḥ || 51 || varāṭikāpi pitrā me na dattā vananirgame | padātirasahāyo'haṃ dhanahīnaśca nirgataḥ || 52 || caturdaśaiva varṣāṇi nītāni ca tadā mayā | kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ parityajya vyādhavṛttyā mahāvane || 53 || daivādyuddhe jayaḥ prāpto nihato'sau mahāsuraḥ | ānītā ca punaḥ sītā prāptāyodhyā mayā tathā || 54 || varṣāṇi katicittatra sukhaṃ saṃsārasambhavam | prāptaṃ rājyañca sampūrṇaṃ kosalānadhitiṣṭhatā || 55 || puraivaṃ vartamānena prāptarājyena vai tadā | lokāpavādabhītena tyaktā sītā vane mayā || 56 || kāntāvirahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ punaḥ prāptaṃ durāsadam | pātālaṃ sā gatā paścāddharāṃ bhittvā dharātmajā || 57 || evaṃ rāmāvatāre'pi duḥkhaṃ prāptaṃ nirantaram | paratantreṇa me nūnaṃ svatantraḥ ko bhavettadā || 58 || paścātkālavaśātprāptaḥ svargo me bhrātṛbhiḥ saha | paratantrasya kā vārtā vaktavyā vibudhena vai || 59 || paratantro'tmyahaṃ nūnaṃ padmayone niśāmaya | tathā tvamapi rudraśca sarve cānye surottamāḥ || 60 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe brahmāṇaṃ prati viṣṇuvākyaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <4.19> devān prati devīvākyavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ punarāha prajāpatim | yanmāyāmohitaḥ sarvastattvaṃ jānāti no janaḥ || 1 || vayaṃ māyāvṛtāḥ kāmaṃ na smarāmo jagadgurum | paramaṃ puruṣaṃ śāntaṃ saccidānandamavyayam || 2 || ahaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ brahmā śivo'hamiti mohitāḥ | na jānīmo vayaṃ dhātaḥ paraṃ vastu sanātanam || 3 || yanmāyāmohitaścāhaṃ sadā varte parātmanaḥ | paravāndārupāñcālī māyikasya yathā vaśe || 4 || bhavatāpi tathā dṛṣṭā vibhūtistasya cādbhutā | kalpādau bhavayuktena mayāpi ca sudhārṇave || 5 || maṇidvīpe'tha mandāraviṭape rāsamaṇḍale | samāje tatra sā dṛṣṭā śrutā na vacasāpi ca || 6 || tasmāttāṃ paramāṃ śaktiṃ smarantvadya surāḥ śivām | sarvakāmapradāṃ māyāmādyāṃ śaktiṃ parātmanaḥ || 7 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktā hariṇā devā brahmādyā bhuvaneśvarīm | sasmarurmanasā devīṃ yogamāyāṃ sanātanīm || 8 || smṛtamātrā tadā devī pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ dadau | pāśāṅkuśavarābhītidharā devī japāruṇā | dṛṣṭvā pramuditā devāstuṣṭuvustāṃ sudarśanām || 9 || devā ūcuḥ ūrṇanābhādyathā tanturvisphuliṅgā vibhāvasoḥ | tathā jagadyadetasyā nirgataṃ tāṃ natā vayam || 10 || yanmāyāśaktisaṃkḷptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ carācaram | tāṃ citaṃ bhuvanādhīśāṃ smarāmaḥ karuṇārṇavām || 11 || yadajñānādbhavotpattiryajjñānādbhavanāśanam | saṃvidrūpāṃ ca tāṃ devīṃ smarāmaḥ sā pracodayāt || 12 || mahālakṣyai ca vidmahe sarvaśaktyai ca dhīmahi | tanno devī pracodayāt || 13 || mātarnatāḥ sma bhuvanārtihare prasīda śanto vidhehi kuru kāryamidaṃ dayārdre | bhāraṃ harasva vinihatya surārivargaṃ mahyā maheśvari satāṃ kuru śaṃ bhavāni || 14 || yadyambujākṣi dayase na surānkadācit kiṃ te kṣamā raṇamukhe'siśaraiḥ prahartum | etattvayaiva gaditaṃ nanu yakṣarūpaṃ dhṛtvā tṛṇaṃ daha hutāśa padābhilāṣaiḥ || 15 || kaṃsaḥ kujo'tha yavanendrasutaśca keśī bārhadratho bakabakīkharaśālvamukhyāḥ | ye'nye tathā nṛpatayo bhuvi santi tāṃstvaṃ hatvā harasva jagato bharamāśu mātaḥ || 16 || ye viṣṇunā na nihatāḥ kila śaṅkareṇa ye vā vigṛhya jalajākṣi purandareṇa | te te mukhaṃ sukhakaraṃ susamīkṣamāṇāḥ saṃkhye śarairvinihatā nijalīlayā te || 17 || śaktiṃ vinā hariharapramukhāḥ surāśca || naiveśvarā vicalituṃ tava devadevi | kiṃ dhāraṇāvirahitaḥ prabhurapyananto dhartuṃ dharāñca rajanīśakalāvataṃse || 18 || indra uvāca vācā vinā vidhiralaṃ bhavatīha viśvaṃ kartuṃ hariḥ kimu ramārahito'tha pātum | saṃhartumīśa umayojjhita īśvaraḥ kiṃ te tābhireva sahitāḥ prabhavaḥ prajeśāḥ || 19 || viṣṇuruvāca kartuṃ prabhurna druhiṇo na kadācanāhaṃ nāpīśvarastava kalārahitastrilokyāḥ | kartuṃ prabhutvamanaghe'tra tathā vihartuṃ tvaṃ vai samastavibhaveśvari bhāsi nūnam || 20 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ stutā tadā devī tānāha vibudheśvarān | kiṃ tatkāryaṃ vadantvadya karomi vigatajvarāḥ || 21 || asādhyamapi loke'smiṃstatkaromi surepsitam | śaṃsantu bhavatāṃ duḥkhaṃ dharāyāśca surottamāḥ || 22 || devā ūcuḥ vasudheyaṃ bharākrāntā samprāptā vibudhānprati | rudatī vepamānā ca pīḍitā duṣṭabhūbhujaiḥ || 23 || bhārāpaharaṇaṃ cāsyāḥ kartavyaṃ bhuvaneśvari | devānāmīṣmita kāryametadevādhunā śive || 24 || ghātitastu purā mātastvayā mahiṣarūpabhṛt | dānavo'tibalākrāntastatsahāyāśca koṭiśaḥ || 25 || tathā śumbho niśumbhaśca raktabījastathāparaḥ | caṇḍamuṇḍau mahāvīryau tathaiva dhūmralocanaḥ || 26 || durmukho duḥsahaścaiva karālaścāti vīryavān | anye ca bahavaḥ krūrāstvayaiva ca nipātitāḥ || 27 || tathaiva ca surārīṃśca jahi sarvānmahīśvarān | (bhāraṃ hara dharāyāśca durdharaṃ duṣṭabhūbhujām |) || vyāsa uvāca ityuktā sā tadā devī devānāhāmbikā śivā || 28 || samprahasyāsitāpāṅgī meghagambhīrayā girā | śrīdevyuvāca mayedaṃ cintitaṃ pūrvamaṃśāvataraṇaṃ surāḥ || 29 || bhārāvataraṇaṃ caiva yathā syādduṣṭabhūbhujām | mayā sarve nihantavyā daityeśā ye mahībhujaḥ || 30 || māgadhādyā mahābhāgāḥ svaśaktyā mandatejasaḥ | bhavadbhirapi svairaṃśairavatīrya dharātale || 31 || macchaktiyuktaiḥ kartavyaṃ bhārāvataraṇaṃ surāḥ | kaśyapo bhāryayā sārdhaṃ divijānāṃ prajāpatiḥ || 32 || yādavānāṃ kule pūrvaṃ bhavitā''nakadundubhiḥ | tathaiva bhṛguśāpādvai bhagavānviṣṇuravyayaḥ || 33 || aṃśena bhavitā tatra vasudevasuto hariḥ | tadāhaṃ prabhaviṣyāmi yaśodāyāṃ ca gokule || 34 || kāryaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi surāṇāṃ surasattamāḥ | kārāgāre gataṃ viṣṇuṃ prāpayiṣyāmi gokule || 35 || śeṣaṃ ca devakīgarbhātprāpayiṣyāmi rohiṇīm | macchaktyopacitau tau ca kartārau duṣṭasaṃkṣayam || 36 || duṣṭānāṃ bhūbhujāṃ kāmaṃ dvāparānte suniścitam | indrāṃśo'pyarjunaḥ sākṣātkariṣyati balakṣayam || 37 || dharmāṃśo'pi mahārājo bhaviṣyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ | vāyvaṃśo bhīmasenaścāśvinyaṃśau ca yamāvapi || 38 || vasoraṃśo'tha gāṅgeyaḥ kariṣyati balakṣayam | vrajantu ca bhavanto'dya dharā bhavatu susthirā || 39 || bhārāvataraṇaṃ nūnaṃ kariṣyāmi surottamāḥ | kṛtvā nimittamātrāṃstānsvaśaktyāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 40 || kurukṣetre kariṣyāmi kṣattriyāṇāṃ ca saṃkṣayam | asūyerṣyā matistṛṣṇā mamatābhimatā spṛhā || 41 || jigīṣā madano moho doṣairnakṣyanti yādavāḥ | brāhmaṇasya ca śāpena vaṃśanāśo bhaviṣyati || 42 || bhagavānapi śāpena tyakṣyatyetatkalevaram | bhavanto'pi nijāṅgaiśca sahāyāḥ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ || 43 || prabhavantu sanārīkā mathurāyāṃ ca gokule | vyāsa uvāca ityuktvāntardadhe devī yogamāyā parātmanaḥ || 44 || sadharā vai surāḥ sarve jagmuḥ svānyālayāni ca | dharāpi susthirā jātā tasyā vākyena toṣitā || 45 || oṣadhīvīrudhopetā babhūva janamejaya | prajāśca sukhino jātā dvijāścāpurmahodayam | santuṣṭā munayaḥ sarve babhūburdharmatatparāḥ || 46 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe devān prati devīvākyavarṇanaṃ nāmakonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || <4.20> kṛṣṇāvatārakathopakramavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca śṛṇa bhārata vakṣyāmi bhārāvataraṇaṃ tathā | kurukṣetre prabhāse ca kṣapitaṃ yogamāyayā || 1 || yaduvaṃśe samutpattirviṣṇoramitatejasaḥ | bhṛguśāpapratāpena mahāmāyābalena ca || 2 || kṣitibhārasamuttāranimittamiti me matiḥ | māyayā vihito yogo viṣṇorjanma dharātale || 3 || kiṃ citraṃ nṛpa devī sā brahmaviṣṇusurānapi | nartayatyaniśaṃ māyā triguṇānaparānkimu || 4 || garbhavāsodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ viṇmūtrasnāyusaṃyutam | viṣṇorāpāditaṃ samyagyayā vigatalīlayā || 5 || purā rāmāvatāre'pi nirjarā vānarāḥ kṛtāḥ | viditaṃ te yathā viṣṇurduḥkhapāśena mohitaḥ || 6 || ahaṃ mameti pāśena sudṛḍhena narādhipa | yogino muktasaṅgāśca bhuktikāmā mumukṣavaḥ || 7 || tāmeva samupāsante devīṃ viśveśvarīṃ śivām | yadbhaktileśaleśāṃśaleśaleśalavāṃśakam || 8 || labdhvā mukto bhavejjantustāṃ na seveta ko janaḥ | bhuvaneśītyeva vaktre dadāti bhuvanatrayam || 9 || māṃ pāhītyasya vacaso deyābhāvādṛṇānvitā | vidyāvidyeti tasyā dve rūpe jānīhi pārthiva || 10 || vidyayā mucyate janturbadhyate'vidyayā punaḥ | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca sarve tasyā vaśānugāḥ || 11 || avatārāḥ sarva eva yantritā iva dāmabhiḥ | kadācicca sukhaṃ bhuṃkte vaikuṇṭhe kṣīrasāgare || 12 || kadācitkurute yuddhaṃ dānavairbalavattaraiḥ | hariḥ kadācidyajñānvai vitatānprakaroti ca || 13 || kadācicca tapastīvraṃ tīrthe carati suvrata | kadācicchayane śete yoganidrāmupāśritaḥ || 14 || na svatantraḥ kadācicca bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ | tathā brahmā tathā rudrastathendro varuṇo yamaḥ || 15 || kubero'gnī ravīndū ca tathānye surasattamāḥ | munayaḥ sanakādyāśca vasiṣṭhādyāstathāpare || 16 || sarve'mbāvaśagā nityaṃ pāñcālīva narasya ca | nasi protā yathā gāvo vicaranti vaśānugāḥ || 17 || tathaiva devatāḥ sarvāḥ kālapāśaniyantritāḥ | harṣaśokādayo bhāvā nidrātandrālasādayaḥ || 18 || sarveṣāṃ sarvadā rājandehināṃ dehasaṃśritāḥ | amarā nirjarāḥ proktā devāśca granthakārakaiḥ || 19 || abhidhānataścārthato na te nūnaṃ tādṛśāḥ kvacit | utpattisthitināśākhyā bhāvā yeṣāṃ nirantaram || 20 || amarāste kathaṃ vācyā nirjarāśca kathaṃ punaḥ | kathaṃ duḥkhābhibhūtā vā jāyante vibudhottamāḥ || 21 || kathaṃ devāśca vaktavyā vyasane krīḍanaṃ katham | kṣaṇādutpattināśaśca dṛśyate'sminna saṃśayaḥ || 22 || jalajānāṃ ca kīṭānāṃ maśakānāṃ tathā punaḥ | upamā na kathaṃ caiṣāmāyuṣo'nte marāḥ smṛtāḥ || 23 || tato varṣāyuṣaścāpi śatavarṣāyuṣastathā | manuṣyā hyamarā devāstasmād brahmāparaḥ smṛtaḥ || 24 || rudrastathā tathā viṣṇuḥ kramaśaśca bhavanti hi | naśyanti kramaśaścaiva vardhanti cottarottaram || 25 || nūnaṃ dehavato nāśo mṛtasyotpattireva ca | cakravad bhramaṇaṃ rājan sarveṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 26 || mohajālāvṛto janturmucyate na kadācana | māyāyāṃ vidyamānāyāṃ mohajālaṃ na naśyati || 27 || utpitsukāla utpattiḥ sarveṣāṃ nṛpa jāyate | tathaiva nāśaḥ kalpānte brahmādīnāṃ yathākramam || 28 || nimittaṃ yastu yannāśe sa ghātayati taṃ nṛpa | nānyathā tadbhavennūnaṃ vidhinā nirmitaṃ tu yat || 29 || janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhaṃ vā sukhameva vā | tattathaiva bhavetkāmaṃ nānyatheha vinirṇayaḥ || 30 || sarveṣāṃ sukhadau devau pratyakṣau śaśibhāskarau | na naśyati tayoḥ pīḍā kyacittadvairisambhavā || 31 || bhāskarasya suto mandaḥ kṣayī candraḥ kalaṅkavān | paśya rājan vidheḥ sūtraṃ durvāraṃ mahatāmapi || 32 || vedakartā jagatsraṣṭā buddhidastu caturmukhaḥ | so'pi viklavatāṃ prāpto dṛṣṭvā putrīṃ sarasvatīm || 33 || śivasyāpi mṛtā bhāryā satī dagdhvā kalevaram | so'bhavadduḥkhasantaptaḥ kāmārtaśca janārtihā || 34 || kāmāgnidagdhadehastu kālindyāṃ patitaḥ śivaḥ | sāpi śyāmajalā jātā tannidāghavaśānnṛpa || 35 || kāmārto ramamāṇastu nagnaḥ so'pi bhṛgorvanam | gataḥ prāpto'tha bhṛguṇā śaptaḥ kāmāturo bhṛśam || 36 || patatvadyaiva te liṅgaṃ nirlajjeti bhṛśaṃ kila | papau cāmṛtavāpīñca dānavairnirmitāṃ mude || 37 || indro'pi ca vṛṣo bhūtvā vāhanatvaṃ gataḥ kṣitau | ādyasya sarvalokasya viṣṇoreva vivekinaḥ || 38 || sarvajñatvaṃ gataṃ kutra prabhuśaktiḥ kuto gatā | yaddhemamṛgavijñānaṃ na jñātaṃ hariṇā kila || 39 || rājan māyābalaṃ paśya rāmo hi kāmamohitaḥ | rāmo virahasantapto ruroda bhṛśamāturaḥ || 40 || yo'pṛcchatpādapānmūḍhaḥ kva gatā janakātmajā | bhakṣitā vā hṛtā kena rudannuccataraṃ tataḥ || 41 || lakṣmaṇāhaṃ mariṣyāmi kāntāvirahaduḥkhitaḥ | tvaṃ cāpi mama duḥkhena mariṣyasi vane'nuja || 42 || āvayormaraṇaṃ jñātvā mātā mama mariṣyati | śatrughno'pyatiduḥkhārtaḥ kathaṃ jīvitumarhati || 43 || sumitrā jīvitaṃ jahyātputravyasanakarśitā | pūrṇakāmātha kaikeyī bhavetputrasamanvitā || 44 || hā sīte kva gatāsi tvaṃ māṃ vihāya smarāturā | ehyehi mṛgaśāvākṣi māṃ jīvaya kṛśodari || 45 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi tvadadhīnañca jīvitam | samāśvāsaya dīnaṃ māṃ priyaṃ janakanandini || 46 || evaṃ vilapatā tena rāmeṇāmitatejasā | vane vane ca bhramatā nekṣitā janakātmajā || 47 || śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ rāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ | śaraṇaṃ vānarāṇāṃ sa gato māyāvimohitaḥ || 48 || sahāyānvānarānkṛtvā babandha varuṇālayam | jaghāna rāvaṇaṃ vīraṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahodaram || 49 || ānīya ca tataḥ sītāṃ rāmo divyamakārayat | sarvajño'pi hṛtāṃ matvā rāvaṇena durātmanā || 50 || kiṃ bravīmi mahārāja yogamāyābalaṃ mahat | yayā viśvamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhrāmitaṃ bhramate kila || 51 || evaṃ nānāvatāre'tra viṣṇuḥ śāpavaśaṃ gataḥ | karoti vividhāśceṣṭā daivādhīnaḥ sadaiva hi || 52 || tavāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi kṛṣṇasyāpi viceṣṭitam | prabhavaṃ mānuṣe loke devakāryārthasiddhaye || 53 || kālindīpuline ramye hyāsīnmadhuvanaṃ purā | lavaṇo madhuputrastu tatrāsīddānavo balī || 54 || dvijānāṃ duḥkhadaḥ pāpo varadānena garvitaḥ | nihato'sau mahābhāga lakṣmaṇasyānujena vai || 55 || śatrughnenātha saṃgrāme taṃ nihatya madotkaṭam | vāsitā mathurā nāma purī paramaśobhanā || 56 || sa tatra puṣkarākṣau dvau putrau śatruniṣūdanaḥ | niveśya rājye matimānkāle prāpte divaṃ gataḥ || 57 || sūryavaṃśakṣaye tāṃ tu yādavāḥ pratipedire | mathurāṃ muktidā rājan yayātitanayaḥ purā || 58 || śūrasenābhidhaḥ śūrastatrābhūnmedinīpatiḥ | māthurāñchūrasenāṃśca bubhuje viṣayānnṛpa || 59 || tatrotpannaḥ kaśyapāṃśaḥ śāpācca varuṇasya vai | vasudevo'tivikhyātaḥ śūrasenasutastadā || 60 || vaiśyavṛttirataḥ so'bhūnmṛte pitari mādhavaḥ | ugraseno babhūvātha kaṃsastasyātmajo mahān || 61 || aditirdevakī jātā devakasya sutā tadā | śāpādvai varuṇasyātha kaśyapānugatā kila || 62 || dattā sā vasudevāya devakena mahātmanā | vivāhe racite tatra vāgabhūd gagane tadā || 63 || kaṃsa kaṃsa mahābhāga devakīgarbhasambhavaḥ | aṣṭamastu sutaḥ śrīmāṃstava hantā bhaviṣyati || 64 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ kaṃso vismito'bhūnmahābalaḥ | devavācaṃ tu tāṃ matvā satyāṃ cintāmavāpa saḥ || 65 || kiṃ karomīti sañcintya vimarśamakarottadā | nihatyaināṃ na me mṛtyurbhavedadyaiva satvaram || 66 || upāyo nānyathā cāsminkārye mṛtyubhayāvahe | iyaṃ pitṛṣvasā pūjyā kathaṃ hanmītyacintayat || 67 || punarvicārayāmāsa maraṇaṃ me'styaho svasā | pāpenāpi prakartavyā deharakṣā vipaścitā || 68 || prāyaścittena pāpasya śuddhirbhavati sarvadā | prāṇarakṣā prakartavyā budhairapyenasā tathā || 69 || vicintya manasā kaṃsaḥ khaḍgamādāya satvaraḥ | jagrāha tāṃ varārohāṃ keśeṣvākṛṣya pāpakṛt || 70 || kośātkhaḍgamupākṛṣya hantukāmo durāśayaḥ | paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ navoḍhāṃ tāṃ cakarṣa ha || 71 || hanyamānāñca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā hāhākāro mahānabhūt | vasudevānugā vīrā yuddhāyodyatakārmukāḥ || 72 || muñca muñceti procustaṃ te tadādbhutasāhasāḥ | kṛpayā mocayāmāsurdevakīṃ devamātaram || 73 || tadyuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ vīrāṇāñca parasparam | vasudevasahāyānāṃ kaṃsena ca mahātmanā || 74 || vartamāne tathā yuddhe dāruṇe lomaharṣaṇe | kaṃsaṃ nivārayāmāsurvṛddhā ye yadusattamāḥ || 75 || pitṛṣvaseyaṃ te vīra pūjanīyā ca bāliśā | na hantavyā tvayā vīra vivāhotsavasaṅgame || 76 || strīhatyā duḥsahā vīra kīrtighnī pāpakṛttamā | bhūtabhāṣitamātreṇa na kartavyā vijānatā || 77 || antarhitena kenāpi śatruṇā tava cāsya vā | uditeti kuto na syādvāganarthakarī vibho || 78 || yaśasaste vighātāya vasudevagṛhasya ca | ariṇā racitā vāṇī guṇamāyāvidā nṛpa || 79 || bibheṣi vīrastvaṃ bhūtvā bhūtabhāṣitabhāṣayā | yaśomūlavighātārthamupāyastvariṇā kṛtaḥ || 80 || pitṛṣvasā na hantavyā vivāhasamaye punaḥ | bhavitavyaṃ mahārāja bhavecca kathamanyathā || 81 || evaṃ tairbodhyamāno'sau nivṛtto nābhavadyadā | tadā taṃ vasudevo'pi nītijñaḥ pratyabhāṣata || 82 || kaṃsa satyaṃ bravīmyadya satyādhāraṃ jagattrayam | dāsyāmi devakīputrānutpannāṃstava sarvaśaḥ || 83 || jātaṃ jātaṃ sutaṃ tubhyaṃ na dāsyāmi yadi prabho | kumbhīpāke tadā ghore patantu mama pūrvajāḥ || 84 || śrutvātha vacanaṃ satyaṃ pauravā ye puraḥsthitāḥ | ūcuste tvaritāḥ kaṃsaṃ sādhu sādhu punaḥ punaḥ || 85 || na mithyā bhāṣate kvāpi vasudevo mahāmanāḥ | keśaṃ muñca mahābhāga strīhatyā pātakaṃ tathā || 86 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ prabodhitaḥ kaṃso yaduvṛddhairmahātmabhiḥ | krodhaṃ tyaktvā sthitastatra satyavākyānumoditaḥ || 87 || tato dundubhayo nedurvāditrāṇi ca sasvanuḥ | jayaśabdastu sarveṣāmutpannastatra saṃsadi || 88 || prasādya kaṃsaṃ pratimocya devakīṃ mahāyaśāḥ śūrasutastadānīm | jagāma gehaṃ svajanānuvṛtto navoḍhayā vītabhayastarasvī || 89 || iti śramiddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe kṛṣṇāvatārakathopakramavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || <4.21> kaṃsena devakīprathamaputravadhavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca atha kāle tu samprāpte devakī devarūpiṇī | garbhaṃ dadhāra vidhivadvasudevena saṅgatā || 1 || pūrṇe'tha daśame māse suṣuve sutamuttamam | rūpāvayavasampannaṃ devakī prathamaṃ yadā || 2 || tadā''ha vasudevastāṃ satyavākyānumoditaḥ | bhāvitvācca mahābhāgo devakīṃ devamātaram || 3 || varoru samayaṃ me tvaṃ jānāsi svasutārpaṇe | mocitā tvaṃ mahābhāge śapathena mayā tadā || 4 || imaṃ putraṃ sukeśānte dāsyāmi bhrātṛsūnave | (khale kaṃse vināśārthaṃ daive kiṃ vā kariṣyasi |) || vicitrakarmaṇāṃ pāko durjñeyo hyakṛtātmabhiḥ || 5 || sarveṣāṃ kila jīvānāṃ kālapāśānuvartinām | bhoktavyaṃ svakṛtaṃ karma śubha vā yadi vāśubham || 6 || prārabdhaṃ sarvathaivātra jīvasya vidhinirmitam | devakyuvāca svāmin pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma bhoktavyaṃ sarvathā nṛbhiḥ || 7 || tīrthaistapobhirdānairvā kiṃ na yāti kṣayaṃ hi tat | likhito dharmaśāstreṣu prāyaścittavidhirnṛpa || 8 || pūrvārjitānāṃ pāpānāṃ vināśāya mahātmabhiḥ | brahmahā hemahārī ca surāpo gurutalpagaḥ || 9 || dvādaśābdavrate cīrṇe śuddhiṃ yāti yatastataḥ | manvādibhiryathoddiṣṭaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhānataḥ || 10 || tathā kṛtvā naraḥ pāpānmucyate vā na vānagha | vigītavacanāste kiṃ munayastattvadarśinaḥ || 11 || yājñavalkyādayaḥ sarve dharmaśāstrapravartakāḥ | bhavitavyaṃ bhavatyeva yadyevaṃ niścayaḥ prabho || 12 || āyurvedaḥ sa mithyaiva mantravādāstathākhilāḥ | udyamastu vṛthā sarvamevaṃ ceddaivanirmitam || 13 || bhavitavyaṃ bhavatyeva pravṛttistu nirarthikā | agniṣṭomādikaṃ vyarthaṃ niyataṃ svargasādhanam || 14 || yadā tadā pramāṇaṃ hi vṛthaiva paribhāṣitam | vitathe tatpramāṇe tu dharmocchedaḥ kuto na hi || 15 || udyame ca kṛte siddhiḥ pratyakṣeṇaiva sādhyate | tasmādatra prakartavyaḥ prapañcaścittakalpitaḥ || 16 || yathāyaṃ bālakaḥ kṣemaṃ prāpnoti mama putrakaḥ | mithyā yadi prakartavyaṃ vacanaṃ śubhamicchatā || 17 || na tatra dūṣaṇaṃ kiñcitpavadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | vasudeva uvāca niśāmaya mahābhāge satyametad bravīmi te || 18 || udyamaḥ khalu kartavyaḥ phalaṃ daivavaśānugam | trividhānīha karmāṇi saṃsāre'tra purāvidaḥ || 19 || pravadantīha jīvānāṃ purāṇeṣvāgameṣu ca | sañcitāni ca jīrṇāni prārabdhāni sumadhyame || 20 || vartamānāni vāmoru vividhānīha dehinām | śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi bījabhūtāni yāni ca || 21 || bahujanmasamutthāni kāle tiṣṭhanti sarvathā | pūrvadehaṃ parityajya jīvaḥ karmavaśānugaḥ || 22 || svargaṃ vā narakaṃ vāpi prāpnoti svakṛtena vai | divyaṃ dehañca samprāpya yātanādehamarthajam || 23 || bhunakti vividhān bhogānsvarge vā narake'thavā | bhogānte ca yadotpatteḥ samayastasya jāyate || 24 || liṅgadehena sahitaṃ jāyate jīvasaṃjñitam | tadaiva sañcitebhyaśca karmabhyaḥ karmabhiḥ punaḥ || 25 || yojayatyeva taṃ kālaṃ karmāṇi prākkṛtāni ca | dehenānena bhāvyāni śubhāni cāśubhāni ca || 26 || prārabdhāni ca jīvena bhoktavyāni sulocane | prāyaścittena naśyanti vartamānāni bhāmini || 27 || sañcitāni tathaivāśu yathārthaṃ vihitena ca | prārabdhakarmaṇāṃ bhogātsaṃkṣayo nānyathā bhavet || 28 || tenāyaṃ te kumāro vai deyaḥ kaṃsāya sarvathā | na mithyā vacanaṃ me'sti lokanindābhidūṣitam || 29 || anitye'smiṃstu saṃsāre dharmasāre mahātmanām | daivādhīnaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ maraṇaṃ jananaṃ tathā || 30 || tasmācchoko na kartavyo dehinā hi nirarthakaḥ | satyaṃ yasya gataṃ kānte vṛthā tasyaiva jīvitam || 31 || ihaloko gato yasmātparalokaḥ kutastataḥ | ato dehi sutaṃ subhru kaṃsāya pradadāmyaham || 32 || satyasaṃstaraṇāddevi śubhamagre bhaviṣyati | kartavyaṃ sukṛtaṃ pumbhiḥ sukhe duḥkhe sati priye || 33 || (satyasaṃrakṣaṇāddevi śubhameva bhaviṣyati) || vyāsa uvāca ityuktavati kānte sā devakī śokasaṃyutā | dadau putraṃ prasūtaṃ ca vepamānā manasvinī || 34 || vasudevo'pi dharmātmā ādāya svasutaṃ śiśum | jagāma kaṃsasadanaṃ mārge lokairabhiṣṭutaḥ || 35 || lokā ūcuḥ paśyantu vasudevaṃ bho lokā evaṃ manasvinam | svavākyamanurudhyaiva bālamādāya yātyasau || 36 || mṛtyave dātukāmo'dya satyavāganasūyakaḥ | saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ cāsya dharmaṃ paśyantu cādbhutam || 37 || yaḥ putraṃ yāti kaṃsāya dātuṃ kālātmane'pi hi | vyāsa uvāca iti saṃstūyamānastu prāptaḥ kaṃsālayaṃ nṛpa || 38 || dadāvasmai kumāraṃ taṃ jātamātramamānuṣam | kaṃso'pi vismayaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭvā dhairyaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 39 || gṛhītvā bālakaṃ prāha smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ | dhanyastvaṃ śūraputrādya jñātaḥ putrasamarpaṇāt || 40 || mama mṛtyurna cāyaṃ vai girā proktastu cāṣṭamaḥ | na hantavyo mayā kāmaṃ bālo'yaṃ yātu te gaham || 41 || aṣṭamastu pradātavyastvayā putro mahāmate | ityuktvā vasudevāya dadāvāśu khalaḥ śiśum || 42 || gacchatvayaṃ gṛhe bālaḥ kṣemaṃ vyāhṛtavānnṛpaḥ | tamādāya tadā śaurirjagāma svagṛhaṃ mudā || 43 || kaṃso'pi sacivānāha vṛthā kiṃ ghātaye śiśum | aṣṭamāddevakīputrānmama mṛtyurudāhṛtaḥ || 44 || ataḥ kiṃ prathamaṃ bālaṃ hatvā pāpaṃ karomyaham | sādhusādhviti te'pyuktvā saṃsthitā mantrisattamāḥ || 45 || visarjitāstu kaṃsena jagmuste svagṛhānprati | gateṣu teṣu samprāpto nārado munisattamaḥ || 46 || abhyutthānārghyapādyādi cakārograsutastadā | papraccha kuśalaṃ rājā tatrāgamanakāraṇam || 47 || nāradastaṃ tadovāca smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ | kaṃsa kaṃsa mahābhāga gato'haṃ hemaparvatam || 48 || tatra brahmādayo devā mantraṃ cakruḥ samāhitāḥ | devakyāṃ vasudevasya bhāryāyāṃ surasattamaḥ || 49 || vadhārthaṃ tava viṣṇuśca janma cātra kariṣyati | tatkathaṃ na hataḥ putrastvayā nītiṃ vijānatā || 50 || kaṃsa uvāca aṣṭamaṃ ca haniṣye'haṃ mṛtyuṃ me devabhāṣitam | nārada uvāca na jānāsi nṛpaśreṣṭha rājanītiṃ śubhāśubhā | 51 || māyābalaṃ ca devānāṃ na tvaṃ vetsi vadāmi kim | ripuralpo'pi śūreṇa nopekṣyaḥ śubhamicchatā || 52 || sammelanakriyāyāṃ tu sarve te hyaṣṭamāḥ smṛtāḥ | mūrkhastvamarisantyāgaḥ kṛto'yaṃ jānatā tvayā || 53 || ityuktvāśu gataḥ śrīmānnārado devadarśanaḥ | gate'tha nārade kaṃsaḥ samāhūyātha bālakam | pāṣāṇe pothayāmāsa sukhaṃ prāpa ca mandadhīḥ || 54 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kaṃsena devakīprathamaputravadhavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || <4.22> devadānavānāmaṃśāvataraṇavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca kiṃ kṛtaṃ pātakaṃ tena bālakena pitāmaha | yajjātamātro nihatastathā tena durātmanā || 1 || nārado'pi muniśreṣṭho jñānavāndharmatatparaḥ | kathamevaṃvidhaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtavānbrahmavittamaḥ || 2 || kartā kārayitā pāpe tulyapāpau smṛtau budhaiḥ | sa kathaṃ prerayāmāsa muniḥ kaṃsaṃ khalaṃ tadā || 3 || saṃśayo'yaṃ mahānme'tra brūhi sarvaṃ savistaram | yena karmavipākena bālako nidhanaṃ gataḥ || 4 || vyāsa uvāca nāradaḥ kautukaprekṣī sarvadā kalahapriyaḥ | devakāryārthamāgatya sarvametaccakāra ha ||
