5 || na mithyābhāṣaṇe buddhirmunestasya kadācana | satyavaktā surāṇāṃ sa kartavye nirataḥ śuciḥ || 6 || evaṃ ṣaḍ bālakāstena jātā jātā nipātitāḥ | ṣaḍ garbhāḥ śāpayogena sambhūya maraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 7 || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi teṣāṃ śāpasya kāraṇam | svāyambhuve'ntare putrā marīceḥ ṣaṇmahābalāḥ || 8 || ūrṇāyāṃ caiva bhāryāyāmāsandharmavicakṣaṇāḥ | brahmāṇaṃ jahasurvīkṣya sutāṃ yabhitumudyatam || 9 || śaśāpa tāṃstadā brahmā daityayoniṃ viśantvadhaḥ | kālanemisutā jātāste ṣaḍgarbhā viśāmpate || 10 || avatāre pare te tu hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutāḥ | jātāste jñānasaṃyuktāḥ pūrvaśāpabhayānnṛpa || 11 || tasmiñjanmani śāntāśca tapaścakruḥ samāhitāḥ | teṣāṃ prīto'bhavad brahmā ṣaḍgarbhāṇāṃ varāndadau || 12 || brahmovāca śaptā yūyaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ krodhayuktena putrakāḥ | tuṣṭo'smi vo mahābhāgā bruvantu vāñchitaṃ varam || 13 || vyāsa uvāca te tu śrutvā vacastasya brahmaṇaḥ prītamānasāḥ | brahmāṇamabruvankāmaṃ sarve kāryārthatatparāḥ || 14 || garbhā ūcuḥ pitāmahādya tuṣṭo'si dehi no vāñchitaṃ varam | avadhyā daivataiḥ sarvairmānavaiśca mahoragaiḥ || 15 || gandharvasiddhapatibhirvadho mābhūtpitāmaha | vyāsa uvāca tānuvāca tato brahmā sarvametadbhaviṣyati || 16 || gacchantu vo mahābhāgāḥ satyameva na saṃśayaḥ | dattvā varaṃ gato brahmā muditāste tadābhavan || 17 || hiraṇyakaśipuḥ kruddhastānuvāca kurūdvaha | yasmādvihāya māṃ putrāstoṣito vai pitāmahaḥ || 18 || vareṇa prārthito'tyarthaṃ balavanto yato'bhavan | yuṣmābhirhāpitaḥ snehastato yuṣmāṃstyajāmyaham || 19 || yūyaṃ vrajantu pātāle ṣaḍgarbhā viśrutā bhuvi | pātāle nidrayāviṣṭāstiṣṭhantu bahuvatsarān || 20 || tatastu devakīgarbhe varṣe varṣe punaḥ punaḥ | pitā vaḥ kālanemistu tatra kaṃso bhaviṣyati || 21 || sa eva jātamātrānvo vadhiṣyati sudāruṇaḥ | vyāsa uvāca evaṃ śaptāṃstadā tena garbhe jātānpunaḥ punaḥ || 22 || jaghāna devakīputrānṣaḍgarbhāñchāpanoditaḥ | śeṣāṃśaḥ saptamastatra devakīgarbhasaṃsthitaḥ || 23 || visraṃsitaśca garbho'sau yogena yogamāyayā | nītaśca rohiṇīgarbhe kṛtvā saṃkarṣaṇaṃ balāt || 24 || patitaḥ pañcame māsi lokakhyātiṃ gatastadā | kaṃso'pi jñātavāṃstatra devakīgarbhapātanam || 25 || mudaṃ prāpa sa duṣṭātmā śrutvā vārtāṃ sukhāvahām | aṣṭame devakīgarbhe bhagavānsātvatāṃ patiḥ || 26 || uvāsa devakāryārthaṃ bhārāvataraṇāya ca | rājovāca vasudevaḥ kaśyapāṃśaḥ śeṣāṃśaśca tadābhavat || 27 || hareraṃśastathā prokto bhavatā munisattama | anye ca yeṃ'śā devānāṃ tatra jātāstu tānvada || 28 || vyāsa uvāca surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca ye yeṃ'śā bhuvi viśrutāḥ || 29 || tānahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa śṛṇuṣva tān | vasudevaḥ kaśyapāṃśo devakī ca tathāditiḥ || 30 || baladevastvanantāṃśo vartamāneṣu teṣu ca | yo'sau dharmasutaḥ śrīmānnārāyaṇa iti śrutaḥ || 31 || tasyāṃśo vāsudevastu vidyamāne munau tadā | narastasyānujo yastu tasyāṃśo'rjuna eva ca || 32 || yudhiṣṭhirastu dharmāṃśo vāyvaṃśo bhīma ityuta | aśvinyaṃśau tataḥ proktau mādrīputrau mahābalau || 33 || sūryāṃśaḥ karṇa ākhyāto dharmāśo viduraḥ smṛtaḥ | droṇo bṛhaspateraṃśastatsatastu śivāṃśajaḥ || 34 || samudraḥ śantanuḥ prokto gaṅgā bhāryā matā budhaiḥ | devakastu samākhyāto gandharvapatirāgame || 35 || vasurbhīṣmo virāṭastu marudgaṇa iti smṛtaḥ | ariṣṭasya suto haṃso dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 36 || marudgaṇaḥ kṛpaḥ proktaḥ kṛtavarmā tathāparaḥ | duryodhanaḥ kaleraṃśaḥ śakuniṃ viddhi dvāparam || 37 || somaputraḥ suvarcākhyaḥ somaprarurudāhṛtaḥ | pāvakāṃśo dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī rākṣasastathā || 38 || sanatkumārasyāṃśastu pradyumnaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | drupado varuṇasyāṃśo draupadī ca ramāṃśajā || 39 || draupadītanayāḥ pañca viśvedevāṃśajāḥ smṛtāḥ | kuntiḥ siddhirdhṛtirmādrī matirgāndhārarājajā || 40 || kṛṣṇapatnyastathā sarvā devavārāṅganāḥ smṛtāḥ | rājānaśca tathā sarve asurāḥ śakranoditāḥ || 41 || hiraṇyakaśiporaṃśaḥ śiśupāla udāhṛtaḥ | vipracittirjarāsandhaḥ śalyaḥ prahlāda ityapi || 42 || kālanemistathā kaṃsaḥ keśī hayaśirāstathā | ariṣṭo baliputrastu kakudmī gokule hataḥ || 43 || anuhlādo dhṛṣṭaketurbhagadatto'tha bāṣkalaḥ | lambaḥ pralambaḥ sañjātaḥ kharo'sau dhenuko'bhavat || 44 || vārāhaśca kiśoraśca daityau paramadāruṇau | mallau tāveva sañjātau khyātau cāṇūramuṣṭikau || 45 || ditiputrastathāriṣṭo gajaḥ kuvalayābhidhaḥ | baliputrī bakī khyātā bakastadanujaḥ smṛtaḥ || 46 || yamo rudrastathā kāmaḥ krodhaścaiva caturthakaḥ | teṣāmaṃśaistu sañjāto droṇaputro mahābalaḥ || 47 || aṃśāvataraṇe pūrvaṃ daiteyā rākṣasāstathā | jātāḥ sarve surāṃśāste kṣitibhārāvatāraṇe || 48 || eteṣāṃ kathitaṃ rājannaṃśāvataraṇaṃ nṛpa | surāṇāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ ca purāṇeṣu prakīrtitam || 49 || yadā brahmādayo devāḥ prārthanārthaṃ hariṃ gatāḥ | hariṇā ca tadā dattau keśau khalu sitāsitau || 50 || śyāmavarṇastataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śvetaḥ saṅkarṣaṇastathā | bhārāvatāraṇārthaṃ tau jātau devāṃśasambhavau || 51 || aṃśāvataraṇaṃ caitacchṛṇoti bhaktibhāvataḥ | sarvapāpavinirmukto modate svajanairvṛtaḥ || 52 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe devadānavānāmaṃśāvataraṇavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || <4.23> kaṃsaṃ prati yogamāyāvākyam vyāsa uvāca hateṣu ṣaṭsu putreṣu devakyā augraseninā | saptame patite garbhe vacanānnāradasya ca || 1 || aṣṭamasya ca garbhasya rakṣaṇārthamatandritaḥ | prayatnamakarodrājā maraṇaṃ svaṃ vicintayan || 2 || samaye devakīgarbhe praveśamakaroddhariḥ | aṃśena vasudeve tu samāgatya yathākramam || 3 || tadeyaṃ yogamāyā ca yaśodāyāṃ yathecchayā | praveśamakaroddevī devakāryārthasiddhaye || 4 || rohiṇyāstanayo rāmo gokule samajāyata | yataḥ kaṃsabhayodvignā saṃsthitā sā ca kāminī || 5 || kārāgāre tataḥ kaṃso devakīṃ devasaṃstutām | sthāpayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ sevakānsamakalpayat || 6 || vasudevastu kāminyāḥ prematantuniyantritaḥ | putrotpattiṃ ca sañcintya praviṣṭaḥ saha bhāryayā || 7 || devakīgarbhago viṣṇurdevakāryārthasiddhaye | saṃstuto'marasaṅghaiśca vyavardhata yathākramam || 8 || sañjāte daśame tatra māse'tha śrāvaṇe śubhe | prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyukte kṛṣṇapakṣe'ṣṭamīdine || 9 || kaṃsastu dānavānsarvānuvāca bhayavihvalaḥ | rakṣaṇīyā bhavadbhiśca devakī garbhamandire || 10 || aṣṭamo devakīgarbhaḥ śatrurme prabhaviṣyati | rakṣaṇīyaḥ prayatnena mṛtyurūpaḥ sa bālakaḥ || 11 || hatvainaṃ bālakaṃ daityāḥ sukhaṃ svapsyāmi mandire | nivṛttivarjite duḥkhe nāśite cāṣṭame sute || 12 || khaḍgaprāsadharāḥ sarve tiṣṭhantu dhṛtakārmukāḥ | nidrātandrāvihīnāśca sarvatra nihitekṣaṇāḥ || 13 || vyāsa uvāca ityādiśyāsuragaṇān kṛśo'tibhayavihvalaḥ | mandiraṃ svaṃ jagāmāśu na lebhe dānavaḥ sukham || 14 || niśīthe devakī tatra vasudevamuvāca ha | kiṃ karomi mahārāja prasavāvasaro mama || 15 || bahavo rakṣapālāśca tiṣṭhantyatra bhayānakāḥ | nandapatnyā mayā sārdhaṃ kṛto'sti samayaḥ purā || 16 || preṣitavyastvayā putro mandire mama mānini | pālayiṣyāmyahaṃ tatra tavātimanasā kila || 17 || apatyaṃ te pradāsyāmi kaṃsasya pratyayāya vai | kiṃ kartavyaṃ prabho cātra viṣame samupasthite || 18 || vyatyayaḥ santateḥ śaure kathaṃ kartuṃ kṣamo bhaveḥ | dūre tiṣṭhasva kāntādya lajjā me'tiduratyayā || 19 || parāvṛtya mukhaṃ svāminnanyathā kiṃ karomyaham | ityuktvā taṃ mahābhāgaṃ devakī devasammatam || 20 || bālakaṃ suṣuve tatra niśīthe paramādbhutam | taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ prāpa devakī bālakaṃ śubham || 21 || patiṃ prāha mahābhāgā harṣotkullakalevarā | paśya putramukhaṃ kānta durlabhaṃ hi tava prabho || 22 || adyainaṃ kālarūpo'sau ghātayiṣyati bhrātṛjaḥ | vasudevastathetyuktvā tamādāya kare sutam || 23 || apaśyaccānanaṃ tasya sutasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ | vīkṣya putramukhaṃ śauriścintāviṣṭo babhūva ha || 24 || kiṃ karomi kathaṃ na syādduḥkhamasya kṛte mama | evaṃ cintāture tasminvāguvācāśarīriṇī || 25 || vasudevaṃ samābhāṣya gagane viśadākṣarā | vasudeva gṛhītvainaṃ gokulaṃ naya satvaraḥ || 26 || rakṣapālāstathā sarve mayā nidrāvimohitāḥ | vivṛtāni kṛtānyaṣṭa kapāṭāni ca śṛṅkhalāḥ || 27 || muktvainaṃ nandagehe tvaṃ yogamāyāṃ samānaya | śrutvaivaṃ vasudevastu tasminkārāgṛhe gataḥ || 28 || vivṛtaṃ dvāramālokya babhūva tarasā nṛpa | tamādāya yayāvāśu dvārapālairalakṣitaḥ || 29 || kālindītaṭamāsādya pūraṃ dṛṣṭvā suniścitam | tadaiva kaṭidaghnī sā babhūvāśu saridvarā || 30 || yogamāyāprabhāveṇa tatārānakadundubhiḥ | gatvā tu gokulaṃ śaurirniśīthe nirjane pathi || 31 || nandadvāre sthitaḥ paśyanvibhūtiṃ paśusaṃjñitām | tadaiva tatra sañjātā yaśodā garbhasambhavā || 32 || yogamāyāṃśajā devī triguṇā divyarūpiṇī | jātāṃ tāṃ bālikāṃ divyāṃ gṛhītvā karapaṅkaje || 33 || tatrāgatya dadau devī sairandhrīrūpadhāriṇī | vasudevaḥ sutaṃ dattvā sairandhrīkarapaṅkaje || 34 || tāmādāya yayau śīghraṃ bālikāṃ muditāśayaḥ | kārāgāre tato gatvā devakyāḥ śayane sutām || 35 || niḥkṣipya saṃsthitaḥ pārśve cintāviṣṭo bhayāturaḥ | ruroda susvaraṃ kanyā tadaivāgatasaṃjñakāḥ || 36 || uttasthuḥ sevakā rājñaḥ śrutvā tadruditaṃ niśi | tamūcurbhūpatiṃ gatvā tvaritāste'tivihvalāḥ || 37 || devakyāśca suto jātaḥ śīghramehi mahāmate | tadākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ śīghraṃ bhojapatiryayau || 38 || prāvṛtaṃ dvāramālokya vasudevamathāhvayat | kaṃsa uvāca sutamānaya devakyā vasudeva mahāmate || 39 || mṛtyurme cāṣṭamo garbhastannihanmi ripuṃ harim | vyāsa uvāca śrutvā kaṃsavacaḥ śaurirbhayatrastavilocanaḥ || 40 || tāmādāya sutāṃ pāṇau dadau cāśu rudanniva | dṛṣṭvātha dārikāṃ rājā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 41 || devavāṇī vṛthā jātā nāradasya ca bhāṣitam | vasudevaḥ kathaṃ kuryādanṛtaṃ saṅkaṭe sthitaḥ || 42 || rakṣapālāśca me sarve sāvadhānā na saṃśayaḥ | kuto'tra kanyakā kāmaṃ kva gataḥ sa sutaḥ kila || 43 || sandeho'tra na kartavyaḥ kālasya viṣamā gatiḥ | iti sañcintya tāṃ bālāṃ gṛhītvā pādayoḥ khalaḥ || 44 || pothayāmāsa pāṣāṇe nirghṛṇaḥ kulapāṃsanaḥ | sā karānniḥsṛtā bālā yayāvākāśamaṇḍalam || 45 || divyarūpā tadā bhūtvā tamuvāca mṛdusvanā | kiṃ mayā hatayā pāpa jātaste balavān ripuḥ || 46 || haniṣyati durārādhyaḥ sarvathā tvāṃ narādhamam | ityuktvā sā gatā kanyā gaganaṃ kāmagā śivā || 47 || kaṃsastu vismayāviṣṭo gato nijagṛhaṃ tadā | ānāyya dānavānsarvānidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 48 || bakadhenukavatsādīnkrodhāviṣṭo bhayāturaḥ | gacchantu dānavāḥ sarve mama kāryārthasiddhaye || 49 || jātamātrāśca hantavyā bālakā yatra kutracit | pūtanaiṣā vrajatvadya bālaghnī nandagokulam || 50 || jātamātrānvinighnantī śiśūṃstatra mamājñayā | dhenuko vatsakaḥ keśī pralambo baka eva ca || 51 || sarve tiṣṭhantu tatraiva mama kāryacikīrṣayā | ityājñāpyāsurānkaṃso yayau nijagṛhaṃ khalaḥ || 52 || cintāviṣṭo'tidīnātmā cintayitvaiva taṃ punaḥ || 53 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe kaṃsaṃ prati yogamāyāvākyaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || <4.24> devyā kṛṣṇaśokāyanodanam vyāsa uvāca prātarnandagṛhe jātaḥ putrajanmamahotsavaḥ | kiṃvadantyatha kaṃsena śrutā cāramukhādapi || 1 || jānāti vasudevasya dārāstatra vasanti hi | paśavo dāsavargaśca sarve te nandagokule || 2 || tena śaṅkāsamāviṣṭo gokulaṃ prati bhārata | nāradenāpi tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ kāraṇaṃ purā || 3 || gokule ye ca nandādyāstatpatnyaśca surāṃśajāḥ | devakīvasudevādyāḥ sarve te śatravaḥ kila || 4 || iti nāradavākyena bodhito'sau kulādhamaḥ | jātaḥ kopamanā rājan kaṃsaḥ paramapāpakṛt || 5 || pūtanā nihatā tatra kṛṣṇenāmitatejasā | bako vatsāsuraścāpi dhenukaśca mahābalaḥ || 6 || pralambo nihatastena tathā govardhano dhṛtaḥ | śrutvaitatkarma kaṃsastu mene maraṇamātmanaḥ || 7 || tathā vinihataḥ keśī jñātvā kaṃso'tidurmanāḥ | dhanuryāgamiṣeṇāśu tāvānetuṃ pracakrame || 8 || akrūraṃ preṣayāmāsa krūraḥ pāpamatistadā | ānetuṃ rāmakṛṣṇau ca vadhāyāmitavikramau || 9 || rathamāropya gopālau gokulād gāndinīsutaḥ | āgato mathurāyāṃ tu kaṃsādeśe sthitaḥ kila || 10 || tāvāgatya tadā tatra dhanurbhaṅgañca cakratuḥ | hatvātha rajakaṃ kāmaṃ gajaṃ cāṇūramuṣṭikam || 11 || śalaṃ ca tośalaṃ caiva nijaghāna haristadā | jaghāna kaṃsaṃ deveśaḥ keśeṣvākṛṣya līlayā || 12 || pitarau mocayitvātha gataduḥkhau cakāra ha | ugrasenāya rājyaṃ taddadāvariniṣūdanaḥ || 13 || vasudevastayostatra mauñjībandhanapūrvakam | kārayāmāsa vidhivad vratabandhaṃ mahāmanāḥ || 14 || upanītau tadā tau tu gatau sāndīpanālayam | vidyāḥ sarvāḥ samabhyasya mathurāmāgatau punaḥ || 15 || jātau dvādaśavarṣīyau kṛtavidyau mahābalau | mathurāyāṃ sthitau vīrau sutāvānakadundubheḥ || 16 || māgadhastu jarāsandho jāmātṛvadhaduḥkhitaḥ | kṛtvā sainyasamājaṃ sa mathurāmāgataḥ purīm || 17 || sa saptadaśavāraṃ tu kṛṣṇena kṛtabuddhinā | jitaḥ saṃgrāmamāsādya madhupuryāṃ nivāsinā || 18 || paścācca preritastena sa kālayavanābhidhaḥ | sarvamlecchādhipaḥ śūro yādavānāṃ bhayaṅkaraḥ || 19 || śrutvā yavanamāyāntaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvān yadūttamān | ānāyya ca tathā rāmamuvāca madhusūdanaḥ || 20 || bhayaṃ no'tra samutpannaṃ jarāsandhānmahābalāt | kiṃ kartavyaṃ mahābhāga yavanaḥ samupaiti vai || 21 || prāṇatrāṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ tyaktvā gehaṃ balaṃ dhanam | sukhena sthīyate yatra sa deśaḥ khalu paitṛkaḥ || 22 || sadodvegakaraḥ kāmaṃ kiṃ kartavyaḥ kulocitaḥ | śailasāgarasānnidhye sthātavyaṃ sukhamicchatā || 23 || yatra vairibhayaṃ na syātsthātavyaṃ tatra paṇḍitaiḥ | śeṣaśayyāṃ samāśritya hariḥ svapiti sāgare || 24 || tathaiva ca bhayādbhītaḥ kailāse tripurārdanaḥ | tasmānnātraiva sthātavyamasmābhiḥ śatrutāpitaiḥ || 25 || dvāravatyāṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ sahitāḥ sarva eva vai | kathitā garuḍenādya ramyā dvāravatī purī || 26 || raivatācalasānidhye sindhukūle manoharā | vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tathyaṃ sarve yādavapuṅgavāḥ || 27 || gamanāya matiṃ cakruḥ sakuṭumbāḥ savāhanāḥ | śakaṭāni tathoṣṭrāśca vāmyaśca mahiṣāstathā || 28 || dhanapūrṇāni kṛtvā te niryayurnagarādbahiḥ | rāmakṛṣṇau puraskṛtya sarve te saparicchadāḥ || 29 || agre kṛtvā prajāḥ sarvāśceluḥ sarve yadūttamāḥ | katiciddivasaiḥ prāpuḥ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ kila || 30 || śilpibhiḥ kārayāmāsa jīrṇoddhāraṃ hi mādhavaḥ | saṃsthāpya yādavāṃstatra tāvetau balakeśavau || 31 || tarasā mathurāmetya saṃsthitau nirjanāṃ purīm | tadā tatraiva samprāpto balavān yavanādhipaḥ || 32 || jñātvainamāgataṃ kṛṣṇo niryayau nagarādbahiḥ | padātiragre tasyābhūdyavanasya janārdanaḥ || 33 || pītāmbaradharaḥ śrīmānprāhasanmadhusūdanaḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā purato yāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kamalalocanam || 34 || yavano'pi padātiḥ sanpṛṣṭhato'nugataḥ khalaḥ | prasupto yatra rājarṣirmucukundo mahābalaḥ || 35 || prayayau bhagavāṃstatra sakālayavano hariḥ | tatraivāntardadhe viṣṇurmucukundaṃ samīkṣya ca || 36 || tatraiva yavanaḥ prāptaḥ suptabhūtamapaśyata | matvā taṃ vāsudevaṃ sa pādenātāḍayannṛpam || 37 || prabuddhaḥ krodharaktākṣastaṃ dadāha mahābalaḥ | taṃ dagdhvā mucukundo'tha dadarśa kamalekṣaṇam || 38 || vāsudevaṃ sudeveśaṃ praṇamya prasthito vanam | jagāma dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇo baladevasamanvitaḥ || 39 || ugrasenaṃ nṛpaṃ kṛtvā vijahāra yathāruci | aharadrukmiṇī kāmaṃ śiśupālasvayaṃvarāt || 40 || rākṣasena vivāhena cakre dāravidhiṃ hariḥ | tato jāmbavatīṃ satyāṃ mitravindāñca bhāminīm || 41 || kālindīṃ lakṣaṇāṃ bhadrāṃ tathā nāgnajitīṃ śubhām | pṛthakpṛthaksamānīyāpyupayeme janārdanaḥ || 42 || aṣṭāveva mahīpāla patnyaḥ paramaśobhanāḥ | prāsūta rukmiṇī putraṃ pradyumnaṃ cārudarśanam || 43 || jātakarmādikaṃ tasya cakāra madhusūdanaḥ | hṛto'sau sūtikāgehācchambareṇa balīyasā || 44 || nītaśca svapurīṃ bālo māyāvatyai samarpitaḥ | vāsudevo hṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ śokasamanvitaḥ || 45 || jagāma śaraṇaṃ devīṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā | vṛtrāsurādayo daityā līlayaiva yayā hatāḥ || 46 || tato'sau yogamāyāyāścakāra paramāṃ smṛtim | vacobhiḥ paramodārairakṣaraiḥ stavanaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 47 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca mātarmayātitapasā paritoṣitā tvaṃ prāgjanmani prasumanādibhirarcitāsi | dharmātmajena badarīvanakhaṇḍamadhye kiṃ vismṛto janani te tvayi bhaktibhāvaḥ || 48 || sūtīgṛhādapahṛtaḥ kimu bālako me kenāpi duṣṭamanasāpyatha kautukādvā | mānāpahārakaraṇāya mamādya nūnaṃ lajjā tavāmba khalu bhaktajanasya yuktā || 49 || durgo mahānatitarāṃ nagarī suguptā tatrāpi me'sti sadanaṃ kila madhyabhāge | antaḥpure ca pihitaṃ nanu sūtigehaṃ bālo hṛtaḥ khalu tathāpi mamaiva doṣāt || 50 || nāhaṃ gataḥ parapuraṃ na ca yādavāśca rakṣāvatīva nagarī kila vīravaryaiḥ | māyā tavaiva janani prakaṭaprabhāvā me bālakaḥ parihṛtaḥ kuhakena kena || 51 || no vedmyahaṃ janani te caritaṃ suguptaṃ ko veda mandamatiralpavideva dehī | kvāsau gato mama bhaṭairna ca vīkṣito vā hartāmbike javanikā tava kalpiteyam || 52 || citraṃ na te'tra purato mama mātṛgarbho nītastvayārdhasamaye kila māyayāsau | yaṃ rohiṇī haladharaṃ suṣuve prasiddhaṃ dūre sthitā patiparā mithunaṃ vināpi || 53 || sṛṣṭiṃ karoṣi jagatāmanupālanaṃ ca nāśaṃ tathaiva punarapyaniśaṃ guṇaistvam | ko veda te'mba caritaṃ duritāntakāri prāyeṇa sarvamakhilaṃ vihitaṃ tvayaitat || 54 || utpādya putrajananaprabhavaṃ pramodaṃ dattvā punarvirahajaṃ kila duḥkhabhāram | tvaṃ krīḍase sulalitaiḥ khalu tairvihārairno cetkathaṃ mama sutāptiratirvṛthā syāt || 55 || mātāsya roditi bhṛśaṃ kurarīva bālā duḥkhaṃ tanoti mama sannidhigā sadaiva | kaṣṭaṃ na vetsi lalite'pramitaprabhāve mātastvameva śaraṇaṃ bhavapīḍitānām || 56 || sīmā sukhasya sutajanma tadīyanāśo duḥkhasya devi bhavane vibudhā vadanti | tatkiṃ karomi janani prathame pranaṣṭe putre mamādya hṛdayaṃ sphuṭatīva mātaḥ || 57 || yajñaṃ karomi tava tuṣṭikaraṃ vrataṃ vā daivaṃ ca pūjanamathākhiladuḥkhahā tvam | mātaḥ suto'tra yadi jīvati darśayāśu tvaṃ vai kṣamā sakalaśokavināśanāya || 58 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ stutā tadā devī kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā | pratyakṣadarśanā bhūtvā tamuvāca jagadgurum || 59 || śrīdevyuvāca śokaṃ mā kuru deveśa śāpo'yaṃ te purātanaḥ | tasya yogena putraste śambareṇa hṛto balāt || 60 || ataste ṣoḍaśe varṣe hatvā taṃ śambaraṃ balāt | āgamiṣyati putraste matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ || 61 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktvāntardadhe devī caṇḍikā caṇḍavikramā | bhagavānapi putrasya śokaṃ tyaktvābhavatsukhī || 62 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe devyā kṛṣṇaśokāpanodanaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || <4.25> parāśakteḥ sarvajñatvakathanam rājovāca sandeho me muniśreṣṭha jāyate vacanāttava | vaiṣṇavāṃśe bhagavati duḥkhotpattiṃ vilokya ca || 1 || nārāyaṇāṃśasambhūto vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān | kathaṃ sa sūtikāgārāddhṛto bālo harerapi || 2 || suguptanagare ramye gupte'tha sūtikāgṛhe | praviśya tena daityena gṛhīto'sau kathaṃ śiśuḥ || 3 || na jñāto vāsudevena citrametanmamādbhutam | jāyate mahadāścaryaṃ citte satyavatīsuta || 4 || brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ brahmanna jñātaṃ keśavena yat | haraṇaṃ tatrasaṃsthena śiśorvā sūtikāgṛhāt || 5 || vyāsa uvāca māyā balavatī rājannarāṇāṃ buddhimohinī | śāmbhavī viśrutā loke ko vā mohaṃ na gacchati || 6 || mānuṣaṃ janma samprāpya guṇāḥ sarve'pi mānuṣāḥ | bhavanti dehajā kāmaṃ na devā nāsurāstadā || 7 || kṣuttṛṇnidrā bhayaṃ tandrā vyāmohaḥ śokasaṃśayaḥ | harṣaścaivābhimānaśca jarāmaraṇameva ca || 8 || ajñānaṃ glāniraprītirīrṣyāsūyā madaḥ śramaḥ | ete dehabhavā bhāvāḥ prabhavanti narādhipa || 9 || yathā hemamṛgaṃ rāmo na bubodha purogatam | jānakyā haraṇañcaiva jaṭāyumaraṇaṃ tathā || 10 || abhiṣekadine rāmo vanavāsaṃ na veda ca | tathā na jñātavān rāmaḥ svaśokānmaraṇaṃ pituḥ || 11 || ajñavadvicacārāsau paśyamāno vane vane | jānakīṃ na vivedātha rāvaṇena hṛtāṃ balāt || 12 || sahāyān vānarānkṛtvā hatvā śakrasutaṃ balāt | sāgare setubandhañca kṛtvottīrya saritpatim || 13 || preṣayāmāsa sarvāsu dikṣu tānkapikuñjarān | saṃgrāmaṃ kṛtavānghoraṃ duḥkhaṃ prāpa raṇājire || 14 || bandhanaṃ nāgapāśena prāpa rāmo mahābalaḥ | garuḍānmokṣaṇaṃ paścādanvabhūdraghunandanaḥ || 15 || ahanadrāvaṇaṃ saṃkhye kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam | meghanādaṃ nikumbhañca kupito raghunandanaḥ || 16 || adūṣyatvañca jānakyā na viveda janārdanaḥ | divyañca kārayāmāsa jvalite'gnau praveśanam || 17 || lokāpavādācca paraṃ tatastatyāja tāṃ priyām | adūṣyāṃ dūṣitāṃ matvā sītāṃ daśarathātmajaḥ || 18 || na jñātau svasutau tena rāmeṇa ca kuśīlavau | muninā kathitau tau tu tasya putrau mahābalau || 19 || pātālagamanaṃ caiva jānakyā jñātavānna ca | rāghavaḥ kopasaṃyukto bhrātaraṃ hantumudyataḥ || 20 || kālasyāgamanañcaiva na viveda kharāntakaḥ | mānuṣaṃ dehamāśritya cakre mānuṣaceṣṭitam || 21 || tathaiva mānuṣānbhāvānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | pūrvaṃ kaṃsabhayātprāpto gokule yadunandanaḥ || 22 || jarāsandhabhayātpaścād dvāravatyāṃ gato hariḥ | adharmaṃ kṛtavānkṛṣṇo rukmiṇyā haraṇañca yat || 23 || śiśupālavṛtāyāśca jānandharmaṃ sanātanam | śuśoca bālakaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śambareṇa hṛtaṃ balāt || 24 || mumoda jānanputraṃ taṃ harṣaśokayutastataḥ | satyabhāmājñayā yattu yuyudhe svargataḥ kila || 25 || indreṇa pādapārthaṃ tu strījitatvaṃ prakāśayan | jahāra kalpavṛkṣaṃ yaḥ parābhūya śatakratum || 26 || māninīmānarakṣārthaṃ hariścitradharaḥ prabhuḥ | baddhvā vṛkṣe hariṃ satyā nāradāya dadau patim || 27 || dattvātha kānakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mocayāmāsa bhāminī | dṛṣṭvā putrānpuruguṇānpradyumnapramukhānatha || 28 || kṛṣṇaṃ jāmbavatī dīnā yayāce santatiṃ śubhām | sa yayau parvataṃ kṛṣṇastapasyākṛtaniścayaḥ || 29 || upamanyurmuniryatra śivabhaktaḥ parantapaḥ | upamanyuṃ guru kṛtvā dīkṣāṃ pāśupato hariḥ || 30 || jagrāha putrakāmastu muṇḍī daṇḍī babhūva ha | ugraṃ tatra tapastepe māsamekaṃ phalāśanaḥ || 31 || jajāpa śivamantraṃ tu śivadhyānaparo hariḥ | dvitīye tu jalāhārastiṣṭhannekapadā hariḥ || 32 || tṛtīye vāyubhakṣastu pādāṅguṣṭhāgrasaṃsthitaḥ | ṣaṣṭhe tu bhagavān rudraḥ prasanno bhaktibhāvataḥ || 33 || darśanañca dadau tatra somaḥ somakalādharaḥ | ājagāma vṛṣārūḍhaḥ surairindrādibhirvṛtaḥ || 34 || brahmaviṣṇuyutaḥ sākṣādyakṣagandharvasevitaḥ | sambodhayanvāsudevaṃ śaṅkarastamuvāca ha || 35 || tuṣṭo'smi kṛṣṇa tapasā tavogreṇa mahāmate | dadāmi vācchitānkāmānbrūhi yādavanandana || 36 || mayi dṛṣṭe kāmapūre kāmaśeṣo na sambhavet | vyāsa uvāca taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkaraṃ tuṣṭaṃ bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ || 37 || papāta pādayostasya daṇḍavatpremasaṃyutaḥ | stutiṃ cakāra deveśo meghagambhīrayā girā || 38 || sthitastu purataḥ śambhorvāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca devadeva jagantātha sarvabhūtārtināśana || 39 || viśvayone surārighna namastrailokyakāraka | nīlakaṇṭha namastubhyaṃ śūline te namo namaḥ || 40 || śailajāvallabhāyāśca yajñaghnāya namo'stu te | dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ darśanāttava suvrata || 41 || janma me saphalaṃ jātaṃ natvā te pādapaṅkajam | baddho'haṃ strīmayaiḥ pāśaiḥ saṃsāre'smiñjagadguro || 42 || śaraṇaṃ te'dya samprāpto rakṣaṇārthaṃ trilocana | samprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma khinno'haṃ duḥkhanāśana || 43 || trāhi māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ bhavabhītaṃ bhavādhunā | garbhavāse mahadduḥkhaṃ prāptaṃ madanadāhaka || 44 || janmataḥ kaṃsabhayajamanubhūtaṃ ca gokule | jāto'haṃ nandagopālo ballavājñākarastathā || 45 || gorajaḥkīrṇakeśastu bhramanvṛndāvane ghane | mleccharājabhayatrasto gato dvāravatīṃ punaḥ || 46 || tyaktvā pitryaṃ śubhaṃ deśaṃ mādhuraṃ durlabhaṃ vibho | yayātiśāpabaddhena tasmai dattaṃ bhayādvibho || 47 || rājyaṃ supuṣṭamapi ca dharmarakṣāpareṇa ca | ugrasenasya dāsatvaṃ kṛtaṃ vai sarvadā mayā || 48 || rājāsau yādavānāṃ vai kṛto naḥ pūrvajaiḥ kila | gārhasthyaṃ duḥkhadaṃ śambho strīvaśyaṃ dharmakhaṇḍanam || 49 || pāratantryaṃ sadā bandhamokṣavārtātra durlabhā | rukyiṇyāstanayāndṛṣṭvā bhāryā jāmbavatī mama || 50 || prerayāmāsa putrārthaṃ tapase madanāntaka | sakāmena mayā taptaṃ tapaḥ putrārthamadya vai || 51 || lajjā bhavati deveśa prārthanāyāṃ jagadguro | kastvāmārādhya deveśaṃ muktidaṃ bhaktavatsalam || 52 || prasannaṃ yācate mūḍhaḥ phalaṃ tucchaṃ vināśi yat | so'yaṃ māyāvimūḍhātmā yāce putrasukhaṃ vibho || 53 || kāminyā preritaḥ śambho muktidaṃ tvāṃ jagatpate | jānāmi duḥkhadaṃ śambho saṃsāraṃ duḥkhasādhanam || 54 || anityaṃ nāśadharmāṇaṃ tathāpi viratirna me | śāpānnārāyaṇāṃśo'haṃ jāto'smi kṣitimaṇḍale || 55 || bhoktuṃ bahutaraṃ duḥkhaṃ māyāpāśena yantritaḥ | vyāsa uvāca ityuktavantaṃ govindaṃ pratyuvāca maheśvaraḥ || 56 || bahavaste bhaviṣyanti putrāḥ śatruniṣūdana | strīṇāṃ ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ bhaviṣyati śatārdhakam || 57 || tāsu putrā daśa daśa bhaviṣyanti mahābalāḥ | ityuktvopararāmāśu śaṅkaraḥ priyadarśanaḥ || 58 || uvāca girijā devī praṇataṃ madhusūdanam | kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho saṃsāre'sminnarādhipa || 59 || gṛhasthapravaro loke bhaviṣyati bhavāniha | tato varṣaśatānte tu dvijaśāpājjanārdana || 60 || gāndhāryāśca tathā śāpādbhavitā te kulakṣayaḥ | parasparaṃ nihatyājau putrāste śāpamohitāḥ || 61 || gamiṣyanti kṣayaṃ sarve yādavāśca tathāpare | sānujastvaṃ tathā dehaṃ tyaktvā yāsyasi vai divam || 62 || śokastatra na kartavyo bhavitavyaṃ prati prabho | avaśyambhāvibhāvānāṃ pratīkāro na vidyate || 63 || tatra śoko na kartavyo nūnaṃ mama mataṃ sadā | aṣṭāvakrasya śāpena bhāryāste madhusūdana || 64 || caurebhyo grahaṇaṃ kṛṣṇa gamiṣyanti mṛte tvayi | vyāsa uvāca ityuktvāntardadhe śambhuḥ somaḥ sasuramaṇḍalaḥ || 65 || upamanyuṃ praṇamyātha kṛṣṇo'pi dvārakāṃ yayau | yasmād brahmādayo rājan santi yadyapyadhīśvarāḥ || 66 || tathāpi māyākallolayogasaṃkṣubhitāntarāḥ | tadadhīnāḥ sthitāḥ sarve kāṣṭhaputtalikopamāḥ || 67 || yathā yathā pūrvabhavaṃ karma teṣāṃ tathā tathā | prerayatyaniśaṃ māyā parabrahmasvarūpiṇī || 68 || na vaiṣamyaṃ na nairghṛṇyaṃ bhagavatyāṃ kadācana | kevalaṃ jīvamokṣārthaṃ yatate bhuvaneśvarī || 69 || yadi sā naiva sṛjyeta jagadetaccarācaram | tadā māyāṃ vinā bhūtaṃ jaḍaṃ syādeva nityaśaḥ || 70 || tasmātkāruṇyamāśritya jagajjīvādikaṃ ca yat | karoti satataṃ devī prerayatyaniśaṃ ca tat || 71 || tasmād brahmādimohe'sminkartavyaḥ saṃśayo na hi | māyāntaḥpātinaḥ sarve māyādhīnāḥ surāsurāḥ || 72 || svatantrā saiva deveśī svecchācāravihāriṇī | tasmātsarvātmanā rājan sevanīyā maheśvarī || 73 || nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcidadhikaṃ bhuvanatraye | etaddhi janmasāphalyaṃ parāśakteḥ padasmṛtiḥ || 74 || mābhūttatra kule janma yatra devī na daivatam | ahaṃ devī na cānyo'smi brahmaivāhaṃ na śokabhāk || 75 || ityabhedena tāṃ nityāṃ cintayejjagadambikām | jñātvā gurumukhādenāṃ vedāntaśravaṇādibhiḥ || 76 || nityamekāgramanasā bhāvayedātmarūpiṇīm | mukto bhavati tenāśu nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ || 77 || śvetāśvatarādayaḥ sarve ṛṣayo nirmalāśayāḥ | ātmarūpāṃ hṛdā jñātvā vimuktā bhavabandhanāt || 78 || brahmaviṣṇvādayastadvad gaurīlakṣmyādayastathā | tāmeva samupāsante saccidānandarūpiṇīm || 79 || iti te kathitaṃ rājan yadyatpuṣṭaṃ tvayānagha | prapañcatāpatrastena kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 80 || etatte kathitaṃ rājanmayākhyānamanuttamam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ paramādbhutam || 81 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasammitam | sarvapāpavinirmukto devīloke mahīyate || 82 || sūta uvāca etanmayā śrutaṃ vyāsātkathyamānaṃ savistaram | purāṇaṃ pañcamaṃ nūnaṃ śrīmadbhāgavatābhidham || 83 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthaskandhe parāśakteḥ sarvajñatvakathanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || <5.1> yogamāyāprabhāvavarṇanam ṛṣaya ūcuḥ bhavatā kathitaṃ sūta mahadākhyānamuttamam | kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ divyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || sandeho'tra mahābhāga vāsudevakathānake | jāyate naḥ procyamāne vistareṇa mahāmate || 2 || vane gatvā tapastaptaṃ vāsudevena duṣkaram | viṣṇoraṃśāvatāreṇa śivasyārādhanaṃ kṛtam || 3 || varapradānaṃ devyā ca pārvatyā yatkṛtaṃ punaḥ | jaganmātuśca pūrṇāyāḥ śrīdevyā aṃśabhūtayā || 4 || īśvareṇāpi kṛṣṇena kutastau samprapūjitau | nyūnatā vā kimastvasya tadevaṃ saṃśayo mama || 5 || sūta uvāca śṛṇudhvaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra mayā vyāsaśrutañca yat | prabravīmi mahābhāgāḥ kathāṃ kṛṣṇaguṇānvitām || 6 || vṛttāntaṃ vyāsataḥ śrutvā vairāṭīsutajastadā | punaḥ papraccha medhāvī sandehaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 7 || janamejaya uvāca samyaksatyavatīsūno śrutaṃ paramakāraṇam | tathāpi manaso vṛttiḥ saṃśayaṃ na vimuñcati || 8 || kṛṣṇenārādhitaḥ śambhustapastaptvātidāruṇam | vismayo'yaṃ mahābhāga devadevena viṣṇunā || 9 || yaḥ sarvātmāpi sarveśaḥ sarvasiddhipradaḥ prabhuḥ | sa kathaṃ kṛtavānghoraṃ tapaḥ prākṛtavaddhariḥ || 10 || jagatkartuṃ kṣamaḥ kṛṣṇastathā pālayituṃ kṣamaḥ | saṃhartumapi kasmātsa dāruṇaṃ tapa ācarat || 11 || vyāsa uvāca satyamuktaṃ tvayā rājan vāsudevo janārdanaḥ | kṣamaḥ sarveṣu kāryeṣu devānāṃ daityasūdanaḥ || 12 || tathāpi mānuṣaṃ dehamāśritaḥ parameśvaraḥ | kṛtavānmānuṣānbhāvānvarṇāśramasamāśritān || 13 || vṛddhānāṃ pūjanaṃ caiva gurupādābhivandanam | brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā sevā devatārādhanaṃ tathā || 14 || śoke śokābhiyogaśca harṣe harṣasamunnatiḥ | dainyaṃ nānāpavādāśca strīṣu kāmopasevanam || 15 || kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhaḥ kāle kāle bhavanti hi | tathā guṇamaye dehe nirguṇatvaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 16 || saubalīśāpajāddoṣāttathā brāhmaṇaśāpajāt | nidhanaṃ yādavānāṃ tu kṛṣṇadehasya mocanam || 17 || haraṇaṃ luṇṭhanaṃ tadvattatpatnīnāṃ narādhipa | arjunasyāstramokṣe ca klībatvaṃ taskareṣu ca || 18 || ajñatvaṃ haraṇe gehāttatpradyumnāniruddhayoḥ | evaṃ mānuṣadehe'sminmānuṣaṃ khalu ceṣṭitam || 19 || viṣṇoraṃśāvatāre'sminnārāyaṇamunestathā | aṃśaje vāsudeve'tra kiṃ citraṃ śivasevane || 20 || sa hi sarveśvaro devo viṣṇorapi ca kāraṇam | suṣuptasthānanāthaḥ sa viṣṇunā ca prapūjitaḥ || 21 || tadaṃśabhūtāḥ kṛṣṇādyāstaiḥ kathaṃ na sa pūjyate | akāro bhagavānbrahmāpyukāraḥ syāddhariḥ svayam || 22 || makāro bhagavān rudro'pyardhamātrā maheśvarī | uttarottarabhāvenāpyuttamatvaṃ smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ || 23 || ataḥ sarveṣu śāstreṣu devī sarvottamā smṛtā | ardhamātrāsthitā nityā yānuccāryā viśeṣataḥ || 24 || viṣṇorapyathiko rudro viṣṇustu brahmaṇo'dhikaḥ | tasmānna saṃśayaḥ kāryaḥ kṛṣṇena śivapūjane || 25 || icchayā brahmaṇo vaktrādvaradānārthamudbabhau | mūlarudrasyāṃśabhūto rudranāmā dvitīyakaḥ || 26 || so'pi pūjyo'sti sarveṣāṃ mūlarudrasya kā kathā | devītattvasya sānnidhyāduttamatvaṃ smṛtaṃ śive || 27 || avatārā harerevaṃ prabhavanti yuge yuge | yogamāyāprabhāveṇa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 28 || yā netrapakṣmaparisañcalanena samyagviśvaṃ sṛjatyavati hanti nigūḍhabhāvā | saiṣā karoti satataṃ druhiṇācyuteśān nānāvatārakalane paribhūyamānān || 29 || sūtīgṛhādvrajanamapyanayā niyuktaṃ saṃgopitaśca bhavane paśupālarājñaḥ | samprāpitaśca madhurāṃ viniyojitaśca śrīdvārakāpraṇayane nanu bhītacittaḥ || 30 || nirmāya ṣoḍaśasahasraśatārdhakāstā nāryo'ṣṭasammatatarāḥ svakalāsamutthāḥ | tāsāṃ vilāsavaśagaṃ tu vidhāya kāmaṃ dāsīkṛto hi bhagavānanayāpyanantaḥ || 31 || ekāpi bandhanavidhau yuvatī samarthā puṃso yathā sudṛḍhalohamayaṃ tu dāma | kiṃ nāma ṣoḍaśasahasraśatārdhakāśca taṃ svīkṛtaṃ śukamivātinibandhayanti || 32 || sātrājitīvaśagatena mudānvitena prāptaṃ surendrabhavanaṃ hariṇā tadānīm | kṛtvā mṛdhaṃ maghavatā vihṛtastarūṇāmīśaḥ priyāsadanabhūṣaṇatāṃ ya āpa || 33 || yo bhīmajāṃ hi hṛtavāñchiśupālakādīñjitvā vidhiṃ nikhiladharmakṛto vidhitsuḥ | jagrāha tāṃ nijabalena ca dharmapatnīṃ ko'sau vidhiḥ parakalatrahṛtau vijātaḥ || 34 || ahaṅkāravaśaḥ prāṇī karoti ca śubhāśubham | vimūḍho mohajālena tatkṛtenātipātinā || 35 || ahaṅkārāddhi sañjātamidaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | mūlāddhariharādīnāmugrātprakṛtisambhavāt || 36 || ahaṅkāraparityakto yadā bhavati padmajaḥ | tadā vimukto bhavati nocetsaṃsārakarmakṛt || 37 || tanmuktastu vimukto hi baddhastadvaśatāṃ gataḥ | na nārī na dhanaṃ gehaṃ na putrā na sahodarāḥ || 38 || bandhanaṃ prāṇināṃ rājannahaṅkārastu bandhakaḥ | ahaṃ kartā mayā cedaṃ kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ balīyasā || 39 || kariṣyāmi karomyevaṃ svayaṃ badhnāti prāṇabhṛt | kāraṇena vinā kāryaṃ na sambhavati karhicit || 40 || yathā na dṛśyate jāto mṛtpiṇḍena vinā ghaṭaḥ | viṣṇuḥ pālayitā viśvasyāhaṅkārasamanvitaḥ || 41 || anyathā sarvadā cintāmbudhau magnaḥ kathaṃ bhavet | ahaṅkāravimuktastu yadā bhavati mānavaḥ || 42 || avatārapravāheṣu kathaṃ majjecchubhāśayaḥ | mohamūlamahaṅkāraḥ saṃsārastatsamudbhavaḥ || 43 || ahaṅkāravihīnānāṃ na moho na ca saṃsṛtiḥ | trividhaḥ puruṣaḥ proktaḥ sāttviko rājasastathā || 44 || tāmasastu mahārāja brahmaviṣṇuśivādiṣu | trividhastriṣu rājendra kājeśādiṣu sarvadā || 45 || ahaṅkāraḥ sadā prokto munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ | ahaṅkāreṇa tenaiva baddhā ete na saṃśayaḥ || 46 || māyāvimohitā mandāḥ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | karoti svecchayā viṣṇuravatārānanekaśaḥ || 47 || mando'pi duḥkhagahane garbhavāse'tisaṅkaṭe | na karoti matiṃ vidvānkathaṃ kuryātsa cakrabhṛt || 48 || kausalyādevakīgarbhe viṣṭhāmalasamākule | svecchayā pravadantyaddhā gato hi madhusūdanaḥ || 49 || vaikuṇṭhasadanaṃ tyaktvā garbhavāse sukhaṃ nu kim | cintākoṭisamutthāne duḥkhade viṣasammite || 50 || tapastaptvā kratūnkṛtvā dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ | na vāñchanti yato lokā garbhavāsaṃ suduḥkhadam || 51 || sa kathaṃ bhagavānviṣṇuḥ svavaśaścejjanārdanaḥ | garbhavāsarucirbhūyādbhavetsvavaśatā yadi || 52 || jānīhi tvaṃ mahārāja yogamāyāvaśe jagat | brahmādistambaparyantaṃ devamānuṣatiryagam || 53 || māyātantrīnibaddhā ye brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ | bhramanti bandhamāyānti līlayā corṇanābhavat || 54 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe yogamāyāprabhāvavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || <5.2> mahiṣāsurotpattiḥ rājovāca yogeśvaryāḥ prabhāvo'yaṃ kathitaścātivistarāt | brūhi taccaritaṃ svāmiñchrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama || 1 || mahādevīprabhāvaṃ vai śrotuṃ ko nābhivāñchati | yo jānāti jagatsarvaṃ tadutpannaṃ carācaram || 2 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi vistareṇa mahāmate | śraddadhānāya śāntāya na brūyātsa tu mandadhīḥ || 3 || purā yuddhamabhūd ghoraṃ devadānavasenayoḥ | pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpāla mahiṣākhye mahīpatau || 4 || mahiṣo nāma rājendra cakāra tapa uttamam | gatvā hemagirau cograṃ devavismayakārakam || 5 || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ pūrṇaṃ cintayanhṛdi devatām | tasya tuṣṭo mahārāja brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 6 || tatrāgatyābravīdvākyaṃ haṃsārūḍhaścaturmukhaḥ | varaṃ varaya dharmātmandadāmi tava vācchitam || 7 || mahiṣa uvāca amaratvaṃ devadeva vāñchāmi druhiṇa prabho | yathā mṛtyu bhayaṃ na syāttathā kuru pitāmaha || 8 || brahmovāca utpannasya dhruvaṃ mṛtyurdhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca | sarvathā maraṇotpattī sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ kila || 9 || nāśaḥ kālena sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ daityapuṅgava | mahāmahīdharāṇāṃ ca samudrāṇāṃ ca sarvathā || 10 || ekaṃ sthānaṃ parityajya maraṇasya mahīpate | prabrūhi taṃ varaṃ sādho yaste manasi vartate || 11 || mahiṣa uvāca na devānmānuṣāddaityānmaraṇaṃ me pitāmaha | puruṣānna ca me mṛtyuryoṣā māṃ kā haniṣyati || 12 || tasmānme maraṇaṃ nūnaṃ kāminyāḥ kuru padmaja | abalā hanta māṃ hantuṃ kathaṃ śaktā bhaviṣyati || 13 || brahmovāca yadā kadāpi daityendra nāryāste maraṇaṃ dhuvam | na narebhyo mahābhāga mṛtiste mahiṣāsura || 14 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ dattvā varaṃ tasmai yayau brahmā nijālayam | so'pi daityavaraḥ prāpa nijaṃ sthānaṃ mudānvitaḥ || 15 || rājovāca mahiṣaḥ kasya putro'sau kathaṃ jāto mahābalī | kathaṃ ca māhiṣaṃ rūpaṃ prāptaṃ tena mahātmanā || 16 || vyāsa uvāca danoḥ putrau mahārāja vikhyātau kṣitimaṇḍale | rambhaścaiva karambhaśca dvāvāstāṃ dānavottamau || 17 || tāvaputrau mahārāja putrārthaṃ tepatustapaḥ | bahūnvarṣagaṇānkāmaṃ puṇye pañcanade jale || 18 || karambhastu jale magnaścakāra paramaṃ tapaḥ | vṛkṣaṃ rasālavaṭaṃ prāpya rambho'gnimasevata || 19 || pañcāgnisādhanāsaktaḥ sa rambhastu yadābhavat | jñātvā śacīpatirduḥkhamudyayau dānavau prati || 20 || gatvā pañcanade tatra grāharūpaṃ cakāra ha | vāsavastu karambhaṃ taṃ tadā jagrāha pādayoḥ || 21 || nijaghāna ca taṃ duṣṭaṃ karambhaṃ vṛtrasūdanaḥ | bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ śrutvā rambhaḥ kopaṃ paraṃ gataḥ || 22 || svaśīrṣaṃ pāvake hotumaicchacchittvā kareṇa ha | keśapāśe gahītvāśu vāmena krodhasaṃyutaḥ || 23 || dakṣiṇena kareṇograṃ gṛhītvā khaḍgamuttamam | chinatti śīrṣaṃ tattāvadvahninā pratibodhitaḥ || 24 || uktaśca daitya mūrkho'si svaśīrṣaṃ chettumicchasi | ātmahatyātiduḥsādhyā kathaṃ tvaṃ kartumudyataḥ || 25 || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yaste manasi vartate | mā mriyasva mṛtenādya kiṃ te kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati || 26 || vyāsa uvāca tacchutvā vacanaṃ rambhaḥ pāvakasya subhāṣitam | tato'bravīdvaco rambhastyaktvā keśakalāpakam || 27 || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa dehi me vāñchitaṃ varam | trailokyavijayī putraḥ syānnaḥ parabalārdanaḥ || 28 || ajeyaḥ sarvathā sa syāddevadānavamānavaiḥ | kāmarūpī mahāvīryaḥ sarvalokābhivanditaḥ || 29 || pāvakastaṃ tathetyāha bhaviṣyati tavepsitam | putrastava mahābhāga maraṇādviramādhunā || 30 || yasyāṃ cittaṃ tu rambha tvaṃ pramadāyāṃ kariṣyasi | tasyāṃ putro mahābhāga bhaviṣyati balādhikaḥ || 31 || vyāsa uvāca ityukto vahninā rambho vacanaṃ cittarañjanam | śrutvā praṇamya prayayau vahniṃ taṃ dānavottamaḥ || 32 || yakṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ sthānaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ śriyānvitam | dṛṣṭvā cakre tadā bhāvaṃ mahiṣyāṃ dānavottamaḥ || 33 || mattāyāṃ rūpapūrṇāyāṃ vihāyānyāñca yoṣitam | sā samāgācca tarasā kāmayantī mudānvitā || 34 || rambho'pi gamanaṃ cakre bhavitavyapraṇoditaḥ | sā tu garbhavatī jātā mahiṣī tasya vīryataḥ || 35 || tāṃ gṛhītvātha pātālaṃ praviveśa manoharam | mahiṣebhyaśca tāṃ rakṣanpriyāmanumatāṃ kila || 36 || kadācinmahiṣaścānyaḥ kāmārtastāmupādravat | svayamāgatya taṃ hantuṃ dānavaḥ samupādravat || 37 || svarakṣārthaṃ samāgatya mahiṣaṃ samatāḍayat | so'pi taṃ nijaghānāśu śṛṅgābhyāṃ kāmamohitaḥ || 38 || tāḍitastena tīkṣṇābhyāṃ śṛṅgābhyāṃ hṛdaye bhṛśam | bhūmau papāta tarasā mamāra ca vimūrcchitaḥ || 39 || mṛte bhartari sā dīnā bhayārtā vidrutā bhṛśam | sā vegāttaṃ vaṭaṃ prāpya yakṣāṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā || 40 || pṛṣṭhatastu gatastatra mahiṣaḥ kāmapīḍitaḥ | kāmayānastu tāṃ kāmī balavīryamadoddhataḥ || 41 || rudatī sā bhṛśaṃ dīnā dṛṣṭā yakṣairbhayāturā | dhāvamānaṃ ca taṃ vīkṣya yakṣāstrātuṃ samāyayuḥ || 42 || yuddhaṃ samabhavad ghoraṃ yakṣāṇāṃ ca hayāriṇā | śareṇa tāḍitastūrṇaṃ papāta dharaṇītale || 43 || mṛtaṃ rambhaṃ samānīya yakṣāste paramaṃ priyam | citāyāṃ ropayāmāsustasya dehasya śuddhaye || 44 || mahiṣī sā patiṃ dṛṣṭvā citāyāṃ ropitaṃ tadā | praveṣṭuṃ sā matiṃ cakre patinā saha pāvakam || 45 || vāryamāṇāpi yakṣaiḥ sā praviveśa hutāśanam | jvālāmālākulaṃ sādhvī patimādāya vallabham || 46 || mahiṣastu citāmadhyātsamuttasthau mahābalaḥ | rambho'pyanyadvapuḥ kṛtvā niḥsṛtaḥ putravatsalaḥ || 47 || raktabījo'pyasau jāto mahiṣo'pi mahābalaḥ | abhiṣiktastu rājye'sau hayārirasurottamaiḥ || 48 || evaṃ sa mahiṣo jāto raktabījaśca vīryavān | avadhyastu surairdaityairmānavaiśca nṛpottama || 49 || ityetatkathitaṃ rājan janma tasya mahātmanaḥ | varapradānañca tathā proktaṃ sarvaṃ savistaram || 50 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe mahiṣāsurotpattirnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <5.3> bhagavatīmāhātmye daityasainyodyogaḥ vyāsa uvāca evaṃ sa mahiṣo nāma dānavo varadarpitaḥ | prāpya rājyaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vaśe cakre mahābalaḥ || 1 || pṛthivīṃ pālayāmāsa sāgarāntāṃ bhujārjitām | ekacchatrāṃ nirātaṅkāṃ vairivargavivarjitām || 2 || senānīścikṣurastasya mahāvīryo madotkaṭaḥ | dhanādhyakṣastathā tāmraḥ senāyutasamāvṛtaḥ || 3 || asilomā tathodarko biḍālākhyaśca bāṣkalaḥ | trinetro'tha tathā kālabandhako baladarpitaḥ || 4 || ete sainyayutāḥ sarve dānavā medinīṃ tadā | āvṛtya saṃsthitāḥ kāmamṛddhāṃ sāgaramekhalām || 5 || karadāśca kṛtāḥ sarve bhūmipālāḥ purātanāḥ | nihatā ye balodagrāḥ kṣātradharmavyavasthitāḥ || 6 || brāhmaṇā vaśagā jātā yajñabhāgasamarpakāḥ | mahiṣasya mahārāja nikhile kṣitimaṇḍale || 7 || ekātapatraṃ tadrājyaṃ kṛtvā sa mahiṣāsuraḥ | svargaṃ jetuṃ manaścakre varadānena garvitaḥ || 8 || praṇidhiṃ preṣayāmāsa hayāristu śacīpatim | sa sandeśaharaṃ śīghramāhūyovāca daityarāṭ || 9 || gaccha vīra mahābāho dūtatvaṃ kuru me'nagha | brūhi śakraṃ divaṃ gatvā niḥśaṅkaḥ surasannidhau || 10 || muñca svargaṃ sahasrākṣa yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha mā ciram | sevāṃ vā kuru deveśa mahiṣasya mahātmanaḥ || 11 || sa tvāṃ saṃrakṣayennūnaṃ rājā śaraṇamāgatam | tasmāttvaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāhi mahiṣasya śacīpate || 12 || nocedvajraṃ gahāṇāśu yuddhāya balasūdana | pūrvairjito'si cāsmākaṃ jānāmi tava pauruṣam || 13 || ahalyājāra vijñātaṃ balaṃ te surasaṅghapa | yudhyasva vraja vā kāmaṃ yatra te ramate manaḥ || 14 || vyāsa uvāca tacchutvā vacanaṃ tasya śakraḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ | uvāca taṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha smitapūrvaṃ vacastadā || 15 || na jāne'haṃ sumandātman yatastvaṃ madadarpitaḥ | cikitsāṃ saṃkariṣyāmi rogasyāsya prabhostava || 16 || ataḥ paraṃ kariṣyāmi mūlasyāsya nimūlanam | gaccha dūta tathā brūhi tasyāgre mama bhāṣitam || 17 || śiṣṭairdūtā na hantavyāstasmāttvāṃ visṛjāmyaham | yuddhecchā cetsamāgaccha tvarito mahiṣīsuta || 18 || hayāre tvadbalaṃ jñātaṃ tṛṇādastvaṃ jaḍākṛtiḥ | śṛṅgayoste kariṣyāmi sudṛḍhaṃ ca śarāsanam || 19 || darpaḥ śṛṅgabalātte'sti viditaṃ kāraṇaṃ mayā | viṣāṇe te paricchidya saṃhariṣyāmi tad balam || 20 || yad balenātipūrṇastvaṃ jāto'si baladarpitaḥ | kuśalastvaṃ tadāghāte na yuddhe mahiṣādhama || 21 || vyāsa uvāca ityukto'sau surendreṇa sa dūtastvarito gataḥ | jagāma mahiṣaṃ mattaṃ praṇamya pratyuvāca ha || 22 || dūta uvāca rājandevādhipaḥ kāmaṃ na tvāṃ vigaṇayatyasau | manyate svabalaṃ pūrṇaṃ devasainyasamāvṛtaḥ || 23 || yaduktaṃ tena mūrkheṇa kathamanyad bravīmyaham | priyaṃ satyaṃ ca vaktavyaṃ bhṛtyena purataḥ prabhoḥ || 24 || priyaṃ satyaṃ ca vaktavyaṃ prabhoragre śubhecchunā | iti nītirmahārāja jāgarti śubhakāriṇī || 25 || kevalaṃ cetpriyaṃ brūyānna te kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati | paruṣaṃ ca na vaktavyaṃ kadācicchubhamicchatā || 26 yathā ripumukhādvācaḥ prasaranti viṣopamāḥ | tathā bhṛtyamukhānnātha niḥsaranti kathaṃ giraḥ || 27 || yādṛśānīha vākyāni tenoktāni mahīpate | tādṛśāni na me jihvā vaktumarhati karhicit || 28 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya hetugarbhaṃ tṛṇāśanaḥ | bhṛśaṃ kopaparītātmā babhūva mahiṣāsuraḥ || 29 || samāhūyābravīddaityānkrodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | lāṅgūlaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe ca kṛtvā mūtraṃ parityajan || 30 || bho bho daityāḥ surendro'sau yuddhakāmo'sti sarvathā | balodyogaṃ kurudhvaṃ vai jetavyo'sau surādhamaḥ || 31 || madagre ko bhavecchūraḥ koṭiśaścettathāvidhāḥ | na bibhemyekataḥ kāmaṃ haniṣyāmyadya sarvathā || 32 || śaraḥ śānteṣvasau nūnaṃ tapasviṣu balādhikaḥ | balakartā hi kuhako lampaṭaḥ paradārahṛt || 33 || apsarobalasammattastapovighnakaraḥ khalaḥ | chidrapraharaṇaḥ pāpo nityaṃ viśvāsaghātakaḥ || 34 || namucirnihato yena kṛtvā sandhiṃ durātmanā | śapathānvividhānādau kṛtvā bhītena chadmanā || 35 || viṣṇustu kapaṭācāryaḥ kuhakaḥ śapathākaraḥ | nānārūpadharaḥ kāmaṃ balakṛddambhapaṇḍitaḥ || 36 || kṛtvā kolākṛtiṃ yena hiraṇyākṣo nipātitaḥ | hiraṇyakaśipuryena nṛsiṃhena ca ghātitaḥ || 37 || nāhaṃ tadvaśago nūnaṃ bhaveyaṃ danunandanāḥ | viśvāsaṃ naiva gacchāmi devānāṃ kutra karhicit || 38 || kiṃ kariṣyati me viṣṇurindro vā balavattaraḥ | rudro vāpi na me śaktaḥ pratikartuṃ raṇāṅgaṇe || 39 || triviṣṭapaṃ grahīṣyāmi jitvendraṃ varuṇaṃ yamam | dhanadaṃ pāvakaṃ caiva candrasūryau vijitya ca || 40 || yajñabhāgabhujaḥ sarve bhaviṣyāmo'dya somapāḥ | jitvā devasamūhañca vihariṣyāmi dānavaiḥ || 41 || na me bhayaṃ surebhyaśca varadānena dānavāḥ | maraṇaṃ na narebhyaśca nārī kiṃ me kariṣyati || 42 || pātālaparvatebhyaśca samāhūya varānvarān | dānavānmama sainyeśānkurvantu tvaritāścarāḥ || 43 || eko'haṃ sarvadeveśānvijetuṃ dānavāḥ kṣamaḥ | śobhārthaṃ vaḥ samāhūya nayāmi surasaṅgame || 44 || śṛṅgābhyāṃ ca khurābhyāṃ ca haniṣye'haṃ surānkila | na me bhayaṃ surebhyaśca varadānaprabhāvataḥ || 45 || avadhyo'haṃ suragaṇairasurairmānavaistathā | tasmātsajjā bhavantvadya devalokajayāya vai || 46 || jitvā surālayaṃ daityā vihariṣyāmi nandane | mandārakusumāpīḍā devayoṣitsamanvitāḥ || 47 || kāmadhenupayotsiktāḥ sudhāpānapramoditāḥ | devagandharvagītādinṛtyalāsyasamanvitāḥ || 48 || urvaśī menakā rambhā ghṛtācī ca tilottamā | pramadvarā mahāsenā miśrakeśī madotkaṭā || 49 || vipracittiprabhṛtayo nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ | rañjayiṣyanti vaḥ sarvānnānāsavaniṣevaṇaiḥ || 50 || sarve sajjā bhavantvadya rocatāṃ gamanaṃ divi | saṃgrāmārthaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā maṅgalamuttamam || 51 || rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhārgavaṃ munisattamam | samāhūya ca saṃpūjya sthāpya yajñe guruṃ param || 52 || vyāsa uvāca iti sandiśya daityendrānmahiṣaḥ pāpadhīstadā | jagāma tvarito rājanbhavanaṃ svaṃ mudānvitaḥ || 53 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe bhagavatīmāhāmye daityasainyodyogo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <5.4> bhayāturendrādidevaiḥ suraguruṇā saha parāmarśavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca gate dūte surendro'pi samāhūya surānatha | yamavāyudhanādhyakṣavaruṇānidamūcivān || 1 || mahiṣo nāma daityendro rambhaputro mahābalaḥ | varadarpamadonmatto māyāśatavicakṣaṇaḥ || 2 || tasya dūto'dya samprāptaḥ preṣitastena bhoḥ surāḥ | svargakāmena lubdhena māmuvācedṛśaṃ vacaḥ || 3 || tyaja devālayaṃ śakra yathecchaṃ vraja vāsava | sevāṃ vā kuru daityasya mahiṣasya mahātmanaḥ || 4 || dayāvāndānavendro'sau sa te vṛttiṃ vidhāsyati | nateṣu bhṛtyabhūteṣu na kupyati kadācana || 5 || nocedyuddhāya deveśa senodyogaṃ kuru svayam | gate mayi sa daityendrastvaritaḥ samupeṣyati || 6 || ityuktvā sa gato dūto dānavasya durātmanaḥ | kiṃ kartavyamataḥ kāryaṃ cintayadhvaṃ surottamāḥ || 7 || durbalo'pi na copekṣyaḥ śatrurbalavatā surāḥ | viśeṣeṇa sadodyogī balavānbaladarpitaḥ || 8 || udyamaḥ kila kartavyo yathābuddhi yathābalam | daivādhīno bhavennūnaṃ jayo vātha parājayaḥ || 9 || sandhiyogo na cātrāsti khale sandhirnirarthakaḥ | sarvathā sādhubhiḥ kāryaṃ vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 10 || yānamapyadhunā naiva kartavyaṃ sahasā punaḥ | prekṣakāḥ preṣaṇīyāśca śīghragāḥ supraveśakāḥ || 11 || iṅgitajñāśca niḥsaṅgā niḥspṛhāḥ satyavādinaḥ | senābhiyogaṃ prasthānaṃ balasaṃkhyāṃ yathārthataḥ || 12 || vīrāṇāṃ ca parijñānaṃ kṛtvāyāntu tvarānvitāḥ | jñātvā daityapatestasya sainyasya ca balābalam || 13 || kariṣyāmi tatastūrṇaṃ yānaṃ vā durgasaṃgraham | vicārya khalu kartavyaṃ kāryaṃ buddhimatā sadā | sahasā vihitaṃ kāryaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sarvathā bhavet || 14 || tasmādvimṛśya kartavyaṃ sukhadaṃ sarvathā budhaiḥ | nātra bhedavidhirnyāyyo dānaveṣu ca sarvathā || 15 || ekacitteṣu kārye'smiṃstasmāccārā vrajantu vai | jñātvā balābalaṃ teṣāṃ paścānnītirvicārya ca || 16 || vidheyā vidhivattajjñaisteṣu kāryapareṣu ca | anyathā vihitaṃ kāryaṃ viparītaphalapradam || 17 || sarvathā tadbhavennūnamajñātamauṣadhaṃ yathā | vyāsa uvāca iti sañcintya taiḥ sarvaiḥ praṇidhiṃ kāryavedinam || 18 || preṣayāmāsa devendraḥ parijñānāya pārthiva | dūtastu tvarito gatvā samāgamya surādhipam || 19 || nivedayāmāsa tadā sarvasainyabalābalam | jñātvā tadbalamudyogaṃ turāṣāḍativismitaḥ || 20 || devānacodayattūrṇaṃ samāhūya purohitam | mantraṃ mantravidāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cakāra tridaśeśvaraḥ || 21 || uvācāṅgirasaśreṣṭhaṃ samāsīnaṃ varāsane | indra uvāca bho bho devaguro vidvankiṃ kartavyaṃ vadasva naḥ || 22 || sarvajño'si samutpanne kārye tvaṃ gatiradya naḥ | dānavo mahiṣo nāma mahāvīryo madānvitaḥ || 23 || yoddhukāmaḥ samāyāti bahubhirdānavairvṛtaḥ | tatra pratikriyā kāryā tvayā mantravidādhunā || 24 || teṣāṃ śukrastathā tvaṃ me vighnahartā susaṃyataḥ | vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ prāha turāsāhaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ || 25 || vicintya manasā kāmaṃ kāryasādhanatatparaḥ | gururuvāca svastho bhava surendra tvaṃ dhairyamālambya māriṣa || 26 || vyasane ca samutpanne na tyājyaṃ dhairyamāśu vai | jayājayau surādhyakṣa daivādhīnau sadaiva hi || 27 || sthātavyaṃ dhairyamālambya tasmād buddhimatā sadā | bhavitavyaṃ bhavatyeva jānanneva śatakrato || 28 || udyamaḥ sarvathā kāryo yathāpauruṣamātmanaḥ | munayo'pi hi muktyarthamudyamaikaratāḥ sadā || 29 || daivādhīnaṃ ca jānanto yogadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | tasmātsadaiva kartavyo vyavahāroditodyamaḥ || 30 || sukhaṃ bhavatu vā mā vā daive kā paridevanā | vinā puruṣakāreṇa kadācitsiddhimāpnuyāt || 31 || andhavatpaṅguvatkāmaṃ na tathā mudamāvahet | kṛte puruṣakāre'pi yadi siddhirna jāyate || 32 || na tatra dūṣaṇaṃ tasya daivādhīne śarīriṇi | kāryasiddhirna sainye'sti na mantre na ca mantraṇe || 33 || na rathe nāyudhe nūnaṃ daivādhīnā surādhipa | balavāñkleśamāpnoti nirbalaḥ sukhamaśnute || 34 || buddhimānkṣudhitaḥ śete nirbuddhirbhogavānbhavet | kātaro jayamāpnoti śūro yāti parājayam || 35 || daivādhīne tu saṃsāre kāmaṃ kā paridevanā | udyame yojayennūnaṃ bhavitavyaṃ surādhipa || 36 || duḥkhade sukhade vāpi tatra tau na vicintayet | duḥkhe duḥkhādhikānpaśyetsukhe paśyetsukhādhikam || 37 || ātmānaṃ harṣaśokābhyāṃ śatrubhyāmiva nārpayet | dhairyamevāvagantavyaṃ harṣaśokodbhave budhaiḥ || 38 || adhairyādyādṛśaṃ duḥkhaṃ na tu dhairye'sti tādṛśam | durlabhaṃ sahanatvaṃ vai samaye sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || 39 || harṣaśokodbhavo yatra na bhaved buddhiniścayāt | kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kasya vā duḥkhaṃ nirguṇo'haṃ sadāvyayaḥ || 40 || caturviṃśātirikto'smi kiṃ me duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ ca kim | prāṇasya kṣutpipāse dve manasaḥ śokamūrchane || 41 || jarāmṛtyū śarīrasya ṣaḍūrmirahitaḥ śivaḥ | śokamohau śarīrasya gaṇau kiṃ me'tra cintane || 42 || śarīraṃ nāhamathavā tatsambandhī na cāpyaham | saptaikaṣoḍaśādibhyo vibhinno'haṃ sadā sukhī || 43 || prakṛtirvikṛtirnāhaṃ kiṃ me duḥkhaṃ sadā punaḥ | iti matvā sureśa tvaṃ manasā bhava nirmamaḥ || 44 || upāyaḥ prathamo'yaṃ te duḥkhanāśe śatakrato | mamatā paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ nirmamatvaṃ paraṃ sukham || 45 || santoṣādaparaṃ nāsti sukhasthānaṃ śacīpate | athavā yadi na jñānaṃ mamatvanāśane kila || 46 || tato vivekaḥ kartavyo bhavitavye surādhipa | prārabdhakarmaṇāṃ nāśo nābhogāllakṣyate kila || 47 || yadbhāvi tadbhavatyeva kā cintā sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | suraiḥ sarvaiḥ sahāyairvā buddhyā vā tava sattama || 48 || sukhaṃ kṣayāya puṇyasya duḥkhaṃ pāpasya māriṣa | tasmātsukhakṣaye harṣaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvathā budhaiḥ || 49 || athavā mantrayitvādya kuru yatnaṃ yathāvidhi | kṛte yatne mahārāja bhavitavyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 50 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe bhayāturendrādidevaiḥ suraguruṇā saha parāmarśavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <5.5> daityasainyaparājayaḥ vyāsa uvāca iti śrutvā sahasrākṣaḥ punarāha bṛhaspatim | yuddhodyogaṃ kariṣyāmi hayārernāśanāya vai || 1 || nodyamena vinā rājyaṃ na sukhaṃ na ca vai yaśaḥ | nirudyamaṃ na śaṃsanti kātarā na ca sodyamāḥ || 2 || yatīnāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ jñānaṃ santoṣo hi dvijanmanām | udyamaḥ śatruhananaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ bhūtimicchatām || 3 || udyamena hatastvāṣṭro namucirbala eva ca | tathainaṃ nihaniṣyāmi mahiṣaṃ munisattama || 4 || balaṃ devagurustvaṃ me vajramāyudhamuttamam | sahāyastu harirnūnaṃ tathomāpatiravyayaḥ || 5 || rakṣoghnānpaṭha me sādho karomyadya samudyamam | svasainyābhiniveśañca mahiṣaṃ prati mānada || 6 || vyāsa uvāca ityukto devarājena vācaspatiruvāca ha | surendraṃ yuddhasaṃraktaṃ smitapūrvaṃ vacastadā || 7 || bṛhaspatiruvāca prerayāmi na cāhaṃ tvāṃ na ca nirvārayāmyaham | sandigdhe'tra jaye kāmaṃ yudhyataśca parājaye || 8 || na te'tra dūṣaṇaṃ kiñcidbhavitavye śacīpate | sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ vihitaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 9 || na mayā tatparijñātaṃ bhāvi duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ tathā | yadbhāryāharaṇe prāptaṃ purā vāsava vetsi hi || 10 || śaśinā me hṛtā bhāryā mitreṇāmitrakarśana | svāśramasthena samprāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvasukhāpaham || 11 || buddhimānsarvalokeṣu vidito'haṃ surādhipa | kva me gatā tadā vuddhiryadā bhāryā hṛtā balāt || 12 || tasmādupāyaḥ kartavyo buddhimadbhiḥ sadā naraiḥ | kāryasiddhiḥ sadā nūnaṃ daivādhīnā surādhipa || 13 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ satyaṃ guroḥ sārthaṃ śacīpatiḥ | brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatvā natvā vacanamabravīt || 14 || pitāmaha surādhyakṣa daityo mahiṣasaṃjñakaḥ | grahītukāmaḥ svargaṃ me balodyogaṃ karotyalam || 15 || anye ca dānavāḥ sarve tatsainyaṃ samupasthitāḥ | yoddhukāmā mahāvīryāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ || 16 || tenāhaṃ bhītabhīto'smi tvatsakāśamihāgataḥ | sarvajño'si mahāprājña sāhāyyaṃ kartumarhasi || 17 || brahmovāca gacchāmaḥ sarva evādya kailāsaṃ tvaritā vayam | śaṅkaraṃ purataḥ kṛtvā viṣṇuṃ ca balināṃ varam || 18 || tato yuddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha | militvā mantramādhāya deśaṃ kālaṃ vicintya ca || 19 || balābalamavijñāya vivekamapahāya ca | sāhasaṃ tu prakurvāṇo naraḥ patanamṛcchati || 20 || vyāsa uvāca tanniśamya sahasrākṣaḥ kailāsaṃ nirjagāma ha | brahmāṇaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā lokapālasamanvitaḥ || 21 || tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraṃ gatvā vedamantrairmaheśvaram | prasannaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā yayau viṣṇupuraṃ prati || 22 || stutvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ kāryaṃ provāca cātmanaḥ | mahiṣāttadbhayaṃ cograṃ varadānamadoddhatāt || 23 || tadākarṇya bhayaṃ tasya viṣṇurdevānuvāca ha | kariṣyāmo vayaṃ yuddhaṃ haniṣyāmastu durjayam || 24 || vyāsa uvāca iti te niścayaṃ kṛtvā brahmaviṣṇuharīśvarāḥ | svāni svāni samāruhya vāhanāni yayuḥ surāḥ || 25 || brahmā haṃsasamārūḍho viṣṇargaruḍavāhanaḥ | śaṅkaro vṛṣabhārūḍho vṛtrahā gajasaṃsthitaḥ || 26 || mayūravāhanaḥ skando yamo mahiṣavāhanaḥ | kṛtvā sainyasamāyogaṃ yāvatte niryayuḥ surāḥ || 27 || tāvaddaityabalaṃ prāptaṃ dṛptaṃ mahiṣapālitam | tatrābhūttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ devadānavasainyayoḥ || 28 || bāṇaiḥ khaḍgaistathā prāsairmusalaiśca paraśvadhaiḥ | gadābhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiścakraiśca śaktitomaraiḥ || 29 || mudgarairbhindipālaiśca halaiścaivātidāruṇaiḥ | anyaiśca vividhairastrairnijaghnuste parasparam || 30 || senānīścikṣurastasya gajārūḍho mahābalaḥ | maghavantaṃ pañcabhistaiḥ sāyakaiḥ samatāḍayat || 31 || turāṣāḍapi tāṃśchittvā bāṇairbāṇāṃstvarānvitaḥ | hṛdaye cārdhacandreṇa tāḍayāmāsa taṃ kṛtī || 32 || bāṇāhatastu senānīḥ prāpa mūrcchāṃ gajopari | kariṇaṃ vajraghātena sa jaghāna kare tataḥ || 33 || tadvajrābhihato nāgo bhagnaḥ sainyaṃ jagāma ha | dṛṣṭvā taṃ daityarāṭ kuddho biḍālākhyamathābravīt || 34 || gaccha vīra mahābāho jahīndraṃ madagarvitam | varuṇādīnparāndevānhatvā''gaccha mamāntikam || 35 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya biḍālākhyo mahābalaḥ | āruhya vāraṇaṃ mattaṃ jagāma tridaśādhipam || 36 || vāsavastaṃ samāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhasamanvitaḥ | jaghāna viśikhaistīkṣaurāśīviṣasamaprabhaiḥ || 37 || sa tu chittvā śarāṃstūrṇaṃ svaśaraiścāpaniḥsṛtaiḥ | pañcāśadbhirjaghānāśu vāsavañca śilīmukhaiḥ || 38 || tathendro'pi ca tānbāṇāṃśchittvā kopasamanvitaḥ | jaghāna viśikhaistīkṣṇairāśīviṣasamaprabhaiḥ || 39 || sa tu chittvā śarāṃstūrṇaṃ svaśaraiścāpaniḥsṛtaiḥ | gadayā tāḍayāmāsa gajaṃ tasya karopari || 40 || svakare nihato nāgaścakārārtasvaraṃ muhuḥ | parivṛtya jaghānāśu daityasainyaṃ bhayāturam || 41 || dānavastu gajaṃ vīkṣya parāvṛtya gataṃ raṇāt | samāviśya rathe ramye jagāmāśu surān raṇe || 42 || turāṣāḍapi taṃ vīkṣya rathasthaṃ punarāgatam | ahanadviśikhaistīkṣṇairāśīviṣasamaprabhaiḥ || 43 || so'pi kruddhaścakārogrāṃ bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ mahābalaḥ | babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ tayostatra jayaiṣiṇoḥ || 44 || indrastu balinaṃ dṛṣṭvā kopenākulitendriyaḥ | jayantamagrataḥ kṛtvā yuyudhe tena saṃyutaḥ || 45 || jayantastu śitairbāṇaistaṃ jaghāna stanāntare | pañcabhiḥ prabalākṛṣṭairasuraṃ madagarvitam || 46 || sa bāṇābhihatastāvannipapāta rathopari | ativāhya rathaṃ sūto nirjagāma raṇājirāt || 47 || tasminvinirgate daitye biḍālākhye'tha mūrcchite | jayaśabdo mahānāsīdundubhīnāṃ ca niḥsvanaḥ || 48 || surāḥ pramuditāḥ sarve tuṣṭuvustaṃ śacīpatim | jagurgandharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || 49 || cukopa mahiṣaḥ śrutvā jayaśabdaṃ suraiḥ kṛtam | preṣayāmāsa tatraiva tāmraṃ paramadāpaham || 50 || tāmrastu bahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ samāgamya raṇājire | śaravṛṣṭiṃ cakārāśu taḍitvāniva sāgare || 51 || varuṇaḥ pāśamudyamya jagāma tvaritastadā | yamaśca mahiṣārūḍho daṇḍamādāya niryayau || 52 || tatra yuddhamabhūd ghoraṃ devadānavayormithaḥ | bāṇaiḥ khaḍgaiśca musalaiḥ śaktibhiśca paraśvadhaiḥ || 53 || daṇḍena nihatastāmro yamahastodyatena ca | na cacāla mahābāhuḥ saṃgrāmāṅgaṇatastadā || 54 || cāpamākṛṣya vegena muktvā tīvrāñchilīmukhān| indrādīnahanattūrṇaṃ tāmrastasmin raṇājire || 55 || te'pi devāḥ śarairdivyairniśitaiśca śilāśitaiḥ | nijaghnurdānavānkruddhāstiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cukuśuḥ || 56 || nihatastaiḥ surairdaityo mūrcchāmāpa raṇāṅgaṇe | hāhākāro mahānāsīddaityasainye bhayāture || 57 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe daityasainyaparājayo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <5.6> mahiṣāsurasyendrādidevaiḥ saha yuddhavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tāmre'tha mūrcchite daitye mahiṣaḥ krodhasaṃyutaḥ | samudyamya gadāṃ gurvīṃ devānupajagāma ha || 1 || tiṣṭhantvadya surāḥ sarve hanmyahaṃ gadayā kila | sarve balibhujaḥ kāmaṃ balahīnāḥ sadaiva hi || 2 || ityuktvāsau gajārūḍhaṃ samprāpya madagarvitaḥ | jaghāna gadayā tūrṇaṃ bāhumūle mahābhujaḥ || 3 || so'pi vajreṇa ghoreṇa cicchedāśu gadāñca tām | prahartukāmastvarito jagāma mahiṣaṃ prati || 4 || hayārirapi kopena khaḍgamādāya suprabham | yayāvindraṃ mahāvīryaṃ prahariṣyannivāntikam || 5 || babhūva ca tayoryuddhaṃ sarvalokabhayāvaham | āyudhairvividhaistatra munivismayakārakam || 6 || cakārāśu tadā daityo māyāṃ mohakarīṃ kila | śāmbarīṃ sarvalokaghnīṃ munīnāmapi mohinīm || 7 || koṭiśo mahiṣāstatra tadrūpāstatparākramāḥ | dadṛśuḥ sāyudhāḥ sarve nighnanto devavāhinīm || 8 || maghavā vismitastatra dṛṣṭvā tāṃ daityanirmitām | babhūvātibhayodvigno māyāṃ mohakarīṃ kila || 9 || varuṇo'pi susantrastastathaiva dhananāyakaḥ | yamo hutāśanaḥ sūryaḥ śītaraśmirbhayāturaḥ || 10 || palāyanaparā sarve babhūvurmohitāḥ surāḥ | brahmaviṣṇamaheśānāṃ smaraṇaṃ cakrurudyatāḥ || 11 || tatrājagmuśca kājeśāḥ smṛtamātrāḥ surottamāḥ | haṃsatārkṣyavṛṣārūḍhāstrātukāmā varāyudhāḥ || 12 || śauristāṃ mohinīṃ dṛṣṭvā sudarśanamathojjvalam | mumoca tattejasaiva māyā sā vilayaṃ gatā || 13 || vīkṣya tānmahiṣastatra sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇaḥ | yoddhukāmaḥ samādāya parighaṃ samupādravat || 14 || mahiṣākhyo mahāvīraḥ senānīścikṣurastathā | ugrāsyaścogravīryaśca dudruvuryuddhakāmukāḥ || 15 || asilomātrinetraśca bāṣkalo'ndhaka eva ca | ete cānye ca bahavo yuddhakāmā viniryayuḥ || 16 || sannaddhā dhṛtacāpāste rathārūḍhā madoddhatāḥ | parivavruḥ surānsarvānvṛkā iva suvatsakān || 17 || bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ tataścakrurdānavā madagarvitāḥ | surāścāpi tathā cakruḥ parasparajighāṃsavaḥ || 18 || andhako harimāsādya pañcabāṇāñchilāśitān | mumoca viṣasandigdhānkarṇākṛṣṭānmahābalān || 19 || vāsudevo'pyasaṃprāptānviśikhānāśugaistadā | ciccheda tānpunaḥ pañca mumoca ripunāśanaḥ || 20 || tayoḥ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva haridaityayoḥ | bāṇāsicakramusalairgadāśaktiparaśvadhaiḥ || 21 || maheśāndhakayoryuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam | pañcāśaddinaparyantaṃ babhūva ca parasparam || 22 || indrabāṣkalayostadvanmahiṣāsurarudrayoḥ | yamatrinetrayostadvanmahāhanudhaneśayoḥ || 23 || asilomavaruṇayoryuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam | garuḍaṃ gadayā daityo jaghāna harivāhanam || 24 || sa gadāpātakhinnāṅgo niḥśvasannavatiṣṭhata | śauristaṃ dakṣiṇenāśu hastena parisāntvayan || 25 || sthiraṃ cakāra deveśo vainateyaṃ mahābalam | samākṛṣya dhanuḥ śārṅgaṃ mumoca viśikhānbahūn || 26 || andhakopari kopena hantukāmo janārdanaḥ | dānavo'pi ca tānvāṇāṃściccheda svaśaraiḥ śitaiḥ || 27 || pañcāśadbhirhariṃ kopājjaghāna ca śilāśitaiḥ | vāsudevo'pi tāṃstūrṇaṃ vañcayitvā śarottamān || 28 || cakraṃ mumoca vegena sahasrāraṃ sudarśanam | tyaktaṃ sudarśanaṃ dūrātsvacakreṇa nyavārayat || 29 || nanāda ca mahārāja devānsammohayanniva | dṛṣṭvā tu viphalaṃ jātaṃ cakraṃ devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 30 || jagmuḥ śokaṃ surāḥ sarve jaharṣurdānavāstathā | vāsudevo'pi tarasā dṛṣṭvā devāñchucāvṛtān || 31 || gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ dhṛtvā dānavaṃ samupādravat | taṃ jaghānātivegena mūrdhni māyāvinaṃ hariḥ || 32 || sa gadābhihato bhūmau nipapātātimūrcchitaḥ | taṃ tathā patitaṃ vīkṣya hayāriratikopanaḥ || 33 || ājagāma ramānāthaṃ trāsayannatigarjitaiḥ | vāsudevo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ krudhānvitam || 34 || cāpajyāninadaṃ cograṃ cakāra nandayansurān | śaravṛṣṭiṃ cakārāśu bhagavānmahiṣopari || 35 || so'pi ciccheda bāṇaughaistāñcharāngaganeritān | tayoryuddhamabhūdrājan parasparabhayāvaham || 36 || gadayā tāḍayāmāsa keśavo mastakopari | sa gadābhihato mūrdhni papātorvyāṃ sumūrcchitaḥ || 37 || hāhākāro mahānāsītsainye tasya sudāruṇaḥ | sa vihāya vyathāṃ daityo muhūrtādutthitaḥ punaḥ || 38 || gṛhītvā parighaṃ śīrṣe jaghāna madhusūdanam | parigheṇāhatastena mūrcchāmāpa janārdanaḥ || 39 || mūrcchitaṃ tamuvāhāśu jagāma garuḍo raṇāt | parāvṛtte jagannāthe devā indrapurogamāḥ || 40 || bhayaṃ prāpuḥ suduḥkhārtāścukruśuśca raṇājire | krandamānānsurānvīkṣya śaṅkaraḥ śūlabhṛttadā || 41 || mahiṣaṃ tarasābhyetya prāharadroṣasaṃyutaḥ | so'pi śaktiṃ mumocātha śaṅkarasyorasi sphuṭam || 42 || jagarja sa ca duṣṭātmā vañcayitvā triśūlakam | śaṅkaro'pi tadā pīḍāṃ na prāporasi tāḍitaḥ || 43 || taṃ jaghāna triśūlena kopādaruṇalocanaḥ | saṃlagnaṃ śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mahiṣeṇa durātmanā || 44 || ājagāma haristāvattyaktvā mūrcchāṃ prahārajām | mahiṣastu tadā vīkṣya samprāptau hariśaṅkarau || 45 || yuddhakāmau mahāvīryo cakraśūladharau varau | kopayukto babhūvāsau dṛṣṭvā tau samupāgatau || 46 || jagāma sammukhastāvatsaṃgrāmārthaṃ mahābhujaḥ | māhiṣaṃ vapurāsthāya dhunvanpucchaṃ samutkaṭam || 47 || cakāra bhairavaṃ nādaṃ trāsayannamarānapi | dhunvañchṛṅge mahākāyo dāruṇo jalado yathā || 48 || śṛṅgābhyāṃ parvatājchṛṅgāṃścikṣepa bhṛśamutkaṭān | dṛṣṭvā tau tu mahāvīryau dānavaṃ devasattamau || 49 || cakraturbāṇavṛṣṭiṃ ca dānavopari dāruṇām | kurvāṇau bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ tau dṛṣṭvā hariharau hariḥ || 50 || cikṣepa giriśṛṅgaṃ tu pucchenāvṛtya dāruṇam | āpatantaṃ giriṃ vīkṣya bhagavānsātvatāṃ patiḥ || 51 || viśikhaiḥ śatadhā cakre cakreṇāśu jaghāna tam | haricakrāhataḥ saṃkhye mūrcchāmāpa sa daityarāṭ || 52 || uttasthau ca kṣaṇānnūnaṃ mānuṣaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ | gadāpāṇirmahāghoro dānavaḥ parvatopamaḥ || 53 || meghanādaṃ nanādoccairbhīṣayannamarānapi | tacchrutvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ pāñcajanyaṃ samujjvalam || 54 || pūrayāmāsa tarasā śabdaṃ kartuṃ kharasvaram | tena śabdena śaṅkhasya bhayatrastāśca dānavāḥ | babhūvurmuditā devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 55 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe mahiṣāsurasyendrādidevaiḥ saha yuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <5.7> śaṅkaraśaraṇagamanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca asurānmahiṣo dṛṣṭvā viṣaṇṇamanasastadā | tyaktvā tanmāhiṣaṃ rūpaṃ babhūva mṛgarāḍasau || 1 || kṛtvā nādaṃ mahāghoraṃ vistārya ca mahāsaṭām | papāta surasenāyāṃ trāsayannakhadarśanaiḥ || 2 || garuḍañca nakhāghātaiḥ kṛtvā rudhiraviplutam | jaghāna ca bhuje viṣṇuṃ nakhāghātena kesarī || 3 || vāsudevo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā cakramudyamya vegavān | hantukāmo hariḥ kāmamavāpāśu krudhānvitaḥ || 4 || yāvaddhayaripuṃ vegāccakreṇābhijaghāna tam | tāvatso'tibalaḥ śṛṅgī śṛṅgābhyāṃ nyahanaddharim || 5 || vāsudevo viṣāṇābhyāṃ tāḍitorasi vihvalaḥ | palāyanaparo vegājjagāma bhuvanaṃ nijam || 6 || gataṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ kāmaṃ śaṅkaro'pi bhayānvitaḥ | avadhyaṃ taṃ paraṃ matvā yayau kailāsaparvatam || 7 || brahmāpi ca nijaṃ dhāma tvaritaḥ prayayau bhayāt | maghavā vajramālambya tasthāvājau mahābalaḥ || 8 || varuṇaḥ śaktimālambya dhairyamālambya saṃsthitaḥ | yamo'pi daṇḍamādāya yattaḥ samaratatparaḥ || 9 || tato yakṣādhipaḥ kāmaṃ babhūva raṇatatparaḥ | pāvakaḥ śaktimādāya tatrābhūdyuddhamānasaḥ || 10 || nakṣatrādhipatiḥ sūryaḥ samavetau sthitāvubhau | vīkṣya taṃ dānavaśreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāya kṛtaniścayau || 11 || etasminnantare kruddhaṃ daityasainyaṃ samabhyagāt | visṛjanbāṇajālāni krūrāhisadṛśāni ca || 12 || kṛtvā hi māhiṣaṃ rūpaṃ bhūpatiḥ saṃsthitastadā | devadānavayodhānāṃ ninādastumulo'bhavat || 13 || jyāghātaśca talāghāto meghanādasamo'bhavat | saṃgrāme sumahāghore devadānavasenayoḥ || 14 || śṛṅgābhyāṃ pārvatāñchṛṅgāṃścikṣepa ca mahābalaḥ | jaghāna surasaṅghāṃśca dānavo madagarvitaḥ || 15 || khurāghātaistathā devānpucchasya bhramaṇena ca | sa jaghāna ruṣāviṣṭo mahiṣaḥ paramādbhutaḥ || 16 || tato devāḥ sagandharvā bhayamājagmurudyatāḥ | maghavā mahiṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyanaparo'bhavat || 17 || saṅgaraṃ samparityajya gate śakre śacīpatau | yamo dhanādhipaḥ pāśī jagmuḥ sarve bhayāturāḥ || 18 || mahiṣo'pi jayaṃ matvā jagāma svagṛhaṃ tataḥ | airāvataṃ gajaṃ prāpya tyaktamindreṇa gacchatā || 19 || tathoccaiḥśravasaṃ bhānoḥ kāmadhenuṃ payasvinīm | svasainyasaṃvṛtastūrṇaṃ svargaṃ gantuṃ mano dadhe || 20 || tarasā devasadanaṃ gatvā sa mahiṣāsuraḥ | jagrāha surarājyaṃ vai tyaktaṃ devairbhayāturaiḥ || 21 || indrāsane tathā ramye dānavaḥ samupāviśat | dānavānsthāpayāmāsa devānāṃ sthānakeṣu saḥ || 22 || evaṃ varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā yuddhaṃ sudāruṇam | avāpaindrapadaṃ kāmaṃ dānavo madagarvitaḥ || 23 || nirjarā nirgatā nākāttena sarve'tipīḍitāḥ | evaṃ bahūni varṣāṇi babhramurgirigahvare || 24 || śrāntāḥ sarve tadā rājan brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | prajāpatiṃ jagannāthaṃ rajorūpaṃ caturmukham || 25 || padmāsanaṃ vedagarbhaṃ sevitaṃ munibhiḥ svajaiḥ | marīcipramukhaiḥ śāntairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ || 26 || kinnaraiḥ siddhagandharvaiścāraṇoragapannagaiḥ | tuṣṭuvurbhayabhītāste devadevaṃ jagadgurum || 27 || devā ūcuḥ dhātaḥ kimetadakhilārtiharāmbujanma janmābhivīkṣya na dayāṃ kuruṣe surān yat | sampīḍitān raṇajitānasurādhipena sthānacyutān giriguhākṛtasannivāsān || 28 || putrānpitā kimaparādhaśataiḥ sametānsantyajya lobharahitaḥ kurute'tiduḥsthān | yastvaṃ surāṃstava padāmbujabhaktiyuktāndaityārditāṃśca kṛpaṇān yadupekṣase'dya || 29 || amarabhuvanarājyaṃ tena bhuktaṃ nitāntaṃ makhahavirapi yogyaṃ brāhmaṇairādadāti | surataruvarapuṣpaṃ sevate'sau durātmā jalanidhinidhibhūtāṃ gāmasau sevate tām || 30 || kiṃ vā gṛṇīmaḥ surakāryamadbhutaṃ jānāsi deveśa surāriceṣṭitam | jñānena sarvaṃ tvamaśeṣakāryavittasmātprabho te praṇatāḥ sma pādayoḥ || 31 || yatrāpi kutrāpi gatānsurānasau nānācaritraḥ khalu pāpamānasaḥ | pīḍāṃ karotyeva sa duṣṭaceṣṭitastrātāsi deveśa vidhehi śaṃ vibho || 32 || no cedvayaṃ dāvamahāgnipīḍitāḥ kaṃ śāntikartāramanantatejasam | yāmaḥ prajeśaṃ śaraṇaṃ sureṣṭaṃ dhātāramādyaṃ parimucya kaṃ śivam || 33 || vyāsa uvāca iti stutvā surāḥ sarve praṇemustaṃ prajāpatim | baddhāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve viṣaṇṇavadanā bhṛśam || 34 || tāṃstathā pīḍitāndṛṣṭvā tadā lokapitāmahaḥ | uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā sukhaṃ sañjanayanniva || 35 || brahmovāca kiṃ karomi surāḥ kāmaṃ dānavo varadarpitaḥ | strīvadhyo'sau na puṃvadhyo vidheyaṃ tatra kiṃ punaḥ || 36 || vrajāmo'dya surāḥ sarve kailāsaṃ parvatottamam | śaṅkaraṃ purataḥ kṛtvā sarvakāryaviśāradam || 37 || tato vrajāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ yatra devo janārdanaḥ | militvā devakāryañca vimṛśāmo viśeṣataḥ || 38 || ityuktvā haṃsamāruhya brahmā kāryasamuccaye | devāṃśca pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā kailāsābhimukho yayau || 39 || tāvacchivo'pi tarasā jñātvā dhyānena padmajam | āgacchantaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ nirgataḥ svagṛhādbahiḥ || 40 || dṛṣṭvā parasparaṃ tau tu kṛtābhivādanau bhṛśam | praṇatau ca suraiḥ sarvaiḥ santuṣṭau sambabhūvatuḥ || 41 || āsanāni pṛthagdattvā devebhyo girijāpatiḥ | upaviṣṭeṣu teṣveva niṣasādāsane svake || 42 || kṛtvā tu kuśalapraśnaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | papraccha kāraṇaṃ devānkailāsāgamane vibhuḥ || 43 || śiva uvāca kimatrāgamanaṃ brahman kṛtaṃ devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ | bhavatā ca mahābhāga brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ kila || 44 || brahmovāca mahiṣeṇa sureśāna pīḍitāḥ svarnivāsinaḥ | bhramanti giridurgeṣu bhayatrastāḥ savāsavāḥ || 45 || yajñabhugmahiṣo jātastathānye suraśatravaḥ | pīḍitā lokapālāśca tvāmadya śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 46 || mayā te bhavanaṃ śambho prāpitāḥ kāryagauravāt | yadyuktaṃ tadvidhatsvādya surakāryaṃ sureśvara || 47 || tvayi bhāro'sti sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhūtabhāvana | vyāsa uvāca iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṅkaraḥ prahasanniva || 48 || vacanaṃ ślakṣṇayā vācā provāca padmajaṃ prati | śiva uvāca bhavataiva kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ varadānātpurā vibho || 49 || anarthadañca devānāṃ kiṃ kartavyamataḥ param | īdṛśo balavāñchūraḥ sarvadevabhayapradaḥ || 50 || kā samarthā varā nārī taṃ hantuṃ madadarpitam | na me bhāryā na te bhāryā saṃgrāmaṃ gantumarhati || 51 || gatvaiva te mahābhāge yuyudhāte kathaṃ punaḥ | indrāṇī ca mahābhāgā na yuddhakuśalāsti hi || 52 || kānyā hantuṃ samarthāsti taṃ pāpaṃ madadarpitam | mamedaṃ matamadyaiva gatvā devaṃ janārdanam || 53 || stutvā taṃ devakāryāya prerayāmaḥ susatvaram | so'tibuddhimatāṃ śreṣṭho viṣṇuḥ sarvārthasādhane || 54 || militvā vāsudevaṃ vai kartavyaṃ kāryacintanam | prapañcena ca buddhyā sa saṃvidhāsyati sādhanam || 55 || vyāsa uvāca iti rudravacaḥ śrutvā brahmādyāḥ surasattamāḥ | utthitāste tathetyuktvā śivena saha satvarāḥ || 56 || svakīyairvāhanaiḥ sarve yayuviṣṇapuraṃ prati | muditāḥ śakunāndṛṣṭvā kāryasiddhikarāñchubhān|| 57 || vavurvātāḥ śubhāḥ śāntāḥ sugandhāḥ śubhaśaṃsinaḥ | pakṣiṇaśca śivā vācastatrocuḥ pathi sarvaśaḥ || 58 || nirmalaṃ cābhavadvyoma diśaśca vimalāstathā | gamane tatra devānāṃ sarvaṃ śubhamivābhavat || 59 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe parājitadevatānāṃ śaṅkaraśaraṇagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <5.8> devyāḥ svarūpodbhavavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tarasā te'tha samprāpya vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇuvallabham | dadṛśuḥ sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ divyasadmavirājitam || 1 || sarovāpīsaridbhiśca saṃyutaṃ sukhadaṃ śubham | haṃsasārasacakrāhvaiḥ kūjadbhiśca virājitam || 2 || campakāśokakahlāramandārabakulāvṛtaiḥ | mallikātilakāmrātayutaiḥ kurabakādibhiḥ || 3 || kokilārāvasannādaiḥ śikhaṇḍairnṛtyarañjitaiḥ | bhramarārāvaramyaiśca divyairupavanairyutam|| 4 || sunandanandanādyaiśca pārṣadairbhaktitatparaiḥ | saṃstuvadbhiryutaṃ bhaktairananyabhavavṛttibhiḥ || 5 || prāsādai ratnakhacitaiḥ kāñcanaiścitramaṇḍitaiḥ | abhraṃlihairvirājadbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ śubhasadmakaiḥ || 6 || gāyadbhirdevagandharvairnṛtyadbhirapsarogaṇaiḥ | rañjitaṃ kinnaraiḥ śaśvadraktakaṇṭhermanoharaiḥ || 7 || munibhiśca tathā śāntairvedapāṭhakṛtādaraiḥ | stuvadbhiḥ śrutisūktaiśca maṇḍitaṃ sadanaṃ hareḥ || 8 || te ca viṣṇugṛhaṃ prāpya dvārapālau śubhākṛtī | vīkṣyocurjayavijayau hemayaṣṭidharau sthitau || 9 || gatvaiko'pyubhayormadhye nivedayatu saṅgatān | dvārasthān brahmarudrādīnviṣṇudarśanalālasān || 10 || vyāsa uvāca vijayastadvacaḥ śrutvā gatvātha viṣṇusannidhau | sarvānsamāgatāndevānpraṇamyovāca satvaraḥ || 11 || vijaya uvāca devadeva mahārāja ramākānta surārihan | samāgatāḥ surāḥ sarve dvāri tiṣṭhanti vai vibho || 12 || brahmā rudrastathendraśca varuṇaḥ pāvako yamaḥ | stuvanti vedavākyaistvāmamarā darśanārthinaḥ || 13 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viṣṇarvijayasya ramāpatiḥ | nirjagāma gṛhāttūrṇaṃ surānsamadhikotsavaḥ || 14 || gatvā vīkṣya harirdevāndvārasthāñchramakarśitān | prītipravaṇayā dṛṣṭyā prīṇayāmāsa duḥkhitān || 15 || praṇemuste surāḥ sarve devadevaṃ janārdanam | tuṣṭuvuśca surārighnaṃ vāgbhirvedaviniścitam || 16 || devā ūcuḥ devadeva jagannātha sṛṣṭisthityantakāraka | dayāsindho mahārāja trāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān || 17 || viṣṇuruvāca viśantu nirjarāḥ sarve kuśalaṃ kathayantu vaḥ | āsaneṣu kimarthaṃ vai militāḥ samupāgatāḥ || 18 || cintāturāḥ kathaṃ jātā viṣaṇṇā dīnamānasāḥ | brahmarudreṇa sahitāḥ kāryaṃ prabrūta satvaram || 19 || devā ūcuḥ mahiṣeṇa mahārāja pīḍitāḥ pāpakarmaṇā | asādhyenātiduṣṭena varadṛptena pāpinā || 20 || yajñabhāgānasau bhuṃkte brāhmaṇaiḥ pratipāditān | amarā giridurgeṣu bhramanti ca bhayāturāḥ || 21 || varadānena dhātuḥ sa durjayo madhusūdana | tasmāttvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā jñātvā tatkāryagauravam || 22 || samartho'si samuddhartuṃ daityamāyāviśārada | kuru kṛṣṇa vadhopāyaṃ tasya dānavamardana || 23 || dhātrā tasmai varo datto hyavadhyo'si naraiḥ kila | kā strī tvevaṃvidhā bālā yā hanyāttaṃ śaṭhaṃ raṇe || 24 || umā mā vā śacī vidyā kā samarthāsya ghātane | mahiṣasyātiduṣṭasya varadānabalādapi || 25 || vicintya buddhyā yatsarvaṃ maraṇasyāsya kāraṇam | kuru kāryaṃ ca devānāṃ bhaktavatsala bhūdhara || 26 || vyāsa uvāca śrutvā tadvacanaṃ viṣṇustānuvāca hasanniva | yuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ purāsmābhistathāpi na mṛto hyasau || 27 || adya sarvasurāṇāṃ vai tejobhī rūpasampadā | utpannā cedvarārohā sā hanyāttaṃ raṇe balāt || 28 || hayāriṃ varadṛptañca māyāśataviśāradam | hantuṃ yogyā bhavennārī śaktyaṃśairnirmitā hi naḥ || 29 || prārthayantu ca tejoṃ'śānstriyo'smākaṃ tathā punaḥ | utpannaistaiśca tejoṃ'śaistejorāśirbhavedyathā || 30 || āyudhāni vayaṃ dadmaḥ sarve rudrapurogamāḥ | tasyai sarvāṇi divyāni triśūlādīni yāni ca || 31 || sarvāyudhadharā nārī sarvatejaḥsamanvitā | haniṣyati durātmānaṃ taṃ pāpaṃ madagarvitam || 32 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktavati deveśe brahmaṇo vadanāttataḥ | svayamevodbabhau tejorāśiścātīva duḥsahaḥ || 33 || raktavarṇaṃ śubhākāraṃ padmarāgamaṇiprabham | kiñcicchītaṃ tathā coṣṇaṃ marīcijālamaṇḍitam || 34 || niḥsṛtaṃ hariṇā dṛṣṭaṃ hareṇa ca mahātmanā | vismitau tau mahārāja babhūvatururukramau || 35 || śaṅkarasya śarīrāttu niḥsṛtaṃ mahadadbhutam | raupyavarṇamabhūttīvraṃ durdarśaṃ dāruṇaṃ mahat || 36 || bhayaṅkarañca daityānāṃ devānāṃ vismayapradam | ghorarūpaṃ giriprakhyaṃ tamoguṇamivāparam || 37 || tato viṣṇuśarīrāttu tejorāśimivāparam | nīlaṃ sattvaguṇopetaṃ prādurāsa mahādyuti || 38 || tataścendraśarīrāttu citrarūpaṃ durāsadam | āvirāsītsusaṃvṛttaṃ tejaḥ sarvaguṇātmakam || 39 || kuberayamavahnīnāṃ śarīrebhyaḥ samantataḥ | niścakrāma mahattejo varuṇasya tathaiva ca || 40 || anyeṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ śarīrebhyo'tibhāsvaram | nirgataṃ tanmahātejorāśirāsīnmahojjvalaḥ || 41 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ | tejorāśiṃ mahādivyaṃ himācalamivāparam || 42 || paśyatāṃ tatra devānāṃ tejaḥpuñjasamudbhavā | babhūvātivarā nārī sundarī vismayapradā || 43 || triguṇā sā mahālakṣmīḥ sarvadevaśarīrajā | aṣṭādaśabhujā ramyā trivarṇā viśvamohinī || 44 || śvetānanā kṛṣṇanetrā saṃraktādharapallavā | tāmrapāṇitalā kāntā divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā || 45 || aṣṭādaśabhujā devī sahasrabhujamaṇḍitā | sambhūtāsuranāśāya tejorāśisamudbhavā || 46 || janamejaya uvāca kṛṣṇa deva mahābhāga sarvajña munisattama | vistaraṃ brūhi tasyāstvaṃ śarīrasya samudbhavam || 47 || ekībhūtaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tejaḥ kiṃ vā pṛthak sthitam | aṅgāni caiva tasyāstu sarvatejomayāni vā || 48 || bhinnabhāgavibhāgena jātānyaṅgāni yāni tu | mukhanāsākṣibhedena sarvatraikabhavāni ca || 49 || brūhi tadvistaraṃ vyāsa śarīrāṅgasamudbhavam | babhūva yasya devasya tejaso'ṅgaṃ yadadbhutam || 50 || āyudhābharaṇādīni dattāni yairyathā yathā | tatsarvaṃ śrotukāmo'smi tvanmukhāmbujanirgatam || 51 || na hi tṛpyāmyahaṃ brahman sudhāmayarasaṃ piban | caritañca mahālakṣyāstvanmukhāmbhojaniḥsṛtam || 52 || sūta uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājñaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ prīṇayanniva bhūpatim || 53 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājanmahābhāga vistareṇa bravīmi te | yathāmati kuruśreṣṭha tasyā dehasamudbhavam || 54 || na brahmā na hariḥ sākṣānna rudro na ca vāsavaḥ | yāthātathyena tadrūpaṃ vaktumīśaḥ kadācana || 55 || kathaṃ jānāmyahaṃ devyā yadrūpaṃ yādṛśaṃ yataḥ | vācārambhaṇamātraṃ tadutpanneti bravīmi yat || 56 || sā nityā sarvadaivāste devakāryārthasiddhaye | nānārūpā tvekarūpā jāyate kāryagauravāt || 57 || yathā naṭo raṅgagato nānārūpo bhavatyasau | ekarūpasvabhāvo'pi lokarañjanahetave || 58 || tathaiṣā devakāryārthamarūpāpi svalīlayā | karoti bahurūpāṇi nirguṇā saguṇāni ca || 59 || kāryakarmānusāreṇa nāmāni prabhavanti hi | dhātvarthaguṇayuktāni gauṇāni subahūnyapi || 60 || tadvai buddhyanusāreṇa prabravīmi narādhipa | yathā tejaḥsamudbhūtaṃ rūpaṃ tasyā manoharam || 61 || śaṅkarasya ca yattejastena tanmukhapaṅkajam | śvetavarṇaṃ śubhākāramajāyata mahattaram || 62 || keśāstasyāstathā snigdhā yāmyena tejasābhavan | vakrāgrāścātidīrghā vai meghavarṇā manoharāḥ || 63 || nayanatritayaṃ tasyā jajñe pāvakatejasā | kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ tathā śvetaṃ varṇatrayavibhūṣitam || 64 || vakre snigdhe kṛṣṇavarṇe sandhyayostejasā bhruvau | jāte devyāḥ sutejaske kāmasya dhanuṣīva te || 65 || vāyośca tejasā śastau śravaṇau sambabhūvatuḥ | nātidīrgho nātihrasvau dolāviva manobhuvaḥ || 66 || tilapuṣpasamākārā nāsikā sumanoharā | sañjātā snigdhavarṇā vai dhanadasya ca tejasā || 67 || dantāḥ śikhariṇaḥ ślakṣṇāḥ kundāgrasadṛśāḥ samāḥ | sañjātāḥ suprabhā rājan prājāpatyena tejasā || 68 || adharaścātirakto'syāḥ sañjāto'ruṇatejasā | uttaroṣṭhastathā ramyaḥ kārtikeyasya tejasā || 69 || aṣṭādaśabhujākārā bāhavo viṣṇutejasā | vasūnāṃ tejasāṅgulyo raktavarṇāstathābhavan || 70 || saumyena tejasā jātaṃ stanayoryugmamuttamam | aindreṇāsyāstathā madhyaṃ jātaṃ trivalisaṃyutam || 71 || jaṅghorū varuṇasyātha tejasā sambabhūvatuḥ | nitambaḥ sa tu sañjāto vipulastejasā bhuvaḥ || 72 || evaṃ nārī śubhākārā surūpā susvarā bhṛśam | samutpannā tathā rājaṃstejorāśisamudbhavā || 73 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā suṣṭhusarvāṅgīṃ sudatīṃ cārulocanām | mudaṃ prāpuḥ surāḥ sarve mahiṣeṇa prapīḍitāḥ || 74 || viṣṇustvāha surānsarvānbhūṣaṇānyāyudhāni ca | prayacchantu śubhānyasyai devāḥ sarvāṇi sāmpratam || 75 || svāyudhebhyaḥ samutpādya tejoyuktāni satvarāḥ | samarpayantu sarve'dya devyai nānāyudhāni vai || 76 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe devyāḥ svarūpodbhavavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <5.9> mahiṣamantriṇā devīvārtāvarṇanam vyāsa uvāca devā viṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvā sarve pramuditāstadā | daduśca bhūṣaṇānyāśu vastrāṇi svāyudhāni ca || 1 || kṣīrodaścāmbare divye rakte sūkṣme tathājare | nirmalañca tathā hāraṃ prītastasmai sumaṇḍitam || 2 || dadau cūḍāmaṇiṃ divyaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham | kuṇḍale ca tathā śubhre kaṭakāni bhujeṣu vai || 3 || keyūrānkaṅkaṇāndivyānnānāratnavirājitān | dadau tasyai viśvakarmā prasannendriyamānasaḥ || 4 || nūpurau susvarau kāntau nirmalau ratnabhūṣitau | dadau sūryapratīkāśau tvaṣṭā tasyai supādayoḥ || 5 || tathā graiveyakaṃ ramyaṃ dadau tasyai mahārṇavaḥ | aṅgulīyakaratnāni tejovanti ca sarvaśaḥ || 6 || amlānapaṅkajāṃ mālāṃ gandhāḍhyāṃ bhramarānugām | tathaiva vaijayantīñca varuṇaḥ samprayacchata || 7 || himavānatha santuṣṭo ratnāni vividhāni ca | dadau ca vāhanaṃ siṃhaṃ kanakābhaṃ manoharam || 8 || bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitā divyaiḥ sā rarāja varā śubhā | siṃhārūḍhā varārohā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || 9 || viṣṇuścakrātsamutpādya dadāvasyai rathāṅgakam | sahasrāraṃ sudīptañca devāriśirasāṃ haram || 10 || svatriśūlātsamutpādya śaṅkaraḥ śūlamuttamam | dadau devyai surārīṇāṃ kṛntanaṃ bhayanāśanam || 11 || varuṇaśca prasannātmā dadau śaṅkhaṃ samujvalam | ghoṣavantaṃ svaśaṅkhāttu samutpādya sumaṅgalam || 12 || hutāśanastathā śaktiṃ śataghnīṃ sumanojavām | prāyacchattu prasannātmā tasyai daityavināśinīm || 13 || iṣudhiṃ bāṇapūrṇañca cāpaṃ cādbhutadarśanam | māruto dattavāṃstasyai durākarṣaṃ kharasvaram || 14 || svavajrādvajramutpādya dadāvindro'tidāruṇam | ghaṇṭāmairāvatāttūrṇaṃ suśabdāṃ cātisundarām || 15 || dadau daṇḍaṃ yamaḥ kāmaṃ kāladaṇḍasamudbhavam | yenāntaṃ sarvabhūtānāmakarotkāla āgate || 16 || brahmā kamaṇḍaluṃ divyaṃ gaṅgāvāriprapūritam | dadāvasyai mudā yukto varuṇaḥ pāśameva ca || 17 || kālaḥ khaḍgaṃ tathā carma prāyacchattu narādhipa | paraśuṃ viśvakarmā ca tīkṣṇamasyai dadāvatha || 18 || dhanadastu surāpūrṇaṃ pānapātraṃ suvarṇajam | paṅkajaṃ varuṇaścādāddevyai divyaṃ manoharam || 19 || gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ tvaṣṭā ghaṇṭāśataninādinīm | adāttasyai prasannātmā suraśatruvināśinīm || 20 || astrāṇyanekarūpāṇi tathābhedyañca daṃśanam | dadau tvaṣṭā jaganmātre nijaraśmīndivākaraḥ || 21 || sāyudhāṃ bhūṣaṇairyuktāṃ dṛṣṭvā te vismayaṃ gatāḥ | tuṣṭuvustāṃ surā devīṃ trailokyamohinīṃ śivām || 22 || devā ūcuḥ namaḥ śivāyai kalyāṇyai śāntyai puṣṭyai namo namaḥ | bhagavatyai namo devyai rudrāṇyai satataṃ namaḥ || 23 || kālarātryai tathāmbāyai indrāṇyai te namo namaḥ | siddhyai buddhyai tathā vṛddhyai vaiṣṇavyai te namo namaḥ || 24 || pṛthivyāṃ yā sthitā pṛthvyā na jñātā pṛthivīñca yā | antaḥsthitā yamayati vande tāmīśvarīṃ parām || 25 || māyāyāṃ yā sthitā jñātā māyayā na ca tāmajām | antaḥsthitā prerayati prerayitrīṃ numaḥ śivām || 26 || kalyāṇaṃ kuru bho mātastrāhi naḥ śatrutāpitān | jahi pāpaṃ hayāriṃ tvaṃ tejasā svena mohitam || 27 || khalaṃ māyāvinaṃ ghoraṃ strīvadhyaṃ varadarpitam | duḥkhadaṃ sarvadevānāṃ nānārūpadharaṃ śatam || 28 || tvamekā sarvadevānāṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaktavatsale | pīḍitāndānavenādya trāhi devi namo'stu te || 29 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ stutā tadā devī suraiḥ sarvasukhapradā | tānuvāca mahādevī smitapūrvaṃ śubhaṃ vacaḥ || 30 || devyuvāca bhayaṃ tyajantu gīrvāṇā mahiṣānmandacetasaḥ | haniṣyāmi raṇe'dyaiva varadṛptaṃ vimohitam || 31 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā sā surāndevī jahāsātīva susvaram | citrametacca saṃsāre bhramamohayutaṃ jagat || 32 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ sendrāścānye surāstathā | kampayuktā bhayatrastā vartante mahiṣātkila || 33 || aho daivabalaṃ ghoraṃ durjayaṃ surasattamāḥ | kālaḥ kartāsti duḥkhānāṃ sukhānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ || 34 || sṛṣṭipālanasaṃhāre samarthā api te yadā | muhyanti kleśasantaptā mahiṣeṇa prapīḍitāḥ || 35 || iti kṛtvā smitaṃ devī sāṭṭahāsaṃ cakāra ha | uccaiḥ śabdaṃ mahāghoraṃ dānavānāṃ bhayapradam || 36 || cakampe vasudhā tatra śrutvā tacchabdamadbhutam | celuśca parvatāḥ sarve cukṣobhābdhiśca vīryavān || 37 || meruścacāla śabdena diśaḥ sarvāḥ prapūritāḥ | bhayaṃ jagmustadā śrutvā dānavāstatsvanaṃ mahat || 38 || jaya pāhīti devāstāmūcuḥ paramaharṣitāḥ | mahiṣo'pi svanaṃ śrutvā cukopa madagarvitaḥ || 39 || kimetaditi tāndaityānpapraccha svanaśaṅkitaḥ | gacchantu tvaritā dūtā jñātuṃ śabdasamudbhavam || 40 || kṛtaḥ kenāyamatyugraḥ śabdaḥ karṇavyathākaraḥ | devo vā dānavo vāpi yo bhavetsvanakārakaḥ || 41 || gṛhītvā taṃ durātmānaṃ matsamīpaṃ nayantviha | haniṣyāmi durācāraṃ garjantaṃ smayadurmadam || 42 || kṣīṇāyuṣyaṃ mandamatiṃ nayāmi yamasādanam | parājitāḥ surāḥ kāmaṃ na garjanti bhayāturāḥ || 43 || nāsurā mama vaśyāste kasyedaṃ mūḍhaceṣṭitam | tvaritā māmupāyāntu jñātvā śabdasya kāraṇam || 44 || ahaṃ gatvā haniṣyāmi taṃ pāpaṃ vitathaśramam | vyāsa uvāca ityuktāstena te dūtā devīṃ sarvāṅgasundarīm || 45 || aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ divyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām | sarvalakṣaṇasampannāṃ varāyudhadharāṃ śubhām || 46 || dadhatīṃ caṣakaṃ haste pibantīṃ ca muhurmadhu | saṃvīkṣya bhayabhītāste jagmustrastāḥ suśaṅkitāḥ || 47 || sakāśe mahiṣasyāśu tamūcuḥ svanakāraṇam | dūtā ūcuḥ devī daityeśvara prauḍhā dṛśyate kācidaṅganā || 48 || sarvāṅgabhūṣaṇā nārī sarvaratnopaśobhitā | na mānuṣī nāsurī sā divyarūpā manoharā || 49 || siṃhārūḍhāyudhadharā cāṣṭādaśakarā varā | sā nādaṃ kurute nārī lakṣyate madagarvitā || 50 || surāpānaratā kāmaṃ jānīmo na sabhartṛkā | antarikṣasthitā devāstāṃ stuvanti mudānvitāḥ || 51 || jayeti pāhi naśceti jahi śatrumiti prabho | na jāne kā varārohā kasya vā sā parigrahaḥ || 52 || kimarthamāgatā cātra kiṃ cikīrṣati sundarī | draṣṭuṃ naiva samarthāḥ smastattejaḥparidharṣitāḥ || 53 || śṛṅgāravīrahāsāḍhyā raudrādbhutarasānvitā | dṛṣṭvaivaivaṃvidhāṃ nārīmasambhāṣya samāgatāḥ || 54 || vayaṃ tvadājñayā rājan kiṃ kartavyamataḥparam | mahiṣa uvāca gaccha vīra mayādiṣṭo mantriśreṣṭha balānvitaḥ || 55 || sāmādibhirupāyaistvaṃ samānaya śubhānanām | nāyāti yadi sā nārī tribhiḥ sāmādibhistviha || 56 || ahatvā tāṃ varārohāṃ tvamānaya mamāntikam | karomi paṭṭamahiṣīṃ tāṃ marālabhruvaṃ mudā || 57 || prītiyuktā samāyāti yadi sā
