mṛgalocanā | rasabhaṅgo yathā na syāttathā kuru mamepsitam || 58 || śravaṇānmohito'smyadya tasyā rūpasya sampadā | vyāsa uvāca mahiṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā peśalaṃ mantrisattamaḥ || 59 || jagāma tarasā kāmaṃ gajāśvarathasaṃyutaḥ | gatvā dūrataraṃ sthitvā tāmuvāca manasvinīm || 60 || vinayāvanataḥ ślakṣṇaṃ mantrī madhurayā girā | pradhāna uvāca kāsi tvaṃ madhurālāpe kimatrāgamanaṃ kṛtam || 61 || pṛcchati tvāṃ mahābhāge manmukhena mama prabhuḥ | sa jetā sarvadevānāmavadhyastu naraiḥ kila || 62 || brahmaṇo varadānena garvitaścārulocane | daityeśvaro'sau balavānkāmarūpadharaḥ sadā || 63 || śrutvā tvāṃ samupāyātāṃ cāruveṣāṃ manoharām | draṣṭumicchati rājā me mahiṣo nāma pārthivaḥ || 64 || mānuṣaṃ rūpamādāya tvatsamīpaṃ sameṣyati | yathā rucyeta cārvaṅgi tathā manyāmahe vayam || 65 || tarhyehi mṛgaśāvākṣi samīpaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ | no cedihānayāmyenaṃ rājānaṃ bhaktitatparam || 66 || tathā karomi deveśi yathā te manasepsitam | vaśago'sau tavātyarthaṃ rūpasaṃśravaṇāttava || 67 || karabhoru vadāśu tvaṃ saṃvidheyaṃ mayā tathā || 68 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe mahiṣamantriṇā devīvārtāvarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <5.10> mantrīdvārā mahiṣāsureṇa devyā saha vivāhaprastāvaḥ vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya pramadottamā | tamuvāca mahārāja meghagambhīrayā girā || 1 || devyuvāca mantrivarya surāṇāṃ vai jananīṃ viddhi māṃ kila | mahālakṣmīmiti khyātāṃ sarvadaityaniṣūdinīm || 2 || prārthitāhaṃ suraiḥ sarvairmahiṣasya vadhāya ca | pīḍitairdānavendreṇa yajñabhāgabahiṣkṛtaiḥ || 3 || tasmādihāgatāsmyadya tadvadhārthaṃ kṛtodyamā | ekākinī na sainyena saṃyutā mantrisattama || 4 || yattvayāhaṃ sāmapūrvaṃ kṛtvā svāgatamādarāt | uktā madhurayā vācā tena tuṣṭāsmi te'nagha || 5 || noceddhanmi dṛśā tvāṃ vai kālāgnisamayā kila | kasya prītikaraṃ na syānmādhuryavacanaṃ khalu || 6 || gaccha taṃ mahiṣaṃ pāpaṃ vada madvacanādidam | gaccha pātālamadhunā jīvitecchā yadasti te || 7 || nocetkṛtāgasaṃ duṣṭaṃ haniṣyāmi raṇāṅgaṇe | madbāṇakṣuṇṇadehastvaṃ gantāsi yamasādanam || 8 || dayālutvaṃ mamedaṃ tvaṃ viditvā gaccha satvaram | hate tvayi surā mūḍha svargaṃ prāpsyanti satvaram || 9 || tasmād gacchasva tyaktvaiko medinīñca sasāgarām | pātālaṃ tarasā manda yāvad bāṇā na me'patan || 10 || yuddhecchā cenmanasi te tarhyehi tvarito'sura | vīrairmahābalaiḥ sarvairnayāmi yamasādanam || 11 || yuge yuge mahāmūḍha hatāstvatsadṛśāḥ kila | asaṃkhyātāstathā tvāṃ vai haniṣyāmi raṇāṅgaṇe || 12 || sāphalyaṃ kuru śastrāṇāṃ dhāraṇe tu śramo'nyathā | tadyudhyasva mayā sārdhaṃ samare smarapīḍitaḥ || 13 || mā garvaṃ kuru duṣṭātman yanme'sti brahmaṇo varaḥ | strīvadhyatve tvayā mūḍha pīḍitāḥ surasattamāḥ || 14 || kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ dhātustenāhaṃ tvāmupāgatā | strīrūpamatulaṃ kṛtvā satyaṃ hantuṃ kṛtāgasam || 15 || yathecchaṃ gaccha vā mūḍha pātālaṃ pannagāvṛtam | hitvā bhūsurasadmādya jīvitecchā yadasti te || 16 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktaḥ sa tato devyā mantriśreṣṭho balānvitaḥ | pratyuvāca niśamyāsau vacanaṃ hetugarbhitam || 17 || devi strīsadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ brūṣe tvaṃ madagarvitā | kvāsau kva tvaṃ kathaṃ yuddhamasambhāvyamidaṃ kila || 18 || ekākinī punarbālā prārabdhayauvanā mṛduḥ | mahiṣo'sau mahākāyo durvibhāvyaṃ hi saṅgatam || 19 || sainyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tasya hastyaśvarathasaṃkulam | padātigaṇasaṃviddhaṃ nānāyudhavirājitam || 20 || kaḥ śramaḥ karirājasya mālatīpuṣpamardane | māraṇe tava vāmoru mahiṣasya tathā raṇe || 21 || yadi tvāṃ paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ bravīmi svalpamapyaham | śṛṅgāre tadviruddhaṃ hi rasabhaṅgādbibhemyaham || 22 || rājāsmākaṃ suraripurvartate tvayi bhaktimān | sāmameva mayā vācyaṃ dānayuktaṃ tathā vacaḥ || 23 || noceddhanmyahamadyaiva bāṇena tvāṃ mṛṣāvadām | mithyābhimānacaturāṃ rūpayauvanagarvitām || 24 || svāmī me mohitaḥ śrutvā rūpaṃ te bhuvanātigam | tatpriyārthaṃ priyaṃ kāmaṃ vaktavyaṃ tvayi yanmayā || 25 || rājyaṃ tava dhanaṃ sarvaṃ dāsaste mahiṣaḥ kila | kuru bhāvaṃ viśālākṣi tyaktvā roṣaṃ mṛtipradam || 26 || patāmi pādayoste'haṃ bhaktibhāvena bhāmini | paṭṭarājñī mahārājño bhava śīghraṃ śucismite || 27 || trailokyavibhavaṃ sarvaṃ prāpsyasi tvamanāvilam | sukhaṃ saṃsārajaṃ sarvaṃ mahiṣasya parigrahāt || 28 || devyuvāca śṛṇu sāciva vakṣyāmi vākyānāṃ sāramuttamam | śāstradṛṣṭena mārgeṇa cāturyamanucintya ca || 29 || mahiṣasya pradhānastvaṃ mayā jñātaṃ dhiyā kila | paśubuddhisvabhāvo'si vacanāttava sāmpratam || 30 || mantriṇastvādṛśā yasya sa kathaṃ buddhimānbhavet | ubhayoḥ sadṛśo yogaḥ kṛto'yaṃ vidhinā kila || 31 || yaduktaṃ strīsvabhāvāsi tadvicārasya mūḍha kim | pumānnāhaṃ tatsvabhāvābhavaṃstrīveṣadhāriṇī || 32 || yācitaṃ maraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ striyā tvatprabhuṇā yathā | tasmānmanye'timūrkho'sau na vīrarasavittamaḥ || 33 || kāminyā maraṇaṃ klībaratidaṃ śūraduḥkhadam | prārthitaṃ prabhuṇā tena mahiṣeṇātmabuddhinā || 34 || tasmātstrīrūpamādhāya kāryaṃ kartumupāgatā | kathaṃ bibhemi tvadvākyairdharmaśāstravirodhakaiḥ || 35 || viparītaṃ yadā daivaṃ tṛṇaṃ vajrasamaṃ bhavet | vidhiścetsumukhaḥ kāmaṃ kuliśaṃ tūlavattadā || 36 || kiṃ sainyairāyudhaiḥ kiṃ vā prapañcairdurgasevanaiḥ | maraṇaṃ sāmprataṃ yasya tasya sainyaistu kiṃ phalam || 37 || yadāyaṃ dehasambandho jīvasya kālayogataḥ | tadaiva likhitaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā mṛtiḥ || 38 || yasya yena prakāreṇa maraṇaṃ daivanirmitam | tasya tenaiva jāyeta nānyatheti viniścayaḥ || 39 || brahmādīnāṃ yathā kāle nāśotpattī vinirmite | tathaiva bhavataḥ kāmaṃ kimanyeṣāṃ vicāryate || 40 || ye mṛtyudharmiṇasteṣāṃ varadānena darpitāḥ | mariṣyāmo na manyante te mūḍhā mandacetasaḥ || 41 || tasmād gaccha nṛpaṃ brūhi vacanaṃ mama satvaram | yadājñāpayate bhūpastatkartavyaṃ tvayā kila || 42 || maghavā svargamāpnotu devāḥ santu havirbhujaḥ | yūyaṃ prayāta pātālaṃ yadi jīvitumicchatha || 43 || anyathā cenmatirmanda mahiṣasya durātmanaḥ | tadyudhyasva mayā sārdhaṃ maraṇāya kṛtādaraḥ || 44 || manyase saṅgare bhagnā devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ | daivaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ tatra varadānaṃ prajāpateḥ || 45 || vyāsa uvāca iti devyā vacaḥ śrutvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā yuddhaṃ gantavyaṃ vā nṛpaṃ prati || 46 || vivāhārthamihājñapto rājñā kāmātureṇa vai | tatkathaṃ virasaṃ kṛtvā gaccheyaṃ nṛpasannidhau || 47 || iyaṃ buddhiḥ samīcīnā yad vrajāmi kaliṃ vinā | yathāgataṃ tathā śīghraṃ rājñe saṃvedayāmyaham || 48 || sa pramāṇaṃ punaḥ kārye rājā matimatāṃ varaḥ | kariṣyati vicāryaiva sacivairnipuṇaiḥ saha || 49 || sahasā na mayā yuddhaṃ kartavyamanayā saha | jaye parājaye vāpi bhūpaterapriyaṃ bhavet || 50 || yadi māṃ sundarī hanyādahaṃ vā hanmi tāṃ punaḥ | yena kenāpyupāyena sa kupyetpārthivaḥ kila || 51 || tasmāttatraiva gatvāhaṃ bodhayiṣyāmi taṃ nṛpam | yathādyābhihitaṃ devyā yathāruci karotu saḥ || 52 || vyāsa uvāca iti sañcintya medhāvī jagāma nṛpasannidhau | praṇamya tamuvācedaṃ kṛtāñjaliramātyakaḥ || 53 || mantryuvāca rājan devī varārohā siṃhasyopari saṃsthitā | aṣṭādaśabhujā ramyā varāyudhadharā parā || 54 || sā mayoktā mahārāja mahiṣaṃ bhaja bhāmini | mahiṣī bhava rājñastvaṃ trailokyādhipateḥ priyā || 55 || paṭṭarājñī tvamevāsya bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ | sa tavājñākaro jāto vaśavartī bhaviṣyati || 56 || trailokyavibhavaṃ bhuktvā cirakālaṃ varānane | mahiṣaṃ patimāsādya yoṣitāṃ subhagā bhava || 57 || iti madvacanaṃ śrutvā sā smayāveśamohitā | māmuvāca viśālākṣī smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 58 || mahiṣīgarbhasambhūtaṃ paśūnāmadhamaṃ kila | baliṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ devyai surāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā || 59 || kā mūḍhā kāminī loke mahiṣaṃ vai patiṃ bhajet | mādṛśī mandabuddhe kiṃ paśubhāvaṃ bhajediha || 60 || mahiṣī mahiṣaṃ nāthaṃ saśṛṅgā śṛṅgasaṃyutam | kurute krandamānā vai nāhaṃ tatsadṛśī śaṭhā || 61 || kariṣye'haṃ mṛdhe yuddhaṃ haniṣye tvāṃ surāpriyam | gaccha vā duṣṭa pātālaṃ jīvitecchā yadasti te || 62 || paruṣaṃ tu tayā vākyamityuktaṃ nṛpa mattayā | tacchrutvāhaṃ samāyātaḥ pravicintya punaḥ punaḥ || 63 || rasabhaṅgaṃ vicintyaiva na yuddhaṃ tu mayā kṛtam | ājñāṃ vinā tavātyantaṃ kathaṃ kuryāṃ vṛthodyamam || 64 || sātīva ca balonmattā vartate bhūpa bhāminī | bhavitavyaṃ na jānāmi kiṃ vā bhāvi bhaviṣyati || 65 || kārye'smiṃstvaṃ pramāṇaṃ no mantro'tīva durāsadaḥ | yuddhaṃ palāyanaṃ śreyo na jāne'haṃ viniścayam || 66 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe mantrīdvārā mahiṣāsureṇa devyā saha vivāhaprastāvo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <5.11> tāmrakṛtaṃ devīṃ prati visraṃsanavacanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā mahiṣo madavihvalaḥ | mantrivṛddhān samāhūya rājā vacanamabravīt || 1 || rājovāca mantriṇaḥ kiṃ ca kartavyaṃ viśrabdhaṃ brūta mā ciram | āgatā devavihitā māyeyaṃ śāmbarīva kim || 2 || kārye'sminnipuṇā yūyamupāyeṣu vicakṣaṇāḥ | sāmādiṣu ca kartavyaḥ ko'tra mahyaṃ bruvantu ca || 3 || mantriṇa ūcuḥ satyaṃ sadaiva vaktavyaṃ priyañca nṛpasattama | kāryaṃ hitakaraṃ nūnaṃ vicārya vibudhaiḥ kila || 4 || satyaṃ ca hitakṛdrājanpriyaṃ cāhitakṛdbhavet | yathauṣadhaṃ nṛṇāṃ loke hyapriyaṃ roganāśanam || 5 || satyasya śrotā mantā ca durlabhaḥ pṛthivīpate | vaktāpi durlabhaḥ kāmaṃ bahavaścāṭubhāṣakāḥ || 6 || kathaṃ brūmo'tra nṛpate vicāre gahane tviha | śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi ko vetti bhuvanatraye || 7 || rājovāca svasvamatyanusāreṇa bruvantvadya pṛthakpṛthak | yeṣāṃ hi yādṛśo bhāvastacchrutvā cintayāmyaham || 8 || bahūnāṃ matamājñāya vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ | yacchreyastaddhi kartavyaṃ kāryaṃ kāryavicakṣaṇaiḥ || 9 || vyāsa uvāca tasyaivaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā virūpākṣo mahābalaḥ | uvāca tarasā vākyaṃ rañjayanpṛthivīpatim || 10 || virūpākṣa uvāca rājannārī varākīyaṃ sā brūte madagarvitā | vibhīṣikāmātramidaṃ jñātavyaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā || 11 || ko bibheti striyo vākyairduruktai raṇadurmadaiḥ | anṛtaṃ sāhasaṃ ceti jānannārīviceṣṭitam || 12 || jitvā tribhuvanaṃ rājannadya kāntābhayena vai | dīnatve'pyayaśo nūnaṃ vīrasya bhuvane bhavet || 13 || tasmādyāmyahamekākī yuddhāya caṇḍikāṃ prati | haniṣye tāṃ mahārāja nirbhayo bhava sāmpratam || 14 || senāvṛto'haṃ gatvā tāṃ śastrāstrairvividhaiḥ kila | niṣūdayāmi durmarṣāṃ caṇḍikāṃ caṇḍavikramām || 15 || baddhvā sarpamayaiḥ pāśairānayiṣye tavāntikam | vaśagā tu sadā te syātpaśya rājan balaṃ mama || 16 || vyāsa uvāca virūpākṣavacaḥ śrutvā durdharo vākyamabravīt | satyamuktaṃ vaco rājan virūpākṣeṇa dhīmatā || 17 || mamāpi vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ śrotavyaṃ dhīmatā tvayā | kāmāturaiṣā sudatī lakṣyate'pyanumānataḥ || 18 || bhavatyevaṃvidhā kāmaṃ nāyikā rūpagarvitā | bhīṣayitvā varārohā tvāṃ vaśe kartumicchati || 19 || hāvo'yaṃ māninīnāṃ vai taṃ vetti rasavittamaḥ | vakroktireṣā kāminyāḥ priyaṃ prati parāyaṇam || 20 || vetti ko'pi naraḥ kāmaṃ kāmaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ | yaduktaṃ nāma bāṇaistvā vadhiṣye raṇamūrdhani || 21 || hetugarbhamidaṃ vākyaṃ jñātavyaṃ hetuvittamaiḥ | bāṇāstu māninīnāṃ vai kaṭākṣā eva viśrutāḥ || 22 || puṣpāñjalimayāścānye vyaṃgyāni vacanāni ca | kā śaktiranyabāṇānāṃ preraṇe tvayi pārthiva || 23 || tādṛśīnāṃ na sā śaktirbrahmaviṣṇuharādiṣu | yayoktaṃ netrabāṇaistvāṃ haniṣye manda pārthivam || 24 || viparītaṃ parijñātaṃ tenārasavidā kila | pātayiṣyāmi śayyāyāṃ raṇamayyāṃ patiṃ tava || 25 || viparītaratikīḍābhāṣaṇaṃ jñeyameva tat | kariṣye vigataprāṇaṃ yaduktaṃ vacanaṃ tayā || 26 || vīryaṃ prāṇā iti proktaṃ tadvihīnaṃ na cānyathā | vyaṃgyādhikyena vākyena varayatyuttamā nṛpa || 27 || tadvai vicārato jñeyaṃ rasagranthavicakṣaṇaiḥ | iti jñātvā mahārāja kartavyaṃ rasasaṃyutam || 28 || sāmadānadvayaṃ tasyā nānyopāyo'sti bhūpate | ruṣṭā vā garvitā vāpi vaśagā māninī bhavet || 29 || tādṛśairmadhurairvākyairānayiṣye tavāntikam | kiṃ bahūktena me rājan kartavyā vaśavartinī || 30 || gatvā mayādhunaiveyaṃ kiṅkarīva sadaiva te | vyāsa uvāva itthaṃ niśamya tadvākyaṃ tāmrastattvavicakṣaṇaḥ || 31 || uvāca vacanaṃ rājanniśāmaya mayoditam | hetumaddharmasahitaṃ rasayuktaṃ nayānvitam || 32 || naiṣā kāmāturā bālā nānuraktā vicakṣaṇā | vyaṃgyāni naiva vākyāni tayoktāni tu mānada || 33 || citramatra mahābāho yadekā varavarṇinī | nirālambā samāyāti citrarūpā manoharā || 34 || aṣṭādaśabhujā nārī na śrutā na ca vīkṣitā | kenāpi triṣu lokeṣu parākramavatī śubhā || 35 || āyudhānyapi tāvanti dhṛtāni balavanti ca | viparītamidaṃ manye sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ nṛpa || 36 || svapnāni durnimittāni mayā dṛṣṭāni vai niśi | tena jānāmyahaṃ nūnaṃ vaiśasaṃ samupāgatam || 37 || kṛṣṇāmbaradharā nārī rudatī ca gṛhāṅgaṇe | dṛṣṭā svapne'pyuṣaḥkāle cintitavyastadatyayaḥ || 38 || vikṛtāḥ pakṣiṇo rātrau roruvanti gṛhe gṛhe | utpātā vividhā rājan prabhavanti gṛhe gṛhe || 39 || tena jānāmyahaṃ nūnaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiñcideva hi | yattvāṃ prārthayate bālā yuddhāya kṛtaniścayā || 40 || naiṣāsti mānuṣī no vā gāndharvī na tathāsurī | devaiḥ kṛteyaṃ jñātavyā māyā mohakarī vibho || 41 || kātaratvaṃ na kartavyaṃ mamaitanmatamityalam | kartavyaṃ sarvathā yuddhaṃ yadbhāvyaṃ tadbhaviṣyati || 42 || ko veda daivakartavyaṃ śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ tathā | avalambya dhiyā dhairyaṃ sthātavyaṃ vai vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 43 || jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ puṃsāṃ daivādhīnaṃ narādhipa | ko'pi naivānyathā kartuṃ samartho bhuvanatraye || 44 || mahiṣa uvāca gaccha tāmra mahābhāga yuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ | tāmānaya varārohāṃ jitvā dharmeṇa māninīm || 45 || na bhavedvaśagā nārī saṃgrāme yadi sā tava | hantavyā nānyathā kāmaṃ mānanīyā prayatnataḥ || 46 || vīrastvamasi sarvajña kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ | yena kenāpyupāyena jetavyā varavarṇinī || 47 || tvaranvīra mahābāho sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ | tatra gatvā tvayā jñeyā vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 48 || kimarthamāgatā ceyaṃ jñātavyaṃ taddhi kāraṇam | kāmādvā vairabhāvācca māyā kasyeyamityuta || 49 || ādau tanniścayaṃ kṛtvā jñātavyaṃ taccikīrṣitam | paścādyuddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ yathābalam || 50 || kātaratvaṃ na kartavyaṃ nirdayatvaṃ tathā na ca | yādṛśaṃ hi manastasyāḥ kartavyaṃ tādṛśaṃ tvayā || 51 || vyāsa uvāca iti tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā tāmraḥ kālavaśaṃ gataḥ | nirgataḥ sainyasaṃyuktaḥ praṇamya mahiṣaṃ nṛpam || 52 || gacchanmārge durātmāsau śakunānvīkṣya dāruṇān | vismayañca bhayaṃ prāpa yamamārgapradarśakān || 53 || sagatvā tāṃ samālokya devīṃ siṃhoparisthitām | stūyamānāṃ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvāyudhavibhūṣitām || 54 || tāmuvāca vinītaḥ san vākyaṃ madhurayā girā | sāmabhāvaṃ samāśritya vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || 55 || devi daityeśvaraḥ śṛṅgī tvadrūpaguṇamohitaḥ | spṛhāṃ karoti mahiṣastvatpāṇigrahaṇāya ca || 56 || bhāvaṃ kuru viśālākṣi tasminnamaradurjaye | patiṃ taṃ prāpya mṛdvaṅgi nandane viharādbhute || 57 || sarvāṅgasundaraṃ dehaṃ prāpya sarvasukhāspadam | sukhaṃ sarvātmanā grāhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ heyamiti sthitiḥ || 58 || karabhoru kimarthaṃ te gṛhītānyāyudhānyalam | puṣpakandukayogyāste karāḥ kamalakomalāḥ || 59 || bhrūcāpe vidyamāne'pi dhanuṣā kiṃ prayojanam | kaṭākṣā viśikhāḥ santi kiṃ bāṇairniṣprayojanaiḥ || 60 || saṃsāre duḥkhadaṃ yuddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ vijānatā | lobhāsaktāḥ prakurvanti saṃgrāmañca parasparam || 61 || puṣpairapi na yoddhavyaṃ kiṃ punarniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | bhedanaṃ nijagātrāṇāṃ kasya tajjāyate mude || 62 || tasmāttvamapi tanvaṅgi prasādaṃ kartumarhasi | bhartāraṃ bhaja me nāthaṃ devadānavapūjitam || 63 || sa te'tra vāñchitaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati manoratham | tvaṃ paṭṭamahiṣī rājñaḥ sarvathā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 64 || vacanaṃ kuru me devi prāpsyase sukhamuttamam | saṃgrāme jayasandehaḥ kaṣṭaṃ prāpya na saṃśayaḥ || 65 || jānāsi rājanītiṃ tvaṃ yathāvadvaravarṇini | bhuṃkṣva rājyasukhaṃ pūrṇaṃ varṣāṇāmayutāyutam || 66 || putraste bhavitā kāntaḥ so'pi rājā bhaviṣyati | yauvane krīḍayitvānte vārdhakye sukhamāpsyasi || 67 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe tāmrakṛtaṃ devīṃ prati visraṃsanavacanavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <5.12> devīparājayakaraṇāya durdharaprabodhavacanam vyāsa uvāca tanniśamya vacastasya tāmrasya jagadambikā | meghagambhīrayā vācā hasantī tamuvāca ha || 1 || devyuvāca gaccha tāmra patiṃ brūhi mumūrṣuṃ mandacetasam | mahiṣaṃ cātikāmārtaṃ mūḍhaṃ jñānavivarjitam || 2 || yathā te mahiṣī mātā prauḍhā yavasabhakṣiṇī | nāhaṃ tathā śṛṅgavatī lambapucchā mahodarī || 3 || na kāmaye'haṃ deveśaṃ naiva viṣṇuṃ na śaṅkaram | dhanadaṃ varuṇaṃ naiva brahmāṇaṃ na ca pāvakam || 4 || etāndevagaṇānhitvā paśuṃ kena guṇena vai | vṛṇomyahaṃ vṛthā loke garhaṇā me bhavediti || 5 || nāhaṃ patiṃvarā nārī vartate me patiḥ prabhuḥ | sarvakartā sarvasākṣī hyakartā niḥspṛhaḥ sthiraḥ || 6 || nirguṇo nirmamo'nanto nirālambo nirāśrayaḥ | sarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ sākṣī pūrṇaḥ pūrṇāśayaḥ śivaḥ || 7 || sarvāvāsakṣamaḥ śāntaḥ sarvadṛksarvabhāvanaḥ | taṃ tyaktvā mahiṣaṃ mandaṃ kathaṃ sevitumutsahe || 8 || prabudhya yudhyatāṃ kāmaṃ karomi yamavāhanam | athavā manujānāṃ vai kariṣye jalavāhakam || 9 || jīvitecchāsti cetpāpa gaccha pātālamāśu vai | samastairdānavairyuktastvanyathā hanmi saṅgare || 10 || kāmaṃ sadṛśayoryogaḥ saṃsāre sukhado bhavet | anyathā duḥkhado bhūyādajñānādyadi kalpitaḥ || 11 || mūrkhastvamasi yad brūṣe patiṃ me bhaja bhāmini | kvāhaṃ kva mahiṣaḥ śṛṅgī sambandhaḥ kīdṛśo dvayoḥ || 12 || gaccha yudhyasva vā kāmaṃ haniṣye'haṃ sabāndhavam | yajñabhāgaṃ devalokaṃ nocettyaktvā sukhī bhava || 13 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā sā tadā devī jagarja bhṛśamadbhutam | kalpāntasadṛśaṃ nādaṃ cakre daityabhayāvaham || 14 || cakampe vasudhā celustena śabdena bhūdharāḥ | garbhāśca daityapatnīnāṃ sasraṃsurgarjitasvanāt || 15 || tāmraḥ śrutvā ca taṃ śabdaṃ bhayatrastamanāstadā | palāyanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā jagāma mahiṣāntikam || 16 || nagare tasya ye daityāste'pi cintāmavāpnuvan | badhirīkṛtakarṇāśca palāyanaparā nṛpa || 17 || tadā krodhena siṃho'pi nanāda bhṛśamutsaṭaḥ | tena nādena daiteyā bhayaṃ jagmurapi sphuṭam || 18 || tāmraṃ samāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā hayārirapi mohitaḥ | cintayāmāsa sacivaiḥ kiṃ kartavyamataḥ param || 19 || durgagraho vā kartavyo yuddhaṃ nirgatya vā punaḥ | palāyane kṛte śreyo bhavedvā dānavottamāḥ || 20 || buddhimanto durādharṣāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ | mantraḥ khalu prakartavyaḥ suguptaḥ kāryasiddhaye || 21 || mantramūlaṃ smṛtaṃ rājyaṃ yadi sa syātsurakṣitaḥ | mantribhiśca sadācārairvidheyaḥ sarvathā budhaiḥ || 22 || mantrabhede vināśaḥ syādrājyasya bhūpatestathā | tasmādbhedabhayād guptaḥ kartavyo bhūtimicchatā || 23 || tadatra mantribhirvācyaṃ vacanaṃ hetumaddhitam | kāladeśānusāreṇa vicintya nītinirṇayam || 24 || yā yoṣātra samāyātā prabalā devanirmitā | ekākinī nirālambā kāraṇaṃ tadvicintyatām || 25 || yuddhaṃ prārthayate bālā kimāścaryamataḥ param | śreyo'tra viparītaṃ vā ko vetti bhuvanatraye || 26 || na bahūnāṃ jayo'pyasti naikasya ca parājayaḥ | daivādhīnau sadā jñeyau yuddhe jayaparājayau || 27 || upāyavādinaḥ prāhurdaivaṃ kiṃ kena vīkṣitam | adṛṣṭamiti yannāma pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 28 || tatsattve'pi pramāṇaṃ kiṃ kātarāśāvalambanam | na samarthajanānāṃ hi daivaṃ kutrāpi lakṣyate || 29 || udyamo daivametau hi śūrakātarayormatam | vicintyādya dhiyā sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ kāryamādarāt || 30 || vyāsa uvāca iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvā hetugarbhaṃ mahāyaśāḥ | biḍālākhyo mahārājamityuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 31 || rājanneṣā viśālākṣī jñātavyā yatnataḥ punaḥ | kimarthamiha samprāptā kutaḥ kasya parigrahaḥ || 32 || maraṇaṃ te parijñāya striyā sarvātmanā suraiḥ | preṣitā padmapatrākṣī samutpādya svatejasā || 33 || te'pi channāḥ sthitāḥ khe'tra sarve yuddhadidṛkṣavaḥ | samaye'syāḥ sahāyāste bhaviṣyanti yuyutsavaḥ || 34 || purataḥ kāminīṃ kṛtvā te vai viṣṇupurogamāḥ | vadhiṣyanti ca naḥ sarvānsā tvāṃ yuddhe haniṣyati || 35 || etaccikīrṣitaṃ teṣāṃ mayā jñātaṃ narādhipa | bhavitavyasya na jñānaṃ vartate mama sarvathā || 36 || yoddhavyaṃ na tvayādyeti nāhaṃ vaktuṃ kṣamaḥ prabho | pramāṇaṃ tvaṃ mahārāja kārye'tra devanirmite || 37 || tadarthe'smābhiraniśaṃ martavyaṃ kāryagauravāt | vihartavyaṃ tvayā sārdhameṣa dharmo'nujīvinām || 38 || vicāro'tra mahānasti yadekā kāminī nṛpa | yuddhaṃ prārthayate'smābhiḥ sasainyairbaladarpitaiḥ || 39 || durmukha uvāca rājan yuddhe jayo no'dya bhavitā vedmyahaṃ kila | palāyanaṃ na kartavyaṃ yaśohānikaraṃ nṛṇām || 40 || indrādīnāṃ saṃyuge'pi na kṛtaṃ yajjugupsitam | ekākinīṃ striyaṃ prāpya ko hi kuryātpalāyanam || 41 || tasmādyuddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā raṇe jayaḥ | yadbhāvi tadbhavatyeva kātra cintā vipaśyataḥ || 42 || maraṇe'tra yaśaḥprāptirjīvane ca tathā sukham | ubhayaṃ manasā kṛtvā kartavyaṃ yuddhamadya vai || 43 || palāyane yaśohānirmaraṇaṃ cāyuṣaḥ kṣaye | tasmācchoko na kartavyo jīvite maraṇe vṛthā || 44 || vyāsa uvāca durmukhasya vacaḥ śrutvā bāṣkalo vākyamabravīt | praṇataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā rājānaṃ vākyakovidaḥ || 45 || bāṣkala uvāca rājaṃścintā na kartavyā kārye'sminkātarapriye | ahameko haniṣyāmi caṇḍīṃ cañcalalocanām || 46 || utsāhastu prakartavyaḥ sthāyībhāvo rasasya ca | bhayānako bhavedvairī vīrasya nṛpasattama || 47 || tasmāttyaktvā bhayaṃ bhūpa kariṣye yuddhamadbhutam | nayiṣyāmi narendrāhaṃ caṇḍikāṃ yamasādanam || 48 || na bibhemi yamādindrātkuberādvaruṇādapi | vāyorvahnestathā viṣṇoḥ śaṅkarācchaśino raveḥ || 49 || ekākinī tathā nārī kiṃ punarmadagarvitā | ahaṃ tāṃ nihaniṣyāmi viśikhaiśca śilāśitaiḥ || 50 || paśya bāhubalaṃ me'dya viharasva yathāsukham | bhavatātra na gantavyaṃ saṃgrāme'pyanayā samam || 51 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ bruvati rājendraṃ bāṣkale madagarvite | praṇamya nṛpatiṃ tatra durdharo vākyamabravīt || 52 || durdhara uvāca mahiṣāhaṃ vijeṣyāmi devīṃ devavinirmitām | aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ ramyāṃ kāraṇācca samāgatām || 53 || rājan bhīṣayituṃ tvāṃ vai māyaiṣā nirmitā suraiḥ | vibhīṣikeyaṃ vijñāya tyaja mohaṃ manogatam || 54 || rājanītiriyaṃ rājan mantrikṛtyaṃ tathā śṛṇu | sāttvikā rājasāḥ kecittāmasāśca tathāpare || 55 || mantriṇastrividhā loke bhavanti dānavādhipa | sāttvikāḥ prabhukāryāṇi sādhayanti svaśaktibhiḥ || 56 || ātmakṛtyaṃ prakurvanti svāmikāryāvirodhataḥ | ekacittā dharmaparā mantraśāstraviśāradāḥ || 57 || rājasā bhinnacittāśca svakāryaniratāḥ sadā | kadācitsvāmikāryaṃ te prakurvanti yadṛcchayā || 58 || tāmasā lobhaniratāḥ svakāryaniratāḥ sadā | prabhukāryaṃ vināśyaiva svakāryaṃ sādhayanti te || 59 || samaye te vibhidyante paraistu parivañcitāḥ | svacchidraṃ śatrupakṣīyānnirdiśanti gṛhasthitāḥ || 60 || kāryabhedakarā nityaṃ kośaguptāsivatsadā | saṃgrāme'tha samutpanne bhīṣayanti prabhuṃ sadā || 61 || viśvāsastu na kartavyasteṣāṃ rājan kadācana | viśvāse kāryahāniḥ syānmantrahāniḥ sadaiva hi || 62 || khalāḥ kiṃ kiṃ na kurvanti viśvastā lobhatatparāḥ | tāmasāḥ pāpaniratā buddhihīnāḥ śaṭhāstathā || 63 || tasmātkāryaṃ kariṣyāmi gatvāhaṃ raṇamastake | cintā tvayā na kartavyā sarvathā nṛpasattama || 64 || gṛhītvā tāṃ durācārāmāgamiṣyāmi satvaraḥ | paśya me'dya balaṃ dhairyaṃ prabhukāryaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 65 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāyurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhsryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe devīparājayakaraṇāya durdharaprabodhavacanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <5.13> mahiṣasenādhipabāṣkaladurmukhanipātanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā tau mahābāhū daityau bāṣkaladurmukhau | jagmaturmadadigdhāṅgau sarvaśastrāstrakovidau || 1 || tau gatvā samare devīmūcaturvacanaṃ tadā | dānavau ca madonmattau meghagambhīrayā girā || 2 || devi devā jitā yena mahiṣeṇa mahātmanā | varaya tvaṃ varārohe sarvadaityādhipaṃ nṛpam || 3 || sa kṛtvā mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam | bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇairdivyaistvāmeṣyati rahaḥ kila || 4 || trailokyavibhavaṃ kāmaṃ tvameṣyasi śucismite | mahiṣe paramaṃ bhāvaṃ kuru kānte manogatam || 5 || kṛtvā patiṃ mahāvīraṃ saṃsārasukhamadbhutam | tvaṃ prāpsyasi pikālāpe yoṣitāṃ khalu vāñchitam || 6 || devyuvāca jālma tvaṃ kiṃ vijānāsi nārīyaṃ kāmamohitā | mandabuddhibalātyarthaṃ bhajeyaṃ mahiṣaṃ śaṭham || 7 || kulaśīlaguṇaistulyaṃ taṃ bhajanti kulastriyaḥ | adhikaṃ rūpacāturyabuddhiśīlakṣamādibhiḥ || 8 || kā nu kāmāturā nārī bhajecca paśurūpiṇam | paśūnāmadhamaṃ nūnaṃ mahiṣaṃ devarūpiṇī || 9 || gacchataṃ mahiṣaṃ tūrṇaṃ bhūpaṃ bāṣkaladurmukhau | vadataṃ madvaco daityaṃ gajatulyaṃ viṣāṇinam || 10 || pātālaṃ gaccha vābhyetya saṃgrāmaṃ kuru vā mayā | raṇe jāte sahasrākṣo nirbhayaḥ syāditi dhuvam || 11 || hatvāhaṃ tvāṃ gamiṣyāmi nānyathā gamanaṃ mama | itthaṃ jñātvā sudurbuddhe yathecchasi tathā kuru || 12 || māmanirjitya bhūbhāge na sthānaṃ te kadācana | bhaviṣyati catuṣpāda divi vā girikandare || 13 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktau tau tayā daityau kopākulitalocanau | dhanurbāṇadharau vīrau yuddhakāmau babhūvatuḥ || 14 || kṛtvā suvipulaṃ nādaṃ devī sā nirbhayā sthitā | ubhau ca cakratustīvrā bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ kurūdvaha || 15 || bhagavatyapi bāṇaughānmumoca dānavau prati | kṛtvātimadhuraṃ nādaṃ devakāryārthasiddhaye || 16 || tayostu bāṣkalastūrṇaṃ sammukho'bhūd raṇāṅgaṇe | durmukhaḥ prekṣakastatra devīmabhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 17 || tayoryuddhamabhūd ghoraṃ devībāṣkalayostadā | bāṇāsiparighāghātairbhayadaṃ mandacetasām || 18 || tataḥ kruddhā jaganmātā dṛṣṭvā taṃ yuddhadurmadam | jaghāna pañcabhirbāṇaiḥ karṇākṛṣṭaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ || 19 || dānavo'pi śarāndevyāściccheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | saptabhistāḍayāmāsa devīṃ siṃhoparisthitām || 20 || sāpi taṃ daśabhistīkṣṇaiḥ supītaiḥ sāyakaiḥ khalam | jaghāna taccharāṃśchittvā jahāsa ca muhurmuhuḥ || 21 || ardhacandreṇa bāṇena ciccheda ca śarāsanam | bāṣkalo'pi gadāṃ gṛhya devīṃ hantumupāyayau || 22 || āgacchantaṃ gadāpāṇiṃ dānavaṃ madagarvitam | caṇḍikā svagadāpātaiḥ pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 23 || bāṣkalaḥ patito bhūmau muhūrtādutthitaḥ punaḥ | cikṣepa ca gadāṃ so'pi caṇḍikāṃ caṇḍavikramaḥ || 24 || tamāgacchantamālokya devī śūlena vakṣasi | jaghāna bāṣkalaṃ kruddhā papāta ca mamāra saḥ || 25 || patite bāṣkale sainyaṃ bhagnaṃ tasya durātmanaḥ | jayeti ca mudā devāścukruśurgagane sthitāḥ || 26 || tasmiṃśca nihate daitye durmukho'tibalānvitaḥ | ājagāma raṇe devīṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 27 || tiṣṭha tiṣṭhābale so'pi bhāṣamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | dhanurbāṇadharaḥ śrīmānrathasthaḥ kavacāvṛtaḥ || 28 || tamāgacchantamālokya devī śaṅkhamavādayat | kopayantī dānavaṃ taṃ jyāghoṣañca cakāra ha || 29 || so'pi bāṇānmumocāśu tīkṣṇānāśīviṣopamān | svabāṇaistānmahāmāyā ciccheda ca nanāda ca || 30 || tayoḥ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva tumulaṃ nṛpa | bāṇaśaktigadāghātairmusalaistomaraistathā || 31 || raṇabhūmau tadā jātā rudhiraughavahā nadī | patitāni tadā tīre śirāṃsi prababhustadā || 32 || yathā santaraṇārthāya yamakiṅkaranāyakaiḥ | tumbīphalāni nītāni navaśikṣāparairmudā || 33 || raṇabhūmistadā ghorā babhūvātīva durgamā | śarīraiḥ patitairbhūmau khādyamānairvṛkādibhiḥ || 34 || gomāyusārameyāśca kākāḥ kaṅkā ayomukhāḥ | gṛdhrā śyenāśca khādanti śarīrāṇi durātmanām || 35 || vavau vāyuśca durgandho mṛtānāṃ dehasaṅgataḥ | abhūtkilakilāśabdaḥ khagānāṃ palabhakṣiṇām || 36 || tadā cukopa duṣṭātmā durmukhaḥ kālamohitaḥ | devīmuvāca garveṇa kṛtvā cordhvakaraṃ śubham || 37 || gaccha caṇḍi haniṣyāmi tvāmadyaiva subāliśe | daityaṃ vā bhaja vāmoru mahiṣaṃ madagarvitam || 38 || devyuvāca āsannamaraṇaḥ kāmaṃ pralapasyadya mohitaḥ | adyaiva tvāṃ haniṣyāmi yathāyaṃ bāṣkalo hataḥ || 39 || gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā manda maraṇaṃ yadi rocate | hatvā tvāṃ vai vadhiṣyāmi bāliśaṃ mahiṣīsutam || 40 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā durmukho martumudyataḥ | mumoca bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ tu caṇḍikāṃ prati dāruṇām || 41 || sāpi tāṃ tarasā chittvā bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ | jaghāna dānavaṃ kṛddhā vṛtraṃ vajradharo yathā || 42 || tayoḥ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ sañjātaṃ cātikarkaśam | bhayadaṃ kātarāṇāñca śūrāṇāṃ balavardhanam || 43 || devī ciccheda tarasā dhanustasya kare sthitam | tathaiva pañcabhirbāṇairbabhañja rathamuttamam || 44 || rathe bhagne mahābāhuḥ padātirdurmukhastadā | gadāṃ gahītvā durdharṣāṃ jagāma caṇḍikāṃ prati || 45 || cakāra sa gadāghātaṃ siṃhamaulau mahābalaḥ | na cacāla hariḥ sthānāttāḍito'pi mahābalaḥ || 46 || ambikā taṃ samālokya gadāpāṇiṃ puraḥsthitam | khaḍgena śitadhāreṇa śiraściccheda maulimat || 47 || chinne ca mastake bhūmau papāta durmukho mṛtaḥ | jayaśabdaṃ tadā cakrurmuditā nirjarā bhṛśam || 48 || tuṣṭuvustāṃ tadā devīṃ durmukhe nihate'marāḥ | puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tathā cakrurjayaśabdaṃ nabhaḥsthitāḥ || 49 || ṛṣayaḥ siddhagandharvāḥ savidyādharakinnarāḥ | jahṛṣustaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavaṃ raṇamastake || 50 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe mahiṣasenādhipabāṣkaladurmukhanipātanavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <5.14> tāmracikṣurākhyavadhavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca durmukhaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā mahiṣaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ | uvāca dānavānsarvānkiṃ jātamiti cāsakṛt || 1 || nihatau dānavau śūrau raṇe durmukhabāṣkalau | tanvyā tatparamāścaryaṃ paśyantu daivaceṣṭitam || 2 || kālo hi balavānkartā satataṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | narāṇāṃ paratantrāṇāṃ puṇyapāpānuyogataḥ || 3 || nihatau dānavaśreṣṭhau kiṃ kartavyamataḥ param | bruvantu militāḥ sarve yadyuktaṃ kāryasaṅkaṭe || 4 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ bruvati rājendra mahiṣe'tibalānvite | cikṣurākhyastu senānīstamuvāca mahārathaḥ || 5 || rājannahaṃ haniṣyāmi kā cintā strīvihiṃsane | ityuktvā svabalairyuktaḥ prayayau rathasaṃyutaḥ || 6 || dvitīyaṃ pārṣṇirakṣaṃ tu kṛtvā tāmraṃ mahābalam | mahatā sainyaghoṣeṇa pūrayangaganaṃ diśaḥ || 7 || tamāgacchantamālokya devī bhagavatī śivā | cakāra śaṅkhajyāghoṣaṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ mahādbhutam || 8 || tatrasustena śabdena te ca sarve surārayaḥ | kimetaditi bhāṣanto dudruvurbhayakampitāḥ || 9 || cikṣurākhyastu tāndṛṣṭvā palāyanaparāyaṇān | uvācātīva saṃkuddhaḥ kiṃ bhayaṃ vaḥ samāgatam || 10 || adyaivāhaṃ haniṣyāmi bāṇairbālāṃ madonnatām | tiṣṭhantvatra bhayaṃ tyaktvā daityāḥ samaramūrdhani || 11 || ityuktvā dānavaśreṣṭhaścāpapāṇirbalānvitaḥ | āgatya saṅgare devīmityuvāca gatavyathaḥ || 12 || kiṃ garjasi viśālākṣi bhīṣayantītarānnarān | nāhaṃ bibhemi tanvaṅgi śrutvā te'dya viceṣṭitam || 13 || strīvadhe dūṣaṇaṃ jñātvā tathaivākīrtisambhavam | upekṣāṃ kurute cittaṃ madīyaṃ vāmalocane || 14 || strīṇāṃ yuddhaṃ kaṭākṣaiśca tathā hāvaiśca sundari | na śastrairvihitaṃ kvāpi tvādṛśīnāṃ kadācana || 15 || puṣpairapi na yoddhavyaṃ kiṃ punarniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | bhavādṛśīnāṃ deheṣu dunoti mālatīdalam || 16 || dhigjanma mānuṣe loke kṣātradharmānujīvinām | lālito'yaṃ priyo dehaḥ kṛntanīyaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 17 || tailābhyaṅgaiḥ puṣpavātaistathā miṣṭānnabhojanaiḥ | poṣito'yaṃ priyo deho ghātanīyaḥ pareṣubhiḥ || 18 || dehaṃ chittvāsidhārābhirdhanabhṛjjāyate naraḥ | dhigdhanaṃ duḥkhadaṃ pūrvaṃ paścātkiṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet || 19 || tvamapyajñaiva vāmoru yuddhamākāṅkṣase yataḥ | sukhaṃ sambhogajaṃ tyaktvā kaṃ guṇaṃ vetsi saṅgare || 20 || khaḍgapātaṃ gadāghātaṃ bhedanañja śilīmukhaiḥ | maraṇānte tu saṃskāro gomāyumukhakarṣaṇam || 21 || tasyaiva kavibhirdhūrtaiḥ kṛtaṃ cātīva śaṃsanam | raṇe mṛtānāṃ svaḥprāptirarthavādo'sti kevalaḥ || 22 || tasmād gaccha varārohe yatra te ramate manaḥ | bhaja vā bhūpatiṃ nāthaṃ hayāriṃ suramardanam || 23 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ taṃ daityaṃ provāca jagadambikā | kiṃ mṛṣā bhāṣase mūḍha buddhimāniva paṇḍitaḥ || 24 || nītiśāstraṃ na jānāsi vidyāṃ cānvīkṣikīṃ tathā | na sevitāstvayā vṛddhā na dharme matirasti te || 25 || mūrkhasevāparo yasmāttasmāttvaṃ mūrkha eva hi | rājadharmaṃ na jānāsi kiṃ bravīṣi mamāgrataḥ || 26 || saṃgrāme mahiṣaṃ hatvā kṛtvā rudhirakardamam | yaśaḥstambhaṃ sthiraṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi yathāsukham || 27 || devānāṃ duḥkhadātāraṃ dānavaṃ madagarvitam | haniṣye'haṃ durācāraṃ yuddhaṃ kuru sthiro bhava || 28 || jīvitecchāsti cenmūḍha mahiṣasya tathā tava | tadā gacchantu pātālaṃ dānavāḥ sarva eva te || 29 || mumūrṣā yadi vaścitte yuddhaṃ kurvantu satvarāḥ | sarvāneva vadhiṣyāmi niścayo'yaṃ mamādhunā || 30 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā dānavo baladarpitaḥ | mumoca bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ tāṃ ghanavṛṣṭimivāparām || 31 || ciccheda tasya sā bāṇānsvabāṇairniśitaistadā | jaghāna taṃ tathā ghorairāśīviṣasamaiḥ śaraiḥ || 32 || yuddhaṃ parasparaṃ tatra babhūva vismayapradam | gadayā ghātayāmāsa taṃ rathājjagadambikā || 33 || mūrcchāṃ prāpa sa duṣṭātmā gadayābhihato bhṛśam | muhūrtadvayamātraṃ tu rathopastha ivācalaḥ || 34 || taṃ tathā mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāmraḥ parabalārdanaḥ | ājagāma raṇe yoddhuṃ caṇḍikāṃ prati cāpalāt || 35 || āgacchantaṃ tu taṃ vīkṣya hasantī prāha caṇḍikā | ehyehi dānavaśreṣṭha yamalokaṃ nayāmyaham || 36 || kiṃ bhavadbhiḥ samāyātairabalaiśca gatāyuṣaiḥ | mahiṣaḥ kiṃ gṛhe mūḍhaḥ karoti jīvanodyamam || 37 || kiṃ bhavadbhirhatairmandairmamāpi viphalaḥ śramaḥ | ahate mahiṣe pāpe suraśatrau durātmani || 38 || tasmādyūyaṃ gṛhaṃ gatvā mahiṣaṃ preṣayantviha | paśyenmāṃ so'pi mandātmā yādṛśīṃ tādṛśīṃ sthitām || 39 || tāmrastadvacanaṃ śrutvā bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ cakāra ha | caṇḍikāṃ prati kopena karṇākṛṣṭaśarāsanaḥ || 40 || bhagavatyapi tāmrākṣī samākṛṣya śarāsanam | bāṇānmumoca tarasā hantukāmā surāhitam || 41 || cikṣurākhyo'pibalavānmūrcchāṃ tyaktvotthitaḥ punaḥ | gṛhītvā saśaraṃ cāpaṃ tasthau tatsammukhaḥ kṣaṇāt || 42 || cikṣurākhyaśca tāmraśca dvāvapyatibalotkaṭau | yuyudhāte mahāvīrau saha devyā raṇāṅgaṇe || 43 || kupitā ca mahāmāyā vavarṣa śarasantatim | cakāra dānavān sarvān bāṇakṣatatanucchadān || 44 || asurāḥ krodhasammūḍhā babhūvuḥ śaratāḍitāḥ | cikṣipuḥ śarajālāni devīṃ prati ruṣānvitāḥ || 45 || babhuste rākṣasāstatra kiṃśukā iva puṣpiṇaḥ | śilīmukhakṣatāḥ sarve vasante ca vane raṇe || 46 || babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ tāmreṇa saha saṃyuge | vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmurdevā ye prekṣakāḥ sthitāḥ || 47 || tāmro musalamādāya lohajaṃ dāruṇaṃ dṛḍham | jaghāna mastake siṃhaṃ jahāsa ca nanarda ca || 48 || nardamānaṃ tadā taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā devī ruṣānvitā | khaḍgena śitadhāreṇa śiraściccheda satvarā || 49 || chinne śirasi tāmrastu viśīrṣo musalī balī | babhrāma kṣaṇamātraṃ tu papāta raṇamastake || 50 || patitaṃ tāmramālokya cikṣurākhyo mahābalaḥ | khaḍgamādāya tarasā dudrāva caṇḍikāṃ prati || 51 || bhagavatyapi taṃ dṛṣṭvā khaḍgapāṇimupāgatam | dānavaṃ pañcabhirbāṇairjaghāna tarasā raṇe || 52 || ekena pātitaṃ khaḍgaṃ dvitīyena tu tatkaraḥ | kaṇṭhācca mastakaṃ tasya kṛntitaṃ cāparaiḥ śaraiḥ || 53 || evaṃ tau nihatau kūrau rākṣasau raṇadurmadau | bhagnaṃ sainyaṃ tayostūrṇaṃ dikṣu santrastamānasam || 54 || devāśca muditāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tau nihatau raṇe | puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ mudā cakrurjayaśabdaṃ nabhaḥsthitāḥ || 55 || ṛṣayo devagandharvā vetālāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ | ūcuste jaya devīti cāmbiketi punaḥ punaḥ || 56 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe tāmracikṣurākhyavadhavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <5.15> asilomabiḍālākhyavadhavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tau tayā nihatau śrutvā mahiṣo vismayānvitaḥ | preṣayāmāsa daiteyāṃstadvadhārthaṃ mahābalān || 1 || asilomabiḍālākhyapramukhān yuddhadurmadān | sainyena mahatā yuktānsāyudhānsaparicchadān || 2 || te tatra dadṛśurdevīṃ siṃhasyopari saṃsthitām | aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ divyāṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīm || 3 || asilomāgrato gatvā tāmuvāca hasanniva | vinayāvanataḥ śānto devīṃ daityavadhodyatām || 4 || asilomovāca devi brūhi vacaḥ satyaṃ kimarthamiha sundari | āgatāsi kimarthaṃ vā haṃsi daityānnirāgasaḥ || 5 || kāraṇaṃ kathayādya tvaṃ tvayā sandhiṃ karomyaham | kāñcanaṃ maṇiratnāni bhājanāni varāṇi ca || 6 || yānīcchasi varārohe gahītvā gaccha mā ciram | kimarthaṃ yuddhakāmāsi duḥkhasantāpavardhanam || 7 || kathayanti mahātmāno yuddhaṃ sarvasukhāpaham | komale'tīva te dehe puṣpaghātāsahe bhṛśam || 8 || kimarthaṃ śastrasampātānsahasīti visismiye | cāturyasya phalaṃ śāntiḥ satataṃ sukhasevanam || 9 || tatkimarthaṃ duḥkhahetuṃ saṃgrāmaṃ kartumicchasi | saṃsāre'tra sukhaṃ grāhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ heyamiti sthitiḥ || 10 || tatsukhaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ nityānityaprabhedataḥ | ātmajñānaṃ sukhaṃ nityamanityaṃ bhogajaṃ smṛtam || 11 || nāśātmakaṃ tu tattyājyaṃ vedaśāstrārthacintakaiḥ | saugatānāṃ mataṃ cettvaṃ svīkaroṣi varānane || 12 || tathāpi yauvanaṃ prāpya bhuṃkṣva bhogānanuttamān | paralokasya sandeho yadi te'sti kṛśodari || 13 || svargabhogaparā nityaṃ bhava bhāmini bhūtale | anityaṃ yauvanaṃ dehe jñātveti sukṛtaṃ caret || 14 || paropatāpanaṃ kāryaṃ varjanīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ | avirodhena kartavyaṃ dharmārthakāmasevanam || 15 || tasmāttvamapi kalyāṇi matiṃ dharme sadā kuru | aparādhaṃ vinā daityānkasmānmārayase'mbike || 16 || dayādharmo'sya deho'sti satye prāṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | tasmāddayā tathā satyaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ || 17 || kāraṇaṃ vada suśroṇi dānavānāṃ vadhe tava | devyuvāca tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ mahābāho kimarthamiha cāgatā || 18 || tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi hanane ca prayojanam | vicarāmi sadā daitya sarvalokeṣu sarvadā || 19 || nyāyānyāyau ca bhūtānāṃ paśyantī sākṣirūpiṇī | na me kadāpi bhogecchā na lobho na ca vairitā || 20 || dharmārthaṃ vicarāmyatra saṃsāre sādhurakṣaṇam | vratametattu niyataṃ pālayāmi nijaṃ sadā || 21 || sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ hantavyā ye'pyasādhavaḥ | vedasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ kāryamavatārairanekaśaḥ || 22 || yuge yuge tānevāhamavatārānbibharmi ca | mahiṣastu durācāro devānvai hantumudyataḥ || 23 || jñātvāhaṃ tadvadhārthaṃ bhoḥ prāptāsmi rākṣasādhunā | taṃ haniṣye durācāraṃ suraśatruṃ mahābalam || 24 || gaccha vā tiṣṭha kāmaṃ tvaṃ satyametadudāhṛtam | brūhi vā taṃ durātmānaṃ rājānaṃ mahiṣīsutam || 25 || kimanyān preṣayasyatra svayaṃ yuddhaṃ kuruṣva ha | sandhiñcetkartumicchāsti rājñastava mayā saha || 26 || sarve gacchantu pātālaṃ vairaṃ tyaktvā yathāsukham | devadravyaṃ tu yatkiñciddhṛtaṃ jitvā raṇe surān | taddattvā yāntu pātālaṃ prahlādo yatra tiṣṭhati || 27 || vyāsa uvāca tacchutvā vacanaṃ devyā asilomā puraḥsthitaḥ | biḍālākhyaṃ mahāvīraṃ papraccha prītipūrvakam || 28 || asilomovāca śrutaṃ te'dya biḍālākhya bhavānyā kathitaṃ ca yat | evaṃ gate kiṃ kartavyo vigrahaḥ sandhireva vā || 29 || biḍālākhya uvāca na sandhikāmo'sti nṛpo'bhimānī yuddhe ca mṛtyuṃ niyataṃ hi jānan | dṛṣṭvā hatān prerayate tathāsmāndaiva hi ko'tikramituṃ samarthaḥ || 30 || (duḥsādhya evāstviha sevakānāṃ dharmaḥ sadā mānavivarjitānām | ājñāparāṇāṃ vaśavartikānāṃ pāñcālikānāmiva sūtrabhedāt ||) gatvā kathaṃ tasya purastvayā ca mayāpi vaktavyamidaṃ kaṭhoram | gacchantu pātālamitaśca sarve dattvātha ratnāni dhanaṃ surāṇām || 31 || (priyaṃ hi vaktavyamasatyameva na ca priyaṃ syāddhitakṛttu bhāṣitam | satyaṃ priyaṃ no bhavatīha kāmaṃ maunaṃ tato buddhimatāṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||) na phalguvākyaiḥ pratibodhanīyo rājā tu vīrairiti nītiśāstram || 32 || na nūnaṃ tatra gantavyaṃ hitaṃ vā vaktumādarāt | praṣṭuṃ vāpi gate rājā kopayukto bhaviṣyati || 33 || iti sañcintya kartavyaṃ yuddhaṃ prāṇasya saṃśaye | svāmikāryaṃ paraṃ matvā maraṇaṃ tṛṇavattathā || 34 || vyāsa uvāca iti sañcintya tau vīrau saṃsthitau yuddhatatparau | dhanurbāṇadharau tatra sannaddhau rathasaṅgatau || 35 || prathamaṃ tu biḍālākhyaḥ saptabāṇānmumoca ha | asilomā sthito dūre prekṣakaḥ paramāstravit || 36 || ciccheda tāṃstathāprāptānambikā svaśaraiḥ śarān | biḍālākhyaṃ tribhirbāṇairjaghāna ca śilāśitaiḥ || 37 || prāpya bāṇavyathāṃ daityaḥ papāta samarāṅgaṇe | mūrcchito'tha mamārāśu dānavo daivayogataḥ || 38 || biḍālākhyaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā raṇe śaktiśarotkaraiḥ | asilomā dhanuṣpāṇiḥ saṃsthito yuddhatatparaḥ || 39 || ūrdhvaṃ savyaṃ karaṃ kṛtvā tāmuvāca mitaṃ vacaḥ | devi jānāmi maraṇaṃ dānavānāṃ durātmanām || 40 || tathāpi yuddhaṃ kartavyaṃ parādhīnena vai mayā | mahiṣo mandabuddhiśca na jānāti priyāpriye || 41 || tadagre naiva vaktavyaṃ hitaṃ caivāpriyaṃ mayā | martavyaṃ vīradharmeṇa śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ bhavet || 42 || daivameva paraṃ manye dhipauruṣamanarthakam | patanti dānavāstūrṇaṃ tava bāṇahatā bhuvi || 43 || ityuktvā śaravṛṣṭiṃ sa cakāra dānavottamaḥ | devī ciccheda tānbāṇairaprāptāṃstu nijāntike || 44 || anyairvivyādha taṃ tūrṇamasilomānamāśugaiḥ | vīkṣitāmarasaṅghaiśca kopapūrṇānanā tadā || 45 || śuśubhe dānavaḥ kāmaṃ bāṇairviddhatanuḥ kila | sravadrudhiradhāraḥ sa praphullaḥ kiṃśuko yathā || 46 || asilomā gadāṃ gurvīṃ lauhīmudyamya vegataḥ | dudrāva caṇḍikāṃ kopātsiṃhaṃ mūrdhni jaghāna ha || 47 || siṃho'pi nakharāghātaistaṃ dadāra bhujāntare | agaṇayya gadāghātaṃ kṛtaṃ tena balīyasā || 48 || utpatya tarasā daityo gadāpāṇiḥ sudāruṇaḥ | siṃhamūrdhni samāruhya jaghāna gadayāmbikām || 49 || kṛtaṃ tena prahāraṃ tu vañcayitvā viśāṃpate | khaḍgena śitadhāreṇa śiraściccheda kaṇṭhataḥ || 50 || chinne śirasi daityendraḥ papāta tarasā kṣitau | hāhākāro mahānāsītsainye tasya durātmanaḥ || 51 || jaya devīti devāstā tuṣṭuvurjagadambikām | devadundubhayo nedurjaguśca nṛpa kinnarāḥ || 52 || nihatau dānavau vīkṣya patitau ca raṇāṅgaṇe | nihatāḥ sainikāḥ sarve tatra kesariṇā balāt || 53 || bhakṣitāśca tathā kecinniḥśeṣaṃ tadraṇaṃ kṛtam | bhagnāḥ kecid gatā mandā mahiṣaṃ prati duḥkhitāḥ || 54 || cukruśū ruruduścaiva trāhi trāhīti bhāṣaṇaiḥ | asilomabiḍālākhyau nihatau nṛpasattama || 55 || anye ye sainikā rājan siṃhena bhakṣitāśca te | evaṃ bruvanto rājānaṃ tadā cakruśca vaiśasam || 56 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ mahiṣo durmanāstadā | babhūva cintākulito vimanā duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ || 57 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāyurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe asilomabiḍālākhyavadhavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <5.16> mahiṣadvārā devīprabodhanam vyāsa uvāca teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā krodhayukto narādhipaḥ | dārukaṃ prāha tarasā rathamānaya me'dbhutam || 1 || sahasrakharasaṃyuktaṃ patākādhvajabhūṣitam | āyudhaiḥ saṃyutaṃ śubhraṃ sucakraṃ cārukūbaram || 2 || sūto'pi rathamānīya tamuvāca tvarānvitaḥ | rājan ratho'yamānīto dvāri tiṣṭhati bhūṣitaḥ || 3 || sarvāyudhasamāyukto varāstaraṇasaṃyutaḥ | ānītaṃ taṃ rathaṃ jñātvā dānavendro mahābalaḥ || 4 || mānuṣaṃ dehamāsthāya saṃgrāme gantumudyataḥ | vicārya manasā ceti devī māṃ prekṣya durmukham || 5 || śṛṅgiṇaṃ mahiṣaṃ nūnaṃ vimanā sā bhaviṣyati | nārīṇāṃ ca priyaṃ rūpaṃ tathā cāturyamityapi || 6 || tasmādrūpaṃ ca cāturyaṃ kṛtvā yāsyāmi tāṃ prati | yathā māṃ vīkṣya sā bālā premayuktā bhaviṣyati || 7 || mamāpi ca tadaiva syātsukhaṃ nānyasvarūpataḥ | iti sañcintya manasā dānavendro mahābalaḥ || 8 || tyaktvā tanmāhiṣaṃ rūpaṃ babhūva puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ | sarvāyudhadharaḥ śrīmāṃścārubhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 9 || divyāmbaradharaḥ kāntaḥ puṣpabāṇa ivāparaḥ | rathopaviṣṭaḥ keyūrasragvī bāṇadhanurdharaḥ || 10 || senāparivṛto devīṃ jagāma madagarvitaḥ | manojñaṃ rūpamāsthāya māninīnāṃ manoharam || 11 || tamāgataṃ samālokya daityānāmadhipaṃ tadā | bahubhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ vīrairdevī śaṅkhamavādayat || 12 || sa śaṅkhaninadaṃ śrutvā janavismayakārakam | samīpametya devyāstu tāmuvāca hasanniva || 13 || devi saṃsāracakre'sminvartamāno janaḥ kila | naro vātha tathā nārī sukhaṃ vāñchati sarvathā || 14 || sukhaṃ saṃyogajaṃ nṝṇāṃ nāsaṃyoge bhavediha | saṃyogo bahudhā bhinnastānbravīmi śṛṇuṣva ha || 15 || bhedānsuprītihetūtthānsvabhāvotthānanekaśaḥ | tatra prītibhavānādau kathayāmi yathāmati || 16 || mātāpitrostu putreṇa saṃyogastūttamaḥ smṛtaḥ | bhrāturbhrātrā tathā yogaḥ kāraṇānmadhyamo mataḥ || 17 || uttamasya sukhasyaiva dātṛtvāduttamaḥ smṛtaḥ | tasmādalpasukhasyaiva pradātṛtvācca madhyamaḥ || 18 || nāvikānāṃ tu saṃyogaḥ smṛtaḥ svābhāviko budhaiḥ | vividhāvṛtacittānāṃ prasaṅgaparivartinām || 19 || atyalpasukhadātṛtvātkaniṣṭho'yaṃ smṛto budhaiḥ | atyuttamastu saṃyogaḥ saṃsāre sukhadaḥ sadā || 20 || nārīpuruṣayoḥ kānte samānavayaso sadā | saṃyogo yaḥ samākhyātaḥ sa evātyuttamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 21 || atyuttamasukhasyaiva dātṛtvātsa tathāvidhaḥ | cāturyarūpaveṣādyaiḥ kulaśīlaguṇaistathā || 22 || parasparasamutkarṣaḥ kathyate hi parasparam | taṃ cetkaroṣi saṃyogaṃ vīreṇa ca mayā saha || 23 || atyuttamasukhasyaiva prāptiḥ syātte na saṃśayaḥ | nānāvidhāni rūpāṇi karomi svecchayā priye || 24 || indrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve saṃgrāme vijitā mayā | ratnāni yāni divyāni bhavane'sminmamādhunā || 25 || bhuṃkṣva tvaṃ tāni sarvāṇi yatheṣṭaṃ dehi vā yathā | paṭṭarājñī bhavādya tvaṃ dāso'smi tava sundari || 26 || vairaṃ tyaje'haṃ devaistu tava vākyānna saṃśayaḥ | yathā tvaṃ sukhamāpnoṣi tathāhaṃ karavāṇi vai || 27 || ājñāpaya viśālākṣi tathāhaṃ prakaromyatha | cittaṃ me tava rūpeṇa mohitaṃ cārubhāṣiṇi || 28 || āturo'smi varārohe prāptaste śaraṇaṃ kila | prapannaṃ pāhi rambhoru kāmabāṇaiḥ prapīḍitam || 29 || dharmāṇāmuttamo dharmaḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam | tvadīyo'smyasitāpāṅgi sevako'haṃ kṛśodari || 30 || maraṇāntaṃ vacaḥ satyaṃ nānyathā prakaromyaham | pādau nato'smi tanvaṅgi tyaktvā nānāyudhāni te || 31 || dayāṃ kuru viśālākṣi tapto'smi kāmamārgaṇaiḥ | janmaprabhṛti cārvaṅgi dainyaṃ nācaritaṃ mayā || 32 || brahmādīnīśvarānprāpya tvayi tadvidadhāmyaham | caritaṃ mama jānanti raṇe brahmādayaḥ surāḥ || 33 || so'pyahaṃ tava dāso'smi manmukhaṃ paśya bhāmini | vyāsa uvāca iti bruvāṇaṃ taṃ daityaṃ devī bhagavatī hi sā || 34 || prahasya sasmitaṃ vākyamuvāca varavarṇinī | devyuvāca nāhaṃ puruṣamicchāmi paramaṃ puruṣaṃ vinā || 35 || tasya cecchāsmyahaṃ daitya sṛjāmi sakalaṃ jagat | sa māṃ paśyati viśvātmā tasyāhaṃ prakṛtiḥ śivā || 36 || tatsānnidhyavaśādeva caitanyaṃ mayi śāśvatam | jaḍāhaṃ tasya saṃyogātprabhavāmi sacetanā || 37 || ayaskāntasya sānnidhyādayasaścetanā yathā | na grāmyasukhavāñchā me kadācidapi jāyate || 38 || mūrkhastvamasi mandātman yatstrīsaṅgaṃ cikīrṣasi | narasya bandhanārthāya śṛṅkhalā strī prakīrtitā || 39 || lohabaddho'pi mucyeta strībaddho naiva mucyate | kimicchasi ca mandātman mūtrāgārasya sevanam || 40 || śamaṃ kuru sukhāya tvaṃ śamātsukhamavāpsyasi | nārīsaṅge mahadduḥkhaṃ jānankiṃ tvaṃ vimuhyasi || 41 || tyaja vairaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vicarāvanau | pātālaṃ gaccha vā kāmaṃ jīvitecchā yadasti te || 42 || athavā kuru saṃgrāmaṃ balavatyasmi sāmpratam | preṣitāhaṃ suraiḥ sarvaistava nāśāya dānava || 43 || satyaṃ bravīmi yenādya tvayā vacanasauhṛdam | darśitaṃ tena tuṣṭāsmi jīvangaccha yathāsukham || 44 || satāṃ saptapadī maitrī tena muñcāmi jīvitam | maraṇecchāsti cedyuddhaṃ kuru vīra yathāsukham || 45 || haniṣyāmi mahābāho tvāmahaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | vyāsa uvāca iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā dānavaḥ kāmamohitaḥ || 46 || uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā madhuraṃ vacanaṃ tataḥ | bibhemyahaṃ varārohe tvāṃ prahartuṃ varānane || 47 || komalāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ nārīṃ naravimohinīm | jitvā hariharādīṃśca lokapālāṃśca sarvaśaḥ || 48 || kiṃ tvayā saha yuddhaṃ me yuktaṃ kamalalocane | rocate yadi cārvaṅgi vivāhaṃ kuru māṃ bhaja || 49 || noced gaccha yatheṣṭaṃ te deśaṃ yasmātsamāgatā | nāhaṃ tvāṃ prahariṣyāmi yato maitrī kṛtā tvayā || 50 || hitamuktaṃ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ tasmād gaccha yathāsukham | kā śobhā me bhavedante hatvā tvāṃ cārulocanām || 51 || strīhatyā bālahatyā ca brahmahatyā duratyayā | gṛhītvā tvāṃ gṛhaṃ nūnaṃ gacchāmyadya varānane || 52 || tathāpi me phalaṃ na syādbalādbhogasukhaṃ kutaḥ | prabravīmi sukeśi tvāṃ vinayāvanato yataḥ || 53 || puruṣasya sukhaṃ na syādṛte kāntāmukhāmbujāt | tattathaiva hi nārīṇāṃ na syācca puruṣaṃ vinā || 54 || saṃyoge sukhasambhūtirviyoge duḥkhasambhavaḥ | kāntāsi rūpasampannā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 55 || cāturyaṃ tvayi kiṃ nāsti yato māṃ na bhajasyaho | tavopadiṣṭaṃ kenedaṃ bhogānāṃ parivarjanam || 56 || vañcitāsi priyālāpe vairiṇā kenacittviha | muñcāgrahamimaṃ kānte kuru kāryaṃ suśobhanam || 57 || sukhaṃ tava mamāpi syādvivāhe vihite kila | viṣṇurlakṣyā sahābhāti sāvitryā ca sahātmabhūḥ || 58 || rudro bhāti ca pārvatyā śacyā śatamakhastathā | kā nārī patihīnā ca sukhaṃ prāpnoti śāśvatam || 59 || yena tvamasitāpāṅgi na karoṣi patiṃ śubham | kāmaḥ kvādya gataḥ kānte yastvāṃ bāṇaiḥ sukomalaiḥ || 60 || mādanaiḥ pañcabhiḥ kāmaṃ na tāḍayati mandadhīḥ | manye'hamiva kāmo'pi dayāvāṃstvayi sundari || 61 || abaleti ca manvāno na prerayati mārgaṇān | manobhavasya vairaṃ vā kimapyasti mayā saha || 62 || tena ca tvayyarālākṣi na muñcati śilīmukhān | athavā me'hitairdevairvārito'sau jhaṣadhvajaḥ || 63 || sukhavidhvaṃsibhistena tvayi na praharatyapi | tyaktvā māṃ mṛgaśāvākṣi paścāttāpaṃ kariṣyasi || 64 || mandodarīva tanvaṅgi parityajya śubhaṃ nṛpam | anukūlaṃ patiṃ paścātsā cakāra śaṭhaṃ patim | kāmārtā ca yadā jātā mohena vyākulāntarā || 65 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe mahiṣadvārā devīprabodhanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <5.17> rājaputrīmandodarīvṛttavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca || iti śrutvā vacastasya devī papraccha dānavam || kā sā maṃdodarī nārī ko'sau tyakto nṛpastayā || 1 || śaṭhaḥ ko vā nṛpaḥ paścāttanme brūhi kathānakam || vistareṇa yathā prāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ vanitayā punaḥ || 2 || mahiṣa uvāca || siṃhalo nāma deśo 'sti vikhyātaḥ pṛthivītale || ghanapādapasaṃyukto dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān || 3 || caṃdrasenā'bhidhastatra rājā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ || nyāyadaṃḍadharaḥ śāṃtaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ || 4 || satyavādī mṛduḥ śūrastitikṣurnītisāgaraḥ || śāstravitsarvadharmajño dhanurvede'tiniṣṭhitaḥ || 5 || tasya bhāryā varārohā sundarī subhagā śubhā || sadācārā'tisumukhīṃ patibhaktiparāyaṇā || 6 || nāmnā guṇavatī kāṃtā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || suṣuve prathame garbhe putrīṃ sā cātisundarīm || 7 || pitā cātīva saṃtuṣṭaḥ putrīṃ prāpya manoramām || mandodarīti nāmāsyāḥ pitā cakre mudānvitaḥ || 8 || iṃdoḥ kaleva cātyarthaṃ vavṛdhe sā dinedine || daśavarṣā yadā jātā kanyā cātimanoharā || 9 || varārthaṃ nṛpatiścintāmavāpa ca dinedine || madradeśādhipaḥ śūraḥ sudhanvā nāma pārthivaḥ || 5.17.10 || tasya putro'timedhāvī kaṃbugrīvo'tiviśrutaḥ || brāhmaṇaiḥ kathito rājñe sa yukto'syā varaḥ śubhaḥ || 11 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvavidyārthapāragaḥ || rājñā pṛṣṭā tadā rājñā nāmnā guṇavatī priyā || 12 || kaṃbugrīvāya kanyāṃ svāṃ dāsyāmi varavarṇinīm || sā tu patyurvacaḥ śrutvā putrīṃ papraccha sādaram || 13 || vivāhaṃ te pitā kartuṃ kaṃbugrīveṇa vāṃchati || tacchrutvā mātaraṃ prāha vākyaṃ mandodarī tadā || 14 || nāhaṃ patiṃ kariṣyāmi necchā me'sti parigrahe || kaumāraṃ vratamāsthāya kālaṃ neṣyāmi sarvathā || 15 || svātaṃtryeṇa cariṣyāmi tapastīvraṃ sadaiva hi || pārataṃtrya paraṃduḥkhaṃ mātaḥ saṃsārasāgare || 15 || svātaṃtryā nmokṣamityāhuḥ paṇḍitāḥ śāstrakovidā || tasmānmuktā bhaviṣyāmi patyā me na prayojanam || 17 || vivāhe vartamāne tu pāvakasya ca sannidhau || vaktavyaṃ vacanaṃ samyaktvadadhīnā'smi sarvadā || 18 || śvaśrūdevaravargāṇāṃ dāsītvaṃ śvaśurālaye || paticiṃttānuvartitvaṃ duḥkhāduḥ khataraṃ smṛtam || 19 || kadācitpatiranyāṃ vā kāminīṃ ca bhajedyadi || tadā mahattaraṃ duḥkhaṃ sapatnīsaṃbhavaṃ bhavet || 5.17.20 || taderṣyā jāyate patyau kleśaścāpi bhavedatha || saṃsāre kva sukhaṃ mātarnārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 21 || svabhāvātparatantrāṇāṃ saṃsāre svapnadharmiṇi || śrutaṃ mayā purā mātaruttānacaraṇātmajaḥ || 22 || uttamaḥ sarvadharmajño dhuvādavarajo nṛpaḥ || patnīṃ dharmaparāṃ sādhvīṃ patibhaktiparāyaṇām || 23 || aparādhaṃ vinā kāṃtāṃ tyaktavānvipine priyām || evaṃvidhāni duḥkhāni vidyamāne tu bhartari || 24 || kālayogānmṛte tasminnārī syād duḥkhabhājanam|| vaidhavyaṃ paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ śoka saṃtāpakārakam || 25 || paroṣi(pi?)tapatitve'pi duḥkhaṃ syādadhikaṃ gṛhe || madanāgnividagdhāyāḥ kiṃ sukha pati saṃgajam || 26 || tasmātpatirna kartavyaḥ sarvatheti matirmama || evaṃ proktā tadā mātā patiṃ prāha nṛpātmajā || 27 || na ca vāṃchati bhartāraṃ kaumāravratadhāriṇī || vratajāpyaparā nityaṃ saṃsārādvimukhī sadā || 28 || na kāṃkṣati patiṃ kartuṃ bahudoṣavicakṣaṇā || bhāryāyā bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā tathaiva saṃsthito nṛpaḥ || 29 || vivāho na kṛtaḥ putryā jñātvā bhāvavi varjitām || vartamānā gṛheṣvevaṃ pitrā mātrā ca rakṣitā || 5.17.30 || yauvanasyāṃkurā jātā nārīṇāṃ kāma dīpakāḥ || tathā'pi sā vayasyābhiḥ preritā'pi punaḥ punaḥ || 31 || cakame na patiṃ kartuṃ jñānārthapada bhāṣiṇī || ekadodyānadeśe sā vihartuṃ bahupādape || 32 || jagāma sumukhī premṇā sairaṃdhrīgaṇasevitā || reme kṛśodarī tatrāpaśyatkusumitā latāḥ || 33 || puṣpāṇi cinvatī ramyā vayasyābhiḥ samāvṛtā || kosalādhipatistatra mārge daivavaśāttadā || 34 || ājagāma mahāvīro vīraseno'tiviśrutaḥ || ekākī rathamārūḍhaḥ katicitsevakairvṛtaḥ || 35 || sainyaṃ ca pṛṣṭhatastasya samāyāti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || dṛṣṭastasyā vayasyā tu dūrataḥ pārthivastadā || 36 || maṃdodaryai tathā proktaṃ samāyāti naraḥ pathi || rathārūḍho mahābāhū rūpavānmadano'paraḥ || 37 || manye'haṃ nṛpatiḥ kaścitprāpto bhāgyavaśādiha || evaṃ bruvatyāṃ tatrāsau kośalendraḥ samāgataḥ || 38 || dṛṣṭvā tāmasitāpāṃgīṃ vismayaṃ prāpa bhūpatiḥ || uttīrya sa rathāttūrṇaṃ papraccha paricārikām || 39 || keyaṃ bālā viśālākṣī kasya putrī vadāśu me || evaṃ pṛṣṭā tu sairaṃdhrī tamuvāca śucismitā || 5.17.40 || prathamaṃ brūhi me vīra pṛcchāmi tvāṃ sulocanam || ko'si tvaṃ kimihāyātaḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ vada sāṃpratam || 41 || iti pṛṣṭastu sairaṃdhryā tāmu vāca mahīpatiḥ || kosalo nāma deśo'sti pṛthivyāṃ paramādbhutaḥ || 42 || tasya pālayitā cāhaṃ vīrasenābhidhaḥ priye || vāhinī pṛṣṭhataḥ kāmaṃ samāyāti caturvidhā || 43 || mārgabhramādiha prāptaṃ viddhi māṃ kosalādhipam || sairaṃdhryuvāca || candrasenasutā rājannāmnā mandodarī kila || 44 || udyāne raṃtukāmeyaṃ prāptā kamala locanā || śrutvā tadbhāṣitaṃ rājā pratyuvāca prasādhikām || 45 || sairaṃdhri caturā'si tvaṃ rājaputrīṃ prabodhaya || kakutsthavaṃśajaścāhaṃ rājā'smi cārulocane ||46|| gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena patiṃ māṃ kuru kāmini || na me bhāryā'sti suśroṇi vayaso'dbhutayauvanām || 47 || vāṃchāmi rūpasaṃpannāṃ sukulāṃ kāminīṃ kila || athavā te pitā mahyaṃ vidhinā dātumarhati || 48 || anukūla patiścāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || mahiṣa uvāca || ityā''karṇya vacastasya sairaṃdhrī prāha tāṃ tadā || 49 || prahasya madhuraṃ vākyaṃ kāmaśāstraviśāradā || mandodari nṛpaḥ prāptaḥ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || 5.17.50 || rūpavānbalavānkāṃto vayasā tvatsamaḥ punaḥ || prītimānnṛpatirjātastvayi sundari sarvathā || 51 || pitā'pi te viśālākṣi paritapyati sarvathā || vivāhakālaṃ te jñātvā tvāṃ ca vairāgyasaṃyutām || 52 || ityāhā'smānsa nṛpatirviniḥśvasya punaḥ punaḥ || putrīṃ prabodhayatvetāṃ sairaṃdhryaḥ sevane ratāḥ || 58 || vaktuṃ śaktā vayaṃ na tvāṃ haṭhadharmaratāṃ punaḥ || bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ paro dhamoṃ'bravīnmanuḥ || 54 || bhartāraṃ sevamānā vai nārī svargamavāpnuyāt || tasmātkuru viśālākṣi vivāhaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 55 || mandodaryuvāca || nā'haṃ patiṃ kariṣyāmi cariṣye tapamadbhutam || nivāraya nṛpaṃ bāle kiṃ māṃ paśyati nistrapaḥ || || 56 || sairaṃdhryuvāca || durjayo devi kāmo'sau kālo'sau duratikramaḥ || tasmānme vacanaṃ pathyaṃ kartumarhasi suṃdari || 57 || anyathā vyasanaṃ nūnamā patediti niścayaḥ || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā kanyo vācātha tāṃ sakhīm || 58 || yadyadbhavettadbhavatu daivayogādasaṃśayam || na vivāhaṃ kariṣye'haṃ sarvathā paricārike || 59 || mahiṣa uvāca || iti tasyāstu nirbaṃdhaṃ jñātvā prāha nṛpaṃ punaḥ || gaccha rājanyathā kāmaṃ neyamicchati satpatim || 5.17.60 || nṛpastu tadvacaḥ śrutvā nirgataḥ saha senayā || kośalānvimanā bhūtvā kāminīṃ prati niḥspṛhaḥ || 61 || iti śrīdevī bhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pacamaskaṃdhe saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <5.18> mahiṣāsuravadhaḥ mahiṣa uvāca || tasyāstu bhaginī kanyā nāmnā ceṃdumatī śubhā || vivāha yogyā saṃjātā surū pā'varajā yadā || 1 || tasyā vivāhaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ sūjātāśca svayaṃvaraḥ || rājāno bahudeśīyāḥ saṃgatāstatra maṃḍape || 2 || tayā vṛto nṛpaḥ kaścidbalavānrūpasaṃyutaḥ || kulaśīlasamāyuktaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 3 || tadā kāmāturā jātā viṭaṃ vīkṣya nṛpaṃ tu sā || cakame daivayogāttu śaṭhaṃ cāturyabhūṣitam || 4 || pitaraṃ prāha tanvaṃgī vivāhaṃ kuru me pitaḥ || icchā me'dya samudbhūtā dṛṣṭvā bhadrādhipaṃ tviha ||5|| caṃdraseno'pi tacchutvā putryā yadbhāṣitaṃ rahaḥ || prahasanneva manasā tatkārye tatparo'bhavat ||6|| tamāhūya nṛpa gehe vivāhavidhinā dadau || kanyāṃ maṃdodarīṃ tasmai pāribarhaṃ tathā bahu || 7 || cārudeṣṇo'pi tāṃ prāpya sundarīṃ mudito'bhavat || jagāma svagṛhaṃ tuṣṭo rājā'pi sahitaḥ striyā || 8 || reme nṛpatiśārdūlaḥ kāminyā bahuvāsarān || kadāciddāsapatnyā sa ramamāṇo rahaḥ kila || 9 || sairaṃdhryā kathitaṃ tasyai tayā dṛṣṭaḥ patistathā || upalaṃbhaṃ dadau tasmai smitapūrvaṃ ruṣā'nvitā || 5.18.10 || kadācidapi sāmānyāṃ raho rūpavatīṃ nṛpaḥ || krīḍayaṃllālayandṛṣṭaḥ khedaṃ prāpa tadaiva sā || 11 || na jñāto'yaṃ śaṭhaḥ pūrvaṃ yadā dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃvare || kiṃ kṛtaṃ tu mayā mohādvaṃcitā'haṃ nṛpeṇa ha || 12 || kiṃ karomyadya saṃtāpa nirlajje nirghṛṇe śaṭhe || kā prītirīdṛśe patyau dhigadya mama jīvitam || 13 || adyaprabhṛti saṃsāre sukhaṃ tyaktaṃ mayā khalu || patisaṃbhogajaṃ sarvaṃ saṃtoṣo'dya mayā kṛtaḥ || 14 || akartavyaṃ kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ tajjātaṃ duḥkhadaṃ mama || dehatyāgaḥ kriyate ceddhatyā'tīva duratyayā || 15 || pitṛgehaṃ vrajāmyāśu tatrā'pi na sukhaṃ bhavet || hāsyayogyā sakhīnāṃ tu bhaveyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 16 || tasmādatraiva saṃvāso vairāgyayutayā mayā || kartavyaḥ kālayogena tyaktvā kāmasukhaṃ punaḥ ||17|| mahiṣa uvāca || iti saṃciṃtya sā nārī duḥkhaśoka parāyaṇā || sthitā patigṛhaṃ tyaktvā sukhaṃ saṃsārajaṃ tataḥ || 18 || tasmāttvamapi kalyāṇi māmanādṛtya bhūpatim || anyaṃ kāpuruṣaṃ maṃdaṃ kāmārtā saṃśrayiṣyasi || 19 || vacanaṃ kuru me tathyaṃ nārīṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam || akṛtvā paramaṃ śokaṃ lapsyase nātra saṃśayaḥ || 5.18.20 || devyuvāca || madātmangaccha pātālaṃ yuddhaṃ vā kuru sāṃpratam || hatvā tvāmasurānsarvānyamiṣyāmi yathāsukham || 21 || yadā yadā hi sādhūnāṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavati dānava || tadā teṣāṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ dehaṃ saṃdhārayā myaham || 22 || arūpāyāśca me rūpamajanmāyāśca janma ca || surāṇāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya viddhi daitya viniścitam || 23 || satyaṃ bravīmi jānīhi prārthitāhaṃ surai kila || tvadvadhārthaṃ hayāre tvāṃ hatvā sthāsyāmi niścalā || 24 || tasmādyudhyasva vā gaccha pātālamasurālayam || savarthā tvāṃ haniṣyāmi satyametadbravīmyahama || 25 || vyāsa uvāca || ityuktaḥ sa tayā devyā dhanurādāya dānavaḥ || yuddhakāmaḥ sthitastatra saṃgrāmāṃgaṇabhūmiṣu || 26 || mumoca tarasā bāṇānkarṇā''kṛṣṭāñchilāśitān || devī ciccheda tānbāṇaiḥ krodhānmuktai rayomukhaiḥ ||27|| tayoḥ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ saṃbabhūva bhayapradam || devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca parasparajayaiṣiṇām || 28 || madhye durdhara āgatya mumoca śilīmukhān || devīṃ prati viṣāsaktānkopayannatidāruṇān || 29 || tato bhagavatī kruddhā taṃ jaghāna śitaiḥ śaraiḥ || durdharastu papātorvyāṃ gatāsugiriśṛṃgavat || 5.18.30 || taṃ tayā nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā trinetraḥ paramāstravit || āgatya saptabhirbāṇairjaghāna para meśvarim || 31 || anāgatāṃstu ciccheda devī tānviśikhaiḥ śarān || triśūlena trinetraṃ tu jaghāna jagadaṃbikā || 32 || andhakastvāja gāmāśu hataṃ dṛṣṭvā trilocanam || gadayā lohamayyā''śu siṃhaṃ vivyādha mastake || 33 || siṃhastu nakhaghātena taṃ hatvā balavattaram || cakhāda tarasā māṃsamaṃdhakasya ruṣā'nvitaḥ || 34 || tānraṇe nihatānvīkṣya dānavo vismayaṃ gataḥ || cikṣepa tarasā bāṇānatitīkṣṇāñchi lāśitān || 35 || dvidhā cakre śarāndevī tānaprāptāñchilīmukhaiḥ || gadayā tāḍayāmāsa daityaṃ vakṣasi cāṃbikā || 36 || sa gadābhihato mūrchāmavāpāmarabādhakaḥ || viṣahya pīḍāṃ pāpātmā punarāgatya satvaraḥ || 37 || jaghāna gadayā siṃhaṃ mūrdhni krodhasamanvitaḥ || siṃho'pi nakhaghātena taṃ dadāra mahāsuram || 38 || vihāya pauruṣaṃ rūpaṃ so'pi siṃho babhūva ha || nakhairvidārayāmāsa devīsiṃhaṃ madotkaṭam ||39|| taṃ ca kesariṇaṃ vīkṣya devī kruddhā hyayomukhaiḥ || śarairavākirattīkṣṇaiḥ śarairāśīviṣairiva || 5.18.40 || tyaktvā sa harirūpaṃ tu gajo bhūtvā madasravaḥ || śaila śṛṃgaṃ kare kṛtvā cikṣepa caṃḍikāṃ prati ||41|| āgacchaṃtaṃ gireḥ śṛṃgaṃ devī bāṇaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ || cakāra tilaśaḥ khaṇḍāñjahāsa jagadaṃbikā || 42 || utpatya ca tadā siṃhastasya mūrdhni vyavasthitaḥ || nakhairvidārayāmāsa mahiṣaṃ gajarūpiṇam ||43|| vihāya gajarūpaṃ ca babhūvāṣṭāpadī tathā || haṃtukāmo harikopāddāruṇo balavattaraḥ || 44 || taṃ vīkṣya śarabhaṃ devī khaḍgena sā ruṣā'nvitā || uttamāṃge jaghānāśu so'pi tāṃ prāharattadā || 45 || tayoḥ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūvāti bhayapradam || māhiṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya śṛṃgābhyāṃ prāharattadā || 46 || pucchaprabhramaṇenāśu śṛṃgaghātairmahāsuraḥ || tāḍayāmāsa tanvaṃgī ghorarūpo bhayānakaḥ || 47 || pucchena parvatāñchṛṃge gṛhītvā bhrāmayanbalāt || preṣayāmāsa pāpātmā prahasanparayā mudā || 48 || tāmuvāca balonmattastiṣṭha devi raṇāṃgaṇe || adyāhaṃ tvāṃ haniṣyāmi rūpa yauvanabhūṣitām || 49 || mūrkhā'si madamattā'dya yanmayā saha saṃgaram || karoṣi mohitā'tīva mṛṣā balavatī kharā || 5.18.50 || hatvā tvāṃ nihaniṣyāmi devānkapaṭapaṃ ḍitān || ye nārīṃ purataḥ kṛtvā jetumicchaṃti māṃ śaṭhāḥ || 51 || devyuvāca || mā garvaṃ kuru maṃdātmaṃstiṣṭha tiṣṭha raṇāṃgaṇe || kariṣyāmi nirātaṃkānhatvā tvāṃ surasattamān || 52 || pītvā'dya mādhavīmiṣṭāṃ śātayāmi raṇe'dhama || devānāṃ duḥkhadaṃ pāpaṃ munīnāṃ bhaya kārakam || 53 || vyāsa uvāca || ityuktvā caṣakaṃ haimaṃ gṛhītvā surayā yutam || papau punaḥ punaḥ krodhāddhaṃtukāmā mahāsuram || 54 || pītvā drākṣāsavaṃ miṣṭaṃ śalūmādāya satvarā || dudrāva dānavaṃ devī harṣayandevatāgaṇān || 55 || devāstāṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ premṇā cakruḥ kusuma varṣaṇam || jayajīveti te procurduṃdubhīnāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ || 56 || ṛṣayaḥ siddhagaṃdharvāḥ piśācoragacāraṇāḥ || kinnarāḥ prekṣya saṃgrāmaṃ muditā gagane sthitāḥ || 57 || so'pi nānāvidhāndehānkṛtvā kṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ || māyāmayāñjaghānājau devī kapaṭapaṃḍitaḥ || 98 || caṃḍikā'pi ca taṃ pāpaṃ triśūlena balādadhṛdi || tāḍayāmāsa tīkṣṇena krodhādaruṇalocanā || 59 || tāḍito'sau papātorvyāṃ mūrchāṃmāpa muhūrtakam || punarutthāya cāmuṃḍāṃ padbhyāṃ vegādatāḍayat ||5.18.60|| vinihatya padāghātairjahāsa ca muhurmuhuḥ|| rurāva dāruṇaṃ śabdaṃ devānāṃ bhayakārakam || 61 || tato devī sahasrāraṃ sunābhaṃ cakramuttamam || kare kṛtvā jagādoccaiḥ saṃsthitaṃ mahiṣāsuram || 62 || paśya cakraṃ madāṃdhādya tava kaṃṭhanikṛṃtanam || kṣaṇamātraṃ sthiro bhūtvā yamalokaṃ vrajādhunā || 63 || ityuktvā dāruṇaṃ cakraṃ mumoca jagadaṃbikā || śiraśchinnaṃ rathāṃgena dānavasya tadā raṇe || 64 || susrāva rudhiraṃ coṣṇaṃ kaṃṭhanālādgireryathā || gairikādyaruṇaṃ prauḍhaṃ pravāhamiva nairjharam || 65 || kabaṃdhastasya daityasya bhramanvai patitaḥ kṣitau || jayaśabdaśca devānāṃ babhūva sukhavardhanaḥ ||66|| siṃhastvatibalāstatra palāyanaparānatha || dānavānbhakṣayāmāsa kṣudhārtaṃ iva saṃgare ||67 || mṛte ca mahiṣe krūre dānavā bhayapīḍitāḥ || mṛtaśeṣāśca ye kecitpātālaṃ te yayurnṛpa || 68 || ānandaṃ paramaṃ jagmurdevāstasminnipātite || munayo mānavāścaiva ye cānye sādhavaḥ kṣitau || 69 || caṃḍikā'pi raṇaṃ tyaktvā śubhe deśe'tha saṃsthitā || devāstatrā''yayuḥ śīghraṃ stotukāmāḥ sukhapradām || 5.18.70 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate pañcamaskaṃdhe mahiṣā'suravadho nāmā'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <5.19> devīsāntvanam vyāsa uvāca atha pramuditāḥ sarve devā indrapurogamāḥ | mahiṣaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭuvurjagadambikām || 1 || devā ūcuḥ brahmā sṛjatyavati viṣṇuridaṃ maheśaḥ śaktyā tavaiva harate nanu cāntakāle || īśā na te'pi ca bhavanti tayā vihīnāstasmāttvameva jagataḥ sthitināśakartrī || 2 || kīrtirmatiḥ smṛtigatī karuṇā dayā tvaṃ śraddhā dhṛtiśca vasudhā kamalājapā ca | puṣṭiḥ kalātha vijayā girijā jayā tvaṃ tuṣṭiḥ pramā tvamasi buddhirumā ramā ca || 3 || vidyā kṣamā jagati kāntirapīha medhā sarvaṃ tvameva viditā bhuvanatraye'smin | ābhirvinā tava tu śaktibhirāśu kartuṃ ko vā kṣamaḥ sakalalokanivāsabhūme || 4 || tvaṃ dhāraṇā nanu na cedasi kūrmanāgau dhartuṃ kṣamau kathamilāmapi tau bhavetām | pṛthvī na cettvamasi vā gagane kathaṃ sthāsyatyetadamba nikhilaṃ bahubhārayuktam || 5 || ye vā stuvanti manujā amarānvimūḍhā māyāguṇaistava caturmukhaviṣṇurudrān | śubhrāṃśuvahniyamavāyugaṇeśamukhyān kiṃ tvāmṛte janani te prabhavanti kārye || 6 || ye juhvati pravitate'lpadhiyo'mba yajñe vahnau surānsamadhikṛtya haviḥ samṛddham | svāhā na cettvamasi te kathamāpuraddhā tvāmeva kiṃ na hi yajanti tato hi mūḍhāḥ || 7 || bhogapradāsi bhavatīha carācarāṇāṃ svāṃśairdadāsi khalu jīvanameva nityam | svīyānsurāñjanani poṣayasīha yadvattadvatparānapi ca pālayasīti hetoḥ || 8 || mātaḥ svayaṃviracitānvipine vinodādvandhyānpalāśarahitāṃśca kaṭūṃśca vṛkṣān | nocchedayanti puruṣā nipuṇāḥ kathañcittasmāttvamapyatitarāṃ paripāsi daityān || 9 || yattvaṃ tu haṃsi raṇamūrdhni śarairarātīndevāṅganāsuratakelimatīnviditvā | dehāntare'pi karuṇārasamādadānā tatte caritramidamīpsitapūraṇāya || 10 || citraṃ tvamī yadasubhī rahitā na santi tvaccintitena danujāḥ prathitaprabhāvāḥ | yeṣāṃ kṛte janani dehanibandhanaṃ te krīḍārasastava na cānyataro'tra hetuḥ || 11 || prāpte kalāvahaha duṣṭatare ca kāle na tvāṃ bhajanti manujā nanu vañcitāste | dhūrtaiḥ purāṇacaturairhariśaṅkarāṇāṃ sevāparāśca vihitāstava nirmitānām || 12 || jñātvā surāṃstava vaśānasurārditāṃśca ye vai bhajanti bhuvi bhāvayutā vibhagnān | dhṛtvā kare suvimalaṃ khalu dīpakaṃ te kūpe patanti manujā vijale'tighore || 13 || vidyā tvameva sukhadāsukhadāpyavidyā mātastvameva jananārtiharā narāṇām | mokṣārthibhistu kalitā kila mandadhībhirnārādhitā janani bhogaparaistathājñaiḥ || 14 || brahmā haraśca harirapyaniśaṃ śaraṇyaṃ pādāmbujaṃ tava bhajanti surāstathānye | tadvai na ye'lpamatayo manasā bhajanti bhrāntāḥ patanti satataṃ bhavasāgare te || 15 || caṇḍi tvadaṅghrijalajottharajaḥprasādairbrahmā karoti sakalaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhavādau | śauriśca pāti khalu saṃharate harastu tvāṃ sevate na manujastviha durbhago'sau || 16 || vāgdevatā tvamasi devi surāsurāṇāṃ vaktuṃ na te'maravarāḥ prabhavanti śaktāḥ | tvaṃ cenmukhe vasasi naiva yadaiva teṣāṃ yasmādbhavanti manujā na hi tadvihīnāḥ || 17 || śapto haristu bhṛguṇā kupitena kāmaṃ mīno babhūva kamaṭhaḥ khalu sūkarastu | paścānnṛsiṃha iti yaśchalakṛddharāyāṃ tānsevatāṃ janani mṛtyubhayaṃ na kiṃ syāt || 18 || śambhoḥ papāta bhuvi liṅgamidaṃ prasiddhaṃ śāpena tena ca bhṛgorvipine gatasya | taṃ ye narā bhuvi bhajanti kapālinaṃ tu teṣāṃ sukhaṃ kathamihāpi paratra mātaḥ || 19 || yo'bhūd gajānanagaṇādhipatirmaheśāttaṃ ye bhajanti manujā vitathaprapannāḥ | jānanti te na sakalārthaphalapradātrīṃ tvāṃ devi viśvajananīṃ sukhasevanīyām || 20 || citraṃ tvayārijanatāpi dayārdrabhāvāddhatvā raṇe śitaśarairgamitā dyulokam | nocetsvakarmanicite niraye nitāntaṃ duḥkhātiduḥkhagatimāpadamāpatetsā || 21 || brahmā haraśca harirapyuta garvabhāvājjānanti te'pi vibudhā na tava prabhāvam | ke'nye bhavanti manujā vidituṃ samarthāḥ sammohitāstava guṇairamitaprabhāvaiḥ || 22 || kliśyanti te'pi munayastava durvibhāvyaṃ pādāmbujaṃ na hi bhajanti vimūḍhacittāḥ | sūryāgnisevanaparāḥ paramārthatattvaṃ jñātaṃ na taiḥ śrutiśatairapi vedasāram || 23 || manye guṇāstava bhuvi prathitaprabhāvāḥ kurvanti ye hi vimukhānnanu bhaktibhāvāt | lokānsvabuddhiracitairvividhāgamaiśca viṣṇvīśabhāskaragaṇeśaparānvidhāya || 24 || kurvanti ye tava padādvimukhānnarāgryānsvoktāgamairhariharārcanabhaktiyogaiḥ | teṣāṃ na kupyasi dayāṃ kuruṣe'mbike tvaṃ tānmohamantranipuṇānprathayasyalaṃ ca || 25 || turye yuge bhavati cātibalaṃ guṇasya turyasya tena mathitānyasadāgamāni | tvāṃ gopayanti nipuṇāḥ kavayaḥ kalau vai tvatkalpitānsuragaṇānapi saṃstuvanti || 26 || dhyāyanti muktiphaladāṃ bhuvi yogasiddhāṃ vidyāṃ parāñca munayo'tiviśuddhasattvāḥ | te nāpnuvanti jananījaṭhare tu duḥkhaṃ dhanyāsta eva manujāstvayi ye vilīnāḥ || 27 || cicchaktirasti paramātmani yena so'pi vyakto jagatsu vidito bhavakṛtyakartā | ko'nyastvayā virahitaḥ prabhavatyamuṣmin kartuṃ vihartumapi sañcalituṃ svaśaktyā || 28 || tattvāni cidvirahitāni jagadvidhātuṃ kiṃ vā kṣamāṇi jagadamba yato jaḍāni | kiṃ cendriyāṇi guṇakarmayutāni santi devi tvayā virahitāni phalaṃ pradātum || 29 || devā makheṣvapi hutaṃ munibhiḥ svabhāgaṃ gṛhṇīyuramba vidhivatpratipāditaṃ kim | svāhā na cettvamasi tatra nimittabhūtā tasmāttvameva nanu pālayasīva viśvam || 30 || sarvaṃ tvayedamakhilaṃ vihitaṃ bhavādau tvaṃ pāsi vai hariharapramukhāndigīśān | kāle'tsi viśvamapi te caritaṃ bhavādyaṃ jānanti naiva manujāḥ kva nu mandabhāgyāḥ || 31 || hatvāsuraṃ mahiṣarūpadharaṃ mahograṃ mātastvayā suragaṇaḥ kila rakṣito'yam | kāṃ te stutiṃ janani mandadhiyo vidāmo vedā gatiṃ tava yathārthatayā na jagmuḥ || 32 || kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ jagati no yadasau durātmā vairī hato bhuvanakaṇṭakadurvibhāvyaḥ | kīrtiḥ kṛtā nanu jagatsu kṛpā vidheyāpyasmāṃśca pāhi janani prathitaprabhāve || 33 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ stutā surairdevī tānuvāca mṛdusvarā | anyatkāryaṃ ca duḥsādhyaṃ bruvantu surasattamāḥ || 34 || yadā yadā hi devānāṃ kāryaṃ syādatidurghaṭam | smartavyāhaṃ tadā śīghraṃ nāśayiṣyāmi cāpadam || 35 || devā ūcuḥ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā devi kāryaṃ naḥ khalu sāmpratam | yadayaṃ nihataḥ śatrurasmākaṃ mahiṣāsuraḥ || 36 || smariṣyāmo yathā te'mba sadaiva padapaṅkajam | tathā kuru jaganmātarbhaktiṃ tvayyapyacañcalām || 37 || aparādhasahasrāṇi mātaiva sahate sadā | iti jñātvā jagadyoniṃ na bhajante kuto janāḥ || 38 || dvau suparṇo tu dehe'smiṃstayoḥ sakhyaṃ nirantaram | nānyaḥ sakhā tṛtīyo'sti yo'parādhaṃ saheta hi || 39 || tasmājjīvaḥ sakhāyaṃ tvāṃ hitvā kiṃ nu kariṣyati | pāpātmā mandabhāgyo'sau suramānuṣayoniṣu || 40 || prāpya dehaṃ suduṣprāpaṃ na smarettvāṃ narādhamaḥ | manasā karmaṇā vācā brūmaḥ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 41 || sukhe vāpyathavā duḥkhe tvaṃ naḥ śaraṇamadbhutam | pāhi naḥ satataṃ devi sarvaistava varāyudhaiḥ || 42 || anyathā śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvatpādāmbujareṇutaḥ | vyāsa uvāca evaṃ stutā surairdevī tatraivāntaradhīyata | vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmurdevāstāṃ vīkṣya nirgatām || 43 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe devīsāntvanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || <5.20> mahiṣavadhānantaraṃ pṛthivīsukhavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca athādbhutaṃ vīkṣya mune prabhāvaṃ devyā jagacchāntikaraṃ parañca | na tṛptirasti dvijavarya śṛṇvataḥ kathāmṛtaṃ te mukhapadmajātam || 1 || antarhitāyāṃ ca tadā bhavānyā cakruśca kiṃ devapurogamāste | devyāścaritra paramaṃ pavitraṃ durāpamevālpapuṇyairnarāṇām || 2 || kastṛptimāpnoti kathāmṛtena bhinno'lpabhāgyātpaṭukarṇarandhraḥ | pītena yenāmaratāṃ prayāti dhiktānnarān ye na pibanti sādaram || 3 || līlācaritraṃ jagadambikāyā rakṣānvitaṃ devamahāmunīnām | saṃsāravārdhestaraṇaṃ narāṇāṃ kathaṃ kṛtajñā hi parityajeyuḥ || 4 || muktāśca ye caiva mumukṣavaśca saṃsāriṇo rogayutāśca kecit | teṣāṃ sadā śrotrapuṭaiśca peyaṃ sarvārthadaṃ vedavido vadanti || 5 || tathā viśeṣeṇa mune nṛpāṇāṃ dharmārthakāmeṣu sadā ratānām | muktāśca yasmātkhalu tatpibanti kathaṃ na peyaṃ rahitaiśca tebhyaḥ || 6 || yaiḥ pūjitā pūrvabhave bhavānī satkundapuṣpairatha campakaiśca | bailvairdalaiste bhuvi bhogayuktā nṛpā bhavantītyanumeyamevam || 7 || ye bhaktihīnā samavāpya dehaṃ taṃ mānuṣaṃ bhāratabhūmibhāge | yairnārcitā te dhanadhānyahīnā rogānvitāḥ santativarjitāśca || 8 || bhramanti nityaṃ kila dāsabhūtā ājñākarāḥ kevalabhāravāhāḥ | divāniśaṃ svārthaparāḥ kadāpi naivāpnuvantyaudarapūrtimātram || 9 || andhāśca mūkā badhirāśca khañjāḥ kuṣṭhānvitā ye bhuvi duḥkhabhājaḥ | tatrānumānaṃ kavibhirvidheyaṃ nārādhitā taiḥ satataṃ bhavānī || 10 || ye rājabhogānvitaṛddhipūrṇāḥ saṃsevyamānā bahubhirmanuṣyaiḥ | dṛśyanti ye vā vibhavaiḥ sametāstaiḥ pūjitāmbetyanumeyameva || 11 || tasmātsatyavatīsūno devyāścaritamuttamam | kathayasva kṛpāṃ kṛtvā dayāvānasi sāmpratam || 12 || hatvā taṃ mahiṣaṃ pāpaṃ stutā sampūjitā suraiḥ | kva gatā sā mahālakṣmīḥ sarvatejaḥsamudbhavā || 13 || kathitaṃ te mahābhāga gatāntardhānamāśu sā | svarge vā mṛtyuloke vā saṃsthitā bhuvaneśvarī || 14 || layaṃ gatā vā tatraiva vaikuṇṭhe vā samāśritā | athavā hemaśaile sā tattvato me vadādhunā || 15 || vyāsa uvāca pūrvaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ maṇidvīpaṃ manoharam | krīḍāsthānaṃ sadā devyā vallabhaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam || 16 || yatra brahmā hariḥ sthāṇuḥ strībhāvaṃ te prapedire | puruṣatvaṃ punaḥ prāpya svāni kāryāṇi cakrire || 17 || yaḥ sudhāsindhumadhye'sti dvīpaḥ paramaśobhanaḥ | nānārūpaiḥ sadā tatra vihāraṃ kurute'mbikā || 18 || stutā sampūjitā devaiḥ sā tatraiva gatā śivā | yatra saṃkrīḍate nityaṃ māyāśaktiḥ sanātanī || 19 || devāstāṃ nirgatāṃ vīkṣya devīṃ sarveśvarīṃ tathā | ravivaṃśodbhavaṃ cakrurbhūmipālaṃ mahābalam || 20 || ayodhyādhipatiṃ vīraṃ śatrughnaṃ nāma pārthivam | sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ mahiṣasyāsane śubhe || 21 || dattvā rājyaṃ tadā tasmai devā indrapurogamāḥ | svakīyairvāhanaiḥ sarve jagmuḥ svānyālayāni te || 22 || gateṣu teṣu deveṣu pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpate | dharmarājyaṃ babhūvātha prajāśca sukhitāstathā || 23 || parjanyaḥ kālavarṣī ca dharā dhānyaguṇāvṛtā | pādapāḥ phalapuṣpāḍhyā babhūvuḥ sukhadāḥ sadā || 24 || gāvaśca kṣīrasampanā ghaṭodhnyaḥ kāmadā nṛṇām | nadyaḥ sumārgagāḥ svacchāḥ śītodāḥ khagasaṃyutāḥ || 25 || brāhmaṇā vedatattvāśca yajñakarmaratāstathā | kṣatriyā dharmasaṃyuktā dānādhyayanatatparāḥ || 26 || śastravidyāratā nityaṃ prajārakṣaṇatatparāḥ | nyāyadaṇḍadharāḥ sarve rājānaḥ śamasaṃyutāḥ || 27 || avirodhastu bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sambabhūva ha | ākarā dhanadā nṛṇāṃ vrajā goyūthasaṃyutāḥ || 28 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca nṛpasattama | devībhaktiparāḥ sarve sambabhūvurdharātale || 29 || sarvatra yajñayūpāśca maṇḍapāśca manoharāḥ | makhaiḥ pūrṇā dharāścāsan brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ kṛtaiḥ || 30 || pativratadharā nāryaḥ suśīlāḥ satyasaṃyutāḥ | pitṛbhaktiparāḥ putrā āsandharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 31 || na pākhaṇḍaṃ na vādharmaḥ kutrāpi pṛthivītale | vedavādā śāstravādā nānye vādāstathābhavan || 32 || kalaho naiva keṣāñcinna dainyaṃ nāśubhā matiḥ | sarvatra sukhino lokāḥ kāle ca maraṇaṃ tathā || 33 || suhṛdāṃ na viyogaśca nāpadaśca kadācana | nānāvṛṣṭirna durbhikṣaṃ na mārī duḥkhadā nṛṇām || 34 || na rogo na ca mātsaryaṃ na virodhaḥ parasparam | sarvatra sukhasampannā narā nāryaḥ sukhānvitāḥ || 35 || krīḍanti mānavāḥ sarve svarge devagaṇā iva | na caurā na ca pākhaṇḍā vañcakā dambhakāstathā || 36 || piśunā lampaṭāḥ stabdhā na babhūvustadā nṛpa | na vedadveṣiṇaḥ pāpā mānavāḥ pṛthivīpate || 37 || sarvadharmaratā nityaṃ dvijasevāparāyaṇāḥ | tridhātvātsṛṣṭidharmasya trividhā brāhmaṇāstataḥ || 38 || sāttvikā rājasāścaiva tāmasāśca tathāpare | sarve vedavido dakṣāḥ sāttvikāḥ sattvavṛttayaḥ || 39 || pratigrahavihīnāśca dayādamaparāyaṇāḥ | yajñāste sāttvikairannaiḥ kurvāṇā dharmatatparāḥ || 40 || puroḍāśavidhānaiśca paśubhirna kadācana | dānamadhyayanañcaiva yajanaṃ tu tṛtīyakam || 41 || trikarmarasikāste vai sāttvikā brāhmaṇā nṛpa | rājasā vedavidvāṃsaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ purohitāḥ || 42 || ṣaṭkarmaniratā sarve vidhivanmāṃsabhakṣakāḥ | yajanaṃ yājanaṃ dānaṃ tathaiva ca pratigrahaḥ || 43 || adhyayanaṃ tu vedānāṃ tathaivādhyāpanaṃ tu ṣaṭ | tāmasāḥ krodhasaṃyuktā rāgadveṣaparāḥ punaḥ || 44 || rājñāṃ karmakarā nityaṃ kiñcidadhyayane ratāḥ | mahiṣe nihate sarve sukhino vedatatparāḥ || 45 || babhūvurvrataniṣṇātā dānadharmaparāstathā | kṣatriyāḥ pālane yuktā vaiśyā vaṇijavṛttayaḥ || 46 || kṛṣivāṇijyagorakṣākusīdavṛttayaḥ pare | evaṃ pramudito loko mahiṣe vinipātite || 47 || anudvegaḥ prajānāṃ vai sambabhūva dhanāgamaḥ | bahukṣīrā śubhā gāvo nadyaścaiva bahūdakāḥ || 48 || vṛkṣā bahuphalāścāsanmānavā rogavarjitāḥ | nādhayo netayaḥ kvāpi prajānāṃ duḥkhadāyakāḥ || 49 || na nidhanamupayānti prāṇinaste'pyakāle sakalavibhavayuktā rogahīnāḥ sadaiva | nigamavihitadharme tatparāścaṇḍikāyāścaraṇasarasijānāṃ sevane dattacittāḥ || 50 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhsryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe mahiṣavadhānantaraṃ pṛthivīsukhavarṇanaṃ nāma viśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || <5.21> śumbhaniśumbhadvārā svargavijayavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi devyāścaritamuttamam | sukhadaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 1 || yathā śumbho niśumbhaśca bhrātarau balavattarau | babhūvaturmahāvīrau avadhyau puruṣaiḥ kila || 2 || bahusenāvṛtau śūrau devānāṃ duḥkhadau sadā durācārau madotsiktau bahudānavasaṃyutau || 3 || hatāvambikayā tau tu saṃgrāme'tīva dāruṇe | devānāñja hitārthāya sarvaiḥ paricaraiḥ saha || 4 || caṇḍamuṇḍau mahābāhū raktabījo'tidāruṇaḥ | dhūmralocananāmā ca nihatāste raṇāṅgaṇe || 5 || tānnihatya surāṇāṃ sā jahāra bhayamuttamam | stutā sampūjitā devairgirau hemācale śubhe || 6 || rājovāca kāvetāvasurāvādau kathaṃ tau balināṃ varau | kena saṃsthāpitau ceha strīvadhyatvaṃ kuto gatau || 7 || tapasā varadānena kasya jātau mahābalau | kathañca nihatau sarvaṃ kathayasva savistaram || 8 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājankathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm | devyāścaritasaṃyuktāṃ sarvārthaphaladāṃ śubhām || 9 || purā śumbhaniśumbhau dvāvasurau bhūmimaṇḍale | pātālataśca samprāptau bhrātarau śubhadarśanau || 10 || tau prāptayauvanau caiva ceratustapa uttamam | annodakaṃ parityajya puṣkare lokapāvane || 11 || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ yāvadyogavidyāparāyaṇau | ekatraivāsanaṃ kṛtvā tepāte paramaṃ tapaḥ || 12 || tayostuṣṭo'bhavad brahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ | tatrāgataśca bhagavānāruhya varaṭāpatim || 13 || tāvubhau ca jagatsraṣṭā dṛṣṭvā dhyānaparau sthitau | uttiṣṭhata mahābhāgau tuṣṭo'haṃ tapasā kila || 14 || vāñchitaṃ vāṃ varaṃ kāmaṃ dadāmi bruvatāmiha | kāmado'haṃ samāyāto dṛṣṭvā vāṃ tapaso balam || 15 || vyāsa uvāca iti śrutvā vacastasya prabuddhau tau samāhitau | pradakṣiṇakriyāṃ kṛtvā praṇāmaṃ cakratustadā || 16 || daṇḍavatpraṇipātañca kṛtvā tau durbalākṛtī | ūcaturmadhurāṃ vācaṃ dīnau gadgadayā girā || 17 || devadeva dayāsindho bhaktānāmabhayaprada | amaratvañca nau brahmandehi tuṣṭo'si cedvibho || 18 || maraṇādaparaṃ kiñcidbhayaṃ nāsti dharātale | tasmādbhayācca santrastau yuṣmākaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatau || 19 || trāhi tvaṃ devadeveśa jagatkartaḥ kṣamānidhe | parisphoṭaya viśvātman sadyo maraṇajaṃ bhayam || 20 || brahmovāca kimidaṃ prārthanīyaṃ vo viparītaṃ tu sarvathā | adeyaṃ sarvathā sarvaiḥ sarvebhyo bhuvanatraye || 21 || jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurdhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca | maryādā vihitā loke pūrvaṃ viśvakṛtā kila || 22 || martavyaṃ sarvathā sarvaiḥ prāṇibhirnātra saṃśayaḥ | anyaṃ prārthayataṃ kāmaṃ dadāmi yacca vāñchitam || 23 || vyāsa uvāca tadākarṇya vacastasya suvimṛśya ca dānavau | ūcatuḥ praṇipatyātha brahmāṇaṃ purataḥ sthitam || 24 || puruṣairamarādyaiśca mānavairmṛgapakṣibhiḥ | avadhyatvaṃ kṛpāsindho dehi nau vāñchitaṃ varam || 25 || nārī balavatī kāsti yā nau nāśaṃ kariṣyati | na bibhīvaḥ striyaḥ kāmaṃ trailokye sacarācare || 26 || avadhyau bhrātarau syātāṃ narebhyaḥ paṅkajodbhava | bhayaṃ na strījanebhyaśca svabhāvādabalā hi sā || 27 || vyāsa uvāca iti śrutvā tayorvākyaṃ pradadau vāñchitaṃ varam | brahmā prasannamanasā jagāmātha svamālayam || 28 || gate'tha bhavane tasmindānavau svagṛhaṃ gatau | bhṛguṃ purohitaṃ kṛtvā cakratuḥ pūjanaṃ tadā || 29 || śubhe dine sunakṣatre jātarūpamayaṃ śubham | kṛtvā siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ rājyārthaṃ pradadau muniḥ || 30 || śumbhāya jyeṣṭhabhūtāya dadau rājyāsanaṃ śubham | sevanārthaṃ tadaivāśu samprāptā dānavottamāḥ || 31 || caṇḍamuṇḍau mahāvīrau bhrātarau baladarpitau | samprāptau sainyasaṃyuktau rathavājigajānvitau || 32 || dhūmralocananāmā ca tadrūpaścaṇḍavikramaḥ | śumbhañca bhūpatiṃ śrutvā tadāgādbalasaṃyutaḥ || 33 || raktabījastathā śūro varadānabalādhikaḥ | akṣauhiṇībhyāṃ saṃyuktastatraivāgatya saṅgataḥ || 34 || tasyaikaṃ kāraṇaṃ rājan saṃgrāme yudhyataḥ sadā | dehādrudhirasampātastasya śastrāhatasya ca || 35 || jāyate ca yadā bhūmāvutpadyante hyanekaśaḥ | tādṛśāḥ puruṣāḥ krūrā bahavaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || 36 || sambhavanti tadākārāstadrūpāstatparākramāḥ | yuddhaṃ punaste kurvanti puruṣā raktasambhavāḥ || 37 || ataḥ so'pi mahāvīryaḥ saṃgrāme'tīva durjayaḥ | avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ raktabījo mahāsuraḥ || 38 || anye ca bahavaḥ śūrāścaturaṅgasamanvitāḥ | śumbhañca nṛpatiṃ matvā babhūvustasya sevakāḥ || 39 || asaṃkhyātā tadā jātā senā śumbhaniśumbhayoḥ | pṛthivyāḥ sakalaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhītaṃ balavattayā || 40 || senāyogaṃ tadā kṛtvā niśumbhaḥ paravīrahā | jagāma tarasā svarge śacīpatijayāya ca || 41 || cakārāsau mahāyuddhaṃ lokapālaiḥ samantataḥ | vṛtrahā vajrapātena tāḍayāmāsa vakṣasi || 42 || sa vajrābhihato bhūmau papāta dānavānujaḥ | bhagnaṃ balaṃ tadā tasya niśumbhasya mahātmanaḥ || 43 || bhrātaraṃ mūrcchitaṃ śrutvā śumbhaḥ parabalārdanaḥ | tatrāgatya surānmarvāṃstāḍayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ || 44 || kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ mahattena śumbhenākliṣṭakarmaṇā | nirjitāstu surāḥ sarve sendrāḥ pālāśca sarvaśaḥ || 45 || aindraṃ padaṃ tadā tena gṛhītaṃ balavattayā | kalpapādapasaṃyuktaṃ kāmadhenusamanvitam || 46 || trailokyaṃ yajñabhāgāśca hṛtāstena mahātmanā | nandanaṃ ca vanaṃ prāpya mudito'bhūnmahāsuraḥ || 47 || sudhāyāścaiva pānena sukhamāpa mahāsuraḥ | kuberaṃ sa ca nirjitya tasya rājyaṃ cakāra ha || 48 || adhikāraṃ tathā bhānoḥ śaśinaśca cakāra ha | yamañcaiva vinirjitya jagrāha tatpadaṃ tathā || 49 || varuṇasya tathā rājyaṃ cakāra vahnikarma ca | vāyoḥ kāryaṃ niśumbhaśca cakāra svabalānvitaḥ || 50 || tato devā vinirdhūtā hṛtarājyā hṛtaśriyaḥ | santyajya nandanaṃ sarve niryayurgirigahvare || 51 || hṛtādhikārāste sarve babhramurvijane vane | nirālambā nirādhārā nistejaskā nirāyudhāḥ || 52 || viceruramarāḥ sarve parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca | udyāneṣu ca śūnyeṣu nadīnāṃ gahvareṣu ca || 53 || na prāpuste sukhaṃ vāpi sthānabhraṣṭā vicetasaḥ | lokapālā mahārāja daivādhīnaṃ sukhaṃ kila || 54 || balavanto mahābhāgā bahujñā dhanasaṃyutāḥ | kāle duḥkhaṃ tathā dainyamāpnuvanti narādhipa || 55 || citrametanmahārāja kālasyaiva viceṣṭitam | yaḥ karoti naraṃ tāvadrājānaṃ bhikṣukaṃ tataḥ || 56 || dātāraṃ yācakaṃ caiva balavantaṃ tathābalam | paṇḍitaṃ vikalaṃ kāmaṃ śūraṃ cātīva kātaram || 57 || makhānāñca śataṃ kṛtvā prāpyendrāsanamuttamam | punarduḥkhaṃ paraṃ prāptaṃ kālasya gatirīdṛśī || 58 || kālaḥ karoti dharmiṣṭhaṃ puruṣaṃ jñānasaṃyutam | tamevātīva pāpiṣṭhaṃ jñānaleśavivarjitam || 59 || na vismayo'tra kartavyaḥ sarvathā kālaceṣṭite | brahmaviṣṇuharādīnāmapīdṛkkaṣṭaceṣṭitam || 60 || viṣṇurjananamāpnoti sūkarādiṣu yoniṣu | haraḥ kapālī sañjātaḥ kālenaiva balīyasā || 61 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe śumbhaniśumbhadvārā svargavijayavarṇanaṃ nāmakaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || <5.22> devakṛtadevyārādhanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca parājitāḥ surāḥ sarve rājyaṃ śumbhaḥ śaśāsa ha | evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu jagāma nṛpasattama || 1 || bhraṣṭarājyāstato devāścintāmāpuḥ sudustarām | guruṃ duḥkhāturāste tu papracchuridamādṛtāḥ || 2 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ guro brūhi sarvajñastvaṃ mahāmuniḥ | upāyo'sti mahābhāga duḥkhasya vinivṛttaye || 3 || upacāraparā nūnaṃ vedamantrāḥ sahasraśaḥ | vācchitārthakarā nūnaṃ sūtraiḥ saṃlakṣitāḥ kila || 4 || iṣṭayo vividhāḥ proktāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ | tāḥ kuruṣva mune nūnaṃ tvaṃ jānāsi ca tatkriyāḥ || 5 || vidhiḥ śatruvināśāya yathoddiṣṭaḥ sadāgame | taṃ kuruṣvādya vidhivadyathā no duḥkhasaṃkṣayaḥ || 6 || bhavedāṃgirasādyaiva tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi | dānavānāṃ vināśāya abhicāraṃ yathāmati || 7 || bṛhaspatiruvāca sarve mantrāśca vedoktā daivādhīnaphalāśca te | na svatantrāḥ surādhīśa tathaikāntaphalapradāḥ || 8 || mantrāṇāṃ devatā yūyaṃ te tu duḥkhaikabhājanam | jātāḥ sma kālayogena kiṃ karomi prasādhanam || 9 || indrāgnivaruṇādīnāṃ yajanaṃ yajñakarmasu | te yūyaṃ vipadaṃ prāptāḥ kariṣyanti kimiṣṭayaḥ || 10 || avaśyambhāvibhāvānāṃ
