|| 11 || caritratrayapāṭhaṃ ca nityaṃ kuryādvisarjayet | navarātravrataṃ caiva vidheyaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 12 || āśvine ca tathā caitre śukle pakṣe narādhipa | navarātro(trā)pavāso vai kartavyaḥ śubhamicchatā || 13 || homaḥ suvipulaḥ kāryo japyamaṃtraiḥ supāyasaiḥ | śarkarāghṛtamiśraiśca madhuyuktaiḥ susaṃskṛtaiḥ ||14|| chāgamāṃsena vā kāryoṃ bilvapatraistathā śubhaiḥ | hayārikusumai raktaistilairvā śarkarāyutaiḥ || 15 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ devyā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam ||16|| nirdhano dhanamāpnoti rogī rogātpramucyate | aputro labhate putrāñchubhāṃśca vaśavartinaḥ ||17|| rājyabhraṣṭo nṛpo rājyaṃ prāpnoti sārvabhaumikam | śatrubhiḥ pīḍito haṃti ripuṃ māyāprasādataḥ || 18 || vidyārthī pūjanaṃ yastu karoti niyateṃdriyaḥ | anavadyāṃ śubhāṃ vidyāṃ viṃdate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 19|| brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā bhaktisaṃyutaḥ | pūjayejjagatāṃ dhātrīṃ sa sarvasukhabhāgbhavet || 20 || navarātravrataṃ kuryānnaranārīgaṇaśca yaḥ | vāṃchitaṃ phalamāpnoti sarvadā bhaktitatparaḥ || 21 || āśvine śuklapakṣe tu navarātravrataṃ śubham | karoti bhāvasaṃyuktaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||22|| vidhivanmaṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā pūjāsthānaṃ prakalpayet | kalaśaṃ sthāpayettatra vedamaṃtravidhānataḥ || 23 || yaṃtraṃ suruciraṃ kṛtvā sthāpayetkalaśopari | vāpayitvā yavāṃścārūnpārśvataḥ parivartitān ||24|| kṛtvopari vitānaṃ ca puṣpamālāsamāvṛtam | dhūpadīpasusaṃyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ caṇḍikāgṛham || 25 || trikālaṃ tatra kartavyā pūjā śaktyanusārataḥ | vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ caṇḍikāyāśca pūjane ||26|| dhūpairdīpaiḥ sunaivedyaiḥ phalapuṣpairanekaśaḥ | gītavādyaiḥ stotrapāṭhairvedapārāyaṇaistathā || 27 || utsavastatra kartavyo nānāvāditrasaṃyutaiḥ | kanyakānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca vidheyaṃ vidhipūrvakam ||28|| candanairbhūṣaṇairvastrairbhakṣyaiśca vividhaistathā | sugandhatailamālyaiśca manaso rucikārakaiḥ ||29|| evaṃ sampūjanaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ mantravidhānataḥ | aṣṭamyāṃ vā navamyāṃ vā kārayedvidhipūrvakam ||30|| brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścātpāraṇaṃ daśamīdine | kartavyaṃ śaktito dānaṃ deyaṃ bhaktiparairnṛpaiḥ || 31|| evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā navarātravrataṃ naraḥ | nārī vā sadhavā bhaktyā vidhavā vā pativratā || 32|| iha loke sukhaṃ bhogānprāpnoti manasepsitān | dehānte paramaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti vratatatparaḥ || 33 || janmāntare'mbikābhaktirbhavatyavyabhicāriṇī| janmottamakule prāpya sadācāro bhaveddhi saḥ || 34|| navarātravrataṃ proktaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam | ārādhanaṃ śivāyāstu sarvasaukhyakaraṃ param ||35|| anena vidhinā rājansamārādhaya caṇḍikām | jitvā ripūnaskhalitaṃ rājyaṃ prāpsyatyanuttamam||36|| sukhaṃ ca paramaṃ bhūpa dehe'sminsvagṛhe punaḥ | putradārānsamāsādya lapsyase nātra saṃśayaḥ || 37 || vaiśyottama tvamevādya samārādhaya kāmadām | devīṃ viśveśvarīṃ māyāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇīm ||38|| svajanānāṃ ca mānyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi gṛhe gataḥ | sukhaṃ sāṃsārikaṃ prāpya yathābhilaṣitaṃ punaḥ ||39|| devīloke śubhe vāso bhavitā te na saṃśayaḥ | nārādhitā bhagavatī yaiste narakabhāginaḥ || 40 || iha loke'tiduḥkhārtā nānārogaiḥ prapīḍitāḥ | bhavaṃti mānavā rājañchatrubhiśca parājitāḥ || 41 || niṣkalatrā hyaputrāśca tṛṣṇārtāḥ stabdhabuddhayaḥ | bilbīdalaiḥ karavīraiḥ śatapatraiśca campakaiḥ ||42|| arcitā jagatāṃ dhātrī yaiste'tīva vilāsinaḥ | bhavaṃti kṛtapuṇyāste śaktibhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||43|| dhanavibhavasukhāḍhyā mānavā mānavaṃtaḥ sakalaguṇagaṇānāṃ bhājanaṃ bhāratīśāḥ | nigamapaṭhitamantraiḥ pūjitā yairbhavānī nṛpatitilakamukhyāste bhavaṃtīha loke || 44|| iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pañcamaskandhe catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34|| <5.35> atha pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ mahiṣa uvāca| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā duḥkhitau vaiśyapārthivau | praṇipatya muniṃ prītyā praśrayāvanatau bhṛśam ||1|| harṣeṇotphullanayanāvūcaturvākyakovidau | kṛtāñjalipuṭau śāntau bhaktipravaṇacetasau ||2|| bhagavanpāvitāvadya śāntau dīnau śucānvitau | tava sūktasarasvatyā gaṅgayeva bhagīrathaḥ || 3 || sādhavaḥ sambhavantīha paropakṛtitatparāḥ | akṛtrimaguṇārāmāḥ sukhadāḥ sarvadehinām ||4|| pūrvapuṇyaprasaṅgena prāpto'yamāśrayaḥ śubhaḥ | tavāvābhyāṃ mahābhāga mahāduḥkhavināśakaḥ ||5|| bhavanti mānavā bhūmau bahavaḥ svārthatatparāḥ | parārthasādhane dakṣāḥ kecitkvāpi bhavādṛśāḥ || 6 || duḥkhito'haṃ muniśreṣṭha vaiśyo'yaṃ cātiduḥkhitaḥ | ubhau saṃsārasaṃtaptau tavāśramapade mudā ||7|| darśanādeva he vidvangataṃ duḥkhamihāvayoḥ | dehajaṃ mānasaṃ vākyaśravaṇādeva sāmpratam ||8|| dhanyāvāvāṃ kṛtakṛtyau jātau sūktisudhārasāt | pāvitau bhavatā brahmankṛpayā karuṇārṇava || 9 || gṛhāṇāsmatkarau sādho naya pāraṃ bhavārṇavāt | magnau śrāṃtāviti jñātvā maṃtradānena sāṃpratam || 10 || tapaḥ kṛtvā'tivipulaṃ samārādhya sukhapradām | saṃprāpya darśanaṃ bhūyo yāsyāvo nijamaṃdiram ||11| vadanāttava samprāpya devīmantraṃ navākṣaram | smaraṇaṃ ca kariṣyāvo nirāhārau dhṛtavratau || 12 || vyāsa uvāca| iti sañcoditastābhyāṃ sumedhā munisattamaḥ | dadau maṃtraṃ śubhaṃ tābhyāṃ dhyānabījapuraḥsaram ||13| tau ca prāpya munermaṃtraṃ sammantrya gurudaivatau | jagmaturvaiśyarājānau nadītīramanuttamam ||14|| ekāṃte vijane sthāne kṛtvāsanaparigraham | upaviṣṭau sthiraprajñau tāvatīva kṛśodarau || 15 | mantrajāpyaratau śāntau caritratrayapāṭhakau | ninyaturmāsamekaṃ tu tatra dhyānaparāyaṇau || 16 | tayormāsavratenaiva jātā prītiranuttamā | padāmbuje bhavānyāstu sthirā buddhistathāpyalam || 17|| kadācitpādayorgatvā munestasya mahātmanaḥ | kṛtapraṇāmāvāgatya tasthatuśca kuśāsane || 18|| nānyakārya parau kvāpi babhūvatuḥ kadācana | devīdhyānaparau nityaṃ japamantraratau sadā ||19|| evaṃ jāte tadā pūrṇe tatra saṃvatsare nṛpa | babhūvatuḥ phalāhāraṃ tyaktvā parṇāśanau nṛpa || 20 || varṣamekaṃ tapastatra cakraturvaiśyapārthivau | śuṣkaparṇāśanau dāntau japadhyānaparāyaṇau ||21|| pūrṇe varṣadvaye jāte kadāciddarśanaṃ ca tau | prāpatuḥ svapnamadhye tu bhagavatyā manoharam ||22|| raktāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ cārubhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | kadācinnṛpatiḥ svapne'pyapaśyajjagadambikām 23|| vīkṣya svapne ca tau devīṃ prītiyuktau babhūvatuḥ | jalāhāraistṛtīye tu sthitau saṃvatsare tu tau ||24|| evaṃ varṣatrayaṃ kṛtvā tatastau vaiśyapārthivau | cakratustau tadā ciṃtāṃ citte darśanalālasau ||25|| pratyakṣadarśanaṃ devyā na prāptaṃ śāṃtidaṃ nṛṇām | dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāvo duḥkhitau bhṛśamāturau || 26|| iti saṃcintya manasā rājā kuṇḍaṃ cakāra ha | trikoṇaṃ susthiraṃ saumyaṃ hastamātrapramāṇataḥ || 27 || saṃsthāpya pāvakaṃ rājā tathā vaiśyo'tibhaktimān | guhāvāso nijaṃ māṃsaṃ chittvā chittvā punaḥpunaḥ ||28|| tathā vaiśyo'pi dīpte'gnau svamāṃsaṃ prāpakṣipattadā | rudhireṇa baliṃ cāsyai dadatustau kṛtodyamau ||29|| tadā bhagavatī dattvā pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ tayoḥ | prāha prītibharodbhrāṃtau dṛṣṭvā tau duḥkhitau bhṛśam || śrīdevyuvāca| varaṃ varaya bho rājan yatte manasi vāṃchitam | tuṣṭā'haṃ tapasā te'dya bhakto'si tvaṃ mato mama 31 || vaiśyaṃ prāha tadā devī prasannā'haṃ mahāmate | kiṃ te'bhīṣṭaṃ dadāmyadya prārthayāśu manogatam ||32|| vyāsa uvāca| tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā tāmuvāca mudānvitaḥ | dehi me'dya nijaṃ rājyaṃ hataśatrubalaṃ balāt || 33 || tamuvāca tadā devī gaccha rājannijaṃ gṛham | śatravaḥ kṣīṇasattvāste gamiṣyaṃti parājitāḥ || 34 || maṃtriṇastu samāgatya te patiṣyaṃti pādayoḥ | kuru rājyaṃ mahābhāga nagare svaṃ yathāsukham ||35|| kṛtvā rājyaṃ suvipulaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ nṛpa | dehānte janma saṃprāpya sūryācca bhavitā manuḥ 36 || vyāsa uvāca| vaiśyastāmapyuvācedaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ śuciḥ | na me gṛheṇa kāryaṃ vai na putreṇa dhanena vā || 37 || sarvaṃ baṃdhakaraṃ mātaḥ svapnavannaśvaraṃ sphuṭam | jñānaṃ me dehi viśadaṃ mokṣadaṃ baṃdhanāśanam || 38 || asāre'smiṃśca saṃsāre mūḍhā majjaṃti pāmarāḥ | paṃḍitāḥ saṃtaraṃtīha tasmānnecchanti saṃsṛtim 39 || vyāsa uvāca| tadākarṇya mahāmāyā vaiśyaṃ prāha puraḥsthitam | vaiśvavarya tava jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 40 || iti dattvā varaṃ tābhyāṃ tatraivāṃtaradhīyata | adarśanaṃ gatāyāṃ tu rājā taṃ munisattamam || 41 || praṇamya hayamāruhya gamanāya mano dadhe | tadaiva tasya sacivāstatrāgatya nṛpaṃ prajāḥ || 42|| praṇemurvinayopetāstamūcuḥ prāṃjalisthitāḥ | rājaṃste śatravaḥ sarve pāpācca nihatā raṇe ||43|| rājyaṃ niṣkaṃṭakaṃ bhūpa kuruṣva puramāsthitaḥ | tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā natvā taṃ munisattamam 44 || āpṛcchya niryayau tatra maṃtribhiḥ parivāritaḥ | saṃprāpya ca nijaṃ rājyaṃ dārānsvajanabāṃdhavān 45 || bubhuje pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ tataḥ sāgaramekhalām | vaiśyo'pi jñānamāsādya muktasaṃgaḥ samaṃtataḥ || 46 || kālātivāhanaṃ tatra muktabaṃdhaścakāra ha| tīrtheṣu vicarangāyanbhagavatyā guṇānatha || 47|| etatte kathitaṃ devyāścaritaṃ paramādbhutam | ārādhanaphalaprāptiryathāvadbhūpavaiśyayoḥ||48|| daityānāṃ hananaṃ proktaṃ prādurbhāvastathā śubhaḥ | evaṃprabhāvā sā devī bhaktānāmabhayapradā || 49 || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro nityametadākhyānamuttamam | saṃprāpnoti naraḥ satyaṃ saṃsārasukhamadbhutam ||50|| jñānadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva kīrtidaṃ sukhadaṃ tathā | pāvanaṃ śravaṇānnūnametadākhyānamadbhutam || 51 || akhilārthapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvadharmasamāvṛtam | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ matam ||52|| sūta uvāca| janamejayena rājñā'sau pṛṣṭaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ | uvāca saṃhitāṃ divyāṃ vyāsaḥ sarvārthatattvavit ||53|| caritaṃ caṃḍikāyāstu śumbhadaityavadhāśritam | kathayāmāsa bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ kāruṇiko muniḥ || iti vaḥ kathitaḥ sāraḥ purāṇānāṃ munīśvarāḥ || 54 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaskandhe pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35|| vyomāṃkābhradvisaṃkhyātaḥ 2090 ślokairvyāsena dhīmatā | devībhāgavatasyāsya pañcamaskandha īritaḥ ||5|| samāpto'yaṃ pañcamaḥ skandhaḥ <6.1> triśirasastapobhaṅgāya devarājendradvārā nānopāyacintanavarṇanam ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sūta sūta mahābhāga miṣṭaṃ te vacanāmṛtam | na tṛptāḥ smo vayaṃ pītvā dvaipāyanakṛtaṃ śubham || 1 || punastvāṃ praṣṭumicchāmaḥ kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām | vede'pi kathitāṃ ramyāṃ prasiddhāṃ pāpanāśinīm || 2 || vṛtrāsura iti khyāto vīryavāṃstvaṣṭurātmajaḥ | sa kathaṃ nihataḥ saṃkhye vāsavena mahātmanā || 3 || tvaṣṭā vai surapakṣīyastatputro balavattaraḥ | śakreṇa ghātitaḥ kasmādbrahmayonirmahābalaḥ || 4 || devāḥ sattvaguṇotpanā mānuṣā rājasāḥ smṛtāḥ | tiryañcastāmasāḥ proktāḥ purāṇāgamavādibhiḥ || 5 || virodho'tra mahān bhāti nūnaṃ śatamakhena ha | chalena balavān vṛtraḥ śakreṇa vinipātitaḥ || 6 || viṣṇuḥ prerayitā tatra sa tu sattvadharaḥ paraḥ | praviṣṭaḥ pavimadhye sa chadmanā bhagavān prabhuḥ || 7 || sandhiṃ vidhāya sa hyevaṃ mantrito'sau mahābalaḥ | haribhyāṃ satyamutsṛjya jalaphenena śātitaḥ || 8 || kṛtamindreṇa hariṇā kimetatsūta sāhasam | mahānto'pi ca mohena vañcitāḥ pāpabuddhayaḥ || 9 || anyāyavartino'tyarthaṃ bhavanti surasattamāḥ | sadācāreṇa yuktena devāḥ śiṣṭatvamāgatāḥ || 10 || evaṃ viśiṣṭadharmeṇa śiṣṭatvaṃ kīdṛśaṃ punaḥ | hatvā vṛtraṃ tu viśvastaṃ śakreṇa chadmanā punaḥ || 11 || prāptaṃ pāpaphalaṃ no vā brahmahatyāsamudbhavam | kiṃ ca tvayā purā proktaṃ vṛtrāsuravadhaḥ kṛtaḥ || 12 || śrīdevyā iti taccāpi cittaṃ mohayatīha naḥ | sūta uvāca śṛṇvantu munayo vṛttaṃ vṛtrāsuravadhāśrayam || 13 || yathendreṇa ca samprāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ hatyāsamudbhavam | evameva purā pṛṣṭo vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ || 14 || pārīkṣitena rājñāpi sa yadāha ca tadbruve | janamejaya uvāca kathaṃ vṛtrāsuraḥ pūrvaṃ hato maghavatā mune || 15 || sahāyaṃ viṣṇumāsādya chadmanā sāttvikena ha | kathaṃ ca devyā nihato daityo'sau kena hetunā || 16 || kathamekavadho dvābhyāṃ kṛtaḥ syānmunipuṅgava | tadetacchrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 17 || mahatāṃ caritaṃ śṛṇvan ko virajyeta mānavaḥ | kathayāmbāvaibhavaṃ tvaṃ vṛtrāsuravadhāśritam || 18 || vyāsa uvāca dhanyo'si rājaṃstava buddhirīdṛśī jātā purāṇaśravaṇe'tisādarā | pītvāmṛtaṃ devavarāstu sarvathā pāne vitṛṣṇāḥ prabhavanti vai punaḥ || 19 || dine dine te'dhikabhaktibhāvaḥ kathāsu rājan mahanīyakīrteḥ | śrotā yadaikapravaṇaḥ śṛṇoti vaktā tadā prītamanā bravīti || 20 || yuddhaṃ purā vāsavavṛtrayoryad vede prasiddhaṃ ca tathā purāṇe | duḥkhaṃ surendreṇa tathaiva labdhaṃ hatvā ripuṃ tvāṣṭramapāpameva || 21 || citraṃ kimatra nṛpate harivajrabhṛdbhyāṃ yacchadmanā vinihatastriśiro'tha vṛtraḥ | māyābalena munayo'pi vimohitāste cakruśca nindyamaniśaṃ kila pāpabhītāḥ || 22 || viṣṇuḥ sadaiva kapaṭena jaghāna daityān sattvātmamūrtirapi mohamavāpya kāmam | ko'nyo'sti tāṃ bhagavatīṃ manasāpi jetuṃ śaktaḥ samastajanamohakarīṃ bhavānīm || 23 || matsyādiyoniṣu sahasrayugeṣu sadyaḥ sākṣādbhavatyapi yayā viniyojito'tra | nārāyaṇo narasakho bhagavānanantaḥ kāryaṃ karoti vihitāvihitaṃ kadācit || 24 || dehaṃ dhanaṃ gṛhamidaṃ svajanā madīyaṃ putrāḥ kalatramiti mohamupetya sarvaḥ | puṇyaṃ karotyatha ca pāpacayaṃ karoti māyāguṇairatibalairvikalīkṛto yat || 25 || na jātu mohaṃ kṣapituṃ naraḥ kṣamaḥ kaścidbhavedbhūpa parāvarārthavit | vimohitastaistribhireva mūlato vaśīkṛtātmā jagatītale bhṛśam || 26 || atha tau māyayā viṣṇuvāsavau mohitau bhṛśam | jaghnatuśchadmanā vṛtraṃ svārthasādhanatatparau || 27 || tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi vṛttāntamavanīpate | kāraṇaṃ pūrvavairasya vṛtravāsavayormithaḥ || 28 || tvaṣṭā prajāpatirhyāsīddevaśreṣṭho mahātapāḥ | devānāṃ kāryakartā ca nipuṇo brāhmaṇapriyaḥ || 29 || sa putraṃ vai triśirasamindradveṣātkilāsṛjat | viśvarūpeti vikhyātaṃ nāmnā rūpeṇa mohanam || 30 || tribhiḥ sa vadanaiḥ śreṣṭhairvyarocata manoharaiḥ | tribhirbhinnāni kāryāṇi mukhaiḥ samakaronmuniḥ || 31 || vedānekena so'dhīte surāṃ caikena so'pibat | tṛtīyena diśaḥ sarvā yugapacca nirīkṣate || 32 || triśirā bhogamutsṛjya tapaścakre suduṣkaram | tapasvī sa mṛdurdānto dharmameva samāśritaḥ || 33 || pañcāgnisādhanaṃ kāle pādapāgre niveśanam | jalamadhye nivāsaṃ ca hemante śiśire tathā || 34 || nirāhāro jitātmāsau tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ | tapaścacāra medhāvī duṣkaraṃ mandabuddhibhiḥ || 35 || taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tapasyantaṃ khedamāpa śacīpatiḥ | viṣādamagamattatra śakro'yaṃ māsmabhūditi || 36 || dṛṣṭvā tasya tapo vīryaṃ satyaṃ cāmitatejasaḥ | cintāṃ ca mahatīṃ prāpa hyaniśaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ || 37 || vivardhamānastriśirā māmayaṃ śātayiṣyati | nopekṣyaḥ sarvathā śatrurvardhamānabalo budhaiḥ || 38 || tasmādupāyaḥ kartavyastaponāśāya sāmpratam | kāmastu tapasāṃ śatruḥ kāmānnaśyati vai tapaḥ || 39 || tathaivādya prakartavyaṃ bhogāsakto bhavedyathā | iti sañcintya manasā buddhimānbalamardanaḥ || 40 || ājñāpayatso'psarasastvāṣṭraputrapralobhane | urvaśīṃ menakāṃ rambhāṃ ghṛtācīṃ ca tilottamām || 41 || samāhūyābravīcchakrastāstadā rūpagarvitāḥ | priyaṃ kurudhvaṃ me sarvāḥ kārye'dya samupasthite || 42 || yatto me'dya mahāñchatrustapastapati durjayaḥ | kāryaṃ kuruta gacchadhvaṃ pralobhayata māciram || 43 || śṛṅgāraveṣairvividhairhāvairdehasamudbhavaiḥ | pralobhayata bhadraṃ vaḥ śamayadhvaṃ jvaraṃ mama || 44 || asvastho'haṃ mahābhāgāstasya jñātvā tapobalam | balavānāsanaṃ me'dya grahīṣyatyavilambitaḥ || 45 || bhayaṃ me samupāyātaṃ kṣipraṃ nāśayatābalāḥ | upakurvantu sahitāḥ kārye'dya samupasthite || 46 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ nārya ūcustaṃ praṇatāḥ puraḥ | mā bhayaṃ kuru deveśa yatiṣyāmaḥ pralobhane || 47 || yathā na syādbhayaṃ tasmāttathā kāryaṃ mahādyute | nṛtyagītavihāraiśca munestasya pralobhane || 48 || kaṭākṣairaṅgabhedaiśca mohayitvā muniṃ vibho | lolupaṃ vaśamasmākaṃ kariṣyāmo niyantritam || 49 || vyāsa uvāca ityābhāṣya hariṃ nāryo yayustriśiraso'ntikam | kurvantyo vividhānbhāvānkāmaśāstrocitānapi || 50 || gāyantyastālabhedaistā nṛtyantyaḥ purato muneḥ | taṃ pralobhayituṃ cakrurnānābhāvānvarāṅganāḥ || 51 || nāpaśyatsa taporāśiraṅganānāṃ viḍambanam | indriyāṇi vaśe kṛtvā mūkāndhabadhiraḥ sthitaḥ || 52 || dināni katicittasthurnāryastasyāśrame vare | kurvantyo gānanṛtyādiprapañcānatimohadān || 53 || na cacāla yadā kāmaṃ dhyānācca triśirā muniḥ | parāvṛtya tadā devyaḥ punaḥ śakramupasthitāḥ || 54 || kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarvā devarājamathābruvan | śrāntā dīnā bhayatrastā vivarṇavadanā bhṛśam || 55 || devadeva mahārāja yatnaśca paramaḥ kṛtaḥ | na sa śakyo durādharṣo dhairyāccālayituṃ vibho || 56 || upāyo'nyaḥ prakartavyaḥ sarvathā pākaśāsana | nāsmākaṃ balametasmiṃstāpase vijitendriye || 57 || diṣṭyā vayaṃ na śaptāḥ sma yadanena mahātmanā | muninā vahnitulyena tapasā dyotitena hi || 58 || visṛjyāpsarasaḥ śakraścintayāmāsa mandadhīḥ | tasyaiva ca vadhopāyaṃ pāpabuddhirasāmpratam || 59 || visṛjya lokalajjāṃ sa tathā pāpabhayaṃ bhṛśam | cakāra pāpabuddhiṃ tu tadvadhāya mahīpate || 60 || <6.2> triśiravadhānantaraṃ vṛtrotpattivarṇanam vyāsa uvāca atha sa lobhamupetya surādhipaḥ samadhigamya gajāsanasaṃsthitaḥ | triśirasaṃ prati duṣṭamatistadā munimapaśyadameyaparākramam || 1 || tamabhivīkṣya dṛḍhāsanasaṃsthitaṃ jitagiraṃ susamādhivaśaṃ gatam | ravivibhāvasusannibhamojasā surapatiḥ paramāpadamabhyagāt || 2 || kathamasau vinihantumaho mayā munirapāpamatiḥ kila sammataḥ | ripurayaṃ susamiddhatapobalaḥ kathamupekṣya ihāsanakāmukaḥ || 3 || iti vicintya paviṃ paramāyudhaṃ prati mumoca muniṃ tapasi sthitam | śaśidivākarasannibhamāśugaṃ triśirasaṃ surasaṅghapatiḥ svayam || 4 || tadabhighātahataḥ sa dharātale kila papāta mamāra ca tāpasaḥ | śikhariṇaḥ śikharaṃ kuliśārditaṃ nipatitaṃ bhuvi cādbhutadarśanam || 5 || taṃ nihatya mudamāpa sureśaścukruśuśca munayastu saṃsthitāḥ | hā hateti bhṛśamārtaniḥsvanāḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ śatamakhena pāpinā || 6 || vināparādhaṃ tapasāṃ nidhirhataḥ śacīpatiḥ pāpamatirdurātmā | phalaṃ kilāyaṃ tarasā kṛtasya prāpnotu pāpī hananodbhavasya || 7 || taṃ nihatya tarasā surarājo nirjagāma nijamandiramāśu | sa hato'pi virarāja mahātmā jīvamāna iva tejasāṃ nidhiḥ || 8 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau jīvantamiva vṛtrahā | cintāmāpātikhinnāṅgaḥ kiṃ vā jīvedayaṃ punaḥ || 9 || vimṛśya manasātīva takṣāṇaṃ purataḥ sthitam | maghavā vīkṣya taṃ prāha svakāryasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ || 10 || takṣaṃśchindhi śirāṃsyasya kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama | mā jīvatu mahātejā bhāti jīvanniva svayam || 11 || ityākarṇya vacastasya takṣovāca vigarhayan | takṣovāca mahāskandho bhṛśaṃ bhāti paraśurna tariṣyati || 12 || tato nāhaṃ kariṣyāmi kāryametadvigarhitam | tvayā vai ninditaṃ karma kṛtaṃ sadbhirvigarhitam || 13 || ahaṃ bibhemi pāpādvai mṛtasyaiva ca māraṇe | mṛto'yaṃ munirastyeva śirasaḥ kṛntanena kim || 14 || bhayaṃ kiṃ te'tra sañjātaṃ pākaśāsana kathyatām | indra uvāca sajīva iva deho'yamābhāti viśadākṛtiḥ || 15 || tasmādbibhemi mā jīvenmuniḥ śatrurayaṃ mama | takṣovāca nātra kiṃ trapase vidvan krūreṇānena karmaṇā || 16 || ṛṣiputramimaṃ hatvā brahmahatyābhayaṃ na kim | indra uvāca prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmi paścātpāpakṣayāya vai || 17 || śatrustu sarvathā vadhyaśchalenāpi mahāmate | takṣovāca tvaṃ lobhābhihataḥ pāpaṃ karoṣi maghavanniha || 18 || taṃ vināhaṃ kathaṃ pāpaṃ karomi vada me vibho | indra uvāca makheṣu khalu bhāgaṃ te kariṣyāmi sadaiva hi || 19 || śiraḥ paśostu te bhāgaṃ yajñe dāsyanti mānavāḥ | śulkenānena chindhi tvaṃ śirāṃsyasya kuru priyam || 20 || vyāsa uvāca etacchrutvā mahendrasya vacastakṣā mudānvitaḥ | kuṭhāreṇa śirāṃsyasya cakarta sudṛḍhena hi || 21 || chinnāni trīṇi śīrṣāṇi patitāni yadā bhuvi | tebhyastu pakṣiṇaḥ kṣipraṃ viniṣpetuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 22 || kalaviṅkāstittirayastathaiva ca kapiñjalāḥ | pṛthakpṛthagviniṣpeturmukhatastarasā tadā || 23 || yena vedānadhīte sma somaṃ ca pibate tathā | tasmādvaktrātkilotpetuḥ sadya eva kapiñjalāḥ || 24 || yena sarvā diśaḥ kāmaṃ pibanniva nirīkṣate | tasmāttu tittirāstatra niḥsṛtāstigmatejasaḥ || 25 || yatsurāpaṃ tu tadvaktraṃ tasmāttu caṭakāḥ kila | viniṣpetustriśirasa evaṃ te vihagā nṛpa || 26 || evaṃviniḥsṛtāndṛṣṭvā tebhyaḥ śakrastadāṇḍajān | mumoda manasā rājan jagāma tridivaṃ punaḥ || 27 || gate śakre tu takṣāpi svagṛhaṃ tarasā yayau | yajñabhāgaṃ paraṃ labdhvā mudamāpa mahīpate || 28 || indro'tha svagṛhaṃ gatvā hatvā śatruṃ mahābalam | mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ brahmahatyāmacintayan || 29 || taṃ śrutvā nihataṃ tvaṣṭā putraṃ paramadhārmikam | cukopātīva manasā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 30 || anāgasaṃ muniṃ yasmātputraṃ nihatavānmama | tasmādutpādayiṣyāmi tadvadhārthaṃ sutaṃ punaḥ || 31 || surāḥ paśyantu me vīryaṃ tapasaśca balaṃ tathā | jānātu sarvaṃ pāpātmā svakṛtasya phalaṃ mahat || 32 || ityuktvāgniṃ juhāvātha mantrairātharvaṇoditaiḥ | putrasyotpādanārthāya tvaṣṭā krodhasamākulaḥ || 33 || kṛte home'ṣṭarātraṃ tu sandīptācca vibhāvasoḥ | prādurbabhūva tarasā puruṣaḥ pāvakopamaḥ || 34 || taṃ dṛṣṭvāgre sutaṃ tvaṣṭā tejobalasamanvitam | vegātprakaṭitaṃ vahnerdīpyamānamivānalam || 35 || uvāca vacanaṃ tvaṣṭā sutaṃ vīkṣya puraḥsthitam | indraśatro vivardhasva pratāpāttapaso mama || 36 || ityukte vacane tvaṣṭrā krodhaprajvalitena ca | so'vardhata divaṃ stabdhvā vaiśvānarasamadyutiḥ || 37 || jātaḥ sa parvatākāraḥ kālamṛtyusamaḥ svarāṭ | kiṃ karomīti taṃ prāha pitaraṃ paramāturam || 38 || kuru me nāmakaṃ nātha kāryaṃ kathaya suvrata | cintāturo'si kasmāttvaṃ brūhi me śokakāraṇam || 39 || nāśayāmyadya te śokamiti me vratamāhitam | tena jātena kiṃ bhūyaḥ pitā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ || 40 || pibāmi sāgaraṃ sadyaścūrṇayāmi dharādharān | udyantaṃ vārayāmyadya taraṇiṃ tigmatejasam || 41 || hanmīndraṃ sasuraṃ sadyo yamaṃ vā devatāntaram | kṣipāmi sāgare sarvānsamutpāṭya ca medinīm || 42 || ityākarṇya vacastasya tvaṣṭā putrasya peśalam | pratyuvācātimuditastaṃ sutaṃ parvatopamam || 43 || vṛjināttrātumadhunā yasmācchakto'si putraka | tasmādvṛtra iti khyātaṃ tava nāma bhaviṣyati || 44 || bhrātā tava mahābhāga triśirā nāma tāpasaḥ | trīṇi tasya ca śīrṣāṇi hyabhavanvīryavanti ca || 45 || vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ | saṃsthitastapasi prāyastrilokīvismayaprade || 46 || śakreṇa tu hataḥ so'dya vajraghātena sāmpratam | vināparādhaṃ sahasā chinnāni mastakāni ca || 47 || tasmāttvaṃ puruṣavyāghra jahi śakraṃ kṛtāgasam | brahmahatyāyutaṃ pāpaṃ nistrapaṃ durmatiṃ śaṭham || 48 || ityuktvā ca tadā tvaṣṭā putraśokasamākulaḥ | āyudhāni ca divyāni cakāra vividhāni ca || 49 || dadāvasmai sahasrākṣavadhāya prabalāni ca | khaḍgaśūlagadāśaktitomarapramukhāni vai || 50 || śārṅga dhanustathā bāṇaṃ parighaṃ paṭṭiśaṃ tathā | cakraṃ divyaṃ sahasrāraṃ sudarśanasamaprabham || 51 || tūṇīrau cākṣayau divyau kavacaṃ cātisundaram | rathaṃ meghapratīkāśaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhārasahaṃ javam || 52 || yuddhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā putrāya pārthiva | dattvāsau prerayāmāsa tvaṣṭā krodhasamanvitaḥ || 53 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādalasāhaktyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe triśiravadhānantaraṃ vṛtrotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <6.3> brahmaṇaḥ samārādhanāya tvaṣṭrā vṛtropadeśavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca kṛtasvastyayano vṛtro brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ | nirjagāma rathārūḍho hantuṃ śakraṃ mahābalaḥ || 1 || tadaiva rākṣasāḥ krūrāḥ purā devaparājitāḥ | samājagmuśca sevārthaṃ vṛtraṃ jñātvā mahābalam || 2 || indradūtāstu taṃ dṛṣṭvā yuddhāya tu samāgatam | vegādāgatya vṛttāntaṃ śaśaṃsustasya ceṣṭitam || 3 || dūtā ūcuḥ svāmiñchīghramihāyāti vṛtro nāma ripustava | balavānsyandane rūḍhastvaṣṭrā cotpāditaḥ kila || 4 || avicāreṇa nāśārthaṃ tava krodhānvitena vai | putraghātābhitaptena duḥsaho rākṣasairyutaḥ || 5 || yatnaṃ kuru mahābhāga śīghramāyāti sāmpratam | merumandarasaṃkāśo ghoraśabdo'tidāruṇaḥ || 6 || etasminnantare tatra bhītā devagaṇā bhṛśam | āgatyocuḥ surapatiṃ śṛṇvantaṃ dūtabhāṣitam || 7 || gaṇāḥ ūcuḥ maghavan durnimittāni bhavanti tridaśālaye | bahūni bhayaśaṃsīni pakṣiṇāṃ virutāni ca || 8 || kākagṛdhrāstathā śyenāḥ kaṅkādyā dāruṇāḥ khagāḥ | rudanti vikṛtaiḥ śabdairutkārairbhavanopari || 9 || cīcīkūcīti ninadān kurvanti vihagā bhṛśam | vāhanānāṃ ca netrebhyo jaladhārāḥ patantyadhaḥ || 10 || śrūyate'timahāñchabdo rudatīnāṃ niśāsu ca | rākṣasīnāṃ mahābhāga bhavanopari dāruṇaḥ || 11 || prapatanti dhvajāstūrṇaṃ vinā vātena mānada | prabhavanti mahotpātā divi bhūmyantarikṣajāḥ || 12 || kṛṣṇāmbaradharā nāryo bhramanti ca gṛhe gṛhe | yāntu yāntu gṛhāttūrṇaṃ kurvantyo vikṛtānanāḥ || 13 || rātrau svapneṣu kāntānāṃ suptānāṃ nijamandire | keśām̐llunanti rākṣasyo bhīṣayantyo bhṛśāturāḥ || 14 || evaṃvidhāni deveśa bhūkampolkādayastathā | gomāyavo rudanti sma niśāyāṃ bhavanāṅgaṇe || 15 || saraṭānāṃ ca jālāni prabhavanti gṛhe gṛhe | aṅgaprasphuraṇādīni durnimittāni sarvaśaḥ || 16 || vyāsa uvāca iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā cintāmāpa sureśvaraḥ | bṛhaspatiṃ samāhūya papraccha ca manogatam || 17 || indra uvāca brahman kimuta ghorāṇi nimittāni bhavanti vai | vātāśca dāruṇā vānti prapatantyulakāḥ khataḥ || 18 || sarvajño'si mahābhāga samartho vighnanāśane | buddhimāñchāstratattvajño devatānāṃ gurustathā || 19 || kuru śāntiṃ vidhānajña śatrukṣayavidhāyinīm | yathā me na bhavedduḥkhaṃ tathā kāryaṃ vidhīyatām || 20 || bṛhaspatiruvāca kiṃ karomi sahasrākṣa tvayādya duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | anāgasaṃ muniṃ hatvā kiṃ phalaṃ samupārjitam || 21 || atyugraṃ puṇyapāpānāṃ phalaṃ bhavati satvaram | vicārya khalu kartavyaṃ kāryaṃ tadbhūtimicchatā || 22 || paropatāpanaṃ karma na kartavyaṃ kadācana | na sukhaṃ vindate prāṇī parapīḍāparāyaṇaḥ || 23 || mohāllobhādbrahmahatyā kṛtā śakra tvayādhunā | tasya pāpasya sahasā phalametadupāgatam || 24 || avadhyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ jāto'sau vṛtrasaṃjñakaḥ | hantuṃ tvāṃ sa samāyāti dānavairbahubhirvṛtaḥ || 25 || āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi vajratulyāni vāsava | tvaṣṭrā dattāni divyāni gṛhītvā samupasthitaḥ || 26 || samāgacchati durdharṣo rathārūḍhaḥ pratāpavān | devendra pralayaṃ kurvannāsya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || 27 || kolāhalastadā jātastathā bruvati vākpatau | gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā munayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 28 || sadanāni vihāyaivāmarāḥ sarve palāyitāḥ | taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ śakraścintāparāyaṇaḥ || 29 || ājñāpayāmāsa tadā senodyogāya sevakān | ānayadhvaṃ vasūn rudrānaśvinau ca divākarān || 30 || pūṣaṇaṃ ca bhagaṃ vāyuṃ kuberaṃ varuṇaṃ yamam | vimāneṣu samāruhya sāyudhāḥ surasattamāḥ || 31 || samāgacchantu tarasā śatrurāyāti sāmpratam | ityājñāpya surapatiḥ samāruhya gajottamam || 32 || bṛhaspatiṃ purodhāya nirgato nijamandirāt | tathaiva tridaśāḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ vāhanamāsthitāḥ || 33 || yuddhāya kṛtasaṃkalpā niryayuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | vṛtro'tha dānavairyuktaḥ samprāpto mānasottaram || 34 || parvataṃ devatāvāsaṃ ramyaṃ pādapaśobhitam | indro'pyāgatya saṃgrāmaṃ cakāra mānasottare || 35 || parvate devatāyukto vācaspatipuraḥsaraḥ | tatrābhūddāruṇaṃ yuddhaṃ vṛtravāsavayostadā || 36 || gadāsiparighaiḥ pāśairbāṇaiḥ śaktiparaśvadhaiḥ | mānuṣeṇa pramāṇena saṃgrāmaḥ śaradāṃ śatam || 37 || babhūva bhayado nṝṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām | varuṇaḥ prathamaṃ bhagnastato vāyugaṇaḥ kila || 38 || yamo vibhāvasuḥ śakraḥ sarve te nirgatā raṇāt | palāyanaparān dṛṣṭvā devānindrapurogamān || 39 || vṛtro'pi pitaraṃ prāgādāśramasthaṃ mudānvitam | praṇamya prāha tvaṣṭāraṃ pitaḥ kāryaṃ mayā kṛtam || 40 || devā vinirjitāḥ sarve sendrāḥ samarasaṃsthitāḥ | vidrutāste gatāḥ sthānaṃ yathā siṃhānmṛgā gajāḥ || 41 || indraḥ padātiragamanmayānīto gajottamaḥ | airāvato'yaṃ bhagavan gṛhāṇa dviradottamam || 42 || na hatāste mayā yasmādayuktaṃ bhītamāraṇam | ājñāpaya punastāta kiṃ karomi tavepsitam || 43 || nirjarā nirgatāḥ sarve bhayabhītā śramāturāḥ | indro'pyairāvataṃ tyaktvā bhayabhītaḥ palāyitaḥ || 44 || vyāsa uvāca iti putravacaḥ śrutvā tvaṣṭā prāha mudānvitaḥ | putravānadya jāto'smi saphalaṃ mama jīvitam || 45 || tvayāhaṃ pāvitaḥ putra gato me mānaso jvaraḥ | niścalaṃ me mano jātaṃ dṛṣṭvā vīryaṃ tavādbhutam || 46 || śṛṇu vakṣyāmyahaṃ putra hitaṃ te'dya niśāmaya | tapaḥ kuru mahābhāga sāvadhānaḥ sthirāsanaḥ || 47 || viśvāso naiva kartavyaḥ keṣāñcitpākaśāsanaḥ | śatruste chalakartāsti nānābhedaviśāradaḥ || 48 || tapasā prāpyate lakṣmīstapasā rājyamuttamam | tapasā balavṛddhiḥ syātsaṃgrāme vijayastathā || 49 || ārādhya druhiṇaṃ devaṃ labdhvā varamanuttamam | jahi śakraṃ durācāraṃ brahmahatyāsamāvṛtam || 50 || sāvadhānaḥ sthiro bhūtvā dātāraṃ bhaja śaṅkaram | vāñchitaṃ sa varaṃ dadyātsantuṣṭaścaturānanaḥ || 51 || toṣayitvā viśvayoniṃ brahmāṇamamitaujasam | avināśitvamāsādya jahi śakraṃ kṛtāgasam || 52 || vairaṃ manasi me putra vartate sutaghātajam | na śāntimanugacchāmi na svapāmi sukhena ha || 53 || tāpaso me hataḥ putro nirāgāḥ pāpmanā yataḥ | na vindāmi sukhaṃ vṛtra tvaṃ māmuddhara duḥkhitam || 54 || vyāsa uvāca tadākarṇya piturvākyaṃ vṛtraḥ krodhayutastadā | ājñāmādāya ca piturjagāma tapase mudā || 55 || gandhamādanamāsādya puṇyāṃ devadhunīṃ śubhām | snātvā kuśāsanaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthitaśca sthirāsanaḥ || 56 || tyaktvānnaṃ vāripānaṃ ca yogābhyāsaparāyaṇaḥ | dhyāyanviśvasṛjaṃ citte sopaviṣṭaḥ sthirāsane || 57 || maghavā taṃ tapasyantaṃ jñātvā cintāturo hyabhūt | gandharvānpreṣayāmāsa vighnārthaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ || 58 || yakṣāṃśca pannagānsarpānkinnarānamitaujasaḥ | vidyādharānapsaraso devadūtānanekaśaḥ || 59 || upāyāstaiḥ kṛtāḥ samyak tapovighnāya māyibhiḥ | na cacāla tato dhyānāttvāṣṭraḥ paramatāpasaḥ || 60 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe brahmaṇaḥ samārādhanāya tvaṣṭrā vṛtropadeśavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <6.4> brahmanetṛtve sendraiḥ surairviṣṇoḥ śaraṇagamanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca nirgatāste parāvṛttāstapovighnakarāḥ surāḥ | nirāśāḥ kāryasaṃsiddhyai taṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛḍhacetasam || 1 || jāte varṣaśate pūrṇe brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | tatrājagāma tarasā haṃsārūḍhaścaturmukhaḥ || 2 || āgatya tamuvācedaṃ tvaṣṭṭaputra sukhī bhava | tyaktvā dhyānaṃ varaṃ brūhi dadāmi tava vāñchitam || 3 || tapasā te'dya tuṣṭo'smi tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā cātikarśitam | varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te mano'bhilaṣitaṃ tava || 4 || vyāsa uvāca vṛtrastadātiviśadāṃ purato niśamya vācaṃ sudhāsamarasāṃ jagadekakartuḥ | santyajya yogakalanāṃ sahasodatiṣṭhatsañjātaharṣanayanāśrukalākalāpaḥ || 5 || pādau praṇamya śirasā praṇayādvidhāturbaddhāñjaliḥ purata eva samāsasāda | provāca taṃ suvaradaṃ tapasā prasannaṃ premṇātigadgadagirā vinayena namraḥ || 6 || prāptaṃ mayā sakaladevapadaṃ prabho'dya yaddarśanaṃ tava sudurlabhamāśu jātam | vāñchāsti nātha manasi pravaṇe durāpā tāṃ prabravīmi kamalāsana vetsi bhāvam || 7 || mṛtyuśca mā bhavatu me kila lohakāṣṭhaśuṣkārdravaṃśanicayairaparaiśca śastraiḥ | vṛddhi prayātu mama vīryamatīva yuddhe yasmādbhavāmi sabalairamarairajeyaḥ || 8 || vyāsa uvāca itthaṃ samprārthito brahmā tamāha prahasanniva | uttiṣṭha gaccha bhadraṃ te vāñchitaṃ saphalaṃ sadā || 9 || na śuṣkeṇa na cārdreṇa na pāṣāṇena dāruṇā | bhaviṣyati ca te mṛtyuriti satyaṃ bravīmyaham || 10 || iti dattvā varaṃ brahmā jagāma bhuvanaṃ param | vṛtrastu taṃ varaṃ labdhā muditaḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau || 11 || śaśaṃsa pituragre tadvaradānaṃ mahāmatiḥ | tvaṣṭā tu muditaḥ prāptaṃ putraṃ prāptavaraṃ tadā || 12 || svasti te'stu mahābhāga jahi śakraṃ ripuṃ mama | hatvāgaccha triśiraso hantāraṃ pāpasaṃyutam || 13 || bhava tvaṃ tridaśādhīśaḥ samprāpya vijayaṃ raṇe | mamādhiṃ chindhi vipulaṃ putranāśasamudbhavam || 14 || jīvato vākyakaraṇātkṣayāhe bhūribhojanāt | gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānācca tribhiḥ putrasya putratā || 15 || tasmātputra mamātyarthaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāśitumarhasi | triśirā mama cittāttu nāpasarpati karhicit || 16 || suśīlaḥ satyavādī ca tāpaso vedavittamaḥ | aparādhaṃ vinā tena nihataḥ pāpabuddhinā || 17 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā vṛtraḥ paramadurjayaḥ | rathamāruhya tarasā nirjagāma piturgṛhāt || 18 || raṇadundubhinirghoṣaṃ śaṅkhanādaṃ mahābalam | kārayitvā prayāṇaṃ sa cakāra madagarvitaḥ || 19 || niryayau nayasaṃyuktaḥ sevakāniti saṃvadan | hatvā śakraṃ grahīṣyāmi surarājyamakaṇṭakam || 20 || ityuktvā nirjagāmāśu svasainyaparivāritaḥ | mahatā sainyanādena bhīṣayannamarāvatīm || 21 || tamāgacchantamājñāya turāṣāḍapi satvaraḥ | senodyogaṃ bhayatrastaḥ kārayāmāsa bhārata || 22 || sarvānāhūya tarasā lokapālānarindamaḥ | yuddhārthaṃ prerayansarvānvyarocata mahādyutiḥ || 23 || gṛdhranvyūhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā saṃsthitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | tatrājagāma vegāttu vṛtraḥ parabalārdanaḥ || 24 || devadānavayostāvatsaṃgrāmastumulo'bhavat | vṛtravāsavayoḥ saṃkhye manasā vijayaiṣiṇoḥ || 25 || evaṃ parasparaṃ yuddhe sandīpte bhayade bhṛśam | ākūtaṃ devatāḥ prāpurdaityāśca paramāṃ mudam || 26 || tomarairbhindipālaiśca khaḍgaiḥ paraśupaṭṭiśaiḥ | jaghnuḥ parasparaṃ devadaityā svasvavarāyudhaiḥ || 27 || evaṃ yuddhe vartamāne dāruṇe lomaharṣaṇe | śakraṃ jagrāha sahasā vṛtraḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ || 28 || apāvṛtya mukhe kṣiptvā sthito vṛtraḥ śatakratum | mudito'bhūnmahārāja pūrvavairamanusmaran || 29 || śakre graste'tha vṛtreṇa saṃbhrāntā nirjarāstadā | cukruśaḥ paramārtāste hā śakreti muhurmuhuḥ || 30 || apāvṛtaṃ mukhe śakraṃ jñātvā sarve divaukasaḥ | bṛhaspatiṃ praṇamyocurdīnā vyathitacetasaḥ || 31 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha tvamasmākaṃ guruḥ paraḥ | śakro grastastu vṛtreṇa rakṣito devatāntaraiḥ || 32 || vinā śakreṇa kiṃ kurmaḥ sarve hīnaparākramāḥ | abhicāraṃ kuru vibho satvaraḥ śakramuktaye || 33 || bṛhaspatiruvāca kiṃ kartavyaṃ surāḥ kṣipto mukhamadhye'sti vāsavaḥ | vṛtreṇotsādito jīvannasti koṣṭhāntare ripoḥ || 34 || vyāsa uvāca devāścintāturāḥ sarve turāsāhaṃ tathākṛtam | dṛṣṭvā vimṛśya tarasā cakruryatnaṃ vimuktaye || 35 || asṛjanta mahāsattvāṃ jṛmbhikāṃ ripunāśinīm | tato vijṛmbhamāṇaḥ sa vyāvṛtāsyo babhūva ha || 36 || vijṛmbhamāṇasya tato vṛtrasyāsyādavāpatat | svānyaṅgānyapi saṃkṣipya niṣkrānto balasūdanaḥ || 37 || tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu jṛmbhikā prāṇisaṃsthitā | jahṛṣuśca surāḥ sarve śakraṃ dṛṣṭvā vinirgatam || 38 || tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tayorlokabhayapradam | varṣāṇāmayutaṃ yāvaddāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam || 39 || ekataśca surāḥ sarve yuddhāya samupasthitāḥ | ekato balavāṃstvāṣṭraḥ saṃgrāme samavartata || 40 || yadā vyavardhata raṇe vṛtro varamadāvṛtaḥ | parājitastadā śakrastejasā tasya dharṣitaḥ || 41 || vivyathe maghavā yuddhe tataḥ prāpya parājayam | viṣādamagamandevā dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ parājitam || 42 || jagmustyaktvā raṇaṃ sarve devā indrapurogamāḥ | gṛhītaṃ devasadanaṃ vṛtreṇāgatya raṃhasā || 43 || devodyānānisarvāṇi bhuṅkte'sau dānavo balāt | airāvato'pi daityena gṛhīto'sau gajottamaḥ || 44 || vimānāni ca sarvāṇi gṛhītāni viśāmpate | uccaiḥśravā hayavaro jātastasya vaśe tadā || 45 || kāmadhenuḥ pārijāto gaṇaścāpsarasāṃ tathā | gṛhītaṃ ratnamātraṃ tu tena tvaṣṭṭasutena ha || 46 || sthānabhraṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve giridurgeṣu saṃsthitāḥ | duḥkhamāpuḥ paribhraṣṭā yajñabhāgātsurālayāt || 47 || vṛtraḥ surapadaṃ prāpya babhūva madagarvitaḥ | tvaṣṭātīva sukhaṃ prāpya mumoda sutasaṃyutaḥ || 48 || amantrayanhitaṃ devā munibhiḥ saha bhārata | kiṃ kartavyamiti prāpte vicintya bhayamohitāḥ || 49 || jagmuḥ kailāsamacalaṃ surāḥ śakrasamanvitāḥ | mahādevaṃ praṇamyocuḥ prahvāḥ prāñjalayo bhṛśam || 50 || devadeva mahādeva kṛpāsindho maheśvara | rakṣāsmānbhayabhītāṃstu vṛtreṇātiparājitān || 51 || gṛhītaṃ devasadanaṃ tena deva balīyasā | kiṃ kartavyamataḥ śambho brūhi satyaṃ śivādya naḥ || 52 || kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ sthānabhraṣṭā maheśvara | duḥkhasya nādhigacchāmo vināśopāyamīśvara || 53 || sāhāyyaṃ kuru bhūteśa vyathitāḥ sma kṛpānidhe | vṛtraṃ jahi madotsiktaṃ varadānabalādvibho || 54 || śiva uvāca brahmāṇaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā vayaṃ sarve hareḥ kṣayam | gatvā sametya taṃ viṣṇuṃ cintayāmo vadhodyamam || 55 || sa śaktaśca chalajñaśca balavānbuddhimattaraḥ | śaraṇyaśca dayābdhiśca vāsudevo janārdanaḥ || 56 || vinā taṃ devadeveśaṃ nārthasiddhirbhaviṣyati | tasmāttatra ca gantavyaṃ sarvakāryārthasiddhaye || 57 || vyāsa uvāca iti sañcintya te sarve brahmā śakraḥ saśaṅkaraḥ | jagmurviṣṇoḥ kṣayaṃ devāḥ śaraṇyaṃ bhaktavatsalam || 58 || gatvā viṣṇupadaṃ devāstuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram | hariṃ puruṣasūktena vedoktena jagadgurum || 59 || pratyakṣo'bhūjjagannāthasteṣāṃ sa kamalāpatiḥ | sammānya ca surānsarvānityuvāca puraḥsthitaḥ || 60 || kimāgatāḥ sma lokeśā harabrahmasamanvitāḥ | kāraṇaṃ kathayadhvaṃ vaḥ sarveṣāṃ surasattamāḥ || 61 || vyāsa uvāca iti śrutvā harervākyaṃ nocurdevā ramāpatim | cintāviṣṭāḥ sthitāḥ prāyaḥ sarveprāñjalayastathā || 62 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe brahmanetṛtve sendraiḥ surairviṣṇoḥ śaraṇagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <6.5> devīsamārādhanāya devakṛtastutivarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tathā cintāturānvīkṣya sarvānmarvārthatattvavit | prāha premabharodbhrāntānmādhavo medinīpate || 1 || viṣṇuruvāca kiṃ maunamāśritā yūyaṃ bruvantu kāraṇaṃ surāḥ | sadasadvāpi yacchrutvā yatiṣye tannivāraṇe || 2 || devā ūcuḥ kimajñātaṃ tava vibho triṣu lokeṣu vartate | sarvaṃ veda bhavānkāryaṃ kiṃ pṛcchasi punaḥ punaḥ || 3 || tvayā pūrvaṃ balirbaddhaḥ śakro devādhipaḥ kṛtaḥ | vāmanaṃ vapurāsthāya krāntaṃ tribhuvanaṃ padaiḥ || 4 || amṛtaṃ tvāhṛtaṃ viṣṇo daityāśca vinipātitāḥ | tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvadevānāṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇe || 5 || viṣṇuruvāca na bhetavyaṃ suravarā vedmyupāyaṃ susammatam | tadvadhāya pravakṣyāmi yena saukhyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 6 || avaśyaṃ karaṇīyaṃ me bhavatāṃ hitamātmanā | buddhyā balena cārthena yena kenacchalena vā || 7 || upāyāḥ khalu catvāraḥ kathitāstattvadarśibhiḥ | sāmādayaḥ suhṛtsveva durhṛdeṣu viśeṣataḥ || 8 || brahmaṇāsya varo dattastapasā''rādhitena ca | durjayatvaṃ ca samprāptaṃ varadānaprabhāvataḥ || 9 || ajeyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṣṭrā samupapāditaḥ | tato balena vṛddhiṃ sa prāptaḥ parapurañjayaḥ || 10 || duḥsādhyo'sau surāḥ śatrurvinā sāmapratāraṇam | pralobhya vaśamāneyo hantavyastu tataḥ param || 11 || gacchadhvaṃ sarvagandharvā yatrāsti balavattaraḥ | sāma tasya prayuñjadhvaṃ tata enaṃ vijeṣyatha || 12 || saṅgamya śapathātkṛtvā viśvāsya samayena hi | mitratvaṃ ca samādhāya hantavyaḥ prabalo ripuḥ || 13 || adṛśyaḥ sampravekṣyāmi vajramasya varāyudham | sāhāyyaṃ ca kariṣyāmi śakrasyāhaṃ surottamāḥ || 14 || samayaṃ ca pratīkṣadhvaṃ sarvathaivāyuṣaḥ kṣaye | maraṇaṃ vibudhāstasya nānyathā sambhaviṣyati || 15 || gacchadhvamṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ gandharvāḥ kapaṭāvṛtāḥ | indreṇa saha mitratvaṃ kurudhvaṃ vākyadānataḥ || 16 || yathā sa yāti viśvāsaṃ tathā kāryaṃ pratāraṇam | gupto'haṃ sampravekṣyāmi paviṃ sañchāditaṃ dṛḍham || 17 || viśvastaṃ maghavā śatruṃ haniṣyati na cānyathā | viśvāsasya kṛte pāpaṃ kṛtvā śakrastu pṛṣṭhataḥ || 18 || matsahāyo'tha vajreṇa śātayiṣyati pāpinam | na doṣo'tra śaṭhe śatrau śāṭhyameva prakurvataḥ || 19 || nānyathā balavānvadhyaḥ śūradharmeṇa jāyate | vāmanaṃ rūpamādhāya mayāyaṃ vañcito baliḥ || 20 || kṛtvā ca mohinīveṣaṃ daityāḥ sarve'pivañcitāḥ | bhavantaḥ sahitāḥ sarve devīṃ bhagavatīṃ śivām || 21 || gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhāvaiḥ stotramantraiḥ surottamāḥ | sāhāyyaṃ sā yogamāyā bhavatāṃ saṃvidhāsyati || 22 || vandāmahe sadā devīṃ sāttvikīṃ prakṛtiṃ parām | siddhidāṃ kāmadāṃ kāmāṃ durāpāmakṛtātmabhiḥ || 23 || indro'pi tāṃ samārādhya haniṣyati ripuṃ raṇe | mohinī sā mahāmāyā mohayiṣyati dānavam || 24 || mohito māyayā vṛtraḥ sukhasādhyo bhaviṣyati | prasannāyāṃ parāmbāyāṃ sarvaṃ sādhyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 25 || nocenmanorathāvāptirna kasyāpi bhaviṣyati | antaryāmisvarūpā sā sarvakāraṇakāraṇā || 26 || tasmāttāṃ viśvajananīṃ prakṛtiṃ paramādṛtāḥ | bhajadhvaṃ sāttvikairbhāvaiḥ śatrunāśāya sattamāḥ || 27 || purā mayāpi saṃgrāmaṃ kṛtvā paramadāruṇam | pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi nihatau madhukaiṭabhau || 28 || stutā mayā tadātyarthaṃ prasannā prakṛtiḥ parā | mohitau tau tadā daityau chalena ca mayā hatau || 29 || vipralabdhau mahābāhū dānavau madagarvitau | tathā kurudhvaṃ prakṛterbhajanaṃ bhāvasaṃyutāḥ || 30 || sarvathā kāryasiddhiṃ sā kariṣyati surottamāḥ | evaṃ te dattamatayo viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 31 || jagmuste meruśikharaṃ mandāradrumamaṇḍitam | ekānte saṃsthitā devāḥ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ japaṃ tapaḥ || 32 || tuṣṭuvurjagatāṃ dhātrīṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇīm | bhaktakāmadughāmambāṃ saṃsārakleśanāśinīm || 33 || devā ūcuḥ devi prasīda paripāhi surānprataptān vṛtrāsureṇa samare paripīḍitāṃśca | dīnārtināśanapare paramārthatattve prāptāṃstvadaṅghrikamalaṃ śaraṇaṃ sadaiva || 34 || tvaṃ sarvaviśvajananī paripālayāsmān putrānivātipatitān ripusaṅkaṭe'smin | mātarna te'styaviditaṃ bhuvanatraye'pi kasmādupekṣasi surānasuraprataptān || 35 || trailokyametadakhilaṃ vihitaṃ tvayaiva brahmā hariḥ paśupatistava vāsanotthāḥ | kurvanti kāryamakhilaṃ svavaśā na te te bhrūbhaṅgacālanavaśādviharanti kāmam || 36 || mātā sutānparibhavātparipāti dīnān rītistvayaiva racitā prakaṭāparādhān | kasmānna pālayasi devi vināparādhānasmāṃstvadaṅghriśaraṇānkaruṇārasābdhe || 37 || nūnaṃ madaṅghribhajanāptapadāḥ kilaite bhaktiṃ vihāya vibhave sukhabhogalubdhāḥ | neme kaṭākṣaviṣayā iti cenna caiṣā rītiḥ sute jananakartari cāpi dṛṣṭā || 38 || doṣo na no'tra janani pratibhāti citte yatte vihāya bhajanaṃ vibhave nimagnāḥ | mohastvayā viracitaḥ prabhavatyasau nastasmātsvabhāvakaruṇe dayase kathaṃ na || 39 || pūrvaṃ tvayā janani daityapatirbaliṣṭho vyāpādito mahiṣarūpadharaḥ kilājau | asmatkṛte sakalalokabhayāvaho'sau vṛtraṃ kathaṃ na bhayadaṃ vidhunoṣi mātaḥ || 40 || śumbhastathātibalavānanujo niśumbhastau bhrātarau tadanugā nihatā hatau ca | vṛtraṃ tathā jahi khalaṃ prabalaṃ dayārdre mattaṃ vimohaya tathā na bhavedyathāsau || 41 || tvaṃ pālayādya vibudhānasureṇa mātaḥ santāpitānatitarāṃ bhayavihvalāṃśca | nānyo'sti ko'pi bhuvaneṣu surārtihantā yaḥ kleśajālamakhilaṃ nidahetsvaśaktyā || 42 || vṛtre dayā tava yadi prathitā tathāpi jahyenamāśu janaduḥkhakaraṃ khalaṃ ca | pāpātsamuddhara bhavāni śaraiḥ punānā nocetprayāsyati tamo nanu duṣṭabuddhiḥ || 43 || te prāpitāḥ suravanaṃ vibudhārayo ye hatvā raṇe'pi viśikhaiḥ kila pāvitāste | trātā na kiṃ nirayapātabhayāddayārdre yacchatravo'pi na hi kiṃ vinihaṃsi vṛtram || 44 || jānīmahe ripurasau tava sevako na prāyeṇa pīḍayati naḥ kila pāpabuddhiḥ | yastāvakastviha bhavedamarānasau kiṃ tvatpādapaṅkajaratānnanu pīḍayedvā || 45 || kurmaḥ kathaṃ janani pūjanamadya te'mba puṣpādikaṃ tava vinirmitameva yasmāt | mantrā vayaṃ ca sakalaṃ paraśaktirūpaṃ tasmādbhavāni caraṇe praṇatāḥ sma nūnam || 46 || dhanyāsta eva manujā hi bhajanti bhaktyā pādāmbujaṃ tava bhavābdhijaleṣu potam | yaṃ yogino'pi manasā satataṃ smaranti mokṣārthino vigatarāgavikāramohāḥ || 47 || ye yājñikāḥ sakalavedavido'pi nūnaṃ tvāṃ saṃsmaranti satataṃ kila homakāle | svāhāṃ tu tṛptijananīmamareśvarāṇāṃ bhūyaḥ svadhāṃ pitṛgaṇasya ca tṛptihetum || 48 || medhāsi kāntirasi śāntirapi prasiddhā buddhistvameva viśadārthakarī narāṇām | sarvaṃ tvameva vibhavaṃ bhuvanatraye'sminkṛtvā dadāsi bhajatāṃ kṛpayā sadaiva || 49 || vyāsa uvāca evaṃ stutā surairdevī pratyakṣā sābhavattadā | cārurūpadharā tanvī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 50 || pāśāṃkuśavarābhītilasadbāhucatuṣṭayā | raṇatkiṅkiṇikājālarasanābaddhasatkaṭiḥ || 51 || kalakaṇṭhīravā kāntā kvaṇatkaṅkaṇanūpurā | candrakhaṇḍasamābaddharatnamaulivirājitā || 52 || mandasmitāravindāsyā netratrayavibhūṣitā | pārijātaprasūnācchanālavarṇasamaprabhā || 53 || raktāmbaraparīdhānā raktacandanacarcitā | prasādasumukhī devī karuṇārasasāgarā || 54 || sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvadvaitāraṇiḥ parā | sarvajñā sarvakartrī ca sarvādhiṣṭhānarūpiṇī || 55 || sarvavedāntasaṃsiddhā saccidānandarūpiṇī | praṇemustāṃ samālokya surā devīṃ puraḥsthitām || 56 || tānāha praṇatānambā kiṃ vaḥ kāryaṃ bruvantu mām | devā ūcuḥ mohayainaṃ ripuṃ vṛtraṃ devānāmatiduḥkhadam || 57 || yathā viśvasate devāṃstathā kuru vimohitam | āyudhe ca balaṃ dehi hataḥ syādyena vā ripuḥ || 58 || vyāsa uvāca tathetyuktvā bhagavatī tatraivāntaradhīyata | svāni svāni niketāni jagmurdevā mudānvitāḥ || 59 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe devīsamārādhanāya devakṛtastutivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <6.6> chadmenendreṇa phenadvārā parāśaktismaraṇapūrvakaṃ vṛtrahananavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca evaṃ prāptavarā devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | (jagmuḥ sarve ca sammantrya vṛtrasyāśramamuttamam |) dadṛśustatra taṃ vṛtraṃ jvalantamiva tejasā || 1 || dhakṣyantamiva lokāṃstrīngrasantamiva cāmarān | ṛṣayo'tha tato'bhyetya vṛtramūcuḥ priyaṃ vacaḥ || 2 || devakāryārthasiddhyarthaṃ sāmayuktaṃ rasātmakam | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vṛtra vṛtra mahābhāga sarvalokabhayaṅkara || 3 || vyāptaṃ tvayaitatsakalaṃ brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ kila | śakreṇa tava vairaṃ yattattu saukhyavighātakam || 4 || yuvayorduḥkhadaṃ kāmaṃ cintāvṛddhikaraṃ param | na tvaṃ svapiṣi santuṣṭo na cāpi maghavā tathā || 5 || sukhaṃ svapiti cintārto dvayoryadvairijaṃ bhayam | yuvayoryudhyatoḥ kālo vyatītastu mahāniha || 6 || pīḍyante ca prajāḥ sarvāḥ sadevāsuramānavāḥ | saṃsāre'tra sukhaṃ grāhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ heyamiti sthitiḥ || 7 || na sukhaṃ kṛtavairasya bhavatīti vinirṇayaḥ | saṃgrāmarasikāḥ śūrāḥ praśaṃsanti na paṇḍitāḥ || 8 || yuddhaṃ śṛṅgāracaturā indriyārthavighātakam | puṣpairapi na yoddhavyaṃ kiṃ punarniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 9 || yuddhe vijayasandeho niścayaṃ bāṇatāḍanam | daivādhīnamidaṃ viśvaṃ tathā jayaparājayau || 10 || daivādhīnāviti jñātvā na yoddhavyaṃ kadācana | kāle'tha bhojanaṃ snānaṃ śayyāyāṃ śayanaṃ tathā || 11 || paricaryāparā bhāryā saṃsāre sukhasādhanam | kiṃ sukhaṃ yudhyataḥ saṃkhye bāṇavṛṣṭibhayaṅkare || 12 || khaḍgapātātiraudre ca tathārātisukhaprade | saṃgrāme maraṇātsvargasukhaprāptiriti sphuṭam || 13 || pralobhanaparaṃ vākyaṃ nodanārthaṃ nirarthakam | chittvā dehaṃ vyathāṃ prāpya śṛgālakaraṭādibhiḥ || 14 || paścātsvargasukhāvāptiṃ ko vā vāñchati mandadhīḥ | sakhyaṃ bhavatu te vṛtra śakreṇa saha nityadā || 15 || avāpsyasi sukhaṃ tvaṃ ca śakraścāpi nirantaram | vayaṃ ca tāpasāḥ sarve gandharvāśca nijāśrame || 16 || sukhavāsaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ śānte vaire'dhunaiva vām | saṃgrāme yuvayordhīra vartamāne divāniśam || 17 || pīḍyante munayaḥ sarve gandharvāḥ kinnarā narāḥ | sarveṣāṃ śāntikāmānāṃ sakhyamicchāmahe vayam || 18 || munayastvaṃ ca śakraśca prāpnuvantu sukhaṃ kila | madhyasthāśca vayaṃ vṛtra yuvayoḥ sakhyakāraṇe || 19 || śapathaṃ kārayitvātra yojayāmo mithaḥ priyam | śakrastu śapathānkṛtvā yathoktāṃśca tavāgrataḥ || 20 || cittaṃ te prītisaṃyuktaṃ kariṣyati tu sāmpratam | satyādhārā dharā nūnaṃ satyena ca divākaraḥ || 21 || tapatyayaṃ yathākālaṃ vāyuḥ satyena vātyatha | udanvānapi maryādāṃ satyenaiva na muñcati || 22 || tasmātsatyena sakhyaṃ vā bhavatvadya yathāsukham | ekatra śayanaṃ krīḍā jalakeliṃ sukhāsanam || 23 || yuvābhyāṃ sarvathā kāryaṃ kartavyaṃ sakhyametya ca | vyāsa uvāca maharṣivacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca mahāmatiḥ || 24 || avaśyaṃ bhagavanto me mānanīyāstapasvinaḥ | bhavanto munayaḥ kvāpi na mithyāvādino bhṛśam || 25 || sadācārāḥ suśāntāśca na viduśchalakāraṇam | kṛtavaire śaṭhe stabdhe kāmuke ca gatatviṣi || 26 || nirlajje naiva kartavyaṃ sakhyaṃ matimatā sadā | nirlajjo'yaṃ durācāro brahmahā lampaṭaḥ śaṭhaḥ || 27 || na viśvāsastu kartavyaḥ sarvathaivedṛśe jane | bhavanto nipuṇāḥ sarve na drohamatayaḥ sadā || 28 || anabhijñāstu śāntatvāccittānāmativādinām | munaya ūcuḥ jantuḥ kṛtasya bhoktā vai śubhasya tvaśubhasya ca || 29 || drohaṃ kṛtvā kutaḥ śāntimāpnuyānnaṣṭacetanaḥ | viśvāsaghātakartāro narakaṃ yānti niścayam || 30 || duḥkhaṃ ca samavāpnoti nūnaṃ viśvāsaghātakaḥ | niṣkṛtirbrahmahantṝṇāṃ surāpānāṃ ca niṣkṛtiḥ || 31 || viśvāsaghātināṃ naiva mitradrohakṛtāmapi | samayaṃ brūhi sarvajña yathā te cetasi dhruvam || 32 || tenaiva samayenādya sandhiḥ syādubhayoḥ kila | vṛtra uvāca na śuṣkeṇa na cārdreṇa nāśmanā na ca dāruṇā || 33 || na vajreṇa mahābhāga na divā niśi naiva ca | vadhyo bhaveyaṃ viprendrāḥ śakrasya saha daivataiḥ || 34 || evaṃ me rocate sandhiḥ śakreṇa saha nānyathā | vyāsa uvāca ṛṣayastaṃ tadā prāhurbāḍhamityeva cādṛtāḥ || 35 || samayaṃ śrāvayāmāsustatrānīya sureśvaram | indro'pi śapathāṃstatra cakāra vigatajvaraḥ || 36 || sākṣiṇaṃ pāvakaṃ kṛtvā munīnāṃ sannidhau kila | vṛtrastu vacanaistasya viśvāsamagamattadā || 37 || babhūva mitravacchakre sahacaryāparāyaṇaḥ | kadācinnandane cobhau kadācidgandhamādane || 38 || kadācidudadhestīre modamānau viceratuḥ | evaṃ kṛte ca sandhāne vṛtraḥ pramudito'bhavat || 39 || śakro'pi vadhakāmastu tadupāyānacintayat | randhrānveṣī samudvignastadāsīnmaghavā bhṛśam || 40 || evaṃ cintayatastasya kālaḥ samabhivartata | viśvāsaṃ paramaṃ prāpa vṛtraḥ śakre'tidāruṇe || 41 || evaṃ katicidabdāni gatāni samaye kṛte | vṛtrasya maraṇopāyānmanasīndro'pyacintayat || 42 || tvaṣṭaikadā sutaṃ prāha viśvastaṃ pākaśāsane | putra vṛtra mahābhāga śṛṇu me vacanaṃ hitam || 43 || na viśvāsastu kartavyaḥ kṛtavaire kathañcana | maghavā kṛtavairaste sadāsūyāparaḥ paraiḥ || 44 || lobhānmatto dveṣarataḥ paraduḥkhotsavānvitaḥ | paradāralampaṭaḥ sa pāpabuddhiḥ pratārakaḥ || 45 || randhrānveṣī drohaparo māyāvī madagarvitaḥ | yaḥ praviśyodare māturgarbhacchedaṃ cakāra ha || 46 || saptakṛtvaḥ saptakṛtvaḥ krandamānamanāturaḥ | tasmātputra na kartavyo viśvāsastu kathañcana || 47 || kṛtapāpasya kā lajjā punaḥ putra prakurvataḥ | vyāsa uvāca evaṃ prabodhitaḥ pitrā vacanairhetusaṃyutaiḥ || 48 || na bubodha tadā vṛtra āsannamaraṇaḥ kila | sa kadācitsamudrānte tamapaśyanmahāsuram || 49 || sandhyākāla upāvṛtte muhūrte'tīva dāruṇe | tataḥ sañcintya maghavā varadānaṃ mahātmanām || 50 || sandhyeyaṃ vartate raudrā na rātrirdivaso na ca | hantavyo'yaṃ mayā cādya balenaiva na saṃśayaḥ || 51 || ekākī vijane cātra samprāptaḥ samayocitaḥ | evaṃ vicārya manasā sasmāra harimavyayam || 52 || tatrājagāma bhagavānadṛśyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | vajramadhye praviśyāsau saṃsthito bhagavānhariḥ || 53 || indro buddhiṃ cakārāśu tadā vṛtravadhaṃ prati | iti sañcintya manasā kathaṃ hanyāṃ ripuṃ raṇe || 54 || ajeyaṃ sarvathā sarvadevaiśca dānavaistathā | yadi vṛtraṃ na hanmyadya vañcayitvā mahābalam || 55 || na śreyo mama nūnaṃ syātsarvathā ripurakṣaṇāt | apāṃ phenaṃ tadāpaśyatsamudre parvatopamam || 56 || nāyaṃ śuṣko na cārdro'yaṃ na ca śastramidaṃ tathā | apāṃ phenaṃ tadā śakro jagrāha kila līlayā || 57 || parāṃ śaktiṃ ca sasmāra bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | smṛtamātrā tadā devī svāṃśaṃ phene nyadhāpayat || 58 || vajraṃ tadāvṛtaṃ tatra cakāra harisaṃyutam | phenāvṛtaṃ paviṃ tatra śakraścikṣepa taṃ prati || 59 || sahasā nipapātāśu vajrāhata ivācalaḥ | vāsavastu prahṛṣṭātmā babhūva nihate tadā || 60 || ṛṣayaśca mahendraṃ tamastuvanvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ | hataśatruḥ prahṛṣṭātmā vāsavaḥ saha daivataiḥ || 61 || devīṃ sampūjayāmāsa yatprasādāddhato ripuḥ | prasādayāmāsa tadā stotrairnānāvidhairapi || 62 || devodyāne parāśakteḥ prāsādamakaroddhariḥ | padmarāgamayīṃ mūrtiṃ sthāpayāmāsa vāsavaḥ || 63 || trikālaṃ mahatīṃ pūjāṃ cakruḥ sarve'pi nirjarāḥ | tadāprabhṛti devānāṃ śrīdevī kuladaivatam || 64 || viṣṇuṃ tribhuvanaśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayāmāsa vāsavaḥ | tato hate mahāvīrye vṛtre devabhayaṅkare || 65 || pravavau ca śivo vāyurjahṛṣurdevatāstathā | hate tasminsagandharvā yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ || 66 || itthaṃ vṛtraḥ parāśaktipraveśayutaphenataḥ | tayā kṛtavimohācca śakreṇa sahasā hataḥ || 67 || tato vṛtranihantrīti devī lokeṣu gīyate | śakreṇa nihatatvācca śakreṇa hata ucyate || 68 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe chadmenendreṇa phenadvārā parāśaktismaraṇamūrvakaṃ vṛtrahananavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <6.7> indrasya padmanālapraveśānantaraṃ nahuṣasya devendrapade'bhiṣekavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca atha taṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇurviṣṇupurīṃ yayau | manasā śaṅkamānastu tasya hatyākṛtaṃ bhayam || 1 || indro'pi bhayasaṃtrasto yayāvindrapurīṃ tataḥ | munayo bhayasaṃvignā hyabhavannihate ripau || 2 || kimasmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yadasau vañcitaḥ kila | muniśabdo vṛthā jātaḥ sureśasya ca saṅgamāt || 3 || asmākaṃ vacanādvṛtro viśvāsamagamatkila | viśvāsaghātinaḥ saṅgādvayaṃ viśvāsaghātakāḥ || 4 || dhigiyaṃ mamatā pāpamūlamevamanarthakṛt | yadasmābhiśchalaṃ kṛtvā śapathairvañcito'suraḥ || 5 || mantrakṛdbuddhidātā ca prerakaḥ pāpakāriṇām | pāpabhāksa bhavennūnaṃ pakṣakartā tathaiva ca || 6 || viṣṇunāpi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yatsāhāyyamavāptavān | vajraṃ praviśya yenāsau pātitaḥ sattvamūrtinā || 7 || nūnaṃ svārthaparaḥ prāṇī na pāpāttrāsamaśnute | hariṇā harisaṅgena sarvathā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 8 || dvāveva staḥ padārthānāṃ dvāveva nidhanaṃ gatau | prathamaśca turīyaśca yau trilokyāṃ tu durlabhau || 9 || arthakāmau praśastau dvau sarveṣāṃ sammatau priyau | dharmādharmeti vāgvādo dambho'yaṃ mahatāmapi || 10 || munayo'pi manastāpamevaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ | jagmuḥ svānāśramāneva vimanaskā hatodyamāḥ || 11 || tvaṣṭā tu nihataṃ śrutvā putramindreṇa bhārata | ruroda duḥkhasantapto nirvedamagamatpunaḥ || 12 || yatrāsau patitastatra gatvā vīkṣya tathāgatam | saṃskāraṃ kārayāmāsa vidhivatpāralaukikam || 13 || snātvāsya salilaṃ dattvā kṛtvā caivaurdhvadaihikam | śaśāpendraṃ sa śokārtaḥ pāpiṣṭhaṃ mitraghātakam || 14 || yathā me nihataḥ putraḥ pralobhya śapathairbhṛśam | tathendro'pi mahadduḥkhaṃ prāpnotu vidhinirmitam || 15 || iti śaptvā sureśānaṃ tvaṣṭā tāpasamanvitaḥ | meroḥ śikharamāsthāya tapastepe suduṣkaram || 16 || janamejaya uvāca hatvā tvāṣṭraṃ sureśo'tha kāmavasthāmavāptavān | sukhaṃ vā duḥkhamevāgre tanme brūhi pitāmaha || 17 || vyāsa uvāca kiṃ pṛcchasi mahābhāga sandehaḥ kīdṛśastava | avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham || 18 || baliṣṭhairdurbalairvāpi svalpaṃ vā bahu vā kṛtam | sarvathaiva hi bhoktavyaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣaiḥ || 19 || śakrāyetthaṃ matirdattā hariṇā vṛtraghātine | praviṣṭo'tha paviṃ viṣṇuḥ sahāyaḥ pratyapadyata || 20 || na cāpadi sahāyo'bhūdvāsudevaḥ kathañcana | samaye svajanaḥ sarvaḥ saṃsāre'sminnarādhipa || 21 || daive vimukhatāṃ prāpte na ko'pyasti sahāyavān | pitā mātā tathā bhāryā bhrātā vātha sahodaraḥ || 22 || sevako vāpi mitraṃ vā putraścaiva tathaurasaḥ | pratikūle gate daive na ko'pyeti sahāyatām || 23 || bhoktā pāpasya puṇyasya kartā bhavati sarvathā | vṛtraṃ hatvā gatāḥ sarve nistejaskaḥ śacīpatiḥ || 24 || śepustaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve brahmahetyabruvañchanaiḥ | ko nāma śapathānkṛtvā satyaṃ dattvā vacaḥ punaḥ || 25 || jighāṃsati suviśvastaṃ muniṃ mitratvamāgatam | devagoṣṭhyāṃ surodyāne gandharvāṇāṃ samāgame || 26 || sarvatraiva kathā tasya vistāramagamatkila | kiṃ kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ karma śakreṇādya jighāṃsatā || 27 || vṛtraṃ chalena viśvastaṃ munibhiśca pratāritam | vedapramāṇamutsṛjya svīkṛtaṃ saugataṃ matam || 28 || yadayaṃ nihataḥ śanurvañcayitvātisāhasāt | ko nāma vacanaṃ dattvā viparītamathācaret || 29 || vinā śakraṃ hariṃ vāpi yathāyaṃ vinipātitaḥ | evaṃvidhāḥ kathāścānyāḥ samājeṣvabhavanbhṛśam || 30 || śuśrāvendro'pi vividhāḥ svakīrterhānikārakāḥ | yasya kīrtirhatā loke dhiktasyaiva kujīvitam || 31 || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā pathi gacchantaṃ śatruḥ smeramukho bhavet | indradyumno'pi rājarṣiḥ patitaḥ kīrtisaṃkṣayāt || 32 || svargādakṛtapāpo'sau pāpakṛtkiṃ na pātyate | svalpe'parādhe'pi nṛpo yayātiḥ patitaḥ kila || 33 || nṛpaḥ karkaṭatāṃ prāpto yugānaṣṭādaśaiva tu | bhṛgupatnīśiraśchedādbhagavānhariracyutaḥ || 34 || brahmaśāpātpaśoryonau sañjāto makarādiṣu | viṣṇuśca vāmano bhūtvā yācanārthaṃ balergṛhe || 35 || gataḥ kimaparaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāpnoti duṣkṛtī naraḥ | rāmo'pi vanavāseṣu sītāvirahajaṃ bahu || 36 || duḥkhaṃ ca prāptavānghoraṃ bhṛguśāpena bhārata | tathendro'pi brahmahatyākṛtaṃ prāpya mahadbhayam || 37 || na svāsthyaṃ prāpa gehe'sau sarvasiddhisamanvite | paulomī taṃ sabhāhīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā provāca vāsavam || 38 || niḥśvasantaṃ bhayatrastaṃ naṣṭasaṃjñaṃ vicetasam | kiṃ prabho'dya bhayārto'si mṛtaste dāruṇo ripuḥ || 39 || kā cintā vartate kānta tava śatruniṣūdana | kasmācchocasi lokeśa niḥśvasanprākṛto yathā || 40 || nānyo'sti balavāñchatruryena cintāparo bhavān | indra uvāca nārātirbalavānme'sti na śāntirna sukhaṃ tathā || 41 || brahmahatyābhayādrājñi bibhemi satataṃ gṛhe | na nandanaṃ sukhakaraṃ nāmṛtaṃ na gṛhaṃ vanam || 42 || gandharvāṇāṃ tathā geyaṃ nṛtyamapsarasāṃ punaḥ | na tvaṃ sukhakarā nārī nānā ca surayoṣitaḥ || 43 || na tathā kāmadhenuśca devavṛkṣaḥ sukhapradaḥ | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kva śarma mama jāyate || 44 || iti cintāparaḥ kānte na labhe sukhamātmani | vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā vacanaṃ śakraḥ priyāṃ paramakātarām || 45 || nirjagāma gṛhānmando mānasaṃ sara uttamam | padmanāle praviṣṭo'sau bhayārtaḥ śokakarṣitaḥ || 46 || na prājñāyata devendrastvabhibhūtaśca kalmaṣaiḥ | praticchanno vasatyapsu ceṣṭamāna ivoragaḥ || 47 || asahāyasturāṣāḍaiccintārto vikalendriyaḥ | tataḥ pranaṣṭe devendre brahmahatyābhayārdite || 48 || surāścintāturāścāsannutpātāścābhavannatha | ṛṣayaḥ siddhagandharvā bhayārtāścābhavanbhṛśam || 49 || arājakaṃ jagatsarvamabhibhūtamupadravaiḥ | avarṣaṇaṃ tadā jātaṃ pṛthivī kṣīṇavaibhavā || 50 || vicchinnasrotaso nadyaḥ sarāṃsyanudakāni vai | evaṃ tvarājake jāte devatā munayastathā || 51 || vicārya nahuṣaṃ cakruḥ śakraṃ sarve divaukasaḥ | samprāpya nahuṣo rājā dharmiṣṭho'pi rajobalāt || 52 || babhūva viṣayāsaktaḥ pañcabāṇaśarāhataḥ | apsarobhirvṛtaḥ krīḍandevodyāneṣu bhārata || 53 || śakrapatnīguṇāñchrutvā cakame tāṃ sa pārthivaḥ | ṛṣīnāha kimindrāṇī nopagacchati māṃ kila || 54 || bhavadbhiścāmaraiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛto'haṃ vāsavastviha | preṣayadhvaṃ surāḥ kāmaṃ sevārthaṃ mama vai śacīm || 55 || priyaṃ cenmama kartavyaṃ sarvathā munayo'marāḥ | ahamindro'dya devānāṃ lokānāṃ ca tatheśvaraḥ || 56 || āgacchatu śacī mahyaṃ kṣipramadya niveśanam | iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devā devarṣayastathā || 57 || gatvā cintāturāḥ procuḥ paulomīṃ praṇatāstataḥ | indrapatni durācāro nahuṣastvāmihecchati || 58 || kupito'smānuvācedaṃ preṣayadhvaṃ śacīmiha | kiṃ kurmastadadhīnāḥ smo yenendro'yaṃ kṛtaḥ kila || 59 || tacchrutvā durmanā devī bṛhaspatimuvāca ha | rakṣa māṃ nahuṣādbrahmaṃstavāsmi śaraṇaṃ gatā || 60 || bṛhaspatiruvāca na bhetavyaṃ tvayā devi nahuṣātpāpamohitāt | na tvāṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vatse tyaktvā dharmaṃ sanātanam || 61 || śaraṇāgatamārtaṃ ca yo dadāti narādhamaḥ | sa eva narakaṃ yāti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam | svasthā bhava pṛthuśroṇi na tyakṣye tvāṃ kadācana || 62 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe indrasya padmanālapraveśānantaraṃ nahuṣasya devendrapade'bhiṣekavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <6.8> indrāṇyā śakradarśanam vyāsa uvāca nahuṣastvatha tāṃ śrutvā gurostu śaraṇaṃ gatām | cukrodha smarabāṇārtastamāṅgirasamāśu vai || 1 || devānāhāṅgirāsūnurhantavyo'yaṃ mayā kila | itīndrāṇīṃ gṛhe mūḍho rakṣatīti mayā śrutam || 2 || iti taṃ kupitaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ sarṣipurogamāḥ | abruvannahuṣaṃ ghoraṃ sāmapūrvaṃ vacastadā || 3 || krodhaṃ saṃhara rājendra tyaja pāpamatiṃ prabho | nindanti dharmaśāstreṣu paradārābhimarśanam || 4 || śakrapatnī sadā sādhvī jīvamāne patau punaḥ | kathamanye patiṃ kuryātsubhagātipativratā || 5 || trilokīśastvamadhunā śāstā dharmasya vai vibho | tvādṛśo'dharmamātiṣṭhettadā naśyetprajā dhruvam || 6 || sarvathā prabhuṇā kāryaṃ śiṣṭācārasya rakṣaṇam | vāramukhyāśca śataśo vartante'tra śacīsamāḥ || 7 || ratistu kāraṇaṃ proktaṃ śṛṅgārasya mahātmabhiḥ | rasahānirbalātkāre kṛte sati tu jāyate || 8 || ubhayoḥ sadṛśaṃ prema yadi pārthivasattama | tadā vai sukhasampattirubhayorupajāyate || 9 || tasmādbhāvamimaṃ muñca paradārābhimarśane | sadbhāvaṃ kuru devendra padaṃ prāpto'syanuttamam || 10 || ṛddhikṣayastu pāpena puṇyenātivivardhanam | tasmātpāpaṃ parityajya sanmatiṃ kuru pārthiva || 11 || nahuṣa uvāca gautamasya yadā bhuktā dārāḥ śakreṇa devatāḥ | vācaspatestu somena kva yūyaṃ saṃsthitāstadā || 12 || paropadeśe kuśalā prabhavanti narāḥ kila | kartā caivopadeṣṭā ca durlabhaḥ puruṣo bhavet || 13 || māmāgacchatu sā devī hitaṃ syādadbhutaṃ hi vaḥ | etasyāḥ paramaṃ devāḥ sukhameva bhaviṣyati || 14 || anyathā na hi tuṣye'haṃ satyametadbravīmi vaḥ | vinayādvā balādvāpi tāmāśu prāpayantviha || 15 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devāśca munayastathā | tamūcuścātisantrastā nahuṣaṃ madanāturam || 16 || indrāṇīmānayiṣyāmaḥ sāmapūrvaṃ tavāntikam | ityuktvā te tadā jagmurbṛhaspatiniketanam || 17 || vyāsa uvāca te gatvāṅgirasaḥ putraṃ procuḥ prāñjalayaḥ surāḥ | jānīmaḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptāmindrāṇīṃ tava veśmani || 18 || sā deyā nahuṣāyādya vāsavo'sau kṛto yataḥ | vṛṇotviyaṃ varārohā patitve varavarṇinī || 19 || bṛhaspatiḥ surānāha tacchrutvā dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ | nāhaṃ tyakṣye tu paulomīṃ satīṃ ca śaraṇāgatām || 20 || devā ūcuḥ upāyo'nyaḥ prakartavyo yena so'dya prasīdati | anyathā kopasaṃyukto durārādhyo bhaviṣyati || 21 || gururuvāca tatra gatvā śacī bhūpaṃ pralobhya vacasā bhṛśam | karotu samayaṃ bālā patiṃ jñātvā mṛtaṃ bhaje || 22 || indre jīvati me kānte kathamanyaṃ karomyaham | anveṣaṇārthaṃ gantavyaṃ mayā tasya mahātmanaḥ || 23 || iti sā samayaṃ kṛtvā vañcayitvā ca bhūpatim | bharturānayane yatnaṃ karotu mama vākyataḥ || 24 || iti sañcintya me sarve bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ | nahuṣaṃ sahitā jagmurindrapatnyā divaukasaḥ || 25 || tānāgatānmamīkṣyāha tadā kṛtrimavāsavaḥ | jaharṣa ca mudāyuktastāṃ vīkṣya mudito'bravīt || 26 || adyāsmi vāsavaḥ kānte bhaja māṃ cārulocane | patitve sarvalokasya pūjyo'haṃ vihitaḥ suraiḥ || 27 || ityuktā sā nṛpaṃ prāha vepamānā trapāyutā | varamicchāmyahaṃ rājaṃstvattaḥ prāptaṃ sureśvara || 28 || kiñcitkālaṃ pratīkṣasva yāvatkurve vinirṇayam | indro'stīti na vāstīti sandeho me hṛdi sthitaḥ || 29 || tatastvāṃ samupasthāsye kṛtvā niścayamātmani | tāvatkṣamasva rājendra satyametadbravīmi te || 30 || na hi vijñāyate śakro naṣṭaḥ kiṃ vā kva vā gataḥ | evamuktaḥ sa cendrāṇyā nahuṣaḥ prītimānabhūt || 31 || vyasarjayatsa tāṃ devīṃ tathetyuktvā mudānvitaḥ | sā visṛṣṭā nṛpeṇāśu gatvā prāha surānsatī || 32 || indrasyāgamane yatnaṃ kurutādya kṛtodyamāḥ | śrutvā tadvacanaṃ devā indrāṇyā rasavacchuci || 33 || mantrayāmāsurekāgrāḥ śakrārthaṃ nṛpasattama | te gatvā vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram || 34 || ādidevaṃ jagannāthaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalam | ūcuścainaṃ samudvignā vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradāḥ || 35 || devadeva surapatirbrahmahatyāprapīḍitaḥ | adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kvāpi tiṣṭhati vāsavaḥ || 36 || tvaddhiyā nihate vipre brahmahatyā kutaḥ prabho | tvaṃ gatistasya bhagavannasmākaṃ ca tathaiva hi || 37 || trāhi naḥ paramāpannānmokṣaṃ tasya vinirdiśa | devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kātaraṃ viṣṇurabravīt || 38 || yajatāmaśvamedhena śakrapāpanivṛttaye | puṇyena hayamedhena pāvitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ || 39 || punareṣyati devānāmindratvamakutobhayaḥ | hayamedhena santuṣṭā devī śrījagadambikā || 40 || brahmahatyādipāpāni nāśayiṣyatyasaṃśayam | yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa pāpajālaṃ vinaśyati || 41 || kiṃ punarvājimedhena tatprītyarthaṃ kṛtena ca | indrāṇī kurutānnityaṃ bhagavatyāḥ prapūjanam || 42 || ārādhanaṃ śivāyāstu sukhakāri bhaviṣyati | nahuṣo'pi jaganmāturmāyayā mohitaḥ kila || 43 || vināśaṃ svakṛtenāśu gamiṣyatyenasā surāḥ | pāvitaścāśvamedhena turāṣāḍapi vaibhavam || 44 || prāpsyatyacirakālena svamāsanamanuttamam | te tu śrutvā śubhāṃ vāṇīṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 45 || jagmustaṃ deśamaniśaṃ yatrāste pākaśāsanaḥ | tamāśvāsya surāḥ śakraṃ bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ || 46 || kārayāmāsurakhilaṃ hayamedhaṃ mahākratum | vibhajya brahmahatyāṃ tu vṛkṣeṣu ca nadīṣu ca || 47 || parvateṣu pṛthivyāṃ ca strīṣu caivākṣipadvibhuḥ | tāṃ visṛjya ca bhūteṣu vipāpaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ || 48 || vijvaraḥ samabhūdbhūyaḥ kālākāṅkṣī sthito jale | adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ padmanāle vyatiṣṭhata || 49 || devāstu nirgatāḥ sthāne kṛtvā kāryaṃ tadadbhutam | paulomī tu guruṃ prāha duḥkhitā virahākulā || 50 || kṛtayajño'pi me bhartā kimadṛśyaḥ purandaraḥ | kathaṃ drakṣye priyaṃ svāmiṃstamupāyaṃ vadasva me || 51 || bṛhaspatiruvāca tvamārādhaya paulomi devīṃ bhagavatīṃ śivām | darśayiṣyati te nāthaṃ devī vigatakalmaṣam || 52 || ārādhitā jagaddhātrī nahuṣaṃ vārayiṣyati | mohayitvā nṛpaṃ sthānātpātayiṣyati cāmbikā || 53 || ityuktā sā tadā tena pulomatanayā nṛpa | jagrāha mantraṃ vidhivadgurordevyāḥ sasādhanam || 54 || vidyāṃ prāpya gurordevī devīṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīm | samyagārādhayāmāsa balipuṣpārcanaiḥ śubhai || 55 || tyaktānyabhogasambhārā tāpasīveṣadhāriṇī | cakāra pūjanaṃ devyāḥ priyadarśanalālasā || 56 || kālena kiyatā tuṣṭā pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ dadau | saumyarūpadharā devī varadā haṃsavāhinī || 57 || sūryakoṭipratīkāśā candrakoṭisuśītalā | vidyutkoṭisamānābhā caturvedasamanvitā || 58 || pāśāṃkuśābhayavarāndadhatī nijabāhubhiḥ | āpādalambinīṃ svacchāṃ muktāmālāṃ ca bibhratī || 59 || prasantasmeravadanā locanatrayabhūṣitā | ābrahmakīṭajananī karuṇāmṛtasāgarā || 60 || anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍanāyikā parameśvarī | saumyānantarasairyuktastanadvayavirājitā || 61 || sarveśvarī ca sarvajñā kūṭasthākṣararūpiṇī | tāmuvāca prasannā sā śakrapatnīṃ kṛtodyamām || 62 || meghagambhīraśabdena mudamādadatī bhṛśam | devyuvāca varaṃ varaya suśroṇi vāñchitaṃ śakravallabhe || 63 || dadāmyadya prasannāsmi pūjitā subhṛśaṃ tvayā | varadāhaṃ samāyātā darśanaṃ sahajaṃ na me || 64 || anekakoṭijanmotthapuṇyapuñjairhi labhyate | ityuktā sā tadā devī tāmāha praṇatā puraḥ || 65 || śakrapatnī bhagavatīṃ prasannāṃ parameśvarīm | vāñchāmi darśanaṃ mātaḥ patyuḥ paramadurlabham || 66 || nahuṣādbhayanāśaṃ ca svapadaprāpaṇaṃ tathā | devyuvāca gaccha tvamanayā dūtyā sārdhaṃ śrīmānasaṃ saraḥ || 67 || yatra me mūrtiracalā viśvakāmābhidhā matā | tatra paśyasi śakraṃ tvaṃ duḥkhitaṃ bhayavihvalam || 68 || mohayiṣyāmi rājānaṃ kālena kiyatā punaḥ | svasthā bhava viśālākṣi karomi tava cepsitam || 69 || bhraṃśayiṣyāmi bhūpālaṃ mohitaṃ tridaśāsanāt | vyāsa uvāca devīdūtī tāṃ gṛhītvā śakrapatnīṃ tvarānvitā || 70 || prāpayāmāsa sānnidhyaṃ svapatyuḥ parameśvarīm | sā dṛṣṭvā taṃ patiṃ bālā sureśaṃ guptasaṃsthitam | muditābhūdvaraṃ vīkṣya bahukālābhivāñchitam || 71 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe indrāṇyā śakradarśanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <6.9> nahuṣasvargacyutivarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tāṃ vīkṣya vipulāpāṅgīṃ rahaḥ śokasamanvitām | ākhaṇḍalaḥ priyāṃ bhāryāṃ vismitaścābravīttadā || 1 || kathamatrāgatā kānte kathaṃ jñātastvayā hyaham | durjñeyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsthito'smi śubhānane || 2 || śacyuvāca deva devyāḥ prasādena jñāto'syadya bhavāniha | punastasyāḥ prasādena prāptāsmi tvāṃ divaspate || 3 || nahuṣo nāma rājarṣiḥ sthāpito bhavadāsane | tridaśairmunibhiścaiva sa māṃ bādhati nityaśaḥ || 4 || patiṃ māṃ kuru cārvaṅgiḥ turāsāhaṃ surādhipam | evaṃ vadati māṃ pāpmā kiṃ karomi balārdana || 5 || indra uvāca kālākāṅkṣī varārohe saṃsthito'smi yadṛcchayā | tathā tvamapi kalyāṇi susthiraṃ svamanaḥ kuru || 6 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktā tena sā devī patinātipraśaṃsinā | niḥśvasantyāha taṃ śakraṃ vepamānātiduḥkhitā || 7 || kathaṃ tiṣṭhe mahābhāga pāpātmā māṃ vaśānugām | kariṣyati madonmatto varadānena garvitaḥ || 8 || devāśca munayaḥ sarve māmūcustadbhayākulāḥ | taṃ bhajasva varārohe devarājaṃ smarāturam || 9 || bṛhaspatistu śatrughna vāḍavo balavarjitaḥ | kathaṃ māṃ rakṣituṃ śakto bhaveddevānugaḥ sadā || 10 || tasmāccintāsti mahatī nāryahaṃ vaśavartinī | anāthā kiṃ kariṣyāmi viparīte vidhau vibho || 11 || nāryasmyahaṃ na kulaṭā tvaccittātipativratā | nāsti me śaraṇaṃ tatra yo māṃ rakṣati duḥkhitām || 12 || indra uvāca upāyaṃ prabravīmyadya taṃ kuruṣva varānane | śīlaṃ te duḥkhite kāle paritrātaṃ bhaviṣyati || 13 || pareṇa rakṣitā nārī na bhavecca pativratā | upāyaiḥ koṭibhiḥ kāmabhinnacittāticañcalā || 14 || śīlameva hi nārīṇāṃ sadā rakṣati pāpataḥ | tasmāttvaṃ śīlamāsthāya sthirā bhava śucismite || 15 || yadā tvāṃ nahuṣo rājā balādākarṣayetkhalaḥ | tadā tvaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā gajaṃ vañcaya bhūpatim || 16 || ekānte tatsamīpe tvaṃ gatvā vada madālase | ṛṣiyānena divyena māmupaihi jagatpate || 17 || evaṃ tava vaśe prītā bhaviṣyāmīti me tatam | iti taṃ vada suśroṇi tadā tu parimohitaḥ || 18 || kāmāndhaḥ sa munīn yāne yojayiṣyati pārthivaḥ | avaśyaṃ tāpaso bhūpaṃ śāpadagdhaṃ kariṣyati || 19 || sāhāyyaṃ jagadambā te kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | jagadambāpadasmartuḥ saṅkaṭaṃ na kadācana || 20 || yadi jāyeta taccāpi jñeyaṃ tatsvastaye kila | tasmātsarvaprayatnena maṇidvīpādhivāsinīm || 21 || bhaja tvaṃ bhuvaneśānīṃ guruvākyānusārataḥ | vyāsa uvāca ityākhyātā śacī tena jagāma nahuṣaṃ prati || 22 || tathetyuktvātiviśvastā bhāvikārye kṛtodyamā | nahuṣastāṃ samālokya mudito vākyamabravīt || 23 || svāgataṃ satyavacanaistvadadhīno'smi kāmini | dāso'haṃ tava satyena pālitaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā || 24 || yadāgatā samīpe me tuṣṭo'smi mitabhāṣiṇi | na ca vrīḍā tvayā kāryā bhaktaṃ māṃ bhaja susmite || 25 || kāryaṃ vada viśālākṣi kariṣyāmi tava priyam | śacyuvāca sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ mama kṛtrimavāsava || 26 || manoratho'sti me deva śṛṇu citte'dhunā vibho | vāñchitaṃ kuru kalyāṇa tvadvaśāhamataḥ param || 27 || bravīmi mānasotsāhaṃ tvaṃ taṃ kartumihārhasi | nahuṣa uvāca kāryaṃ tvaṃ brūhi candrāsye karomi tava vāñchitam || 28 || alabhyamapi dāsyāmi tubhyaṃ subhru vadasva mām | śacyuvāca kathaṃ bravīmi rājendra pratyayo nāsti me tava || 29 || śapathaṃ kuru rājendra yatkaromi priyaṃ tava | rājānaḥ satyavacaso durlabhā eva bhūtale || 30 || paścādbravīmyahaṃ rājan jñātvā satyena yantritam | kṛte cedvāñchite bhūpa sadā te vaśavartinī || 31 || bhaviṣyāmi turāṣāḍ vai satyametadvaco mama | nahuṣa uvāca avaśyameva kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ tava sundari || 32 || śapāmi sukṛtenāhaṃ yajñadānakṛtena vai | śacyuvāca indrasya harayo vāhā gajaścaiva rathastathā || 33 || garuḍo vāsudevasya yamasya mahiṣastathā | vṛṣabhaḥ śaṅkarasyāpi brahmaṇo varaṭāpatiḥ || 34 || mayūraḥ kārtikeyasya gajāsyasya tu mūṣakaḥ | icchāmyahamapūrvaṃ vai vāhanaṃ te surādhipa || 35 || yanna viṣṇorna rudrasya nāsurāṇāṃ na rakṣasām | vahantu tvāṃ mahārāja munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 36 || sarve śibikayā rājannetaddhi mama vāñchitam | sarvadevādhikaṃ tvāṃ vai jānāmi vasudhādhipa || 37 || tena te tejaso vṛddhiṃ vāñchāmyahamatandritā | vyāsa uvāca tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya jñānadurbalaḥ || 38 || mohitastu mahādevyā kṛtamohena tatkṣaṇam | uvāca vacanaṃ bhūpaḥ saṃstuvanvāsavapriyām || 39 || nahuṣa uvāca satyamuktaṃ tvayā tanvi vāhanaṃ ruciraṃ mama | kariṣyāmi sukeśānte vacanaṃ tava sarvathā || 40 || na hyalpavīryo bhavati yo vāhānkurute munīn | ahamāruhya yānena tvāmeṣyāmi śucismite || 41 || saptarṣayo māṃ vakṣyanti sarve devarṣayastathā | samarthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu jñātvā māṃ tapasādhikam || 42 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā tāṃ susantuṣṭo visasarja haripriyām | munīnāhūya sarvāstānityuvāca smarānvitaḥ || 43 || nahuṣa uvāca ahamindro'dya bho viprāḥ sarvaśaktisamanvitaḥ | kāryamatra prakurvantu bhavanto vigatasmayāḥ || 44 || indrāsanaṃ mayā prāptaṃ nendrāṇī māmupaiti ca | ākāritā ca māṃ sūte premapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 45 || muniyānena devendra māmupaihi surādhipa | devadeva mahārāja matpriyaṃ kuru mānada || 46 || etatkāryaṃ muniśreṣṭhā mamātyantaṃ durāsadam | bhavadbhistu prakartavyaṃ sarvathaiva dayālubhiḥ || 47 || mano dahati me kāmaḥ śakrapatnyāṃ pravartitam | bhavantaḥ śaraṇaṃ me'dya kurudhvaṃ kāryamadbhutam || 48 || agastipramukhāstasya śrutvā vākyamasatkaram | aṅgīcakruśca bhāvitvātkṛpayā paramarṣayaḥ || 49 || aṅgīkṛte'tha tadvākye munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ | mudaṃ prāpa nṛpaḥ kāmaṃ paulomīkṛtamānasaḥ || 50 || āruhya śibikāṃ ramyāṃ saṃsthitastvarayānvitaḥ | vāhānkṛtvā munīndivyānsarpa sarpeti cābravīt || 51 || kāmārtaḥ so'spṛśanmūḍhaḥ pādena munimastakam | agastiṃ tāpasaśreṣṭhaṃ lopāmudrāpatiṃ tadā || 52 || vātāpibhakṣakartāraṃ samudrasyāpi śoṣakam | kaśayā tāḍayāmāsa pañcabāṇaśarāhataḥ || 53 || indrāṇīhṛtacitto'sau sarpeti prabruvanmunim | taṃ śaśāpa muniḥ kruddhaḥ kaśāghātamanusmaran || 54 || sarpo bhava durācāra vane ghoravapurmahān | bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi yatra kleśo mahānbhavet || 55 || vicariṣyasi vīryeṇa punaḥ svargamavāpsyasi | dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraṃ nāma tava mokṣo bhaviṣyati || 56 || praśnānāmuttaraṃ śrutvā dharmaputramukhāttataḥ | vyāsa uvāca evaṃ śaptaḥ sa rājarṣiḥ stutvā taṃ munisattamam || 57 || svargātpapāta sahasā sarparūpadharo'bhavat | bṛhaspatistato gatvā tarasā mānasaṃ prati || 58 || indrāya sarvavṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa vistarāt | tacchrutvā maghavā rājñaḥ svargātpracyavanādikam || 59 || mudito'bhūnmahārāja sthitastatraiva vāsavaḥ | devāśca munayo dṛṣṭvā nahuṣaṃ patitaṃ bhuvi || 60 || jagmuḥ sarve'pi tatraiva yatrendraḥ sarasi sthitaḥ | tamāśvāsya surāḥ sarve munibhiḥ sahitāstadā || 61 || svarge samānayāmāsurmānapūrvaṃ śacīpatim | samāgataṃ tataḥ śakraṃ sarve te munayaḥ surāḥ || 62 || sthāpayitvā''sane paścādabhiṣekaṃ dadhuḥ śivam | indro'pi svāsanaṃ prāpya śacyā saha surālaye || 63 || cikrīḍa nandane ramye kānane premayuktayā | vyāsa uvāca evamindreṇa samprāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ paramadāruṇam || 64 || hatvāsuraṃ kāmarūpaṃ viśvarūpaṃ mahāmunim | punardevyāḥ prasādena svasthānaṃ prāptavānnṛpa || 65 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ vṛtrāsuravadhāśrayam | yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayā rājan kathānakamanuttamam || 66 || yādṛśaṃ kurute karma tādṛśaṃ phalamāpnuyāt | avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham || 67 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe nahuṣasvargacyutivarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <6.10> karmaṇāṃ gahanagativarṇanam janamejaya uvāca kathitaṃ caritaṃ brahmañchakrasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ | sthānabhraṃśastathā duḥkhaprāptiruktā viśeṣataḥ || 1 || yatra devādhidevyāśca mahimātīva varṇitaḥ | sandeho'tra mamāpyasti yacchakro'pi mahātapāḥ || 2 || devādhipatyamāsādya duḥsahaṃ duḥkhamanvabhūt | makhānāṃ tu śataṃ kṛtvā prāptaṃ sthānamanuttamam || 3 || deveśatvaṃ ca samprāpya bhraṣṭaḥ sthānādasau katham | etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva kāraṇaṃ karuṇānidhe || 4 || sarvajño'si muniśreṣṭha purāṇānāṃ pravartakaḥ | nāvācyaṃ mahatāṃ kiñcicchiṣye ca śraddhayānvite || 5 || tasmātkuru mahābhāga matsandehāpanodanam | sūta uvāca iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa rājñā vai tadā satyavatīsutaḥ || 6 || tamāhātiprasannātmā yathānukramamuttaram | vyāsa uvāca nibodha nṛpatiśreṣṭha kāraṇaṃ paramādbhutam || 7 || karmaṇastu tridhā proktā gatistattvavidāṃ varaiḥ | sañcitaṃ vartamānaṃ ca prārabdhamiti bhedataḥ || 8 || anekajanmasañjātaṃ prāktanaṃ sañcitaṃ smṛtam | sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ karma tāmasaṃ trividhaṃ punaḥ || 9 || śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ bhūpa sañcitaṃ bahukālikam | avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ tathā || 10 || janmajanmani jīvānāṃ sañcitānāṃ ca karmaṇām | niḥśeṣastu kṣayo nābhūtkalpakoṭiśatairapi || 11 || kriyamāṇaṃ ca yatkarma vartamānaṃ taducyate | dehaṃ prāpya śubhaṃ vāpi hyaśubhaṃ vā samācaret || 12 || sañcitānāṃ punarmadhyātsamāhṛtya kiyānkila | dehārambhe ca samaye kālaḥ prerayatīva tat || 13 || prārabdhaṃ karma vijñeyaṃ bhogāttasya kṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ | prāṇibhiḥ khalu bhoktavyaṃ prārabdhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14 || purā kṛtāni rājendra hyaśubhāni śubhāni ca | avaśyameva karmāṇi bhoktavyānīti niścayaḥ || 15 || devairmanuṣyairasurairyakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ | karmaiva hi mahārāja dehārambhasya kāraṇam || 16 || karmakṣaye janmanāśaḥ prāṇināṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | brahmā viṣṇustathā rudra indrādyāśca surāstathā || 17 || dānavā yakṣagandharvāḥ sarve karmavaśā kila | anyathā dehasambandhaḥ kathaṃ bhavati bhūpate || 18 || kāraṇaṃ yastu bhogasya dehinaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | tasmādanekajanmotthasañcitānāṃ ca karmaṇām || 19 || madhye vegaḥ samāyāti kasyacitkālapākataḥ | tatprārabdhavaśātpuṇyaṃ karoti ca yathā tathā || 20 || pāpaṃ karoti manujastathā devādayo'pi ca | tathā nārāyaṇo rājannaraśca dharmajāvubhau || 21 || jātau kṛṣṇārjunau kāmamaṃśau nārāyaṇasya tau | purāṇapīṭhikeyaṃ vai munibhiḥ parikīrtitā || 22 || devāṃśaḥ sa tu vijñeyo yo bhavedvibhavādhikaḥ | nānṛṣiḥ kurute kāvyaṃ nārudro rudramarcate || 23 || nādevāṃśo dadātyannaṃ nāviṣṇuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | indrādagneryamādviṣṇordhanadāditi bhūpate || 24 || prabhutvaṃ ca prabhāvaṃ ca kopaṃ caiva parākramam | ādāya kriyate nūnaṃ śarīramiti niścayaḥ || 25 || yaḥ kaścidbalavām̐lloke bhāgyavānatha bhogavān | vidyāvāndānavānvāpi sa devāṃśaḥ prapaḍhyate || 26 || tathaivaite mayākhyātā pāṇḍavāḥ pṛthivīpate | devāṃśo vāsudevo'pi nārāyaṇasamadyutiḥ || 27 || śarīraṃ prāṇināṃ nūnaṃ bhājanaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | śarīrī prāpnuyātkāmaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhamanantaram || 28 || dehī nāsti vaśaḥ ko'pi daivādhīnaḥ sadaiva hi | jananaṃ maraṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ prāpnoti cāvaśaḥ || 29 || pāṇḍavāste vane jātāḥ prāptāstu svagṛhaṃ punaḥ | svabāhubalataḥ paścādrājasūyaṃ kratūttamam || 30 || vanavāsaṃ punaḥ prāptā bahuduḥkhakaraṃ param | arjunena tapastaptaṃ duṣkaraṃ hyajitendriyaiḥ || 31 || santuṣṭaistu surairdattaṃ varadānaṃ punaḥ śubham | naradehakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ kva gataṃ vanavāsajam || 32 || naradehe tapastaptaṃ cograṃ badarikāśrame | nārjunasya śarīre tatphaladaṃ sambabhūva ha || 33 || prāṇināṃ dehasambandhe gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ | durjñeyā sarvathā devairmānavānāṃ tu kā kathā || 34 || vāsudevo'pi sañjātaḥ kārāgāre'tisaṅkaṭe | nīto'sau vasudevena nandagopasya gokulam || 35 || ekādaśaiva varṣāṇi saṃsthitastatra bhārata | punaḥ sa mathurāṃ gatvā jaghānograsutaṃ balāt || 36 || mocayāmāsa pitarau bandhanādbhṛśaduḥkhitau | ugrasenaṃ ca rājānañcakāra madhurāpure || 37 || jagāma dvāravatyāṃ sa mleccharājabhayātpunaḥ | sarvaṃ bhāvivaśātkṛṣṇaḥ kṛtavānpauruṣaṃ mahat || 38 || kṛtvā kāryāṇyanekāni dvāravatyāṃ janārdanaḥ | dehaṃ tyaktvā prabhāse tu sakuṭumbo divaṃ gataḥ || 39 || putrāḥ pautrāśca suhṛdo bhrātaro jāmayastathā | prabhāse yādavāḥ sarve vipraśāpātkṣayaṃ gatāḥ || 40 || evaṃ te kathitā rājan karmaṇo gahanā gatiḥ | vāsudevo'pi vyādhasya bāṇena nidhanaṃ gataḥ || 41 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe karmaṇāṃ gahanagativarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <6.11> yugadharmavyavasthāvarṇanam janamejaya uvāca bhārāvatāraṇārthāya kathitaṃ janma kṛṣṇayoḥ | saṃśayo'yaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha hṛdaye mama tiṣṭhati || 1 || pṛthivī gosvarūpeṇa brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā | dvāparānte'tidīnārtā gurubhāraprapīḍitā || 2 || vedhasā prārthito viṣṇuḥ kamalāpatirīśvaraḥ | bhūbhārottāraṇārthāya sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 3 || bhagavan bhārate khaṇḍe devaiḥ saha janārdana | avatāraṃ gṛhāṇāśu vasudevagṛhe vibho || 4 || evaṃ samprārthito dhātrā bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ | babhūva saha rāmeṇa bhūbhārottāraṇāya vai || 5 || kiyānuttārito bhāro hatvā duṣṭānanekaśaḥ | jñātvā sarvāndurācārānpāpabuddhinṛpāniha || 6 || hato bhīṣmo hato droṇo virāṭo drupadastathā | bāhlīkaḥ somadattaśca karṇo vaikartanastathā || 7 || yairluṇṭhitaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ hṛtāśca hariyoṣitaḥ | kathaṃ na nāśitā duṣṭā ye sthitāḥ pṛthivītale || 8 || ābhīrāśca śakā mlecchā niṣādāḥ koṭiśastathā | bhārāvataraṇaṃ kiṃ tatkṛtaṃ kṛṣṇena dhīmatā || 9 || sandeho'yaṃ mahābhāga na nivartati cittataḥ | kalāvasminmajāḥ sarvāḥ paśyataḥ pāpaniścayāḥ || 10 || vyāsa uvāca rājan yasminyuge yādṛkprajā bhavati kālataḥ | nānyathā tadbhavennūnaṃ yugadharmo'tra kāraṇam || 11 || ye dharmarasikā jīvāste vai satyayuge'bhavan | dharmārtharasikā ye tu te vai tretāyuge'bhavan || 12 || dharmārthakāmarasikā dvāpare cābhavanyuge | arthakāmaparāḥ sarve kalāvasminbhavanti hi || 13 || yugadharmastu rājendra na yāti vyatyayaṃ punaḥ | kālaḥ kartāsti dharmasya hyadharmasya ca vai punaḥ || 14 || rājovāca ye tu satyayuge jīvā bhavanti dharmatatparāḥ | kutra te'dya mahābhāga tiṣṭhanti puṇyabhāginaḥ || 15 || tretāyuge dvāpare vā ye dānavratakārakāḥ | vartante munayaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kutra brūhi pitāmaha || 16 || kalāvadya durācārā ye'tra santi gatatrapāḥ | ādye yuge kva yāsyanti pāpiṣṭhā devanindakāḥ || 17 || etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate | sarvathā śrotukāmo'smi yadetaddharmanirṇayam || 18 || vyāsa uvāca ye vai kṛtayuge rājan sambhavantīha mānavāḥ | kṛtvā te puṇyakarmāṇi devalokānvrajanti vai || 19 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca nṛpasattama | svadharmaniratā yānti lokānkarmajitānkila || 20 || satyaṃ dayā tathā dānaṃ svadāragamanaṃ tathā | adrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣu samatā sarvajantuṣu || 21 || etatsādhāraṇaṃ dharmaṃ kṛtvā satyayuge punaḥ | svargaṃ yāntītare varṇā dharmato rajakādayaḥ || 22 || tathā tretāyuge rājan dvāpare'tha yuge tathā | kalāvasminyuge pāpā narakaṃ yānti mānavāḥ || 23 || tāvattiṣṭhanti te tatra yāvatsyādyugaparyayaḥ | punaśca mānuṣe loke bhavanti bhuvi mānavāḥ || 24 || yadā satyayugasyādiḥ kalerantaśca pārthiva | tadā svargātpuṇyakṛto jāyante kila mānavāḥ || 25 || yadā kaliyugasyādirdvāparasya kṣayastathā | narakātpāpinaḥ sarve bhavanti bhuvi mānavāḥ || 26 || evaṃ kālasamācāro nānyathābhūtkadācana | tasmātkalirasatkartā tasmiṃstu tādṛśī prajā || 27 || kadāciddaivayogāttu prāṇināṃ vyatyayo bhavet | kalau ye sādhavaḥ keciddvāpare sambhavanti te || 28 || tathā tretāyuge kecitkecitsatyayuge tathā | duṣṭāḥ satyayuge ye tu te bhavanti kalāvapi || 29 || kṛtakarmaprabhāveṇa prāpnuvantyasukhāni ca | punaśca tādṛśaṃ karma kurvanti yugabhāvataḥ || 30 || janamejaya uvāca yugadharmānmahābhāga brūhi sarvānaśeṣataḥ | yasminvai yādṛśo dharmo jñātumicchāmi taṃ tathā || 31 || vyāsa uvāca nibodha nṛpaśārdūla dṛṣṭāntaṃ te bravīmyaham | sādhūnāmapi cetāṃsi yugabhāvādbhramanti hi || 32 || pituryathā te rājendra vuddhirviprāvahelane | kṛtā vai kalinā rājan dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ || 33 || anyathā kṣatriyo rājā yayātikulasambhavaḥ | tāpasasya gale sarpaṃ mṛtaṃ kasmādayojayat || 34 || sarvaṃ yugabalaṃ rājanveditavyaṃ vijānatā | prayatnena hi kartavyaṃ dharmakarma viśeṣataḥ || 35 || nūnaṃ satyayuge rājan brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ | parāśaktyarcanaratā devīdarśanalālasāḥ || 36 || gāyatrīpraṇavāsaktā gāyatrīdhyānakāriṇaḥ | gāyatrījapasaṃsaktā māyābījaikajāpinaḥ || 37 || grāme grāme parāmbāyāḥ prāsādakaraṇotsukāḥ | svakarmaniratāḥ sarve satyaśaucadayānvitāḥ || 38 || trayyuktakarmaniratāstattvajñānaviśāradāḥ | abhavankṣatriyāstatra prajābharaṇatatparāḥ || 39 || vaiśyāstu kṛṣivāṇijyagosevāniratāstathā | śūdrāḥ sevāparāstatra puṇye satyayuge nṛpa || 40 || parāmbāpūjanāsaktāḥ sarve varṇāḥ pare yuge | tathā tretāyuge kiñcinnyūnā dharmasya saṃsthitiḥ || 41 || dvāpare ca viśeṣeṇa nyūnā satyayugasthitiḥ | pūrvaṃ ye rākṣasā rājan te kalau brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 42 || pākhaṇḍaniratāḥ prāyo bhavanti janavañcakāḥ | asatyavādinaḥ sarve vedadharmavivarjitāḥ || 43 || dāmbhikā lokacaturā mānino vedavarjitāḥ | śūdrasevāparāḥ kecinnānādharmapravartakāḥ || 44 || vedanindākarāḥ krūrā dharmabhraṣṭātivādukāḥ | yathā yathā kalirvṛddhiṃ yāti rājaṃstathā tathā || 45 || dharmasya satyamūlasya kṣayaḥ sarvātmanā bhavet | tathaiva kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca dharmavarjitāḥ || 46 || asatyavādinaḥ pāpāstathā varṇetarāḥ kalau | śūdradharmaratā viprāḥ pratigrahaparāyaṇāḥ || 47 || bhaviṣyanti kalau rājan yuge vṛddhiṃ gatāḥ kila | kāmacārāḥ striyaḥ kāmalobhamohasamanvitāḥ || 48 || pāpā mithyābhivādinyaḥ sadā kleśaratā nṛpa | svabhartṛvañjakā nityaṃ dharmabhāṣaṇapaṇḍitāḥ || 49 || bhavantyevaṃvidhā nāryaḥ pāpiṣṭhāśca kalau yuge | āhāraśuddhyā nṛpate cittaśuddhistu jāyate || 50 || śuddhe citte prakāśaḥ syāddharmasya nṛpasattama | vṛttasaṅkaradoṣeṇa jāyate dharmasaṅkaraḥ || 51 || dharmasya saṅkare jāte nūnaṃ syādvarṇasaṅkaraḥ | evaṃ kaliyuge bhūpa sarvadharmavivarjite || 52 || svavarṇadharmavārtaiṣā na kutrāpyupalabhyate | mahānto'pi ca dharmajñā adharmaṃ kurvate nṛpa || 53 || kalisvabhāva evaiṣa parihāryo na kenacit | tasmādatra
