manuṣyāṇāṃ svabhāvātpāpakāriṇām || 54 || niṣkṛtirna hi rājendra sāmānyopāyato bhavet | janamejaya uvāca bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada || 55 || kalāvadharmabahule narāṇāṃ kā gatirbhavet | yadyasti tadupāyaśceddayayā taṃ vadasva me || 56 || vyāsa uvāca eka eva mahārāja tatropāyo'sti nāparaḥ | sarvadoṣanirāsārthaṃ dhyāyeddevīpadāmbujam || 57 || na santyaghāni tāvanti yāvatī śaktirasti hi | nāsti devyāḥ pāpadāhe tasmādbhītiḥ kuto nṛpa || 58 || avaśenāpi yannāma līlayoccāritaṃ yadi | kiṃ kiṃ dadāti tajjñātuṃ samarthā na harādayaḥ || 59 || prāyaścittaṃ tu pāpānāṃ śrīdevīnāmasaṃsmṛtiḥ | tasmātkalibhayādrājan puṇyakṣetre vasennaraḥ || 60 || nirantaraṃ parāmbāyā nāmasaṃsmaraṇaṃ caret | chittvā bhittvā ca bhūtāni hatvā sarvamidaṃ jagat || 61 || devīṃ namati bhaktyā yo na sa pāpairvilipyate | rahasyaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ mayā rājannudīritam || 62 || vimṛśyaitadaśeṣeṇa bhaja devīpadāmbujam | ajapāṃ nāma gāyatrīṃ japanti nikhilā janāḥ || 63 || mahimānaṃ na jānanti māyāyā vaibhavaṃ mahat | gāyatrīṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve japanti hṛdayāntare || 64 || mahimānaṃ na jānanti māyāyā vaibhavaṃ mahat | etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ tattvayā nṛpa | yugadharmavyavasthāyāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 65 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe yugadharmavyavasthāvarṇanaṃ nāmakādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <6.12> hariścandrasya jalodaravyādhipīḍāvarṇanam rājovāca tīrthāni bhuvi puṇyāni brūhi me munisattama | gamyāni mānavairdevaiḥ kṣetrāṇi saritastathā || 1 || phalaṃ ca yādṛśaṃ yatra tīrtheṣu snānadānataḥ | vidhiṃ tu tīrthayātrāyāṃ niyamāṃśca viśeṣataḥ || 2 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi tīrthāni vividhāni ca | yeṣu tīrtheṣu devīnāṃ praśastānyāyanāni ca || 3 || nadīnāṃ jāhnavī śreṣṭhā yamunā ca sarasvatī | narmadā gaṇḍakī sindhurgomatī tamasā tathā || 4 || kāverī candrabhāgā ca puṇyā vetravatī śubhā | carmaṇvatī ca sarayūstāpī sābhramatī tathā || 5 || etāśca kathitā rājannanyāśca śataśaḥ punaḥ | tāsāṃ samudragāḥ puṇyāḥ svalpapuṇyā hyanabdhigāḥ || 6 || samudragānāṃ tāḥ puṇyāḥ sarvadaughavahāstu yāḥ | māsadvayaṃ śrāvaṇādau tāśca sarvā rajasvalāḥ || 7 || bhavanti vṛṣṭiyogena grāmyavārivahāstathā | puṣkaraṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ supāvanam || 8 || prabhāsaṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca naimiṣāraṇyameva ca | viśrutaṃ cārbudāraṇyaṃ śailāśca pāvanāstathā || 9 || śrīśailaśca sumeruśca parvato gandhamādanaḥ | sarāṃsi caiva puṇyāni mānasaṃ sarvaviśrutam || 10 || tathā bindusaraḥ śreṣṭhamacchodaṃ nāma pāvanam | āśramāstu tathā puṇyā munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 11 || viśrutastu sadā puṇyaḥ khyāto badarikāśramaḥ | naranārāyaṇau yatra tepāte tau munī tapaḥ || 12 || vāmanāśrama ākhyātaḥ śatayūpāśramastathā | yena yatra tapastaptaṃ tasya nāmnātiviśrutaḥ || 13 || evaṃ puṇyāni sthānāni hyasaṃkhyātāni bhūtale | munibhiḥ parigītāni pāvanāni mahīpate || 14 || eṣu sthāneṣu sarvatra devīsthānāni bhūpate | darśanātpāpahārīṇi vasanti niyamena ca || 15 || kathayiṣyāmi tānyagre prasaṅgena ca kānicit | tīrthāni nṛpa dānāni vratāni ca makhāstathā || 16 || tapāṃsi puṇyakarmāṇi sāpekṣāṇi mahīpate | dravyaśuddhiṃ kriyāśuddhiṃ manaḥśuddhimapekṣya ca || 17 || pāvanāni hi tīrthāni tapāṃsi ca vratāni ca | kadāciddravyaśuddhiḥ syātkriyāśuddhiḥ kadācana || 18 || durlabhā manasaḥ śuddhiḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nṛpa | manastu cañcalaṃ rājannanekaviṣayāśritam || 19 || kathaṃ śuddhaṃ bhavedrājannānābhāvasamāśritam | kāmakrodhau tathā lobho hyahaṅkāro madastathā || 20 || sarvavighnakarā hyete tapastīrthavrateṣu ca | ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ || 21 || svadharmapālanaṃ rājan sarvatīrthaphalapradam | nityakarmaparityāgānmārge saṃsargadoṣataḥ || 22 || vyarthaṃ tīrthādhigamanaṃ pāpamevāvaśiṣyate | kṣālayanti hi tīrthāni sarvathā dehajaṃ malam || 23 || mānasaṃ kṣālituṃ tāni na samarthāni vai nṛpa | śaktāni yadi cettāni gaṅgātīranivāsinaḥ || 24 || munayo drohasaṃyuktāḥ kathaṃ syurbhāviteśvarāḥ | vasiṣṭhasadṛśāḥ prahvā viśvāmitrādayaḥ kila || 25 || rāgadveṣaratāḥ sarve kāmakrodhākulāḥ sadā | cittaśuddhimayaṃ tīrthaṃ gaṅgādibhyo'tipāvanam || 26 || yadi syāddaivayogena kṣālayatyāntaraṃ malam | viśeṣeṇa tu satsaṅgo jñānaniṣṭhasya bhūpate || 27 || na vedā na ca śāstrāṇi na vratāni tapāṃsi na | na makhā na ca dānāni cittaśuddhestu kāraṇam || 28 || vasiṣṭho brahmaṇaḥ putro vedavidyāviśāradaḥ | rāgadveṣānvitaḥ kāmaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritaḥ || 29 || āḍībakaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ viśvāmitravasiṣṭhayoḥ | jātaṃ nirarthakaṃ dveṣāddevānāṃ vismayapradam || 30 || viśvāmitro bakastatra jātaḥ paramatāpasaḥ | śaptaḥ sa tu vasiṣṭhena hariścandrasya kāraṇāt || 31 || kauśikena vasiṣṭho'pi śastvāḍīdehabhākkṛtaḥ | śāpādāḍībakau jātau tau munī viśadaprabhau || 32 || nivāsaṃ prāpatustīre saraso mānasasya ca | cakraturdāruṇaṃ yuddhaṃ nakhacañcupratāḍanaiḥ || 33 || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ yāvattāvṛṣī roṣasaṃyutau | yuyudhāte madonmattau siṃhāviva parasparam || 34 || rājovāca kathaṃ tau muniśārdūlau tāpasau dharmatatparau | parasparaṃ vairaparau sañjātau kena hetunā || 35 || śāpaṃ parasparaṃ kena kāraṇena mahāmatī | dattavantau mithaḥ kleśakārakau duḥkhadau nṛṇām || 36 || vyāsa uvāca hariścandro nṛpaśreṣṭhastriśaṃkutanayaḥ purā | babhūva ravivaṃśīyo rāmacandrasya pūrvajaḥ || 37 || anapatyaḥ sa rājarṣirvaruṇāya mahākratum | pratijajñe putrakāmo naramedhaṃ durāsadam || 38 || varuṇastasya santuṣṭo yajñasya niyame kṛte | dadhāra garbhaṃ rājñastu bhāryā paramasundarī || 39 || rājā babhūva santuṣṭo dṛṣṭvā bhāryāṃ sadohadām | cakāra vidhivatkarma garbhasaṃskārakārakam || 40 || suṣuve tanayaṃ nārī sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam | mudaṃ prāpa nṛpastatra putre jāte viśāmpate || 41 || kṛtavāñjātakarmādisaṃskāravidhimuttamam | dadau hiraṇyaṃ gā dogdhīrbrāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥ || 42 || janmotsave'tisaṃvṛtte gehe vai yādasāmpatiḥ | ājagāma mahārāja vipraveṣadharastathā || 43 || pūjitaḥ pārthivenātha dattvā vidhivadāsanam | kārye pṛṣṭe'bravīdvākyaṃ varuṇo'smīti bhūpatim || 44 || kuru yajñaṃ sutaṃ kṛtvā paśuṃ paramapāvanam | satyavāgbhava rājendra saṃkalpastu tvayā kṛtaḥ || 45 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā vihvalo'tivyathākulaḥ | saṃstabhyādhiṃ nṛpaḥ prāha varuṇaṃ satkṛtāñjaliḥ || 46 || svāminkaromi taṃ yajñaṃ sarvathā vidhipūrvakam | mayā te yatpratijñātaṃ bhavāmi satyavāgaham || 47 || pūrṇe māse viśudhyeta dharmapatnī surottama | viśuddhāyāṃ tu bhāryāyāṃ kartavyaḥ sa paśormakhaḥ || 48 || vyāsa uvāca ityukte vacane rājñā varuṇaḥ svagṛhaṃ gataḥ | rājā babhūva santuṣṭaḥ kiñciccintāturastathā || 49 || pūrṇe māsi punaḥ pāśī parīkṣārthaṃ nṛpālaye | ājagāma dvijo bhūtvā suveṣaḥ suṣṭhubhāṣakaḥ || 50 || kṛtārhaṇaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhūpatistaṃ surottamam | uvāca vinayopeto hetugarbhaṃ vacastadā || 51 || asaṃskṛtaṃ sutaṃ svāminyūpe badhnāmi taṃ katham | saṃskatya kṣatriyaṃ kṛtvā yaje'haṃ yajñamuttamam || 52 || dayase yadi deva tvaṃ jñātvā dīnaṃ svasevakam | asaṃskṛtasya bālasya nādhikāro'sti kutracit || 53 || varuṇa uvāca pratārayasi rājendra kṛtvā samayamagrataḥ | dustyajastava jānāmi sutasneho hyaputriṇaḥ || 54 || gṛhaṃ vrajāmi bhūpāla vacanāttava komalāt | kiyatkālaṃ pratīkṣyāhamāgamiṣyāmi te gṛham || 55 || bhavitavyaṃ tvayā tāta tadā satyavaco'nvitam | anyathā tvayi muñcāmi kopaṃ śāpasamanvitam || 56 || rājovāca samāvartanakarmānte sarvathā yādasāṃpate | kṛtvā putrapaśuṃ yajñe yajiṣye vidhipūrvakam || 57 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājño varuṇaḥ prītamānasaḥ | tathetyuktvā yayau tūrṇaṃ nṛpastu susthito'bhavat || 58 || rohitākhya iti khyātaḥ sutastasya vivṛddhimān | sañjātaścaturaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ ca viśāradaḥ || 59 || yajñasya kāraṇaṃ tena jñātaṃ sarvaṃ savistaram | bhayabhītastataḥ so'pi matvā maraṇamātmanaḥ || 60 || kṛtvā palāyanaṃ vīro gato'sau girigahvare | agamye nṛpatisthāne sthitastatra bhayāturaḥ || 61 || prāpte kāle'tha varuṇo yajñārthī nṛpatergṛham | gatvā tamāha bhūpālaṃ kuru yajñaṃ viśāṃpate || 62 || pramlānavadano rājā tamāha vyathitendriyaḥ | kiṃ karomi gataḥ kvāpi suto me surasattama || 63 || śrutvā tadvacanaṃ rājñaḥ kupito yādasāṃpatiḥ | śaśāpa taṃ nṛpaṃ kopādasatyavādinaṃ bhṛśam || 64 || jalodarābhidho vyādhirdehe bhavatu te nṛpa | yataḥ pratāritaścāhaṃ kṛtvā kapaṭapaṇḍita || 65 || iti śaptvā yayau dhāma svakaṃ pāśadharastadā | rājā cintāturastasthau bhavane vyādhipīḍitaḥ || 66 || yadātivyādhito rājā rogeṇa śāpajena ha | tadā śuśrāva putro'pi pitaraṃ vyādhipīḍitam || 67 || pānthikaḥ prāha putraṃ hi pitā te bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ | jalodaravikāreṇa śāpajena nṛpātmaja || 68 || vinaṣṭaṃ jīvitaṃ te'dya vṛthā jātasya durmate | yattyaktvā pitaraṃ duḥsthaṃ prāpto'si girigahvaram || 69 || kimanena śarīreṇa prāptaṃ te janmanaḥ phalam | dehadaṃ duḥkhitaṃ kṛtvā sthito'syatra sutādhama || 70 || prāṇāstyājyāḥ pituḥ kārye satputreṇeti niścayaḥ | tvadarthe duḥkhito rājā krandati vyādhipīḍitaḥ || 71 || vyāsa uvāca tadākarṇya vacastathyaṃ pānthikāddharmasaṃyutam | yadā cakre mano gantuṃ draṣṭuṃ tātaṃ vyathāturam || 72 || tadā vipravapurbhūtvā vāsavastamupāgamat | rahaḥ prāha hitaṃ vākyaṃ dayāvāniva bhārata || 73 || mūrkho'si rājaputra tvaṃ gamanāya matiṃ vṛthā | karoṣi pitaraṃ tvadya na jānāsi vyathāyutam || 74 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe hariścandrasya jalodaravyādhipīḍāvarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <6.13> āḍībakayuddha varṇanasahitaṃ devīmāhātmyavarṇanam indra uvāca sāhasaṃ kṛtavān rājā pūrvaṃ yatkathito makhaḥ | varuṇāya pratijñātaḥ putraṃ kṛtvā paśuṃ priyam || 1 || gate tvayi pitā putraṃ baddhvā yūpe'ghṛṇaḥ punaḥ | paśuṃ kṛtvā mahābuddhe vadhiṣyati vyathāturaḥ || 2 || itthaṃ niṣiddhastatputraḥ śakreṇāmitatejasā | sthitastatraiva māyeśīmāyayā mohito bhṛśam || 3 || yadā punaḥ punaḥ śrutvā pitaraṃ rogapīḍitam | gamanāya matiṃ cakre tadendraḥ pratyaṣedhayat || 4 || hariścandro'tiduḥkhārtaḥ papraccha gurumantike | sthitaṃ vasiṣṭhamekānte sarvajñaṃ hitatatparam || 5 || rājovāca bhagavan ki karomyadya kātaro'smi vyathākulaḥ | trāhi māṃ duḥkhamanasaṃ mahāvyādhibhayāturam || 6 || vasiṣṭha uvāca śṛṇu rājannupāyo'sti roganāśaṃ prati stutaḥ | trayodaśavidhāḥ putrāḥ kathitā dharmasaṃgrahe || 7 || tasmātkrītaṃ sutaṃ kṛtvā yajasva makhamuttamam | dravyaṃ dattvā yathoddiṣṭamānayasva dvijottamam || 8 || evaṃ kṛte makhe bhūpa roganāśo bhaviṣyati | varuṇo'pi prasannātmā bhaviṣyati yathāsukham || 9 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājā provāca mantriṇam | anveṣaya mahābuddhe viṣayeṣvatiyatnataḥ || 10 || kadācitko'pi lobhārthī dadāti svasutaṃ pitā | samānaya dhanaṃ dattvā yāvatprārthayate'pyasau || 11 || sarvathaiva samāneyo yajñārthe dvijabālakaḥ | na kāryā kṛpaṇā buddhistvayā matkāryahetave || 12 || prārthanīyastvayā putraḥ kasyaciddvijavādinaḥ | dravyeṇa dehi yajñārthaṃ kartavyo'sau paśuḥ kila || 13 || iti sañcoditastena sacivaḥ kāryahetave | anveṣayāmāsa pure grāme grāme gṛhe gṛhe || 14 || evamanveṣatastasya viṣaye kaścidāturaḥ | nirdhanastrisutaścāsīdajīgarteti nāmataḥ || 15 || tasya putraṃ śunaḥśepaṃ madhyamaṃ mantrisattamaḥ | ānayāmāsa dattvārthaṃ prārthitaṃ yaddhanaṃ tadā || 16 || samānīya śunaḥśepaṃ sacivaḥ kāryatatparaḥ | rājñe nivedayāmāsa paśuyogyaṃ dvijātmajam || 17 || rājātimuditastena viprānānīya sarvataḥ | kārayāmāsa sambhārānyajñārthaṃ vedavittamān || 18 || prārabdhe tu makhe tatra viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ | baddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śunaḥśepaṃ niṣiṣedha nṛpaṃ tadā || 19 || rājanmā sāhasaṃ kārṣīrmuñcainaṃ dvijabālakam | prārthayāmyahamāyuṣman sukhaṃ te'dya bhaviṣyati || 20 || krandatyayaṃ śunaḥśepaḥ karuṇā māṃ dunotyapi | dayāvānbhava rājendra kuru me vacanaṃ nṛpa || 21 || paradehasya rakṣāyai svadehaṃ ye dayāparāḥ | dadati kṣatriyāḥ pūrvaṃ svargakāmāḥ śucivratāḥ || 22 || tvaṃ svadehasya rakṣārthaṃ haṃsi dvijasutaṃ balāt | pāpaṃ mā kuru rājendra dayāvān bhava bālake || 23 || sarveṣāṃ sadṛśī prītirdehe vetsi svayaṃ nṛpa | muñcainaṃ bālakaṃ tasmātpramāṇaṃ yadi me vacaḥ || 24 || vyāsa ktvaca anādṛtya ca tadvākyaṃ rājā duḥkhāturo bhṛśam | na mumoca munistasmai cūkopātīva tāpasaḥ || 25 || upadeśaṃ dadau tasmai śunaḥśepāya kauśikaḥ | mantraṃ pāśadharasyātha dayāvānvedavittamaḥ || 26 || śunaḥśepo'pi taṃ mantramasakṛdvadhakarśitaḥ | stutasvareṇa cukrośa saṃsmaranvaruṇaṃ bhṛśam || 27 || stuvantaṃ muniputraṃ taṃ jñātvā vai yādasāṃ patiḥ | tatrāgatya śunaḥśepaṃ mumoca karuṇārṇavaḥ || 28 || rogahīnaṃ nṛpaṃ kṛtvā varuṇaḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau | viśvāmitrastu taṃ putraṃ kṛtavānmocitaṃ mṛteḥ || 29 || na kṛtaṃ vacanaṃ rājñā kauśikasya mahātmanaḥ | roṣaṃ dadhāra manasā rājopari sa gādhijaḥ || 30 || ekasminsamaye rājā hayārūḍho vanaṃ gataḥ | sūkaraṃ hantukāmastu madhyāhne kauśikītaṭe || 31 || vṛddhabrāhmaṇaveṣeṇa viśvāmitreṇa vañcitaḥ | sarvasvaṃ prārthitaṃ tasya gṛhītaṃ rājyamadbhutam || 32 || pīḍito'sau hariścandro yajamāno yato bhṛśam | vasiṣṭhaḥ kauśikaṃ prāha vane prāptaṃ yadṛcchayā || 33 || kṣatriyādhama durbuddhe vṛthā brāhmaṇaveṣabhṛt | bakadharma vṛthā kiṃ tvaṃ garvaṃ vahasi dāmbhika || 34 || kasmāttvayā nṛpaśreṣṭho yajamāno mamāpyasau | aparādhaṃ vinā jālma gamito duḥkhamadbhutam || 35 || bakadhyānaparo yasmāttasmāttvaṃ vai bako bhava | iti śapto vasiṣṭhena kauśikaḥ prāha taṃ punaḥ || 36 || tvamapyāḍirbhavāyuṣman bako'haṃ yāvadeva hi | vyāsa uvāca evaṃ parasparaṃ dattvā śāpaṃ tau krodhapīḍitau || 37 || aṇḍajau tarasā jātau sarasyāḍībakau munī | ekasminpādape nīḍaṃ kṛtvāsau bakarūpabhāk || 38 || viśvāmitraḥ sthitastatra divye sarasi mānase | anyasmitpādape kṛtvā vasiṣṭho nīḍamuttamam || 39 || āḍīrūpadharastasthāvanyonyaṃ dveṣatatparau | dine dine tau saṃgrāmaṃ cakratuḥ krodhasaṃyutau || 40 || duḥkhadaṃ sarvalokānāṃ krandamānāvubhau bhṛśam | cañcupakṣaprahāraistu nakhāghātaiḥ parasparam || 41 || jaghnatū rudhiraklinau puṣpitāviva kiṃśukau | evaṃ bahūni varṣāṇi pakṣirūpadharau munī || 42 || sthitau tatra mahārāja śāpapāśena yantritau | rājovāca kathaṃ muktau muniśreṣṭhau śāpādvasiṣṭhakauśikau || 43 || tanmamācakṣva viprarṣe paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me | vyāsa uvāca yudhyamānābvubhau dṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 44 || tatrājagāmānimiṣairvṛtaḥ sarvairdayāparaiḥ | tāvāśvāsya jagatkartā yuddhato vinivārya ca || 45 || śāpaṃ saṃmocayāmāsa tayoḥ kṣiptaṃ parasparam | tato jagmuḥ surāḥ sarve svāni dhiṣṇyāni padmabhūḥ || 46 || satyalokaṃ jagāmāśu haṃsārūḍhaḥ pratāpavān | viśvāmitro'pyagāttūrṇaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ svāśramaṃ gataḥ || 47 || mithaḥ snehaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prajāpatyupadeśataḥ | maitrāvaruṇināpyevaṃ kṛtaṃ yuddhamakāraṇam || 48 || kauśikena samaṃ bhūpa duḥkhadaṃ ca parasparam | ko nāma mānavo loke devo vā dānavo'pi vā || 49 || ahaṅkārajayaṃ kṛtvā sarvadā sukhabhāgbhavet | tasmādrājaṃścittaśuddhirmahatāmapi durlabhā || 50 || yatnena sādhanīyā sā tadvihīnaṃ nirarthakam | tīrthaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ yatkiñciddharmasādhanam || 51 || (śraddhātra trividhā proktā sāttvikī rājasī tathā | tāmasī sarvadeheṣu dehināṃ dharmakarmasu || sāttvikī durlabhā loke yathoktaphaladā sadā | tadardhaphaladā proktā rājasī vidhisaṃyutā || tāmasī tvaphalā rājanna tu kīrtikarī punaḥ | kāmakrodhābhibhūtānāṃ janānāṃ nṛpasattama ||) vāsanārahitaṃ kṛtvā taccittaṃ śravaṇādinā | tīrthādiṣu vasennityaṃ devīpūjanatatparaḥ || 52 || devīnāmāni vacasā gṛhṇaṃstasyā guṇānstuvan | dhyāyaṃstasyāḥ padāmbhojaṃ kalidoṣabhayārditaḥ || 53 || evaṃ tu kurvatastasya na kadācitkalerbhayam | anāyāsena saṃsārānmucyate pātakī janaḥ || 54 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādalasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe āḍībakayuddha varṇanasahitaṃ devīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <6.14> vasiṣṭhasya maitrāvaruṇiritināmavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca maitrāvaruṇirityuktaṃ nāma tasya muneḥ katham | vasiṣṭhasya mahābhāga brahmaṇastanujasya ha || 1 || kimasau karmato nāma prāptavān guṇatastathā | brūhi me vadatāṃśreṣṭha kāraṇaṃ tasya nāmajam || 2 || vyāsa uvāca nibodha nṛpatiśreṣṭha vasiṣṭho brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ | nimiśāpāttanuṃ tyaktvā punarjāto mahādyutiḥ || 3 || mitrāvaruṇayoryasmāttasmāttannāma viśrutam | maitrāvaruṇirityasmim̐lloke sarvatra pārthiva || 4 || rājovāca kasmācchaptaḥ sa dharmātmā rājñā brahmātmajo muniḥ | citrametanmuniṃ lagno rājñaḥ śāpo'tidāruṇaḥ || 5 || anāgasaṃ muniṃ rājā kimasau śaptavānmune | kāraṇaṃ vada dharmajña tasya śāpasya mūlataḥ || 6 || vyāsa uvāca kāraṇaṃ tu mayā proktaṃ tava pūrvaṃ viniścitam | saṃsāro'yaṃ tribhirvyāpto rājanmāyāguṇaiḥ kila || 7 || dharmaṃ karotu bhūpālaścarantu tāpasāstapaḥ | sarveṣāṃ tu guṇairviddhaṃ nojjvalaṃ tadbhavediha || 8 || kāmakrodhābhibhūtāśca rājāno munayastathā | lobhāhaṅkārasaṃyuktāścaranti duścaraṃ tapaḥ || 9 || yajanti kṣatriyā rājan rajoguṇasamāvṛtāḥ | brāhmaṇāstu tathā rājan na ko'pi sattvasaṃyutaḥ || 10 || ṛṣiṇāsau nimiḥ śaptastena śapto muniḥ punaḥ | duḥkhādduḥkhataraṃ prāptāvubhāvapi vidherbalāt || 11 || dravyaśuddhiḥ kriyāśuddhirmanasaḥ śuddhirujjvalā | durlabhā prāṇināṃ bhūpa saṃsāre triguṇātmake || 12 || parāśaktiprabhāvo'yaṃ nollaṃghyaḥ kenacitkvacit | yasyānugṛhamicchetsā mocayatyeva taṃ kṣaṇāt || 13 || mahānto'pi na mucyante haribrahmaharādayaḥ | pāmarā api mucyante yathā satyavratādayaḥ || 14 || tasyāstu hṛdayaṃ ko'pi na vetti bhuvanatraye | tathāpi bhaktavaśyeyaṃ bhavatyeva suniścitam || 15 || tasmāttadbhaktirāstheyā doṣanirbhūlanāya ca | rāgadambhādiyuktā cetsā bhaktirnāśinī bhavet || 16 || ikṣyākukulasambhūto nimirnāma narādhipaḥ | rūpavān guṇasampanno dharmajño lokarañjakaḥ || 17 || satyavādī dānaparo yājako jñānavācchuciḥ | dvādaśastanayo dhīmānprajāpālanatatparaḥ || 18 || puraṃ niveśayāmāsa gautamāśramasannidhau | jayantapurasaṃjñaṃ tu brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya saḥ || 19 || buddhistasya samutpannā yajeyamiti rājasī | yajñena bahukālena dakṣiṇāsaṃyutena ca || 20 || isvākuṃ pitaraṃ pṛṣṭvā yajñakāryāya pārthivaḥ | kārayāmāsa sambhāraṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || 21 || bhṛgumaṅgirasaṃ caiva vāmadevaṃ ca gautamam | vasiṣṭhaṃ ca pulastyaṃ ca ṛcīkaṃ pulahaṃ kratum || 22 || munīnāmantrayāmāsa sarvajñānvedapāragān | yajñavidyāpravīṇāṃśca tāpasānvedavittamān || 23 || rājā sambhṛtasambhāraḥ sampūjya gurumātmanaḥ | vasiṣṭhaṃ prāha dharmajño vinayena samanvitaḥ || 24 || yajeyaṃ muniśārdūla yājayasva kṛpānidhe | gurustvaṃ sarvavettāsi kāryaṃ me kuru sāmpratam || 25 || yajñopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ samānītaṃ susaṃskṛtam | pañcavarṣasahasraṃ tu dīkṣāṃ kartuṃ matiśca me || 26 || yasminyajñe samārādhyā devī śrījagadambikā | tatprītyarthamahaṃ yajñaṃ karomi vidhipūrvakam || 27 || tacchrutvāsau nimervākyaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha bhūpatim | indreṇāhaṃ vṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ yajñārthaṃ nṛpasattama || 28 || parāśaktimakhaṃ kartumudyuktaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | sa dīkṣāṃ gamito devaḥ pañcavarṣaśatātmikām || 29 || tasmāttvamantaraṃ tāvatpratipālaya pārthiva | indrayajñe samāpte'tra kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaspateḥ || 30 || āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ rājaṃstāvattvaṃ pratipālaya | rājovāca mayā nimantritāścānye munayo yajñakāraṇāt || 31 || sambhārāḥ sambhṛtāḥ sarve pālayāmi kathaṃ guro | ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule brahmangurustvaṃ vedavittamaḥ || 32 || kathaṃ tyaktvādya me kāryamudyato gantumāśu vai | na te yuktaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha yadutsṛjya makhaṃ mama || 33 || gantāsi dhanalobhena lobhākulitacetanaḥ | nivārito'pi rājñā sa jagāmendramakhaṃ guruḥ || 34 || rājāpi vimanā bhūtvā gautamaṃ pratyapūjayat | iyāja himavatpārśve sāgarasya samīpataḥ || 35 || dakṣiṇā bahulā dattā viprebhyo makhakarmaṇi | niminā pañcasāhasrī dīkṣā tatra kṛtā nṛpa || 36 || ṛtvijaḥ pūjitāḥ kāmaṃ dhanairgobhirmudā yutāḥ | śakrayajñasamāpte tu pañcavarṣaśatātmake || 37 || ājagāma vasiṣṭhastu rājñaḥ satradidṛkṣayā | āgatya saṃsthitastatra darśanārthaṃ nṛpasya ca || 38 || tadā rājā prasuptastu nidrayāpahṛto bhṛśam | nāsau prabodhito bhṛtyairnāgatastu muniṃ nṛpaḥ || 39 || vasiṣṭhasya tato manyuḥ prādurbhūto'vamānataḥ | adarśanānnimestatra cukopa munisattamaḥ || 40 || śāpaṃ ca dattavāṃstasmai rājñe manyuvaśaṃ gataḥ | yasmāttvaṃ māṃ guruṃ tyaktvā kṛtvānyaṃ gurumātmanaḥ || 41 || dīkṣito'si balānmanda māmavajñāya pārthiva | vārito'pi mayā tasmādvidehastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 42 || patatvidaṃ śarīraṃ te videho bhava bhūpate | vyāsa uvāca iti tadvyāhṛtaṃ śrutvā rājñastu paricārakāḥ || 43 || sadyaḥ prabodhayāmāsurmunimāhuḥ prakopitam | kupitaṃ taṃ samāgatya rājā vigatakalmaṣaḥ || 44 || uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ hetugarbhaṃ ca yuktimat | . mama doṣo na dharmajña gatastvaṃ tṛṣṇayā''kulaḥ || 45 || hitvā māṃ yajamānaṃ vai prārthito'pi mayā bhṛśam | na lajjase dvijaśreṣṭha kṛtvā karma jugupsitam || 46 || santoṣe brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha jānandharmasya niścayam | putro'si brahmaṇaḥ sākṣādvedavedāṅgavittamaḥ || 47 || na vetsi vipradharmasya gatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ duratyayām | ātmadoṣaṃ mayi jñātvā mṛṣā māṃ śastumicchasi || 48 || tyājyastu sujanaiḥ krodhaścaṇḍālādadhiko yataḥ | vṛthā krodhaparītena mayi śāpaḥ prapātitaḥ || 49 || tavāpi ca patatvadya deho'yaṃ krodhasaṃyutaḥ | evaṃ śapto munī rājñā rājā ca muninā tathā || 50 || parasparaṃ prāpya śāpaṃ duḥkhitau tau babhūvatuḥ | vasiṣṭhastvaticintārto brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 51 || nivedayāmāsa tathā śāpaṃ bhūpakṛtaṃ mahat | vasiṣṭa uvāca rājñā śapto'smi deho'yaṃ patatvadya taveti vai || 52 || kiṃ karomi pitaḥ prāpyaṃ kaṣṭaṃ kāyaprapātajam | anyadehasamutpattau janakaṃ vada sāmpratam || 53 || tathā me dehasaṃyogaḥ pūrvavatsamapadyatām | yādṛśaṃ jñānametasmindehe tatrāstu tatpitaḥ || 54 || samartho'si mahārāja prasādaṃ kartumarhasi | vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā provāca taṃ sutam || 55 || mitrāvaruṇayostejastvaṃ praviśya sthiro bhava | tasmādayonijaḥ kāle bhavitā tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 56 || punardehaṃ samāsādya dharmayukto bhaviṣyasi | bhūtātmā vedavitkāmaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvapūjitaḥ || 57 || evamuktastadā pitrā prayayau varuṇālayam | kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ prītyā praṇamya ca pitāmaham || 58 || viveśa sa tayordehe mitrāvaruṇayoḥ kila | jīvāṃśena vasiṣṭho'tha tyaktvā dehamanuttamam || 59 || kadācittūrvaśī rājannāgatā varuṇālayam | yadṛcchayā varārohā sakhīgaṇasamāvṛtā || 60 || dṛṣṭvā tāmapsarāṃ divyāṃ rūpayauvanasaṃyutām | jātau kāmāturau devau tadā tāmūcaturnṛpa || 61 || vivaśau cārusarvāṅgīṃ devakanyāṃ manoramām | āvāṃ tvamanavadyāṅgi varayasva samākulau || 62 || viharasva yathākāmaṃ sthāne'sminvaravarṇini | tathoktā sā tato devī tābhyāṃ tatra sthitāvaśā || 63 || kṛtvā bhāvaṃ sthiraṃ devī mitrāvaruṇayorgṛhe | sā gṛhītvā tayorbhāvaṃ saṃsthitā cārudarśanā || 64 || tayostu patitaṃ vīryaṃ kumbhe daivādanāvṛte | tasmājjātau munī rājandvāvevātimanoharau || 65 || agastiḥ prathamastatra vasiṣṭhaścāparastathā | mitrāvaruṇayorvīryāttāpasāvṛṣisattamau || 66 || prathamastu vanaṃ prāpto bāla eva mahātapāḥ | ikṣvākustu vasiṣṭhaṃ taṃ bālaṃ vavre purohitam || 67 || vaṃśasyāsya sukhārthaṃ te pālayāmāsa pārthiva | viśeṣeṇa muniṃ jñātvā prītyā yukto babhūva ha || 68 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ vasiṣṭhasya ca kāraṇam | śāpāddehāntaraprāptirmitrāvaruṇayoḥ kule || 69 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe vasiṣṭhasya maitrāvaruṇiritināmavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <6.15> devīmahimni nānābhāvavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca dehaprāptirvasiṣṭhasya kathitā bhavatā kila | nimiḥ kathaṃ punardehaṃ prāptavāniti me vada || 1 || vyāsa uvāca vasiṣṭhena ca samprāptaḥ punardeho narādhipa | niminā na tathā prāpto dehaḥ śāpādanantaram || 2 || yadā śapto vasiṣṭhena tadā te brāhmaṇāḥ kratau ṛtvijo ye vṛtā rājñā te sarve samacintayan || 3 || kiṃ kartavyamaho'smābhiḥ śāpadagdho mahīpatiḥ | asminyajñe tvasampūrṇe dīkṣāyuktaśca dhārmikaḥ || 4 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ kāryametadviparītamabhūtkila | avaśyambhāvibhāvatvādaśaktāḥ sma nivāraṇe || 5 || mantrairbahuvidhairdehaṃ tadā tasya mahātmanaḥ | rakṣitaṃ dhārayāmāsuḥ kiñcicchvasanasaṃyutam || 6 || gandhairmālyaiśca vividhaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | mantraśaktyā pratiṣṭabhya nirvikāraṃ supūjitam || 7 || samāpte ca kratau tatra devāḥ sarve samāgatāḥ | ṛtvigbhistu stutāḥ sarve suprītāścābhavannṛpa || 8 || vijñaptā munibhiḥ stotrairnirviṇṇātmānamabruvan | prasannāḥ sma mahīpāla varaṃ varaya suvrata || 9 || yajñenānena rājarṣe varaṃ janma vidhīyate | devadehaṃ nṛdehaṃ vā yatte manasi vāñchitam || 10 || dṛptaḥ kāmaṃ purodhāste mṛtyuloke yathāsukham | evamukto nimerātmā santuṣṭastānuvāca ha || 11 || na dehe mama vāñchāsti sarvadaiva vinaśvare | vāso me sarvasattvānāṃ dṛṣṭāvastu surottamāḥ || 12 || netreṣu sarvabhūtānāṃ vāyubhūtaścarāmyaham | evamuktāḥ surāstatra nimerātmānamabruvan || 13 || prārthaya tvaṃ mahārāja devīṃ sarveśvarīṃ śivām | makhenānena santuṣṭā sā te'bhīṣṭaṃ vidhāsyati || 14 || sa devairevamuktastu prārthayāmāsa devatām | stotrairnānāvidhairdivyairbhaktyā gadgadayā girā || 15 || prasannā sā tadā devī pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ dadau | koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ rūpaṃ lāvaṇyadīpitam | 16 dṛṣṭvā pramuditāḥ sarve kṛtakṛtyāśca cetasi | prasannāyāṃ devatāyāṃ rājā vavre varaṃ nṛpa || 17 || jñānaṃ tadvimalaṃ dehi yena mokṣo bhavedapi | netreṣu sarvabhūtānāṃ nivāso me bhavediti || 18 || tataḥ prasannā deveśī provāca jagadambikā | jñānaṃ te vimalaṃ bhūyātprārabdhasyāvaśeṣataḥ || 19 || netreṣu sarvabhūtānāṃ nivāso'pi bhaviṣyati | nimiṣaṃ yānti cakṣūṃṣi tvatkṛtenaiva dehinām || 20 || tava vāsātsanimiṣā mānavāḥ paśavastathā | pataṅgāśca bhaviṣyanti punaścānimiṣāḥ surāḥ || 21 || iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai tadā śrīvaradevatā | āmantrya ca munīnsarvāṃstatraivāntarhitābhavat || 22 || antarhitāyāṃ devyāṃ tu munayastatra saṃsthitāḥ | vicintya vithivatsarve nimerdehaṃ samāharan || 23 || araṇiṃ tatra saṃsthāpya mamandhurmantravattadā | mantrahomairmahātmānaḥ putrahetornimeratha || 24 || araṇyāṃ mathyamānāyāṃ putraḥ prādurabhūttadā | sarvalakṣaṇasampannaḥ sākṣānnimirivāparaḥ || 25 || araṇyā mathanājjātastasmānmithiriti smṛtaḥ | yenāyaṃ janakājjātastenāsau janako'bhavat || 26 || videhastu nimirjāto yasmāttasmāttadanvaye | samudbhūtāstu rājāno videhā iti kīrtitāḥ || 27 || evaṃ nimisuto rājā prathito janako'bhavat | nagarī nirmitā tena gaṅgātīre manoharā || 28 || mithileti suvikhyātā gopurāṭṭālasaṃyutā | dhanadhānyasamāyuktā haṭṭaśālāvirājitā || 29 || vaṃśe'sminye'pi rājānaste sarve janakāstathā | vikhyātā jñāninaḥ sarve videhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 30 || etatte kathitaṃ rājannimerākhyānamuttamam | śāpādyasya videhatvaṃ vistarāduditaṃ mayā || 31 || rājovāca bhagavanbhavatā proktaṃ nimiśāpasya kāraṇam | śrutvā sandehamāpannaṃ mano me'tīva cañcalam || 32 || vasiṣṭho brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho rājñaścaiva purohitaḥ | putraḥ paṅkajayonestu rājñā śaptaḥ kathaṃ muniḥ || 33 || guruṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ jñātvā niminā na kṛtā kṣamā | yajñakarma śubhaṃ kṛtvā kathaṃ krodhamupāgataḥ || 34 || jñātvā dharmasya vijñānaṃ kathamikṣvākusambhavaḥ | krodhasya vaśamāpantaḥ śaptavānbrāhmaṇaṃ gurum || 35 || vyāsa uvāca kṣamātidurlabhā rājanprāṇibhirajitātmabhiḥ | kṣamāvāndurlabho loke susamartho viśeṣataḥ || 36 || sarvasaṅgaparityāgī munirbhavatu tāpasaḥ | nidrākṣudhorvijetā ca yogābhyāse suniṣṭhitaḥ || 37 || kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho hyahaṅkāraścaturthakaḥ | durjñeyā dehamadhyasthā ripavastena sarvathā || 38 || na bhūtapūrvaḥ saṃsāre na caiva vartate'dhunā | bhavitā na pumānkaścidyo jayeta ripūnimān || 39 || na svarge na ca bhūloke brahmaloke hareḥ pade | kailāse nedṛśaḥ kaścidyo jayeta ripūnimān || 40 || munayo brahmaputrāśca tathānye tāpasottamāḥ | te'pi guṇatrayāviddhāḥ kiṃ punarmānavā bhuvi || 41 || kapilaḥ sāṃkhyavettā ca yogābhyāsarataḥ śuciḥ | tenāpi daivayogāddhi pradagdhāḥ sagarātmajāḥ || 42 || tasmādrājannahaṅkārātsañjātaṃ bhuvanatrayam | kāryakāraṇabhāvāttu tadviyuktaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 43 || brahmā guṇatrayāviṣṭo viṣṇuścaivātha śaṅkaraḥ | prabhavanti śarīreṣu teṣāṃ bhāvāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 44 || mānavānāṃ ca kā vārtā sattvaikāntavyavasthitau | guṇānāṃ saṅkaro rājansarvatra samavasthitaḥ || 45 || kadācitsattvavṛddhiḥ syātkadācidrajasaḥ kila | kadācittamaso vṛddhiḥ samabhāvaḥ kadācana || 46 || nirguṇaḥ paramātmāsau nirlepaḥ paramo'vyayaḥ | alakṣyaḥ sarvasattvānāmaprameyaḥ sanātanaḥ || 47 || tathaiva paramā śaktirnirguṇā brahmasaṃsthitā | durjñeyā cālpamatibhiḥ sarvabhūtavyavasthitiḥ || 48 || parātmanastathā śaktestayoraikyaṃ sadaiva hi | abhinnaṃ tadvapurjñātvā mucyate sarvadoṣataḥ || 49 || tajjñānādeva mokṣaḥ syāditi vedāntaḍiṇḍimaḥ | yo veda sa vimukto'sminsaṃsāre triguṇātmake || 50 || jñānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ śābdikaṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam | vedaśāstrārthavijñānāttadbhavedbuddhiyogataḥ || 51 || vikalpāstatra bahavo bhavanti matikalpitāḥ | (kutarkakalpitāḥ kecitsatarkakalpitāḥ pare | vitarkairvibhramotpattirvibhramādbuddhibhraṃśatā | buddhibhraṃśājjñānanāśaḥ prāṇināṃ parikīrtitaḥ | ) anubhavākhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu jñānaṃ taddurlabhaṃ nṛpa || 52 || tattadā prāpyate tasya vettuḥ saṅgo yadā bhavet | śabdajñānānna kāryasya siddhirbhavati bhārata || 53 || tasmānnānubhavajñānaṃ sambhavatyatimānuṣam | antargataṃ tamaśchettuṃ śābdabodho hi na kṣamaḥ || 54 || yathā na naśyati tamaḥ kṛtayā dīpavārtayā | tatkarma yanna bandhāya sā vidyā yā vimuktaye || 55 || āyāsāyāparaṃ karma vidyānyā śilpanaipuṇam | śīlaṃ parahitatvaṃ ca kopābhāvaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ || 56 || santoṣaśceti vidyāyāḥ paripākojjvalaṃ phalam | vidyayā tapasā vāpi yogābhyāsena bhūpate || 57 || vinā kāmādiśatrūṇāṃ naiva nāśaḥ kadācana | (manastu cañcalaṃ rāsvabhāvādatidurgraham | tadvaśaḥ sarvathā prāṇī trividho bhuvanatraye | ) kāmakrodhādayo bhāvāścittajāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 58 || te tadā na bhavantyeva yadā vai nirjitaṃ manaḥ | tasmāttu niminā rājanna kṣamā vihitā munau || 59 || yathā yayātinā pūrvaṃ kṛtā śukre kṛtāgasi | bhṛguputreṇa śapto'pi yayātirnṛpasattamaḥ || 60 || na śaśāpa muniṃ krodhājjarāṃ rājā gṛhītavān | kaścitsaumyo bhavetkaścitkrūro bhavati pārthivaḥ || 61 || svabhāvabhedānnṛpate kasya doṣo'tra kalpyate | haihayā bhārgavānpūrvaṃ dhanalobhātpurohitān || 62 || brāhmaṇānmūlataḥ sarvāṃścicchiduḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ | pātakaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā brahmahatyāsamudbhavam || 63 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe devīmahimni nānābhāvavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <6.16> haihayairdhanāharaṇena saha bhṛgūṇāṃ vadhavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca kule kasya samutpannāḥ kṣatriyā haihayāśca te | brahmahatyāmanādṛtya nijaghnurbhārgavāṃśca ye || 1 || vairasya kāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ kiṃ me brūhi pitāmaha | nimittena vinā krodhaṃ kathaṃ kurvanti sattamāḥ || 2 || vairaṃ purohitaiḥ sārdhaṃ kasmātteṣāmajāyata | nālpahetorhi tadvairaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhaviṣyati || 3 || anyathā brāhmaṇān pūjyānkathaṃ jaghnuranāgasaḥ | bāhujā balavanto'pi pāpabhītāḥ kathaṃ na te || 4 || svalpe'parādhe ko hanyādvāḍavānkṣatriyarṣabhaḥ | sandeho me muniśreṣṭha kāraṇaṃ vaktumarhasi || 5 || sūta uvāca iti pṛṣṭastadā tena rājñā satyavatīsutaḥ | uvāca paramaprītaḥ kathāṃ saṃsmṛtya cetasā || 6 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu pārikṣite vārtāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ purātanīm | āścaryakāriṇīṃ samyagviditāṃ ca purā mayā || 7 || kārtavīryeti nāmnābhūddhaihayaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | sahasrabāhurbalavānarjuno dharmatatparaḥ || 8 || dattātreyasya śiṣyo'bhūdavatāro hareriva | siddhaḥ sarvārthadaḥ śākto bhṛgūṇāṃ yājya eva saḥ || 9 || yajvā paramadharmiṣṭhaḥ sadā dānaparāyaṇaḥ | dadau vittaṃ bhṛgubhyo'sau kṛtvā yajñānanekaśaḥ || 10 || dhaninaste dvijā jātā bhṛgavo nṛpadānataḥ | hayaratnasamṛddhyāḍhyāḥ sañjātāḥ prathitā bhuvi || 11 || svaryāte nṛpaśārdūle kārtavīryārjune punaḥ | haihayā nirdhanā jātāḥ kālena mahatā nṛpa || 12 || dhanakāryaṃ samutpannaṃ haihayānāṃ kadācana | yāciṣṇavo'bhijagmustānbhūgūṃste haihayā nṛpa || 13 || vinayaṃ kṣatriyāḥ kṛtvāpyayācanta dhanaṃ bahu | na daduste'tilobhārtā nāsti nāstītivādinaḥ || 14 || bhūmau ca nidadhuḥ kecidbhṛgavo dhanamuttamam | daduḥ keciddvijātibhyo jñātvā kṣatriyato bhayam || 15 || kṛtvā sthānāntare dravyaṃ brāhmaṇā bhayavihvalāḥ | tyaktvā''śramānyayuḥ sarve bhṛgavastṛṣṇayānvitāḥ || 16 || yājyāṃśca duḥkhitāndṛṣṭvā na dadurlobhamohitāḥ | palāyitvā gatāḥ sarve giridurgānupāśritāḥ || 17 || tataste haihayāstāta duḥkhitāḥ kāryagauravāt | bhṛgūṇāmāśramāñjagmurdravyārthaṃ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ || 18 || bhṛgūṃstu nirgatānvīkṣya śūnyāṃstyaktyā gṛhānatha | cakhanurbhūtalaṃ tatra dravyārthaṃ haihayā bhṛśam || 19 || khanatādhigataṃ vittaṃ kenacidbhṛguveśmani | dadṛśuḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve tadvittaṃ śramakarśitāḥ || 20 || yatra yatra samutpannaṃ bhūri dravyaṃ mahītalāt | tadā te pārśvabhāgasthabrāhmaṇānāṃ gṛhāṇyapi || 21 || nirbhidya haihayā dravyaṃ dadṛśurdhanalipsayā | brāhmaṇāścukuśaḥ sarve bhītāśca śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 22 || aticinvatsu viprāṇāṃ bhavanānniḥsṛtaṃ bahu | nijaghnustāñcharaiḥ kopādvāḍavāñcharaṇāgatān || 23 || yayuste giridurgāṃśca yatra vai bhṛgavaḥ sthitāḥ | āgarbhādanukṛntantaśceruścaiva mahīmimām || 24 || prāptānprāptānbhṛgūnsarvānnijaghnurniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ | ābālavṛddhānaparānavamanya ca pātakam || 25 || evamutpāṭyamāneṣu bhārgaveṣu yatastataḥ | hanyurgarbhāṃśca nārīṇāṃ gṛhītvā haihayā bhṛśam || 26 || rurudustāḥ striyaḥ kāmaṃ kurarya iva duḥkhitāḥ | garbhāśca kṛntitā yāsāṃ kṣatriyaiḥ pāpaniścayaiḥ || 27 || anye'pyāhuśca tāndṛptānmunayastīrthavāsinaḥ | muñcantu kṣatriyāḥ krodhaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu bhayāvaham || 28 || ayuktametadārabdhaṃ bhavadbhiḥ karma garhitam | yadgarbhānbhṛgupatnīnāṃ nihanyuḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ || 29 || atyugrapuṇyapāpānāmihaiva phalamāpnuyāt | tasmājjugupsitaṃ karma tyaktavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 30 || tānāhurhaihayāḥ kruddhā munīnatha dayāparān | bhavantaḥ sādhavaḥ sarve nārthajñāḥ pāpakarmaṇām || 31 || ebhirhṛtaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvajānāṃ mahātmanām | vañcayitvā chalābhijñairmārge pāṭaccarairiva || 32 || ete pratārakā dambhāstādṛśā bakavṛttayaḥ | utpanne ca mahākārye prārthitā vinayena te || 33 || na daduḥ prārthitaṃ viprāḥ pādavṛddhyāpi yācitāḥ | nāstītivādinaḥ stabdhāḥ duḥkhitānvīkṣya yājyakān || 34 || dhanaṃ prāptaṃ kārtavīryādrakṣitaṃ kena hetunā | na kṛtāḥ kratavaḥ kiṃ tairdānaṃ cārthiṣu bhūriśaḥ || 35 || na sañcitavyaṃ vipraistu dhanaṃ cāpi kadācana | yaṣṭavyaṃ vidhivaddeyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ ca yathāsukham || 36 || dravye caurabhayaṃ proktaṃ tathā rājabhayaṃ dvijāḥ | vahnerbhayaṃ mahāghoraṃ tathā dhūrtabhayaṃ mahat || 37 || yena kenāpyupāyena dhanaṃ tyajati rakṣakam | athavāsau mṛto yāti dravyaṃ tyaktvā hyasadgatim || 38 || pādavṛddhyā tathāsmābhiḥ prārthitaṃ vinayānvitaiḥ | tathāpi lobhasandigdhairna dattaṃ naḥ purohitaiḥ || 39 || dānaṃ bhogastathā nāśo dhanasya gatirīdṛśī | dānabhogau kṛtīnāṃ ca nāśaḥ pāpātmanāṃ kila || 40 || na dātā na ca yo bhoktā kṛpaṇo guptitatparaḥ | rājñāsau sarvathā daṇḍyo vañcako duḥkhabhāṅnaraḥ || 41 || tasmādvayaṃ gurūnetānvañcakānbrāhmaṇādhamān | hantuṃ samudyatāḥ sarve na krodhavyaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || 42 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā hetumadvākyaṃ tānāśvāsya munīnatha | viceruśca vicinvānā bhṛgudārānanekaśaḥ || 43 || bhayārtā bhṛgupatnyastu himavantaṃ dharādharam | prapedire rudantyaśca vepamānāḥ kṛśā bhṛśam || 44 || evaṃ te haihayairviprāḥ pīḍitā dhanakāmukaiḥ | nihatāśca yathākāmaṃ saṃrabdhaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ || 45 || lobha eva manuṣyāṇāṃ dehasaṃstho mahāripuḥ | sarvaduḥkhākaraḥ prokto duḥkhadaḥ prāṇanāśakaḥ || 46 || sarvapāpasya mūlaṃ hi sarvadā tṛṣṇayānvitaḥ | virodhakṛttrivarṇānāṃ sarvārteḥ kāraṇaṃ tathā || 47 || lobhāttyajanti dharmaṃ vai kuladharmaṃ tathaiva hi | mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ hanti pitaraṃ bāndhavaṃ tathā || 48 || guruṃ mitraṃ tathā bhāryāṃ putraṃ ca bhaginīṃ tathā | lobhāviṣṭo na kiṃ kuryādakṛtyaṃ pāpamohitaḥ || 49 || krodhātkāmādahaṅkārāllobha eva mahāripuḥ | prāṇāṃstyajati lobhena kiṃ punaḥ syādanāvṛtam || 50 || pūrvajāste mahārāja dharmajñāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ | pāṇḍavāḥ kauravāścaiva lobhena nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 51 || yatra bhīṣmaśca droṇaśca kṛpaḥ karṇaśca bāhlikaḥ | bhīmaseno dharbhaputrastathaivārjunakeśavau || 52 || tathāpi yuddhamatyugraṃ kṛtaṃ taiśca parasparam | kuṭumbakadanaṃ bhūri kṛtaṃ lobhāturairiha || 53 || hato droṇo hato bhīṣmastathaiva pāṇḍavātmajāḥ | bhrātaraḥ pitaraḥ putrāḥ sarve vai nihatā raṇe || 54 || tasmāllobhābhibhūtastu kiṃ na kuryānnaraḥ kila | haihayairnihatāḥ sarve bhṛgavaḥ pāpabuddhibhiḥ || 55 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe haihayairdhanāharaṇena saha bhṛgūṇāṃ vadhavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <6.17> haihayānāmutpattiprasaṅge ramāviṣṇusaṃvādavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca kathaṃ tāśca striyaḥ sarvā bhṛgūṇāṃ duḥkhasāgarāt | muktā vaṃśaḥ punasteṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ sthiro'bhavat || 1 || haihayaiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ hatvā tānbrāhmaṇānapi | kṣatriyairlobhasaṃyuktaiḥ pāpācārairvadasva tat || 2 || na tṛptirasti me brahman pibataste kathāmṛtam | pāvanaṃ sukhadaṃ nṝṇāṃ paraloke phalapradam || 3 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm | yathā striyastu tā muktā duḥkhāttasmādduratyayāt || 4 || bhṛgupatnyo yadā rājan himavantaṃ giriṃ gatāḥ | bhayatrastā vibhagnāśā haihayaiḥ pīḍitā bhṛśam || 5 || gaurīṃ tatra tu saṃsthāpya mṛṇmayīṃ saritastaṭe | upoṣaṇaparāścakrurniścayaṃ maraṇaṃ prati || 6 || svapne gatvā tadā devī prāha tāḥ pramadottamāḥ | yuṣmāsu madhye kasyāścidbhavitā corujaḥ pumān || 7 || madaṃśaśaktisambhinnaḥ sa vaḥ kāryaṃ vidhāsyati | ityādiśya parāmbā sā paścādantarhitābhavat || 8 || jāgṛtāstu tataḥ sarvā mudamāpurvarāṅganāḥ | kācittāsāṃ bhayodvignā kāminī caturā bhṛśam || 9 || dadhāra coruṇaikena garbhaṃ sā kulavṛddhaye | palāyanaparā dṛṣṭā kṣatriyairbrāhmaṇī yadā || 10 || vihvalā tejasā yuktā tadā te dudruvurbhṛśam | gṛhyatāṃ vadhyatāṃ nārī sagarbhā yāti satvarā || 11 || iti bruvantaḥ samprāptāḥ kāminīṃ khaḍgapāṇayaḥ | sā bhayārtā tu tāndṛṣṭvā ruroda samupāgatān || 12 || garbhasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ sā cukrośātibhayāturā | rudatīṃ mātaraṃ śrutvā dīnāṃ prāṇavivarjitām || 13 || nirādhārāṃ krandamānāṃ kṣatriyairbhṛśatāpitām | gṛhītāmiva siṃhena sagarbhāṃ hariṇīṃ yathā || 14 || sāśrunetrāṃ vepamānāṃ saṅkrudhya bālakastadā | bhittvoruṃ nirjagāmāśu garbhaḥ sūrya ivāparaḥ || 15 || muṣṇandṛṣṭīḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tejasā bālakaḥ śubhaḥ | darśanādbālakasyāśu sarve jātā vilocanāḥ || 16 || babhramurgiridurgeṣu janmāndhā iva kṣatriyāḥ | cintitaṃ manasā sarvaiḥ kimetaditi sāmpratam || 17 || sarve cakṣurvihīnā yajjātā sma bāladarśanāt | brāhmaṇyāstu prabhāvo'yaṃ satīvratabalaṃ mahat || 18 || kṣaṇādvāmoghasaṅkalpāḥ kiṃ kariṣyantiduḥkhitāḥ | iti sañcintya manasā netrahīnā nirāśrayāḥ || 19 || brāhmaṇīṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurhaihayā gatacetasaḥ | praṇemustāṃ bhayatrastāṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭāśca te || 20 || ūcuścaināṃ bhayodvignāṃ dṛṣṭyarthaṃ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ | prasīda subhage mātaḥ sevakāste vayaṃ kila || 21 || kṛtāparādhā rambhoru kṣatriyāḥ pāpabuddhayaḥ | darśanāttava tanvaṅgi jātāḥ sarve vilocanāḥ || 22 || mukhaṃ te naiva paśyāmo janmāndhā iva bhāmini | adbhutaṃ te tapo vīryaṃ kiṃ kurmaḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ || 23 || śaraṇaṃ te prapannāḥ smo dehi cakṣūṃṣi mānade | andhatvaṃ maraṇādugraṃ kṛpāṃ kartuṃ tvamarhasi || 24 || punardṛṣṭipradānena sevakānkṣatriyānkuru | uparamya ca gacchema sahitāḥ pāpakarmaṇaḥ || 25 || ataḥ paraṃ na kartavyamīdṛśaṃ karma karhicit | bhārgavāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ sevakāḥ smo vayaṃ kila || 26 || ajñānādyatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kṣantavyaṃ tattvayādhunā | vairaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ kvāpi bhṛgubhiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ saha || 27 || kartavyaṃ śapathaiḥ samyagvartitavyaṃ tu haihayaiḥ | saputrā bhava suśroṇi praṇatāḥ smo vayaṃ ca te || 28 || prasādaṃ kuru kalyāṇi na dviṣyāmaḥ kadācana | vyāsa uvāca iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇī vismayānvitā || 29 || tānāha praṇatānduḥsthānāśvāsya gatalocanān | gṛhītā na mayā dṛṣṭiryuṣmākaṃ kṣatriyāḥ kila || 30 || nāhaṃ ruṣānvitā satyaṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇutādya yat | ayaṃ ca bhārgavo nūnamūrujaḥ kupito'dya vaḥ || 31 || cakṣūṃṣi tena yuṣmākaṃ stambhitāni ruṣāvatā | svabandhūnnihatāñjñātvā garbhasthānapi kṣatriyaiḥ || 32 || anāgaso dharmaparāṃstāpasāndhanakāmyayā | garbhānapi yadā yūyaṃ bhṛgūnaghnaṃstu putrakāḥ || 33 || tadāyamūruṇā garbho mayā varṣaśataṃ dhṛtaḥ | ṣaḍaṅgaścākhilo vedo gṛhīto'nena cāñjasā || 34 || garbhasthenāpi bālena bhṛguvaṃśavivṛddhaye | so'pi pitṛvadhānnūnaṃ krotheddho hantumicchati || 35 || bhagavatyāḥ prasādena jāto'yaṃ mama bālakaḥ | tejasā yasya divyena cakṣūṃṣi muṣitāni vaḥ || 36 || tasmādaurvaṃ sutaṃ me'dya yācadhvaṃ vinayānvitāḥ | praṇipātena tuṣṭo'sau dṛṣṭiṃ vaḥ pratimokṣyati || 37 || vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā haihayāstuṣṭuvuśca tam | praṇemurvinayopetā ūrujaṃ munisattamam || 38 || sa santuṣṭo babhūvātha tānuvāca vicakṣuṣaḥ | gacchadhvaṃ svagṛhānbhūpā mamākhyānakṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 39 || avaśyambhāvibhāvāste bhavanti devanirmitāḥ | nātra śokastu kartavyaḥ puruṣeṇa vijānatā || 40 || pūrvavadṛṣayaḥ sarve prāpnuvantu yathāsukham | vrajantu vigatakrodhā bhavanāni yathāsukham || 41 || iti tena samādiṣṭā haihayāḥ prāptalocanāḥ | aurvamāmantrya jagmuste sadanāni yathāruci || 42 || brāhmaṇī taṃ sutaṃ divyaṃ gṛhītvā svāśramaṃ gatā | pālayāmāsa bhūpāla tejasvinamatandritā || 43 || evaṃ te kathitaṃ rājan bhṛgūṇāṃ tu vināśanam | lobhāviṣṭaiḥ kṣatriyaiśca yatkṛtaṃ pātakaṃ kila || 44 || janamejaya uvāca śrutaṃ mayā mahatkarma kṣatriyāṇāñca dāruṇam | kāraṇaṃ lobha evātra duḥkhadaścobhayostu saḥ || 45 || kiñcitpraṣṭumihecchāmi saṃśayaṃ vāsavīsuta | haihayāste kathaṃ nāmnā khyātā bhuvi nṛpātmajāḥ || 46 || yadostu yādavāḥ kāmaṃ bharatādbhāratāstathā | haihayaḥ ko'pi rājābhūtteṣāṃ vaṃśe pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 47 || tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi kāraṇaṃ karuṇānidhe | haihayāste kathaṃ jātāḥ kṣatriyāḥ kena karmaṇā || 48 || vyāsa uvāca haihayānāṃ samutpattiṃ śṛṇu bhūpa savistarām | purātanīṃ supuṇyāṃ ca kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || 49 || kasmiṃścitsamaye bhūpa sūryaputraḥ suśobhanaḥ | revanteti ca vikhyāto rūpavānamitaprabhaḥ || 50 || uccaiḥśravasamāruhya hayaratnaṃ manoharam | jagāma viṣṇusadanaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhāskarātmajaḥ || 51 || bhagavaddarśanākāṃkṣī hayārūḍho yadāgataḥ | hayasthastu tadā dṛṣṭo lakṣmyāsau ravinandanaḥ || 52 || ramā vīkṣya hayaṃ divyaṃ bhrātaraṃ sāgarodbhavam | rūpeṇa vismitā tasya tasthau stambhitalocanā || 53 || bhagavānapi taṃ dṛṣṭvā hayārūḍhaṃ manoharam | āgacchantaṃ ramāṃ viṣṇuḥ papraccha praṇayātprabhuḥ || 54 || ko'yamāyāti cārvaṅgi hayārūḍha ivāparaḥ | smaratejastanuḥ kānte mohayanbhuvanatrayam || 55 || prekṣamāṇā tadā lakṣmīstaccittā daivayogataḥ | novāca vacanaṃ kiñcitpṛṣṭāpi ca punaḥ punaḥ || 56 || vyāsa uvāca aśvāsaktamatiṃ vīkṣya kāminīmatimohitām | paśyantīṃ paramapremṇā cañcalākṣīṃ ca cañcalām || 57 || tāmāha bhagavānkuddhaḥ kiṃ paśyasi sulocane | mohitā ca hariṃ dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭā naivābhibhāṣase || 58 || sarvatra ramase yasmādramā tasmādbhaviṣyasi | cañcalatvāccaletyevaṃ sarvathaiva na saṃśayaḥ || 59 || prākṛtā ca yathā nārī nūnaṃ bhavati cañcalā | tathā tvamapi kalyāṇi sthirā naiva kadācana || 60 || tvaṃ hayaṃ matsamīpasthā samīkṣya yadi mohitā | vaḍavā bhava vāmoru martyaloke'tidāruṇe || 61 || iti śaptā ramā devī hariṇā daivayogataḥ | ruroda vepamānā sā bhayabhītātiduḥkhitā || 62 || tamuvāca ramānātha śaṅkitā cāruhāsinī | praṇamya śirasā devaṃ svapatiṃ vinayānvitā || 63 || devadeva jagannātha karuṇākara keśava | svalpe'parādhe govinda kasmācchāpaṃ dadāsi me || 64 || na kadācinmayā dṛṣṭaḥ krodhaste hīdṛśaḥ prabho | kva gataste mayi snehaḥ sahajo na tu naśvaraḥ || 65 || vajrapātastu śatrau vai kartavyo na suhṛjjane | sadāhaṃ varayogyā te śāpayogyā kathaṃ kṛtā || 66 || prāṇāṃstyakṣyāmi govinda paśyato'dya tavāgrataḥ | kathaṃ jīve tvayā hīnā virahānalatāpitā || 67 || prasādaṃ kuru deveśa śāpādasmātsudāruṇāt | kadā muktā samīpaṃ te prāpnomi sukhadaṃ vibhau || 68 || hariruvāca yadā te bhavitā putraḥ pṛthivyāṃ matsamaḥ priye | tadā māṃ prāpya tanvaṅgi sukhitā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 69 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe haihayānāmutpattiprasaṅge ramāviṣṇusaṃvādavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <6.18> śivaprasādena lakṣmīdvārā bhagavatyāḥ samārādhanavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca iti śaptā bhagavatā sindhujā kopayogataḥ | kathaṃ sā vaḍavā jātā revantena ca kiṃ kṛtam || 1 || kasmindeśe'bdhijā devī vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī | saṃsthitaikākinī bālā paroṣitpatikā yathā || 2 || kālaṃ kiyantamāyuṣman viyuktā patinā ramā | saṃsthitā vijane'raṇye kiṃ kṛtaṃ ca tayā punaḥ || 3 || samāgamaṃ kadā prāptā vāsudevasya sindhujā | putraḥ kathaṃ tayā prāpto nārāyaṇaviyuktayā || 4 || etadvṛttāntamāryeśa kathayasva savistaram | śrotukāmo'smi viprendra kathākhyānamanuttamam || 5 || sūta uvāca iti pṛṣṭastadā vyāsaḥ parīkṣittanayena vai | kathayāmāsa bho viprāḥ kathāmetāṃ suvistarām || 6 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām | pāvanīṃ sukhadāṃ karṇe viśadākṣarasaṃyutām || 7 || revantastu ramāṃ dṛṣṭvā śaptā devena kāminīm | bhayārtaḥ prayayau dūrātpraṇamya jagatāṃ patim || 8 || pituḥ sakāśaṃ tvarito vīkṣya kopaṃ jagatpateḥ | nivedayāmāsa kathāṃ bhāskarāya sa śāpajām || 9 || duḥkhitā sā ramā devī praṇamya jagadīśvaram | ājñaptā mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ prāptā kamalalocanā || 10 || sūryapatnyā tapastaptaṃ yatra pūrvaṃ sudāruṇam | tatraiva sā yayāvāśu vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī || 11 || kālindītamasāsaṅge suparṇākṣasya cottare | sarvakāmaprade sthāne suramyavanamaṇḍite || 12 || tatra sthitā mahādevaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vāñchitapradam | dadhyau caikena manasā śūlinaṃ candraśekharam || 13 || pañcānanaṃ daśabhujaṃ gaurīdehārdhadhāriṇam | karpūragauradehābhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ trilocanam || 14 || vyāghrājinadharaṃ devaṃ gajacarmottarīyakam | kapālamālākalitaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam || 15 || sāgarasya sutā kṛtvā hayīrūpaṃ manoharam | tasmiṃstīrthe ramādevī cakāra duścaraṃ tapaḥ || 16 || dhyāyamānā paraṃ devaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritā | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu gataṃ tatra mahīpate || 17 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo vṛṣārūḍhastrilocanaḥ | pratyakṣo'bhūnmaheśānaḥ pārvatīsahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 18 || tatraitya sagaṇaḥ śambhustāmāha harivallabhām | tapasyantīṃ mahābhāgāmaśvinīrūpadhāriṇīm || 19 || kiṃ tapasyasi kalyāṇi jaganmātarvadasva me | sarvārthadaḥ patiste'sti sarvalokavidhāyakaḥ || 20 || hariṃ tyaktvādya māṃ kasmātstauṣi devi jagatpatim | vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam || 21 || vedoktaṃ vacanaṃ kāryaṃ nārīṇāṃ devatā patiḥ | nānyasminsarvathā bhāvaḥ kartavyaḥ karhicitkvacit || 22 || patiśuśrūṣaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ dharma eva sanātanaḥ | yādṛśastādṛśaḥ sevyaḥ sarvathā śubhakāmyayā || 23 || nārāyaṇastu sarveṣāṃ sevyo yogyaḥ sadaiva hi | taṃ tyaktvā devadeveśaṃ kiṃ māṃ dhyāyasi sindhuje || 24 || lakṣmīruvāca āśutoṣa maheśāna śaptāhaṃ patinā śiva | māṃ samuddhara deveśa śāpādasmāddayānidhe || 25 || tadoktaṃ hariṇā śambho śāpānugrahakāraṇam | vijñaptena mayā kāmaṃ dayāyuktena viṣṇunā || 26 || yadā te bhavitā putrastadā śāpasya mokṣaṇam | bhaviṣyati ca vaikuṇṭhavāsaste kamalālaye || 27 || ityuktāhaṃ tapastaptumāgatāsmi tapovane | ārādhito mayā deva tvaṃ sarvārthapradāyakaḥ || 28 || patisaṅgaṃ vinā putraṃ devadeva labhe katham | sa tu tiṣṭhati vaikuṇṭhe tyaktvā vāmāmanāgasam || 29 || varaṃ me dehi deveśa yadi tuṣṭo'si śaṅkara | tava tasya dvidhā bhāvo nāsti nūnaṃ kadācana || 30 || mayaitadgirijākānta jñātaṃ patyuḥ puro hara | yastvaṃ yo'sau punaryo'sau sa tvaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 31 || ekatvaṃ ca mayā jñātvā mayā te smaraṇaṃ kṛtam | anyathā mama doṣastvāmāśrayantyā bhavecchiva || 32 || śiva uvāca kathaṃ jñātastvayā devi mama tasya ca sundari | aikyabhāvo harernūnaṃ satyaṃ me vada sindhuje || 33 || ekatvaṃ ca na jānanti devāśca munayastathā | jñānino vedatattvajñāḥ kutarkopahatāḥ kila || 34 || madbhaktā vāsudevasya nindakā bahavastathā | viṣṇabhaktāstu bahavo mama nindāparāyaṇāḥ || 35 || bhavanti kālabhedena kalau devi viśeṣataḥ | kathaṃ jñātastvayā bhadre durjñeyo hyakṛtātmabhiḥ || 36 || sarvathā tvaikyabhāvastu harermama ca durlabhaḥ | vyāsa uvāca iti sā śambhunā puṣṭā tuṣṭena harivallabhā || 37 || vṛttāntaṃ tasya vijñātaṃ pravaktumupacakrame | śivaṃ prati ramā tatra prasannavadanā bhṛśam || 38 || lakṣmīruvāca ekadā devadeveśa viṣṇurdhyānaparo rahaḥ | dṛṣṭo mayā tapaḥ kurvanpadmāsanagato yadā || 39 || tadāhaṃ vismitā devaṃ tamapṛcchaṃ patiṃ kila | prabuddhaṃ suprasannaṃ ca jñātvā vinayapūrvakam || 40 || devadeva jagannātha yadāhaṃ nirgatārṇavāt | mathyamānātsurairdaityaiḥ sarvairbrahmādibhiḥ prabho || 41 || vīkṣitāśca mayā sarve patikāmanayā tadā | vṛtastvaṃ sarvadevebhyaḥ śreṣṭho'sīti viniścayāt || 42 || tvaṃ kaṃ dhyāyasi sarveśa saṃśayo'yaṃ mahānmama | priyo'si kaiṭabhāre me kathayasva manogatam || 43 || viṣṇuruvāca śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi yaṃ dhyāyāmi surottamam | āśutoṣaṃ maheśānaṃ girijāvallabhaṃ hṛdi || 44 || kadāciddevadevo māṃ dhyāyatyamitavikramaḥ | dhyāyāmyahaṃ ca deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tripurāntakam || 45 || śivasyāhaṃ priyaḥ prāṇaḥ śaṅkarastu tathā mama | ubhayorantaraṃ nāsti mithaḥ saṃsaktacetasoḥ || 46 || narakaṃ yānti te nūnaṃ ye dviṣanti maheśvaram | bhaktā mama viśālākṣi satyametadbravīmyaham || 47 || ityuktaṃ devadevena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | ekānte kila pṛṣṭena mayā śailasutāpriya || 48 || tasmāttvāṃ vallabhaṃ viṣṇorjñātvā dhyātavatī hyaham | tathā kuru maheśāna yathā me priyasaṅgamaḥ || 49 || vyāsa uvāca iti śriyo vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca maheśvaraḥ | tāmāśvāsya priyairvākyairyathārthaṃ vākyakovidaḥ || 50 || svasthā bhava pṛthuśroṇi tuṣṭo'haṃ tapasā tava | samāgamaste patinā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 51 || atraiva hayarūpeṇa bhagavāñjagadīśvaraḥ | āgamiṣyati te kāmaṃ pūrṇaṃ kartuṃ mayeritaḥ || 52 || tathāhaṃ prerayiṣyāmi taṃ devaṃ madhusūdanam | yathāsau hayarūpeṇa tvāmeṣyati madāturaḥ || 53 || putraste bhavitā subhru nārāyaṇasamaḥ kṣitau | bhaviṣyati sa bhūpālaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 54 || sutaṃ prāpya mahābhāge tvaṃ tena patinā saha | gantāsi devi vaikuṇṭhaṃ priyā tasya bhaviṣyasi || 55 || ekavīreti nāmnāsau khyātiṃ yāsyati te sutaḥ | tasmāttu haihayo vaṃśo bhuvi vistārameṣyati || 56 || paraṃ tu vismṛtāsi tvaṃ hṛdisthāṃ parameśvarīm | madāndhā mattacittā ca tena te phalamīdṛśam || 57 || atastaddoṣaśāntyarthaṃ hṛdisthāṃ paradevatām | śaraṇaṃ yāhi sarvātmabhāvena jaladheḥ sute || 58 || anyathā tava cittaṃ tu kathaṃ gaccheddhayottame | vyāsa uvāca iti dattvā varaṃ devyai bhagavāñchailajāpatiḥ || 59 || antardhānaṃ gataḥ sākṣādumayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ | sāpi tatraiva cārvaṅgī saṃsthitā kamalāsanā || 60 || dhyāyantī caraṇāmbhojaṃ devyāḥ paramaśobhanam | devāsuraśiroratnanighṛṣṭanakhamaṇḍalam || 61 || premagadgadayā vācā tuṣṭāva ca muhurmuhuḥ | pratīkṣamāṇā bhartāraṃ hayarūpadharaṃ harim || 62 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe śivaprasādena lakṣmīdvārā bhagavatyāḥ samārādhanavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <6.19> putrajanmānantaraṃ svasvarūpeṇa vaikuṇṭhagamanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tasyai dattvā varaṃ śambhuḥ kailāsaṃ tvarito yayau | ramyaṃ devagaṇairjuṣṭamapsarobhiśca maṇḍitam || 1 || tatra gatvā citrarūpaṃ gaṇaṃ kāryaviśāradam | preṣayāmāsa vaikuṇṭhe lakṣmīkāryārthasiddhaye || 2 || śiva uvāca citrarūpa hariṃ gatvā brūhi tvaṃ vacanānmama | yathāsau duḥkhitāṃ patnīṃ viśokāṃ ca kariṣyati || 3 || ityuktaścitrarūpo'tha nirjagāma tvarānvitaḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ vaiṣṇavaiśca gaṇairvṛtam || 4 || nānādrumagaṇākīrṇaṃ vāpīśatavirājitam | saṃjuṣṭaṃ haṃsakāraṇḍamayūraśukakokilaiḥ || 5 || uccaprāsādasaṃyuktaṃ patākābhiralaṃkṛtam | nṛtyagītakalāpūrṇaṃ mandāradrumasaṃyutam || 6 || bakulāśokatilakacampakālivimaṇḍitam | kūjitairvihagānāṃ tu karṇāhlādakarairyutam || 7 || saṃvīkṣya bhavanaṃ viṣṇordvāsthau prāha praṇamya ca | jayavijayanāmānau vetrapāṇī sthitāvubhau || 8 || citrarūpa uvāca bho nivedayata śīghraṃ haraye paramātmane | dūtaṃ prāpyaṃ harasyātra preritaṃ śūlapāṇinā || 9 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya jayaḥ paramabuddhimān | gatvā hariṃ praṇamyāha kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ puraḥ || 10 || devadeva ramākānta karuṇākara keśava | dvāri tiṣṭhati dūto'tra śaṅkarasya samāgataḥ || 11 || ājñāpaya praveṣṭavyo na veti garuḍadhvaja | citrarūpadharo'pyasti na jāne kāryagauravam || 12 || ityākarṇya hariḥ prāha jayaṃ prajñātakāraṇaḥ | praveśayātra rudrasya bhṛtyaṃ samayasaṃsthitam || 13 || ityākarṇya jayastūrṇaṃ gatvā taṃ paramādbhutam | ehītyākārayāmāsa jayaḥ śaṅkarasevakam || 14 || praveśito jayenātha citrarūpastathākṛtiḥ | praṇamya daṇḍavadviṣṇuṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 15 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ vismayaṃ prāpa bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ | citrarūpadharaṃ śambhoḥ sevakaṃ vinayānvitam || 16 || papraccha taṃ smitaṃ kṛtvā citrarūpaṃ ramāpatiḥ | kuśalaṃ devadevasya sakuṭumbasya cānagha || 17 || kasmāttvaṃ preṣito'syatra brūhikāryaṃ harasya kim | athavā devatānāṃ ca kiñcitkāryaṃ samutthitam || 18 || dūta uvāca kimajñātaṃ tavāstīha saṃsāre garuḍadhvaja | vartamānaṃ trikālajña yadahaṃ prabravīmi vai || 19 || preṣito'smi bhavenātra vijñastu tvāṃ janārdana | harasya vacanādvākyaṃ prabravīmi tvayi prabho || 20 || tenoktametaddeveśa bhāryā te kamalālayā | tapastapati kālindītamasāsaṅgame vibho || 21 || hayīrūpadharā devī sarvārthasiddhidāyinī | dhyātuṃ yogyāmaragaṇairmānavairyakṣakinnaraiḥ || 22 || vinā tayā naraḥ ko'pisukhabhāgī bhavenna hi | tāṃ tyaktvā puṇḍarīkākṣa prāpnoṣi kiṃ sukhaṃ hare || 23 || durbalo'pi striyaṃ pāti nirdhano'pi jagatpate | vināparādhaṃ ca vibho kiṃ tyaktā jagadīśvarī || 24 || duḥkhaṃ prāpnoti saṃsāre yasya bhāryā jagadguro | dhiktasya jīvitaṃ loke ninditaṃ tvarimaṇḍale || 25 || sakāmā ripavaste'dya dṛṣṭvā tāṃ duḥkhitā bhṛśam | tvāṃ viyuktaṃ ca ramayā hasiṣyanti divāniśam || 26 || ramāṃ ramaya deveśa tvadutsaṅgagatāṃ kuru | sarvalakṣaṇasampannāṃ suśīlāṃ ca surūpiṇīm || 27 || sukhito bhava tāṃ prāpya vallabhāṃ cāruhāsinīm | kāntāvirahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ smarāmyahamanāturaḥ || 28 || mama bhāryā mṛtā viṣṇo dakṣayajñe satī yadā | tadāhaṃ duḥsahaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhuktavānambujekṣaṇa || 29 || saṃsāre'sminnaraḥ ko'pi mābhūnmatsadṛśo'paraḥ | manasākaravaṃ śokaṃ tasyā virahapīḍitaḥ || 30 || kālena mahatā prāptā mayā girisutā punaḥ | tapastaptvātiduḥsādhyaṃ yā dagdhā tu ruṣādhvare || 31 || hare kiṃ sukhamāpannaṃ tvayā santyajya kāminīm | ekākī tiṣṭhatā kālaṃ sahasravatsarātmakam || 32 || gatvāśvāsya mahābhāgāṃ samānaya nijālayam | mābhūtko'pīha saṃsāre vimukto ramayā tayā || 33 || kṛtvā turagarūpaṃ tvaṃ bhaja tāṃ kamalālayām | utpādya putramāyuṣmaṃstāmānaya śucismitām || 34 || vyāsa uvāca harirākarṇya tadvākyaṃ citrarūpasya bhārata | tathetyuktvā tu taṃ dūtaṃ preṣayāmāsa śaṅkaram || 35 || gate dūte'tha bhagavānvaikuṇṭhātkāmasaṃyutaḥ | jagāma dhṛtvā tatrāśu vājirūpaṃ manoharam || 36 || yatra sā vaḍavārūpaṃ kṛtvā tapati sindhujā | viṣṇustaṃ deśamāsādya tāmapaśyaddhayīṃ sthitām || 37 || sāpi taṃ vīkṣya govindaṃ hayarūpadharaṃ patim | jñātvā vīkṣya sthitā sādhvī vismitā sāśrulocanā || 38 || tayostu saṅgamastatra pravṛtto manmathārtayoḥ | kālindītamasāsaṅge pāvane lokaviśrute || 39 || sagarbhā sā tadā jātā vaḍavā harivallabhā | suṣuve sundaraṃ bālaṃ tatraiva suguṇottaram || 40 || tāmāha bhagavānvākyaṃ prahasya samayāśritam | tyajādya vāḍavaṃ dehaṃ pūrvadehā bhavādhunā || 41 || gamiṣyāvaḥ svavaikuṇṭhamāvāṃ kṛtvā nijaṃ vapuḥ | tiṣṭhatvatra kumāro'yaṃ tvayā jātaḥ sulocane || 42 || lakṣmīruvāca svadehasambhavaṃ putraṃ kathaṃ hitvā vrajāmyaham | snehaḥ sudustyajaḥ kāmaṃ svātmajasya surarṣabha || 43 || kā gatiḥ syādameyātman bālasyāsya nadītaṭe | anāthasyāsamarthasya vijane'lpatanoriha || 44 || anāśrayaṃ sutaṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ gantuṃ mano mama | samarthaṃ sadayaṃ svāmin bhavedambujalocana || 45 || divyadehau tato jātau lakṣmīnārāyaṇāvubhau | vimānavarasaṃviṣṭau stūyamānau surairdivi || 46 || gantukāmaṃ patiṃ prāha kamalā kamalāpatim | gṛhāṇemaṃ sutaṃ nātha nāhaṃ śaktāsmi hāpitum || 47 || prāṇapriyo'sti me putraḥ kāntyā tvatsadṛśaḥ prabho | gṛhītvainaṃ gamiṣyāvo vaikuṇṭhaṃ madhusūdana || 48 || hariruvāca mā viṣādaṃ priye kartuṃ tvamarhasi varānane | tiṣṭhatvayaṃ sukhenātra rakṣā me vihitā tviha || 49 || kāryaṃ kimapi vāmoru vartate mahadadbhutam | nibodha kathayāmyadya sutasyātra vimocane || 50 || turvasurnāma vikhyāto yayātitanujo bhuvi | harivarmeti pitrāsya kṛtaṃ nāma suviśrutam || 51 || sa rājā putrakāmo'dya tapastapati pāvane | tīrthe varṣaśataṃ jātaṃ tasya vai kurvatastapaḥ || 52 || tasyārthe nirmitaḥ putro mayāyaṃ kamalālaye | tatra gatvā nṛpaṃ subhru prerayiṣyāmi sāmpratam || 53 || tasmai dāsyāmyahaṃ putraṃ putrakāmāya kāmini | gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ rājā prāpayiṣyati bālakam || 54 || vyāsa uvāca ityāśvāsya priyāṃ padmāṃ kṛtvā rakṣāṃ ca bālake | vimānavaramāruhya prayayau priyayā saha || 55 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe putrajanmānantaraṃ svasvarūpeṇa vaikuṇṭhagamanavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || <6.20> ekavīrākhyānavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca saṃśayo'yaṃ mahānatra jātamātraḥ śiśustathā | muktaḥ kena gṛhīto'sāvekākī vijane vane || 1 || kā gatistasya bālasya jātā satyavatīsuta | vyāghrasiṃhādibhirhiṃsrairgṛhīto nātibālakaḥ || 2 || vyāsa uvāca lakṣmīnārāyaṇau tasmātsthānācca calitau yadā | tadaiva tatra campākhyaḥ prāpto vidyādharaḥ kila || 3 || vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ kāminyā sahito nṛpa | madanālasayā kāmaṃ krīḍamāno yadṛcchayā || 4 || vilokya taṃ śiśuṃ bhūmāvekākinamanuttamam | devaputrapratīkāśaṃ ramamāṇaṃ yathāsukham || 5 || vimānāttarasottīrya campakastaṃ śiśu javāt | jagrāha ca mudaṃ prāpa nidhiṃ prāpya yathādhanaḥ || 6 || gṛhītvā campakaḥ prādāddevyai taṃ madanopamam | madanālasāyai taṃ bālaṃ jātamātraṃ manoharam || 7 || sā gṛhītvā śiśuṃ premṇā saromāñcā savismayā | mukhaṃ cucumba bālasya kṛtvā tu hṛdaye bhṛśam || 8 || āliṅgitaścumbitaśca tayāsau prītipūrvakam | utsaṅge ca kṛtastanvyā putrabhāvena bhārata || 9 || kṛtvāṅke tau samārūḍhau vimānaṃ dampatī mudā | patiṃ papraccha cārvaṅgī prahasya madanālasā || 10 || kasyāyaṃ bālakaḥ kānta tyaktaḥ kena ca kānane | putro'yaṃ mama devena dattastryambakapāṇinā || 11 || campaka uvāca priye gatvādya pṛccheyaṃ śakraṃ sarvajñamāśu vai | devo vā dānavo vāpi gandharvo vā śiśuḥ kila || 12 || tenājñaptaḥ kariṣyāmi putraṃ prāptaṃ vanādamum | apṛṣṭvā naiva kartavyaṃ kāryaṃ kiñcinmayā dhruvam || 13 || ityuktvā tāṃ gṛhītvā taṃ vimānenātha campakaḥ | yayau śakrapuraṃ tūrṇaṃ harṣeṇotphullalocanaḥ || 14 || praṇamya pādayoḥ prītyā campakastu śacīpatim | nivedya bālakaṃ prāha kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 15 || devadeva mayā labdhastīrthe paramapāvane | kālindītamasāsaṅge bālako'yaṃ smaraprabhaḥ || 16 || kasyāyaṃ bālakaḥ kāntaḥ kathaṃ tyaktaḥ śacīpate | ājñā cettava deveśa kurve'haṃ bālakaṃ sutam || 17 || atīva sundaro bālaḥ priyāyā vallabhaḥ sutaḥ | kṛtrimastu sutaḥ prokto dharmaśāstreṣu sarvathā || 18 || indra uvāca putro'yaṃ vāsudevasya vājirūpadharasya ha | haihayo'yaṃ mahābhāga lakṣmyāṃ jātaḥ parantapaḥ || 19 || utpādito bhagavatā kāryārthaṃ kila bālakaḥ | dātuṃ nṛpataye nūnaṃ yayātitanayāya ca || 20 || hariṇā preritaḥ so'dya rājā paramadhārmikaḥ | āgamiṣyati putrārthaṃ tīrthe tasminmanorame || 21 || tāvattvaṃ gaccha tatraiva gṛhītvā bālakaṃ śubham | yāvanna yāti nṛpatirgrahītuṃ hariṇeritaḥ || 22 || gatvā tatra vimuñcainaṃ vilambaṃ mā kṛthā vara | adṛṣṭvā bālakaṃ rājā duḥkhitaśca bhaviṣyati || 23 || tasmāccampaka muñcainaṃ rājā prāpnotu putrakam | ekavīreti nāmnāyaṃ khyātaḥ syāt pṛthivītale || 24 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā campakastvarayānvitaḥ | jagāma putramādāya sthale tasminmahīpate || 25 || mumoca bālakaṃ tatra yatra pūrvaṃ sthito hyabhūt | āruhya svavimānaṃ tu yayau svāśramamaṇḍalam || 26 || tadaiva kamalākānto lakṣmyā saha jagadguruḥ | vimānavaramārūḍho jagāma nṛpatiṃ prati || 27 || dṛṣṭastadā tena nṛpeṇa viṣṇuḥ samuttaraṃstatra vimānamukhyāt | jaharṣa rājā haridarśanena papāta bhūmau khalu daṇḍavacca || 28 || uttiṣṭha vatseti hariḥ patantamāśvāsayadbhūmigataṃ svabhaktam | so'pyutsuko vāsudevaṃ puraḥsthaṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktyā mukharīkṛto'tha || 29 || devādhidevākhilalokanātha kṛpānidhe lokaguro rameśa | mandasya me te kila darśanaṃ yatsudurlabhaṃ yogijanairalabhyam || 30 || ye niḥspṛhāste viṣayairapetāsteṣāṃ tvadīyaṃ khalu darśanaṃ syāt | āśāparo'haṃ bhagavannananta yogyo na te darśane devadeva || 31 || iti stutastena nṛpeṇa viṣṇu stamāha vākyena sudhāmayena | vṛṇīṣva rājan manasepsitaṃ te dadāmi tuṣṭastapasā taveti || 32 || tato nṛpastaṃ praṇipatya pādayoḥ provāca viṣṇuṃ purataḥ sthitaṃ ca | tapastu taptaṃ hi mayā sutārthe putraṃ dadasvātmasamaṃ murāre || 33 || śrutvā nṛpaprārthitamādidevastamāha rājānamamoghavākyam | yayātisūno vraja tatra tīrthe kalindakanyātamasāprasaṅge || 34 || mayādya putrastu yathepsitaste tatraiva mukto'styamitaprabhāvaḥ | lakṣmyāḥ prasūto mama vīryajaśca kṛtastavārthe'tha gṛhāṇa rājan || 35 || śrutvā harervākyamatīva mṛṣṭaṃ santuṣṭacittaḥ prababhūva rājā | haristu dattveti varaṃ jagāma vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ ramayā yutaśca || 36 || gate harau so'tha yayātisūnuryayāvanuddhātarathena rājā | premānvitastatra suto'sti yatra vaco niśamyeti janārdanasya || 37 || sa tatra gatvātimanoharaṃ taṃ dadarśa bālaṃ bhuvi khelamānam | mukhe niveśyaikakareṇa kṛtvā ślakṣṇaṃ padāṅguṣṭhamananyasattvaḥ || 38 || taṃ vīkṣya putraṃ madanasvarūpaṃ nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ kamalāprasūtam | hariprabhāvaṃ harivarmanāmā harṣapraphullānanapaṅkajo'bhūt || 39 || gṛhṇan suvegāt karapaṅkajābhyāṃ babhūva premārṇavamagnadehaḥ | mūrdhanyupāghrāya mudānvito'sau nananda rājā sutamāliliṅga || 40 || mukhaṃ samīkṣyātimanoharaṃ tamuvāca netrāmbuniruddhakaṇṭhaḥ | datto'si devena janārdanena mātrā hi putrāvamaduḥkhabhīteḥ || 41 || taptaṃ mayā putra tapastavārthe suduṣkaraṃ varṣaśataṃ ca pūrṇam | tenaiva tuṣṭena ramāpriyeṇa datto'si saṃsārasukhodayāya || 42 || mātā ramā tvāṃ tanujaṃ madarthe tyaktvā gatā sā hariṇā sametā | dhanyā tu sā yā prahasantamaṅke kṛtvā sutaṃ tvāṃ muditānanā syāt || 43 || tvameva saṃsārasamudranaukārūpaḥ kṛtaḥ putra lakṣmīdhareṇa | ityevamuktvā nṛpatiḥ sutaṃ taṃ mudā samādāya yayau gṛhāya || 44 || purīsamīpe nṛpamāgataṃ tamākarṇya sarve sacivāstu rājñaḥ | yayuḥ samīpaṃ nṛpateśca lokāḥ sopāyanāste sapurohitāśca || 45 || bandījanā gāyanakāśca sūtāḥ samāyayuḥ sammukhamāśu rājñaḥ | nṛpaḥ puraṃ prāpya puraḥ samāgataṃ janaṃ samāśvāsya vākyaiśca dṛṣṭyā || 46 || sampūjitaḥ paurajanena rājā viveśa putreṇa yuto nagaryām | mārgeṣu lājaiḥ kusumaiḥ samantādvikīryamāṇo nṛpatirjagāma || 47 || gṛhaṃ samṛddhaṃ sacivaiḥ sametaḥ sutaṃ samādāya mudā karābhyām | rājye dadau cātha sutaṃ manojñaṃ sadyaḥprasūtaṃ ca manobhavābham || 48 || rājñī gṛhītvābhinavaṃ tanūjaṃ papraccha rājānamaninditā sā | rājan kutaścaiva sutaḥ sujanmā prāptastvayā manmathatulyarūpaḥ || 49 || kenaiṣa dattaḥ kathayāśu kānta ceto madīyaṃ prahṛtaṃ sutena | nṛpastadovāca mudānvito'sau priye rameśena suto hi mahyam || 50 || lolākṣi dattaḥ kamalāsamuttho janārdanāṃśo'yamahīnasattvaḥ | sā taṃ gṛhītvā mudamāpa rājñī rājā cakārotsavamadbhutaṃ ca || 51 || dadau ca dānaṃ kila yācakebhyo gītāni vādyāni bahūni neduḥ | kṛtvotsavaṃ bhūpatirātmajasya nāmaikavīreti cakāra viśrutam || 52 || sukhaṃ ca samprāpya mudānvito'sau nananda devādhipatulyavīryaḥ | putraṃ hare rūpaguṇānurūpaṃ samprāpya vaṃśasya ṛṇācca muktaḥ || 53 || iti sakalasurāṇāmīśvareṇārpitaṃ taṃ sakalaguṇagaṇāḍhyaṃ putramāsādya rājā | vividhasukhavinodairbhāryayā sevyamāno vyaharata nijagehe śakratulyapratāpaḥ || 54 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavatemahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe ekavīrākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || <6.21> rājaputryāḥ ekāvalyāḥ varṇanam vyāsa uvāca jātakarmādisaṃskārāṃścakāra nṛpatistadā | dine dine jagāmāśu vṛddhiṃ bālaḥ sulālitaḥ || 1 || nṛpaḥ saṃsārajaṃ prāpya sukhaṃ putrasabhudbhavam | ṛṇatrayavimokṣaṃ ca mene tena mahātmanā || 2 || ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃ tasya kṛtvā māsi yathāvidhi | tṛtīye'tha tathā varṣe cūḍākaraṇamuttamam || 3 || cakāra brāhmaṇān dravyaiḥ sampūjya vividhairdhanaiḥ | gobhiśca vividhairdānairyācakānitarānapi || 4 || varṣe caikādaśe tasya mauñjībandhanakarma vai | kārayitvā dhanurvedamadhyāpayata pārthivaḥ || 5 || adhītavedaṃ putraṃ taṃ rājadharmaviśāradam | dṛṣṭvā tasyābhiṣekāya matiṃ cakre janādhipaḥ || 6 || puṣyārkayogasaṃyukte divase nṛpasattamaḥ | kārayāmāsa sambhārānabhiṣekārthamādarāt || 7 || dvijānāhūya vedajñān sarvaśāstravicakṣaṇān | abhiṣekaṃ cakārāsau vidhivat svātmajasya ha || 8 || jalamānīya tīrthebhyaḥ sāgarebhyaśca pārthivaḥ | svayaṃ cakāra vithivadabhiṣekaṃ śubhe dine || 9 || dhanaṃ dattvātha viprebhyo rājyaṃ putre niveśya saḥ | jagāma vanamevāśu svargakāmaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ || 10 || ekavīraṃ nṛpaṃ kṛtvā sammānya sacivānatha | bhāryayā saha bhūpālaḥ praviveśa vanaṃ vaśī || 11 || mainākaśikhare rājā kṛtvā tārtīyamāśramam | nityaṃ patraphalāhāraścintayāmāsa pārvatīm || 12 || evaṃ sa nṛpatiḥ kṛtvā diṣṭānte saha bhāryayā | mṛto'sau vāsavaṃ lokaṃ gataḥ puṇyena karmaṇā || 13 || indralokaṃ pitā prāpta iti śrutvātha haihayaḥ | cakāra vedanirdiṣṭaṃ karma caivaurdhvadaihikam || 14 || kṛtvottarāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pituḥ pārthivanandanaḥ | rājyaṃ cakāra medhāvī pitrā dattaṃ susammatam || 15 || ekavīro'tha dharmajñaḥ prāpya rājyamanuttamam | bubhuje vividhān bhogānsacivaiśca sumānitaḥ || 16 || ekasmin divase rājā mantriputraiḥ samanvitaḥ | jagāma jāhnavītīre hayārūḍhaḥ pratāpavān || 17 || sampaśyan pādapān ramyān kokilālāpasaṃyutān | puṣpitān phalasaṃyuktān ṣaṭpadālivirājitān || 18 || munīnāmāśramāndivyān vedadhvaninināditān | homadhūmāvṛtākāśān mṛgaśāvasamāvṛtān || 19 || kedārāñchālisampakvān gopikābhiḥ surakṣitān | praphullapaṅkajārāmānnikuñjāṃśca manoramān || 20 || prekṣamāṇaḥ priyālāṃstu campakān panasadrumān | bakulāṃstilakānnīpānmandārāṃśca praphullitān || 21 || śālāṃstālāṃstamālāṃśca jambūcūtakadambakān | sa gacchañjāhnavītoye praphullaṃ śatapatrakam || 22 || paṅkajaṃ cātigandhāḍhyamapaśyadavanīpatiḥ | dakṣiṇe jalajasyātha pārśve kamalalocanām || 23 || kanakābhāṃ sukeśīṃ ca kambugrīvāṃ kṛśodarīm | bimboṣṭhī sundarīṃ kiñcitsamudyatsupayodharām || 24 || sunāsāṃ cārusarvāṅgīmapaśyat kanyakāṃ nṛpaḥ | rudatīṃ tāṃ sakhīṃ tyaktvā vihvalāṃ duḥkhapīḍitām || 25 || sāśrunetrāṃ krandamānāṃ vijane kurarīmiva | saṃvīkṣya rājā papraccha kanyakāṃ śokakāraṇam || 26 || sunase brūhi kāsi tvaṃ kasya putrī śubhānane | gandharvī devakanyātha kathaṃ rodiṣi sundari || 27 || kathamekākinī bāle tyaktā kena pikasvare | patiste kva gataḥ kānte pitā vā brūhi sāmpratam || 28 || kiṃ te duḥkhamarālabhru kathayādya mamāntike | karomi duḥkhanāśaṃ te sarvathaiva kṛśodari || 29 || na rājye mama tanvaṅgi pīḍāṃ ko'pi karotyalam | na bhayaṃ caurajaṃ kānte na rākṣasabhayaṃ tathā || 30 || mayi śāsati bhūpāle notpātā dāruṇā bhuvi | bhayaṃ na vyāghrasiṃhebhyo na bhayaṃ kasyacidbhavet || 31 || vada vāmoru kasmāttvaṃ vilāpaṃ jāhnavītaṭe | karoṣi trāṇahīnātra kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ vadasva me || 32 || hanmyahaṃ duḥkhamatyugraṃ prāṇināṃ pṛthivītale | daivaṃ ca mānuṣaṃ kānte vratametanmamādbhutam || 33 || viśālalocane brūhi karomi tava cintitam | ityukte vacane rājñā śrutvovāca mṛdusvanā || 34 || śṛṇu rājendra vakṣyāmi mama śokasya kāraṇam | vipattirahitaḥ prāṇī kathaṃ rudati bhūpate || 35 || prabravīmi mahābāho yadarthaṃ rudatī tvaham | tava rājyādanyadeśe rājā paramadhārmikaḥ || 36 || raibhyo nāma mahārājaḥ santānarahito bhṛśam | tasya bhāryā suvikhyātā rukmarekheti nāmataḥ || 37 || surūpā caturā sādhvī sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā | aputrā duḥkhitā kāntamityuvāca punaḥ punaḥ || 38 || kiṃ jīvitena me nātha dhigvṛthā jīvitaṃ mama | vandhyāyāḥ sukhahīnāyā hyaputrāyā dharātale || 39 || ityevaṃ bhāryayā bhūpaḥ prerito makhamuttamam | cakāra brāhmaṇāṃstajjñānāhūya vidhivattadā || 40 || putrakāmo dhanaṃ bhūri dadāvatha yathoditam | hūyamāne ghṛte'tyarthaṃ pāvakādatisuprabhāt || 41 || āvirbabhūva cārvaṅgī kanyakā śubhalakṣaṇā | bimboṣṭhī sudatī subhrūḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanā || 42 || kanakābhā sukeśāntā raktapāṇitalā mṛduḥ | suraktanayanā tanvī raktapādatalā bhṛśam || 43 || hutāśanātsamudbhūtā hotrā sā svīkṛtā tadā | hotā provāca rājānaṃ gṛhītvā tāṃ sumadhyamām || 44 || rājan putrīṃ gṛhāṇemāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām | ekāvalīva sambhūtā hūyamānāddhutāśanāt || 45 || nāmnā caikāvalī loke khyātā putrī bhaviṣyati | sukhito bhava bhūpāla putryā putrasamānayā || 46 || santoṣaṃ kuru rājendra dattā devena viṣṇunā | hoturvākyaṃ nṛpaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kanyakāṃ śubhām || 47 || jagrāha paramaprīto hotrā dattāṃ susammatām | gṛhītvā nṛpatistāṃ tu dadau patnyai varānanām || 48 || ābhāṣya rukmarekhāyai gṛhāṇa subhage sutām | sā tāṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ prāpya kanyāṃ manoramām || 49 || jaharṣa muditā rājñī putraṃ prāpya yathāsukham | cakāra maṅgalaṃ karma jātakarmādikaṃ śubham || 50 || putrajanmasamutthaṃ yattatsarvaṃ vidhivattataḥ | samāpya ca makhaṃ rājā dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām || 51 || dattvā visṛjya viprendrān mudaṃ prāpa mahīpatiḥ | dine dine'sitāpāṅgī putravṛddhyā bhṛśaṃ babhau || 52 || mudaṃ ca paramāṃ prāpa nṛpabhāryā sutānvitā | utsavastaddine tasya pravṛttaḥ sutajanmajaḥ || 53 || putrī putrasamātyarthaṃ babhūva vallabhā kila | rājño mantrisutā cāhaṃ subuddhe manmathākṛte || 54 || yaśovatī ca me nāma samānaṃ vaya āvayoḥ | vayasyāhaṃ kṛtā rājñā krīḍanāya tayā saha || 55 || sadā sahacarī jātā premayuktā divāniśam | ekāvalī gandhavanti yatra padmāni paśyati || 56 || tatra sā ramate bālā nānyatra sukhamāpnuyāt | sudūre jāhnavītīre bhavanti kamalānyapi || 57 || ramamāṇā tatra yātā matsametā sakhīyutā | mayā niveditaṃ rājan putrī te kamalākarān || 58 || prekṣamāṇātidūre sā prayāti nirjane vane | niṣedhitātha pitrāsau gṛhe kṛtvā jalāśayān || 59 || kamalān vāpayitvātha puṣpitān bhramarāvṛtān | tathāpi niryayau bālā kamalāsaktacetanā || 60 || tadā rājñā rakṣapālāḥ preritāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | evaṃ rakṣāyutā tanvī matsametā sakhīyutā | krīḍārthaṃ jāhnavītoye nityamāyāti yāti ca || 61 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe rājaputryāḥ ekāvalyāḥ varṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || <6.22> haihayaikavīrāya yaśovatyaikāvalīmocanāya devīsvapnavarṇanam yaśovatyuvāca prātarutthāya tanvaṅgī calitā ca sakhīyutā | cāmarairvījyamānā sā rakṣitā bahurakṣibhiḥ || 1 || sāyudhaiścātisannaddhaiḥ sahitā varavarṇinī | krīḍārthamatra rājendra samprāptā nalinīṃ śubhām || 2 || ahamapyanayā sārdhaṃ gaṅgātīre samāgatā | apsarobhiḥ sametā ca kamalaiḥ krīḍamānayā || 3 || ekāvalī tathā cāhaṃ jāte krīḍāpare yadā | sahasaiva tadāyāto dānavo balasaṃyutaḥ || 4 || kālaketuriti khyāto rākṣasairbahubhiryutaḥ | parighāsigadācāpabāṇatomarapāṇibhiḥ || 5 || dṛṣṭā caikāvalī tena rūpayauvanaśālinī | dvitīyā kāmapatnīva krīḍamānā supaṅkajaiḥ || 6 || mayoktaikāvalī rājan ko'yaṃ daityaḥ samāgataḥ | gacchāvo rakṣapālānāṃ madhye paṅkajalocane || 7 || vimṛśyaiva sakhī cāhaṃ tvarayaiva gate bhayāt | madhye vai sainikānāṃ tu sāyudhānāṃ nṛpātmaja || 8 || kālaketustu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mohinīṃ madanāturaḥ | gadāṃ gurvī gṛhītvā tu dhāvamānaḥ samāgataḥ || 9 || rakṣakāndūrataḥ kṛtvā jagrāhāmbujalocanām | trastāṃ vepathusaṃyuktāṃ krandamānāṃ kṛśodarīm || 10 || tyajaināṃ māṃ gṛhāṇeti mayā cokto'pi dānavaḥ | na māṃ jagrāha kāmārtastāṃ gṛhītvā viniḥsṛtaḥ || 11 || tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti bhāṣanto rakṣakāstaṃ mahābalam | pratiṣidhya tu saṃgrāmaṃ cakrurvismayakārakam || 12 || tasyāpi rākṣasāḥ krūrāḥ sarvataḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | yuyudhū rakṣakaiḥ sārdhaṃ svāmikārye kṛtodyamāḥ || 13 || saṃgrāmastu tadā jātaḥ kālaketostathā raṇe | nihatya rakṣakānsarvāngṛhītvaināṃ mahābalaḥ || 14 || yukto rākṣasasainyena nirjagāma puraṃ prati | vīkṣya tāṃ rudatīṃ bālāṃ gṛhītā dānavena tu || 15 || pṛṣṭhato'haṃ gatā tatra yatra nītā sakhī mama | vikrośantī yathā sā māṃ paśyediti padānugā || 16 || sāpi māmāgatāṃ vīkṣya kiñcitsvasthābhavattadā | gatāhaṃ tatsamīpe tu tāmābhāṣya punaḥ punaḥ || 17 || sā māṃ prāpyātiduḥkhārtā stambhasvedasamākulā | kaṇṭhe gṛhītvā māṃ bhūpa ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhitā || 18 || sa māmāha kālaketuḥ prītipūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ | samāśvāsaya bhītāṃ tvaṃ sakhīṃ cañcalalocanām || 19 || prāptaṃ mamādya nagaraṃ devalokasamaṃ priye | dāso'smi tava ratyā hi kasmātkrandasi kātarā || 20 || kathayaināṃ sakhīṃ te'dya svasthā bhava sulocane | ityuktvā māṃ sakhīpārśve samāropya rathottame || 21 || jagāma tarasā duṣṭaḥ pure svasya manohare | sainyena mahatā yuktaḥ praphullavadanāmbujaḥ || 22 || ekāvalī tathā māṃ ca saṃsthāpya dhavale gṛhe | rākṣasān gṛharakṣārthaṃ kalpayāmāsa koṭiśaḥ || 23 || dvitīye divase so'tha māmuvāca raho nṛpa | prabodhaya sakhīṃ bālāṃ śocantīṃ virahāturām || 24 || patnī me bhava suśroṇi sukhaṃ bhuṅkṣava yathepsitam | rājyaṃ tvadīyaṃ candrāsye sevako'haṃ sadā tava || 25 || punaruktaṃ mayā vākyaṃ śrutvā tadbhāṣitaṃ kharam | nāhaṃ kṣamāpriyaṃ vaktuṃ tvamenāṃ kathaya prabho || 26 || ityukte vacane duṣṭo madanakṣatamānasaḥ | uvāca vinayādenāṃ sakhīṃ kṣāmodarīṃ priyām || 27 || kṛśodari tvayā mantro nikṣipto'sti mamopari | tena me hṛdayaṃ kānte hṛtaṃ te vaśatāṃ gatam || 28 || tenāhaṃ tava dāso'dya kṛto'smīti viniścayaḥ | bhaja māṃ kāmabāṇena pīḍitaṃ vivaśaṃ bhṛśam || 29 || yauvanaṃ yāti rambhoru cañcalaṃ durlabhaṃ tadā | saphalaṃ kuru kalyāṇi patiṃ māṃ parirabhya ca || 30 || ekāvalyuvāca pitrāhaṃ kalpitā pūrvaṃ dātuṃ rājasutāya vai | haihayastu mahābhāga sa mayā manasā vṛtaḥ || 31 || kathamanyaṃ bhaje kāntaṃ tyaktvā dharmaṃ sanātanam | kanyādharmaṃ vihāyādya vetsi śāstraviniścayam || 32 || yasmai dadyātpitā kāmaṃ kanyā taṃ patimāpnuyāt | paratantrā sadā kanyā na svātantryaṃ kadācana || 33 || ityukto'pi tayā pāpī virarāma na mohitaḥ | na mumoca viśālākṣīṃ māṃ ca pārśvasthitāṃ tathā || 34 || pātālavivare tasya puraṃ paramasaṅkaṭe | rākṣasai rakṣitaṃ durgaṃ maṇḍitaṃ parikhāvṛtam || 35 || tatra tiṣṭhati duḥkhārtā sakhī me prāṇavallabhā | tenāhaṃ viraheṇātra rāraṭīmi suduḥkhitā || 36 || ekavīra uvāca kathaṃ tvamatra samprāptā purāttasya durātmanaḥ | vismayo me mahānatra tattvaṃ brūhi varānane || 37 || tvayā ca kathitaṃ vākyaṃ sandigdhaṃ bhāti bhāmini | haihayārthe kalpitā sā pitreti mama sāmpratam || 38 || haihayo nāma rājāhaṃ nānyo'sti pṛthivīpatiḥ | madarthe kathitā sā kiṃ sakhī tava sulocanā || 39 || etanme saṃśayaṃ subhru chettumarhasi bhāmini | ahaṃ tāmānayiṣyāmi taṃ hatvā rākṣasādhamam || 40 || sthānaṃ darśaya me tasya yadi jānāsi suvrate | rājñe niveditaṃ kiṃ vā tatpitre cātiduḥkhitā || 41 || yasyaiṣā vallabhā putrī na kiṃ jānāti tāṃ hṛtām | nodyamaḥ kiṃ kṛtastena tato mocanahetave || 42 || bandīkṛtāṃ sutāṃ jñātvā kathaṃ tiṣṭhati susthiraḥ | asamartho nṛpaḥ kiṃ vā kāraṇaṃ brūhi satvaram || 43 || tvayā me'pahṛtaṃ ceto guṇānuktvā hyamānuṣān | sakhyāḥ paṅkajapatrākṣi kṛtaḥ kāmavaśo bhṛśam || 44 || kadā paśyāmi tāṃ kāntāṃ mocayitvātisaṅkaṭāt | iti me hṛdayaṃ cādya karotyatimanoratham || 45 || brūhi me gamanopāyaṃ pure tasyātidurgame | kathaṃ tvamāgatā tasmātsaṅkaṭādatra tadvada || 46 || yaśovatyuvāca bālabhāvānmayā mantro bhagavatyā viśāṃpate | prāpto'sti brāhmaṇātsiddhātsabījadhyānapūrvakaḥ || 47 || tatrāvasthitayā rājan mayā citte vicāritam | ārādhayāmi satataṃ caṇḍikāṃ caṇḍavikramām || 48 || sā devī sevitā kāmaṃ bandhamokṣaṃ kariṣyati | bhaktānukampinī śaktiḥ samarthā sarvasādhane || 49 || yā viśvaṃ sṛjate śaktyā pālayatyeva sā punaḥ | kalpānte saṃharatyeva nirākārā nirāśrayā || 50 || iti sañcintya manasā devīṃ viśveśvarīṃ śivām | dhyātvā raktāmbarāṃ saumyāṃ suraktanayanāṃ hṛdi || 51 || saṃsmṛtya manasā rūpaṃ mantrajāpyaparābhavam | upāsitā mayā devī māsamekaṃ samādhinā || 52 || svapne mama samāyātā bhaktibhāvena toṣitā | māmāhāmṛtayā vācā kiṃ suptāsīti caṇḍikā || 53 || uttiṣṭha yāhi tarasā gaṅgātīraṃ manoharam | āgamiṣyati tatrāsau haihayo nṛpapuṅgavaḥ || 54 || ekavīro mahābāhuḥ sarvaśatruvimardanaḥ | dattātreyeṇa manmantro mahāvidyābhidhaḥ paraḥ || 55 || datto'smai so'pi satataṃ māmupāste'tibhaktitaḥ | mayyāsaktamatirnityaṃ mama pūjāparāyaṇaḥ || 56 || māmeva sarvabhūteṣu dhyāyannāste ca matparaḥ | sa te duḥkhavināśaṃ vai kariṣyati mahāmatiḥ || 57 || māsuto viharaṃstatra tava trātā bhaviṣyati | hatvā taṃ rākṣasaṃ ghoraṃ mocayiṣyati māninīm || 58 || ekāvalīmekavīraḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ | paścātsaiva patiḥ kāryastvayā rājasutaḥ śubhaḥ || 59 || ityuktvāntardadhe devī prabuddhāhaṃ tadaiva hi | kathitaṃ svapnavṛttāntaṃ devyāścārādhanaṃ tathā || 60 || prasannavadanā jātā śrutvā sā kamalekṣaṇā | viśeṣeṇa ca santuṣṭā māmuvāca śucismitā || 61 || gaccha tatra tvarāyuktā kuru kāryaṃ mama priye | satyavākyā bhagavatī sāvāṃ mokṣaṃ vidhāsyati || 62 || ityājñaptā tayā cāhaṃ sakhyā vai premayuktayā | matvopasaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ tasmātsthānāttadā nṛpa || 63 || cālitāhaṃ tataḥ śīghraṃ mahādevīprasādataḥ | mārgajñānaṃ śīghragatirmayā prāptā nṛpātmaja || 64 || ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ mama duḥkhajam | kastvaṃ kasya sutaśceti vada vīra yathā tathā || 65 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaskandhe haihayaikavīrāya yaśovatyaikāvalīmocanāya devīsvapnavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || <6.23> ekavīraikāvalyorvivāhavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca tasyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā ramāputraḥ pratāpavān | praphullavadanāmbhojastāmuvāca viśāmpate || 1 || rājovāca rambhoru yastvayā pṛṣṭo vṛttānto viśadākṣaraḥ | hehayo'haṃ caikavīranāmnā sindhusutāsutaḥ || 2 || mano me yattvayā nūnaṃ paratantraṃ kṛtaṃ kila | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi viraheṇātipīḍitaḥ || 3 || prathamaṃ rūpamākhyātaṃ sarvalokātigaṃ tvayā | tena me vihvalaṃ jātaṃ kāmabāṇahataṃ manaḥ || 4 || tatastasyā guṇāḥ proktāstaistu cittaṃ hṛtaṃ punaḥ | yattvayoktaṃ punarvākyaṃ tena me vismayo'bhavat || 5 || ekāvalyā vacaḥ proktaṃ dānavāgre mayā vṛtaḥ | haihayastaṃ vinā nānyaṃ vṛṇomīti viniścayaḥ || 6 || tena vākyena tanvaṅgi bhṛtyo'hamadhunā kṛtaḥ | tvayā tasyāḥ sukeśānte brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi vām || 7 || sthānaṃ tasya na jānāmi rākṣasasya durātmanaḥ | gatirme nāsti gamane pure tasminsulocane || 8 || vada māṃ tvaṃ viśālākṣi tatra prāpayituṃ kṣamā | prāpayāśu sakhī te sā yatra tiṣṭhati sundarī || 9 || hatvā taṃ rākṣasaṃ krūraṃ mocayiṣyāmi sāmpratam | vivaśāṃ śokasantaptāṃ rājaputrīṃ tava priyām || 10 || vimuktaduḥkhāṃ kṛtvā''śu prāpayiṣyāmi te puram | pitre cāsyāḥ pradāsyāmi kanyāmekāvalīmaham || 11 || paścādvivāhaṃ kartāsau rājā putryāḥ parantapaḥ | evaṃ te manasaḥ kāmo mama cāpi priyaṃvade || 12 || bhaviṣyati sa sampūrṇaḥ sādhanena tavādhunā | darśayāśu puraṃ tasya paśya me tvaṃ parākramam || 13 || yathā hanmi durācāraṃ paradārāpahārakam | tathā kuru priyaṃ kartuṃ śaktāsi varavarṇini || 14 || mārgaṃ darśaya tasyādya purasya durgamasya ca | vyāsa uvāca tanniśamya priyaṃ vākyaṃ muditā ca yaśovatī || 15 || tamuvāca ramāputraṃ gamanopāyamādarāt | mantraṃ gṛhāṇa rājendra bhagavatyāstu siddhidam || 16 || darśayiṣyāmi tasyādya puraṃ rākṣasapālitam | sajjo bhava mahābhāga gamanāya mayā saha || 17 || sainyena mahatā yuktastatra yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati | kālaketurmahāvīro rākṣasairbalibhirvṛtaḥ || 18 || tasmānmantraṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ vraja tatra mayā saha | darśayiṣyāmi te mārgaṃ purasyāsya durātmanaḥ || 19 || hatvā taṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ mocayāśu ca me sakhīm | śrutvā tadvacanaṃ vīro mantraṃ jagrāha satvaraḥ || 20 || dattātreyāddaivayogātprāptājjñānivarācchubhāt | yogeśvarīmahāmantraṃ trilokītilakābhidham || 21 || tena sarvajñatā jātā sarvāntaścāritā tathā | tayā saha jagāmāśu puraṃ tasya sudurgamam || 22 || rakṣitaṃ rākṣasaighoraiḥ pātālamiva pannagaiḥ | yaśovatyā ca sainyena mahatā saṃyuto nṛpaḥ || 23 || tamāyāntaṃ samālokya dūtāstasya bhayāturāḥ | krośanto'bhiyayuḥ pārśvaṃ kālaketostarasvinaḥ || 24 || tamūcuḥ sahasā matvā rākṣasaṃ kāmamohitam | ekāvalīsamīpasthaṃ kurvantaṃ vinayānbahūn || 25 || dūtā ūcuḥ rājan yaśovatī nārī kāminyāḥ sahacāriṇī | āyāti saha sainyena rājaputreṇa saṃyutā || 26 || jayanto vā mahārāja kārtikeyo'thavā nu kim | āgacchati balonmatto vāhinīsahitaḥ kila || 27 || saṃyatto bhava rājendra saṃgrāmaḥ samupasthitaḥ | devaputreṇa yudhyasva tyaja vā kamalekṣaṇām || 28 || ito dūre'sti sainyaṃ tadyojanatrayamātrataḥ | sajjo bhava mahīpāla dundubhiṃ ghoṣayāśu vai || 29 || vyāsa uvāca teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ | rākṣasānprerayāmāsa sāyudhānsabalānvahūn || 30 || gacchadhvaṃ rākṣasāḥ sarve sammukhāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | tānājñāpya kālaketuḥ papraccha praṇayānvitaḥ || 31 || ekāvalīṃ samīpasthāṃ vivaśāṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitām | ko'yamāyāti tanvaṅgi pitā te vāparaḥ pumān || 32 || tvadarthe sainyasaṃyukto brūhi satyaṃ kṛśodari | pitā te yadi samprāpto netuṃ tvāṃ virahāturaḥ || 33 || jñātvā te pitaraṃ samyak saṃgrāmaṃ na karomyaham | ānayitvā gṛhe pūjāṃ ratnairvastrairhayaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 34 || karomi tasya cātithyaṃ gṛhe prāptasya sarvathā | anyaścedyadi samprāptastaṃ hanmi niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 35 || ānītaḥ kila kālena maraṇāya mahātmanā | tasmādvada viśālākṣi ko'yamāyāti mandadhīḥ || 36 || ajñātvā māṃ durādharṣaṃ kālarūpaṃ mahābalam | ekāvalyuvāca na jāne'haṃ mahābhāga ko'yamāyāti satvaraḥ || 37 || name'sti viditaḥ ko'pi sthitāyāstava bandhane | nāyaṃ pitā me na bhrātā ko'pyanyo'sti mahābalaḥ || 38 || kimarthamiha cāyāti nāhaṃ veda viniścayam | daitya uvāca evaṃ vadantyamī dūtā vayasyā te yaśovatī || 39 || samānīya ca taṃ vīramāgateti kṛtodyamā | kva gatā sā sakhī kānte vidagdhā kāryaniścaye || 40 || nānyaḥ ko'pi mamārātiryo me pratibalo bhavet | vyāsa uvāca etasminnantare dūtāstatrānye vai samāgatāḥ || 41 || te hocustvaritā bhītāḥ kālaketuṃ gṛhe sthitam | kiṃ svastho'si mahārāja samīpe sainyamāgatam || 42 || nirgaccha nagarāttūrṇaṃ sainyena mahatā''vṛtaḥ | iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā kālaketurmahābalaḥ || 43 || rathamāruhya tvarito niryayau svapurādbahiḥ | ekavīro'pi sahasā hayārūḍhaḥ pratāpavān || 44 || āgatastatra kāminyā viraheṇa samākulaḥ | yuddhaṃ tayorabhūttatra vṛtravāsavayoriva || 45 || śastrāstrairbahudhā muktairādīpitadigantaram | vartamāne tadā yuddhe kātarāṇāṃ bhayāvahe || 46 || gadayā tāḍayāmāsa daityaṃ sindhusutāsutaḥ | sa gatāsuḥ papātorvyāṃ vajrāhata ivācalaḥ || 47 || palāyitvā gatāḥ sarve rākṣasā bhayapīḍitāḥ | yaśovatī tato gatvā vegādekāvalīṃ tadā || 48 || uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ vismitā muditā bhṛśam | ehyāli nṛpaputreṇa dānavo'sau nipātitaḥ || 49 || ekavīreṇa dhīreṇa yuddhaṃ kṛtvā sudāruṇam | skandhāvāre'pyasau rājā tiṣṭhatyadya śramāturaḥ || 50 || darśanaṃ kāṅkṣamāṇaste śrutarūpaguṇastava | paśya taṃ kuṭilāpāṅgi manobhavasamaṃ nṛpam || 51 || kathitā tvaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ tasyāgre jāhnavītaṭe | pūrṇānurāgaḥ sañjātastenāsau virahāturaḥ || 52 || vāñchati tvāṃ cārurūpāṃ draṣṭuṃ nṛpatinandanaḥ | sā tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā gamanāya mano dadhe || 53 || lajjamānā bhṛśaṃ bhītyā kaumāraṃ prāptayā tayā | kathaṃ tasya mukhaṃ drakṣye kumārī hyavaśā bhṛśam || 54 || sa māṃ gṛhṇāti kāmārta iti cintākulā satī | yaśovatyā yutā tatra narayānasthitā yayau || 55 || skandhāvāre'timalinā malināmbaradhāriṇī | tāmāgatāṃ viśālākṣīṃ dṛṣṭvā rājasuto'bravīt || 56 || darśanaṃ dehi tanvaṅgi tṛṣite nayane mama | kāmāturaṃ ca taṃ vīkṣya tāṃ ca lajjābharāvṛtām || 57 || nītijñā śiṣṭamārgajñā
