pratijñāvarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <7.6> cyavaneśvinoḥ kṛte somapānādhikāratvaceṣṭāvarṇanam janamejaya uvāca cyavanena kathaṃ vaidyau tau kṛtau somapāyinau | vacanaṃ ca kathaṃ satyaṃ jātaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ || 1 || mānuṣasya balaṃ kīdṛgdevarājabalaṃ prati | niṣiddhau bhiṣajau tena kṛtau tau somapāyinau || 2 || dharmaniṣṭha tadāścaryaṃ vistareṇa vada prabho | caritaṃ cyavanasyādya śrotukāmo'smi sarvathā || 3 || vyāsa uvāca niśāmaya mahārāja caritaṃ paramādbhutam | cyavanasya makhe tasmiñcharyāterbhuvi bhārata || 4 || sukanyāṃ sundarīṃ prāpya cyavanaḥ surasannibhaḥ | vijahāra prasannātmā devakanyāmivāparaḥ || 5 || kadācidatha śaryātibhāryā cintāturā bhṛśam | patiṃ prāha vepamānā vacanaṃ rudatī priyā || 6 || rājan putrī tvayā dattā munaye'ndhāya kānane | mṛtā jīvati vā sā tu draṣṭavyā sarvathā tvayā || 7 || gaccha nātha munestāvadāśramaṃ draṣṭumādarāt | kiṃ karoti sukanyā sā prāpya nāthaṃ tathāvidham || 8 || putrīduḥkhena rājarṣe dagdhāsmi sarvathā hṛdi | tāmānaya viśālākṣīṃ tapaḥkṣāmāṃ madantike || 9 || paśyāmi sarvathā putrīṃ kṛśāṅgīṃ valkalāvṛtām | andhaṃ patiṃ samāsādya duḥkhabhājaṃ kṛśodarīm || 10 || śaryātiruvāca gacchāmo'dya viśālākṣi sukanyāṃ draṣṭumādarāt | priyaputrīṃ varārohe muniṃ taṃ saṃśitavratam || 11 || vyāsa uvāca evamuktva tu śaryātiḥ kāminīṃ śokasaṃkulām | jagāma rathamāruhya tvaritaścāśramaṃ muneḥ || 12 || gatvā''śramasamīpe tu tamapaśyanmahīpatiḥ | navayauvanasampannaṃ devaputropamaṃ munim || 13 || taṃ vilokyāmarākāraṃ vismayaṃ nṛpatirgataḥ | kiṃ kṛtaṃ kutsitaṃ karma putryā lokavigarhitam || 14 || nihato'sau munirvṛddhastvanayānyaḥ patiḥ kṛtaḥ | kāmapīḍitayā kāmaṃ praśānto'pyatinirdhanaḥ || 15 || duḥsahayo'yaṃ puṣpadhanvā viśeṣeṇa ca yauvane | kule kalaṅkaḥ sumahānanayā mānave kṛtaḥ || 16 || dhiktasya jīvitaṃ loke yasya putrī hi kutsitā | sarvapāpaistu duḥkhāya putrī bhavati dehinām || 17 || mayā tvanucitaṃ karma kṛtaṃ svārthasya siddhaye | vṛddhāyāndhāya yā dattā putrī sarvātmanā kila || 18 || kanyā yogyāya dātavyā pitrā sarvātmanā kila | tādṛśaṃ hi phalaṃ prāptaṃ yādṛśaṃ vai kṛtaṃ mayā || 19 || hanmi cedadya tanayāṃ duḥśīlāṃ pāpakāriṇīm | strīhatyā dustarā syānme tathā putryā viśeṣataḥ || 20 || manuvaṃśastu vikhyātaḥ sakalaṅkaḥ kṛto mayā | lokāpavādo balavāndustyājyā snehaśṛṅkhalā || 21 || kiṃ karomīti cintābdhau yadā magnaḥ sa pārthivaḥ | sukanyayā tadā daivāddṛṣṭaścintākulaḥ pitā || 22 || sā dṛṣṭvā taṃ jagāmāśu sukanyā piturantike | gatvā papraccha bhūpālaṃ premapūritamānasā || 23 || kiṃ vicārayase rājaṃścintāvyākulitānanaḥ | upaviṣṭaṃ muniṃ vīkṣya yuvānamambujekṣaṇam || 24 || ehyehi puruṣavyāghra praṇamasva patiṃ mama | mā viṣādaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sāmprataṃ kuru mānava || 25 || vyāsa uvāca iti putryā vacaṃ śrutvā śaryātiḥ krodhapīḍitaḥ | provāca vacanaṃ rājā puraḥsthāṃ tanayāṃ tataḥ || 26 || rājovāca kva muniścyavanaḥ putri vṛddho'ndhastāpasottamaḥ | ko'yaṃ yuvā madonmattaḥ sandeho'tra mahānmama || 27 || muniḥ kiṃ nihataḥ pāpe tvayā duṣkṛtakāriṇi | nūtano'sau patiḥ kāmātkṛtaḥ kulavināśini || 28 || so'haṃ cintāturastaṃ na paśyāmyāśramasaṃsthitam | kiṃ kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ karma kulaṭācaritaṃ kila || 29 || nimagno'haṃ durācāre śokābdhau tvatkṛte'dhunā | dṛṣṭvainaṃ puruṣaṃ divyamadṛṣṭvā cyavanaṃ munim || 30 || vihasya tamuvācāśu sā śrutvā vacanaṃ pituḥ | gṛhītvā''nīya pitaraṃ bharturantikamādarāt || 31 || cyavano'sau munistāta jāmātā te na saṃśayaḥ | aśvibhyāmīdṛśaḥ kāntaḥ kṛtaḥ kamalalocanaḥ || 32 || yadṛcchayātra samprāptau nāsatyāvāśrame mama | tābhyāṃ karuṇayā nūnaṃ cyavanastādṛśaḥ kṛtaḥ || 33 || nāhaṃ tava sutā tāta tathā syāṃ pāpakāriṇī | yathā tvaṃ manyase rājan vimūḍho rūpasaṃśaye || 34 || praṇama tvaṃ muniṃ rājan bhārgavaṃ cyavanaṃ pitaḥ | āpṛccha kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ kathiyiṣyati vistaram || 35 || iti śrutvā vacaṃ putryā śaryātistvaritastadā | praṇanāma muniṃ tatra gatvā papraccha sādaram || 36 || rājovāca kathayasva svavṛttāntaṃ bhārgavāśu yathocitam | nayane ca kathaṃ prāpte kva gatā te jarā punaḥ || 37 || saṃśayo'yaṃ mahānme'sti rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvātisundaram | vada vistarato brahman śrutvāhaṃ sukhamāpnuyām || 38 || cyavana uvāca nāsatyāvatra samprāptau devānāṃ bhiṣajāvubhau | upakāraḥ kṛtastābhyāṃ kṛpayā nṛpasattama || 39 || mayā tābhyāṃ varo datta upakārasya hetave | kariṣyāmi makhe rājño bhavantau somapāyinau || 40 || evaṃ mayā vayaḥ prāptaṃ locane vimale tathā | svastho bhava mahārāja saṃviśasvāsane śubhe || 41 || ityuktaḥ sa tu vipreṇa sabhāryaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | sukhopaviṣṭaḥ kalyāṇīḥ kathāścakre mahātmanā || 42 || athainaṃ bhārgavaṃ prāha rājānaṃ parisāntvayan | yājayiṣyāmi rājaṃstvāṃ sambhārānupakalpaya || 43 || mayā pratiśrutaṃ tābhyāṃ kartavyau somapau yuvām | tatkartavyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tava yajñe'tivistare || 44 || indraṃ nivārayiṣyāmi kruddhaṃ tejobalena vai | pāyayiṣyāmi rājendra somaṃ somamakhe tava || 45 || tataḥ paramasantuṣṭaḥ śaryātiḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | cyavanasya mahārāja tadvākyaṃ pratyapūjayat || 46 || sammānya cyavanaṃ rājā jagāma nagaraṃ prati | sabhāryaścātisantuṣṭaḥ kurvanvārtāṃ muneḥ kila || 47 || praśastehani yajñīye sarvakāmasamṛddhimān | kārayāmāsa śaryātiryajñāyatanamuttamam || 48 || samānīya munīnpūjyānvasiṣṭhapramukhānasau | bhārgavo yājayāmāsa cyavanaḥ pṛthivīpatim || 49 || vitate tu tathā yajñe devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ | ājagmuścāśvinau tatra somārthamupajagmatuḥ || 50 || indrastu śaṅkitastatra vīkṣya tāvaśvināvubhau | papraccha ca surānsarvānkimetau samupāgatau || 51 || cikitsakau na somārhau kenānītāviheti ca | nābruvannamarāstatra rājñastu vitate makhe || 52 || agṛhṇāccyavanaḥ somamaśvinordevayostadā | śakrastaṃ vārayāmāsa mā gṛhāṇaitayorgraham || 53 || tamāha cyavanastatra kathametau raveḥ sutau | na grahārhau ca nāsatyau brūhi satyaṃ śacīpate || 54 || na saṅkarau samutpannau dharmapatnīsutau raveḥ | kena doṣeṇa devendra nārhau somaṃ bhiṣagvarau || 55 || nirṇayo'tra makhe śakra kartavyaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ | grāhayiṣyāmahaṃ somaṃ kṛtau tau somapau mayā || 56 || prerito'sau mayā rājā makhāya maghavankila | etadarthaṃ kariṣyāmi satyaṃ me vacanaṃ vibho || 57 || ābhyāmupakṛtaḥ śakra tathā dattaṃ navaṃ vayaḥ | tasmātpratyupakārastu kartavyaḥ sarvathā mayā || 58 || indra uvāca cikitsakau kṛtāvetau nāsatyau ninditau suraiḥ | ubhāvetau na somārhau mā gṛhāṇaitayorgraham || 59 || cyavana uvāca ahalyājāra saṃyaccha kopaṃ cādya nirarthakam | vṛtraghna kiṃ hi nāsatyau na somārhau surātmajau || 60 || evaṃ vivāde samupasthite ca na ko'pi vācaṃ tamuvāca bhūpa | grahaṃ tayorbhārgavatigmatejāḥ saṃgrāhayāmāsa tapobalena || 61 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe cyavanāśvinoḥ kṛte somapānādhikāratvaceṣṭāvarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭo'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <7.7> revatasya revatīvarārthaṃ brahmalokagamanavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca datte grahe tu rājendra vāsavaḥ kupitau bhṛśam | provāca cyavanaṃ tatra darśayanbalamātmanaḥ || 1 || mā brahmabandho maryādāmimāṃ tvaṃ karttumarhasi | vadhiṣyāmi dviṣantaṃ tvāṃ viśvarūpamivā'param || 2 || cyavana uvāca māvamaṃsthā mahātmānau rūpadraviṇavarcasā | yau cakraturmāṃ maghavan vṛndārakamivāparam || 3 || ṛte tvāṃ vibudhāścānye kathaṃ vādadate graham | aśvināvapi devendra devau viddhi parantapau || 4 || indra uvāca bhiṣajau nārhataḥ kāmaṃ grahaṃ yajñe kathañcana | yadi ditsasi mandātman śiraśchetsyāmi sāmpratam || 5 || vyāsa uvāca anādṛtya tu tadvākyaṃ vāsavasya ca bhārgavaḥ | grahaṃ tu grāhayāmāsa bhartsayanniva taṃ bhṛśam || 6 || somapātraṃ yadā tābhyāṃ gṛhītaṃ tu pipāsayā | samīkṣya balabhiddeva idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 7 || ābhyamarthāya somaṃ tvaṃ grāhayiṣyasi cetsvayam | vajraṃ tu prahariṣyāmi viśvarūpamivāparam || 8 || vāsavenaivamuktastu bhārgavaścātigarvitaḥ | jagrāha vidhivatsomamaśvibhyāmatimanyumān || 9 || indro'pi prākṣipatkopādvajramasmai svamāyudham | paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham || 10 || preritaṃ cāśaniṃ prekṣya cyavanastapasā tataḥ | stambhayāmāsa vajraṃ sa śakrasyāmitatejasaḥ || 11 || kṛtyayā sa mahābāhurindraṃ hantumihodyataḥ | juhāvāgnau śrutaṃ havyaṃ mantreṇa munisattamaḥ || 12 || tatra kṛtyā samutpannā cyavanasya tapobalāt | prabalaḥ puruṣaḥ krūro bṛhatkāyo mahāsuraḥ || 13 || mado nāma mahāghoro bhayadaḥ prāṇināmiha | śarīre parvatākārastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro mayānakaḥ || 14 || catasraścāyatā daṃṣṭrā yojanānāṃ śataṃ śatam | itare tvasya daśanā babhūvurdaśayojanāḥ || 15 || bāhū parvatasaṃkāśāvāyatau krūradarśanau | jihvā tu bhīṣaṇā krūrā lelihānā nabhastalam || 16 || grīvā tu giriśṛṅgābhā kaṭhinā bhīṣaṇā bhṛśam | nakhā vyāghranakhaprakhyāḥ keśāścātīvabhīṣaṇāḥ || 17 || śarīraṃ kajjalābhaṃ ca tasya cāsyaṃ bhayānakam | netre dāvānalaprakhye bhīṣaṇe'tibhayānake || 18 || hanurekā sthitā tasya bhūmāvekā divaṃ gatā | evaṃvidhaḥ samutpanno mado nāma bṛhattanuḥ || 19 || taṃ vilokya surāḥ sarve bhayamājagmuraṃhasā | indro'pi bhayasaṃtrasto yuddhāya na mano dadhe || 20 || daityo'pi vadane kāmaṃ vajramādāya saṃsthitaḥ | vyāptaṃ nabho ghoradṛṣṭirgrasanniva jagattrayam || 21 || sa bhakṣyayiṣyansaṃkruddhaḥ śatakratumupādravat | cakruśuśca surāḥ sarve hā hatāḥ smeti saṃsthitāḥ || 22 || indraḥ stambhitabāhustu mumukṣurvajramantikāt | na śaśāka paviṃ tasminprahartuṃ pākaśāsanaḥ || 23 || vajrahastaḥ sureśānastaṃ vīkṣya kālasannibham | sasmāra manasā tatra guruṃ samayakovidam || 24 || smaraṇādājagāmāśu bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ | gurustatsamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vipattisadṛśaṃ mahat || 25 || vicārya manasā kṛtyaṃ tamuvāca śacīpatim | duḥsādhyo'yaṃ mahāmantraistvayaṃ vajreṇa vāsava || 26 || asuro madasaṃjñastu yajñakuṇḍātsamutthitaḥ | tapobalamṛṣeḥ samyak cyavanasya mahābalaḥ || 27 || anivāryo hyayaṃ śatrustvayā devaistathā mayā | śaraṇaṃ yāhi deveśa cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ || 28 || sa nivārayitā nūnaṃ kṛtyāmātmakṛtāṃ kila | na nivārayituṃ śaktāḥ śaktibhaktaruṣaṃ kvacit || 29 || vyāsa uvāca ityukto guruṇā śakrastadāgacchanmuniṃ prati | praṇamya śirasā namraḥ tamuvāca bhayānvitaḥ || 30 || kṣamasva muniśārdūla śamayāsuramudyatam | prasanno bhava sarvajña vacanaṃ te karomyaham || 31 || somārhāvaśvināvetāvadyaprabhṛti bhārgava | bhaviṣyataḥ satyametadvaco vipra prasīda me || 32 || mithyā te nodyamo hyeṣa bhavatyeva tapodhana | jāne tvamapi dharmajña mithyā naiva kariṣyasi || 33 || somapāvaśvināvetau tvatkṛtau ca sadaive hi | bhaviṣyataśca śaryāteḥ kīrtistu vipulā bhavet || 34 || mayā yaddhi kṛtaṃ karma sarvathā munisattama | parīkṣārthaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ tava vīryaprakāśanam || 35 || prasādaṃ kuru me brahman madaṃ saṃhara cotthitam | kalyāṇaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tathā bhūyo vidhīyatām || 36 || evamuktastu śakreṇa cyavanaḥ paramārthavit | saṃjahāra tapaḥ kopaṃ samutpannaṃ virodhajam || 37 || devamāśvāsya saṃvignaṃ bhārgavastu madaṃ tataḥ | vyabhajatstrīṣu pāneṣu dyūteṣu mṛgayāsu ca || 38 || madaṃ vibhajya devendramāśvāsya cakitaṃ bhiyā | saṃsthāpya ca surānsarvānmakhaṃ tasya nyavartayat || 39 || tatastu saṃskṛtaṃ somaṃ vāsavāya mahātmane | aśvibhyāṃ sarvadharmātmā pāyayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ || 40 || evaṃ tau cyavanenāryāvaśvinau raviputrakau | vihitau somapau rājan sarvathā tapaso balāt || 41 || sarastadapi vikhyātaṃ jātaṃ yūpavimaṇḍitam | āśramastu muneḥ samyak pṛthivyāṃ viśruto'bhavat || 42 || śaryātirapi santuṣṭo hyabhavattena karmaṇā | yajñaṃ samāpya nagare jagāma sacivairvṛtaḥ || 43 || rājyaṃ cakāra dharmajño manuputraḥ pratāpavān | ānartastasya putro'bhūdānartādrevato'bhavat || 44 || so'ntaḥsamudre nagarīṃ vinirmāya kuśasthalīm | āsthito'bhuṅkta viṣayānānartādīnarindamaḥ || 45 || tasya putraśataṃ jajñe kakudmijyeṣṭhamuttamam | putrī ca revatī nāmnā sundarī śubhalakṣaṇā || 46 || varayogyā yadā jātā tadā rājā ca revataḥ | cintayāmāsa rājendro rājaputrānkulodbhavān || 47 || raivataṃ nāma ca girimāśritaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | cakāra rājyaṃ balavānānarteṣu narādhipaḥ || 48 || vicintya manasā rājā kasmai deyā mayā sutā | gatvā pṛcchāmi brahmāṇaṃ sarvajñaṃ surapūjitam || 49 || iti sañcintya bhūpālaḥ sutāmādāya revatīm | brahmalokaṃ jagāmāśu praṣṭukāmaḥ pitāmaham || 50 || yatra devāśca yajñāśca chandāṃsi parvatāstathā | abdhayaḥ siddhagandharvāḥ divyarūpadharāḥ sthitāḥ || 51 || ṛṣayaḥ siddhagandharvāḥ pannagāścāraṇāstathā | tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve stuvantaśca purātanāḥ || 52 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe revatasya revatīvarārthaṃ brahmalokagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <7.8> ikṣvākuvaṃśavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca saṃśayo'yaṃ mahān brahman vartate mama mānase | brahmalokaṃ gato rājā revatīsaṃyutaḥ svayam || 1 || mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ kṛtsnaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ kathāntare | brāhmaṇo brahmavicchānto brahmalokamavāpnuyāt || 2 || rājā kathaṃ gatastatra revatīsaṃyutaḥ svayam | satyaloke'tiduṣprāpe bhūrlokāditi saṃśayaḥ || 3 || mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnoti sarvaśāstreṣu nirṇayaḥ | (mānuṣeṇa tu dehena brahmaloke gatiḥ katham | ) svargātpunaḥ kathaṃ loke mānuṣe jāyate gatiḥ || 4 || etanme saṃsyayaṃ vidvaṃśchettumarhasi sāmpratam | yathā rājā gatastatra praṣṭukāmaḥ prajāpatim || 5 || vyāsa uvāca merostu śikhare rājan sarve lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | indraloko vahniloko yā ca saṃyaminī purī || 6 || tathaiva satyalokaśca kailāsaśca tathā punaḥ | vaikuṇṭhaśca punastatra vaiṣṇavaṃ padamucyate || 7 || yathārjunaḥ śakraloke gataḥ pārtho dhanurdharaḥ | pañcavarṣāṇi kaunteyaḥ sthitastatra surālaye || 8 || mānuṣeṇaiva dehena vāsavasya ca sannidhau | tathaivānye'pi bhūpālāḥ kakutsthapramukhāḥ kila || 9 || svarlokagatayaḥ paścāddaityāścāpi mahābalāḥ | jitvendrasadanaṃ prāpya saṃsthitāstatra kāmataḥ || 10 || mahābhiṣaḥ purā rājā brahmalokaṃ gataḥ svarāṭ | āgacchantīṃ nṛpo gaṅgāmapaśyaccātisundarīm || 11 || vāyunāmbaramasyāstu daivādapahṛtaṃ nṛpa | kiñcinnagnā nṛpeṇātha dṛṣṭā sā sundarī tathā || 12 || smitaṃ cakāra kāmārtaḥ sā ca kiñcijjahāsa vai | brahmaṇā tau tadā dṛṣṭau śaptau jātau vasundharām || 13 || vaikuṇṭhe'pi surāḥ sarve pīḍitā daityadānavaiḥ | gatvā hariṃ jagannāthamastuvankamalāpatim || 14 || sandeho nātra kartavyaḥ sarvathā nṛpasattama | gamyāḥ sarve'pi lokāḥ syurmānavānāṃ narādhipa || 15 || avaśyaṃ kṛtapuṇyānāṃ tāpasānāṃ narādhipa | puṇyasadbhāva evātra gamane kāraṇaṃ nṛpa || 16 || tathaiva yajamānānāṃ yajñena bhāvitātmanām | janamejaya uvāca revato revatīṃ kanyāṃ gṛhītvā cārulocanām || 17 || brahmalokaṃ gataḥ paścātkiṃ kṛtaṃ tene bhūbhujā | brahmaṇā kiṃ samādiṣṭaṃ kasmai dattā sutā punaḥ || 18 || tatsarvaṃ vistarādbahman kathaya tvaṃ mamādhunā | vyāsa uvāca niśāmaya mahīpāla rājā revatakaḥ kila || 19 || putryā varaṃ paripraṣṭuṃ brahmalokaṃ gato yadā | āvartamāne gāndharve sthito labdhakṣaṇaḥ kṣaṇam || 20 || śṛṇvannatṛpyaddhṛṣṭātmā sabhāyāṃ tu sakanyakaḥ | samāpte tatra gāndharve praṇamya parameśvaram || 21 || darśayitvā sutāṃ tasmai svābhiprāyaṃ nyavedayat | rājovāca varaṃ kathaya deveśa kanyeyaṃ mama putrikā || 22 || deyā kasmai mayā brahman praṣṭuṃ tvāṃ samupāgataḥ | bahavo rājaputrā me vīkṣitāḥ kulasambhavāḥ || 23 || kasmiṃścinme manaḥ kāmaṃ nopatiṣṭhati cañcalam | tasmāttvāṃ devadeveśa praṣṭumatrāgato'smyaham || 23 || tadājñāpaya sarvajña yogyaṃ rājasutaṃ varam | kulīnaṃ balavantaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam || 25 || dātāraṃ dharmaśīlaṃ ca rājaputraṃ samādiśa | vyāsa uvāca tadākarṇya jagatkartā vacanaṃ nṛpatestadā || 26 || tamuvāca hasanvākyaṃ dṛṣṭvā kālasya paryayam | brahmovāca rājaputrāstvayā rājan varā ye hṛdaye kṛtāḥ || 27 || grastāḥ kālena te sarve sapitṛpautrabāndhavāḥ | saptaviṃśatimo'dyaiva dvāparastu pravartate || 28 || vaṃśajāste mṛtāḥ sarve purī daityairviluṇṭhitā | somavaṃśodbhavastatra rājā rājyaṃ praśāsti hi || 29 || ugrasena iti khyāto mathurādhipatiḥ kila | yayātivaṃśasambhūto rājā māthuramaṇḍale || 30 || ugrasenātmajaḥ kaṃsaḥ suradveṣī mahābalaḥ | daityāṃśaḥ pitaraṃ so'pi kārāgāraṃ nyaveśayat || 31 || svayaṃ rājyaṃ cakārāsau nṛpāṇāṃ madagarvitaḥ | medinī cātibhārārtā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā || 32 || duṣṭarājanyasainyāyāṃ bhāreṇātisamākulā | aṃśāvataraṇaṃ tatra gaditaṃ surasattamaiḥ || 33 || vāsudevaḥ samutpannaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kamalalocanaḥ | devakyāṃ devarūpiṇyāṃ yo'sau nārāyaṇo muniḥ || 34 || tapaścacāra duḥsādhyaṃ dharmaputraḥ sanātanaḥ | gaṅgātīre narasakhaḥ puṇye badarikāśrame || 35 || so'vatīrṇo yadukule vāsudevo'pi viśrutaḥ | tenāsau nihataḥ pāpaḥ kaṃsaḥ kṛṣṇena sattama || 36 || ugrasenāya rājyaṃ vai dattaṃ hatvā khalaṃ sutam | kaṃsasya śvaśuraḥ pāpo jarāsandho mahābalaḥ || 37 || āgatya mathurāṃ krodhāccakāra saṅgaraṃ mudā | kṛṣṇenāsau jitaḥ saṃkhye jarāsandho mahābalaḥ || 38 || preṣayāmāsa yuddhāya sabalaṃ yavanaṃ tataḥ | śrutvā''yāntaṃ mahāśūraṃ sasainyaṃ yavanādhipam || 39 || [kṛṣṇastu mathurāṃ tyaktvā purīṃ dvārāvatīmagāt | prabhagnāṃ tāṃ purīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śilpibhiḥ saha saṅgataiḥ || kārayāmāsa durgāḍhyāṃ haṭṭaśālāvimaṇḍitām | jīrṇoddhāraṃ puraḥ kṛtvā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān | ugrasenaṃ ca rājānaṃ cakāra vaśavartinam ||] yādavānsthāpayāmāsa dvāravatyāṃ yadūttamaḥ | vāsudevastu tatrādya vartate bāndhavaiḥ saha || 40 || tāsyāgrataḥ sa vikhyāto baladevo halāyudhaḥ | śeṣāṃśo musalī vīro varo'stu tava sammataḥ || 41 || saṅkarṣaṇāya dehyāśu kanyāṃ kamalalocanām | revatīṃ balabhadrāya vivāhavidhinā tataḥ || 42 || dattvā putrīṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha gaccha tvaṃ badarikāśramam | tapastaptuṃ surārāmaṃ pāvanaṃ kāmadaṃ nṛṇām || 43 || vyāsa uvāca iti rājā samādiṣṭo brahmaṇā padmayoninā | jagāma tarasā rājan dvārakāṃ kanyayānvitaḥ || 44 || dadau tāṃ baladevāya kanyāṃ vai śubhalakṣaṇām | tatastaptvā tapastīvraṃ nṛpatiḥ kālaparyaye || 45 || jagāma tridaśāvāsaṃ tyaktvā dehaṃ sarittaṭe | rājovāca bhagavanmahadāścaryaṃ bhavatā samudāhṛtam || 46 || revatastu sthitastatra brahmaloke sutārthataḥ | yugānāṃ tu gataṃ tatra śatamaṣṭottaraṃ kila || 47 || kanyā vṛddhā na sañjātā rājā vātitarāṃ nu kim | etāvantaṃ tathā kālamāyuḥ pūrṇaṃ tayoḥ katham || 48 || vyāsa uvāca na jarā kṣupitpāsā vā na mṛtyurna bhayaṃ punaḥ | na tu glāniḥ prabhavati brahmaloke sadānagha || 49 || meruṃ gatasya śaryāteḥ santatī rākṣasairhatā | gatāḥ kuśasthalīṃ tyaktvā bhayabhītā itastataḥ || 50 || manośca kṣuvataḥ putra utpanno vīryavattaraḥ | ikṣvākuriti vikhyātaḥ sūryavaṃśakarastu saḥ || 51 || vaṃśārthaṃ tapa ātiṣṭhaddevīṃ dhyātvā nirantaram | nāradasyopadeśena prāpya dīkṣāmanuttamām || 52 || tasya putraśataṃ rājannikṣvākoriti viśrutam | vikukṣiḥ prathamasteṣāṃ balavīryasamanvitaḥ || 53 || ayodhyāyāṃ sthito rājā ikṣvākuriti viśrutaḥ | śakunipramukhāḥ putrā pañcāśadbalavattarāḥ || 54 || uttarāpathadeśasya rakṣitāraḥ kṛtāḥ kila | dakṣiṇasyāṃ tathā rājannādiṣṭāstena te sutāḥ || 55 || catvāriṃśattathāṣṭau ca rakṣaṇārthaṃ mahātmanā | anyau dvau saṃsthitau pārśve sevārthaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ || 56 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe ikṣvākuvaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <7.9> māndhātotpattivarṇanam vyāsa uvāca kadācidaṣṭakāśrāddhe vikukṣiṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ | ājñāpayadasaṃmūḍho māṃsamānaya satvaram || 1 || medhyaṃ śrāddhārthamadhunā vane gatvā sūtādarāt | utyukto'sau tathetyāśu jagāma vanamastrabhṛt || 2 || gatvā jaghāna bāṇaiḥ sa varāhānsūkarānmṛgān | śaśāṃścāpi pariśrānto babhūvātha bubhūkṣitaḥ || 3 || vismṛtā cāṣṭakā tasya śaśaṃ cādadasau vane | śeṣaṃ nivedayāmāsa pitre māṃsamanuttamam || 4 || prokṣaṇāya samānītaṃ māṃsaṃ dṛṣṭvā gurustadā | anarhamiti tajjñātvā cukopa munisattamaḥ || 5 || bhuktaśeṣaṃ tu na śrāddhe prokṣaṇīyamiti sthitiḥ | rājñe nivedayāmāsa vasiṣṭhaḥ pākadūṣaṇam || 6 || putrasya karma tajjñātvā bhūpatirguruṇoditam | cukopa vidhilopāttaṃ deśānniḥsārayattataḥ || 7 || śaśāpa iti vikhyāto nāmnā jāto nṛpātmajaḥ | gato vane śaśādastu pitṛkopādasambhramaḥ || 8 || vanyena vartayankālaṃ nītavān dharmatatparaḥ | pitaryuparate rājyaṃ prāptaṃ tena mahātmanā || 9 || śaśādastvakarodrājyamayodhyāyāḥ patiḥ svayam | yajñānanekaśaḥ pūrṇāṃścakāra sarayūtaṭe || 10 || śaśādasyābhavatputraḥ kakutstha iti viśrutaḥ | tasyaiva nāmabhedādvai indravāhaḥ purañjayaḥ || 11 || janamejaya uvāca nāmabhedaḥ kathaṃ jāto rājaputrasya cānagha | kāraṇaṃ brūhi me sarvaṃ karmaṇā yena cābhavat || 12 || vyāsa uvāca śaśāde svargate rājā kakutstha iti cābhavat | [rājyaṃ cakāra dharmajñaḥ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ balāt |] etasminnantare devā daityaiḥ sarve parājitāḥ || 13 || jagmustrilokādhipatiṃ viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamavyayam | tānprovāca mahāviṣṇustadā devānsanātanaḥ || 14 || viṣṇuruvāca pārṣṇigrāhaṃ mahīpālaṃ prārthayantu śaśādajam | sa haniṣyati vai daityānsaṃgrāme surasattamāḥ || 15 || āgamiṣyati dharmātmā sāhāyyārthaṃ dhanurdharaḥ | parāśakteḥ prasādena sāmarthyaṃ tasya cātulam || 16 || hareḥ suvacanāddevā yayuḥ sarve savāsavāḥ | ayodhyāyāṃ mahārāja śaśādatanayaṃ prati || 17 || tānāgatān surān rājā pūjayāmāsa dharmataḥ | papracchāgamane rājā prayojanamatandritaḥ || 18 || rājovāca dhanyo'haṃ pāvitaścāsmi jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ mama | yadāgatya gṛhe devā daduśca darśanaṃ mahat || 19 || bruvantu kṛtyaṃ deveśā duḥsādhyamapi mānavaiḥ | kariṣyāmi mahatkāryaṃ sarvathā bhavatāṃ mahat || 20 || devā ūcuḥ sāhāyyaṃ kuru rājendra sakhā bhava śacīpateḥ | saṃgrāme jaya daityendrāndurjayāṃstridaśairapi || 21 || parāśaktiprasādena durlabhaṃ nāsti te kvacit | viṣṇunā preritāścaivamāgatāstava sannidhau || 22 || rājovāca pārṣṇigrāho bhavāmyadya devānāṃ surasattamāḥ | indro me vāhanaṃ tatra bhavedyadi surādhipaḥ || 23 || saṃgrāmaṃ tu kariṣyāmi daityairdevakṛte'dhunā | āruhyendraṃ gamiṣyāmi satyametadbravīmyaham || 24 || tadocurvāsavaṃ devāḥ kartavyaṃ kāryamadbhutam | patraṃ bhava narendrasya tyaktvā lajjāṃ śacīpate || 25 || lajjamānastadā śakraḥ prerito hariṇā bhṛśam | babhūva vṛṣabhastūrṇaṃ rudrasyevāparo mahān || 26 || tamāruroha rājāsau saṃgrāmagamanāya vai | sthitaḥ kakudi yenāsya kakutsthastena cābhavat || 27 || indro vāhaḥ kṛto yena tena nāmnendravāhakaḥ | puraṃ jitaṃ tu daityānāṃ tenābhūcca purañjayaḥ || 28 || jitvā daityānmahābāhurdhanaṃ teṣāṃ pradattavān | papraccha caivaṃ rājarṣeriti sakhyaṃ babhūva ha || 29 || kakutsthaścātivikhyāto nṛpatistasya vaṃśajāḥ | kākutsthā bhuvi rājāno babhūvurbahuviśrutāḥ || 30 || kakutsthasyābhavatputro dharmapatnyāṃ mahābalaḥ | anenā viśrutastasya pṛthuḥ putraśca vīryavān || 31 || viṣṇoraṃśaḥ smṛtaḥ sākṣātparāśaktipadārcakaḥ | viśvarandhistu vijñeyaḥ pṛthoḥ putro narādhipaḥ || 32 || candrastasya sutaḥ śrīmān rājā vaṃśakaraḥ smṛtaḥ | tatsuto yuvanāśvastu tejasvī balavattaraḥ || 33 || śāvanto yuvanāśvasya jajñe paramadhārmikaḥ | śāvantī nirmitā tena purī śakrapurīsamā || 34 || bṛhadaśvastu putro'bhūcchāvantasya mahātmanaḥ | kuvalayāśvaḥ sutastasya babhūva pṛthivīpatiḥ || 35 || dhundhurnāmā hato daityastenāsau pṛthivītale | dhundhumāreti vikhyātaṃ nāma prāpātiviśrutam || 36 || putrastasya dṛḍhāśvastu pālayāmāsa medinīm | dṛḍhāśvasya sutaḥ śrīmānharyaśva iti kīrtitaḥ || 37 || nikumbhastatsutaḥ prokto babhūva pṛthivīpatiḥ | barhaṇāśvo nikumbhasya kuśāśvastasya vai sutaḥ || 38 || prasenajitkṛśāśvasya balavānsatyavikramaḥ | tasya putro mahābhāgo yauvanāśveti viśrutaḥ || 39 || yauvanāśvasutaḥ śrīmānmāndhāteti mahīpatiḥ | aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu prāsādā yena nirmitāḥ || 40 || bhagavatyāstu tuṣṭyarthaṃ mahātīrtheṣu mānada | mātṛgarbhe na jāto'sāvutpanno janakodare || 41 || niḥsāritastataḥ putraḥ kukṣiṃ bhittvā pituḥ punaḥ | rājovāca na śrutaṃ na ca dṛṣṭaṃ vā bhavatā tadudāhṛtam || 42 || asaṃbhāvyaṃ mahābhāga tasya janma yathoditam | vistareṇa vadasvādya māndhāturjanmakāraṇam || 43 || rājodare yathotpannaḥ putraḥ sarvāṅgasundaraḥ | vyāsa uvāca yauvanāśvo'napatyo'bhūdrājā paramadhārmikaḥ || 44 || bhāryāṇāṃ ca śataṃ tasya babhūva nṛpaternṛpa | rājā cintāparaḥ prāyaścintayāmāsa nityaśaḥ || 45 || apatyārthe yauvanāśvo duḥkhitastu vanaṃ gataḥ | ṛṣīṇāmāśrame puṇye nirviṇṇaḥ sa ca pārthivaḥ || 46 || mumoca duḥkhitaḥ śvāsāṃstāpasānāṃ ca paśyatām | dṛṣṭvā tu duḥkhitaṃ viprā babhūvuśca kṛpālavaḥ || 47 || tamūcurbrāhmaṇā rājankasmācchocasi pārthiva | kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ mahārāja brūhi satyaṃ manogatam || 48 || pratīkāraṃ kariṣyāmo duḥkhasya tava sarvathā | yauvanāśva uvāca rājyaṃ dhanaṃ sadaśvāśca vartante munayo mama || 49 || bhāryāṇāṃ ca śataṃ śuddhaṃ vartate viśadaprabham | nārātistriṣu lokeṣu ko'pyasti balavānmama || 50 || ājñākarāstu sāmantā vartante mantriṇastathā | ekaṃ santānajaṃ duḥkhaṃ nānyatpaśyāmi tāpasāḥ || 51 || aputrasya gatirnāsti svargo naiva ca naiva ca | tasmācchocāmi viprendrāḥ santānārthaṃ bhṛśaṃ tataḥ || 52 || vedaśāstrārthatattvajñāstāpasāśca kṛtaśramāḥ | iṣṭiṃ santānakāmasya yuktāṃ jñātvā diśantu me || 53 || kurvantu mama kāryaṃ vai kṛpā cedasti tāpasāḥ | vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājñaḥ kṛpayā pūrṇamānasāḥ || 54 || kārayāmāsuravyagrāstasyeṣṭimindradevatām | kalaśaḥ sthāpitastatra jalapūrṇastu vāḍavaiḥ || 55 || mantrito vedamantraiśca putrārthaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ | rājā tadyajñasadanaṃ praviṣṭastṛṣito niśi || 56 || viprāndṛṣṭvā śayānānsa papau mantrajalaṃ svayam | bhāryārthaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ viprairmantritaṃ vidhinoddhṛtam || 57 || pītaṃ rājñā tṛṣārtena tadajñānānnṛpottama | vyudakaṃ kalaśaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā viprā viśaṅkitāḥ || 58 || papracchuste nṛpaṃ kena pītaṃ jalamiti dvijāḥ | rājñā pītaṃ viditvā te jñātvā daivabalaṃ mahat || 59 || iṣṭiṃ samāpayāmāsurgatāste munayo gṛhān | garbhaṃ dadhāra nṛpatistato mantrabalādatha || 60 || tataḥ kāle sa utpannaḥ kukṣiṃ bhittvā'sya dakṣiṇām | putraṃ niṣkāsamāyāsurmantriṇastasya bhūpateḥ || 61 || devānāṃ kṛpayā tatra na mamāra mahīpatiḥ | kaṃ dhāsyati kumāro'yaṃ mantriṇaścukruśurbhṛśam || 62 || tadendro deśinīṃ prādānmāṃ dhātetyavadadvacaḥ | so'bhavadbalavān rājā māndhātā pṛthivīpatiḥ | tadutpattistu bhūpāla kathitā tava vistarāt || 63 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe māndhātotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <7.10> satyavratākhyānavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca || babhūva cakravartī sa nṛpatiḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ || māṃdhātā pṛthivīṃ sarvāmajayannṛpatīśvaraḥ ||1|| dasyavo'sya bhayatrastā yayurgiriguhāsu ca || iṃdreṇāsya kṛtaṃ nāma trasadasyuriti sphuṭam || 2 || tasya biṃdumatī bhāryā śaśabiṃdoḥ sutā'bhavat || pativratā surūpā ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || 3 || tasyāmutpādayāmāsa māṃdhātā dvau sutau nṛpa || purukutsaṃ suvikhyātaṃ mucukuṃdaṃ tathā'param ||4|| purukutsāttato'raṇyaḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || pitṛbhaktirataścābhūd bṛhadaśvastadātmajaḥ || 5 || haryaśvastasya putro'bhūddhārmikaḥ paramārthavit || tasyā''tmajastridhanvā bhūdaruṇastasya cātmajaḥ || 6 || aruṇasya sutaḥ śrīmānsatyavrata iti śrutaḥ || so'bhūdicchācaraḥ kāmī maṃdātmā hyatilolupaḥ || 7 || sa pāpātmā viprabhāryāṃ hṛtavānkāmamohitaḥ || vivāhe tasya vighnaṃ sa cakāra nṛpateḥ sutaḥ || 8 || militā brāhmaṇāstatra rājānamaruṇaṃ nṛpa || ūcurbhṛśaṃ suduḥkhārtā hā hatāḥ smeti cāsakṛt || 9 || papraccha rājā tānviprānduḥkhitānpuravāsinaḥ || kiṃ kṛtaṃ mama putreṇa bhavatāmaśubhaṃ dvijāḥ || 7.10.10 || tanniśamya dvijā vākyaṃ rājño vinayapūrvakam || tadocustvaruṇaṃ viprāḥ kṛtāśīrvacanā bhṛśam || 11 || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || rājaṃstava sutenādya vivāhe prahṛtā kila || vivāhitā viprakanyā balena balināṃ vara || 12 || vyāsa uvāca || śrutvā teṣāṃ vacastathyaṃ rājā paramadhārmikaḥ || putramāha vṛthā nāma kṛtaṃ te duṣṭakarmaṇā || 13 || gaccha dūraṃ sumaṃdātmandurācāra gṛhānmama || na sthātavyaṃ tvayā pāpa viṣaye mama sarvathā || 14 || kupitaṃ pitaraṃ prāha kva gacchāmiti vai muhuḥ || aruṇāstamathovāca śvapākaiḥ saha vartaya || 15 || śvapacasya kṛtaṃ karma dvijadārāpahāraṇam|| tasmāttaiḥ saha saṃsargaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭha yathāsukham || 16 || nahi putreṇa putrārthī tvayā ca kulapāṃsanā || yatheṣṭaṃ vraja duṣṭātmankītanāśaḥ kṛtastvayā || 17 || sa niśamya piturvākyaṃ kupitasya mahātmanaḥ || niścakrāma purāttasmāttarasā śvapacānyayau || 18 || satyavratastadā tatra śvapākaiḥ saha vartate || dhanurbāṇadharaḥ śrīmānkavacī karuṇālayaḥ || 19 || yadā niṣkāsitaḥ pitrā kupitena mahātmanā || guruṇā'tha vasiṣṭhena prerito'sau mahīpatiḥ || 7.10.20 || tasmātsatyavratastasminbabhūva krodhasaṃyutaḥ || vasiṣṭhe dharmaśāstrajñe nivāraṇaparāṅmukhe || 21 || kenacitkāraṇenātha pitā tasya mahīpatiḥ || putrarthe'sau tapastaptuṃ puraṃ tyaktvā vanaṃ gata || 22 || na vavarṣa tadā tasminviṣaye pākaśāsanaḥ || samā dvādaśa rājeṃdra tenā'dharmeṇa sarvathā || 23 || viśvāmitrastadā dārāṃstasmiṃstu viṣaye nṛpa || saṃnyasya kauśikītīre cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 24 || kātarā tatra saṃjātā bhāryā kauśikasya ha || kuṭuṃbabharaṇārthāya duḥkhitā varavarṇinī || 25 || bālakānkṣudhayā''krāṃtānrudataḥ paśyatī bhṛśam || yācāmānāṃśca nīvārānkaṣṭamāpa pati vratā || 26 || ciṃtayāmāsa duḥkhārtā tokānvīkṣya kṣudhā''turān || nṛpo nāsti pure hyadya kaṃ yāce vā karomi kim || 27 || na me trātā'sti putrāṇāṃ patirme nāsti sannidhau || rudaṃti bālakāḥ kāmaṃ dhiṅme jīvanamadya vai || 28 || dhanahīnā ca māṃ tyaktvā tapastaptaṃ gataḥ patiḥ || na jānāti samartho'pi duḥkhitāṃ dhanavarjitām || 29 || bālānāṃ bharaṇaṃ kena karomi patinā vinā || mariṣyaṃti sutāḥ sarve kṣudhayā pīḍitā bhṛśam || 7.10.30 || ekaṃ sutaṃ tu vikrīya dravyeṇa kiyatā punaḥ|| pālayāmi sutānanyāneṣa me vihito vidhiḥ || 31 || sarveṣāṃ māraṇaṃ nāddhā yuktaṃ mama viparyaye || kālasya kalanāyāhaṃ vikrīṇāmi tathā''tmajam || 32 || hṛdayaṃ kaṭhinaṃ kṛtvā saṃciṃtya manasā satī || sā darbharajjvā baddhātha gale putraṃ vinirgatā || 33 || munipatnī gale baddhvā madhyamaṃ putramaurasam || śeṣasya bharaṇārthāya gṛhītvā calitā gṛhāt || 34 || dṛṣṭā satyavratenā''rtā tāpasī śokasaṃyutā || papraccha nṛpatistāṃ tu kiṃ cikīrṣasi śobhane || 35 || rudaṃtaṃ bālakaṃ kaṃṭhe baddhvā nayasi kā'dhunā || kimarthaṃ cārusarvāṃgi satyaṃ brūhi mamā'grataḥ || || 36 || ṛṣipatnyuvāca || viśvāmitrasya bhāryā'haṃ putro'yaṃ me nṛpātmaja || vikretumaurasaṃ kāmaṃ gamiṣye viṣame' sutam || 37 || annaṃ nāsti patirmuktvā gatastaptaṃ nṛpa kvacit || vikrīṇāmi kṣudhārtena śeṣasya bharaṇāya vai || 38 || rājovāca || pativrate rakṣa putraṃ dāsyāmi bharaṇaṃ tava || tāvadeva patiste'tra vanāccaivā''gamiṣyati || 39 || vṛkṣe tavā''śramābhyāśe bhakṣyaṃ kiṃcinniraṃtaram || vaṃdhayitvā gamiṣyāmi satyametadbravīmyaham || 7.10.40 || ityuktā sā tadā tena rājñā kauśikakāminī || vibaṃdhaṃ tayayaṃ kṛtvā jagāmā''śramamaṃḍalam ||41|| so'bhavadgālavo nāma galabaṃdhānmahātapāḥ || sā tu svasyā''śrame gatvā mumoda bālakairvṛtā || 42 || satyavratastu bhaktyā ca kṛpayā ca pariplutaḥ || viśvāmitrasya ca muneḥ kalatraṃ tadbabhāra ha || 43 || vane sthitānmṛgānhatvā varāhānmahiṣāṃstathā || viśvāmitravanābhyāśe māṃsaṃ vṛkṣe babaṃdha ha || 44 || ṛṣipatnī gṛhītvā tanmāṃsaṃ putrānadā ttataḥ || nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ prāpa prāpya bhakṣyamanuttamam || 45 || ayodhyāṃ caiva rājyaṃ ca tathaivāṃtaḥ puraṃ muniḥ || gate taptuṃ nṛpe tasminva siṣṭhaḥ paryarakṣata || 46 || satyavrato'pi dharmātmā hyatiṣṭhannagarādbahiḥ || piturājñāṃ samāsthāya paśughnavratavānvane || 47 || satyavrato hyakasmācca kasyacitkāraṇānnṛpaḥ || vasiṣṭhe cā'dhikaṃ manyuṃ dhārayāmāsa nityadā || 48 || tyājyamānaṃ vane pitrā dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca priyaṃ sutam || na vārayāmāsa munirvasiṣṭhaḥ kāraṇena ha || 49 || pāṇigrahaṇamaṃtrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syātsaptame pade || jānannapi sa dharmātmā vipradāraparigrahe || 7.10.50 || kasmiṃściddivase'raṇye mṛgābhāvaṃ mahīpatiḥ || vasiṣṭhasya ca gāṃ dogdhrīmapaśyadvanamadhyagām|| 51 || tāṃ jaghāna kṣudhārtasya krodhānmohācca dasyuvat || vṛkṣe babaṃdha tanmāṃsaṃ nītvā svayama bhakṣayat || 52 || ṛṣiṣatnī sutānsarvānbhojayāmāsa tattadā || śaṃkamānā mṛgasyeti na goriti ca suvratā || 53 || vasiṣṭhastu hatāṃ dogdhrīṃ jñātvā kuddhastamabravīt || durātmankiṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ dhenughātātpiśācavat || 54 || evaṃ te śaṃkavaḥ krūrā pataṃtu tvaritāstrayaḥ || govadhāhāraharaṇātpituḥ krodhāttathā bhṛśam || 55 || triśaṃkuriti nāmnā vai bhuvi khyāto bhaviṣyasi || piśācarūpamātmānaṃ darśayansarva dehinām || 56 || vyāsa uvāca || evaṃ śapto vasiṣṭhena tadā satyavrato nṛpaḥ|| cacāra ca tapastīvraṃ tasminnevā''śrame thitaḥ || 57 || kasmāccinmuniputrāttu prāpya maṃtramanuttamam || dhyāyanbhagavatīṃ devīṃ prakṛtiṃ paramāṃ śivām || 58 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe saptamaskaṃdhe daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <7.11> satyavratāya rājanītyupadeśavarṇanam janamejaya uvāca vasiṣṭhena ca śapto'sau triśaṅkurnṛpateḥ sutaḥ | kathaṃ śāpādvinirmuktastanme brūhi mahāmate || 1 || vyāsa uvāca satyavratastathā śaptaḥ piśācatvamavāptavān | tasminnevāśrame tasthau devībhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || kadācinnṛpatistatra japtvā mantraṃ navākṣaram | homārthaṃ brāhmaṇāngatvā praṇamyovāca bhaktitaḥ || 3 || bhūmidevāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ vai vacanaṃ praṇatasya me | ṛtvijo mama sarve'tra bhavantaḥ prabhavantu ha || 4 || japasya ca daśāṃśena homaḥ kāryo vidhānataḥ | bhavadbhiḥ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ vedavidbhiḥ kṛpāparaiḥ || 5 || satyavrato'haṃ nṛpateḥ putro brahmavidāṃvarāḥ | kāryaṃ mama vidhātavyaṃ sarvathā sukhahetave || 6 || tacchrutvā brāhmaṇāstatra tamūcurnṛpateḥ sutam | śaptastvaṃ guruṇā prāptaṃ piśācatvaṃ tvayādhunā || 7 || na yāgārho'si tasmāttvaṃ vedeṣvanadhikārataḥ | piśācatvamanuprāptaṃ sarvalokeṣu garhitam || 8 || vyāsa uvāca tanniśamya vacasteṣāṃ rājā duḥkhamavāpa ha | dhigjīvitamidaṃ me'dya kiṃ karomi vane sthitaḥ || 9 || pitrā cāhaṃ parityaktaḥ śaptaśca guruṇā bhṛśam | rājyādbhraṣṭaḥ piśācatvamanuprāptaḥ karomi kim || 10 || tadā pṛthutarāṃ kṛtvā citāṃ kāṣṭhairnṛpātmajaḥ | sasmāra caṇḍikāṃ devīṃ praveśamanucintayan || 11 || smṛtā devīṃ mahāmāyāṃ citāṃ prajvalitāṃ puraḥ | kṛtvā snātvā praveśārthaṃ sthitaḥ prāñjaliragrataḥ || 12 || jñātvā bhagavatī taṃ tu martukāmaṃ mahīpatim | ājagāma tadā''kāśaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tasya cāgrataḥ || 13 || dattvātha darśanaṃ devī tamuvāca nṛpātmajam | siṃhārūḍhā mahārāja meghagambhīrayā girā || 14 | devyuvāca kiṃ te vyavasitaṃ sādho hutāśe mā tanuṃ tyaja | sthiro bhava mahābhāga pitā te jarasānvitaḥ || 15 || rājyaṃ dattvā vane tubhyaṃ gantāsti tapase kila | viṣādaṃ tyaja he vīra paraśvo'hani bhūpate || 16 || netuṃ tvāmāgamiṣyanti sacivāśva pitustava | matprasādātpitā ca tvāmabhiṣicya nṛpāsane || 17 || jitvā kāmaṃ brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyetyeṣa niścayaḥ | vyāsa uvāca ityuktvā taṃ tadā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata || 18 || rājaputro viramito maraṇātpāvakāttataḥ | ayodhyāyāṃ tadā''gatya nāradena mahātmanā || 19 || vṛttāntaḥ kathitaḥ sarvo rājñe satvaramāditaḥ | śrutvā rājātha putrasya taṃ tathā maraṇodyamam || 20 || khedamādhāya manasi śuśoca bahudhā nṛpaḥ | sacivānāha dharmātmā putraśokapariplutaḥ || 21 || jñātaṃ bhavadbhiratyugraṃ putrasya mama ceṣṭitam | tyakto mayā vane dhīmānputraḥ satyavrato mama || 22 || ājñayāsau gataḥ sadyo rājyārhaḥ paramārthavit | sthitastatraiva vijñāne dhanahīnaḥ kṣamānvitaḥ || 23 || vasiṣṭhena tathā śaptaḥ piśācasadṛśaḥ kṛtaḥ | so'dya duḥkhena santaptaḥ praveṣṭuñca hutāśanam || 24 || udyataḥ śrīmahādevyā niṣiddhaḥ saṃsthitaḥ punaḥ | tasmād gacchantu taṃ śīghraṃ jyeṣṭhaputraṃ mahābalam || 25 || āśvāsya vacanairatra tarasaivānayantviha | abhiṣicya sutaṃ rājye aurasaṃ pālanakṣamam || 26 || vanaṃ yāsyāmi śānto'haṃ tapase kṛtaniścayaḥ | ityuktvā mantriṇaḥ sarvānpreṣayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || 27 || tasyaivānayanārthaṃ hi prītipravaṇamānasaḥ | te gatvā taṃ samāśvāsya mantriṇaḥ pārthivātmajam || 28 || ayodhyāyāṃ mahātmānaṃ mānapūrvaṃ samānayan | dṛṣṭvā satyavrataṃ rājā durbalaṃ malināmbaram || 29 || jaṭājūṭadharaṃ krūraṃ cintāturamacintayat | kiṃ kṛtaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ karma mayā putro vivāsitaḥ || 30 || rājyārhaścātimedhāvī jānatā dharmaniścayam | iti sañcintya manasā tamāliṅya mahīpatiḥ || 31 || āsane svasamīpaśe samāśvāsyopaveśayat | upaviṣṭaṃ sutaṃ rājā premapūrvamuvāca ha || 32 || premagadgadayā vācā nītiśāstraviśāradaḥ | rājovāca putra dharme matiḥ kāryā mānanīyā mukhodbhavāḥ || 33 || nyāyāgataṃ dhanaṃ grāhyaṃ rakṣaṇīyāḥ sadā prajāḥ | nāsatyaṃ kvāpi vaktavyaṃ nāmārge gamanaṃ kvacit || 34 || śiṣṭaproktaṃ prakartavyaṃ pūjanīyāstapasvinaḥ | hantavyā dasyavaḥ krūrā indriyāṇāṃ tathā jayaḥ || 35 || kartavyaṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ rājñā putra sadaiva hi | mantrastu sarvathā gopyaḥ kartavyaḥ sacivaiḥ saha || 36 || nopekṣyo'lpo'pi kṛtinā ripuḥ sarvātmanā suta | na viśvasetparāsaktaṃ sacivaṃ ca tathā natam || 37 || cārāḥ sarvatra yoktavyāḥ śatrumitreṣu sarvathā | dharme matiḥ sadā kāryā dānaṃ dadyācca nityaśaḥ || 38 || śuṣkavādo na kartavyo duṣṭasaṅgaṃ ca varjayet | yaṣṭavyā vividhā yajñāḥ pūjanīyā maharṣayaḥ || 39 || na viśvasetstriyaṃ kvāpi straiṇaṃ dyūtarataṃ naram | atyādaro na kartavyo mṛgayāyāṃ kadācana || 40 || dyūte madye tathā geye nūnaṃ vāravadhūṣu ca | svayaṃ tadvimukho bhūyāt prajāstebhyaśca rakṣayet || 41 || brāhme muhūrte kartavyamutthānaṃ sarvathā sadā | snānādikaṃ sarvavidhiṃ vidhāya vidhivadyathā || 42 || parāśakteḥ parāṃ pūjāṃ bhaktyā kuryātsudīkṣitaḥ | putraitajjanmasāphalyaṃ parāśakteḥ padārcanam || 43 || sakṛtkṛtvā mahāpūjāṃ daivīpādajalaṃ piban | na jātu jananīgarbhe gacchediti viniścayaḥ || 44 || sarvaṃ dṛśyaṃ mahādevī draṣṭā sākṣī ca saiva hi | iti tadbhāvabharitastiṣṭhennirbhayacetasā || 45 || kṛtvā nityavidhiṃ samyaggantavyaṃ sadasi dvijān | samāhūya ca praṣṭavyo dharmaśāstravinirṇayaḥ || 46 || sampūjya brāhmaṇānpūjyānvedavedāntapāragān | gobhūhiraṇyādikaṃ ca deyaṃ pātreṣu sarvadā || 47 || avidvānbrāhmaṇaḥ ko'pi naiva pūjyaḥ kadācana | āhārādadhikaṃ naiva deyaṃ mūrkhāya karhicit || 48 || na vā lobhāttvayā putra kartavyaṃ dharmalaṅghanam | ataḥ paraṃ na kartavyaṃ kvacidviprāvamānanam || 49 || brāhmaṇā bhūmidevāśca mānanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ | kāraṇaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca dvijā eva na saṃśayaḥ || 50 || adbhyo'gnirbrahmaṇaḥ kṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam | teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati || 51 || tasmādrājñā viśeṣeṇa mānanīyā mukhodbhavāḥ | dānena vinayenaiva sarvathā bhūtimicchatā || 52 || daṇḍanītiḥ sadā kāryā dharmaśāstrānusārataḥ | kośasya saṃgrahaḥ kāryo nūnaṃ nyāyāgatasya ha || 53 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe satyavratāya rājanītyupadeśavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <7.12> triśaṅkūpākhyānavarṇanam evaṃ prabodhitaḥ pitrā triśaṅkuḥ praṇato nṛpaḥ | tatheti pitaraṃ prāha premagadgadayā girā || 1 || viprānāhūya mantrajñānvedaśāstraviśāradān | abhiṣekāya sambhārān kārayāmāsa satvaram || 2 || salilaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ samānāyya viśāṃpatiḥ | prakṛtīśca samāhūya sāmantānbhūpatīṃstathā || 3 || puṇye'hni vidhivattasmai dadāvāsanamuttamam | abhiṣicya sutaṃ rājye triśaṅkuṃ vidhivatpitā || 4 || tṛtīyamāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ jagrāha bhāryayā yutaḥ | vane tripathagākūle cacāra duścaraṃ tapaḥ || 5 || kāle prāpte yayau svargaṃ pūjitastridaśairapi | indrāsanasamīpastho rarāja ravivatsadā || 6 || rājovāca pūrvaṃ bhagavatā proktaṃ kathāyogena sāmpratam | satyavrato vasiṣṭhena śapto dogdhrīvadhātkila || 7 || kupitene piśācatvaṃ prāpito guruṇā tataḥ | kathaṃ muktaḥ piśācatvādityetatsaṃśayaḥ prabho || 8 || na siṃhāsanayogyo hi bhavecchāpasamanvitaḥ | muninā mocitaḥ śāpātkenānyena ca karmaṇā || 9 || etanme brūhi viprarṣe śāpamokṣaṇakāraṇam | ānītastu kathaṃ pitrā svagṛhe tādṛśākṛtiḥ || 10 || vyāsa uvāca vasiṣṭhena ca śapto'sau sadyaḥ paiśācatāṃ gataḥ | durveṣaścātidurdharṣaḥ sarvalokabhayaṅkaraḥ || 11 || yadaivopāsitā devī bhaktyā satyavratena ha | tayā prasannayā rājan divyadehaḥ kṛtaḥ kṣaṇāt || 12 || piśācatvaṃ gataṃ tasya pāpaṃ caiva kṣayaṃ gatam | vipāpmā cātitejasvī sambhūtastatkṛpāmṛtāt || 13 || vasiṣṭho'pi prasannātmā jātaḥ śaktiprasādataḥ | pitāpi ca babhūvāsya premayuktastvanugrahāt || 14 || rājyaṃ śaśāsa dharmātmā mṛte pitari pārthivaḥ | īje ca vividhairyajñairdevadevīṃ sanātanīm || 15 || tasya putro babhūvātha hariścandraḥ suśobhanaḥ | lakṣaṇaiḥ śāstranirdiṣṭaiḥ saṃyutaścātisundaraḥ || 16 || yuvarājaṃ sutaṃ kṛtvā triśaṅkuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | mānuṣeṇa śarīreṇa svargaṃ bhoktuṃ mano dadhe || 17 || vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ gatvā praṇamya vidhivannṛpaḥ | uvāca vacanaṃ prītaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭastadā || 18 || rājovāca brahmaputra mahābhāga sarvamantraviśārada | vijñaptiṃ me sumanasā śrotumarhasi tāpasa || 19 || icchā me'dya samutpannā svargalokasukhāya ca | anenaiva śarīreṇa bhogānbhoktumamānuṣān || 20 || apsarobhiśca saṃvāsaḥ krīḍituṃ nandane vane | devagandharvagānaṃ ca śrotavyaṃ madhuraṃ kila || 21 || yājaya tvaṃ makhenāśu tādṛśena mahāmune | yathānena śarīreṇa vase lokaṃ triviṣṭapam || 22 || samartho'si muniśreṣṭha kuru kāryaṃ mamādhunā | prāpayāśu makhaṃ kṛtvā devalokaṃ durāsadam || 23 || vasiṣṭha uvāca rājan mānuṣadehena svarge vāsaḥ sudurlabhaḥ | mṛtasya hi dhruvaṃ svargaḥ kathitaḥ puṇyakarmaṇā || 24 || tasmād bibhemi sarvajña durlabhācca manorathāt | apsarobhiśca saṃvāso jīvamānasya durlabhaḥ || 25 || kuru yajñānmahābhāga mṛtaḥ svargamavāpsyasi | vyāsa uvāca ityākarṇya vacastasya rājā paramadurmanāḥ || 26 || uvāca vacanaṃ bhūyo vasiṣṭhaṃ pūrvaroṣitam | na tvaṃ yājayase brahman garvāveśācca māṃ yadi || 27 || anyaṃ purohitaṃ kṛtvā yakṣye'haṃ kila sāmpratam | tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya vasiṣṭhaḥ kopasaṃyutaḥ || 28 || śaśāpa bhūpatiṃ ceti cāṇḍālo bhava durmate | anena tvaṃ śarīreṇa śvapaco bhava satvaram || 29 || svargakṛntana pāpiṣṭha surabhīvadhadūṣita | brahmapatnīharocchinna dharmamārgavidūṣaka || 30 || na te svargagatiḥ pāpa mṛtasyāpi kathañcana | vyāsa uvāca ityukto guruṇā rājaṃstriśaṅkustatkṣaṇādapi || 31 || tatra tena śarīreṇa babhūva śvapacākṛtiḥ | kuṇḍale'śmamaye vāpi jāte tasya ca tatkṣaṇāt || 32 || dehe candanagandhaśca vigandho hyabhavattadā | nīlavarṇe'tha sañjāte divye pītāmbare tanau || 33 || rājavarṇo'bhavaddehaḥ śāpāttasya mahātmanaḥ | śaktyupāsakaroṣeṇa phalametadabhūnnṛpa || 34 || tasmācchrīśaktibhakto hi nāvamānyaḥ kadācana | gāyatrījapaniṣṭho hi vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ || 35 || dṛṣṭvā nindyaṃ nijaṃ dehaṃ rājā duḥkhamavāptavān | na jagāma gṛhe dīno vanamevābhito yayau || 36 || cintayāmāsa duḥkhārtāstriśaṅkuḥ śokavihvalaḥ | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi deho me'tīva ninditaḥ || 37 || kartavyaṃ naiva paśyāmi yena me duḥkhasaṃkṣayaḥ | gṛhe gacchāmi cetputraḥ pīḍito'dya bhaviṣyati || 38 || bhāryāpi śvapacaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāṅgīkāraṃ kariṣyati | sacivā nādariṣyanti vīkṣya māmīdṛśaṃ punaḥ || 39 || jñātayo bandhuvargaśca saṅgato na bhajiṣyati | sarvaistaktasya me nūnaṃ jīvitānmaraṇaṃ varam || 40 || viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayitvādya patitvā vā jalāśaye | kṛtvā vā kaṇṭhapāśaṃ ca dehatyāgaṃ karomyaham || 41 || agnau vā jvalite dehaṃ juhomi vidhivad balāt | kṛtvā vānaśanaṃ prāṇāṃstyajāmi dūṣitānbhṛśam || 42 || ātmahatyā bhavennūnaṃ punarjanmani janmani | śvapacatvaṃ ca śāpaśca hatyādoṣādbhavedapi || 43 || punarvicārya bhūpālaścetasā samacintayat | ātmahatyā na kartavyā sarvathaiva mayādhunā || 44 || bhoktavyaṃ svakṛtaṃ karma dehenānena kānane | bhogenāsya vipākasya bhavitā sarvathā kṣayaḥ || 45 || prārabdhakarmaṇāṃ bhogādanyathā na kṣayo bhavet | tasmānmayātra bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham || 46 || kurvanpuṇyāśramābhyāśe tīrthānāṃ sevanaṃ tathā | smaraṇaṃ cāmbikāyāstu sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ tathā || 47 || evaṃ karmakṣayaṃ nūnaṃ kariṣyāmi vane vasan | bhāgyayogātkadācittu bhavetsādhusamāgamaḥ || 48 || iti sañcintya manasā tyaktvā svanagaraṃ nṛpaḥ | gaṅgātīre gataḥ kāmaṃ śocaṃstatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 49 || hariścandrastadā jñātvā pituḥ śāpasya kāraṇam | duḥkhitaḥ sacivāṃstatra preṣayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || 50 || sacivāstatra gatvā''śu tamūcuḥ praśrayānvitāḥ | praṇamya śvapacākāraṃ niḥśvasantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 51 || rājan putreṇa te nūnaṃ preṣitānsamupāgatān | avehi sacivāṃstvaṃ no hariścandrājñayā sthitān || 52 || yuvarājasutaḥ prāha yattacchṛṇu narādhipa | ānayadhvaṃ nṛpaṃ yūyaṃ sammānya pitaraṃ mama || 53 || tasmādrājan samāgaccha rājyaṃ prati gatavyathaḥ | sevāṃ sarve kariṣyanti sacivāśca prajāstathā || 54 || guruṃ prasādayiṣyāmaḥ sa yathā tu dayeta vai | prasanno'sau mahātejā duḥkhasyāntaṃ kariṣyati || 55 || iti putreṇa te rājan kathitaṃ bahudhā kila | tasmād gamanamevāśu rocatāṃ nijasadmani || 56 || vyāsa uvāca iti teṣāṃ nṛpaḥ śrutvā bhāṣitaṃ śvapacākṛtiḥ | svagṛhaṃ gamanāyāsau na matiṃ kṛtavānataḥ || 57 || tānuvāca tadā vākyaṃ vrajantu sacivāḥ puram | gatvā puraṃ mahābhāgā bruvantu vacanācca me || 58 || nāgamiṣyāmyahaṃ putra kuru rājyamatandritaḥ | mānayanbrāhmaṇāndevānyajanyajñairanekaśaḥ || 59 || nāhaṃ śvapacaveṣeṇa garhitena mahātmabhiḥ | āgamiṣyāmyayodhyāyāṃ sarve gacchantu mā ciram || 60 || putraṃ siṃhāsane sthāpya hariścandraṃ mahābalam | kurvantu rājyakarmāṇi yūyaṃ tatra mamājñayā || 61 || ityādiṣṭāstataste tu ruruduścāturā bhṛśam | sacivā niryayustūrṇaṃ natvā taṃ ca vanāśramāt || 62 || ayodhyāyāmupāgatya puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam | abhiṣekaṃ tadā cakrurhariścandrasya mūrdhni te || 63 || abhiṣiktastu tejasvī sacivaiśca nṛpājñayā | rājyaṃ cakāra dharmiṣṭhaḥ pitaraṃ cintayanbhṛśam || 64 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe triśaṅkūpākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <7.13> triśaṅkuśāpoddhārāya viśvāmitrasāntvanavarṇanam rājovāca hariścandraḥ kṛto rājā sacivairnṛpaśāsanāt | triśaṅkustu kathaṃ muktastasmāccāṇḍāladehataḥ || 1 || mṛto vā vanamadhye tu gaṅgātīre pariplutaḥ | guruṇā vā kṛpāṃ kṛtvā śāpāttasmādvimocitaḥ || 2 || etad vṛttāntamakhilaṃ kathayasva mamāgrataḥ | caritaṃ tasya nṛpateḥ śrotukāmo'smi sarvathā || 3 || vyāsa uvāca abhiṣiktaṃ sutaṃ kṛtvā rājā santuṣṭamānasaḥ | kālātikramaṇaṃ tatra cakāra cintayañchivām || 4 || evaṃ gacchati kāle tu tapastaptvā samāhitaḥ | draṣṭuṃ dārānsutādīṃśca tadāgātkauśiko muniḥ || 5 || āgatya svajanaṃ dṛṣṭvā susthitaṃ mudamāptavān | bhāryāṃ papraccha medhāvī sthitāmagre saparyayā || 6 || durbhikṣe tu kathaṃ kālastayā nītaḥ sulocane | annaṃ vinā tvime bālāḥ pālitā kena tadvada || 7 || ahaṃ tapasi sannaddho nāgataḥ śṛṇu sundari | kiṃ kṛtaṃ tu tvayā kānte vinā dravyeṇa śobhane || 8 || mayā cintā kṛtā tatra śrutvā durbhikṣamadbhutam | nāgato'haṃ vicāryaivaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi nirdhanaḥ || 9 || ahamapyati vāmoru pīḍitaḥ kṣudhayā vane | praviṣṭaścaurabhāvena kutracicchvapacālaye || 10 || śvapacaṃ nidritaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣudhayā pīḍito bhṛśam | mahānasaṃ parijñāya bhakṣyārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ || 11 || yadā bhāṇḍaṃ samudghāṭya pakvaṃ śvatanujāmiṣam | gṛhṇāmi bhakṣaṇārthāya tadā dṛṣṭastu tena vai || 12 || pṛṣṭaḥ kastvaṃ kathaṃ prāpto gṛhe me niśi sādaram | brūhi kāryaṃ kimarthaṃ tvamudghāṭayasi bhāṇḍakam || 13 || ityuktaḥ śvapacenāhaṃ kṣudhayā pīḍito bhṛśam | tamavocaṃ sukeśānte kāmaṃ gadgadayā girā || 14 || brāhmaṇo'haṃ mahābhāga tāpasaḥ kṣudhayārditaḥ | caurabhāvamanuprāpto bhakṣyaṃ paśyāmi bhāṇḍake || 15 || caurabhāvena samprāpto'smyatithiste mahāmate | kṣudhito'smi dadasvājñāṃ māṃsamadmi susaṃskṛtam || 16 || viśvāmitra uvāca śvapacastu vacaḥ śrutvā māmuvāca suniścitam | bhakṣaṃ mā kuru varṇāgrya jānīhi śvapacālayam || 17 || durlabhaṃ khalu mānuṣyaṃ tatrāpi ca dvijanmatā | dvijatve brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca durlabhaṃ vetsi kiṃ na hi || 18 || duṣṭāhāro na kartavyaḥ sarvathā lokamicchatā | agrāhyā manunā proktāḥ karmaṇā sapta cāntyajāḥ || 19 || tyājyo'haṃ karmaṇā vipra śvapaco nātra saṃśayaḥ | nivārayāmi bhakṣyāttvāṃ na lobhenāñjasā dvija || 20 || varṇasaṅkaradoṣo'yaṃ mā yātu tvāṃ dvijottama | viśvāmitra uvāca satyaṃ vadasi dharmajña matiste viśadāntyaja || 21 || tathāpyāpadi dharmasya sūkṣmamārgaṃ bravīmyaham | dehasya rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sarvathā yadi mānada || 22 || pāpasyānte punaḥ kāryaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye | durgatistu bhavetpāpādanāpadi na cāpadi || 23 || maraṇātkṣudhitasyātha narako nātra saṃśayaḥ | tasmātkṣudhāpaharaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ śubhamicchatā || 24 || tenāhaṃ cauryadharmeṇa dehaṃ rakṣe'pyathāntyaja | avarṣaṇe ca cauryeṇa yatpāpaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ || 25 || yo na varṣati parjanyastattu tasmai bhaviṣyati | ityukte vacane kānte parjanyaḥ sahasāpatat || 26 || gaganāddhastihastābhirdhārābhirabhikāṅkṣitaḥ | mudito'haṃ ghanaṃ vīkṣya varṣantaṃ vidyutā saha || 27 || tadāhaṃ tadgṛhaṃ tyaktvā niḥsṛtaḥ parayā mudā | kathaya tvaṃ varārohe kālo nītastvayā katham || 28 || kāntāre paramaḥ krūraḥ kṣayakṛtprāṇināmiha | vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā patimāha priyaṃvadā || 29 || yathā śṛṇu mayā nītaḥ kālaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ | gate tvayi muniśreṣṭha durbhikṣaṃ samupāgatam || 30 || annārthaṃ putrakāḥ sarve babhūvuścātiduḥkhitāḥ | kṣudhitānbālakānvīkṣya nīvārārthaṃ vane vane || 31 || bhrāntāhaṃ cintayā''viṣṭā kiñcitprāptaṃ phalaṃ tadā | evaṃ ca katicinmāsā nīvāreṇātivāhitāḥ || 32 || tadabhāve mayā kānta cintitaṃ manasā punaḥ | na bhikṣā kila durbhikṣe nīvārā nāpi kānane || 33 || na vṛkṣeṣu phalānyāsurna mūlāni dharātale | kṣudhayā pīḍitā bālā rudanti bhṛśamāturāḥ || 34 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kiṃ bravīmi kṣudhārtitān | evaṃ vicintya manasā niścayastu mayā kṛtaḥ || 35 || putramekaṃ dadāmyadya kasmaiciddhanine kila | gṛhītvā tasya maulyaṃ tu tena dravyeṇa bālakān || 36 || pālaye'haṃ kṣudhārtāṃstu nānyopāyo'sti pālane | iti sañcintya manasā putro'yaṃ prahito mayā || 37 || vikrayārthaṃ mahābhāga krandamāno bhṛśāturaḥ | krandamānaṃ gṛhītvainaṃ nirgatāhaṃ gatatrapā || 38 || tadā satyavrato mārge māmudvīkṣya bhṛśāturām | papraccha sa ca rājarṣiḥ kasmādroditi bālakaḥ || 39 || tadāhaṃ tamuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ munisattama | vikrayārthaṃ nīyate'sau bālako'dya mayā nṛpa || 40 || śrutvā me vacanaṃ rājā dayārdrahṛdayastataḥ | māmuvāca gṛhaṃ yāhi gṛhītvainaṃ kumārakam || 41 || bhojanārthe kumārāṇāmāmiṣaṃ vihitaṃ tava | prāpayiṣyāmyahaṃ nityaṃ yāvanmunisamāgamaḥ || 42 || ahanyahani bhūpālo vṛkṣe'sminmṛgasūkarān | vinyasya yāti hatvāsau pratyahaṃ dayayānvitaḥ || 43 || tenaiva bālakāḥ kānta pālitā vṛjinārṇavāt | vasiṣṭhenātha śaptā'sau bhūpatirmama kāraṇāt || 44 || kasmiṃściddivase māṃsaṃ na prāptaṃ tena kānane | hatā dogdhrī vasiṣṭhasya tenāsau kupito muniḥ || 45 || triśaṅkuriti bhūpasya kṛtaṃ nāma mahātmanā | kupitena vadhāddhetoścāṇḍālaśca kṛto nṛpaḥ || 46 || tenāhaṃ duḥkhitā jātā tasya duḥkhena kauśika | śvapacatvamasau prāpto matkṛte nṛpanandanaḥ || 47 || yena kenāpyupāyena bhavatā nṛpateḥ kila | tasmādrakṣā prakartavyā tapasā prabalena ha || 48 || vyāsa uvāca iti bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā kauśiko munisattamaḥ | tāmāha kāminīṃ dīnāṃ sāntvapūrvamarindama || 49 || viśvāmitra uvāca mocayiṣyāmi taṃ śāpānnṛpaṃ kamalalocane | upakāraḥ kṛto yena kāntārādrakṣitāsi vai || 50 || vidyātapobalenāhaṃ kariṣye duḥkhasaṃkṣayam | ityāśvāsya priyāṃ tatra kauśikaḥ paramārthavit || 51 || cintayāmāsa nṛpateḥ kathaṃ syādduḥkhanāśanam | saṃvimṛśya munistatra jagāma yatra pārthivaḥ || 52 || triśaṅkuḥ pakvaṇe dīnaḥ saṃsthitaḥ śvapacākṛtiḥ | āgacchantaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito'sau narādhipaḥ || 53 || daṇḍavannipapātorvyāṃ pādayostarasā muneḥ | gṛhītvā taṃ kare bhūpaṃ patitaṃ kauśikastadā || 54 || utthāpyovāca vacanaṃ sāntvapūrvaṃ dvijottamaḥ | matkṛte tvaṃ mahīpāla śapto'si muninā yataḥ || 55 || vāñchitaṃ te kariṣyāmi brūhi kiṃ karavāṇyaham | rājovāca mayā samprārthitaḥ pūrvaṃ vasiṣṭho makhahetave || 56 || māṃ yājaya muniśreṣṭha karomi makhamuttamam | yatheṣṭaṃ kuru viprendra yathā svargaṃ vrajāmyaham || 57 || anenaiva śarīreṇa śakralokaṃ sukhālayam | kopaṃ kṛtvā vasiṣṭho'sau māmāheti sudurmate || 58 || mānuṣeṇa hi dehena svargavāsaḥ kutastava | punarmayokto bhagavānsvargalubdhena cānagha || 59 || anyaṃ purohitaṃ kṛtvā yakṣye'haṃ yajñamuttamam | tadā tenaiva śapto'haṃ cāṇḍālo bhava pāmara || 60 || ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ śāpasambhavam | mama duḥkhavināśāya samartho'si munīśvara || 61 || ityuktvā viraramāsau rājā duḥkharujārditaḥ | kauśiko'pi nirākartuṃ śāpaṃ tasya vyacintayat || 62 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe triśaṅkuśāpoddhārāya viśvāmitrasāntvanavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <7.14> varuṇakṛpayā śaivyāyāṃ putroptattivarṇanam vyāsa uvāca vicintya manasā kṛtyaṃ gādhisūnurmahātapāḥ | prakalpya yajñasambhārānmunīnāmantrayattadā || 1 || munayastaṃ makhaṃ jñātvā viśvāmitranimantritāḥ | nāgatāḥ sarva evaite vasiṣṭhena nivāritāḥ || 2 || gādhisūnustadājñāya vimanāścātiduḥkhitaḥ | ājagāmāśramaṃ tatra yatrāsau nṛpatiḥ sthitaḥ || 3 || tamāha kauśikaḥ kruddho vasiṣṭhena nivāritāḥ | nāgatāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve yajñārthaṃ nṛpasattama || 4 || paśya me tapasaḥ siddhiṃ yathā tvāṃ surasadmani | prāpayāmi mahārāja vāñchitaṃ te karomyaham || 5 || ityuktvā jalamādāya hastena munisattamaḥ | dadau puṇyaṃ tadā tasmai gāyatrījapasambhavam || 6 || dattvātha sukṛtaṃ rājñe tamuvāca mahīpatim | yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha rājarṣe triviṣṭapamatandritaḥ || 7 || puṇyena mama rājendra bahukālārjitena ca | yāhi śakrapurīṃ prītaḥ svasti te'stu surālaye || 8 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktavati viprendre triśaṅkustarasā tataḥ | utpapāta yathā pakṣī vegavāṃstapaso balāt || 9 || utpatya gagane rājā gataḥ śakrapurīṃ yadā | dṛṣṭo devagaṇaistatra krūraścāṇḍālaveṣabhāk || 10 || kathito'sau surendrāya ko'yamāyāti satvaraḥ | gagane devavadvā yo durdarśaḥ śvapacākṛtiḥ || 11 || sahasotthāya śakrastamapaśyatpuruṣādhamam | jñātvā triśaṅkumapi sa nirbhartsya tarasābravīt || 12 || śvapaca kva samāyāsi devaloke jugupsitaḥ | yāhi śīghraṃ tato bhūmau nātra sthātuṃ tvayocitam || 13 || ityuktaḥ skhalitaḥ svargācchakreṇāmitrakarśana | nipapāta tadā rājā kṣīṇapuṇyo yathāmaraḥ || 14 || punaścukrośa bhūpālo viśvāmitreti cāsakṛt | patāmi rakṣa duḥkhārtaṃ svargāccalitamāśugam || 15 || tasya tatkranditaṃ rājan patitaḥ kauśiko muniḥ | śrutvā tiṣṭheti hovāca patantaṃ vīkṣya bhūpatim || 16 || vacanāttasya tatraiva sthito'sau gagane nṛpaḥ | munestapaḥprabhāveṇa calito'pi surālayāt || 17 || viśvāmitro'pyapaḥ spṛṣṭvā cakāreṣṭiṃ suvistarām | vidhātuṃ nūtanāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ svargalokaṃ dvitīyakam || 18 || tasyodyamaṃ tathā jñātvā tvaritastu śacīpatiḥ | tatrājagāma sahasā muniṃ prati tu gādhijam || 19 || kiṃ brahman kriyate sādho kasmātkopasamākulaḥ | alaṃ sṛṣṭyā muniśreṣṭha brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || 20 || viśvāmitra uvāca svaṃ nivāsaṃ mahīpālaṃ cyutaṃ tvadbhuvanād vibho | nayasva prītiyogena triśaṅkuṃ cātiduḥkhitam || 21 || vyāsa uvāca tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā turāṣāḍatiśaṅkitaḥ | tapobalaṃ viditvogramomityovāca vāsavaḥ || 22 || divyadehaṃ nṛpaṃ kṛtvā vimānavarasaṃsthitam | āpṛcchya kauśikaṃ śakro'gamannijapurīṃ tadā || 23 || gate śakre tu vai svargaṃ triśaṅkusahite tataḥ | viśvāmitraḥ sukhaṃ prāpya svāśrame susthiro'bhavat || 24 || hariścandro'tha tacchrutvā viśvāmitropakārakam | pituḥ svargamanaṃ kāmaṃ mudito rājyamanvaśāt || 25 || ayodhyādhipatiḥ krīḍāṃ cakāra saha bhāryayā | rūpayauvanacāturyayuktayā prītisaṃyutaḥ || 26 || atītakāle yuvatī na sā garbhavatī hyabhūt | tadā cintāturo rājā babhūvātīva duḥkhitaḥ || 27 || vasiṣṭasyāśramaṃ gatvā praṇamya śirasā munim | anapatyatvajāṃ cintāṃ gurave samavedayat || 28 || daivajño'si bhavānkāmaṃ mantravidyāviśāradaḥ | upāyaṃ kuru dharmajña santatermama mānada || 29 || aputrasya gatirnāsti jānāsi dvijasattama | kasmādupekṣase jānan duḥkhaṃ mama ca śaktimān || 30 || kalaviṃkāstvime dhanyā ye śiśuṃ lālayanti hi | mandabhāgyo'hamaniśaṃ cintayāmi divāniśam || 31 || vyāsa uvāca ityākarṇya munistasya nirvedamiśritaṃ vacaḥ | sañcintya manasā samyak tamuvāca vidheḥ sutaḥ || 32 || vasiṣṭha uvāca satyaṃ brūhi mahārāja saṃsāre'sminna vidyate | anapatyatvajaṃ duḥkhaṃ yattathā duḥkhamadbhutam || 33 || tasmāttvamapi rājendra varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim | samārādhaya yatnena sa te kāryaṃ kariṣyati || 34 || varuṇādadhiko nāsti devaḥ santānadāyakaḥ | tamārādhaya dharmiṣṭha kāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati || 35 || daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca mānanīyāvimau nṛbhiḥ | udyamena vinā kāryasiddhiḥ sañjāyate katham || 36 || nyāyatastu naraiḥ kārya udyamastattvadarśibhiḥ | kṛte tasminbhavetsiddhirnānyathā nṛpasattama || 37 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā guroramitatejasaḥ | praṇamya niryayau rājā tapase kṛtaniścayaḥ || 38 || gaṅgātīre śubhe sthāne kṛtapadmāsano nṛpaḥ | dhyāyanpāśadharaṃ citte cacāra duścaraṃ tapaḥ || 39 || evaṃ tapasyatastasya pracetā dṛṣṭigocaraḥ | kṛpayābhūnmahārāja prasannamukhapaṅkajaḥ || 40 || hariścandramuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ yādasāṃ patiḥ | varaṃ varaya dharmajña tuṣṭo'smi tapasā tava || 41 || rājovāca anapatyo'smi deveśa putraṃ dehi sukhapradam | ṛṇatrayāpahārārthamudyamo'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ || 42 || nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā pragalbhaṃ duḥkhitasya ca | smitapūrvaṃ tataḥ pāśī tamāha purāḥ sthitam || 43 || varuṇa uvāca putro yadi bhavedrājan guṇī manasi vāñchitaḥ | siddhe kārye tataḥ paścātkiṃ kariṣyasi me priyam || 44 || yadi tvaṃ tena putreṇa māṃ yajethā viśaṅkitaḥ | paśubandhena tenaiva dadāmi nṛpate varam || 45 || rājovāca deva me māstu vandhyatvaṃ yajiṣye'haṃ jalādhipa | paśuṃ kṛtvā sutaṃ putraṃ satyametadbravīmi te || 46 || vandhyatve paramaṃ duḥkhamasahyaṃ bhuvi mānada | śokāgniśamanaṃ nṝṇāṃ tasmāddehi sutaṃ śubham || 47 || varuṇa uvāca bhaviṣyati sutaḥ kāmaṃ rājan gaccha gṛhāya vai | satyaṃ tadvacanaṃ kāryaṃ yadbravīṣi mamāgrataḥ || 48 || vyāsa uvāca ityukto varuṇenāsau hariścandro gṛhaṃ yayau | bhāryāyai kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ varadānajam || 49 || tasya bhāryāśataṃ pūrṇaṃ babhūvātimanoharam | paṭṭarājñī śubhā śaivyā dharmapatnī pativratā || 50 || kāle gate'tha sā garbhaṃ dadhāra varavarṇinī | babhūva mudito rājā śrutvā dohadaceṣṭitam || 51 || kārayāmāsa vidhivatsaṃskārānnṛpatistadā | māse'tha daśame pūrṇe suṣuve sā śubhe dine || 52 || tārāgrahabalopete putraṃ devasutopamam | putre jāte nṛpaḥ snātvā brāhmaṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ || 53 || cakāra jātakarmādau dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ | rājñaścātipramodo'bhūtputrajanmasamudbhavaḥ || 54 || babhūva paramodāro dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ | viśeṣadānasaṃyukto gītavāditrasaṃkulaḥ || 55 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe varuṇakṛpayā śaivyāyāṃ putroptattivarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <7.15> hariścandrasya jalodaravyādhiprāptivarṇanam vyāsa uvāca pravṛtte sadane tasya rājñaḥ putramahotsave | ājagāma tadā pāśī vipraveṣadharaḥ śubhaḥ || 1 || svastītyuktvā nṛpaṃ prāha varuṇo'haṃ niśāmaya | putro jātastavādhīśa yajānena nṛpāśu mām || 2 || satyaṃ kuru vaco rājan yatproktaṃ bhavataḥ purā | vandhyatvaṃ tu gataṃ te'dya varadānena me kila || 3 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājā cintāṃ cakāra ha | kathaṃ hanmi sutaṃ jātaṃ jalajena samānanam || 4 || lokapālaḥ samāyāto vipraveṣeṇa vīryavān | na devahelanaṃ kāryaṃ sarvathā śubhamicchatā || 5 || putrasnehaḥ suduśchedyaḥ sarvathā prāṇibhiḥ sadā | kiṃ karomi kathaṃ me syātsukhaṃ santatisambhavam || 6 || dhairyamālambya bhūpālastaṃ natvā pratipūjya ca | uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ yuktaṃ vinayapūrvakam || 7 || rājovāca devadeva tavānujñāṃ karomi karuṇānidhe | vedoktena vidhānena makhaṃ ca bahudakṣiṇam || 8 || putre jāte daśāhena karmayogyo bhavetpitā | māsena śudhyejjananī dampatī tatra kāraṇam || 9 || sarvajño'si pracetastvaṃ dharmaṃ jānāsi śāśvatam | kṛpāṃ kuru tvaṃ vārīśa kṣamasva parameśvara || 10 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktastu pracetāstaṃ pratyuvāca janādhipam | svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi kuru kāryāṇi pārthiva || 11 || āgamiṣyāmi māsānte yaṣṭavyaṃ sarvathā tvayā | kṛtvautthānikamācāraṃ putrasya nṛpasattama || 12 || ityuktvā ślakṣṇayā vācā rājānaṃ yādasāṃ patiḥ | hariścandro mudaṃ prāpa gate pāśini pārthivaḥ || 13 || koṭiśaḥ pradadau gāstā ghaṭodhnīrhemapūritāḥ | viprebhyo vedavidbhyaśca tathaiva tilaparvatān || 14 || rājā putramukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhamāpa mahattaram | nāmāsya rohitaśceti cakāra vidhipūrvakam || 15 || pūrṇe māse tataḥ pāśī vipraveṣeṇa bhūpateḥ | ājagāma gṛhe sadyo yajasveti bruvanmuhuḥ || 16 || vīkṣya taṃ nṛpatirdevaṃ nimagnaḥ śokasāgare | praṇipatya kṛtātithyaṃ tamuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 17 || diṣṭyā deva tvamāyāto gṛhaṃ me pāvitaṃ prabho | makhaṃ karomi vārīśa vidhivadvāñchitaṃ tava || 18 || adanto na paśuḥ ślāghya ityāhurvedavādinaḥ | tasmāddantodbhave te'haṃ kariṣyāmi mahāmakham || 19 || vyāsa uvāca ityuktastena varuṇastathetyuktvā yayāvatha | hariścandro mudaṃ prāpya vijahāra gṛhāśrame || 20 || punardantodbhavaṃ jñātvā pracetā dvijarūpavān | ājagāma gṛhe tasya kuru kāryamiti bruvan || 21 || bhūpālo'pi jalādhīśaṃ vīkṣya prāptaṃ dvijākṛtim | praṇamyāsanasammānaiḥ pūjayāmāsa sādaram || 22 || stutvā provāca vacanaṃ vinayānatakandharaḥ | karomi vidhivatkāmaṃ makhaṃ prabaladakṣiṇam || 23 || bālo'pyakṛtacaulo'yaṃ garbhakeśo na sammataḥ | yajñārthe paśukaraṇe mayā vṛddhamukhācchrutam || 24 || tāvatkṣamasva vārīśa vidhiṃ jānāsi śāśvatam | kartavyaḥ sarvathā yajño muṇḍanānte śiśoḥ kila || 25 || tasyeti vacanaṃ śrutvā pracetāḥ prāha taṃ punaḥ | pratārayasi māṃ rājan punaḥ punaridaṃ bruvan || 26 || api te sarvasāmagrī vartate nṛpate'dhunā | putrasnehanibaddhastvaṃ vañcayasyeva sāmpratam || 27 || kṣaurakarmavidhiṃ kṛtvā na kartāsi makhaṃ yadi | tadāhaṃ dāruṇaṃ śāpaṃ dāsye kopasamanvitaḥ || 28 || adya gacchāmi rājendra vacanāttava mānada | na mṛṣā vacanaṃ kāryaṃ tvayekṣvākukulodbhava || 29 || ityābhāṣya yayāvāśu pracetā nṛpatergṛhāt | rājā paramasantuṣṭo nananda bhavane tadā || 30 || cūḍākaraṇakāle tu pravṛtte paramotsave | samprāptastarasā pāśī bhavanaṃ nṛpateḥ punaḥ || 31 || yadāṅke sutamādāya rājñī nṛpatisannidhau | upaviṣṭā kriyākāle tadaiva varuṇo'bhyagāt || 32 || kuru karmeti vispaṣṭaṃ vacanaṃ kathayannṛpam | viprarūpadharaḥ śrīmān pratyakṣa iva pāvakaḥ || 33 || nṛpatistvaṃ samālokya babhūvātīva vihvalaḥ | namaścakāra taṃ bhītyā kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ puraḥ || 34 || vidhivatpūjayitvā taṃ rājovāca vinītavān | svāmin kāryaṃ karomyadya makhasya vidhipūrvakam || 35 || vaktavyamasti tatrāpi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vibho | yuktaṃ cenmanyase svāmiṃstad bravīmi tavāgrataḥ || 36 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyastrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ | saṃskṛtāścānyathā śūdrā evaṃ vedavido viduḥ || 37 || tasmādayaṃ suto me'dya śudravadvartate śiśuḥ | upanītaḥ kriyārhaḥ syāditi vedeṣu nirṇayaḥ || 38 || rājñāmekādaśe varṣe sadopanayanaṃ smṛtam | aṣṭame brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vaiśyānāṃ dvādaśe kila || 39 || dayase yadi deveśa dīnaṃ māṃ sevakaṃ tava | tadopanīya kartāsmi paśunā yajñamuttamam || 40 || lokapālo'si dharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada | manyase madvacaḥ satyaṃ tad gaccha bhavanaṃ vibho || 41 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā dayāvān yādasāṃ patiḥ | omityuktvā yayāvāśu prasannavadano nṛpaḥ || 42 || gate'tha varuṇo rājā babhūvātimudānvitaḥ | sukhaṃ prāpya sutasyaivaṃ rājā mudamavāpa ha || 43 || cakāra rājakāryāṇi hariścandrastadā nṛpaḥ | kālena vrajatā putro babhūva daśavārṣikaḥ || 44 || tasyopavītasāmagrīṃ vibhūtisadṛśīṃ nṛpaḥ | cakāra brāhmaṇaiḥ śiṣṭairanvitaḥ sacivaistathā || 45 || ekādaśe sutāsyābde vratabandhavidhau nṛpaḥ | vidadhe vidhivatkāryaṃ citte cintāturaḥ punaḥ || 46 || vartamāne tathā kārye upanīte kumārake | ājagāmātha varuṇo vipraveṣadharastadā || 47 || taṃ vīkṣya nṛpatistūrṇaṃ praṇamya purataḥ sthitaḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ prītaḥ pratyuvāca surottamam || 48 || deva dattopavīto'yaṃ paśuyogyo'sti me sutaḥ | prasādāttava me śoko gato vandhyāpavādajaḥ || 49 || kartumicchāmyahaṃ yajñaṃ prabhūtavaradakṣiṇam | samaye śṛṇu dharmajña satyamadya bravīmyaham || 50 || samāvartanakarmānte kariṣyāmi tavepsitam | mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā tāvattvaṃ kṣantumarhasi || 51 || varuṇa uvāca pratārayasi māṃ rājan putrapremākulo bhṛśam | muhurmuhurmatiṃ kṛtvā yuktiyuktāṃ mahāmate || 52 || gacchāmyadya mahārāja vacasā tava noditaḥ | āgamiṣyāmi samaye samāvartanakarmaṇi || 53 || ityuktvā prayayau pāśī tapāpṛcchya viśāṃpate | rājā pramuditaḥ kāryaṃ cakāra ca yathottaram || 54 || āgataṃ varuṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kumāro'tivicakṣaṇaḥ | yajñasya samayaṃ jñātvā tadā cintāturo'bhavat || 55 || śokasya kāraṇaṃ rājñaḥ paryapṛcchaditastataḥ | jñātvātmavadhamāyuṣman gamanāya matiṃ dadhau || 56 || niścayaṃ paramaṃ kṛtvā sammantrya sacivātmajaiḥ | prayayau nagarāttasmānnirgatya vanamapyasau || 57 || gate putre nṛpaḥ kāmaṃ duḥkhito'bhūd bhṛśaṃ tadā | prerayāmāsa dūtānsvāṃstasyānveṣaṇakāmyayā || 58 || evaṃ gate'tha kāle'sau varuṇastadgṛhaṃ gataḥ | rājānaṃ śokasantaptaṃ kuru yajñamiti bruvan || 59 || rājā praṇamya taṃ prāha devadeva karomi kim | na jāne kvāpi putro me gatastvadya bhayākulaḥ || 60 || sarvatra giridurgeṣu munīnāmāśrameṣu ca | anveṣito me dūtaistu na prāpto yādasāṃpate || 61 || ājñāpaya mahārāja kiṃ karomi gate sute | na me doṣo'tra sarvajña bhāgyadoṣastu sarvathā || 62 || vyāsa uvāca iti bhūpavacaḥ śrutvā pracetāḥ kupito bhṛśam | śaśāpa ca nṛpaṃ krodhādvañcitastu punaḥ punaḥ || 63 || nṛpate'haṃ tvayā yasmādvacasā ca pravañcitaḥ | tasmājjalodaro vyādhistvāṃ tudatvatidāruṇaḥ || 64 || vyāsa uvāca iti śapto mahīpālaḥ kupitena pracetasā | pīḍito'bhūttadā rājā vyādhinā duḥkhadena tu || 65 || evaṃ śaptvā nṛpaṃ pāśī jagāma nijamāspadam | rājā prāpya mahāvyādhiṃ babhūvātīva duḥkhitaḥ || 66 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe hariścandrasya jalodaravyādhiprāptivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <7.16> yajñapaśubhūtasya brāhmaṇaputrasya vadhakaraṇāya viśvāmitraniṣedhavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca gate'tha varuṇe rājā rogeṇātīva pīḍitaḥ | duḥkhādduḥkhaṃ paraṃ prāpya vyathito'bhūd bhṛśaṃ tadā || 1 || kumāro'sau vane śrutvā pitaraṃ rogapīḍitam | gamanāya matiṃ rājaṃścakāra snehayantritaḥ || 2 || saṃvatsare vyatīte tu pitaraṃ draṣṭumādarāt | gantukāmaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā śakrastatrājagāma ha || 3 || vāsavastu tadā rūpaṃ kṛtvā viprasya satvaraḥ | vārayāmāsa yuktyā vai kumāraṃ gantumudyatam || 4 || indra uvāca rājaputra na jānāsi rājanītiṃ sudurlabhām | ataḥ karoṣi mūḍhastvaṃ gamanāya matiṃ vṛthā || 5 || pitā tava mahābhāga brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ | kārayiṣyati homaṃ te jvalite'tha vibhāvasau || 6 || ātmā hi vallabhastāta sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ khalu | tadarthe vallabhāḥ santi putradāradhanādayaḥ || 7 || ātmano deharakṣārthaṃ hatvā tvāṃ vallabhaṃ sutam | havanaṃ kārayitvāsau rogamukto bhaviṣyati || 8 || tasmāttvayā na gantavyaṃ rājaputra piturgṛhe | mṛte pitari gantavyaṃ rājyārthe sarvathā punaḥ || 9 || evaṃ niṣedhitastatra vāsavena nṛpātmajaḥ | vanamadhye sthitaḥ kāmaṃ punaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa || 10 || atyantaṃ duḥkhitaṃ śrutvā hariścandraṃ tadā''tmajaḥ | gamanāya matiṃ cakre maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ || 11 || tuṣārāḍ dvijarūpeṇa tatrāgatya ca rohitam | nivārayāmāsa sutaṃ yuktivākyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 12 || hariścandro'tiduḥkhārto vasiṣṭhaṃ svapurohitam | papraccha roganāśāya tatropāyaṃ suniścitam || 13 || tamāha brahmaṇaḥ putro yajñaṃ kuru nṛpottama | krayakrītena putreṇa śāpamokṣo bhaviṣyati || 14 || putrā daśavidhāṃ proktā brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ | dravyeṇānīya tasmāttvaṃ putraṃ kuru nṛpottama || 15 || varuṇo'pi prasannaḥ sansukhakārī bhaviṣyati | lobhātko'pi dvijaḥ putraṃ pradāsyati svarāṣṭrajaḥ || 16 || evaṃ pramodito rājā vasiṣṭhena mahāmanā | pradhānaṃ prerayāmāsa tadanveṣaṇakāmyayā || 17 || ajīgarto dvijaḥ kaścidviṣaye tasya bhūpateḥ | tasyāsaṃśca trayaḥ putrā nirdhanasya viśeṣataḥ || 18 || pradhānenāpyasau pṛṣṭaḥ putrārthaṃ durbalo dvijaḥ | gavāṃ śataṃ dadāmīti dehi putraṃ makhāya vai || 19 || śunaḥpucchaḥ śunaḥśepaḥ śunolāṃgūla ityamī | teṣāmekatamaṃ dehi dadāmi tu gavāṃ śatam || 20 || ajīgartastu tacchrutvā kṣudhayā pīḍito bhṛśam | putraṃ ca katamaṃ tebhyo vikretuṃ vai mano dadhe || 21 || kāryādhikāriṇaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ matvā nāsāvadādamum | kaniṣṭhaṃ nāpyadānmātā mamaiṣa iti vādinī || 22 || madhyamaṃ ca śunaḥśepaṃ dadau gavāṃ śatena ca | ānināya paśuṃ cakre naramedhe narādhipaḥ || 23 || rudantaṃ duḥkhitaṃ dīnaṃ vepamānaṃ bhṛśāturam | yūpe baddhaṃ nirīkṣyāmuṃ cukruśurmunayastadā || 24 || śāmitrāya paśuṃ cakre naramedhe narādhipaḥ | śamitā nādade śastraṃ tamālambhayituṃ śiśum || 25 || nāhaṃ dvijasutaṃ dīnaṃ rudantaṃ karuṇaṃ bhṛśam | haniṣyāmi svalobhārthamityuvācāpyasau tadā || 26 || ityuktvā virarāmāsau karmaṇo duṣkarādatha | rājā ābhāsadaḥ prāha kiṃ kartavyamiti dvijāḥ || 27 || jātaḥ kilakilāśabdo janānāṃ krośatāṃ tadā | krandamāne śunaḥśepe sabhāyāṃ bhṛśamadbhutam || 28 || ajīgartastadotthāya tamuvāca nṛpottamam | rājan kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi tavāhaṃ susthiro bhava || 29 || vetanaṃ dviguṇaṃ dehi haniṣyāmi paśuṃ kila | kartavyaṃ makhakāryaṃ vai mayā te'dya dhanārthinā || 30 || duḥkhitasya dhanārthasya sadāsūyā prasūyate | vyāsa uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya hariścandro mudānvitaḥ || 31 || tamuvāca dadāmyadya gavāṃ śatamanuttamam | tadākarṇya pitā tasya putraṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ || 32 || lobhenākulacitto'sau śāmitre kṛtaniścayaḥ | samudyataṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā janāḥ sarve sabhāsadaḥ || 33 || cukruśurbhṛśaduḥkhārtā hāheti jagadurvacaḥ | piśāco'yaṃ mahāpāpī krūrakarmā dvijākṛtiḥ || 34 || yatsvayaṃ svasutaṃ hantumudyataḥ kulapāṃsanaḥ | dhikcāṇḍāla kimetatte pāpakarma cikīrṣitam || 35 || hatvā sutaṃ dhanaṃ prāpya kiṃ sukhaṃ te bhaviṣyati | ātmā vai jāyate putra aṅgādvai vedabhāṣitam || 36 || tatkathaṃ pāpabuddhe tvamātmānaṃ hantumicchasi | evaṃ kolāhale tatra jāte kuśikanandanaḥ || 37 || samīpaṃ nṛpatergatvā tamuvāca dayāparaḥ | viśvāmitra uvāca rājannamuṃ śunaḥśepaṃ rudantaṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitam || 38 || kratuste bhavitā pūrṇo roganāśaśca sarvathā | dayāsamaṃ nāsti puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ hiṃsāsamaṃ nahi || 39 || rāgiṇāṃ rocanārthāya nodaneyaṃ vicāraya | ātmadehasya rakṣārthaṃ paradehanikṛntanam || 40 || na kartavyaṃ mahārāja sarvataḥ śubhamicchatā | dayayā sarvabhūteṣu santuṣṭo yena kena ca || 41 || sarvendriyopaśāntyā ca tuṣyatyāśu jagatpatiḥ | ātmavatsarvabhūteṣu cintanīyaṃ nṛpottama || 42 || jīvitavyaṃ priyaṃ nūnaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvadā kila | tvamicchasi sukhaṃ kartuṃ dehe hatvā tvamuṃ dvijam || 43 || kathaṃ necchedasau dehaṃ rakṣituṃ svasukhāspadam | pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ vairaṃ nānena saha te nṛpa || 44 || yenāmuṃ hantukāmastvaṃ dvijaputraṃ nirāgasam | yo yaṃ hanti vinā vairaṃ svakāmaḥ satataṃ punaḥ || 45 || hantāraṃ hanti taṃ prāpya jananaṃ jananāntare | janako'sya suduṣṭātmā yenāsau te samarpitaḥ || 46 || svātmajo dhanalobhena pāpācāraḥ sudurmatiḥ | eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko'pi gayāṃ vrajet || 47 || yajeta cāśvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet | deśamadhye ca yaḥ kaścitpāpakarma samācaret || 48 || ṣaṣṭhāṃśastasya pāpasya rājā bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ | niṣedhanīyo rājñāsau pāpaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ || 49 || na niṣiddhastvayā kasmātputraṃ vikretumudyataḥ | sūryavaṃśe samutpannastriśaṅkutanayaḥ śubhaḥ || 50 || āryastvanāryavatkarma kartumicchasi pārthiva | mocanānmuniputrasya karaṇādvacanasya me || 51 || tava dehe sukhaṃ rājan bhaviṣyatyavicāraṇāt | pitā te śāpayogena cāṇḍālatvamupāgataḥ || 52 || mayāsau tena dehena svarlokaṃ prāpitaḥ kila | tenaiva prītiyogena kuru me vacanaṃ nṛpa || 53 || muñcainaṃ bālakaṃ dīnaṃ rudantaṃ bhṛśamāturam | yācito'si mayā nūnaṃ yajñe'smin rājasūyake || 54 || prārthanābhaṅgajaṃ doṣaṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ nāvabudhyase | prārthitaṃ sarvadā deyaṃ makhe'sminnṛpasattama || 55 || anyathā pāpameva syāttava rājanna saṃśayaḥ | vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kauśikasya nṛpotamaḥ || 56 || pratyuvāca mahārāja kauśikaṃ munisattamam | jalodareṇa gādheya duḥkhito'haṃ bhṛśaṃ mune || 57 || tasmānna mocayāmyenamanyatprārthaya kauśika | na tvayā vigrahaḥ kāryaḥ kārye'sminmama sarvathā || 58 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājño viśvāmitro'tikopanaḥ | babhūva duḥkhasantapto vīkṣya dīnaṃ dvijātmajam || 59 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe yajñapaśubhūtasya brāhmaṇaputrasya vadhakaraṇāya viśvāmitraniṣedhavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <7.17> vasiṣṭhaviśvāmitrapaṇavarṇanam vyāsa uvāca rudantaṃ bālakaṃ vīkṣya viśvāmitro dayāturaḥ | śunaḥśepamuvācedaṃ gatvā pārśve'tiduḥkhitam || 1 || mantraṃ pracetasaḥ putra mayoktaṃ manasā smaran | japatastava kalyāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati mamājñayā || 2 || viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā śunaḥśepaḥ śucā''kulaḥ | mantraṃ jajāpa manasā kauśikoktaṃ sphuṭākṣaram || 3 || japatastatra tasyāśu pracetāstu kṛpākaraḥ | prādurbabhūva sahasā prasanno nṛpa bālake || 4 || dṛṣṭvā tamāgataṃ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ | tuṣṭuvurvaruṇaṃ devaṃ muditā darśanena te || 5 || rājātivismitaḥ pādau praṇanāma rujāturaḥ | baddhāñjalipuṭo devaṃ tuṣṭāva purataḥ sthitam || 6 || hariścandra uvāca devadeva kṛpāsindho pāpātmāhaṃ sumandadhīḥ | kṛtāparādhaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ pāvitaḥ parameṣṭhinā || 7 || mayā te putrakāmena duḥkhasaṃsthena helanam | kṛtaṃ kṣamāpyaṃ prabhuṇā ko'parādhaḥ sudurmateḥ || 8 || arthī doṣaṃ na jānāti tasmātputrārthinā mayā | vañcitastvaṃ devadeva bhītena narakādvibho || 9 || aputrasya gatirnāsti svargo naiva ca naiva ca | bhīto'haṃ tena vākyena tasmātte helanaṃ kṛtam || 10 || nājñasya dūṣaṇaṃ cintyaṃ nūnaṃ jñānavatā vibho | duḥkhito'haṃ rujākrānto vañcitaḥ svasutena ha || 11 || na jāne'haṃ mahārāja putro me kva gataḥ prabho | vañcayitvā vane bhīto maraṇānmāṃ kṛpānidhe || 12 || prayayau draviṇaṃ datvā gṛhīto dvijabālakaḥ | yajño'yaṃ krītaputreṇa prārabdhastava tuṣṭaye || 13 || darśanaṃ tava samprāpya gataṃ duḥkhaṃ mamādbhutam | jalodarakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ prasanne tvayi sāmpratam || 14 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājño rogāturasya ca | dayāvāndevadeveśaḥ pratyuvāca nṛpottamam || 15 || varuṇa uvāca muñca rājañchunaḥśepaṃ stuvantaṃ māṃ bhṛśāturam | yajño'yaṃ paripūrṇaste rogamukto bhavātmanā || 16 || ityuktvā varuṇastūrṇaṃ rājānaṃ virujaṃ tathā | cakāra paśyatāṃ tatra sadasyānāṃ susaṃsthitam || 17 || vimukto'sau dvijaḥ pāśādvaruṇena mahātmanā | jayaśabdastatastatra sañjāto makhamaṇḍape || 18 || rājā pramuditaḥ sadyo rogānmuktaḥ sudāruṇāt | yūpānmuktaḥ śunaḥśepo babhūvātīva saṃsthitaḥ || 19 || rājā tvimaṃ makhaṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra vinayānvitaḥ | śunaḥśepastadā sabhyānityuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 20 || bho bhoḥ sabhyā sudharmajñāḥ bruvantu dharmanirṇayam | vedaśāstrānusāreṇa yathārthavādinaḥ kila || 21 || putro'haṃ kasya sarvajñāḥ pitā ke ko'grataḥ param | bhavatāṃ vacanāttasya śaraṇaṃ pravrajāmyaham || 22 || ityukte vacane tatra sabhyāḥ procuḥ parasparam | sabhyā ūcūḥ ajīgartasya putro'yaṃ kasyānyasya bhavedasau || 23 || aṅgādaṅgātsamudbhūtaḥ pālitastena bhaktitaḥ | anyasya kasya putro'sau prabhavediti niścayaḥ || 24 || tacchrutvā vāmadevastu tānuvāca sabhāsadaḥ | vikrītastena tātena dravyalobhātsutaḥ kila || 25 || putro'yaṃ dhanadātuśca rājñastatra na saṃśayaḥ | athavā varuṇasyaiṣa pāśānmukto'styanena vai || 26 || annadātā bhayatrātā tathā vidyāpradaśca yaḥ | tathā vittapradaścaiva pañcaite pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 27 || tadā kecitpituḥ prāhuḥ kecidrājñastathāpare | varuṇasyeti saṃvāde nirṇayaṃ na yayuśca te || 28 || itthaṃ sandehamāpanne vasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt | sabhyānvivadatastatra sarvajñaḥ sarvapūjitaḥ || 29 || śṛṇudhvaṃ bho mahābhāgā nirṇayaṃ śrutisammatam | niḥsnehena yadā pitrā vikrīto'yaṃ sutaḥ śiśuḥ || 30 || sambandhastu gatastasya tadaiva dhanasaṃgrahāt | hariścandrasya sañjātaḥ putro'sau krīta eva ca || 31 || yūpe baddho yadā rājñā tadā tasya na vai sutaḥ | varuṇastu stuto'nena tena tuṣṭena mocitaḥ || 32 || tasmānnāyaṃ mahābhāgā hyasau putraḥ pracetasaḥ | yo yaṃ stauti mahāmantraiḥ so'pi tuṣṭo dadāti ca || 33 || dhanaṃ prāṇānpaśūn rājyaṃ tathā mokṣaṃ kilepsitam | kauśikasya sutaścāyamariṣṭe yena rakṣitaḥ || 34 || mantraṃ dattvā mahāvīryaṃ varuṇasyātisaṅkaṭe | vyāsa uvāca śrutvā vākyaṃ vasiṣṭhasya bāḍhamūcuḥ sabhāsadaḥ || 35 || viśvāmitrastu jagrāha taṃ kare dakṣiṇe tadā | ehi putra gṛhaṃ me tvamityuktvā premapūritaḥ || 36 || śunaḥśepo jagāmāśu tenaiva saha satvaraḥ | varuṇastu prasannātmā jagāma ca svamālayam || 37 || ṛtvijaśca tathā sabhyāḥ svagṛhānniryayustadā | rājāpi roganirmukto babhūvātimudānvitaḥ || 38 || prajāstu pālayāmāsa suprasannena cetasā | rohitākhyastu tacchrutvā vṛttāntaṃ varuṇasya ha || 39 || ājagāma gṛhaṃ prīto durgamādvanaparvatāt | dūtā rājānamabhyetya procuḥ putraṃ samāgatam || 40 || mudito'sau jagāmāśu sammukhaḥ kosalādhipaḥ | dṛṣṭvā pitaramāyāntaṃ premodriktaḥ susambhramaḥ || 41 || daṇḍavatpatito bhūmāvaśrupūrṇamukhaḥ śucā | rājāpi taṃ samutthāpya parirabhya mudānvitaḥ || 42 || tamāghrāya sutaṃ mūrdhni papraccha kuśalaṃ punaḥ | utsaṅge taṃ samāropya mudito medinīpatiḥ || 43 || uṣṇairnetrajalaiḥ śīrṣaṇyabhiṣekamathākarot | rājyaṃ śaśāsa tenāsau putreṇātipriyeṇa ca || 44 || vṛttāntaṃ naramedhasya kathayāmāsa vistarāt | rājasūyaṃ kratuvaraṃ cakāra nṛpasattamaḥ || 45 || vasiṣṭhaṃ pūjayitvātha hotāramakarodvibhuḥ | samāpte tvatha yajñeśe vasiṣṭho'tīva pūjitaḥ || 46 || śakrasya sadanaṃ ramyaṃ jagāma munirādarāt | viśvāmitro'pi tatraiva vasiṣṭhena ca saṅgataḥ || 47 || militvā tau sthitau devasadane munisattama | viśvāmitro'pi papraccha vasiṣṭhaṃ pratipūjitam || 48 || vīkṣya vismayacittastaṃ sabhāyāṃ tu śacīpateḥ | viśvāmitra uvāca kveyaṃ pūjā tvayā prāptā mahatī munisattama || 49 || kṛtā kena mahābhāga satyaṃ brūhi mamāntike | vasiṣṭha uvāca yajamāno'sti me rājā hariścandraḥ pratāpavān || 50 || rājasūyaḥ kṛtastena rājñā pravaradakṣiṇaḥ | nedṛśo'sti nṛpaścānyaḥ satyavādī dhṛtavrataḥ || 51 || dātā ca dharmaśīlaśca prajārañjanatatparaḥ | tasya yajñe mayā pūjā prāptā kauśikanandana || 52 || [ kiṃ pṛcchasi punaḥ satyaṃ bravīmyakṛtrimaṃ dvija ] hariścandrasamo rājā na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | satyavādī tathā dātā śūraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || 53 || vyāsa uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā viśvāmitro'tikopanaḥ | babhūva krodhasaṃraktalocano'pyabravīcca tam || 54 || viśvāmitra uvāca evaṃ stauṣi nṛpaṃ mithyāvādinaṃ kapaṭapriyam | vañcito varuṇo yena pratiśrutya varaṃ punaḥ || 55 || mama janmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tapasaḥ paṭhitasya ca | tvadīyaṃ vātitapaso glahaṃ kuru mahāmate || 56 || ahaṃ cettaṃ nṛpaṃ sadyo na karomyatisaṃstutam | asatyavādinaṃ kāmamadātāraṃ mahākhalam || 57 || ājanmasañcitaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ mama vinaśyatu | anyathā tvatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ tviti paṇāvahe || 58 || glahaṃ kṛtvā tatastau tu vivadantau munī tadā | svāśramaṃ svargalokācca gatau paramakopanau || 59 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamaskandhe vasiṣṭhaviśvāmitrapaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <7.18> hariścandradvārā vṛddhabrāhmaṇāya dhanadānapratijñāvarṇanam vyāsa uvāca kadācittu hariścandro mṛgayārthaṃ vanaṃ yayau | apaśyadrudatīṃ bālāṃ sundarīṃ cārulocanām || 1 || tāmapṛcchanmahārājajh kāminīṃ karuṇāparaḥ | padmapatraviśālākṣi kiṃ rodiṣi varānane || 2 || kenāsi pīḍitātyarthaṃ kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ vadāśu me | kāca tvaṃ vijane ghore kaste bhartā pitāthavā || 3 || na bādhate ca rājye me rākṣaso'pi parāṅganām | taṃ hanmi tarasā kānte yastvāṃ sundari bādhate || 4 || brūhi duḥkhaṃ varārohe svasthā bhava kṛśodari | viṣaye mama pāpātmā na tiṣṭhati sumadhyame || 5 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā nārī tamabravīnnṛpam | pramṛjyāśrūṇi vadanāddhariścandraṃ nṛpottamam || 6 || nāryuvāca rājan māṃ bādhatetyarthaṃ viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ | tapaḥ karoti yadghoraṃ madarthaṃ kauśiko vane || 7 || tenāhaṃ duḥkhitā rājan viṣaye tava suvrata | viddhi māṃ kamanāṃ kāntāṃ pīḍitāṃ muninā bhṛśam || 8 || rājovāca svasthā bhava viśālākṣi na te duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati | tamahaṃ vārayiṣyāmi muniṃ tāpaparāyaṇam || 9 || ityāśvāsya striyaṃ rājā tarasā munisannidhau | natvā praṇamya śirasā tamuvāca mahīpatiḥ || 10 || svāminkiṃ kriyate'tyarthaṃ tapasā dehapīḍanam | kimarthaṃ te samārambho brūhi satyaṃ mahāmate || 11 || vāñchitaṃ tava gādheya karomi saphalaṃ kila | uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha tarasā tapasālamataḥ param || 12 || viṣaye mama sarvajña na kartavyaṃ sudāruṇam | lokapīḍākaraṃ ghoraṃ tapaḥ kenāpi karhicit || 13 || itthaṃ niṣidhya taṃ rājā viśvāmitraṃ gṛhaṃ yayau | manasā krodhamādhāya gato'sau kauśiko muniḥ || 14 || sa gatvā cintayāmāsa nṛpakṛtyamasāmpratam | vasiṣṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ tapasaḥ pratiṣedhanam || 15 || kopāviṣṭena manasā pratīkāramathākarot | vicintya bahudhā citte dānavaṃ ghoravigraham || 16 || preṣayāmāsa taddeśaṃ vidhāya sūkarākṛtim | so'tikāyo mahākālaḥ kurvannādaṃ sudāruṇam || 17 || rājñaścopavane prāptastrāsayan rakṣakāṃstadā | mālatīnāṃ ca khaṇḍāni kadambānāṃ tathaiva ca || 18 || yūthikānāṃ ca vṛndāni kampayaṃśca muhurmuhuḥ | dantena vilikhanbhūmiṃ samunmūlayate drumān || 19 || campakānketakīkhaṇḍānmallikānāṃ ca pādapān | karavīrānuśīrāṃśca nicakhāna śubhānmṛdūn || 20 || mucukundānaśokāṃśca bakulāṃstilakāṃstathā | unmūlya kadanaṃ tatra cakāra sūkaro vane || 21 || vāṭikārakṣakāḥ sarve dudruvuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | hāheti cukruśustatra mālākārā bhṛśāturāḥ || 22 || bāṇaiḥ santāḍyamāno'pi yadā trasto na vai mṛgaḥ | rakṣakānpīḍayāmāsa kolaḥ kālasamadyutiḥ || 23 || te tadātibhayākrāntā rājānaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ | tamūcustrāhi trāhīti vepamānā bhayākulāḥ || 24 || tānāgatānsamālokya bhayārtānbhūpatistadā | papraccha kiṃ bhayaṃ kasmānmāṃ bruvantu samāgatāḥ || 25 || nāhaṃ bibhemi devebhyo rākṣasebhyaśca rakṣakāḥ | kasmādbhayaṃ samutpannaṃ tadbruvantu mamāgrataḥ || 26 || hanmi caikena bāṇena taṃ śatruṃ durbhagaṃ kila | yo me'rātiḥ samutpanno loke pāpamatiḥ khalaḥ || 27 || devo vā dānavo vāpi taṃ nihanmi śaraiḥ śitaiḥ | kva tiṣṭhati kiyadrūpaḥ kiyadbalasamanvitaḥ || 28 || mālākārā ūcuḥ na devo na ca daityo'sti na yakṣo na ca kinnaraḥ | kaścitkolo mahākāyo rājaṃstiṣṭhati kānane || 29 || puṣpavṛkṣānatimṛdūndantenonmūlayatyasau | vidīrṇaṃ tadvanaṃ sarvaṃ sūkareṇātiraṃhasā || 30 || viśikhaistāḍito'smābhirdṛṣadbhirlakuṭaistathā | na bibheti mahārāja hanumasmānupādravat || 31 || vyāsa uvāca ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ rājā kopasamākulaḥ | aśvāmāruhya tarasā jagāmopavanaṃ prati || 32 || sainyena mahatā yukto gajāśvarathasaṃyutaḥ | padātivṛndasahitaḥ prayayau vanamuttamam || 33 || tatrāpaśyanmahākolaṃ ghurghurantaṃ bhayānakam | vanaṃ bhagnaṃ ca saṃvīkṣya rājā krodhayuto'bhavat || 34 || cāpe bāṇaṃ samāropya vikṛṣya ca śarāsanam | taṃ hantuṃ sūkaraṃ pāpaṃ tarasā samupākramat || 35 || samālokya ca rājānaṃ cāpahastaṃ ruṣākulam | sammukho'bhyadravattūrṇaṃ kurvañchabdaṃ sudāruṇam || 36 || tamāyāntaṃ samālokya varāhaṃ vikṛtānanam | mumoca viśikhaṃ tasminhantukāmo mahīpatiḥ || 37 || vañcayitvātha tadbāṇaṃ sūkarastarasā balāt | nirjagāma mahāvegāttamullaṃghya nṛpaṃ tadā || 28 || gacchantaṃ taṃ samālokya rājā kopasamanvitaḥ | mumoca viśikhāṃstīkṣṇāṃścāpamākṛṣya yatnataḥ || 39 || kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ rājñaḥ kṣaṇaṃ cādarśanaṃ gataḥ | kurvanbahuvidhārāvaṃ sūkaraṃ samupādravat || 40 || hariścandro'tikupito mṛgasyānujagāma ha | aśvena vāyuvegena vikṛṣya ca śarāsanam || 41 || itastatastaḥ sainyamagamacca vanāntaram | ekākī nṛpatiḥ kolaṃ vrajantaṃ samupādravat || 42 || madhyāhnasamaye rājā samprāpto vijane vane | tṛṣitaḥ kṣudhito'tyarthaṃ babhūva śrāntavāhanaḥ || 43 || sūkaro'darśanaṃ prāpto rājā cintāturo'bhavat | mārgabhraṣṭo'tivipine dāruṇe dīnavatsthitaḥ || 44 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi na sahāyo'sti me vane | ajñātasvapathaḥ kutra vrajāmīti vyacintayat || 45 || evaṃ vintayatastatra vipine janavarjite | rājñā cintāturo'paśyannadīṃ suvimalodakām || 46 || vīkṣya tāṃ mudito rājā pāyayitvā turaṅgakam | aśvādutterya vimalaṃ papau pānīyamuttamam || 47 || jalaṃ pītvā nṛpastatra sukhamāpa mahīpatiḥ | ityeṣa nagaraṃ gantuṃ digbhrameṇātimohitaḥ || 48 ||
