sarīsṛpaṃ sthāṇu yadatra dṛśyate || 20 || bhavān yugāntārṇava ūrmimālini kṣoṇīmimāmoṣadhivīrudhāṃ nidhim | mayā sahorukrama te'ja ojasā tasmai jagatprāṇagaṇātmane namaḥ || 21 || evaṃ stauti ca deveśaṃ manuḥ pārthivasattamaḥ | matsyāvatāraṃ deveśaṃ saṃśayacchedakāraṇam || 22 || dhyānayogena devasya nirdhūtāśeṣakalmaṣaḥ | āste paricaranbhaktyā mahābhāgavatottamaḥ || 23 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe bhuvanakośavarṇane harivarṣaketumālaramyakavarṣavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <8.10> bhuvanakośavarṇane hiraṇmayakimpuruṣavarṣavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca hiraṇmaye nāma varṣe bhagavānkūrmarūpadhṛk | āste yogapatiḥ so'yamaryamṇā pūjya īḍyate || 1 || aryamovāca oṃ namo bhagavate akūpārāya sarvasattvaguṇaviśeṣaṇāya nopalakṣitasthānāya namo varṣmaṇe namo bhūme namo'vasthānāya namaste | yadrūpametannijamāyayārpitamarthasvarūpaṃ bahurūparūpitam | saṃkhyā na yasyāstyayathopalambhanāttasmai namaste'vyapadeśarūpiṇe || 2 || jarāyujaṃ svedajamaṇḍajodbhidaṃ carācaraṃ devarṣipitṛbhūtamaindriyam | dyauḥ khaṃ kṣitiḥ śailasaritsamudraṃ dvīpagraharkṣetyabhidheya ekaḥ || 3 || yasminasaṃkhyeyaviśeṣanāmarūpākṛtau kavibhiḥ kalpiteyam | saṃkhyā yayā tattvadṛśāpanīyate tasmai namaḥ sāṃkhyanidarśanāya te || 4 || evaṃ stuvati deveśamaryamā saha varṣapaiḥ | gīyate cāpi bhajate sarvabhūtabhavaṃ prabhum || 5 || tathottareṣu kuruṣu bhagavānyajñapūruṣaḥ | ādivārāharūpo'sau dharaṇyā pūjyate sadā || 6 || sampūjya vidhivaddevaṃ tadbhaktyārdrārdrahṛtkajā | bhūmiḥ stauti hariṃ yajñavārāhaṃ daityamardanam || 7 || bhūruvāca oṃ namo bhagavate mantratattvaliṅgāya yajñakratave mahādhvarāvayavāya mahāvarāhāya namaḥ karmaśuklāya triyugāya namaste || 8 || yasya svarūpaṃ kavayo vipaścito guṇeṣu dāruṣviva jātavedasam | majjanti mathnā manasā didṛkṣavo gūḍhaṃ kriyārthernama īritātmane || 9 || dravyakriyāhetvayaneśakartṛbhirmāyāguṇairvastubhirīkṣitātmane | anvīkṣayāṅgātiśayātmabuddhibhiniṃrastamāyākṛtaye namo'stu te || 10 || karoti viśvasthitisaṃyamodayaṃ yasyepsitaṃ neṣmitumīkṣiturguṇaiḥ | māyā yathā'yo bhramate tadāśrayaṃ grāvṇo namaste guṇakarmasākṣiṇe || 11 || pramathya daityaṃ prativāraṇaṃ mṛdhe yo māṃ rasāyā jagadādisūkaraḥ | kṛtvāgradaṃṣṭraṃ niragādudanvataḥ krīḍannivebhaḥ praṇatāsmi taṃ vibhum || 12 || kimpuruṣe varṣe'sminbhagavantaṃ dāśarathiṃ ca sarveśam | sītārāmaṃ devaṃ śrīhanumānādipūruṣaṃ stauti || 13 || oṃ namo bhagavate uttamaślokāya nama iti | āryalakṣaṇaśīlavratāya nama upaśikṣitātmane upāsitalokāya namaḥ | sādhuvādanikaṣaṇāya namo brahmaṇyadevāya mahāpuruṣāya mahābhāgāya nama iti | yattadviśuddhānubhavātmamekaṃ svatejasā dhvastaguṇavyavastham | pratyak praśāntaṃ sudhiyopalambhanaṃ hyanāmarūpaṃ nirahaṃ prapadye || 14 || martyāvatārastviha martyaśikṣaṇaṃ rakṣovadhāyaiva na kevalaṃ vibho | kuto'nyathā syād''ramataḥ sva ātmanaḥ sītākṛtāni vyasanānīśvarasya || 15 || na vai sa ātmātmavatāṃ suhṛttamaḥ saktasvilokyāṃ bhagavānvāsudevaḥ | na strīkṛtaṃ kaśmalamaśnuvīta na lakṣaṇaṃ cāpi vihātumarhati || 16 || na janma nūnaṃ mahato na saubhagaṃ na vāṅ na cuddhirnākṛtistoṣahetuḥ | tairyadvisṛṣṭānapi no vanaukasaścakāra sakhye bata lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ || 17 || suro'suro vāpyathavā naro'naraḥ sarvātmanā yaḥ sukṛtajñamuttamam | bhajeta rāmaṃ manujākṛtiṃ hariṃ ya uttarānanayatkosalān divam || 18 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca evaṃ kimpuruṣe varṣe satyasandhaṃ dṛḍhavratam | rāmaṃ rājīvapatrākṣaṃ hanumān vānarottamaḥ || 19 || stauti gāyati bhaktyā ca saṃpūjayati sarvaśaḥ | ya etacchṛṇuyāccitraṃ rāmacandrakathānakam | sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā yāti rāmasalokatām || 20 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe bhuvanakośavarṇane hiraṇmayakimpuruṣavarṣavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || adhyāya dahāvā samāpta <8.11> bhuvanakośavarṇane bhāratavarṣavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca bhāratākhye ca varṣe'sminnahamādijapūruṣaḥ | tiṣṭhāmi bhavatā caiva stavanaṃ kriyate'niśam || 1 || nārada uvāca oṃ namo bhagavate upaśamaśīlāyoparatānātmyāya namo'kiñcanavittāya ṛṣiṛṣabhāya naranārāyaṇāya paramahaṃsaparamagurave ātmārāmādhipataye namo nama iti | kartāsya sargādiṣu yo na badhyate na hanyate dehagato'pi daihikaiḥ | draṣṭurna dṛśyasya guṇairvidūṣyate tasmai namo'saktaviviktasākṣiṇe || 2 || idaṃ hi yogeśvarayoganaipuṇaṃ hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāñjagāda yat | yadantakāle tvayi nirguṇe mano bhaktyā dadhītojjhitaduṣkalevaraḥ || 3 || yathaihikāmuṣmikakāmalampaṭaḥ suteṣu dāreṣu dhaneṣu cintayan | śaṅketa vidvān kukalevarātyayādyastasya yatnaḥ śrama eva kevalam || 4 || tannaḥ prabho tvaṃ kukalevarārpitāṃ tvaṃ māyayāhaṃ mamatāmadhokṣaja | bhindyāma yenāśu vayaṃ sudurbhidāṃ vidhehi yogaṃ tvayi naḥ svabhāvajam || 5 || evaṃ stauti sadā devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam | nārado muniśārdūlaḥ prajñātākhilasāradṛk || 6 || asmin vai bhārate varṣe saricchailāstu santi hi | tānpravakṣyāmi devarṣe śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ || 7 || malayo maṅgalaprastho mainākaśca trikūṭakaḥ | ṛṣabhaḥ kūṭakaḥ kollaḥ sahyo devagiristathā || 8 || ṛṣyamūkaśca śrīśailo vyaṅkaṭādrirmahendrakaḥ | vāridhāraśca vindhyaśca muktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ || 9 || pāriyātrastathā droṇaścitrakūṭagiristathā | govardhano raivatakaḥ kakubho nīlaparvataḥ || 10 || gauramukhaścendrakīlo giriḥ kāmagiristathā | ete cānye'pyasaṃkhyātā girayo bahupuṇyadāḥ || 11 || etadutpannasaritaḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ | pānāvagāhanasnānadarśanotkīrtanairapi || 12 || nāśayanti ca pāpāni trividhāni śarīriṇām | tāmraparṇī candravaśā kṛtamālā vaṭodakā || 13 || vaihāyasī ca kāverī veṇā caiva payasvinī | tuṅgabhadrā kṛṣṇaveṇā śarkarāvartakā tathā || 14 || godāvarī bhīmarathī nirvindhyā ca payoṣṇikā | tāpī revā ca surasā narmadā ca sarasvatī || 15 || carmaṇvatī ca sindhuśca andhaśoṇau mahānadau | ṛṣikulyā trisāmā ca vedasmṛtirmahānadī || 16 || kauśikī yamunā caiva mandākinī dṛṣadvatī | gomatī sarayū rodhavatī saptavatī tathā || 17 || suṣomā ca śatadruśca candrabhāgā marudvṛdhā | vitastā ca asiknī ca viśvā ceti prakīrtitāḥ || 18 || asminvarṣe labdhajanmapuruṣaiḥ svasvakarmabhiḥ | śuklalohitakṛṣṇākhyairdivyamānuṣanārakāḥ || 19 || bhavanti vividhā bhogāḥ sarveṣāṃ ca nivāsinām | yathā varṇavidhānenāpavargo bhavati sphuṭam || 20 || etadeva ca varṣasya prādhānyaṃ kāryasiddhitaḥ | vadanti munayo vedavādinaḥ svargavāsinaḥ || 21 || aho amīṣāṃ kimakāri śobhanaṃ prasanna eṣāṃ sviduta svayaṃ hariḥ | yairjanma labdhaṃ nṛṣu bhāratājire mukundasevaupayikaṃ spṛhā hi naḥ || 22 || kiṃ duṣkarairnaḥ kratubhistapovratairdānādibhirvā dyujayena phalgunā | na yatra nārāyaṇapadapaṅkajasmṛtiḥ pramuṣṭātiśayendriyotsavāt || 23 || kalpāyuṣāṃ sthānajayātpunarbhavātkṣaṇāyuṣāṃ bhāratabhūjayo varam | kṣaṇena martyena kṛtaṃ manasvinaḥ saṃnyasya saṃyāntyabhayaṃ padaṃ hareḥ || 24 || na yatra vaikuṇṭhakathāsudhāpagā na sādhavo bhāgavatāstadāśrayāḥ | na yatra yajñeśamakhā mahotsavāḥ sureśaloko'pi na vai sa sevyatām || 25 || prāptā nṛjātiṃ tviha ye ca jantavo jñānakriyādravyakalāpasambhṛtām | na vai yateranna punarbhavāya te bhūyo vanaukā iva yānti bandhanam || 26 || yaiḥ śraddhayā barhiṣi bhāgaśo havirniruptamiṣṭaṃ vidhimantravastutaḥ | ekaḥ pṛthaṅnāmabhirāhuto mudā gṛhṇāti pūrṇaḥ svayamāśiṣāṃ prabhuḥ || 27 || satyaṃ diśatyarthitamarthito nṛṇāṃ naivārthado yatpunararthitā yataḥ | svayaṃ vidhatte bhajatāmanicchatāmicchāpidhānaṃ nijapādapallavam || 28 || (yadyatra naḥ svargasukhāvaśeṣitaṃ sviṣṭasya pūrtasya kṛtasya śobhanam | tenābjanābhe smṛtimajjanma naḥ syādvarṣe harirbhajatāṃ śaṃ tanoti ||) śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca evaṃ svargagatā devāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ | pravadanti ca māhātmyaṃ bhāratasya suśobhanam || 29 || jambudvīpasya cāṣṭau hi upadvīpāḥ smṛtāḥ pare | hayamārgānviśodhadbhiḥ sāgaraiḥ parikalpitāḥ || 30 || svarṇaprasthaścandraśukra āvartanaramāṇakau | mandaropākhyahariṇaḥ pāñcajanyastathaiva ca || 31 || siṃhalaścaiva laṅketi upadvīpāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam | jambudvīpasya mānaṃ hi kīrtitaṃ vistareṇa ca || 32 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi plakṣādidvīpaṣaṭkakam || 33 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe bhuvanakośavarṇane bhāratavarṣavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <8.12> bhuvanakośavarṇane plakṣadvīpakuśadvīpavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca jambudvīpo yathā cāyaṃ yatpramāṇena kīrtitaḥ | tāvatā sarvataḥ kṣārodadhinā pariveṣṭitaḥ || 1 || jambākhyena yathā merustathā kṣārodakena ca | kṣārodadhistu dviguṇaḥ plakṣākhyenopaveṣṭitaḥ || 2 || yathaiva parikhā bāhyopavanena hi veṣṭyate | plakṣākhyaśca svayaṃ jambupramāṇo dvīparūpadhṛk || 3 || hiraṇmayo'gnistatraiva tiṣṭhatīti viniścayaḥ | priyavatātmajastatra saptajihva iti smṛtaḥ || 4 || agnistadadhipastvidhmajihvaḥ svaṃ dvīpameva ca | vibhajya saptavarṣāṇi svaputrebhyo dadau vibhuḥ || 5 || svayamātmavidāṃ mānyāṃ yogacaryāṃ samāśritaḥ | tenaiva cātmayogena bhagavantamupāgataḥ || 6 || śivaṃ ca yavasaṃ bhadraṃ śāntaṃ kṣemāmṛte tathā | abhayaṃ ceti saptaiva tadvarṣāṇi sadekṣatām || 7 || teṣu proktā nadīḥ sapta girayaḥ sapta caiva hi | aruṇā nṛmṇāṅgirasī sāvitrī suprabhātikā || 8 || ṛtambharā satyambharā iti nadyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | maṇikūṭo vajrakūṭa indrasenastathaiva ca || 9 || jyotiṣmānvai suparṇaśca hiraṇyaṣṭhīva eva ca | meghamāla iti khyātāḥ plakṣadvīpasya parvatāḥ || 10 || nadīnāṃ jalamātreṇa darśanasparśanādibhiḥ | nirdhūtāśeṣarajaso nistamaskāḥ prajāstathā || 11 || haṃsaścaiva pataṅgaśca ūrdhvāyana itīva ca | satyāṅgasaṃjñāścatvāro varṇāḥ plakṣasya dvīpake || 12 || sahasrāyupramāṇāśca vividhopamadarśanāḥ | svargadvāraṃ trayīvidyāvidhinārkaṃ yajanti te || 13 || pratnasya viṣṇo rūpaṃ ca satyartasya ca brahmaṇaḥ | amṛtasya ca mṛtyośca sūryamātmānamīmahi || 14 || plakṣādiṣu ca sarveṣu pajjadvīpeṣu nārada | āyurindriyamojaśca balaṃ buddhiḥ saho'pi ca || 15 || vikramaḥ sarvalokānāṃ siddhirautpattikī sadā | plakṣadvīpātparaṃ cekṣurasodaḥ saritāmpatiḥ || 16 || plakṣadvīpaṃ samagraṃ ca parivāryāvatiṣṭhate | śālmalākhyastato dvīpaścāsmād dviguṇavistaraḥ || 17 || samānena surodena sindhunā pariveṣṭitaḥ | yatra vai śālmalīvṛkṣaḥ plakṣāyāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 18 || sthānaṃ tatpakṣirājasya garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ | tasya dvīpasya nātho hi yajñabāhuḥ priyavratāt || 19 || jātaḥ sa eva saptabhyaḥ svaputrebhyo dadau dharām | tadvarṣāṇāṃ ca nāmāni kathitāni nibodhata || 20 || surocanaṃ saumanasyaṃ ramaṇaṃ devavarṣakam | pāribhadre tathā cāpyāyanaṃ vijñātanāmakam || 21 || teṣu varṣādrayaḥ sapta saptaiva saritaḥ smṛtāḥ | sarasaḥ śataśṛṅgaśca vāmadevaśca kandakaḥ || 22 || kumudaḥ puṣpavarṣaśca sahasraśrutireva ca | ete ca parvatāḥ sapta nadīnāmāni cocyate || 23 || anumatiḥ sinīvālī sarasvatī kuhūstathā | rajanī caiva nandā ca rāketi parikīrtitāḥ || 24 || tadvarṣapuruṣāḥ sarve cāturvarṇyasamāhvayāḥ | śrutadharo vīryadharo vasundhara iṣundharaḥ || 25 || bhagavantaṃ vedamayaṃ yajante somamīśvaram | svagobhiḥ pitṛdevebhyo vibhajatkṛṣṇaśuklayoḥ || 26 || sarvāsāṃ ca prajānāṃ ca rājā somaḥ prasīdatu | evaṃ surodād dviguṇaḥ svamānena prakīrtitaḥ || 27 || ghṛtodenāvṛtaḥ so'yaṃ kuśadvīpaḥ prakāśate | yasminnāste kuśastambo dvīpākhyākāraṇo jvalan || 28 || svaśaṣparociṣā kāṣṭhā bhāsayanparitiṣṭhate | hiraṇyaretāstaddvīpapatiḥ praiyavrata svarāṭ || 29 || svaputrebhyaśca saptabhyastaddvīpaṃ santadhābhajat | vasuśca vasudānaśca tathā dṛḍharuciḥ paraḥ || 30 || nābhiguptastutyavratau viviktanāmadevakau | teṣāṃ varṣeṣu saptaiva sīmāgirivarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 31 || nadyaḥ saptaiva santīha tannāmāni nibodhata | cakrastathā catuḥśṛṅgaḥ kapilaścitrakūṭakaḥ || 32 || devānīkaścordhvaromā draviṇa sapta parvatāḥ | rasakulyā madhukulyā mitravindā tathaiva ca || 33 || śrutavindā devagarbhā ghṛtacyunmandamālike | yatpayobhiḥ kuśadvīpavāsinaḥ sarva eva te || 34 || kuśalaḥ kovidaścaivāpyabhiyuktastathaiva ca | kulakaśceti saṃjñābhiścaturvarṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 35 || jātavedasarūpaṃ taṃ devaṃ karmajakauśalaiḥ | yajante devavaryābhāḥ sarve sarvavido janāḥ || 36 || parasyabrahmaṇaḥ sākṣājjātavedo'si havyavāṭ | devānāṃ puruṣāṅgānāṃ yajñena puruṣaṃ yaja | evaṃ yajante jvalanaṃ sarve dvīpādhivāsinaḥ || 37 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe bhuvanakośavarṇane plakṣadvīpakuśadvīpavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <8.13> bhuvanakośavarṇane krauñcaśākapuṣkaradvīpavarṇanam nārada uvāca śiṣṭadvīpapramāṇaṃ ca vada sarvārthadarśana | yena vijñātamātreṇa parānandamayo bhavet || 1 || śrīrānārāyaṇa uvāca kuśadvīpasya parito ghṛtodāvaraṇaṃ mahat | tato bahiḥ krauṃcadvīpo dviguṇaḥ syātsvamānataḥ || 2 || kṣīrodenāvṛto bhāti yasminkrauṃcādrirasti ca | nāmanirvartakaḥ so'yaṃ dvīpasya parivartate || 3 || yo'sau guhasya śaktyā ca bhinnakukṣiḥ purābhavat | kṣīrodenāsicyamāno varuṇena ca rakṣitaḥ || 4 || ghṛtapṛṣṭho nāma yasya vibhāti kila nāyakaḥ | priyavratātmajaḥ śrīmān sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 5 || svadvīpaṃ tu vibhajyaiva saptadhā svātmajāndadau | putranāmasu varṣeṣu varṣapānsanniveśayan || 6 || svayaṃ bhagavatastasya śaraṇaṃ sañjagāma ha | āmo madhuruhaścaiva meghapṛṣṭhaḥ sudhāmakaḥ || 7 || bhrājiṣṭho lohitārṇaśca vanaspatiritīva ca | nagā nadyaśca saptaiva vikhyātā bhuvi sarvataḥ || 8 || śuklo vai vardhamānaśca bhojanaścopabarhaṇaḥ | nandaśca nandanaḥ sarvatobhadra iti kīrtitāḥ || 9 || abhayā amṛtaughā cāryakā tīrthavatīti ca | vṛttirūpavatī śuklā pavitravatikā tathā || 10 || etāsāmudakaṃ puṇyaṃ cāturvarṇyena pīyate | puruṣaṛṣabhau tadvad draviṇākhyaśca devakaḥ || 11 || ete caturvarṇajātāḥ puruṣā nivasanti hi | tatratyāḥ puruṣā āpomayaṃ devamapāṃ patim || 12 || pūrṇenāñjalinā bhaktyā yajante vividhakriyāḥ | āpaḥ puruṣavīryāḥ stha punantīrbhūrbhuvaḥ svaraḥ || 13 || tā naḥ punītāmīvaghnīḥ spṛśatāmātmanā bhuvaḥ | iti mantrajapānte ca stuvanti vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 14 || evaṃ parastātkṣīrodātparitaścopaveśitaḥ | dvātriṃśallakṣasaṃkhyākayojanāyāmamāśritaḥ || 15 || svamānena ca dvīpo'yaṃ dadhimaṇḍodakena ca | śākadvīpo viśiṣṭo'yaṃ yasmicchāko mahīruhaḥ || 16 || svakṣetravyapadeśasya kāraṇaṃ sa hi nārada | praiyavrato'dhipastasya medhātithiriti smṛtaḥ || 17 || vibhajya sapta varṣāṇi putranāmāni teṣu ca | sapta putrānnijān sthāpya svayaṃ yogagatiṃ gataḥ || 18 || purojavo manaḥpūrvajavo'tha pavamānakaḥ | dhūmrānīkaścitrarepho bahurūpo'tha viśvadhṛk || 19 || maryādāgirayaḥ sapta nadyaḥ saptaiva kīrtitāḥ | īśāna ūruśṛṅgo'tha balabhadraḥ śatakeśaraḥ || 20 || sahasrasrotako devapālo'pyante mahāśanaḥ | ete'drayaḥ sapta coktāḥ sarinnāmāni sapta ca || 21 || anaghā prathamā''yurdā ubhayaspṛṣṭireva ca | aparājitā pañcapadī sahasraśrutireva ca || 22 || tato nijadhṛtiścoktāḥ sapta nadyo mahojjvalāḥ | tadvarṣapuruṣāḥ sarve satyavratakratuvratau || 23 || dānavratānuvratau ca caturvarṇā udīritāḥ | bhagavantaṃ prāṇavāyuṃ prāṇāyāmena saṃyutāḥ || 24 || yajanti nirdhūtarajastamasaḥ paramaṃ harim | antaḥ praviśya bhūtāni yo bibhartyātmaketubhiḥ || 25 || antaryāmīśvaraḥ sākṣātpātu no yadvaśe idam | parastāddadhimaṇḍodāttatastu bahuvistaraḥ || 26 || puṣkaradvīpanāmāyaṃ śākadvīpadvisaṃguṇaḥ | svasamānena svādūdakenāyaṃ pariveṣṭitaḥ || 27 || yatrāste puṣkaraṃ bhrājadagnicūḍānibhāni ca | patrāṇi viśadānīha svarṇapatrāyutāyutam || 28 || śrīmadbhagavataścedamāsanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ | kalpitaṃ lokaguruṇā sarvalokasisṛkṣayā || 29 || taddvīpa eka evāyaṃ mānasottaranāmakaḥ | arvācīnaparācīnavarṣayoravadhirgiriḥ || 30 || ucchrāyāyāmayoḥ saṃkhyāyutayojanasammitā | yatra dikṣu ca catvāri catasṛṣu purāṇi ha || 31 || indrādilokapālānāṃ yaduparyarkanirgamaḥ | meruṃ pradakṣiṇīkurvan bhānuḥ paryeti yatra hi || 32 || saṃvatsarātmakaṃ cakraṃ devāhorātrato bhraman | praiyavrato'dhipo vītihotraḥ svātmajakadvayam || 33 || varṣadvaye paristhāpya varṣanāmadharaṃ kramāt | ramaṇo dhātakiścaiva tattadvarṣapatī ubhau || 34 || kṛtāḥ svayaṃ pūrvajavadbhagavadbhaktitatparāḥ | tadvarṣapuruṣā brahmarūpiṇaṃ parameśvaram || 35 || sakarmakena yogena yajanti pariśīlitāḥ | yattatkarmamayaṃ liṅga brahmaliṅgaṃ jano'rcayet | ekāntamadvayaṃ śāntaṃ tasmai bhagavate namaḥ || 36 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe bhuvanakośavarṇanaṃ krauñcaśākapuṣkaradvīpavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <8.14> sūryagativarṇanam nārāyaṇa uvāca tataḥ parastādacalo lokāloketi nāmakaḥ | antarāle ca lokālokayoryaḥ parikalpitaḥ || 1 || yāvadasti ca devarṣe hyantaraṃ mānasottarāt | sumerostāvatī śuddhā kāñcanī bhūmirasti hi || 2 || darpaṇodaratulyā sā sarvaprāṇivivarjitā | yasyāṃ padārthaḥ prahito na kiñcitpratyudīyate || 3 || ataḥ sarvaprāṇisaṅgharahitā sā ca nārada | lokāloka iti vyākhyā yadatra parikalpitā || 4 || lokālokāntare cāsya vartate sarvadā sthitiḥ | īśvareṇa sa lokānāṃ trayāṇāmantagaḥ kṛtaḥ || 5 || sūryādīnāṃ dhruvāntānāṃ raśmayo yadvaśādiha | arvācīnāśca trīm̐llokānātanvānāḥ kadāpi hi || 6 || parācīnatvabhājo hi na bhavanti ca nārada | tāvadunnahanāyāmaḥ parvatendro mahodayaḥ || 7 || etāvām̐llokavinyāso'yaṃ saṃsthāmānalakṣaṇaiḥ | kavibhiḥ sa tu pañcāśatkoṭibhirgaṇitasya ca || 8 || bhūgolasya caturthāṃśo lokālokācalo mune | tasyopari caturdikṣu brahmaṇā cātmayoninā || 9 || niveśitā diggajā ye tannāmāni nibodhata | ṛṣabhaḥ puṣpacūḍo'tha vāmano'thāparājitaḥ || 10 || ete samastalokasya sthitihetava īritāḥ | teṣāṃ ca svavibhūtīnāṃ bahuvīryopabṛṃhaṇam || 11 || viśuddhasattvaṃ caiśvaryaṃ vardhayanbhagavān hariḥ | āste siddhyaṣṭakopeto viṣvaksenādisaṃvṛtaḥ || 12 || nijāyudhaiḥ parivṛto bhujadaṇḍaiḥ samantataḥ | āste sakalalokasya svastaye parameśvaraḥ || 13 || ākalpamevaṃ veṣaṃ sa gato viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ | svamāyāracitasyāsya gopīthāyātmasādhanaḥ || 14 || yo'ntarvistāra etena hyalokaparimāṇakam | vyākhyātaṃ yadbahirlokālokācala itīraṇāt || 15 || tataḥ parastādyogeśagatiṃ śuddhā vadanti hi | aṇḍamadhyagataḥ sūryo dyāvābhūmyoryadantaram || 16 || sūryāṇḍagolayormadhye koṭyaḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | mṛte'ṇḍa eṣa etasmiñjāto mārtaṇḍaśabdabhāk || 17 || hiraṇyagarbha iti yaddhiraṇyāṇḍasamudbhavaḥ | sūryeṇa hi vibhajyante diśaḥ khaṃ dyaurmahībhidā || 18 || svargāpavargau narakā rasaukāṃsi ca sarvaśaḥ | devatiryaṅmanuṣyāṇāṃ sarīsṛpasavīrudhām || 19 || sarvajīvanikāyānāṃ sūrya ātmā dṛgīśvaraḥ | etāvānbhūmaṇḍalasya sanniveśa udāhṛtaḥ || 20 || etena hi divo mānaṃ varṇayanti ca tadvidaḥ | dvidalānāṃ ca niṣpāvādīnāṃ ca dalayoryathā || 21 || antareṇa tayorantarikṣaṃ tadubhayasandhitam | yanmadhyagaśca bhagavān bhānurvai tapatāṃ varaḥ || 22 || ātapena trilokaṃ ca pratapatyeva bhāsayan | uttarāyaṇamāsādya gatimāndyaṃ vitanvate || 23 || ārohaṇasthānamasau gatvāho dairdhyamācaret | dakṣiṇāyanamāsādya gatiśaighryaṃ vitanvate || 24 || avarohasthānamasau gacchanhrasvaṃ dinaṃ caret | viṣuvatsaṃjñamāsādya gatisāmyaṃ vitanvate || 25 || samasthānamathāsādya dinasāmyaṃ karoti ca | yadā ca meṣatulayoḥ sañcareddhi divākaraḥ || 26 || samānāni tvahorātrāṇyātanoti trayīmayaḥ | vṛṣādipañcasu yadā rāśiṣvarko virocate || 27 || tadāhāni ca vardhante rātrayo'pi hrasanti ca | vṛścikādiṣu sūryo hi yadā sañcarate raviḥ || 28 || tadāpīmānyahorātrāṇi bhavanti viparyayāt || 29 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe sūryagativarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <8.15> bhuvanakośavarṇane sūryagativarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhānorgamanamuttamam | śīghramandādigatibhistrividhaṃ gamanaṃ raveḥ || 1 || sarvagrahāṇāṃ trīṇyeva sthānāni surasattama | sthānaṃ jāradgavaṃ madhyaṃ tathairāvatamuttaram || 2 || vaiśvānaraṃ dakṣiṇato nirdiṣṭamiti tattvataḥ | aśvinī kṛttikā yāmyā nāgavīthīti śabditā || 3 || rohiṇyārdrā mṛgaśiro gajavīthyabhidhīyate | puṣyāśleṣā tathā''dityā vīthī cairāvatī smṛtā || 4 || etāstu vīthayastisra uttaro mārga ucyate | tathā dve cāpi phalgunyau maghā caivārṣabhī matā || 5 || hastaścitrā tathā svātī govīthīti tu śabditā | jyeṣṭhā viśākhānurādhā vīthī jāradgavī matā || 6 || etāstu vīthayastisro madhyamo mārga ucyate | mūlāṣāḍhottarāṣāḍhā ajavīthyabhiśabditā || 7 || śravaṇaṃ ca dhaniṣṭhā ca mārgī śatabhiṣak tathā | vaiśvānarī bhādrapade revatī caiva kīrtitā || 8 || etāstu vīthayastisro dakṣiṇo mārga ucyate | uttarāyaṇamāsādya yugākṣāntarnibaddhayoḥ || 9 || karṣaṇaṃ pāśayorvāyubaddhayo rohaṇaṃ smṛtam | tadābhyantaragānmaṇḍalādrathasya gaterbhavet || 10 || māndyaṃ divasavṛddhiśca jāyate surasattama | rātrihrāsaśca bhavati saumyāyanakramo hyayam || 11 || dakṣiṇāyanake pāśe preraṇādavarohaṇam | bahirmaṇḍalaveśena gatiśaighryaṃ tadā bhavet || 12 || tadā dinālpatā rātrivṛddhiśca parikīrtitā | vaiṣuve pāśasāmyāttu samāvasthānato raveḥ || 13 || madhyamaṇḍalaveśaśca sāmyaṃ rātridinādike | ākṛṣyete yadā tau tu dhruveṇa samadhiṣṭhitau || 14 || tadābhyantarataḥ sūryo bhramate maṇḍalāni ca | dhruveṇa mucyamānena punā raśmiyugena tu || 15 || tathaiva bāhyataḥ sūryo bhramate maṇḍalāni ca | tasminmerau pūrvabhāge puryaindrī devadhānikā || 16 || dakṣiṇe vai saṃyamanī nāma yāmyā mahāpurī | paścānnimlocanī nāma vāruṇī vai mahāpurī || 17 || taduttare purī saumyā proktā nāma vibhāvarī | aindrapuryāṃ raveḥ prokta udayo brahmavādibhiḥ || 18 || saṃyamanyāṃ ca madhyāhne nimlocanyāṃ nimīlanam | vibhāvaryāṃ niśīthaḥ syāttigmāṃśoḥ surapūjitaḥ || 19 || pravṛtteśca nimittāni bhūtānāṃ tāni sarvaśaḥ | meroścaturdiśaṃ bhānoḥ kīrtitāni mayā mune || 20 || merusthānāṃ sadā madhyaṃ gata eva vibhāti hi | savyaṃ gacchandakṣiṇena karoti svarṇaparvatam || 21 || udayāstamaye caiva sarvakālaṃ tu sammukhe | diśāsvaśeṣāsu tathā surarṣe vidiśāsu ca || 22 || yairyatra dṛśyate bhāsvānsa teṣāmudayaḥ smṛtaḥ | tirobhāvaṃ ca yatraiti tatraivāstamanaṃ raveḥ || 23 || naivāstamanamarkasya nodayaḥ sarvadā sataḥ | udayāstamanākhyaṃ hi darśanādarśanaṃ raveḥ || 24 || śakrādīnāṃ pure tiṣṭhanspṛśatyeṣa puratrayam | vikarṇau dvau vikarṇasthastrīnkoṇāndve pure tathā || 25 || sarveṣāṃ dvīpavarṣāṇāṃ meruruttarataḥ sthitaḥ | yairyatra dṛśyate bhānuḥ saiva prācīti cocyate || 26 || tadvāmabhāgato merurvartateti vinirṇayaḥ | yadi caindryāḥ pracalate ghaṭikā daśapañcabhiḥ || 27 || yāmyāṃ tadā yojanānāṃ sapādaṃ koṭiyugmakam | sārdhadvādaśalakṣāṇi pañcanetrasahasrakam || 28 || prakrāmati sahasrāṃśuḥ kālamārgapradarśakaḥ | evaṃ tato vāruṇīṃ ca saumyāmaindrīṃ sahasradṛk || 29 || paryeti kālacakrātmā dyumaṇiḥ kālabuddhaye | tathā cānye grahāḥ somādayo ye digvicāriṇaḥ || 30 || nakṣatraiḥ saha codyanti saha cāstaṃ vrajanti te | evaṃ muhūrtena ratho bhānoraṣṭaśatādhikam || 31 || yojanānāṃ catustriṃśallakṣāṇi bhramati prabhuḥ | trayīmayaścaturdikṣu purīṣu ca samīraṇāt || 32 || pravahākhyātsadā kālacakraṃ paryeti bhānumān | yasya cakraṃ rathasyaikaṃ dvādaśāraṃ trinābhikam || 33 || ṣaṇnemi kavayastaṃ ca vatsarātmakamūcire | merumūrdhani tasyākṣo mānasottaraparvate || 34 || kṛtetaravibhāgo yaḥ protaṃ tatra rathāṅgakam | tailakārakayantreṇa cakrasāmyaṃ paribhraman | 35 || mānasottaranāmnīha girau paryeti cāṃśumān | tasminnakṣe kṛtaṃ mūlaṃ dvitīyo'kṣo dhruve kṛtaḥ || 36 || turyamānena tailasya yantrākṣavaditīritaḥ | kṛtoparitano bhāgaḥ sūryasya jagatāṃ pateḥ || 37 || rathanīḍastu ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣayojanamāyataḥ | tatturyabhāgataḥ so'yaṃ pariṇāhena kīrtitaḥ || 38 || tāvānarkarathasyātra yugastasminhayāḥ śubhāḥ | saptacchando'bhidhānāśca sūrasūtena yojitāḥ || 39 || vahanti devamādityaṃ lokānāṃ sukhahetave | purastātsavituḥ sūto'ruṇaḥ paścānniyojitaḥ || 40 || sautye karmaṇi saṃyukto vartate garuḍāgrajaḥ | tathaiva bālakhilyākhyā ṛṣayo'ṅguṣṭhaparvakāḥ || 41 || pramāṇena parikhyātāḥ ṣaṣṭisāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ | stuvanti purataḥ sūryaṃ sūktavākyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ || 42 || tathā cānye ca ṛṣayo gandharvā apsaroragāḥ | grāmaṇyo yātudhānāśca devāḥ sarve pareśvaram || 43 || ekaikaśaḥ sapta sapta māsi māsi virocanam | sārdhalakṣottaraṃ koṭinavakaṃ bhūmimaṇḍalam || 44 || dvisahasraṃ yojanānāṃ sa gavyūtyuttaraṃ kṣaṇāt | paryeti devadeveśo viśvavyāpī nirantaram || 45 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe bhuvanakośavarṇane sūryagativarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <8.16> somādigativarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athātaḥ śrūyatāṃ citraṃ somādīnāṃ gamādikam | tadgatyanusṛtā nṝṇāṃ śubhāśubhanidarśanā || 1 || yathā kulālacakreṇa bhramatā bhramatāṃ saha | tadāśrayāṇāṃ ca gatiranyā kīṭādināṃ bhavet || 2 || evaṃ hi rāśivṛndena kālacakreṇa tena ca | meruṃ dhuraṃ ca saratāṃ prādakṣiṇyena sarvadā || 3 || grahāṇāṃ bhānumukhyānāṃ gatiranyaiva dṛśyate | nakṣatrāntaragāmitvādbhāntare gamanaṃ tathā || 4 || gatidvayaṃ cāviruddhaṃ sarvatraiṣa vinirṇayaḥ | sa eva bhagavānādipuruṣo lokabhāvanaḥ || 5 || nārāyaṇo'khilādhāro lokānāṃ svastaye bhraman | karmaśuddhinimittaṃ tu ātmānaṃ vai trayīmayam || 6 || kavibhiścaiva vedena vijijñāsyo'rkadhābhavat | ṣaṭsu krameṇa ṛtuṣu vasantādiṣu ca svayam || 7 || yathopajoṣamṛtujān guṇān vai vidadhāti ca | tamenaṃ puruṣāḥ sarve trayyā ca vidyayā sadā || 8 || varṇāśramācārapathā tathāmnātaiśca karmabhiḥ | uccāvacaiḥ śraddhayā ca yogānāṃ ca vitānakaiḥ || 9 || añjasā ca yajante ye śreyo vindanti te matam | athaiṣa ātmā lokānāṃ dyāvābhūmyantareṇa ca || 10 || kālacakragato bhuṅkte māsāndvādaśarāśibhiḥ | saṃvatsarasyāvayavānmāsaḥ pakṣadvayaṃ divā || 11 || naktaṃ ceti sa pādarkṣadvayamityupadiśyate | yāvatā ṣaṣṭhamaṃśaṃ sa bhuñjīta ṛturucyate || 12 || saṃvatsarasyāvayavaḥ kavibhiścopavarṇitaḥ | yāvatārdhena cākāśavīthyāṃ pracarate raviḥ || 13 || taṃ prāktanā varṇayanti ayanaṃ munipūjitāḥ | atha yāvannabhomaṇḍalaṃ saha pratigacchati || 14 || kārtsnyena saha bhuñjīta kālaṃ taṃ vatsaraṃ viduḥ | saṃvatsaraṃ parivatsaramiḍāvatsarameva ca || 15 || anuvatsaramidvatsaramiti pañcakamīritam | bhānormāndyaśaighryasamagatibhiḥ kālavittamaiḥ || 16 || evaṃ bhānorgatiḥ proktā candrādīnāṃ nibodhata | evaṃ candro'rkaraśmibhyo lakṣayojanamūrdhvataḥ || 17 || upalabhyamāno mitrasya saṃvatsarabhujiṃ ca saḥ | pakṣābhyāṃ cauṣadhīnātho bhuṅkte māsabhujiṃ ca saḥ || 18 || sapādamābhyāṃ divasabhuktiṃ pakṣabhujiṃ caret | evaṃ śīghragatiḥ somo bhuṅkte nūnaṃ bhacakrakam || 19 || pūryamāṇakalābhiścāmarāṇāṃ prītimāvahan | kṣīyamāṇakalābhiśca pitṝṇāṃ cittarañjakaḥ || 20 || ahorātrāṇi tanvānaḥ pūrvāparasughasrakaiḥ | sarvajīvanikāyasya prāṇo jīvaḥ sa eva hi || 21 || bhuṅkte caikaikanakṣatraṃ muhūrtatriṃśatā vibhuḥ | sa eva ṣoḍaśakalaḥ puruṣo'nādisattamaḥ || 22 || manomayo'pyannamayo'mṛtadhāmā sudhākaraḥ | devapitṛmanuṣyādisarīsṛpasavīrudhām || 23 || prāṇāpyāyanaśīlatvātsa sarvamaya ucyate | tato bhacakraṃ bhramati yojanānāṃ trilakṣataḥ || 24 || merupradakṣiṇenaiva yojitaṃ ceśvareṇa tu | aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni gaṇitāni sahābhijit || 25 || tataḥ śukro dvilakṣeṇa yojanānāmathopari | puraḥ paścātsahaivāsāvarkasya parivartate || 26 || śīghramandasamānābhirgatibhirvicaranvibhuḥ | lokānāmanukūlo'yaṃ prāyaḥ proktaḥ śubhāvahaḥ || 27 || vṛṣṭiviṣṭambhaśamano bhārgavaḥ sarvadā mune | śukrād budhaḥ samākhyāto yojanānāṃ dvilakṣataḥ || 28 || śīghramandasamānābhirgatibhiḥ śukravatsadā | yadārkādvyatiricyeta saumyaḥ prāyeṇa tatra tu || 29 || ativātābhrapātānāṃ vṛṣṭyādibhayasūcakaḥ | upariṣṭhāttato bhaumo yojanānāṃ dvilakṣataḥ || 30 || pakṣaistribhistribhiḥ so'yaṃ bhuṅkte rāśīnathaikaśaḥ | dvādaśāpi ca devarṣe yadi vakro na jāyate || 31 || prāyeṇāśubhakṛtso'yaṃ grahaughānāṃ ca sūcakaḥ | nato dvilakṣamānena yojanānāṃ ca gīṣpatiḥ || 32 || ekaikasminnatho rāśau bhuṅge saṃvatsaraṃ caran | yadi vakro bhavennaivānukūlo brahmavādinām || 33 || tataḥ śanaiścaro ghoro lakṣadvayaparo mitaḥ | yojanaiḥ sūryaputro'yaṃ triṃśanmāsaiḥ paribhraman || 34 || ekaikarāśau paryeti sarvān rāśīnmahāgrahaḥ | sarveṣāmaśubho mandaḥ proktaḥ kālavidāṃ varaiḥ || 35 || tata uttarataḥ proktamekādaśasulakṣakaiḥ | yojanaiḥ parisaṃkhyātaṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ ca maṇḍalam || 36 || lokānāṃ śaṃ bhāvayanto munayaḥ sapta te mune | yattadviṣṇupadaṃ sthānaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ prakramanti te || 37 iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādalasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe somādigativarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <8.17> dhruvamaṇḍalasaṃsthānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atharṣimaṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ | lakṣaistrayodaśamitaiḥ paramaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 1 || mahābhāgavataḥ śrīmān vartate lokavanditaḥ | auttānapādirindreṇa vahninā kaśyapena ca || 2 || dharmeṇa saha caivāste samakālayujā dhruvaḥ | bahumānaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ kurvadbhiḥ prekṣakaiḥ sadā || 3 || ājīvyaḥ kalpajīvināmupāste bhagavatpadam | jyotirgaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ grahanakṣatrabhādinām || 4 || kālenānimiṣeṇāyaṃ bhrāmyatāṃ vyaktaraṃhasā | avaṣṭambhasthāṇuriva vihitaśceśvareṇa saḥ || 5 || bhāsate bhāsayanbhāsā svīyayā devapūjitaḥ | meḍhistambhe yathā yuktāḥ paśavaḥ karṣaṇārthakāḥ || 6 || maṇḍalāni carantīme savanatritayena ca | evaṃ grahādayaḥ sarve bhagaṇādyā yathākramam || 7 || antarbahirvibhāgena kālacakre niyojitāḥ | dhruvamevāvalambyāśu vāyunodīritāśca te || 8 || ākalpāntaṃ ca kramanti khe śyenādyāḥ khagā iva | karmasārathayo vāyuvaśagāḥ sarva eva te || 9 || evaṃ jyotirgaṇāḥ sarve prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca | saṃyogānugṛhītāste bhūmau na nipatanti ca || 10 || jyotiścakraṃ kecidetacchiśumārasvarūpakam | sopayogaṃ bhagavato yogadhāraṇakarmaṇi || 11 || yasyārvākśirasaḥ kuṇḍalībhūtavapuṣo mune | pucchāgre kalpito yo'yaṃ dhruva uttānapādajaḥ || 12 || lāṅgūle'sya ca samproktaḥ prajāpatirakalmaṣaḥ | agnirindraśca dharmaśca tiṣṭhante surapūjitāḥ || 13 || dhātā vidhātā pucchānte kaṭyāṃ saptarṣayastataḥ | dakṣiṇāvartabhogena kuṇḍalākāramīyuṣaḥ || 14 || uttarāyaṇabhānīha dakṣapārśve'rpitāni ca | dakṣiṇāyanabhānīha savye pārśve'rpitāni ca || 15 || kuṇḍalābhogaveśasya pārśvayorubhayorapi | samasaṃkhyāścāvayavā bhavanti kajanandana || 16 || ajavīthī pṛṣṭhabhāge ākāśasaridaudare | punarvasuśca puṣyaśca śroṇyau dakṣiṇavāmayoḥ || 17 || ārdrāśleṣe paścimayoḥ pādayordakṣavāmayoḥ | abhijiccottarāṣāḍhā nāsayordakṣavāmayoḥ || 18 || yathāsaṃkhyaṃ ca devarṣe śrutiśca jalabhaṃ tathā | kalpite kalpanāvidbhirnetrayordakṣavāmayoḥ || 19 || dhaniṣṭhā caiva mūlaṃ ca karṇayordakṣavāmayoḥ | maghādīnyaṣṭabhānīha dakṣiṇāyanagāni ca || 20 || yuñjīta vāmapārśvīyavaṃkriṣu kramato mune | tathaiva mṛgaśīrṣādīnyudagbhāni ca yāni hi || 21 || dakṣapārśve vaṃkrikeṣu prātilomyena yojayet | śatatārā tathā jyeṣṭhā skandhayordakṣavāmayoḥ || 22 || agastiścottarahanāvadharāyāṃ hanau yamaḥ | mukheṣvaṅgārakaḥ prokto mandaḥ prokta upasthake || 23 || bṛhaspatiśca kakudi vakṣasyarko grahādhipaḥ | nārāyaṇaśca hṛdaye candro manasi tiṣṭhati || 24 || stanayoraśvinau nābhyāmuśanāḥ parikīrtitaḥ | budhaḥ prāṇāpānayośca gale rāhuśca ketavaḥ || 25 || sarvāṅgeṣu tathā romakūpe tārāgaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | etadbhagavato viṣṇoḥ sarvadevamayaṃ vapuḥ || 26 || sandhyāyāṃ pratyahaṃ dhyāyetprayato vāgyato muniḥ | nirīkṣamāṇaścottiṣṭhenmantreṇānena dhīśvaraḥ || 27 || namo jyotirlokāya kālāyānimiṣāṃ pataye mahāpuruṣāyābhidhīmahīti || 28 || graharkṣatārāmayamādhidaivikaṃ pāpāpahaṃ mantrakṛtāṃ trikālam | namasyataḥ smarato vā trikālaṃ naśyeta tatkālajamāśu pāpam || 29 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe dhruvamaṇḍalasaṃsthānavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <8.18> rāhumaṇḍalādyavasthānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca adhastātsavituḥ proktamayutaṃ rāhumaṇḍalam | nakṣatravaccarati ca saiṃhikeyo'tadarhaṇaḥ || 1 || sūryācandramasoreva mardanaḥ siṃhikāsutaḥ | amaratvaṃ ca kheṭatvaṃ lebhe yo viṣṇvanugrahāt || 2 || yadadastaraṇerbimbaṃ tapato yojanāyutam | tacchādako'suro jñeyo'pyarkasāhasravistaram || 3 || trayodaśasahasraṃ tu somasyācchādako grahaḥ | yaḥ parvasamaye vairānubandhī chādako'bhavat || 4 || sūryācandramasordūrādbhavecchādanakārakaḥ | tanniśamyobhayatrāpi viṣṇunā preritaṃ svakam || 5 || cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāma jvālāmālātibhīṣaṇam | tattejasā duḥsahena samantātparivāritam || 6 || muhūrto dvijamānastu dūrāccakitamānasaḥ | ārānnivartate so'yamuparāga itīva ha || 7 || ucyate lokamadhye tu devarṣe avabudhyatām | tato'dhastātsamākhyātā lokāḥ paramapāvanāḥ || 8 || siddhānāṃ cāraṇānāṃ ca vidyādhrāṇāṃ ca sattama | yojanāyutavikhyātā lokāḥ puṇyaniṣevitāḥ || 9 || tato'pyadhastāddevarṣe yakṣāṇāṃ ca sarakṣasām | piśācapretabhūtānāṃ vihārājiramuttamam || 10 || antarikṣaṃ ca tatproktaṃ yāvadvāyuḥ pravāti hi | yāvanmeghāstatodyanti tatproktaṃ jñānakovidaiḥ || 11 || tato'dhastādyojanānāṃ śataṃ yāvad dvijottama | pṛthivī parisaṃkhyātā suparṇaśyenasārasāḥ || 12 || haṃsādayaḥ protpatanti pārthivāḥ pṛthivībhavāḥ | bhūsanniveśāvasthānaṃ yathāvadupavarṇitam || 13 || adhastādavaneḥ sapta devarṣe vivarāḥ smṛtāḥ | ekaikaśo yojanānāmāyāmocchrāyataḥ punaḥ || 14 || ayutāntaravikhyātāḥ sarvartusukhadāyakāḥ | atalaṃ prathamaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyaṃ vitalaṃ tathā || 15 || tṛtīyaṃ sutalaṃ proktaṃ caturthaṃ vai talātalam | mahātalaṃ pañcamaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ proktaṃ rasātalam || 16 || saptamaṃ vipra pātālaṃ saptaite vivarāḥ smṛtāḥ | eteṣu bilasvargeṣu divo'pyadhikameva ca || 17 || kāmabhogaiśvaryasukhasamṛddhabhuvaneṣu ca | nityodyānavihāreṣu sukhāsvādaḥ pravartate || 18 || daityāśca kādraveyāśca dānavā balaśālinaḥ | nityapramuditā raktāḥ kalatrāpatyabandhubhiḥ || 19 || suhṛdbhiranujīvādyaiḥ saṃyutāśca gṛheśvarāḥ | īśvarādapratihatakāmā māyāvinaśca te || 20 || nivasanti sadā hṛṣṭāḥ sarvartusukhasaṃyutāḥ | mayena māyāvibhunā yeṣu yeṣu ca nirmitāḥ || 21 || puraḥ prakāmaśo bhaktā maṇipravaraśālinaḥ | vicitrabhavanāṭṭālagopurādyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 22 || sabhācatvaracaityādiśobhāḍhyāḥ suradurlabhāḥ | nāgāsurāṇāṃ mithunaiḥ sapārāvatasārikaiḥ || 23 || kīrṇakṛtrimabhūmiśca vivareśagṛhottamaiḥ | alaṅkṛtāścakāsanti udyānāni mahānti ca || 24 || manaḥprasannakārīṇi phalapuṣpaviśālibhiḥ | lalanānāṃ vilāsārhasthānaiḥ śobhitabhāñji ca || 25 || nānāvihaṃgamavrātasaṃyuktajalarāśibhiḥ | svacchārṇapūritahradaiḥ pāṭhīnasamalaṅkṛtaiḥ || 26 || jalajantukṣubdhanīranīrajātairanekaśaḥ | kumudotpalakahlāranīlaraktotpalaistathā || 27 || teṣu kṛtaniketānāṃ vihāraiḥ saṅkulāni ca | indriyotsavakāraiśca tathaiva vividhaiḥ svaraiḥ || 28 || amarāṇāṃ ca paramāṃ śriyaṃ cātiśayanti ca | yatra naiva bhayaṃ kvāpi kālāṅgairdinarātribhiḥ || 29 || yatrāhipravarāṇāṃ ca śiraḥsthairmaṇiraśmibhiḥ | nityaṃ tamaḥ prabādhyeta sadā prasphuṭakāntibhiḥ || 30 || na vā eteṣu vasatāṃ divyauṣadhirasāyanaiḥ | rasānnapānasnānādyairnādhayo na ca vyādhayaḥ || 31 || valīpalitajīrṇatvavaivarṇyasvedagandhatāḥ | anutsāhavayo'vasthā na bādhante kadācana || 32 || kalyāṇānāṃ sadā teṣāṃ na ca mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ | bhagavattejaso'nyatra cakrāccaiva sudarśanāt || 33 || yasminpraviṣṭe daiteyavadhūnāṃ garbharāśayaḥ | prāyo bhayātpatantyeva sravanti brahmaputraka || 34 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe rāhumaṇḍalādyavasthānavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <8.19> atalavitalasutalalokavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca prathame vivare vipra atalākhye manorame | mayaputro balo nāma vartate'kharvagarvakṛt || 1 || ṣaṇṇavatyo yena sṛṣṭā māyāḥ sarvārthasādhikāḥ | māyāvino yāśca sadyo dhārayanti ca kāścana || 2 || jṛmbhamāṇasya yasyaiva balasya balaśālinaḥ | strīgaṇā upapadyante trayolokavimohanāḥ || 3 || puṃścalyaścaiva svairiṇyaḥ kāminyaśceti viśrutāḥ | yā vai bilāyanaṃ preṣṭhaṃ praviṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ rahaḥ || 4 || rasena hāṭakākhyena sādhayitvā prayatnataḥ | svavilāsāvalokānurāgasmitavigūhanaiḥ || 5 || saṃlāpavibhramādyaiśca ramayantyapi tāḥ striyaḥ | yasminnupayukte jano manute bahudhā svayam || 6 || īśvaro'hamahaṃ siddho nāgāyutabalo mahān | ātmānaṃ manyamānaḥ sanmadāndha iva kathyate || 7 || evaṃ proktā sthitiścātra atalasya ca nārada | dvitīyavivarasyātra vitalasya nibodhata || 8 || bhūtalādhastale caiva vitale bhagavānbhavaḥ | hāṭakeśvaranāmāyaṃ svapārṣadagaṇairvṛtaḥ || 9 || prajāpatikṛtasyāpi sargasya bṛṃhaṇāya ca | bhavānyā mithunībhūya āste devādhipūjitaḥ || 10 || bhavayorvīryasambhūtā hāṭakī sariduttamā | samiddho marutā vahnirojasā pibatīva hi || 11 || tanniṣṭhyūtaṃ hāṭakākhyaṃ suvarṇaṃ daityavallabham | daityāṅganā bhūṣaṇārhaṃ sadā taṃ dhārayanti hi || 12 || tadbilādhastalātproktaṃ sutalākhyaṃ bileśvaram | puṇyaśloko balirnāmā āste vairocanirmune || 13 || mahendrasya ca devasya cikīrṣuḥ priyamuttamam | trivikramo'pi bhagavān sutale balimānayat || 14 || trailokyalakṣmīmākṣipya sthāpitaḥ kila daityarāṭ | indrādiṣvapyalabdhā yā sā śrīstamanuvartate || 15 || tameva devadeveśamārādhayati bhaktitaḥ | vyapetasādhvaso'dyāpi vartate sutalādhipaḥ || 16 || bhūmidānaphalaṃ hyetatpātrabhūte'khileśvare | varṇayanti mahātmāno naitadyuktaṃ ca nārada || 17 || vāsudeve bhagavati puruṣārthaprade harau | etaddānaphalaṃ vipra sarvathā nahi yujyate || 18 || yasyaiva devadevasya nāmāpi vivaśo gṛṇan | svakīyakarmabandhīyaguṇānvidhunute'ñjasā || 19 || yatkleśabandhahānāya sāṃkhyayogādisādhanam | kurvate yatayo nityaṃ bhagavatyakhileśvare || 20 || na cāyaṃ bhagavānasmānanujagrāha nārada | māyāmayaṃ ca bhogānāmaiśvaryaṃ vyatanotparam || 21 || sarvakleśādhihetuṃ tadātmānusmṛtimoṣaṇam | yaṃ sākṣādbhagavān viṣṇuḥ sarvopāyavidīśvaraḥ || 22 || yāñjāchalenāpahṛtaṃ sarvasvaṃ dehaśeṣakam | aprāptānyopāya īśaḥ pāśairvāruṇasaṃbhavaiḥ || 23 || bandhayitvāvamucyāpi giridaryāmivābravīt | asāvindro mahāmūḍho yasya mantrī bṛhaspatiḥ || 24 || prasannamimamatyarthamayācallokasampadam | trailokyamidamaiśvaryaṃ kiyadevātitucchakam || 25 || āśiṣāṃ prabhavaṃ muktvā yo mūḍho lokasampadi | asmatpitāmahaḥ śrīmān prahlādo bhagavatpriyaḥ || 26 || dāsyaṃ vavre vibhostasya sarvalokopakārakaḥ | pitryamaiśvaryamatulaṃ dīyamānaṃ ca viṣṇunā || 27 || pitaryuparate vīre naivaicchadbhagavatpriyaḥ | tasyātulānubhāvasya sarvalokopadhīmataḥ || 28 || asmadvidho nālpapakvetaradoṣo'vagacchati | evaṃ daityapatiḥ so'yaṃ baliḥ paramapūjitaḥ || 29 || sutale vartate yasya dvārapālo hariḥ svayam | ekadā digvijaye rājā rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ || 30 || praviśansutale yena bhaktānugrahakāriṇā | pādāṅguṣṭhena prakṣipto yojanāyutamatra hi || 31 || evaṃbhūtānubhāvo'yaṃ baliḥ sarvasukhaikabhuk | āste sutalarājastho devadevaprasādataḥ || 32 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe atalavitalasutalalokavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || <8.20> talātalādilokavarṇane'nantavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tato'dhastādvivarakaṃ talātalamudīritam | dānavendro mayo nāma tripurādhipatirmahān || 1 || trilokyāḥ śaṅkareṇāyaṃ pālito dagdhapūstrayaḥ | devadevaprasādāttu labdharājyasukhāspadaḥ || 2 || ācāryo māyināṃ so'yaṃ nānāmāyāviśāradaḥ | pūjyate rākṣasairghoraiḥ sarvakāryasamṛddhaye || 3 || tato'dhastāstuvikhyātaṃ mahātalamiti sphuṭam | sarpāṇāṃ kādraveyāṇāṃ gaṇaḥ krodhavaśo mahān || 4 || anekaśirasāṃ vipra pradhānānkīrtayāmi te | kuhakastakṣakaścaiva suṣeṇaḥ kāliyastathā || 5 || mahābhogā mahāsattvāḥ krūrāḥ krūrasvajātayaḥ | patatrirājādhipaterudvignāḥ sarva eva te || 6 || svakalatrāpatyasuhṛtkuṭumbasya ca saṅgatāḥ | pramattā viharantyeva nānākrīḍāviśāradāḥ || 7 || tato'dhastācca vivare rasātalasamāhvaye | daiteyā nivasantyeva paṇayo dānavāśca ye || 8 || nivātakavacā nāma hiraṇyapuravāsinaḥ | kāleyā iti ca proktāḥ pratyanīkā havirbhujām || 9 || mahaujasaścotpattyaiva mahāsāhasinastathā | sakaleśasya ca harestejasā hatavikramāḥ || 10 || bileśayā iva sadā vivare nivasanti hi | ye vai vāgbhiḥ saramayā śakradūtyā nirantaram || 11 || mantravarṇābhirasurāstāḍitā bibhyati sma ha | tato'pyadhastātpātāle nāgalokādhipālakāḥ || 12 || vāsukipramukhāḥ śaṅkhaḥ kulikaḥ śveta eva ca | dhanañjayo mahāśaṅkho dhṛtarāṣṭrastathaiva ca || 13 || śaṅkhacūḍaḥ kambalāśvataro devopadattakaḥ | mahāmarṣā mahābhogā nivasanti viṣolbaṇāḥ || 14 || pañcamastakavantaśca phaṇāsaptakabhūṣitāḥ | keciddaśaphaṇāḥ kecicchataśīrṣāstathāpare || 15 || sahasraśirasaḥ ke'pi rociṣṇumaṇidhārakāḥ | pātālarandhratimiranikaraṃ svamarīcibhiḥ || 16 || vidhamanti ca devarṣe sadā sañjātamanyavaḥ | asya mūlapradeśe hi triṃśatsāhasrake'ntare || 17 || yojanaiḥ parisaṃkhyāte tāmasī bhagavatkalā | anantākhyā samāste hi sarvadevaprapūjitā || 18 || ahamityabhimānasya lakṣaṇaṃ yaṃ pracakṣate | saṅkarṣaṇaṃ sātvatīyāḥ karṣaṇaṃ draṣṭṭadṛśyayoḥ || 19 || idaṃ bhūmaṇḍalaṃ yasya sahasraśirasaḥ prabhoḥ | anantamūrteḥ śeṣasya dhriyamāṇaṃ ca śīrṣake || 20 || pṛdhvīgolamaśeṣaṃ hi siddhārtha iva lakṣyate | yasya kālena devasya sañjihīrṣoḥ samaṃ vibhoḥ || 21 || carācaraṃ bhruvorantarvivarādudapadyata | sāṅkarṣaṇo nāma rudro vyūhaikādaśaśobhitaḥ || 22 || trilocanaśca triśikhaṃ śūlamuttambhayansvayam | udatiṣṭhanmahāsattvo mahābhūtakṣayaṅkaraḥ || 23 || yasyāṅghrikamaladvandvaśoṇācchanakhamaṇḍale | virājanmaṇibimbeṣu mahāhipatayo'niśam || 24 || ekāntabhaktiyogena saha sāttvatapuṅgavaiḥ | praṇamantaḥ svamūrdhnā te svamukhāni samīkṣate || 25 || sphuratkuṇḍalamāṇikyaprabhāmaṇḍalabhāñjyapi | sukapolāni cārūṇi gaṇḍasthaladyumanti ca || 26 || nāgarājakumāryo'pi cārvaṅgavilasattviṣaḥ | viśadairvipulaistadvaddhavalaiḥ subhagaistathā || 27 || rucirairbhujadaṇḍaiśca śobhamānā itastataḥ | candanāgurukāśmīrapaṅkalepena bhūṣitāḥ || 28 || tadabhimarṣasañjātakāmāveśasamāyutāḥ | lalitasmitasaṃyuktāḥ savrīḍaṃ lokayanti ca || 29 || anurāgamadonmattavighūrṇāruṇalocanam | karuṇāvalokanetraṃ ca āśāsānāstathāśiṣaḥ || 30 || so'nanto bhagavāndevo'nantasattvo mahāśayaḥ | anantaguṇavārdhiśca ādidevo mahādyutiḥ || 31 || saṃhṛtāmarṣaroṣādivego lokaśubhāya ca | āste mahāsattvanidhiḥ sarvadevaprapūjitaḥ || 32 || dhyāyamānaḥ suraiḥ siddhairasuraiścoragaistathā | vidyādharaiśca gandharvairmunisaṅghaiśca nityaśaḥ || 33 || anāratamadonmattalokavihvalalocanaḥ | vākyāmṛtena vibudhānsvapārṣadagaṇānapi || 34 || āpyāyamānaḥ sa vibhurvaijayantīṃ srajaṃ dadhat | amlānābhinavaiḥ svacchaistulasīdalasañcayaiḥ || 35 || mādyanmadhukaravrātaghoṣaśrīsaṃyutāṃ sadā | nīlavāsā devadeva ekakuṇḍalabhūṣitaḥ || 36 || halasya kakudi nyastasupīvarabhujo'vyayaḥ | mahendraḥ kāñcanīṃ yadvadvaratrāṃ ca mataṅgamaḥ | udāralīlo deveśo varṇitaḥ sāttvatarṣabhaiḥ || 37 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe talātalādilokavarṇane'nantavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || <8.21> narakasvarūpavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca tasyānubhāvaṃ bhagavān brahmaputraḥ sanātanaḥ | sabhāyāṃ brahmadevasya gāyamāna upāsate || 1 || utpattisthitilayahetavo'sya kalpāḥ sattvādyāḥ prakṛtiguṇā yadīkṣayā''san | yadrūpaṃ dhruvamakṛtaṃ yadekamātmannānādhātkathamuha veda tasya vartma || 2 || mūrtiṃ naḥ purukṛpayā babhāra sattvaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ sadasadidaṃ vibhāti yatra | yallīlāṃ mṛgapatirādade'navadyāmādātuṃ svajanamanāṃsyudāravīryaḥ || 3 || yannāma śrutamanukīrtayedakasmādārto vā yadi patitaḥ pralambhanādvā | hantyaṃhaḥ sapadi nṛṇāmaśeṣamanyaṃ kaṃ śeṣādbhagavata āśrayetyumukṣuḥ || 4 || mūrdhanyarpitamaṇuvatsahasramūrdhno bhūgolaṃ sagirisaritsamudrasattvam | ānantyādanamitavikramasya bhūmnaḥ ko vīryāṇyadhigaṇayetsahasrajihvaḥ || 5 || evaṃprabhāvo bhagavānananto durantavīryoruguṇānubhāvaḥ | mūle rasāyāḥ sthita ātmatantro yo līlayā kṣmāṃ sthitaye bibharti || 6 || etā hyeveha tu nṛbhirgatayo munisattama | gantavyā bahuśo yadvadyathākarmavinirmitāḥ || 7 || yathopadeśaṃ ca kāmānsadā kāmayamānakaiḥ | etāvatīrhi rājendra manuṣyamṛgapakṣiṣu || 8 || vipākagatayaḥ proktā dharmasya vaśagāstathā | uccāvacā visadṛśā yathāpraśnaṃ nibodhata || 9 || nārada uvāca vaicitryametallokasya kathaṃ bhagavatā kṛtam | samānatve karmaṇāṃ ca tanno brūhi yathātatham || 10 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kartuḥ śraddhāvaśādeva gatayo'pi pṛthagvidhāḥ | triguṇatvātsadā tāsāṃ phalaṃ visadṛśaṃ tviha || 11 || sāttvikyā śraddhayā kartuḥ sukhitvaṃ jāyate sadā | duḥkhitvaṃ ca tathā kartū rājasyā śraddhayā bhavet || 12 || duḥkhitvaṃ caiva mūḍhatvaṃ tāmasyā śraddhayoditam | tāratamyāttu śraddhānāṃ phalavaicitryamīritam || 13 || anādyavidyāvihitakarmaṇāṃ pariṇāmajāḥ | sahasraśaḥ pravṛttāstu gatayo dvijapuṅgava || 14 || tadbhedānvarṇayiṣyāmi prācuryeṇa dvijottama | trijagatyā antarāle dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśīha vai || 15 || bhūmeradhastādupari tvatalasya ca nārada | agniṣvāttāḥ pitṛgaṇā vartante pitaraśca ha || 16 || vasanti yasyāṃ svīyānāṃ gotrāṇāṃ paramāśiṣaḥ | satyāḥ samādhinā śīghraṃ tvāśāsānāḥ pareṇa vai || 17 || pitṛrājo'pi bhagavān sampareteṣu jantuṣu | viṣayaṃ prāpiteṣveṣu svakīyaiḥ puruṣairiha || 18 || sagaṇo bhagavatproktājñāparo damadhārakaḥ | yathākarma yathādoṣaṃ vidadhāti vicāradṛk || 19 || svāngaṇāndharmatattvajñānsarvānājñāpravartakān | sadā prerayati prājño yathādeśaniyojitān || 20 || narakānekaviṃśatyā saṃkhyayā varṇayanti hi | aṣṭāviṃśamitānkecittānanukramato bruve || 21 || tāmisra andhatāmisro rauravo'pi tṛtīyakaḥ | mahārauravanāmā ca kumbhīpāko'paro mataḥ || 22 || kālasūtraṃ tathā cāsipatrāraṇyamudāhṛtam | sūkarasya mukhaṃ cāndhakūpo'tha kṛmibhojanaḥ || 23 || saṃdaṃśastaptamūrtiśca vajrakaṇṭaka eva ca | śālmalī cātha devarṣe nāmnā vairataṇī tathā || 24 || pūyodaḥ prāṇarodhaśca tathā viśasanaṃ matam | lālābhakṣaḥ sārameyādanamuktamataḥ param|| 25 || avīcirapyayaḥ pānaṃ kṣārakardama eva ca | rakṣogaṇākhyasambhojaḥ śūlaproto'pyataḥ param || 26 || dandaśūko'vaṭārodhaḥ paryāvartanakaḥ param | sūcīmukhamiti proktā aṣṭāviṃśatinārakāḥ || 27 || ityete nārakā nāma yātanābhūmayaḥ parāḥ | karmabhiścāpi bhūtānāṃ gamyāḥ padmajasambhava || 28 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavatemahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe narakasvarūpavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || <8.22> narakapradapātakavarṇanam nārada uvāca karmabhedāḥ katividhāḥ sanātanamune mama | śrotavyāḥ sarvathaivaite yātanāprāptibhūmayaḥ || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yo vai parasya vittāni dārāpatyāni caiva hi | harate sa hi duṣṭātmā yamānucaragocaraḥ || 2 || kālapāśena sambaddho yāmyairatibhayānakaiḥ | tāmisranāmanarake pātyate yātanāspade || 3 || tāḍanaṃ daṇḍanaṃ caiva santarjanamataḥ param | yāmyāḥ kurvanti pāśāḍhyāḥ kaśmalaṃ yāti caiva hi || 4 || mūrcchāmāyāti vivaśo nārakī padmabhūsuta | yaḥ patiṃ vañcayitvā tu dārādīnupabhujyati || 5 || andhatāmisranarake pātyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ | pātyamāno yatra janturvedanāparavānbhavet || 6 || naṣṭadṛṣṭirnaṣṭamatirbhavatyevāvilambataḥ | vanaspatirbhajyamānamūlo yadvadbhavediha || 7 || tasmādapyandhatāmisranāmnā proktaḥ purātanaiḥ | etanmamāhamiti yo bhūtadroheṇa kevalam || 8 || puṣṇāti pratyahaṃ svīyaṃ kuṭumbaṃ kāryalampaṭaḥ | etadvihāya cātraiva svāśubhena patediha || 9 || raurave nāma narake sarvasattvabhayāvahe | iha loke'munā ye tu hiṃsitā jantavaḥ purā || 10 || ta eva ruravo bhūtvā paratra pīḍayanti tam | tasmādrauravamityāhuḥ purāṇajñā manīṣiṇaḥ || 11 || ruruḥ sarpādatikrūro janturuktaḥ purātanaiḥ | evaṃ mahārauravākhyo narako yatra pūruṣaḥ || 12 || yātanāṃ prāpyamāṇo hi yaḥ paraṃ dehasambhavaḥ | kravyādā nāma ruravastaṃ kravye ghātayanti ca || 13 || ya ugraḥ puruṣaḥ krūraḥ paśupakṣigaṇānapi | uparandhayate mūḍho yāmyāstaṃ randhayanti ca || 14 || kumbhīpāke taptataile uparyapi ca nārada | yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvadvarṣasahasrakam || 15 || pitṛviprabrāhmaṇadhrukkālasūtre sa nārake | agnyarkābhyāṃ tapyamāne nārakī viniveśitaḥ || 16 || kṣutpipāsādahyamāno'ntaḥśarīrastathā bahiḥ | āste śete ceṣṭate cāvatiṣṭhati ca dhāvati || 17 || nijavedapathādyo vai pākhaṇḍaṃ copayāti ca | anāpadyapi devarṣe taṃ pāpaṃ puruṣaṃ bhaṭāḥ || 18 || asipatravanaṃ nāma narakaṃ veśayanti ca | kaśayā praharantyeva nārakī tadgatastadā || 19 || itastato dhāvamāna uttālamativegataḥ | asipatraiśchidyamāna ubhayatra ca dhārabhiḥ || 20 || saṃchidyamānasarvāṅgo hāhato'smīti mūrcchitaḥ | vedanāṃ paramāṃ prāptaḥ patatyeva pade pade || 21 || svadharmānugataṃ bhuṅkte pākhaṇḍaphalamalpadhīḥ | yo rājā rājapuruṣo daṇḍayedvai tvadharmataḥ || 22 || dvije śarīradaṇḍaṃ ca pāpīyānnārakī ca saḥ | narake sūkaramukhe pātyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ || 23 || viniṣyiṣṭāvayavako balavadbhistathekṣuvat | ārtasvareṇa svanayanmūrcchitaḥ kaśmalaṅgataḥ || 24 || sa pīḍyamāno bahudhā vedanāṃ yātyatīva hi | viviktaparapīḍo yo'pyaviviktaparavyathām || 25 || īśvarāṅkitavṛttīnāṃ vyathāmācarate svayam | sa cāndhakūpe patati tadabhidrohayantrite || 26 || tatrāsau jantubhiḥ krūraiḥ paśubhirmṛgapakṣibhiḥ | sarīsṛpaiśca maśakairyūkāmatkuṇajātibhiḥ || 27 || makṣikābhiśca tamasi dandaśūkaiśca pīḍyate | parikrāmati caivātra kuśarīre ca jantuvat || 28 || yastu saṃvihitaiḥ pañcayajñaiḥ kākaiśca saṃstutaḥ | aśnāti cāsaṃvibhajya yatkiṃñcidupapadyate || 29 || sa pāpapuruṣaḥ krūrairyāmyaiśca kṛmibhojane | narakādhamake duṣṭakarmaṇā paripātyate || 30 || lakṣayojanavistīrṇe kṛmikuṇḍe bhayaṅkare | kṛmirūpaṃ samāsādya bhakṣyamāṇaśca taiḥ svayam || 31 || aprattāprahutādo yaḥ pātamāpnoti tatra vai | yastu steyena ca balāddhiraṇyaṃ ratnameva ca || 32 || brāhmaṇasyāpaharati anyasyāpi ca kasyacit | anāpadi ca devarṣe tamamutra yamānugāḥ || 33 || ayasmayairagnipiṇḍaiḥ sadṛśairnitkuṣanti ca | yo'gamyāṃ yoṣitaṃ gacchedagamyaṃ puruṣaṃ ca yā || 34 || tāvamutrāpi kaśayā tāḍayanto yamānugāḥ | tigmayā lohamayyā ca sūrmyāpyāliṅgayanti tam || 35 || tāṃ cāpi yoṣitaṃ sūrmyāliṅgayanti yamānugāḥ | yastu sarvābhigamanaḥ puruṣaḥ pāpasañcayī || 36 || niraye'mutra taṃ yāmyāḥ śālmalīṃ ropayanti tam | vajrakaṇṭakasaṃyuktāṃ śālmalīṃ tāmayasmayīm || 37 || rājanyā rājapuruṣā ye vā pākhaṇḍavartinaḥ | dharmasetuṃ vibhindanti te paretya gatā narāḥ || 38 || vaitaraṇyāṃ patantyeva bhinnamaryādapātakāḥ | nadyāṃ nirayadurgasya parikhāyāṃ ca nārada || 39 || yādogaṇaiḥ samantāttu bhakṣyamāṇā itastataḥ | nātmanā viyujantyeva nāsubhiścāpi nārada || 40 || svīyena karmapākenopatapanti ca sarvataḥ | viṇmūtrapūyaraktaiśca keśāsthinakhamāṃsakaiḥ || 41 || medovasāsaṃyutāyāṃ nadyāmupapatanti te | vṛṣalīpatayo ye ca naṣṭaśaucā gatatrapāḥ || 42 || ācāraniyamaistyaktāḥ paśucaryāparāyaṇāḥ | te'trānukaṣṭagatayo viṇmūtraśleṣmaraktakaiḥ || 43 || śleṣmamalasamāpūrṇe nipatanti durāgrahāḥ | tadeva khādayantyetānyamānucaravargakāḥ || 44 || ye śvānagardabhādīnāṃ patayo vai dvijātayaḥ | mṛgayārasikā nityamatīrthe mṛgaghātakāḥ || 45 || paretāṃstānyamabhaṭā lakṣībhūtānnarādhamān | iṣubhiśca vibhindanti tāṃstāndurnayamāgatān || 46 || ye dambhā dambhayajñeṣu paśūnghnanti narādhamāḥ | tānamuṣminyamabhaṭā narake vaiśase tadā || 47 || nipātya pīḍayantyeva kaśāghātairdurāsadaiḥ | yo bhāryāṃ ca savarṇāṃ vai dvijo madanamohitaḥ || 48 || retaḥ pāyayati mūḍho'mutra taṃ yamakiṅkarāḥ | retaḥkuṇḍe pātayanti retaḥ sampāyayanti ca || 49 || ye dasyavo'gnidāścaiva garadā sārthaghātakāḥ | grāmānsārthānvilumpanti rājāno rājapūruṣāḥ || 50 || tānparetānyamabhaṭā nayanti śvānakādanam | viṃśatyathikasaṃkhyātāḥ sārameyā mahādbhutāḥ || 51 || saptaśatyā samākhyātā rabhasaṃ khādayanti te | sārameyādanaṃ nāma narakaṃ dāruṇaṃ mune | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi avīciprabhukhānmune || 52 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe narakapradapātakavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || <8.23> avaśiṣṭanarakavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ye narāḥ sarvadā sākṣye anṛtaṃ bhāṣayanti ca | dāne vinimaye'rthasya devarṣe pāpabuddhayaḥ || 1 || te pretyāmutra narake avīcyākhye'tidāruṇe | yojanānāṃ śatocchrāyādgirimūrdhnaḥ patanti hi || 2 || anākāśe'dhaḥśirasastadavīcītināmake | yatra sthalaṃ dṛśyate ca jalavadvīcisaṃyutam || 3 || avīcimattatastatra tilaśaśchinnavigrahaḥ | mriyate naiva devarṣe punarevā'varopyate || 4 || yo vā dvijo vā rājanyo vaiśyo vā brahmasambhava | somapīthastatkalatraṃ surāṃ vā pibatīva hi || 5 || pramādatastu teṣāṃ vai niraye paripātanam | kurvanti yamadūtāste pānaṃ kārṣṇāyaso mune || 6 || vahninā dravamāṇasya nitarāṃ brahmasambhava | sambhāvanena svasyaiva yo'dhamo'pi narādhamaḥ || 7 || vidyājanmatapovarṇāśramācāravato narān | varīyaso'pi na bahu manyate puruṣādhamaḥ || 8 || sa nīyate yamabhaṭaiḥ kṣārakardamanāmake | niraye'rvākśirā ghorā durantayātanāśnute || 9 || ye vai narā yajantyanyaṃ naramedhena mohitāḥ | striyo'pi vā narapaśuṃ khādantyatra mahāmune || 10 || paśavo nihitāste tu yamasadyani saṅgatāḥ | saunikā iva te sarve vidārya śitadhārayā || 11 || asṛkpibanti nṛtyanti gāyanti bahudhā mune | yatheha māṃsabhoktāraḥ puruṣādā durāsadāḥ || 12 || anāgaso'pi ye'raṇye grāme vā brahmaputraka | vaiśrambhakairupasṛtānviśrambhayyajijīviṣūn || 13 || śūlasūtrādiṣu protānkrīḍanotkārakāniva | pātayanti ca te pretya śūlapāte patanti ha || 14 || śūlādiṣu protadehāḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ cātipīḍitāḥ | tigmatuṇḍaiḥ kaṅkabakairitaścetaśca tāḍitāḥ || 15 || pīḍitā ātmaśamalaṃ bahudhā saṃsmaranti hi | ye bhūtānudvejayanti narā ulbaṇavṛttayaḥ || 16 || yathā sarpādikāste'pi narake nipatanti hi | dandaśūkābhidhāne ca yatrottiṣṭhanti sarvataḥ || 17 || pañcānanaḥ saptamukhā grasanti narakāgatān | yathā bileśayā vipra krūrabuddhisamanvitāḥ || 18 || ye'vaṭeṣu kusūlādiguhādiṣu nirundhate | tānamutrodyatakarāḥ kīnāśaparisevakāḥ || 19 teṣvevopaviśitvā ca sagareṇa ca vahninā | dhūmena ca nirundhanti pāpakarmaratānnarān || 20 || yo'tithīnsamayaprāptāndidhakṣuriva cakṣuṣā | pāpenehālokayecca svayaṃ gṛhapatirdvijaḥ || 21 || tasyāpi pāpadṛṣṭerhi niraye yamakiṅkarāḥ | akṣiṇī vajratuṇḍā ye kaṅkāḥ kākavaṭādayaḥ || 22 || gṛdhrāḥ krūratarāścāpi prasahyotpāṭayanti hi | ya āḍhyābhimatiryāti ahaṅkṛtyātigarvitaḥ || 23 || tiryakprekṣaṇa evātrābhiviśaṅkī narādhamaḥ | cintayārthasya sarvatrāyativyayasvarūpayā || 24 || śuṣyaddhṛdayavaktraśca nirvṛtiṃ naiva gacchati | grahavadrakṣate cārthaṃ sa preto yamakiṅkaraiḥ || 25 || sūcīmukhe ca narake pātyate nijakarmaṇā | vittagrahaṃ ca puruṣaṃ vāyakā iva yāmyakāḥ || 26 || kiṅkarāḥ sarvato'ṅgeṣu sūtraiḥ parivayanti hi | ete bahuvidhā vipra narakāḥ pāpakarmaṇām || 27 || narāṇāṃ śataśaḥ santi yātanāsthānabhūmayaḥ | sahasraśo'pi devarṣe uktānuktāṃstathāpi hi || 28 || viśanti narakānetānyātanābahulānmune | tathā dharmaparāścāpi lokānyānti sukhodgatān || 29 || svadharmo bahudhā gīto yathā tava mahāmune | devīpūjanarūpo hi devyārādhanalakṣaṇaḥ || 30 || yenānuṣṭhitamātreṇa naro na narakaṃ vrajet | sā devī bhavapāthodheruddhartrī pūjitā nṛṇām || 31 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe'vaśiṣṭanarakavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || <8.24> devīpūjanavidhinirūpaṇam nārada uvāca dharmaśca kīdṛśastāta devyārādhanalakṣaṇaḥ | kathamārādhitā devī sā dadāti paraṃ padam || 1 || ārādhanavidhiḥ ko vā kathamārādhitā kadā | kena sā durganarakāddurgā trāṇapradā bhavet || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca devarṣe śṛṇu cittaikāgryeṇa me viduṣāṃ vara | yathā prasīdate devī dharmārādhanataḥ svayam || 3 || svadharmo yādṛśaḥ proktastaṃ ca me śṛṇu nārada | anādāviha saṃsāre devī saśṛjitā svayam || 4 || paripālayate ghorasaṅkaṭādiṣu sā mune | sā devī pūjyate lokairyathāvattadvidhiṃ śṛṇu || 5 || pratipattithimāsādya devīmājyena pūjayet | ghṛtaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya rogahīno bhavetsadā || 6 || dvitīyāyāṃ śarkarayā pūjayejjagadambikām | śarkarāṃ pradadedvipre dīrghāyurjāyate naraḥ || 7 || tṛtīyādivase devyai dugdhaṃ pūjanakarmaṇi | kṣīraṃ dattvā dvijāgryāya sarvaduḥkhātigo bhavet || 8 || caturthyāṃ pūjane'pūpā deyā devyai dvijāya ca | apūpā eva dātavyā na vighnairabhibhūyate || 9 || pañcamyāṃ kadalījātaṃ phalaṃ devyai nivedayet | tadeva brāhmaṇe deyaṃ medhāvānpuruṣo bhavet || 10 || ṣaṣṭhītithau madhu proktaṃ devīpūjanakarmaṇi | brāhmaṇāya ca dātavyaṃ madhu kāntiryato bhavet || 11 || saptamyāṃ guḍanaivedyaṃ devyai dattvā dvijāya ca | guḍaṃ dattvā śokahīno jāyate dvijasattama || 12 || nārikelamathāṣṭamyāṃ devyai naivedyamarpayet | brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ tāpahīno bhavennaraḥ || 13 || navamyāṃ lājamambāyai cārpayitvā dvijāya ca | dattvā sukhādhiko bhūyādiha loke paratra ca || 14 || daśamyāmarpayitvā tu devyai kṛṣṇatilānmune | brāhmaṇāya pradattvā tu yamalokādbhayaṃ na hi || 15 || ekādaśyāṃ dadhi tathā devyai cārpayate tu yaḥ | dadāti brāhmaṇāyaitaddevīpriyatamo bhavet || 16 || dvādaśyāṃ pṛthukāndevyai dattvācāryāya yo dadet | tāneva ca muniśreṣṭha sa devīpriyatāṃ vrajet || 17 || trayodaśyāṃ ca durgāyai caṇakānpradadāti ca | tāneva dattvā viprāya prajāsantatimānbhavet || 18 || caturdaśyāṃ ca devarṣe devyai saktūnprayacchati | tāneva dadyādviprāya śivasya dayito bhavet || 19 || pāyasaṃ pūrṇimātithyāmaparṇāyai prayacchati | dadāti ca dvijāgryāya pitṛnuddharate'khilān || 20 || tattithau havanaṃ proktaṃ devīprītyai mahāmune | tattattithyuktavastūnāmaśeṣāriṣṭanāśanam || 21 || ravivāre pāyasaṃ ca naivedyaṃ parikīrtitam | somavāre payaḥ proktaṃ bhaume ca kadalīphalam || 22 || budhavāre ca samproktaṃ navanītaṃ navaṃ dvija | guruvāre śarkarāṃ ca sitāṃ bhārgavavāsare || 23 || śanivāre ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ naivedyaṃ parikīrtitam | saptaviṃśatinakṣatranaivedyaṃ śrūyatāṃ mune || 24 || ghṛtaṃ tilaṃ śarkarāṃ ca dadhi dugdhaṃ kilāṭakam | dathikūrcī modakaṃ ca pheṇikāṃ ghṛtamaṇḍakam || 25 || kaṃsāraṃ vaṭapatraṃ ca ghṛtapūramataḥ param | vaṭakaṃ kokarasakaṃ pūraṇaṃ madhu sūraṇam || 26 || guḍaṃ pṛthukadrākṣe ca kharjūraṃ caiva cārakam | apūpaṃ navanītaṃ ca mudgaṃ modaka eva ca || 27 || mātuliṅgamiti proktaṃ bhanaivedyaṃ ca nārada | viṣkambhādiṣu yogeṣu pravakṣyāmi nivedanam || 28 || padārthānāṃ kṛteṣveṣu prīṇāti jagadambikā | guḍaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi takraṃ tvapūpakam || 29 || navanītaṃ karkaṭīṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍaṃ cāpi modakam | panasaṃ kadalaṃ jambuphalamāmraphalaṃ tilam || 30 || nāraṅgaṃ dāḍimaṃ caiva badarīphalameva ca | dhātrīphalaṃ pāyasañca pṛthukaṃ caṇakaṃ tathā || 31 || nārikelaṃ jambhaphalaṃ kaseruṃ sūraṇaṃ tathā | etāni kramaśo vipra naivedyāni śubhāni ca || 32 || viṣkambhādiṣu yogeṣu nirṇītāni manīṣibhiḥ | atha naivedyamākhyāsye karaṇānāṃ pṛthaṅmune || 33 || kaṃsāraṃ maṇḍakaṃ pheṇī modakaṃ vaṭapatrakam | laḍḍukaṃ ghṛtapūraṃ ca tilaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu || 34 || karaṇānāmidaṃ proktaṃ devīnaivedyamādarāt | athānyatsampravakṣyāmi devīprītikaraṃ param || 35 || vidhānaṃ nāradamune śṛṇu tatsarvamādṛtaḥ | caitraśuddhatṛtīyāyāṃ naro madhukavṛkṣakam || 36 || pūjayetpañca khādyaṃ ca naivedyamupakalpayet | evaṃ dvādaśamāseṣu tṛtīyātithiṣu kramāt || 37 || śuklapakṣe vidhānena naivedyamabhidadhmahe | vaiśākhamāse naivedyaṃ guḍayuktaṃ ca nārada || 38 || jyeṣṭhamāse madhu proktaṃ devīprītyarthameva tu | āṣāḍhe navanītaṃ ca madhukasya nivedanam || 39 || śrāvaṇe dadhi naivedyaṃ bhādramāse ca śarkarā | āśvine pāyasaṃ proktaṃ kārtike paya uttamam || 40 || mārge pheṇyuttamā proktā pauṣe ca dadhikūrcikā | māghe māsi ca naivedyaṃ mṛtaṃ gavyaṃ samāharet || 41 || nārikelaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phālgune parikīrtitam | evaṃ dvādaśanaivedyairmāse ca kramato'rcayet || 42 || maṅgalā vaiṣṇavī māyā kālarātrirduratyayā | mahāmāyā mataṅgī ca kālī kamalavāsinī || 43 || śivā sahasracaraṇā sarvamaṅgalarūpiṇī | ebhirnāmapadairdevīṃ madhūke paripūjayet || 44 || tataḥ stuvīta deveśīṃ madhūkasthāṃ maheśvarīm | sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ vratapūrṇatvasiddhaye || 45 || namaḥ puṣkaranetrāyai jagaddhātryai namo'stu te | māheśvaryaṃ mahādevyai mahāmaṅgalamūrtaye || 46 || paramā pāpahantrī ca paramārgapradāyinī | parameśvarī prajotpattiḥ parabrahmasvarūpiṇī || 47 || madadātrī madonmattā mānagamyā mahonnatā | manasvinī munidhyeyā mārtaṇḍasahacāriṇī || 48 || jaya lokeśvari prājñe pralayāmbudasannibhe | mahāmohavināśārthaṃ pūjitāsi surāsuraiḥ || 49 || yamalokābhāvakartrī yamapūjyā yamāgrajā | yamanigraharūpā ca yajanīye namo namaḥ || 50 || samasvabhāvā sarveśī sarvasaṅgavivarjitā | saṅganāśakarī kāmyarūpā kāruṇyavigrahā || 51 || kaṅkālakrūrā kāmākṣī mīnākṣī marmabhedinī | mādhuryarūpaśīlā ca madhurasvarapūjitā || 52 || mahāmantravatī mantragamyā mantrapriyaṅkarī | manuṣyamānasagamā manmathāripriyaṅkarī || 53 || aśvatthavaṭanimbāmrakapitthabadarīgate | panasārkakarīrādikṣīravṛkṣasvarūpiṇī || 54 || dugdhavallīnivāsārhe dayanīye dayādhike | dākṣiṇyakaruṇārūpe jaya sarvajñavallabhe || 55 || evaṃ stavena deveśīṃ pūjanānte stuvīta tām | vratasya sakalaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate sarvadā naraḥ || 56 || nityaṃ yaḥ paṭhate stotraṃ devīprītikaraṃ naraḥ | ādhivyādhibhayaṃ nāsti ripubhītirna tasya hi || 57 || arthārthī cārthamāpnoti dharmārthī dharmamāpnuyāt | kāmānavāpnuyātkāmī mokṣārthī mokṣamājapnuyāt || 58 || brāhmaṇo vedasampano vijayī kṣatriyo bhavet | vaiśyaśca dhanadhānyāḍhyo bhavecchūdraḥ sukhādhikaḥ || 59 || stotrametacchrāddhakāle yaḥ paṭhetprayato naraḥ | pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirjāyate kalpavartinī || 60 || evamārādhanaṃ devyāḥ samuktaṃ surapūjitam | yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā sa devīlokabhāgbhavet || 61 || devīpūjanato vipra sarve kāmā bhavanti hi | sarvapāpahatiḥ śuddhā matirante prajāyate || 62 || yatra tatra bhavetpūjyo mānyo mānadhaneṣu ca | jāyate jagadambāyāḥ prasādena virañcija || 63 || narakāṇāṃ na tasyāsti bhayaṃ svapne'pi kutracit | mahāmāyāprasādena putrapautrādivardhanaḥ || 64 || devībhakto bhavatyeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | ityevaṃ te samākhyātaṃ narakoddhāralakṣaṇam || 65 || pūjanaṃ hi mahādevyāḥ sarvamaṅgalakārakam | madhūkapūjanaṃ tadvanmāsānāṃ kramato mune || 66 || sarvaṃ samācaredyastu pūjanaṃ madhukāhvayam | na tasya rogabādhādibhayamudbhavate'nagha || 67 || athānyadapi vakṣyāmi prakṛteḥ pañcakaṃ param | nāmnā rūpeṇa cotpattyā jagadānandadāyakam || 68 || sākhyānaṃ ca samāhātmyaṃ prakṛteḥ pañcakaṃ mune | kutūhalakara caiva śṛṇu muktividhāyakam || 69 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe devīpūjanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || <9.1> prakṛticaritravarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca gaṇeśajananī durgā rādhā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | sāvitrī ca sṛṣṭividhau prakṛtiḥ pañcadhā smṛtā || 1 || nārada uvāca āvirbabhūva sā kena kā vā sā jñānināṃvara | kiṃ vā tallakṣaṇaṃ sādho babhūva pañcadhā katham || 2 || sarvāsāṃ caritaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ guṇa īpsitaḥ | avatāraḥ kutra kasyāstanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ vatsa ko vā vaktuṃ kṣamo bhavet | kiñcittathāpi vakṣyāmi yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrataḥ || 4 || prakṛṣṭavācakaḥ praśna kṛtiśca sṛṣṭivācakaḥ | sṛṣṭau prakṛṣṭā yā devī prakṛtiḥ sā prakīrtitā || 5 || guṇe sattve prakṛṣṭe ca praśabdo vartate śrutaḥ | madhyame rajasi kṛśca tiśabdastamasi smṛtaḥ || 6 || triguṇātmasvarūpā yā sā ca śaktisamanvitā | pradhānā sṛṣṭikaraṇe prakṛtistena kathyate || 7 || prathame vartate praśna kṛtiśca sṛṣṭivācakaḥ | sṛṣṭerādau ca yā devī prakṛtiḥ sā prakīrtitā || 8 || yogenātmā sṛṣṭividhau dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ | pumāṃśca dakṣiṇārdhāṅgo vāmārdhā prakṛtiḥ smṛtā || 9 || sā ca brahmasvarūpā ca nityā sā ca sanātanī | yathā''tmā ca tathā śaktiryathāgnau dāhikā sthitā || 10 || ata eva hi yogīndraiḥ strīpumbhedo na manyate | sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ brahmañchaśvatsadapi nārada || 11 || svecchāmayasyecchayā ca śrīkṛṣṇasya sisṛkṣayā | sā''virbabhūva sahasā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī || 12 || tadājñayā pañcavidhā sṛṣṭikarmavibhedikā | atha bhaktānurodhādvā bhaktānugrahavigrahā || 13 || gaṇeśamātā durgā yā śivarūpā śivapriyā | nārāyaṇī viṣṇumāyā pūrṇabrahmasvarūpiṇī || 14 || brahmādidevairmunibhirmanubhiḥ pūjitā stutā | sarvādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā śarvarūpā sanātanī || 15 || dharmasatyapuṇyakīrtiryaśomaṅgaladāyinī | sukhamokṣaharṣadātrī śokārtiduḥkhanāśinī || 16 || śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇā | tejaḥsvarūpā paramā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 17 || sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca śaktirīśasya santatam | siddheśvarī siddhirūpā siddhidā siddhirīśvarī || 18 || buddhirnidrā kṣutpipāsā chāyā tandrā dayā smṛtiḥ | jātiḥ kṣāntiśca bhrāntiśca śāntiḥ kāntiśca cetanā || 19 || tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭistathā lakṣmīrdhṛtirmāyā tathaiva ca | sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 20 || uktaḥ śrutau śrutaguṇaścātisvalpo yathāgamam | guṇo'styananto'nantāyā aparāṃ ca niśāmaya || 21 || śuddhasattvasvarūpā yā padmā sā paramātmanaḥ | sarvasampatsvarūpā sā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 22 || kāntātidāntā śāntā ca suśīlā sarvamaṅgalā | lobhamohakāmaroṣamadāhaṅkāravarjitā || 23 || bhaktānuraktā patyuśca sarvābhyaśca pativratā | prāṇatulyā bhagavataḥ premapātraṃ priyaṃvadā || 24 || sarvasasyātmikā devī jīvanopāyarūpiṇī | mahālakṣmīśca vaikuṇṭhe patisevāratā satī || 25 || svarge ca svargalakṣmīśca rājalakṣmīśca rājasu | gṛheṣu gṛhalakṣmīśca martyānāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ tathā || 26 || sarvaprāṇiṣu dravyeṣu śobhārūpā manoharā | kīrtirūpā puṇyavatāṃ prabhārūpā nṛpeṣu ca || 27 || vāṇijyarūpā vaṇijāṃ pāpināṃ kalahāṅkurā | dayārūpā ca kathitā vedoktā sarvasammatā || 28 || sarvapūjyā sarvavandyā cānyāṃ matto niśāmaya | vāgbuddhividyājñānādhiṣṭhātrī ca paramātmanaḥ || 29 || sarvavidyāsvarūpā yā sā ca devī sarasvatī | sā buddhiḥ kavitā medhā pratibhā smṛtidā nṛṇām || 30 || nānāprakārasiddhāntabhedārthakalanā matā | vyākhyābodhasvarūpā ca sarvasandehabhañjinī || 31 || vicārakāriṇī granthakāriṇī śaktirūpiṇī | svarasaṅgītasandhānatālakāraṇarūpiṇī || 32 || viṣayajñānavāgrūpā prativiśvopajīvinī | vyākhyāvādakarī śāntā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī || 33 || śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca suśīlā śrīharipriyā | himacandanakundendukumudāmbhojasannibhā || 34 || yajantī paramātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ratnamālayā | tapaḥsvarūpā tapasāṃ phaladātrī tapasvinām || 35 || siddhividyāsvarūpā ca sarvasiddhipradā sadā | yayā vinā tu vipraugho mūko mṛtasamaḥ sadā || 36 || devī tṛtīyā gaditā śrutyuktā jagadambikā | yathāgamaṃ yathākiñcidaparāṃ tvaṃ nibodha me || 37 || mātā caturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ vedāṅgānāṃ ca chandasām | sandhyāvandanamantrāṇāṃ tantrāṇāṃ ca vicakṣaṇā || 38 || dvijātijātirūpā ca japarūpā tapasvinī | brahmaṇyatejorūpā ca sarvasaṃskārarūpiṇī || 39 || pavitrarūpā sāvitrī gāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā | tīrthāni yasyāḥ saṃsparśaṃ vāñchanti hyātmaśuddhaye || 40 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī | paramānandarūpā ca paramā ca sanātanī || 41 || parabrahmasvarūpā ca nirvāṇapadadāyinī | brahmatejomayī śaktistadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 42 || yatpādarajasā pūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ ca nārada | devī caturthī kathitā pañcamīṃ varṇayāmi te || 43 || pañcaprāṇādhidevī yā pañcaprāṇasvarūpiṇī | prāṇādhikapriyatamā sarvābhyaḥ sundarī parā || 44 || sarvayuktā ca saubhāgyamāninī gauravānvitā | vāmāṅgārdhasvarūpā ca guṇena tejasā samā || 45 || parāvarā sārabhūtā paramādyā sanātanī | paramānandarūpā ca dhanyā mānyā ca pūjitā || 46 || rāsakrīḍādhidevī śrīkṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | rāsamaṇḍalasambhūtā rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitā || 47 || rāseśvarī surasikā rāsāvāsanivāsinī | golokavāsinī devī gopīveṣavidhāyikā || 48 || paramāhlādarūpā ca santoṣaharṣarūpiṇī | nirguṇā ca nirākārā nirliptā''tmasvarūpiṇī || 49 || nirīhā nirahaṅkārā bhaktānugrahavigrahā | vedānusāridhyānena vijñātā mā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 50 || dṛṣṭidṛṣṭā na sā ceśaiḥ surendrairmunipuṅgavaiḥ | vahniśuddhāṃśukadharā nānālaṅkārabhūṣitā || 51 || koṭicandraprabhā puṣṭasarvaśrīyuktavigrahā | śrīkṛṣṇabhaktidāsyaikakarā ca sarvasampadām || 52 || avatāre ca vārāhe vṛṣabhānusutā ca yā | yatpādapadmasaṃsparśātpavitrā ca vasundharā || 53 || brahmādibhiradṛṣṭā yā sarvairdṛṣṭā ca bhārate | strīratnasārasambhūtā kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthale sthitā || 54 || yathāmbare navaghane lolā saudāmanī mune | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi prataptaṃ brahmaṇā purā || 55 || yatpādapadmanakharadṛṣṭaye cātmaśuddhaye | na ca dṛṣṭaṃ ca svapne'pi pratyakṣasyāpi kā kathā || 56 || tenaiva tapasā dṛṣṭā bhuvi vṛndāvane vane | kathitā pañcamī devī sā rādhā ca prakīrtitā || 57 || aṃśarūpāḥ kalārūpāḥ kalāṃśāṃśāṃśasambhavāḥ | prakṛteḥ prativiśveṣu devyaśca sarvayoṣitaḥ || 58 || paripūrṇatamāḥ pañca vidyādevyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | yā yāḥ pradhānāṃśarūpā varṇayāmi niśāmaya || 59 || pradhānāṃśasvarūpā sā gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī | viṣṇuvigrahasambhūtā dravarūpā sanātanī || 60 || pāpipāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagnisvarūpiṇī | sukhasparśā snānapānairnirvāṇapadadāyinī || 61 || golokasthānaprasthānasukhasopānarūpiṇī | pavitrarūpā tīrthānāṃ saritāṃ ca parāvarā || 62 || śambhumaulijaṭāmerumuktāpaṃktisvarūpiṇī | tapaḥsampādinī sadyo bhārateṣu tapasvinām || 63 || candrapadmakṣīranibhā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī | nirmalā nirahaṅkārā sādhvī nārāyaṇapriyā || 64 || pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca tulasī viṣṇukāminī | viṣṇubhūṣaṇarūpā ca viṣṇupādasthitā satī || 65 || tapaḥsaṃkalpapūjādisaṅghasampādinī mune | sārabhūtā ca puṣpāṇāṃ pavitrā puṇyadā sadā || 66 || darśanasparśanābhyāṃ ca sadyo nirvāṇadāyinī | kalau kaluṣaśuṣkedhmadahanāyāgnirūpiṇī || 67 || yatpādapadmasaṃsparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā | yatsparśadarśane caivecchanti tīrthāni śuddhaye || 68 || yayā vinā ca viśveṣu sarvakarma ca niṣphalam | mokṣadā yā mumukṣūṇāṃ kāminī sarvakāmadā || 69 || kalpavṛkṣasvarūpā yā bhārate vṛkṣarūpiṇī | bhāratīnāṃ prīṇanāya jātā yā paradevatā || 70 || pradhānāṃśasvarūpā yā manasā kaśyapātmajā | śaṅkarapriyaśiṣyā ca mahājñānaviśāradā || 71 || nāgeśvarasyānantasya bhaginī nāgapūjitā | nāgeśvarī nāgamātā sundarī nāgavāhinī || 72 || nāgendragaṇasaṃyuktā nāgabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | nāgendravanditā siddhā yoginī nagaśāyinī || 73 || viṣṇurūpā viṣṇubhaktā viṣṇupūjāparāyaṇā | tapaḥsvarūpā tapasāṃ phaladātrī tapasvinī || 74 || divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣaṃ ca tapastaptvā ca yā hareḥ | tapasvinīṣu pūjyā ca tapasviṣu ca bhārate || 75 || sarvamantrādhidevī ca jvalantī brahmatejasā | brahmasvarūpā paramā brahmabhāvanatatparā || 76 || jaratkārumuneḥ patnī kṛṣṇāṃśasya pativratā | āstīkasya munermātā pravarasya tapasvinām || 77 || pradhānāṃśasvarūpā yā devasenā ca nārada | mātṛkāsu pūjyatamā sā ṣaṣṭhī ca prakīrtitā || 78 || putrapautrādidātrī ca dhātrī trijagatāṃ satī | ṣaṣṭhāṃśarūpā prakṛtestena ṣaṣṭhī prakīrtitā || 79 || sthāne śiśūnāṃ paramā vṛddharūpā ca yoginī | pūjā dvādaśamāseṣu yasyā viśveṣu santatam || 80 || pūjā ca sūtikāgāre purā ṣaṣṭhadine śiśoḥ | ekaviṃśatime caiva pūjā kalyāṇahetukī || 81 || munibhirnamitā caiṣā nityakāmāpyataḥ parā | mātṛkā ca dayārūpā śaśvadrakṣaṇakāriṇī || 82 || jale sthale cāntarikṣe śiśūnāṃ sadmagocare | pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca devīmaṅgalacaṇḍikā || 83 || prakṛtermukhasambhūtā sarvamaṅgaladā sadā | sṛṣṭau maṅgalarūpā ca saṃhāre koparūpiṇī || 84 || tena maṅgalacaṇḍī sā paṇḍitaiḥ parikīrtitā | pratimaṅgalavāreṣu prativiśveṣu pūjitā || 85 || putrapautradhanaiśvaryayaśomaṅgaladāyinī | parituṣṭā sarvavāñchāpradātrī sarvayoṣitām || 86 || ruṣṭā kṣaṇena saṃhartuṃ śaktā viśvaṃ maheśvarī | pradhānāṃśasvarūpā sā kālī kamalalocanā || 87 || durgālalāṭasambhūtā raṇe śumbhaniśumbhayoḥ | durgārdhāṃśasvarūpā sā guṇena tejasā samā || 88 || koṭisūryasamājuṣṭapuṣṭajājvalavigrahā | pradhānā sarvaśaktīnāṃ balā balavatī parā || 89 || sarvasiddhipradā devī paramā yogarūpiṇī | kṛṣṇabhaktā kṛṣṇatulyā tejasā vikramairguṇaiḥ || 90 || kṛṣṇabhāvanayā śaśvatkṛṣṇavarṇā sanātanī | saṃhartuṃ sarvabrahmāṇḍaṃ śaktā niḥśvāsamātrataḥ || 91 || raṇaṃ daityaiḥ samaṃ tasyāḥ krīḍayā lokaśikṣayā | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca dātuṃ śaktā ca pūjitā || 92 || brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānā munibhirmanubhirnaraiḥ | pradhānāṃśasvarūpā sā prakṛteśca vasundharā || 93 || ādhārarūpā sarveṣāṃ sarvasasyā prakīrtitā | ratnākarā ratnagarbhā sarvaratnākarāśrayā || 94 || prajābhiśca prajeśaiśca pūjitā vanditā sadā | sarvopajīvyarūpā ca sarvasampadvidhāyinī || 95 || yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ nirādhāraṃ carācaram | prakṛteśca kalā yā yāstā nibodha munīśvara || 96 || yasya yasya ca yā patnī tatsarvaṃ varṇayāmi te | svāhādevī vahnipatnī prativiśveṣu pūjitā || 97 || yayā vinā havirdānaṃ na grahītuṃ surāḥ kṣamāḥ | dakṣiṇā yajñapatnī ca dīkṣā sarvatra pūjitā || 98 || yayā vinā hi viśveṣu sarvakarma hi niṣphalam | svadhā pitṝṇāṃ patnī ca munibhirmanubhirnaraiḥ || 99 || pūjitā pitṛdānaṃ hi niṣkalaṃ ca yayā vinā | svastidevī vāyupatnī prativiśveṣu pūjitā || 100 || ādānaṃ ca pradānaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ ca yayā vinā | puṣṭirgaṇapateḥ patnī pūjitā jagatītale || 101 || yayā vinā parikṣīṇāḥ pumāṃso yoṣito'pi ca | anantapatnī tuṣṭiśca pūjitā vanditā bhavet || 102 || yayā vinā na santuṣṭāḥ sarvalokāśca sarvataḥ | īśānapatnī sampattiḥ pūjitā ca surairnaraiḥ || 103 || sarve lokā daridrāśca viśveṣu ca yayā vinā | dhṛtiḥ kapilapatnī ca sarvaiḥ sarvatra pūjitā || 104 || sarve lokā adhairyāśca jagatsu ca yayā vinā | satyapatnī satī muktaiḥ pūjitā ca jagatpriyā || 105 || yayā vinā bhavelloko bandhutārahitaḥ sadā | mohapatnī dayā sādhvī pūjitā ca jagatpriyā || 106 || sarve lokāśca sarvatra niṣphalāśca yayā vinā | puṇyapatnī pratiṣṭhā sā pūjitā puṇyadā sadā || 107 || yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ jīvanmṛtasamaṃ mune | sukarmapatnī saṃsiddhā kīrtirdhanyaiśca pūjitā || 108 || yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ yaśohīnaṃ mṛtaṃ yathā | kriyā tūdyogapatnī ca pūjitā sarvasammatā || 109 || yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca nārada | adharmapatnī mithyā sā sarvadhūrtaiśca pūjitā || 110 || yayā vinā jagatsarvamucchinnaṃ vidhinirmitam | satye adarśanā yā ca tretāyāṃ sūkṣmarūpiṇī || 111 || ardhāvayavarūpā ca dvāpare caiva saṃvṛtā | kalau mahāpragalbhā ca sarvatra vyāpikā balāt || 112 || kapaṭena samaṃ bhrātrā bhramate ca gṛhe gṛhe | śāntirlajjā ca bhārye dve suśīlasya ca pūjite || 113 || yābhyāṃ vinā jagatsarvamunmattamiva nārada | jñānasya tisro bhāryāśca buddhirmedhādhṛtistathā || 114 || yābhirvinā jagatsarvaṃ mūḍhaṃ mattasamaṃ sadā | mūrtiśca dharmapatnī sā kāntirūpā manoharā || 115 || paramātmā ca viśvaugho nirādhāro yayā vinā | sarvatra śobhārūpā ca lakṣmīrmūrtimatī satī || 116 || śrīrūpā mūrtirūpā ca mānyā dhanyātipūjitā | kālāgnī rudrapatnī ca nidrā sā siddhayoginī || 117 || sarve lokāḥ samācchannā yayā yogena rātriṣu | kālasya tisro bhāryāśca saṃdhyā rātrirdināni ca || 118 || yābhirvinā vidhātā ca saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate | kṣutpipāse lobhabhārye dhanye mānye ca pūjite || 119 || yābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ nityaṃ cintāturaṃ bhavet | prabhā ca dāhikā caiva dve bhārye tejasastathā || 120 || yābhyāṃ vinā jagatsraṣṭā vidhātuṃ ca na hīśvaraḥ | kālakanye mṛtyujare prajvārasya priyāpriye || 121 || yābhyāṃ jagatsamucchinnaṃ vidhātrā nirmitaṃ vidhau | nidrākanyā ca tandrā sā prītiranyā sukhapriye || 122 || yābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vidhiputra vidhervidhau | vairāgyasya ca dve bhārye śraddhā bhaktiśca pūjite || 123 || yābhyāṃ śaśvajjagatsarvaṃ yajjīvanmuktimanmune | aditirdevamātā ca surabhī ca gavāṃ prasūḥ || 124 || ditiśca daityajananī kadrūśca vinatā danuḥ | upayuktāḥ sṛṣṭividhāvetāstu kīrtitāḥ kalāḥ || 125 || kalā anyāḥ santi bahvyastāsu kāścinnibodha me | rohiṇī candrapatnī ca saṃjñā sūryasya kāminī || 126 || śatarūpā manorbhāryā śacīndrasya ca gehinī | tārā bṛhaspaterbhāryā vasiṣṭhasyāpyarundhatī || 127 || ahalyā gautamastrī sāpyanasūyātrikāminī | devahūtiḥ kardamasya prasūtirdakṣakāminī || 128 || pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā menakā sāmbikāprasūḥ | lopāmudrā tathā kuntī kuberakāminī tathā || 129 || varuṇānī prasiddhā ca balervindhyāvalistathā | kāntā ca damayantī ca yaśodā devakī tathā || 130 || gāndhārī draupadī śaivyā sā ca satyavatī priyā | vṛṣabhānupriyā sādhvī rādhāmātā kulodvahā || 131 || mandodarī ca kausalyā subhadrā kauravī tathā | revatī satyabhāmā ca kālindī lakṣmaṇā tathā || 132 || jāmbavatī nāgnajitirmitravindā tathāparā | lakṣmaṇā rukmiṇī sītā svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā || 133 || kālī yojanagandhā ca vyāsamātā mahāsatī | bāṇaputrī tathoṣā ca citralekhā ca tatsakhī || 134 || prabhāvatī bhānumatī tathā māyāvatī satī | reṇukā ca bhṛgormātā rāmamātā ca rohiṇī || 135 || ekanandā ca durgā sā śrīkṛṣṇabhaginī satī | bahvyaḥ satyaḥ kalāścaiva prakṛtereva bhārate || 136 || yā yāśca grāmadevyaḥ syustāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ | kalāṃśāṃśasamudbhūtāḥ prativiśveṣu yoṣitaḥ || 137 || yoṣitāmavamānena prakṛteśca parābhavaḥ | brāhmaṇī pūjitā yena patiputravatī satī || 138 || prakṛtiḥ pūjitā tena vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ | kumārī cāṣṭavarṣīyā vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ || 139 || pūjitā yena viprasya prakṛtistena pūjitā | sarvāḥ prakṛtisambhūtā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ || 140 || sattvāṃśāścottamā jñeyāḥ suśīlāśca pativratāḥ | madhyamā rajasaścāṃśāstāśca bhogyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 141 || sukhasambhogavaśyāśca svakārye tatparāḥ sadā | adhamāstamasaścāṃśā ajñātakulasambhavāḥ || 142 || durmukhāḥ kulahā dhūrtāḥ svatantrāḥ kalahapriyāḥ | pṛthivyāṃ kulaṭā yāśca svarge cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 143 || prakṛtestamasaścāṃśāḥ puṃścalyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ | evaṃ nigaditaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛte rūpavarṇanam || 144 || tāḥ sarvāḥ pūjitāḥ pṛthvyāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate | pūjitā surathenādau durgā durgārtināśinī || 145 || tataḥ śrīrāmacandreṇa rāvaṇasya vadhārthinā | tatpaścājjagatāṃ mātā triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā || 146 || jātā''dau dakṣakanyā yā nihatya daityadānavān | tato dehaṃ parityajya yajñe bhartuśca nindayā || 147 || jajñe himavataḥ patnyāṃ lebhe paśupatiṃ patim | gaṇeśaśca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ skando viṣṇukalodbhavaḥ || 148 || babhūvatustau tanayau paścāttasyāśca nārada | lakṣmīrmaṅgalabhūpena prathamaṃ paripūjitā || 149 || triṣu lokeṣu tatpaścāddevatāmunimānavaiḥ | sāvitrī cāśvapatinā prathamaṃ paripūjitā || 150 || tatpaścāttriṣu lokeṣu devatāmunipuṅgavaiḥ | ādau sarasvatī devī brahmaṇā paripūjitā || 151 || tatpaścāttriṣu lokeṣu devatāmunipuṅgavaiḥ | prathamaṃ pūjitā rādhā goloke rāsamaṇḍale || 152 || paurṇamāsyāṃ kārtikasya kṛṣṇena paramātmanā | gopikābhiśca gopaiśca bālikābhiśca bālakaiḥ || 153 || gavāṃ gaṇaiḥ surabhyā ca tatpaścādājñayā hareḥ | tadā brahmādibhirdevairmunibhiḥ parayā mudā || 154 || puṣpadhūpādibhirbhaktyā pūjitā vanditā sadā | pṛthivyāṃ prathamaṃ devī suyajñenaiva pūjitā || 155 || śaṅkareṇopadiṣṭena puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate | triṣu lokeṣu tatpaścādājñayā paramātmanaḥ || 156 || puṣpadhūpādibhirbhaktyā pūjitā munibhiḥ sadā | kalā yā yāḥ samudbhūtā pūjitāstāśca bhārate || 157 || pūjitā grāmadevyaśca grāme ca nagare mune | evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛteścaritaṃ śubham || 158 || yathāgamaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 159 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe prakṛticaritravarṇanaṃ nāma prathamodhyāyaḥ || 1 || <9.2> pañcaprakṛtitadbhartṛgaṇotpattivarṇanam nārada uvāca samāsena śrutaṃ sarvaṃ devīnāṃ caritaṃ prabho | vibodhanāya bodhasya vyāsena vaktumarhasi || 1 || sṛṣṭerādyā sṛṣṭividhau kathamāvirbabhūva ha | kathaṃ vā pañcadhā bhūtā vada vedavidāṃvara || 2 || bhūtā yayāṃśakalayā tayā triguṇayā bhave | vyāsena tāsāṃ caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam || 3 || tāsāṃ janmānukathanaṃ pūjādhyānavidhiṃ budha | stotraṃ kavacamaiśvaryaṃ śauryaṃ varṇaya maṅgalam || 4 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca nitya ātmā nabho nityaṃ kālo nityo diśo yathā | viśvānāṃ golakaṃ nityaṃ nityo goloka eva ca || 5 || tadekadeśo vaikuṇṭho namrabhāgānusārakaḥ | tathaiva prakṛtirnityā brahmalīlā sanātanī || 6 || yathāgnau dāhikā candre padme śobhā prabhā ravau | śaśvadyuktā na bhinnā sā tathā prakṛtirātmani || 7 || vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ | vinā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ kulālo hi nahīśvaraḥ || 8 || na hi kṣamastathātmā ca sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ tayā vinā | sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā yayā ca śaktimānsadā || 9 || aiśvaryavacanaḥ śaśca ktiḥ parākrama eva ca | tatsvarūpā tayordātrī sā śaktiḥ parikīrtitā || 10 || jñānaṃ samṛddhiḥ sampattiryaśaścaiva balaṃ bhagaḥ | tena śaktirbhagavatī bhagarūpā ca sā sadā || 11 || tayā yuktaḥ sadātmā ca bhagavāṃstena kathyate | sa ca svecchāmayo devaḥ sākāraśca nirākṛtiḥ || 12 || tejorūpaṃ nirākāraṃ dhyāyante yoginaḥ sadā | vadanti ca paraṃ brahma paramānandamīśvaram || 13 || adṛśyaṃ sarvadraṣṭāraṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam | sarvadaṃ sarvarūpaṃ taṃ vaiṣṇavāstanna manvate || 14 || vadanti caiva te kasya tejastejasvinā vinā | tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ brahma tejasvinaṃ param || 15 || svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | atīva sundaraṃ rūpaṃ bibhrataṃ sumanoharam || 16 || kiśoravayasaṃ śāntaṃ sarvakāntaṃ parātparam | navīnanīradābhāsadhāmaikaṃ śyāmavigraham || 17 || śaranmadhyāhnapadmaughaśobhāmocanalocanam | muktācchavivinindyaikadantapaṃktimanoramam || 18 || mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam | sunasaṃ sasmitaṃ kāntaṃ bhaktānugrahakāraṇam || 19 || jvaladagniviśuddhaikapītāṃśukasuśobhitam | dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 20 || sarvādhāraṃ ca sarveśaṃ sarvaśaktiyutaṃ vibhum | sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ sarvasvatantraṃ sarvamaṅgalam || 21 || paripūrṇatamaṃ siddhaṃ siddheśaṃ siddhikārakam | dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ śaśvaddevadevaṃ sanātanam || 22 || janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītiharaṃ param | brahmaṇo vayasā yasya nimeṣa upacaryate || 23 || sa cātmā sa paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityabhidhīyate | kṛṣistadbhaktivacano naśca taddāsyavācakaḥ || 24 || bhaktidāsyapradātā yaḥ sa ca kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāro bījameva ca || 25 || sa kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasraṣṭā''dau sisṛkṣanneka eva ca | sṛṣṭyunmukhastadaṃśena kālena preritaḥ prabhuḥ || 26 || svecchāmayaḥ svecchayā ca dvidhārūpo babhūva ha | strīrūpo vāmabhāgāṃśo dakṣiṇāṃśaḥ pumānsmṛtaḥ || 27 || tāṃ dadarśa mahākāmī kāmādhārāṃ sanātanaḥ | atīva kamanīyā ca cārupaṅkajasannibhām || 28 || candrabimbavinindyaikanitambayugalāṃ parām | sucārukadalīstambhaninditaśroṇisundarīm || 29 || śrīyuktaśrīphalākārastanayugmamanoramām | puṣpajuṣṭāṃ suvalitāṃ madhyakṣīṇāṃ manoharām || 30 || atīva sundarīṃ śāntāṃ sasmitāṃ vakralocanām | vahniśuddhāṃśukādhārāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 31 || śaśvaccakṣuścakorābhyāṃ pibantīṃ satataṃ mudā | kṛṣṇasya mukhacandraṃ ca candrakoṭivininditam || 32 || kastūrībindunā sārdhamadhaścandanabindunā | samaṃ sindūrabinduṃ ca bhālamadhye ca bibhratīm || 33 || vakrimaṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam | ratnendrasārahāraṃ ca dadhatīṃ kāntakāmukīm || 34 || koṭicandraprabhāmṛṣṭapuṣṭaśobhāsamanvitām | gamanena rājahaṃsagajagarvavināśinīm || 35 || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ tu tayā sārdhaṃ rāseśo rāsamaṇḍale | rāsollāse surasiko rāsakrīḍāñcakāra ha || 36 || nānāprakāraśṛṅgāraṃ śṛṅgāro mūrtimāniva | cakāra sukhasambhogaṃ yāvadvai brahmaṇo dinam || 37 || tataḥ sa ca pariśrāntastasyā yonau jagatpitā | cakāra vīryādhānaṃ ca nityānande śubhakṣaṇe || 38 || gātrato yoṣitastasyāḥ suratānte ca suvrata | niḥsasāra śramajalaṃ śrāntāyāstejasā hareḥ || 39 || mahākramaṇakliṣṭāyā niḥśvāsaśca babhūva ha | tadā vavre śramajalaṃ tatsarvaṃ viśvagolakam || 40 || sa ca niḥśvāsavāyuśca sarvādhāro babhūva ha | niḥśvāsavāyuḥ sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ ca bhaveṣu ca || 41 || babhūva mūrtimadvāyorvāmāṅgātprāṇavallabhā | tatpatnī sā ca tatputrāḥ prāṇāḥ pañca ca jīvinām || 42 || prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaścodānavyānau ca vāyavaḥ | babhūvureva tatputrā adhaḥ prāṇāśca pañca ca || 43 || gharmatoyādhidevaśca babhūva varuṇo mahān | tadvāmāṅgācca tatpatnī varuṇānī babhūva sā || 44 || atha sā kṛṣṇacicchaktiḥ kṛṣṇagarbhaṃ dadhāra ha | śatamanvantaraṃ yāvajjvalantī brahmatejasā || 45 || kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī sā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikapriyā | kṛṣṇasya saṅginī śaśvatkṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthalasthitā || 46 || śatamanvantarānte ca kāle'tīte tu sundarī | suṣāva ḍimbhaṃ svarṇābhaṃ viśvādhārālayaṃ param || 47 || dṛṣṭvā ḍimbhaṃ ca sā devī hṛdayena vyadūyata | utsasarja ca kopena brahmāṇḍagolake jale || 48 || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaśca tattyāgaṃ hāhākāraṃ cakāra ha | śaśāpa devīṃ deveśastatkṣaṇaṃ ca yathocitam || 49 ||
