yato'patyaṃ tvayā tyaktaṃ kopaśīle ca niṣṭhure | bhava tvamanapatyāpi cādyaprabhṛti niścitam || 50 || yā yāstvadaṃśarūpāśca bhaviṣyanti surastriyaḥ | anapatyāśca tāḥ sarvāstvatsamā nityayauvanāḥ || 51 || etasminnantare devī jihvāgrātsahasā tataḥ | āvirbabhūva kanyaikā śuklavarṇā manoharā || 52 || śvetavastraparīdhānā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī | ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyā sarvaśāstrādhidevatā || 53 || atha kālāntare sā ca dvidhārūpo babhūva ha | vāmārdhāṅgācca kamalā dakṣiṇārdhācca rādhikā || 54 || etasminnantare kṛṣṇo dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ | dakṣiṇārdhaśca dvibhujo vāmārdhaśca caturbhujaḥ || 55 || uvāca vāṇīṃ kṛṣṇastāṃ tvamasya kāminī bhava | atraiva māninī rādhā tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati || 56 || evaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca pradadau tuṣṭo nārāyaṇāya ca | sa jagāma ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tābhyāṃ sārdhaṃ jagatpatiḥ || 57 || anapatye ca te dve ca jāte rādhāṃśasambhave | bhūtā nārāyaṇāṅgācca pārṣadāśca caturbhujāḥ || 58 || tejasā vayasā rūpaguṇābhyāṃ ca samā hareḥ | babhūvuḥ kamalāṅgācca dāsīkoṭyaśca tatsamāḥ || 59 || atha golokanāthasya lomnāṃ vivarato mune | bhūtāścāsaṃkhyagopāśca vayasā tejasā samāḥ || 60 || rūpeṇa ca guṇenaiva balena vikrameṇa ca | prāṇatulyapriyāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ pārṣadā vibhoḥ || 61 || rādhāṅgalomakūpebhyo babhūvurgopakanyakāḥ | rādhātulyāśca tāḥ sarvā rādhādāsyaḥ priyaṃvadāḥ || 62 || ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāḥ śaśvatsusthirayauvanāḥ | anapatyāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ puṃsaḥ śāpena santatam || 63 || etasminnantare vipra sahasā kṛṣṇadevatā | āvirbabhūva durgā sā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī || 64 || devī nārāyaṇīśānā sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī | buddhyadhiṣṭhātrī devī sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 65 || devīnāṃ bījarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī | paripūrṇatamā tejaḥsvarūpā triguṇātmikā || 66 || taptakāñcanavarṇābhā koṭisūryasamaprabhā | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā sahasrabhujasaṃyutā || 67 || nānāśastrāstranikaraṃ bibhratī sā trilocanā | vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā || 68 || yasyāścāṃśāṃśakalayā babhūvuḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ | sarve viśvasthitā lokā mohitāḥ syuśca māyayā || 69 || sarvaiśvaryapradātrī ca kāmināṃ gṛhavāsinām | kṛṣṇabhaktipradā yā ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavī || 70 || mumukṣūṇāṃ mokṣadātrī sukhināṃ sukhadāyinī | svargeṣu svargalakṣmīśca gṛhalakṣyīrgṛheṣu ca || 71 || tapasviṣu tapasyā ca śrīrūpā tu nṛpeṣu ca | yā vahnau dāhikārūpā prabhārūpā ca bhāskare || 72 || śobhārūpā ca candre ca sā padmeṣu ca śobhanā | sarvaśaktisvarūpā yā śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani || 73 || yayā ca śaktimānātmā yayā ca śaktimajjagat | yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ jīvanmṛtamiva sthitam || 74 || yā ca saṃsāravṛkṣasya bījarūpā sanātanī | sthitirūpā vṛddhirūpā phalarūpā ca nārada || 75 || kṣutpipāsādayārūpā nidrā tandrā kṣamā matiḥ | śāntilajjātuṣṭipuṣṭibhrāntikāntyādirūpiṇī || 76 || sā ca saṃstūya sarveśaṃ tatpuraḥ samuvāsa ha | ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tasyai pradadau rādhikeśvaraḥ || 77 || etasminnantare tatra sastrīkaśca caturmukhaḥ | padmanābhernābhipadmānniḥsasāra mahāmune || 78 || kamaṇḍaludharaḥ śrīmāṃstapasvī jñānināṃ varaḥ | caturmukhaistaṃ tuṣṭāva prajvalanbrahmatejasā || 79 || sā tadā sundarī sṛṣṭā śatacandrasamaprabhā | vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣaṇā || 80 || ratnasiṃhāsane ramye saṃstūya sarvakāraṇam | uvāsa svāminā sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇasya purato mudā || 81 || etasminnantare kṛṣṇo dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ | vāmārdhāṅgo mahādevo dakṣiṇe gopikāpatiḥ || 82 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaḥ śatakoṭiraviprabhaḥ | triśūlapaṭṭiśadharo vyāghracarmāmbaro haraḥ || 83 || taptakāñcanavarṇābho jaṭābhāradharaḥ paraḥ | bhasmabhūṣitagātraśca sasmitaścandraśekharaḥ || 84 || digambaro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ sarpabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | bibhraddakṣiṇahastena ratnamālāṃ susaṃskṛtām || 85 || prajapanpañcavaktreṇa brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam | satyasvarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram || 86 || kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam | janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītiharaṃ param || 87 || saṃstūya mṛtyormṛtyuṃ taṃ yato mṛtyuñjayābhidhaḥ | ratnasiṃhāsane ramye samuvāsa hareḥ puraḥ || 88 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe pañcaprakṛtitadbhartṛgaṇotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <9.3> brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarādidevatotpattivarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca atha ḍimbho jale tiṣṭhanyāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ | tataḥ sa kāle sahasā dvidhābhūto babhūva ha ||1|| tanmadhye śiśurekaśca śatakoṭiraviprabhaḥ| kṣaṇaṃ rorūyamāṇaśca stanāndhaḥ pīḍitaḥ kṣudhā||2|| pitrā mātrā parityakto jalamadhye nirāśrayaḥ| brahmāṇḍāsaṃkhyanātho yo dadarśordhvamanāthavat ||3|| sthūlāsthūlatamaḥ so'pi nāmnā devo mahāvirāṭ| paramāṇuryathā sūkṣmātparaḥ sthūlāttathāpyasau ||4|| tejasā ṣoḍaśāṃśo'yaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ| ādhāraḥ sarvaviśvānāṃ mahāviṣṇuśca prākṛtaḥ ||5|| pratyekaṃ lomakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilāni ca| asyāpi teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ ca kṛṣṇo vaktuṃ nahi kṣamaḥ ||6|| saṃkhyā cedrajasāmasti viśvānāṃ na kadācana| brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tathā saṃkhyā na vidyate||7|| prativiśveṣu santyevaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ| pātālād brahmalokāntaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ parikīrtitam||8|| tata ūrdhvaṃ ca vaikuṇṭho brahmāṇḍād bahireva saḥ| tata ūrdhvaṃ ca golokaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanaḥ||9|| nityaḥ satyasvarūpaśca yathā kṛṣṇastathāpyayam| saptadvīpamitā pṛdhvī saptasāgarasaṃyutā ||10|| ūnapañcāśadupadvīpāsaṃkhyaśailavanānvitā | ūrdhvaṃ sapta svargalokā brahyalokasamanvitāḥ ||11|| pātālāni ca saptādhaścaivaṃ brahmāṇḍameva ca| ūrdhvaṃ dharāyā bhūrloko bhuvarlokastataḥ param||12|| tataḥ paraśca svarloko janalokastathā paraḥ | tataḥ parastapolokaḥ satyalokastataḥ paraḥ ||13|| tataḥ paraṃ brahmalokastaptakāñcanasannibhaḥ | evaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtrimaṃ ca bāhyābhyantarameva ca ||14|| tadvināśe vināśaśca sarveṣāmeva nārada | jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ viśvasaṃghamanityakam ||15|| nityau golokavaikuṇṭhau proktau śaśvadakṛtrimau | pratyekaṃ lomakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍaṃ pariniścitam ||16|| eṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ na jānāti kṛṣṇo'nyasyāpi kā kathā | pratyekaṃ pratibrahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ||17|| tisraḥ koṭyaḥ surāṇāṃ ca saṃkhyā sarvatra putraka| digīśāścaiva dikpālā nakṣatrāṇi grahādayaḥ ||18|| bhuvi varṇāśca catvāro'pyadho nāgāścarācarāḥ | atha kāle'tra sa virāḍūrdhvaṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ|| 19|| ḍimbhāntare ca śūnyaṃ ca na dvitīyaṃ ca kiñcana | cintāmavāpa kṣudyukto ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ ||20|| jñānaṃ prāpya tadā dadhyau kṛṣṇaṃ paramapūruṣam| tato dadarśa tatraiva brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam ||21|| navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam | sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ||22|| jahāsa bālakastuṣṭo dṛṣṭvā janakamīśvaram | varaṃ tadā dadau tasmai vareśaḥ samayocitam ||23|| matsamo jñānayuktaśca kṣutpipāsādivarjitaḥ | brahmāṇḍāsaṃkhyanilayo bhava vatsa layāvadhi ||24|| niṣkāmo nirbhayaścaiva sarveṣāṃ varado bhava | jarāmṛtyurogaśokapīḍādivarjito bhava ||25|| ityuktvā tasya karṇe sa mahāmantraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram | triḥkṛtvaśca prajajāpa vedāṅgapravaraṃ param ||26|| praṇavādicaturthyantaṃ kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam | vahnijāyāntamiṣṭaṃ ca sarvavighnaharaṃ param ||27|| mantraṃ dattvā tadāhāraṃ kalpayāmāsa vai vibhuḥ| śrūyatāṃ tad brahmaputra nibodha kathayāmi te ||28|| prativiśvaṃ yannaivedyaṃ dadāti vaiṣṇavo janaḥ | tatṣoḍaśāṃśo viṣayiṇo viṣṇoḥ pajvadaśāsya vai ||29|| nirguṇasyātmanaścaiva paripūrṇatamasya ca | naivedye caiva kṛṣṇasya na hi kiñcitprayojanam|| 30|| yadyaddadāti naivedyaṃ tasmai devāya yo janaḥ | sa ca khādati tatsarvaṃ lakṣmīnātho virāṭ tathā|| 31|| taṃ ca mantravaraṃ dattvā tamuvāca punarvibhuḥ | varamanyaṃ kimiṣṭaṃ te tanme brūhi dadāmi ca ||32|| kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca virāḍ vibhuḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ bālakastāvadvacanaṃ samayocitam ||33|| bālaka uvāca varo me tvatpadāmbhoje bhaktirbhavatu niścalā| satataṃ yāvadāyurme kṣaṇaṃ vā suciraṃ ca vā||34|| tvadbhaktiyuktaloke'smiñjīvanmuktaśca santatam| tvadbhaktihīno mūrkhaśca jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ||35|| kiṃ tajjapena tapasā yajñena pūjanena ca| vratena copavāsena puṇyena tīrthasevayā ||36|| kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnasya mūrkhasya jīvanaṃ vṛthā | yenātmanā jīvitaśca tameva na hi manyate ||37|| yāvadātmā śarīre'sti tāvatsa śaktisaṃyutaḥ | paścādyānti gate tasminsvatantrāḥ sarvaśaktayaḥ||38|| sa ca tvaṃ ca mahābhāga sarvātmā prakṛteḥ paraḥ | svecchāmayaśca sarvādyo brahmajyotiḥ sanātanaḥ||39|| ityuktvā bālakastatra virarāma ca nārada | uvāca kṛṣṇaḥ pratyuktiṃ madhurāṃ śrutisundarīm||40|| "śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca suciraṃ susthiraṃ tiṣṭha yathāhaṃ tvaṃ tathā bhava | brahmaṇo'saṃkhyapāte ca pātaste na bhaviṣyati||41|| aṃśena pratibrahmāṇḍe tvaṃ ca kṣudravirāḍ bhava | tvannābhipadmād brahmā ca viśvasraṣṭā bhaviṣyati|| 42|| lalāṭe brahmaṇaścaiva rudrāścaikādaśaiva te | śivāṃśena bhaviṣyanti sṛṣṭisaṃharaṇāya vai||43|| kālāgnirudrasteṣveko viśvasaṃhārakārakaḥ| pātā viṣṇuśca viṣayī rudrāṃśena(kṣudrāṃśena) bhaviṣyati||44|| madbhaktiyuktaḥ satataṃ bhaviṣyasi vareṇa me | dhyānena kamanīyaṃ māṃ nityaṃ drakṣyasi niścitam|| 45|| mātaraṃ kamanīyāṃ ca mama vakṣaḥsthalasthitām| yāmi lokaṃ tiṣṭha vatsetyuktvā so'ntaradhīyata|| 46|| gatvā svalokaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ samuvāca ha| sraṣṭāraṃ sraṣṭumīśaṃ ca saṃhartuṃ caiva tatkṣaṇam ||47|| "śrībhagavānuvāca sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ gaccha vatsa nābhipadmodbhavo bhava | mahāvirāḍ lomakūpe kṣudrasya ca vidhe śṛṇu||48|| gaccha vatsa mahādeva brahmabhālodbhavo bhava| aṃśena ca mahābhāga svayaṃ ca suciraṃ tapa||49|| ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho virarāma vidheḥ suta| jagāma brahmā taṃ natvā śivaśca śivadāyakaḥ||50|| mahāvirāḍ lomakūpe brahmāṇḍagolake jale | babhūva ca virāṭ kṣudro virāḍaṃśena sāmpratam||51|| śyāmo yuvā pītavāsāḥ śayāno jalatalpake | īṣaddhāsyaḥ prasannāsyo viśvavyāpī janārdanaḥ ||52|| tannābhikamale brahmā babhūva kamalodbhavaḥ | sambhūya padmadaṇḍe ca babhrāma yugalakṣakam ||53|| nāntaṃ jagāma daṇḍasya padmanālasya padmajaḥ | nābhijasya ca padmasya cintāmāpa pitā tava||54|| svasthānaṃ punarāgamya dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujam | tato dadarśa kṣudraṃ taṃ dhyānena divyacakṣuṣā ||55|| śayānaṃ jalatalpe ca brahmāṇḍagolakāplute | yallomakūpe brahmāṇḍaṃ taṃ ca tatparamīśvaram ||56|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ cāpi golokaṃ gopagopīsamanvitam | taṃ saṃstūya varaṃ prāpa tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ||57|| babhūvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ sanakādayaḥ | tato rudrakalāścāpi śivasyaikādaśa smṛtāḥ ||58|| babhūva pātā viṣṇuśca kṣudrasya vāmapārśvataḥ| caturbhujaśca bhagavān śvetadvīpe sa cāvasat ||59|| kṣudrasya nābhipadme ca brahmā viśvaṃ sasarja ha| svargaṃ martyaṃ ca pātālaṃ trilokīṃ sacarācarām||60|| evaṃ sarvaṃ lomakūpe viśvaṃ pratyekameva ca | prativiśve kṣudravirāḍ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ||61|| ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahman kṛṣṇasaṅkīrtanaṃ śubham| sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ brahmankiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi||62|| iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarādidevatotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3|| <9.4> sarasvatīstotrapūjākavacādivarṇanam nārada uvāca śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ tvatprasādātsudhopamam | adhunā prakṛtīnāṃ ca vyastaṃ varṇaya pūjanam || 1 || kasyāḥ pūjā kṛtā kena kathaṃ martye pracāritā | kena vā pūjitā kā vā kena kā vā stutā prabho || 2 || tāsāṃ stotraṃ ca dhyānaṃ ca prabhāvaṃ caritaṃ śubham | kābhiḥ kebhyo varo dattastanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca gaṇeśajananī durgā rādhā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | sāvitrī ca sṛṣṭividhau prakṛtiḥ pañcadhā smṛtā || 4 || āsāṃ pūjā prasiddhā ca prabhāvaḥ paramādbhutaḥ | sudhopamaṃ ca caritaṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam || 5 || prakṛtyaṃśāḥ kalā yāśca tāsāṃ ca caritaṃ śubham | sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi te brahman sāvadhāno niśāmaya || 6 || kālī vasundharā gaṅgā ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalacaṇḍikā | tulasī manasā nidrā svadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā || 7 || saṃkṣiptamāsāṃ caritaṃ puṇyadaṃ śrutisundaram | jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca tacca vakṣyāmi sundaram || 8 || durgāyāścaiva rādhāyā vistīrṇaṃ caritaṃ mahat | tadvatpaścātpravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepakramataḥ śṛṇu || 9 || ādau sarasvatīpūjā śrīkṛṣṇena vinirmitā | yatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ || 10 || āvirbhūtā yathā devī vaktrataḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ | iyeṣa kṛṣṇaṃ kāmena kāmukī kāmarūpiṇī || 11 || sa ca vijñāya tadbhāvaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvamātaram | tāmuvāca hitaṃ satyaṃ pariṇāme sukhāvaham || 12 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ sādhvi madaṃśaṃ ca caturbhujam | yuvānaṃ sundaraṃ sarvaguṇayuktaṃ ca matsamam || 13 || kāmajñaṃ kāminīnāṃ ca tāsāṃ ca kāmapūrakam | koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlālaṅkatamīśvaram || 14 || kānte kāntaṃ ca māṃ kṛtvā yadi sthātumihecchasi | tvatto balavatī rādhā na bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati || 15 || yo yasmād balavānvāpi tato'nyaṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ | kathaṃ parānsādhayati yadi svayamanīśvaraḥ || 16 || sarveśaḥ sarvaśāstāhaṃ rādhāṃ bādhitumakṣamaḥ | tejasā matsamā sā ca rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca || 17 || prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ | prāṇato'pi priyaḥ putraḥ keṣāṃ vāsti ca kaścana || 18 || tvaṃ bhadre gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati | patiṃ tamīśvaraṃ kṛtvā modasva suciraṃ sukham || 19 || lobhamohakāmakrodhamānahiṃsāvivarjitā | tejasā tvatsamā lakṣmī rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca || 20 || tayā sārdhaṃ tava prītyā śaśvatkālaḥ prayāsyati | gauravaṃ ca haristulyaṃ kariṣyati dvayorapi || 21 || prativiśveṣu tāṃ pūjāṃ mahatīṃ gauravānvitām | māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ vidyārambhe ca sundari || 22 || mānavā manavo devā munīndrāśca mumukṣavaḥ | vasavo yoginaḥ siddhā nāgā gandharvarākṣasāḥ || 23 || madvareṇa kariṣyanti kalpe kalpe layāvadhi | bhaktiyuktāśca dattvā vai copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa || 24 || kaṇvaśākhoktavidhinā dhyānena stavanena ca | jitendriyāḥ saṃyatāśca ghaṭe ca pustake'pi ca || 25 || kṛtvā suvarṇaguṭikāṃ gandhacandanacarcitām | kavacaṃ te grahīṣyanti kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bhuje || 26 || paṭhiṣyanti ca vidvāṃsaḥ pūjākāle ca pūjite | ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa tāṃ devīṃ sarvapūjitām || 27 || tatastatpūjanaṃ cakurbrahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ | anantaścāpi dharmaśca munīndrāḥ sanakādayaḥ || 28 || sarve devāśca munayo nṛpāśca mānavādayaḥ | babhūva pūjitā nityaṃ sarvalokaiḥ sarasvatī || 29 || nārada uvāca pūjāvidhānaṃ kavacaṃ dhyānaṃ cāpi nirantaram | pūjopayuktaṃ naivedyaṃ puṣpaṃ ca candanādikam || 30 || vada vedavidāṃ śreṣṭha śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama | vartate hṛdaye śaśvatkimidaṃ śrutisundaram || 31 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi kaṇvaśākhoktapaddhatim | jaganmātuḥ sarasvatyāḥ pūjāvidhisamanvitām || 32 || māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ vidyārambhadine'pi ca | pūrve'hni samayaṃ kṛtvā tatrāhni saṃyataḥ śuciḥ || 33 || snātvā nityakriyāḥ kṛtvā ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ | svaśākhoktavidhānena tāntrikeṇāthavā punaḥ || 34 || gaṇeśaṃ pūrvamabhyarcya tato'bhīṣṭāṃ prapūjayet | dhyānena vakṣyamāṇena dhyātvā bāhyaghaṭe dhruvam || 35 || dhyātvā punaḥ ṣoḍaṣopacāreṇa pūjayed vratī | pūjopayuktaṃ naivedyaṃ yacca vedanirūpitam || 36 || vakṣyāmi saumya tatkiñcidyathādhītaṃ yathāgamam | navanītaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ lājāṃśca tilalaḍḍukam || 37 || ikṣumikṣurasaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ pañcaguḍaṃ madhu | svastikaṃ śarkarāṃ śukladhānyasyākṣatamakṣatam || 38 || acchinnaśukladhānyasya pṛthukaṃ śuklamodakam | ghṛtasaindhavasaṃyuktaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ yathoditam || 39 || yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ piṣṭakaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam | piṣṭakaṃ svastikasyāpi pakvarambhāphalasya ca || 40 || paramānnaṃ ca saghṛtaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam | nārikelaṃ tadudakaṃ kaseruṃ mūlamārdrakam || 41 || pakvarambhāphalaṃ cāru śrīphalaṃ badarīphalam | kāladeśodbhavaṃ cāru phalaṃ śuklaṃ ca saṃskatam || 42 || sugandhaṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ ca sugandhaṃ śuklacandanam | navīnaṃ śuklavastraṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca sundaraṃ mune || 43 || mālyaṃ ca śuklapuṣpāṇāṃ śuklahāraṃ ca bhūṣaṇam | yādṛśaṃ ca śrutau dhyānaṃ praśasyaṃ śrutisundaram || 44 || tannibodha mahābhāga bhramabhañjanakāraṇam | sarasvatīṃ śuklavarṇāṃ sasmitāṃ sumanoharām || 45 || koṭicandraprabhāmuṣṭapuṣṭaśrīyuktavigrahām | vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ vīṇāpustakadhāriṇīm || 46 || ratnasārendranirmāṇanavabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | supūjitāṃ suragaṇairbrahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ || 47 || vande bhaktyā vanditāṃ ca munīndramanumānavaiḥ | evaṃ dhyātvā ca mūlena sarvaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 48 || saṃstūya kavacaṃ dhṛtvā praṇameddaṇḍavadbhuvi | yeṣāṃ ceyamiṣṭadevī teṣāṃ nityakriyā mune || 49 || vidyārambhe ca varṣānte sarveṣāṃ pañcamīdine | sarvopayuktaṃ mūlaṃ ca vaidikāṣṭākṣaraḥ paraḥ || 50 || yeṣāṃ yenopadeśo vā teṣāṃ sa mūla eva ca | sarasvatī caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca || 51 || lakṣmīmāyādikaṃ caiva mantro'yaṃ kalpapādapaḥ | purā nārāyaṇaścemaṃ vālmīkāya kṛpānidhiḥ || 52 || pradadau jāhnavītīre puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate | bhṛgurdadau ca śukrāya puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi || 53 || candraparvaṇi mārīco dadau vākpataye mudā | bhṛgoścaiva dadau tuṣṭo brahmā badarikāśrame || 54 || āstikasya jaratkārurdadau kṣīrodasannidhau | vibhāṇḍako dadau merau ṛṣyaśṛṅgāya dhīmate || 55 || śivaḥ kaṇādamunaye gautamāya dadau mudā | sūryaśca yājñavalkyāya tathā kātyāyanāya ca || 56 || śeṣaḥ pāṇinaye caiva bhāradvājāya dhīmate | dadau śākaṭāyanāya sutale balisaṃsadi || 57 || caturlakṣajapenaiva mantraḥ siddho bhavennṛṇām | yadi syānmantrasiddho hi bṛhaspatisamo bhavet || 58 || kavacaṃ śṛṇu viprendra yaddattaṃ brahmaṇā purā | viśvasraṣṭā viśvajayaṃ bhṛgave gandhamādane || 59 || bhṛguruvāca brahmanbrahmavidāṃ śreṣṭha brahmajñānaviśārada | sarvajña sarvajanaka sarveśa sarvapūjita || 60 || sarasvatyāśca kavacaṃ brūhi viśvajayaṃ prabho | ayātayāmaṃ mantrāṇāṃ samūhasaṃyutaṃ param || 61 || brahmovāca śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ sarvakāmadam | śrutisāraṃ śrutisukhaṃ śrutyuktaṃ śrutipūjitam || 62 || uktaṃ kṛṣṇena goloke mahyaṃ vṛndāvane vane | rāseśvareṇa vibhunā rāse vai rāsamaṇḍale || 63 || atīva gopanīyaṃ ca kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ param | aśrutādbhutamantrāṇāṃ samūhaiśca samanvitam || 64 || yaddhṛtvā bhagavāñchukraḥ sarvadaityeṣu pūjitaḥ | yaddhṛtvā paṭhanād brahman buddhimāṃśca bṛhaspatiḥ || 65 || paṭhanāddhāraṇādvāgmī kavīndro vālmiko muniḥ | svāyambhuvo manuścaiva yaddhṛtvā sarvapūjitaḥ || 66 || kaṇādo gautamaḥ kaṇvaḥ pāṇiniḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ | grandhaṃ cakāra yaddhṛtvā dakṣaḥ kātyāyanaḥ svayam || 67 || dhṛtvā vedavibhāgaṃ ca purāṇānyakhilāni ca | cakāra līlāmātreṇa kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam || 68 || śātātapaśca saṃvarto vasiṣṭhaśca parāśaraḥ | yaddhṛtvā paṭhanād granthaṃ yājñavalkyaścakāra saḥ || 69 || ṛṣyaśṛṅgo bharadvājaścāstiko devalastathā | jaigīṣavyo yayātiśca dhṛtvā sarvatra pūjitāḥ || 70 || kavacasyāsya viprendra ṛṣireva prajāpatiḥ | svayaṃ chandaśca bṛhatī devatā śāradāmbikā || 71 || sarvatattvaparijñānasarvārthasādhaneṣu ca | kavitāsu ca sarvāsu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 72 || śrīṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāhā śiro me pātu sarvataḥ | śrīṃ vāgdevatāyai svāhā bhālaṃ me sarvadāvatu || 73 || oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāheti śrotre pātu nirantaram | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bhagavatyai sarasvatyai svāhā netrayugmaṃ sadāvatu || 74 || aiṃ hrīṃ vāgvādinyai svāhā nāsāṃ me sarvadāvatu | hrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā coṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu || 75 || oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ brāhmyai svāheti dantapaṃktiṃ sadāvatu | aimityekākṣaro mantro mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadāvatu || 76 || oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ pātu me grīvāṃ skandhau me śrīṃ sadāvatu | oṃ hrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā vakṣaḥ sadāvatu || 77 || oṃ hrīṃ vidyādhisvarūpāyai svāhā me pātu nābhikām | oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ vāṇyai svāheti mama hastau sadāvatu || 78 || oṃ sarvavarṇātmikāyai svāhā pādayugmaṃ sadāvatu | oṃ vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā sarvaṃ sadāvatu || 79 || oṃ sarvakaṇṭhavāsinyai svāhā prācyāṃ sadāvatu | oṃ sarvajihvāgravāsinyai svāhāgnidiśi rakṣatu || 80 || oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ sarasvatyai budhajananyai svāhā | satataṃ mantrarājo'yaṃ dakṣiṇe māṃ sadāvatu || 81 || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ tryakṣaro mantro nairṛtyāṃ sarvadāvatu | oṃ aiṃ jihvāgravāsinyai svāhā māṃ vāruṇe'vatu || 82 || oṃ sarvāmbikāyai svāhā vāyavye māṃ sadāvatu | oṃ aiṃ śrīṃ klīṃ gadyavāsinyai svāhā māmuttare'vatu || 83 || oṃ aiṃ sarvaśāstravāsinyai svāhaiśānyāṃ sadāvatu | oṃ hrīṃ sarvapūjitāyai svāhā cordhvaṃ sadāvatu || 84 || oṃ hrīṃ pustakavāsinyai svāhādho māṃ sadāvatu | oṃ granthabījasvarūpāyai svāhā māṃ sarvato'vatu || 85 || iti te kathitaṃ vipra brahmamantraughavigraham | idaṃ viśvajayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ brahmarūpakam || 86 || purā śrutaṃ dharmavaktrātparvate gandhamādane | tava snehānmayākhyātaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit || 87 || gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ | praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau kavacaṃ dhārayetsudhīḥ || 88 || pañcalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ tu kavacaṃ bhavet | yadi syātsiddhakavaco bṛhaspatisamo bhavet || 89 || mahāvāgmī kavīndraśca trailokyavijayī bhavet | śaknoti sarvaṃ jetuṃ ca kavacasya prasādataḥ || 90 || idaṃ ca kaṇvaśākhoktaṃ kavacaṃ kathitaṃ mune | stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ ca vandanaṃ śṛṇu || 91 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe sarasvatīstotrapūjākavacādivarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <9.5> yājñavalkyakṛtaṃ sarasvatīstotravarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vāgdevatāyāḥ stavanaṃ śrūyatāṃ sarvakāmadam | mahāmuniryājñavalkyo yena tuṣṭāva tāṃ purā || 1 || guruśāpājja sa munirhatavidyo babhūva ha | tadā jagāma duḥkhārto ravisthānaṃ supuṇyadam || 2 || samprāpya tapasā sūryaṃ lolārke dṛṣṭigocare | tuṣṭāva sūryaṃ śokena ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ || 3 || sūryastaṃ pāṭhayāmāsa vedaṃ vedāṅgamīśvaraḥ | uvāca stauhi vāgdevīṃ bhaktyā ca smṛtihetave || 4 || tamityuktvā dīnanātho'pyantardhānaṃ cakāra saḥ | muniḥ snātvā ca tuṣṭāva bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ || 5 || yājñavalkya uvāca kṛpāṃ kuru jaganmātarmāmevaṃ hatatejasam | guruśāpātsmṛtibhraṣṭaṃ vidyāhīnaṃ ca duḥkhitam || 6 || jñānaṃ dehi smṛtiṃ vidyāṃ śaktiṃ śiṣyaprabodhinīm | granthakartṛtvaśaktiṃ ca suśiṣyaṃ supratiṣṭhitam || 7 || pratibhāṃ satsabhāyāṃ ca vicārakṣamatāṃ śubhām | luptaṃ sarvaṃ daivayogānnavībhūtaṃ punaḥ kuru || 8 || yathāṅkuraṃ bhasmani ca karoti devatā punaḥ | brahmasvarūpā paramā jyotīrūpā sanātanī || 9 || sarvavidyādhidevī yā tasyai vāṇyai namo namaḥ | visargabindumātrāsu yadadhiṣṭhānameva ca || 10 || tadadhiṣṭhātrī yā devī tasyai nityai namo namaḥ | vyākhyāsvarūpā sā devī vyākhyādhiṣṭhātṛrūpiṇī || 11 || yayā vinā prasaṃkhyāvān saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate | kālasaṃkhyāsvarūpā yā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ || 12 || bhramasiddhāntarūpā yā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ | smṛtiśaktijñānaśaktibuddhiśaktisvarūpiṇī || 13 || pratibhākalpanāśaktiryā ca tasyai namo namaḥ | sanatkumāro brahmāṇaṃ jñānaṃ papraccha yatra vai || 14 || babhūva mūkavatso'pi siddhāntaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ | tadā''jagāma bhagavānātmā śrīkṛṣṇa īśvaraḥ || 15 || uvāca sa tāṃ stauhi vāṇīmiṣṭāṃ prajāpate | sa ca tuṣṭāva tāṃ brahmā cājñayā paramātmanaḥ || 16 || cakāra tatprasādena tadā siddhāntamuttamam | yadāpyanantaṃ papraccha jñānamekaṃ vasundharā || 17 || babhūva mūkavatso'pi siddhāntaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ | tadā tāṃ sa ca tuṣṭāva saṃtrastaḥ kaśyapājñayā || 18 || tataścakāra siddhāntaṃ nirmalaṃ bhramabhañjanam | vyāsaḥ purāṇasūtraṃ ca papraccha vālmikiṃ yadā || 19 || maunībhūtaśca sasmāra tāmeva jagadambikām | tadā cakāra siddhāntaṃ tadvareṇa munīśvaraḥ || 20 || samprāpya nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ bhramāndhadhvaṃsadīpakam | purāṇasūtraṃ śrutvā ca vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇakalodbhavaḥ || 21 || tāṃ śivāṃ veda dadhyau ca śatavarṣaṃ ca puṣkare | tadā tvatto varaṃ prāpya satkavīndro babhūva ha || 22 || tadā vedavibhāgaṃ ca purāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ | yadā mahendraḥ papraccha tattvajñānaṃ sadāśivam || 23 || kṣaṇaṃ tāmeva sañcintya tasmai jñānaṃ dadau vibhuḥ | papraccha śabdaśāstraṃ ca mahendraśca bṛhaspatim || 24 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca sa tvāṃ dadhyau ca puṣkare | tadā tvatto varaṃ prāpya divyavarṣasahasrakam || 25 || uvāca śabdaśāstraṃ ca tadarthaṃ ca sureśvaram | adhyāpitāśca ye śiṣyā yairadhītaṃ munīśvaraiḥ || 26 || te ca tāṃ parisañcintya pravartante sureśvarīm | tvaṃ saṃstutā pūjitā ca munīndrairmanumānavaiḥ || 27 || daityendraiśca suraiścāpi brahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ | jaḍībhūtaḥ sahasrāsyaḥ pañcavaktraścaturmukhaḥ || 28 || yāṃ stotuṃ kimahaṃ staumi tāmekāsyena mānavaḥ | ityuktvā yājñavalkyaśca bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ || 29 || praṇanāma nirāhāro ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ | jyotīrūpā mahāmāyā tena dṛṣṭāpyuvāca tam || 30 || sukavīndro bhavetyuktvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jagāma ha | yājñavalkyakṛtaṃ vāṇīstotrametattu yaḥ paṭhet || 31 || sa kavīndro mahāvāgmī bṛhaspatisamo bhavet | mahāmūrkhaśca durbuddhirvarṣamekaṃ yadā paṭhet || 32 || sa paṇḍitaśca medhāvī sukavīndro bhave dhruvam || 33 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe yājñavalkyakṛtaṃ sarasvatīstotravarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <9.6> lakṣmīgaṅgāsarasvatīnāṃ bhūloke'vataraṇavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sarasvatī tu vaikuṇṭhe svayaṃ nārāyaṇāntike | gaṅgāśāpena kalahātkalayā bhārate sarit || 1 || puṇyadā puṇyarūpā ca puṇyatīrthasvarūpiṇī | puṇyavadbhirniṣevyā ca sthitiḥ puṇyavatāṃ mune || 2 || tapasvināṃ taporūpā tapasaḥ phalarūpiṇī | kṛtapāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagnisvarūpiṇī || 3 || jñānātsarasvatītoye mṛtā ye mānavā bhuvi | teṣāṃ sthitiśca vaikuṇṭhe suciraṃ harisaṃsadi || 4 || bhārate kṛtapāpaśca snātvā tatra ca līlayā | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke vasecciram || 5 || cāturmāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmakṣayāyāṃ dinakṣaye | vyatīpāte ca grahaṇe'nyasminpuṇyadine'pi ca || 6 || anuṣaṅgeṇa yaḥ snāto hetunā śraddhayāpi vā | sārūpyaṃ labhate nūnaṃ vaikuṇṭhe sa harerapi || 7 || sarasvatīmanuṃ tatra māsamekaṃ ca yo japet | mahāmūrkhaḥ kavīndraśca sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ || 8 || nityaṃ sarasvatītoye yaḥ snāyānmuṇḍayannaraḥ | na garbhavāsaṃ kurute punareva sa mānavaḥ || 9 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ kiñcidbhāratīguṇakīrtanam | sukhadaṃ kāmadaṃ sāraṃ bhūyaḥ kiṃ śrotumicchasi || 10 || sūta uvāca nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā nārado munisattamaḥ | punaḥ papraccha sandehamimaṃ śaunaka satvaram || 11 || nārada uvāca kathaṃ sarasvatī devī gaṅgāśāpena bhārate | kalayā kalahenaiva babhūva puṇyadā sarit || 12 || śravaṇe śrutisārāṇāṃ vardhate kautukaṃ mama | kathāmṛtena me tṛptiḥ kena śreyasi tṛpyate || 13 || kathaṃ śaśāpa sā gaṅgā pūjitāṃ tāṃ sarasvatīm | sā tu sattvasvarūpā yā puṇyadā śubhadā sadā || 14 || tejasvinordvayorvādakāraṇaṃ śrutisundaram | sudurlabhaṃ purāṇeṣu tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 15 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm | yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpātpramucyate || 16 || lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṅgā tisro bhāryā harerapi | premṇā samāstāstiṣṭhanti satataṃ harisannidhau || 17 || cakāra saikadā gaṅgā viṣṇormukhanirīkṣaṇam | sasmitā ca sakāmā ca sakaṭākṣaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 18 || vibhurjahāsa tadvaktraṃ nirīkṣya ca kṣaṇaṃ tadā | kṣamāṃ cakāra tad dṛṣṭvā lakṣmīrnaiva sarasvatī || 19 || bodhayāmāsa padmā tāṃ sattvarūpā ca sasmitā | krodhāviṣṭā ca sā vāṇī na ca śāntā babhūva ha || 20 || uvāca vāṇī bhartāraṃ raktāsyā raktalocanā | kupitā kāmavegena śaśvatprasphuritādharā || 21 || sarasvatyuvāca sarvatra samatābuddhiḥ sadbhartuḥ kāminīṃ prati | dharmiṣṭhasya variṣṭhasya viparītā khalasya ca || 22 || jñātaṃ saubhāgyamadhikaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ te gadādhara | kamalāyāṃ ca tattulyaṃ na ca kiñcinmayi prabho || 23 || gaṅgāyāḥ padmayā sārdhaṃ prītiścāsti susammatā | kṣamāṃ cakāra tenedaṃ viparītaṃ haripriyā || 24 || kiṃ jīvanena me'traiva durbhagāyāśca sāmpratam | niṣkalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasyā yā patyuḥ premavañcitā || 25 || tvāṃ sarve sattvarūpaṃ ca ye vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | te ca mūrkhā na vedajñā na jānanti matiṃ tava || 26 || sarasvatīvacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kopasaṃyutām | manasā ca samālocya sa jagāma bahiḥ sabhām || 27 || gate nārāyaṇe gaṅgāmuvāca nirbhayaṃ ruṣā | vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā vākyaṃ śravaṇaduṣkaram || 28 || he nirlajje he sakāme svāmigarvaṃ karoṣi kim | adhikaṃ svāmisaubhāgyaṃ vijñāpayitumicchasi || 29 || mānacūrṇaṃ kariṣyāmi tavādya harisannidhau | kiṃ kariṣyati te kānto mamaivaṃ kāntavallabhe || 30 || ityevamuktvā gaṅgāyāḥ keśaṃ grahītumudyatā | vārayāmāsa tāṃ padmā madhyadeśaṃ samāśritā || 31 || śaśāpa vāṇī tāṃ padmāṃ mahābalavatī satī | vṛkṣarūpā saridrūpā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 32 || viparītaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā kiñcinno vaktumarhasi | santiṣṭhati sabhāmadhye yathā vṛkṣo yathā sarit || 33 || śāpaṃ śrutvā tu sā devī na śaśāpa cukopa ha | tatraiva duḥkhitā tasthau vāṇīṃ dhṛtvā kareṇa ca || 34 || asantuṣṭāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kopaprasphuritādharām | uvāca gaṅgā tāṃ devīṃ padmāṃ cāraktalocanām || 35 || gaṅgovāca tvamutsṛja mahogrāṃ ca padme kiṃ me kariṣyati | duḥśīlā mukharā naṣṭā nityaṃ vācālarūpiṇī || 36 || vāgadhiṣṭhātrī devīyaṃ satataṃ kalahapriyā | yāvatī yogyatā cāsyā yāvatī śaktireva ca || 37 || tathā karotu vādaṃ ca mayā sārdhaṃ ca durmukhī | svabalaṃ yanmama balaṃ vijñāpayitumicchati || 38 || jānantu sarve hyubhayoḥ prabhāvaṃ vikramaṃ sati | ityevamuktvā sā devī vāṇyai śāpaṃ dadāviti || 39 || sariktyarūpā bhavatu sā yā tvāṃ ca śaśāpa ha | adhomartyaṃ sā prayātu santi yatraiva pāpinaḥ || 40 || kalau teṣāṃ ca pāpāni grahīṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tāṃ śaśāpa sarasvatī || 41 || tvameva yāsyasi mahīṃ pāpipāpaṃ labhiṣyasi | etasminnantare tatra bhagavānājagāma ha || 42 || caturbhujaścaturbhiśca pārṣadaiśca caturbhujaiḥ | sarasvatīṃ kare dhṛtvā vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi || 43 || bodhayāmāsa sarvajñaḥ sarvajñānaṃ purātanam | śrutvā rahasyaṃ tāsāṃ ca śāpasya kalahasya ca || 44 || uvāca duḥkhitāstāśca vācaṃ sāmayikīṃ vibhuḥ | śrībhagavānuvāca lakṣmi tvaṃ kalayā gaccha dharmadhvajagṛhaṃ śubhe || 45 || ayonisambhavā bhūmau tasya kanyā bhaviṣyasi | tatraiva daivadoṣeṇa vṛkṣatvaṃ ca labhiṣyasi || 46 || madaṃśasyāsurasyaiva śaṅkhacūḍasya kāminī | bhūtvā paścācca matpatnī bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 47 || trailokyapāvanī nāmnā tulasīti ca bhārate | kalayā ca saridbhāvaṃ śīghraṃ gaccha varānane || 48 || bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpānnāmnā padmāvatī bhava | gaṅge yāsyasi paścāttvamaṃśena viśvapāvanī || 49 || bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātpāpadāhāya pāpinām | bhagīrathasya tapasā tena nītā sukalpite || 50 || nāmnā bhāgīrathī pūtā bhaviṣyasi mahītale | madaṃśasya samudrasya jāyā jāyermamājñayā || 51 || matkalāṃśasya bhūpasya śantanośca sureśvari | gaṅgāśāpena kalayā bhārataṃ gaccha bhārati || 52 || kalahasya phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva sapatnībhyāṃ sahācyute | svayaṃ ca brahmasadane brahmaṇaḥ kāminī bhava || 53 || gaṅgā yātu śivasthānamatra padmaiva tiṣṭhatu | śāntā ca krodharahitā madbhaktā sattvarūpiṇī || 54 || mahāsādhvī mahābhāgā suśīlā dharmacāriṇī | yadaṃśakalayā sarvā dharmiṣṭhāśca pativratāḥ || 55 || śāntarūpāḥ suśīlāśca prativiśveṣu pūjitāḥ | tisro bhāryāstriśīlāśca trayo bhṛtyāśca bāndhavāḥ || 56 || dhruvaṃ vedaviruddhāśca na hyete maṅgalapradāḥ | strīpuṃvacca gṛhe yeṣāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ strīvaśaḥ pumān || 57 || niṣphalaṃ ca janma teṣāmaśubhaṃ ca pade pade | mukhe duṣṭā yoniduṣṭā yasya strī kalahapriyā || 58 || araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ gṛhādvaram | jalānāṃ ca sthalānāṃ ca phalānāṃ prāptireva ca || 59 || satataṃ sulabhā tatra na teṣāṃ gṛha eva ca | varamagnau sthitirhiṃsrajantūnāṃ sannidhau sukham || 60 || tato'pi duḥkhaṃ puṃsāṃ ca duṣṭastrīsannidhau dhruvam | vyādhijvālā viṣajvālā varaṃ puṃsāṃ varānane || 61 || duṣṭastrīṇāṃ mukhajvālā maraṇādatiricyate | puṃsāṃ ca strījitāṃ caiva bhasmāntaṃ śaucamadhruvam || 62 || yadahni kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet | nindito'tra paratraiva sarvatra narakaṃ vrajet || 63 || yaśaḥkīrtivihīno yo jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ | bahvīnāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ naikatra śreyase sthitiḥ || 64 || ekabhāryaḥ sukhī naiva bahubhāryaḥ kadācana | gaccha gaṅge śivasthānaṃ brahmasthānaṃ sarasvati || 65 || atra tiṣṭhatu madgehe suśīlā kamalālayā | susādhyā yasya patnī ca suśīlā ca pativratā || 66 || iha svarge sukhaṃ tasya dharmo mokṣaḥ paratra ca | pativratā yasya patnī sa ca muktaḥ śuciḥ sukhī | jīvanmṛto'śucirduḥkhī duḥśīlāpatireva ca || 67 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe lakṣmīgaṅgāsarasvatīnāṃ bhūloke'vataraṇavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <9.7> gaṅgādīnāṃ śāpoddhāravarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho virarāma ca nārada | atīva rurudurdevyaḥ samāliṅgya parasparam || 1 || tāśca sarvāḥ samālokya krameṇocustadeśvaram | kampitāḥ sāśrunetrāśca śokena ca bhayena ca || 2 || sarasvatyuvāca viśāpaṃ dehi he nātha duṣṭamājanmaśocanam | satsvāminā parityaktāḥ kuto jīvanti tāḥ striyaḥ || 3 || dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi yogena bhārate dhruvam | atyunnato hi niyataṃ pātumarhati niścitam || 4 || gaṅgovāca ahaṃ kenāparādhena tvayā tyaktā jagatpate | dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi nirdoṣāyā vadhaṃ labha || 5 || nirdoṣakāminītyāgaṃ karoti yo naro bhuvi | sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ kintu sarveśvaro'pi vā || 6 || padmovāca nātha sattvasvarūpastvaṃ kopaḥ kathamaho tava | prasādaṃ kuru bhārye dve sadīśasya kṣamā varā || 7 || bhārate bhāratīśāpādyāsyāmi kalayā hyaham | kiyatkālaṃ sthitistatra kadā drakṣyāmi te padam || 8 || dāsyanti pāpinaḥ pāpaṃ sadyaḥ snānāvagāhanāt | kena tena vimuktāhamāgamiṣyāmi te padam || 9 || kalayā tulasīrūpaṃ dharmadhvajasutā satī | bhuktvā kadā labhiṣyāmi tvatpādāmbujamacyuta || 10 || vṛkṣarūpā bhaviṣyāmi tvadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā | samuddhariṣyasi kadā tanme brūhi kṛpānidhe || 11 || gaṅgā sarasvatīśāpādyadi yāsyati bhārate | śāpena muktā pāpācca kadā tvāṃ ca labhiṣyati || 12 || gaṅgāśāpena vā vāṇī yadi yāsyati bhāratam | kadā śāpādvinirmucya labhiṣyati padaṃ tava || 13 || tāṃ vāṇīṃ brahmasadanaṃ gaṅgāṃ vā śivamandiram | gantuṃ vadasi he nātha tatkṣamasva ca te vacaḥ || 14 || ityuktvā kamalā kāntapādaṃ dhṛtvā nanāma sā | svakeśairveṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ || 15 || (uvāca padmanābhastāṃ padmāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyo bhaktānugrahakātaraḥ ||) || śrībhagavānuvāca tvadvākyamācariṣyāmi svavākyaṃ ca sureśvari | samatāṃ ca kariṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ kamalekṣaṇe || 16 || bhāratī yātu kalayā saridrūpā ca bhārate | ardhā sā brahmasadanaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe || 17 || bhagīrathena sā nītā gaṅgā yāsyati bhārate | pūtaṃ kartuṃ tribhuvanaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe || 18 || tatraiva candramauleśca mauliṃ prāpsyati durlabham | tataḥ svabhāvataḥ pūtāpyatipūtā bhaviṣyati || 19 || kalāṃśāṃśena gaccha tvaṃ bhārate vāmalocane | padmāvatī saridrūpā tulasīvṛkṣarūpiṇī || 20 || kaleḥ pañcasahasre ca gate varṣe tu mokṣaṇam | yuṣmākaṃ saritāṃ caiva madgehe cāgamiṣyatha || 21 || sampadā hetubhūtā ca vipattiḥ sarvadehinām | vinā vipattermahimā keṣāṃ padmabhave bhavet || 22 || manmantropāsakānāṃ ca satāṃ snānāvagāhanāt | yuṣmākaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pāpāddarśanātsparśanāttathā || 23 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni santyasaṃkhyāni sundari | bhaviṣyanti ca pūtāni madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 24 || manmantropāsakā bhaktā vibhramanti ca bhārate | pūtaṃ kartuṃ tārituṃ ca supavitrāṃ vasundharām || 25 || madbhaktā yatra tiṣṭhanti pādaṃ prakṣālayanti ca | tatsthānaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ supavitraṃ bhaveddhruvam || 26 || strīghno goghnaḥ kṛtaghnaśca brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ | jīvanmukto bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 27 || ekādaśīvihīnaśca sandhyāhīno'tha nāstikaḥ | naraghātī bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 28 || asijīvī masījīvī dhāvako grāmayācakaḥ | vṛṣavāho bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 29 || viśvāsaghātī mitraghno mithyāsākṣyasya dāyakaḥ | sthāpyāhārī bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 30 || atyugravāndūṣakaśca jārakaḥ puṃścalīpatiḥ | pūtaśca vṛṣalīputro madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 31 || śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca devalo grāmayājakaḥ | adīkṣito bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 32 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhāryāṃ bhrātaraṃ tanayaṃ sutām | guroḥ kulaṃ ca bhaginīṃ cakṣurhīnaṃ ca bāndhavam || 33 || śvaśrūṃ ca śvaśuraṃ caiva yo na puṣṇāti sundari | sa mahāpātakī pūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 34 || aśvatthanāśakaścaiva madbhaktanindakastathā | śūdrānnabhojī vipraśca pūto madbhaktadarśanāt || 35 || devadravyāpahārī ca vipradravyāpahārakaḥ | lākṣāloharasānāṃ ca vikretā duhitustathā || 36 || mahāpātakinaścaiva śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakaḥ | bhaveyurete pūtāśca madbhaktasparśadarśanāt || 37 || mahālakṣmīruvāca bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi bhaktānugrahakātara | yeṣāṃ tu darśanasparśātsadyaḥ pūtā narādhamāḥ || 38 || haribhaktivihīnāśca mahāhaṅkārasaṃyutaḥ | svapraśaṃsāratā dhūrtāḥ śaṭhāśca sādhunindakāḥ || 39 || punanti sarvatīrthāni yeṣāṃ snānāvagāhanāt | yeṣāṃ ca pādarajasā pūtā pādodakānmahī || 40 || yeṣāṃ saṃdarśanaṃ sparśaṃ ye vā vāñchanti bhārate | sarveṣāṃ paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ || 41 || na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ | te punantyapi kālena viṣṇubhaktāḥ kṣaṇādaho || 42 || sūta uvāva mahālakṣmīvacaḥ śrutvā lakṣmīkāntaśca sasmitaḥ | nigūḍhatattvaṃ kathitumapi śreṣṭhopacakrame || 43 || śrībhagavānuvāca bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmi gūḍhaṃ śrutipurāṇayoḥ | puṇyasvarūpaṃ pāpaghnaṃ sukhadaṃ bhuktimuktidam || 44 || sārabhūtaṃ gopanīyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ khaleṣu ca | tvāṃ pavitrāṃ prāṇatulyāṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya || 45 || guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe patiṣyati | vadanti vedāstaṃ cāpi pavitraṃ ca narottamam || 46 || puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ tathā tajjanmamātrataḥ | svargasthaṃ narakasthaṃ vā muktimāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt || 47 || yaiḥ kaiścidyatra vā janma labdhaṃ yeṣu ca jantuṣu | jīvanmuktāstu te pūtā yānti kāle hareḥ padam || 48 || madbhaktiyukto martyaśca sa mukto madguṇānvitaḥ | madguṇādhīnavṛttiryaḥ kathāviṣṭaśca santatam || 49 || madguṇaśrutimātreṇa sānandaḥ pulakānvitaḥ | sagadgadaḥ sāśrunetraḥ svātmavismṛta eva ca || 50 || na vāñchati sukhaṃ muktiṃ sālokyādicatuṣṭayam | brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tadvāñchā mama sevane || 51 || indratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca brahmatvaṃ ca sudurlabham | svargarājyādibhogaṃ ca svapne'pi ca na vāñchati || 52 || bhramanti bhārate bhaktāstādṛgjanma sudurlabham | madguṇaśravaṇāḥ śrāvyagānairnityaṃ mudānvitāḥ || 53 || te yānti ca mahīṃ pūtvā naraṃ tīrthaṃ mamālayam | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ padme kuru yathocitam | tadājñayā tāstaccakrurharistasthau sukhāsane || 54 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpūrāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ navamaskandhe gaṅgādīnāṃ śāpoddhāravarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <9.8> nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde kalimāhātmyavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sarasvatī puṇyakṣetramājagāma ca bhārate | gaṅgāśāpena kalayā svayaṃ tasthau hareḥ pade || 1 || bhāratī bhārataṃ gatvā brāhmī ca brahmaṇaḥ priyā | vāṇyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā tena vāṇī prakīrtitā || 2 || saro vāpyāṃ ca srotastu sarvatraiva hi dṛśyate | hariḥ sarasvāṃstasyeyaṃ tena nāmnā sarasvatī || 3 || sarasvatī nadī sā ca tīrtharūpātipāvanī | pāpināṃ pāpadāhāya jvaladagnisvarūpiṇī || 4 || paścādbhāgīrathī nītā mahīṃ bhagīrathena ca | sā vai jagāma kalayā vāṇīśāpena nārada || 5 || tatraiva samaye tāṃ ca dadhāra śirasā śivaḥ | vegaṃ soḍhumayaṃ śakto bhuvaḥ prārthanayā vibhuḥ || 6 || padmā jagāma kalayā sā ca padmāvatī nadī | bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātsvayaṃ tasthau hareḥ pade || 7 || tato'nyayā sā kalayā lebhe janma ca bhārate | dharmadhvajasutā lakṣmīrvikhyātā tulasīti ca || 8 || purā sarasvatīśāpātpaścācca hariśāpataḥ | babhūva vṛkṣarūpā sā kalayā viśvapāvanī || 9 || kaleḥ pañcasahasraṃ ca varṣaṃ sthitvā tu bhārate | jagmustāśca saridrūpaṃ vihāya śrīhareḥ padam || 10 || yāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni kāśīṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vinā | yāsyanti sārdhaṃ tābhiśca vaikuṇṭhamājñayā hareḥ || 11 || śālagrāmaḥ śaktiśivau jagannāthaśca bhāratam | kalerdaśasahasrānte tyaktvā yānti nijaṃ padam || 12 || sādhavaśca purāṇāni śaṅkhāni śrāddhatarpaṇe | vedoktāni ca karmāṇi yayustaiḥ sārdhameva ca || 13 || devapūjā devanāma tatkīrtiguṇakīrtanam | vedāṅgāni ca śāstrāṇi yayustaiḥ sārdhameva ca || 14 || santaśca satyadharmaśca vedāśca grāmadevatāḥ | vrataṃ tapaścānaśanaṃ yayustaiḥ sārdhameva ca || 15 || vāmācāraratāḥ sarve mithyākapaṭasaṃyutāḥ | tulasīrahitā pūjā bhaviṣyati tataḥ param || 16 || śaṭhāḥ krūrā dāmbhikāśca mahāhaṅkārasaṃyutāḥ | corāśca hiṃsakāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param || 17 || puṃso bhedaḥ strīvibhedo vivāho vāpi nirbhayaḥ | svasvāmibhedo vastūnāṃ bhaviṣyati tataḥ param || 18 || sarve strīvaśagāḥ puṃsaḥ puścalyaśca gṛhe gṛhe | tarjanairbhartsanaiḥ śaśvatsvāminaṃ tāḍayanti ca || 19 || gṛheśvarī ca gṛhiṇī gṛhī bhṛtyādhiko'dhamaḥ | ceṭīdāsasamau vadhvāḥ śvaśrūśca śvaśurastathā || 20 || kartāro balino gehe yonisambandhibāndhavāḥ | vidyāsambandhibhiḥ sārdhaṃ sambhāṣāpi na vidyate || 21 || yathāparicitā lokāstathā puṃsaśca bāndhavāḥ | sarvakarmākṣamāḥ puṃso yoṣitāmājñayā vinā || 22 || brahmakṣatraviśaḥ śūdrā jātyācāravivarjitāḥ | sandhyā ca yajñasūtraṃ ca bhavelluptaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 23 || mlecchācārā bhaviṣyanti varṇāścatvāra eva ca | mlecchaśāstraṃ paṭhiṣyanti svaśāstrāṇi vihāya ca || 24 || brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vaṃśāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ sevakāḥ kalau | sūpakārā dhāvakāśca vṛṣavāhāśca sarvaśaḥ || 25 || satyahīnā janāḥ sarve sasyahīnā ca medinī | phalahīnāśca taravo'patyahīnāśca yoṣitaḥ || 26 || kṣīrahīnāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirvivarjitam | dampatī prītihīnau ca gṛhiṇaḥ satyavarjitāḥ || 27 || pratāpahīnā bhūpāśca prajāśca karapīḍitāḥ | jalahīnā mahānadyo dīrghikākandarādayaḥ || 28 || dharmahīnā puṇyahīnā varṇāścatvāra eva ca | lakṣeṣu puṇyavānko'pi na tiṣṭhati tataḥ param || 29 || kutsitā vikṛtākārā narā nāryaśca bālakāḥ | kuvārtā kutsitaḥ śabdo bhaviṣyati tataḥ param || 30 || kecidgrāmāśca nagarā naraśūnyā bhayānakāḥ | kecitsvalpakuṭīreṇa nareṇa ca samanvitāḥ || 31 || araṇyāni bhaviṣyanti grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca | araṇyavāsinaḥ sarve janāśca karapīḍitāḥ || 32 || sasyāni ca bhaviṣyanti taḍāgeṣu nadīṣu ca | prakṛṣṭavaṃśajā hīnā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 33 || alīkavādino dhūrtāḥ śaṭhāścāsatyavādinaḥ | prakṛṣṭāni ca kṣetrāṇi sasyahīnāni nārada || 34 || hīnāḥ prakṛṣṭā dhanino devabhaktāśca nāstikāḥ | hiṃsakāśca dayāhīnā paurāśca naraghātinaḥ || 35 || vāmanā vyādhiyuktāśca narā nāryaśca sarvataḥ | svalpāyuṣo gadāyuktā yauvanai rahitāḥ kalau || 36 || palitāḥ ṣoḍaśe varṣe mahāvṛddhāśca viṃśatau | aṣṭavarṣā ca yuvatī rajoyuktā ca garbhiṇī || 37 || vatsarāntaprasūtā strī ṣoḍaśe ca jarānvitā | patiputravatī kācitsarvā vandhyāḥ kalau yuge || 38 || kanyāvikrayiṇaḥ sarve varṇāścatvāra eva ca | mātṛjāyāvadhūnāṃ ca jāropetānnabhakṣakāḥ || 39 || kanyānāṃ bhaginīnāṃ vā jāropāttānajīvinaḥ | harernāmnāṃ vikrayiṇo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 40 || svayamutsṛjya dānaṃ ca kīrtivardhanahetave | tataḥ paścātsvadānaṃ ca svayamullaṅghayiṣyati || 41 || devavṛttiṃ brahmavattiṃ vṛttiṃ gurukulasya ca | svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā sarvamullaṅghayiṣyati || 42 || kanyakāgāminaḥ kecitkecicca śvaśrugāminaḥ | kecidvadhūgāminaśca kecidvai sarvagāminaḥ || 43 || bhaginīgāminaḥ kecitsapatnīmātṛgāminaḥ | bhrātṛjāyāgāminaśca bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 44 || agamyāgamanaṃ caiva kariṣyanti gṛhe gṛhe | mātṛyoniṃ parityajya vihariṣyanti sarvataḥ || 45 || patnīnāṃ nirṇayo nāsti bhartṝṇāṃ ca kalau yuge | prajānāṃ caiva grāmāṇāṃ vastunāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 46 || alīkavādinaḥ sarve sarve caurāśca lampaṭāḥ | parasparaṃ hiṃsakāśca sarve ca naraghātinaḥ || 47 || brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vaṃśā bhaviṣyanti ca pāpinaḥ | lākṣā loharasānāṃ ca vyāpāraṃ lavaṇasya ca || 48 || vṛṣavāhā vipravaṃśāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhinaḥ | śūdrānnabhojinaḥ sarve sarve ca vṛṣalīratāḥ || 49 || pañcayajñavihīnāśca kuhūrātrau ca bhojinaḥ | yajñasūtravihīnāśca saṃdhyāśaucavihīnakāḥ || 50 || puṃścalī vārdhuṣājīvā kuṭṭanī ca rajasvalā | viprāṇāṃ randhanāgāre bhaviṣyati ca pācikā || 51 || annānāṃ niyamo nāsti yonīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | āśramāṇāṃ janānāṃ ca sarve mlecchāḥ kalau yuge || 52 || evaṃ kalau sampravṛtte sarvaṃ mlecchamayaṃ bhavet | hastapramāṇe vṛkṣe ca aṅguṣṭhe caiva mānave || 53 || viprasya viṣṇuyaśasaḥ putraḥ kalkirbhaviṣyati | nārāyaṇakalāṃśaśca bhagavān balināṃ varaḥ || 54 || dīrgheṇa karavālena dīrghaghoṭakavāhanaḥ | mlecchaśūnyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ trirātreṇa kariṣyati || 55 || nirmlecchāṃ vasudhāṃ kṛtvā cāntardhānaṃ kariṣyati | arājakā ca vasudhā dasyugrastā bhaviṣyati || 56 || sthūlāpramāṇā ṣaḍrātraṃ varṣadhārā''plutā mahī | lokaśūnyā vṛkṣaśūnyā gṛhaśūnyā bhaviṣyati || 57 || tataśca dvādaśādityāḥ kariṣyantyudayaṃ mune | prāpnoti śuṣkatāṃ pṛthvī samā teṣāṃ ca tejasā || 58 || kalau gate ca durdharṣe pravṛtte ca kṛte yuge | tapaḥsattvasamāyukto dharmaḥ pūrṇo bhaviṣyati || 59 || tapasvinaśca dharmiṣṭhā vedajñā brāhmaṇā bhuvi | pativratāśca dharmiṣṭhā yoṣitaśca gṛhe gṛhe || 60 || rājānaḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve viprabhaktā manasvinaḥ | pratāpavanto dharmiṣṭhāḥ puṇyakarmaratāḥ sadā || 61 || vaiśyā vāṇijyaniratā viprabhaktāśca dhārmikāḥ | śūdrāśca puṇyaśīlāśca dharmiṣṭhā viprasevinaḥ || 62 || viprakṣatraviśāṃ vaṃśā devībhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | devīmantraratāḥ sarve devīdhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || 63 || śrutismṛtipurāṇajñāḥ pumāṃsa ṛtugāminaḥ | leśo nāsti hyadharmasya pūrṇo dharmaḥ kṛte yuge || 64 || dharmastripācca tretāyāṃ dvipācca dvāpare tataḥ | kalau vṛtte caikapācca sarvaluptistataḥ param || 65 || vārāḥ sapta tathā vipra tithayaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ | tathā dvādaśa māsāśca ṛtavaśca ṣaḍeva ca || 66 || dvau pakṣau cāyane dve ca caturbhiḥ praharairdinam | caturbhiḥ praharai rātrirmāsastriṃśaddinaistathā || 67 || varṣaṃ pañcavidhaṃ jñeyaṃ kālasaṃkhyāvidhikrame | yathā cāyānti yāntyeva yathā yugacatuṣṭayam || 68 || varṣe pūrṇe narāṇāṃ ca devānāṃ ca divāniśam | śatatraye ṣaṣṭhyadhike narāṇāṃ ca yuge gate || 69 || devānāṃ ca yugaṃ jñeyaṃ kālasaṃkhyāvidāṃ matam | manvantaraṃ tu divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ || 70 || manvantarasamaṃ jñeyamāyuṣyañca śacīpateḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatime cendre gate brahmadivāniśam || 71 || aṣṭottaraśate varṣe gate pātaśca brahmaṇaḥ | pralayaḥ prākṛto jñeyastatrādṛṣṭā vasundharā || 72 || jalaplutāni viśvāni brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ | ṛṣayo jñāninaḥ sarve līnāḥ satye cidātmani || 73 || tatraiva prakṛtirlīnā tatra prākṛtiko layaḥ | laye prākṛtike jāte pāte ca brahmaṇo mune || 74 || nimeṣamātraṃ kālaśca śrīdevyāḥ procyate mune | evaṃ naśyanti sarvāṇi brahmāṇḍānyakhilāni ca || 75 || nimeṣāntarakālena punaḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇa ca | evaṃ katividhā sṛṣṭirlayaḥ katividho'pi vā || 76 || kati kalpā gatāyātāḥ saṃkhyāṃ jānāti kaḥ pumān | sṛṣṭīnāṃ ca layānāṃ ca brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca nārada || 77 || brahmādīnāṃ ca brahmāṇḍe saṃkhyāṃ jānāti kaḥ pumān | brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca sarveṣāmīśvaraścaika eva saḥ || 78 || sarveṣāṃ paramātmā ca saccidānandarūpadhṛk | brahmādayaśca tasyāṃśāstasyāṃśaśca mahāvirāṭ || 79 || tasyāṃśaśca virāṭ kṣudraḥ saiveyaṃ prakṛtiḥ parā | tasyāḥ sakāśātsañjāto'pyardhanārīśvarastataḥ || 80 || saiva kṛṣṇo dvidhābhūto dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ | caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam || 81 || brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtikaṃ bhavet | yadyatprākṛtikaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva ca || 82 || evaṃvidhaṃ sṛṣṭihetuṃ satyaṃ nityaṃ sanātanam | svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param || 83 || nirupādhi nirākāraṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram | karoti brahmā brahmāṇḍaṃ yajjñānātkamalodbhavaḥ || 84 || śivo mṛtyujjayaścaiva saṃhartā sarvasattvavit | yajjñānādyasya tapasā sarveśastu tapo mahān|| 85 || mahāvibhūtiyuktaśca sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ | sarvavyāpī sarvapātā pradātā sarvasampadām || 86 || viṣṇuḥ sarveśvaraḥ śrīmān yadbhaktyā yasya sevayā | mahāmāyā ca prakṛtiḥ sarvaśaktimayīśvarī || 87 || saiva proktā bhagavatī saccidānandarūpiṇī | yajjñānādyasya tapasā yadbhaktyā yasya sevayā || 88 || sāvitrī devamātā ca vedādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā | pūjyā dvijānāṃ vedajñā yajjñānādyasya sevayā || 89 || sarvavidyādhidevī sā pūjyā ca viduṣāṃ parā | yatsevayā yattapasā sarvaviśveṣu pūjitā || 90 || sarvagrāmādhidevī sā sarvasampatpradāyinī | sarveśvarī sarvavandyā sarveṣāṃ putradāyinī || 91 || sarvastutā ca sarvajñā sarvadurgārtināśinī | kṛṣṇavāmāṃśasambhūtā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevatā || 92 || kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā premṇā rādhikā śaktisevayā | sarvādhikaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ mānagaurave || 93 || kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthalasthānaṃ patnītve prāpa sevayā | tapaścakāra sā pūrvaṃ śataśṛṅge ca parvate || 94 || divyavarṣasahasraṃ ca patiṃ prāptyarthameva ca | jāte śaktiprasāde tu dṛṣṭvā candrakalopamām || 95 || kṛṣṇo vakṣaḥsthale kṛtvā ruroda kṛpayā vibhuḥ | varaṃ tasyai dadau sāraṃ sarveṣāmapi durlabham || 96 || mama vakṣaḥsthale tiṣṭha mama bhaktā ca śāśvatī | saubhāgyena ca mānena premṇātho gauraveṇa ca || 97 || tvaṃ me śreṣṭhā ca jyeṣṭhā ca preyasī sarvayoṣitām | variṣṭhā ca gariṣṭhā ca saṃstutā pūjitā mayā || 98 || satataṃ tava sādhyo'haṃ vaśyaśca prāṇavallabhe | ityuktvā ca jagannāthaścakāra lalanāṃ tataḥ || 99 || sapatnīrahitāṃ tāṃ ca cakāra prāṇavallabhām | anyā yā yāśca tā devyaḥ pūjitāḥ śaktisevayā || 100 || tapastu yādṛśaṃ yāsāṃ tādṛktādṛkphalaṃ mune | divyavarṣasahasraṃ ca tapastaptvā himācale || 101 || durgā ca tatpadaṃ dhyātvā sarvapūjyā babhūva ha | sarasvatī tapastaptvā parvate gandhamādane || 102 || lakṣavarṣaṃ ca divyaṃ ca sarvavandyā babhūva sā | lakṣmīryugaśataṃ divyaṃ tapastaptvā ca puṣkare || 103 || sarvasampatpradātrī ca jātā devīniṣevaṇāt | sāvitrī malaye taptvā pūjyā vandyā babhūva sā || 104 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasraṃ ca divyaṃ dhyātvā ca tatpadam | śatamanvantaraṃ taptaṃ śaṅkareṇa purā vibho || 105 || śatamanvantaraṃ cedaṃ brahmā śaktiṃ jajāpa ha | śatamanvantaraṃ viṣṇustaptvā pātā babhūva ha || 106 || daśamanvantaraṃ taptvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ | golokaṃ prāptavāndivyaṃ modate'dyāpi yatra hi || 107 || daśamanvantaraṃ dharmastaptvā vai bhaktisaṃyutaḥ | sarvaprāṇaḥ sarvapūjyaḥ sarvādhāro babhūva saḥ || 108 || evaṃ devyāśca tapasā sarve devāśca pūjitāḥ | munayo manavo bhūpā brāhmaṇāścaiva pūjitāḥ || 109 || evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ purāṇaṃ sayathāgamam | guruvaktrādyathā jñātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 110 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde kalimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <9.9> bhūmistotravarṇanam nārada uvāca devyā nimeṣamātreṇa brahmaṇaḥ pāta eva ca | tasya pātaḥ prākṛtikaḥ pralayaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 1 || pralaye prākṛte coktā tatrādṛṣṭā vasundharā | jalaplutāni viśvāni sarve līnāḥ parātmani || 2 || vasundharā tirobhūtā kutra vā sā ca tiṣṭhati | sṛṣṭervidhānasamaye sāvirbhūtā kathaṃ punaḥ || 3 || kathaṃ babhūva sā dhanyā mānyā sarvāśrayā jayā | tasyāśca janmakathanaṃ vada maṅgalakāraṇam || 4 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sarvādisṛṣṭau sarveṣāṃ janma devyā iti śrutiḥ | āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sarveṣu pralayeṣu ca || 5 || śrūyatāṃ vasudhājanma sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam | vighnanighnakaraṃ pāpanāśanaṃ puṇyavardhanam || 6 || aho kecidvadantīti madhukaiṭabhamedasā | babhūva vasudhā dhanyā tadviruddhamataḥ śṛṇu || 7 || ūcatustau purā viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭau yuddhena tejasā | āvāṃ vadhyau na yatrorvī pāthasā saṃvṛteti ca || 8 || tayorjīvanakāle na pratyakṣā sābhavatsphuṭam | tato babhūva medaśca maraṇānantaraṃ tayoḥ || 9 || medinīti ca vikhyātetyuktametanmataṃ śṛṇu | jaladhautā kṛtā pūrvaṃ vardhitā medasā yataḥ || 10 || kathayāmi te tajjanma sārthakaṃ sarvamaṅgalam | purā śrutaṃ yacchrutyuktaṃ dharmavaktrācca puṣkare || 11 || mahāvirāṭśarīrasya jalasthasya ciraṃ sphuṭam | mano babhūva kālena sarvāṅgavyāpakaṃ dhruvam || 12 || tacca praviṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ tallomnāṃ vivareṣu ca | kālena mahatā paścād babhūva vasudhā mune || 13 || pratyekaṃ pratilomnāṃ ca kūpeṣu saṃsthitā sadā | āvirbhūtā tirobhūtā sajalā ca punaḥ punaḥ || 14 || āvirbhūtā sṛṣṭikāle tajjaloparyupasthitā | pralaye ca tirobhūtā jalasyābhyantare sthitā || 15 || prativiśveṣu vasudhā śailakānanasaṃyutā | saptasāgarasaṃyuktā saptadvīpasamanvitā || 16 || hemādrimerusaṃyuktā grahacandrārkasaṃyutā | brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaiśca surairlokaistadājñayā || 17 || puṇyatīrthasamāyuktā puṇyabhāratasaṃyutā | kāñcanībhūmisaṃyuktā saptasvargasamanvitā || 18 || pātālasaptaṃ tadadhastadūrdhvaṃ brahmalokataḥ | dhruvalokaśca tatraiva sarvaṃ viśvaṃ ca tatra vai || 19 || evaṃ sarvāṇi viśvāni pṛthivyāṃ nirmitāni ca | naśvarāṇi ca viśvāni sarvāṇi kṛtrimāṇi vai || 20 || pralaye prākṛte caiva brahmaṇaśca nipātane | mahāvirāḍādisṛṣṭau sṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇena cātmanā || 21 || nityau ca sthitipralayau kāṣṭhākāleśvaraiḥ saha | nityādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā vārāhe pūjitā suraiḥ || 22 || munibhirmanubhirviprairgandharvādibhireva ca | viṣṇorvarāharūpasya patnī sā śrutisammatā || 23 || tatputro maṅgalo jñeyo ghaṭeśo maṅgalātmajaḥ | nārada uvāca pūjitā kena rupeṇa vārāhe ca surairmahī || 24 || vārāhe caiva vārāhī sarvaiḥ sarvāśrayā satī | mūlaprakṛtisambhūtā pañcīkaraṇamārgataḥ || 25 || tasyāḥ pūjāvidhānaṃ cāpyadhaścordhvamanekaśaḥ | maṅgalaṃ maṅgalasyāpi janma vāsaṃ vada prabho || 26 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vārāhe ca varāhaśca brahmaṇā saṃstutaḥ purā | uddadhāra mahīṃ hatvā hiraṇyākṣaṃ rasātalam || 27 || jale tāṃ sthāpayāmāsa padmapatraṃ yathā hṛde | tatraiva nirmame brahmā viśvaṃ sarvaṃ manoharam || 28 || dṛṣṭvā tadadhidevīṃ ca sakāmāṃ kāmuko hariḥ | varāharūpī bhagavān koṭisūryasamaprabhaḥ || 29 || kṛtvā ratikalāṃ sarvāṃ mūrtiṃ ca sumanoharām | krīḍāñcakāra rahasi divyavarṣamaharniśam || 30 || sukhasambhogasaṃsparśānmūrcchāṃ samprāpa sundarī | vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo'tisukhapradaḥ || 31 || viṣṇustadaṅgasaṃśleṣād bubudhe na divāniśam | varṣānte cetanāṃ prāpya kāmī tatyāja kāmukīm || 32 || pūrvarūpaṃ varāhaṃ ca dadhāra sa ca līlayā | pūjāñcakāra tāṃ devīṃ dhyātvā ca dharaṇīṃ satīm || 33 || dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaiḥ sindūrairanulepanaiḥ | vastraiḥ puṣpaiśca balibhiḥ sampūjyovāca tāṃ hariḥ || 34 || śrībhagavānuvāca sarvādhārā bhava śubhe sarvaiḥ sampūjitā sukham | munibhirmanubhirdevaiḥ siddhaiśca dānavādibhiḥ || 35 || ambuvācītyāgadine gṛhārambhe praveśane | vāpītaḍāgārambhe ca gṛhe ca kṛṣikarmaṇi || 36 || tava pūjāṃ kariṣyanti madvareṇa surādayaḥ | mūḍhā ye na kariṣyanti yāsyanti narakaṃ ca te || 37 || vasudhovāca vahāmi sarvaṃ vārāharūpeṇāhaṃ tavājñayā | līlāmātreṇa bhagavan viśvaṃ ca sacarācaram || 38 || muktāṃ śuktiṃ harerarcāṃ śivaliṅgaṃ śivāṃ tathā | śaṅkhaṃ pradīpaṃ yantraṃ ca māṇikyaṃ hīrakaṃ tathā || 39 || yajñasūtraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca pustakaṃ tulasīdalam | japamālāṃ puṣpamālāṃ karpūraṃ ca suvarṇakam || 40 || gorocanaṃ candanaṃ ca śālagrāmajalaṃ tathā | etānvoḍumaśaktāhaṃ kliṣṭā ca bhagavañchṛṇu || 41 || śrībhagavānuvāca dravyāṇyetāni ye mūḍhā arpayiṣyanti sundari | yāsyanti kālasūtraṃ te divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ tvayi || 42 || ityevamuktvā bhagavān virarāma ca nārada | babhūva tena garbheṇa tejasvī maṅgalagrahaḥ || 43 || pūjāñcakruḥ pṛthivyāśca te sarve cājñayā hareḥ | kaṇvaśākhoktadhyānena tuṣṭuvuśca stavena te || 44 || dadurmūlena mantreṇa naivedyādikameva ca | saṃstutā triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā sā babhūva ha || 45 || nārada uvāca kiṃ dhyānaṃ stavanaṃ tasyā mūlamantraṃ ca kiṃ vada | gūḍhaṃ sarvapurāṇeṣu śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama || 46 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ādau ca pṛthivī devī varāheṇa ca pūjitā | tato hi brahmaṇā paścāmṛjitā pṛthivī tadā || 47 || tataḥ sarvairmunīndraiśca manubhirmānavādibhiḥ | dhyānaṃ ca stavanaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi nārada || 48 || oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ vasudhāyai svāhetyanena mantreṇa viṣṇunā pūjitā purā | śvetapaṅkajavarṇābhāṃ śaraccandranibhānanām || 49 || candanotkṣiptasarvāṅgīṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | ratnādhārāṃ ratnagarbhāṃ ratnākarasamanvitām || 50 || vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ sasmitāṃ vanditāṃ bhaje | dhyānenānena sā devī sarvaiśca pūjitābhavat || 51 || stavanaṃ śṛṇu viprendra kaṇvaśākhoktameva ca | śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca jaye jaye jalādhāre jalaśīle jalaprade || 52 || yajñasūkarajāye tvaṃ jayaṃ dehi jayāvahe | maṅgale maṅgalādhāre māṅgalye maṅgalaprade || 53 || maṅgalārthaṃ maṅgaleśe maṅgalaṃ dehi me bhave | sarvādhāre ca sarvajñe sarvaśaktisamanvite || 54 || sarvakāmaprade devi sarveṣṭaṃ dehi me bhave | puṇyasvarūpe puṇyānāṃ bījarūpe sanātani || 55 || puṇyāśraye puṇyavatāmālaye puṇyade bhave | sarvasasyālaye sarvasasyāḍhye sarvasasyade || 56 || sarvasasyahare kāle sarvasasyātmike bhave | bhūme bhūmipasarvasve bhūmipālaparāyaṇe || 57 || bhūmipānāṃ sukhakare bhūmiṃ dehi ca bhūmide | idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet || 58 || koṭijanmasu sa bhaved balavānbhūmipeśvaraḥ | bhūmidānakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ labhyate paṭhanājjanaiḥ || 59 || bhūmidānaharātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | ambuvācībhūkaraṇapāpātsa mucyate dhruvam || 60 || anyakūpe kūpakhananapāpātsa mucyate dhruvam | parabhūmiharātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 61 || bhūmau vīryatyāgapāpādbhūmau dīpādisthāpanāt | pāpena mucyate so'pi stotrasya paṭhanānmune || 62 || aśvamedhaśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | bhūmidevyā mahāstotraṃ sarvakalyāṇakārakam || 63 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe bhūmistotravarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <9.10> pṛthivyupākhyāne narakaphalaprāptivarṇanam nārada uvāca bhūmidānakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ taddharaṇena ca | parabhūharaṇātpāpaṃ parakūpe khanane tathā || 1 || ambuvācyāṃ bhūkhanane vīryasya tyāga eva ca | dīpādisthāpanātpāpaṃ śrotumicchāmi yatnataḥ || 2 || anyadvā pṛthivījanyaṃ pāpaṃ yatpṛcchate param | yadasti tatpratīkāraṃ vada vedavidāṃvara || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca vitastimātrabhūmiṃ ca yo dadāti ca bhārate | sandhyāpūtāya viprāya sa yāti śivamandiram || 4 || bhūmiṃ ca sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ brāhmaṇāya dadāti ca | bhūmireṇupramāṇābdamante viṣṇupade sthitiḥ || 5 || grāmaṃ bhūmiṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca brāhmaṇāya dadāti yaḥ | sarvapāpādvinirmuktau cobhau devīpuraḥsthitau || 6 || bhūmidānaṃ ca tatkāle yaḥ sādhuścānumodate | sa ca prayāti vaikuṇṭhe mitragotrasamanvitaḥ || 7 || svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ harettu yaḥ | sa tiṣṭhati kālasūtre yāvaccandradivākarau || 8 || tatyutrapautraprabhṛtirbhūmihīnaḥ śriyā hataḥ | putrahīno daridraśca ghoraṃ yāti ca rauravam || 9 || gavāṃ mārgaṃ viniṣkṛṣya yaśca sasyaṃ dadāti ca | divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ caiva kumbhīpāke ca tiṣṭhati || 10 || goṣṭhaṃ taḍāgaṃ niṣkṛṣya mārge sasyaṃ dadāti yaḥ | sa tiṣṭhatyasipatre ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 11 || pañcapiṇḍānanuddhṛtya parakūpe ca snāti yaḥ | prāpnoti narakaṃ caiva snānaṃ niṣphalameva ca || 12 || kāmī bhūmau ca rahasi vīryatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ | bhūmireṇupramāṇaṃ ca varṣaṃ tiṣṭhati raurave || 13 || ambuvācyāṃ bhūkaraṇaṃ yaḥ karoti ca mānavaḥ | sa yāti kṛmidaṃśaṃ ca sthitistatra caturyugam || 14 || parakīye luptakūpe kūpaṃ mūḍhaḥ karoti yaḥ | puṣkariṇyāṃ ca luptāyāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ dadāti yaḥ || 15 || sarvaṃ phalaṃ parasyaiva taptakuṇḍaṃ vrajecca saḥ | tatra tiṣṭhati santapto yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 16 || parakīye taḍāge ca paṅkamuddhṛtya conmṛjet | reṇupramāṇavarṣaṃ ca brahmaloke vasennaraḥ || 17 || piṇḍaṃ pitre bhūmibharturna pradāya ca mānavaḥ | śrāddhaṃ karoti yo mūḍho narakaṃ yāti niścitam || 18 || bhūmau dīpaṃ yo'rpayati sa cāndhaḥ saptajanmasu | bhūmau śaṅkhaṃ ca saṃsthāpya kuṣṭhaṃ janmāntare labhet || 19 || muktāṃ māṇikyahīrau ca suvarṇaṃ ca maṇiṃ tathā | pañca saṃsthāpayedbhūmau sa cāndhaḥ saptajanmasu || 20 || śivaliṅgaṃ śivāmarcāṃ yaścārpayati bhūtale | śatamanvantaraṃ yāvatkṛmibhakṣaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || 21 || śaṅkhaṃ yantraṃ śilātoyaṃ puṣpaṃ ca tulasīdalam | yaścārpayati bhūmau ca sa tiṣṭhennarake dhruvam || 22 || japamālāṃ puṣpamālāṃ karpūraṃ rocanaṃ tathā | yo mūḍhaścārpayedbhūmau sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam || 23 || bhūmau candanakāṣṭhaṃ ca rudrākṣaṃ kuśamūlakam | saṃsthāpya bhūmau narake vasenmanvantarāvadhi || 24 || pustakaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca bhūmau saṃsthāpayennaraḥ | na bhavedviprayonau ca tasya janmāntare janiḥ || 25 || brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpamiha vai labhate dhruvam | grandhiyuktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ pūjyaṃ ca sarvavarṇakaiḥ || 26 || yajñaṃ kṛtvā tu yo bhūmiṃ kṣīreṇa na hi siñcati | sa yāti taptabhūmiṃ ca santaptaḥ saptajanmasu || 27 || bhūkampe grahaṇe yo hi karoti khananaṃ bhuvaḥ | janmāntare mahāpāpo hyaṅgahīno bhaved dhruvam || 28 || bhavanaṃ yatra sarveṣāṃ bhūmistena prakīrtitā | kāśyapī kaśyapasyeyamacalā sthirarūpataḥ || 29 || viśvambharā dhāraṇāccānantānantasvarūpataḥ | pṛthivī pṛthukanyātvādvistṛtatvānmahāmune || 30 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe pṛthivyupākhyāne narakaphalaprāptivarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <9.11> gaṅgopākhyānavarṇanam nārada uvāca || 1 || śrutaṃ pṛthivyupākhyānamatīva sumanoharam || gaṃgopākhyānamadhunā vada vedavidāṃ vara ||1|| bhārate bhāratīśāpātsā jagāma sureśvarī || viṣṇu svarūpā paramā svayaṃ viṣṇupadīti ca ||2|| kathaṃ kutra yuge kena prārthitā preritā purā || tatkramaṃ śrotumicchāmi pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmānsagaraḥ sūryavaṃśajaḥ || tasya bhāryā ca vaidarbhī śaibyā ca dve manohare || 4 || tatpatnyāmekaputraśca babhūva sumanoharaḥ || asamaṃja iti khyātaḥ śaibyāyāṃ kulavardhanaḥ || 5 || anyā cā''rādhayāmāsa śaṃkaraṃ putra kāmukī|| babhūva garbhastasyāśca harasya ca vareṇa ha ||6|| gate śatābde pūrṇe ca māṃsapiṃḍaṃ suṣāva sā || taddṛṣṭvā sā śivaṃ dhyātvā rurodoccaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 7 || śaṃbhurbrāhmaṇarūpeṇa tatsamīpaṃ jagāma ha || cakāra saṃvibhajyaitatpiḍaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasradhā || 8 || sarve babhūvuḥ putrāśca mahābalaparākramāḥ || grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṃḍaprabhāmuṣṭakalevarāḥ || 9 || kapilasya muneḥ śāpādbabhūvurbhasmasācca te || rājā ruroda tacchutvā jagāma gahane vane || 9.11.10 || tapaścakārā'samaṃjo gaṃgānayanakāraṇāt || lakṣavarṣaṃ tapastaptvā mamāra kālayogataḥ || 11 || aṃśumāṃstasya tanayo gaṃgānayanakāraṇāt || tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ mamāra kālayogataḥ || 12 || bhagīrathastasya putro mahābhāgavataḥ sudhīḥ || vaiṣṇavo viṣṇubhaktaśca guṇavānajarāmaraḥ || 13 || tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ gaṃgānayanakāraṇāt || dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ grīṣma sthasūryakoṭisamaprabham || 14 || dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ kiśoragopaveṣiṇam || gopālasundarīrūpaṃ bhaktānugraharūpiṇam || 15|| svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma paripūrṇatamaṃ prabhum || brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaiśca stutaṃ munigaṇairnutam || 16 || nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param || īṣaddhāsya prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakāraṇam || 17|| vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānaṃ ralabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || tuṣṭāva dṛṣṭvā nṛpatiḥ praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 18 || līlayā ca varaṃ prāpa vāṃchitaṃ vaṃśatā raṇam || kṛtvā ca stavanaṃ divyaṃ pulakāṃkitavigrahaḥ || 19 || śrībhagavānuvāca || bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpādgaccha śīghraṃ sureśvari || sagarasya sutānsarvānvṛtānkuru mamājñayā ||9.11.20|| tvatsparśavāyunāḥ pūtā yāsyaṃti mama maṃdiram || bibhrato mama mūrtīśca divyasyaṃdanagāminaḥ || 21 || matpārṣadā bhaviṣyaṃti sarva kālaṃ nirāmayāḥ || samucchidya karmabhogānkṛtāñjanmanijanmani || 22 || koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ bhārate yatkṛtaṃ nṛbhiḥ || gaṃgāyā vāta sparśena naśyatīti śrutau śrutam || 23 || sparśanāddarśanāddevyāḥ puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ || mausalasnānamātreṇa sāmānyadivase nṛṇām|| 24 || śatakoṭijanmapāpaṃ naśyatīti śrutau śrutam || yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyā dikāni ca || 25 || janmasaṃkhyārjitānyeva kāmato'pi kṛtāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi naśyaṃti mausalasnānato nṛṇām || 26 || puṇyāhasnānataḥ puṇyaṃ vedā naiva vadaṃti ca || kiṃcidvadaṃti te vipra phalameva yathāgamam || 27 || brahmaviṣṇuśivādyāśca sarvaṃ naiva vadaṃti ca || sāmānyadivasasnānasaṃkalpaṃ śṛṇu sundari || 28 || puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ caiva mausalasnānataḥ param || tatastriṃśadguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ ravisaṃkramaṇe dine ||29|| amāyāṃ cāpi tattulyaṃ dviguṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyane || tato daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ narāṇāmuttarāyaṇe ||9.11.30|| caturmāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmanaṃtaṃ puṇyameva ca || akṣayāyāṃ tattulyaṃ caitadvede nirūpitam || 31 || asaṃkhyapuṇyaphaladameteṣu snānadānakam || sāmānyadivasasnānāddānācchataguṇaṃ phalam || 32 || manvatarādyāyāṃ tithau yugādyāyāṃ tathaiva ca || māghasyāsita saptamyāṃ bhīṣmāṣṭamyāṃ tathaiva ca || 33 || athāpyaśokāṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca tathā hareḥ || tato'pi dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ naṃdāyāṃ tava durlabham || 34 || daśaharādaśamyāṃ tu yugādyādisamaṃ phalam || naṃdāsamaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ mahartve(?) caturguṇam || 35 || tataścaturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dvimahatpūrvake sati || puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ caiva sāmānyasnānato'pi yat || 36 || caṃdroparāgasamaye sūrye daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ || puṇyamardhodaye kāle tataḥ śataguṇaṃ phalam || 37 || ityevamuktvā deveśo virarāma tayoḥ puraḥ || tamuvāca tato gaṃgā bhaktinamrātsakaṃdharā || 38 || gaṃgovāca || yāmi cedbhārataṃ nātha bhāratī śāpataḥ purāḥ || tavājñayā ca rājeṃdra tapasā caiva sāṃpratam || 39 || dāsyaṃti pāpino mahyaṃ pāpāni yāni kāni ca || tāni me kena naśyaṃti tamupāyaṃ vada prabho || 9.11.40 || katikālaṃ parimitaṃ sthitirme tatra bhārate || kadā yāsyāmi deveśa tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 41 || mamānyadvāchitaṃ yadyatsarvaṃ jānāsi sarvavit || sarvāntarātmansarvajña tadupāyaṃ vada prabho || 42 || śrībhagavānuvāca || jānāmi vāṃchitaṃ gaṃge tava sarvaṃ sureśvari || patiste dravarūpāyā lavaṇodo bhaviṣyati || 43 || sa mamāṃśa svarūpaśca tvaṃ ca lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī || pidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhuvi || 44 || yāvatyaḥ saṃti nadyaśca bhāratyādyāśca bhārate || saubhāgyā tvaṃ ca tāsveva lavaṇodasya saurate || 45 || adyaprabhṛti deveśi kaleḥ paṃcasahasrakam || varṣaṃ sthitiste bhāratyāḥ śāpena bhārate bhuvi || 46 || nityaṃ tvamabdhinā sārthaṃ kariṣyasi raho ratim || tvameva rasikā devī rasikeṃdreṇa saṃyutā || 47 || tvāṃ stoṣyanti ca stotreṇa bhagīrathakṛtena ca || bhāratasthā janāḥ sarve pūrṇayiṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || 48 || kaṇvaśākhokta dhyānena dhyātvā tvāṃ pūjayiṣyati || yaḥ stauti praṇayennityaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 49 || gaṃgā gaṃgeti yo brūyādyojanānāṃ śatairapi || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 9.11.50 || sahasrapāpināṃ snānādyatpāpaṃ te bhaviṣyati || prakṛterbhaktasaṃsparśādeva taddhi vinaṃkṣyati || 51 || pāpināṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ śavasparśena yattvayi || tanmantropāsakasnānāttadaghaṃ ca vinaṃkṣyati || 52 || tatraiva tvamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kariṣyasyaghamocanam || sārdhaṃ saridbhiḥ śreṣṭhābhiḥ sarasvatyādibhiḥ śubhe || 53 || tattu tīrthaṃ bhavetsadyo yatra tadguṇakīrtanam || tvadreṇusparśamātreṇa pūto bhavati pātakī || 54 || reṇupramāṇavarṣaṃ ca develoke vased dhuvam || jñānena tvayi ye bhaktyā mannāmasmṛtipūrvakam || 55 || samutsṛjaṃti prāṇāṃśca te gacchanti hareḥ padam || pārṣadapravarāste ca bhaviṣyaṃti hareściram || 56 || layaṃ prākṛtikaṃ te ca drakṣyaṃti cāpya saṃkhyakam || mṛtasya bahupuṇyena tacchavaṃ tvayi vinyaset || 57 || prayāti sa ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāvadahnaḥ sthitistvayi || kāyavyūhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhojayitvā svakarmakam || 58 || tasmai dadāmi sārūpyaṃ karomi taṃ ca pārṣadam || ajñānī tvajjalasparśādyadi prāṇānsamutsṛjet || 59 || tasmai dadāmi sālokyaṃ karomi taṃ ca pārṣadam || anyatra vā tyajetprāṇāṃstvannāmasmṛtipūrvakam||9.11.60|| tasmai dadāmi sālokyaṃ yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ || anyatra vā tyajetprāṇāṃstvannāmasmṛtipūrvakam || 61 || tasmai dadāmi sārūpyamasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam || ratneṃdrasāra nirmāṇayānena saha pārṣadaiḥ ||62|| sadyaḥ prayāti golokaṃ mama tulyo bhaved dhuvam|| tīrthe'pyarthe maraṇe viśeṣo nāsti kaścana ||63|| manmaṃtropāsakānāṃ tu nityaṃ naivedyabhojinām|| pūtaṃ kartuṃ sa śakto hi līlayā bhuvanatrayam||64|| ratneṃdrasāra yānena golokaṃ saṃprayāṃti ca|| madbhaktā bāṃdhavā yeṣāṃ te'pi paśvādayo'pi hi||65|| prayāṃti ratnayānena golokaṃ cātidurlabham || yatra yatra smṛtāste ca jñānena jñāninaḥ sati ||66|| jīvanmuktāśca te pūtā madbhakte saṃvidhānataḥ || ityuktvā śrīharistāṃ ca pratyuvāca bhagīratham || 67 || stuhi gaṃgāmimāṃ bhaktyā pūjāṃ ca kuru sāṃpratam || bhagīrathastāṃ tuṣṭāva pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 68 || kauthumoktena dhyānena stotreṇāpi punaḥ punaḥ || praṇanāma ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram || 69 || bhagīrathaśca gaṃgā ca soṃ'tardhānaṃ cakāra ha || nārada uvāca || kena dhyānena stotreṇa kena pūjākrameṇa ca || 9.11.70 || pūjāṃ cakāra nṛpatirvada vedavidāṃ vara || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī || 71 || saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca saṃyato bhaktipūrvakam || gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahni viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām || 72 || saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca so'dhikārī ca pūjane || gaṇeśaṃ vighnanāśāya ārogyāya divākaram || 73 || vahniṃ śaucāya viṣṇuṃ ca lakṣmyarthaṃ pūjayennaraḥ || śivaṃ jñānāya jñāneśaṃ śivāṃ ca muktisiddhaye || 74 || saṃpūjyaitām̐llabhetprājño viparītamato'nyathā || dadhyāvanena dhyānena taddhyānaṃ śṛṇu nārada || 75 || iti śrīdevībhāgavate ma0 navamaskandhe ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <9.12> gaṅgopākhyānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || dhyānaṃ ca kaṇva śākhoktaṃ sarvaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || śvetapaṃkajavarṇābhāṃ gaṃgāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ||1|| kṛṣṇavigrahasambhūtāṃ kṛṣṇatulyāṃ parāṃ satīm || vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 2 || śaratpūrṇeṃduśatakamṛṣṭaśobhākarāṃ parām || īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām || 3 || nārāyaṇapriyāṃ śāṃtāṃ tatsaubhāgyasamanvitām || bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatī mālya saṃyutam || 4 || siṃdūrabiṃdulalitaṃ sārdhaṃ candanabiṃdubhiḥ || kastūrīpatrakaṃ gaṃḍe nānācitrasamanvitam || 5 || pakvabiṃbaviniṃdyāccha cārvoṣṭhapuṭamuttamam|| muktāpaṃktiprabhāmuṣṭadaṃtapaṃktimanoramam || 6 || sucāruvaktranayanaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ manoharam || kaṭhinaṃ śrīphalākāraṃ stanayugmaṃ ca bibhratīm || 7 || bṛhacchroṇiṃ sukaṭhināṃ raṃbhāstaṃbhaviniṃditām || sthalapadmaprabhāmuṣṭapadapadmayugaṃ varam || 8 || ratnapāduka saṃyuktaṃ kuṃkumāktaṃ sayāvakam || deveṃdramaulimaṃdāramakaraṃdakaṇāruṇam || 9 || surasiddhamunīṃdraiśca dattārghasaṃyutaṃ sadā || tapasvimaulinikarabhramaraśreṇisaṃyutam || 9.12.10 || muktipradaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ kāmināṃ sarvabhogadam || varāṃ vareṇyāṃ varadāṃ bhaktānugrahakāriṇīm || 11 || śrīviṣṇoḥ padadātrīṃ ca bhaje viṣṇupadīṃ satīm || ityanenaiva dhyānena dhyātvā tripathagāṃ śubhām || 12 || dattvā saṃpūjayedbrahmannupacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa || āsanaṃ pādyamarghaṃ ca snānīyaṃ cā'nulepanam || 13 || dhūpadīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ śītalaṃ jalam || vasanaṃ bhūṣaṇa mālyaṃ gaṃdhamācamanīyakam || 14 || manoharaṃ sutalpaṃ ca deyānyetāni ṣoḍaśa || dattvā bhaktyā ca praṇametsaṃstūya saṃpuṭāṃjaliḥ || 15 || saṃpūjyaivaṃ prakāreṇa so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || nārada uvāca || śrotumicchāmi deveśa lakṣmīkāṃta jagatpate ||16|| viṣṇorviṣṇupadīstotraṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyakārakam || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi pāpaghnaṃ puṇyakārakam ||17|| śivasaṃgītasaṃmugdha śrīkṛṣṇāṃgasamudbhavām || rādhāṃgadravasaṃyuktāṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ||18|| yajjanma sṛṣṭerādau ca goloke rāsamaṃḍale || sannidhāne śaṃkarasya tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 19 || gopairgopībhirākīrṇe śubhe rādhāmahotsave || kārttikī pūrṇimāyāṃ ca tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ||9.12.20|| koṭiyojana vistīrṇā dairghye lakṣaguṇā tataḥ || samāvṛtā yā goloke tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ||21|| ṣaṣṭilakṣayojanā yā tato dairghye caturguṇā || samāvṛtā yā vaikuṇṭhe tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 22 || triṃśallakṣayojanā yā dairghye paṃcaguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā brahmaloke yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 23 || triṃśallakṣayojanā yā dairghye caturguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā śivaloke yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 24 || lakṣayojanavistīrṇā dairghye saptaguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā dhruvaloke yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 25 || lakṣayojanavistīrṇā dairghye paṃcaguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā caṃdraloke yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 26 || ṣaṣṭisahasrayojanā yā dairghye daśaguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā sūryaloke yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 27 || lakṣayojanavistīrṇā dairghye paṃcaguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā yā tapoloke tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 28 || sahasra yojanāyāmā dairghye daśaguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā janaloke yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 29 || daśalakṣayojanā yā dairghye paṃcaguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā yā maharloke tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 9.12.30 || sahasrayojanāyāmā dairghye śataguṇā tataḥ || āvṛtā yā ca kailāse tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 31 || śatayojanavistīrṇā dairghye daśaguṇā tataḥ || maṃdākinī yeṃdraloke tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 32 || pātāle bhogavatī caiva vistīrṇā daśayojanā || tato daśaguṇā dairghye tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 33 || krośaikamātravistīrṇā tataḥ kṣīṇā ca kutracit || kṣitau cālakanandā yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 34 || satye yā kṣīravarṇā ca tretāyāmiṃdusannibhā || dvāpare candanābhā yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 35 || jalaprabhā kalau yā ca nā'nyatra pṛthivītale || svarge ca nityaṃ kṣīrābhā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 36 || yattoyakaṇikāsparśe pāpināṃ jñānasaṃbhavaḥ || brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ koṭijanmārjitaṃ dahet || 37 || ityevaṃ kathitā brahmangaṃgāpadyaikaviśatiḥ || stotrarūpaṃ ca paramaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyajīvanam || 38 || nityaṃ yo hi paṭhedbhaktyā saṃpūjya ca sureśvarīm || so'śvamedhaphalaṃ nityaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 39 || aputro labhate putraṃ bhāryāhīno labhetstriyam || rogātpramucyate rogī baṃdhānmukto bhaved dhruvam || 9.12.40 || aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṃḍitaḥ || yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya gaṃgāstotramidaṃ śubham || 41 || śubhaṃ bhavecca duḥsvapne gagāsnānaphalaṃ labhet || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || stotreṇānena gaṃgāṃ ca stutvā caiva bhagīratha || 42 || jagāma tāṃ gṛhītvā ca yatra naṣṭāśca sāgarāḥ || vaikuṇṭhaṃ te yayustūrṇaṃ gaṃgāyā sparśavāyunā || 43 || bhagīrathena sā nītā tena bhāgīrathī smṛtā || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaṃgopākhyānamuttamam || 44 || puṇyadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || nārada uvāca || kathaṃ gaṃgā tripathagā jātā bhuvanapāvanī ||45|| kutra vā kena vidhinā tatsarvaṃ vada me prabho || tatrasthāśca janā ye ye te ca kiṃ cakruruttamam || 46 || etatsarvaṃ tu vistīrṇaṃ kṛtvā vaktumihārhasi || nārāyaṇa uvāca || kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu rādhāyāḥ sumahotsavaḥ || 47 || kṛṣṇaḥ saṃpūjya tāṃ rādhāmuvāsa rāsamaṇḍale || kṛṣṇena pūjitāṃ sā tu saṃpūjya dṛṣṭamānasāḥ || 48 || ūṣurbrahmādayaḥ sarve ṛṣayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ || etasminnaṃtare kṛṣṇasaṃgītā ca sarasvatī || 49 || jagau sundaratālena vīṇayā ca manoharam || tuṣṭo brahmā dadau tasyai ratneṃdrasārahārakam || 9.12.50 || śivo maṇīṃdrasāraṃ tu sarvabrahmāṇḍa durlabham || kṛṣṇaḥ kaustubharatnaṃ ca sarvaratnātparaṃ varam || 51 || amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ hārasāraṃ ca rādhikā || nārāyaṇaśca bhagavāndadau mālāṃ manoharām || 52 || amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ lakṣmīḥ kanakakuṃḍalam || viṣṇumāyā bhagavatī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī || 53 || durgā nārāyaṇīśānā brahmabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām || dharmabuddhiṃ ca dharmaśca yaśaśca vipulaṃ bhave || 54 || vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ vahnirvāyuśca maṇinūpurān || etasminnaṃtare śaṃbhurbrahmaṇā prerito muhuḥ || 55 || jagau śrīkṛṣṇasaṃgītaṃ sasollāsasamanvitam || mūrcchāṃ prāpuḥ surāḥ sarve citraputtalikā yathā ||56|| kaṣṭena cetanāṃ prāpya dadṛśū rāsamaṃḍale || sthalaṃ sarvaṃ jalākīrṇaṃ rādhākṛṣṇavihīnakam ||57|| atyuccai ruruduḥ sarve gopā gopyaḥ surā dvijāḥ || dhyānena brahmā bubudhe sarvaṃ tīrthamabhīpsitam || 58 || gataśca rādhayā sārdhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo dravatāmiti || tato brahmādayaḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvarāt || 59 || svamūrtiṃ darśaya vibho vāṃchitaṃ varameva naḥ || etasminnaṃtare tatra vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī || 9.12.60 || tāmeva śuśruvuḥ sarve suvyaktāṃ madhurānvitām || sarvātmā'hamiyaṃ śaktirbhaktānugraha vigrahā || 61 || mamāpyasyāśca dehena karttavyaṃ ca kimāvayoḥ || manavo mānavāḥ sarve munayaścaiva vaiṣṇavāḥ || 62 || manmantrapūtā māṃ draṣṭumāgamiṣyaṃti matpadam || mūrtiṃ draṣṭuṃ ca suvyaktāṃ yadīcchata sureśvarāḥ || 63 || karotu śaṃbhustatraivaṃ madīyaṃ vākyapālanam || svayaṃ vidhātastvaṃ bahmannājñāṃ kuru jagadgurum || 64 || kartuṃ śāstraviśeṣaṃ ca vedāṃgaṃ sumanoharam || apūrvamantranikaraiḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradaiḥ || 65 || stotraiśca ca nikarairdhyānairyutaṃ pūjāvidhikramaiḥ || manmantrakavacastotraṃ kṛtvā yatnena gopanam || 66 || bhavaṃti vimukhā yena janā māṃ tatkariṣyati || sahasreṣu śateṣveko manmaṃtropāsako bhavet || 67 || janā manmaṃtrapūtāśca gamiṣyaṃti ca matpadam || anyathā na bhaviṣyaṃti sarve golokavāsinaḥ || 68 || niṣphalaṃ bhavitā sarvaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ caiva brahmaṇaḥ || janāḥ paṃca prakārāśca yuktāḥ sraṣṭuṃ bhave bhave || 69 || pṛthivīvāsinaḥ kacitkecitsvarganivāsinaḥ || idaṃ kartuṃ mahādevaḥ karoti devasaṃsadi || 9.12.70 || pratijñāṃ sudṛḍhāṃ sadya stato mūrtiṃ ca drakṣyati || ityevamuktvā gagane virarāma sanātanaḥ || 71 || tacchutvā jagatāṃ dhātā tamuvāca śivaṃ mudā || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā jñāneśo jñāninaḥ varaḥ || 72 || gaṃgātoyaṃ kare kṛtvā svīkāraṃ ca cakāra saḥ || saṃyuktaṃ viṣṇumāyāyā maṃtraughaiḥ śāstramuttamam || 73 || vedasāraṃ kariṣyāmi pratijñāpālanāya ca || gaṃgātoyamupaspṛśya mithyā yadi vadejjanaḥ || 74 || sa yāti kālasūtraṃ ca yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ || ityukte śaṃkare brahmangoloke surasaṃsadi || 75 || āvirbabhūva śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā sahitastataḥ || taṃ sudṛṣṭvā ca saṃhṛṣṭāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam || 76 || paramānandapūrṇāśca cakruśca punarutsavam || kālena śaṃbhurbhagavānmuktidīpaṃ cakāra saḥ || 77 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sugopyaṃ ca sudurlabham || sa eva dravarūpā sā gaṃgā golokasaṃbhavā || 78 || rādhākṛṣṇāṃgasaṃbhūtā bhuktimuktiphalapradā || sthāne sthāne sthāpitā sā kṛṣṇena ca parātmanā ||79|| kṛṣṇasvarūpā paramā sarvabrahmāṃḍapūjitā || iti śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe navamaskandhe dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <9.13> gaṅgopākhyānavarṇanam nārada uvāca kaleḥ pañcasahasrābde samatīte sureśvara | kva gatā sā mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātsamāgatyeśvarecchayā | jagāma tatra vaikuṇṭhe śāpānte punareva sā || 2 || bhāratī bhārataṃ tyaktvā tajjagāma hareḥ padam | padmāvatī ca śāpānte gaṅgā sā caiva nārada || 3 || gaṅgā sarasvatī lakṣyīścaitāstisraḥ priyā hareḥ | tulasīsahitā brahmaṃścatasraḥ kīrtitāḥ śrutau || 4 || nārada uvāca kenopāyena sā devī viṣṇupādābjasambhavā | brahmakamaṇḍalusthā ca śrutā śivapriyā ca sā || 5 || babhūva sā muniśreṣṭha gaṅgā nārāyaṇapriyā | aho kena prakāreṇa tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca purā babhūva goloke sā gaṅgā dravarūpiṇī | rādhākṛṣṇāṅgasambhūtā tadaṃśā tatsvarūpiṇī || 7 || dravādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi | navayauvanasampannā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 8 || śaranmadhyāhnapadmāsyā sasmitā sumanoharā | taptakāñcanavarṇābhā śaraccandrasamaprabhā || 9 || snigdhaprabhātisusnigdhā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī | supīnakaṭhinaśroṇiḥ sunitambayugaṃdharā || 10 || pīnonnataṃ sukaṭhinaṃ stanayugmaṃ suvartulam | sucārunetrayugalaṃ sukaṭākṣaṃ suvaṃkrimam || 11 || vaṃkrimaṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam | sindūrabindulalitaṃ sārdhaṃ candanabindubhiḥ || 12 || kastūrīpatrikāyuktaṃ gaṇḍayugmaṃ manoramam | bandhūkakusumākāramadharoṣṭhaṃ ca sundaram || 13 || pakvadāḍimabījābhadantapaṃktisamujjvalam | vāsasī vahniśuddhe ca nīvīyukte ca bibhratī || 14 || sā sakāmā kṛṣṇapārśve samuvāsa sulajjitā | vāsasā mukhamācchādya locanābhyāṃ vibhormukham || 15 || nimeṣarahitābhyāṃ ca pibantī satataṃ mudā | praphullavadanā harṣānnavasaṅgamalālasā || 16 || mūrcchitā prabhurūpeṇa pulakāṅkitavigrahā | etasminnantare tatra vidyamānā ca rādhikā || 17 || gopītriṃśatkoṭiyuktā candrakoṭisamaprabhā | kopenāraktapadmāsyā raktapaṅkajalocanā || 18 || pītacampakavarṇābhā gajendramandagāminī | amūlyaratnanirmāṇanānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitā || 19 || amūlyaratnakhacitamamūlyaṃ vahniśaucakam | pītavastrasya yugalaṃ nīvīyuktaṃ ca bibhratī || 20 || sthalapadmaprabhāmuṣṭaṃ komalaṃ ca surañjitam | kṛṣṇadattārghyasaṃyuktaṃ vinyasantī padāmbujam || 21 || ratnendrasāranirmāṇavimānādavaruhya sā | sevyamānā ca ṛṣibhiḥ śvetacāmaravāyunā || 22 || kastūrībindubhiryuktaṃ candanena samanvitam | dīptadīpaprabhākāraṃ sindūraṃ binduśobhitam || 23 || dadhatī bhālamadhye ca sīmantādhaḥsthalojjvale | pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāyuktaṃ suvaṃkrimam || 24 || sucārukabarībhāraṃ kampayantī sukampitā | sucārurāgasaṃyuktamoṣṭhaṃ kampayatī ruṣā || 25 || gatvovāsa kṛṣṇapārśve ratnasiṃhāsane śubhe | sakhīnāṃ ca samūhaiśca paripūrṇā vibhoḥ priyā || 26 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca samuttasthau kṛṣṇaḥ sādarapūrvakam | sambhāṣya madhurālāpaiḥ sasmitaśca sasaṃbhramaḥ || 27 || praṇemuratisantrastā gopā namrātmakandharāḥ | tuṣṭuvuste ca bhaktyā ca tuṣṭāva parameśvaraḥ || 28 || utthāya gaṅgā sahasā stutiṃ bahu cakāra sā | kuśalaṃ paripapraccha bhītātivinayena ca || 29 || namrabhāgasthitā trastā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā | dhyānena śaraṇāyattā śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbuje || 30 || tāṃ hṛtpadmasthitāṃ kṛṣṇo bhītāyai cābhayaṃ dadau | babhūva sthiracittā sā sarveśvaravareṇa ca || 31 || ūrdhvasiṃhāsanasthāṃ ca rādhāṃ gaṅgā dadarśa sā | susnigdhāṃ sukhadṛśyāṃ ca jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā || 32 || asaṃkhyabrahmaṇaḥ kartrīmādisṛṣṭeḥ sanātanīm | sadā dvādaśavarṣīyāṃ kanyābhinavayauvanām || 33 || viśvavṛnde nirupamāṃ rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca | śāntāṃ kāntāmanantāṃ tāmādyantarahitāṃ satīm || 34 || śubhāṃ subhadrāṃ subhagāṃ svāmisaubhāgyasaṃyutām | saundaryasundarīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sarvāsu sundarīṣu ca || 35 || kṛṣṇārdhāṅgāṃ kṛṣṇasamāṃ tejasā vayasā tviṣā | pūjitāṃ ca mahālakṣmīṃ lakṣmyā lakṣmīśvareṇa ca || 36 || pracchādyamānāṃ prabhayā sabhāmīśasya suprabhām | sakhīdattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantīṃ ca durlabham || 37 || ajanyāṃ sarvajananīṃ dhanyāṃ mānyāṃ ca māninīm | kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevīṃ ca prāṇapriyatamāṃ ramām || 38 || dṛṣṭvā rāseśvarīṃ tṛptiṃ na jagāma sureśvarī | nimeṣarahitābhyāṃ ca locanābhyāṃ papau ca tām || 39 || etasminnantare rādhā jagadīśamuvāca sā | vācā madhurayā śāntā vinītā sasmitā mune || 40 || rādhovāca keyaṃ prāṇeśa kalyāṇī sasmitā tvanmukhāmbujam | paśyantī sasmitaṃ pārśve sakāmā vakralocanā || 41 || mūrcchāṃ prāpnoti rūpeṇa pulakāṅkitavigrahā | vastreṇa mukhamācchādya nirīkṣantī punaḥ punaḥ || 42 || tvaṃ cāpi tāṃ saṃnirīkṣya sakāmaḥ sasmitaḥ sadā | mayi jīvati goloke bhūtā durvṛttirīdṛśī || 43 || tvameva caiva durvṛttaṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ karoṣi ca | kṣamāṃ karomi premṇā ca strījātiḥ snigdhamānasā || 44 || saṃgṛhyemāṃ priyāmiṣṭāṃ golokād gaccha lampaṭa | anyathā na hi te bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati vrajeśvara || 45 || dṛṣṭastvaṃ virajāyukto mayā candanakānane | kṣamā kṛtā mayā pūrvaṃ sakhīnāṃ vacanādaho || 46 || tvayā macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ purā | dehaṃ tatyāja virajā nadīrūpā babhūva sā || 47 || koṭiyojanavistīrṇā tato dairghye caturguṇā | adyāpi vidyamānā sā tava satkīrtirūpiṇī || 48 || gṛhaṃ mayi gatāyāṃ ca punargatvā tadantike | uccai ruroda viraje viraje ceti saṃsmaran || 49 || tadā toyātsamutthāya sā yogātsiddhayoginī | sālaṅkārā mūrtimatī dadau tubhyaṃ ca darśanam || 50 || tatastāṃ ca samākṣipya vīryādhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā | tato babhūvustasyāṃ ca samudrāḥ sapta eva ca || 51 || dṛṣṭastvaṃ śobhayā gopyā yuktaścampakakānane | sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā || 52 || śobhā dehaṃ parityajya jagāma candramaṇḍale | tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca snigdhaṃ tejo babhūva ha || 53 || saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā | ratnāya kiñcitsvarṇāya kiñcinmaṇivarāya ca || 54 || kiñcitstrīṇāṃ mukhābjebhyaḥ kiñcidrājñe ca kiñcana | kiñcitkisalayebhyaśca puṣpebhyaścāpi kiñcana || 55 || kiñcitkalebhyaḥ pakvebhyaḥ sasyebhyaścāpi kiñcana | nṛpadevagṛhebhyaśca saṃskṛtebhyaśca kiñcana || 56 || kiñcinnūtanapatrebhyo dugdhebhyaścāpi kiñcana | dṛṣṭastvaṃ prabhayā gopyā yukto vṛndāvane vane || 57 || sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā | prabhā dehaṃ parityajya jagāma sūryamaṇḍale || 58 || tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca tīvraṃ tejo babhūva ha | saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā prarudatā purā || 59 || visṛṣṭaṃ cakṣuṣoḥ kṛṣṇa lajjayā madbhayena ca | hutāśanāya kiñcicca yakṣebhyaścāpi kiñcana || 60 || kiñcitpuruṣasiṃhebhyo devebhyaścāpi kiñcana | kiñcidviṣṇujanebhyaśca nāgebhyo'pi ca kiñcana || 61 || brāhmaṇebhyo
