munibhyaśca tapasvibhyaśca kiñcana | strībhyaḥ saubhāgyayuktābhyo yaśasvibhyaśca kiñcana || 62 || tattu dattvā ca sarvebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ praruditaṃ tvayā | śāntigopyā yutastvaṃ ca dṛṣṭo'si rāsamaṇḍale || 63 || vasante puṣpaśayyāyāṃ mālyavāṃścandanokṣitaḥ | ratnapradīpairyukte ca ratnanirmāṇamandire || 64 || ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyo ratnabhūṣitayā saha | tayā dattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavāṃśca purā vibho || 65 || sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā | śāntirdehaṃ parityajya bhiyā līnā tvayi prabho || 66 || tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca guṇaśreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha | saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā prarudatā purā || 67 || viśve tu vipine kiñcidbrahmaṇe ca mayi prabho | śuddhasattvasvarūpāyai kiñcillakṣmyai purā vibho || 68 || tvanmantropāsakebhyaśca śāktebhyaścāpi kiñcana | tapasvibhyaśca dharmāya dharmiṣṭhebhyaśca kiñcana || 69 || mayā pūrvaṃ ca tvaṃ dṛṣṭo gopyā ca kṣamayā saha | suveṣayukto mālāvān gandhacandanacarcitaḥ || 70 || ratnabhūṣitayā gandhacandanokṣitayā saha | sukhena mūrcchitastalpe puṣpacandanacarcite || 71 || śliṣṭo nidritayā sadyaḥ sukhena navasaṅgamāt | mayā prabodhitā sā ca bhavāṃśca smaraṇaṃ kuru || 72 || gṛhītaṃ pītavastraṃ ca muralī ca manoharā | vanamālākaustubhaścāpyamūlyaṃ ratnakuṇḍalam || 73 || paścātpradattaṃ premṇā ca sakhīnāṃ vacanādaho | lajjayā kṛṣṇavarṇo'bhūdbhavān pāpena yaḥ prabho || 74 || kṣamā dehaṃ parityajya lajjayā pṛthivīṃ gatā | tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca guṇaśreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha || 75 || saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā prarudatā punaḥ | kiñciddattaṃ viṣṇave ca vaiṣṇavebhyaśca kiñcana || 76 || dhārmikebhyaśca dharmāya durbalebhyaśca kiñcana | tapasvibhyo'pi devebhyaḥ paṇḍitebhyaśca kiñcana || 77 || etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi | tvadguṇaṃ caiva bahuśo na jānāmi paraṃ prabho || 78 || ityevamuktvā sā rādhā raktapaṅkajalocanā | gaṅgāṃ vaktuṃ samārebhe namrāsyāṃ lajjitāṃ satīm || 79 || gaṅgā rahasyaṃ vijñāya yogena siddhayoginī | tirobhūya sabhāmadhye svajalaṃ praviveśa sā || 80 || rādhā yogena vijñāya sarvatrāvasthitāṃ ca tām | pānaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe gaṇḍūṣātsiddhayoginī || 81 || gaṅgā rahasyaṃ vijñāya yogena siddhayoginī | śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje viveśa śaraṇaṃ yayau || 82 || goloke sā ca vaikuṇṭhe brahmalokādike tathā | dadarśa rādhā sarvatra naiva gaṅgāṃ dadarśa sā || 83 || sarvatra jalaśūnyaṃ ca śuṣkapaṅkaṃ ca golakam | jalajantusamūhaiśca mṛtadehaiḥ samanvitam || 84 || brahmaviṣṇuśivānantadharmendrendudivākarāḥ | manavo munayaḥ sarve devasiddhatapasvinaḥ || 85 || golokaṃ ca samājagmuḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukāḥ | sarve praṇemurgovindaṃ sarveśaṃ prakṛteḥ param || 86 || varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ variṣṭhaṃ varakāraṇam | gopikāgopavṛndānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraṃ prabhum || 87 || nirīhaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirliptaṃ ca nirāśrayam | nirguṇaṃ ca nirutsāhaṃ nirvikāraṃ nirañjanam || 88 || svecchāmayaṃ ca sākāraṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam | sattvasvarūpaṃ satyeśaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ sanātanam || 89 || paraṃ pareśaṃ paramaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram | praṇamya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ || 90 || sagadgadāḥ sāśrunetrāḥ pulakāṅkitavigrahāḥ | sarve saṃstūya sarveśaṃ bhagavantaṃ parātparam || 91 || jyotirmayaṃ paraṃ brahma sarvakāraṇakāraṇam | amūlyaratnanirmāṇacitrasiṃhāsanasthitam || 92 || sevyamānaṃ ca gopālaiḥ śvetacāmaravāyunā | gopālikānṛtyagītaṃ paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā || 93 || prāṇādhikapriyatamaṃ rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam | tayā pradattaṃ tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ suvāsitam || 94 || paripūrṇatamaṃ rāse dadṛśuśca sureśvaram | munayo manavaḥ siddhāstāpasāśca tapasvinaḥ || 95 || prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve jagmuḥ paramavismayam | parasparaṃ samālokya procuste ca caturmukham || 96 || niveditaṃ jagannāthaṃ svābhiprāyamabhīpsitam | brahmā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viṣṇuṃ kṛtvā svadakṣiṇe || 97 || vāmato vāmadevaṃ ca jagāma kṛṣṇasannidhim | paramānandayuktaṃ ca paramānandarūpiṇīm || 98 || sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ dhātā dadarśa rāsamaṇḍale | sarvaṃ samānaveṣaṃ ca samānāsanasaṃsthitam || 99 || dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam | mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca kaustubhena virājitam || 100 || atīva kamanīyaṃ ca sundaraṃ śāntavigraham | guṇabhūṣaṇarūpeṇa tejasā vayasā tviṣā || 101 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitam | kiṃ sevyaṃ sevakaṃ kiṃ vā dṛṣṭvā nirvaktumakṣamaḥ || 102 || kṣaṇaṃ tejaḥ svarūpaṃ ca rūpaṃ tatra sthitaṃ kṣaṇam | nirākāraṃ ca sākāraṃ dadarśa dvividhaṃ kṣaṇam || 103 || ekameva kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhayā rahitaṃ param | pratyekāsanasaṃsthaṃ ca tayā sārdhaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam || 104 || rādhārūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ kalatrakam | kiṃ strīrūpaṃ ca puruṣaṃ vidhātā dhyātumakṣamaḥ || 105 || hṛtpadmasthaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhyātvā dhyānena cakṣuṣā | cakāra stavanaṃ bhaktyā parihāramanekadhā || 106 || tataḥ svacakṣurunmīlya punaśca tadanujñayā | dadarśa kṛṣṇamekaṃ ca rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam || 107 || svapārṣadaiḥ parivṛtaṃ gopīmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam | punaḥ praṇemustaṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram || 108 || tadabhiprāyamājñāya tānuvāca rameśvaraḥ | sarvātmā sa ca sarvajñaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ || 109 || śrībhagavānuvāca āgaccha kuśalaṃ brahmannāgaccha kamalāpate | ihāgaccha mahādeva śaśvatkuśalamastu vaḥ || 110 || āgatā hi mahābhāgā gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt | gaṅgā ca caraṇāmbhoje bhayena śaraṇaṃ gatā || 111 || rādhemāṃ pātumicchantī dṛṣṭvā matsannidhānataḥ | dāsyāmīmāṃ ca bhavatāṃ yūyaṃ kuruta nirbhayām || 112 || śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā sasmitaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ | tuṣṭāva rādhāmārādhyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇaparipūjitām || 113 || vaktraiścaturbhiḥ saṃstūya bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ | dhātā caturṇāṃ vedānāmuvāca caturānanaḥ || 114 || caturānana uvāca gaṅgā tvadaṅgasambhūtā prabhośca rāsamaṇḍale | yuvayordravarūpā sā mugdhayoḥ śaṅkarasvanāt || 115 || kṛṣṇāṃśā ca tvadaṃśā ca tvatkanyāsadṛśī priyā | tvanmantragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā karotu tava pūjanam || 116 || bhaviṣyati patistasyā vaikuṇṭheśaścaturbhujaḥ | bhūsthāyāḥ kalayā tasyāḥ patirlavaṇavāridhiḥ || 1 re 7 || golokasthā ca yā gaṅgā sarvatrasthā tathāmbike | tadambikā tvaṃ deveśī sarvadā sā tvadātmajā || 118 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā svīcakāra ca sasmitā | vahirbabhūva sā kṛṣṇapādāṅguṣṭhanakhāgrataḥ || 119 || tatraiva satkṛtā śāntā tasthau teṣāṃ ca madhyataḥ | uvāsa toyādutthāya tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 120 || tattoyaṃ brahmaṇā kiñcitsthāpitaṃ ca kamaṇḍalau | kiñciddadhāra śirasi candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ || 121 || gaṅgāyai rādhikāmantraṃ pradadau kamalodbhavaḥ | tatstotraṃ kavacaṃ pūjāṃ vidhānaṃ dhyānameva ca || 122 || sarvaṃ tatsāmavedoktaṃ puraścaryākramaṃ tathā | gaṅgā tāmeva sampūjya vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau saha || 123 || lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṅgā tulasī viśvapāvanī | etā nārāyaṇasyaiva catasro yoṣito mune || 124 || atha taṃ sasmitaḥ kṛṣṇo brahmāṇaṃ samuvāca saḥ | sarvakālasya vṛttāntaṃ durbodhamavipaścitam || 125 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca gṛhāṇa gaṅgāṃ he brahman he viṣṇo he maheśvara | śṛṇu kālasya vṛttāntaṃ matto brahmanniśāmaya || 126 || yūyaṃ ca ye'nye devāśca munayo manavastathā | siddhā yaśasvinaścaiva ye ye'traiva samāgatāḥ || 127 || ete jīvanti goloke kālacakravivarjite | jalāplute sarvaviśvaṃ jātaṃ kalpakṣayo'dhunā || 128 || brahmādyā ye'nyaviśvasthāste vilīnādhunā mayi | vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca vinā sarvaṃ jalamagnaṃ ca padmaja || 129 || gatvā sṛṣṭiṃ kuru punarbrahmalokādikaṃ bhavam | svaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ viracaya paścād gaṅgā prayāsyati || 130 || evamanyeṣu viśveṣu sṛṣṭau brahmādikaṃ punaḥ | karomyahaṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ gaccha śīghraṃ suraiḥ saha || 131 || gato bahutaraḥ kālo yuṣmākaṃ ca caturmukhāḥ | gatāḥ katividhāste ca bhaviṣyanti ca vedhasaḥ || 132 || ityuktvā rādhikānātho jagāmāntaḥpure mune | devā gatvā punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ cakrureva prayatnataḥ || 133 || goloke ca sthitā gaṅgā vaikuṇṭhe śivalokake | brahmaloke sthitānyatra yatra yatra puraḥ sthitā || 134 || tatraiva sā gatā gaṅgā cājñayā paramātmanaḥ | nirgatā viṣṇupādābjāttena viṣṇupadī smṛtā || 135 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahman gaṅgopākhyānamuttamam | sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 136 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe gaṅgopākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <9.14> gaṅgāyāḥ kṛṣṇapatnītvavarṇanam nārada uvāca lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṅgā tulasī viśvapāvanī | etā nārāyaṇasyaiva catasraśca priyā iti || 1 || gaṅgā jagāma vaikuṇṭhamidameva śrutaṃ mayā | kathaṃ sā tasya patnī ca babhūveti ca na śrutam || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca gaṅgā jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatpaścājjagatāṃ vidhiḥ | gatvovāca tayā sārdhaṃ praṇamya jagadīśvaram || 3 || brahmovāca rādhākṛṣṇāṅgasambhūtā yā devī dravarūpiṇī | navayauvanasampannā suśīlā sundarī varā || 4 || śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca krodhāhaṅkāravarjitā | tadaṅgasambhavā nānyaṃ vṛṇotīyaṃ ca taṃ vinā || 5 || tatrātimāninī rādhā sā ca tejasvinī varā | samudyuktā pātumimāṃ bhīteyaṃ buddhipūrvakam || 6 || viveśa caraṇāmbhoje kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | sarvatra golakaṃ śuṣkaṃ dṛṣṭvāhamagamaṃ tadā || 7 || goloke yatra kṛṣṇaśca sarvavṛttāntaprāptaye | sarvāntarātmā sarveṣāṃ jñātvābhiprāyameva ca || 8 || bahiścakāra gaṅgā ca pādāṅguṣṭhanakhāgrataḥ | dattvāsyai rādhikāmantraṃ pūrayitvā ca golakam || 9 || praṇamya tāṃ ca rādheśaṃ gṛhītvātrāgamaṃ prabho | gāndharveṇa vivāhena gṛhāṇemāṃ sureśvarīm || 10 || sureśvareṣu rasiko rasikeyaṃ samāgatā | tvaṃ ratnaṃ puṃsu deveśa strīratnaṃ strīṣviyaṃ satī || 11 || vidagdhayā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavān bhavet | upasthitāṃ svayaṃ kanyāṃ na gṛhṇātīha yaḥ pumān || 12 || taṃ vihāya mahālakṣmī ruṣṭā yāti na saṃśayaḥ | yo bhavetpaṇḍitaḥ so 'pi prakṛtiṃ nāvamanyate || 13 || sarve prākṛtikāḥ puṃsaḥ kāminyaḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ | tvameva bhagavānnātho nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ || 14 || ardhāṅgaṃ dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo yo'rdhāṅgena caturbhujaḥ | kṛṣṇavāmāṅgasambhūtā babhūva rādhikā purā || 15 || dakṣiṇāṃśaḥ svayaṃ sā ca vāmāṃśaḥ kamalā tathā | teneyaṃ tvāṃ vṛṇotyeva yatastvaddehasambhavā || 16 || ekāṅgaṃ caiva strīpuṃsoryathā prakṛtipūruṣau | ityevamuktvā dhātā tāṃ taṃ samarpya jagāma saḥ || 17 || gāndharveṇa vivāhena tāṃ jagrāha hariḥ svayam | nārāyaṇaḥ karaṃ dhṛtvā puṣpacandanacarcitam || 18 || reme ramāpatistatra gaṅgayā sahito mudā | gaṅgā pṛthvīṃ gatā yā sā svasthānaṃ punarāgatā || 19 || nirgatā viṣṇupādābjāttena viṣṇupadīti ca | mūrcchāṃ samprāpa sā devī navasaṅgamalīlayā || 20 || rasikā sukhasambhogādrasikeśvarasaṃyutā | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitā vāṇī padmayā varjitāpi ca || 21 || nityamīrṣyati tāṃ vāṇī na ca gaṅgā sarasvatīm | gaṅgā śaśāpa kopena bhārate ca haripriyā || 22 || gaṅgayā saha tasyaiva tisro bhāryā ramāpateḥ | sārdhaṃ tulasyā paścācca catasraścābhavanmune || 23 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe gaṅgāyāḥ kṛṣṇapatnītvavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <9.15> nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śaktiprādurbhāvaḥ nārada uvāca nārāyaṇapriyā sādhvī kathaṃ sā ca babhūva ha | tulasī kutra sambhūtā kā vā sā pūrvajanmani || 1 || kasya vā sā kule jātā kasya kanyā kule satī | kena vā tapasā sā ca samprāptā prakṛteḥ param || 2 || nirvikāraṃ nirīhaṃ ca sarvaviśvasvarūpakam | nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ brahma parameśvaramīśvaram || 3 || sarvārādhyaṃ ca sarveśaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam | sarvādhāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ paripālakam || 4 || kathametādṛśī devī vṛkṣatvaṃ samavāpa ha | kathaṃ sāpyasuragrastā sambabhūva tapasvinī || 5 || susnigdhaṃ me mano lolaṃ prerayanmāṃ muhurmuhuḥ | chettumarhasi sandehaṃ sarvaṃ sandehabhañjana || 6 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca manuśca dakṣasāvarṇiḥ puṇyavān vaiṣṇavaḥ śuciḥ | yaśasvī kīrtimāṃścaiva viṣṇoraṃśasamudbhavaḥ || 7 || tatputro brahmasāvarṇirdharmiṣṭho vaiṣṇavaḥ śuciḥ | tatputro dharmasāvarṇirvaiṣṇavaśca jitendriyaḥ || 8 || tatputro rudrasāvarṇirbhaktimānvijitendriyaḥ | tatputro devasāvarṇirviṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ || 9 || tatputra indrasāvarṇirmahāviṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ | vṛṣadhvajaśca tatputro vṛṣadhvajaparāyaṇaḥ || 10 || (vṛkṣadhvaja pāṭhabheda) yasyāśrame svayaṃ śambhurāsīddevayugatrayam | putrādapi paraḥ sneho nṛpe tasmiñchivasya ca || 11 || na ca nārāyaṇaṃ mene na lakṣmīṃ na sarasvatīm | pūjāṃ ca sarvadevānāṃ dūrībhūtā cakāra saḥ || 12 || bhādre māsi mahālakṣmīpūjāṃ matto babhañja ha | tathā māghīyapañcamyāṃ vismṛtā sarvadaivataiḥ || 13 || pāpaḥ sarasvatīpūjāṃ dūrībhūtā cakāra saḥ | yajñaṃ ca viṣṇupūjāṃ ca nindantaṃ taṃ divākaraḥ || 14 || cukopa devo bhūpendraṃ śaśāpa śivakāraṇāt | bhraṣṭaśrīstvañca bhaveti taṃ śaśāpa divākaraḥ || 15 || śūlaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ sūryamadhāvacchaṅkaraḥ svayam | pitrā sārdhaṃ dineśaśca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || 16 || śivastriśūlahastaśca brahmalokaṃ yayau krudhā | brahmā sūryaṃ puraskṛtya vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca yayau bhiyā || 17 || brahmakaśyapamārtaṇḍāḥ santrastāḥ śuṣkatālukāḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ ca sarveśaṃ te yayuḥ śaraṇaṃ bhiyā || 18 || mūrchā praṇemuste gatvā tuṣṭuvuśca punaḥ punaḥ | sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakrurbhayasya kāraṇaṃ harau || 19 || nārāyaṇaśca kṛpayā tebhyaśca hyabhayaṃ dadau | sthirā bhavata he bhītā bhayaṃ kiñca mayi sthite || 20 || smaranti ye yatra tatra māṃ vipattau bhayānvitāḥ | tāṃstatra gatvā rakṣāmi cakrahastastvarānvitaḥ || 21 || pātāhaṃ jagatāṃ devāḥ kartā ca satataṃ sadā | sraṣṭā ca brahmarūpeṇa saṃhartā śivarūpataḥ || 22 || śivo'haṃ tvamahaṃ cāpi sūryo'haṃ triguṇātmakaḥ | vidhāya nānārūpaṃ ca karomi sṛṣṭipālanam || 23 || yūyaṃ gacchata bhadraṃ vo bhaviṣyati bhayaṃ kutaḥ | adyaprabhṛti madvareṇa bhayaṃ vo nāsti śaṅkarāt || 24 || sarveśo vai sa bhagavācchaṅkaraśca satāṃ patiḥ | bhaktādhīnaśca bhaktānāṃ bhaktātmā bhaktavatsalaḥ || 25 || sudarśanaḥ śivaścaiva mama prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ | brahmāṇḍeṣu na tejasvī he brahmannanayoḥ paraḥ || 26 || śaktaḥ sraṣṭuṃ mahādevaḥ sūryakoṭiṃ ca līlayā | koṭiṃ ca brahmaṇāmevaṃ nāsādhyaṃ śūlinaḥ prabhoḥ || 27 || bāhyajñānaṃ naiva kiñciddhyāyate māṃ divāniśam | manmantrānmadguṇānbhaktyā pañcavaktreṇa gāyati || 28 || ahamevaṃ cintayāmi tatkalyāṇaṃ divāniśam | ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham || 29 || śivasvarūpo bhagavāñchivādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā | śivaṃ bhavati tasmācca śivaṃ tena vidurbudhāḥ || 30 || etasminnantare tatra jagāma śaṅkaraḥ sthitaḥ | śūlahasto vṛṣārūḍho raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ || 31 || avaruhya vṛṣāttūrṇaṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ | nanāma bhaktyā taṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ parātparam || 32 || ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitam | kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ cakriṇaṃ vanamālinam || 33 || navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ sundaraṃ ca caturbhujam | caturbhujaiḥ sevitaṃ ca śvetacāmaravāyunā || 34 || candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bhūṣitaṃ pītavāsasam | lakṣmīpradattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca nārada || 35 || vidyādharīnṛtyagītaṃ paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ sadā | īśvaraṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham || 36 || taṃ nanāma mahādevo brahmaṇā namitaśca saḥ | nanāma sūryo bhaktyā ca santrastaścandraśekharam || 37 || kaśyapaśca mahābhaktyā tuṣṭāva ca nanāma ca | śivaḥ saṃstūya sarveśaṃ samuvāsa sukhāsane || 38 || sukhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ viśrāntaṃ candraśekharam | śvetacāmaravātena sevitaṃ viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ || 39 || pīyūṣatulyamadhuraṃ vacanaṃ sumanoharam | viṣṇuruvāca āgato'si kathaṃ cātra vada kopasya kāraṇam || 40 || mahādeva uvāca vṛṣadhvajaṃ ca madbhaktaṃ mama prāṇādhikaṃ priyam | sūryaḥ śaśāpa iti me prakopasya tu kāraṇam || 41 || putravatsalaśokena sūryaṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ | sa brahmāṇaṃ prapannaśca sūryaśca sa vidhistvayi || 42 || tvayi ye śaraṇāpannā dhyānena vacasāpi vā | nirāpado viśaṅkāste jarā mṛtyuśca tairjitaḥ || 43 || pratyakṣaṃ śaraṇāpannāstatphalaṃ kiṃ vadāmi bhoḥ | harismṛtiścābhayadā sarvamaṅgaladā sadā || 44 || kiṃ me bhaktasya bhavitā tanme brūhi jagatprabho | śrīhatasyāsya mūḍhasya sūryaśāpena hetunā || 45 || viṣṇuruvāca kālo'tiyāto daivena yugānāmekaviṃśatiḥ | vaikuṇṭhaṃ ghaṭikārdhena śīghraṃ gaccha tvamālayam || 46 || vṛṣadhvajo mṛtaḥ kālāddurnivāryātsudāruṇāt | rathadhvajaśca tatputro mṛtaḥ so'pi śriyā hataḥ || 47 || tatputrau ca mahābhāgau dharmadhvajakuśadhvajau | hṛtaśriyau sūryaśāpātsmṛtau paramavaiṣṇavau || 48 || rājyabhraṣṭau śriyā bhraṣṭau kamalātapasā ratau | tayośca bhāryayorlakṣmīḥ kalayā ca bhaviṣyati || 49 || sampadyuktau tadā tau ca nṛpaśreṣṭhau bhaviṣyataḥ | mṛtaste sevakaḥ śambho gaccha yūyaṃ ca gacchata || 50 || ityuktvā ca salakṣmīkaḥ sabhāto'bhyantaraṃgataḥ | devā jagmuḥ samprahṛṣṭāḥ svāśramaṃ parayā mudā | śivaśca tapase śīghraṃ paripūrṇatamo yayau || 51 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śaktiprādurbhāvo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <9.16> mahālakṣamyā vedavatīrūpeṇa rājagṛhe janmavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca lakṣmīṃ tau ca samārādhya cogreṇa tapasā mune | varamiṣṭaṃ ca pratyekaṃ samprāpaturabhīpsitam || 1 || mahālakṣmīvareṇaiva tau pṛthvīśau babhūvatuḥ | puṇyavantau putravantau dharmadhvajakuśadhvajau || 2 || kuśadhvajasya patnī ca devī mālāvatī satī | sā suṣāva ca kālena kamalāṃśāṃ sutāṃ satīm || 3 || sā ca bhūyiṣṭhakālena jñānayuktā babhūva ha | kṛtvā vedadhvaniṃ spaṣṭamuttasthau sūtikāgṛhāt || 4 || vedadhvaniṃ sā cakāra jātamātreṇa kanyakā | tasmāttāṃ ca vedavatīṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 5 || jātamātreṇa susnātā jagāma tapase vanam | sarvairniṣiddhā yatnena nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā || 6 || ekamanvantaraṃ caiva puṣkare ca tapasvinī | atyugrāṃ ca tapasyāṃ ca līlayā hi cakāra sā || 7 || tathāpi puṣṭā na kliṣṭā navayauvanasaṃyutā | suśrāva sā ca sahasā suvācamaśarīriṇīm || 8 || janmāntare ca te bhartā bhaviṣyati hariḥ svayam | brahmādibhirdurārādhyaṃ patiṃ lapsyasi sundari || 9 || iti śrutvā ca sā hṛṣṭā cakāra ha punastapaḥ | atīva nirjanasthāne parvate gandhamādane || 10 || tatraiva suciraṃ taptvā viśvasya samuvāsa sā | dadarśa puratastatra rāvaṇaṃ durnivāraṇam || 11 || dṛṣṭvā sātithibhaktyā ca pādyaṃ tasmai dadau kila | susvādubhūtaṃ ca phalaṃ jalaṃ cāpi suśītalam || 12 || tacca bhuktvā sa pāpiṣṭhaścovāsa tatsamīpataḥ | cakāra praśnamiti tāṃ kā tvaṃ kalyāṇi vartase || 13 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa varārohāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām | śaratpadmotsavāsyāṃ ca sasmitāṃ sudatīṃ satīm || 14 || mūrcchāmavāpa kṛpaṇaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ | sa kareṇa samākṛṣya śṛṅgāraṃ kartumudyataḥ || 15 || satī cukopa dṛṣṭvā taṃ stambhitaṃ ca cakāra ha | sa jaḍo hastapādaiśca kiñcidvaktuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ || 16 || tuṣṭāva manasā devīṃ prayayau padmalocanām | sā tuṣṭā tasya stavanaṃ sukṛtaṃ ca cakāra ha || 17 || sā śaśāpa madarthe tvaṃ vinaṃkṣyasi sabāndhavaḥ | spṛṣṭāhaṃ ca tvayā kāmād balaṃ cāpyavalokaya || 18 || ityuktvā sā ca yogena dehatyāgaṃ cakāra ha | gaṅgāyāṃ tāṃ ca saṃnyasya svagṛhaṃ rāvaṇo yayau || 19 || aho kimadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ vānayādhunā | iti sañcintya sañcintya vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ || 20 || sā ca kālāntare sādhvī babhūva janakātmajā | sītādevīti vikhyātā yadarthe rāvaṇo hataḥ || 21 || mahātapasvinī sā ca tapasā pūrvajanmataḥ | lebhe rāmaṃ ca bhartāraṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ harim || 22 || samprāpa tapasā''rādhya durārādhyaṃ jagatpatim | sā ramā suciraṃ reme rāmeṇa saha sundarī || 23 || jātismarā na smarati tapasaśca klamaṃ purā | sukhena tajjahau sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ cāpi sukhaṃ phale || 24 || nānāprakāravibhavaṃ cakāra suciraṃ satī | samprāpya sukumāraṃ tamatīva navayauvanā || 25 || guṇinaṃ rasikaṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ devamanuttamam | strīṇāṃ manojñaṃ ruciraṃ tathā lebhe yathepsitam || 26 || pituḥ satyapālanārthaṃ satyasandho raghūdvahaḥ | jagāma kānanaṃ paścātkālena ca balīyasā || 27 || tasthau samudranikaṭe sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca | dadarśa tatra vahniṃ ca viprarūpadharaṃ hariḥ || 28 || rāmaṃ ca duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa ca duḥkhī babhūva ha | uvāca kiñcitsatyeṣṭaṃ satyaṃ satyaparāyaṇaḥ || 29 || dvija uvāca bhagavacchrūyatāṃ rāma kālo'yaṃ yadupasthitaḥ | sītāharaṇakālo'yaṃ tavaiva samupasthitaḥ || 30 || daivaṃ ca durnivāryaṃ ca na ca daivātparo balī | jagatprasūṃ mayi nyasya chāyāṃ rakṣāntike'dhunā || 31 || dāsyāmi sītāṃ tubhyaṃ ca parīkṣāsamaye punaḥ | devaiḥ prasthāpito'haṃ ca na ca vipro hutāśanaḥ || 32 || rāmastadvacanaṃ śrutvā na prakāśya ca lakṣmaṇam | svīkāraṃ vacasaścakre hṛdayena vidūyatā || 33 || vahniryogena sītāyā māyāsītāṃ cakāra ha | tattulyaguṇasarvāṅgāṃ dadau rāmāya nārada || 34 || sītāṃ gṛhītvā sa yayau gopyaṃ vaktuṃ niṣidhya ca | lakṣmaṇo naiva bubudhe gopyamanyasya kā kathā || 35 || etasminnantare rāmo dadarśa kānakaṃ mṛgam | sītā taṃ prerayāmāsa tadarthe yatnapūrvakam || 36 || saṃnyasya lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo jānakyā rakṣaṇe vane | svayaṃ jagāma tūrṇaṃ taṃ vivyādha sāyakena ca || 37 || lakṣmaṇeti ca śabdaṃ sa kṛtvā ca māyayā mṛgaḥ | prāṇāṃstatyāja sahasā puro dṛṣṭvā hariṃ smaran || 38 || mṛgadehaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca | ratnanirmāṇayānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa jagāma ha || 39 || vaikuṇṭhalokadvāryāsītkiṅkaro dvārapālayoḥ | punarjagāma taddvāramādeśād dvārapālayoḥ || 40 || atha śabdaṃ ca sā śrutvā lakṣmaṇeti ca viklavam | taṃ hi sā prerayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmasannidhau || 41 || gate ca lakṣmaṇe rāmaṃ rāvaṇo durnivāraṇaḥ | sītāṃ gṛhītvā prayayau laṅkāmeva svalīlayā || 42 || viṣasāda ca rāmaśca vane dṛṣṭvā ca lakṣmaṇam | tūrṇaṃ ca svāśramaṃ gatvā sītāṃ naiva dadarśa saḥ || 43 || mūrcchāṃ samprāpa suciraṃ vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ punaḥ | punaḥ punaśca babhrāma tadanveṣaṇapūrvakam || 44 || kālena prāpya tadvārtāṃ godāvarīnadītaṭe | sahāyānvānarātkṛtvā babandha sāgaraṃ hariḥ || 45 || laṅkāṃ gatvā raghuśreṣṭho jaghāna sāyakena ca | kālena prāpya taṃ hatvā rāvaṇaṃ bāndhavaiḥ saha || 46 || tāṃ ca vahniparīkṣāṃ ca kārayāmāsa satvaram | hutāśastatra kāle tu vāstavīṃ jānakīṃ dadau || 47 || uvāca chāyā vahniṃ ca rāmaṃ ca vinayānvitā | kariṣyāmīti kimahaṃ tadupāyaṃ vadasva me || 48 || śrīrāmāgnī ūcatuḥ tvaṃ gaccha tapase devi puṣkaraṃ ca supuṇyadam | kṛtvā tapasyā tatraiva svargalakṣmīrbhaviṣyasi || 49 || sā ca tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratapya puṣkare tapaḥ | divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣaṃ ca svargalakṣmīrbabhūva ha || 50 || sā ca kālena tapasā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā | kāminī pāṇḍavānāṃ ca draupadī drupadātmajā || 51 || kṛte yuge vedavatī kuśadhvajasutā śubhā | tretāyāṃ rāmapatnī ca sīteti janakātmajā || 52 || tacchāyā draupadī devī dvāpare drupadātmajā | trihāyaṇī ca sā proktā vidyamānā yugatraye || 53 || nārada uvāca priyāḥ pañca kathaṃ tasyā babhūvurmunipuṅgava | iti maccittasaṃdehaṃ bhañja saṃdehabhañjana || 54 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca laṅkāyāṃ vāstavī sītā rāmaṃ samprāpa nārada | rūpayauvanasampannā chāyā ca bahucintayā || 55 || rāmāgnyorājñayā taptumupāste śaṅkaraṃ param | kāmāturā pativyagrā prārthayantī punaḥ punaḥ || 56 || patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi trilocana | patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi pañcavāraṃ cakāra sā || 57 || śivastatprārthanāṃ śrutvā prahasya rasikeśvaraḥ | priye tava priyāḥ pañca bhaviṣyanti varaṃ dadau || 58 || tena sā pāṇḍavānāṃ ca babhūva kāminī priyā | iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prastāvaṃ vāstavaṃ śṛṇu || 59 || atha samprāpya laṅkāyāṃ sītāṃ rāmo manoharām | vibhīṣaṇāya tāṃ laṅkāṃ dattvāyodhyāṃ yayau punaḥ || 60 || ekādaśasahasrābdaṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ ca bhārate | jagāma sarvairlokaiśca sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhameva ca || 61 || kamalāṃśā vedavatī kamalāyāṃ viveśa sā | kathitaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ puṇyadaṃ pāpanāśanam || 62 || satataṃ mūrtimantaśca vedāścatvāra eva ca | santi yasyāśca jihvāgre sā ca vedavatī śrutā || 63 || dharmadhvajasutākhyānaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te || 64 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe mahālakṣamyā vedavatīrūpeṇa rājagṛhe janmavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <9.17> dharmadhvajasutātulasyupākhyānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca dharmadhvajasya patnī mādhavīti ca viśrutā | nṛpeṇa sārdhaṃ sārāme reme ca gandhamādane || 1 || śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā puṣpacandanacarcitām | candanāliptasarvāṅgīṃ puṣpacandanavāyunā || 2 || strīratnamaticārvaṅgī ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | kāmukī rasikā sṛṣṭā rasikena ca saṃyutā || 3 || surate viratirnāsti tayoḥ surativijñayoḥ | gataṃ devavarṣaśataṃ na jñātaṃ ca divāniśam || 4 || tato rājā matiṃ prāpya suratādvirarāma ca | kāmukī sundarī kiñcinna ca tṛptiṃ jagāma sā || 5 || dadhāra garbhaṃ sā sadyo daivādabdaśataṃ satī | śrīgarbhā śrīyutā sā ca sambabhūva dine dine || 6 || śubhe kṣaṇe śubhadine śubhayoge ca saṃyute | śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca śubhasvāmigrahānvite || 7 || kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu sitavāre ca pādmaja | suṣāva sā ca padmāṃśāṃ padminīṃ tāṃ manoharām || 8 || śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām | pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca paśyantīṃ sasmitāṃ gṛham || 9 || hastapādatalāraktāṃ nimnanābhiṃ manoramām | tadadhastrivalīyuktāṃ nitambayugavartulām || 10 || śīte sukhoṣṇasarvāṅgīṃ grīṣme ca sukhaśītalām | śyāmāṃ sukeśīṃ rucirāṃ nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalām || 11 || pītacampakavarṇābhāṃ sundarīṣveva sundarīm | narā nāryaśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tulanāṃ dātumakṣamāḥ || 12 || tena nāmnā ca tulasīṃ tāṃ vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | sā ca bhūyiṣṭhamānena yogyā strī prakṛtiryathā || 13 || sarvairniṣiddhā tapase jagāma badarīvanam | tatra devābdalakṣaṃ ca cakāra paramaṃ tapaḥ || 14 || manasā nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī bhaviteti ca niścitā | grīṣme pañcatapāḥ śīte toyavastrā ca prāvṛṣi || 15 || āsanasthā vṛṣṭidhārāḥ sahantīti divāniśam | viṃśatsahasravarṣaṃ ca phalatoyāśanā ca sā || 16 || triṃśatsahasravarṣaṃ ca patrāhārā tapasvinī | catvāriṃśatsahasrābdaṃ vāyvāhārā kṛśodarī || 17 || tato daśasahasrābdaṃ nirāhārā babhūva sā | nirlakṣyāṃ caikapādasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kamalodbhavaḥ || 18 || samāyayau varaṃ dātuṃ paraṃ badarikāśramam | caturmukhaṃ ca sā dṛṣṭvā nanāma haṃsavāhanam || 19 || tāmuvāca jagatkartā vidhātā jagatāmapi | brahmovāca varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tulasi yatte manasi vācchitam || 20 || haribhaktiṃ harerdāsyamajarāmaratāmapi | tulasyuvāca śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi yanme manasi vāñchitam || 21 || sarvajñasyāpi purataḥ kā lajjā mama sāmpratam | ahaṃ tu tulasī gopī goloke'haṃ sthitā purā || 22 || kṛṣṇapriyā kiṃkarī ca tadaṃśā tatsakhī priyā | govindaratisambhuktāmatṛptāṃ māṃ ca mūrcchitām || 23 || rāseśvarī samāgatya dadarśa rāsamaṇḍale | govindaṃ bhartsayāmāsa māṃ śaśāpa ruṣānvitā || 24 || yāhi tvaṃ mānavīṃ yonimityevaṃ ca śaśāpa ha | māmuvāca sa govindo madaṃśaṃ ca caturbhujam || 25 || labhiṣyasi tapastaptvā bhārate brahmaṇo varāt | ityevamuktvā deveśo'pyantardhānaṃ cakāra saḥ || 26 || devyā bhiyā tanuṃ tyaktvā prāptaṃ janma guro bhuvi | ahaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ śāntaṃ sundaravigraham || 27 || sāmprataṃ taṃ patiṃ labdhuṃ varaye tvaṃ ca dehi me | brahmadeva uvāca sudāmā nāma gopaśca śrīkṛṣṇāṅgasamudbhavaḥ || 28 || tadaṃśaścātitejasvī lebhe janma ca bhārate | sāmprataṃ rādhikāśāpāddanuvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || 29 || śaṅkhacūḍeti vikhyātastrailokye na ca tatsamaḥ | goloke tvāṃ purā dṛṣṭvā kāmonmathitamānasaḥ || 30 || vilambhituṃ na śaśāka rādhikāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ | sa ca jātismarastasmātsadāmābhūcca sāgare || 31 || jātismarā tvamapi sā sarvaṃ jānāsi sundari | adhunā tasya patnī tvaṃ sambhaviṣyasi śobhane || 32 || paścānnārāyaṇaṃ śāntaṃ kāntameva variṣyasi | śāpānnārāyaṇasyaiva kalayā daivayogataḥ || 33 || bhaviṣyasi vṛkṣarūpā tvaṃ pūtā viśvapāvanī | pradhānā sarvapuṣpeṣu viṣṇuprāṇādhikā bhaveḥ || 34 || tvayā vinā ca sarveṣāṃ pūjā ca viphalā bhavet | vṛndāvane vṛkṣarūpā nāmnā vṛndāvanīti ca || 35 || tvatpatrairgopigopāśca pūjayiṣyanti mādhavam | vṛkṣādhidevīrūpeṇa sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇena santatam || 36 || vihariṣyasi gopena svacchandaṃ madvareṇa ca | ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sasmitā hṛṣṭamānasā || 37 || praṇanāma ca brahmāṇaṃ taṃ ca kiñciduvāca sā | tulasyuvāca yathā me dvibhuje kṛṣṇe vāñchā ca śyāmasundare || 38 || satyaṃ bravīmi he tāta na tathā ca caturbhuje | atṛptāhaṃ ca govinde daivācchṛṅgārabhaṅgataḥ || 39 || govindasyaiva vacanātprārthayāmi caturbhujam | tvatprasādena govindaṃ punareva sudurlabham || 40 || dhruvameva labhiṣyāmi rādhābhītiṃ pramocaya | brahyadeva uvāca gṛhāṇa rādhikāmantraṃ dadāmi ṣoḍaśākṣaram || 41 || tasyāśca prāṇatulyā tvaṃ madvareṇa bhaviṣyasi | śṛṅgāraṃ yuvayorgopyaṃ na jñāsyati ca rādhikā || 42 || rādhāsamā tvaṃ subhage govindasya bhaviṣyasi | ityevamuktvā dattvā ca devyā vai ṣoḍaśākṣaram || 43 || mantraṃ caiva jagaddhātā stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ param | sarvaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca puraścaryāvidhikramam || 44 || parāṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ caiva pūjāṃ caiva cakāra sā | babhūva siddhā sā devī tatprasādādramā yathā || 45 || siddhaṃ mantreṇa tulasī varaṃ prāpa yathoditam | bubhuje ca mahābhogaṃ yadviśveṣu ca durlabham || 46 || prasannamanasā devī tatyāja tapasaḥ klamam | siddhe phale narāṇāṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca sukhamuttamam || 47 || bhuktyā pītvā ca santuṣṭā śayanaṃ ca cakāra sā | talpe manorame tatra puṣpacandanacarcite || 48 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde dharmadhvajasutātulasyupākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <9.18> śaṅkhacūḍena saha tulasyāḥ saṅgativarṇanam nārāyaṇa uvāca tulasī parituṣṭā ca suṣvāpa hṛṣṭamānasā | navayauvanasampannā vṛṣadhvajavarāṅganā || 1 || cikṣepa pañcabāṇaśca pañcabāṇāṃśca tāṃ prati | puṣpāyudhena sā dagdhā puṣpacandanacarcitā || 2 || pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgī kampitāraktalocanā | kṣaṇaṃ sā śuṣkatāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa ha || 3 || kṣaṇamudvignatāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ tandrāṃ sukhāvahām | kṣaṇaṃ ca dahanaṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ prāpa prasannatām || 4 || kṣaṇaṃ sā cetanāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ prāpa viṣaṇṇatām | uttiṣṭhantī kṣaṇaṃ talpād gacchantī nikaṭe kṣaṇam || 5 || bhramantī kṣaṇamudvegānnivasantī kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ | kṣaṇameva samudvegātsuṣvāpa punareva sā || 6 || puṣpacandanatalpaṃ ca tad babhūvātikaṇṭakam | viṣahāri sukhaṃ divyaṃ sundaraṃ ca phalaṃ jalam || 7 || nilayaṃ ca bilākāraṃ sūkṣmavastraṃ hutāśanaḥ | sindūrapatrakaṃ caiva vraṇatulyaṃ ca duḥkhadam || 8 || kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa tandrāyāṃ suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ satī | sundaraṃ ca yuvānaṃ ca sasmitaṃ rasikeśvaram || 9 || candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam | āgacchantaṃ mālyavantaṃ pibantaṃ tanmukhāmbujam || 10 || kathayantaṃ ratikathāṃ bruvantaṃ madhuraṃ muhuḥ | sambhuktavantaṃ talpe ca samāśliṣyantamīpsitam || 11 || punareva tu gacchantamāgacchantaṃ ca sannidhau | yāntaṃ kva yāsi prāṇeśa tiṣṭhatyevamuvāca sā || 12 || punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ | evaṃ sā yauvanaṃ prāpya tasthau tatraiva nārada || 13 || śaṅkhacūḍo mahāyogī jaigīṣavyānmanoharam | kṛṣṇamantraṃ ca samprāpya kṛtvā siddhaṃ tu puṣkare || 14 || kavacaṃ ca gale baddhvā sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam | brahmaṇaśca varaṃ prāpya yatte manasi vāñchitam || 15 || ājñayā brahmaṇaḥ so'pi badarīṃ ca samāyayau | āgacchantaṃ śaṅkhacūḍaṃ dadarśa tulasī mune || 16 || navayauvanasampannaṃ kāmadevasamaprabham | śvetacampakavarṇābhaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 17 || śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam | ratnasāravinirmāṇavimānasthaṃ manoharam || 18 || ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitam | pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāvantaṃ ca susmitam || 19 || kastūrīkuṅkumāyuktaṃ sugandhicandanānvitam | sā dṛṣṭvā sannidhāvenaṃ mukhamācchādya vāsasā || 20 || sasmitā taṃ nirīkṣantī sakaṭākṣaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | babhūvātinamramukhī navasaṅgamalajjitā || 21 || śaradinduvinindyaikasvamukhenduvirājitā | amūlyaratnanirmāṇayāvakāvalisaṃyutā || 22 || maṇīndrasāranirmāṇakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitā | dadhatī kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam || 23 || amūlyaratnanirmāṇamakarākṛtikuṇḍalā | citrakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitā || 24 || ratnendrasārahāreṇa stanamadhyasthalojjvalā | ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūraśaṅkhabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā || 25 || ratnāṅgulīyakairdivyairaṅgulyāvalirājitā | dṛṣṭvā tāṃ lalitāṃ ramyāṃ suśīlāṃ sundarīṃ satīm || 26 || uvāsa tatsamīpe tu madhuraṃ tāmuvāca saḥ | śaṅkhacūḍa uvāca kā tvaṃ kasya ca kanyā ca dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām || 27 || kā tvaṃ mānini kalyāṇi sarvakalyāṇadāyini | maunībhūte kiṅkare māṃ sambhāṣāṃ kuru sundari || 28 || ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sakāmā vāmalocanā | sasmitā namravadanā sakāmaṃ tamuvāca sā || 29 || tulasyuvāca dharmadhvajasutāhaṃ ca tapasyāyāṃ tapovane | tapasvinyahaṃ tiṣṭhāmi kastvaṃ gaccha yathāsukham || 30 || kāminīṃ kulajātāṃ ca rahasyekākinīṃ satīm | na pṛcchati kule jāta ityevaṃ me śrutau śrutam || 31 || lampaṭo'satkule jāto dharmaśāstrārthavarjitaḥ | yenāśrutaḥ śruterarthaḥ sa kāmīcchati kāminīm || 32 || āpātamadhurāṃ mattāmantakāṃ puruṣasya tām | viṣakumbhākārarūpāmamṛtāsyāṃ ca santatam || 33 || hṛdaye kṣuradhārābhāṃ śaśvanmadhurabhāṣiṇīm | svakāryapariniṣpattyai tatparā satataṃ ca tām || 34 || kāryārthe svāmivaśagāmanyathaivāvaśāṃ sadā | svāntarmalinarūpāṃ ca prasannavadanekṣaṇām || 35 || śrutau purāṇe yāsāṃ ca caritramatidūṣitam | tāsu ko viśvasetprājñaḥ prajñāvāṃśca durāśayaḥ || 36 || tāsāṃ ko vā ripurmitraṃ prārthayanti navaṃ navam | dṛṣṭvā suveṣaṃ puruṣamicchanti hṛdaye sadā || 37 || bāhye svārthaṃ satītvaṃ ca jñāpayantī prayatnataḥ | śaśvatkāmā ca rāmā ca kāmādhārā manoharā || 38 || bāhye chalātkhedayantī svāntarmaithunamānasā | kāntaṃ hasantī rahasi bāhye'tīva sulajjitā || 39 || māninī maithunābhāve kopanā kalahāṅkurā | suprītā bhūrisambhogātsvalpamaithunaduḥkhitā || 40 || sumiṣṭānnācchītatoyādākāṅkṣantī ca mānase | sundaraṃ rasikaṃ kāntaṃ yuvānaṃ guṇinaṃ sadā || 41 || sutātparamabhisnehaṃ kurvatī rasikopari | prāṇādhikaṃ priyatamaṃ sambhogakuśalaṃ priyam || 42 || paśyantī riputulyaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ vā maithunākṣamam | kalahaṃ kurvatī śaśvattena sārdhaṃ sukopanā || 43 || vācayā bhakṣayantī taṃ sarpa ākhumivolbaṇam | duḥsāhasasvarūpā ca sarvadoṣāśrayā sadā || 44 || brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ duḥsādhyā moharūpiṇī | tapomārgārgalā śaśvanmokṣadvārakapāṭikā || 45 || harerbhaktivyavahitā sarvamāyākaraṇḍikā | saṃsārakārāgāre ca śaśvannigaḍarūpiṇī || 46 || indrajālasvarūpā ca mithyā ca svapnarūpiṇī | bibhratī bāhyasaundaryamadho'ṅgamatikutsitam || 47 || nānāviṇmūtrapūyānāmādhāraṃ malasaṃyutam | durgandhidoṣasaṃyuktaṃ raktāraktamasaṃskṛtam || 48 || māyārūpā māyināṃ ca vidhinā nirmitā purā | viṣarūpā mumukṣūṇāmadṛśyāpyabhivāñchatām || 49 || ityuktvā tulasī taṃ tu virarāma ca nārada | sasmitaḥ śaṅkhacūḍaśca pravaktumupacakrame || 50 || śaṅkhacūḍa uvāca tvayā yatkathitaṃ devi na ca sarvamalīkakam | kiñcitsatyamalīkaṃ ca kiñcinmatto niśāmaya || 51 || nirmitaṃ dvividhaṃ dhātrā strīrūpaṃ sarvamohanam | kṛtvā rūpaṃ vāstavaṃ ca praśasyaṃ cāpraśaṃsitam || 52 || lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikādikā | sṛṣṭisūtrasvarūpā ca ādyā sṛṣṭirvinirmitā || 53 || etāsāmaṃśarūpaṃ ca strīrūpaṃ vāstavaṃ smṛtam | tatpraśasyaṃ yaśorūpaṃ sarvamaṅgalakārakam || 54 || śatarūpā devahūtī svadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā | chāyāvatī rohiṇī ca varuṇānī śacī tathā || 55 || kuberasya ca patnī yāpyaditiśca ditistathā | lopāmudrānasūyā ca koṭabhī tulasī tathā || 56 || ahalyārundhatī menā tārā mandodarī tathā | damayantī vedavatī gaṅgā ca manasā tathā || 57 || puṣṭistuṣṭiḥ smṛtirmedhā kālikā ca vasundharā | ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalacaṇḍī ca mūrtiśca dharmakāminī || 58 || svastiḥ śraddhā ca śāntiśca kāntiḥ kṣāntistathā parā | nidrā tandrā kṣutpipāsā sandhyā rātridināni ca || 59 || sampattirdhṛtikīrtī ca kriyā śobhā prabhā śivā | yatstrīrūpaṃ ca sambhūtamuttamaṃ tu yuge yuge || 60 || kalākalāṃśarūpaṃ ca svarveśyādikameva ca | tadapraśasyaṃ viśveṣu puṃścalīrūpameva ca || 61 || sattvapradhānaṃ yadrūpaṃ tadyuktaṃ ca prabhāvataḥ | taduttamaṃ ca viśveṣu sādhvīrūpaṃ praśaṃsitam || 62 || tadvāstavaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | rajorūpaṃ tamorūpaṃ kalāsu vividhaṃ smṛtam || 63 || madhyamā rajasaścāṃśāstāstu bhogeṣu lolupāḥ | sukhasambhogavaśyāśca svakārye niratāḥ sadā || 64 || kapaṭā mohakāriṇyo dharmārthavimukhāḥ sadā | rajorūpasya sādhvītvamato naivopajāyate || 65 || idaṃ madhyamarūpaṃ ca pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | tamorūpaṃ durnivāryamadhamaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ || 66 || na pṛcchati kule jātaḥ paṇḍitaśca parastriyam | nirjane nirjale vāpi rahasyapi parastriyam || 67 || āgacchāmi tvatsamīpamājñayā brahmaṇo'dhunā | gāndharveṇa vivāhena tvāṃ grahīṣyāmi śobhane || 68 || ahameva śaṅkhacūḍo devavidrāvakārakaḥ | danuvaṃśyo viśeṣeṇa sudāmāhaṃ hareḥ purā || 69 || ahamaṣṭasu gopeṣu gopo'pi pārṣadeṣu ca | adhunā dānavendro'haṃ rādhikāyāśca śāpataḥ || 70 || jātismaro'haṃ jānāmi kṛṣṇamantraprabhāvataḥ | jātismarā tvaṃ tulasī sambhuktā hariṇā purā || 71 || tvameva rādhikākopājjātāsi bhārate bhuvi | tvāṃ sambhoktumutsuko'haṃ nālaṃ rādhābhayāttataḥ || 72 || ityevamuktvā sa pumānvirarāma mahāmune | sasmitaṃ tulasī tuṣṭā pravaktumupacakrame || 73 || tulasyuvāca evaṃvidho budho nityaṃ viśveṣu ca praśaṃsitaḥ | kāntamevaṃvidhaṃ kāntā śaśvadicchati kāmataḥ || 74 || tvayāhamadhunā satyaṃ vicāreṇa parājitā | sa ninditaścāpyaśuciryaḥ pumāṃśca striyā jitaḥ || 75 || nindanti pitaro devā bāndhavāḥ strījitaṃ naram | strījitaṃ manasā mātā pitā bhrātā ca nindati || 76 || śuddho vipro daśāhena jātake mṛtake yathā | bhūmipo dvādaśāhena vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhataḥ || 77 || śūdro māsena vedeṣu mātṛvaddhīnasaṅkaraḥ | aśuciḥ strījitaḥ śuddhyeccitādahanakālataḥ || 78 || na gahṇantīcchayā tasya pitaraḥ piṇḍatarpaṇam | na gahṇantyeva devāśca tasya puṣpajalādikam || 79 || kiṃ vā jñānena tapasā japahomaprapūjanaiḥ | kiṃ vidyayā ca yaśasā strībhiryasya mano hṛtam || 80 || vidyāprabhāvajñānārthaṃ mayā tvaṃ ca parīkṣitaḥ | kṛtvā parīkṣāṃ kāntasya vṛṇoti kāminī varam || 81 || varāya guṇahīnāya vṛddhāyājñānine tathā | daridrāya ca mūrkhāya rogiṇe kutsitāya ca || 82 || atyantakopayuktāya vātyantadurmukhāya ca | paṅgave cāṅgahīnāya cāndhāya badhirāya ca || 83 || jaḍāya caiva mūkāya klībatulyāya pāpine | brahmahatyāṃ labhetso'pi svakanyāṃ pradadāti yaḥ || 84 || śāntāya guṇine caiva yūne ca viduṣe'pi ca | sādhave ca sutāṃ dattvā daśayajñaphalaṃ labhet || 85 || yaḥ kanyāpālanaṃ kṛtvā karoti yadi vikrayam | vikretā dhanalobhena kumbhīpākaṃ sa gacchati || 86 || kanyāmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca tatra bhakṣati pātakī | kṛmibhirdaṃśitaḥ kākairyāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 87 || tadante vyādhisaṃyuktaḥ sa labhejjanma niścitam | vikrīṇāti māṃsabhāraṃ vahatyeva divāniśam || 88 || ityevamuktvā tulasī virarāma taponidhe | brahmovāca kiṃ karoṣi śaṅkhacūḍa saṃvādamanayā saha || 89 || gāndharveṇa vivāhena tvaṃ cāsyā grahaṇaṃ kuru | puruṣeṣvasi ratnaṃ tvaṃ strīṣu ratnaṃ tviyaṃ satī || 90 || vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavānbhavet | nirvirodhasukhaṃ rājan ko vā tyajati durlabham || 91 || yo'virodhasukhatyāgī sa paśurnātra saṃśayaḥ | kiṃ parīkṣasi tvaṃ kāntamīdṛśaṃ guṇinaṃ sati || 92 || devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca dānavānāṃ vimardakam | yathā lakṣmīśca lakṣmīśe yathā kṛṣṇe ca rādhikā || 93 || yathā mayi ca sāvitrī bhavānī ca bhave yathā | yathā dharā varāhe ca dakṣiṇā ca yathādhvare || 94 || dyathātreranasūyā ca damayantī yathā nale | rohiṇī ca yathā candre yathā kāme ratiḥ satī || 95 || yathāditiḥ kaśyape ca vasiṣṭhe'rundhatī sakhī | yathāhalyā gautame ca devahūtiśca kardame || 96 || yathā bṛhaspatau tārā śatarūpā manau yathā | yathā ca dakṣiṇā yajñe yathā svāhā hutāśane || 97 || yathā śacī mahendre ca yathā puṣṭirgaṇeśvare | devasenā yathā skande dharme bhūrtiryathā satī || 98 || saubhāgyā supriyā tvaṃ ca śaṅkhacūḍe tathā bhava | anena sārdhaṃ suciraṃ sundareṇa ca sundari || 99 || sthāne sthāne vihāraṃ ca yathecchaṃ kuru santatam | paścātprāpyasi goloke śrīkṛṣṇaṃ punareva ca | caturbhujaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe śaṅkhacūḍe mṛte sati || 100 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe śaṅkhacūḍena saha tulasyāḥ saṅgativarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <9.19> śaṅkhacūḍena saha tulasīsaṅgamavarṇanam nārada uvāca vicitramidamākhyānaṃ bhavatā samudāhṛtam | śrutena yena me tṛptirna kadāpi hi jāyate || 1 || tataḥ paraṃ tu yajjātaṃ tattvaṃ vada mahāmate | śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ityevamāśiṣaṃ dattvā svālayaṃ ca yayau vidhiḥ || 2 || gāndharveṇa vivāhena jagṛhe tāṃ ca dānavaḥ | svarge dundubhivādyaṃ ca puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha || 3 || sa reme rāmayā sārdhaṃ vāsagehe manorame | mūrcchāṃ sā prāpa tulasī navasaṅgamasaṅgatā || 4 || nimagnā nirjale sādhvī sambhogasukhasāgare | catuḥṣaṣṭikalāmānaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭividhaṃ sukham || 5 || kāmaśāstre yanniruktaṃ rasikānāṃ yathepsitam | aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃśleṣapūrvakaṃ strīmanoharam || 6 || tatsarvaṃ rasaśṛṅgāraṃ cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ | atīva ramyadeśe ca sarvajantuvivarjite || 7 || puṣpacandanatalpe ca puṣpacandanavāyunā | puṣpodyāne nadītīre puṣpacandanacarcite || 8 || gahītvā rasiko rāse puṣpacandanacarcitām | bhūṣito bhūṣaṇenaiva ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 9 || surate viratirnāsti tayoḥ surativijñayoḥ | jahāra mānasaṃ bharturlolayā līlayā satī || 10 || cetanāṃ rasikāyāśca jahāra rasabhāvavit | vakṣasaścandanaṃ rājñastilakaṃ vijahāra sā || 11 || sa ca jahāra tasyāśca sindūraṃ bindupatrakam | tadvakṣasyuroje ca nakharekhāṃ dadau mudā || 12 || sā dadau tadvāmapārśve karabhūṣaṇalakṣaṇam | rājā tadoṣṭhapuṭake dadau radanadaṃśanam || 13 || tadgaṇḍayugale sā ca pradadau taccaturguṇam | āliṅganaṃ cumbanaṃ ca jaṅghādimardanaṃ tathā || 14 || evaṃ parasparaṃ krīḍāṃ cakratustau vijānatau | surate virate tau ca samutthāya parasparam || 15 || suveṣaṃ cakratustatra yadyanmanasi vāñchitam | candanaiḥ kuṅkumāraktaiḥ sā tasya tilakaṃ dadau || 16 || sarvāṅge sundare ramye cakāra cānulepanam | suvāsaṃ caiva tāmbūlaṃ vahniśuddhe ca vāsasī || 17 || pārijātasya kusumaṃ jarārogaharaṃ param | amūlyaratnanirmāṇamaṅgulīyakamuttamam || 18 || sundaraṃ ca maṇivaraṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham | dāsī tavāhamityevaṃ samuccārya punaḥ punaḥ || 19 || nanāma parayā bhaktyā svāminaṃ guṇaśālinam | sasmitā tanmukhāmbhojaṃ locanābhyāṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 20 || nimeṣarahitābhyāṃ cāpyapaśyatkāmasundaram | sa ca tāṃ ca samākṛṣya cakāra vakṣasi priyām || 21 || sasmitaṃ vāsasācchannaṃ dadarśa mukhapaṅkajam | cucumba kaṭhine gaṇḍe bimboṣṭhau punareva ca || 22 || dadau tasyai vastrayugmaṃ varuṇādāhṛtaṃ ca yat | tadāhṛtāṃ ratnamālāṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabhām || 23 || dadau mañjīrayugmaṃ ca svāhāyā āhṛtaṃ ca yat | keyūrayugmaṃ chāyāyā rohiṇyāścaiva kuṇḍalam || 24 || aṅgulīyakaratnāni ratyāśca karabhūṣaṇam | śaṅkhaṃ ca ruciraṃ citraṃ yaddattaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 25 || vicitrapadmakaśreṇīṃ śayyāṃ cāpi sudurlabhām | bhūṣaṇāni ca dattvā sa bhūpo hāsaṃ cakāra ha || 26 || nirmame kabarībhāre tasyā māṅgalyabhūṣaṇam | sucitraṃ patrakaṃ gaṇḍamaṇḍale'syāḥ samaṃ tathā || 27 || candralekhātribhiryuktaṃ candanena sugandhinā | parītaṃ paritaścitraiḥ sārdhaṃ kuṅkumabindubhiḥ || 28 || jvalatpradīpākāraṃ ca sindūratilakaṃ dadau | tatpādapadmayugale sthalapadmavinindite || 29 || citrālaktakarāgaṃ ca nakhareṣu dadau mudā | svavakṣasi muhurnyasya sarāgaṃ caraṇāmbujam || 30 || he devi tava dāso'hamityuccārya punaḥ punaḥ | ratnabhūṣitahastena tāṃ ca kṛtvā svavakṣasi || 31 || tapovanaṃ parityajya rājā sthānāntaraṃ yayau | malaye devanilaye śaile śaile tapovane || 32 || sthāne sthāne'tiramye ca puṣpodyāne ca nirjane | kandare kandare sindhutīre caivātisundare || 33 || puṣpabhadrānadītīre nīravātamanohare | puline puline divye nadyāṃ nadyāṃ nade nade || 34 || madhau madhukarāṇāṃ ca madhuradhvaninādite | vispandane surasane nandane gandhamādane || 35 || devodyāne nandane ca citracandanakānane | campakānāṃ ketakīnāṃ mādhavīnāṃ ca mādhave || 36 || kundānāṃ mālatīnāṃ ca kumudāmbhojakānane | kalpavṛkṣe kalpavṛkṣe pārijātavane vane || 37 || nirjane kāñcane sthāne dhanye kāñcanaparvate | kāñcīvane kiñjalake kañcuke kāñcanākare || 38 || puṣpacandanatalpeṣu puṃskokilarutaśrute | puṣpacandanasaṃyuktaḥ puṣpacandanavāyunā || 39 || kāmukyā kāmukaḥ kāmātsa reme rāmayā saha | na hi tṛpto dānavendrastṛptiṃ naiva jagāma sā || 40 || haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva vavṛdhe madanastayoḥ | tayā saha samāgatya svāśramaṃ dānavastataḥ || 41 || ramyaṃ krīḍālayaṃ gatvā vijahāra punaḥ punaḥ | evaṃ sa bubhuje rājyaṃ śaṅkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān || 42 || ekamanvantaraṃ pūrṇaṃ rājarājeśvaro mahān | devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca dānavānāṃ ca santatam || 43 || gandharvāṇāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca śāntidaḥ | hṛtādhikārā devāśca caranti bhikṣukā yathā || 44 || te sarve'tiviṣaṇṇāśca prajagmurbrahmaṇaḥ sabhām | vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsū ruruduśca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ || 45 || tadā brahmā suraiḥ sārdhaṃ jagāma śaṅkarālayam | sarveśaṃ kathayāmāsa vidhātā candraśekharam || 46 || brahmā śivaśca taiḥ sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jagāma ha | durlabhaṃ paramaṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param || 47 || samprāpa ca varaṃ dvāramāśramāṇāṃ hareraho | dadarśa dvārapālāṃśca ratnasiṃhāsanasthitān || 48 || śobhitānpītavastraiśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān | vanamālānvitānsarvān śyāmasundaravigrahān || 49 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharāṃścaiva caturbhujān | sasmitānsmeravaktrāsyānpadmanetrānmanoharān || 50 || brahmā tānkathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ gamanārthakam | te'nujñāṃ ca dadustasmai praviveśa tadājñayā || 51 || evaṃ ṣoḍaśa dvārāṇi nirīkṣya kamalodbhavaḥ | devaiḥ sārdhaṃ tānatītya praviveśa hareḥ sabhām || 52 || devarṣibhiḥ parivṛtāṃ pārṣadaiśca caturbhujaiḥ | nārāyaṇasvarūpaiśca sarvaiḥ kaustubhabhūṣitaiḥ || 53 || navendumaṇḍalākārāṃ caturasrāṃ manoharām | maṇīndrahāranirmāṇāṃ hīrāsārasuśobhitām || 54 || amūlyaratnakhacitāṃ racitāṃ svecchayā hareḥ | māṇikyamālājālābhāṃ muktāpaṅktivibhūṣitām || 55 || maṇḍitāṃ maṇḍalākārai ratnadarpaṇakoṭibhiḥ | vicitraiścitrarekhābhirnānācitravicitritām || 56 || padmarāgendraracitāṃ rucirāṃ maṇipaṅkajaiḥ | sopānaśatakairyuktāṃ syamantakavinirmitaiḥ || 57 || paṭṭasūtragranthiyuktaiścārucandanapallavaiḥ | indranīlastambhavaryairveṣṭitāṃ sumanoharām || 58 || sadratnapūrṇakumbhānāṃ samūhaiśca samanvitām | pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitām || 59 || kastūrīkuṅkumāraktaiḥ sugandhicandanadrumaiḥ | susaṃskṛtāṃ tu sarvatra vāsitāṃ gandhavāyunā || 60 || vidyādharīsamūhānāṃ nṛtyajālairvirājitām | sahasrayojanāyāmāṃ paripūrṇāṃ ca kiṅkaraiḥ || 61 || dadarśa śrīhariṃ brahmā śaṅkaraśca suraiḥ saha | vasantaṃ tanmadhyadeśe yathenduṃ tārakāvṛtam || 62 || amūlyaratnanirmāṇacitrasiṃhāsane sthitam | kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 63 || candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bibhrataṃ kelipaṅkajam | purato nṛtyagītaṃ ca paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā || 64 || śāntaṃ sarasvatīkāntaṃ lakṣmīdhṛtapadāmbujam | lakṣmyā pradattaṃ tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ suvāsitam || 65 || gaṅgayā parayā bhaktyā sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ | sarvaiśca stūyamānaṃ ca bhaktinamrātmakandharaiḥ || 66 || evaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā paripūrṇatamaṃ prabhum | brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve praṇamya tuṣṭuvustadā || 67 || pulakāñcitasarvāṅgāḥ sāśrunetrāśca gadgadāḥ | bhaktāśca parayā bhaktyā bhītā namrātmakandharāḥ || 68 || kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vidhātā jagatāmapi | vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa vinayena hareḥ puraḥ || 69 || haristadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvavit | prahasyovāca brahmāṇaṃ rahasyaṃ ca manoharam || 70 || śrībhagavānuvāca śaṅkhacūḍasya vṛttāntaṃ sarvaṃ jānāmi padmaja | madbhaktasya ca gopasya mahātejasvinaḥ purā || 71 || śṛṇu tatsarvavṛttāntamitihāsaṃ purātanam | golokasyaiva caritaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyakārakam || 72 || sudāmā nāma gopaśca pārṣadapravaro mama | sa prāpa dānavīṃ yoniṃ rādhāśāpātsudāruṇāt || 73 || tatraikadāhamagamaṃ svālayādrāsamaṇḍalam | virajāmapi nītvā ca mama prāṇādhikā parā || 74 || sā māṃ virajayā sārdhaṃ vijñāya kiṅkarīmukhāt | paścātkruddhā sājagāma na dadarśa ca tatra mām || 75 || virajāṃ ca nadīrūpāṃ māṃ jñātvā ca tirohitam | punarjagāma sā dṛṣṭvā svālayaṃ sakhibhiḥ saha || 76 || māṃ dṛṣṭvā mandire devī sudāmnā sahitaṃ purā | bhṛśaṃ sā bhartsayāmāsa maunībhūtaṃ ca susthiram || 77 || tacchrutvāsahamānaśca sudāmā tāṃ cukopa ha | sa ca tāṃ bhartsayāmāsa kopena mama sanidhau || 78 || tacchrutvā kopayuktā sā raktapaṅkajalocanā | bahiṣkartuṃ cakārājñāṃ saṃtrastaṃ mama saṃsadi || 79 || sakhīlakṣaṃ samuttasthau durvāraṃ tejasolbaṇam | bahiścakāra taṃ tūrṇaṃ jalpantaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ || 80 || sā ca tattāḍanaṃ tāsāṃ śrutvā ruṣṭā śaśāpa ha | yāhi re dānavīṃ yonimityevaṃ dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ || 81 || taṃ gacchantaṃ śapantaṃ ca rudantaṃ māṃ praṇamya ca | vārayāmāsa tuṣṭā sā rudatī kṛpayā punaḥ || 82 || he vatsa tiṣṭha mā gaccha kva yāsīti punaḥ punaḥ | samuccārya ca tatpaścājjagāma sā ca viklavam || 83 || gopyaśca ruruduḥ sarvā gopāścāpi suduḥkhitāḥ | te sarve rādhikā cāpi tatpaścād bodhitā mayā || 84 || āyāsyati kṣaṇārdhena kṛtvā śāpasya pālanam | sudāmaṃstvamihāgacchetyuktvā sā ca nivāritā || 85 || golokasya kṣaṇārdhena caikaṃ manvantaraṃ bhavet | pṛthivyāṃ jagatāṃ dhātarityeva vacanaṃ dhruvam || 86 || ityevaṃ śaṅkhacūḍaśca punastatraiva yāsyati | mahābaliṣṭho yogeśaḥ sarvamāyāviśāradaḥ || 87 || mama śūlaṃ gṛhītvā ca śīghraṃ gacchata bhāratam | śivaḥ karotu saṃhāraṃ mama śūlena rakṣasaḥ || 88 || mamaiva kavacaṃ kaṇṭhe sarvamaṅgalakārakam | bibharti dānavaḥ śaśvatsaṃsāre vijayī tataḥ || 89 || tasmin brahman sthite caiva na ko'pi hiṃsituṃ kṣamaḥ | tadyācanāṃ kariṣyāmi viprarūpo'hameva ca || 90 || satītvahānistatpatnyā yatra kāle bhaviṣyati | tatraiva kāle tanmṛtyuriti datto varastvayā || 91 || tatpatnyāścodare vīryamarpayiṣyāmi niścitam | tatkṣaṇe caiva tanmṛtyurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 92 || paścātsā dehamutsajya bhaviṣyati mama priyā | ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho dadau śūlaṃ harāya ca || 93 || śūlaṃ dattvā yayau śīghraṃ harirabhyantare mudā | bhārataṃ ca yayurdevā brahyarudrapurogamāḥ || 94 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe śaṅkhacūḍena saha tulasīsaṅgamavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || <9.20> śaṅkhacūḍena saha devānāṃ saṅgrāmodyogavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca brahmā śivaṃ saṃniyojya saṃhāre dānavasya ca | jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ yathāsthānaṃ surottamāḥ || 1 || candrabhāgānadītīre vaṭamūle manohare | tatra tasthau mahādevo devavistārahetave || 2 || dūtaṃ kṛtvā citrarathaṃ gandharveśvaramīpsitam | śīghraṃ prasthāpayāmāsa śaṅkhacūḍāntikaṃ mudā || 3 || sarveśvarājñayā śīghraṃ yayau tannagaraṃ param | mahendranagarotkṛṣṭaṃ kuberabhavanādhikam || 4 || pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ dairghye tad dviguṇaṃ bhavet | sphaṭikākāramaṇibhirnirmitaṃ yānaveṣṭitam || 5 || saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca durgamābhiḥ samanvitam | jvaladagninibhaiḥ śaśvatkalpitaṃ ratnakoṭibhiḥ || 6 || yuktaṃ ca vīthīśatakairmaṇivedivicitritaiḥ | parito vaṇijāṃ saudhairnānāvastuvirājitaiḥ || 7 || sindūrākāramaṇibhirnirmitaiśca vicitritaiḥ | bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣitairdivyairāśramaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ || 8 || gatvā dadarśa tanmadhye śaṅkhacūḍālayaṃ param | atīva valayākāraṃ yathā pūrṇendumaṇḍalam || 9 || jvaladagniśikhāktābhiḥ parikhābhiścatasṛbhiḥ | taddurgamaṃ ca śatrūṇāmanyeṣāṃ sugamaṃ sukham || 10 || atyuccairgaganasparśimaṇiśṛṅgavirājitam | rājitaṃ dvādaśadvārairdvārapālasamanvitam || 11 || maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaiḥ śobhitaṃ lakṣamandiraiḥ | śobhitaṃ ratnasopānai ratnastambhavirājitam || 12 || tad dṛṣṭvā puṣpadanto'pi varaṃ dvāraṃ dadarśa saḥ | dvāre niyuktaṃ puruṣaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca sasmitam || 13 || tiṣṭhantaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ ca tāmravarṇaṃ bhayaṅkaram | kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ jagāma tadanujñayā || 14 || atikramya ca taddvāraṃ jagāmābhyantaraṃ punaḥ | na ko'pi rakṣati śrutvā dūtarūpaṃ raṇasya ca || 15 || gatvā so'bhyantaradvāraṃ dvārapālamuvāca ha | raṇasya sarvavṛttāntaṃ vijñāpayata māciram || 16 || sa ca taṃ kathayitvā ca dūto gantumuvāca ha | sa gatvā śaṅkhacūḍaṃ taṃ dadarśa sumanoharam || 17 || rājamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsane sthitam | maṇīndraracitaṃ divyaṃ ratnadaṇḍasamanvitam || 18 || ratnakṛtrimapuṣpaiśca praśastaiḥ śobhitaṃ sadā | bhṛtyena mastakanyastaṃ svarṇacchatraṃ manoharam || 19 || sevitaṃ pārṣadagaṇai ruciraiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ | suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 20 || mālyena lepanaṃ sūkṣmaṃ suvastraṃ dadhataṃ mune | dānavendraiḥ parivṛtaṃ suveṣaiśca trikoṭibhiḥ || 21 || śatakoṭibhiranyaiśca bhramadbhirastrapāṇibhiḥ | evaṃbhūtañca taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṣpadantaḥ savismayaḥ || 22 || uvāca sa ca vṛttāntaṃ yaduktaṃ śaṅkareṇa ca | puṣpadanta uvāca rājendra śivabhṛtyo'haṃ puṣpadantābhidhaḥ prabho || 23 || yaduktaṃ śaṅkareṇaiva tad bravīmi niśāmaya | rājyaṃ dehi ca devānāmadhikāraṃ ca sāmpratam || 24 || devāśca śaraṇāpannā deveśaṃ śrīhariṃ param | harirdattvāsya śūlaṃ ca tena prasthāpitaḥ śivaḥ || 25 || puṣpabhadrānadītīre vaṭamūle trilocanaḥ | viṣayaṃ dehi teṣāṃ ca yuddhaṃ vā kuru niścitam || 26 || gatvā vakṣyāmi kiṃ śambhumatha tadvada māmapi | dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śaṅkhacūḍaḥ prahasya ca || 27 || prabhāte'haṃ gamiṣyāmi tvaṃ ca gacchetyuvāca ha | sa gatvovāca taṃ tūrṇaṃ vaṭamūlasthamīśvaram || 28 || śaṅkhacūḍasya vacanaṃ tadīyaṃ tanmukhoditam | etasminnantare skanda ājagāma śivāntikam || 29 || vīrabhadraśca nandī ca mahākālaḥ subhadrakaḥ | viśālākṣaśca bāṇaśca piṅgalākṣo vikampanaḥ || 30 || virūpo vikṛtiścaiva maṇibhadraśca bāṣkalaḥ | kapilākhyo dīrghadaṃṣṭro vikaṭastāmralocanaḥ || 31 || kālakaṇṭho balībhadraḥ kālajihnaḥ kuṭīcaraḥ | balonmatto raṇaślāghī durjayo durgamastathā || 32 || aṣṭau ca bhairavā raudrā rudrāścaikādaśa smṛtāḥ | vasavo'ṣṭau vāsavaśca ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 33 || hutāśanaśca candraśca viśvakarmāśvinau ca tau | kuberaśca yamaścaiva jayanto nalakūbaraḥ || 34 || vāyuśca varuṇaścaiva budhaśca maṅgalastathā | dharmaśca śanirīśānaḥ kāmadevaśca vīryavān || 35 || ugradaṃṣṭrā cogradaṇḍā koṭarā kaiṭabhī tathā | svayaṃ cāṣṭabhujā devī bhadrakālī bhayaṅkarī || 36 || ratnendrasāranirmāṇavimānopari saṃsthitā | raktavastraparīdhānā raktamālyānulepanā || 37 || nṛtyantī ca hasantī ca gāyantī susvaraṃ mudā | abhayaṃ dadāti bhaktebhyo'bhayā sā ca bhayaṃ ripum || 38 || bibhratī vikaṭāṃ jihvāṃ sulolāṃ yojanāyatām | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmakhaḍgacarmadhanuḥśarān || 39 || kharparaṃ vartulākāraṃ gambhīraṃ yojanāyatam | triśūlaṃ gaganasparśi śaktiṃ ca yojanāyatām || 40 || mudgaraṃ musalaṃ vajraṃ kheṭaṃ phalakamujjvalam | vaiṣṇavāstraṃ vāruṇāstraṃ vāhneyaṃ nāgapāśakam || 41 || nārāyaṇāstraṃ gāndharvaṃ brahmāstraṃ gāruḍaṃ tathā | parjanyāstraṃ pāśupataṃ jṛmbhaṇāstraṃ ca pārvatam || 42 || māheśvarāstraṃ vāyavyaṃ daṇḍaṃ sammohanaṃ tathā | avyarthamastrakaṃ divyaṃ divyāstraśatakaṃ param || 43 || āgatya tatra tasthau ca yoginīnāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ | sārdhaṃ ca ḍākinīnāṃ ca vikaṭānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ || 44 || bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍā brahmarākṣasāḥ | vetālā rākṣasāścaiva yakṣāścaiva tu kinnarāḥ || 45 || tābhiścaiva saha skandaḥ praṇamya candraśekharam | pituḥ pārśve sahāyārthaṃ samuvāsa tadājñayā || 46 || atha dūte gate tatra śaṅkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān | uvāca tulasīṃ vārtāṃ gatvābhyantarameva ca || 47 || raṇavārtāṃ ca sā śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā | uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvī hṛdayena vidūyatā || 48 || tulasyuvāca he prāṇabandho he nātha tiṣṭha me vakṣasi kṣaṇam | he prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdeva rakṣa me jīvitaṃ kṣaṇam || 49 || bhuṃkṣva janma samāsādya yanme manasi vāñchitam | paśyāmi tvāṃ kṣaṇaṃ kiñcillocanābhyāṃ ca sādaram || 50 || āndolayante prāṇā me mano dagdhaṃ ca santatam | duḥsvapnaśca mayā dṛṣṭaścādyaiva carame niśi || 51 || tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā bhuktvā pītvā nṛpeśvara | uvāca vacanaṃ prājño hitaṃ satyaṃ yathocitam || 52 || śaṃkhacūḍa uvāca kālena yojitaṃ sarvaṃ karmabhoganibandhanam | śubhaṃ harṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaśca maṅgalam || 53 || kāle bhavanti vṛkṣāśca skandhavantaśca kālataḥ | krameṇa puṣpavantaśca phalavantaśca kālataḥ || 54 || teṣāṃ phalāni pakvāni prabhavantyeva kālataḥ | te sarve phalitāḥ kāle pātaṃ yānti ca kālataḥ || 55 || kāle bhavanti viśvāni kāle naśyanti sundari | kālātsraṣṭā ca sṛjati pātā pāti ca kālataḥ || 56 || saṃhartā saṃharetkāle krameṇa sañcaranti te | brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvaraḥ prakṛtiḥ parā || 57 || sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā sa cātmā kālanartakaḥ | kāle sa eva prakṛtiṃ svābhinnāṃ svecchayā prabhuḥ || 58 || nirmāya kṛtavānsarvānviśvasthāṃśca carācarān | sarveśaḥ sarvarūpaśca sarvātmā parameśvaraḥ || 59 || janaṃ janena janitā janaṃ pāti janena yaḥ | janaṃ janena harate taṃ devaṃ bhaja sāmpratam || 60 || yasyājñayā vāti vātaḥ śīghragāmī ca sāmpratam | yasyājñayā ca tapanastapatyeva yathākṣaṇam || 61 || yathākṣaṇaṃ varṣatīndro mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu | yathākṣaṇaṃ dahatyagniścandro bhramati śītavān || 62 || mṛtyormṛtyuṃ kālakālaṃ yamasya ca yamaṃ param | vibhuṃ sraṣṭuśca sraṣṭāraṃ mātuśca mātṛkaṃ bhave || 63 || saṃhartāraṃ ca saṃhartustaṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja | ko vā bandhuśca keṣāṃ vā sarvabandhuṃ bhaja priye || 64 || ahaṃ ko vā ca tvaṃ kā vā vidhinā yojitaḥ purā | tvayā sārdhaṃ karmaṇā ca punastena viyojitaḥ || 65 || ajñānī kātaraḥ śoke vipattau na ca paṇḍitaḥ | sukhe duḥkhe bhramatyeva kālanemikrameṇa ca || 66 || nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ sarveśaṃ kāntaṃ yāsyasi niścitam | tapaḥ kṛtaṃ yadarthaṃ ca purā badarikāśrame || 67 || mayā tvaṃ tapasā labdhā brahmaṇastu vareṇa ca | haryarthe yattava tapo hariṃ prāpsyasi kāmini || 68 || vṛndāvane ca govindaṃ goloke tvaṃ labhiṣyasi | ahaṃ yāsyāmi tallokaṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā ca dānavīm || 69 || tatra drakṣyasi māṃ tvaṃ ca drakṣyāmi tvāṃ ca sāmpratam | agamaṃ rādhikāśāpādbhārataṃ ca sudurlabham || 70 || punaryāsyāmi tatraiva kaḥ śoko me śṛṇu priye | tvaṃ ca dehaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca || 71 || tatkālaṃ prāpsyasi hariṃ mā kānte kātarā bhava | ityuktvā ca dinānte ca tayā sārdhaṃ manoharam || 72 || suṣvāpa śobhane talpe puṣpacandanacarcite | nānāprakāravibhavaṃ cakāra ratnamandire || 73 || ratnapradīpasaṃyukte strīratnaṃ prāpya sundarīm | nināya rajanīṃ rājā krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ || 74 || kṛtvā vakṣasi tāṃ kāntāṃ rudatīmatiduḥkhitām | kṛśodarīṃ nirāhārāṃ nimagnāṃ śokasāgare || 75 || punastāṃ bodhayāmāsa divyajñānena jñānavit | purā kṛṣṇena yaddattaṃ bhāṇḍīre tattvamuttamam || 76 || sa ca tasyai dadau sarvaṃ sarvaśokaharaṃ param | jñānaṃ samprāpya sā devī prasannavadanekṣaṇā || 77 || krīḍāṃ cakāra harṣeṇa sarvaṃ matveti naśvaram | tau dampatī ca krīḍantau nimagnau sukhasāgare || 78 || pulakāñcitasarvāṅgau mūrcchitau nirjane mune | aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃyuktau suprītau suratotsuko || 79 || ekāṅgau ca tathā tau dvau cārdhanārīśvaro yathā | prāṇeśvaraṃ ca tulasī mene prāṇādhikaṃ param || 80 || prāṇādhikāṃ ca tāṃ mene rājā prāṇeśvarīṃ satīm | tau sthitau sukhasuptau ca tandritau sundarau samau || 81 || suveṣau sukhasambhogādaceṣṭau sumanoharau | kṣaṇaṃ sucetanau tau ca kathayantau rasāśrayāt || 82 || kathāṃ manoramāṃ divyāṃ hasantau ca kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ | kṣaṇaṃ ca kelisaṃyuktau rasabhāvasamanvitau || 83 || surate viratirnāsti tau tadviṣayapaṇḍitau | satataṃ jayayuktau dvau kṣaṇaṃ naiva parājitau || 84 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śaṅkhacūḍena saha devānāṃ saṅgrāmodyogavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || <9.21> śaṅkhacūḍakṛte prabodhavākyavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ manasā dhyātvā rakṣaḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ | brāhme muhūrte cotthāya puṣpatalpānmanoharāt || 1 || rātrivāsaḥ parityajya snātvā maṅgalavāriṇā | dhaute ca vāsasī dhṛtvā kṛtvā tilakamujjvalam || 2 || cakārāhnikamāvaśyamabhīṣṭadevavandanam | dadhyājyamadhulājāṃśca dadarśa vastu maṅgalam || 3 || ratnaśreṣṭhaṃ maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ vastraśreṣṭhaṃ ca kāñcanam | brāhmaṇebhyo dadau bhaktyā yathā nityaṃ ca nārada || 4 || amūlyaratnaṃ yatkiñcinmuktāmāṇikyahīrakam | dadau viprāya gurave yātrāmaṅgalahetave || 5 || gajaratnamaśvaratnaṃ dhanaratnaṃ manoharam | dadau sarvaṃ daridrāya viprāya maṅgalāya ca || 6 || bhāṇḍārāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi nagarāṇāṃ dvilakṣakam | grāmāṇāṃ śatakoṭiṃ ca brāhmaṇāya dadau mudā || 7 || putraṃ kṛtvā tu rājendraṃ sarveṣu dānaveṣu ca | putraṃ samarpya bhāryāṃ tāṃ rājyaṃ ca sarvasampadam || 8 || prajānucarasaṅghaṃ ca bhāṇḍāraṃ vāhanādikam | svayaṃ sannāhayuktaśca dhanuṣpāṇirbabhūva ha || 9 || bhṛtyadvārā krameṇaiva cakāra sainyasañcayam | aśvānāṃ ca trilakṣeṇa lakṣeṇa varahastinām || 10 || rathānāmayutenaiva dhānuṣkāṇāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ | trikoṭibhirvarmiṇāṃ ca śūlināṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ || 11 || kṛtā senāparimitā dānavendreṇa nārada | tasyāṃ senāpatiścaiva yuddhaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 12 || mahārathaḥ sa vijñeyo rathināṃ pravaro raṇe | trilakṣākṣauhiṇīsenāpatiṃ kṛtvā narādhipaḥ || 13 || triṃśadakṣauhiṇībādhaṃ bhāṇḍaughaṃ ca cakāra ha | bahirbabhūva śivirānmanasā śrīhariṃ smaran || 14 || ratnendrasāranirmāṇavimānamāruroha saḥ | guruvargānpuraskṛtya prayayau śaṅkarāntikam || 15 || puṣpabhadrānadītīre yatrākṣayavaṭaḥ śubhaḥ | siddhāśramaṃ ca siddhānāṃ siddhikṣetraṃ ca nārada || 16 || kapilasya tapaḥsthānaṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate | paścimodadhipūrve ca malayasya ca paścime || 17 || śrīśailottarabhāge ca gandhamādanadakṣiṇe | pañcayojanavistīrṇā dairghye śataguṇā tathā || 18 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā bhārate ca supuṇyadā | śāśvatī jalapūrṇā ca puṣpabhadrā nadī śubhā || 19 || lavaṇābdhipriyā bhāryā śaśvatsaubhāgyasaṃyutā | śarāvatīmiśritā ca nirgatā sā himālayāt || 20 || gomatīṃ vāmataḥ kṛtvā praviṣṭā paścimodadhau | tatra gatvā śaṅkhacūḍo dadarśa candraśekharam || 21 || vaṭamūle samāsīnaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham | kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ dṛṣṭvā mudrāyuktaṃ ca sasmitam || 22 || śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā | triśalapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ varam || 23 || bhaktamṛtyuharaṃ śāntaṃ gaurīkāntaṃ manoharam | tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām || 24 || āśutoṣaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram | viśvanāthaṃ viśvabījaṃ viśvarūpaṃ ca viśvajam || 25 || viśvambharaṃ viśvavaraṃ viśvasaṃhārakārakam | kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca narakārṇavatāraṇam || 26 || jñānapradaṃ jñānabījaṃ jñānānandaṃ sanātanam | avaruhya vimānācca taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānaveśvaraḥ || 27 || sarvaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhaktiyuktaḥ śirasā praṇanāma saḥ | vāmato bhadrakālīṃ ca skandaṃ ca tatpuraḥ sthitam || 28 || āśiṣaṃ ca dadau tasmai kālī skandaśca śaṅkaraḥ | uttasthurāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve nandīśvarādayaḥ || 29 || parasparaṃ ca bhāṣante cakrustatra ca sāmpratam | rājā kṛtvā ca sambhāṣāmuvāsa śivasannidhau || 30 || prasannātmā mahādevo bhagavāṃstamuvāca ha | mahādeva uvāca vidhātā jagatāṃ brahmā pitā dharmasya dharmavit || 31 || marīcistasya putraśca vaiṣṇavāścāpi dhārmikaḥ | kaśyapaścāpi tatputro dharmiṣṭhaśca prajāpatiḥ || 32 || dakṣaḥ prītyā dadau tasmai bhaktyā kanyāstrayodaśa | tāsvekā ca danuḥ sādhvī tatsaubhāgyavivardhitā || 33 || catvāriṃśaddanoḥ putrā dānavāstejasolbaṇāḥ | teṣveko vipracittiśca mahābalaparākramaḥ || 34 || tatputro dhārmiko dambho viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ | jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ puṣkare lakṣavatsaram || 35 || śukrācāryaṃ guruṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | tadā tvāṃ tanayaṃ prāpa paraṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇam || 36 || purā tvaṃ pārṣado gopo gopeṣvapi sudhārmikaḥ | adhunā rādhikāśāpādbhārate dānaveśvaraḥ || 37 || ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ tucchaṃ mene ca vaiṣṇavaḥ | sālokyasārṣṭisāyujyasāmīpyaṃ ca harerapi || 38 || dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sevanaṃ vinā | brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tucchaṃ mene ca vaiṣṇavaḥ || 39 || indratvaṃ vā manutvaṃ vā na mene gaṇanāsu ca | kṛṣṇabhaktasya te kiṃ vā devānāṃ viṣaye bhrame || 40 || dehi rājyaṃ ca devānāṃ matprītiṃ rakṣa bhūmipa | sukhaṃ svarājye tvaṃ tiṣṭha devāstiṣṭhantu vai pade || 41 || alaṃ bhūtavirodhena sarve kaśyapavaṃśajāḥ | yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca || 42 || jñātidrohasya pāpāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | svasampadāṃ ca hāniṃ ca yadi rājendra manyase || 43 || sarvāvasthā ca samatāṃ keṣāṃ yāti ca sarvadā | brahmaṇaśca tirobhāvo laye prākṛtike sadā || 44 || āvirbhāvaḥ punastasya prabhāvādīśvarecchayā | jñānavṛddhiśca tapasā smṛtilopaśca niścitam || 45 || karoti sṛṣṭiṃ jñānena sraṣṭā so'pi krameṇa ca | paripūrṇatamo dharmaḥ satye satyāśraye sadā || 46 || tribhāgaḥ so'pi tretāyāṃ dvibhāgo dvāpare smṛtaḥ | ekabhāgaḥ kalau pūrvaṃ tadaṃśaśca kameṇa ca || 47 || kalāmātraṃ kaleḥ śeṣe kuhvāṃ candrakalā yathā | yādṛk tejo ravergnīṣme na tādṛk śiśire punaḥ || 48 || dineṣu yādṛṅmadhyāhne sāyaṃ prātarna tatsamam | udayaṃ yāti kālena bālatāṃ ca krameṇa ca || 49 || prakāṇḍatāṃ ca tatpaścātkāle'staṃ punareti saḥ | dine pracchannatāṃ yāti kālena durdine ghane || 50 || rāhugraste kampitaśca punareva prasannatām | paripūrṇatamaścandraḥ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca jāyate || 51 || tādṛśo na bhavennityaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti dine dine | punaśca puṣṭimāyāti paraṃ kuhvā dine dine || 52 || sampadyuktaḥ śuklapakṣe kṛṣṇe mlānaśca yakṣmaṇā | rāhugraste dine mlāno durdine na virocate || 53 || kāle candro bhavecchuklo bhraṣṭaśrīḥ kālabhedataḥ | bhaviṣyati baliścendro bhraṣṭaśrīḥ sutale'dhunā || 54 || kālena pṛthvī sasyāḍhyā sarvādhārā vasundharā | kāle jale nimagnā sā tirobhūtāmbuviplutā || 55 || kāle naśyanti viśvāni prabhavantyeva kālataḥ | carācarāśca kālena naśyanti prabhavanti ca || 56 || īśvarasyaiva samatā brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ | ahaṃ mṛtyuñjayo yasmādasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam || 57 || ādarśaṃ cāpi drakṣyāmi vāraṃ vāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ | sa ca prakṛtirūpaśca sa eva puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ || 58 || sa cātmā sa ca jīvaśca nānārūpadharaḥ paraḥ | karoti satataṃ yo hi tanāmaguṇakīrtanam || 59 || kāle mṛtyuṃ sa jayati janmarogabhayaṃ jarām | sraṣṭā kṛto vidhistena pātā viṣṇuḥ kṛto bhavet || 60 || ahaṃ kṛtaśca saṃhartā vayaṃ viṣayiṇaḥ kṛtāḥ | kālāgnirudraṃ saṃhāre niyojya viṣaye nṛpa || 61 || ahaṃ karomi satataṃ tannāmaguṇakīrtanam | tena mṛtyuñjayo'haṃ ca jñānenānena nirbhayaḥ || 62 || mṛtyurmṛtyubhayādyāti vainateyādivoragāḥ | ityuktvā sa ca sarveśaḥ sarvabhāvena tatparaḥ || 63 || virarāma ca śambhuśca sabhāmadhye ca nārada | rājā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praśaśaṃsa punaḥ punaḥ || 64 || uvāca madhuraṃ devaṃ paraṃ vinayapūrvakam | śaṅkhacūḍa uvāca tvayā yatkathitaṃ deva nānyathā vacanaṃ smṛtam || 65 || tathāpi kiñcidyathārthaṃ śrūyatāṃ mannivedanam | jñātidrohe mahatpāpaṃ tvayoktamadhunā ca yat || 66 || gṛhītvā tasya sarvasvaṃ kutaḥ prasthāpito baliḥ | mayā samuddhṛtaṃ sarvamūrdhvamaiśvaryamīśvara || 67 || sutalācca samuddhartuṃ nālaṃ tatra gadādharaḥ | sabhrātṛko hiraṇyākṣaḥ kathaṃ devaiśca hiṃsitaḥ || 68 || śumbhādayaścāsurāśca kathaṃ devairnipātitāḥ | purā samudramathane pīyūṣaṃ bhakṣitaṃ suraiḥ || 69 || kleśabhājo vayaṃ tatra te sarve phalabhoginaḥ | krīḍābhāṇḍamidaṃ viśvaṃ prakṛteḥ paramātmanaḥ || 70 || yasmai yatra sa dadāti tasyaiśvaryaṃ bhavettadā | devadānavayorvādaḥ śaśvannaimittikaḥ sadā || 71 || parājayo jayasteṣāṃ kāle'smākaṃ krameṇa ca | tadāvayorvirodhe vā''gamanaṃ niṣkalaṃ param || 72 || samasambandhino bandhorīśvarasya mahātmanaḥ | iyaṃ te mahatī lajjā yuddhe'smābhiḥ sahādhunā || 73 || jaye tato'dhikā kīrtirhāniścaiva parājaye | ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya ca trilocanaḥ || 74 || yathocitamuttaraṃ tamuvāca dānaveśvaram | mahādeva uvāca yuṣmābhiḥ saha yuddhe me brahmavaṃśasamudbhavaiḥ || 75 || kā lajjā mahatī rājannakīrtirvā parājaye | yuddhamādau harereva madhunā kaiṭabhena ca || 76 || hiraṇyakaśipoścaiva saha tenātmanā nṛpa | hiraṇyākṣasya yuddhaṃ ca punastena gadābhṛtā || 77 || tripuraiḥ saha yuddhaṃ ca mayāpi ca purā kṛtam | sarveśvaryāḥ sarvamātuḥ prakṛtyāśca babhūva ha || 78 || saha śumbhādibhiḥ pūrvaṃ samaraḥ paramādbhutaḥ | pārṣadapravarastvaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 79 || ye ye hatāśca daiteyā nahi ke'pi tvayā samāḥ | kā lajjā mahatī rājan mama yuddhe tvayā saha || 80 || surāṇāṃ śaraṇasyaiva preṣitaśca hareraho | dehi rājyaṃ ca devānāmiti me niścitaṃ vacaḥ || 81 || yuddhaṃ vā kuru matsārdhaṃ vāgvyaye kiṃ prayojanam | ityuktvā śaṅkarastatra virarāma ca nārada | uttasthau śaṅkhacūḍaśca hyamātyaiḥ saha satvaram || 82 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādalasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śaṅkhacūḍakṛte prabodhavākyavarṇanaṃ nāmekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || <9.22> kālīśaṅkhacūḍayuddhavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śivaṃ praṇamya śirasā dānavendraḥ pratāpavān | samāruroha yānaṃ ca sahāmātyaiḥ sa satvaraḥ || 1 || śivaḥ svasainyaṃ devāṃśca prerayāmāsa satvaram | dānavendraḥ sasainyaśca yuddhārambhe babhūva ha || 2 || svayaṃ mahendro yuyudhe sārdhaṃ ca vṛṣaparvaṇā | bhāskaro yuyudhe vipracittinā saha satvaraḥ || 3 || dambhena saha candraśca cakāra paramaṃ raṇam | kālasvareṇa kālaśca gokarṇena hutāśanaḥ || 4 || kuberaḥ kālakeyena viśvakarmā mayena ca | bhayaṅkareṇa mṛtyuśca saṃhāreṇa yamastathā || 5 || vikaṅkaṇena varuṇaścañcalena samīraṇaḥ | budhaśca ghṛtapṛṣṭhena raktākṣeṇa śanaiścaraḥ || 6 || jayanto ratnasāreṇa vasavo varcasāṃ gaṇaiḥ | aśvinau ca dīptimatā dhūmreṇa nalakūbaraḥ || 7 || dhurandhareṇa dharmaśca uṣākṣeṇa ca maṅgalaḥ | śobhākareṇa vai bhānuḥ piṭhareṇa ca manmathaḥ || 8 || godhāmukhena cūrṇena khaḍgena ca dhvajena ca | kāñcīmukhena piṇḍena dhūmeṇa saha nandinā || 9 || viśvena ca palāśenādityādyā yuyudhuḥ pare | ekādaśa ca rudrā vai ekādaśabhayaṅkaraiḥ || 10 || mahāmārī ca yuyudhe cogracaṇḍādibhiḥ saha | nandīśvarādayaḥ sarve dānavānāṃ gaṇaiḥ saha || 11 || yuyudhuśca mahāyuddhe pralaye'pi bhayaṅkare | vaṭamūle ca śambhuśca tasthau kālyā sutena ca || 12 || sarve ca yuyudhuḥ sainyasamūhāḥ satataṃ mune | ratnasiṃhāsane ramye koṭibhirdānavaiḥ saha || 13 || uvāsa śaṅkhacūḍaśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | śaṅkarasya ca ye yodhā dānavaiśca parājitāḥ || 14 || devāśca dudruvuḥ sarve bhītāśca kṣatavigrahāḥ | cakāra kopaṃ skandaśca devebhyaścābhayaṃ dadau || 15 || balaṃ ca svargaṇānāṃ ca vardhayāmāsa tejasā | so'yamekaśca yuyudhe dānavānāṃ gaṇaiḥ saha || 16 || akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatakaṃ samare ca jaghāna saḥ | asurānpātayāmāsa kālī kamalalocanā || 17 || papau raktaṃ dānavānāmatikuddhā tataḥ param | daśalakṣagajendrāṇāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca koṭiśaḥ || 18 || samādāyaikahastena mukhe cikṣepa līlayā | kabandhānāṃ sahasraṃ ca nanarta samare mune || 19 || skandasya śarajālena dānavāḥ kṣatavigrahāḥ | bhītāśca dudruvuḥ sarve mahāraṇaparākramāḥ || 20 || vṛṣaparvā vipracittirdambhaścāpi vikaṅkaṇaḥ | skandena sārdhaṃ yuyudhuste sarve vikrameṇa ca || 21 || mahāmārī ca yuyudhe na babhūva parāṅmukhī | babhūvuste ca saṃkṣubdhāḥ skandasya śaktipīḍitāḥ || 22 || na dudruvurbhayātsvarge puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha | skandasya samaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāraudraṃ samulbaṇam || 23 || dānavānāṃ kṣayakaraṃ yathā prākṛtiko layaḥ | rājā vimānamāruhya cakāra bāṇavarṣaṇam || 24 || nṛpasya śaravṛṣṭiśca ghanasya varṣaṇaṃ yathā | mahāghorāndhakāraśca vahnyutthānaṃ babhūva ca || 25 || devāḥ pradudruvuḥ sarve'pyanye nandīśvarādayaḥ | eka eva kārtikeyastasthau samaramūrdhani || 26 || parvatānāṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ śilānāṃ śākhināṃ tathā | nṛpaścakāra vṛṣṭiṃ ca durvārāṃ ca bhayaṅkarīm || 27 || nṛpasya śaravṛṣṭyā ca prahitaḥ śivanandanaḥ | nīhāreṇa ca sāndreṇa prahito bhāskaro yathā || 28 || dhanuściccheda skandasya durvahaṃ ca bhayaṅkaraḥ | babhañja ca rathaṃ divyaṃ ciccheda rathapīṭhakān || 29 || mayūraṃ jarjarībhūtaṃ divyāstreṇa cakāra saḥ | śaktiṃ cikṣepa sūryābhāṃ tasya vakṣasya ghātinīm || 30 || kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāṃ ca samprāpa babhūva cetanaḥ punaḥ | gṛhītvā taddhanurdivyaṃ yaddattaṃ viṣṇunā purā || 31 || ratnendrasāranirmāṇayānamāruhya kārtikaḥ | śastrāstraṃ ca gṛhītvā ca cakāra raṇamulbaṇam || 32 || sarpāṃśca parvatāṃścaiva vṛkṣāṃśca prastarāṃstathā | sarvāṃściccheda kopena divyāstreṇa śivātmajaḥ || 33 || vahniṃ nirvāpayāmāsa pārjanyena pratāpavān | rathaṃ dhanuśca ciccheda śaṅkhacūḍasya līlayā || 34 || sannāhaṃ sārathiṃ caiva kirīṭaṃ mukuṭojjvalam | cikṣepa śaktiṃ śuklābhāṃ dānavendrasya vakṣasi || 35 || mūrcchāṃ samprāpya rājā ca cetanaśca babhūva ha | āruroha yānamanyaddhanurjagrāha satvaraḥ || 36 || cakāra śarajālaṃ ca māyayā māyināṃ varaḥ | guhaṃ cacchāda samare śarajālena nārada || 37 || jagrāha śaktimavyagrāṃ śatasūryasamaprabhām | pralayāgniśikhārūpāṃ viṣṇośca tejasā''vṛtām || 38 || cikṣepa tāṃ ca kopena mahāvegena kārtike | papāta śaktistadgātre vahnirāśirivojjvalā || 39 || mūrcchāṃ samprāpa śaktyā ca kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ | kālī gṛhītvā taṃ kroḍe nināya śivasanidhau || 40 || śivastaṃ cāpi jñānena jīvayāmāsa līlayā | dadau balamanantaṃ ca samuttasthau pratāpavān || 41 || kālī jagāma samaraṃ rakṣituṃ kārtikasya yā | vīrāstāmanujagmuśca te ca nandīśvarādayaḥ || 42 || sarve devāśca gandharvā yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ | vādyabhāṇḍāśca bahuśaḥ śataśo madhuvāhakāḥ || 43 || sā ca gatvātha saṃgrāmaṃ siṃhanādaṃ cakāra ca | devyāśca siṃhanādena prāpurmūrcchāṃ ca dānavāḥ || 44 || aṭṭāṭṭahāsamaśivaṃ cakāra ca punaḥ punaḥ | dṛṣṭvā papau ca mādhvīkaṃ nanarta raṇamūrdhani || 45 || ugradaṃṣṭrā cogradaṇḍā koṭavī ca papau madhu | yoginīḍākinīnāṃ ca gaṇāḥ suragaṇādayaḥ || 46 || dṛṣṭvā kālīṃ śaṅkhacūḍaḥ śīghramājau samāyayau | dānavāśca bhayaṃ prāpū rājā tebhyo'bhayaṃ dadau || 47 || kālī cikṣepa vahniṃ ca pralayāgniśikhopamam | rājā nirvāpayāmāsa pārjanyena ca līlayā || 48 || cikṣepa vāruṇaṃ sā ca tīvraṃ ca mahadadbhutam | gāndharveṇa ca ciccheda dānavendraśca līlayā || 49 || māheśvaraṃ pracikṣepa kālī vahniśikhopamam | rājā jaghāna taṃ śīghraṃ vaiṣṇavena ca līlayā || 50 || nārāyaṇāstraṃ sā devī cikṣepa mantrapūrvakam | rājā nanāma tad dṛṣṭvā cāvaruhya rathādasau || 51 || ūrdhvaṃ jagāma taccāstraṃ pralayāgniśikhopamam | papāta śaṅkhacūḍaśca bhaktyā taṃ daṇḍavadbhuvi || 52 || brahmāstraṃ sā ca cikṣepa yatnato mantrapūrvakam | brahmāstreṇa mahārājo nirvāpaṃ ca cakāra saḥ || 53 || tadā cikṣepa divyāstraṃ sā devī mantrapūrvakam | rājā divyāstrajālena tannirvāṇaṃ cakāra ca || 54 || tadā cikṣepa śaktiṃ ca yatnato yojanāyatām | rājā divyāstrajālena śatakhaṇḍāṃ cakāra ha || 55 || jagrāha mantrapūtaṃ ca devī pāśupataṃ ruṣā | nikṣepaṇaṃ niroddhuṃ ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī || 56 || mṛtyuḥ pāśupate nāsti nṛpasya ca mahātmanaḥ | yāvadasti ca mantrasya kavacaṃ ca hareriti || 57 || yāvatsatītvamastyeva satyāśca nṛpayoṣitaḥ | tāvadasya jarāmṛtyurnāstīti brahmaṇo vacaḥ || 58 || ityākarṇya bhadrakālī na taccikṣepa śastrakam | śatalakṣaṃ dānavānāṃ jagrāsa līlayā kṣudhā || 59 || grastuṃ jagāma vegena śaṅkhacūḍaṃ bhayaṅkarī | divyāstreṇa sutīkṣṇena vārayāmāsa dānavaḥ || 60 || khaḍgaṃ cikṣepa sā devī grīṣmasūryopamaṃ yathā | divyāstreṇa dānavendraḥ śatakhaṇḍaṃ cakāra saḥ || 61 || punargrastuṃ mahādevī vegena ca jagāma tam | sarvasiddheśvaraḥ śrīmānvavṛdhe dānaveśvaraḥ || 62 || vegena muṣṭinā kālī kopayuktā bhayaṅkarī | babhañja ca rathaṃ tasya jaghāna sārathiṃ satī || 63 || sā ca śūlaṃ pracikṣepa pralayāgniśikhopamam | vāmahastena jagrāha śaṅkhacūḍaḥ svalīlayā || 64 || muṣṭyā jaghāna taṃ devī mahākopena vegataḥ | babhrāma ca tayā daityaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa ca || 65 || kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau pratāpavān | na cakāra bāhuyuddhaṃ devyā saha nanāma tām || 66 || devyāścāstraṃ sa ciccheda jagrāha ca svatejasā | nāstraṃ cikṣepa tāṃ bhakto mātṛbhaktyā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ || 67 || gṛhītvā dānavaṃ devī bhrāmayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ ca prāpayāmāsa mahāvegena kopitā || 68 || ūrdhvātpapāta vegena śaṅkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān | nipatya ca samuttasthau praṇamya bhadrakālikām || 69 || ratnendrasāranirmāṇaṃ vimānaṃ sumanoharam | āruroha harṣayukto na viśrānto mahāraṇe || 70 || dānavānāṃ ca kṣatajaṃ sā devī ca papau kṣudhā | pītvā bhuktvā bhadrakālī jagāma śaṅkarāntikam || 71 || uvāca raṇavṛttāntaṃ paurvāparyaṃ yathākramam | śrutvā jahāsa śambhuśca dānavānāṃ vināśanam || 72 || lakṣaṃ ca dānavendrāṇāmavaśiṣṭaṃ raṇe'dhunā | bhuñjantyā nirgataṃ vaktrāttadanyaṃ bhuktamīśvara || 73 || saṃgrāme dānavendraṃ ca hantuṃ pāśupatena vai | avadhyastava rājeti vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī || 74 || rājendraśca mahājñānī mahābalaparākramaḥ | na ca cikṣepa mayyastraṃ ciccheda mama sāyakam || 75 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasavāde kālīśaṅkhacūḍayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || <9.23> śaṅkhacūḍavadhavarṇanam śivastattvaṃ samākarṇya tattvajñānaviśāradaḥ | yayau svayaṃ ca samare svagaṇaiḥ saha nārada || 1 || śaṅkhacūḍaḥ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā vimānādavaruhya ca | nanāma parayā bhaktyā śirasā daṇḍavadbhuvi || 2 || taṃ praṇamya ca vegena vimānamāruroha saḥ | tūrṇaṃ cakāra sannāhaṃ dhanurjagrāha durvaham || 3 || śivadānavayoryuddhaṃ pūrṇamabdaśataṃ purā | na babhūvaturanyonyaṃ brahmañjayaparājayau || 4 || nyastaśastraśca bhagavān nyastaśastraśca dānavaḥ | rathasthaḥ śaṅkhacūḍaśca vṛṣastho vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 5 || dānavānāṃ ca śatakamuddhṛtaṃ ca babhūva ha | raṇe ye ye mṛtāḥ śambhurjīvayāmāsa tānvibhuḥ || 6 || etasminnantare vṛddhabrāhmaṇaḥ paramāturaḥ | āgatya ca raṇasthānamuvāca dānaveśvaram || 7 || vṛddhabrāhmaṇa uvāca dehi bhikṣāṃ ca rājendra mahyaṃ viprāya sāmpratam | tvaṃ sarvasampadāṃ dātā yanme manasi vāñchitam || 8 || nirīhāya ca vṛddhāya tṛṣitāya ca sāmpratam | paścāttvāṃ kathayiṣyāmi puraḥ satyaṃ ca kurviti || 9 || omityuvāca rājendraḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ | kavacārthī janaścāhamityuvācātimāyayā || 10 || tacchrutvā kavacaṃ divyaṃ jagrāha harireva ca | śaṅkhacūḍasya rūpeṇa jagāma tulasīṃ prati || 11 || gatvā tasyāṃ māyayā ca vīryādhānaṃ cakāra ha | atha śambhurhareḥ śūlaṃ jagrāha dānavaṃ prati || 12 || grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍapralayāgniśikhopamam | durnivāryaṃ ca durdharṣamavyarthaṃ vairighātakam || 13 || tejasā cakratulyaṃ ca sarvaśastrāstrasārakam | śivakeśavayoranyairdurvahaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram || 14 || dhanuḥsahasraṃ dairghyeṇa prasthena śatahastakam | sajīvaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca nityarūpamanirdiśam || 15 || saṃhartuṃ sarvabrahmāṇḍamalaṃ yatsvīyalīlayā | cikṣepa tolanaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhacūḍe ca nārada || 16 || rājā cāpaṃ parityajya śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbujam | dhyānaṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ dhiyā || 17 || śūlaṃ ca bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā papāta dānavopari | cakāra bhasmasāttaṃ ca sarathaṃ cātha līlayā || 18 || rājā dhṛtvā divyarūpaṃ kiśoraṃ gopaveṣakam | dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 19 || ratnendrasāranirmāṇaṃ veṣṭitaṃ gopakoṭibhiḥ | golokādāgataṃ yānamāruroha puraṃ yayau || 20 || gatvā nanāma śirasā sa rādhākṛṣṇayormune | bhaktyā ca caraṇāmbhojaṃ rāse vṛndāvane vane || 21 || sudāmānaṃ ca tau dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇau | kroḍe cakraturatyantaṃ premṇātiparisaṃyutau || 22 || atha śalaṃ ca vegena prayayau taṃ ca sādaram | asthibhiḥ śaṅkhacūḍasya śaṅkhajātirbabhūva ha || 23 || nānāprakārarūpeṇa śaśvatpūtā surārcane | praśastaṃ śaṅkhatoyaṃ ca devānāṃ prītidaṃ param || 24 || tīrthatoyasvarūpaṃ ca pavitraṃ śambhunā vinā | śaṅkhaśabdo bhavedyatra tatra lakṣmīḥ susaṃsthirā || 25 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yaḥ snātaḥ śaṅkhavāriṇā | śaṅkho hareradhiṣṭhānaṃ yatra śaṅkhastato hariḥ || 26 || tatraiva vasate lakṣmīrdūrībhūtamamaṅgalam | strīṇāṃ ca śaṅkhadhvanibhiḥ śūdrāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 27 || bhītā ruṣṭā yāti lakṣmīstatsthalādanyadeśataḥ | śivo'pi dānavaṃ hatvā śivalokaṃ jagāma ha || 28 || prahṛṣṭo vṛṣabhārūḍhaḥ svagaṇaiśca samāvṛtaḥ | surāḥ svaviṣayaṃ prāpuḥ paramānandasaṃyutāḥ || 29 || nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge jagurgandharvakinnarāḥ | babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca śivasyopari santatam | praśaśaṃsuḥ surāstaṃ ca munīndrapravarādayaḥ || 30 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe śaṅkhacūḍavadhavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || <9.24> tulasīmāhātmyena saha śālagrāmamahattvavarṇanam nārada uvāca nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānvīryādhānaṃ cakāra ha | tulasyāṃ kena rūpeṇa tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca nārāyaṇaśca bhagavāndevānāṃ sādhaneṣu ca | śaṅkhacūḍasya kavacaṃ gahītvā viṣṇumāyayā || 2 || punarvidhāya tadrūpaṃ jagāma tatsatīgṛham | pātivratasya nāśena śaṅkhacūḍajighāṃsayā || 3 || dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsa tulasīdvārasannidhau | jayaśabdaṃ ca taddvāre bodhayāmāsa sundarīm || 4 || tacchrutvā ca ravaṃ sādhvī paramānandasaṃyutā | rājamārge gavākṣeṇa dadarśa paramādarāt || 5 || brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā kārayāmāsa maṅgalam | vandibhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca vācibhyaśca dhanaṃ dadau || 6 || avaruhya rathāddevo devyāśca bhavanaṃ yayau | amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ sundaraṃ sumanoharam || 7 || dṛṣṭvā ca purataḥ kāntaṃ sā taṃ kāntaṃ mudānvitā | tatpādaṃ kṣālayāmāsa nanāma ca ruroda ca || 8 || ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa kāmukī | tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau tasmai karpūrādisuvāsitam || 9 || adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvanaṃ ca babhūva ha | raṇe gataṃ ca prāṇeśaṃ paśyantyāśca punargṛhe || 10 || sasmitā sakaṭākṣaṃ ca sakāmā pulakāṅkitā | papraccha raṇavṛttāntaṃ kāntaṃ madhurayā girā || 11 || tulasyuvāca asaṃkhyaviśvasaṃhartrā sārdhamājau tava prabho | kathaṃ babhūva vijayastanme brūhi kṛpānidhe || 12 || tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya kamalāpatiḥ | śaṅkhacūḍasya rūpeṇa tāmuvācāmṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 13 || śrībhagavānuvāca āvayoḥ samaraḥ kānte pūrṇamabdaṃ babhūva ha | nāśo babhūva sarveṣāṃ dānavānāṃ ca kāmini || 14 || prītiñca kārayāmāsa brahmā ca svayamāvayoḥ | devānāmadhikāraśca pradattastasya cājñayā || 15 || mayāgataṃ svabhavanaṃ śivalokaṃ śivo gataḥ | ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthaḥ śayanaṃ ca cakāra ha || 16 || reme ramāpatistatra rāmayā saha nārada | sā sādhvī sukhasambhogādākarṣaṇavyatikramāt || 17 || sarvaṃ vitarkayāmāsa kastvamevetyuvāca sā | tulasyuvāca ko vā tvaṃ vada māyeśa bhuktāhaṃ māyayā tvayā || 18 || dūrīkṛtaṃ matsatītvaṃ yadatastvāṃ śapāmi he | tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā hariḥ śāpabhayena ca || 19 || dadhāra līlayā brahman sumūrtiṃ sumanoharām | dadarśa purato devī devadevaṃ sanātanam || 20 || navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam | koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 21 || īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasam | taṃ dṛṣṭvā kāminī kāmaṃ mūrcchāṃ samprāpa līlayā || 22 || punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya punaḥ sā tamuvāca ha | tulasyuvāca he nātha te dayā nāsti pāṣāṇasadṛśasya ca || 23 || chalena dharmabhaṅgena mama svāmī tvayā hataḥ | pāṣāṇahṛdayastvaṃ hi dayāhīno yataḥ prabho || 24 || tasmātpāṣāṇarūpastvaṃ bhave deva bhavādhunā | ye vadanti ca sādhuṃ tvāṃ te bhrāntā hi na saṃśayaḥ || 25 || bhakto vināparādhena parārthe ca kathaṃ hataḥ | bhṛśaṃ ruroda śokārtā vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ || 26 || tataśca karuṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā karuṇārasasāgaraḥ | nayena tāṃ bodhayitumuvāca kamalāpatiḥ || 27 || śrībhagavānuvāca tapastvayā kṛtaṃ bhadre madarthe bhārate ciram | tvadarthe śaṅkhacūḍaśca cakāra suciraṃ tapaḥ || 28 || kṛtvā tvāṃ kāminīṃ so'pi vijahāra ca tatkṣaṇāt | adhunā dātumucitaṃ tavaiva tapasaḥ phalam || 29 || idaṃ śarīraṃ tyaktvā ca divyadehaṃ vidhāya ca | rāme rama mayā sārdhaṃ tvaṃ ramāsadṛśī bhava || 30 || iyaṃ tanurnadīrūpā gaṇḍakīti ca viśrutā | pūtā supuṇyadā nṝṇāṃ puṇye bhavatu bhārate || 31 || tava keśasamūhaśca puṇyavṛkṣo bhaviṣyati | tulasīkeśasambhūtā tulasīti ca viśrutā || 32 || triṣu lokeṣu puṣpāṇāṃ patrāṇāṃ devapūjane | pradhānarūpā tulasī bhaviṣyati varānane || 33 || svarge martye ca pātāle goloke mama sannidhau | bhava tvaṃ tulasī vṛkṣavarā puṣpeṣu sundarī || 34 || goloke virajātīre rāse vṛndāvane vane | bhāṇḍīre campakavane ramye candanakānane || 35 || mādhavīketakīkundamālikāmālatīvane | vāsaste'traiva bhavatu puṇyasthāneṣu puṇyadaḥ || 36 || tulasītarumūleṣu puṇyadeśeṣu puṇyadam | adhiṣṭhānaṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 37 || tatraiva sarvadevānāṃ mamādhiṣṭhānameva ca | tulasīpatrapatanaprāptaye ca varānane || 38 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ | tulasīpatratoyena yo'bhiṣekaṃ samācaret || 39 || sudhāghaṭasahasrāṇāṃ yā tuṣṭistu bhaveddhareḥ | sā ca tuṣṭirbhavennūnaṃ tulasīpatradānataḥ || 40 || gavāmayutadānena yatphalaṃ tatphalaṃ bhavet | tulasīpatradānena tatphalaṃ kārtike sati || 41 || tulasīpatratoyaṃ ca mṛtyukāle ca yo labhet| mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 42 || nityaṃ yastulasītoyaṃ bhuṃkte bhaktyā ca mānavaḥ | lakṣāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ
