samprāpnoti sa mānavaḥ || 43 || tulasīṃ svakare kṛtvā dhṛtvā dehe ca mānavaḥ | prāṇāṃstyajati tīrtheṣu viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 44 || tulasīkāṣṭhanirmāṇamālāṃ gṛhṇāti yo naraḥ | pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam || 45 || tulasīṃ svakare kṛtvā svīkāraṃ yo na rakṣati | sa yāti kālasūtraṃ ca yāvaccandradivākarau || 46 || karoti mithyāśapathaṃ tulasyā yo'tra mānavaḥ | sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 47 || tulasītoyakaṇikāṃ mṛtyukāle ca yo labhet | ratnayānaṃ samāruhya vaikuṇṭhe prāpyate dhruvam || 48 || pūrṇimāyāmamāyāṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ ravisaṃkrame | tailābhyaṅgaṃ ca kṛtvā ca madhyāhne niśi sandhyayoḥ || 49 || aśauce'śucikāle ye rātrivāso'nvitā narāḥ | tulasīṃ ye vicinvanti te chindanti hareḥ śiraḥ || 50 || trirātraṃ tulasīpatraṃ śuddhaṃ paryuṣitaṃ sati | śrāddhe vrate ca dāne ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ surārcane || 51 || bhūgataṃ toyapatitaṃ yaddattaṃ viṣṇave sati | śuddhaṃ ca tulasīpatraṃ kṣālanādanyakarmaṇi || 52 || vṛkṣādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā goloke ca nirāmaye | kṛṣṇena sārdhaṃ nityaṃ ca nityakrīḍāṃ kariṣyasi || 53 || nadyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā bhārate ca supuṇyadā | lavaṇodasya sā patnī madaṃśasya bhaviṣyati || 54 || tvaṃ ca svayaṃ mahāsādhvī vaikuṇṭhe mama sannidhau | ramāsamā ca rāmā ca bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 55 || ahaṃ ca śailarūpeṇa gaṇḍakītīrasannidhau | adhiṣṭhānaṃ kariṣyāmi bhārate tava śāpataḥ || 56 || koṭisaṃkhyāstatra kīṭāstīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāvarāyudhaiḥ | tacchilākuhare cakraṃ kariṣyanti madīyakam || 57 || ekadvāraṃ catuścakraṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam | navīnanīradākāraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidham || 58 || ekadvāraṃ catuścakraṃ navīnanīradopamam | lakṣmījanārdano jñeyo rahito vanamālayā || 59 || dvāradvaye catuścakraṃ goṣpadena virājitam | raghunāthābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā || 60 || atikṣudraṃ dvicakraṃ ca navīnajaladaprabham | tadvāmanābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā || 61 || atikṣudraṃ dvicakraṃ ca vanamālāvibhūṣitam | vijñeyaṃ śrīdharaṃ rūpaṃ śrīpradaṃ gṛhiṇā sadā || 62 || sthūlaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā | dvicakraṃ sphuṭamatyantaṃ jñeyaṃ dāmodarābhidham || 63 || madhyamaṃ vartulākāraṃ dvicakraṃ bāṇavikṣatam | raṇarāmābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ śaratūṇasamanvitam || 64 || madhyamaṃ saptacakrañca chatrabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam | rājarājeśvaraṃ jñeyaṃ rājasampatpradaṃ nṛṇām || 65 || dvisaptacakraṃ sthūlaṃ ca navanīradasuprabham | anantākhyaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ caturvargaphalapradam || 66 || cakrākāraṃ dvicakraṃ ca saśrīkaṃ jaladaprabham | sagoṣpadaṃ madhyamaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ madhusūdanam || 67 || sudarśanaṃ caikacakraṃ guptacakraṃ gadādharam | dvicakraṃ hayavaktrābhaṃ hayagrīvaṃ prakīrtitam || 68 || atīva vistṛtāsyaṃ ca dvicakraṃ vikaṭaṃ sati | narasiṃhaṃ suvijñeyaṃ sadyo vairāgyadaṃ nṛṇām || 69 || dvicakraṃ vistṛtāsyaṃ ca vanamālāsamanvitam | lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ vijñeyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca sukhapradam || 70 || dvāradeśe dvicakraṃ ca saśrīkaṃ ca samaṃ sphuṭam | vāsudevaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 71 || pradyumnaṃ sūkṣmacakraṃ ca navīnanīradaprabham | suṣiracchidrabahulaṃ gṛhiṇā ca sukhapradam || 72 || dve cakre caikalagne ca pṛṣṭhaṃ yatra tu puṣkalam | saṅkarṣaṇaṃ suvijñeyaṃ sukhadaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sadā || 73 || aniruddhaṃ tu pītābhaṃ vartulaṃ cātiśobhanam | sukhapradaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 74 || śālagrāmaśilā yatra tatra sannihito hariḥ | tatraiva lakṣmīrvasati sarvatīrthasamanvitā || 75 || yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca | tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti śālagrāmaśilārcanāt || 76 || chatrākāre bhavedrājyaṃ vartule ca mahāśriyaḥ | duḥkhañca śakaṭākāre śūlāgre maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 77 || vikṛtāsye ca dāridryaṃ piṅgale hānireva ca | bhagnacakre bhavedvyādhirvidīrṇe maraṇaṃ dhruvam || 78 || vrataṃ dānaṃ pratiṣṭhā ca śrāddhaṃ ca devapūjanam | śālagrāmasya sānnidhyātpraśastaṃ tadbhavediti || 79 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ | sarvayajñeṣu tīrtheṣu vrateṣu ca tapaḥsu ca || 80 || pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ tapasāṃ karaṇe sati | tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nūnaṃ śālagrāmaśilārcanāt || 81 || (śālagrāmaśilātoyairyo'bhiṣekaṃ sadā caret | sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ bhuvo yathā ||) || śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ nityaṃ bhuṅkte ca yo naraḥ | surepsitaṃ prasādaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 82 || tasya sparśaṃ ca vāñchanti tīrthāni nikhilāni ca | jīvanmukto mahāpūto'pyante yāti hareḥ padam || 83 || tatraiva hariṇā sārdhamasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam | yāsyatyeva hi dāsye ca niyukto dāsyakarmaṇi || 84 || yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni ca | taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca palāyante vainateyādivoragāḥ || 85 || tatpādarajasā devī sadyaḥpūtā vasundharā | puṃsāṃ lakṣaṃ tatpitṝṇāṃ nistarettasya janmataḥ || 86 || śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ mṛtyukāle ca yo labhet | sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 87 || nirvāṇamuktiṃ labhate karmabhogātpramucyate | viṣṇoḥ pade pralīnaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 88 || śālagrāmaśilāṃ dhṛtvā mithyāvākyaṃ vadettu yaḥ | sa yāti kumbhīpāke ca yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ || 89 || śālagrāmaśilāṃ dhṛtvā svīkāraṃ yo na pālayet | sa prayātyasipatraṃ ca lakṣamanvantarāvadhi || 90 || tulasīpatravicchedaṃ śālagrāme karoti yaḥ | tasya janmāntare kānte strīvicchedo bhaviṣyati || 91 || tulasīpatravicchedaṃ śaṅkhe yo hi karoti ca | bhāryāhīno bhavetso'pi rogī ca saptajanmasu || 92 || śālagrāmaṃ ca tulasīṃ śaṅkhaṃ caikatra eva ca | yo rakṣati mahājñānī sa bhavecchrīhareḥ priyaḥ || 93 || sakṛdeva hi yo yasyāṃ vīryādhānaṃ karoti ca | tadvicchede tasya duḥkhaṃ bhavedeva parasparam || 94 || tvaṃ priyā śaṅkhacūḍasya caikamanvantarāvadhi | śaṅkhena sārdhaṃ tvadbhedaḥ kevalaṃ duḥkhadastathā || 95 || ityuktvā śrīharistāṃ ca virarāma ca nārada | sā ca dehaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca || 96 || yathā śrīśca tathā sā cāpyuvāsa harivakṣasi | sa jagāma tayā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ kamalāpatiḥ || 97 || lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṅgā tulasī cāpi nārada | hareḥ priyāścatasraśca babhūvurīśvarasya ca || 98 || sadyastaddehajātā ca babhūva gaṇḍakī nadī | īśvaraḥ so'pi śailaśca tattīre puṇyado nṛṇām || 99 || kurvanti tatra kīṭāśca śilāṃ bahuvidhāṃ mune | jale patanti yā yāśca phaladāstāśca niścitam || 100 || sthalasthāḥ piṅgalā jñeyāścopatāpādraveriti | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 101 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde tulasīmāhātmyena saha śālagrāmamahattvavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || <9.25> tulasīpūjāvidhivarṇanam nārada uvāca tulasī ca yadā pūjyā kṛtā nārāyaṇapriyā | asyāḥ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ ca vada sāmpratam || 1 || kena pūjā kṛtā kena stutā prathamato mune | tatra pūjyā sā babhūva kena vā vada māmaho || 2 || sūta uvāca nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṅgavaḥ | kathāṃ kathitumārebhe puṇyāṃ pāpaharāṃ parām || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca hariḥ saṃpūjya tulasīṃ reme ca ramayā saha | ramāsamānasaubhāgyāṃ cakāra gauraveṇa ca || 4 || sehe ca lakṣmīrgaṅgā ca tasyāśca navasaṅgamam | saubhāgyagauravaṃ kopātte na sehe sarasvatī || 5 || sā tāṃ jaghāna kalahe māninī harisannidhau | vrīḍayā cāpamānena sāntardhānaṃ cakāra ha || 6 || sarvasiddheśvarī devī jñānināṃ siddhiyoginī | jagāmādarśanaṃ kopātsarvatra ca hareraho || 7 || harirna dṛṣṭvā tulasīṃ bodhayitvā sarasvatīm | tadanujñāṃ gahītvā ca jagāma tulasīvanam || 8 || tatra gatvā ca susnāto hariḥ sa tulasīṃ satīm | pūjayāmāsa tāṃ dhyātvā stotraṃ bhaktyā cakāra ha || 9 || lakṣmīmāyākāmavāṇībījapūrvaṃ daśākṣaram | vṛndāvanīti ṅe'ntaṃ ca vahnijāyāntameva ca || 10 || anena kalpataruṇā mantrarājena nārada | pūjayedyo vidhānena sarvasiddhiṃ labhed dhruvam || 11 || ghṛtadīpena dhūpena sindūracandanena ca | naivedyena ca puṣpeṇa copacāreṇa nārada || 12 || haristotreṇa tuṣṭā sā cāvirbhūtā mahīruhāt | prasannā caraṇāmbhoje jagāma śaraṇaṃ śubhā || 13 || varaṃ tasyai dadau viṣṇuḥ sarvapūjyā bhaveriti | ahaṃ tvāṃ dhārayiṣyāmi surūpāṃ mūrdhni vakṣasi || 14 || sarve tvāṃ dhārayiṣyanti svamūrdhni ca surādayaḥ | ityuktvā tāṃ gṛhītvā ca prayayau svālayaṃ vibhuḥ || 15 || nārada uvāca kiṃ dhyānaṃ stavanaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ vā pūjāvidhānakam | tulasyāśca mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 16 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca antarhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ ca harirvṛndāvane tadā | tasyāścakre stutiṃ gatvā tulasīṃ virahāturaḥ || 17 || śrībhagavānuvāca vṛndarūpāśca vṛkṣāśca yadaikatra bhavanti ca | vidurbudhāstena vṛndāṃ matpriyāṃ tāṃ bhajāmyaham || 18 || purā babhūva yā devī tvādau vṛndāvane vane | tena vṛndāvanī khyātā saubhāgyā tāṃ bhajāmyaham || 19 || asaṃkhyeṣu ca viśveṣu pūjitā yā nirantaram | tena viśvapūjitā''khyāṃ pūjitāṃ ca bhajāmyaham || 20 || asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni pavitrāṇi tvayā sadā | tāṃ viśvapāvanīṃ devīṃ viraheṇa smarāmyaham || 21 || devā na tuṣṭāḥ puṣpāṇāṃ samūhena yayā vinā | tāṃ puṣpasārāṃ śuddhāṃ ca draṣṭumicchāmi śokataḥ || 22 || viśve yatprāptimātreṇa bhaktānando bhaved dhruvam | nandinī tena vikhyātā sā prītā bhavatādiha || 23 || yasyā devyāstulā nāsti viśveṣu nikhileṣu ca | tulasī tena vikhyātā tāṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ priyām || 24 || kṛṣṇajīvanarūpā sā śaśvatpriyatamā satī | tena kṛṣṇajīvanī sā sā me rakṣatu jīvanam || 25 || ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā tasthau tatra ramāpatiḥ | dadarśa tulasīṃ sākṣātpādapadmanatāṃ satīm || 26 || rudatīmavamānena māninīṃ mānapūjitām | priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā priyaḥ śīghraṃ vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi || 27 || bhāratyājñāṃ gahītvā ca svālayaṃ ca yayau hariḥ | bhāratyā saha tatprītiṃ kārayāmāsa satvaram || 28 || varaṃ viṣṇurdadau tasyai sarvapūjyā bhaveriti | śirodhāryā ca sarveṣāṃ vandyā mānyā mameti ca || 29 || viṣṇorvareṇa sā devī parituṣṭā babhūva ca | sarasvatī tāmākṛṣya vāsayāmāsa sannidhau || 30 || lakṣmīrgaṅgā sasmitā ca tāṃ samākṛṣya nārada | gṛhaṃ praveśayāmāsa vinayena satīṃ tadā || 31 || vṛndā vṛndāvanī viśvapūjitā viśvapāvanī | puṣpasārā nandanī ca tulasī kṛṣṇajīvanī || 32 || etannāmāṣṭakañcaiva stotraṃ nāmārthasaṃyutam | yaḥ paṭhettāṃ ca saṃpūjya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 33 || kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca tulasyā janma maṅgalam | tatra tasyāśca pūjā ca vihitā hariṇā purā || 34 || tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayettāṃ ca bhaktyā vai viśvapāvanīm | sarvapāpādvinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 35 || kārtike tulasīpatraṃ yo dadāti ca viṣṇuve | gavāmayutadānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti niścitam || 36 || aputro labhate putraṃ priyāhīno labhetpriyām | bandhuhīno labhed bandhūn stotraśravaṇamātrataḥ || 37 || rogī pramucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt | bhayānmucyeta bhītastu pāpānmucyeta pātakī || 38 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu | tvameva vede jānāsi kaṇvaśākhoktameva ca || 39 || tadavṛkṣe pūjayettāṃ ca bhaktyā cāvāhanaṃ vinā | tāṃ dhyātvā copacāreṇa dhyānaṃ pātakanāśanam || 40 || tulasīṃ puṣpasārāṃ ca satīṃ pūtāṃ manoharām | kṛtapāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagniśikhopamām || 41 || puṣpeṣu tulanā yasyā nāsti vedeṣu bhāṣitam | pavitrarūpā sarvāsu tulasī sā ca kīrtitā || 42 || śirodhāryā ca sarveṣāmīpsitā viśvapāvanī | jīvanmuktāṃ muktidāṃ ca bhaje tāṃ haribhaktidām || 43 || iti dhyātvā ca saṃpūjya stutvā ca praṇametsudhīḥ | uktaṃ tulasyupākhyānaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 44 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe tulasīpūjāvidhivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || <9.26> sāvitrīpūjāvidhikathanam nārada uvāca tulasyupākhyānamidaṃ śrutaṃ cātisudhopamam | tataḥ sāvitryupākhyānaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 1 || purā kena samudbhūtā sā śrutā ca śruteḥ prasūḥ | kena vā pūjitā loke prathame kaiśca vā pare || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca brahmaṇā vedajananī prathame pūjitā mune | dvitīye ca vedagaṇaistatpaścādviduṣāṃ gaṇaiḥ || 3 || tadā cāśvapatirbhūpaḥ pūjayāmāsa bhārate | tatpaścātpūjayāmāsurvarṇāścatvāra eva ca || 4 || nārada uvāca ko vā so'śvapatirbrahman kena vā tena pūjitā | sarvapūjyā ca sā devī prathame kaiśca vā pare || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca madradeśe mahārājo babhūvāśvapatirmune | vairiṇāṃ balahartā ca mitrāṇāṃ duḥkhanāśanaḥ || 6 || āsīttasya mahārājñī mahiṣī dharmacāriṇī | mālatīti samākhyātā yathā lakṣmīrgadābhṛtaḥ || 7 || sā ca rājñī ca vandhyā ca vasiṣṭhasyopadeśataḥ | cakārārādhanaṃ bhaktyā sāvitryāścaiva nārada || 8 || pratyādeśaṃ na sā prāptā mahiṣī na dadarśa tām | gṛhaṃ jagāma duḥkhārtā hṛdayena vidūyatā || 9 || rājā tāṃ duḥkhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā bodhayitvā nayena vai | sāvitryāstapase bhaktyā jagāma puṣkaraṃ tadā || 10 || tapaścakāra tatraiva saṃyataḥ śatavatsaram | na dadarśa ca sāvitryā pratyādeśo babhūva ca || 11 || śuśrāvākāśavāṇīṃ ca nṛpendraścāśarīriṇīm | gāyatryā daśalakṣaṃ ca japaṃ tvaṃ kuru nārada || 12 || etasminnantare tatra ājagāma parāśaraḥ | praṇanāma tatastaṃ ca munirnṛpamuvāca ca || 13 || muniruvāca sakṛjjapaśca gāyatryāḥ pāpaṃ dinabhavaṃ haret | daśavāraṃ japenaiva naśyetpāpaṃ divāniśam || 14 || śatavāraṃ japaścaiva pāpaṃ māsārjitaṃ haret | sahasradhā japaścaiva kalmaṣaṃ vatsarārjitam || 15 || lakṣo janmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ daśalakṣo'nyajanmajam | sarvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śatalakṣādvinaśyati || 16 || karoti muktiṃ viprāṇāṃ japo daśaguṇastataḥ | karaṃ sarpaphaṇākāraṃ kṛtvā tadrandhamudritam || 17 || ānamramūrdhamacalaṃ prajapetprāṅmukho dvijaḥ | anāmikāmadhyadeśādadho'vāmakrameṇa ca || 18 || tarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ japasyaivaṃ kramaḥ kare | śvetapaṅkajabījānāṃ sphaṭikānāṃ ca saṃskṛtām || 19 || kṛtvā vai mālikāṃ rājan japettīrthe surālaye | saṃsthāpya mālāmaśvatthapatre padme ca saṃyataḥ || 20 || kṛtvā gorocanāktāṃ ca gāyatryā snāpayetsudhīḥ | gāyatrīśatakaṃ tasyāṃ japecca vidhipūrvakam || 21 || athavā pañcagavyena snātvā mālāṃ susaṃskṛtām | atha gaṅgodakenaiva snātvā vātisusaṃskṛtām || 22 || evaṃ krameṇa rājarṣe daśalakṣaṃ japaṃ kuru | sākṣāddrakṣyasi sāvitrīṃ trijanmapātakakṣayāt || 23 || nityaṃ sandhyāṃ ca he rājan kariṣyasi dine dine | madhyāhne cāpi sāyāhne prātareva śuciḥ sadā || 24 || sandhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu | yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet || 25 || nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yastu paścimām | sa śūdravadbahiṣkāryaḥ sarvasmād dvijakarmaṇaḥ || 26 || yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ triḥsandhyāṃ yaḥ karoti ca | sa ca sūryasamo viprastejasā tapasā sadā || 27 || tatpādapadmarajasā sadyaḥpūtā vasundharā | jīvanmuktaḥ sa tejasvī sandhyāpūto hi yo dvijaḥ || 28 || tīrthāni ca pavitrāṇi tasya saṃsparśamātrataḥ | tataḥ pāpāni yāntyeva vainateyādivoragāḥ || 29 || na gṛhṇanti surāḥ pūjāṃ pitaraḥ piṇḍatarpaṇam | svecchayā ca dvijāteśca trisandhyārahitasya ca || 30 || mūlaprakṛtyabhakto yastanmantrasyāpyanarcakaḥ | tadutsavavihīnaśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ || 31 || viṣṇumantravihīnaśca trisandhyārahito dvijaḥ | ekādaśīvihīnaśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ || 32 || hareranaivedyabhojī dhāvako vṛṣavāhakaḥ | śūdrānnabhojī yo vipro viṣahīno yathoragaḥ || 33 || śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī yaḥ sa vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ | śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ || 34 || śūdrāṇāṃ ca pratigrāhī śūdrayājī ca yo dvijaḥ | masijīvī asijīvī viṣahīno yathoragaḥ || 35 || yaḥ kanyāvikrayī vipro yo harernāmavikrayī | yo vipro'vīrānnabhojī ṛtusnātānnabhojakaḥ || 36 || bhagajīvī bārdhuṣiko viṣahīno yathoragaḥ | yo vidyāvikayī vipro viṣahīno yathoragaḥ || 37 || sūryodaye svapedyo hi matsyabhojī ca yo dvijaḥ | śivāpūjādirahito viṣahīno yathoragaḥ || 38 || ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭhaḥ sarvapūjāvidhikramam | tamuvāca ca sāvitryā dhyānādikamabhīpsitam || 39 || dattvā sarvaṃ nṛpendrāya yayau ca svāśrame mune | rājā saṃpūjya sāvitrīṃ dadarśa varamāpa ca || 40 || nārada uvāca kiṃ vā dhyānaṃ ca sāvitryāḥ kiṃ vā pūjāvidhānakam | stotraṃ mantraṃ ca kiṃ dattvā prayayau sa parāśaraḥ || 41 || nṛpaḥ kena vidhānena saṃpūjya śrutimātaram | varaṃ ca kaṃ vā samprāpa sampūjya tu vidhānataḥ || 42 || tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāvitryāḥ paramaṃ mahat | rahasyātirahasyaṃ ca śrutisiddhaṃ samāsataḥ || 43 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ śuddhakāle ca yatnataḥ | vratameva caturdaśyāṃ vratī bhaktyā samācaret || 44 || vrataṃ caturdaśābdaṃ ca dvisaptaphalasaṃyutam | dattvā dvisaptanaivedyaṃ puṣpadhūpādikaṃ caret || 45 || vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca bhojanaṃ vidhipūrvakam | saṃsthāpya maṅgalaghaṭaṃ phalaśākhāsamanvitam || 46 || gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām | sampūjya pūjayediṣṭaṃ ghaṭe āvāhite dvijaḥ || 47 || śṛṇu dhyānaṃ ca sāvitryāścoktaṃ mādhyandine ca yat | stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca mantraṃ ca sarvakāmadam || 48 || taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā | grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍasahasrasammitaprabhām || 49 || īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahām || 50 || sukhadāṃ muktidāṃ śāntāṃ kāntāṃ ca jagatāṃ vidheḥ | sarvasampatsvarūpāṃ ca pradātrīṃ sarvasampadām || 51 || vedādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca vedaśāstrasvarūpiṇīm | vedabījasvarūpāṃ ca bhaje tāṃ vedamātaram || 52 || dhyātvā dhyānena naivedyaṃ dattvā pāṇiṃ svamūrdhani | punardhyātvā ghaṭe bhaktyā devīmāvāhayed vratī || 53 || dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ vedoktaṃ mantrapūrvakam | sampūjya stutvā praṇameddevadevīṃ vidhānataḥ || 54 || āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca snānīyaṃ cānulepanam | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ śītalaṃ jalam || 55 || vasanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mālyaṃ gandhamācamanīyakam | manoharaṃ sutalpaṃ ca deyānyetāni ṣoḍaśa || 56 || dārusāravikāraṃ ca hemādinirmitaṃ ca vā | devādhāraṃ puṇyadaṃ ca mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam || 57 || tīrthodakaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca puṇyadaṃ prītidaṃ mahat | pūjāṅgabhūtaṃ śuddhaṃ ca mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam || 58 || pavitrarūpamarghyaṃ ca dūrvāpuṣpadalānvitam | puṇyadaṃ śaṅkhatoyāktaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam || 59 || sugandhaṃ gandhatoyaṃ ca snehaṃ saugandhakārakam | mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā snānīyaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 60 || gandhadravyodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ prītidaṃ divyagandhadam | mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gandhatoyaṃ tavāmbike || 61 || sarvamaṅgalarūpaṃ ca sarvaṃ ca maṅgalapradam | puṇyadaṃ ca sudhūpaṃ taṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvari || 62 || sugandhayuktaṃ sukhadaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam | jagatāṃ darśanārthāya pradīpaṃ dīptikārakam || 63 || andhakāradhvaṃsabījaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam | tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ caiva prītidaṃ kṣudvināśanam || 64 || puṇyadaṃ svādurūpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām | tāmbūlapravaraṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam || 65 || tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ caiva mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam | suśītalaṃ vāri śītaṃ pipāsānāśakāraṇam || 66 || jagatāṃ jīvanarūpaṃ ca jīvanaṃ pratigṛhyatām | dehaśobhāsvarūpaṃ ca sabhāśobhāvivardhanam || 67 || kārpāsajaṃ ca kṛmijaṃ vasanaṃ pratigṛhyatām | kāñcanādivinirmāṇaṃ śrīkaraṃ śrīyutaṃ sadā || 68 || sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaṃ pratigṛhyatām | nānāvṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ nānārūpasamanvitam || 69 || phalasvarūpaṃ phaladaṃ phalaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām | sarvamaṅgalarūpaṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam || 70 || nānāpuṣpavinirmāṇaṃ bahuśobhāsamanvitam | prītidaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva mālyaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām || 71 || puṇyadaṃ ca sugandhāḍhyaṃ gandhaṃ ca devi gṛhyatām | sindūraṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ bhālaśobhāvivardhanam || 72 || bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca pravaraṃ sindūraṃ pratigṛhyatām | viśuddhaṃ granthisaṃyuktaṃ puṇyasūtravinirmitam || 73 || pavitraṃ vedamantreṇa yajñasūtraṃ ca gṛhyatām | dravyāṇyetāni mūlena dattvā stotraṃ paṭhetsudhīḥ || 74 || tato viprāya bhaktyā ca vratī dadyācca dakṣiṇām | sāvitrīti caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca || 75 || lakṣmīmāyākāmapūrvaṃ mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ viduḥ | mādhyandinoktaṃ stotraṃ ca sarvakāmaphalapradam || 76 || viprajīvanarūpaṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te | kṛṣṇena dattāṃ sāvitrīṃ goloke brahmaṇe purā || 77 || nāyāti sā tena sārdhaṃ brahmaloke ca nārada | brahmā kṛṣṇājñayā bhaktyā tuṣṭāva vedamātaram || 78 || tadā sā parituṣṭā ca brahmāṇaṃ cakame patim | brahmovāva saccidānandarūpe tvaṃ mūlaprakṛtirūpiṇi || 79 || hiraṇyagarbharūpe tvaṃ prasannā bhava sundari | tejaḥsvarūpe parame paramānandarūpiṇi || 80 || dvijātīnāṃ jātirūpe prasannā bhava sundari | nitye nityapriye devi nityānandasvarūpiṇi || 81 || sarvamaṅgalarūpe ca prasannā bhava sundari | sarvasvarūpe viprāṇāṃ mantrasāre parātpare || 82 || sukhade mokṣade devi prasannā bhava sundari | viprapāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagniśikhopame || 83 || bahmatejaḥprade devi prasannā bhava sundari | kāyena manasā vācā yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ || 84 || tattvatsmaraṇamātreṇa bhasmībhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati | ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tasthau tatraiva saṃsadi || 85 || sāvitrī brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ brahmalokaṃ jagāma sā | anena stavarājena saṃstūyāśvapatirnṛpaḥ || 86 || dadarśa tāṃ ca sāvitrīṃ varaṃ prāpa manogatam | stavarājamimaṃ puṇyaṃ sandhyāṃ kṛtvā ca yaḥ paṭhet | pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ yatphalaṃ labhate ca tat || 87 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ navamaskandhe sāvitrīpūjāvidhikathanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || <9.27> sāvitryupākhyāne yamasāvitrīsaṃvādavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāva stutvānena so'śvapatiḥ sampūjya vidhipūrvakam | dadarśa tatra tāṃ devīṃ sahasrārkasamaprabhām || 1 || uvāca sā ca rājānaṃ prasannā sasmitā satī | yathā mātā svaputraṃ ca dyotayantī diśastviṣā || 2 || sāvitryuvāca jānāmyahaṃ mahārāja yatte manasi vāñchitam | vāñchitaṃ tava patnyāśca sarvaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam || 3 || sādhvī kanyābhilāṣaṃ ca karoti tava kāminī | tvaṃ prārthayasi putraṃ ca bhaviṣyati krameṇa ca || 4 || ityuktvā sā tadā devī brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha | rājā jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatkanyā''dau babhūva ha || 5 || ārādhanācca sāvitryā babhūva kamalā parā | sāvitrīti ca tannāma cakārāśvapatirnṛpaḥ || 6 || kālena sā vardhamānā babhūva ca dine dine | rūpayauvanasampannā śukle candrakalā yathā || 7 || sā varaṃ varayāmāsa dyumatsenātmajaṃ tadā | satyavantaṃ satyaśīlaṃ nānāguṇasamanvitam || 8 || rājā tasmai dadau tāṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | so'pi sārdhaṃ kautukena tāṃ gṛhītvā gṛhaṃ yayau || 9 || sa ca saṃvatsare'tīte satyavān satyavikramaḥ | jagāma phalakāṣṭhārthaṃ praharṣaṃ piturājñayā || 10 || jagāma sādhvī tatpaścātsāvitrī daivayogataḥ | nipatya vṛkṣāddaivena prāṇāṃstatyāja satyavān || 11 || yamastaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā baddhvāṅguṣṭhasamaṃ mune | gṛhītvā gamanaṃ cakre tatpaścātprayayau satī || 12 || paścāttāṃ sudatīṃ dṛṣṭvā yamaḥ saṃyamanīpatiḥ | uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvīṃ sādhūnāṃ pravaro mahān || 13 || dharmarāja uvāca aho kva yāsi sāvitri gṛhītvā mānuṣīṃ tanum | yadi yāsyasi kāntena sārdhaṃ dehaṃ tadā tyaja || 14 || gantuṃ martyo na śaknoti gṛhītvā pāñcabhautikam | dehaṃ ca mama lokaṃ ca naśvaraṃ naśvaraḥ sadā || 15 || bhartuste pūrṇakālo vai babhūva bhārate sati | svakarmaphalabhogārthaṃ satyavān yāti madgṛham || 16 || karmaṇā jāyate jantuḥ karmaṇaiva pralīyate | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ karmaṇaiva praṇīyate || 17 || karmaṇendro bhavejjīvo brahmaputraḥ svakarmaṇā | svakarmaṇā harerdāso janmādirahito bhavet || 18 || svakarmaṇā sarvasiddhimamaratvaṃ labhed dhruvam | labhetsvakarmaṇā viṣṇoḥ sālokyādicatuṣṭayam || 19 || suratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca rājendratvaṃ labhennaraḥ | karmaṇā ca śivatvaṃ ca gaṇeśatvaṃ tathaiva ca || 20 || karmaṇā ca munīndratvaṃ tapasvitvaṃ svakarmaṇā | svakarmaṇā kṣatriyatvaṃ vaiśyatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā || 21 || karmaṇaiva ca mlecchatvaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | svakarmaṇā jaṅgamatvaṃ śailatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā || 22 || karmaṇā rākṣasatvaṃ ca kinnaratvaṃ svakarmaṇā | karmaṇaivādhipatyaṃ ca vṛkṣatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā || 23 || karmaṇaiva paśutvaṃ ca vanajīvī svakarmaṇā | karmaṇā kṣudrajantutvaṃ kṛmitvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā || 24 || daiteyatvaṃ dānavatvamasuratvaṃ svakarmaṇā | ityetaduktvā sāvitrīṃ virarāma sa vai yamaḥ || 25 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe sāvitryupākhyāne yamasāvitrīsaṃvādavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || <9.28> sāvitryupākhyāne yamasāvitrīsaṃvādavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca yamasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī ca pativratā | tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā tamuvāca manasvinī || 1 || sāvitryuvāca kiṃ karma tadbhavetkena ko vā taddhetureva ca | ko vā dehī ca dehaḥ kaḥ ko vātra karmakārakaḥ || 2 || kiṃ vā jñānaṃ ca buddhiḥ kā ko vā prāṇaḥ śarīriṇām | kānīndriyāṇi kiṃ teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ devatāśca kāḥ || 3 || bhoktā bhojayitā ko vā ko vā bhogaśca niṣkṛtiḥ | ko jīvaḥ paramātmā kastanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 4 || dharma uvāca vedapraṇihito dharmaḥ karma yanmaṅgalaṃ param | avaidikaṃ tu yatkarma tadevāśubhameva ca || 5 || ahaitukī devasevā saṃkalparahitā satī | karmanirmūlarūpā ca sā eva parabhaktidā || 6 || ko vā karmaphalaṃ bhuṅkte ko vā nirlipta eva ca | brahmabhakto yo naraśca sa ca muktaḥ śrutaḥ śrutau || 7 || janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītivivarjitaḥ | bhaktiśca dvividhā sādhvi śrutyuktā sarvasammatā || 8 || nirvāṇapadadātrī ca harirūpapradā nṛṇām | harirūpasvarūpāṃ ca bhaktiṃ vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ || 9 || anye nirvāṇamicchanti yogino brahmavittamāḥ | karmaṇo bījarūpaśca satataṃ tatphalapradaḥ || 10 || karmarūpaśca bhagavānparātmā prakṛtiḥ parā | so'pi taddheturūpaśca deho naśvara eva ca || 11 || pṛthivī vāyurākāśo jalaṃ tejastathaiva ca | etāni sūtrarūpāṇi sṛṣṭirūpavidhau sataḥ || 12 || karmakartā ca dehī ca ātmā bhojayitā sadā | bhogo vibhavabhedaśca nitkṛtirmuktireva ca || 13 || sadasadbhedabījaṃ ca jñānaṃ nānāvidhaṃ bhavet | viṣayāṇāṃ vibhāgānāṃ bhedi bījaṃ ca kīrtitam || 14 || buddhirvivecanā sā ca jñānabījaṃ śrutau śrutam | vāyubhedāśca prāṇāśca balarūpāśca dehinām || 15 || indriyāṇāṃ ca pravaramīśvarāṃśamanūhakam | prerakaṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva durnivāryaṃ ca dehinām || 16 || anirūpyamadṛśyaṃ ca jñānabhedo manaḥ smṛtam | locanaṃ śravaṇaṃ ghrāṇaṃ tvakca rasanamindriyam || 17 || aṅgināmaṅgarūpaṃ ca prerakaṃ sarvakarmaṇām | ripurūpaṃ mitrarūpaṃ sukharūpaṃ ca duḥkhadam || 18 || sūryo vāyuśca pṛthivī brahmādyā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ | prāṇadehādibhṛdyo hi sa jīvaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 19 || paramaṃ vyāpakaṃ brahma nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ | kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca paramātmā sa ucyate || 20 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ yathāgamam | jñānināṃ jñānarūpaṃ ca gaccha vatse yathāsukham || 21 || sāvitryuvāca tyaktvā kva yāmi kāntaṃ vā tvāṃ vā jñānārṇavaṃ dhruvam | yadyatkaromi praśnaṃ ca tadbhavānvaktumarhati || 22 || kāṃ kāṃ yoniṃ yāti jīvaḥ karmaṇā kena vā punaḥ | kena vā karmaṇā svargaṃ kena vā narakaṃ pitaḥ || 23 || kena vā karmaṇā muktiḥ kena bhaktirbhaved gurau | kena vā karmaṇā yogī rogī vā kena karmaṇā || 24 || kena vā dīrghajīvī ca kenālpāyuśca karmaṇā | kena vā karmaṇā duḥkhī sukhī vā kena karmaṇā || 25 || aṅgahīnaśca kāṇaśca badhiraḥ kena karmaṇā | andho vā paṅgurapi vā pramattaḥ kena karmaṇā || 26 || kṣipto'tilubdhakaścauraḥ kena vā karmaṇā bhavet | kena siddhimavāpnoti sālokyādicatuṣṭayam || 27 || kena vā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca tapasvitvaṃ ca kena vā | svargabhogādikaṃ kena vaikuṇṭhaṃ kena karmaṇā || 28 || golokaṃ kena vā brahman sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ nirāmayam | narako vā katividhaḥ kiṃsaṃkhyo nāma kiṃ ca vā || 29 || ko vā kaṃ narakaṃ yāti kiyantaṃ teṣu tiṣṭhati | pāpināṃ karmaṇā kena ko vā vyādhiḥ prajāyate | yadyatpriyaṃ mayā pṛṣṭaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 30 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasavāde sāvitryupākhyāne yamasāvitrīsaṃvādavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || <9.29> sāvitryupākhyāne karmavipākavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sāvitrīvacanaṃ śrutvā jagāma vismayaṃ yamaḥ | prahasya vaktumārebhe karmapākaṃ tu jīvinām || 1 || dharma uvāca kanyā dvādaśavarṣīyā vatse tvaṃ vayasādhunā | jñānaṃ te pūrvaviduṣāṃ jñānināṃ yogināṃ param || 2 || sāvitrīvaradānena tvaṃ sāvitrī kalā satī | prāptā purā bhūbhṛtā ca tapasā tatsamā sute || 3 || yathā śrīḥ śrīpateḥ kroḍe bhavānī ca bhavorasi | yathāditiḥ kaśyape ca yathāhalyā ca gautame || 4 || yathā śacī mahendre ca yathā candre ca rohiṇī | yathā ratiḥ kāmadeve yathā svāhā hutāśane || 5 || yathā svadhā ca pitṛṣu yathā sandhyā divākare | varuṇānī ca varuṇe yajñe ca dakṣiṇā yathā || 6 || yathā varāhe pṛthivī devasenā ca kārtike | saubhāgyā supriyā tvaṃ ca tathā satyavataḥ priye || 7 || ayaṃ tubhyaṃ varo datto'pyaparaṃ ca yathepsitam | śṛṇu devi mahābhāge dadāmi sakalepsitam || 8 || sāvitryuvāca satyavata aurasānāṃ putrāṇāṃ śatakaṃ mama | bhaviṣyati mahābhāga varametanmadīpsitam || 9 || matpituḥ putraśatakaṃ śvaśurasya ca cakṣuṣī | rājyalābho bhavatvevaṃ varametanmadīpsitam || 10 || ante satyavatā sārdhaṃ yāsyāmi harimandiram | samatīte lakṣavarṣe dehīdaṃ me jagatprabho || 11 || jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama | viśvanistārabījaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 12 || dharmarāja uvāca bhaviṣyati mahāsādhvi sarvaṃ mānasikaṃ tava | jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya || 13 || śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ janma bhārate | puṇyakṣetre ca nānyatra sarvaṃ ca bhuñjate janāḥ || 14 || surā daityā dānavāśca gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ | narāśca karmajanakā na sarve jīvinaḥ sati || 15 || viśiṣṭajīvinaḥ karma bhuñjate sarvayoniṣu | śubhāśubhaṃ ca sarvatra svargeṣu narakeṣu ca || 16 || viśeṣato jīvinaśca bhramante sarvayoniṣu | śubhāśubhaṃ bhuñjate ca karma pūrvārjitaṃ param || 17 || śubhena karmaṇā yāti svarlokādikameva ca | karmaṇā cāśubhenaiva bhramanti narakeṣu ca || 18 || karmanirmūlane bhaktiḥ sā coktā dvividhā sati | nirvāṇarūpā bhaktiśca brahmaṇaḥ prakṛteriha || 19 || rogī kukarmaṇā jīvaścārogī śubhakarmaṇā | dīrghajīvī ca kṣīṇāyuḥ sukhī duḥkhī ca karmaṇā || 20 || andhādayaścāṅgahīnāḥ karmaṇā kutsitena ca | siddhyādikamavāpnoti sarvotkṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 21 || sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ devi viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari | sudurlabhaṃ sugopyaṃ ca purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi || 22 || durlabhā mānuṣī jātiḥ sarvajātiṣu bhārate | sarvebhyo brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ praśastaḥ sarvakarmasu || 23 || brahmaniṣṭho dvijaścaiva garīyān bhārate sati | niṣkāmaśca sakāmaśca brāhmaṇo dvividhaḥ sati || 24 || sakāmājja pradhānaśca niṣkāmo bhakta eva ca | karmabhogī sakāmaśca niṣkāmo nirupadravaḥ || 25 || sa yāti dehaṃ tyaktvā ca padaṃ yattannirāmayam | punarāgamanaṃ nāsti teṣāṃ niṣkāmināṃ sati || 26 || sevante dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram | golokaṃ prati te bhaktā divyarūpavidhāriṇaḥ || 27 || sakāmino vaiṣṇavāśca gatvā vaikuṇṭhameva ca | bhārataṃ punarāyānti teṣāṃ janma dvijātiṣu || 28 || kāle gate ca niṣkāmā bhavantyeva krameṇa ca | bhaktiṃ ca nirmalāṃ tebhyo dāsyāmi niścitaṃ punaḥ || 29 || brāhmaṇā vaiṣṇavāścaiva sakāmāḥ sarvajanmasu | na teṣāṃ nirmalā buddhirviṣṇubhaktivivarjitāḥ || 30 || tīrthāśritā dvijā ye ca tapasyāniratāḥ sati | te yānti brahmalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhārate || 31 || svadharmaniratā ye ca tīrthānyatranivāsinaḥ | vrajanti te satyalokaṃ punarāyānti bhārate || 32 || svadharmaniratā viprāḥ sūryabhaktāśca bhārate | vrajanti te sūryalokaṃ punarāyānti bhārate || 33 || mūlaprakṛtibhaktā ye niṣkāmā dharmacāriṇaḥ | maṇidvīpaṃ prayāntyeva punarāvṛttivarjitam || 34 || svadharme niratā bhaktāḥ śaivāḥ śāktāśca gāṇapāḥ | te yānti śivalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhārate || 35 || ye viprā anyadevejyāḥ svadharmaniratāḥ sati | te yānti sarvalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhārate || 36 || haribhaktāśca niṣkāmāḥ svadharmaniratā dvijāḥ | te ca yānti harerlokaṃ kramādbhaktibalādaho || 37 || svadharmarahitā viprā devānyasevanāḥ sadā | bhraṣṭācārāśca kāmāśca te yānti narakaṃ dhruvam || 38 || svadharmaniratā eva varṇāścatvāra eva ca | bhavantyeva śubhasyaiva karmaṇaḥ phalabhoginaḥ || 39 || svakarmarahitā ye ca narakaṃ yānti te dhruvam | bhārate na bhavantyeva karmaṇaḥ phalabhoginaḥ || 40 || svadharmaniratā eva varṇāścatvāra eva ca | svadharmaniratā viprāḥ svadharmaniratāya ca || 41 || kanyāṃ dadati viprāya candralokaṃ prayānti te | vasanti tatra te sādhvi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 42 || sālaṅkṛtāyā dānena dviguṇaṃ phalamucyate | sakāmā yānti tallokaṃ na niṣkāmāśca sādhavaḥ || 43 || te prayānti viṣṇulokaṃ phalasaṅghātavarjitāḥ | gavyaṃ ca rajataṃ svarṇaṃ vastraṃ sarpiḥ phalaṃ jalam || 44 || ye dadatyeva viprebhyaścandralokaṃ prayānti te | vasanti te ca talloke yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati || 45 || sucirātsuciraṃ vāsaṃ kurvanti tena te janāḥ | ye dadati suvarṇāṃśca gāśca tāmrādikaṃ sati || 46 || te yānti sūryalokaṃ ca śucaye brāhmaṇāya ca | vasanti te tatra loke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati || 47 || vipule suciraṃ vāsaṃ kurvanti ca nirāmayāḥ | dadāti bhūmiṃ viprebhyo dhanāni vipulāni ca || 48 || sa yāti viṣṇulokaṃ ca śvetadvīpaṃ manoharam | tatraiva nivasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau || 49 || vipule vipulaṃ vāsaṃ karoti puṇyavānmune | gṛhaṃ dadati viprāya ye janā bhaktipūrvakam || 50 || te yānti viṣṇulokaṃ ca suciraṃ sukhadāyakam | gṛhareṇupramāṇaṃ ca viṣṇuloke mahattame || 51 || vipule vipulaṃ vāsaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ sati | yasmai yasmai ca devāya yo dadāti gṛhaṃ naraḥ || 52 || sa yāti tasya lokaṃ ca reṇumānābdameva ca | saudhe caturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ deśe śataguṇaṃ phalam || 53 || prakṛṣṭe dviguṇaṃ tasmādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ | yo dadāti taḍāgaṃ ca sarvapāpāpanuttaye || 54 || sa yāti janalokaṃ ca reṇumānābdameva ca | vāpyāṃ phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ sadā || 55 || sa tu vāpīpradānena taḍāgasya phalaṃ labhet | dhanuścatuḥsahasreṇa darśyamānena niścitam || 56 || nyūnā vā tāvatī prasthe sā vāpī parikīrtitā | daśavāpīsamā kanyā yadi pātre pradīyate || 57 || phalaṃ dadāti dviguṇaṃ yadi sālaṅkṛtā bhavet | yatphalaṃ ca taḍāge ca taduddhāre ca tatkalam || 58 || vāpyāśca paṅkoddharaṇe vāpītulyaphalaṃ labhet | aśvatthavṛkṣamāropya pratiṣṭhāṃ yaḥ karoti ca || 59 || sa prayāti tapolokaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati | puṣpodyānaṃ yo dadāti sāvitri sarvabhūtaye || 60 || sa vased dhruvaloke ca varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhuvam | yo dadāti vimānaṃ ca viṣṇave bhārate sati || 61 || viṣṇuloke vasetso'pi yāvanmanvantaraṃ param | citrayukte ca vipule phalaṃ tasya caturguṇam || 62 || tasyārdhaṃ śibikādāne phalameva labhed dhruvam | yo dadāti bhaktiyukto haraye dolamandiram || 63 || viṣṇuloke vasetso'pi yāvanmanvantaraṃ śatam | rājamārgaṃ saudhayuktaṃ yaḥ karoti pativrate || 64 || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ so'pi śakraloke mahīyate | brāhmaṇebhyo'tha devebhyo dāne samaphalaṃ labhet || 65 || yaddhi dattaṃ ca tadbhuṅkte na dattaṃ nopatiṣṭhate | bhuktvā svargādijaṃ saukhyaṃ puṇyavāñjanma bhārate || 66 || labhedviprakuleṣveva krameṇaivottamādiṣu | bhārate puṇyavānvipro bhuktvā svargādikaṃ phalam || 67 || punaḥ so'pi bhavedvipraścaivaṃ ca kṣatriyādayaḥ | kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā kalpakoṭiśatena ca || 68 || tapasā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca na prāpnoti śrutau śrutam | nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 69 || avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham | devatīrthasahāyena kāyavyūhena śudhyati | etatte kathitaṃ kiñcit kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 70 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne karmavipākavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || <9.30> yamena karmavipākakathanam sāvitryuvāca prayānti svargamanyaṃ ca yenaiva karmaṇā yama | mānavāḥ puṇyavantaśca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 1 || dharmarāja uvāca annadānaṃ ca viprāya yaḥ karoti ca bhārate | annapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca śivaloke mahīyate || 2 || annadānaṃ mahādānamanyebhyo'pi karoti yaḥ | annadānapramāṇaṃ ca śivaloke mahīyate || 3 || annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | nātra pātraparīkṣā syānna kālaniyamaḥ kvacit || 4 || devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo vā dadāti cāsanaṃ yadi | mahīyate viṣṇuloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati || 5 || yo dadāti ca viprāya divyāṃ dhenuṃ payasvinīm | tallomamānavarṣaṃ ca viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 6 || caturguṇaṃ puṇyadine tīrthe śataguṇaṃ phalam | dānaṃ nārāyaṇakṣetraṃ phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 7 || gāṃ yo dadāti viprāya bhārate bhaktipūrvakam | varṣāṇāmayutaṃ caiva candraloke mahīyate || 8 || yaścobhayamukhīdānaṃ karoti brāhmaṇāya ca | tallomamānavarṣaṃ ca viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 9 || yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya śvetacchatraṃ manoharam | varṣāṇāmayutaṃ so'pi modate varuṇālaye || 10 || viprāya pīḍitāṅgāya vastrayugmaṃ dadāti ca | mahīyate vāyuloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati || 11 || yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya śālagrāmaṃ savastrakam | mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāvaccandradivākarau || 12 || yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya divyāṃ śayyāṃ manoharām | mahīyate candraloke yāvaccandradivākarau || 13 || yo dadāti pradīpaṃ ca devebhyo brāhmaṇāya ca | yāvanmanvantaraṃ so'pi vahniloke mahīyate || 14 || karoti gajadānaṃ ca yadi viprāya bhārate | yāvadindro narastāvadindrasyārdhāsane vaset || 15 || bhārate yo'śvadānaṃ ca karoti brāhmaṇāya ca | modate vāruṇe loke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 16 || prakṛṣṭāṃ śibikāṃ yo hi dadāti brāhmaṇāya ca | modate vāruṇe loke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 17 || prakṛṣṭāṃ vāṭikā yo hi dadāti brāhmaṇāya ca | mahīyate vāyuloke yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati || 18 || yo dadāti ca viprāya vyajanaṃ śvetacāmaram | mahīyate vāyuloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam || 19 || dhānyaṃ ratnaṃ yo dadāti cirañjīvī bhavetsudhīḥ | dātā grahītā tau dvau ca dhruvaṃ vaikuṇṭhagāminau || 20 || satataṃ śrīharernāma bhārate yo japennaraḥ | sa eva cirajīvī ca tato mṛtyuḥ palāyate || 21 || yo naro bhārate varṣe dolanaṃ kārayetsudhīḥ | pūrṇimārajanīśeṣe jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ || 22 || ihaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante viṣṇumandiram | niścitaṃ nivasettatra śatamanvantarāvadhi || 23 || phalamuttaraphalgunyāṃ tato'pi dviguṇaṃ bhavet | kalpāntajīvī sa bhavedityāha kamalodbhavaḥ || 24 || tiladānaṃ brāhmaṇāya yaḥ karoti ca bhārate | tilapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca modate śivamandire || 25 || tataḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya cirañjīvī bhavetsukhī | tāmrapātrasya dānena dviguṇaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet || 26 || sālaṃkṛtāṃ ca bhogyāṃ ca savastrāṃ sundarīṃ priyām | yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya bhārate ca pativratām || 27 || mahīyate candraloke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | tatra svarveśyayā sārdhaṃ modate ca divāniśam || 28 || tato gandharvaloke ca varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam | divāniśaṃ kautukena corvaśyā saha modate || 29 || tato janmasahasraṃ ca prāpnoti sundarīṃ priyām | satīṃ saubhāgyayuktāṃ ca komalāṃ priyavādinīm || 30 || pradadāti phalaṃ cāru brāhmaṇāya ca yo naraḥ | phalapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca śakraloke mahīyate || 31 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya labhate sutamuttamam | saphalānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca praśaṃsitam || 32 || kevalaṃ phaladānaṃ vā brāhmaṇāya dadāti ca | suciraṃ svargavāsaṃ ca kṛtvā yāti ca bhārate || 33 || nānādravyasamāyuktaṃ nānāsasyasamanvitam | dadāti yaśca viprāya bhārate vipulaṃ gṛham || 34 || suraloke vasetso'pi yāvanmanvantaraṃ śatam | tataḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya sa mahādhanavānbhavet || 35 || yo naraḥ sasyasaṃyuktāṃ bhūmiṃ ca rucirāṃ sati | dadāti bhaktyā viprāya puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate || 36 || mahīyate ca vaikuṇṭhe manvantaraśataṃ dhruvam | punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya mahāṃśca bhūmipo bhavet || 37 || taṃ na tyajati bhūmiśca janmanāṃ śatakaṃ param | śrīmāṃśca dhanavāṃścaiva putravāṃśca prajeśvaraḥ || 38 || yo vrajaṃ ca prakṛṣṭaṃ ca grāmaṃ dadyād dvijāya ca | lakṣamanvantaraṃ caiva vaikuṇṭhe sa mahīyate || 39 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya grāmalakṣasamanvitam | na jahāti ca taṃ pṛthvī janmanāṃ lakṣameva ca || 40 || suprajaṃ ca prakṛṣṭaṃ ca pakvasasyasamanvitam | nānāpuṣkariṇīvṛkṣaphalavallīsamanvitam || 41 || nagaraṃ yaśca viprāya dadāti bhārate bhuvi | mahīyate sa kailāse daśalakṣendrakālakam || 42 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya rājendro bhārate bhavet | nagarāṇāṃ ca niyutaṃ sa labhennātra saṃśayaḥ || 43 || dharā taṃ na jahātyeva janmanāmayutaṃ dhruvam | paramaiśvaryaniyuto bhavedeva mahītale || 44 || nagarāṇāṃ ca śatakaṃ deśaṃ yo hi dvijātaye | suprakṛṣṭaṃ madhyakṛṣṭaṃ prajāyuktaṃ dadāti ca || 45 || vāpītaḍāgasaṃyuktaṃ nānāvṛkṣasamanvitam | mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe koṭimanvantarāvadhi || 46 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya jambudvīpapatirbhavet | paramaiśvaryasaṃyukto yathā śakrastathā bhuvi || 47 || mahī taṃ na jahātyeva janmanāṃ koṭimeva ca | kalpāntajīvī sa bhavedrājarājeśvaro mahān || 48 || svādhikāraṃ samagraṃ ca yo dadāti dvijātaye | caturguṇaṃ phalaṃ cānte bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ || 49 || jambudvīpaṃ yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya tapasvine | phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ cānte bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ || 50 || jambudvīpamahīdātuḥ sarvatīrthāni sevituḥ | sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ kartuḥ sarveṣāṃ vāsakāriṇaḥ || 51 || sarvadānapradātuśca sarvasiddheśvarasya ca | astyeva punarāvṛttirna bhaktasya maheśituḥ || 52 || asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pātaṃ paśyanti bhuvaneśituḥ | nivasanti maṇidvīpe śrīdevyāḥ parame pade || 53 || devīmantropāsakāśca vihāya mānavīṃ tanum | vibhūtiṃ divyarūpaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāharam || 54 || labdhvā devyāśca sārūpyaṃ devīsevāṃ ca kurvate | paśyanti te maṇidvīpe sakhaṇḍaṃ lokasaṃkṣayam || 55 || naśyanti devāḥ siddhāśca viśvāni nikhilāni ca | devībhaktā na naśyanti janmamṛtyujarāharāḥ || 56 || kārtike tulasīdānaṃ karoti haraye ca yaḥ | yugatrayapramāṇaṃ ca modate harimandire || 57 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya haribhaktiṃ labhed dhruvam | jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraḥ sa bhavedbhārate bhuvi || 58 || madhye yaḥ snāti gaṅgāyāmaruṇodayakālataḥ | yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate harimandire || 59 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya viṣṇumantraṃ labhed dhruvam | tyaktvā ca mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ punaryāti hareḥ padam || 60 || nāsti tatpunarāvṛttirvaikuṇṭhācca mahītale | karoti haridāsyaṃ ca tathā sārūpyameva ca || 61 || nityasnāyī ca gaṅgāyāṃ sa pūtaḥ sūryavadbhuvi | pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam || 62 || tasyaiva pādarajasā sadyaḥpūtā vasundharā | modate sa ca vaikuṇṭhe yāvaccandradivākarau || 63 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya haribhaktiṃ labhed dhruvam | jīvanmukto'titejasvī tapasvipravaro bhavet || 64 || svadharmanirataḥ śuddho vidvāṃśca sa jitendriyaḥ | mīnakarkaṭayormadhye gāḍhaṃ tapati bhāskaraḥ || 65 || bhārate yo dadātyeva jalameva suvāsitam | sa modate ca kailāse yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 66 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya rūpavāṃśca sukhī bhavet | śivabhaktaśca tejasvī vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ || 67 || vaiśākhe saktudānaṃ ca yaḥ karoti dvijātaye | saktureṇupramāṇābdaṃ modate śivamandire || 68 || karoti bhārate yo hi kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvratam | śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 69 || vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya kṛṣṇe bhaktiṃlabhed dhruvam || 70 || ihaiva bhārate varṣe śivarātriṃ karoti yaḥ | modate śivaloke sa saptamanvantarāvadhi || 71 || śivāya śivarātrau ca bilvapatraṃ dadāti yaḥ | patramānayugaṃ tatra modate śivamandire || 72 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya śivabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam | vidyāvānputravāñchrīmān prajāvānbhūmimānbhavet || 73 || caitramāse'thavā māghe śaṅkaraṃ yo'rcayedvratī | karoti nartanaṃ bhaktyā vetrapāṇirdivāniśam || 74 || māsaṃ vāpyardhamāsaṃ vā daśa sapta dināni ca | dinamānayugaṃ so'pi śivaloke mahīyate || 75 || śrīrāmanavamīṃ yo hi karoti bhārate pumān | saptamanvantaraṃ yāvanmodate viṣṇumandire || 76 || punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya rāmabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam | jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaro mahāṃśca dhanavānbhavet || 77 || śāradīyāṃ mahāpūjāṃ prakṛteryaḥ karoti ca | mahiṣaiśchāgalairmeṣaiḥ khaḍgairbhekādibhiḥ sati || 78 || naivedyairupahāraiśca dhūpadīpādibhistathā | nṛtyagītādibhirvādyairnānākautukamaṅgalam || 79 || śivaloke vasetso'pi saptamanvantarāvadhi | punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya naro buddhiṃ ca nirmalām || 80 || atulāṃ śriyamāpnoti putrapautravivardhanīm | mahāprabhāvayuktaśca gajavājisamanvitaḥ || 81 || rājarājeśvaraḥ so'pi bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ | tataḥ śuklāṣṭamīṃ prāpya mahālakṣmīṃ ca yo'rcayet || 82 || nityaṃ bhaktyā pakṣamekaṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate | dattvā tasyai prakṛṣṭāni copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa || 83 || goloke ca vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | punaḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya rājarājeśvaro bhavet || 84 || kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca kṛtvā tu rāsamaṇḍalam | gopānāṃ śatakaṃ kṛtvā gopīnāṃ śatakaṃ tathā || 85 || śilāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhayā saha | bhārate pūjayedbhaktyā copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa || 86 || goloke vasate so'pi yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ | bhārataṃ punarāgatya kṛṣṇe bhaktiṃ labheddṛḍhām || 87 || krameṇa sudṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ labdhvā mantraṃ hareraho | dehaṃ tyaktvā ca golokaṃ punareva prayāti saḥ || 88 || tataḥ kṛṣṇasya sārūpyaṃ pārṣadapravaro bhavet | punastatpatanaṃ nāsti jarāmṛtyuharo bhavet || 89 || śuklāṃ vāpyathavā kṛṣṇāṃ karotyekādaśīṃ ca yaḥ | vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ || 90 || bhārate punarāgatya kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam | krameṇa bhaktiṃ sudṛḍhāṃ karotyekāṃ hareraho || 91 || dehaṃ tyaktvā ca golokaṃ punareva prayāti saḥ | tataḥ kṛṣṇasya sārūpyaṃ samprāpya pārṣado bhavet || 92 || punastatpatanaṃ nāsti jarāmṛtyuharo bhavet | bhādre ca śukladvādaśyāṃ yaḥ śakraṃ pūjayennaraḥ || 93 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śakraloke mahīyate | ravivāre ca saṃkrāntyāṃ saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣake || 94 || sampūjyārkaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ yaḥ karoti ca bhārate | mahīyate so'rkaloke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 95 || bhārataṃ punarāgatya cārogī śrīyuto bhavet | jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitrīṃ yo hi pūjayet || 96 || mahīyate brahmaloke saptamanvantarāvadhi | punarmahīṃ samāgatya śrīmānatulavikramaḥ || 97 || cirajīvī bhavetso'pi jñānavānsampadā yutaḥ | māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ pūjayedyaḥ sarasvatīm || 98 || saṃyato bhaktito dattvā copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa | mahīyate maṇidvīpe yāvadbrahma divāniśam || 99 || samprāpya ca punarjanma sa bhavetkavipaṇḍitaḥ | gāṃ suvarṇādikaṃ yo hi brāhmaṇāya dadāti ca || 100 || nityaṃ jīvanaparyantaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca bhārate | gavāṃ lomapramāṇābdaṃ dviguṇaṃ viṣṇumandire || 101 || modate hariṇā sārdhaṃ krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ | tadante punarāgatya rājarājeśvaro bhavet || 102 || śrīmāṃśca putravānvidvāñjñānavānsarvataḥ sukhī | bhojayedyo'pi miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaśca bhārate || 103 || vipralomapramāṇābdaṃ modate viṣṇumandire | tataḥ punarihāgatya sukhī ca dhanavānbhavet || 104 || vidvānsucirajīvī ca śrīmānatulavikramaḥ | yo vakti vā dadātyeva harernāmāni bhārate || 105 || yugaṃ nāma pramāṇaṃ ca viṣṇuloke mahīyate | tataḥ punarihāgatya sa sukhī dhanavānbhavet || 106 || yadi nārāyaṇakṣetre phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet | nāmnā koṭiṃ hareryo hi kṣetre nārāyaṇe japet || 107 || sarvapāpavinirmukto jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam | na labhetsa punarjanma vaikuṇṭhe sa mahīyate || 108 || labhedviṣṇośca sārūpyaṃ na tasya patanaṃ bhavet | viṣṇubhaktiṃ labhetso'pi viṣṇusārūpyamāpnuyāt || 109 || śivaṃ yaḥ pūjayennityaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ ca pārthivam | yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ sa yāti śivamandiram || 110 || mṛdo reṇupramāṇābdaṃ śivaloke mahīyate | tataḥ punarihāgatya rājendro bhārate bhavet || 111 || śilāṃ ca pūjayennityaṃ śilātoyaṃ ca bhakṣati | mahīyate ca vaikuṇṭhe yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam || 112 || tato labdhvā punarjanma haribhaktiṃ ca durlabhām | mahīyate viṣṇuloke na tasya patanaṃ bhavet || 113 || tapāṃsi caiva sarvāṇi vratāni nikhilāni ca | kṛtvā tiṣṭhati vaikuṇṭhe yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 114 || tato labdhvā punarjanma rājendro bhārate bhavet | tato mukto bhavetpaścātpunarjanma na vidyate || 115 || yaḥ snātvā sarvatīrtheṣu bhuvaḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām | sa tu nirvāṇatāṃ yāti na ca janma bhavedbhuvi || 116 || puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca yo'śvamedhaṃ karoti ca | aśvalomamitābdaṃ ca śakrasyārdhāsanaṃ bhajet || 117 || caturguṇaṃ rājasūye phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ | sarvebhyo'pi makhebhyo hi paro devīmakhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 118 || viṣṇunā ca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā ca varānane | śaṅkareṇa maheśena tripurāsuranāśane || 119 || śaktiyajñaḥ pradhānaśca sarvayajñeṣu sundari | nānena sadṛśo yajñastriṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 120 || dakṣeṇa ca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ mahānsaṃvādasaṃyutaḥ | babhūva kalaho yatra dakṣaśaṅkarayoḥ sati || 121 || śepuśca nandinaṃ viprā nandī viprāṃśca kopataḥ | yaddhetordakṣayajñaṃ ca babhañja candraśekharaḥ || 122 || cakāra devīyajñaṃ sa purā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ | dharmaśca kaśyapaścaiva śeṣaścāpi ca kardamaḥ || 123 || svāyambhuvo manuścaiva tatputraśca priyavrataḥ | śivaḥ sanatkumāraśca kapilaśca dhruvastathā || 124 || rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam | devīyajñātparo yajño nāsti vede phalapradaḥ || 125 || varṣāṇāṃ śatajīvī ca jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam | jñānena tejasā caiva viṣṇutulyo bhavediha || 126 || devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvaiṣṇavānāṃ ca nārada | śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedā varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā || 127 || tīrthānāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā pavitrāṇāṃ śivo yathā | ekādaśī vratānāṃ ca puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī yathā || 128 || nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā candraḥ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā | yathā strīṇāṃ ca prakṛtī rādhā vāṇī vasundharā || 129 || śīghrāṇāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ ca cañcalānāṃ mano yathā | prajāpatīnāṃ brahmā ca prajānāṃ ca prajāpatiḥ || 130 || vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ yathā | śrīmatāṃ ca yathā śrīśca viduṣāṃ ca sarasvatī || 131 || pativratānāṃ durgā ca saubhāgyānāṃ ca rādhikā | devīyajñastathā vatse sarvayajñeṣu bhāmini || 132 || aśvamedhaśatenaiva śakratvaṃ ca labheddhruvam | sahasreṇa viṣṇupadaṃ samprāptaḥ pṛthureva ca || 133 || snānaṃ ca sarvatīrthānāṃ sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣaṇam | sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasāṃ phalameva ca || 134 || pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā | phalabhūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ muktidaṃ śaktisevanam || 135 || purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu cetihāseṣu sarvataḥ | nirūpitaṃ sārabhūtaṃ devīpādāmbujārcanam || 136 || tadvarṇanaṃ ca taddhyānaṃ tannāmaguṇakīrtanam | tatstotrasmaraṇaṃ caiva vandanaṃ japameva ca || 137 || tatpādodakanaivedyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ nityameva ca | sarvasammatamityevaṃ sarvepsitamidaṃ sati || 138 || bhaja nityaṃ paraṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ prakṛtiṃ parām | gṛhāṇa svāminaṃ vatse sukhaṃ vasa ca mandire || 139 || ayaṃ te kathitaḥ karmavipāko maṅgalo nṛṇām | sarvepsitaḥ sarvamatastattvajñānapradaḥ paraḥ || 140 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe yamena karmavipākakathanaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 || <9.31> yamāṣṭakavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śakterutkīrtanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī yamavaktrataḥ | sāśrunetrā sapulakā yamaṃ punaruvāca sā || 1 || sāvitryuvāca śakterutkīrtanaṃ dharma sakaloddhārakāraṇam | śrotṝṇāṃ caiva vaktṝṇāṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam || 2 || dānavānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ tapasāṃ ca paraṃ padam | yogānāṃ caiva vedānāṃ kīrtanaṃ sevanaṃ vibho || 3 || muktitvamamaratvaṃ ca sarvasiddhitvameva ca | śrīśaktisevakasyaiva kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 4 || bhajāmi kena vidhinā vada vedavidāṃvara | śubhakarmavipākaṃ ca śrutaṃ nṝṇāṃ manoharam || 5 || karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi | ityuktvā ca satī brahman bhaktinamrātmakandharā || 6 || tuṣṭāva dharmarājaṃ ca vedoktena stavena ca | sāvitryuvāca tapasā dharmamārādhya puṣkare bhāskaraḥ purā || 7 || dharmaṃ sūryaḥ sutaṃ prāpa dharmarājaṃ namāmyaham | samatā sarvabhūteṣu yasya sarvasya sākṣiṇaḥ || 8 || ato yannāma śamanamiti taṃ praṇamāmyaham | yenāntaśca kṛto viśve sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ param || 9 || kāmānurūpaṃ kālena taṃ kṛtāntaṃ namāmyaham | bibharti daṇḍaṃ daṇḍāya pāpināṃ śuddhihetave || 10 || namāmi taṃ daṇḍadharaṃ yaḥ śāstā sarvajīvinām | viśvaṃ ca kalayatyeva yaḥ sarveṣu ca santatam || 11 || atīva durnivāryaṃ ca taṃ kālaṃ praṇamāmyaham | tapasvī brahmaniṣṭho yaḥ saṃyamī sañjitendriyaḥ || 12 || jīvānāṃ karmaphaladastaṃ yamaṃ praṇamāmyaham | svātmārāmaśca sarvajño mitraṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ bhavet || 13 || pāpināṃ kleśado yastaṃ puṇyamitraṃ namāmyaham | yajjanma brahmaṇoṃ'śena jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā || 14 || yo dhyāyati paraṃ brahma tamīśaṃ praṇamāmyaham | ityuktvā sā ca sāvitrī praṇanāma yamaṃ mune || 15 || yamastāṃ śaktibhajanaṃ karmapākamuvāca ha | idaṃ yamāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet || 16 || yamāttasya bhayaṃ nāsti sarvapāpātpramucyate | mahāpāpī yadi paṭhennityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ | yamaḥ karoti saṃśuddhaṃ kāyavyūhena niścitam || 17 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe yamāṣṭakavarṇanaṃ nāmekatriśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 || <9.32> sāvitryupākhyāne kuṇḍasaṃkhyānirūpaṇam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca māyābījaṃ mahāmantraṃ pradattvā vidhipūrvakam | karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tāmuvāca raveḥ sutaḥ || 1 || dharmarāja uvāca śubhakarmavipākānna narakaṃ yāti mānavaḥ | karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya || 2 || nānāpurāṇabhedena nāmabhedena bhāmini | nānāprakāraṃ svargaṃ ca yāti jīvaḥ svakarmabhiḥ || 3 || śubhakarmavipākānna narakaṃ yāti karmabhiḥ | kukarmaṇā ca narakaṃ yāti nānāvidhaṃ naraḥ || 4 || narakāṇāṃ ca kuṇḍāni santi nānāvidhāni ca | nānāśāstrapramāṇena karmabhedena yāni ca || 5 || vistṛtāni ca gartāni kleśadāni ca duḥkhinām | bhayaṅkarāṇi ghorāṇi he vatse kutsitāni ca || 6 || ṣaḍaśīti ca kuṇḍāni evamanyāni santi ca | nibodha teṣāṃ nāmāni prasiddhāni śrutau sati || 7 || vahnikuṇḍaṃ taptakuṇḍaṃ kṣārakuṇḍaṃ bhayānakam | viṭkuṇḍaṃ mūtrakuṇḍaṃ ca śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ ca duḥsaham || 8 || garakuṇḍaṃ dūṣikuṇḍaṃ vasākuṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca | śukrakuṇḍamasukkuṇḍamaśrukuṇḍaṃ ca kutsitam || 9 || kuṇḍaṃ gātramalānāṃ ca karṇaviṭkuṇḍameva ca | majjākuṇḍaṃ māṃsakuṇḍaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ ca dustaram || 10 || lomakuṇḍaṃ keśakuṇḍamasthikuṇḍaṃ ca dustaram | tāmrakuṇḍaṃ lohakuṇḍaṃ prataptaṃ kleśadaṃ mahat || 11 || carmakuṇḍaṃ taptasurākuṇḍaṃ ca parikīrtitam | tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍaṃ ca viṣodaṃ viṣakuṇḍakam || 12 || prataptakuṇḍaṃ tailasya kuntakuṇḍaṃ ca durvaham | kṛmikuṇḍaṃ pūyakuṇḍaṃ sarpakuṇḍaṃ durantakam || 13 || maśakuṇḍaṃ daṃśakuṇḍaṃ bhīmaṃ garalakuṇḍakam | kuṇḍaṃ ca vajradaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ vṛścikānāṃ ca suvrate || 14 || śarakuṇḍaṃ śūlakuṇḍaṃ khaḍgakuṇḍaṃ ca bhīṣaṇam | golakuṇḍaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ kākakuṇḍaṃ śucāspadam || 15 || manthānakuṇḍaṃ bījakuṇḍaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ ca duḥsaham | taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍaṃ ca tīkṣṇapāṣāṇakuṇḍakam || 16 || lālākuṇḍaṃ masīkuṇḍaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca | cakrakuṇḍaṃ vakrakuṇḍaṃ kūrmakuṇḍaṃ maholbaṇam || 17 || jvālākuṇḍaṃ bhasmakuṇḍaṃ dagdhakuṇḍaṃ śucismite | taptasūcīmasipatraṃ kṣuradhāraṃ sūcīmukham || 18 || gokāmukha nakramukhaṃ gajadaṃśaṃ ca gomukham | kumbhīpākaṃ kālasūtraṃ matsyodaṃ kṛmitantukam || 19 || pāṃsubhojyaṃ pāśaveṣṭaṃ śūlaprotaṃ prakampanam | ulkāmukhamandhakūpaṃ vedhanaṃ tāḍanaṃ tathā || 20 || jālarandhraṃ dehacūrṇaṃ dalanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ kaṣam | śūrpaṃ jvālāmukhaṃ caiva dhūmāndhaṃ nāgaveṣṭanam || 21 || kuṇḍānyetāni sāvitri pāpināṃ kleśadāni ca | niyutaiḥ kiṅkaragaṇai rakṣitāni ca santatam || 22 || daṇḍahastaiḥ pāśahastairmadamattairbhayaṅkaraiḥ | śaktihastairgadāhastairasihastaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ || 23 || tamoyuktairdayāhīnairnivāryaiśca na sarvataḥ | tejasvibhiśca niḥśaṅkairātāmrapiṅgalocanaiḥ || 24 || yogayuktaiḥ siddhiyuktairnānārūpadharairbhaṭaiḥ | āsannamṛtyubhirdṛṣṭaiḥ pāpibhiḥ sarvajīvibhiḥ || 25 || svakarmanirataiḥ sarvaiḥ śāktaiḥ sauraiśca gāṇapaiḥ | adṛśyaiḥ puṇyakṛdbhiśca siddhairyogibhireva ca || 26 || svadharmaniratairvāpi vitatairvā svatantrakaiḥ | balavadbhiśca niḥśaṅkaiḥ svapnadṛṣṭaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 27 || etatte kathitaṃ sādhvi kuṇḍasaṃkhyānirūpaṇam | yeṣāṃ nivāso yatkuṇḍe nibodha kathayāmi te || 28 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne kuṇḍasaṃkhyānirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || <9.33> nānākarmavipākaphalakathanam dharmarāja uvāca harisevārataḥ śuddho yogasiddho vratī sati | tapasvī brahmacārī ca na yāti narakaṃ dhruvam || 1 || kaṭuvācā bāndhavāṃśca balalepena yo naraḥ | dagdhānkaroti balavān vahnikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ || 2 || svagātralomamānābdaṃ tatra sthitvā hutāśane | paśuyonimavāpnoti raudradagdhāṃ trijanmani || 3 || brāhmaṇaṃ tṛṣitaṃ taptaṃ kṣudhitaṃ gṛhamāgatam | na bhojayati yo mūḍhastaptakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ || 4 || tatra tallomamānaṃ ca varṣaṃ sthitvā ca duḥkhade | taptasthale vahnitalpe pakṣī ca saptajanmasu || 5 || ravivāre ca saṃkrāntyāmamāyāṃ śrāddhavāsare | vastrāṇāṃ kṣārasaṃyogaṃ karoti kevalaṃ naraḥ || 6 || sa yāti kṣārakuṇḍaṃ ca sūtramānābdameva ca | sa vrajedrajakīṃ yoniṃ saptajanmasu bhārate || 7 || mūlaprakṛtinindāṃ yaḥ kurute mānavādhamaḥ | vedanindāṃ śāstranindāṃ purāṇānāṃ tathaiva ca || 8 || brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tathā nindāparo janaḥ | gaurīvāṇyādidevīnāṃ tathā nindāparo janaḥ || 9 || te sarve niraye yānti tasminkuṇḍe bhayānake | nātaḥ parataraṃ kuṇḍaṃ duḥkhadaṃ tu bhaviṣyati || 10 || tatra sthitvānekakalpaṃ sarpayoniṃ vrajetpunaḥ | devīnindāparādhasya prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 11 || svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā vṛttiṃ ca suraviprayoḥ | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkuṇḍaṃ ca prayāti saḥ || 12 || tāvantyeva ca varṣāṇi viḍbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkṛmiśca punarbhuvi || 13 || parakīyataḍāge ca taḍāgaṃ yaḥ karoti ca | utsajeddaivadoṣeṇa mūtrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ || 14 || tadreṇumānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati | punaḥ pūrṇaśatābdaṃ ca sa vṛṣo bhārate bhavet || 15 || ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ prayāti ca | pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati || 16 || tataḥ pūrṇaśatābdaṃ ca sa preto bhārate bhavet | śleṣmamūtraparaṃ caiva pūyaṃ bhuṅkte tataḥ śuciḥ || 17 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva guruṃ bhāryāṃ sutaṃ sutām | yo na puṣṇātyanāthaṃ ca garakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ || 18 || pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati | tato vrajedbhūtayoniṃ śatavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ || 19 || dṛṣṭvātithiṃ vakracakṣuḥ karoti yo hi mānavaḥ | pitṛdevāstasya jalaṃ na gṛhṇanti ca pāpinaḥ || 20 || yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca | ihaiva labhate cānte dūṣikākuṇḍamāvrajet || 21 || pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati | tato vrajedbhūtayoniṃ śatavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ || 22 || dattvā dravyaṃ ca viprāya cānyasmai dīyate yadi | sa tiṣṭhati vasākuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram || 23 || kṛkalāso bhavetso'pi bhārate saptajanmasu | tato bhavenmahāraudro daridro'lpāyureva ca || 24 || pumāṃsaṃ kāminī vāpi kāminīṃ vā pumānatha | yaḥ śukraṃ pāyayatyeva śukrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ || 25 || pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati | kṛmiyoniṃ śatābdaṃ ca vrajedbhūtvā tataḥ śuciḥ || 26 || santāḍya ca guruṃ vipraṃ raktapātaṃ ca kārayet | sa ca tiṣṭhatyasṛkkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram || 27 || tato labhedvyāghrajanma saptajanmasu bhārate | tataḥ śuddhimavāpnoti mānavaśca krameṇa ha || 28 || yo'śru tatyāja gāyantaṃ bhaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā sagadgadam | śrīkṛṣṇaguṇasaṅgīte hasatyeva hi yo naraḥ || 29 || sa vasedaśrukuṇḍe ca tadbhojī śatavarṣakam | tato bhavecca cāṇḍālastrijanmani tataḥ śuciḥ || 30 || karoti śaṭhatā tadvannityaṃ suhṛdi yo naraḥ | kuṇḍaṃ gātramalānāṃ ca sa prayāti śatābdakam || 31 || tataḥ sa gārdabhīṃ yonimavāpnoti trijanmani | trijanmani ca śārgālīṃ tataḥ śuddho bhaved dhruvam || 32 || badhiraṃ yo hasatyeva nindatyevābhimānataḥ | sa vasetkarṇaviṭkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram || 33 || tato bhavetsa badhiro daridraḥ saptajanmasu | saptajanmanyaṅgahīnastataḥ śuddhiṃ labhed dhruvam || 34 || lobhātsvabharaṇārthāya jīvinaṃ hanti yo naraḥ | majjākuṇḍe vasetso'pi tadbhojī lakṣavatsaram || 35 || tato bhavecca śaśako mīnaśca saptajanmasu | trijanmani varāhaśca kukkuṭaḥ saptajanmasu || 36 || eṇādayaśca karmabhyastataḥ śuddhiṃ labhed dhruvam | svakanyāpālanaṃ kṛtvā vikrīṇāti ca yo naraḥ || 37 || arthalobhānmahāmūḍho māṃsakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ | kanyālomapramāṇābdaṃ tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati || 38 || tasya daṇḍaprahāraṃ ca kurvanti yamakiṅkarāḥ | māṃsabhāraṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā raktabhāraṃ lihetkṣudhā || 39 || tato hi bhārate pāpī kanyāviṭkṛmigo bhavet | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi vyādhaśca saptajanmasu || 40 || trijanmani varāhaśca kukkuṭaḥ saptajanmasu | maṇḍūko hi jalaukāśca saptajanmasu bhārate || 41 || saptajanmasu kākaśca tataḥ śuddhiṃ labhed dhruvam | vratānāmupavāsānāṃ śrāddhādīnāṃ ca saṅgame || 42 || karoti yaḥ kṣaurakarma so'śuciḥ sarvakarmasu | sa ca tiṣṭhati kuṇḍe ca nakhādīnāñca sundari || 43 || taddaivadinamānābdaṃ tadbhojī daṇḍatāḍitaḥ | sakeśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ yo vārcayati bhārate || 44 || sa tiṣṭhati keśakuṇḍe mṛdreṇumānavarṣakam | tadante yāvanīṃ yoniṃ prayāti harakopataḥ || 45 || śatābdācchuddhimāpnoti rākṣasaḥ sa bhaved dhruvam | pitṝṇāṃ yo viṣṇupade piṇḍaṃ naiva dadāti ca || 46 || sa ca tiṣṭhatyasthikuṇḍe svalomābdaṃ maholbaṇe | tataḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya kukhañjaḥ saptajanmasu || 47 || bhavenmahādaridraśca tataḥ śuddho hi dehataḥ | yaḥ sevate mahāmūḍho gurviṇīṃ ca svakāminīm || 48 || pratapte tāmrakuṇḍe ca śatavarṣaṃ sa tiṣṭhati | avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte ṛtusnātānnameva ca || 49 || lohakuṇḍe śatābdaṃ ca sa ca tiṣṭhati taptake | sa vrajedrajakīṃ yoniṃ kākānāṃ saptajanmasu || 50 || mahāvraṇī daridraśca tataḥ śuddhī bhavennaraḥ | yo hi carmāktahastena devadravyamupasmṛśet || 51 || śatavarṣapramāṇaṃ ca carmakuṇḍe sa tiṣṭhati | yaḥ śūdreṇābhyanujñāto bhuṅkte śūdrānnameva ca || 52 || sa ca taptasurākuṇḍe śatābdaṃ tiṣṭhati dvijaḥ | tato bhavecchūdrayājī brāhmaṇaḥ saptajanmasu || 53 || śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaveddha ruvam | vāgduṣṭaḥ kaṭuko vācā tāḍayetsvāminaṃ sadā || 54 || tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍe sa tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati | tāḍito yamadūtena daṇḍena ca caturguṇam || 55 || tataḥ uccaiḥśravāḥ saptajanmasveva tataḥ śuci | viṣeṇa jīvanaṃ hanti nirdayo yo hi mānavaḥ || 56 || viṣakuṇḍe ca tadbhojī sahasrābdaṃ ca tiṣṭhati | tato bhavennṛghātī ca vraṇī ca śatajanmasu || 57 || saptajanmasu kuṣṭhī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaved dhuvam | daṇḍena tāḍayed gāṃ hi vṛṣañca vṛṣavāhakaḥ || 58 || bhṛtyadvārā svatantro vā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate | pratapte tailakuṇḍe'gnau tiṣṭhati sma caturyugam || 59 || gavāṃ lomapramāṇābdaṃ vṛṣo bhavati tatparam | kuntena hanti yo jīvaṃ vahnilohena helayā || 60 || kuntakuṇḍe vasetso'pi varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati | tataḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya codare vyādhisaṃyutaḥ || 61 || janmanaikena kleśena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ | yo bhuṅkte ca vṛthā māṃsaṃ māṃsalobhī dvijādhamaḥ || 62 || hareranaivedyabhojī kṛmikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ | svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati || 63 || tato bhavenmlecchajātistrijanmani tato dvijaḥ | brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrayājī ca śūdraśrāddhānnabhojakaḥ || 64 || śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca pūyakuṇḍe vased dhruvam | yāvallomapramāṇābdaṃ yamadaṇḍena suvrate || 65 || tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati | tato bhāratamāgatya sa śūdraḥ saptajanmasu || 66 || mahārogī daridraśca badhiro mūka eva ca | kṛṣṇaṃ padmaṃ ca ke yasya taṃ sarpaṃ hanti yo naraḥ || 67 || svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca sarpakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ | sarpeṇa bhakṣitaḥ so'tha yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ || 68 || vasecca sarpaviḍbhojī tataḥ sarpo bhaved dhruvam | tato bhavenmānavaśca svalpāyurdadrusaṃyutaḥ || 69 || mahākleśena tanmṛtyuḥ sarpeṇa bhakṣitād dhruvam | vidhipradattajīvyāṃśca kṣudrajantūṃśca hanti yaḥ || 70 || sa daṃśamaśayoḥ kuṇḍe jantumānābdameva ca | divāniśaṃ bhakṣitastairanāhāraśca śabdavān || 71 || hastapādādibaddhaśca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ | tato bhavetkṣudrajanturjātiśca yāvanī bhavet || 72 || tato bhavenmānavaśca so'ṅgahīnastataḥ śuciḥ | yo mūḍho madhumaśnāti hatvā ca madhumakṣikāḥ || 73 || sa eva gārale kuṇḍe jīvamānābdakaṃ vaset | bhakṣito garalairdagdho yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ || 74 || tato hi makṣikājātistataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ | daṇḍaṃ karotyadaṇḍye ca vipre daṇḍaṃ karoti ca || 75 || sa kuṇḍaṃ vajradaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ kīṭānāṃ yāti satvaram | sa tallomapramāṇābdaṃ tatra tiṣṭhatyaharniśam || 76 || śabdakṛdbhakṣitastaistu yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ | karoti rodanaṃ bhadre hāhākāraṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 77 || punaḥ sūkarayonau ca jāyate saptajanmasu | trijanmani kākayonau tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ || 78 || arthalobhena yo mūḍhaḥ prajādaṇḍaṃ karoti saḥ | vṛścikānāṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ ca tallomābdaṃ vased dhruvam || 79 || tato vṛścikajātiśca saptajanmasu bhārate | tato naraścāṅgahīno vyādhiśuddho bhaved dhruvam || 80 || brāhmaṇaḥ śastradhārī yo hyanyeṣāṃ dhāvako bhavet | sandhyāhīnaśca yo vipro haribhaktivihīnakaḥ || 81 || sa tiṣṭhati svalomābdaṃ kuṇḍeṣu ca śarādiṣu | viddhaḥ śarādibhiḥ śaśvattataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ || 82 || kārāgāre sāndhakāre praṇihanti prajāśca yaḥ | pramattaḥ svasya doṣeṇa golakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ || 83 || sa paṅkataptatoyāktaṃ sāndhakāraṃ bhayaṅkaram | tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiśca kīṭaiśca saṃyuktaṃ golakuṇḍakam || 84 || kīṭairviddho vasettatra prajālomābdameva ca | tato bhavetprajābhṛtyastataḥ śuddho bhavetkramāt || 85 || sarovarādutthitāṃśca nakrādīnhanti yo naraḥ | nakrakaṇṭakamānābdaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ || 86 || tato nakrādijātīyo bhavennakrādiṣu dhruvam | tataḥ sadyo viśuddho hi daṇḍenaiva punaḥ punaḥ || 87 || vakṣaḥ śroṇīstanāsyañca yaḥ paśyati parastriyāḥ | kāmena kāmuko yo hi puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate || 88 || sa vasetkākakuṇḍe ca kākaiḥ saṃcūrṇalocanaḥ | tataḥ svalomamānābdaṃ bhaveddagdhastrijanmani || 89 || svarṇasteyī ca yo mūḍho bhārate suraviprayoḥ | sa ca manthānakuṇḍe vai svalomābdaṃ vased dhruvam || 90 || tāḍito yamadūtena manthānaiśchannalocanaḥ | tadviḍbhojī ca tatraiva tataścāndhastrijanmani || 91 || saptajanma daridraśca mahākrūraśca pātakī | bhārate svarṇakāraśca sa ca svarṇavaṇik tataḥ || 92 || yo bhārate tāmracauro lohacauraśca sundari | sa ca svalomamānābdaṃ bījakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ || 93 || tatraiva bījaviḍbhojī bījaiśca channalocanaḥ | tāḍito yamadūtena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ || 94 || bhārate devacauraśca devadravyāpahārakaḥ | sa dustare vajrakuṇḍe svalomābdaṃ vased dhruvam || 95 || dehadagdho'pi tadvajrairanāhāraśca śabdakṛt | tāḍito yamadūtaiśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ || 96 || raupyagavyāṃśukānāṃ ca yaścauraḥ suraviprayoḥ | taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍeca svalomābdaṃ vased dhruvam || 97 || trijanmani ca kaṃso'pi śvetarūpastrijanmani | janmaikaṃ śvetacihnaśca tato'nye śvetapakṣiṇaḥ || 98 || tato raktavikārī ca śūlī vai mānavo bhavet | saptajanmasu cālpāyustataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ || 99 || raitaṃ kāṃsyamayaṃ pātraṃ yo hareddevaviprayoḥ | tīkṣṇapāṣāṇakuṇḍe ca svalomābdaṃ vasennaraḥ || 100 || sa bhavedaśvajātiśca bhārate saptajanmasu | tato'dhikāṅgajātiśca pādarogī tataḥ śuciḥ || 101 || puṃścalyannaṃ ca yo bhadre puṃścalījīvyajīvinaḥ | svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca lālākuṇḍe vased dhruvam || 102 || tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra duḥkhitaḥ | tataścakṣuḥśūlarogī tataḥ śuddhaḥ krameṇa saḥ || 103 || mlecchasevī masījīvī yo vipro bhārate bhuvi | vasetsvalomamānābdaṃ masīkuṇḍe sa duḥkhabhāk || 104 || tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati | tatastrijanmani bhavetkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ paśuḥ sati || 105 || trijanmani bhavecchāgaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇastrijanmani | tataḥ sa tālavṛkṣaśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ || 106 || dhānyādisasyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ yo haretsuraviprayoḥ | āsanaṃ ca tathā talpaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍe prayāti saḥ || 107 || śatābdaṃ tatra nivasedyamadūtena tāḍitaḥ | tato bhavenmeṣajātiḥ kukkuṭaśca trijanmani || 108 || tato bhavedvānaraśca kāsavyādhiyuto bhuvi | vaṃśahīno daridraśca svalpāyuśca tataḥ śuciḥ || 109 || karoti cakraṃ viprāṇāṃ hṛtvā dravyaṃ ca yo janaḥ | sa vaseccakrakuṇḍe ca śatābdaṃ daṇḍatāḍitaḥ || 110 || tato bhavenmānavaśca tailakārastrijanmani | vyādhiyukto bhavedrogī vaṃśahīnastataḥ śuciḥ || 111 || godhaneṣu ca vipreṣu karoti vakratāṃ pumān | prayāti vakrakuṇḍaṃ sa tiṣṭhedyugaśataṃ sati || 112 || tato bhavetsa vakrāṅgo hīnāṅgaḥ saptajanmani | daridro vaṃśahīnaśca bhāryāhīnastataḥ śuciḥ || 113 || tato bhaved gṛdhrajanmā trijanmani ca sūkaraḥ | trijanmani biḍālaśca mayūraśca trijanmani || 114 || niṣiddhaṃ kūrmamāṃsaṃ ca brāhmaṇo yo hi bhakṣati | kūrmakuṇḍe vasetso'pi śatābdaṃ kūrmabhakṣitaḥ || 115 || tato bhavetkūrmajanmā trijanmani ca sūkaraḥ | trijanmani biḍālaśca mayūraśca tataḥ śuciḥ || 116 || ghṛtaṃ tailādikaṃ caiva yo haretsuraviprayoḥ | sa yāti jvālākuṇḍaṃ ca bhasmakuṇḍaṃ ca pātakī || 117 || tatra sthitvā śatābdaṃ ca sa bhavettailapācitaḥ | saptajanmani matsyaśca mūṣakaśca tataḥ śuciḥ || 118 || sugandhitailaṃ dhātrīṃ vā gandhadravyānyadeva vā | bhārate puṇyavarṣe ca yo haretsuraviprayoḥ || 119 || sa vaseddagdhakuṇḍe ca bhaveddagdho divāniśam | svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca tato durgandhiko bhavet || 120 || durgandhikaḥ saptajanma mṛganābhistrijanmani | saptajanmasu manthānastato hi mānavo bhavet || 121 || balenaiva chalenaiva hiṃsārūpeṇa vā sati | baliṣṭhaśca haredbhūmiṃ bhārate parapaitṛkīm || 122 || sa vasettaptasūciṃ ca bhavettāpī divāniśam | taptataile yathā jīvo dagdho bhavati santatam || 123 || bhasmasānna bhavatyeva bhoge dehī na naśyati | saptamanvantaraṃ pāpī santaptastatra tiṣṭhati || 124 || śabdaṃ karotyanāhāro yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkṛmiśca bhavettataḥ || 125 || tato bhavedbhūmihīno daridraśca tataḥ śuciḥ | tataḥ svayoniṃ samprāpya śubhaṃ karmācaretpunaḥ || 126 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nānākarmavipākaphalakathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 || <9.34> nānākarmavipākaphalavarṇanam yama uvāca chinatti jīvaṃ khaḍgena dayāhīnaḥ sudāruṇaḥ | naraghātī hanti naramarthalobhena bhārate || 1 || asipatre vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | teṣu yo brāhmaṇān hanti śatamanvantaraṃ vaset || 2 || chinnāṅgaḥ saṃvaset so'pi khaḍgadhāreṇa santatam | anāhāraḥ śabdamuccairyamadūtena tāḍitaḥ || 3 || manthānaḥ śatajanmāni śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ | kukkuṭaḥ sapta janmāni śṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu || 4 || vyāghraśca sapta janmāni vṛkaścaiva trijanmasu | saptajanmasu maṇḍūko yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ || 5 || sa bhavedbhārate varṣe mahiṣaśca tataḥ śuciḥ | grāmāṇāṃ nagarāṇāṃ vā dahanaṃ yaḥ karoti ca || 6 || kṣuradhāre vasetso'pi chinnāṅgastriyugaṃ sati | tataḥ preto bhavetsadyo vahnivaktro bhramanmahīm || 7 || saptajanmāmedhyabhojī kapotaḥ saptajanmasu | tato bhavenmahāśūlī mānavaḥ saptajanmani || 8 || saptajanma galatkuṣṭhī tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ | parakarṇe mukhaṃ dattvā paranindāṃ karoti yaḥ || 9 || paradoṣe mahāślāghī devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ | sūcīmukhe vasetso'pi sūcīviddho yugatrayam || 10 || tato bhaved vṛścikaśca sarpaśca saptajanmasu | vajrakīṭaḥ saptajanma bhasmakīṭastataḥ param || 11 || tato bhavenmānavaśca mahāvyādhistataḥ śuciḥ | gṛhiṇāṃ hi gṛhaṃ bhittvā vastusteyaṃ karoti yaḥ || 12 || gāśca chāgāṃśca meṣāṃśca yāti gokāmukhe ca saḥ | tāḍito yamadūtena vasettatra yugatrayam || 13 || tato bhavetsaptajanma gojātirvyādhisaṃyutaḥ | trijanmani meṣajātiśchāgajātistrijanmani || 14 || tato bhavenmānavaśca nityarogī daridrakaḥ | bhāryāhīno bandhuhīnaḥ santāpī ca tataḥ śuciḥ || 15 || sāmānyadravyacauraśca yāti nakramukhaṃ ca saḥ | tāḍito yamadūtena vasettatrābdakatrayam || 16 || tato bhavetsaptajanma gopatirvyādhisaṃyutaḥ | tato bhavenmānavaśca mahārogī tataḥ śuciḥ || 17 || hanti gāśca gajāṃścaiva turagāṃśca nagāṃstathā | sa yāti gajadaṃśaṃ ca mahāpāpī yugatrayam || 18 || tāḍito yamadūtena nāgadantena santatam | sa bhavedgajajātiśca turagaśca trijanmani || 19 || gojātirmlecchajātiśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ | jalaṃ pibantīṃ tṛṣitāṃ gāṃ vārayati yaḥ pumān || 20 || narakaṃ gomukhākāraṃ kṛmitaptodakānvitam | tatra tiṣṭhati santapto yāvanmanvantarāvadhi || 21 || tato naro'pi gohīno mahārogī daridrakaḥ | saptajanmāntyajātiśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ || 22 || gohatyāṃ brahmahatyāṃ ca karoti hyatideśikīm | yo hi gacchatyagamyāṃ ca yaḥ strīhatyāṃ karoti ca || 23 || bhikṣuhatyāṃ mahāpāpī bhrūṇahatyāṃ ca bhārate | kumbhīpāke vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 24 || tāḍito yamadūtena cūrṇyamānaśca santatam | kṣaṇaṃ patati vahnau ca kṣaṇaṃ patati kaṇṭake || 25 || kṣaṇaṃ patettaptataile tapto yena kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam | kṣaṇaṃ ca taptalohe ca kṣaṇaṃ ca taptatāmrake || 26 || gṛdhro janmasahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ | kākaśca sapta janmāni sarpaśca saptajanmasu || 27 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ | nānājanmasu sa vṛṣastataḥ kuṣṭhī daridrakaḥ || 28 || sāvitryuvāca viprahatyā ca gohatyā kiṃvidhā cātidaiśikī | kā vā nṛṇāmagamyā ca ko vā saṃdhyāvihīnakaḥ || 29 || adīkṣitaḥ pumānko vā ko vā tīrthapratigrahī | dvijaḥ ko vā grāmayājī ko vā vipro'tha devalaḥ || 30 || śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca pramatto vṛṣalīpatiḥ | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara || 31 || dharmarāja uvāca śrīkṛṣṇe ca tadarcāyāmanyeṣāṃ prakṛtau sati | śive ca śivaliṅge ca sūrye sūryamaṇau tathā || 32 || gaṇeśe vātha durgāyāmevaṃ sarvatra sundari | yaḥ karoti bhedabuddhiṃ brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 33 || svagurau sveṣṭadeve ca janmadātari mātari | karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 34 || vaiṣṇaveṣu ca bhakteṣu brāhmaṇeṣvitareṣu ca | karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 35 || viprapādodake caiva śālagrāmodake tathā | karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 36 || śivanaivedyake caiva harinaivedyake tathā | karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 37 || sarveśvareśvare kṛṣṇe sarvakāraṇakāraṇe | sarvādye sarvadevānāṃ sevye sarvāntarātmani || 38 || māyayānekarūpe vāpyeka eva hi nirguṇe | karotīśena bhedaṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 39 || śaktibhakte dveṣabuddhiṃ śaktiśāstre tathaiva ca | dveṣaṃ yaḥ kurute martyo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 40 || pitṛdevārcanaṃ yo vā tyajedvedanirūpitam | yaḥ karoti niṣiddhaṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 41 || yo nindati hṛṣīkeśaṃ tanmantropāsakaṃ tathā | pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca jñānānandaṃ sanātanam || 42 || pradhānaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca devānāṃ sevyamīśvaram | ye nārcayanti nindanti brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te || 43 || ye nindanti mahādevīṃ kāraṇabrahmarūpiṇīm | sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca prakṛtiṃ sarvamātaram || 44 || sarvadevasvarūpāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vanditāṃ sadā | sarvakāraṇarūpāṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te || 45 || kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ rāmanavamīṃ ca supuṇyadām | śivarātriṃ tathā caikādaśīṃ vāre ravestathā || 46 || pañca parvāṇi puṇyāni ye na kurvanti mānavāḥ | labhanti brahmahatyāṃ te cāṇḍālādhikapāpinaḥ || 47 || ambuvācyāṃ bhūkhananaṃ jalaśaucādikaṃ ca ye | kurvanti bhārate varṣe brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te || 48 || guruñca mātaraṃ tātaṃ sādhvīṃ bhāryāṃ sutaṃ sutām | anindyāṃ yo na puṣṇāti brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 49 || vivāho yasya na bhavenna paśyati sutaṃ tu yaḥ | haribhaktivihīno yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ || 50 || hareranaivedyabhojī nityaṃ viṣṇuṃ na pūjayet | puṇyaṃ pārthivaliṅgaṃ ca brahmahāsau prakīrtitaḥ || 51 || goprahāraṃ prakurvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā yo na nivārayet | yāti goviprayormadhye gohatyā tu labhettu saḥ || 52 || daṇḍairgostāḍayenmūḍho yo vipro vṛṣavāhanaḥ | dine dine govadhaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 53 || dadāti gobhya ucchiṣṭaṃ bhojayed vṛṣavāhakam | bhunakti vṛṣavāhānnaṃ sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam || 54 || vṛṣalīpatiṃ yājayedyo bhuṅkte'nnaṃ tasya yo naraḥ | gohatyāśatakaṃ so'pi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 55 || pādaṃ dadāti vahnau yo gāśca pādena tāḍayet | gehaṃ viśedadhautāṅghriḥ snātvā govadhamāpnuyāt || 56 || yo bhuṅkte snigdhapādena śete snigdhāṅghrireva ca | sūryodaye ca yo bhuṅkte sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam || 57 || avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte yonijīvyasya ca dvijaḥ | yastrisandhyāvihīnaśca gohatyā labhate ca saḥ || 58 || svabhartari ca deve vā bhedabuddhiṃ karoti yā | kaṭūktyā tāḍayet kāntaṃ sā gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam || 59 || gomārgavarjanaṃ kṛtvā dadāti sasyameva vā | taḍāge vā tu durge vā sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam || 60 || prāyaścitte govadhasya yaḥ karoti vyatikramam | putralobhādathājñānātsa gohatyā labhed dhruvam || 61 || rājake daivake yatnād gosvāmī gāṃ na rakṣati | duḥkhaṃ dadāti yo mūḍho gohatyāṃ sa labhed dhruvam || 62 || prāṇino laṅghayedyo hi devārcāmanalaṃ jalam | naivedyaṃ puṣpamannaṃ ca sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam || 63 || śaśvannāstīti yo vādī mithyāvādī pratārakaḥ | devadveṣī gurudveṣī sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam || 64 || devatāpratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā guruṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ sati | sambhramānna namedyo hi sa gohatyā labhed dhruvam || 65 || na dadātyāśiṣaṃ kopātpraṇatāya ca yo dvijaḥ | vidyārthine ca vidyāṃ ca sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam || 66 || gohatyā viprahatyā ca kathitā cātideśikī | gamyāṃ striyaṃ nṛṇāmeva nibodha kathayāmi te || 67 || svastrī gamyā ca sarveṣāmiti vedānuśāsanam | agamyā ca tadanyā yā ceti vedavido viduḥ || 68 || sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari | atyagamyā hi yā yāśca nibodha kathayāmi tāḥ || 69 || śūdrāṇāṃ viprapatnī ca viprāṇāṃ śūdrakāminī | atyagamyā ca nindyā ca loke vede pativrate || 70 || śūdraśca brāhmaṇīṃ gatvā brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet | tatsamaṃ brāhmaṇī cāpi kumbhīpākaṃ labhed dhruvam || 71 || śūdrāṇāṃ viprapatnī ca viprāṇāṃ śūdrakāminī | yadi śūdrā vrajedvipro vṛṣalīpatireva saḥ || 72 || sa bhraṣṭo viprajāteśca cāṇḍālātso'dhamaḥ smṛtaḥ | viṣṭhāsamaśca tatpiṇḍo mūtraṃ tasya ca tarpaṇam || 73 || na pitṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca taddattamupatiṣṭhati | koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasyārcāttapasārjitam || 74 || dvijasya vṛṣalīlobhānnaśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | brāhmaṇaśca surāpītirviḍbhojī vṛṣalīpatiḥ || 75 || taptamudrādagdhadehastaptaśūlāṅkitastathā | harivāsarabhojī ca kumbhīpākaṃ vrajed dvijaḥ || 76 || gurupatnīṃ rājapatnīṃ sapatnīṃ mātaraṃ dhruvam | sutāṃ putravadhūṃ śvaśrūṃ sagarbhāṃ bhaginīṃ satīm || 77 || sahodarabhrātṛjāyāṃ mātulānīṃ pituḥ prasūm | mātuḥ prasūṃ tatsvasāraṃ bhaginīṃ bhrātṛkanyakām || 78 || śiṣyāṃ śiṣyasya patnīṃ ca bhāgineyasya kāminīm | bhrātuḥ putrapriyāṃ caivātyagamyā āha padmajaḥ || 79 || etāḥ kāmena kāntā yo vrajedvai mānavādhamaḥ | sa mātṛgāmī vedeṣu brahmahatyāśataṃ vrajet || 80 || akarmārho'pyasaṃspṛśyo loke vede ca ninditaḥ | sa yāti kumbhīpāke ca mahāpāpī suduṣkare || 81 || karotyaśuddhāṃ sandhyāṃ vā na sandhyāṃ vā karoti ca | trisandhyaṃ varjayedyo vā sandhyāhīnaśca sa dvijaḥ || 82 || vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā śaivaṃ śāktaṃ sauraṃ ca gāṇapam | yo'haṅkārānna gṛhṇāti mantraṃ so'dīkṣitaḥ smṛtaḥ || 83 || pravāhamavadhiṃ kṛtvā yāvaddhastacatuṣṭayam | tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī gaṅgāgarbhāntare vaset || 84 || tatra nārāyaṇakṣetre mṛto yāti hareḥ padam | vārāṇasyāṃ badaryāṃ ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame || 85 || puṣkare hariharakṣetre prabhāse kāmarūsthale | haridvāre ca kedāre tathā mātṛpure'pi ca || 86 || sarasvatīnadītīre puṇye vṛndāvane vane | godāvaryāṃ ca kauśikyāṃ triveṇyāṃ ca himācale || 87 || eṣu tīrtheṣu yo dānaṃ pratigṛhṇāti kāmataḥ | sa ca tīrthapratigrāhī kumbhīpāke prayāti saḥ || 88 || śūdrasevī śūdrayājī grāmayājīti kīrtitaḥ | tathā devopajīvī ca devalaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 89 || śūdrapākopajīvī yaḥ sūpakāra iti smṛtaḥ | sandhyāpūjanahīnaśca pramattaḥ patitaḥ smṛtaḥ || 90 || uktaṃ sarvaṃ mayā bhadre lakṣaṇaṃ vṛṣalīpateḥ | ete mahāpātakinaḥ kumbhīpākaṃ prayānti te | kuṇḍānyanyāni ye yānti nibodha kathayāmi te || 91 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne nānākarmavipākaphalavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || <9.35> nānākarmavipākaphalakathanam dharmarāja uvāca devasevāṃ vinā sādhvi na bhavetkarmakṛntanam | śuddhakarma śuddhabījaṃ narakaśca kukarmaṇā || 1 || puṃścalyannaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte yo'syāṃ gacchetpativrate | sa dvijaḥ kālasūtraṃ ca mṛto yāti sudurgamam || 2 || śatavarṣaṃ kālasūtre sthirībhūto bhaved dhruvam | tatra janmani rogī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaved dvijaḥ || 3 || pativratā caikapatau dvitīye kulaṭā smṛtā | tṛtīye dharṣiṇī jñeyā caturthe puṃścalītyapi || 4 || veśyā ca pañcame ṣaṣṭhe puṅgī ca saptame'ṣṭame | tata ūrdhvaṃ mahāveśyā sāspṛśyā sarvajātiṣu || 5 || yo dvijaḥ kulaṭāṃ gaccheddharṣiṇīṃ puṃścalīmapi | puṅgīṃ veśyāṃ mahāveśyāṃ matsyode yāti niścitam || 6 || śatābdaṃ kulaṭāgāmī dhṛṣṭāgāmī caturguṇam | ṣaḍguṇaṃ puṃścalīgāmī veśyāgāmī guṇāṣṭakam || 7 || puṅgīgāmī daśaguṇaṃ vasettatra na saṃśayaḥ | mahāveśyākāmukaśca tato daśaguṇaṃ vaset || 8 || tatraiva yātanāṃ bhuṅkte yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ | tittiriḥ kulaṭāgāmī dhṛṣṭāgāmī ca vāyasaḥ || 9 || kokilaḥ puṃścalīgāmī veśyāgāmī vṛkaḥ smṛtaḥ | puṅgīgāmī sūkaraśca saptajanmani bhārate || 10 || mahāveśyāpragāmī ca jāyate śālmalītaruḥ | yo bhuṅkte jñānahīnaśca grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ || 11 || aruntudaṃ sa yātyevāpyannamānābdameva ca | tato bhavenmānavaścāpyudare rogapīḍitaḥ || 12 || gulmayuktaśca kāṇaśca dantahīnastataḥ śuciḥ | vākpradattāṃ svakanyāṃ ca yo'nyasmai pradadāti ca || 13 || sa vasetpāṃsukuṇḍe ca tadbhojī śatavatsaram | taddravyahārī yaḥ sādhvi pāṃsuveṣṭe śatābdakam || 14 || nivaseccharaśayyāyāṃ mama dūtena tāḍitaḥ | bhaktyā na pūjayedvipraḥ śivaliṅgaṃ ca pārthivam || 15 || sa yāti śūlinaḥ pāpācchūlaprotaṃ sudāruṇam | sthitvā śatābdaṃ tatraiva śvāpadaḥ saptajanmasu || 16 || tato bhaveddevalaśca saptajanma tataḥ śuciḥ | karoti kuṇṭhitaṃ vipraṃ yadbhiyā kampate dvijaḥ || 17 || prakampane vasetso'pi vipralomābdameva ca | prakopavadanā kopāt svāminaṃ yā ca paśyati || 18 || kaṭūktiṃ taṃ pravadati solmukaṃ samprayāti hi | ulkāṃ dadāti tadvaktre satataṃ mama kiṅkaraḥ || 19 || daṇḍena tāḍayenmūrdhni tallomābdapramāṇakam | tato bhavenmānavī ca vidhavā saptajanmasu || 20 || sā bhuktvā caiva vaidhavyaṃ vyādhiyuktā tataḥ śuciḥ | yā brāhmaṇī śūdrabhogyā cāndhakūpe prayāti sā || 21 || taptaśaucodake dhvānte tadāhārī divāniśam | nivasedatisantaptā mama dūtena tāḍitā || 22 || śaucodake nimagnā sā yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | kākī janmasahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkarī || 23 || śṛgālī śatajanmāni śatajanmāni kukkuṭī | pārāvatī saptajanma vānarī saptajanmasu || 24 || tato bhavetsā cāṇḍālī sarvabhogyā ca bhārate | tato bhavecca rajakī yakṣmagrastā ca puṃścalī || 25 || tataḥ kuṣṭhayutā tailakārī śuddhā bhavettataḥ | nivasedvedhane veśyā puṅgī ca daṇḍatāḍane || 26 || jalarandhre vasedveśyā kulaṭā dehacūrṇake | svairiṇī dalane caiva dhṛṣṭā ca śoṣaṇe tathā || 27 || nivasedyātanāyuktā mama dūtena tāḍitā | viṇmūtrabhakṣā satataṃ yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati || 28 || tato bhavedviṭkṛmiśca lakṣavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ | brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇīṃ gacchetkṣatriyāṃ vāpi kṣatriyaḥ || 29 || vaiśyo vaiśyāṃ ca śūdrā vā śūdraścāpi vrajedyadi | savarṇaparadāraiśca kaṣāyaṃ yānti te janāḥ || 30 || bhuktvā kaṣāyataptodaṃ nivasedvā śatābdakam | tato vipro bhavecchuddhastato vai kṣatriyādayaḥ || 31 || yoṣitaścāpi śuddhyantītyevamāha pitāmahaḥ | kṣatriyo brāhmaṇīṃ gacchedvaiśyo vāpi pativrate || 32 || mātṛgāmī bhavetso'pi śūrpe ca narake vaset | śūrpākāraiśca kṛmibhirbrāhmaṇyā saha bhakṣitaḥ || 33 || prataptamūtrabhojī ca mama dūtena tāḍitaḥ | tatraiva yātanāṃ bhuṅkte yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 34 || saptajanma varāhaśca chāgalaśca tataḥ śuciḥ | kare dhṛtvā tu tulasīṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet || 35 || mithyā vā śapathaṃ kuryātsa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet | gaṅgātoyaṃ kare kṛtvā pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet || 36 || śilāṃ vā devapratimāṃ sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet | dattvā dakṣiṇahastaṃ ca pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet || 37 || sthitvā devagṛhe vāpi sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet | āspṛśya brāhmaṇaṃ gāṃ ca jvālāvahniṃ vrajed dvijaḥ || 38 || na pālayetpratijñāṃ ca sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet | mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca yaśca viśvāsaghātakaḥ || 39 || mithyāsākṣyapradaścaiva sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet | ete tatra vasantyeva yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 40 || tathāṅgārapradagdhāśca mama dūtena tāḍitāḥ | cāṇḍālastulasīṃ spṛṣṭvā saptajanma tataḥ śuciḥ || 41 || mleccho gaṅgājalasparśī pañcajanma tataḥ śuciḥ | śilāsparśī viṭkṛmiśca saptajanmasu sundari || 42 || arcāsparśī brahmakṛmiḥ saptajanma tataḥ śuci | dakṣahastapradātā ca sarpaśca saptajanmasu || 43 || tato bhaved brahmahīno mānavaśca tataḥ śuciḥ | mithyāvādī devagṛhe devalaḥ saptajanmasu || 44 || viprādisparśakārī ca vyāghrajātirbhaved dhruvam | tato bhavecca mūkaḥ sa badhiraśca trijanmani || 45 || bhāryāhīno bandhuhīno vaṃśahīnastataḥ śuciḥ | mitradrohī ca nakulaḥ kṛtaghnaścāpi gaṇḍakaḥ || 46 || viśvāsaghātī vyāghraśca saptajanmasu bhārate | mithyāsākṣī ca vaktavye maṇḍūkaḥ saptajanmasu || 47 || pūrvānsaptāparānsapta puruṣānhanti cātmanaḥ | nityakriyāvihīnaśca jaḍatvena yuto dvijaḥ || 48 || yasyānāsthā vedavākye mandaṃ hasati saṃtatam | vratopavāsahīnaśca sadvākyaparanindakaḥ || 49 || dhūmrāndhe ca vasetso'pi śatābdaṃ dhūmrabhakṣakaḥ | jalajanturbhavetso'pi śatajanmakrameṇa ca || 50 || tato nānāprakāraśca matsyajātistataḥ
