śuciḥ | yaḥ karotyupahāsaṃ ca devabrāhmaṇayordhane || 51 || pātayitvā sa puruṣāndaśapūrvāndaśāparān | so'yaṃ yāti ca dhūmrāndhaṃ dhūmradhvāntasamanvitam || 52 || dhūmrakliṣṭo dhūmrabhojī vasettatra caturguṇam | tato mūṣakajātiśca saptajanmasu bhārate || 53 || tato nānāvidhāḥ pakṣijātayaḥ kṛmijātibhiḥ | tato nānāvidhā vṛkṣā paśavaśca tato naraḥ || 54 || vipro daivajñajīvī ca vaidyajīvī cikitsakaḥ | lākṣālohādivyāpārī rasādivikrayī ca yaḥ || 55 || sa yāti nāgaveṣṭaṃ ca nāgairveṣṭitameva ca | vasetsa lomamānābdaṃ tatraiva nāgapāśitaḥ || 56 || tato nānāvidhāḥ pakṣijātayaśca tato naraḥ | tato bhavetsa gaṇako vaidyaśca saptajanmasu || 57 || gopaśca karmakāraśca raṅgakārastataḥ śuciḥ | prasiddhāni ca kuṇḍāni kathitāni pativrate || 58 || anyāni cāprasiddhāni kṣudrāṇi santi tatra vai | santi pātakinasteṣu svakarmaphalabhoginaḥ | bhramanti nānāyoniṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 59 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nānākarmavipākaphalakathanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || <9.36> devapūjanāt sarvāriṣṭanivṛttivarṇanam sāvitryuvāca dharmarāja mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāraga | nānāpurāṇetihāse yatsāraṃ tatpradarśaya || 1 || sarveṣu sārabhūtaṃ yatsarveṣṭaṃ sarvasammatam | karmacchedabījarūpaṃ praśastaṃ sukhadaṃ nṛṇām || 2 || sarvapradaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam | bhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ na paśyanti yena vai sarvamānavāḥ || 3 || kuṇḍāni te na paśyanti teṣu naiva patanti ca | na bhavedyena janmādi tatkarma vada sāmpratam || 4 || kimākārāṇi kuṇḍāni tāni vā nirmitāni ca | ke ca kenaiva rūpeṇa tatra tiṣṭhanti pāpinaḥ || 5 || svadehe bhasmasādbhūte yāti lokāntaraṃ naraḥ | kena dehena vā bhogaṃ karoti ca śubhāśubham || 6 || suciraṃ kleśabhogena kathaṃ deho na naśyati | deho vā kiṃvidho brahmaṃstanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 7 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sāvitrīvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmarājo hariṃ smaran | kathāṃ kathitumārebhe karmabandhanikṛntanīm || 8 || dharmarāja uvāca vatse caturṣu vedeṣu dharmeṣu saṃhitāsu ca | purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu pāñcarātrādikeṣu ca || 9 || anyeṣu dharmaśāstreṣu vedāṅgeṣu ca suvrate | sarveṣṭaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca pañcadevānusevanam || 10 || janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokasantāpanāśanam | sarvamaṅgalarūpaṃ ca paramānandakāraṇam || 11 || kāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ narakārṇavatāraṇam | bhaktivṛkṣāṅkurakaraṃ karmavṛkṣanikṛntanam || 12 || vimokṣasopānamidamavināśapadaṃ smṛtam | sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyādipradaṃ śubham || 13 || kuṇḍāni yamadūtaiśca rakṣitāni sadā śubhe | na hi paśyanti svapne ca pañcadevārcakā narāḥ || 14 || devībhaktivihīnā ye te paśyanti mamālayam | yānti ye haritīrthaṃ vā śrayanti harivāsaram || 15 || praṇamanti hariṃ nityaṃ haryarcāṃ kalpayanti ca | na yānti te'pi ghorāṃ ca mama saṃyaminīṃ purīm || 16 || trisandhipūtā viprāśca śuddhācārasamanvitāḥ | nivṛttiṃ naiva lapsyanti devīsevāṃ vinā narāḥ || 17 || svadharmaniratācārāḥ svadharmaniratāstathā | gacchanto mṛtyulokaṃ ca durdṛśā mama kiṅkarāḥ || 18 || bhītāḥ śivopāsakebhyo vainateyādivoragāḥ | svadūtaṃ pāśahastaṃ ca gacchantaṃ vārayāmyaham || 19 || yāsyanti te ca sarvatra haridāsāśramaṃ vinā | kṛṣṇamantropāsakācca vainateyādivoragāḥ || 20 || devīmantropāsakānāṃ nāmnāñcaiva nikṛntanam | karoti nakhalekhanyā citraguptaśca bhītavat || 21 || madhuparkādikaṃ teṣāṃ kurute ca punaḥ punaḥ | vilaṅghya brahmalokaṃ ca lokaṃ gacchanti te sati || 22 || duritāni ca naśyanti yeṣāṃ saṃsparśamātrataḥ | te mahābhāgyavanto hi sahasrakulapāvanāḥ || 23 || yathā ca prajvaladvahnau śuṣkāni ca tṛṇāni ca | prāpnoti mohaḥ sammohaṃ tāṃśca dṛṣṭvā ca bhītavat || 24 || kāmaśca kāminaṃ yāti lobhakrodhau tataḥ sati | mṛtyuḥ pralīyate rogo jarā śoko bhayaṃ tathā || 25 || kālaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ karma harṣo bhogastathaiva ca | ye ye na yānti tāṃ pīḍāṃ kathitāste mayā sati || 26 || śṛṇu dehavivaraṇaṃ kathayāmi yathāgamam | pṛthivī vāyurākāśastejastoyamiti sphuṭam || 27 || dehināṃ dehabījaṃ ca sraṣṭṛsṛṣṭividhau param | pṛthivyādipañjabhūtairyo deho nirmito bhavet || 28 || sa kṛtrimo naśvaraśca bhasmasācca bhavediha | baddho'ṅguṣṭhapramāṇaśca yo jīvaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛtaḥ || 29 || bibharti sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ taṃ tadrūpaṃ bhogahetave | sa deho na bhavedbhasma jvaladagnau mamālaye || 30 || jalena naṣṭo dehī vā prahāre suciraṃ kṛte | na śastreṇa na vāstreṇa sutīkṣṇakaṇṭake tathā || 31 || taptadrave taptalohe taptapāṣāṇa eva ca | prataptapratimāśleṣe yatpūrvapatane'pi ca || 32 || na dagdho na ca bhagnaḥ sa bhuṅkte santāpameva ca | kathito dehavṛttāntaḥ kāraṇaṃ ca yathāgamam | kuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ bodhāya kathayāmi te || 33 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde devapūjanāt sarvāriṣṭanivṛttivarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 || <9.37> nānānarakakuṇḍavarṇanam sāvitryuvāca dharmarāja uvāca pūrṇendumaṇḍalākāraṃ sarvaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ca vartulam | nimnaṃ pāṣāṇabhedaiśca pācitaṃ bahubhiḥ sati || 1 || na naśvaraṃ cāpralayaṃ nirmitaṃ ceśvarecchayā | kleśadaṃ pātakānāṃ ca nānārūpaṃ tadālayam || 2 || jvaladaṅgārarūpaṃ ca śatahastaśikhānvitam | paritaḥ krośamānaṃ ca vahnikuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam || 3 || mahāśabdaṃ prakurvadbhiḥ pāpibhiḥ paripūritam | rakṣitaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiścāpi santatam || 4 || prataptodakapūrṇaṃ ca hiṃsrajantusamanvitam | mahāghoraṃ kākuśabdaṃ prahāreṇa dṛḍhena ca || 5 || krośārdhamānaṃ taddūtaistāḍitairmama pārṣadaiḥ | taptakṣārodakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ punaḥ kākaiśca saṅkulam || 6 || saṅkulaṃ pāpibhiścaiva krośamānaṃ bhayānakam | trāhīti śabdaṃ kurvadbhirmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ || 7 || pracaladbhiranāhāraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaiḥ | viḍbhireva kṛtaṃ pūrṇaṃ krośamānaṃ ca kutsitam || 8 || atidurgandhisaṃsaktaṃ vyāptaṃ pāpibhiranvaham | tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca tadāhāraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ || 9 || rakṣeti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistatkīṭaireva bhakṣitaiḥ | taptamūtradravaiḥ pūrṇaṃ mūtrakīṭaiśca saṅkulam || 10 || yuktaṃ mahāpātakibhistatkīṭairbhakṣitaiḥ sadā | gavyūtimānaṃ dhvāntāktaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam || 11 || maddūtaistāḍitairghoraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaiḥ | śleṣmapūrṇaṃ praśamitaṃ tatkīṭaiḥ pūritaṃ sadā || 12 || tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca veṣṭitaṃ veṣṭitaiḥ sadā | krośārdhaṃ garakuṇḍaṃ ca garabhojibhiranvitam || 13 || garakīṭairbhakṣitaiśca pāpibhiḥ pūrṇameva ca | tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca śabdakṛdbhiśca kampitaiḥ || 14 || sarpākārervajradaṃṣṭrai śuṣkakaṇṭhaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ | netrayormalapūrṇaṃ ca krośārdhaṃ kīṭasaṃyutam || 15 || pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ śaśvadbhramadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ | vasārasena sampūrṇaṃ krośaturyaṃ suduḥsaham || 16 || tadbhojibhiḥ pātakibhirmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | śukrakuṇḍaṃ krośamitaṃ śukrakīṭaiśca saṃyutam || 17 || pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ śaśvad dravadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ | durgandhiraktapūrṇaṃ ca vāpīmānaṃ gabhīrakam || 18 || tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca saṅkulaṃ kīṭabhakṣitam | pūrṇaṃ netrāśrubhistaptaṃ bahupāpibhiranvitam || 19 || vāpīturyapramāṇaṃ ca rudadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ | nṛṇāṃ gātramalairyuktaṃ tadbhakṣaiḥ pāpibhiryutam || 20 || tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca vyagraiśca kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ | karṇaviṭparipūrṇaṃ ca tadbhakṣaiḥ pāpibhirvṛtam || 21 || vāpīturyapramāṇaṃ ca bruvadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ | majjāpūrṇaṃ narāṇāṃ ca mahādurgandhisaṃyutam || 22 || mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ vāpīturyapramāṇakam | paripūrṇaṃ sigdhamāṃsairmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ || 23 || pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ caiva vāpīmānaṃ bhayānakam | kanyāvikrayibhiścaiva tadbhakṣyaiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ || 24 || pāhīti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistrāsitaiśca bhayānakaiḥ | vāpīturyapramāṇaṃ ca nakhādikacatuṣṭayam || 25 || pāpibhiḥ saṃyutaṃ śaśvanmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | prataptatāmrakuṇḍaṃ ca tāmroparyulmukānvitam || 26 || tāmrāṇāṃ pratimālakṣaiḥ prataptairvyāpṛtaṃ sadā | pratyekaṃ pratimāśliṣṭaiḥ rudadbhiḥ pāpibhiryutam || 27 || gavyūtimānaṃ vistīrṇaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | prataptalohadhāraṃ ca jvavaladaṅgārasaṃyutam || 28 || lohānāṃ pratimāśliṣṭaiḥ rudadbhiḥ pāpibhiryutam | pratyekaṃ pratimāśliṣṭaiḥ śaśvatprajvalitairbhiyā || 29 || rakṣa rakṣeti śabdaṃ ca kurvadbhirdūtatāḍitaiḥ | mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam || 30 || bhayānakaṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ lohakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam | carmakuṇḍaṃ taptasurākuṇḍaṃ vāpyardhameva ca || 31 || tadbhojipāpibhirvyāptaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | ataḥ śālmalikuṇḍaṃ ca vṛkṣakaṇṭakaśobhitam || 32 || lakṣapauruṣamānaṃ ca krośamānaṃ ca duḥkhadam | dhanurmānaiḥ kaṇṭakaiśca sutīkṣṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitam || 33 || pratyekaṃ viddhagātraiśca mahāpātakibhiryutam | vṛkṣāgrānnipatadbhiśca mama dūtaiśca pātitaiḥ || 34 || jalaṃ dehīti śabdaṃ ca kurvadbhiḥ śuṣkatālukaiḥ | mahābhiyātivyagraiśca daṇḍaiḥ sambhagnamastakaiḥ || 35 || pracaladbhiryathā taptatailajīvibhireva ca | viṣodaistakṣakāṇāṃ ca pūrvaṃ ca krośamānakam || 36 || tadbhakṣaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍite | prataptatailapūrṇaṃ ca kīṭādiparivarjitam || 37 || mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ dagdhāṅgāraiśca veṣṭitam | kākuśabdaṃ prakurvadbhiścaladbhirdūtapīḍitaiḥ || 38 || dhvāntayuktaṃ krośamānaṃ kleśadaṃ ca bhayānakam | śūlākāraiḥ sutīkṣṇāgrairlohaśastraiśca veṣṭitam || 39 || śastratalpasvarūpañca kośaturyapramāṇakam | veṣṭitaṃ tatpātakibhiḥ kuntaviddhaiśca veṣṭitaiḥ || 40 || tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaiḥ | kīṭaiśca śaṅkupramitaiḥ sarpamānairbhayaṅkaraiḥ || 41 || tīkṣṇadantaiśca vikṛtairvyāptaṃ dhvāntayutaṃ sati | mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍite || 42 || dvigavyūtipramāṇaṃ ca pūyakuṇḍaṃ pracakṣate | tadbhakṣyaiḥ prāṇibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ || 43 || tālavṛkṣapramāṇaiśca sarpakoṭibhirāvṛtam | sarpaveṣṭitagātraiśca pāpibhiḥ sarpabhakṣitaiḥ || 44 || saṅkulaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | kuṇḍatrayaṃ maśādīnāṃ pūrṇaṃ ca maśakādibhiḥ || 45 || sarvaṃ kośārdhamānaṃ ca mahāpātakibhiryutam | hastapādādibaddhaiśca kṣatajaughena lohitaiḥ || 46 || hāheti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistāḍitairmama pārṣadaiḥ | vajravṛścikayoḥ kuṇḍaṃ tābhyāṃ ca paripūritam || 47 || vāpyardhaṃ pāpibhiryuktaṃ vajravṛścikadaṃśitaiḥ | kuṇḍatrayaṃ śarādīnāṃ taireva paripūritam || 48 || tairviddhaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ vāpyardhaṃ raktalohitaiḥ | taptatoyodakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sadhvāntaṃ golakuṇḍakam || 49 || kīṭaiḥ śaṅkusamānaiśca bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam | vāpyarthamānaṃ bhītaiśca pāpibhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ || 50 || rudadbhiḥ krośamānaiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | atidurgandhisaṃyuktaṃ duḥkhadaṃ pāpināṃ sadā || 51 || dāruṇairvikṛtākārairbhakṣitaṃ pāpibhiryutam | vāpyardhaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca jalasthairnakrakoṭibhiḥ || 52 || viṇmūtraśleṣmabhakṣaiśca saṃyutaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ | kākaiśca vikṛtākārairbhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam || 53 || manthānakuṇḍaṃ bījakuṇḍaṃ tābhyāṃ pūrṇaṃ dhanuḥśatam | bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam || 54 || dhanuḥśataṃ jīvayuktaṃ pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ sadā | śabdakṛdbhirvajradaṃṣṭraiḥ sāndradhvāntamayaṃ param || 55 || vāpīdviguṇamānaṃ ca taptaprastaranirmitam | jvaladaṅgārasadṛśaṃ caladbhiḥ pāpibhiryutam || 56 || kṣuradhāropamaistīkṣṇaiḥ pāṣāṇairnirmitaṃ param | mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ lālākuṇḍaṃ ca lohitaiḥ || 57 || krośamātraṃ ca gambhīraṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | taptāñjanācalākāraiḥ paripūrṇaṃ dhanuḥśatam || 58 || caladbhiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | pūrṇaṃ cūrṇadravaiḥ krośamānaṃ pāpibhiranvitam || 59 || tadbhojibhiḥ pradagdhaiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ | kuṇḍaṃ kulālacakraṃ ca ghūrṇamānañca santatam || 60 || sutīkṣṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ ca cūrṇitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam | atīva vakraṃ nimnaṃ ca dvigavyūtipramāṇakam || 61 || kandarākāranirmāṇaṃ taptodaiśca samanvitam | mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ bhakṣitairjalajantubhiḥ || 62 || jvaladbhiḥ śabdakṛdbhiśca dhvāntayuktaṃ bhayānakam | koṭibhirvikṛtākāraiḥ kacchapaiśca sudāruṇaiḥ || 63 || jalasthaiḥ saṃyutaṃ taiśca bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam | jvālākalāpaistejobhirnirmitaiḥ krośamānakam || 64 || śabdakṛdbhiḥ pātakibhiḥ saṃyutaṃ kleśadaṃ sadā | krośamānañca gambhīraṃ taptabhasmabhiranvitam || 65 || śaśvajjvaladbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ pāpibhirbhasmabhakṣitaiḥ | taptapāṣāṇalohānāṃ samūhaiḥ paripūritaiḥ || 66 || pāpibhirdagdhagātraiśca yuktañca śuṣkatālukaiḥ | krośamānaṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ gambhīramatidāruṇam || 67 || tāḍitaiśca pradagdhaiśca dagdhakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam | atīvormiyutaṃ toyaṃ prataptakṣārasaṃyutam || 68 || nānāprakārairvirutairjalajantubhiranvitam | dvigavyūtipramāṇaṃ ca gambhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyutam || 69 || tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ daṃśitairjalajantubhiḥ | jvaladbhiḥ śabdakṛdbhiśca na paśyadbhiḥ parasparam || 70 || prataptasūcīkuṇḍañca kīrtitaṃ ca bhayānakam | asīva dhārāpatrasyā'pyuccaistālataroradhaḥ || 71 || krośārdhamānaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ca patatpatrasamanvitam | pāpināṃ raktapūrṇaṃ ca vṛkṣāgrātpatatāṃ dhruvam | 72 paritrāhīti śabdaṃ ca kurvatāmasatāmapi | gambhīraṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ ca raktakīṭasamanvitam || 73 || tadasīpatrakuṇḍaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ ca bhayānakam | dhanuḥśatapramāṇaṃ ca kṣuradhārāstrasaṃyutam || 74 || pāpināṃ raktapūrṇaṃ ca kṣuradhāraṃ bhayānakam | sūcīmukhāstrasaṃyuktaṃ pāpiraktaughapūratam || 75 || pañcāśaddhanurāyāmaṃ kleśadaṃ sūcikāmukham | kasyacijjantubhedasya gokākhyasya mukhākṛti || 76 || kūparūpaṃ gabhīraṃ ca dhanurviṃśatpramāṇakam | mahāpātakināṃ caiva mahatkleśapradaṃ param || 77 || tatkīṭabhakṣitānāṃ ca namrāsyānāṃ ca santatam | kuṇḍaṃ nakramukhākāraṃ dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānakam || 78 || gambhīraṃ kūparūpaṃ ca pāpināṃ saṅkulaṃ sadā | dhanuḥśatapramāṇaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ gajadaṃśanam || 79 || dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ ca gomukhākṛti | pāpināṃ kleśadaṃ śaśvad gomukhaṃ parikīrtitam || 80 || kālacakreṇa saṃyuktaṃ bhramamāṇaṃ bhayānakam | kumbhākāraṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam || 81 || lakṣapauruṣamānaṃ ca gambhīraṃ vismṛtaṃ sati | kutracittaptatailaṃ ca tāmrādikuṇḍameva ca || 82 || pāpināṃ ca pradhānaiśca mūrcchitaiḥ kṛmibhiryutam | parasparaṃ ca naśyadbhiḥ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam || 83 || tāḍitairyamadūtaiśca musalairmudgaraistathā | ghūrṇamānaiḥ patadbhiśca mūrcchitaiśca kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam || 84 || pātitairyamadūtaiśca rudantyasmātkṣaṇaṃ punaḥ | yāvantaḥ pāpinaḥ santi sarvakuṇḍeṣu sundari || 85 || tataścaturguṇāḥ santi kumbhīpāke ca duḥkhade | suciraṃ vadhyamānāste bhogadehā na naśvarāḥ || 86 || sarvakuṇḍapradhānaṃ ca kumbhīpākaṃ prakīrtitam | kālanirmitasūtreṇa nibaddhā yatra pāpinaḥ || 87 || utthāpitāśca dūtaiśca kṣaṇameva nimajjitāḥ | niḥśvāsabaddhāḥ suciraṃ tathā mohaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ || 88 || atīva kleśasaṃyuktā dehabhogena sundari | prataptatoyayuktaṃ ca kālasūtraṃ prakīrtitam || 89 || avaṭaḥ kūpabhedaśca matsyodaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ | prataptatoyapūrṇaṃ ca caturviṃśatpramāṇakam || 90 || vyāptaṃ mahāpātakibhirvyādagdhāṅgaiśca santatam | maddūtaistāḍitaiḥ śaśvadavaṭodaṃ prakīrtitam || 91 || yatrodasparśamātreṇa sarvavyādhiśca pāpinām | bhavedakasmātpatatāṃ yasminkuṇḍe dhanuḥśate || 92 || aruntudairbhakṣitaistu prāṇibhiryacca saṅkulam | hāheti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistadevāruntudaṃ viduḥ || 93 || taptapāṃsubhirākīrṇaṃ jvaladbhistuṣadagdhakaiḥ | tadbhakṣaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ pāṃsubhojairdhanuḥśatam || 94 || pātamātreṇa pāpī ca pāśena veṣṭito bhavet | krośamātreṇa kuṇḍaṃ ca tatpāśaveṣṭanaṃ viduḥ || 95 || pātamātreṇa pāpī ca śūlena veṣṭito bhavet | dhanurviṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca śūlaprotaṃ prakīrtitam || 96 || patatāṃ pāpināṃ yatra bhavedeva prakampanam | atīva himatoyāktaṃ krośārdhaṃ ca prakampanam || 97 || dadatyeva hi me dūtā yatrolkāḥ pāpināṃ mukhe | dhanurviṃśatpramāṇaṃ tadulkābhiśca susaṅkulam || 98 || lakṣapauruṣamānaṃ ca gambhīraṃ ca dhanuḥśatam | nānāprakārakṛmibhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ ca bhayānakam || 99 || atyandhakāravyāptaṃ ca kūpākāraṃ ca vartulam | tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ praṇaśyadbhiḥ parasparam || 100 || taptatoyapradagdhaiśca jvaladbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ | dhvāntena cakṣuṣā cāndhairandhakūpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 101 || nānāprakāraśastraughairyatra viddhāśca pāpinaḥ | dhanurviṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca vedhanaṃ tatprakīrtitam || 102 || daṇḍena tāḍitā yatra mama dūtaiśca pāpinaḥ | dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānaṃ ca tatkuṇḍaṃ daṇḍatāḍanam || 103 || niruddhāśca mahājālairyathā mīnāśca pāpinaḥ | dhanurviṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca jālarandhraṃ prakīrtitam || 104 || patatāṃ pāpināṃ kuṇḍe dehaścūrṇo bhavediha | lohabandīnibaddhānāṃ koṭipauruṣamānakam || 105 || gambhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyuktaṃ dhanurviṃśatpramāṇakam | mūrcchitānāṃ jaḍānāṃ ca dehacūrṇaṃ prakīrtitam || 106 || dalitāḥ pāpino yatra mama dūtaiśca tāḍitāḥ | dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānaṃ ca tatkuṇḍaṃ dalanaṃ smṛtam || 107 || patanenaiva pāpī ca śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ | bālukāsu ca taptāsu dhanustriṃśatpramāṇakam || 108 || śatapauruṣamānaṃ ca gambhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyutam | śoṣaṇaṃ kuṇḍametaddhi pāpināṃ paraduḥkhadam || 109 || nānācarmakaṣāyodaparipūrṇaṃ dhanuḥśatam | durgandhiyuktatadbhakṣyaiḥ prāṇibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ kaṣam || 110 || śūrpākāramukhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhanurdvādaśamānakam | taptalohabālukābhiḥ pūrṇaṃ pātakisaṃyutam || 111 || durgandhiyuktaṃ tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ sati | śūrpākāramukhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhanurdvādaśamātrakam || 112 || prataptabālukāpūrṇaṃ mahāpātakibhiryutam | antaragniśikhānāṃ ca jvālāvyāptamukhaṃ sadā || 113 || dhanurviṃśatimātraṃ ca pramāṇaṃ yasya sundari | jvālābhirdagdhagātraiśca pāpibhirvyāptameva ca || 114 || tanmahākleśadaṃ śaśvatkuṇḍaṃ jvālāmukhaṃ smṛtam | pātamātrādyatra pāpī mūrcchito vai naro bhavet || 115 || tapteṣṭakābhyantaritaṃ vāpyardhaṃ jihmakuṇḍakam | dhūmāndhakārasaṃyuktaṃ dhūmrāndhaiḥ pāpibhiryutam || 116 || dhanuḥśataṃ śvāsarandhrairdhūmrāndhaṃ parikīrtitam | pātamātrādyatra pāpī nāgaiśca veṣṭito bhavet || 117 || dhanuḥśataṃ nāgapūrṇaṃ tannāgairveṣṭitaṃ bhavet | ṣaḍaśīti ca kuṇḍāni mayoktāni niśāmaya | lakṣaṇaṃ cāpi teṣāṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 118 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaptasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde nānānarakakuṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 || <9.38> sāvitryupākhyānavarṇanam sāvitryuvāca devībhaktiṃ dehi mahyaṃ sārāṇāṃ caiva sārakam | puṃsāṃ muktidvārabījaṃ narakārṇavatārakam || 1 || kāraṇaṃ muktisārāṇāṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam | dārakaṃ karmavṛkṣāṇāṃ kṛtapāpaughahāraṇam || 2 || muktiśca katithāpyasti kiṃ vā tāsāṃ ca lakṣaṇam | devībhaktiṃ bhaktibhedaṃ niṣekasyāpi khaṇḍanam || 3 || tattvajñānavihīnā ca strījātirvidhinirmitā | kiñciñjñānaṃ sārabhūtaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara || 4 || sarvaṃ dānaṃ ca yajñaśca tīrthasnānaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ | ajñānijñānadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 5 || pituḥ śataguṇā mātā gaurave ceti niścitam | mātuḥ śataguṇaḥ pūjyo jñānadātā guruḥ prabho || 6 || dharmarāja uvāca pūrvaṃ sarvo varo datto yaste manasi vāñchitaḥ | adhunā śaktibhaktiste vatse bhavatu madvarāt || 7 || śrotumicchasi kalyāṇi śrīdevīguṇakīrtanam| vaktṝṇāṃ pṛcchakānāṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ kulatāraṇam || 8 || śeṣo vaktrasahasreṇa nahi yadvaktumīśvaraḥ | mṛtyuñjayo na kṣamaśca vaktuṃ pañcamukhena ca || 9 || dhātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi | brahmā caturmukhenaiva nālaṃ viṣṇuśca sarvavit || 10 || kārtikeyaḥ ṣaṇmukhena nāpi vaktumalaṃ dhruvam | na gaṇeśaḥ samarthaśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ || 11 || sārabhūtāśca śāstrāṇāṃ vedāścatvāra eva ca | kalāmātraṃ yadguṇānāṃ na vidanti budhāśca ye || 12 || sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā nālaṃ tadguṇavarṇane | sanatkumāro dharmaśca sanandanaḥ sanātanaḥ || 13 || sanakaḥ kapilaḥ sūryo ye'nye ca brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ | vicakṣaṇā na yadvaktuṃ kiñcānye jaḍabuddhayaḥ || 14 || na yadvaktuṃ kṣamāḥ siddhā munīndrā yoginastathā | ke cānye ca vayaṃ ke vā śrīdevyā guṇavarṇane || 15 || dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ | atisādhyaṃ svabhaktānāṃ tadanyeṣāṃ sudurlabham || 16 || kaścitkiñcidvijānāti tadguṇotkīrtanaṃ śubham | atiriktaṃ vijānāti brahmā brahmaviśāradaḥ || 17 || tato'tiriktaṃ jānāti gaṇeśo jñānināṃ guruḥ | sarvātiriktaṃ jānāti sarvajñaḥ śambhureva saḥ || 18 || tasmai dattaṃ purā jñānaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā | atīva nirjane'raṇye goloke rāsamaṇḍale || 19 || tatraiva kathitaṃ kiñcittadguṇotkīrtanaṃ śubham | dharmaṃ ca kathayāmāsa śivaloke śivaḥ svayam || 20 || dharmastu kathayāmāsa bhāsvate pṛcchate tathā | yāmārādhya matpitāpi samprāpa tapasā sati || 21 || pūrvaṃ svaṃ viṣayaṃ cāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi prayatnataḥ | vairāgyayuktastapase gantumicchāmi suvrate || 22 || tadā māṃ kathayāmāsa pitā tadguṇakīrtanam | yathāgamaṃ tadvadāmi nibodhātīva durgamam || 23 || tadguṇaṃ sā na jānāti tadanyasya ca kā kathā | yathākāśo na jānāti svāntameva varānane || 24 || sarvātmā sarvabhagavān sarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ | sarveśvaraśca sarvādyaḥ sarvavitparipālakaḥ | 25 nityarūpī nityadehī nityānando nirākṛtiḥ | niraṅkuśo nirāśaṅko nirguṇaśca nirāmayaḥ || 26 || nirliptaḥ sarvasākṣī ca sarvādhāraḥ parātparaḥ | māyāviśiṣṭaḥ prakṛtistadvikārāśca prākṛtāḥ || 27 || svayaṃ pumāṃśca prakṛtistāvabhinnau parasparam | yathā vahnestasya śaktirna bhinnāstyeva kutracit || 28 || seyaṃ śaktirmahāmāyā saccidānandarūpiṇī | rūpaṃ bibhartyarūpā ca bhaktānugrahahetave || 29 || gopālasundarīrūpaṃ prathamaṃ sā sasarja ha | atīva kamanīyaṃ ca sundaraṃ sumanoharam || 30 || navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ gopaveṣakam | kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāmamanoharam || 31 || śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāmocanalocanam | śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduśobhāpracchādanānanam || 32 || amūlyaratnanirmāṇanānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam | sasmitaṃ śobhitaṃ śaśvadamūlyapītavāsasā || 33 || parabrahmasvarūpaṃ ca jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā | sukhadṛśyaṃ ca śāntaṃ ca rādhākāntamanantakam || 34 || gopībhirvīkṣyamāṇaṃ ca sasmitābhiśca santatam | rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam || 35 || vaṃśīṃ kvaṇantaṃ dvibhujaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam | kaustubhendramaṇīndreṇa śaśvadvakṣaḥsthalojjvalam || 36 || kuṅkumāgurukasturīcandanārcitavigraham | cārucampakamālāktaṃ mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam || 37 || cārucandrakaśobhāḍhyaṃ cūḍāvaṅkrimarājitam | evaṃbhūtaṃ ca dhyāyanti bhaktā bhaktipariplutāḥ || 38 || yadbhayājjagatā dhātā vidhatte sṛṣṭimeva ca | karmānusārāllikhitaṃ karoti sarvakarmaṇām || 39 || tapasāṃ phaladātā ca karmaṇāṃ ca yadājñayā | viṣṇuḥ pātā ca sarveṣāṃ yadbhayātpāti santatam || 40 || kālāgnirudraḥ saṃhartā sarvaviśveṣu yadbhayāt | śivo mṛtyuñjayaścaiva jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ || 41 || yajjñānājjñānavānasti yogīśo jñānavitprabhuḥ | paramānandayuktaśca bhaktivairāgyasaṃyutaḥ || 42 || yadbhayādvāti pavanaḥ pravaraḥ śīghragāminām | tapanaśca pratapati yadbhayātsantataṃ sati || 43 || yadājñayā varṣatīndro mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu | yadājñayā dahedvahnirjalamevaṃ suśītalam || 44 || diśo rakṣanti dikpālā mahābhītā yadājñayā | bhramanti rāśicakrāṇi grahāśca yadbhayena ca || 45 || bhayātphalanti vṛkṣāśca puṣyantyapi ca yadbhayāt | yadājñāṃ tu puraskṛtya kālaḥ kāle haredbhayāt || 46 || tathā jalasthalasthāśca na jīvanti yadājñayā | akāle nāharedviddhaṃ raṇeṣu viṣameṣu ca || 47 || dhatte vāyustoyarāśiṃ toyaṃ kūrmaṃ tadājñayā | kūrmo'nantaṃ sa ca kṣoṇīṃ samudrān sā ca parvatān || 48 || sarvā caiva kṣamārūpā nānāratnaṃ bibharti yā | yataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthīyante hanti tatra hi || 49 || indrāyuścaiva divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ | aṣṭāviṃśe śakrapāte brahmaṇaśca divāniśam || 50 || evaṃ triṃśaddinairmāso dvābhyāmābhyāmṛtuḥ smṛtaḥ | ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirevābdaṃ brahmaṇo vai vayaḥ smṛtam || 51 || brahmaṇaśca nipāte ca cakṣurunmīlanaṃ hareḥ | cakṣurunmīlane tasya layaṃ prākṛtikaṃ viduḥ || 52 || pralaye prākṛte sarve devādyāśca carācarāḥ | līnā dhātā vidhātā ca śrīkṛṣṇanābhipaṅkaje || 53 || viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyī ca vaikuṇṭhe yaścaturbhujaḥ | vilīnā vāmapārśve ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 54 || yasya jñāne śivo līno jñānādhīśaḥ sanātanaḥ | durgāyāṃ viṣṇumāyāyāṃ vilīnāḥ sarvaśaktayaḥ || 55 || sā ca kṛṣṇasya buddhau ca buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā | nārāyaṇāṃśaḥ skandaśca līno vakṣasi tasya ca || 56 || śrīkṛṣṇāṃśaśca tadbāhau devādhīśo gaṇeśvaraḥ | padmāṃśāścaiva padmāyāṃ sā rādhāyāṃ ca suvrate || 57 || gopyaścāpi ca tasyāṃ ca sarvāśca devayoṣitaḥ | kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī sā tasya prāṇeṣu saṃsthitā || 58 || sāvitrī ca sarasvatyāṃ vedāḥ śāstrāṇi yāni ca | sthitā vāṇī ca jihvāyāṃ yasya ca paramātmanaḥ || 59 || golokasya ca gopāśca vilīnāstasya lomasu | tatprāṇeṣu ca sarveṣāṃ prāṇā vātā hutāśanāḥ || 60 || jaṭharāgnau vilīnāśca jalaṃ tadrasanāgrataḥ | vaiṣṇavāścaraṇāmbhoje paramānandasaṃyutāḥ || 61 || sārātsāratarā bhaktirasapīyūṣapāyinaḥ | virāḍaṃśāśca mahati līnāḥ kṛṣṇe mahāvirāṭ || 62 || yasyaiva lomakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilāni ca | yasya cakṣuṣa unmeṣe prākṛtaḥ pralayo bhavet || 63 || cakṣurunmīlane sṛṣṭiryasyaiva punareva saḥ | yāvatkālo nimeṣeṇa tāvadunmīlanena ca || 64 || brahmaṇaśca śatābde ca sṛṣṭeḥ sūtralayaḥ punaḥ | brahmasṛṣṭilayānāṃ ca saṃkhyā nāstyeva suvrate || 65 || yathā bhūrajasāṃ caiva saṃkhyānaṃ naiva vidyate | cakṣurnimeṣe pralayo yasya sarvāntarātmanaḥ || 66 || unmīlane punaḥ sṛṣṭirbhavedeveśvarecchayā | sa kṛṣṇaḥ pralaye tasyāṃ prakṛtau līna eva hi || 67 || ekaiva ca parā śaktirnirguṇaḥ paramaḥ pumān | sadevedamagra āsīditi vedavido viduḥ || 68 || mūlaprakṛtiravyaktāpyavyākṛtapadābhidhā | cidabhinnatvamāpannā pralaye saiva tiṣṭhati || 69 || tadguṇotkīrtanaṃ vaktuṃ brahmāṇḍeṣu ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ | muktayaśca caturvedairniruktāśca caturvidhāḥ || 70 || tatpradhānā devabhaktirmukterapi garīyasī | sālokyadā bhavedekā tathā sārūpyadā parā || 71 || sāmīpyadātha nirvāṇapradā muktiścaturvidhā | bhaktāstā na hi vāñchanti vinā tatsevanaṃ vibhoḥ || 72 || śivatvamamaratvaṃ ca brahmatvaṃ cāvahelayā | janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaśokādikaṃ dhanam || 73 || divyarūpadhāraṇaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ viduḥ | muktiśca sevārahitā bhaktiḥ sevāvivardhinī || 74 || bhaktimuktyorayaṃ bhedo niṣekakhaṇḍanaṃ śṛṇu | vidurbudhā niṣekaṃ ca bhogaṃ ca kṛtakarmaṇām || 75 || tatkhaṇḍanaṃ ca śubhadaṃ śrīvibhoḥ sevanaṃ param | tattvajñānamidaṃ sādhvi sthiraṃ ca lokavedayoḥ || 76 || nirvighnaṃ śubhadaṃ coktaṃ gaccha vatse yathāsukham | ityuktvā sūryaputraśca jīvayitvā ca tatpatim || 77 || tasyai śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā gamanaṃ kartumudyataḥ | dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ ca gacchantaṃ sā sāvitrī praṇamya ca || 78 || ruroda caraṇau dhṛtvā sādhucchedena duḥkhitā | sāvitrīrodanaṃ śrutvā yamaścaiva kṛpānidhiḥ || 79 || tāmityuvāca santuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ caiva ruroda ha | dharmarāja uvāva lakṣavarṣaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate || 80 || ante yāsyasi tallokaṃ yatra devī virājate | gatvā ca svagṛhaṃ bhadre sāvitryāśca vrataṃ kuru || 81 || dvisaptavarṣaparyantaṃ nārīṇāṃ mokṣakāraṇam | jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitryāśca vrataṃ śubham || 82 || śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade mahālakṣyā yathā vratam | dvyaṣṭavarṣaṃ vrataṃ caiva pratyādeyaṃ śucismite || 83 || karoti bhaktyā yā nārī sā yāti ca vibhoḥ padam | pratimaṅgalavāre ca devīṃ maṅgaladāyinīm || 84 || pratimāsaṃ śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ maṅgaladāyinīm | tathā cāṣāḍhasaṅkrāntyāṃ manasāṃ sarvasiddhidām || 85 || rādhāṃ rāse ca kārtikyāṃ kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikapriyām | upoṣya śuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca pratimāsaṃ varapradām || 86 || viṣṇumāyāṃ bhagavatīṃ durgāṃ durgatināśinīm | prakṛtiṃ jagadambāṃ ca patiputravatīṣu ca || 87 || pativratāsu śuddhāsu yantreṣu pratimāsu ca | yā nārī pūjayedbhaktyā dhanasantānahetave || 88 || ihaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante śrīvibhoḥ padam | evaṃ devyā vibhūtīśca pūjayetsādhako'niśam || 89 || sarvakālaṃ sarvarūpā saṃsevyā parameśvarī | nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcitkṛtakṛtyatvadāyakam || 90 || ityuktvā tāṃ dharmarājo jagāma nijamandiram | gṛhītvā svāminaṃ sā ca sāvitrī ca nijālayam || 91 || sāvitrī satyavāṃścaiva prayayau ca yathāgamam | anyāṃśca kathayāmāsa svavṛttāntaṃ hi nārada || 92 || sāvitrījanakaḥ putrān samprāptaḥ prakrameṇa ca | śvaśuraścakṣuṣī rājyaṃ sā ca putrān vareṇa ca || 93 || lakṣavarṣaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate | jagāma svāminā sārdhaṃ devīlokaṃ pativratā || 94 || savituścādhidevī yā mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā | sāvitrī hyapi vedānāṃ sāvitrī tena kīrtitā || 95 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa sāvitryākhyānamuttamam | jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi || 96 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatrilo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 || <9.39> lakṣmyupākhyānavarṇanam nārada uvāca śrīmūlaprakṛterdevyā gāyatryāstu nirākṛteḥ | sāvitrīyamasaṃvāde śrutaṃ vai nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ || 1 || tadguṇotkīrtanaṃ satyaṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam | adhunā śrotumicchāmi lakṣmyupākhyānamīśvara || 2 || kenādau pūjitā sāpi kiṃbhūtā kena vā purā | tadguṇotkīrtanaṃ mahyaṃ vada vedavidāṃvara || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sṛṣṭerādau purā brahman kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | devī vāmāṃsasambhūtā babhūva rāsamaṇḍale || 4 || atīva sundarī śyāmā nyagrodhaparimaṇḍitā | yathā dvādaśavarṣīyā śaśvatsusthirayauvanā || 5 || śvetacampakavarṇābhā sukhadṛśyā manoharā | śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduprabhāpracchādanānanā || 6 || śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāmocanalocanā | sā devī dvividhā bhūtā saha sarveśvarecchayā || 7 || svīyarūpeṇa varṇena tejasā vayasā tviṣā | yaśasā vāsasā kṛtyā bhūṣaṇena guṇena ca || 8 || smitena vīkṣaṇenaiva premṇā vānunayena ca | tadvāmāṃsānmahālakṣmīrdakṣiṇāsāṃcca rādhikā || 9 || rādhā''dau varayāmāsa dvibhujañca parātparam | mahālakṣmīśca tatpaścāccakame kamanīyakam || 10 || kṛṣṇastadgauraveṇaiva dvidhārūpo babhūva ha | dakṣiṇāṃsaśca dvibhujo vāmāṃsaśca caturbhujaḥ || 11 || caturbhujāya dvibhujo mahālakṣmīṃ dadau purā | lakṣyate dṛśyate viśvaṃ snigdhadṛṣṭyā yayāniśam || 12 || devībhūtā ca mahatī mahālakṣmīśca sā smṛtā | rādhākāntaśca dvibhujo lakṣmīkāntaścaturbhujaḥ || 13 || śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca gopairgopībhirāvṛtā | caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau padmayā saha || 14 || sarvāṃśena samau tau dvau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇau parau | mahālakṣmīśca yogena nānārūpā babhūva sā || 15 || vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīḥ paripūrṇatamā ramā | śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca sarvasaubhāgyasaṃyutā || 16 || premṇā sā ca pradhānā ca sarvāsu ramaṇīṣu ca | svargeṣu svargalakṣmīśca śakrasampatsvarūpiṇī || 17 || pātāle nāgalakṣmīśca rājalakṣmīśca rājasu | gṛhalakṣmīrgṛheṣveva gṛhiṇāṃ ca kalāṃśataḥ || 18 || sampatsvarūpā gṛhiṇāṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalā | gavāṃ prasūtiḥ surabhirdakṣiṇā yajñakāminī || 19 || kṣīrodasindhukanyā sā śrīrūpā padminīṣu ca | śobhāsvarūpā candre ca sūryamaṇḍalamaṇḍitā || 20 || vibhūṣaṇeṣu ratneṣu phaleṣu ca jaleṣu ca | nṛpeṣu nṛpapatnīṣu divyastrīṣu gṛheṣu ca || 21 || sarvasasyeṣu vastreṣu sthāneṣu saṃskṛteṣu ca | pratimāsu ca devānāṃ maṅgaleṣu ghaṭeṣu ca || 22 || māṇikyeṣu ca muktāsu mālyeṣu ca manoharā | maṇīndreṣu ca hīreṣu kṣīreṣu candaneṣu ca || 23 || vṛkṣaśākhāsu ramyāsu navamegheṣu vastuṣu | vaikuṇṭhe pūjitā sā''dau devī nārāyaṇena ca || 24 || dvitīye brahmaṇā bhaktyā tṛtīye śaṅkareṇa ca | viṣṇunā pūjitā sā ca kṣīrode bhārate mune || 25 || svāyambhuvena manunā mānavendreśca sarvataḥ | ṛṣīndraiśca munīndraiśca sadbhiśca gṛhibhirbhave || 26 || gandharvaiścaiva nāgādyaiḥ pātāleṣu ca pūjitā | śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade kṛtā pūjā ca brahmaṇā || 27 || bhaktyā ca pakṣaparyantaṃ triṣu lokeṣu nārada | caitre pauṣe ca bhādre ca puṇye maṅgalavāsare || 28 || viṣṇunā pūjitā sā ca triṣu lokeṣu bhaktitaḥ | varṣānte pauṣasaṅkrāntyāṃ mādhyāmāvāhya maṅgale || 29 || manustāṃ pūjayāmāsa sā bhūtā bhuvanatraye | pūjitā sā mahendreṇa maṅgalenaiva maṅgalā || 30 || kedāreṇaiva nīlena subalena nalena ca | dhruveṇottānapādena śakreṇa balinā tathā || 31 || kaśyapena ca dakṣeṇa kardamena vivasvatā | priyavratena candreṇa kubereṇaiva vāyunā || 32 || yamena vahninā caiva varuṇenaiva pūjitā | evaṃ sarvatra sarveṣu pūjitā vanditā sadā | sarveśvaryādhidevī sā sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī || 33 || ti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe lakṣmyupākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 || <9.40> lakṣmyutpattivarṇanam nārada uvāca nārāyaṇapriyā sā ca parā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī | vaikuṇṭhādhiṣṭhātṛdevī mahālakṣmīḥ sanātanī || 1 || kathaṃ babhūva sā devī pṛthivyāṃ sindhukanyakā | purā kena stutā''dau sā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 2 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca purā durvāsasaḥ śāpād bhraṣṭaśrīśca purandaraḥ | babhūva devasaṅghaśca martyaloke hi nārada || 3 || lakṣmīḥ svargādikaṃ tyaktvā ruṣṭā paramaduḥkhitā | gatvā līnā tu vaikuṇṭhe mahālakṣmīśca nārada || 4 || tadā śokādyayuḥ sarve duḥkhitā brahmaṇaḥ sabhām | brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya yayurvaikuṇṭhameva ca || 5 || vaikuṇṭhe śaraṇāpannā devā nārāyaṇe pare | atīva dainyayuktāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukāḥ || 6 || tadā lakṣmīśca kalayā purāṇapuruṣājñayā | babhūva sindhukanyā sā sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī || 7 || tathā mathitvā kṣīrodaṃ devā daityagaṇaiḥ saha | samprāptāśca mahālakṣmīṃ viṣṇustāṃ ca dadarśa ha || 8 || surādibhyo varaṃ dattvā vanamālāṃ ca viṣṇave | dadau prasannavadanā tuṣṭā kṣīrodaśāyine || 9 || devāścāpyasuragrastaṃ rājyaṃ prāpuśca nārada | tāṃ sampūjya ca sambhūya sarvatra ca nirāpadaḥ || 10 || nārada uvāca kathaṃ śaśāpa durvāsā muniśreṣṭhaḥ kadācana | kena doṣeṇa vā brahman brahmiṣṭhastattvavitpurā || 11 || mamanthuḥ kenarūpeṇa jaladhiṃ te surādayaḥ | kena stotreṇa vā devī śakraṃ sākṣādbabhūva sā || 12 || ko vā tayośca saṃvādo babhūva tadvada prabho | śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca madhupānapramattaśca trailokyādhipatiḥ purā || 13 || krīḍāṃ cakāra rahasi rambhayā saha kāmukaḥ | kṛtvā krīḍāṃ tayā sārdhaṃ kāmukyā hṛtamānasaḥ || 14 || tasthau tatra mahāraṇye kāmonmathitamānasaḥ | kailāsaśikhare yāntaṃ vaikuṇṭhādṛṣisattamam || 15 || durvāsasaṃ dadarśendro jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā | grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍasahasraprabhamīśvaram || 16 || prataptakāñcanākāraṃ jaṭābhāramahojjvalam | śuklayajñopavītaṃ ca cīradaṇḍau kamaṇḍalum || 17 || mahojjvalaṃ ca tilakaṃ bibhrantaṃ cendusannibham | samanvitaṃ śiṣyalakṣairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ || 18 || dṛṣṭvā nanāma śirasā sampramattaḥ purandaraḥ | śiṣyavargaṃ tadā bhaktyā tuṣṭāva ca mudānvitam || 19 || muninā ca saśiṣyeṇa dattāstasmai śubhāśiṣaḥ | viṣṇudattaṃ pārijātapuṣpaṃ ca sumanoharam || 20 || tajjarārogamṛtyughnaṃ śokajaṃ mokṣakārakam | śakraḥ puṣpaṃ gahītvā ca pramatto rājyasampadā || 21 || puṣpaṃ sa nyastayāmāsa tadaiva karimastake | hastī tatsparśamātreṇa rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca || 22 || tejasā vayasākasmādviṣṇutulyo babhūva ha | tyaktvā śakraṃ gajendraśca jagāma ghorakānanam || 23 || na śaśāka mahendrastaṃ rakṣituṃ tejasā mune | tatpuṇyaṃ tyaktavantaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ munīśvaraḥ || 24 || tamuvāca mahāruṣṭaḥ śaśāpa ca ruṣānvitaḥ | muniruvāca are śriyā pramattastvaṃ kathaṃ māmavamanyase || 25 || maddattapuṣpaṃ dattaṃ ca garveṇa karimastake | viṣṇorniveditaṃ caiva naivedyaṃ vā phalaṃ jalam || 26 || prāptimātreṇa bhoktavyaṃ tyāgena brahmahā bhavet | bhraṣṭaśrīrbhraṣṭabuddhiśca purabhraṣṭo bhavettu saḥ || 27 || yastyajedviṣṇunaivedyaṃ bhāgyenopasthitaṃ śubham | prāptimātreṇa yo bhuṅkte bhakto viṣṇuniveditam || 28 || puṃsāṃ śataṃ samuddhṛtya jīvanmuktaḥ svayaṃ bhavet | naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ kṛtvā nityaṃ yaḥ praṇameddharim || 29 || pūjayetstauti vā bhaktyā sa viṣṇusadṛśo bhavet | tatsparśavāyunā sadyastīrthaughaśca viśudhyati || 30 || tatpādarajasā mūḍha sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā | puṃścalyannamavīrānnaṃ śūdraśrāddhāntameva ca || 31 || yaddhareranivedyaṃ ca vṛthā māṃsasya bhakṣaṇam | śivaliṅgapradānaṃ ca yaddattaṃ śūdrayājinā || 32 || cikitsakadvijānnaṃ ca devalānnaṃ tathaiva ca | kanyāvikrayiṇāmannaṃ yadannaṃ yonijīvinām || 33 || ucchiṣṭānnaṃ paryuṣitaṃ sarvabhakṣāvaśeṣitam | śūdrāpatidvijānāṃ ca bhūṣavāhadvijānnakam || 34 || adīkṣitadvijānāṃ ca yadannaṃ śavadāhinām | agamyāgāmināṃ caiva dvijānāmannameva ca || 35 || mitradruhāṃ kṛtajjānāmannaṃ viśvāsaghātinām | mithyāsākṣyapradānnaṃ ca brāhmaṇānnaṃ tathaiva ca || 36 || ete sarve viśudhyanti viṣṇonaivedyabhakṣaṇāt | śvapacaścedviṣṇusevī vaṃśānāṃ koṭimuddharet || 37 || harerabhakto manujaḥ svaṃ ca rakṣitumakṣamaḥ | ajñānādyadi gṛhṇāti viṣṇornirmālyameva ca || 38 || saptajanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | jñātvā bhaktyā ca gṛhṇāti viṣṇonaivedyameva ca || 39 || koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate niścitaṃ hare | yasmātsaṃsthāpitaṃ puṣpaṃ garveṇa karimastake || 40 || tasmādyuṣmānparityajya yātu lakṣmīrhareḥ padam | nārāyaṇasya bhakto'haṃ na bibhemi surādvidheḥ || 41 || kālānmṛtyorjarātaśca kānanyān gaṇayāmi ca | kiṃ kariṣyati te tātaḥ kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ || 42 || bṛhaspatirguruścaiva niḥśaṅkasya ca me hare | idaṃ puṣpaṃ yasya mūrdhni tasyaiva pūjanaṃ param || 43 || iti śrutvā mahendraśca dhṛtvā sa caraṇaṃ muneḥ | uccai ruroda śokārtastamuvāca bhayākulaḥ || 44 || mahendra uvāca dattaḥ samucitaḥ śāpo mahyaṃ māyāpahaḥ prabho | hṛtāṃ na yāce sampattiṃ kiñcijjñānaṃ ca dehi me || 45 || aiśvaryaṃ vipadāṃ bījaṃ jñānapracchannakāraṇam | muktimārgakuṭhāraśca bhakteśca vyavadhāyakam || 46 || muniruvāca janmamṛtyujarāśokarogabījāṅkuraṃ param | sampattitimirāndhaśca muktimārgaṃ na paśyati || 47 || sampanmatto vimūḍhaśca surāmattaḥ sa eva ca | bāndhavairveṣṭitaḥ so'pi bandhutvenaiva he hare || 48 || sampattimadamattaśca viṣayāndhaśca vihvalaḥ | mahākāmī rājasikaḥ sattvamārgaṃ na paśyati || 49 || dvividho viṣayāndhaśca rājasastāmasaḥ smṛtaḥ | aśāstrajñastāmasaśca śāstrajño rājasaḥ smṛtaḥ || 50 || śāstraṃ ca dvividhaṃ mārgaṃ darśayetsurapuṅgava | pravṛttibījamekaṃ ca nivṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ param || 51 || caranti jīvinaścādau pravṛtterduḥkhavartmani | svacchandaṃ ca prasannaṃ ca nirvirodhaṃ ca santatam || 52 || āyāti madhuno lobhātkleśena sukhamānitaḥ | pariṇāme nāśabīje janmamṛtyujarākare || 53 || anekajanmaparyantaṃ kṛtvā ca bhramaṇaṃ mudā | svakarmavihitāyāṃ ca nānāyonyāṃ krameṇa ca || 54 || tataśceśānugahāgracca satsaṅgaṃ labhate ca saḥ | sahasreṣu śateṣveko bhavābdhipārakāraṇam || 55 || sādhustattvapradīpena muktimārgaṃ pradarśayet | tadā karoti yatnaṃ ca jīvo bandhanakhaṇḍane || 56 || anekajanmayogena tapasānaśanena ca | tadā labhenmuktimārgaṃ nirvighnaṃ sukhadaṃ param || 57 || idaṃ śrutaṃ gurorvakyādyat pṛcchasi purandara | munestadvacanaṃ śrutvā vītarāgo babhūva saḥ || 58 || vairāgyaṃ vardhayāmāsa tasya brahman dine dine | muneḥ sthānād gṛhaṃ gatvā sa dadarśāmarāvatīm || 59 || daityairasurasaṅghaiśca samākīrṇāṃ bhayākulām | viṣamopaplavāṃ putrabandhuhīnāṃ ca kutracit || 60 || pitṛmātṛkalatrādivihīnāmaticañcalām | śatrugrastāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāma vākpatiṃ prati || 61 || śakro mandākinītīre dadarśa gurumīśvaram | dhyāyamānaṃ paraṃ brahma gaṅgātoye sthitaṃ param || 62 || sūryābhisammukhaṃ pūrvamukhaṃ ca viśvatomukham | sāśrunetraṃ pulakinaṃ paramānandasaṃyutam || 63 || variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca dharmiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhasevitam | preṣṭhaṃ ca bandhuvargāṇāmatiśreṣṭhaṃ ca jñāninām || 64 || jyeṣṭhaṃ ca bhrātṛvargāṇāmaniṣṭaṃ suravairiṇām | dṛṣṭvā guruṃ japantaṃ ca tatra tasthau sureśvaraḥ || 65 || praharānte guruṃ dṛṣṭvā cotthitaṃ praṇanāma saḥ | praṇamya caraṇāmbhoje rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ || 66 || vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa brahmaśāpādikaṃ tathā | punarvaropalabdhiṃ ca jñānaprāptiṃ sudurlabhām || 67 || vairigrastāṃ ca svapurīṃ krameṇaiva sureśvaraḥ | śiṣyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā subuddhirvadatāṃ varaḥ || 68 || bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ | gururuvāca śrutaṃ sarvaṃ suraśreṣṭha mā rodīrvacanaṃ śṛṇu || 69 || na kātaro hi nītijño vipattau ca kadācana | sampattirvā vipattirvā naśvarā śramarūpiṇī || 70 || pūrvasya karmāyattā ca svayaṃ kartā tayorapi | sarveṣāṃ ca bhavatyeva śaśvajjanmani janmani || 71 || cakranemikrameṇaiva tatra kā paridevanā | uktaṃ hi svakṛtaṃ karma bhujyate'khilabhārate || 72 || śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkiñcitsvakarmaphalabhuk pumān | nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 73 || avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham | ityevamuktaṃ vede ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā || 74 || sāmavedoktaśākhāyāṃ sambodhya kamalodbhavam | janmabhogāvaśeṣe ca sarveṣāṃ kṛtakarmaṇām || 75 || anurūpaṃ hi teṣāṃ ca bhārate'nyatra caiva hi | karmaṇā brahmaśāpaṃ ca karmaṇā ca śubhāśiṣam || 76 || karmaṇā ca mahālakṣmīṃ labheddainyaṃ ca karmaṇā | koṭijanmārjitaṃ karma jīvināmanugacchati || 77 || na hi tyajedvinā bhogaṃ tacchāyeva purandara | kālabhede deśabhede pātrabhede ca karmaṇām || 78 || nyūnatādhikabhāvo'pi bhavedeva hi karmaṇā | vastudānena vastūnāṃ samaṃ puṇyaṃ dine dine || 79 || dinabhede koṭiguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā tato'dhikam | same deśe ca vastūnāṃ dāne puṇyaṃ samaṃ sura || 80 || deśabhede koṭiguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā tato'dhikam | same pātre samaṃ puṇyaṃ vastūnāṃ kartureva ca || 81 || pātrabhede śataguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā tato'dhikam | yathā phalanti sasyāni nyūnānyapyadhikāni ca || 82 || karṣakāṇāṃ kṣetrabhede pātrabhede phalaṃ tathā | sāmānyadivase vipradānaṃ samaphalaṃ bhavet || 83 || amāyāṃ ravisaṃkrāntyāṃ phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet | cāturmāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmanantaṃ phalameva ca || 84 || grahaṇe śaśinaḥ koṭiguṇaṃ ca phalameva ca | sūryasya grahaṇe vāpi tato daśaguṇaṃ bhavet || 85 || akṣayāyāmakṣayaṃ tadasaṃkhyaṃ phalamucyate | evamanyatra puṇyāhe phalādhikyaṃ bhavediti || 86 || yathā dāne tathā snāne jape'nyapuṇyakarmasu | evaṃ sarvatra boddhavyaṃ narāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam || 87 || yathā daṇḍena cakreṇa śarāveṇa bhrameṇa ca | kumbhaṃ nirmāti nirmātā kumbhakāro mṛdā bhuvi || 88 || tathaiva karmasūtreṇa phalaṃ dhātā dadāti ca | yasyājñayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ taṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ bhaja || 89 || sa vidhātā vidhātuśca pātuḥ pātā jagattraye | sraṣṭuḥ sraṣṭā ca saṃhartuḥ saṃhartā kālakālakaḥ || 90 || mahāvipattau saṃsāre yaḥ smarenmadhusūdanam | vipattau tasya sampattirbhavedityāha śaṅkaraḥ || 91 || ityevamuktvā tattvajñaḥ samāliṅgya sureśvaram | dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ ceṣṭaṃ bodhayāmāsa nārada || 92 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe lakṣmyutpattivarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 || <9.41> śrīlakṣmyupākhyānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca hariṃ dhyātvā harirbrahman jagāma brahmaṇaḥ sabhām | bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha || 1 || śīghraṃ gatvā brahmalokaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca kamalodbhavam | praṇemurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ sahendrā guruṇā saha || 2 || vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa surācāryo vidhiṃ prati | prahasyovāca tacchrutvā mahendraṃ kamalāsanaḥ || 3 || brahmovāca vatsa madvaṃśajāto'si prapautro me vicakṣaṇaḥ | bṛhaspateśca śiṣyastvaṃ surāṇāmadhipaḥ svayam || 4 || mātāmahaśca dakṣaste viṣṇubhaktaḥ pratāpavān | kulatrayaṃ yasya śuddhaṃ kathaṃ so'haṅkṛto bhavet || 5 || mātā pativratā yasya pitā śuddho jitendriyaḥ | mātāmaho mātulaśca kathaṃ so'haṅkṛto bhavet || 6 || janaḥ paitṛkadoṣeṇa doṣānmātāmahasya ca | gurudoṣāttribhirdoṣairharidoṣī bhaved dhruvam || 7 || sarvāntarātmā bhagavān sarvadeheṣvavasthitaḥ | yasya dehātsa prayāti sa śavastatkṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 8 || mano'hamindriyeśaṃ ca jñānarūpo hi śaṅkaraḥ | viṣṇuprāṇā ca prakṛtirbuddhirbhagavatī satī || 9 || nidrādayaḥ śaktayaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ | ātmanaḥ pratibimbaśca jīvo bhogaśarīrabhṛt || 10 || ātmanīśe gate dehātsarve yānti sasambhramāḥ | yathā vartmani gacchantaṃ naradevamivānugāḥ || 11 || ahaṃ śivaśca śeṣaśca viṣṇurdharmo mahāvirāṭ | yūyaṃ yadaṃśā bhaktāśca tatpuṣpaṃ nyakkṛtaṃ tvayā || 12 || śivena pūjitaṃ pādapadmaṃ puṣpeṇa yena ca | tatra durvāsasā dattaṃ daivena nyakkṛtaṃ tvayā || 13 || tatpuṇyaṃ mastake yasya kṛṣṇapādābjapracyutam | sarveṣāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca tatpūjāpurato bhavet || 14 || daivena vañcitastvaṃ hi daivaṃ ca balavattaram | bhāgyahīnaṃ janaṃ mūḍhaṃ ko vā rakṣitumīśvaraḥ || 15 || sā śrīrgatādhunā kopātkṛṣṇanirmālyavarjanāt | adhunā gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ mayā ca guruṇā saha || 16 || niṣevya tatra śrīnāthaṃ śriyaṃ prāpsyati madvarāt | evamuktvā ca sa brahmā sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha || 17 || tatra gatvā parabrahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam | dṛṣṭvā tejaḥsvarūpaṃ taṃ prajvalantaṃ svatejasā || 18 || grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaśatakoṭisamaprabham | śāntamanādimadhyāntaṃ lakṣyīkāntamanantakam || 19 || caturbhujaiḥ pārṣadaiśca sarasvatyā yutaṃ prabhum | bhaktyā caturbhirvedaiśca gaṅgayā pariveṣṭitam || 20 || taṃ praṇemuḥ surāḥ sarve mūrdhnā brahmapurogamāḥ | bhaktinamrāḥ sāśrunetrāstuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram || 21 || vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa svayaṃ brahmā kṛtāñjaliḥ | rurudurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ svādhikārāccutāśca tāḥ || 22 || sa dadarśa suragaṇaṃ vipadgrastaṃ bhayākulam | ratnabhūṣaṇaśūnyaṃ ca vāhanādivivarjitam || 23 || śobhāśūnyaṃ hataśrīkaṃ niṣprabhaṃ sabhayaṃ param | uvāca kātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayabhītivibhañjanaḥ || 24 || śrībhagavānuvāca mā bhairbrahman he surāśca bhayaṃ kiṃ vo mayi sthite | dāsyāmi lakṣmīmacalāṃ paramaiśvaryavardhinīm || 25 || kiñca madvacanaṃ kiñcicchrūyatāṃ samayocitam | hitaṃ satyaṃ sārabhūtaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham || 26 || janāścāsaṃkhyaviśvasthā madadhīnāśca santatam | yathā tathāhaṃ madbhaktaparādhīno'svatantrakaḥ || 27 || yaṃ yaṃ ruṣṭo hi madbhakto matparo hi niraṅkuśaḥ | tadgṛhe'haṃ na tiṣṭhāmi padmayā saha niścitam || 28 || durvāsāḥ śaṅkarāṃśaśca vaiṣṇavo matparāyaṇaḥ | tacchāpādāgato'haṃ ca salakṣmīko hi vo gṛhāt || 29 || yatra śaṅkhadhvanirnāsti tulasī na śivārcanam | na bhojanaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ na padmā tatra tiṣṭhati || 30 || madbhaktānāṃ ca me nindā yatra brahman bhavetsurāḥ | mahāruṣṭā mahālakṣmīstato yāti parābhavam || 31 || madbhaktihīno yo mūḍho bhuṅkte yo harivāsare | mama janmadine vāpi yāti śrīstadgṛhādapi || 32 || mannāmavikrayī yaśca vikrīṇāti svakanyakām | yatrātithirna bhuṅkte ca matpriyā yāti tadgṛhāt || 33 || yo vipraḥ puṃścalīputro mahāpāpī ca tatpatiḥ | pāpino yo gṛhaṃ yāti śūdraśrāddhānnabhojakaḥ || 34 || mahāruṣṭā tato yāti mandirātkamalālayā | śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca bhāgyahīno dvijādhamaḥ || 35 || yāti ruṣṭā tadgṛhācca devāḥ kamalavāsinī | śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārī yo brāhmaṇo vṛṣavāhakaḥ || 36 || tattoyapānabhītā ca kamalā yāti tadgṛhāt | aśuddhahṛdayaḥ krūro hiṃsako nindako dvijaḥ || 37 || brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrayājī ca yāti devī ca tadgṛhāt | avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte tasmādyāti jagatprasūḥ || 38 || tṛṇaṃ chinatti nakharaistairvā yo vilikhenmahīm | nirāśo brāhmaṇo yatra tadgṛhādyāti matpriyā || 39 || sūryodaye dvijo bhuṅkte divāsvāpī ca brāhmaṇaḥ | divā maithunakārī ca yastasmādyāti matpriyā || 40 || ācārahīno vipro yo yaśca śūdrapratigrahī | adīkṣito hi yo mūḍhastasmādvai yāti matpriyā || 41 || snigdhapādaśca nagno hi yaḥ śete jñānadurbalaḥ | śaśvadvadati vācālo yāti sā tadgṛhātsatī || 42 || śirasnātastu tailena yo'nyāṅgaṃ samupaspṛśet | svāṅgaṃ ca vādayedvādyaṃ ruṣṭā sā yāti tadgṛhāt || 43 || vratopavāsahīno yaḥ sandhyāhīno'śucirdvijaḥ | viṣṇubhaktivihīnastu tasmādyāti ca matpriyā || 44 || brāhmaṇaṃ nindayedyo hi taṃ ca yo dveṣṭi santatam | jīvahiṃsro dayāhīno yāti sarvaprasūstataḥ || 45 || yatra yatra harerarcā harerutkīrtanaṃ tathā | tatra tiṣṭhati sā devī sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalā || 46 || yatra praśaṃsā kṛṣṇasya tadbhaktasya pitāmaha | sā ca kṛṣṇapriyā devī tatra tiṣṭhati santatam || 47 || yatra śaṅkhadhvaniḥ śaṅkhaḥ śilā ca tulasīdalam | tatsevā vandanaṃ dhyānaṃ tatra sā paritiṣṭhati || 48 || śivaliṅgārcanaṃ yatra tasya cotkīrtanaṃ śubham | durgārcanaṃ tadguṇāśca tatra padmanivāsinī || 49 || viprāṇāṃ sevanaṃ yatra teṣāṃ ca bhojanaṃ śubham | arcanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tatra padmamukhī satī || 50 || ityuktvā ca surānsarvān ramāmāha ramāpatiḥ | kṣīrodasāgare janma kalayākalayeti ca || 51 || ityuktvā tāṃ jagannātho brahmāṇaṃ punarāha ca | mathitvā sāgaraṃ lakṣmīṃ devebhyo dehi padmaja || 52 || ityuktvā kamalākānto jagāmāntaḥpuraṃ mune | devāścireṇa kālena yayuḥ kṣīrodasāgaram || 53 || manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā kūrmaṃ kṛtvā ca bhājanam | kṛtvā śeṣaṃ manthapāśaṃ mamanthurasurāḥ surāḥ || 54 || dhanvantariṃ ca pīyūṣamuccaiḥśravasamīpsitam | nānāratnaṃ hastiratnaṃ prāpurlakṣmīṃ sudarśanam || 55 || vanamālāṃ dadau sā ca kṣīrodaśāyine mune | sarveśvarāya ramyāya viṣṇave vaiṣṇavī satī || 56 || devaiḥ stutā pūjitā ca brahmaṇā śaṅkareṇa ca | dadau dṛṣṭiṃ suragṛhe brahmaśāpavimocanāt || 57 || prāpurdevāḥ svaviṣayaṃ daityagrastaṃ bhayaṅkaram | mahālakṣmīprasādena varadānena nārada || 58 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmyupākhyānamuttamam | sukhadaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 59 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe śrīlakṣmyupākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || <9.42> mahālakṣmyāḥ dhyānastotravarṇanam nārada uvāca harerutkīrtanaṃ bhadraṃ śrutaṃ tajjñānamuttamam | īpsitaṃ lakṣmyupākhyānaṃ dhyānaṃ stotraṃ vada prabho || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca snātvā tīrthe purā śakro dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī | ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya kṣīrode ṣaḍdevān paryapūjayat || 2 || gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām | etān bhaktyā samabhyarcya puṣpagandhādibhistadā || 3 || āvāhya ca mahālakṣmīṃ paramaiśvaryarūpiṇīm | pūjāñcakāra deveśo brahmaṇā ca purodhasā || 4 || puraḥsthiteṣu muniṣu brāhmaṇeṣu gurau harau | devādiṣu sudeśe ca jñānānandaṃ śive mune || 5 || pārijātasya puṣpaṃ ca gṛhītvā candanokṣitam | dhyātvā devīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ pūjayāmāsa nārada || 6 || dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ yaddattaṃ brahmaṇe purā | hariṇā tena dhyānena tannibodha vadāmi te || 7 || sahasradalapadmasthakarṇikāvāsinīṃ parām | śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduprabhāmuṣṭikarāṃ parām || 8 || svatejasā prajvalantīṃ sukhadṛśyāṃ manoharām | prataptakāñcananibhaśobhāṃ mūrtimatīṃ satīm || 9 || ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ śobhitāṃ pītavāsasā | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām || 10 || sarvasampatpradātrīṃ ca mahālakṣmīṃ bhaje śubhām | dhyānenānena tāṃ dhyātvā nānāguṇasamanvitām || 11 || sampūjya brahmavākyena copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa | dadau bhaktyā vidhānena pratyekaṃ mantrapūrvakam || 12 || praśastāni prakṛṣṭāni varāṇi vividhāni ca | amūlyaratnasāraṃ ca nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 13 || āsanaṃ ca vicitraṃ ca mahālakṣmi pragṛhyatām | śuddhaṃ gaṅgodakamidaṃ sarvavanditamīpsitam || 14 || pāpedhmavahnirūpaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ kamalālaye | puṣpacandanadūrvādisaṃyutaṃ jāhnavījalam || 15 || śaṅkhagarbhasthitaṃ svarghyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ padmavāsini | sugandhipuṣpatailaṃ ca sugandhāmalakīphalam || 16 || dehasaundaryabījaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ śrīhareḥ priye | kārpāsajaṃ ca kṛmijaṃ vasanaṃ devi gṛhyatām || 17 || ratnasvarṇavikāraṃ ca dehabhūṣāvivardhanam | śobhāyai śrīkaraṃ ratnaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ devi gṛhyatām || 18 || sarvasaundaryabījaṃ ca sadyaḥ śobhākaraṃ param | vṛkṣaniryāsarūpaṃ ca gandhadravyādisaṃyutam || 19 || śrīkṛṣṇakānte dhūpaṃ ca pavitraṃ pratigṛhyatām | sugandhiyuktaṃ sukhadaṃ candanaṃ devi gṛhyatām || 20 || jagaccakṣuḥsvarūpaṃ ca pavitraṃ timirāpaham | pradīpaṃ sukharūpaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ ca sureśvari || 21 || nānopahārarūpaṃ ca nānārasasamanvitam | atisvādukaraṃ caiva naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 22 || annaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca prāṇarakṣaṇakāraṇam | tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ caiva devyannaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 23 || śālyannajaṃ supakvaṃ ca śarkarāgavyasaṃyutam | svāduyuktaṃ mahālakṣmi paramānnaṃ pragṛhyatām || 24 || śarkarāgavyapakvaṃ ca susvādu sumanoharam | svastikaṃ nāma naivedyaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvari || 25 || nānāvidhāni ramyāṇi pakvānnāni phalāni ca | surabhistanasaṃtyaktaṃ susvādu sumanoharam || 26 || martyāmṛtaṃ sugavyaṃ ca gṛhyatāmacyutapriye | susvādu rasasaṃyuktamikṣuvṛkṣasamudbhavam || 27 || agnipakvamatisvādu guḍaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām | yavagodhūmasasyānāṃ cūrṇareṇusamudbhavam || 28 || supakvaṃ guḍagavyāktaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ devi gṛhyatām | sasyacūrṇodbhavaṃ pakvaṃ svastikādisamanvitam || 29 || mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām | śītavāyupradaṃ caiva dāhe ca sukhadaṃ param || 30 || kamale gṛhyatāṃ cedaṃ vyajanaṃ śvetacāmaram | tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam || 31 || jihvājāḍyacchedakaraṃ tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām | suvāsitaṃ suśītaṃ ca pipāsānāśakāraṇam || 32 || jagajjīvanarūpaṃ ca jīvanaṃ devi gṛhyatām | dehasaundaryabījaṃ ca sadā śobhāvivardhanam || 33 || kārpāsajaṃ ca kṛmijaṃ vasanaṃ devi gṛhyatām | raktasvarṇavikāraṃ ca dehabhūṣādivardhanam || 34 || śobhādhāraṃ śrīkaraṃ ca bhūṣaṇaṃ devi gṛhyatām | nānāṛtuṣu nirmāṇaṃ bahuśobhāśrayaṃ param || 35 || surabhūpapriyaṃ śuddhaṃ mālyaṃ devi pragṛhyatām | śuddhidaṃ śuddharūpaṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam || 36 || gandhavastūdbhavaṃ ramyaṃ gandhaṃ devi pragṛhyatām | puṇyatīrthodakaṃ caiva viśuddhaṃ śuddhidaṃ sadā || 37 || gṛhyatāṃ kṛṣṇakānte tvaṃ ramyamācamanīyakam | ratnasārādinirmāṇaṃ puṣpacandanacarcitam || 38 || ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sutalpaṃ devi gṛhyatām | yadyad dravyamapūrvaṃ ca pṛthivyāmapi durlabham || 39 || devabhūṣārhabhogyaṃ ca tad dravyaṃ devi gṛhyatām | dravyāṇyetāni dattvā ca mūlena devapuṅgavaḥ || 40 || mūlaṃ jajāpa bhaktyā ca daśalakṣaṃ vidhānataḥ | japena daśalakṣeṇa mantrasiddhirbabhūva ha || 41 || mantraśca brahmaṇā dattaḥ kalpavṛkṣaśca sarvataḥ | lakṣmīrmāyā kāmavāṇī ṅe'ntā kamalavāsinī || 42 || vaidiko mantrarājo'yaṃ prasiddhaḥ svāhayānvitaḥ | kubero'nena mantreṇa paramaiśvaryamāptavān || 43 || rājarājeśvaro dakṣaḥ sāvarṇirmanureva ca | maṅgalo'nena mantreṇa saptadvīpe'vanīpatiḥ || 44 || priyavratottānapādau kedāro nṛpa eva ca | ete siddhāśca rājendrā mantreṇānena nārada || 45 || siddhe mantre mahālakṣmīḥ śakrāya darśanaṃ dadau | ratnendrasāranirmāṇavimānasthā varapradā || 46 || saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ chādayantī tviṣā ca sā | śvetacampakavarṇābhā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā || 47 || īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugrahakātarā | bibhratī ratnamālāṃ ca koṭicandrasamaprabhām || 48 || dṛṣṭvā jagatprasūṃ śāntāṃ tuṣṭāvaitāṃ purandaraḥ | pulakāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ || 49 || brahmaṇā ca pradattena stotrarājena saṃyutaḥ | sarvābhīṣṭapradenaiva vaidikenaiva tatra ca || 50 || purandara uvāca namaḥ kamalavāsinyai nārāyaṇyai namo namaḥ | kṛṣṇapriyāyai satataṃ mahālakṣyai namo namaḥ || 51 || padmapatrekṣaṇāyai ca padmāsyāyai namo namaḥ | padmāsanāyai padminyai vaiṣṇavyai ca namo namaḥ || 52 || sarvasampatsvarūpiṇyai sarvārādhyai namo namaḥ | haribhaktipradātryai ca harṣadātryai namo namaḥ || 53 || kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthitāyai ca kṛṣṇeśāyai namo namaḥ | candraśobhāsvarūpāyai ratnapadme ca śobhane || 54 || sampattyadhiṣṭhātṛdevyai mahādevyai namo namaḥ | namo vṛddhisvarūpāyai vṛddhidāyai namo namaḥ || 55 || vaikuṇṭhe yā mahālakṣmīryā lakṣmīḥ kṣīrasāgare | svargalakṣmīrindragehe rājalakṣmīrnṛpālaye || 56 || gṛhalakṣmīśca gṛhiṇāṃ gehe ca gṛhadevatā | surabhiḥ sāgare jātā dakṣiṇā yajñakāminī || 57 || aditirdevamātā tvaṃ kamalā kamalālayā | svāhā tvaṃ ca havirdāne kavyadāne svadhā smṛtā || 58 || tvaṃ hi viṣṇusvarūpā ca sarvādhārā vasundharā | śuddhasattvasvarūpā tvaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā || 59 || krodhahiṃsāvarjitā ca varadā śāradā śubhā | paramārthapradā tvaṃ ca haridāsyapradā parā || 60 || yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ bhasmībhūtamasārakam | jīvanmṛtaṃ ca viśvaṃ ca śaśvatsarvaṃ yayā vinā || 61 || sarveṣāṃ ca parā mātā sarvabāndhavarūpiṇī | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ tvaṃ ca kāraṇarūpiṇī || 62 || yathā mātā stanāndhānāṃ śiśūnāṃ śaiśave sadā | tathā tvaṃ sarvadā mātā sarveṣāṃ sarvarūpataḥ || 63 || mātṛhīnaḥ stanāndhastu sa ca jīvati daivataḥ | tvayā hīno janaḥ ko'pi na jīvatyeva niścitam || 64 || suprasannasvarūpā tvaṃ māṃ prasannā bhavāmbike | vairigrastaṃ ca viṣayaṃ dehi mahyaṃ sanātani || 65 || ahaṃ yāvattvayā hīno bandhuhīnaśca bhikṣukaḥ | sarvasampadvihīnaśca tāvadeva haripriye || 66 || jñānaṃ dehi ca dharmaṃ ca sarvasaubhāgyamīpsitam | prabhāvañca pratāpaṃ ca sarvādhikārameva ca || 67 || jayaṃ parākramaṃ yuddhe paramaiśvaryameva ca | ityuktvā ca mahendraśca sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha || 68 || praṇanāma sāśrunetro mūrdhnā caiva punaḥ punaḥ | brahmā ca śaṅkaraścaiva śeṣo dharmaśca keśavaḥ || 69 || sarve cakruḥ parīhāraṃ surārthe ca punaḥ punaḥ | devebhyaśca varaṃ dattvā puṣpamālāṃ manoharām || 70 || keśavāya dadau lakṣmīḥ santuṣṭā surasaṃsadi | yayurdevāśca santuṣṭāḥ svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ ca nārada || 71 || devī yayau hareḥ sthānaṃ hṛṣṭā kṣīrodaśāyinaḥ | yayatuścaiva svagṛhaṃ brahmeśānau ca nārada || 72 || dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ tau ca devebhyaḥ prītipūrvakam | idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ || 73 || kuberatulyaḥ sa bhavedrājarājeśvaro mahān | pañcalakṣajapenaiva stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām || 74 || siddhastotraṃ yadi paṭhenmāsamekaṃ tu santatam | mahāsukhī ca rājendro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 75 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādatasāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe mahālakṣmyāḥ dhyānastotravarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃpto'dhyāyaḥ || 42 || <9.43> svāhopākhyānavarṇanam nārada uvāca nārāyaṇa mahābhāga nārāyaṇa mahāprabho | rūpeṇaiva guṇenaiva yaśasā tejasā tviṣā || 1 || tvameva jñānināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ siddhānāṃ yogināṃ mune | tapasvināṃ munīnāṃ ca paro vedavidāṃvara || 2 || mahālakṣmyā upākhyānaṃ vijñātaṃ mahadadbhutam | anyatkiñcidupākhyānaṃ nigūḍhaṃ vada sāmpratam || 3 || atīva gopanīyaṃ yadupayuktaṃ ca sarvataḥ | aprakāśyaṃ purāṇeṣu vedoktaṃ dharmasaṃyutam || 4 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca nānāprakāramākhyānamaprakāśyaṃ purāṇataḥ | śrutaṃ katividhaṃ gūḍhamāste brahman sudurlabham || 5 || teṣu yatsārabhūtaṃ ca śrotuṃ kiṃ vā tvamicchasi | tanme brūhi mahābhāga paścādvakṣyāmi tatpunaḥ || 6 || nārada uvāca svāhā devī havirdāne praśastā sarvakarmasu | pitṛdāne svadhā śastā dakṣiṇā sarvato varā || 7 || etāsāṃ caritaṃ janmaphalaṃ prādhānyameva ca | śrotumicchāmi tvadvaktrādvada vedavidāṃvara || 8 || sūta uvāca nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munisattamaḥ | kathāṃ kathitumārebhe purāṇoktāṃ purātanīm || 9 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sṛṣṭeḥ prathamato devāḥ svāhārārthaṃ yayuḥ purā | brahmalokaṃ brahmasabhāmājagmuḥ sumanoharām || 10 || gatvā nivedanaṃ cakrurāhārahetukaṃ mune | brahmā śrutvā pratijñāya niṣeve śrīhariṃ param || 11 || nārada uvāca yajñarūpo hi bhagavān kalayā ca babhūva ha | yajñe yadyaddhavirdānaṃ dattaṃ tebhyaśca brāhmaṇaiḥ || 12 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca havirdadati viprāśca bhaktyā ca kṣatriyādayaḥ | surā naiva prāpnuvanti taddānaṃ munipuṅgava || 13 || devā viṣaṇṇāste sarve tatsabhāṃ ca yayuḥ punaḥ | gatvā nivedanaṃ cakrurāhārābhāvahetukam || 14 || brahmā śrutvā tu dhyānena śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau | pūjāñcakāra prakṛtedhyānenaiva tadājñayā || 15 || prakṛteḥ kalayā caiva sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī | atīva sundarī śyāmā ramaṇīyā manoharā || 16 || īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugrahakātarā | uvāceti vidheragre padmayone varaṃ vṛṇu || 17 || vidhistadvacanaṃ śrutvā sambhramātsamuvāca tām | prajāpatiruvāca tvamagnerdāhikā śaktirbhava yātīva sundarī || 18 || dagdhuṃ na śaktaḥ prakṛtīrhutāśaśca tvayā vinā | tvannāmoccārya mantrānte yo dāsyati havirnaraḥ || 19 || surebhyastatprāpnuvanti surāḥ sānandapūrvakam | agneḥ sampatsvarūpā ca śrīrūpā sā gṛheśvarī || 20 || devānāṃ pūjitā śaśvannarādīnāṃ bhavāmbike | brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā sā viṣaṇṇā babhūva ha || 21 || tamuvāca tato devī svābhiprāyaṃ svayambhuvam | svāhovāca ahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajiṣyāmi tapasā sucireṇa ca || 22 || brahmaṃstadanyaṃ yatkiñcitsvapnavad bhramameva ca | vidhātā jagatastvaṃ ca śambhurmṛtyuñjayo vibhuḥ || 23 || bibharti śeṣo viśvaṃ ca dharmaḥ sākṣī ca dharmiṇām | sarvādyapūjyo devānāṃ gaṇeṣu ca gaṇeśvaraḥ || 24 || prakṛtiḥ sarvasampūjyā yatprasādātpurābhavat | ṛṣayo munayaścaiva pūjitā yanniṣevayā || 25 || tatpādapadmaṃ niyataṃ bhāvena cintayāmyaham | padmāsyā pādyamityuktvā padmanābhānusārataḥ || 26 || jagāma tapase devī dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ nirāmayam | tapastepe varṣalakṣamekapādena padmajā || 27 || tadā dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param | atīva kamanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca rūpiṇī || 28 || mūrcchāṃ samprāpa kālena kāmeśasya ca kāmukī | vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ sarvajñastāmuvāca ha || 29 || samutthāpya ca tāṃ kroḍe kṣīṇāṅgīṃ tapasā ciram | śrībhagavānuvāca vārāhe vai tvamaṃśena mama patnī bhaviṣyasi || 30 || nāmnā nāgnajitī kanyā kānte nagnajitasya ca | adhunāgnerdāhikā tvaṃ bhava patnī ca bhāminī || 31 || mantrāṅgarūpā pūjyā ca matprasādād bhaviṣyasi | vahnistvāṃ bhaktibhāvena sampūjya ca gṛheśvarīm || 32 || ramiṣyati tvayā sārdhaṃ rāmayā ramaṇīyayā | ityuktvāntardadhe devo devīṃ sambhāṣya nārada || 33 || tatrājagāma santrasto vahnirbrahmanideśataḥ | sāmavedoktadhyānena dhyātvā tāṃ jagadambikām || 34 || sampūjya parituṣṭāva pāṇiṃ jagrāha mantrataḥ | tadā divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sa reme rāmayā saha || 35 || atīva nirjane deśe sambhogasukhade sadā | babhūva garbhastasyāṃ ca hutāśasya ca tejasā || 36 || taṃ dadhāra ca sā devī divyaṃ dvādaśavatsaram | tataḥ suṣāva putrāṃśca ramaṇīyānmanoharān || 37 || dakṣiṇāgnigārhapatyāhavanīyān krameṇa ca | ṛṣayo munayaścaiva brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ || 38 || svāhāntaṃ mantramuccārya havirdānaṃ ca cakrire | svāhāyuktaṃ ca mantraṃ ca yo gṛhṇāti praśastakam || 39 || sarvasiddhirbhavettasya mantragrahaṇamātrataḥ | viṣahīno yathā sarpo vedahīno yathā dvijaḥ || 40 || patisevāvihīnā strī vidyāhīno yathā pumān | phalaśākhāvihīnaśca yathā vṛkṣo hi ninditaḥ || 41 || svāhāhīnastathā mantro na hutaḥ phaladāyakaḥ | parituṣṭā dvijāḥ sarve devāḥ samprāpurāhutīḥ || 42 || svāhāntenaiva mantreṇa saphalaṃ sarvameva ca | ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ svāhopākhyānamuttamam || 43 || sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi | nārada uvāca svāhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ stotraṃ munīśvara || 44 || sampūjya vahnistuṣṭāva yena tadvada me prabho | śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ stotrapūjāvidhānakam || 45 || vadāmi śrūyatāṃ brahman sāvadhāno munīśvara | sarvayajñārambhakāle śālagrāme ghaṭe'thavā || 46 || svāhāṃ sampūjya yatnena yajñaṃ kuryātkalāptaye | svāhāṃ mantrāṅgayuktāṃ ca mantrasiddhisvarūpiṇīm || 47 || siddhāṃ ca siddhidāṃ nṝṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladāṃ śubhām | iti dhyātvā ca mūlena dattvā pādyādikaṃ naraḥ || 48 || sarvasiddhiṃ labhetstutvā mūlamantraṃ mune śṛṇu | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vahnijāyāyai devyai svāhetyanena ca || 49 || yaḥ pūjayecca tāṃ bhaktyā sarveṣṭaṃ sambhaved dhruvam | vahniruvāca svāhā vahnipriyā vahnijāyā santoṣakāriṇī || 50 || śaktiḥ kriyā kāladātrī paripākakarī dhruvā | gatiḥ sadā narāṇāṃ ca dāhikā dahanakṣamā || 51 || saṃsārasārarūpā ca ghorasaṃsāratāriṇī | devajīvanarūpā ca devapoṣaṇakāriṇī || 52 || ṣoḍaśaitāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ | sarvasiddhirbhavettasya iha loke paratra ca || 53 || nāṅgahīnaṃ bhavettasya sarvaṃ karma suśobhanam | aputro labhate putraṃ bhāryāhīno labhetpriyām || 54 || rambhopamāṃ svakāntāṃ ca samprāpya sukhamāpnuyāt || 55 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde svāhopākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 || <9.44> svadhopākhyānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi svadhopākhyānamuttamam | pitṝṇāṃ ca tṛptikaraṃ śrāddhāntaphalavardhanam || 1 || sṛṣṭerādau pitṛgaṇānsasarja jagatāṃ vidhiḥ | caturaśca mūrtimatastrīṃśca tejaḥsvarūpiṇaḥ || 2 || dṛṣṭvā saptapitṛgaṇān sukharūpānmanoharān | āhāraṃ sasṛje teṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ tarpaṇapūrvakam || 3 || snānaṃ tarpaṇaparyantaṃ śrāddhaṃ tu devapūjanam | āhnikaṃ ca trisandhyāntaṃ viprāṇāṃ ca śrutau śrutam || 4 || nityaṃ na kuryādyo viprastrisandhyaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam | baliṃ vedadhvaniṃ so'pi viṣahīno yathoragaḥ || 5 || devīsevāvihīnaśca śrīhareranivedyabhuk | bhasmāntaṃ sūtakaṃ tasya na karmārhaśca nārada || 6 || brahmā śrāddhādikaṃ sṛṣṭvā jagāma pitṛhetave | na prāpnuvanti pitaro dadati brāhmaṇādayaḥ || 7 || sarve ca jagmuḥ kṣudhitāḥ khinnāstu brahmaṇaḥ sabhām | sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakrustameva jagatāṃ vidhim || 8 || brahmā ca mānasīṃ kanyāṃ sasṛje ca manoharām | rūpayauvanasampannāṃ śatacandranibhānanām || 9 || vidyāvatīṃ guṇavatīmatirūpavatīṃ satīm | śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 10 || viśuddhāṃ prakṛteraṃśāṃ sasmitāṃ varadāṃ śubhām | svadhābhidhāṃ ca sudatīṃ lakṣmīlakṣaṇasaṃyutām || 11 || śatapadmapadanyastapādapadmaṃ ca bibhratīm | patnīṃ pitṝṇāṃ padmāsyāṃ padmajāṃ padmalocanām || 12 || pitṛbhyaśca dadau brahmā tuṣṭebhyastuṣṭirūpiṇīm | brāhmaṇānāṃ copadeśaṃ cakāra gopanīyakam || 13 || svadhāntaṃ mantramuccārya pitṛbhyo deyamityapi | krameṇa tena viprāśca pitre dānaṃ daduḥ purā || 14 || svāhā śastā devadāne pitṛdāne svadhā smṛtā | sarvatra dakṣiṇā śastā hataṃ yajñamadakṣiṇam || 15 || pitaro devatā viprā munayo manavastathā | pūjāṃ cakruḥ svadhāṃ śāntāṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ paramādarāt || 16 || devādayaśca santuṣṭāḥ paripūrṇamanorathāḥ | viprādayaśca pitaraḥ svadhādevīvareṇa ca || 17 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ svadhopākhyānameva ca | sarveṣāṃ ca tuṣṭikaraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 18 || nārada uvāca svadhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ stotraṃ mahāmune | śrotumicchāmi yatnena vada vedavidāṃvara || 19 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca dhyānaṃ ca stavanaṃ brahman vedoktaṃ sarvamaṅgalam | sarvaṃ jānāsi ca kathaṃ jñātumicchasi vṛddhaye || 20 || śaratkṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ maghāyāṃ śrāddhavāsare | svadhāṃ sampūjya yatnena tataḥ śrāddhaṃ samācaret || 21 || svadhāṃ nābhyarcya yo vipraḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryādahaṃmatiḥ | na bhavetphalabhāksatyaṃ śrāddhasya tarpaṇasya ca || 22 || brahmaṇo mānasīṃ kanyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām | pūjyāṃ vai pitṛdevānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ phaladāṃ bhaje || 23 || iti dhyātvā śilāyāṃ vā hyathavā maṅgale ghaṭe | dadyātpādyādikaṃ tasyai mūleneti śrutau śrutam || 24 || oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ svadhādevyai svāheti ca mahāmune | samuccārya tu sampūjya stutvā tāṃ praṇamed dvijaḥ || 25 || stotraṃ śṛṇu muniśreṣṭha brahmaputra viśārada | sarvavāñchāpradaṃ nṝṇāṃ brahmaṇā yatkṛtaṃ purā || 26 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca svadhoccāraṇamātreṇa tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet || 27 || svadhā svadhā svadhetyevaṃ yadi vāratrayaṃ smaret | śrāddhasya phalamāpnoti baleśca tarpaṇasya ca || 28 || śrāddhakāle svadhāstotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ | sa labhecchrāddhasambhūtaṃ phalameva na saṃśayaḥ || 29 || svadhā svadhā svadhetyevaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ | priyāṃ vinītāṃ sa labhetsādhvīṃ putraguṇānvitām || 30 || pitṝṇāṃ prāṇatulyā tvaṃ dvijajīvanarūpiṇī | śrāddhādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca śrāddhādīnāṃ phalapradā || 31 || nityā tvaṃ satyarūpāsi puṇyarūpāsi suvrate | āvirbhāvatirobhāvau sṛṣṭau ca pralaye tava || 32 || oṃ svastiśca namaḥ svāhā svadhā tvaṃ dakṣiṇā tathā | nirūpitāścaturvedaiḥ praśastāḥ karmiṇāṃ punaḥ || 33 || karmapūrtyarthamevaitā īśvareṇa vinirmitāḥ | ityevamuktvā sa brahmā brahmaloke svasaṃsadi || 34 || tasthau ca sahasā sadyaḥ svadhā sā''virbabhūva ha | tadā pitṛbhyaḥ pradadau tāmeva kamalānanām || 35 || tāṃ samprāpya yayuste ca pitaraśca praharṣitāḥ | svadhāstotramidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ | sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu vāñchitaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 36 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde svadhopākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || <9.45> dakṣiṇopākhyānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca uktaṃ svāhāsvadhākhyānaṃ praśastaṃ madhuraṃ param | vakṣyāmi dakṣiṇākhyānaṃ sāvadhāno niśāmaya || 1 || gopī suśīlā goloke purā''sītpreyasī hareḥ | rādhā pradhānā sadhrīcī dhanyā mānyā manoharā || 2 || atīva sundarī rāmā subhagā sudatī satī | vidyāvatī guṇavatī cātirūpavatī satī || 3 || kalāvatī komalāṅgī kāntā kamalalocanā | suśroṇī sustanī śyāmā nyagrodhaparimaṇḍitā || 4 || īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitā | śvetacampakavarṇābhā bimboṣṭhī mṛgalocanā || 5 || kāmaśāstreṣu nipuṇā kāminī haṃsagāminī | bhāvānuraktā bhāvajñā kṛṣṇasya priyabhāminī || 6 || rasajñā rasikā rāse rāseśasya rasotsukā | uvāsādakṣiṇe kroḍe rādhāyāḥ purataḥ purā || 7 || sambabhūvānamramukho bhayena madhusūdanaḥ | dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ ca purato gopīnāṃ pravarottamām || 8 || kāminīṃ raktavadanāṃ raktapaṅkajalocanām | kopena kampitāṅgīṃ ca kopena sphuritādharām || 9 || vegena tāṃ tu gacchantīṃ vijñāya tadanantaram | virodhabhīto bhagavānantardhānaṃ cakāra saḥ || 10 || palāyantaṃ ca kāntaṃ ca śāntaṃ sattvaṃ suvigraham | vilokya kampitā gopyaḥ suśīlādyāstato bhiyā || 11 || vilokya lampaṭaṃ tatra gopīnāṃ lakṣakoṭayaḥ | puṭāñjaliyutā bhītā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ || 12 || rakṣa rakṣetyuktavantyo devīmiti punaḥ punaḥ | yayurbhayena śaraṇaṃ yasyāścaraṇapaṅkaje || 13 || trilakṣakoṭayo gopāḥ sudāmādaya eva ca | yayurbhayena śaraṇaṃ tatpādābje ca nārada || 14 || palāyantaṃ ca kāntaṃ ca vijñāya parameśvarī | palāyantīṃ sahacarīṃ suśīlāṃ ca śaśāpa sā || 15 || adyaprabhṛti golokaṃ sā cedāyāti gopikā | sadyo gamanamātreṇa bhasmasācca bhaviṣyati || 16 || ityevamuktvā tatraiva devadeveśvarī ruṣā | rāseśvarī rāsamadhye rāseśamājuhāva ha || 17 || nālokya purataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhā virahakātarā | yugakoṭisamaṃ mene kṣaṇabhedena suvratā || 18 || he kṛṣṇa prāṇanātheśāgaccha prāṇādhikapriya | prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdeveśa prāṇā yānti tvayā vinā || 19 || strīgarvaḥ patisaubhāgyādvardhate ca dine dine | sukhaṃ ca vipulaṃ yasmāttaṃ seveddharmataḥ sadā || 20 || patirbandhuḥ kulastrīṇāmadhidevaḥ sadāgatiḥ | parasampatsvarūpaśca mūrtimān bhogadaḥ sadā || 21 || dharmadaḥ sukhadaḥ śaśvatprītidaḥ śāntidaḥ sadā | sammānairdīpyamānaśca mānado mānakhaṇḍanaḥ || 22 || sārātsārataraḥ svāmī bandhūnāṃ bandhuvardhanaḥ | na ca bhartuḥ samo bandhurbandhorbandhuṣu dṛśyate || 23 || bharaṇādeva bhartā ca pālanātpatirucyate | śarīreśācca sa svāmī kāmadaḥ kānta ucyate || 24 || bandhuśca sukhavṛddhyā ca prītidānātpriyaḥ smṛtaḥ | aiśvaryadānādīśaśca prāṇeśātprāṇanāyakaḥ || 25 || ratidānācca ramaṇaḥ priyo nāsti priyātparaḥ | putrastu svāminaḥ śukrājjāyate tena sa priyaḥ || 26 || śataputrātparaḥ svāmī kulajānāṃ priyaḥ sadā | asatkulaprasūtā yā kāntaṃ vijñātumakṣamā || 27 || snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dakṣiṇā | prādakṣiṇyaṃ pṛthivyāśca sarvāṇi ca tapāṃsi ca || 28 || sarvāṇyeva vratādīni mahādānāni yāni ca | upoṣaṇāni puṇyāni yāni yāni śrutāni ca || 29 || gurusevā viprasevā devasevādikaṃ ca yat | svāminaḥ pādasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 30 || guruviprendradeveṣu sarvebhyaśca patirguruḥ | vidyādātā yathā puṃsāṃ kulajānāṃ tathā priyaḥ || 31 || gopīnāṃ lakṣakoṭīnāṃ gopānāṃ ca tathaiva ca | brahmāṇḍānāmasaṃkhyānāṃ tatrasthānāṃ tathaiva ca || 32 || viśvādigolakāntānāmīśvarī yatprasādataḥ | ahaṃ na jāne taṃ kāntaṃ strīsvabhāvo duratyayaḥ || 33 || ityuktvā rādhikā kṛṣṇaṃ tatra dadhyau svabhaktitaḥ | ruroda premṇā sā rādhā nātha nātheti cābravīt || 34 || darśanaṃ dehi ramaṇa dīnā virahaduḥkhitā | atha sā dakṣiṇā devī dhvastā golokato mune || 35 || suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā viveśa kamalātanau | atha devādayaḥ sarve yajñaṃ kṛtvā suduṣkaram || 36 || nālabhaṃste phalaṃ teṣāṃ viṣaṇṇāḥ prayayurvidhim | vidhirnivedanaṃ śrutvā devādīnāṃ jagatpatim || 37 || dadhyau ca suciraṃ bhaktyā pratyādeśamavāpa saḥ | nārāyaṇaśca bhagavān mahālakṣyāśca dehataḥ || 38 || viniṣkṛṣya martyalakṣmīṃ brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadau | brahmā dadau tāṃ yajñāya pūraṇārthaṃ ca karmaṇām || 39 || yajñaḥ sampūjya vidhivattāṃ tuṣṭāva tadā mudā | taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ candrakoṭisamaprabhām || 40 || atīva kamanīyāṃ ca sundarīṃ sumanoharām | kamalāsyāṃ komalāṅgīṃ kamalāyatalocanām || 41 || kamalāsanapūjyāṃ ca kamalāṅgasamudbhavām | vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ bimboṣṭhīṃ sudatīṃ satīm || 42 || bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam | īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 43 || suveṣāḍhyāṃ ca susnātāṃ munimānasamohinīm | kastūrībindubhiḥ sārdhaṃ sugandhicandanendubhiḥ || 44 || sindūrabindunālpenāpyalakādhaḥsthalojjvalām | supraśastanitambāḍhyāṃ bṛhacchroṇipayodharām || 45 || kāmadevādhārarūpāṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā ramaṇīyāṃ ca yajño mūrcchāmavāpa ha || 46 || patnīṃ tāmeva jagrāha vidhibodhitapūrvakam | divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ caiva tāṃ gṛhītvā tu nirjane || 47 || yajño reme mudā yukto rāmeśo ramayā saha | garbhaṃ dadhāra sā devī divyaṃ dvādaśavarṣakam || 48 || tataḥ suṣāva putraṃ ca phalaṃ vai sarvakarmaṇām | paripūrṇe karmaṇi ca tatputraḥ phaladāyakaḥ || 49 || yajño dakṣiṇayā sārdhaṃ putreṇa ca phalena ca | karmiṇāṃ phaladātā cetyevaṃ vedavido viduḥ || 50 || yajñaśca dakṣiṇāṃ prāpya putraṃ ca phaladāyakam | phalaṃ dadau ca sarvebhyaḥ karmaṇāṃ caiva nārada || 51 || tadā devādayastuṣṭāḥ paripūrṇamanorathāḥ | svasthāne te yayuḥ sarve dharmavaktrādidaṃ śrutam || 52 || kṛtvā karma ca kartā ca tūrṇaṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇām | tatkṣaṇaṃ phalamāpnoti vedairuktamidaṃ mune || 53 || karmī karmaṇi pūrṇe ca tatkṣaṇe yadi dakṣiṇām | na dadyād brāhmaṇebhyaśca daivenājñānato'thavā || 54 || muhūrte samatīte tu dviguṇā sā bhaved dhruvam | ekarātre vyatīte tu bhavecchataguṇā ca sā || 55 || trirātre tacchataguṇā saptāhe dviguṇā tataḥ | māse lakṣaguṇā proktā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vardhate || 56 || saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sā trikoṭiguṇā bhavet | karma tadyajamānānāṃ sarvaṃ vai niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 57 || sa ca brahmasvahārī ca na karmārho'śucirnaraḥ | daridro vyādhiyuktaśca tena pāpena pātakī || 58 || tadgṛhādyāti lakṣmīśca śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam | pitaro naiva gṛhṇanti taddattaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam || 59 || evaṃ surāśca tatpūjāṃ taddattāmagnirāhutim | dattaṃ na dīyate dānaṃ grahītā naiva yācate || 60 || ubhau tau narake yātaśchinnarajjau yathā ghaṭaḥ | nārpayedyajamānaścedyācitaścāpi dakṣiṇām || 61 || bhavedbrahmasvāpahārī kumbhīpākaṃ vrajed dhruvam | varṣalakṣaṃ vasettatra yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ || 62 || tato bhavetsa cāṇḍālo vyādhiyukto daridrakaḥ | pātayetpuruṣānsapta pūrvāṃśca sapta janmataḥ || 63 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi | nārada uvāca yatkarma dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ ko bhuṅkte tatphalaṃ mune || 64 || pūjāvidhiṃ dakṣiṇāyāḥ purā yajñakṛtaṃ vada | śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca karmaṇo'dakṣiṇasyaiva kuta eva phalaṃ mune || 65 || sadakṣiṇe karmaṇi ca phalameva pravartate | adakṣiṇaṃ ca yatkarma tadbhuṅkte ca balirmune || 66 || balaye tatpradattaṃ ca vāmanena purā mune | aśrotriyaḥ śrāddhadravyamaśraddhādānameva ca || 67 || vṛṣalīpativiprāṇāṃ pūjādravyādikaṃ ca yat | asaddvijaiḥ kṛtaṃ yajñamaśuceḥ pūjanaṃ ca yat || 68 || gurāvabhaktasya karma balirbhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ | dakṣiṇāyāśca yaddhyānaṃ stotraṃ pūjāvidhikramam || 69 || tatsarvaṃ kaṇvaśākhoktaṃ pravakṣyāmi niśāmaya | purā samprāpya tāṃ yajñaḥ karmadakṣāṃ ca dakṣiṇām || 70 || mumohāsyāḥ svarūpeṇa tuṣṭāva kāmakātaraḥ | yajña uvāca purā golokagopī tvaṃ gopīnāṃ pravarā varā || 71 || rādhāsamā tatsakhī ca śrīkṛṣṇapreyasī priyā | kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu rāse rādhāmahotsave || 72 || āvirbhūtā dakṣiṇāṃsāllakṣmyāśca tena dakṣiṇā | purā tvaṃ ca suśīlākhyā khyātā śīlena śobhane || 73 || lakṣmīdakṣāṃsabhāgāttvaṃ rādhāśāpācca dakṣiṇā | golokāttvaṃ paribhraṣṭā mama bhāgyādupasthitā || 74 || kṛpāṃ kuru mahābhāge māmeva svāminaṃ kuru | karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ devī tvameva phaladā sadā || 75 || tvayā vinā ca sarveṣāṃ sarvaṃ karma ca niṣphalam | tvayā vinā tathā karma karmiṇāṃ ca na śobhate || 76 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca dikpālādaya eva ca | karmaṇaśca phalaṃ dātuṃ na śaktāśca tvayā vinā || 77 || karmarūpī svayaṃ brahmā phalarūpī maheśvaraḥ | yajñarūpī viṣṇurahaṃ tvameṣāṃ sārarūpiṇī || 78 || phaladātṛparaṃ brahma nirguṇā prakṛtiḥ parā | svayaṃ kṛṣṇaśca bhagavān sa ca śaktastvayā saha || 79 || tvameva śaktiḥ kānte me śaśvajjanmani janmani | sarvakarmaṇi śakto'haṃ tvayā saha varānane || 80 || ityuktvā ca purastasthau yajñādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā | tuṣṭā babhūva sā devī bheje taṃ kamalākalā || 81 || idaṃ ca dakṣiṇāstotraṃ yajñakāle ca yaḥ paṭhet | phalaṃ ca sarvayajñānāṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 82 || rājasūye vājapeye gomedhe naramedhake | aśvamedhe lāṅgale ca viṣṇuyajñe yaśaskare || 83 || dhanade bhūmide pūrte phalade gajamedhake | lohayajñe svarṇayajñe ratnayajñe'tha tāmrake || 84 || śivayajñe rudrayajñe śakrayajñe ca bandhuke | vṛṣṭau varuṇayāge ca kaṇḍake vairimardane || 85 || śuciyajñe dharmayajñe'dhvare ca pāpamocane | brahmāṇīkarmayāge ca yoniyāge ca bhadrake || 86 || eteṣāṃ ca samārambhe idaṃ stotraṃ ca yaḥ paṭhet | nirvighnena ca tatkarma sarvaṃ bhavati niścitam || 87 || idaṃ stotraṃ ca kathitaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu | śālagrāme ghaṭe vāpi dakṣiṇāṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ || 88 || lakṣmīdakṣāṃsasambhūtāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kamalākalām | sarvakarmasudakṣāṃ ca phaladāṃ sarvakarmaṇām || 89 || viṣṇoḥ śaktisvarūpāṃ ca pūjitāṃ vanditāṃ śubhām | śuddhidāṃ śuddhirūpāṃ ca suśīlāṃ śubhadāṃ bhaje || 90 || dhyātvānenaiva varadāṃ mūlena pūjayetsudhīḥ | dattvā pādyādikaṃ devyai vedoktenaiva nārada || 91 || oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇāyai svāheti ca vicakṣaṇaḥ | pūjayedvidhivad bhaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ sarvapūjitām || 92 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahman dakṣiṇākhyānameva ca | sukhadaṃ prītidaṃ caiva phaladaṃ sarvakarmaṇām || 93 || idaṃ ca dakṣiṇākhyānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ | aṅgahīnaṃ ca tatkarma na bhavedbhārate bhuvi || 94 || aputro labhate putraṃ niścitaṃ ca guṇānvitam | bhāryāhīno labhedbhāryāṃ suśīlāṃ sundarīṃ parām || 95 || varārohāṃ putravatīṃ vinītāṃ priyavādinīm | pativratāṃ ca śuddhāṃ ca kulajāṃ ca vadhūṃ varām || 96 || vidyāhīno labhedvidyāṃ dhanahīno labheddhanam | bhūmihīno labhedbhūmiṃ prajāhīno labhetprajām || 97 || saṅkaṭe bandhuvicchede vipattau bandhane tathā | māsamekamidaṃ śrutvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 98 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde dakṣiṇopākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 || <9.46> ṣaṣṭhyupākhyānavarṇanam nārada uvāca anekānāṃ ca devīnāṃ śrutamākhyānamuttamam | anyāsāṃ caritaṃ brahman vada vedavidāṃvara || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca sarvāsāṃ caritaṃ vipra vedeṣu ca pṛthakpṛthak | pūrvoktānāṃ ca devīnāṃ kāsāṃ śrotumihecchasi || 2 || nārada uvāca ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalacaṇḍī ca manasā prakṛteḥ kalā | utpattimāsāṃ caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ṣaṣṭhāṃśā prakṛteryā ca sā ca ṣaṣṭhī prakīrtitā | bālakānāmadhiṣṭhātrī viṣṇumāyā ca bāladā || 4 || mātṛkāsu ca vikhyātā devasenābhidhā ca yā | prāṇādhikapriyā sādhvī skandabhāryā ca suvratā || 5 || āyuḥpradā ca bālānāṃ dhātrī rakṣaṇakāriṇī | satataṃ śiśupārśvasthā yogena siddhiyoginī || 6 || tasyāḥ pūjāvidhiṃ brahmanitihāsamidaṃ śṛṇu | yacchrutaṃ dharmavakyeṇa sukhadaṃ putradaṃ param || 7 || rājā priyavrataścāsītsvāyambhuvamanoḥ sutaḥ | yogīndro nodvahadbhāryāṃ tapasyāsu rataḥ sadā || 8 || brahmājñayā ca yatnena kṛtadāro babhūva ha | suciraṃ kṛtadāraśca na lebhe tanayaṃ mune || 9 || putreṣṭiyajñaṃ taṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa kaśyapaḥ | mālinyaṃ tasya kāntāyai muniryajñacaruṃ dadau || 10 || bhuktvā ca taṃ caruṃ tasyāḥ sadyo garbho babhūva ha | dadhāra taṃ ca sā devī daivaṃ dvādaśavatsaram || 11 || tataḥ suṣāva sā brahman kumāraṃ kanakaprabham | sarvāvayavasampannaṃ mṛtamuttāralocanam || 12 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā ruruduḥ sarvā nāryaśca bāndhavastriyaḥ | mūrcchāmavāpa tanmātā putraśokena bhūyasā || 13 || śmaśānaṃ ca yayau rājā gṛhītvā bālakaṃ mune | ruroda tatra kāntāre putraṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi || 14 || notsṛjad bālakaṃ rājā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ | jñānayogaṃ visasmāra putraśokātsudāruṇāt || 15 || etasminnantare tatra vimānaṃ ca dadarśa saḥ | śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ maṇirājavinirmitam || 16 || tejasā jvalitaṃ śaśvacchobhitaṃ kṣaumavāsasā | nānācitravicitrāḍhyaṃ puṣpamālāvirājitam || 17 || dadarśa tatra devīṃ ca kamanīyāṃ manoharām | śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām || 18 || īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | kṛpāmayīṃ yogasiddhāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām || 19 || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ purato rājā tuṣṭāva paramādarāt | cakāra pūjanaṃ tasyā vihāya bālakaṃ bhuvi || 20 || papraccha rājā tāṃ tuṣṭāṃ grīṣmasūryasamaprabhām | tejasā jvalitāṃ śāntāṃ kāntāṃ skandasya nārada || 21 || rājovāca kā tvaṃ suśobhane kānte kasya kāntāsi suvrate | kasya kanyā varārohe dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām || 22 || nṛpendrasya vacaḥ śrutvā jaganmaṅgalacaṇḍikā | uvāca devasenā sā devānāṃ raṇakāriṇī || 23 || devānāṃ daityagrastānāṃ purā senā babhūva sā | jayaṃ dadau sā tebhyaśca devasenā ca tena sā || 24 || śrīdevasenovāca brahmaṇo mānasī kanyā devasenāhamīśvarī | sṛṣṭvā tāṃ manasā dhātā dadau skandāya bhūmipa || 25 || mātṛkāsu ca vikhyātā skandabhāryā ca suvratā | viśve ṣaṣṭhīti vikhyātā ṣaṣṭhāṃśā prakṛteḥ parā || 26 || aputrāya putradāhaṃ priyādātrī priyāya ca | dhanadāhaṃ daridrebhyaḥ karmibhyaśca svakarmadā || 27 || sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śoko harṣo maṅgalameva ca | sampattiśca vipattiśca sarvaṃ bhavati karmaṇā || 28 || karmaṇā bahuputraśca vaṃśahīnaḥ svakarmaṇā | karmaṇā mṛtaputraśca karmaṇā cirajīvanaḥ || 29 || karmaṇā guṇavāṃścaiva karmaṇā cāṅgahīnakaḥ | karmaṇā bahubhāryaśca bhāryāhīnaśca karmaṇā || 30 || karmaṇā rūpavāndharmī rogī śaśvatsvakarmaṇā | karmaṇā ca bhavedvyādhiḥ karmaṇā''rogyameva ca || 31 || tasmātkarma paraṃ rājan sarvebhyaśca śrutau śrutam | ityevamuktvā sā devī gṛhītvā bālakaṃ mune || 32 || mahājñānena sā devī jīvayāmāsa līlayā | rājā dadarśa taṃ bālaṃ sasmitaṃ kanakaprabham || 33 || devasenā ca paśyantaṃ nṛpamāpṛcchya sā tadā | gṛhītvā bālakaṃ devī gaganaṃ gantumudyatā || 34 || punastuṣṭāva tāṃ rājā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ | nṛpastotreṇa sā devī parituṣṭā babhūva ha || 35 || uvāca taṃ nṛpaṃ brahman vedoktaṃ karmanirmitam | devyuvāca triṣu lokeṣu tvaṃ rājā svāyambhuvamanoḥ sutaḥ || 36 || mama pūjāṃ ca sarvatra kārayitvā svayaṃ kuru | tadā dāsyāmi putraṃ te kulapadmaṃ manoharam || 37 || suvrataṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ guṇavantaṃ supaṇḍitam | jātismaraṃ ca yogīndraṃ nārāyaṇakalātmakam || 38 || śatakratukaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca vanditam | mattamātaṅgalakṣāṇāṃ dhṛtavantaṃ balaṃ śubham || 39 || dhaninaṃ guṇinaṃ śuddhaṃ viduṣāṃ priyameva ca | yogināṃ jñānināṃ caiva siddhirūpaṃ tapasvinām || 40 || yaśasvinaṃ ca lokeṣu dātāraṃ sarvasampadām | ityevamuktvā sā devī tasmai tadbālakaṃ dadau || 41 || rājā cakāra svīkāraṃ pūjārthaṃ ca priyavrataḥ | jagāma devī svargaṃ ca dattvā tasmai śubhaṃ varam || 42 || ājagāma sahāmātyaḥ svagṛhaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ | āgatya kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ putrahetukam || 43 || śrutvā babhūvuḥ santuṣṭā narā nāryaśca nārada | maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa sarvatra putrahetukam || 44 || devīṃ ca pūjayāmāsa brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau | rājā ca pratimāseṣu śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ mahotsavam || 45 || ṣaṣṭyā devyāśca yatnena kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ | bālānāṃ sūtikāgāre ṣaṣṭhāhe yatnapūrvakam || 46 || tatpūjāṃ kārayāmāsa caikaviṃśativāsare | bālānāṃ śubhakārye ca śubhānnaprāśane tathā || 47 || sarvatra vardhayāmāsa svayameva cakāra ha | dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ matto niśāmaya || 48 || yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktreṇa kauthumoktaṃ ca suvrata | śālagrāme ghaṭe vātha vaṭamūle'thavā mune || 49 || bhittyāṃ puttalikāṃ kṛtvā pūjayedvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | ṣaṣṭhāṃśāṃ prakṛteḥ śuddhāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya ca suprabhām || 50 || suputradāṃ ca śubhadā dayārūpāṃ jagatprasūm | śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 51 || pavitrarūpāṃ paramāṃ devasenāṃ parāṃ bhaje | iti dhyātvā svaśirasi puṣpaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 52 || punardhyātvā ca mūlena pūjayetsuvratāṃ satīm | pādyārghyācamanīyaiśca gandhapuṣpapradīpakaiḥ || 53 || naivedyairvividhaiścāpi phalena śobhanena ca | oṃ hrīṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevyai svāheti vidhipūrvakam || 54 || aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ yathāśakti japennaraḥ | tataḥ stutvā ca praṇamedbhaktiyuktaḥ samāhitaḥ || 55 || stotraṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ varaṃ putraphalapradam | aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ lakṣadhā yo japettataḥ || 56 || suputraṃ sa labhennūnamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ | stotraṃ śṛṇu muniśreṣṭha sarvakāmaśubhāvaham || 57 || vāñchāpradaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ gūḍhaṃ vedeṣu nārada | namo devyai mahādevyai siddhyai śāntyai namo namaḥ || 58 || śubhāyai devasenāyai ṣaṣṭhyai devyai namo namaḥ | varadāyai putradāyai dhanadāyai namo namaḥ || 59 || sukhadāyai mokṣadāyai ṣaṣṭhyai devyai namo namaḥ | sṛṣṭyai ṣaṣṭhāṃśarūpāyai siddhāyai ca namo namaḥ || 60 || māyāyai siddhayoginyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ | sārāyai śāradāyai ca parādevyai namo namaḥ || 61 ||
