bālādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ | kalyāṇadāyai kalyāṇyai phaladāyai ca karmaṇām || 62 || pratyakṣāyai svabhaktānāṃ ṣaṣṭhyai devyai namo namaḥ | pūjyāyai skandakāntāyai sarveṣāṃ sarvakarmasu || 63 || devarakṣaṇakāriṇyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ | śuddhasattvasvarūpāyai vanditāyai nṛṇāṃ sadā || 64 || hiṃsākrodhavarjitāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ | dhanaṃ dehi priyāṃ dehi putraṃ dehi sureśvari || 65 || mānaṃ dehi jayaṃ dehi dviṣo jahi maheśvari | dharmaṃ dehi yaśo dehi ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ || 66 || dehi bhūmiṃ prajāṃ dehi vidyāṃ dehi supūjite | kalyāṇaṃ ca jayaṃ dehi ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ || 67 || iti devīṃ ca saṃstūya lebhe putraṃ priyavrataḥ | yaśasvinaṃ ca rājendraḥ ṣaṣṭhīdevyāḥ prasādataḥ || 68 || ṣaṣṭhīstotramidaṃ brahman yaḥ śṛṇoti tu vatsaram | aputro labhate putraṃ varaṃ sucirajīvinam || 69 || varṣamekaṃ ca yo bhaktyā sampūjyedaṃ śṛṇoti ca | sarvapāpādvinirmukto mahāvandhyā prasūyate || 70 || vīraṃ putraṃ ca guṇinaṃ vidyāvantaṃ yaśasvinam | sucirāyuṣyavantaṃ ca sūte devīprasādataḥ || 71 || kākavandhyā ca yā nārī mṛtavatsā ca yā bhavet | varṣaṃ śrutvā labhetputraṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥ || 72 || rogayukte ca bāle ca pitā mātā śṛṇoti cet | māsena mucyate bālaḥ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥ || 73 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde ṣaṣṭhyupākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 || <9.47> maṅgalacaṇḍīmanasayorupākhyānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca kathitaṃ ṣaṣṭhyupākhyānaṃ brahmaputra yathā''gamam | devī maṅgalacaṇḍī ca tadākhyānaṃ niśāmaya || 1 || tasyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ dharmavaktreṇa yacchrutam | śrutisammatameveṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ viduṣāmapi || 2 || dakṣā yā vartate caṇḍī kalyāṇeṣu ca maṅgalā | maṅgaleṣu ca yā dakṣā sā ca maṅgalacaṇḍikā || 3 || pūjyā yā vartate caṇḍī maṅgalo'pi mahīsutaḥ | maṅgalābhīṣṭadevī yā sā vā maṅgalacaṇḍikā || 4 || maṅgalo manuvaṃśyaśca saptadvīpadharāpatiḥ | tasya pūjyābhīṣṭadevī tena maṅgalacaṇḍikā || 5 || mūrtibhedena sā durgā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī | kṛpārūpātipratyakṣā yoṣitāmiṣṭadevatā || 6 || prathame pūjitā sā ca śaṅkareṇa parātparā | tripurasya vadhe ghore viṣṇunā preritena ca || 7 || brahman brahmopadeśena durgatena ca saṅkaṭe | ākāśātpatite yāne daityena pātite ruṣā || 8 || brahmaviṣṇūpadiṣṭaśca durgāṃ tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraḥ | sā ca maṅgalacaṇḍī yā babhūva rūpabhedataḥ || 9 || uvāca purataḥ śambhorbhayaṃ nāstīti te prabho | bhagavānvṛṣarūpaśca sarveśaste bhaviṣyati || 10 || yuddhaśaktisvarūpāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | māyātmanā ca hariṇā sahāyena vṛṣadhvaja || 11 || jahi daityaṃ svaśatruṃ ca surāṇāṃ padaghātakam | ityuktvāntarhitā devī śambhoḥ śaktirbabhūva sā || 12 || viṣṇudattena śastreṇa jaghāna tamumāpatiḥ | munīndra patite daitye sarve devā maharṣayaḥ || 13 || tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ | sadyaḥ śirasi śambhośca puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha || 14 || brahmā viṣṇuśca santuṣṭo dadau tasmai śubhāśiṣam | brahmaviṣṇūpadiṣṭaśca susnātaḥ śaṅkarastathā || 15 || pūjayāmāsa tāṃ bhaktyā devīṃ maṅgalacaṇḍikām | pādyārghyācamanīyaiśca vastraiśca vividhairapi || 16 || puṣpacandananaivedyairbhaktyā nānāvidhairmune | chāgairmeṣaiśca mahiṣairgavayaiḥ pakṣibhistathā || 17 || vastrālaṅkāramālyaiśca pāyasaiḥ piṣṭakairapi | madhubhiśca sudhābhiśca phalairnānāvidhairapi || 18 || saṅgītairnartakairvādyairutsavairnāmakīrtanaiḥ | dhyātvā mādhyandinoktena dhyānena bhaktipūrvakam || 19 || dadau dravyāṇi mūlena mantreṇaiva ca nārada | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ sarvapūjye devi maṅgalacaṇḍike || 20 || hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ svāhāpyekaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ | pūjyaḥ kalpataruścaiva bhaktānāṃ sarvakāmadaḥ || 21 || daśalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhaved dhruvam | dhyānaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ brahman vedoktaṃ sarvasammatam || 22 || devīṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām | bimboṣṭhīṃ sudatīṃ śuddhāṃ śaratpadmanibhānanām || 23 || śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ sunīlotpalalocanām | jagaddhātrīṃ ca dātrīṃ ca sarvebhyaḥ sarvasampadām || 24 || saṃsārasāgare ghore jyotīrūpāṃ sadā bhaje | devyāśca dhyānamityevaṃ stavanaṃ śrūyatāṃ mune || 25 || mahādeva uvāca rakṣa rakṣa jaganmātardevi maṅgalacaṇḍike | hārike vipadāṃ rāśerharṣamaṅgalakārike || 26 || harṣamaṅgaladakṣe ca harṣamaṅgaladāyike | śubhe maṅgaladakṣe ca śubhe maṅgalacaṇḍike || 27 || maṅgale maṅgalārhe ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgale | satāṃ maṅgade devi sarveṣāṃ maṅgalālaye || 28 || pūjye maṅgalavāre ca maṅgalābhīṣṭadevate | pūjye maṅgalabhūpasya manuvaṃśasya santatam || 29 || maṅgalādhiṣṭhātṛdevi maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgale | saṃsāramaṅgalādhāre mokṣamaṅgaladāyini || 30 || sāre ca maṅgalādhāre pāre ca sarvakarmaṇām | pratimaṅgalavāre ca pūjye maṅgasukhaprade || 31 || stotreṇānena śambhuśca stutvā maṅgalacaṇḍikām | pratimaṅgalavāre ca pūjāṃ dattvā gataḥ śivaḥ || 32 || prathame pūjitā devī śivena sarvamaṅgalā | dvitīye pūjitā sā ca maṅgalena graheṇa ca || 33 || tṛtīte pūjitā bhadrā maṅgalena nṛpeṇa ca | caturthe maṅgale vāre sundarībhiḥ prapūjitā || 34 || pañcame maṅgalākāṅkṣinarairmaṅgalacaṇḍikā | pūjitā prativiśveṣu viśveśapūjitā sadā || 35 || tataḥ sarvatra sampūjyā babhūva parameśvarī | devaiśca munibhiścaiva mānavairmanubhirmune || 36 || devyāśca maṅgastotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ | tanmaṅgalaṃ bhavettasya na bhavettadamaṅgalam | vardhate putrapautraiśca maṅgalaṃ ca dine dine || 37 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca uktaṃ dvayorupākhyānaṃ brahmaputra yathāgamam | śrūyatāṃ manasā''khyānaṃ yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrataḥ || 38 || sā ca kanyā bhagavatī kaśyapasya ca mānasī | tenaiva manasā devī manasā yā ca dīvyati || 39 || manasā dhyāyate yā ca paramātmānamīśvaram | tena sā manasā devī tena yogena dīvyati || 40 || ātmārāmā ca sā devī vaiṣṇavī siddhayoginī | triyugaṃ ca tapastaptvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 41 || jaratkāruśarīraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yatkṣīṇamīśvaraḥ | gopīpatirnāma cakre jaratkāruriti prabhuḥ || 42 || vāñchitaṃ ca dadau tasyai kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ | pūjāṃ ca kārayāmāsa cakāra ca svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 43 || svarge ca nāgaloke ca pṛthivyāṃ brahmalokataḥ | bhṛśaṃ jagatsu gaurī sā sundarī ca manoharā | 44 jagadgaurīti vikhyātā tena sā pūjitā satī | śivaśiṣyā ca sā devī tena śaivī prakīrtitā || 45 || viṣṇubhaktātīva śaśvadvaiṣṇavī tena kīrtitā | nāgānāṃ prāṇarakṣitrī yajñe pārīkṣitasya ca || 46 || nāgeśvarīti vikhyātā sā nāgabhaginīti ca | viṣaṃ saṃhartumīśā yā tena viṣaharī smṛtā || 47 || siddhayogaṃ harātprāpa tena sā siddhayoginī | mahājñānaṃ ca yogaṃ ca mṛtasajjīvanīṃ parām || 48 || mahājñānayutāṃ tāṃ ca pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | āstīkasya munīndrasya mātā sāpi tapasvinī || 49 || āstīkamātā vijñātā jagatyāṃ supratiṣṭhitā | priyā munerjaratkārormunīndrasya mahātmanaḥ || 50 || yogino viśvapūjyasya jaratkārupriyā tataḥ | jaratkārurjagadgaurī manasā siddhayoginī || 51 || vaiṣṇavī nāgabhaginī śaivī nāgeśvarī tathā | jaratkārupriyāstīkamātā viṣahareti ca || 52 || mahājñānayutā caiva sā devī viśvapūjitā | dvādaśaitāni nāmāni pūjākāle tu yaḥ paṭhet || 53 || tasya nāgabhayaṃ nāsti tasya vaṃśodbhavasya ca | nāgabhīte ca śayane nāgagraste ca mandire || 54 || nāgaśobhe mahādurge nāgaveṣṭitavigrahe | idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 55 || nityaṃ paṭhedyastaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāgavargaḥ palāyate | daśalakṣajapenaiva stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām || 56 || stotrasiddhirbhavedyasya sa viṣaṃ bhoktumīśvaraḥ | nāgaiśca bhūṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sa bhavennāgavāhanaḥ || 57 || nāgāsano nāgatalpo mahāsiddho bhavennaraḥ | ante ca viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ krīḍatyeva divāniśam || 58 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde maṅgalacaṇḍīmanasayorupākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 || <9.48> manasopākhyānavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca mattaḥ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ munipuṅgava | dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ proktaṃ devīvidhānakam || 1 || śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm || 2 || mahājñānayutāṃ tāṃ ca pravarajñānināṃ varām | siddhādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca siddhāṃ siddhipradāṃ bhaje || 3 || iti dhyātvā ca tāṃ devīṃ mūlenaiva prapūjayet | naivedyairvividhairdhūpaiḥ puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ || 4 || mūlamantraiśca vedoktairbhaktānāṃ vācchitapradaḥ | mune kalpatarurnāma susiddho dvādaśākṣaraḥ || 5 || oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ manasādevyai svāheti kīrtitaḥ | pañcalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām || 6 || mantrasiddhirbhavedyasya sa siddho jagatītale | sudhāsamaṃ viṣaṃ tasya dhanvantarisamo bhavet || 7 || brahmansnātvā tu saṅkrāntyāṃ gūḍhaśālāsu yatnataḥ | āvāhya devīmīśānāṃ pūjayedyo'tibhaktitaḥ || 8 || pañcamyāṃ manasā dhyāyan devyai dadyācca yo balim | dhanavānputravāṃścaiva kīrtimānsa bhaved dhruvam || 9 || pūjāvidhānaṃ kathitaṃ tadākhyānaṃ niśāmaya | kathayāmi mahābhāga yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrataḥ || 10 || purā nāgabhayākrāntā babhūvurmānavā bhuvi | gatāste śaraṇaṃ sarve kaśyapaṃ munipuṅgavam || 11 || mantrāṃśca sasṛje bhītaḥ kaśyapo brahmaṇānvitaḥ | vedabījānusāreṇa copadeśena brahmaṇaḥ || 12 || mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ tāṃ manasā sasṛje tathā | tapasā manasā tena babhūva manasā ca sā || 13 || kumārī sā ca sambhūtā jagāma śaṅkarālayam | bhaktyā sampūjya kailāse tuṣṭāva candraśekharam || 14 || divyavarṣasahasraṃ taṃ siṣeve ca muneḥ sutā | āśutoṣo maheśaśca tāṃ ca tuṣṭo babhūva ha || 15 || mahājñānaṃ dadau tasyai pāṭhayāmāsa sāma ca | kṛṣṇamantraṃ kalpataruṃ dadāvaṣṭākṣaraṃ mune || 16 || lakṣmīmāyākāmabījaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ tataḥ | trailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ pūjanakramam || 17 || puraścaryākramaṃ cāpi vedoktaṃ sarvasammatam | prāpya mṛtyuñjayānmantraṃ sā satī ca muneḥ sutā || 18 || jagāma tapase sādhvī puṣkaraṃ śaṅkarājñayā | triyugaṃ ca tapastaptvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || 19 || siddhā babhūva sā devī dadarśa purataḥ prabhum | dṛṣṭvā kṛśāṅgīṃ bālāṃ ca kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ || 20 || pūjāṃ ca kārayāmāsa cakāra ca svayaṃ hariḥ | varaṃ ca pradadau tasyai pūjitā tvaṃ bhave bhava || 21 || varaṃ dattvā tu kalyāṇyai tataścāntardadhe hariḥ | prathame pūjitā sā ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā || 22 || dvitīye śaṅkareṇaiva kaśyapena sureṇa ca | muninā manunā caiva nāgena mānavādibhiḥ || 23 || babhūva pūjitā sā ca triṣu lokeṣu suvratā | jaratkārumunīndrāya kaśyapastāṃ dadau purā || 24 || ayācito muniśreṣṭho jagrāha brāhmaṇājñayā | kṛtvodvāhaṃ mahāyogī viśrāntastapasā ciram || 25 || suṣvāpa devyā jaghane vaṭamūle ca puṣkare | nidrāṃ jagāma sa muniḥ smṛtvā nidreśamīśvaram || 26 || jagāmāstaṃ dinakaraḥ sāyaṅkāla upasthite | sañcintya manasā sādhvī manasā sā pativratā || 27 || dharmalopabhayenaiva cakārālocanaṃ satī | akṛtvā paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ nityāṃ caiva dvijanmanām || 28 || brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ labhiṣyati patirmama | nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yastu paścimām || 29 || sa sarvatrāśucirnityaṃ brahmahatyādikaṃ labhet | vedoktamiti sañcintya bodhayāmāsa sundarī || 30 || sa ca buddho muniśreṣṭhastāṃ cukopa bhṛśaṃ mune | muniruvāca kathaṃ me sukhinaḥ sādhvi nidrābhaṅgaḥ kṛtastvayā || 31 || vyarthaṃ vratādikaṃ tasyā yā bhartuścāpakāriṇī | tapaścānaśanaṃ caiva vrataṃ dānādikaṃ ca yat || 32 || bharturapriyakāriṇyāḥ sarvaṃ bhavati niṣkalam | yayā priyaḥ pūjitaśca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pūjitastayā || 33 || pativratāvratārthañca patirūpo hariḥ svayam | sarvadānaṃ sarvayajñaḥ sarvatīrthaniṣevaṇam || 34 || sarvaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ sarvamupavāsādikaṃ ca yat | sarvadharmaśca satyaṃ ca sarvadevaprapūjanam || 35 || tatsarvaṃ svāmisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm | puṇye ca bhārate varṣe patisevā karoti yā || 36 || vaikuṇṭhe svāminā sārdhaṃ sā yāti brahmaṇaḥ padam | vipriyaṃ kurute bharturvipriyaṃ vadati priyam || 37 || asatkule prasūtā hi tatphalaṃ śrūyatāṃ sati | kumbhīpākaṃ vrajetsā ca yāvaccandradivākarau || 38 || tato bhavati cāṇḍālī patiputravivarjitā | ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho babhūva sphuritādharaḥ || 39 || cakampe tena sā sādhvī bhayenovāca taṃ patim | sādhvyuvāca sandhyālopabhayenaiva nidrābhaṅgaḥ kṛtastava || 40 || kuru śāntiṃ mahābhāga duṣṭāyā mama suvrata | śṛṅgārāhāranidrāṇāṃ yaśca bhaṅgaṃ karoti vai || 41 || sa vrajetkālasūtraṃ vai yāvaccandradivākarau | ityuktvā manasā devī svāminaścaraṇāmbuje || 42 || papāta bhaktyā bhītā ca ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ | kupitaṃ ca muniṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīsūryaṃ śaptumudyatam || 43 || tatrājagāma bhagavānsandhyayā saha nārada | tatrāgatya muniṃ samyaguvāca bhāskaraḥ svayam || 44 || vinayena ca bhītaśca tayā saha yathocitam | bhāskara uvāca sūryāstasamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhvī dharmabhayena ca || 45 || bodhayāmāsa tvāṃ vipra śaraṇaṃ tvāmahaṃ gataḥ | kṣamasva bhagavanbrahman māṃ śaptuṃ nocitaṃ mune || 46 || brāhmaṇānāṃ ca hṛdayaṃ navanītasamaṃ sadā | teṣāṃ kṣaṇārdhaṃ krodhaśca tato bhasma bhavejjagat || 47 || punaḥ sraṣṭuṃ dvijaḥ śakto na tejasvī dvijātparaḥ | brāhmaṇo brahmaṇo vaṃśaḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā || 48 || śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam | sūryasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dvijastuṣṭo babhūva ha || 49 || sūryo jagāma svasthānaṃ gṛhītvā brāhmaṇāśiṣam | tatyāja manasāṃ vipraḥ pratijñāpālanāya ca || 50 || rudatīṃ śokasaṃyuktāṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā | sā sasmāra guruṃ śambhumiṣṭadevaṃ vidhiṃ harim || 51 || kaśyapaṃ janmadātāraṃ vipattau bhayakarśitā | tatrājagāma gopīśo bhagavācchambhureva ca || 52 || vidhiśca kaśyapaścaiva manasā paricintitaḥ | dṛṣṭvā vipro'bhīṣṭadevaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param || 53 || tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ | namaścakāra śambhuṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ kaśyapaṃ tathā || 54 || kathamāgamanaṃ devā iti praśnaṃ cakāra saḥ | brahmā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sahasā samayocitam || 55 || pratyuvāca namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśapadāmbujam | yadi tyaktā dharmapatnī dharmiṣṭhā manasā satī || 56 || kuruṣvāsyāṃ sutotpattiṃ svadharmapālanāya vai | jāyāyāṃ ca sutotpattiṃ kṛtvā paścāttyajenmune || 57 || akṛtvā tu sutotpattiṃ virāgī yastyajetpriyām | sravate tasya puṇyaṃ ca cālanyāṃ ca yathā jalam || 58 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā jaratkārurmunīśvaraḥ | cakāra nābhisaṃsparśaṃ yogena mantrapūrvakam || 59 || manasāyā muniśreṣṭha muniśreṣṭha uvāca tām | jaratkāruruvāca garbheṇānena manase tava putro bhaviṣyati || 60 || jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaro dhārmiko brāhmaṇāgraṇīḥ | tejasvī ca tapasvī ca yaśasvī ca guṇānvitaḥ || 61 || varo vedavidāṃ caiva jñānināṃ yogināṃ tathā | sa ca putro viṣṇubhakto dhārmikaḥ kulamuddharet || 62 || nṛtyanti pitaraḥ sarve janmamātreṇa vai mudā | pativratā suśīlā yā sā priyā priyavādinī || 63 || dharmiṣṭhā putramātā ca kulastrī kulapālikā | haribhaktiprado bandhurna cābhīṣṭasukhapradaḥ || 64 || yo bandhuścetsa ca pitā harivartmapradarśakaḥ | sā garbhadhāriṇī yā ca garbhāvāsavimocanī || 65 || dayārūpā ca bhaginī yamabhītivimocanī | viṣṇumantrapradātā ca sa gururviṣṇubhaktidaḥ || 66 || guruśca jñānado yo hi yajjñānaṃ kṛṣṇabhāvanam | ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ tato viśvaṃ carācaram || 67 || āvirbhūtaṃ tirobhūtaṃ kiṃ vā jñānaṃ tadanyataḥ | vedajaṃ yajñajaṃ yadyattatsāraṃ harisevanam || 68 || tattvānāṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca hareranyadviḍambanam | dattaṃ jñānaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ sa svāmī jñānado hi yaḥ || 69 || jñānātpramucyate bandhātsa ripuryo hi bandhadaḥ | viṣṇubhaktiyutaṃ jñānaṃ no dadāti ca yo guruḥ || 70 || sa ripuḥ śiṣyaghātī ca yato bandhānna mocayet | jananīṃ garbhajakleśādyamayātanayā tathā || 71 || na mocayedyaḥ sa kathaṃ gurustāto hi bāndhavaḥ | paramānandarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇamārgamanaśvaram || 72 || na darśayedyaḥ satataṃ kīdṛśo bāndhavo nṛṇām | bhaja sādhvi paraṃ brahmācyutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca nirguṇam || 73 || nirmūlaṃ ca bhavetpuṃsāṃ karma vai tasya sevayā | mayā chalena tvaṃ tyaktā kṣamasvaitanmama priye || 74 || kṣamāyutānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ sattvātkrodho na vidyate | puṣkare tapase yāmi gaccha devi yathāsukham || 75 || śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje niḥspṛhāṇāṃ manorathāḥ | jaratkāruvacaḥ śrutvā manasā śokakātarā || 76 || sāśrunetrā ca vinayāduvāca prāṇavallabham | manasovāca doṣo nāstyeva me tyaktuṃ nidrābhaṅgena te prabho || 77 || yatra smarāmi tvāṃ nityaṃ tatra māmāgamiṣyasi | bandhubhedaḥ kleśatamaḥ putrabhedastataḥ param || 78 || prāṇeśabhedaḥ prāṇānāṃ vicchedātsarvataḥ paraḥ | patiḥ pativratānāṃ tu śataputrādhikaṃ priyaḥ || 79 || sarvasmāttu priyaḥ strīṇāṃ priyastenocyate budhaiḥ | putre yathaikaputrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā harau || 80 || netre yathaikanetrāṇāṃ tṛṣitānāṃ yathā jale | kṣudhitānāṃ yathānne ca kāmukānāṃ ca maithune || 81 || yathā parasve caurāṇāṃ yathā jāre kuyoṣitām | viduṣāṃ ca yathā śāstre vāṇijye vaṇijāṃ yathā || 82 || tathā śaśvanmanaḥ kānte sādhvīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ prabho | ityuktvā manasā devī papāta svāminaḥ pade || 83 || kṣaṇaṃ cakāra kroḍe tāṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ | netrodakena manasāṃ snāpayāmāsa tāṃ muniḥ || 84 || sāśru netrā muneḥ kroḍaṃ siṣeca bhedakātarā | tadā jñānena tau dvau ca viśokau sambabhūvatuḥ || 85 || smāraṃ smāraṃ padāmbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ | jagāma tapase vipraḥ svakāntāṃ samprabodhya ca || 86 || jagāma manasā śambhoḥ kailāsaṃ mandiraṃ guroḥ | pārvatī bodhayāmāsa manasāṃ śokakarśitām || 87 || śivaścātīva jñānena śivena ca śivālayaḥ | supraśaste dine sādhvī suṣuve maṅgalakṣaṇe || 88 || nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ putraṃ taṃ yogināṃ jñānināṃ gurum | garbhasthito mahājñānaṃ śrutvā śaṅkaravaktrataḥ || 89 || sambabhūva ca yogīndro yogināṃ jñānināṃ guruḥ | jātakaṃ kārayāmāsa vācayāmāsa maṅgalam || 90 || vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa śivāya ca śivaḥ śiśoḥ | maṇiratnakirīṭāṃśca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau śivaḥ || 91 || pārvatī ca gavāṃ lakṣaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca | śambhuśca caturo vedānvedāṅgānitarāṃstathā || 92 || bālakaṃ pāṭhayāmāsa jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ param | bhaktirastyadhikā kānte'bhīṣṭadeve gurau tathā || 93 || yasyāstena ca tatputro babhūvāstīka eva ca | jagāma tapase viṣṇoḥ puṣkaraṃ śaṅkarājñayā || 94 || samprāpya ca mahāmantraṃ tataśca paramātmanaḥ | divyaṃ varṣatrilakṣaṃ ca tapastaptvā tapodhanaḥ || 95 || ājagāma mahāyogī namaskartuṃ śivaṃ prabhum | śaṅkaraṃ ca namaskṛtya sthitvā tatraiva bālakaḥ || 96 || sā cājagāma manasā kaśyapasyāśramaṃ pituḥ | tāṃ saputrāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā mudaṃ prāpa prajāpatiḥ || 97 || śatalakṣaṃ ca ratnānāṃ bāhmaṇebhyo dadau mune | brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa so'saṃkhyān śreyase śiśoḥ || 98 || aditiśca ditiścānyā mudaṃ prāpa parantapa | sā saputrā ca suciraṃ tasthau tātālaye sadā || 99 || tadīyaṃ punarākhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tanniśāmaya | athābhimanyutanaye brahmaśāpaḥ parīkṣite || 100 || babhūva sahasā brahman daivadoṣeṇa karmaṇā | saptāhe samatīte tu takṣakastvāṃ ca dhakṣyati || 101 || śaśāpa śṛṅgī tatraiva kauśikyāśca jalena vai | rājā śrutvā tatpravṛttiṃ nirvātasthānamāgataḥ || 102 || tatra tasthau ca saptāhaṃ deharakṣaṇatatparaḥ | saptāhe samatīte tu gacchantaṃ takṣakaṃ pathi || 103 || dhanvantarirnṛpaṃ bhoktuṃ dadarśa gāmukaḥ pathi | tayorbabhūva saṃvādaḥ suprītiśca parasparam || 104 || dhanvantarirmaṇiṃ prāpa takṣakaḥ svecchayā dadau | sa yayau taṃ gṛhītvā tu santuṣṭo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 105 || takṣako bhakṣayāmāsa nṛpaṃ taṃ mañcake sthitam | rājā jagāma tarasā dehaṃ tyaktvā paratra ca || 106 || saṃskāraṃ kārayāmāsa piturvai janamejayaḥ | rājā cakāra yajñaṃ ca sarpasatraṃ tato mune || 107 || prāṇāṃstatyāja sarpāṇāṃ samūho brahmatejasā | sa takṣako vai bhītastu mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || 108 || sendraṃ ca takṣakaṃ hantuṃ vipravargaḥ samudyataḥ | atha devāśca sendrāśca sañjagmurmanasāntikam || 109 || tāṃ tuṣṭāva mahendraśca bhayakātaravihvalaḥ | tata āstīka āgatya yajñaṃ ca māturājñayā || 110 || mahendratakṣakaprāṇānyayāce bhūmipaṃ param | dadau varaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpayā brāhmaṇājñayā || 111 || yajñaṃ samāpya viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadau mudā | viprāśca munayo devā gatvā ca manasāntikam || 112 || manasāṃ pūjayāmāsustuṣṭuvuśca pṛthak pṛthak | śakraḥ sambhṛtasambhāro bhaktiyuktaḥ sadā śuciḥ || 113 || manasāṃ pūjayāmāsa tuṣṭāva paramādarāt | natvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ baliṃ ca tatpriyaṃ tadā || 114 || pradadau parituṣṭaśca brahmaviṣṇuśivājñayā | sampūjya manasāṃ devīṃ prayayuḥ svālayaṃ ca te || 115 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi | nārada uvāca kena stotreṇa tuṣṭāva mahendro manasāṃ satīm || 116 || pūjāvidhikramaṃ tasyāḥ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ | śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca susnātaḥ śucirācānto dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī || 117 || ratnasiṃhāsane devīṃ vāsayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ | svargaṅgāyā jalenaiva ratnakumbhasthitena ca || 118 || snāpayāmāsa manasāṃ mahendro vedamantrataḥ | vāsasī vāsayāmāsa vahmiśuddhe manohare || 119 || sarvāṅge candanaṃ kṛtvā pādārghyaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ | gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām || 120 || sampūjyādau devaṣaṭkaṃ pūjayāmāsa tāṃ satīm | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ manasādevyai svāhetyevaṃ ca mantrataḥ || 121 || daśākṣareṇa mūlena dadau sarvaṃ yathocitam | dattvā ṣoḍaśopacārāndurlabhāndevanāyakaḥ || 122 || pūjayāmāsa bhaktyā ca viṣṇunā prerito mudā | vādyaṃ nānāprakāraṃ ca vādayāmāsa tatra vai || 123 || babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca nabhaso manasopari | devapriyājñayā tatra bahmaviṣṇuśivājñayā || 124 || tuṣṭāva sāśrunetraśca pulakāṅkitavigrahaḥ | purandara uvāca devi tvāṃ stotumicchāmi sādhvīnāṃ pravarāṃ varām || 125 || parātparāṃ ca paramāṃ na hi stotuṃ kṣamo'dhunā | stotrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vede svabhāvākhyānatatparam || 126 || na kṣamaḥ prakṛte vaktuṃ guṇānāṃ gaṇanāṃ tava | śuddhasattvasvarūpā tvaṃ kopahiṃsādivarjitā || 127 || na ca śakto munistena tyaktuṃ yāñcā kṛtā yataḥ | tvaṃ mayā pūjitā sādhvī jananī me yathāditiḥ || 128 || dayārūpā ca bhaginī kṣamārūpā yathā prasūḥ | tvayā me rakṣitāḥ prāṇāḥ putradārāḥ sureśvari || 129 || ahaṃ karomi tvatpūjāṃ prītiśca vardhatāṃ sadā | nityā yadyapi pūjyā tvaṃ sarvatra jagadambike || 130 || tathāpi tava pūjāṃ ca vardhayāmi sureśvari | ye tvāmāṣāḍhasaṅkrāntyāṃ pūjayiṣyanti bhaktitaḥ || 131 || pañcamyāṃ manasākhyāyāṃ māsānte vā dine dine | putrapautrādayasteṣāṃ vardhante ca dhanāni vai || 132 || yaśasvinaḥ kīrtimanto vidyāvanto guṇānvitāḥ | ye tvāṃ na pūjayiṣyanti nindantyajñānato janāḥ || 133 || lakṣmīhīnā bhaviṣyanti teṣāṃ nāgabhayaṃ sadā | tvaṃ svayaṃ sarvalakṣmīśca vaikuṇṭhe kamalālayā || 134 || nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavāñjaratkārurmunīśvaraḥ | tapasā tejasā tvāṃ ca manasā sasṛje pitā || 135 || asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāyaiva tena tvaṃ manasābhidhā | manasādevi śaktyā tvaṃ svātmanā siddhayoginī || 136 || tena tvaṃ manasādevī pūjitā vanditā bhava | ye bhaktyā manasāṃ devāḥ pūjayantyaniśaṃ bhṛśam || 137 || tena tvāṃ manasāṃ devīṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | satyasvarūpā devi tvaṃ śaśvatsatyaniṣevaṇāt || 138 || yo hi tvāṃ bhāvayennityaṃ sa tvāṃ prāpnoti tatparaḥ | indraśca manasāṃ stutvā gṛhītvā bhaginīvaram || 139 || prajagāma svabhavanaṃ bhūṣayā saparicchadam | putreṇa sārdhaṃ sā devī ciraṃ tasthau piturgṛhe || 140 || bhrātṛbhiḥ pūjitā śaśvanmānyā vandyā ca sarvataḥ | golokātsurabhirbrahman tatrāgatya supūjitām || 141 || tāṃ snāpayitvā kṣīreṇa pūjayāmāsa sādaram | jñānaṃ ca kathayāmāsa gopyaṃ sarvaṃ sudurlabham || 142 || tayā devaiḥ pūjitā sā svarlokaṃ ca punaryayau | indrastotraṃ puṇyabījaṃ manasāṃ pūjayetpaṭhet || 143 || tasya nāgabhayaṃ nāsti tasya vaṃśodbhavasya ca | viṣaṃ bhavetsudhātulyaṃ siddhastotro yadā bhavet || 144 || pañcalakṣajapenaiva siddhastotro bhavennaraḥ | sarpaśāyī bhavetso'pi niścitaṃ sarpavāhanaḥ || 145 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe manasopākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 || <9.49> surabhyupākhyānavarṇanam nārada uvāca kā vā sā surabhirdevī golokādāgatā ca yā | tajjanmacaritaṃ brahmañchrotumicchāmi yatnataḥ || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇāya uvāca gavāmadhiṣṭhātṛdevī gavāmādyā gavāṃ prasūḥ | gavāṃ pradhānā surabhirgoloke sā samudbhavā || 2 || sarvādisṛṣṭeścaritaṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya | babhūva tena tajjanma purā vṛndāvane vane || 3 || ekadā rādhikānātho rādhayā saha kautukī | gopāṅganāparivṛtaḥ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau || 4 || sahasā tatra rahasi vijahāra sa kautukāt | babhūva kṣīrapānecchā tasya svecchāmayasya ca || 5 || sasṛje surabhiṃ devīṃ līlayā vāmapārśvataḥ | vatsayuktāṃ dugdhavatīṃ vatso nāma manorathaḥ || 6 || dṛṣṭvā savatsāṃ śrīdāmā navabhāṇḍe dudoha ca | kṣīraṃ sudhātiriktaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāharam || 7 || tadutthaṃ ca payaḥ svādu papau gopīpatiḥ svayam | saro babhūva payasāṃ bhāṇḍavisraṃsanena ca || 8 || dīrghaṃ ca vistṛtaṃ caiva paritaḥ śatayojanam | goloke'yaṃ prasiddhaśca so'pi kṣīrasarovaraḥ || 9 || gopikānāṃ ca rādhāyāḥ krīḍāvāpī babhūva sā | ratnendraracitā pūrṇaṃ bhūtā cāpīśvarecchayā || 10 || babhūva kāmadhenūnāṃ sahasā lakṣakoṭayaḥ | yāvantastatra gopāśca surabhyā lomakūpataḥ || 11 || tāsāṃ putrāśca bahavaḥ sambabhūvurasaṃkhyakāḥ | kathitā ca gavāṃ sṛṣṭistayā ca pūritaṃ jagat || 12 || pūjāṃ cakāra bhagavān surabhyāśca purā mune | tato babhūva tatpūjā triṣu lokeṣu durlabhā || 13 || dīpānvitāparadine śrīkṛṣṇasyājñayā hareḥ | babhūva surabhiḥ pūjyā dharmavaktrādidaṃ śrutam || 14 || dhyānaṃ stotraṃ mūlamantraṃ yadyatyūjāvidhikramam | vedoktaṃ ca mahābhāga nibodha kathayāmi te || 15 || oṃ surabhyai nama iti mantrastasyāḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | siddho lakṣajapenaiva bhaktānāṃ kalpapādapaḥ || 16 || dhyānaṃ yajurvedagītaṃ tasyāḥ pūjā ca sarvataḥ | ṛddhidā vṛddhidā caiva muktidā sarvakāmadā || 17 || lakṣmīsvarūpāṃ paramāṃ rādhāsahacarīṃ parām | gavāmadhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ gavāmādyāṃ gavāṃ prasūm || 18 || pavitrarūpāṃ pūtāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ sarvakāmadām | yayā pūtaṃ sarvaviśvaṃ tāṃ devīṃ surabhiṃ bhaje || 19 || ghaṭe vā dhenuśirasi bandhastambhe gavāmapi | śālagrāme jalāgnau vā surabhiṃ pūjayed dvijaḥ || 20 || dīpānvitāparadine pūrvāhne bhaktisaṃyutaḥ | yaḥ pūjayecca surabhiṃ sa ca pūjyo bhavedbhuvi || 21 || ekadā triṣu lokeṣu vārāhe viṣṇumāyayā | kṣīraṃ jahāra surabhiścintitāśca surādayaḥ || 22 || te gatvā brahmaloke ca brahmāṇaṃ tuṣṭuvustadā | tadājñayā ca surabhiṃ tuṣṭāva pākaśāsanaḥ || 23 || purandara uvāca namo devyai mahādevyai surabhyai ca namo namaḥ | gavāṃ bījasvarūpāyai namaste jagadambike || 24 || namo rādhāpriyāyai ca padmāṃśāyai namo namaḥ | namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca gavāṃ mātre namo namaḥ || 25 || kalpavṛkṣasvarūpāyai sarveṣāṃ satataṃ pare | kṣīradāyai dhanadāyai buddhidāyai namo namaḥ || 26 || śubhāyai ca subhadrāyai gopradāyai namo namaḥ | yaśodāyai kīrtidāyai dharmadāyai namo namaḥ || 27 || stotraśravaṇamātreṇa tuṣṭā hṛṣṭā jagatprasūḥ | āvirbabhūva tatraiva brahmaloke sanātanī || 28 || mahendrāya varaṃ dattvā vāñchitaṃ cāpi durlabham | jagāma sā ca golokaṃ yayurdevādayo gṛham || 29 || babhūva viśvaṃ sahasā dugdhapūrṇaṃ ca nārada | dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ tato yajñastataḥ prītiḥ surasya ca || 30 || idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet | sa gomān dhanavāṃścaiva kīrtimānputravāṃstathā || 31 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ | iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante kṛṣṇamandire || 32 || suciraṃ nivasettatra karoti kṛṣṇasevanam | na punarbhavanaṃ tatra brahmaputro bhavettataḥ || 33 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe surabhyupākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāmekonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 || <9.50> devyā āvaraṇapūjāvidhivarṇanam nārada uvāca śrutaṃ sarvamupākhyānaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ yathātatham | yacchrutvā mucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt || 1 || adhunā śrotumicchāmi rahasyaṃ vedagopitam | rādhāyāścaiva durgāyā vidhānaṃ śruticoditam || 2 || mahimā varṇito'tīva bhavatā parayordvayoḥ | śrutvā taṃ tadgataṃ ceto na kasya syānmunīśvara || 3 || yayoraṃśo jagatsarvaṃ yanniyamyaṃ carācaram | yayorbhaktyā bhavenmuktistadvidhānaṃ vadādhunā || 4 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ śruticoditam | yanna kasyāpi cākhyātaṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam || 5 || śrutvā parasmai no vācyaṃ yato'tīva rahasyakam | mūlaprakṛtirūpiṇyāḥ saṃvido jagadudbhave || 6 || prādurbhūtaṃ śaktiyugmaṃ prāṇabuddhyadhidaivatam | jīvānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ niyantṛprerakaṃ sadā || 7 || tadadhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ virāḍādicarācaram | yāvattayoḥ prasādo na tāvanmokṣo hi durlabhaḥ || 8 || tatastayoḥ prasādārthaṃ nityaṃ seveta taddvayam | tatrādau rādhikāmantraṃ śṛṇu nārada bhaktitaḥ || 9 || brahmaviṣṇvādibhirnityaṃ sevito yaḥ parātparaḥ | śrīrādheti caturthyantaṃ vahnerjāyā tataḥ param || 10 || ṣaḍakṣaro mahāmantro dharmādyarthaprakāśakaḥ | māyābījādikaścāyaṃ vāñchācintāmaṇiḥ smṛtaḥ || 11 || vaktrakoṭisahasraistu jihvākoṭiśatairapi | etanmantrasya māhātmyaṃ varṇituṃ naiva śakyate || 12 || jagrāha prathamaṃ mantraṃ śrīkṛṣṇo bhaktitatparaḥ | upadeśānmūladevyā goloke rāsamaṇḍale || 13 || viṣṇustenopadiṣṭastu tena brahmā virāṭ tathā | tena dharmastena cāhamityeṣā hi paramparā || 14 || ahaṃ japāmi taṃ mantraṃ tenāhamṛṣirīḍitaḥ | brahmādyāḥ sakalā devā nityaṃ dhyāyanti tāṃ mudā || 15 || kṛṣṇārcāyāṃ nādhikāro yato rādhārcanaṃ vinā | vaiṣṇavaiḥ sakalaistasmātkartavyaṃ rādhikārcanam || 16 || kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī sā tadadhīno vibhuryataḥ | rāseśvarī tasya nityaṃ tayā hīno na tiṣṭhati || 17 || rādhnoti sakalānkāmāṃstasmādrādheti kīrtitā | atroktānāṃ manūnāṃ ca ṛṣirasmyahameva ca || 18 || chandaśca devī gāyatrī devatātra ca rādhikā | tāro bījaṃ śaktibījaṃ śaktistu parikīrtitā || 19 || mūlāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni kartavyānītaratra ca | atha dhyāyenmahādevīṃ rādhikāṃ rāsanāyikām || 20 || pūrvoktarītyā tu mune sāmavede vigītayā | śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ śaradindusamānanām || 21 || koṭicandrapratīkāśāṃ śaradambhojalocanām | bimbādharāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ kāñcīyutanitambinīm || 22 || kundapaṅktisamānābhadantapaṅktivirājitām | kṣaumāmbaraparīdhānāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitām || 23 || īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ karikumbhayugastanīm | sadā dvādaśavarṣīyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 24 || śṛṅgārasindhulaharīṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām | mallikāmālatīmālākeśapāśavirājitām || 25 || sukumārāṅgalatikāṃ rāsamaṇḍalamadhyagām | varābhayakarāṃ śāntāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām || 26 || ratnasiṃhāsanāsīnāṃ gopīmaṇḍalanāyikām | kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ vedabodhitāṃ parameśvarīm || 27 || evaṃ dhyātvā tato bāhye śālagrāme ghaṭe'thavā | yantre vāṣṭadale devīṃ pūjayettu vidhānataḥ || 28 || āvāhya devīṃ tatpaścādāsanādi pradīyatām | mūlamantraṃ samuccārya cāsanādīni kalpayet || 29 || pādyaṃ tu pādayordadyānmastake'rghyaṃ samīritam | mukhe tvācamanīyaṃ syāttrivāraṃ mūlavidyayā || 30 || madhuparkaṃ tato dadyādekāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm | tato nayetsnānaśālāṃ tāṃ ca tatraiva bhāvayet || 31 || abhyaṅgādisnānavidhiṃ kalpayitvātha vāsasī | tataśca candanaṃ dadyānnānālaṅkārapūrvakam || 32 || puṣpamālā bahuvidhāstulasīmañjarīyutāḥ | pārijātaprasūnāni śatapatrādikāni ca || 33 || tataḥ kuryātpavitraṃ tatparivārārcanaṃ vibhoḥ | agnīśāsuravāyavyamadhye dikṣvaṅgapūjanam || 34 || kṛtvā paścādaṣṭadale dakṣiṇāvartato'grataḥ | mālāvatīmagradale vahnikoṇe ca mādhavīm || 35 || ratnamālāṃ dakṣiṇe ca nairṛtye tu suśīlakām | paścāddale śaśikalāṃ pūjayenmatimānnaraḥ || 36 || mārute pārijātāṃ cāpyuttare ca parāvatīm | īśānakoṇe sampūjyā sundarī priyakāriṇī || 37 || brāhmyādayastu tadbāhye'pyāśāpālāṃstu bhūpure | vajrādikānyāyudhāni devīmitthaṃ prapūjayet || 38 || tato devīṃ sāvaraṇāṃ gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ | rājopacārasahitaiḥ pūjayenmatimānnaraḥ || 39 || tataḥ stuvīta deveśīṃ stotrairnāmasahasrakaiḥ | sahasrasaṃkhyaṃ ca japaṃ nityaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ || 40 || ya evaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ rādhāṃ rāseśvarīṃ parām | sa bhavedviṣṇutulyastu golokaṃ yāti santatam || 41 || yaḥ kārtikyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ rādhājanmotsava budhaḥ | kurute tasya sānnidhyaṃ dadyādrāseśvarī parā || 42 || kenacitkāraṇenaiva rādhā vṛndāvane vane | vṛṣabhānusutā jātā golokasthāyinī sadā || 43 || atroktānāṃ tu mantrāṇāṃ varṇasaṃkhyāvidhānataḥ | puraścaraṇakarmoktaṃ daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret || 44 || tilaistrisvādusaṃyuktairjuhuyādbhaktibhāvataḥ | nārada uvāca stotraṃ vada mune samyagyena devī prasīdati || 45 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca namaste parameśāni rāsamaṇḍalavāsini | rāseśvari namaste'stu kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikapriye || 46 || namastrailokyajanani prasīda karuṇārṇave | brahmaviṣṇvādibhirdevairvandyamānapadāmbuje || 47 || namaḥ sarasvatīrūpe namaḥ sāvitri śaṅkari | gaṅgāpadmāvatīrūpe ṣaṣṭhi maṅgalacaṇḍike || 48 || namaste tulasīrūpe namo lakṣmīsvarūpiṇi | namo durge bhagavati namaste sarvarūpiṇi || 49 || mūlaprakṛtirūpāṃ tvāṃ bhajāmaḥ karuṇārṇavām | saṃsārasāgarādasmānuddharāmba dayāṃ kuru || 50 || idaṃ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedrādhāṃ smarannaraḥ | na tasya durlabhaṃ kiñcitkadācicca bhaviṣyati || 51 || dehānte ca vasennityaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale | idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ na cākhyeyaṃ tu kasyacit || 52 || adhunā śṛṇu viprendra durgādevyā vidhānakam | yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa palāyante mahāpadaḥ || 53 || enāṃ na bhajate yo hi tādṛṅnāstyeva kutracit | sarvopāsyā sarvamātā śaivī śaktirmahādbhutā || 54 || sarvabuddhyādhidevīyamantaryāmisvarūpiṇī | durgasaṅkaṭahantrīti durgeti prathitā bhuvi || 55 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śaivānāmupāsyeyaṃ ca nityaśaḥ | mūlaprakṛtirūpā sā sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇī || 56 || tasyā navākṣaraṃ mantraṃ vakṣye mantrottamottamam | vāgbhavaṃ śambhuvanitā kāmabījaṃ tataḥ param || 57 || cāmuṇḍāyai padaṃ paścādvicce ityakṣaradvayam | navākṣaro manuḥ prokto bhajatāṃ kalpapādapaḥ || 58 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśānā ṛṣayo'sya prakīrtitāḥ | chandāṃsyuktāni satataṃ gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭubhaḥ || 59 || mahākālī mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatyapi devatāḥ | syādraktadantikābījaṃ durgā ca bhrāmarī tathā || 60 || nandāśākambharīdevyau bhīmā ca śaktayaḥ smṛtāḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyoga udāhṛtaḥ || 61 || ṛṣicchando daivatāni maulau vaktre hṛdi nyaset | stanayoḥ śaktibījāni nyasetsarvārthasiddhaye || 62 || bījatrayaiścaturbhiśca dvābhyāṃ sarveṇa caiva hi | ṣaḍaṅgāni manoḥ kuryājjātiyuktāni deśikaḥ || 63 || śikhāyāṃ locanadvandve śrutināsānaneṣu ca | gude nyasenmantravarṇānsarveṇa vyāpakaṃ caret || 64 || khaḍgacakragadābāṇacāpāni parighaṃ tathā | śūlaṃ bhuśuṇḍīṃ ca śiraḥ śaṅkhaṃ sandadhatīṃ karaiḥ || 65 || mahākālīṃ trinayanāṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | nīlāñjanasamaprakhyāṃ daśapādānanāṃ bhaje || 66 || madhukaiṭabhanāśārthaṃ yāṃ tuṣṭāvāmbujāsanaḥ | evaṃ dhyāyenmahākālīṃ kāmabījasvarūpiṇīm || 67 || akṣamālāṃ ca paraśuṃ gadeṣukuliśāni ca | padmaṃ dhanuṣkuṇḍikāṃ ca daṇḍaṃ śaktimasiṃ tathā || 68 || carmāmbujaṃ tathā ghaṇṭāṃ surāpātraṃ ca śūlakam | pāśaṃ sudarśanaṃ caiva dadhatīmaruṇaprabhām || 69 || raktāmbujāsanagatāṃ māyābījasvarūpiṇīm | mahālakṣmīṃ bhajedevaṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm || 70 || ghaṇṭāśūle halaṃ śaṅkhaṃ musalaṃ ca sudarśanam | dhanurbāṇān hastapadmairdadhānāṃ kundasannibhām || 71 || śumbhādidaityasaṃhartrīṃ vāṇībījasvarūpiṇīm | mahāsarasvatīṃ dhyāyetsaccidānandavigrahām || 72 || yantramasyāḥ śṛṇu prājña tryasraṃ ṣaṭkoṇasaṃyutam | tato'ṣṭadalapadmaṃ ca caturviṃśatipatrakam || 73 || bhūgṛheṇa samāyuktaṃ yantramevaṃ vicintayet | śālagrāme ghaṭe vāpi yantre vā pratimāsu vā || 74 || bāṇaliṅge'thavā sūrye yajeddevīmananyadhīḥ | jayādiśaktisaṃyukte pīṭhe devīṃ prapūjayet || 75 || pūrvakoṇe sarasvatyā sahitaṃ padmajaṃ yajet | śriyā saha hariṃ tatra nairṛte koṇake yajet || 76 || pārvatyā sahitaṃ śambhuṃ vāyukoṇe samarcayet | devyā uttarataḥ pūjyaḥ siṃho vāme mahāsuram || 77 || mahiṣaṃ pūjayedante ṣaṭkoṇeṣu yajetkramāt | nandajāṃ raktadantāṃ ca tathā śākambharīṃ śivām || 78 || durgāṃ bhīmāṃ bhrāmarīṃ ca tato vasudaleṣu ca | brāhmīṃ māheśvarīṃ caiva kaumārīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ tathā || 79 || vārāhīṃ nārasiṃhīṃ ca aindrīṃ cāmuṇḍakāṃ tathā | pūjayecca tataḥ paścāttattvapatreṣu pūrvataḥ || 80 || viṣṇumāyāṃ cetanāṃ ca buddhiṃ nidrāṃ kṣudhāṃ tathā | chāyāṃ śaktiṃ parāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ śāntiṃ jātiṃ ca lajjayā || 81 || kṣāntiṃ śraddhāṃ kīrtilakṣmyau dhṛtiṃ vṛttiṃ śrutiṃ smṛtim | dayāṃ tuṣṭiṃ tataḥ puṣṭiṃ mātṛbhrāntī iti kramāt || 82 || tato bhūpurakoṇeṣu gaṇeśaṃ kṣetrapālakam | vaṭukaṃ yoginīścāpi pūjayenmatimānnaraḥ || 83 || indrādyānapi tadbāhye vajrādyāyudhasaṃyutān | pūjayedanayā rītyā devīṃ sāvaraṇāṃ tataḥ || 84 || rājopacārānvividhāndadyādambāpratuṣṭaye | tato japennavārṇaṃ ca mantraṃ mantrārthapūrvakam || 85 || tataḥ saptaśatīstotraṃ devyā agre tu sampaṭhet | nānena sadṛśaṃ stotraṃ vidyate bhuvanatraye || 86 || tataścānena deveśīṃ toṣayet pratyahaṃ naraḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmālayaṃ jāyate naraḥ || 87 || iti te kathitaṃ vipra śrīdurgāyā vidhānakam | kṛtārthatā yena bhavettadetatkathitaṃ tava || 88 || sarve devā haribrahmapramukhā manavastathā | munayo jñānaniṣṭhāśca yoginaścāśramāstathā || 89 || lakṣmyādayastathā devyaḥ sarve dhyāyanti tāṃ śivām | tadaiva janmasāphalyaṃ durgāsmaraṇamasti cet || 90 || caturdaśāpi manavo dhyātvā caraṇapaṅkajam | manutvaṃ prāptavantaśca devāḥ svaṃ svaṃ padaṃ tathā || 91 || tadetatsarvamākhyātaṃ rahasyātirahasyakam | prakṛtīnāṃ pañcakasya tadaṃśānāṃ ca varṇanam || 92 || śrutvaitanmanujo nityaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | labhate nātra sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam || 93 || aputro labhate putraṃ vidyārthī prāpnuyācca tām | yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ smaredvāpi taṃ taṃ śrutvā samāpnuyāt || 94 || navarātre paṭhedetaddevyagre tu samāhitaḥ | parituṣṭā jagaddhātrī bhavatyeva hi niścitam || 95 || nityamekaikamadhyāyaṃ paṭhedyaḥ pratyahaṃ naraḥ | tasya vaśyā bhaveddevī devīpriyakaro hi saḥ || 96 || śakunāṃśca parīkṣeta nityamasminyathāvidhi | kumārīdivyahastena yadvā baṭukarāmbujāt || 97 || manorathaṃ tu saṅkalpya pustakaṃ pūjayettataḥ | devīṃ ca jagadīśānīṃ praṇamecca punaḥ punaḥ || 98 || susnātāṃ kanyakāṃ tatrānīyābhyarcya yathāvidhi | śalākāṃ ropayenmadhye tathā svarṇena nirmitām || 99 || śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ tatra yadāyāti ca tadbhavet | udāsīne'pyudāsīnaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati niścitam || 100 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ navamaskandhe devyā āvaraṇapūjāvidhivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 || <10.1> manukṛtaṃ devīstavanam nārada uvāca nārāyaṇa dharādhāra sarvapālanakāraṇa | bhavatodīritaṃ devīcaritaṃ pāpanāśanam || 1 || manvantareṣu sarveṣu sā devī yatsvarūpiṇī | yadākāreṇa kurute prādurbhāvaṃ maheśvarī || 2 || tānnaḥ sarvānsamākhyāhi devīmāhātmyamiśritān | yathā ca yena yeneha pūjitā saṃstutāpi hi || 3 || manorathānpūrayati bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalā | tannaḥ śubhūṣamāṇānāṃ devīcaritamuttamam || 4 || varṇayasva kṛpāsindho yenāpnoti sukhaṃ mahat | śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ākarṇaya maharṣe tvaṃ caritaṃ pāpanāśanam || 5 || bhaktānāṃ bhaktijananaṃ mahāsampattikārakam | jagadyonirmahātejā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 6 || āvirāsīnnābhipadmāddevadevasya cakriṇaḥ | sa caturmukha āsādya prādurbhāvaṃ mahāmate || 7 || manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ nāma janayāmāsa mānasāt | sa mānaso manuḥ putro brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 8 || śatarūpāṃ ca tatpatnīṃ jajñe dharmasvarūpiṇīm | sa manuḥ kṣīrasindhośca tīre paramapāvane || 9 || devīmārādhayāmāsa mahābhāgyaphalapradām | mūrtiṃ ca mṛṇmayīṃ tasyā vidhāya pṛthivīpatiḥ || 10 || upāsate sma tāṃ devīṃ vāgbhavaṃ sa japan rahaḥ | nirāhāro jitaśvāso niyamavratakarśitaḥ || 11 || ekapādena santiṣṭhan dharāyāmaniśaṃ sthiraḥ | śatavarṣaṃ jitaḥ kāmaḥ krodhastena mahātmanā || 12 || je sthāvaratāṃ devyāścaraṇau cintayan hṛdi | tasya tattapasā devī prādurbhūtā jaganmayī || 13 || uvāca vacanaṃ divyaṃ varaṃ varaya bhūmipa | tata ānandajanakaṃ śrutvā vākyaṃ mahīpatiḥ || 14 || varayāmāsa tān hṛtsthān varānamaradurlabhān | manuruvāca jaya devi viśālākṣi jaya sarvāntarasthite || 15 || mānye pūjye jagaddhātri sarvamaṅgalamaṅgale | tvatkaṭākṣāvalokena padmabhūḥ sṛjate jagat || 16 || vaikuṇṭhaḥ pālayatyeva haraḥ saṃharate kṣaṇāt | śacīpatistrilokyāśca śāsako bhavadājñayā || 17 || prāṇinaḥ śikṣayatyeva daṇḍena ca paretarāṭ | yādasāmadhipaḥ pāśī pālanaṃ mādṛśāmapi || 18 || kurute sa kubero'pi nidhīnāṃ patiravyayaḥ | hutabhuṅnairṛto vāyurīśānaḥ śeṣa eva ca || 19 || tvadaṃśasambhavā eva tvacchaktiparibṛṃhitāḥ | athāpi yadi me devi varo deyo'sti sāmpratam || 20 || tadā prahvāḥ sargakārye vighnā naśyantu me śive | vāgbhavasyāpi mantrasya ye kecidupasevinaḥ || 21 || teṣāṃ siddhiḥ satvarāpi kāryāṇāṃ jāyatāmapi | ye saṃvādamimaṃ devi paṭhanti śrāvayanti ca || 22 || teṣāṃ loke bhuktimuktī sulabhe bhavatāṃ śive | jātismaratvaṃ bhavatu vaktṛtvaṃ sauṣṭhavaṃ tathā || 23 || jñānasiddhiḥ karmamārgasaṃsiddhirapi cāstu hi | putrapautrasamṛddhiśca jāyedityeva me vacaḥ || 24 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe manukṛtaṃ devīstavanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || <10.2> vindhyopākhyānavarṇanam śrīdevyuvāca bhūmipāla mahābāho sarvametadbhaviṣyati | yattvayā prārthitaṃ tatte dadāmi manujādhipa || 1 || ahaṃ prasannā daityendranāśanāmoghavikramā | vāgbhavasya japenaiva tapasā te suniścitam || 2 || rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ te'stu putrā vaṃśakarā api | mayi bhaktirdṛḍhā vatsa mokṣānte satpade bhavet || 3 || evaṃ varānmahādevī tasmai dattvā mahātmane | paśyatastu manoreva jagāma vindhyaparvatam || 4 || yo'sau vindhyācalo ruddhaḥ kumbhodbhavamaharṣiṇā | bhānumārgāvarodhārthaṃ pravṛtto gaganaṃ spṛśan || 5 || sā vindhyavāsinī viṣṇoranujā varadeśvarī | babhūva pūjyā lokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ munisattama || 6 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ko'sau vindhyācalaḥ sūta kimarthaṃ gaganaṃ spṛśan | bhānumārgāvarodhaṃ ca kimarthaṃ kṛtavānasau || 7 || kathaṃ ca maitrāvaruṇiḥ parvataṃ taṃ mahonnatam | prakṛtisthaṃ cakāreti sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 8 || na hi tṛpyāmahe sādho tvadāsyagalitāmṛtam | devyāścaritrarūpākhyaṃ pītvā tṛṣṇā pravardhate || 9 || sūta uvāca āsīdvindhyācalo nāma mānyaḥ sarvadharābhṛtām | mahāvanasamūhāḍhyo mahāpādapasaṃvṛtaḥ || 10 || supuṣpitairanekaiśca latāgulmaistu saṃvṛtaḥ | mṛgā varāhā mahiṣā vyāghrāḥ śārdūlakā api || 11 || vānarāḥ śaśakā ṛkṣāḥ śṛgālāśca samantataḥ | vicaranti sadā hṛṣṭā puṣṭā eva mahodyamāḥ || 12 || nadīnadajalākrānto devagandharvakinnaraiḥ | apsarobhiḥ kimpuruṣaiḥ sarvakāmaphaladrumaiḥ || 13 || etādṛśe vindhyanage kadācitparyaṭan mahīm | devarṣiḥ paramaprīto jagāma svecchayā muniḥ || 14 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa nago maṅkṣu tūrṇamutthāya sambhramāt | pādyamarghyaṃ tathā dattvā varāsanamathārpayat || 15 || sukhopaviṣṭaṃ devarṣiṃ prasannaṃ naga ūcivān | vindhya uvāca devarṣe kathyatāṃ jāta āgamaḥ kuta uttamaḥ || 16 || tavāgamanato jātamanarghyaṃ mama mandiram | tava caṅkramaṇaṃ devābhayārthaṃ hi yathā raveḥ || 17 || apūrvaṃ yanmanovṛttaṃ tad brūhi mama nārada | nārada uvāca mamāgamanamindrāre jātaṃ svarṇagireratha || 18 || tatra dṛṣṭā mayā lokāḥ śakrāgniyamapāśinām | sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ bhavanāni samantataḥ || 19 || mayā dṛṣṭāni vindhyāga nānābhogapradāni ca | iti coktvā brahmayoniḥ punarucchvāsamāviśat || 20 || ucchvasantaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ papraccha śailarāṭ | ucchvāsakāraṇaṃ kiṃ tad brūhi devaṛṣe mama || 21 || ityākarṇya nagasyoktaṃ devarṣiramitadyutiḥ | abravīcchrūyatāṃ vatsa mamocchvāsasya kāraṇam || 22 || gaurīgurustu himavāñchivasya śvaśuraḥ kila | sambandhitvātpaśupateḥ pūjya āsītkṣamābhṛtām || 23 || evameva ca kailāsaḥ śivasyāvasathaḥ prabhuḥ | pūjyaḥ pṛthvībhṛtāṃ jāto loke pāpaughadāraṇaḥ || 24 || niṣadhaḥ parvato nīlo gandhamādana eva ca | pūjyāḥ svasthānamāsādya sarva eva kṣamābhṛtaḥ || 25 || yaṃ paryeti ca viśvātmā sahasrakiraṇaḥ svarāṭ | sagraharkṣagaṇopetaḥ so'yaṃ kanakaparvataḥ || 26 || ātmānaṃ manute śreṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ ca dharābhṛtām | sarveṣāmahamevāgryo nāsti lokeṣu matsamaḥ || 27 || evaṃmānābhimānaṃ taṃ smṛtvocchvāso mayojjhitaḥ | astu naitāvatā kṛtyaṃ tapobalavatāṃ naga | prasaṅgato mayoktaṃ te gamiṣyāmi nijaṃ gṛham || 28 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe vindhyopākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <10.3> devīmāhātmye vindhyopākhyānavarṇanam sūtauvāca evaṃ samupadiśyāyaṃ devarṣiḥ paramaḥ svarāṭ | jagāma brahmaṇo lokaṃ svairacārī mahāmuniḥ || 1 || gate munivare vindhyaścintāṃ lebhe'napāyinīm | naiva śāntiṃ sa lebhe ca sadāntaḥkṛtaśocanaḥ || 2 || kathaṃ kiṃ tvatra me kāryaṃ kathaṃ meruṃ jayāmyaham | naiva śāntiṃ labhe nāpi svāsthyaṃ me mānase bhavet || 3 || (dhigutsāhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca dhiṅme kīrtiṃ ca dhikkulam) dhigbalaṃ me pauruṣaṃ dhik smṛtaṃ pūrvairmahātmabhiḥ | evaṃ cintayamānasya vindhyasya manasi sphuṭam || 4 || prādurbhūtā matiḥ kārye kartavye doṣakāriṇī | merupradakṣiṇāṃ kurvannityameva divākaraḥ || 5 || sagraharkṣagaṇopetaḥ sadā dṛpyatyayaṃ nagaḥ | tasya mārgasya saṃrodhaṃ kariṣyāmi nijaiḥ karaiḥ || 6 || tadā niruddho dyumaṇiḥ parikrāmetkathaṃ nagam | evaṃ mārge niruddhe tu mayā dinakarasya ca || 7 || bhagnadarpo divyanago bhaviṣyati viniścayam | evaṃ niścitya vindhyādriḥ khaṃ spṛśan vavṛdhe bhujaiḥ || 8 || mahonnataiḥ śṛṅgavaraiḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitaḥ | kadodeṣyati bhāsvāṃstaṃ rodhayiṣyāmyahaṃ kadā || 9 || evaṃ sañcintayānasya sā vyatīyāya śarvarī | prabhātaṃ vimalaṃ jajñe diśo vitimirāḥ karaiḥ || 10 || kurvansa nirgato bhānurudayāyodaye girau | prakāśate sma vimalaṃ nabho bhānukaraiḥ śubhaiḥ || 11 || vikāsaṃ nalinī bheje mīlanaṃ ca kumudvatī | svāni kāryāṇi sarve ca lokāḥ samupatasthire || 12 || havyaṃ kavyaṃ bhūtabaliṃ devānāṃ ca pravardhayan | prāhṇāparāhṇamadhyāhnavibhāgena tviṣāṃ patiḥ || 13 || evaṃ prācīṃ tathāgneyīṃ samāśvāsya viyoginīm | jvalantīṃ cirakālīnavirahādiva kāminīm || 14 || bhāskaro'tha kṛśānośca diśaṃ nūnaṃ vihāya ca | yāmyāṃ gantuṃ tatastūrṇaṃ pratasthe kamalākaraḥ || 15 || na śaśākāgrato gantuṃ tato'nūrurvyajijñapat | anūruruvāca bhāno mānonnato vindhyo nirudhya gaganaṃ sthitaḥ || 16 || spardhate meruṇā prepsustvaddattāṃ ca pradakṣiṇām | sūta uvāca anūruvākyamākarṇya savitā hyāsa cintayan || 17 || aho gaganamārgo'pi rudhyate cātivismayaḥ | prāyaḥ śūro na kiṃ kuryādutpathe vartmani sthitaḥ || 18 || niruddho no vājimārgo daivaṃ hi balavattaram | rāhubāhugrahavyagro yaḥ kṣaṇaṃ nāvatiṣṭhate || 19 || sa ciraṃ ruddhamārgo'pi kiṃ karoti vidhirbalī | evaṃ ca mārge saṃruddhe lokāḥ sarve ca seśvarāḥ || 20 || nānvavindanta śaraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ nānvapadyata | citraguptādayaḥ sarve kālaṃ jānanti sūryataḥ || 21 || saṃruddho vindhyagiriṇā aho daivaviparyayaḥ | yadā niruddhaḥ savitā giriṇā spardhayā tadā || 22 || naṣṭaḥ svāhāsvadhākāro naṣṭaprāyamabhūjjagat | evaṃ ca pāścimā lokā dākṣiṇātyāstathaiva ca || 23 || nidrāmīlitacakṣuṣkā niśāmeva prapedire | prāñcastathottarāhāśca tīkṣṇatāpapratāpitāḥ || 24 || mṛtā naṣṭāśca bhagnāśca vināśamabhajan prajāḥ | hāhābhūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ svadhākavyavivarjitam | devāḥ sendrāḥ samudvignāḥ kiṃ kurma itivādinaḥ || 25 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe devīmāhātmye vindhyopākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <10.4> rudraprārthanam sūta uvāca tataḥ sarve suragaṇā mahendrapramukhāstadā | padmayoniṃ puraskṛtya rudraṃ śaraṇamanvayuḥ || 1 || upatasthuḥ praṇatibhiḥ stotraiścāruvibhūtibhiḥ | devadevaṃ giriśayaṃ śaśilolitaśekharam || 2 || devavā ūcuḥ jaya deva gaṇādhyakṣa umālālitapaṅkaja | aṣṭasiddhivibhūtīnāṃ dātre bhaktajanāya te || 3 || mahāmāyāvilasitasthānāya paramātmane | vṛṣāṅkāyāmareśāya kailāsasthitiśāline || 4 || ahirbudhnyāya mānyāya manave mānadāyine | ajāya bahurūpāya svātmārāmāya śambhave || 5 || gaṇanāthāya devāya giriśāya namo'stu te | mahāvibhūtidātre te mahāviṣṇustutāya ca || 6 || viṣṇuhṛtkañjavāsāya mahāyogaratāya ca | yogagamyāya yogāya yogināṃ pataye namaḥ || 7 || yogīśāya namastubhyaṃ yogānāṃ phaladāyine | dīnadānaparāyāpi dayāsāgaramūrtaye || 8 || ārtipraśamanāyogravīryāya guṇamūrtaye | vṛṣadhvajāya kālāya kālakālāya te namaḥ || 9 || sūta uvāca evaṃ stutaḥ sa deveśo yajñabhugbhirvṛṣadhvajaḥ | prāha gambhīrayā vācā prahasanvibudharṣabhān || 10 || śrībhagavānuvāca prasanno'haṃ diviṣadaḥ stotreṇottamapūruṣāḥ | manorathaṃ pūrayāmi sarveṣāṃ devatarṣabhāḥ || 11 || devā ūcuḥ sarvadeveśa giriśa śaśimaulivirājita | ārtānāṃ śaṅkarastvaṃ ca śaṃ vidhehi mahābala || 12 || parvato vindhyanāmāsti merudveṣṭā mahonnataḥ | bhānumārganiroddhā hi sarveṣāṃ duḥkhado'nagha || 13 || tadavṛddhiṃ stambhayeśāna sarvakalyāṇakṛdbhava | bhānusañcārarodhena kālajñānaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 14 || naṣṭe svāhāsvadhākāre loke kaḥ śaraṇaṃ bhavet | asmākaṃ ca bhayārtānāṃ bhavāneva hi dṛśyate || 15 || duḥkhanāśakaro deva prasīda girijāpate | śrīśiva uvāca nāsmākaṃ śaktirastīha tadvṛddhistambhane surāḥ || 16 || imamevaṃ vadiṣyāmo bhagavantaṃ ramādhavam | so'smākaṃ prabhurātmā ca pūjyaḥ kāraṇarūpadhṛk || 17 || govindo bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ | taṃ gatvā kathayiṣyāmaḥ sa duḥkhānto bhaviṣyati || 18 || ityevamākarṇya girīśabhāṣitaṃ devāśca sendrāḥ sapayojasambhavāḥ | rudraṃ puraskṛtya ca vepamānā vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ pratijagmurañjasā || 19 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe rudraprārthanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <10.5> śrīviṣṇunā devebhyo varapradānam sūta uvāca te gatvā devadeveśaṃ ramānāthaṃ jagadgurum | viṣṇuṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ dadṛśuḥ prabhayānvitam || 1 || stotreṇa tuṣṭuvurbhaktyā gadgadasvarasatkṛtāḥ | devā ūcuḥ jaya viṣṇo rameśādya mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja || 2 || daityāre kāmajanaka sarvakāmaphalaprada | mahāvarāha govinda mahāyajñasvarūpaka || 3 || mahāviṣṇo dhruveśādya jagadutpattikāraṇa | matsyāvatāre vedānāmuddhārādhārarūpaka || 4 || satyavrata dharādhīśa matsyarūpāya te namaḥ | jayākūpāra daityāre surakāryasamarpaka || 5 || amṛtāptikareśāna kūrmarūpāya te namaḥ | jayādidaityanāśārthamādisūkararūpadhṛk || 6 || mahyuddhārakṛtodyogakolarūpāya te namaḥ | nārasiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā mahādaityaṃ dadāra yaḥ || 7 || karajairvaradṛptāṅgaṃ tasmai nṛharaye namaḥ | vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya trailokyaiśvaryamohitam || 8 || baliṃ sañchalayāmāsa tasmai vāmanarūpiṇe | duṣṭakṣatravināśāya sahasrakaraśatrave || 9 || reṇukāgarbhajātāya jāmadagnyāya te namaḥ | duṣṭarākṣasapaulastyaśiraśchedapaṭīyase || 10 || śrīmaddāśarathe tubhyaṃ namo'nantakramāya ca | kaṃsaduryodhanādyaiśca daityaiḥ pṛthvīśalāñchanaiḥ || 11 || bhārākrāntāṃ mahīṃ yo'sāvujjahāra mahāvibhuḥ | dharmaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa pāpaṃ kṛtvā sudūrataḥ || 12 || tasmai kṛṣṇāya devāya namo'stu bahudhā vibho | duṣṭayajñavighātāya paśuhiṃsānivṛttaye || 13 || bauddharūpaṃ dadhau yo'sau tasmai devāya te namaḥ | mlecchaprāye'khile loke duṣṭarājanyapīḍite || 14 || kalkirūpaṃ samādadhyau devadevāya te namaḥ | daśāvatārāste deva bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya vai || 15 || duṣṭadaityavighātāya tasmāttvaṃ sarvaduḥkhahṛt | jaya bhaktārtināśāya dhṛtaṃ nārījalātmasu || 16 || rūpaṃ yena tvayā deva ko'nyastvatto dayānidhiḥ | ityevaṃ devadeveśaṃ stutvā śrīpītavāsasam || 17 || praṇemurbhaktisahitāḥ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ vibudharṣabhāḥ | teṣāṃ stavaṃ samākarṇya devaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 18 || uvāca vibudhānsarvān harṣayacchrīgadādharaḥ | śrībhagavānuvāca prasanno'smi stavenāhaṃ devāstāpaṃ vimuñcatha || 19 || bhavatāṃ nāśayiṣyāmi duḥkhaṃ paramaduḥsaham | vṛṇudhvaṃ ca varaṃ matto devāḥ paramadurlabham || 20 || dadāmi paramaprītaḥ stavasyāsya prasādataḥ | ya etatpaṭhate stotraṃ kalya utthāya mānavaḥ || 21 || mayi bhaktiṃ parāṃ kṛtvā na taṃ śokaḥ spṛśetkadā | alakṣmīḥ kālakarṇī ca nākrāmettadgṛhaṃ surāḥ || 22 || nopasargā na vetālā na grahā brahmarākṣasāḥ | na rogā vātikāḥ paittāḥ śleṣmasambhavinastathā || 23 || nākālamaraṇaṃ tasya kadāpi ca bhaviṣyati | santatiścirakālasthā bhogāḥ sarve sukhādayaḥ || 24 || sambhaviṣyanti tanmartyagṛhe yaḥ stotrapāṭhakaḥ | kiṃ punarbahunoktena stotraṃ sarvārthasādhakam || 25 || etasya paṭhanānṝṇāṃ bhuktimuktī na dūrataḥ | devā bhavatsu yadduḥkhaṃ kathyatāṃ tadasaṃśayam || 26 || nāśayāmi na sandehaścātra kāryo'ṇureva ca | evaṃ śrībhagavadvākyaṃ śrutvā sarve divaukasaḥ | prasannamanasaḥ sarve punarūcurvṛṣākapim || 27 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaptasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe śrīviṣṇunā devebhyo varapradānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <10.6> agastyāśvāsanavarṇanam sūta uvāca śrīśasya vacanāddevāḥ santuṣṭāḥ sarva eva hi | prasannamanaso bhūtvā punarenaṃ samūcire || 1 || devā ūcuḥ devadeva mahāviṣṇo sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇa | viṣṇo vindhyanago'rkasya mārgarodhaṃ karoti hi || 2 || tena bhānuvirodhena sarva eva mahāvibho | alabdhabhogabhāgā hi kiṃ kurmaḥ kutra yāma hi || 3 || śrībhagavānuvāca yā kartrī sarvajagatāmādyā ca kulavardhanī | devī bhagavatī tasyāḥ pūjakaḥ paramadyutiḥ || 4 || agastyo munivaryo'sau vārāṇasyāṃ samāsate | tattejovañcako'gastyo bhaviṣyati surottamāḥ || 5 || taṃ prasādya dvijavaramagastyaṃ paramaujasam | yācadhvaṃ vibudhāḥ kāśīṃ gatvā niḥśreyasaḥ padīm || 6 || sūta uvāca evaṃ samupadiṣṭāste viṣṇunā vibudhottamāḥ | pratītāḥ praṇatāḥ sarve jagmurvārāṇasīṃ purīm || 7 || kṣaṇena vibudhaśreṣṭhā gatvā kāśīpurīṃ śubhām | maṇikarṇīṃ samāplutya sacailaṃ bhaktisaṃyutāḥ || 8 || santarpya devāṃśca pitṝndattvā dānaṃ vidhānataḥ | āgatya munivaryasya cāśramaṃ paramaṃ mahat || 9 || praśāntaśvāpadākīrṇaṃ nānāpādapasaṅkulam | mayūraiḥ sārasairhaṃsaiścakravākairupāśritam || 10 || mahāvarāhaiḥ kolaiśca vyāghraiḥ śārdūlakairapi | mṛgai rurubhiratyarthaṃ khaḍgaiḥ śarabhakairapi || 11 || samāśritaṃ paramayā lakṣmyā munivaraṃ tadā | daṇḍavatpatitāḥ sarve praṇemuśca punaḥ punaḥ || 12 || devā ūcuḥ jaya dvijagaṇādhīśa mānya pūjya dharāsura | vātāpībalanāśāya namaste kumbhayonaye || 13 || lopāmudrāpate śrīmanmitrāvaruṇasambhava | sarvavidyānidhe'gastya śāstrayone namo'stu te || 14 || yasyodaye prasannāni bhavantyujjvalabhāṃjyapi | toyāni toyarāśīnāṃ tasmai tubhyaṃ namo'stu te || 15 || kāśapuṣpavikāsāya laṅkāvāsapriyāya ca | jaṭāmaṇḍalayuktāya saśiṣyāya namo'stu te || 16 || jaya sarvāmarastavya guṇarāśe mahāmune | variṣṭhāya ca pūjyāya sastrīkāya namo'stu te || 17 || prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ svāmin vayaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | dustarācchailajādduḥkhātpīḍitāḥ paramadyute || 18 || ityevaṃ saṃstuto'gastyo muniḥ paramadhārmikaḥ | prāha prasannayā vācā vihasan dvijasattamaḥ || 19 || muniruvāca bhavantaḥ paramaśreṣṭhā devāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ | lokapālā mahātmāno nigrahānugrahakṣamāḥ || 20 || yo'marāvatyadhīśānaḥ kuliśaṃ yasya cāyudham | siddhyaṣṭakaṃ ca yaddvāri sa śakro marutāṃ patiḥ || 21 || vaiśvānaraḥ kṛśānurhi havyakavyavaho'niśam | mukhaṃ sarvāmarāṇāṃ hi so'gniḥ kiṃ tasya duṣkaram || 22 || rakṣogaṇādhipo bhīmaḥ sarveṣāṃ karmasākṣikaḥ | daṇḍavyagrakaro devaḥ kiṃ tasyāsukaraṃ surāḥ || 23 || tathāpi yadi deveśāḥ kāryaṃ macchaktisiddhibhṛt | asti ceducyatāṃ devāḥ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 24 || evaṃ munivareṇoktaṃ niśamya vibudharṣabhāḥ | pratītāḥ praṇayodvignāḥ kāryaṃ nijagadurnijam || 25 || maharṣe vindhyagiriṇā niruddho'rkavinirgamaḥ | trailokyaṃ tena saṃviṣṭaṃ hāhābhūtamacetanam || 26 || tadvṛddhiṃ stambhaya mune nijayā tapasaḥ śriyā | bhavatastejasāgastya nūnaṃ namro bhaviṣyati | etadevāsmadīyaṃ ca kāryaṃ kartavyamasti hi || 27 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe agastyāśvāsanavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <10.7> vindhyavṛddhyavarodhavarṇanam sūta uvāca iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya vibudhānāṃ dvijottamaḥ | kariṣye kāryametadvaḥ pratyuvāca tato muniḥ || 1 || aṅgīkṛte tadā kārye muninā kumbhajanmanā | devāḥ pramuditāḥ sarve babhūburdvijasattamāḥ || 2 || te devāḥ svāni dhiṣṇyāni bhejire munivākyataḥ | patnīṃ munivaraḥ śrīmānuvāca nṛpakanyakām || 3 || aye nṛpasute prāpto vighno'narthasya kārakaḥ | bhānumārganirodhena kṛto vindhyamahībhṛtā || 4 || ājñātaṃ kāraṇaṃ tacca smṛtaṃ vākyaṃ purātanam | kāśīmuddiśya yadgītaṃ munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || 5 || avimuktaṃ na moktavyaṃ sarvathaiva mumukṣubhiḥ | kintu vighnā bhaviṣyanti kāśyāṃ nivasatāṃ satām || 6 || so'ntarāyo mayā prāptaḥ kāśyāṃ nivasatā priye | ityevamuktvā bhāryāṃ tāṃ muniḥ paramatāpanaḥ || 7 || maṇikarṇyāṃ samāplutya dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ vibhum | daṇḍapāṇiṃ samabhyarcya kālarājaṃ samāgataḥ || 8 || kālarāja mahābāho bhaktānāṃ bhayahāraka | kathaṃ dūrayase puryāḥ kāśīpuryāstvamīśvaraḥ || 9 || tvaṃ kāśīvāsavighnānāṃ nāśako bhaktarakṣakaḥ | māṃ kiṃ dūrayase svāmin bhaktārtivinivāraka || 10 || parāpavādo nokto me na paiśunyaṃ na cānṛtam | kena karmavipākena kāśyā dūraṃ karoṣi mām || 11 || evaṃ prārthya ca taṃ kālanāthaṃ kumbhodbhavo muniḥ | jagāma sākṣivighneśaṃ sarvavighnanivāraṇam || 12 || taṃ dṛṣṭvābhyarcya samprārthya tataḥ puryā vinirgataḥ | lopāmudrāpatiḥ śrīmānagastyo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || 13 || kāśīvirahasantapto mahābhāgyanidhirmuniḥ | saṃsmṛtyānukṣaṇaṃ kāśīṃ jagāma saha bhāryayā || 14 || tapoyānamivāruhya nimiṣārdhena vai muniḥ | agre dadarśa taṃ vindhyaṃ ruddhāmbaramathonnatam || 15 || cakampe cācalastūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvaivāgre sthitaṃ munim | giriḥ kharvataro bhūtvā vivakṣuravanīmiva || 16 || daṇḍavatpatito bhūmau sāṣṭāṅgaṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā namraśikharaṃ vindhyaṃ nāma mahāgirim || 17 || prasannavadano'gastyo munirvindhyamathābravīt | vatsaivaṃ tiṣṭha tāvattvaṃ yāvadāgamyate mayā || 18 || aśakto'haṃ gaṇḍaśailārohaṇe tava putraka | evamuktvā muniryāmyadiśaṃ prati gamotsukaḥ || 19 || āruhya tasya śikharāṇyavāruhadanukramāt | gato yāmyadiśaṃ cāpi śrīśailaṃ prekṣya vartmani || 20 || malayācalamāsādya tatrāśramaparo'bhavat | sāpi devī tatra vindhyamāgatā manupūjitā || 21 || lokeṣu prathitā vindhyavāsinīti ca śaunaka | sūta uvāca etaccaritraṃ paramaṃ śatrunāśanamuttamam || 22 || agastyavindhyanagayorākhyānaṃ pāpanāśanam | rājñāṃ vijayadaṃ tacca dvijānāṃ jñānavardhanam || 23 || vaiśyānāṃ dhānyadhanadaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ sukhadaṃ tathā | dharmārthī dharmamāpnoti dhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt || 24 || kāmānavāpnuyātkāmī bhaktyā cāsya sakṛcchravāt | evaṃ svāyambhuvamanurdevīmārādhya bhaktitaḥ || 25 || lebhe rājyaṃ dharāyāśca nijamanvantarāśrayam | ityetadvarṇitaṃ saumya mayā manvantarāśritam | ādyaṃ caritraṃ śrīdevyāḥ kiṃ punaḥ kathayāmi te || 26 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe vindhyavṛddhyavarodhavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <10.8> manūtpattivarṇanam śaunaka uvāca ādyo manvantaraḥ prokto bhavatā cāyamuttamaḥ | anyeṣāmudbhavaṃ brūhi manūnāṃ divyatejasām || 1 || sūta uvāca evamādyasya cotpattiṃ śrutvā svāyambhuvasya hi | anyeṣāṃ kramaśasteṣāṃ sambhūtiṃ paripṛcchati || 2 || nāradaḥ paramo jñānī devītattvārthakovidaḥ | nārada uvāca manūnāṃ me samākhyāhi sūtpattiṃ ca sanātana || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca prathamo'yaṃ manuḥ svāyambhuva ukto mahāmune | devyārādhanato yena prāptaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam || 4 || priyavratottānapādau manuputrau mahaujasau | rājyapālanakartārau vikhyātau vasudhātale || 5 || dvitīyaśca manuḥ svārociṣa ukto manīṣibhiḥ | priyavratasutaḥ śrīmānaprameyaparākramaḥ || 6 || sa svārociṣanāmāpi kālindīkūlato manuḥ | nivāsaṃ kalpayāmāsa sarvasattvapriyaṅkaraḥ || 7 || jīrṇapatrāśano bhūtvā tapaḥ kartumanuvrataḥ | devyā mūrtiṃ mṛṇmayīṃ ca pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 8 || evaṃ dvādaśa varṣāṇi vanasthasya tapasyataḥ | devī prādurabhūttāta sahasrārkasamadyutiḥ || 9 || tataḥ prasannā deveśī stavarājena suvratā | dadau svārociṣāyaiva sarvamanvantarāśrayam || 10 || ādhipatyaṃ jagaddhātrī tāriṇīti prathāmagāt | evaṃ svārociṣamanustāriṇyārādhanāttataḥ || 11 || ādhipatyaṃ ca lebhe sa sarvārātivivarjitam | dharmaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivadrājyaṃ putraiḥ samaṃ vibhuḥ || 12 || bhuktvā jagāma svarlokaṃ nijamanvantarāśrayāt | tṛtīya uttamo nāma priyavratasuto manuḥ || 13 || gaṅgākūle tapastaptvā vāgbhavaṃ sañjapan rahaḥ | varṣāṇi trīṇyupavasan devyanugrahamāviśat || 14 || stutvā devīṃ stotravarairbhaktibhāvitamānasaḥ | rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ lebhe santatiṃ cirakālikīm || 15 || rājyotthānyāni saukhyāni bhuktvā dharmānyugasya ca | so'pyājagāma padavīṃ rājarṣivarabhāvitām || 16 || caturthastāmaso nāma priyavratasuto manuḥ | narmadādakṣiṇe kūle samārādhya jaganmayīm || 17 || maheśvarīṃ kāmarājakūṭajāpaparāyaṇaḥ | vāsante śārade kāle navarātrasaparyayā || 18 || toṣayāmāsa deveśīṃ jalajākṣīmanūpamām | tasyāḥ prasādamāsādya natvā stotrairanuttamaiḥ || 19 || akaṇṭakaṃ mahadrājyaṃ bubhuje gatasādhvasaḥ | putrānvaloddhatāñchūrāndaśa vīryaniketanān || 20 || utpādya nijabhāryāyāṃ jagāmāmbaramuttamam | pañcamo manurākhyāto raivatastāmasānujaḥ || 21 || kālindīkūlamāśritya jajāpa kāmasaṃjñakam | bījaṃ paramavāgdarpadāyakaṃ sādhakāśrayam || 22 || etadārādhanādāpa svārājyarddhimanuttamām | balamaprahataṃ loke sarvasiddhividhāyakam || 23 || santatiṃ cirakālīnāṃ putrapautramayīṃ śubhām | dharmānvyasya vyavasthāpya viṣayānupabhujya ca | jagāmāpratimaḥ śūro mahendrālayamuttamam || 24 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe manūtpattivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <10.9> cākṣuṣamanuvṛttavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athātaḥ śrūyatāṃ citraṃ devīmāhāktyamuttamam | aṅgaputreṇa manunā yathā''ptaṃ rājyamuttamam || 1 || aṅgasya rājñaḥ putro'bhūccākṣuṣo manuruttamaḥ | ṣaṣṭhaḥ supulahaṃ nāma brahmarṣiṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 2 || brahmarṣe tvāmahaṃ prāptaḥ śaraṇaṃ praṇatārtihan | śādhi māṃ kiṅkaraṃsvāmin yenāhaṃ prāpnuyāṃ śriyam || 3 || medinyāścādhipatyaṃ me syādyathāvadakhaṇḍitam | avyāhataṃ bhujabalaṃ śastrāstranipuṇaṃ kṣamam || 4 || santatiścirakālīnāpyakhaṇḍaṃ vaya uttamam | ante'pavargalābhaśca syāttathopadiśādya me || 5 || ityevaṃ vacanaṃ tasya manoḥ karṇapathe'bhavat | pratyuvāca muniḥ śrīmān devyāḥ saṃrādhanaṃ param || 6 || rājannākarṇaya vaco mama śrotrasukhaṃ mahat | śivāmārādhayādya tvaṃ tatprasādādidaṃ bhavet || 7 || cākṣuṣa uvāca kīdṛgārādhanaṃ devyāstasyāḥ paramapāvanam | kenākāreṇa kartavyaṃ kāruṇyādvaktumarhasi || 8 || muniruvāca rājannākarṇyatāṃ devyāḥ pūjanaṃ paramavyayam | vāgbhavaṃ bījamavyaktaṃ sañjapyamaniśaṃ tathā || 9 || trikālaṃ sañjapanmartyo bhuktimuktī labhettu hi | na bījaṃ vāgbhavādanyadasti rājanyanandana || 10 || japātsiddhikaraṃ vīryabalavṛddhikaraṃ param | etasya jāpātpādmo'pi sṛṣṭikartā mahābalaḥ || 11 || viṣṇuryajjapataḥ sṛṣṭipālakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | maheśvaro'pi saṃhartā yajjapādabhavannṛpa || 12 || lokapālāstathānye'pi nigrahānugrahakṣamāḥ | yadāśrayādabhūvaṃste balavīryamadoddhatāḥ || 13 || evaṃ tvamapi rājanya maheśīṃ jagadambikām | samārādhya maharddhiṃ ca lapsyase'cirakālataḥ || 14 || evaṃ sa munivaryeṇa pulahena prabodhitaḥ | aṅgaputrastapastaptuṃ jagāma virajāṃ nadīm || 15 || sa ca tepe tapastīvraṃ vāgbhavasya jape rataḥ | bījasya pṛthivīpālaḥ śīrṇaparṇāśano vibhuḥ || 16 || prathame'bde pallavāśo dvitīye toyabhakṣaṇaḥ | tṛtīye'bde pavanabhuk tasthau sthāṇurivācalaḥ || 17 || evaṃ dvādaśa varṣāṇi tyaktāhārasya bhūbhujaḥ | vāgbhavaṃ japato nityaṃ matirāsīcchubhānvitā || 18 || tathā ca devyāḥ paramaṃ mantraṃ sajjapato rahaḥ | prādurāsījjaganmātā sākṣācchrīparameśvarī || 19 || tejomayī durādharṣā sarvadevamayīśvarī | uvācāṅgatanūjaṃ taṃ prasannā lalitākṣaram || 20 || devyuvāca pṛthivīpāla te yatsyāccintitaṃ paramaṃ varam | tad brūhi sampradāsyāmi tapasā te sutoṣitā || 21 || cākṣuṣa uvāca jānāsi devadeveśi yatprārthyaṃ manasepsitam | antaryāmisvarūpeṇa tatsarvaṃ devapūjite || 22 || tathāpi mama bhāgyena jātaṃ yattava darśanam | bravīmi devi me dehi rājyaṃ manvantarāśritam || 23 || devyuvāca dattaṃ manvantarasyāsya rājyaṃ rājanyasattama | putrā mahābalāste ca bhaviṣyanti guṇādhikāḥ || 24 || rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ bhāvi mokṣo'nte cāpi niścitaḥ | evaṃ dattvā paraṃ devī manave varamuttamam || 25 || jagāmādarśanaṃ sadyastena bhaktyā ca saṃstutā | so'pi rājā manuḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ prasādāttu tadāśrayāt || 26 || babhūva manumānyo'sau sārvabhaumasukhairvṛtaḥ | putrāstasya balodyuktāḥ kāryabhārasahādṛtāḥ || 27 || devībhaktāśca śūrāśca mahābalaparākramāḥ | anyatra mānanīyāśca mahārājyasukhāspadāḥ || 28 || evaṃ ca cākṣuṣamanurdevyārādhanataḥ prabhuḥ | babhūva manuvaryo'sau jagāmānte śivāpadam|| 29 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe devīcaritre cākṣuṣamanuvṛttavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <10.10> surathanṛpativṛmattavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca saptamo manurākhyāto manurvaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ | śrāddhadevaḥ parānandabhoktā mānyastu bhūbhujām || 1 || sa ca vaivasvatamanuḥ paradevyāḥ prasādataḥ | tathā tattapasā caiva jāto manvantarādhipaḥ || 2 || aṣṭamo manurākhyātaḥ sāvarṇiḥ prathitaḥ kṣitau | sa janmāntara ārādhya devīṃ tadvaralābhataḥ || 3 || jāto manvantarapatiḥ sarvarājanyapūjitaḥ | mahāparākramī dhīro devībhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 4 || nārada uvāva kathaṃ janmāntare tena manunārādhanaṃ kṛtam | devyāḥ pṛthivyudbhavāyāstanmamākhyātumarhasi || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca caitravaṃśasamudbhūto rājā svārociṣe'ntare | suratho nāma vikhyāto mahābalaparākramaḥ || 6 || guṇagrāhī dhanurdhārī mānyaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaviḥ kṛtī | dhanasaṃgrahakartā ca dātā yācakamaṇḍale || 7 || arīṇāṃ mardano mānī sarvāstrakuśalo balī | tasyaikadā babhūvuste kolāvidhvaṃsino nṛpāḥ || 8 || śatravaḥ sainyasahitāḥ parivāryenamūrjitāḥ | rurudhurnagarīṃ tasya rājño mānadhanasya hi || 9 || tadā sa suratho nāma rājā sainyasamāvṛtaḥ | niryayau nagarātsvīyātsarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ || 10 || tadā sa samare rājā surathaḥ śatrubhirjitaḥ | amātyairmantribhiścaiva tasya kośagataṃ dhanam || 11 || hṛtaṃ sarvamaśeṣeṇa tadātapyata bhūmipaḥ | niṣkāsitaśca nagarātsa rājā paramadyutiḥ || 12 || jagāmāśvamathāruhya mṛgayāmiṣato vanam | ekākī vijane'raṇye babhrāmodbhrāntamānasaḥ || 13 || muneḥ kasyacidāgatya svāśramaṃ śāntamānasaḥ | praśāntajantusaṃyuktaṃ muniśiṣyagaṇairyutam || 14 || uvāsa kañcitkālaṃ sa rājā paramaśobhane | āśrame munivaryasya dīrghadṛṣṭeḥ sumedhasaḥ || 15 || ekadā sa mahīpālo muniṃ pūjāvasānake | kāle gatvā praṇamyāśu papraccha vinayānvitaḥ || 16 || mune mama manoduḥkhaṃ bādhate cādhisambhavam | jñātatattvasya bhūdeva niṣprajñasya ca santatam || 17 || śatrubhirnirjitasyāpi hṛtarājyasya sarvaśaḥ | tathāpi teṣu manasi mamatvaṃ jāyate sphuṭam || 18 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ śarma labhe mune | tvadanugrahamāśāse vada vedavidāṃ vara || 19 || muniruvāca ākarṇaya mahīpāla mahāścaryakaraṃ param | devīmāhātmyamatulaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ param || 20 || jaganmayī mahāmāyā viṣṇubrahmaharodbhavā | sā balādapahṛtyaiva jantūnāṃ mānasāni hi || 21 || mohāya pratisaṃyacchediti jānīhi bhūmipa | sā sṛjatyakhilaṃ viśvaṃ sā pālayati sarvadā || 22 || saṃhāre hararūpeṇa saṃharatyeva bhūmipa | kāmadātrī mahāmāyā kālarātrirduratyayā || 23 || viśvasaṃhāriṇī kālī kamalā kamalālayā | tasyāṃ sarvaṃ jagajjātaṃ tasyāṃ viśvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 24 || layameṣyati tasyāṃ ca tasmātsaiva parātparā | tasyā devyāḥ prasādaśca yasyopari bhavennṛpa | sa eva mohamatyeti nānyathā dharaṇīpate || 25 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe surathanṛpativṛmattavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <10.11> devīmāhātmye madhukaiṭabhavadhavarṇanam rājovāca kā sā devī tvayā proktā brūhi kālavidāṃ vara | kā mohayati sattvāni kāraṇaṃ kiṃ bhaved dvija || 1 || kasmādutpadyate devī kiṃrūpā sā kimātmikā | sarvamākhyāhi bhūdeva kṛpayā mama sarvataḥ || 2 || muniruvāca rājan devyāḥ svarūpaṃ te varṇayāmi niśāmaya | yathā cotpatitā devī yena vā sā jaganmayī || 3 || yadā nārāyaṇo devo viśvaṃ saṃhṛtya yogarāṭ | āstīrya śeṣaṃ bhagavān samudre nidrito'bhavat || 4 || tadā prasvāpavaśago devadevo janārdanaḥ | tatkarṇamalasañjātau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau || 5 || brahmāṇaṃ hantumudyuktau dānavau ghorarūpiṇau | tadā kamalajo devo dṛṣṭvā tau madhukaiṭabhau || 6 || nidritaṃ devadeveśaṃ cintāmāpa duratyayām | nidrito bhagavānīśo dānavau ca durāsadau || 7 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ śarma labhe hyaham | evaṃ cintayatastasya padyayonermahātmanaḥ || 8 || buddhiḥ prādūrabhūttāta tadā kāryaprasādhinī | yasyā vaśaṃ gato devo nidrito bhagavān hariḥ || 9 || tāṃ devīṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi nidrāṃ sarvaprasūtikām | brahmovāca devi devi jagaddhātri bhaktābhīṣṭaphalaprade || 10 || jaganmāye mahāmāye samudraśayane śive | tvadājñāvaśagāḥ sarve svasvakāryavidhāyinaḥ || 11 || kālarātrirmahārātrirmoharātrirmadotkaṭā | vyāpinī vaśagā mānyā mahānandaikaśevadhiḥ || 12 || mahanīyā mahārādhyā māyā madhumatī mahī | parāparāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ paramā tvaṃ prakīrtitā || 13 || lajjā puṣṭiḥ kṣamā kīrtiḥ kāntiḥ kāruṇyavigrahā | kamanīyā jagadvandyā jāgradādisvarūpiṇī || 14 || paramā parameśānī parānandaparāyaṇā | ekāpyekasvarūpā ca sadvitīyā dvayātmikā || 15 || trayī trivarganilayā turyā turyapadātmikā | pañcamī pañcabhūteśī ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭheśvarīti ca || 16 || saptamī saptavāreśī saptasaptavarapradā | aṣṭamī vasunāthā ca navagrahamayīśvarī || 17 || navarāgakalā ramyā navasaṃkhyā naveśvarī | daśamī daśadikpūjyā daśāśāvyāpinī ramā || 18 || ekādaśātmikā caikādaśarudraniṣevitā | ekādaśītithiprītā ekādaśagaṇādhipā || 19 || dvādaśī dvādaśabhujā dvādaśādityajanmabhūḥ | trayodaśātmikā devī trayodaśagaṇapriyā || 20 || trayodaśābhidhā bhinnā viśvedevādhidevatā | caturdaśendravaradā caturdaśamanuprasūḥ || 21 || pañcādhikadaśī vedyā pañcādhikadaśī tithiḥ | ṣoḍaśī ṣoḍaśabhujā ṣoḍaśendukalāmayī || 22 || ṣoḍaśātmakacandrāṃśuvyāptadivyakalevarā | evaṃrūpāsi deveśi nirguṇe tāmasodaye || 23 || tvayā gṛhīto bhagavāndevadevo ramāpatiḥ | etau durāsadau daityau vikrāntau madhukaiṭabhau || 24 || etayośca vadhārthāya deveśaṃ pratibodhaya | muniruvāca evaṃ stutā bhagavatī tāmasī bhagavatpriyā || 25 || devadevaṃ tadā tyaktvā mohayāmāsa dānavau | tadaiva bhagavānviṣṇuḥ paramātmā jagatpatiḥ || 26 || prabodhamāpa deveśo dadṛśe dānavottamau | tadā tau dānavau ghorau dṛṣṭvā taṃ madhusūdanam || 27 || yuddhāya kṛtasaṅkalpau jagmatuḥ sannidhiṃ hareḥ | yuyudhe ca tatastābhyāṃ bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || 28 || pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi bāhupraharaṇo vibhuḥ | tau tadātibalonmattau jaganmāyāvimohitau || 29 || vriyatāṃ vara ityevamūcatuḥ parameśvaram | evaṃ tayorvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānādipūruṣaḥ || 30 || vavre vadhyābubhau me'dya bhavetāmiti niścitam | tau tadātibalau devaṃ punarevocaturharim || 31 || āvāṃ jahi na yatrorvī payasā ca pariplutā | tathetyuktvā bhagavatā gadāśaṅkhabhṛtā nṛpa || 32 || kṛtvā cakreṇa vai chinne jaghane śirasī tayoḥ | evaṃ devī samutpannā brahmaṇā saṃstutā nṛpa || 33 || mahākālī mahārāja sarvayogeśvareśvarī | mahālakṣmyāstathotpattiṃ niśāmaya mahīpate || 34 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe devīmāhātmye madhukaiṭabhavadhavarṇanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <10.12> devīcaritrasahitaṃ sāvarṇimanuvṛtāntavarṇanam muniruvāca mahiṣīgarbhasambhūto mahābalaparākramaḥ | devānsarvānparājitya mahiṣo'bhūjjagatprabhuḥ || 1 sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāmadhikārānmahāsuraḥ | balānirjitya bubhuje trailokyaiśvaryamadbhutam || 2 || tataḥ parājitāḥ sarve devāḥ svargaparicyutāḥ | brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya te jagmurlokamuttamam || 3 || yatrottamau devadevau saṃsthitau śaṅkarācyutau | vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsurmahiṣasya durātmanaḥ || 4 || devānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sthānāni tarasāsuraḥ | vinirjitya svayaṃ bhuṅkte balavīryamadoddhataḥ || 5 || mahiṣāsuranāmāsau duṣṭadaityo'mareśvarau | vadhopāyaśca tasyāśu cintyatāmasurārdanau || 6 || evaṃ śrutvā sa bhagavāndevānāmārtiyugvacaḥ | cakāra kopaṃ subahuṃ tathā śaṅkarapadmajau || 7 || evaṃ kopayutasyāsya harerāsyānmahīpate | tejaḥ prādurabhūddivyaṃ sahasrārkasamadyuti || 8 || athānukramatastejaḥ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām | śarīrādudbhavaṃ prāpa harṣayadvibudhādhipān || 9 || yadabhūcchambhujaṃ tejo mukhamasyodapadyata | keśā babhūvuryāmyena vaiṣṇavena ca bāhavaḥ || 10 || saumyena ca stanau jātau māhendreṇa ca madhyamaḥ | vāruṇena tato bhūpa jaṅghorū sambabhūvatuḥ || 11 || nitambau tejasā bhūmeḥ pādau brāhmeṇa tejasā | pādāṅgulyo bhānavena vāsavena karāṅgulī || 12 || kaubereṇa tathā nāsā dantāḥ sañjajñire tadā | prājāpatyenottamena tejasā vasudhādhipa || 13 || pāvakena ca sañjātaṃ locanatritayaṃ śubham | sāndhyena tejasā jāte bhṛkuṭyau tejasāṃ nidhī || 14 || karṇau vāyavyato jātau tejaso manujādhipa | sarveṣāṃ tejasā devī jātā mahiṣamardinī || 15 || śūlaṃ dadau śivo viṣṇuścakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca pāśabhṛt | hutāśano dadau śaktiṃ mārutaścāpasāyakau || 16 || vajraṃ mahendraḥ pradadau ghaṇṭāṃ cairāvatād gajāt | kāladaṇḍaṃ yamo brahmā cākṣamālākamaṇḍalū || 17 || divākaro raśmimālāṃ romakūpeṣu sandadau | kālaḥ khaḍgaṃ tathā carma nirmalaṃ vasudhādhipa || 18 || samudro nirmalaṃ hāramajare cāmbare nṛpa | cūḍāmaṇiṃ kuṇḍale ca kaṭakāni tathāṅgade || 19 || ardhacandraṃ nirmalaṃ ca nūpurāṇi tathā dadau | graiveyakaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ca tasyai devyai mudānvitaḥ || 20 || viśvakarmā cormikāśca dadau tasyai dharāpate | himavānvāhanaṃ siṃhaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca || 21 || pānapātraṃ surāpūrṇaṃ dadau tasyai dhanādhipaḥ | śeṣaśca bhagavāndevo nāgahāraṃ dadau vibhuḥ || 22 || anyairaśeṣavibudhairmānitā sā jaganmayī | tāṃ tuṣṭuvurmahādevīṃ devā mahiṣapīḍitāḥ || 23 || nānāstotrairmaheśānīṃ jagadudbhavakāriṇīm | teṣāṃ niśamya deveśī stotraṃ vibudhapūjitā || 24 || mahiṣasya vadhārthāya mahānādaṃ cakāra ha | tena nādena mahiṣaścakito'bhūddharāpate || 25 || āsasāda jagaddhātrīṃ sarvasainyasamāvṛtaḥ | tataḥ sa yuyudhe devyā mahiṣākhyo mahāsuraḥ || 26 || śastrāstrairbahudhā kṣiptaiḥ pūrayannambarāntaram | cikṣuro grāmaṇīḥ senāpatirdurdharadurmukhau || 27 || bāṣkalastāmrakaścaiva biḍālavadano'paraḥ | etaiścānyairasaṃkhyātaiḥ saṃgrāmāntakasannibhaiḥ || 28 || yodhaiḥ parivṛto vīro mahiṣo dānavottamaḥ | tataḥ sā kopatāmrākṣī devī lokavimohinī || 29 || jaghāna yodhānsamare devī mahiṣamāśritān | tatasteṣu hateṣveva sa daityo roṣamūrcchitaḥ || 30 || āsasāda tadā devīṃ tūrṇaṃ māyāviśāradaḥ | rūpāntarāṇi sambheje māyayā dānaveśvaraḥ || 31 || tāni tānyasya rūpāṇi nāśayāmāsa sā tadā | tato'nte māhiṣaṃ rūpaṃ bibhrāṇamamarārdanam || 32 || pāśena baddhvā sudṛḍhaṃ chittvā khaḍgena tacchiraḥ | pātayāmāsa mahiṣaṃ devī devagaṇāntakam || 33 || hāhākṛtaṃ tataḥ śeṣaṃ sainyaṃ bhagnaṃ diśo daśa | tuṣṭuvurdevadeveśīṃ sarve devāḥ pramoditāḥ || 34 || evaṃ lakṣmīḥ samutpannā mahiṣāsuramardinī | rājañchṛṇu sarasvatyāḥ prādurbhāvo yathābhavat || 35 || ekadā śumbhanāmāsīddaityo madabalotkaṭaḥ | niśumbhaścāpi tadbhrātā mahābalaparākramaḥ || 36 || tena sampīḍitā devāḥ sarve bhraṣṭaśriyo nṛpa | himavantamathāsādya devīṃ tuṣṭuvurādarāt || 37 || devā ūcuḥ jaya deveśi bhaktānāmārtināśanakovide | dānavāntakarūpe tvamajarāmaraṇe'naghe || 38 || deveśi bhaktisulabhe mahābalaparākrame | viṣṇuśaṅkarabrahmādisvarūpe'nantavikrame || 39 || sṛṣṭisthitikare nāśakārike kāntidāyini | mahātāṇḍavasuprīte modadāyini mādhavi || 40 || prasīda devadeveśi prasīda karuṇānidhe | niśumbhaśumbhasambhūtabhayāpārāmbuvāridhe || 41 || uddharāsmān prapannārtināśike śaraṇāgatān | evaṃ saṃstuvatāṃ teṣāṃ tridaśānāṃ dharāpate || 42 || prasannā girijā prāha brūta stavanakāraṇam | etasminnantare yasyāḥ kośarūpātsamutthitā || 43 || kauśikī sā jagatpūjyā devānprītyedamabravīt| prasannāhaṃ suraśreṣṭhāḥ stavenottamarūpiṇī || 44 || vriyatāṃ vara ityukte devāḥ saṃvavrire varam | śumbhanāmāvaro bhrātā niśumbhastasya viśrutaḥ || 45 || trailokyamojasākrāntaṃ daityena balaśālinā | tadvadhaścintyatāṃ devi durātmā dānaveśvaraḥ || 46 || bādhate satataṃ devi tiraskṛtya nijaujasā | devyuvāca devaśatruṃ pātayiṣye niśumbhaṃ śumbhameva ca || 47 || svasthāstiṣṭhata bhadraṃ vaḥ kaṇṭakaṃ nāśayāmi vaḥ | ityuktvā devadeveśī devānsendrāndayāmayī || 48 || jagāmādarśanaṃ sadyo miṣatāṃ tridivaukasām | devāḥ samāgatā hṛṣṭāḥ suvarṇādriguhāṃ śubhām || 49 || caṇḍamuṇḍau paśyataḥsma bhṛtyau śumbhaniśumbhayoḥ | dṛṣṭvā tāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ devīṃ lokavimohinīm || 50 || kathayāmāsatū rājñe bhṛtyau tau caṇḍamuṇḍakau | deva sarvāsuraśreṣṭha ratnabhogārha mānada || 51 || apūrvā kāminī dṛṣṭā cāvābhyāṃ ripumardana | tasyāḥ saṃbhogayogyatvamastyeva tava sāmpratam || 52 || tāṃ samānaya cārvaṅgīṃ bhuṅkṣva saukhyasamanvitaḥ | tādṛśī nāsurī nārī na gandharvī na dānavī || 53 || na mānavī nāpi devī yādṛśī sā manoharā | evaṃ bhṛtyavacaḥ śrutvā śumbhaḥ parabalārdanaḥ || 54 || dūtaṃ sammeṣayāmāsa sugrīvaṃ nāma dānavam | sa dūtastvaritaṃ gatvā devyāḥ savidhamādarāt || 55 || vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa devyai śumbhasya yadvacaḥ | devi śumbhāsuro nāma trailokyavijayī prabhuḥ || 56 || sarveṣāṃ ratnavastūnāṃ bhoktā mānyo divaukasām | taduktaṃ śṛṇu me devi ratnabhoktāhamavyayaḥ || 57 || tvaṃ cāpi ratnabhūtāsi bhaja māṃ cārulocane | sarveṣu yāni ratnāni devāsuranareṣu ca || 58 || tāni mayyeva subhage bhaja māṃ kāmajai rasaiḥ | devyuvāca satyaṃ vadasi he dūta daityarājapriyaṅkaram || 59 || pratijñā yā mayā pūrvaṃ kṛtā sāpyanṛtā katham | bhavettāṃ śṛṇu me dūta yā pratijñā mayā kṛtā || 60 || yo me darpaṃ vidhunute yo me balamapohati | yo me pratibalo bhūyātsa eva mama bhogabhāk || 61 || tata enāṃ pratijñāṃ me satyāṃ kṛtvāsureśvaraḥ | gṛhṇātu pāṇiṃ tarasā tasyāśakyaṃ kimatra hi || 62 || tasmād gaccha mahādūta svāminaṃ brūhi cādṛtaḥ | pratijñāṃ cāpi me satyāṃ vidhāsyati balādhikaḥ || 63 || evaṃ vākyaṃ mahādevyāḥ samākarṇya sa dānavaḥ | kathayāmāsa śumbhāya devyā vṛttāntamāditaḥ || 64 || tadāpriyaṃ dūtavākyaṃ śumbhaḥ śrutvā mahābalaḥ | kopamāhārayāmāsa mahāntaṃ danujādhipaḥ || 65 || tato dhūmrākṣanāmānaṃ daityaṃ daityapatiḥ prabhuḥ | ādideśa śṛṇu vaco dhūmrākṣa mama cādṛtaḥ || 66 || tāṃ duṣṭāṃ keśapāśeṣu hatvāpyānīyatāṃ mama | samīpamavilambena śīghraṃ gacchasva me puraḥ || 67 || ityādeśaṃ samāsādya daityeśo dhūmralocanaḥ | ṣaṣṭyāsurāṇāṃ sahitaḥ sahasrāṇāṃ mahābalaḥ || 68 || tuhinācalamāsādya devyāḥ savidhameva saḥ | uccairdevīṃ jagādāśu bhaja daityapatiṃ śubhe || 69 || śumbhaṃ nāma mahāvīryaṃ sarvabhogānavāpnuhi | nocetkeśāngṛhītvā tvāṃ neṣye daityapatiṃ prati || 70 || ityuktā sā tato devī daityena tridaśāriṇā | uvāca daitya yad brūṣe tatsatyaṃ te mahābala || 71 || rājā śumbhāsurastvaṃ ca kiṃ kariṣyasi tadvada | ityukto daityapo'dhāvattūrṇaṃ śastrasamanvitaḥ || 72 || bhasmasāttaṃ cakārāśu huṅkāreṇa maheśvarī | tataḥ sainyaṃ vāhanena devyā bhagnaṃ mahīpate || 73 || diśo daśābhajacchīghraṃ hāhābhūtamacetanam | tadvṛttāntaṃ samāśrutya sa śumbho daityarāḍ vibhuḥ || 74 || cukopa ca mahākopād bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ | tataḥ kopaparītātmā daityarājaḥ pratāpavān || 75 || caṇḍaṃ muṇḍaṃ raktabījaṃ kramataḥ praiṣayadvibhuḥ | te ca gatvā trayo daityā vikrāntā bahuvikramāḥ || 76 || devīṃ grahītumārabdhayatnāste hyabhavanbalāt | tānāpatata evāsau jagaddhātrī madotkaṭā || 77 || śūlaṃ gahītvā vegena pātayāmāsa bhūtale | sasainyānnihatāñchrutvā daityāṃstrīndānaveśvarau || 78 || śumbhaścaiva niśumbhaśca samājagmaturojasā | niśumbhaścaiva śumbhaśca kṛtvā yuddhaṃ mahotkaṭam || 79 || devyāśca vaśagau jātau nihatau ca tayāsurau | iti daityavaraṃ śumbhaṃ ghātayitvā jaganmayī || 80 || vibudhaiḥ saṃstutā tadvatsākṣādvāgīśvarī parā | evaṃ te varṇito rājan prādurbhāvo'tiramyakaḥ || 81 || kālyāścaiva mahālakṣyāḥ sarasvatyāḥ krameṇa ca | parā pareśvarī devī jagatsargaṃ karoti ca || 82 || pālanaṃ caiva saṃhāraṃ saiva devī dadhāti hi | tāṃ samāśraya deveśīṃ jaganmohanivāriṇīm || 83 || mahāmāyāṃ pūjyatamāṃ sā kāryaṃ te vidhāsyati | śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca iti rājā vacaḥ śrutvā muneḥ paramaśobhanam || 84 || devīṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām | nirāhāro yatātmā ca tanmanāśca samāhitaḥ || 85 || devīmūrtiṃ mṛṇmayīṃ ca pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ | pūjanānte baliṃ tasyai nijagātrāsṛjaṃ dadat || 86 || tadā prasannā deveśī jagadyoniḥ kṛpāvatī | prādurbabhūva purato varaṃ brūhīti bhāṣiṇī || 87 || sa rājā nijamohasya nāśanaṃ jñānamuttamam | rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ caiva yācati sma maheśvarīm || 88 || devyuvāca rājanniṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ jñānaṃ vai mohanāśanam | bhaviṣyati mayā dattamasminneva bhave tava || 89 || anyacca śṛṇu bhūpāla janmāntaraviceṣṭitam | bhānorjanma samāsādya sāvarṇirbhavitā bhavān || 90 || tatra manvantarasyāpi patitvaṃ bahuvikramam | santatiṃ bahulāṃ cāpi prāpsyate madvarādbhavān || 91 || evaṃ dattvā varaṃ devī jagāmādarśanaṃ tadā | so'pi devyāḥ prasādena jāto manvantarādhipaḥ || 92 || evaṃ te varṇitaṃ sādho sāvarṇerjanma karma ca | etatpaṭhaṃstathā śṛṇvandevyanugrahamāpnuyāt || 93 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe devīcaritrasahitaṃ sāvarṇimanuvṛtāntavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe devīcaritrasahitaṃ sāvarṇimanuvṛtāntavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <10.13> bhrāmarīcaritravarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca athātaḥ śrūyatāṃ śeṣamanūnāṃ citramudbhavam | yasya smaraṇamātreṇa devībhaktiḥ prajāyate || 1 || āsanvaivasvatamanoḥ putrāḥ ṣaḍ vimalodayāḥ | karūṣaśca pṛṣadhraśca nābhāgo diṣṭa eva ca || 2 || śaryātiśca triśaṅkuśca sarva eva mahābalāḥ | tataḥ ṣaḍeva te gatvā kālindyāstīramuttamam || 3 || nirāhārā jitaśvāsāḥ pūjāṃ cakrustataḥ sthitāḥ | devyā mahīmayīṃ mūrtiṃ vinirmāya pṛthakpṛthak || 4 || vividhairupacāraistāṃ pūjayāmāsurādṛtāḥ | tataśca sarva evaite tapaḥsārā mahābalāḥ || 5 || jīrṇaparṇāśanā vāyubhakṣaṇāstoyajīvanāḥ | dhūmrapānā raśmipānāḥ kramaśaśca bahuśramāḥ || 6 || tatasteṣāmādareṇārādhanaṃ kurvatāṃ sadā | vimalā matirutpannā sarvamohavināśinī || 7 || babhūvurmanuputrāste devīpādaikacintanāḥ | matyā vimalayā teṣāmātmanyevākhilaṃ jagat || 8 || darśanaṃ sañjagāmāśu tadadbhutamivābhavat | evaṃ dvādaśavarṣānte tapasā jagadīśvarī || 9 || prādurbabhūva deveśī sahasrārkasamadyutiḥ | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vimalātmāno rājaputrāḥ ṣaḍeva te || 10 || tuṣṭuvurbhaktinamrāntaḥkaraṇā bhāvasaṃyutāḥ | rājaputrā ūcuḥ maheśvari jayeśāni parame karuṇālaye || 11 || vāgbhavārādhanaprīte vāgbhavapratipādite | klīṃkāravigrahe devi klīṃkāraprītidāyini || 12 || kāmarājamanomodadāyinīśvaratoṣiṇi | mahāmāye modapare mahāsāmrājyadāyini || 13 || viṣṇvarkaharaśakrādisvarūpe bhogavardhini | evaṃ stutā bhagavatī rājaputrairmahātmabhiḥ || 14 || prasādasumukhī devī provāca vacanaṃ śubham | devyuvāca rājaputrā mahātmāno bhavantastapasā yutāḥ || 15 || niṣkalmaṣāḥ śuddhadhiyo jātā vai madupāsanāt | varaṃ manogataṃ sarvaṃ yācadhvamavilambitam || 16 || prasannāhaṃ pradāsyāmi yuṣmākaṃ manasi sthitam | rājaputrā ūcuḥ devi niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ santatiścirajīvinī || 17 || bhogā avyāhatā kāmaṃ yaśastejo matiśca ha | akuṇṭhitatvaṃ sarveṣāmeṣa eva varo hitaḥ || 18 || devyuvāca evamastu ca sarveṣāṃ bhavatāṃ yanmanogatam | athānyadapi me vākyaṃ bhūyatāmādarādidam || 19 || bhavantaḥ sarva evaite manvantarapatīśvarāḥ | santatyā dīrghayā bhogairanekairapi saṅgamaḥ || 20 || akhaṇḍitabalaiśvaryaṃ yaśastejovibhūtayaḥ | bhavitāro matprasādādrājaputrāḥ krameṇa tu || 21 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca evaṃ tebhyo varāndattvā bhrāmarī jagadambikā | antardhānaṃ jagāmāśu bhaktyā taiḥ saṃstutā satī || 22 || te rājaputrāḥ sarve'pi tasmiñjanmanyanuttamam | rājyaṃ mahīgatānbhogānbubhujuśca mahaujasaḥ || 23 || santatiṃ cākhaṇḍitāṃ te samutpādya mahītale | vaṃśaṃ saṃsthāpya sarve'pi manūnāṃ patayo'bhavan || 24 || bhavāntare krameṇaiva sāvarṇipadabhāginaḥ | prathamo dakṣasāvarṇirnavamo manurīritaḥ || 25 || avyāhatabalo devyāḥ prasādādabhavadvibhuḥ | dvitīyo merusāvarṇirdaśamo manureva ca || 26 || babhūva manvantarapo mahādevīprasādataḥ | tṛtīyo manurākhyātaḥ sūryasāvarṇināmakaḥ || 27 || ekādaśo mahotsāhastapasā svena bhāvitaḥ | caturthaścandrasāvarṇirdvādaśo manurāḍ vibhuḥ || 28 || devīsamārādhanena jāto manvantareśvaraḥ | pañcamo rudrasāvarṇistrayodaśamanuḥ smṛtaḥ || 29 || mahābalo mahāsattvo babhūva jagadīśvaraḥ | ṣaṣṭhaśca viṣṇusāvarṇiścaturdaśamanuḥ kṛtī || 30 ||
