babhūva devīvarato jagatāṃ prathitaḥ prabhuḥ | caturdaśaite manavo mahātejobalairyutāḥ || 31 || devyārādhanataḥ pūjyā vandyā lokeṣu nityaśaḥ | mahāpratāpinaḥ sarve bhrāmaryāstu prasādataḥ || 32 || nārada uvāca keyaṃ sā bhrāmarī devī kathaṃ jātā kimātmikā | tadākhyānaṃ vada prājña vicitraṃ śokanāśakam || 33 || na tṛptimadhigacchāmi pibandevīkathāmṛtam | amṛtaṃ pibatāṃ mṛtyurnāsya śravaṇato yataḥ || 34 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi jaganmāturviceṣṭitam | acintyāvyaktarūpāyā vicitraṃ mokṣadāyakam || 35 || yadyaccaritraṃ śrīdevyāstatsarvaṃ lokahetave | nirvyājayā karuṇayā putre māturyathā tathā || 36 || pūrvaṃ daityo mahānāsīdaruṇākhyo mahābalaḥ | pātāle daityasaṃsthāne devadveṣī mahākhalaḥ || 37 || sa devāñjetukāmaśca cakāra paramaṃ tapaḥ | padmasambhavamuddiśya sa nastrātā bhaviṣyati || 38 || gatvā himavataḥ pārśve gaṅgājalasuśītale | pakvaparṇāśano yogī sannirudhya marudgaṇam || 39 || gāyatrījapasaṃsaktaḥ sakāmastamasā yutaḥ | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tato vārikaṇāśanaḥ || 40 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tataḥ pavanabhojanaḥ | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi nirāhāro'bhavattataḥ || 41 || evaṃ tapasyatastasya śarīrādutthito'nalaḥ | dadāha jagatīṃ sarvāṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat || 42 || kimidaṃ kimidaṃ ceti devāḥ sarve cakampire | santrastāḥ sakalā lokā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 43 || vijñāpitaṃ devavaraiḥ śrutvā tatra caturmukhaḥ | gāyatrīsahito haṃsasamārūḍho yayau mudā || 44 || prāṇamātrāvaśiṣṭaṃ taṃ dhamanīśatasaṅkulam | śuṣkodaraṃ kṣāmagātraṃ dhyānamīlitalocanam || 45 || dadarśa tejasā dīptaṃ dvitīyamiva pāvakam | varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te vatsa yanmanasi sthitam || 46 || śrutimātreṇa santoṣakārakaṃ vākyamūcivān | śrutvā brahmamukhādvāṇīṃ sudhādhārāmivāruṇaḥ || 47 || unmīlitākṣaḥ purato dadarśa jalajodbhavam | gāyatrīsahitaṃ devaṃ caturvedasamanvitam || 48 || akṣasrakkuṇḍikāhastaṃ japantaṃ brahma śāśvatam | dṛṣṭvotthāya nanāmātha stutvā ca vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 49 || varaṃ vavre svabuddhisthaṃ mā bhavenmṛtyurityapi | śrutvāruṇavaco brahmā bodhayāmāsa sādaram || 50 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā mṛtyunā kavalīkṛtāḥ | tadānyeṣāṃ tu kā vārtā maraṇe dānavottama || 51 || varaṃ yogyaṃ tato brūhi dātuṃ yaḥ śakyate mayā | nātrāgrahaṃ prakurvanti buddhimanto janāḥ kvacit || 52 || iti brahmavacaḥ śrutvā punaḥ provāca sādaram | na yuddhe na ca śastrāstrānna puṃbhyo nāpi yoṣitaḥ || 53 || dvipādbhyo vā catuṣpādbhyo nobhayākāratastathā | bhavenme mṛtyurityevaṃ deva dehi varaṃ prabho || 54 || balaṃ ca vipulaṃ dehi yena devajayo bhavet | iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā tathāstviti vaco'bravīt || 55 || dattvā varaṃ jagāmāśu padmajaḥ svaṃ niketanam | tato'ruṇākhyo daityastu pātālātsvāśrayasthitān || 56 || daityānākārayāmāsa brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ | āgatya te'surāḥ sarve daityeśaṃ taṃ pracakrire || 57 || dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsuryuddhārthamamarāvatīm | dūtavākyaṃ tadā śrutvā devarāḍ bhayakampitaḥ || 58 || devaiḥ sārdhaṃ jagāmāśu brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ prati | brahmaviṣṇū puraskṛtya jagmuste śaṅkarālayam || 59 || vicāraṃ cakrire tatra vadhārthaṃ te suradruhām | etasminsamaye tatra daityasenāsamāvṛtaḥ || 60 || aruṇākhyo daityarājo jagāmāśu triviṣṭapam | sūryenduyamavahnīnāmadhikārānpṛthakpṛthak || 61 || svayaṃ cakāra tapasā nānārūpadharo mune | svasvasthānacyutāḥ sarve jagmuḥ kailāsamaṇḍalam || 62 || śaśaṃsuḥ śaṅkaraṃ devāḥ svasvaduḥkhaṃ pṛthakpṛthak | mahān vicārastatrāsītkiṃ kartavyamataḥ param || 63 || na yuddhena ca śastrāstrairna puṃbhyo nāpi yoṣitaḥ | dvipādbhyo vā catuṣpādbhyo nobhayākārato'pi vā || 64 || mṛtyurbhavediti brahmā provāca vacanaṃ yataḥ | iti cintāturāḥ sarve kartuṃ kiñcinna ca kṣamāḥ || 65 || etasminsamaye tatra vāgabhūdaśarīriṇī | bhajadhvaṃ bhuvaneśānīṃ sā vaḥ kāryaṃ vidhāsyati || 66 || gāyatrījapasaṃsakto daityarāḍ yadi tāṃ tyajet | mṛtyuyogyastadā bhūyādityuccaistoṣakāriṇī || 67 || śrutvā daivīṃ tathā vāṇīṃ mantrayāmāsurādṛtāḥ | bṛhaspatiṃ samāhūya vacanaṃ prāha devarāṭ || 68 || guro gaccha surāṇāṃ tu kāryārthamasuraṃ prati | yathā bhavecca gāyatrītyāgastasya tathā kuru || 69 || asmābhiḥ parameśānī sevyate dhyānayogataḥ | prasannā sā bhagavatī sāhāyyaṃ te kariṣyati || 70 || ityādiśya guruṃ sarve jagmurjāmbūnadeśvarīm | sāsmāndaityabhayatrastān pālayiṣyati śobhanā || 71 || tatra gatvā tapaścaryāṃ cakruḥ sarve suniṣṭhitāḥ | māyābījajapāsaktā devīmakhaparāyaṇāḥ || 72 || bṛhaspatistadā śīghraṃ jagāmāsurasannidhau | āgataṃ munivaryaṃ taṃ papracchātha sa daityarāṭ || 73 || mune kutrāgamaḥ kasmātkimarthamiti me vada | nāhaṃ yuṣmatpakṣapātī pratyutārātireva ca || 74 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā provāca munināyakaḥ | asmatsevyā ca yā devī sā tvayā pūjyate'niśam || 75 || tasmādasmatpakṣapātī na bhavestvaṃ kathaṃ vada | iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā mohito devamāyayā || 76 || tatyāja paramaṃ mantramabhimānena sattama | gāyatrītyāgato daityo nistejasko babhūva ha || 77 || kṛtakāryo gurustasmātsthānānnirgatavānpunaḥ | tato vṛttāntamakhilaṃ kathayāmāsa vajriṇe || 78 || saṃtuṣṭāste surāḥ sarve bhejire parameśvarīm | evaṃ bahugate kāle kasmiṃścitsamaye mune || 79 || prādurāsījjaganmātā jaganmaṅgalakāriṇī | koṭisūryapratīkāśā koṭikandarpasundarī || 80 || citrānulepanā devī citravāsoyugānvitā | vicitramālyābharaṇā citrabhramaramuṣṭikā || 81 || varābhayakarā śāntā karuṇāmṛtasāgarā | nānābhramarasaṃyuktapuṣpamālāvirājitā || 82 || bhrāmarībhirvicitrābhirasaṃkhyābhiḥ samāvṛtā | bhramarairgāyamānaiśca hrīṃkāramanumanvaham || 83 || samantataḥ parivṛtā koṭikoṭibhirambikā | sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvavedapraśaṃsitā || 84 || sarvātmikā sarvamayī sarvamaṅgalarūpiṇī | sarvajñā sarvajananī sarvā sarveśvarī śivā || 85 || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ taralātmāno devā brahmapurogamāḥ | tuṣṭuvurhṛṣṭamanaso viṣṭaraśravasāṃ śivām || 86 || devā ūcuḥ namo devi mahāvidye sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇi | namaḥ kamalapatrākṣi sarvādhāre namo'stu te || 87 || saviśvataijasaprājñavirāṭsūtrātmike namaḥ | namo vyākṛtarūpāyai kūṭasthāyai namo namaḥ || 88 || durge sargādirahite duṣṭasaṃrodhanārgale | nirargalapremagamye bharge devi namo'stu te || 89 || namaḥ śrīkālike mātarnamo nīlasarasvati | ugratāre mahogre te nityameva namo namaḥ || 90 || namaḥ pītāmbare devi namastripurasundari | namo bhairavi mātaṅgi dhūmāvati namo namaḥ || 91 || chinnamaste namaste'stu kṣīrasāgarakanyake | namaḥ śākambhari śive namaste raktadantike || 92 || niśumbhaśumbhadalani raktabījavināśini | dhūmralocananirṇāśe vṛtrāsuranibarhiṇi || 93 || caṇḍamuṇḍapramathini dānavāntakare śive | namaste vijaye gaṅge śārade vikacānane || 94 || pṛthvīrūpe dayārūpe tejorūpe namo namaḥ | prāṇarūpe mahārūpe bhūtarūpe namo'stu te || 95 || viśvamūrte dayāmūrte dharmamūrte namo namaḥ | devamūrte jyotimūrte jñānamūrte namo'stu te || 96 || gāyatri varade devi sāvitri ca sarasvati | namaḥ svāhe svadhe mātardakṣiṇe te namo namaḥ || 97 || neti netīti vākyairyā bodhyate sakalāgamaiḥ | sarvapratyaksvarūpāṃ tāṃ bhajāmaḥ paradevatām || 98 || bhramarairveṣṭitā yasmād bhrāmarī yā tataḥ smṛtā | tasyai devyai namo nityaṃ nityameva namo namaḥ || 99 || namaste pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe namaste purato'mbike | nama ūrdhvaṃ namaścādhaḥ sarvatraiva namo namaḥ || 100 || kṛpāṃ kuru mahādevi maṇidvīpādhivāsini | anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍanāyike jagadambike || 101 || jaya devi jaganmātarjaya devi parātpare | jaya śrībhuvaneśāni jaya sarvottamottame || 102 || kalyāṇaguṇaratnānāmākare bhuvaneśvari | prasīda parameśāni prasīda jagatoraṇe || 103 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca iti devavacaḥ śrutvā pragalbhaṃ madhuraṃ vacaḥ | uvāca jagadambā sā mattakokilabhāṣiṇī || 104 || devyuvāca prasannāhaṃ sadā devā varadeśaśikhāmaṇiḥ | bruvantu vibudhāḥ sarve yadeva syāccikīrṣitam || 105 || devīvākyaṃ surāḥ śrutvā procurduḥkhasya kāraṇam | duṣṭadaityasya caritaṃ jagadbādhākaraṃ param || 106 || devabrāhmaṇavedānāṃ helanaṃ nāśanaṃ tathā | sthānabhraṃśaṃ surāṇāṃ ca kathayāmāsurādṛtāḥ || 107 || brahmaṇo varadānaṃ ca yathāvatte samūcire | śrutvā devamukhādvāṇīṃ mahābhagavatī tadā || 108 || prerayāmāsa hastasthānbhramarānbhrāmarī tadā | pārśvasthānagnabhāgasthānnānārūpadharāṃstathā || 109 || janayāmāsa bahuśo yairvyāptaṃ bhuvanatrayam | maṭacīyūthavatteṣāṃ samudāyastu nirgataḥ || 110 || tadāntarikṣaṃ tairvyāptamandhakāraḥ kṣitāvabhūt | divi parvataśṛṅgeṣu drumeṣu vipineṣvapi || 111 || bhramarā eva sañjātāstadadbhutamivābhavat | te sarve daityavakṣāṃsi dārayāmāsurudgatāḥ || 112 || naraṃ madhuharaṃ yadvanmakṣikāḥ kopasaṃyutāḥ | upāyo na ca śastrāṇāṃ tathāstrāṇāṃ tadābhavat || 113 || na yuddhaṃ na ca sambhāṣā kevalaṃ maraṇaṃ khalu | yasminyasminsthale ye ye sthitā daityā yathā yathā || 114 || tatraiva ca tathā sarve maraṇaṃ prāpurutsmayāḥ | parasparaṃ samācāro na kasyāpyabhavattadā || 115 || kṣaṇamātreṇa te sarve vinaṣṭā daityapuṅgavāḥ | kṛtvetthaṃ bhramarāḥ kāryaṃ devīnikaṭamāyayuḥ || 116 || āścaryametadāścaryamiti lokāḥ samūcire | kiṃ citraṃ jagadambāyā yasyā māyeyamīdṛśī || 117 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ | nimagnā harṣajaladhau pūjayāmāsurambikām || 118 || nānopacārairvividhairnānopāyanapāṇayaḥ | jayaśabdaṃ prakurvāṇā mumucuḥ sumanāṃsi ca || 119 || divi dundubhayo nedurnanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ | peṭhurvedānmuniśreṣṭhā gandharvādyā jagustathā || 120 || mṛdaṅgamurajāvīṇāḍhakkāḍamaruniḥsvanaiḥ | ghaṇṭāśaṅkhaninādaiśca vyāptamāsījjagattrayam || 121 || nānāstotraistadā stutvā mūrdhnyādhāyājjalīṃstathā | jaya mātarjayeśānītyevaṃ sarve samūcire || 122 || tatastuṣṭā mahādevī varāndattvā pṛthakpṛthak | svasmiṃśca vipulāṃ bhaktiṃ prārthitā tairdadau ca tām || 123 || paśyatāmeva devānāmantardhānaṃ gatā tataḥ | iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ bhrāmaryāścaritaṃ mahat || 124 || paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | śrutamāścaryajanakaṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakam || 125 || evaṃ manūnāṃ sarveṣāṃ caritaṃ pāpanāśanam | devīmāhātmyasaṃyuktaṃ paṭhañśṛṇvañśubhapradam || 126 || yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādyo'niśaṃ naraḥ | sarvapāpavinirmukto devīsāyujyamāpnuyāt || 127 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ daśamaskandhe bhrāmarīcaritravarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <11.1> manukṛtaṃ devīstavanam nārada uvāca bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa nārāyaṇa sanātana | ākhyātaṃ paramāścaryaṃ devīcāritramuttamam || 1 || prādurbhāvaḥ paro mātuḥ kāryārthamasuradruhām | adhikārāptiruktātra devīpūrṇakṛpāvaśāt || 2 || adhunā śrotumicchāmi yena prīṇāti sarvadā | svabhaktānparipuṣṇāti tamācāraṃ vada prabho || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nārada tattvajña sadācāravidhikramam | yadanuṣṭhānamātreṇa devī prīṇāti sarvadā || 4 || prātarutthāya kartavyaṃ yad dvijena dine dine | tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi dvijānāmupakārakam || 5 || udayāstamayaṃ yāvad dvijaḥ satkarmakṛdbhavet | nityanaimittikairyuktaḥ kāmyaiścānyairagarhitaiḥ || 6 || ātmanaśca sahāyārthaṃ pitā mātā na tiṣṭhati | na putradārā na jñātirdharmastiṣṭhati kevalam || 7 || tasmāddharmaṃ sahāyārthaṃ nityaṃ sañcinu sādhanaiḥ | dharmeṇaiva sahāyāttu tamastarati dustaram || 8 || ācāraḥ prathamo dharmaḥ śrutyuktaḥ smārta eva ca | tasmādasminsamāyukto nityaṃ syādātmano dvijaḥ || 9 || ācārāllabhate cāyurācārāllabhate prajāḥ | ācārādannamakṣayyamācāro hanti pātakam || 10 || ācāraḥ paramo dharmo nṛṇāṃ kalyāṇakārakaḥ | iha loke sukhī bhūtvā paratra labhate sukham || 11 || ajñānāndhajanānāṃ tu mohitairbhrāmitātmanām | dharmarūpo mahādīpo muktimārgapradarśakaḥ || 12 || ācārātprāpyate śraiṣṭhyamācārātkarma labhyate | karmaṇo jāyate jñānamiti vākyaṃ manoḥ smṛtam || 13 || sarvadharmavariṣṭho'yamācāraḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ | tadeva jñānamuddiṣṭaṃ tena sarvaṃ prasādhyate || 14 || yastvācāravihīno'tra vartate dvijasattamaḥ | sa śūdravad bahiṣkāryo yathā śūdrastathaiva saḥ || 15 || ācāro dvividhaḥ proktaḥ śāstrīyo laukikastathā | ubhāvapi prakartavyau na tyājyau śubhamicchatā || 16 || grāmadharmā jātidharmā deśadharmāḥ kulodbhavāḥ | parigrāhyā nṛbhiḥ sarvairnaiva tām̐llaṅghayenmune || 17 || durācāro hi puruṣo loke bhavati ninditaḥ | duḥkhabhāgī ca satataṃ vyādhinā vyāpta eva ca || 18 || parityajedarthakāmau yau syātāṃ dharmavarjitau | dharmamapyasukhodarkaṃ lokavidviṣṭameva ca || 19 || nārada uvāca bahutvādiha śāstrāṇāṃ niścayaḥ syātkathaṃ mune | kiyatpramāṇaṃ tad brūhi dharmamārgavinirṇaye || 20 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca śrutismṛtī ubhe netre purāṇaṃ hṛdayaṃ smṛtam | etattrayokta eva syāddharmo nānyatra kutracit || 21 || virodho yatra tu bhavettrayāṇāṃ ca parasparam | śrutistatra pramāṇaṃ syād dvayordvaidhe smṛtirvarā || 22 || śrutidvaidhaṃ bhavedyatra tatra dharmāvubhau smṛtau | smṛtidvaidhaṃ tu yatra syādviṣayaḥ kalpyatāṃ pṛthak || 23 || purāṇeṣu kvaciccaiva tantradṛṣṭaṃ yathātatham | dharmaṃ vadanti taṃ dharmaṃ gṛhṇīyānna kathañcana || 24 || vedāvirodhi cettantraṃ tatpramāṇaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | pratyakṣaśrutiruddhaṃ yattatpramāṇaṃ bhavenna ca || 25 || sarvathā veda evāsau dharmamārgapramāṇakaḥ | tenāviruddhaṃ yatkiñcittatpramāṇaṃ na cānyathā || 26 || yo vedadharmamujjhitya vartate'nyapramāṇataḥ | kuṇḍāni tasya śikṣārthaṃ yamaloke vasanti hi || 27 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena vedoktaṃ dharmamāśrayet | smṛtiḥ purāṇamanyadvā tantraṃ vā śāstrameva ca || 28 || tanmūlatve pramāṇaṃ syānnānyathā tu kadācana | ye kuśāstrābhiyogena vartayantīha mānavān || 29 || adhomukhordhvapādāste yāsyanti narakārṇavam | kāmācārāḥ pāśupatāstathā vai liṅgadhāriṇaḥ || 30 || taptamudrāṅkitā ye ca vaikhānasamatānugāḥ | te sarve nirayaṃ yānti vedamārgabahiṣkṛtāḥ || 31 || vedoktameva saddharmaṃ tasmātkuryānnaraḥ sadā | utthāyotthāya boddhavyaṃ kiṃ mayādya kṛtaṃ kṛtam || 32 || dattaṃ vā dāpitaṃ vāpi vākyenāpi ca bhāṣitam | upapāpeṣu sarveṣu pātakeṣu mahatsvapi || 33 || avāpya rajanīyāmaṃ brahmadhyānaṃ samācaret | ūrusthottānacaraṇaḥ savye corau tathottaram || 34 || uttānaṃ kiñciduttānaṃ mukhamavaṣṭabhya corasā | nimīlitākṣaḥ sattvastho dantairdantānna saṃspṛśet || 35 || tālusthācalajihvaśca saṃvṛtāsyaḥ suniścalaḥ | sanniruddhendriyagrāmo nātinimnasthitāsanaḥ || 36 || dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vāpi prāṇāyāmamupakramet | tato dhyeyaḥ sthito yo'sau hṛdaye dīpavatprabhuḥ || 37 || dhārayettatra cātmānaṃ dhāraṇāṃ dhārayedbudhaḥ | sadhūmaśca vidhūmaśca sagarbhaścāpyagarbhakaḥ || 38 || salakṣyaścāpyalakṣyaśca prāṇāyāmastu ṣaḍvidhaḥ | prāṇāyāmasamo yogaḥ prāṇāyāma itīritaḥ || 39 || prāṇāyāma iti prokto recapūrakakumbhakaiḥ | varṇatrayātmakā hyete recapūrakakumbhakāḥ || 40 || sa eva praṇavaḥ proktaḥ prāṇāyāmaśca tanmayaḥ | iḍayā vāyumāropya pūrayitvodare sthitam || 41 || śanaiḥ ṣoḍaśamātrābhiranyayā taṃ virecayet | evaṃ sadhūmaḥ prāṇānāmāyāmaḥ kathito mune || 42 || ādhāreliṅganābhiprakaṭitahṛdaye tālumūle lalāṭe dve patre ṣoḍaśāre dvidaśadaśadaladvādaśārdhe catuṣke | vāsānte bālamadhye ḍaphakatasahite kaṇṭhadeśe svarāṇāṃ haṃkṣaṃtattvārthayuktaṃ sakaladalagataṃ varṇarūpaṃ namāmi || 43 || aruṇakamalasaṃsthā tadrajaḥpuñjavarṇā haraniyamitacihnā padmatantusvarūpā | ravihutavaharākānāyakāsyastanāḍhyā sakṛdapi yadi citte saṃvasetsyātsa bhuktaḥ || 44 || sthitiḥ saiva gatiryātrā matiścintā stutirvacaḥ | ahaṃ sarvātmako devaḥ stutiḥ sarvaṃ tvadarcanam || 45 || ahaṃ devī na cānyo'smi brahmaivāhaṃ na śokabhāk | saccidānandarūpo'haṃ svātmānamiti cintayet || 46 || prakāśamānāṃ prathame prayāṇe pratiprayāṇe'pyamṛtāyamānām | antaḥpadavyāmanusañcarantīmānandarūpāmabalāṃ prapadye || 47 || tato nijabrahmarandhre dhyāyettaṃ gurumīśvaram | upacārairmānasaiśca pūjayettu yathāvidhi || 48 || stuvītānena mantreṇa sādhako niyatātmavān | gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ | gurureva paraṃ brahma tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 49 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe manukṛtaṃ devīstavanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || <11.2> śaucavidhivarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ācārahīnaṃ na punanti vedā yadapyadhītāḥ saha ṣaḍbhiraṅgaiḥ | chandāṃsyenaṃ mṛtyukāle tyajanti nīḍaṃ śakuntā iva jātapakṣāḥ || 1 || brāhme muhūrtte cotthāya tatsarvaṃ samyagācaret | rātrerantimayāme tu vedābhyāsaṃ cared budhaḥ || 2 || kiñcitkālaṃ tataḥ kuryādiṣṭadevānucintanam | yogī tu pūrvamārgeṇa brahmadhyānaṃ samācaret || 3 || jīvabrahmaikyatā yena jāyate tu nirantaram | jīvanmuktaśca bhavati tatkṣaṇādeva nārada || 4 || pañcapañca uṣaḥkālaḥ saptapañcāruṇodayaḥ | aṣṭapañcabhavetprātaḥ śeṣaḥ sūryodayaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5 || prātarutthāya yaḥ kuryādviṇmūtraṃ dvijasattamaḥ | nairṛtyāmiṣuvikṣepamatītyābhyadhikaṃ bhuvaḥ || 6 || viṇmūtre'pi ca karṇastha āśrame prathame dvijaḥ | nivītaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kuryādvānaprasthagṛhasthayoḥ || 7 || kṛtvā yajñopavītaṃ tu pṛṣṭhataḥ kaṇṭhalambitam | viṇmūtraṃ tu gṛhī kuryātkarṇasthaṃ prathamāśramī || 8 || antardhāya tṛṇairbhūmiṃ śiraḥ prāvṛtya vāsasā | vācaṃ niyamya yatnena ṣṭhīvanaśvāsavarjitaḥ || 9 || na phālakṛṣṭe na jale na citāyāṃ na parvate | jīrṇadevālaye kuryānna valmīke na śādvale || 10 || na sasattveṣu garteṣu na gacchanna pathi sthitaḥ | sandhyayorubhayorjapye bhojane dantadhāvane || 11 || pitṛkārye ca daive ca tathā mūtrapurīṣayoḥ | utsāhe maithune vāpi tathā vai gurusannidhau || 12 || yāge dāne brahmayajñe dvijo maunaṃ samācaret | devatā ṛṣayaḥ sarve piśācoragarākṣasāḥ || 13 || ito gacchantu bhūtāni bahirbhūmiṃ karomyaham | iti samprārthya paścāttu kuryācchaucaṃ yathāvidhi || 14 || vāyvagnī vipramādityamāpaḥ paśyaṃstathaiva gāḥ | na kadācana kurvīta viṇmūtrasya visarjanam || 15 || udaṅmukho divā kuryādrātrau ceddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | tata ācchādya viṇmūtraṃ loṣṭhaparṇatṛṇādibhiḥ || 16 || gṛhītaliṅga utthāya sa gacchedvārisannidhau | pātre jalaṃ gahītvā tu gacchedanyatra caiva hi || 17 || gṛhītvā mṛttikāṃ kūlācchvetāṃ brāhmaṇasattamaḥ | raktāṃ pītāṃ tathā kṛṣṇāṃ gṛhṇīyuścānyavarṇakāḥ || 18 || athavā yā yatra deśe saiva grāhyā dvijottamaiḥ | antarjalāddevagṛhādvalmīkānmūṣakotkarāt || 19 || kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭācca na grāhyāḥ pañcamṛttikāḥ | mūtrāttu dviguṇaṃ śauce maithune triguṇaṃ smṛtam || 20 || ekā liṅge kare tisra ubhayormṛddvayaṃ smṛtam | mūtraśaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ śauce tad dviguṇaṃ smṛtam || 21 || viṭśauce liṅgadeśe tu pradadyānmṛttikādvayam | pañcāpāne daśaikasminnubhayoḥ sapta mṛttikāḥ || 22 || vāmapādaṃ puraskṛtya paścāddakṣiṇameva ca | pratyekaṃ ca caturvāraṃ mṛttikāṃ lepayetsudhīḥ || 23 || evaṃ śaucaṃ gṛhasthasya dviguṇaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ | triguṇaṃ vānaprasthasya yatīnāṃ ca caturguṇam || 24 || ārdrāmalakamānā tu mṛttikā śaucakarmaṇi | pratyekaṃ tu sadā grāhyā nāto nyūnā kadācana || 25 || etaddivā syādviṭśaucaṃ tadardhaṃ niśi kīrtitam | āturasya tadardhaṃ tu mārgasthasya tadardhakam || 26 || strīśūdrāṇāmaśaktānāṃ bālānāṃ śaucakarmaṇi | yathā gandhakṣayaḥ syāttu tathā kuryādasaṃkhyakam || 27 || gandhalepakṣayo yāvattāvacchaucaṃ vidhīyate | sarveṣāmeva varṇānāmityāha bhagavānmanuḥ || 28 || vāmahastena śaucaṃ tu kuryādvai dakṣiṇena na | nābheradho vāmahasto nābherūrdhvaṃ tu dakṣiṇaḥ || 29 || śaucakarmaṇi vijñeyo nānyathā dvijapuṅgavaiḥ | jalapātraṃ na gṛhṇīyādviṇmūtrotsarjane budhaḥ || 30 || gṛhṇīyādyadi mohena prāyaścittaṃ carettataḥ | mohādvāpyathavā''lasyānna kuryācchaucamātmanaḥ || 31 || jalāhārastrirātraḥ syāttato jāpācca śudhyati | deśakāladravyaśaktisvopapattīśca sarvaśaḥ || 32 || jñātvā śaucaṃ prakartavyamālasyaṃ nātra dhārayet | purīṣotsarjane kuryād gaṇḍūṣāndvādaśaiva tu || 33 || caturo mūtravikṣepe nāto nyūnānkadācana | adhomukhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā tyajettaṃ vāmataḥ śanaiḥ || 34 || ācamya ca tataḥ kuryāddantadhāvanamādarāt | kaṇṭakikṣīravṛkṣotthaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamavraṇam || 35 || kaniṣṭhikāgravatsthūlaṃ pūrvārdhe kṛtakūrcakam | karañjodumbarau cūtaḥ kadambo lodhracampakau | badarīti drumāśceti proktā dantapradhāvane || 36 || annādyāya vyūhadhvaṃse somo rājāyamāgamat | sa me mukhaṃ prakṣālya tejasā ca bhagena ca || 37 || āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca | brahmaprajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvanno dehi vanaspate || 38 || abhāve dantakāṣṭhasya pratiṣiddhadineṣu ca | apāṃ dvādaśagaṇḍūṣairvidadhyāddantadhāvanam || 39 || raverdine yaḥ kurute prāṇī dantasya dhāvanam | savitā bhakṣitastena svakulaṃ tena ghātitam || 40 || pratipaddarśaṣaṣṭhīṣu navamyekādaśīravau | dantānāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃyogāddahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam || 41 || kṛtvālaṃ pādaśaucaṃ hyamalamatha jalaṃ triḥpibed dvirvimṛjya tarjanyāṅguṣṭhavatyā sajalamabhimṛśennāsikārandhrayugmam | aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ nayanayugayutaṃ karṇayugmaṃ kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ nābhideśe hṛdayamatha talenāṅgulībhiḥ śirāṃsi || 42 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe śaucavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <11.3> kṣamāhātmyavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca (śuddhaṃ smārtaṃ cācamanaṃ paurāṇaṃ vaidikaṃ tathā | tāntrikaṃ śrautamityāhuḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ śruticoditam || viṇmūtrādikaśaucaṃ ca śuddhaṃ ca parikīrtitam | smārtaṃ paurāṇikaṃ karma ācānte vidhipūrvakam || vaidikaṃ śrautramityādi brahmayajñādipūrvakam | astravidyādikaṃ karma tāntriko vidhirucyate ||) smṛtvā coṅkāragāyatrīṃ nibadhnīyācchikhāṃ tathā | punarācamya hṛdayaṃ bāhū skandhau ca saṃspṛśet || 1 || kṣute niṣṭhīvane caiva dantocchiṣṭe tathānṛte | patitānāṃ ca sambhāṣe dakṣiṇaṃ śravaṇaṃ spṛśet || 2 || agnirāpaśca vedāśca somaḥ sūryo'nilastathā | sarve nārada viprasya karṇe tiṣṭhanti dakṣiṇe || 3 || tatastu gatvā nadyādau prātaḥsnānaṃ viśodhanam | samācarenmuniśreṣṭha dehasaṃśuddhihetave || 4 || atyantamalino deho navadvārairmalaṃ vahan | sadā''ste tacchodhanāya prātaḥsnānaṃ vidhīyate || 5 || agamyāgamanātpāpaṃ yacca pāpaṃ pratigrahāt | rahasyācaritaṃ pāpaṃ mucyate snānakarmaṇā || 6 || asnātasya kriyāḥ sarvā bhavanti viphalā yataḥ | tasmātprātaścaretsnānaṃ nityameva dine dine || 7 || darbhayuktaścaretsnānaṃ tathā sandhyābhivandanam | saptāhaṃ prātarasnāyī sandhyāhīnastribhirdinaiḥ || 8 || dvādaśāhamanagniḥ sandvijaḥ śūdratvamāpnuyāt | alpatvāddhomakālasya bahutvātsnānakarmaṇaḥ || 9 || prātarna tu tathā snāyāddhomakāle vigarhitaḥ | gāyatryāstu paraṃ nāsti iha loke paratra ca || 10 || gāyantaṃ trāyate yasmādgāyatrītyabhidhīyate | praṇavena tu saṃyuktāṃ vyāhṛtitrayasaṃyutām || 11 || vāyuṃ vāyau jayedvipraḥ prāṇasaṃyamanatrayāt | brāhmaṇaḥ śrutisampannaḥ svadharmanirataḥ sadā || 12 || sa vaidikaṃ japenmantraṃ laukikaṃ na kadācana | gauśṛṅge sarṣapo yāvat tāvadyeṣāṃ na sa sthiraḥ || 13 || na tārayantyubhau pakṣau pitṝnekottaraṃ śatam | sagarbho japasaṃyuktastvagarbho dhyānamātrakaḥ || 14 || snānāṅgatarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā devarṣipitṛtoṣakam | śuddhe vastre parīdhāya jalādbahirupāgataḥ || 15 || vibhūtidhāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ rudrākṣāṇāṃ ca dhāraṇam | kramayogena kartavyaṃ sarvadā japasādhakaiḥ || 16 || rudrākṣānkaṇṭhadeśe daśanaparimitānmastake viṃśatī dve ṣaṭ ṣaṭ karṇapradeśe karayugalakṛte dvādaśa dvādaśaiva | bāhvorindoḥ kalābhirnayanayugakṛte tvekamekaṃ śikhāyāṃ vakṣasyaṣṭādhikaṃ yaḥ kalayati śatakaṃ sa svayaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ || 17 || baddhvā svarṇena rudrākṣaṃ rajatenāthavā mune | śikhāyāṃ dhārayennityaṃ karṇayorvā samāhitaḥ || 18 || yajñopavīte haste vā kaṇṭhe tunde'thavā naraḥ | śrīmatpañcākṣareṇaiva praṇavena tathāpi vā || 19 || nirvyājabhaktyā medhāvī rudrākṣaṃ dhārayenmudā | rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ sākṣācchivajñānasya sādhanam || 20 || rudrākṣaṃ yacchikhāyāṃ tattāratattvamiti smaret | karṇayorubhayorbrahman devaṃ devīṃ ca bhāvayet || 21 || yajñopavīte vedāṃśca tathā haste diśaḥ smaret | kaṇṭhe sarasvatīṃ devīṃ pāvakaṃ cāpi bhāvayet || 22 || sarvāśramāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ rudrākṣāṇāṃ ca dhāraṇam | kartavyaṃ mantrataḥ proktaṃ dvijānāṃ nānyavarṇinām || 23 || rudrākṣadhāraṇādrudro bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | paśyannapi niṣiddhāṃśca tathā śṛṇvannapi smaran || 24 || jighrannapi tathā cāśnan pralapannapi santatam | kurvannapi sadā gacchanvisṛjannapi mānavaḥ || 25 || rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva sarvapāpairna lipyate | anena bhuktaṃ devena bhuktaṃ yattu tathā bhavet || 26 || pītaṃ rudreṇa tatpītaṃ ghrātaṃ ghrātaṃ śivena tat | rudrākṣadhāraṇe lajjā yeṣāmasti mahāmune || 27 || teṣāṃ nāsti vinirmokṣaḥ saṃsārājjanmakoṭibhiḥ | rudrākṣadhāriṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā parivādaṃ karoti yaḥ || 28 || utpattau tasya sāṅkaryamastveveti viniścayaḥ | rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva rudro rudratvamāpnuyāt || 29 || munayaḥ satyasaṅkalpā brahmā brahmatvamāgataḥ | rudrākṣadhāraṇācchreṣṭhaṃ na kiñcidapi vidyate || 30 || rudrākṣadhāriṇe bhaktyā vastraṃ dhānyaṃ dadāti yaḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || 31 || rudrākṣadhāriṇaṃ śrāddhe bhojayeta vimodataḥ | pitṛlokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 32 || rudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ pādau prakṣālyādbhiḥ pibennaraḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 33 || hāraṃ vā kaṭakaṃ vāpi suvarṇaṃ vā dvijottamaḥ | rudrākṣasahitaṃ bhaktyā dhārayan rudratāmiyāt || 34 || rudrākṣaṃ kevalaṃ vāpi yatra kutra mahāmate | samantrakaṃ vā mantreṇa rahitaṃ bhāvavarjitam || 35 || yo vā ko vā naro bhaktyā dhārayellajjayāpi vā | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ samyagjñānamavāpnuyāt || 36 || aho rudrākṣamāhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate | tasmātsarvaprayatnena kuryādrudrākṣadhāraṇam || 37 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe sadācāranirūpaṇe rudrākṣamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <11.4> rudrākṣamāhātmyavarṇanam nārada uvāca evaṃbhūtānubhāvo'yaṃ rudrākṣo bhavatānagha | varṇito mahatāṃ pūjyaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra kiṃ vada || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca evameva purā pṛṣṭo bhagavān giriśaḥ prabhuḥ | ṣaṇmukhena ca rudrastaṃ yaduvāca śṛṇuṣva tat || 2 || īśvara uvāca śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha tattvena kathayāmi samāsataḥ | tripuro nāma daityastu purā''sītsarvadurjayaḥ || 3 || jitāstena surāḥ sarve bahmaviṣṇvādidevatāḥ | sarvaistu kathite tasmiṃstadāhaṃ tripuraṃ prati || 4 || acintayaṃ mahāśastramaghorākhyaṃ manoharam | sarvadevamayaṃ divyaṃ jvalantaṃ ghorarūpi yat || 5 || tripurasya vadhārthāya devānāṃ tāraṇāya ca | sarvavighnopaśamanamaghorāstramacintayam || 6 || divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu cakṣurunmīlitaṃ mayā | paścānmamākulākṣibhyaḥ patitā jalabindavaḥ || 7 || tatrāśrubinduto jātā mahārudrākṣavṛkṣakāḥ | mamājñayā mahāsena sarveṣāṃ hitakāmyayā || 8 || babhūvuste ca rudrākṣā aṣṭatriṃśatprabhedataḥ | sūryanetrasamudbhūtāḥ kapilā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 9 || somanetrotthitāḥ śvetāste ṣoḍaśavidhāḥ kramāt | vahninetrodbhavāḥ kṛṣṇā daśa bhedā bhavanti hi || 10 || śvetavarṇaśca rudrākṣo jātito brāhma ucyate | kṣātro raktastathā miśro vaiśyaḥ kṛṣṇastu śūdrakaḥ || 11 || ekavaktraḥ śivaḥ sākṣādbrahmahatyāṃ vyapohati | dvivaktro devadevyo syādvividhaṃ nāśayedagham || 12 || trivaktrastvanalaḥ sākṣātstrīhatyāṃ dahati kṣaṇāt | caturvaktraḥ svayaṃ brahmā narahatyāṃ vyapohati || 13 || pañcavaktraḥ svayaṃ rudraḥ kālāgnirnāma nāmataḥ | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇodbhūtairagamyāgamanodbhavaiḥ || 14 || mucyate sarvapāpaistu pañcavaktrasya dhāraṇāt | ṣaḍvaktraḥ kārtikeyastu sa dhāryo dakṣiṇe kare || 15 || brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | saptavaktro mahābhāgo hyanaṅgo nāma nāmataḥ || 16 || taddhāraṇānmucyate hi svarṇasteyādipātakaiḥ | aṣṭavaktro mahāsena sākṣāddevo vināyakaḥ || 17 || antakūṭaṃ tūlakūṭaṃ svarṇakūṭaṃ tathaiva ca | duṣṭānvayastriyaṃ vātha saṃspṛśaṃśca gurustriyam || 18 || evamādīni pāpāni hanti sarvāṇi dhāraṇāt | vighnāstasya praṇaśyanti yāti cānte paraṃ padam || 19 || bhavantyete guṇāḥ sarve hyaṣṭavaktrasya dhāraṇāt | navavaktro bhairavastu dhārayedvāmabāhuke || 20 || bhuktimuktipradaḥ prokto mama tulyabalo bhavet | bhrūṇahatyāsahasrāṇi brahmahatyāśatāni ca || 21 || sadyaḥ pralayamāyānti navavaktrasya dhāraṇāt | daśavaktrastu deveśaḥ sākṣāddevo janārdanaḥ || 22 || grahāścaiva piśācāśca vetālā brahmarākṣasāḥ | pannagāścopaśāmyanti daśavaktrasya dhāraṇāt || 23 || vaktraikādaśarudrākṣo rudraikādaśakaṃ smṛtam | śikhāyāṃ dhārayedyo vai tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 24 || aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca | gavāṃ śatasahasrasya samyagdattasya yatphalam || 25 || tatphalaṃ labhate śīghraṃ vaktraikādaśadhāraṇāt | dvādaśāsyasya rudrākṣasyaiva karṇe tu dhāraṇāt || 26 || ādityāstoṣitā nityaṃ dvādaśāsye vyavasthitāḥ | gobhedhe cāśvamedhe ca yatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt || 27 || śṛṅgiṇāṃ śastriṇāṃ caiva vyāghrādīnāṃ bhayaṃ na hi | na ca vyādhibhayaṃ tasya naiva cādhiḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 28 || na ca kiñcidbhayaṃ tasya na ca vyādhiḥ pravartate | na kutaścidbhayaṃ tasya sukhī caiveśvaro bhavet || 29 || hastyaśvamṛgamārjārasarpamūṣakadardurān | kharāṃśca śvaśṛgālāṃśca hatvā bahuvidhānapi || 30 || mucyate nātra sandeho vaktradvādaśadhāraṇāt | vaktratrayodaśo vatsa rudrākṣo yadi labhyate || 31 || kārtikeyasamo jñeyaḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhidaḥ | raso rasāyanaṃ caiva tasya sarvaṃ prasiddhyati || 32 || tasyaiva sarvabhogyāni nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva bhrātaraṃ vā nihanti yaḥ || 33 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo dhāraṇāttasya ṣaṇmukha | caturdaśāsyo rudrākṣo yadi labhyeta putraka || 34 || dhārayetsatataṃ mūrdhni tasya piṇḍaḥ śivasya tu | kiṃ mune bahunoktena varṇanena punaḥ punaḥ || 35 || pūjyate santataṃ devaiḥ prāpyate ca parā gatiḥ | rudrākṣa ekaḥ śirasā dhāryo bhaktyā dvijottamaiḥ || 36 || ṣaḍviṃśadbhiḥ śiromālā pañcāśaddhṛdayena tu | kalākṣairbāhuvalaye arkākṣairmaṇibandhanam || 37 || aṣṭottaraśatairmālā pañcāśadbhiḥ ṣaḍānana | athavā saptaviṃśatyā kṛtvā rudrākṣamālikām || 38 || dhāraṇādvā japādvāpi hyanantaṃ phalamaśnute | aṣṭottaraśatairmālā rudrākṣairdhāryate yadi || 39 || kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti ṣaṇmukha | triḥsaptakulamuddhṛtya śivaloke mahīyate || 40 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe rudrākṣamāhāmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || <11.5> rudrākṣajapamālāvidhānavarṇanam īśvara uvāca lakṣaṇaṃ japamālāyāḥ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi ṣaṇmukha | rudrākṣasya mukhaṃ brahmā bindū rudra itīritaḥ || 1 || viṣṇuḥ pucchaṃ bhaveccaiva bhogamokṣaphalapradam | pañcaviṃśatibhiścākṣaiḥ pañcavaktraiḥ sakaṇṭakaiḥ || 2 || raktavarṇaiḥ sitairmiśraiḥ kṛtarandhravidarbhitaiḥ | akṣasūtraṃ prakartavyaṃ gopucchavalayākṛti || 3 || vaktraṃ vaktreṇa saṃyojya pucchaṃ pucchena yojayet | merumūrdhvamukhaṃ kuryāttadūrdhvaṃ nāgapāśakam || 4 || evaṃ saṃgrathitāṃ mālāṃ mantrasiddhipradāyinīm | prakṣālya gandhatoyena pañcagavyena copari || 5 || tataḥ śivāmbhasā''kṣālya tato mantragaṇānnyaset | spṛṣṭvā śivāstramantreṇa kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet || 6 || mūlamantraṃ nyasetpaścātpūrvavatkārayettathā | sadyojātādibhiḥ prokṣya yāvadaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 7 || mūlamantraṃ samuccārya śuddhabhūmau nidhāya ca | tasyopari nyasetsāmbaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇam || 8 || pratiṣṭhitā bhavenmālā sarvakāmaphalapradā | yasya devasya yo mantrastāṃ tenaivābhipūjayet || 9 || mūrdhni kaṇṭhe'thavā karṇe nyasedvā japamālikām | rudrākṣamālayā caivaṃ japtavyaṃ niyatātmanā || 10 || kaṇṭhe mūrdhni hṛdi prānte karṇe bāhuyuge'thavā | rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | 11 || kimatra bahunoktena varṇanena punaḥ punaḥ | rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ nityaṃ tasmādetatpraśasyate || 12 || snāne dāne jape home vaiśvadeve surārcane | prāyaścitte tathā śrāddhe dīkṣākāle viśeṣataḥ || 13 || arudrākṣadharo bhūtvā yatkiñcitkarma vaidikam | kurvanviprastu mohena narake patati dhruvam || 14 || rudrākṣaṃ dhārayenmūrdhni kaṇṭhe sūtre kare'thavā | suvarṇamaṇisambhinnaṃ śuddhaṃ nānyairdhṛtaṃ śivam || 15 || nāśucirdhārayedakṣaṃ sadā bhaktyaiva dhārayet | rudrākṣatarusambhūtavātodbhūtatṛṇānyapi || 16 || puṇyalokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham | rudrākṣaṃ dhārayanpāpaṃ kurvannapi ca mānavaḥ || 17 || sarvaṃ tarati pāpmānaṃ jābālaśrutirāha hi | paśavo hi ca rudrākṣadhāraṇādyānti rudratām || 18 || kimu ye dhārayanti sma narā rudrākṣamālikām | rudrākṣaḥ śirasā hyeko dhāryo rudraparaiḥ sadā || 19 || dhvaṃsanaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ sarvapāpavimocanam | vyāharanti ca nāmāni ye śambhoḥ paramātmanaḥ || 20 || rudrākṣālaṅkṛtā ye ca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ | rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ sarvaśreyo'rthibhirnṛbhiḥ || 21 || karṇapāśe śikhāyāṃ ca kaṇṭhe haste tathodare | mahādevaśca viṣṇuśca brahmā teṣāṃ vibhūtayaḥ || 22 || devāścānye tathā bhaktyā khalu rudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ | gotrarṣayaśca sarveṣāṃ kūṭasthā mūlarūpiṇaḥ || 23 || teṣāṃ vaṃśaprasūtāśca munayaḥ sakalā api | śrautadharmaparāḥ śuddhāḥ khalu rudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ || 24 || śraddhā na jāyate sākṣādvedasiddhe vimuktide | bahūnāṃ janmanāmante mahādevaprasādataḥ || 25 || rudrākṣadhāraṇe vāñchā svabhāvādeva jāyate | rudrākṣasya tu māhātmyaṃ jābālairādareṇa tu || 26 || paṭhyate munibhiḥ sarvairmayā putra tathaiva ca | rudrākṣasya phalaṃ caiva triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 27 || phalasya darśane puṇyaṃ sparśātkoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet | śatakoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dhāraṇāllabhate naraḥ || 28 || lakṣakoṭisahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca | japācca labhate nityaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 29 || haste corasi kaṇṭhe ca karṇayormastake tathā | rudrākṣaṃ dhārayedyastu sa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 30 || avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudravaddhi caredbhuvi | surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca vandanīyo yathā śivaḥ || 31 || rudrākṣadhārī satataṃ vandanīyastathā naraiḥ | ucchiṣṭo vā vikarmastho yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ || 32 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudrākṣasya tu dhāraṇāt | kaṇṭhe rudrākṣamābadhya śvāpi vā mriyate yadi || 33 || so'pi muktimavāpnoti kiṃ punarmānuṣo'pi saḥ | japadhyānavihīno'pi rudrākṣaṃ yadi dhārayet || 34 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim | ekaṃ vāpi hi rudrākṣaṃ kṛtvā yatnena dhārayet || 35 || ekaviṃśatimuddhṛtya rudraloke mahīyate | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rudrākṣasya punarvidhim || 36 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmekādaśaskandhe rudrākṣajapamālāvidhānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <11.6> rudrākṣamāhātmye guṇanidhimokṣavarṇanam īśvara uvāca mahāsena kuśagranthiputrājīvādayaḥ pare | rudrākṣasya tu naiko'pi kalāmarhati ṣoḍaśīm || 1 || puruṣāṇāṃ yathā viṣṇurgrahāṇāṃ ca yathā raviḥ | nadīnāṃ tu yathā gaṅgā munīnāṃ kaśyapo yathā || 2 || uccaiḥśravā yathāśvānāṃ devānāmīśvaro yathā | devīnāṃ tu yathā gaurī tadvacchreṣṭhamidaṃ bhavet || 3 || nātaḥ parataraṃ stotraṃ nātaḥ parataraṃ vratam | akṣayyeṣu ca dāneṣu rudrākṣastu viśiṣyate || 4 || śivabhaktāya śāntāya dadyādrudrākṣamuttamam | tasya puṇyaphalasyāntaṃ na cāhaṃ vaktumutsahe || 5 || dhṛtarudrākṣakaṇṭhāya yastvannaṃ samprayacchati | trisaptakulamuddhṛtya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 6 || yasya bhāle vibhūtirna nāṅge rudrākṣadhāraṇam | na śambhorbhavane pūjā sa vipraḥ śvapacādhamaḥ || 7 || khādanmāṃsaṃ pibanmadyaṃ saṅgacchannantyajānapi | pātakebhyo vimucyeta rudrākṣaṃ śirasi sthite || 8 || sarvayajñatapodānavedābhyāsaiśca yatphalam | tatphalaṃ labhate sadyo rudrākṣasya tu dhāraṇāt || 9 || vedaiścaturbhiryatpuṇyaṃ purāṇapaṭhanena ca | yattīrthasevanenaiva sarvavidyādibhistathā || 10 || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate sadyo rudrākṣasya tu dhāraṇāt | prayāṇakāle rudrākṣaṃ bandhayitvā mriyedyadi || 11 || sa rudratvamavāpnoti punarjanma na vidyate | rudrākṣaṃ dhārayetkaṇṭhe bāhvorvā mriyate yadi || 12 || kulaikaviṃśamuttārya rudraloke vasennaraḥ | brāhmaṇo vāpi cāṇḍālo nirguṇaḥ saguṇo'pi ca || 13 || bhasmarudrākṣadhārī yaḥ sa devatvaṃ śivaṃ vrajet | śucirvāpyaśucirvāpi tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣakaḥ || 14 || mleccho vāpyatha cāṇḍālo yuto vā sarvapātakaiḥ | rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva sa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ || 15 || śirasā dhārite koṭiḥ karṇayordaśakoṭayaḥ | śatakoṭirgale baddho mūrdhni koṭisahasrakam || 16 || ayutaṃ copavīte tu lakṣakoṭirbhuje sthite | maṇibandhe tu rudrākṣo mokṣasādhanakaḥ paraḥ || 17 || rudrākṣadhārako bhūtvā yatkiñcitkarma vaidikam | kurvanvipraḥ sadā bhaktyā mahadāpnoti tatphalam || 18 || rudrākṣamālikāṃ kaṇṭhe dhārayedbhaktivarjitaḥ | pāpakarmā tu yo nityaṃ sa muktaḥ sarvabandhanāt || 19 || rudrākṣārpitacetā yo rudrākṣastu na vai dhṛtaḥ | asau māheśvaro loke namasyaḥ sa tu liṅgavat || 20 || avidyo vā savidyo vā rudrākṣasya tu dhāraṇāt | śivalokaṃ prapadyeta kīkaṭe gardabho yathā || 21 || skanda uvāca rudrākṣānsandadhe deva gardabhaḥ kena hetunā | kīkaṭe kena vā dattastadbrūhi parameśvara || 22 || śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu putra purāvṛttaṃ gardabho vindhyaparvate | dhatte rudrākṣabhāraṃ tu vāhitaḥ pathikena tu || 23 || śrānto'samarthastadbhāraṃ voḍhuṃ patitavānbhuvi | prāṇaistvaktastrinetrastu śūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ || 24 || matprasādānmahāsena madantikamupāgataḥ | yāvadvaktrasya saṃkhyānaṃ rudrākṣāṇāṃ sudurlabham || 25 || tāvadyugasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate | svaśiṣyebhyastu vaktavyaṃ nāśiṣyebhyaḥ kadācana || 26 || abhaktebhyo'pi mūrkhebhyaḥ kadācinna prakāśayet | abhakto vāstu bhakto vā nīco nīcataro'pi vā || 27 || rudrākṣāndhārayedyastu mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kena vā sadṛśaṃ bhavet || 28 || mahāvratamidaṃ prāhurmunayastattvadarśinaḥ | sahasraṃ dhārayedyastu rudrākṣāṇāṃ dhṛtavrataḥ || 29 || taṃ namanti surāḥ sarve yathā rudrastathaiva saḥ | abhāve tu sahasrasya bāhvoḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa || 30 || ekaṃ śikhāyāṃ karayordvādaśa dvādaśaiva tu | dvātriṃśatkaṇṭhadeśe tu catvāriṃśacca mastake || 31 || ekaikaṃ karṇayoḥ ṣaṭ ṣaṭ vakṣasyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | yo dhārayati rudrākṣān rudravatsa tu pūjyate || 32 || muktāpravālaskaṭikaraupyavaidūryakāñcanaiḥ | sametāndhārayedyastu rudrākṣānsa śivo bhavet || 33 || kevalānapi rudrākṣānyadyālasyādbibharti yaḥ | taṃ na spṛśanti pāpāni tamāṃsīva vibhāvasum || 34 || rudrākṣamālayā mantro japto'nantaphalapradaḥ | yasyāṅge nāsti rudrākṣa eko'pi bahupuṇyadaḥ || 35 || tasya janma nirarthaṃ syāttripuṇḍrarahitaṃ yathā | rudrākṣaṃ mastake dhṛtvā śiraḥsnānaṃ karoti yaḥ || 36 || gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | ekavaktraḥ pañcavaktra ekādaśamukhāḥ pare || 37 || caturdaśamukhāḥ kecidrudrākṣā lokapūjitāḥ | bhaktyā saṃpūjyate nityaṃ rudrākṣaḥ śaṅkarātmakaḥ || 38 || daridraṃ vāpi puruṣaṃ rājānaṃ kurute bhuvi | atra te kathayiṣyāmi purāṇaṃ matamuttamam || 39 || kosaleṣu dvijaḥ kaścidgirinātha iti śrutaḥ | mahādhanī ca dharmātmā vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ || 40 || yajñakṛddīkṣitastasya tanayaḥ sundarākṛtiḥ | nāmnā guṇanidhiḥ khyātastaruṇaḥ kāmasundaraḥ || 41 || guroḥ sudhiṣaṇasyātha patnīṃ muktāvalīmatha | mohayāmāsa rūpeṇa yauvanena madena ca || 42 || saṅgatastu tayā sārdhaṃ kañcitkālaṃ tato bhiyā | viṣaṃ dadau ca gurave yebhe paścāttu nirbhayaḥ || 43 || yadā mātā pitā karma kiñcijjānāti yatkṣaṇe | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi mārayāmāsa tadviṣāt || 44 || nānāvilāsabhogaiśca jāte dravyavyaye tataḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛhe cauryaṃ cakāra sa tadā khalaḥ || 45 || surāpānamadonmattastadā jñātibahiṣkṛtaḥ | grāmānniṣkāsitaḥ sarvaistadā so'bhūdvanecaraḥ || 46 || muktāvalyā tayā sārdhaṃ jagāma gahanaṃ vanam | mārge sthito dravyalobhājjaghāna brāhmaṇānbahūn || 47 || evaṃ bahugate kāle mamāra sa tadādhamaḥ | netuṃ taṃ yamadūtāśca samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 48 || śivalokācchivagaṇāstathaiva ca samāgatāḥ | tayoḥ parasparaṃ vādo babhūva girijāsuta || 49 || yamadūtāstadā procuḥ puṇyamasya kimasti hi | bruvantu sevakāḥ śambhoryadyenaṃ netumicchatha || 50 || śivadūtāstadā procurayaṃ yasminsthale mṛtaḥ | daśahastādadho bhūme rudrākṣastatra cāsti hi || 51 || tatprabhāveṇa he dūtā neṣyāmaḥ śivasannidhim | tato vimānamāruhya divyarūpadharo dvijaḥ || 52 || gato guṇanidhirdūtaiḥ sahitaḥ śaṅkarālayam | iti rudrākṣamāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tava suvrata || 53 || evaṃ rudrākṣamahimā samāsātkathito mayā | sarvapāpakṣayakaro mahāpuṇyaphalapradaḥ || 54 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe rudrākṣamāhātmye guṇanidhimokṣavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <11.7> rudrākṣamāhātmyavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca evaṃ nārada ṣaḍvaktro giriśena vibodhitaḥ | rudrākṣamahimānaṃ ca jñātvāsītsa kṛtārthakaḥ || 1 || itthaṃ bhūtānubhāvo'yaṃ rudrākṣo varṇito mayā | sadācāraprasaṅgena śṛṇu cānyatsamāhitaḥ || 2 || yathā rudrākṣamahimā varṇito'nantapuṇyadaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ mantravinyāsaṃ tathāhaṃ varṇayāmi te || 3 || lakṣaṃ tu darśanātyuṇyaṃ koṭistatsparśanādbhavet | tasya koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate dhāraṇānnaraḥ || 4 || lakṣakoṭisahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca | tajjapāllabhate puṇyaṃ naro rudrākṣadhāraṇāt || 5 || rudrākṣāṇāṃ tu bhadrākṣadhāraṇātsyānmahāphalam | dhātrīphalapramāṇaṃ yacchreṣṭhametadudāhṛtam || 6 || badarīphalamātraṃ tu procyate madhyamaṃ budhaiḥ | adhamaṃ caṇamātraṃ syātpratijñaiṣā mayoditā || 7 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśceti śivājñayā | vṛkṣā jātāḥ pṛthivyāṃ tu tajjātīyāḥ śubhākṣakāḥ || 8 || śvetāstu brāhmaṇā jñeyāḥ kṣatriyā raktavarṇakāḥ | pītā vaiśyāstu vijñeyāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ śūdrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 9 || brāhmaṇo bibhṛyācchvetān raktān rājā tu dhārayet | pītānvaiśyastu bibhṛyātkṛṣṇān śūdrastu dhārayet || 10 || samāḥ snigdhā dṛḍhāstadvatkaṇṭakaiḥ saṃyutāḥ śubhāḥ | kṛmidaṣṭāñchinnabhinnānkaṇṭakairahitāṃstathā || 11 || vraṇayuktānāvṛtāṃśca ṣaḍrudrākṣāṃstu varjayet | svayameva kṛtadvāro rudrākṣaḥ syādihottamaḥ || 12 || yattu pauruṣayatnena kṛtaṃ tanmadhyamaṃ bhavet | samānsnigdhāndṛḍhānvṛttānkṣaumasūtreṇa dhārayet || 13 || sarvagātreṣu sāmyena samānātivilakṣaṇā | nirgharṣe hemalekhābhā yatra lekhā pradṛśyate || 14 || tadakṣamuttamaṃ vidyātsa dhāryaḥ śivapūjakaiḥ | śikhāyāmekarudrākṣaṃ triṃśadvai śirasā vahet || 15 || ṣaṭtriṃśacca gale dhāryā bāhvoḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa | maṇibandhe dvādaśākṣānskandhe pañcāśataṃ bhavet || 16 || aṣṭottaraśatairmālopavītaṃ ca prakalpayet | dvisaraṃ trisaraṃ vāpi bibhṛyātkaṇṭhadeśataḥ || 17 || kuṇḍale mukuṭe caiva karṇikāhārakeṣu ca | keyūre kaṭake caiva kukṣivaṃśe tathaiva ca || 18 || supte pīte sarvakālaṃ rudrākṣaṃ dhārayennaraḥ | triśataṃ tvadhamaṃ pañcaśataṃ madhyamamucyate || 19 || sahasramuttamaṃ proktaṃ caivaṃ bhedena dhārayet | śirasīśānamantreṇa karṇe tatpuruṣeṇa ca || 20 || aghoreṇa lalāṭe tu tenaiva hṛdaye'pi ca | aghorabījamantreṇa karayordhārayetpunaḥ || 21 || pañcāśadakṣagrathitāṃ vāmadevena codare | pañcabrahmabhiraṅgaiścāpyevaṃ rudrākṣadhāraṇam || 22 || grathitānmūlamantreṇa sarvānakṣāṃstu dhārayet | ekavaktrastu rudrākṣaḥ paratattvaprakāśakaḥ || 23 || paratattvadhāraṇācca jāyate tatprakāśanam | dvivaktrastu muniśreṣṭha ardhanārīśvaro bhavet || 24 || dhāraṇādardhanārīśaḥ prīyate tasya nityaśaḥ | trivaktrastvanalaḥ sākṣātstrīhatyāṃ dahati kṣaṇāt || 25 || trimukhaścaiva rudrākṣo'pyagnitrayasvarūpakaḥ | taddhāraṇācca hutabhuk tasya tuṣyati nityaśaḥ || 26 || caturmukhastu rudrākṣaḥ pitāmahasvarūpakaḥ | taddhāraṇānmahāśrīmānmahadārogyamuttamam || 27 || mahatī jñānasampattiḥ śuddhaye dhārayennaraḥ | pañcamukhastu rudrākṣaḥ pañcabrahmasvarūpakaḥ || 28 || tasya dhāraṇamātreṇa santuṣyati maheśvaraḥ | ṣaḍvaktraścaiva rudrākṣaḥ kārtikeyādhidaivataḥ || 29 || vināyakaṃ cāpi devaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | saptavaktrastu rudrākṣaḥ saptamātrādhidaivataḥ || 30 || saptāśvadaivataścaiva munisaptakadaivataḥ | taddhāraṇānmahāśrīḥ syānmahadārogyamuttamam || 31 || mahatī jñānasampattiḥ śucirvai dhārayennaraḥ | aṣṭavaktrastu rudrākṣo'pyaṣṭamātrādhidaivataḥ || 32 || vasvaṣṭakaprītikaro gaṅgāprītikaraḥ śubhaḥ | taddhāraṇādime prītā bhaveyuḥ satyavādinaḥ || 33 || navavaktrastu rudrākṣo yamadeva udāhṛtaḥ | taddhāraṇādyamabhayaṃ na bhavatyeva sarvathā || 34 || daśavaktrastu rudrākṣo daśāśādaivataḥ smṛtaḥ | daśāśāprītijanako dhāraṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ || 35 || ekādaśamukhastvakṣo rudraikādaśadaivataḥ | tamindradaivataṃ cāhuḥ sadā saukhyavivardhanam || 36 || rudrākṣo dvādaśamukho mahāviṣṇusvarūpakaḥ | dvādaśādityadaivaśca bibhartyeva hi tatparaḥ || 37 || trayodaśamukhaścākṣaḥ kāmadaḥ siddhidaḥ śubhaḥ | tasya dhāraṇamātreṇa kāmadevaḥ prasīdati || 38 || caturdaśamukhaścākṣo rudranetrasamudbhavaḥ | sarvavyādhiharaścaiva sarvārogyapradāyakaḥ || 39 || madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca laśunaṃ palāṇḍuṃ śigrumeva ca | śleṣmātakaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ bhakṣaṇe varjayettataḥ || 40 || grahaṇe viṣuve caiva saṅkrame tvayane tathā | darśe ca paurṇamāse ca puṇyeṣu divaseṣvapi | rudrākṣadhāraṇātsadyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 41 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe rudrākṣamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || <11.8> bhūtaśuddhivarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca bhūtaśuddhiprakāraṃ ca kathayāmi mahāmune | mūlādhārātsamutthāya kuṇḍalīṃ paradevatām || 1 || suṣumṇāmārgamāśritya brahmarandhragatāṃ smaret | jīvaṃ brahmaṇi saṃyojya haṃsamantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 2 || pādādijānuparyantaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ savajrakam | laṃ bījākhyaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ smaredavanimaṇḍalam || 3 || jānvādyānābhicandrārdhanibhaṃ padmadvayāṅkitam | vaṃ bījayuktaṃ śvetābhamambhaso maṇḍalaṃ smaret || 4 || nābherhṛdayaparyantaṃ trikoṇaṃ svastikānvitam | raṃ bījena yutaṃ raktaṃ smaretpāvakamaṇḍalam || 5 || hṛdo bhūmadhyaparyantaṃ vṛttaṃ ṣaḍbindulāñchitam | yaṃ bījayuktaṃ dhūmrābhaṃ nabhasvanmaṇḍalaṃ smaret || 6 || ābrahmarandhraṃ bhrūmadhyādvṛttaṃ svacchaṃ manoharam | haṃ bījayuktamākāśamaṇḍalaṃ ca vicintayet || 7 || evaṃ bhūtāni sañcintya pratyekaṃ saṃvilāpayet | bhuvaṃ jale jalaṃ vahnau vahniṃ vāyau nabhasyamum || 8 || vilāpya khamahaṅkāre mahattattve'pyahaṅkṛtim | mahāntaṃ prakṛtau māyāmātmani pravilāpayet || 9 || śuddhasaṃvinmayo bhūtvā cintayetpāpapūruṣam | vāmakukṣisthitaṃ kṛṣṇamaṅguṣṭhaparimāṇakam || 10 || brahmahatyāśiroyuktaṃ kanakasteyabāhukam | madirāpānahṛdayaṃ gurutalpakaṭīyutam || 11 || tatsaṃsargipadadvandvamupapātakamastakam | khaḍgacarmadharaṃ kṛṣṇamadhovaktraṃ suduḥsaham || 12 || vāyubījaṃ smaranvāyuṃ sampūryainaṃ viśoṣayet | svaśarīrayutaṃ mantro vahnibījena nirdahet || 13 || kumbhake parijaptena tataḥ pāpanarodbhavam | bahirbhasma samutsārya vāyubījena recayet || 14 || sudhābījena dehotthaṃ bhasma saṃplāvayetsudhīḥ | bhūbījena ghanīkṛtya bhasma tatkanakāṇḍavat || 15 || viśuddhamukurākāraṃ japanbījaṃ vihāyasaḥ | mūrdhādipādaparyantānyaṅgāni racayetsudhīḥ || 16 || ākāśādīni bhūtāni punarutpādayeccitaḥ | so'haṃ mantreṇa cātmānamānayeddhṛdayāmbuje || 17 || kuṇḍalījīvamādāya parasaṅgātsudhāmayam | saṃsthāpya hṛdayāmbhoje mūlādhāragatāṃ smaret || 18 || raktāmbhodhisthapotollasadaruṇasarojādhirūḍhā karābjaiḥ śūlaṃ kodaṇḍamikṣūdbhavamaṇiguṇamapyaṅkuśaṃ pañcabāṇān | bibhrāṇāsṛkkapālaṃ trinayanalasitā pīnavakṣoruhāḍhyā devī bālārkavarṇā bhavatu sukhakarī prāṇaśaktiḥ parā naḥ || 19 || evaṃ dhyātvā prāṇaśaktiṃ paramātmasvarūpiṇīm | vibhūtidhāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ sarvādhikṛtisiddhaye || 20 || vibhūtervistaraṃ vakṣye dhāraṇe ca mahāphalam | śrutismṛtipramāṇoktaṃ bhasmadhāraṇamuttamam || 21 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe bhūtaśuddhivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <11.9> saśirovrataṃ tripuṇḍadhāraṇavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca idaṃ śirovrataṃ cīrṇaṃ vidhivadyairdvijātibhiḥ | teṣāmeva parāṃ vidyāṃ vadedajñānabādhikām || 1 || vidhivacchraddhayā sārdhaṃ na cīrṇaṃ yaiḥ śirovratam | śrautasmārtasamācārasteṣāmanupakārakaḥ || 2 || śirovratasamācārādeva brahmādidevatāḥ | devatā abhavanvidvan khalu nānyena hetunā || 3 || śirovratasya māhātmyaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca devatāḥ sakalā api || 4 || sarvapātakayukto'pi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | śirovratamidaṃ yena caritaṃ vidhivadbudhaiḥ || 5 || śirovratamidaṃ nāma śirasyātharvaṇaśruteḥ | yaduktaṃ taddhi naivānyattattu puṇyena labhyate || 6 || śākhābhedeṣu nāmāni vratasyāsya vibhedataḥ | paṭhyante muniśārdūla śākhāsvekavrataṃ hi tat || 7 || sarvaśākhāsu vastvekaṃ śivākhyaṃ satyacidghanam | tathā tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ tathaiva ca śirotavratam || 8 || śirovratavihīnastu sarvadharmavivarjitaḥ | api sarvāsu vidyāsu so'dhikārī na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || śirovratamidaṃ kāryaṃ pāpakāntāradāhakam | sādhanaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ yatastatsamyagācaret || 10 || śrutirātharvaṇī sūkṣmā sūkṣmārthasya prakāśinī | yaduvāca vrataṃ prītyā tannityaṃ samyagācaret || 11 || agnirityādibhirmantraiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śuddhena bhasmanā | sarvāṅgoddhūlanaṃ kuryācchirovratasamāhvayam || 12 || etacchirovrataṃ kuryātsandhyākāleṣu sādaram | yāvadvidyodayastāvattasya vidyā khalūttamā || 13 || dvādaśābdamathābdaṃ vā tadardhaṃ ca tadardhakam | prakuryāddvādaśāhaṃ vā saṅkalpena śirovratam || 14 || śirovratena yaḥ snātastaṃ tu nopadiśettu yaḥ | tasya vidyā vinaṣṭā syānnirghṛṇaḥ sa guruḥ khalu || 15 || brahmavidyāguruḥ sākṣānmuniḥ kāruṇikaḥ khalu | yathā sarveśvaraḥ śrīmānmṛduḥ kāruṇikaḥ khalu || 16 || janmāntarasahasreṣu narā ye dharmacāriṇaḥ | teṣāmeva khalu śraddhā jāyate na kadācana || 17 || pratyutājñānabāhulyāddveṣa eva vijāyate | ataḥ pradveṣayuktasya na bhavedātmavedanam || 18 || brahmavidyopadeśasya sākṣādevādhikāriṇaḥ | ta eva netare vidvan ye tu snātāḥ śirovrataiḥ || 19 || vrataṃ pāśupataṃ cīrṇaṃ yairdvijairādareṇa tu | teṣāmevopadeṣṭavyamiti vedānuśāsanam || 20 || yaḥ paśustatpaśutvaṃ ca vratenānena santyajet | tānhatvā na sa pāpīyānbhavedvedāntaniścayaḥ || 21 || tripuṇḍradhāraṇaṃ proktaṃ jābālairādareṇa tu | triyambakena mantreṇa satāreṇa śivena ca || 22 || tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayennityaṃ gahasthāśramamāśritaḥ | oṅkāreṇa triruktena sahaṃsena tripuṇḍrakam || 23 || dhārayedbhikṣuko nityamiti jābālikī śrutiḥ | triyambakena mantreṇa praṇavena śivena ca || 24 || gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho dhārayecca tripuṇḍrakam | medhāvītyādinā vāpi brahmacārī dine dine || 25 || bhasmanā sajalenāpi dhārayecca tripuṇḍrakam | brāhmaṇo vidhinotpannastripuṇḍrabhasmanaiva tu || 26 || lalāṭe dhārayennityaṃ tiryagbhasmāvaguṇṭhanam | (mahādevasya sambandhāttaddharme'pyasti saṅgatiḥ |) samyak tripuṇḍradharmaṃ ca brāhmaṇo nityamācaret || 27 || ādibrāhmaṇabhūtena tripuṇḍraṃ bhasmanā dhṛtam | yato'ta eva viprastu tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayetsadā || 28 || bhasmanā vedasiddhena tripuṇḍraṃ dehaguṇṭhanam | rudraliṅgārcanaṃ vāpi mohato'pi ca na tyajet || 29 || triyambakena mantreṇa satāreṇa tathaiva ca | pañcākṣareṇa mantreṇa praṇavena tathaiva ca || 30 || lalāṭe hṛdaye caiva dordvandve ca mahāmune | tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayennityaṃ saṃnyāsāśramamāśritaḥ || 31 || triyāyuṣeṇa mantreṇa medhāvītyādināthavā | gauṇena bhasmanā dhāryaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ brahmacāriṇā || 32 || namo'ntena śivenaiva śūdraḥ śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ | uddhūlanaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca nityaṃ bhaktyā samācaret || 33 || anyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ vinā mantreṇa suvrata | uddhūlanaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca kartavyaṃ bhaktito mune || 34 || bhūtyaivoddhūlanaṃ tiryak tripuṇḍrasya ca dhāraṇam | vareṇyaṃ sarvadharmebhyastasmānnityaṃ samācaret || 35 || bhasmāgnihotrajaṃ vātha virajāgnisamudbhavam | ādareṇa samādāya śuddhe pātre nidhāya tat || 36 || prakṣālya pādau hastau ca dvirācamya samāhitaḥ | gṛhītvā bhasma tatpañcabrahmamantraiḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 37 || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā agnirityādimantritam | taireva saptabhirmantraistrivāramabhimantrayet || 38 || omāpojyotirityuktvā dhyātvā mantrānudīrayet | sitena bhasmanā pūrvaṃ samuddhūlya śarīrakam || 39 || vipāpo virajo martyo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | tato dhyātvā mahāviṣṇuṃ jagannāthaṃ jalādhipam || 40 || saṃyojya bhasmanā toyamagnirityādibhiḥ punaḥ | vimṛjya sāmbaṃ dhyātvā ca samuddhūlyordhvamastakam || 41 || tena bhāvanayā brāhmabhūtena sitabhasmanā | lalāṭavakṣaḥskandheṣu svāśramocitamantrataḥ || 42 || madhyamānāmikāṅguṣṭhairanulomavilomataḥ | tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayennityaṃ trikāleṣvapi bhaktitaḥ || 43 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe saśirovrataṃ tripuṇḍadhāraṇavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <11.10> bhasmamāhātmye pāśupatavratavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca āgneyaṃ gauṇamajñānadhvaṃsakaṃ jñānasādhakam | gauṇaṃ nānāvidhaṃ viddhi brahmanbrahmavidāṃvara || 1 || agnihotrāgnijaṃ tadvadvirajānalajaṃ mune | aupāsanasamutpannaṃ samidagnisamudbhavam || 2 || pacanāgnisamutpannaṃ dāvānalasamudbhavam | traivarṇikānāṃ sarveṣāmagnihotrasamudbhavam || 3 || virajānalajaṃ caiva dhāryaṃ bhasma mahāmune | aupāsanasamutpannaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 4 || samidagnisamutpannaṃ dhāryaṃ vai brahmacāriṇā | śūdrāṇāṃ śrotriyāgārapacanāgnisamudbhavam|| 5 || anyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ dhāryaṃ dāvānalodbhavam | kālaścitrā paurṇamāsī deśaḥ svīyaḥ parigrahaḥ || 6 || kṣetrārāmādyaraṇyaṃ vā praśastaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ | tatra pūrvatrayodaśyāṃ susnātaḥ sukṛtāhnikaḥ || 7 || anujñāpya svamācāryaṃ saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca | pūjāṃ vaiśeṣikīṃ kṛtvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ svayam || 8 || śuddhayajñopavītī ca śuklamālyānulepanaḥ | darbhāsane samāsīno darbhamuṣṭiṃ pragṛhya ca || 9 || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ | dhyātvā devaṃ ca devīṃ ca tadvijñāpanavartmanā || 10 || vratametatkaromīti bhavetsaṅkalpadīkṣitaḥ | yāvaccharīrapātaṃ vā dvādaśābdamathāpi vā || 11 || tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā māsadvādaśakaṃ tu vā | tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā māsamekamathāpi vā || 12 || dinadvādaśakaṃ vāpi dinaṣaṭkamathāpi vā | tadardhaṃ dinamekaṃ vā vratasaṅkalpanāvadhi || 13 || agnimādhāya vidhivadvirajāhomakāraṇāt | hutvā''jyena samidbhiśca caruṇā ca yathāvidhi || 14 || pūtāhātpurato bhūyastattvānāṃ śuddhimuddiśan | juhuyānmūlamantreṇa taireva samidādibhiḥ || 15 || tattvānyetāni me dehe śudhyantāmityanusmaran | paścādbhūtāditanmātrāḥ pañcakarmendriyāṇi ca || 16 || jñānakarmavibhedena pañca pañca vibhāgaśaḥ | tvagādidhātavaḥ sapta pañca prāṇādivāyavaḥ || 17 || mano buddhirahaṅkāro guṇāḥ prakṛtipūruṣau | rāgo vidyā kalā caiva niyatiḥ kāla eva ca || 18 || māyā ca śuddhavidyā ca maheśvarasadāśivau | śaktiśca śivatattvaṃ ca tattvāni kramaśo viduḥ || 19 || mantraistu virajairhutvā hotāsau virajo bhavet | atha gomayamādāya piṇḍīkṛtyābhimantrya ca || 20 || nyasyāgnau taṃ ca saṃrakṣya dine tasmin haviṣyabhuk | prabhāte ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛtvā sarvaṃ puroditam || 21 || tasmindine nirāhāraḥ kālaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | prātaḥ parvaṇi cāpyevaṃ kṛtvā homāvasānataḥ || 22 || upasaṃhṛtya rudrāgniṃ gṛhītvā bhasma yatnataḥ | tataśca jaṭilo muṇḍaḥ śikhaikajaṭa eva ca || 23 || bhūtvā snātvā punarvītalajjaścetsyāddigambaraḥ | anyaḥ kāṣāyavasanaścarmacīrāmbaro'thavā || 24 || ekāmbaro valkalavānbhaveddaṇḍī ca mekhalī | prakṣālya caraṇau paścāddvirācamyātmanastanum || 25 || saṅkalīkṛtya tadbhasma virajānalasambhavam | agnirityādibhirmantraiḥ ṣaḍbhirātharvaṇaiḥ kramāt || 26 || vimṛjyāṅgāni mūrdhādicaraṇāntaṃ ca taiḥ spṛśet | tatastena krameṇaiva samuddhūlya ca bhasmanā || 27 || sarvāṅgoddhūlanaṃ kuryātpraṇavena śivena vā | tataśca puṇḍraṃ racayettriyāyuṣasamāhvayam || 28 || śivabhāvaṃ samāgamya śivabhāvamathācaret | kuryāttrisandhyamapyevametatpāśupataṃ vratam || 29 || bhuktimuktipradaṃ caiva paśutvaṃ vinivartayet | tatpaśutvaṃ parityajya kṛtvā pāśupataṃ vratam || 30 || pūjanīyo mahādevo liṅgamūrtiḥ sadāśivaḥ | bhasmasnānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvasaukhyakaraṃ param || 31 || āyuṣyaṃ balamārogyaṃ śrīpuṣṭivardhanaṃ yataḥ | rakṣārthaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ ca sarvasampatsamṛddhaye || 32 || bhasmasnigdhamanuṣyāṇāṃ mahāmārībhayaṃ na ca | śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ bhasma kāmadaṃ ca tridhā bhavet || 33 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe bhasmamāhātmye pāśupatavratavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <11.11> trividhabhasmamāhātmyavarṇanam nārada uvāca trividhatvaṃ kathaṃ cāsya bhasmanaḥ parikīrtitam | etatkathaya me deva mahatkautūhalaṃ mama || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca trividhatvaṃ pravakṣyāmi devarṣe bhasmanaḥ śṛṇu | mahāpāpakṣayakaraṃ mahākīrtikaraṃ param || 2 || gomayaṃ yonisambaddhaṃ taddhastenaiva gṛhyate | brāhmairmantraistu sandagdhaṃ tacchāntikṛdihocyate || 3 || sāvadhānastu gṛhṇīyānnaro vai gomayaṃ tu yat | antarikṣe gṛhītvā tatṣaḍaṅgena dahedataḥ || 4 || pauṣṭikaṃ tatsamākhyātaṃ kāmadaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu | prāsādena dahedetatkāmadaṃ bhasma kīrtitam || 5 || prātarutthāya devarṣe bhasmavrataparaḥ śuciḥ | gavāṃ goṣṭheṣu gatvā tu namaskṛtya tu gokulam || 6 || gavāṃ varṇānurūpāṇāṃ gṛhṇīyādgomayaṃ śubham | brāhmaṇasya ca gauḥ śvetā raktā gauḥ kṣatriyasya ca || 7 || pītavarṇā tu vaiśyasya kṛṣṇā śūdrasya kathyate | paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāmaṣṭamyāṃ vā viśuddhadhīḥ || 8 || prāsādena tu mantreṇa gṛhītvā gomayaṃ śubham | hṛdayena tu mantreṇa piṇḍīkṛtya tu gomayam || 9 || raviraśmisusantaptaṃ śucau deśe manohare | tuṣeṇa vā busairvāpi prāsādena tu nikṣipet || 10 || araṇyudbhavamagniṃ vā śrotriyāgārajaṃ tu vā | tadagnau vinyasettaṃ ca śivabījena mantrataḥ || 11 || gṛhṇīyādatha tatrāgnikuṇḍādbhasma vicakṣaṇaḥ | navapātraṃ samādāya prāsādena tu nikṣipet || 12 || ketakī pāṭalī tadvaduśīraṃ candanaṃ tathā | nānāsugandhidravyāṇi kāśmīraprabhṛtīni ca || 13 || nikṣipettatra pātre tu sadyomantreṇa śuddhadhīḥ | jalasnānaṃ purā kṛtvā bhasmasnānamataḥ param || 14 || jalasnāne tvaśaktaśca bhasmasnānaṃ samācaret | prakṣālya pādau hastau ca śiraśceśānamantrataḥ || 15 || samuddhūlya tataḥ paścādānanaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tu | aghoreṇa tu hṛdayaṃ nābhiṃ vāmena tatparam || 16 || sadyomantreṇa sarvāṅgaṃ samūddhūlya vicakṣaṇaḥ | pūrvavastraṃ parityajya śuddhavastraṃ parigrahet || 17 || prakṣālya pādau hastau ca paścādācamanaṃ caret | bhasmanoddhūlanābhāve tripuṇḍraṃ tu vidhīyate || 18 || madhyāhnātprāgjalairyuktaṃ parato jalavarjitam | tarjanyanāmikāmadhyaistripuṇḍraṃ ca samācaret || 19 || mūrdhni caiva lalāṭe ca karṇe kaṇṭhe tathaiva ca | hṛdaye caiva bāhvośca nyāsasthānaṃ hi cocyate || 20 || pañcāṅgulairnyasenmūrdhni prāsādena tu mantrataḥ | tryaṅgulairvinyasedbhāle śiromantreṇa deśikaḥ || 21 || sadyena dakṣiṇe karṇe vāmadevena vāmataḥ | aghoreṇa tu kaṇṭhe ca madhyāṅgulyā spṛśedbudhaḥ || 22 || hṛdayaṃ hṛdayenaiva tribhiraṅgulibhiḥ spṛśet | vinyaseddakṣiṇe bāhau śikhāmantreṇa deśikaḥ || 23 || vāmabāhau nyaseddhīmānkavacena triyaṅgulaiḥ | madhyena saṃspṛśennābhyāmīśāna iti mantrataḥ || 24 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāstisro rekhā iti smṛtāḥ | ādyo brahmā tato viṣṇustadūrdhvaṃ tu maheśvaraḥ || 25 || ekāṅgulena nyastaṃ yadīśvarastatra devatā | śiromadhye tvayaṃ brahmā īśvarastu lalāṭake || 26 || karṇayoraśvinau devau gaṇeśastu gale tathā | kṣatriyaśca tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraścoddhūlanaṃ tyajet || 27 || sarveṣāmantyajātīnāṃ mantreṇa rahitaṃ bhavet | (adīkṣitaṃ manuṣyāṇāmapi mantraṃ vinā bhavet) || 28 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe trividhabhasmamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmakādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <11.12> bhasmadhāraṇamāhāmyavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca devarṣe śṛṇu tatsarvaṃ bhasmoddhūlanajaṃ phalam | sarahasyavidhānaṃ ca sarvakāmaphalapradam || 1 || kapilāyāḥ śakṛtsvacchaṃ gṛhītvā gagane'patat | na klinnaṃ nāpi kaṭhinaṃ na durgandhaṃ na coṣitam || 2 || uparyadhaḥ parityajya gahṇīyātpatitaṃ yadi | piṇḍīkṛtya śivāgnyādau tatkṣipenmūlamantritam || 3 || ādāya vāsasā''cchādya bhasmādhāne vinikṣipet | sukṛte sudṛḍhe śuddhe kṣālite prokṣite śubhe || 4 || vinyasya mantrī mantreṇa pātre bhasma vinikṣipet | taijasaṃ dāravaṃ cātha mṛṇmayaṃ cailameva ca || 5 || anyadvā śobhanaṃ śuddhaṃ bhasmādhāraṃ prakalpayet | kṣaume caivātiśuddhe vā dhanavadbhasma nikṣipet || 6 || prasthito bhasma gṛhṇīyātsvayaṃ cānucaro'pi vā | na cāyuktakare dadyānna cāśucitale kṣipet || 7 || na saṃspṛśettu nīcāṅgairna kṣipenna ca laṅghayet | tasmādbhasitamādāya viniyuñjīta mantritam || 8 || vibhūtidhāraṇavidhiḥ smṛtiprokto mayeritaḥ | yadīyācaraṇenaiva śivatulyo na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || śaivaiḥ sampāditaṃ bhasma vaidikaiḥ śivasannidhau | bhaktyā paramayā grāhyaṃ prārthayitvā tu pūjayet || 10 || tantroktavartmanā siddhaṃ bhasma tāntrikapūjakaiḥ | yatrakutrāpi dattaṃ cettadgrāhyaṃ naiva vaidikaiḥ || 11 || śūdraiḥ kāpālikairvātha pākhaṇḍairaparaistu tat | tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayedbhaktyā manasāpi na laṅghayet || 12 || śrutyā vidhīyate yasmāttattyāgī patito bhavet | tripuṇḍradhāraṇaṃ bhaktyā tathā dehāvaguṇṭhanam || 13 || dvijaḥ kuryāddhi mantreṇa tattyāgī patito bhavet | uddhūlanaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca bhaktyā naivācaranti ye || 14 || teṣāṃ nāsti vinirmokṣaḥ saṃsārājjanmakoṭibhiḥ | yena bhasmoktamārgeṇa dhṛtaṃ na munipuṅgava || 15 || tasya viddhi mune janma niṣkalaṃ saukaraṃ yathā | yeṣāṃ vapurmanuṣyāṇāṃ tripuṇḍreṇa vinā sthitam || 16 || śmaśānasadṛśaṃ tatsyānna prekṣyaṃ puṇyakṛjjanaiḥ | dhigbhasmarahitaṃ bhālaṃ dhiggrāmamaśivālayam || 17 || dhiganīśārcanaṃ janma dhigvidyāmaśivāśrayām | tripuṇḍraṃ ye vinindanti nindanti śivameva te || 18 || dhārayanti ca ye bhaktyā dhārayanti tameva te | yathā kṛśānurahito bhūdharo na virājate || 19 || aśeṣasādhane'pyevaṃ bhasmahīnaṃ śivārcanam | uddhūlanaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca śraddhayā nācaranti ye || 20 || taiḥ pūrvācaritaṃ sarvaṃ viparītaṃ bhavedapi | bhasmanā vedamantreṇa tripuṇḍrasya ca dhāraṇam || 21 || vinā vedocitācāraṃ smārtasyānarthakāraṇam | kṛtaṃ syādakṛtaṃ tena śrutamapyaśrutaṃ bhavet || 22 || adhītamanadhītaṃ ca tripuṇḍraṃ yo na dhārayet | vṛthā vedā vṛthā yajñā vṛthā dānaṃ vṛthā tapaḥ || 23 || vṛthā vratopavāsena tripuṇḍraṃ yo na dhārayet | bhasmadhāraṇakaṃ tyaktvā muktimicchati yaḥ pumān || 24 || viṣapānena nityatvaṃ kurute hyātmano hi saḥ | sraṣṭā sṛṣṭicchalenāha tripuṇḍrasya ca dhāraṇam || 25 || sasarja sa lalāṭaṃ hi tiryagūrdhvaṃ na vartulam | tiryagrekhāḥ pradṛśyante lalāṭe sarvadehinām || 26 || tathāpi mānavā mūrkhā na kurvanti tripuṇḍrakam | na taddhyānaṃ na tanmokṣaṃ na tajjñānaṃ na tattapaḥ || 27 || vinā tiryaktripuṇḍraṃ ca vipreṇa yadanuṣṭhitam | vedasyādhyayane śūdro nādhikārī yathā bhavet || 28 || tripuṇḍreṇa vinā vipro nādhikārī śivārcane | prāṅmukhaścaraṇau hastau prakṣālyācamya pūrvavat || 29 || prāṇānāyamya saṅkalpya bhasmasnānaṃ samācaret | ādāya bhasitaṃ śuddhamagnihotrasamudbhavam || 30 || īśānena tu mantreṇa svamūrdhani vinikṣipet | tata ādāya tadbhasma mukhe ca puruṣeṇa tu || 31 || aghorākhyeṇa hṛdaye guhye vāmāhvayena ca | sadyojātābhidhānena bhasma pādadvaye kṣipet || 32 || sarvāṅgaṃ praṇavenaiva mantreṇoddhūlanaṃ tataḥ | etadāgneyakaṃ snānamuditaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ || 33 || sarvakarmasamṛddhyarthaṃ kuryādādāvidaṃ budhaḥ | tataḥ prakṣālya hastādīnupaspṛśya yathāvidhi || 34 || tiryaktripuṇḍraṃ vidhinā lalāṭe hṛdaye gale | pañcabhirbrahmabhirvāpi kṛtena bhasitena ca || 35 || ghṛtametattripuṇḍraṃ syātsarvakarmasu pāvanam | śūdrairantyajahastasthaṃ na dhāryaṃ bhasma ca kvacit || 36 || bhasmanā sāgnihotreṇa liptaḥ karma samācaret | anyathā sarvakarmāṇi na phalanti kadācana || 37 || satyaṃ śaucaṃ japo homastīrthaṃ devādipūjanam | tasya vyarthamidaṃ sarvaṃ yastripuṇḍraṃ na dhārayet || 38 || tripuṇḍradhṛgvipravaro yo rudrākṣadharaḥ śuciḥ | sa hanti rogaduritavyādhidurbhikṣataskarān || 39 || samāpnoti paraṃ brahma yato nāvartate punaḥ | sa paṅktipāvanaḥ śrāddhe pūjyo vipraiḥ surairapi || 40 || śrāddhe yajñe jape home vaiśvadeve surārcane | dhṛtatripuṇḍraḥ pūtātmā mṛtyuṃ jayati mānavaḥ | bhasmadhāraṇamāhātmyaṃ bhūyo'pi kathayāmi te || 41 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe bhasmadhāraṇamāhāmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <11.13> tripuṇḍadhāraṇamāhātmyavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca mahāpātakasaṅghāśca pātakānyaparāṇyapi | naśyanti muniśārdūla satyaṃ satyaṃ na cānyathā || 1 || ekaṃ bhasma dhṛtaṃ yena tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | yatīnāṃ jñānadaṃ proktaṃ vānasthānāṃ viraktidam || 2 || gṛhasthānāṃ mune tadvaddharmavṛddhikaraṃ tathā | brahmacaryāśramasthānāṃ svādhyāyapradameva ca || 3 || śūdrāṇāṃ puṇyadaṃ nityamanyeṣāṃ pāpanāśanam | bhasmanoddhūlanaṃ caiva tathā tiryak tripuṇḍrakam || 4 || rakṣārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vidhatte vaidikī śrutiḥ | bhasmanoddhūlanaṃ caiva tathā tiryak tripuṇḍrakam || 5 || yajñatvenaiva sarveṣāṃ vidhatte vaidikī śrutiḥ | bhasmanoddhūlanaṃ caiva tathā tiryak tripuṇḍrakam || 6 || sarvadharmatayā teṣāṃ vidhatte vaidikī śrutiḥ | bhasmanoddhūlanaṃ caiva tathā tiryak tripuṇḍrakam || 7 || māheśvarāṇāṃ liṅgārthaṃ vidhatte vaidikī śrutiḥ | bhasmanoddhūlanaṃ caiva tathā tiryak tripuṇḍrakam || 8 || vijñānārthaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vidhatte vaidikī śrutiḥ | śivena viṣṇunā caiva brahmaṇā vajriṇā tathā || 9 || hiraṇyagarbheṇa tadavatārairvaruṇādibhiḥ | devatābhirdhṛtaṃ bhasma tripuṇḍroddhūlanātmakam || 10 || umādevyā ca lakṣyā ca vācā cānyābhirāstikaiḥ | sarvastrībhirdhṛtaṃ bhasma tripuṇḍroddhūlanātmanā || 11 || yakṣarākṣasagandharvasiddhavidyādharādibhiḥ | munibhiśca dhṛtaṃ bhasma tripuṇḍroddhūlanātmanā || 12 || brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdrerapi ca saṅkaraiḥ | apabhraṃśairdhṛtaṃ bhasma tripuṇḍroddhūlanātmanā || 13 || uddhūlanaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca yaiḥ samācaritaṃ mudā | ta eva śiṣṭā vidvāṃso netare munipuṅgava || 14 || śivaliṅgaṃ maṇiḥ sakhyaṃ mantraḥ pañcākṣarastathā | vibhūtirauṣadhaṃ puṃsāṃ muktistrīvaśyakarmaṇi || 15 || bhunakti yatra bhasmāṅgo mūrkho vā paṇḍito'pi vā | tatra bhuṅkte mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 16 || bhasmasañchannasarvāṅgamanugacchati yaḥ pumān | sarvapātakayukto'pi pūjito mānavo'cirāt || 17 || bhasmasañchannasarvāṅgaṃ yaḥ stauti śraddhayā saha | sarvapātakayukto'pi pūjyate mānavo'cirāt || 18 || tripuṇḍradhāriṇe bhikṣāpradānena hi kevalam | tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam || 19 || yena vipreṇa śirasi tripuṇḍraṃ bhasmanā kṛtam | kīkaṭeṣvapi deśeṣu yatra bhūtivibhūṣaṇaḥ || 20 || mānavastu vasennityaṃ kāśīkṣetrasamaṃ hi tat | duḥśīlaḥ śīlayukto vā yogayukto'pyalakṣaṇaḥ || 21 || bhūtiśāsanayukto vā sa pūjyo mama putravat | chadmanāpi caredyo hi bhūtiśāsanamaiśvaram || 22 || so'pi yāṃ gatimāpnoti na tāṃ yajñaśatairapi | samparkāllīlayā vāpi bhayādvā dhārayettu yaḥ || 23 || vidhiyukto vibhūtiṃ tu sa ca pūjyo yathā hyaham | śivasya viṣṇordevānāṃ brahmaṇastṛptikāraṇam || 24 || pārvatyāśca mahālakṣyā bhāratyāstṛptikāraṇam | na dānena na yajñena na tapobhiḥ sudurlabhaiḥ || 25 || na tīrthayātrayā puṇyaṃ tripuṇḍreṇa ca labhyate | dānaṃ yajñāśca dharmāśca tīrthayātrāśca nārada || 26 || dhyānaṃ tapastripuṇḍrasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm | yathā rājā svacihnāṅkaṃ svajanaṃ manyate sadā || 27 || tathā śivastripuṇḍrāṅkaṃ svakīyamiva manyate | dvijātirvānyajātirvā śuddhacittena bhasmanā || 28 || dhārayedyastripuṇḍrāṅkaṃ rudrastena vaśīkṛtaḥ | tyaktasarvāśramācāro luptasarvakriyo'pi saḥ || 29 || sakṛttiryaktripuṇḍrāṅkaṃ dhārayetso'pi mucyate | nāsya jñānaṃ parīkṣeta na kulaṃ na vrataṃ tathā || 30 || tripuṇḍrāṅkitabhālena pūjya eva hi nārada | śivamantrātparo mantro nāsti tulyaṃ śivātparam || 31 || śivārcanātparaṃ puṇyaṃ na hi tīrthaṃ ca bhasmanā | rudrāgneryatparaṃ tīrthaṃ tadbhasma parikīrtitam || 32 || dhvaṃsanaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanam | antyajo vādhamo vāpi mūrkho vā paṇḍito'pi vā || 33 || yasmindeśe vasennityaṃ bhūtiśāsanasaṃyutaḥ | tasminsadāśivaḥ somaḥ sarvabhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ | sarvatīrtheśca saṃyuktaḥ sānnidhyaṃ kurute sadā || 34 || etāni pañcaśivamantrapavitritāni bhasmāni kāmadahanāṅgavibhūṣitāni | traipuṇḍrakāṇi racitāni lalāṭapaṭṭe lumpanti daivalikhitāni durakṣarāṇi || 35 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe tripuṇḍadhāraṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <11.14> vibhūtidhāraṇamāhātmyavarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca bhasmadigdhaśarīrāya yo dadāti dhanaṃ mudā | tasya sarvāṇi pāpāni vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 1 || śrutayaḥ smṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ purāṇānyakhilānyapi | vadanti bhūtimāhāmyaṃ tattasmāddhārayeddvijaḥ || 2 || sitena bhasmanā kuryāttrisandhyaṃ yastripuṇḍrakam | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 3 || yogī sarvāṅgakaṃ stānamāpādatalamastakam | trisandhyamācarennityamāśu yogamavāpnuyāt || 4 || bhasmasnānena puruṣaḥ kulasyoddhārako bhavet | bhasmasnānaṃ jalasnānādasaṃkhyeyaguṇānvitam || 5 || sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam | tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ bhasmasnānānna saṃśayaḥ || 6 || mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vāpyupapātakaiḥ | bhasmasnānena tatsarvaṃ dahatyagnirivendhanam || 7 || bhasmasnānātparaṃ snānaṃ pavitraṃ naiva vidyate | evamuktaṃ śivenādau tadā snātaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ || 8 || tadāprabhṛti brahmādyā munayaśca śivārthinaḥ | sarvakarmasu yatnena bhasmasnānaṃ pracakrire || 9 || tasmādetacchiraḥsnānamāgneyaṃ yaḥ samācaret | anenaiva śarīreṇa sa hi rudro na saṃśayaḥ || 10 || ye bhasmadhāriṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā paritṛptā bhavanti te | devāsuramunīndraiśca pūjyā nityaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || bhasmasañchannasarvāṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvottiṣṭhati yaḥ pumān | taṃ dṛṣṭvā devarājo'pi daṇḍavatpraṇamiṣyati || 12 || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ bhasmadhāraṇapūrvakam | teṣāṃ tadbhakṣyameva syānmune nātra vicāraṇā || 13 || yaḥ snāti bhasmanā nityaṃ jale snātvā tataḥ param | brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho''thavādarāt || 14 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim | āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ yatīnāṃ ca viśiṣyate || 15 || ārdrasnānādvaraṃ bhasmasnānamārdravadho dhruvaḥ | ārdraṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyātprakṛtiṃ bandhanaṃ viduḥ || 16 || prakṛtestu prahāṇāya bhasmanā snānamiṣyate | bhasmanā sadṛśaṃ brahyannāsti lokatrayeṣvapi || 17 || rakṣārthaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ ca pavitrārthaṃ purā suraiḥ | bhasma dṛṣṭvā mune pūrvaṃ dattaṃ devyai priyeṇa tu || 18 || tasmādetacchiraḥsnānamāgneyaṃ yaḥ samācaret | bhavapāśairvinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 19 || jvararakṣaḥpiśācāśca pūtanākuṣṭhagulmakāḥ | bhagandarāṇi sarvāṇi cāśītirvātarogakāḥ || 20 || catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ pittarogāḥ śleṣmā saptatripañcakāḥ | vyāghracaurabhayaṃ caivāpyanye duṣṭagrahā api || 21 || bhasmasnānena naśyanti siṃhenaiva yathā gajāḥ | śuddhaśītajalenaiva bhasmanā ca tripuṇḍrakam || 22 || yo dhārayetparaṃ brahma sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ | (bhasmanā ca tripuṇḍraṃ ca yaḥ ko'pi dhārayetparam | sa brahmalokamāpnoti muktapāpo na saṃśayaḥ ||) yathāvidhi lalāṭe vai vahnivīryapradhāraṇāt || 23 || nāśayellikhitāṃ yāmīṃ lalāṭasthāṃ lipiṃ dhruvam | kaṇṭhoparikṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayettatpradhāraṇāt || 24 || kaṇṭhe ca dhāraṇātkaṇṭhabhogādikṛtapātakam | bāhvorbāhukṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vakṣasā manasā kṛtam || 25 || nābhyāṃ śiśnakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gude gudakṛtaṃ haret | pārśvayordhāraṇādbrahman parastryāliṅganādikam || 26 || tadbhasmadhāraṇaṃ śastaṃ sarvatraiva triliṅgakam | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ trayyagnīnāṃ ca dhāraṇam || 27 || guṇalokatrayāṇāṃ ca dhāraṇaṃ tena vai kṛtam | bhasmacchanno dvijo vidvānmahāpātakasambhavaiḥ || 28 || doṣairviyujyate sadyo mucyate ca na saṃśayaḥ | bhasmaniṣṭhasya dahyante doṣā bhasmāgnisaṅgamāt || 29 || bhasmasnānaviśuddhātmā ātmaniṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ | bhasmanā digdhasarvāṅgo bhasmadīptatripuṇḍrakaḥ || 30 || bhasmaśāyī ca puruṣo bhasmaniṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ | bhūtapretapiśācādyā rogāścātīva duḥsahāḥ || 31 || bhasmaniṣṭhasya sānnidhyādvidravanti na saṃśayaḥ | bhāsanādbhasitaṃ proktaṃ bhasma kalmaṣabhakṣaṇāt || 32 || bhūtirbhūtikarī puṃsāṃ rakṣā rakṣākarī purā | tripuṇḍradhāriṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūtapretapuraḥsarāḥ || 33 || bhītāḥ prakampitāḥ śīghraṃ naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ | smaraṇādeva rudrasya yathā pāpaṃ praṇaśyati || 34 || apyakāryasahasrāṇi kṛtvā yaḥ snāti bhasmanā | tatsarvaṃ dahate bhasma yathāgnistejasā vanam || 35 || kṛtvāpi cātulaṃ pāpaṃ mṛtyukāle'pi yo dvijaḥ | bhasmasnāyī bhavetkaścitkṣipraṃ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 36 || bhasmasnānāddhi śuddhātmā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ | matsamīpaṃ samāgamya na sa bhūyo'bhivartate || 37 || vanaspatigate some bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ | arcitaṃ śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 38 || āyuṣkāmo'thavā vidvānbhūtikāmo'thavā naraḥ | nityaṃ vai dhārayedbhasma mokṣakāmī ca vai dvijaḥ || 39 || tripuṇḍraṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam | ye ghorā rākṣasāḥ pretā ye cānye kṣudrajantavaḥ || 40 || tripuṇḍradhāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante na saṃśayaḥ | kṛtvā śaucādikaṃ karma snātvā tu vimale jale || 41 || bhasmanoddhūlanaṃ kāryamāpādatalamastakam | kevalaṃ vāruṇaṃ snānaṃ dehe bāhyamalāpaham || 42 || vibhūtistānamanaghaṃ bāhyāntaramalāpaham | tyaktvāpi vāruṇaṃ snānaṃ tatparaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ || 43 || kṛtamapyakṛtaṃ satyaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ vinā mune | bhasmasnānaṃ śrutiproktamāgneyaṃ snānamucyate || 44 || antarbahiśca saṃśuddhaṃ śivapūjāphalaṃ labhet | yadbāhyamalamātrasya nāśakaṃ stānamasti tat || 45 || tannāśayati tīvreṇa prāṇibāhyāntaraṃ malam | kṛtvāpi koṭiśo nityaṃ vāruṇaṃ snānamādarāt || 46 || na bhavatyeva pūtātmā bhasmasnānaṃ vinā mune | yadbhasmasnānamāhāmyaṃ tadvedo veda tattvataḥ || 47 || yadvā veda mahādevaḥ sarvadevaśikhāmaṇiḥ | bhasmasnānamakṛtvaiva yaḥ kuryātkarma vaidikam || 48 || sa tatkarmakalārdhārdhamapi nāpnoti vastutaḥ | yaḥ kariṣyati yatnena bhasmasnānaṃ yathāvidhi || 49 || sa evaikaḥ sarvakarmasvadhikārī śrutiśrutaḥ | pāvanaṃ pāvanānāṃ ca bhasmasnānaṃ śrutiśrutam || 50 || na kariṣyati yo mohātsa mahāpātakī bhavet | anantairvāruṇaiḥ snānairyatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate dvijaiḥ || 51 || tato'nantaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bhasmasnānādavāpyate | kālatraye'pi kartavyaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ prayatnataḥ || 52 || bhasmasnānaṃ smṛtaṃ śrautaṃ tattyāgī patito bhavet | mūtrādyutsarjanānte tu bhasmasnānaṃ prayatnataḥ || 53 || kartavyamanyathā pūtā na bhaviṣyanti mānavāḥ | vidhivatkṛtaśauco'pi bhasmasnānaṃ vinā dvijaḥ || 54 || na bhaviṣyati pūtātmā nādhikāryapi karmaṇi | apānavāyuniryāte jṛmbhaṇe skandane kṣute || 55 || śleṣmodgāre'pi kartavyaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ prayatnataḥ | śrībhasmasnānamāhātmyasyaikadeśo'tra varṇitaḥ || 56 || punaśca sampravakṣyāmi bhasmasnānotthitaṃ phalam | sāvadhānena manasā śrotavyaṃ munipuṅgava || 57 || iti śrīmaddevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe'ṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ekādaśaskandhe vibhūtidhāraṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <11.15> tripuṇḍrordhvapuṇḍradhāraṇavidhivarṇanam tripuṇḍrordhvapuṇḍradhāraṇavidhivarṇanam śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca agnirityādibhirmantrairbhasma saṃśodhya sādaram | dhāraṇīyaṃ lalāṭādau tripuṇḍraṃ kevalaṃ dvijaiḥ || 1 || brahmakṣatriyavaiśyāśca ete sarve dvijāḥ smṛtāḥ | tasmāddvijaiḥ prayatnena tripuṇḍraṃ dhāryamanvaham || 2 || yasyopanayanaṃ brahman sa eva dvija ucyate | tasmācchrautaṃ dvijaiḥ kāryaṃ tripuṇḍrasya ca dhāraṇam || 3 || vibhūtidhāraṇaṃ tyaktvā yaḥ satkarma samācaret | tatkṛtaṃ cākṛtaprāyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 4 || na gāyatryupadeśo'pi bhasmano dhāraṇaṃ vinā | tato dhṛtvaiva bhasmāṅge gāyatrījapamācaret || 5 || gāyatrīṃ mūlamevāhurbrāhmaṇye munipuṅgava | sā bhasmadhāraṇābhāve na kenāpyupadiśyate || 6 || na tāvadadhikāro'sti gāyatrīgrahaṇe mune | yāvanna bhasma bhālādau dhṛtamagnisamudbhavam || 7 || bhasmahīnalalāṭatvaṃ na brahmaṇyānumāpakam | evameva mayā brahman heturuktaḥ supuṇyadaḥ || 8 || mantrapūtaṃ sitaṃ bhasma lalāṭe parivartate | sa eva brāhmaṇo vidvānsatyaṃ satyaṃ mayocyate || 9 || yasyāsti sahajā prītirmaṇivadbhasmasaṃgrahe | sa eva brāhmaṇo brahman satyaṃ satyaṃ mayocyate || 10 || na yasya sahajā prītirmaṇivadbhasmasaṃgrahe | sa cāṇḍāla iti jñeyo janmajanmāntare dhruvam || 11 || na yasya sahajā prītistripuṇḍroddhūlanādiṣu | sa cāṇḍāla iti jñeyaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ mayocyate || 12 || ye bhasmadhāraṇaṃ tyaktvā bhuñjante ca phalādikam | te sarve narakaṃ ghoraṃ prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ || 13 || (vibhūtidhāraṇaṃ tyaktvā yaḥ śivaṃ pūjayiṣyati | sa durbhagaḥ śivadveṣṭā sa dveṣo narakapradaḥ | sarvakarmabahirbhūto bhasmadhāraṇavarjitaḥ ||) vibhūtidhāraṇaṃ tyaktvā kurvan hematulāmapi | na tatphalamavāpnoti patito hi bhaveddhi saḥ || 14 || yathopavītarahitaiḥ sandhyā na kriyate dvijaiḥ | tathā sandhyā na kartavyā vibhūtirahitairapi || 15 || gatopavītaiḥ sandhyāyāṃ kāryaḥ pratinidhiḥ kvacit | japādikaṃ tu sāvitryāstathaivopoṣaṇādikam || 16 || vibhūtidhāraṇe tvanyo nāsti pratinidhiḥ kvacit | vibhūtidhāraṇaṃ tyaktvā yadi sandhyāṃ karoti yaḥ || 17 || pratyavaityeva yenāsau nādhikārī tadā dvijaḥ | yathā śrutvāntyajo vedānpratyavaiti tathā dvijaḥ || 18 || pratyavaiti na sandehaḥ sandhyākṛdbhasmavarjitaḥ | sampādanīya yatnena śrautaṃ bhasma sadā dvijaiḥ || 19 || smārtaṃ vā tadabhāve tu laukikaṃ vā samāhitaiḥ | yādṛśaṃ tādṛśaṃ vāstu pavitraṃ bhasma santatam || 20 || dhāraṇīyaṃ prayatnena dvijaiḥ sandhyādikarmasu | na saṃviśanti pāpāni bhasmaniṣṭhe tataḥ sadā || 21 || kartavyamapi yatnena brāhmaṇairbhasmadhāraṇam | madhyāṅgulitrayeṇaiva svadakṣiṇakarasya tu || 22 || ṣaḍaṅgulāyataṃ mānamapi cādhikamānakam | netrayugmapramāṇena bhāle dīptaṃ tripuṇḍrakam || 23 || kadācidbhasmanā kuryātsa rudro nātra saṃśayaḥ | akāro'nāmikā prokta ukāro madhyamāṅguliḥ || 24 || makārastarjanī tasmāt tripuṇḍraṃ triguṇātmakam | tripuṇḍraṃ madhyamātarjanyanāmābhiranulomataḥ || 25 || atra te kathayāmyenamitihāsaṃ purātanam | kadācidatha durvāsāḥ pitṛlokaṃ gato'bhavat || 26 || bhasmasandigdhasarvāṅgo rudrākṣābharaṇānvitaḥ | śiva śaṅkara sarvātmañchrīmātarjagadambike || 27 || nāmānīti gṛṇannuccaistāpasānāṃ śikhāmaṇiḥ | kavyavāḍādayaste tu pratyutthānābhivādanaiḥ || 28 || āsanādyupacāraiśca sammānaṃ bahu cakrire | nānākathābhiranyonyaṃ sambhāṣāñcakrire tadā || 29 || tasmiṃstu samaye kumbhīpākasthānāṃ tu pāpinām | ghoraḥ samabhavacchabdo hā hatāḥ smetivādinām || 30 || mṛtāḥ smeti vadantyeke dagdhāḥ smeti pare jaguḥ | chinnāḥ smeti vibhinnāḥ smetyevaṃ rodanakāriṇaḥ || 31 || śrutvā taṃ karuṇa śabdaṃ duḥkhito munirāḍ hṛdi | papraccha pitṛnāthāṃstānkeṣāṃ śabdo'yamityapi || 32 || te samūcurmune'traiva purī saṃyamanī parā | vartate yamarāḍatra pāpināṃ bhogadāyakaḥ || 33 || nānādūtaiḥ kālarūpaiḥ kṛṣṇavarṇerbhayaṅkaraiḥ | sahito'traiva tatpuryāṃ nāyako vidyate'nagha || 34 || tatra kuṇḍānyanekāni pāpināṃ bhogadāni ca | ṣaḍaśītirghorarūpairdūtaiḥ parivṛtāni ca || 35 || tatra mukhyatamaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kumbhīpākābhidhaṃ mahat | vartate tadgatānāṃ ca yātanānāṃ tu varṇanam || 36 || kartuṃ na śakyate kaiścidapi varṣaśatairapi | ye śivadrohiṇaḥ santi tathā devīvinindakāḥ || 37 || ye viṣṇudrohiṇaḥ santi patantyatraiva te mune | ye vedanindakāḥ santi sūryasya ca gaṇeśituḥ || 38 || brāhmaṇānāṃ drohiṇo ye patantyatraiva te mune | kāmācārāśca ye santi taptamudrāṅkitāśca ye || 39 || triśūladhāriṇo ye ca patantyatraiva te mune | mātṛpitṛgurujyeṣṭhapurāṇasmṛtinindakāḥ || 40 || ye dharmadūṣakāḥ santi patantyatraiva te mune | teṣāmayaṃ mahāghoraḥ śabdaḥ śravaṇadāruṇaḥ || 41 || śrūyate'smābhiraniśaṃ vairāgyaṃ yacchruterbhavet | iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā munirāṭ taddidṛkṣayā || 42 || utthāya calitastūrṇaṃ yayau kuṇḍasamīpataḥ | avāṅmukho dadarśādhastasminneva kṣaṇe mune || 43 || tatratyānāṃ pāpināṃ tu svargādhikamabhūtsukham | hasanti kecidgāyanti nṛtyanti ca tathāpare || 44 || parasparaṃ ramante te'tyunmattāḥ sukhavardhanāt | mṛdaṅgamurajāvīṇāḍhakkādundubhinisvanāḥ || 45 || samudbhūtāstu madhurāḥ pañcamasvarabhūṣitāḥ | vasantavallīpuṣpāṇāṃ sugandhamaruto vavuḥ || 46 || munistu cakito dṛṣṭvā yamadūtāśca vismitāḥ | śīghraṃ te kathayāmāsurdharmarājāya vedine || 47 || mahārāja mahāścaryamadhunaivābhavadvibho | svargādapyadhikaṃ saukhyaṃ kumbhīpākasthapāpinām || 48 || nimittaṃ naiva jānīmaḥ kasmādidamabhūdvibho | cakitāḥ sma vayaṃ sarve prāptā deva tvadantikam || 49 || niśamya dūtavāṇīṃ tāṃ dharmarāṭ śīghramutthitaḥ | mahāmahiṣamārūḍho yayau te yatra pāpinaḥ || 50 || tāṃ vārtāṃ preṣayāmāsa dūtadvārāmarāvatīm | śrutvā tāṃ devarājo'pi prāpto devagaṇaiḥ saha || 51 || brahmalokātpadmajo'pi vaikuṇṭhādviṣṭaraśravāḥ | tattallokācca dikpālāḥ samājagmurgaṇaiḥ saha || 52 || parivārya sthitāḥ sarve kumbhīpākamitastataḥ | apaśyaṃstadgatāñjīvānsvargādhikasukhāntvitān || 53 || cakitā eva te sarve na vidustasya kāraṇam | aho pāpasya bhogārthaṃ kuṇḍametadvinirmitam || 54 || tatra saukhyaṃ yadā jātaṃ tadā pāpāttu kiṃ bhayam | ucchinnā vedamaryādā parameśakṛtā katham || 55 || bhagavān svasya saṃkalpaṃ vitathaṃ kṛtavānkatham | āścaryametadāścaryametadityeva bhāṣiṇaḥ || 56 || taṭasthā abhavansarve na vidustatra kāraṇam | etasminnantare śauriḥ sammantrya vibudhādibhiḥ || 57 || yayau kaiścitsuragaṇaiḥ sahitaḥ śaṅkarālayam | pārvatyā sahitaṃ devaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram || 58 || ramaṇīyatamāṅgaṃ taṃ lāvaṇyakhanimadbhutam | sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyaṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitam || 59 || nānāgaṇaiḥ parivṛtaṃ lālayantaṃ parāṃ śivām | dadarśa candramauliṃ sa caturvedaṃ nanāma ha || 60 || vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa camatkṛtamatisphuṭam | etasya kāraṇaṃ deva na jānīmaḥ kathañcana || 61 || vada tatkāraṇaṃ deva sarvajño'si yataḥ prabho | viṣṇuvākyaṃ tadā śrutvā prasannamukhapaṅkajaḥ || 62 || uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ meghagambhīrayā girā | śṛṇu viṣṇo tannimittaṃ nāścaryaṃ tvatra vidyate || 63 || bhasmano mahimaivāyaṃ bhasmanā kiṃ bhavenna hi | kumbhīpākaṃ gato draṣṭuṃ durvāsāḥ śaivasammataḥ || 64 || avāṅmukho dadarśādhastadā vāyuvaśāddhare | bhālabhasmakaṇāstatra patitā daivayogataḥ || 65 || tena jātamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhasmano mahimā tvayam | itaḥ paraṃ tu tattīrthaṃ pitṛlokanivāsinām || 66 || bhaviṣyati na sandeho yatra snātvā sukhī bhavet | pitṛtīrthaṃ tu tannāmnāpyata ūrdhvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 67 || malliṅgasthāpanaṃ tatra kāryaṃ devyāśca sattama | pūjayiṣyanti te tatra pitṛlokanivāsinaḥ || 68 || trailokye yāni tīrthāni tatra śreṣṭhamidaṃ bhavet | pitrīśvarīpūjayā tu trailokyaṃ pūjitaṃ bhavet || 69 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca iti devavacaḥ śrutvā devaṃ mūrdhnā praṇamya ca | tadanujñāṃ samādāya yayau devāntikaṃ hariḥ || 70 || tatsarvaṃ kathayāmāsa kāraṇaṃ śaṅkaroditam | sādhu sādhviti te procuramarā maulicālanaiḥ || 71 || śaśaṃsurbhasmamāhātmyaṃ haribrahmādayaḥ surāḥ | pitaraścaiva santuṣṭāstīrthalābhātparantapa || 72 || tattīrthatīre liṅgaṃ ca devyā mūrtiṃ yathāvidhi | sthāpayāmāsuramarāḥ pūjayāmāsuranvaham || 73 || tatra ye prāṇino'bhūvanpāpabhogārthamāsthitāḥ | te vimānaṃ samāruhya gatāḥ kailāsamaṇḍalam || 74 || nāmnā bhadragaṇāste tu vasantyadyāpi tatra hi | punaśca dūradeśe tu kumbhīpāko vinirmitaḥ || 75 || niruddhaṃ śaivagamanaṃ devaistatra tu taddināt | iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ bhasmamāhātmyamuttamam || 76 || nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcidadhikaṃ vidyate mune | ūrdhvapuṇḍravidhiṃ caivāpyadhikārivibhedataḥ || 77 || pravakṣye muniśārdūla vaiṣṇavāgamalokanāt | ūrdhvapuṇḍrapramāṇāni divyānyaṅgulibhedataḥ || 78 || varṇābhimantradevāṃśca pravakṣyāmi phalāni ca | parvatāgre nadītīre śivakṣetre viśeṣataḥ || 79 || sindhutīre ca valmīke tulasīmūlamāśrite | mṛda etāstu saṅgrāhyā varjayedanyamṛttikāḥ || 80 || śyāmaṃ śāntikaraṃ proktaṃ raktaṃ vaśyakaraṃ bhavet | śrīkaraṃ pītamityāhurdharmadaṃ śvetamucyate || 81 || aṅguṣṭhaḥ puṣṭidaḥ prokto madhyamāyuṣkarī bhavet | anāmikānnadā nityaṃ muktidā ca pradeśinī || 82 || etairaṅgulibhedaistu kārayenna nakhaiḥ spṛśet | vartidīpāvalikṛtiṃ veṇapatrākṛtiṃ tathā || 83 || padmasya mukulākāraṃ tathā kuryātprayatnataḥ | matsyakūrmākṛtiṃ vāpi śaṅkhākāraṃ tataḥ param || 84 || daśāṅgulipramāṇaṃ tu uttamottamamucyate | navāṅgulaṃ madhyamaṃ syādaṣṭāṅgulamataḥ param || 85 || saptaṣaṭpañcabhiḥ puṇḍraṃ madhyamaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam | catustridvyaṅgulaiḥ puṇḍraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ trividhaṃ bhavet || 86 || lalāṭe keśavaṃ vidyānnārāyaṇamathodare | mādhavaṃ hṛdi vinyasya govindaṃ kaṇṭhakūpake || 87 || udare dakṣiṇe pārśve viṣṇurityabhidhīyate | tatpārśvabāhumadhye ca madhusūdanameva ca || 88 || trivikramaṃ karṇadeśe vāmakukṣau tu vāmanam | śrīdharaṃ bāhuke vāme hṛṣīkeśaṃ tu karṇake || 89 || pṛṣṭhe ca padmanābhaṃ tu kakuddāmodaraṃ smaret | dvādaśaitāni nāmāni vāsudeveti mūrdhani || 90 || pūjākāle ca home ca sāyaṃ prātaḥ samāhitaḥ | nāmānyuccārya vidhinā dhārayedūrdhvapuṇḍrakam || 91 || aśucirvāpyanācāro manasā pāpamācaret | śucireva bhavennityaṃ mūrdhni puṇḍrāṅkito naraḥ || 92 || ūrdhvapuṇḍradharo martyo mriyate yatra kutracit | śvapāko'pi vimānastho mama loke mahīyate || 93 || ekāntino mahābhāgā matsvarūpavido'malāḥ | sāntarālānprakurvanti puṇḍrānviṣṇupadākṛtīn || 94 ||
